Závod nabízí různé kategorie pro muže, ženy, dorost a děti na tratích od 330 metrů až po 6,6 km. Každý účastník obdrží medaili a svařák v cíli, což přispívá k příjemné adventní atmosféře. Prezentace začíná od 14:00, hlavní závody startují od 15:55. Pořadatelem je tým Hopman triatlonu, který pořádá akce pro všechny úrovně běžců.
course_highlights: Okruh dlouhý 2 200 m historickým centrem Žatce
Muži běží 3 okruhy (6 600 m), ženy a dorostenci 2 okruhy (4 400 m)
Dětské a žákovské tratě 330 m a 1 000 m
additional: Prezentace od 14:00, první dětské závody startují od 15:15, hlavní dospělé kategorie od 15:55.

name: Adventní běh pro zdraví
description: Adventní běh pro zdraví je tradiční běžecká akce pořádaná Běžeckým klubem Hodonín, která podporuje zdravý životní styl a sportovní aktivitu v komunitě. Závod se koná v centru města Hodonín u Městského úřadu a nabízí příležitost pro běžce všech věkových kategorií a výkonnostních úrovní. Klub má dlouholetou historii pořádání běžeckých soutěží a podporuje rozvoj vytrvalostního běhu v regionu. Akce je součástí širšího běžeckého kalendáře a je oblíbená mezi místními i návštěvníky.
course_highlights: Start a cíl u Městského úřadu v Hodoníně
Trasa vede městským prostředím s příjemným povrchem
Přátelská atmosféra a podpora zdravého životního stylu
additional: Pořadatelem je Běžecký klub Hodonín s dlouholetou tradicí. Klub organizuje také další běžecké akce v regionu. Kontakty na předsedu klubu Pavla Bílu jsou uvedeny na stránkách. Na stránkách jsou k dispozici výsledky z předchozích ročníků a informace o dalších závodech v rámci Grand Prix vytrvalců okresu Hodonín. Ročník 2025 odstartoval první kategorii v 10:30; výsledky jsou zveřejňovány na webu Běžeckého klubu Hodonín.

name: /10k Rainbow Run 2026
location: Frankfurt am Main, Frankfurt City Forest, Hesse, Germany
description: The 5/10k Rainbow Run is a trail race in Frankfurt’s Goldstein City Forest, taking place on December 5, 2026. Participants can choose between one 5 km lap or two laps for 10 km. The course runs mostly on firm forest paths, with some sections on asphalt, making it suitable for both beginners and runners looking for a faster pace. The race is part of the FVV XMAS Tournament weekend and stands against homophobia in sport by promoting an open and tolerant society. The event welcomes a diverse field of runners, including queer athletes, allies, and people of all ages and backgrounds.
course_highlights: Forest course in Frankfurt’s Goldstein City Forest
Firm forest paths with some sections on asphalt
Part of the long-running FVV XMAS Tournament, with more than 30 years of LGBTIQ* sports history
additional: In addition to the run, the FVV XMAS Tournament includes a Saturday evening party, a Sunday brunch, and a city tour. Typical December weather is around 3 °C, with frequent snowfall and an average of 40 mm of precipitation. The FVV XMAS Tournament weekend also features social events such as a party, brunch, and city tour, and supports LGBTQ+ causes.

name: Berliner Nikolauslauf 2026
price_range: 5,00 Euro bis 30,00 Euro (je nach Kategorie und Anmeldungstermin)
description: The 2026 Berlin St. Nicholas Run is a traditional race around the picturesque Schlachtensee and Krumme Lanke lakes in Berlin’s Grunewald forest. The course follows a measured 5.3-kilometre lakeside path that is popular with both recreational visitors and competitive athletes. The event offers a range of distances for the whole family, from the Bambini Marathon to the Big 5 Marathon, and is known for its friendly atmosphere and scenic surroundings. It takes place on December 6, 2026, and is organised by DIE LAUFPARTNER e.V.
course_highlights: A loop around Schlachtensee, 5.3 km per lap
A nature-rich route through Berlin’s Grunewald forest
A popular training route with top athletes and recreational visitors
additional: Race bibs can be collected on race day from 8:00 a.m. at Fischerhüttenstraße 137, 14163 Berlin, near the turning circle between Schlachtensee and Krumme Lanke. Race-day late entries are available online, subject to an additional fee. The event offers a range of distances for runners and Nordic walkers, as well as relay races. Distances range from 330 m to 26.8 km. Registration is available online or in writing; race-day late entries are online only and subject to a fee. Race bibs can be collected in Berlin.

name: Forchheimer Nikolauslauf
description: The Forchheim Nikolauslauf is a long-standing running event hosted by LG Forchheim on the Sportinsel in Forchheim. The 46th edition takes place on December 5, 2026, and features races for children and young people, a 5.3 km fun run, and a 10 km main race. The course follows a new route heading south, with the 10 km race making four circuits around the Sportinsel. The event regularly attracts more than 600 participants and offers a friendly, sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: Children’s and youth races in the morning, starting at 11:20 a.m.
5.3 km fun run on a new route heading south (4 laps)
10 km main race with four laps around the Sportinsel
additional: Start times: children’s and youth races from 11:20 a.m., 5.3 km fun run at 1:00 p.m., 10 km main race at 2:00 p.m. The 5.3 km course is run four times heading south; the 10 km course is run four times around the Sportinsel. Various race categories, festive atmosphere, traditional December event, children’s and youth races, 5.3 km fun run, 10 km main race.

name: Nikolauslauf
description: The Nikolauslauf in Schnaitheim is a traditional running event held annually at Moldenberg. The event offers various distances for students, fitness runners, and trail runners, including 5 km, 10 km, and a 12 km trail run. Runners can look forward to a varied course in a sporty, family-friendly atmosphere. TSG Schnaitheim Athletics looks forward to welcoming all participants on December 5.
course_highlights: Children’s races with age-appropriate courses
5 km fitness run and walking on varied terrain
12 km trail run with sections close to nature
additional: The Nikolauslauf takes place at Moldenberg. The event is organized by TSG Schnaitheim 1874 e.V. Various race distances are available for different age and ability groups. Results and rankings from previous races are available to download. The event takes place on December 5, 2026, with course analyses, elevation details, and downloadable results. It is a popular event for runners and walkers in the region.

name: Nikolauslauf und 131. Straßenlauf
description: The Nikolauslauf in Dülmen will take place for the 40th time on December 5, 2026, at Nuhaj Stadium on Grenzweg. The event offers various race distances for all age groups, from Bambini to adults, and supports Kinderkrebshilfe Münster e.V. With its family-friendly atmosphere and the distribution of Stutenkerle by St. Nicholas, the race is a popular event for young and old alike. Certificates can be printed for all participants on request.
course_highlights: Races for all age groups, from 600 m to 10 km
Start and finish at Nuhaj Stadium on Grenzweg
Family-friendly atmosphere with St. Nicholas and Stutenkerle distribution
additional: Race start times are staggered from 13:00 (Bambini) to 15:00 (10 km). Proceeds from entry fees and donations go to Kinderkrebshilfe Münster e.V. The race takes place in wintry weather, with temperatures around 3°C and possible snow. Participation is open to those aged 14 and over, with individual and team rankings.

name: Steinfurter Nikolauslauf 10 km
description: The Steinfurter Nikolauslauf 10 km is an annual pre-Christmas road race in Steinfurt, Germany, held as part of the Nikolausmarkt. The race starts at the historic market square in Burgsteinfurt and finishes at the Nikolausmarkt. The course first passes through the historic old town, then follows natural forest trails around the Bagno recreation area before returning to the market. Since its founding in 1975, the race has become a fixture in the local running calendar, attracting both club and recreational runners from the region.
course_highlights: Start at the historic market square in Burgsteinfurt
Route through the historic old town
Loop on natural forest trails around the Bagno recreation area
additional: Typical December weather: approx. 3 °C, usually snow-covered, with an average of 40 mm of precipitation. 10 km race, typical December weather with possible snowfall; participants are usually local club members and recreational runners.

name: Winterlaufserie Rodgau Jügesheim (2)
description: The Rodgau Winter Race Series is a long-standing running event that has taken place in Rodgau-Jügesheim since 1980 and attracts both recreational runners and top athletes from Germany and abroad. The series consists of four race dates, each featuring 5 km and 10 km distances, starting at the Maingau-Energie Stadium. Alongside the sporting competition, community spirit is also a focus, supported by team scoring for men’s, women’s, and mixed teams. The event is easy to reach by public transport and offers professional timing with a chip attached to the race bib.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Maingau-Energie Stadium in Rodgau-Jügesheim
5 km and 10 km distances
Easy to reach by S-Bahn (S1), with just a 1 km walk from the station
additional: Team scoring is available for teams of three (men, women, mixed). Chip timing with gun-time recording by MA:XX-. The first 250 series registrations receive a gift. The series includes several races, with team scoring also available. The routes are on paved surfaces and asphalt forest paths, which often have snow or frost in winter conditions. Training plans for various target times are offered to help runners prepare for the races.

name: Augsburger AOK-Winterlaufserie Südring
description: The Augsburg AOK Winter Running Series organized by TG Viktoria Augsburg consists of four races through the beautiful Western Forests Nature Park. The courses run through hilly terrain in the western forests of Augsburg and require good fitness and health. The event offers age-group rankings and an overall ranking with attractive prizes and trophies. The races take place on Saturdays and one Sunday in November and December and are a popular series for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Running routes through the Western Forests Nature Park
Hilly terrain with challenging sections
Course distances of approximately 2.8 to 3.2 km per race
additional: Race numbers are distributed in the start/finish area each time. Portable toilets are available at the Kathreinerstraße car park (races 1–3), and there is space to leave a change of clothes or luggage in a tent or pavilion (at your own risk). Finish refreshments include tea, water and a cake buffet at races 1–3; the fourth race also offers mulled wine and children’s punch. The overall awards ceremony takes place at the forest hut after the fourth race. Parking is available in Bergheim, on Kathreinerstraße and on surrounding streets, but not at the Bergheim sports clubhouse. Races take place in November, with distances ranging from approximately 2.8 km to 9.9 km. The meeting point is usually by the forest car park near Kathreinerstrasse and Brennhölzerweg in Augsburg-Bergheim. November weather can be cool and rainy.

name: MOUNTAINMAN Nikolaus-Trail Pommelsbrunn
description: The MOUNTAINMAN Nikolaus Trail in Pommelsbrunn offers trail running and hiking in the picturesque Hersbrucker Schweiz in the Nürnberger Land. On December 5, 2026, runners can choose from four challenging routes ranging from 10 km to a marathon, and families can take part in the Wichtel Trail. The trails are well marked and cross varied terrain with some challenging climbs, making them ideal for both ambitious runners and beginners. A free shuttle service makes getting there easier, and there are special options for trail runners with dogs.
course_highlights: Four routes from 10 km to a marathon, with challenging climbs
Well-marked trails in the Hersbrucker Schweiz
Wichtel Trail for families and special trails for runners with dogs
additional: On Saturday, December 5, 2026, the XL and L trails and the Wichtel Trail take place; on Sunday, December 6, 2026, the S and M trails take place, including options for runners with dogs. A free shuttle service runs from parking areas in Happurg to the start and finish area. The routes are fully marked, and participants receive a voucher code 14 days before the event for a free Komoot route download. Parking in Pommelsbrunn is limited, so travel by public transport is recommended. Trails with up to 1,582 meters of elevation gain, aid stations, well-marked routes, GPS downloads available.

name: Hamelner Cross-Winterlaufserie
price_range: Kein Startgeld; Spenden für Materialkosten willkommen
description: The Hameln Cross Winter Running Series 2026/2027 is organized by the athletics section of ESV Eintracht Hameln and takes place in the Klüt Forest around the Finkenborn Youth Hostel. The series consists of six events, with the three best results counting toward the standings. The course uses paved and unpaved paths and offers a varied cross-country running experience. There is no entry fee, though small donations toward material costs are welcome. After the final race, an awards ceremony and informal get-together will be held.
course_highlights: Races in the Klüt Forest on paved and unpaved paths
Start and finish at the sports grounds/parking lot of the Finkenborn Youth Hostel
Varied cross-country course with a natural character
additional: Entries are accepted only on the day of each race, up to 15 minutes before the start. Timing is manual. The standings are based on each participant’s three best races in the series. After the final race, an awards ceremony will be held at the Finkenborn Youth Hostel. There is no compulsory entry fee; small donations toward material costs are welcome. Donations of cakes for the closing event are welcome. Participation is at your own risk; the organizer accepts no liability. The meeting point is the sports grounds or parking lot at the Finkenborn Youth Hostel. Registration is available on race day up to 15 minutes before the start. The three fastest races per person count toward the series standings.

name: CROSSLAUF am Rodelberg
location: Kampfbahn B, An der Raa, Pinneberg, Germany
description: The cross-country race at Rodelberg is organized by LG Wedel-Pinneberg and takes place on December 5, 2026, in Pinneberg. There are various events for children, teenagers, and adults, with distances from approximately 1,200 m to 8,500 m. The races start in staggered order from 11:00 a.m., separated by gender and age group, with each group scored separately. All participants receive a certificate. The event offers a sporting challenge in the natural surroundings of Rodelberg.
course_highlights: Various distances from approximately 1,200 m to 8,500 m
Separate scoring by age group and gender
A nature-rich course at Rodelberg in Pinneberg
additional: Registration is online via LADV or directly by clicking on the respective race on the website. Online registration via LADV; the VfL Pinneberg organizes the race.

name: Göttinger Cross-Serie (2. Lauf)
description: The Göttingen Cross-Country Series 2026/27 comprises three traditional cross-country races, including the second race on December 5, 2026, at Hainholzhof/Kehr in Göttingen. The event offers races over various distances, including the middle distance (approx. 5,000 m), long distance (approx. 10,000 m), and children’s races over approx. 900 m and 1,800 m. The races take place in all weather conditions and multiple starts are permitted. The series is open to runners of all ages and ability levels and is an established event in the region.
course_highlights: Traditional cross-country races at various locations in Göttingen
A range of distances from approx. 900 m to 10,000 m
Terrain with typical cross-country challenges at Hainholzhof/Kehr
additional: Multiple starts are permitted. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Registration is online and requires details of the race distance and personal information, as well as confirmation of the liability waiver and data protection provisions. Children’s, middle-distance, and long-distance races have scheduled start times. Multiple starts are permitted; the event takes place in all weather conditions.

name: Plopsa Nikolauslauf by LCH
description: The Plopsa Nikolauslauf by LCH takes place on 05.12.2026 at Plopsaland Deutschland in Haßloch. A total of seven races are offered, from the Biene Maja Mini-Lauf to the Holly-Halbmarathon. The half-marathon course leads through the Haßlocher Wald, with the start and finish located in the amusement park. The two 5 km races are especially appealing: they follow an extended loop that passes, among other things, the new family roller coaster "100 % Wolf". All participants receive a free parking ticket, and spectators have free admission to the park; rides require a separate ticket.
course_highlights: Half-marathon course through the Haßlocher Wald
Start and finish in the Plopsaland Deutschland amusement park
5 km loop passing the new family roller coaster "100 % Wolf"
additional: Participant limits apply to all distances up to 5 km; the half-marathon is exempt. No changes or late registrations are possible. A T-shirt can be ordered during registration. Payment is by SEPA direct debit via the results service br-timing. Awards ceremonies take place promptly on site after the announcer calls participants. All runners receive a free parking ticket with their race number, and spectators have free admission to the park. Rides are not included with park admission. Aid stations on the half-marathon course are at km 6 and km 13.

name: Augsburger AOK-Winterlaufserie Viktoria-Cross
location: Waldparkplatz an der Kathreinerstraße, Augsburg-Bergheim, Augsburg, Germany
description: The 2026 Augsburg AOK Winter Running Series, organised by TG Viktoria Augsburg, consists of four races through the beautiful Western Forests Nature Park. The courses pass through hilly terrain in Augsburg-Bergheim and Wellenburg and require good fitness and health. The series offers various distances for children, young people and adults, with points awarded across all races. The start and finish of each race are near the Kathreinerstraße forest car park in Augsburg-Bergheim.
course_highlights: Race routes through the Western Forests Nature Park
Hilly terrain with challenging sections
Start and finish at the Kathreinerstraße forest car park in Augsburg-Bergheim
additional: The series consists of four races with different distances for various age groups. Bib collection and the start/finish area are in Augsburg-Bergheim, near the Kathreinerstraße forest car park. Scoring is based on points, separately by gender and age group. Starts are staggered: children and youth at 13:00, women and M/WJU20+18 at 13:45; men run three laps. Three completed races are required to qualify for the overall Winter Running Series standings.

name: Nikolauslauf Crosslauf 2026
location: Sportanlage des SV Union Meppen, Meppen, Germany
organizer: LAV Meppen und SV Union Meppen
description: The Nikolauslauf of LAV Meppen and SV Union Meppen is a traditional cross-country race held at the SV Union Meppen sports grounds in Meppen. The event is open to runners of all ages, from children to Masters, and features a varied cross-country course. The race is part of the district championships and is organised by LAV Meppen. Online registration is open until 29 November 2026.
course_highlights: Cross-country race at the SV Union Meppen sports grounds
A range of age groups, from children to Masters
Part of the Emsland district championships
additional: Online entries are open until 29 November 2026 at 23:59. The organisers are LAV Meppen and SV Union Meppen. The event is listed under district championship category 6.4.1.

name: 37. ESV-Cross-Winterlaufserie (1. Lauf)
description: The 37th ESV Cross Winter Running Series takes place in Hameln at the Finkenborn Youth Guesthouse. This long-standing running series gives runners of different age groups and ability levels the opportunity to compete in cross-country running. The course passes through varied terrain and challenges runners’ fitness and technique in winter conditions. The event is a fixture in the regional running calendar and encourages sporting exchange in the region.
course_highlights: Cross-country course through varied terrain
Winter running conditions, with partly icy ground
Traditional running series with several scoring races
additional: Entry is free; donations toward equipment costs are welcome. Registration is available on race day until 15 minutes before the start. The series standings take the three fastest races into account.

name: Nikolaus-Cross-Lauf
description: The Nikolaus Cross-Country Run takes place on 5 December 2026 at Jahnstadion in Neuss. The event offers 400-metre races for Bambinis and 1000-metre races for children and adults. The run is a popular local sporting event organised by Turngemeinde Neuss von 1848 e.V. Participation is open to all age groups and promotes grassroots sport in the region.
course_highlights: 400 m race for Bambinis
1000 m race for children and adults
Course at Jahnstadion Neuss
additional: A €5 deposit is charged for the race bib and refunded when it is returned. The run is also suitable for beginner runners. An additional €5 deposit is charged for the race bib and refunded when it is returned. All finishers receive a Weckmann.

name: 2. Rossmann Nikolauslauf

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Wichtel-Lauf (6,12 km): 6 € – Davon geht 1 € Erlös in die Aktion Weihnachtspakete

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Nikolaus-Lauf (12,24 km): 12 € – Davon gehen 2 € Erlös in die Aktion Weihnachtspakete

description: The ROSSMANN Nikolauslauf in Hannover is a festive run during Advent that aims to bring joy, especially to children, young people and families facing challenging circumstances. The event offers various distances, including the free Engelchen-Lauf, the Wichtel-Lauf over 6.12 km and the Nikolaus-Lauf over 12.24 km. Part of the entry fees is donated to the Weihnachtspakete initiative, giving the run a charitable purpose. The route passes through Hannover’s old town and city centre, offering a special night-running experience.
course_highlights: Night run through Hannover’s old town and city centre
Distances: Engelchen-Lauf (612 m), Wichtel-Lauf (6.12 km), Nikolaus-Lauf (12.24 km)
Part of the entry fees is donated to the Weihnachtspakete initiative
additional: Part of the entry fees supports the Weihnachtspakete initiative for children and families in difficult circumstances. Additional donations can be made during online registration. The entry fee for the two longer runs includes a race bib, refreshments, cloakroom storage and a ROSSMANN goodie bag. Additional donations can be made during online registration; €1 from the Wichtel-Lauf and €2 from the Nikolaus-Lauf go to the Weihnachtspakete initiative. The start area is near the Hannover Messe/Ost (EXPO-Plaza) light rail stop.

name: XVII Grand Prix Mysłowic
description: The 17th Mysłowice Grand Prix is a series of races organized by the Truchtacz Mysłowice Association, promoting a healthy, active lifestyle and bringing together runners of all abilities. The event takes place in Mysłowice and is open to all age groups and running levels. Participants can expect a friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to compete throughout the Grand Prix series. Registration is available only at the Race Office on race day, and participation is free.
course_highlights: 10 km race in the scenic surroundings of Mysłowice
A series of seasonal events promoting a healthy lifestyle
A running community and opportunities to connect with the local community
additional: Registration for the Grand Prix series is available only at the Race Office on race day. Participation in the Grand Prix races is free. The event is open to everyone, regardless of age or ability. It focuses on promoting physical activity, health, and the running community, with varied courses and seasonal editions.

name: Bunt Mikołajów
description: Bunt Mikołajów is a Santa-themed 5 km run in Niepołomice, with its 6th edition on 5 December 2026 at 16:30. Start and finish are at the Royal Castle, and the route follows city streets over asphalt, concrete and cobblestones. Runners wear Santa outfits, this year green elf outfits. Online registration runs until 3 December 2026 or until the 999-place limit is reached.
course_highlights: City route over asphalt, concrete and cobblestones
Start and finish at the Royal Castle
50 minute time limit
additional: The race office is at the Royal Castle, ul. Zamkowa 2, from 14:00 to 16:15. Every registered runner gets a chip bib, a medal, a mug and refreshments.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL — Wrocław
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury, Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego oraz Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata za pojedynczy bieg uiszczona najpóźniej do środy poprzedzającej start

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Karnet można wykupić najpóźniej do środy przed drugim biegiem

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in the beautiful woodland setting of Osobowicki Forest in Wrocław. The races are open to runners of all abilities, from beginners to advanced athletes, who can track their results on the same course. The event promotes outdoor physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, and participants can compete in both local and series-wide classifications. The start and finish are near the sports field in Osobowicki Forest, and the races take place in the morning.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through the woodland setting of Osobowicki Forest
Start and finish located by the sports field in Osobowicki Forest
A cross-country course suitable for both beginner and advanced runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30. Race bibs and timing chips are collected on race day. There is no participant limit. A charity package supporting the Siepomaga Foundation is available for purchase. Parking is available along Osobowicka Street, following directions from traffic staff. Participants must obey traffic regulations. As part of a season pass, participants may take one free start in another city in the series after notifying the organizers by email in advance. Online registration is available via the CITY TRAIL website; registration is also possible at the race office on race day. Participants in the main race must be at least 16 years old, or turn 16 in 2026.

name: VI Nocny Mikołajkowy Bieg Nyski
description: Nocny Mikołajkowy Bieg Nyski is an evening street run in Nysa over about 5.2 km. The sixth edition takes place on 5 December 2026. The organiser is the W działaniu foundation, which also runs the Bieg Nyski in May. The previous edition started in the evening from the Market Square in Nysa.
course_highlights: Evening run through the streets of Nysa
Distance of about 5.2 km
St Nicholas edition in December
additional: The race office is open on race day from 13:00 to 18:45 in the DSPiLH sports hall at Św. Piotra 1A. The 2026 field limit has been reached and registration is closed. Minors need consent from a parent or guardian.

name: XII Półmaraton Mikołajkowy w Mikołajkach
description: The 12th St Nicholas Half Marathon takes place in Mikołajki on 5 December 2026 together with the 20th St Nicholas Street Runs. Runners can choose the 21 km half marathon or the 10 km Mikołajkowa Dyszka, and children's and youth races are held in the morning. The half marathon and 10 km start at 11:45. The field is limited to 450 registered runners.
course_highlights: 21 km half marathon and 10 km race
Children's and youth races before the main races
Free entry for over-70s and residents of Mikołajki municipality
additional: Children's registration and bib pickup run from 8:00 to 11:00, and the children's races start at 10:30. The 10 km and half marathon prize giving is at 14:15. Online registration runs until 1 December 2026, and payment on site is also possible. Runners aged 60-69 and people with disabilities pay half price.

name: 6 Bieg Mikołajkowy wzdłuż Leńcy
description: The 6th St. Nicholas Run along the Leńca invites you to Boronów for a sporting event in a festive St. Nicholas atmosphere. The program includes 5 km and 10 km runs, as well as a 5 km Nordic walking event. It’s an opportunity to spend the day actively on routes through the Boronów area.
course_highlights: The routes run mainly along farm roads and forest tracks.
The routes also include asphalt sections.
Available distances are 5 km and 10 km, as well as a 5 km Nordic walking event.
additional: The participant limit is 200.

name: 57 Biegi Przełajowe
location: Polana leśna przy ul. Zakopiańskiej, Legionowo
description: The 57th Cross-Country Runs for the Legionowo Mayor's Cup take place on 5 December 2026 in the Legionowo forest, with start and finish on a forest clearing at ul. Zakopiańska. The 12 km main race starts at 12:00 and costs 40 PLN with a full starter package of bib, bag drop, a running gadget, a meal and a medal. The organizer is the City of Legionowo, reachable at arena@um.legionowo.pl.
course_highlights: Cross-country run in the Legionowo forest
Start and finish on the forest clearing at ul. Zakopiańska
12 km main race
additional: The city page lists 08:30 as the start of the event day, and online registration runs through zapisyonline.pl.

name: Mikołajkowa Sianowska 5
organizer: Fundacja Zastopuj, Sportowiec.info, Gmina i miasto Sianów
description: Mikołajkowa Sianowska 5 is a 5 km race in Kłos in the Sianów municipality and the final race of the five-race Sianowska series. Children's races from 100 to 1000 metres start before the main race, and on every distance a parent may run together with their child. The race counts towards the RUNking runners' ranking, and the series will be wrapped up at the 9th RUNking Runners' Gala. The organisers have prepared 120 medals for participants.
course_highlights: Main 5 km race in Kłos (Sianów municipality)
Children's races over 100, 200, 400, 800 and 1000 m
Final race of the Sianowska series, counting towards RUNking
additional: Race packs are handed out from 9:30, the last ones at 10:45 at the latest. Children's races start from 11:00, the main race at 12:00. Race-day entry only if places remain. Runners must be 16 or older; younger runners take part under the care of a parent or guardian.

name: Piastowski Bieg Mikołajowy
description: Piastowski Bieg Mikołajowy is a cross-country race organised by the WKB Piast Wrocław running club. Start and finish are in Wilkszyn by the ORLIK pitch on ul. Sportowa. Runners can choose a 10 km cross-country race over two loops, a shorter cross-country run of about 5 km, or 5 km of Nordic walking. The organisers invite everyone to treat themselves to some exercise and time together over the festive season.
course_highlights: 10 km cross-country race over two loops
Shorter run of about 5 km and 5 km Nordic walking
Start by the ORLIK pitch in Wilkszyn
additional: Start at 11:00. A lower fee (70 zł) applies to Miękinia residents and club members. A separate free race is held for children.

name: Trail!ON Stawiguda 2026/2027 #1
description: Trail!ON Stawiguda is a winter series of four off-road races in Ruś near Olsztyn, held in a bend of the Łyna river. The first race of the series offers a 5 km main race and children's races over 300 m, 500 m and 1 km. Every date follows the same schedule, and after the main race anyone who wants to can join a winter swim. After the last race of the series the overall standings are announced and finisher medals for the series are handed out.
course_highlights: 5 km main race in a bend of the Łyna river
Children's races over 300 m, 500 m and 1 km
Winter swimming after the main race
additional: Children's races start from 9:45, the main race at 11:00, winter swimming from 11:45 to 12:15. A season-pass bib is valid for the whole series; on race day only single-race entries are sold. Registration and payment via sportaktywni.pl.

name: Warta Challenge
location: Parking leśny Łysy Młyn, ul. Poznańska 4, Biedrusko
organizer: SPORT CHALLENGE Fundacja Wspierania Aktywności Fizycznej
description: WARTA CHALLENGE Marathon&Half is a winter series of four cross-country races and nordic walking events in the Warta river forests near Biedrusko. The St Nicholas Run on 5 December 2026 opens the 2026/2027 series, followed by the New Year Run, the Valentine's Run and the final Women's Run. Races are held over 42.2 km and 21.3 km, plus 5 and 10 km. The event centre and race office are by Lake Łyse at the Łysy Młyn forest car park. Each race this season has a theme and the organiser encourages themed outfits.
course_highlights: Forest tracks and paths along the Warta river
Marathon 42.2 km, half marathon 21.3 km plus 5 and 10 km
Themed St Nicholas Run opening the winter series
additional: The race office is open on race day from 7:45 to 9:30. The marathon and half marathon start at 10:00, the 5 and 10 km races at 10:15. Nordic walking is held over 21.3 km and over 5 and 10 km. Online registration ran until 30 November, and the field is limited to 250 people.

name: XXI Bieg Mikołajów i Mikołajek
organizer: MOSiR „Pszczelnik” i Urząd Miasta Siemianowice Śląskie
description: Bieg Mikołajów i Mikołajek is a traditional running and Nordic walking event in Siemianowice Śląskie, organised by the MOSiR Pszczelnik sports centre and the city hall. The 5.5 km route follows the paths of Pszczelnik Park to the golf course, through the Bażantarnia woods and past the Rzęsa pond, finishing back in the park. Every participant gets a sweet gift and a drink. It is a festive chance to get moving for runners and Nordic walkers alike.
course_highlights: 5.5 km route along the paths of Pszczelnik Park
Passes the golf course, Bażantarnia and the Rzęsa pond
Sweet gift and a drink for every participant
additional: Start at 11:00. Entries by email to sport@um.siemianowice.pl; after the deadline, paper entries at the race office on race day between 10:15 and 10:50.

name: Mikołajkowa Piątka
organizer: Opalenicki Klub Biegacza, Powiatowe Centrum Sportu w Nowym Tomyślu
description: Mikołajkowa Piątka is a 5 km run in Porażyn and part of the Nowy Tomyśl county winter Grand Prix over 5 km. The race takes place on 5 December 2026. Start, finish and race office are at Porażyn Tartak 14. The organisers are the Opalenica Runners Club and the Nowy Tomyśl County Sports Centre.
course_highlights: 5 km distance
Part of the Nowy Tomyśl county winter Grand Prix
Start and finish at Porażyn Tartak 14
additional: The race office in Porażyn is open on race day from 8:00 to 8:45. Registration runs through the Datasport panel.

name: VII Charytatywny ZwariOWany Trip Nocny
description: The 7th Charity ZwariOWany Night Trip is a nighttime running event held in Kąkolewo for a good cause. This year’s edition supports Mikołaj Wróblewski. Participants come together to run and support the charity initiative.

name: Mikulášsky charitatívny beh pre Zatúlané psíky
ČSOB zimná séria - Bratislava
distance_verbose: 534 km, 50 km, Maratón, Polmaratón, 16 km, 11.6 km, 11.5 km, 11 km, 10 km, 7 km, 6 km, 5 km, 3.2 km, 1 km

name: Mikulášsky beh okolo Hviezdoslavova
location: Hviezdoslavov, Dunajská Streda District, Trnava Region, Slovakia

name: Séria adventných behov - Dvorníky-Včeláre
location: Turňa nad Bodvou, Košice-okolie District, Košice Region, Slovakia
distance_verbose: 22 km, 15 km, 12 km, 10 km, 8 km, 5 km, 3000 meter, 1 km

name: Mikulášsky beh
location: Tekovská Breznica, Žarnovica District, Banská Bystrica Region, Slovakia

name: Malá cena Velké Verandy
description: Malá cena Velké Verandy je tradiční lesní kros, který se koná v Choceňi. Závod má délku 4 300 metrů a vede po lesních cestách a pěšinách s převýšením přibližně 200 metrů. Trasa je značena fáborky a zahrnuje i krátký úsek asfaltu. Tento závod je zároveň Memoriálem Jirky Švadleny a je oblíbený mezi běžci, kteří hledají náročný terén s kopcovitým profilem.
course_highlights: 4 300 m po lesních cestách a pěšinách
Kopcovitý profil s převýšením cca 200 m
Trasa značena fáborky, cca 400 m asfaltu
additional: Závod nabízí cca 400 m asfaltu, je vhodný pro běžce hledající výzvu v přírodním prostředí, a je součástí místního sportovního kalendáře.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Olomouc - prosinec
description: Běh 2 míle Olomouc je otevřený závod na 2 míle (3,2 km) určený pro všechny věkové kategorie a úrovně běžců, od začátečníků po zkušené. Závod se koná v malebném prostředí Smetanových sadů v Olomouci, kde si každý může užít běh pro radost a soutěžit především sám se sebou. Součástí je i soutěž o pohár, kde se výsledky přepočítávají podle věkového koeficientu a běžci sbírají body během roku. Registrace probíhá v den závodu od 9:30 do 10:00 hodin, start je u fontány v parku.
course_highlights: Trať dlouhá 2 míle (3,2 km) v Smetanových sadech v Olomouci
Závod vhodný pro všechny věkové kategorie a úrovně běžců
Malebné prostředí parku s fontánou jako startovním místem
additional: Místo závodu je u fontány v Smetanových sadech, kromě dvou červnových a srpnových závodů, které se konají u řeky na ulici U Dětského domova. První tři místa v každé kategorii jsou oceněna. Závod se koná na asfaltové trati, registrace probíhá od 9:30 do 10:00, akce je součástí série běhů v Olomouci s více termíny během roku.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Olomouc - září
description: Běh 2 míle Olomouc je otevřený závod na 2 míle (3,2 km), který je určen pro všechny věkové kategorie a úrovně běžců - od začátečníků po zkušené. Každý soutěží především sám se sebou a běží pro radost. Závod se koná v malebném prostředí Smetanových sadů u fontány v Olomouci. Součástí je také soutěž o pohár, kde se výsledky přepočítávají podle věkového koeficientu a body se sčítají během roku.
course_highlights: Trať dlouhá 2 míle (3,2 km) v Smetanových sadech u fontány
Vhodné pro všechny věkové kategorie a úrovně běžců
Soutěž o pohár s bodováním podle věkového koeficientu
additional: Registrace probíhá od 9:30 do 10:00 hodin v den závodu. První tři místa jsou vyhlašována v každé kategorii.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://cs.srichinmoyraces.org/beh-2-mile-olomouc): 2026-12-06 — "Další závod: 6. prosinec 2026 Olomouc" (was estimated 2027-09-05)

name: Čertovský běh Damníkov
location: ZŠ a MŠ Damníkov, Damníkov, Česko

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné je 100 Kč, přihlásit se lze jen v den závodu při prezentaci.

description: Čertovský běh Damníkov je tradiční silniční běh do kopce z Damníkova do Anenské Studánky na Lanškrounsku, který se koná již od roku 1984. Trať dlouhá 4 km vede po asfaltové silnici s převýšením asi 150 metrů a nabízí náročný stoupavý profil, zejména v druhé polovině. Závod je součástí seriálu ISCAREX POHÁR 2026 a je vhodný pro širokou veřejnost včetně juniorských kategorií. Start je u ZŠ a MŠ Damníkov a cíl u kulturního domu v Anenské Studánce, kde je zajištěno občerstvení a vyhlášení výsledků.
course_highlights: 4 km asfaltová trať s převýšením cca 150 m
Stoupání začíná výrazněji po železničním přejezdu
Trasa vede z Damníkova do Anenské Studánky, v prosinci může být sníh nebo náledí
additional: Prezentace probíhá v den závodu od 9:00 do 10:10 v budově ZŠ a MŠ Damníkov. Šatny jsou k dispozici ve startu i v cíli. V cíli je občerstvení a vyhlášení výsledků. Železniční zastávka Anenská Studánka je na trati asi 1,2 km před cílem, což usnadňuje návrat ze závodu. Podle dostupných informací probíhá registrace v den závodu při prezentaci v budově ZŠ a MŠ Damníkov; zimní počasí může ovlivnit povrch trati.

name: Winterlaufserie
description: The Nuremberg Winter Running Series is a long-established running event held in several stages around Dutzendteich and Silbersee in Nuremberg. The races follow gravel and partly paved paths, where snow and ice may be present, underscoring the winter character of the event. The series offers distances from 5 km to 20 km and is open to recreational runners of all age groups. All runners are welcome; club membership is not required. Times are measured electronically, and there is a cup competition for participants who take part in all three races.
course_highlights: Course around Dutzendteich and Silbersee
Gravel and partly paved paths
Possible icy and snowy conditions on the course
additional: The winter running series consists of three races, with distances of 5 km, 10 km, 15 km and 20 km spread across three dates. To enter the cup competition, you must register for all three races. Bib numbers are non-transferable and must be worn visibly. Refreshments are available in the start/finish area. The course may change due to official requirements. Routes around Dutzendteich and Silbersee; snow and ice possible; accompanying people on sports equipment are not permitted; aids such as inline skates are not permitted.

name: 47. Mühlenberger Nikolauslauf
location: Bezirkssportanlage am Ossietzkyring, Ossietzkyring, Hannover, Germany
description: The 47th Mühlenberger Nikolaus Run is a family-friendly running event in Hanover on December 6, 2026. It offers races over 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km on a flat, fast course, ideal for runners of all ages and experience levels. The event takes place at the district sports facility on Ossietzkyring and is known for its pleasant, community atmosphere. There are special races for children and teenagers, with every student receiving a St. Nicholas surprise. The best runners in each age group are rewarded with certificates and honorary prizes. The race is part of the Lauf(s)pass series in the Hanover region and invites all running enthusiasts to celebrate the festive season in an active way.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course at the district sports facility
Family- and child-friendly event with special races for teenagers
Part of the Lauf(s)pass series in the Hanover region
additional: Online registration available; race in Mühlenberg, Hanover; open to all age groups; awards for winners and age-group winners

name: Adventslauf
description: The Advent Run in Lage is a traditional running event organized by the running division of TG Lage. The course runs through the Teutoburg Forest Nature Park and features well-maintained forest trails, partly along the famous Hermann Trail. The run is suitable for runners of all ability levels and takes place annually in December. The event is part of TG Lage’s varied running and walking program, which also offers beginner courses and training opportunities.
course_highlights: Course through the Teutoburg Forest Nature Park
Well-maintained, easy-to-run forest trails
Sections along the famous Hermann Trail
additional: TG Lage’s running division also offers a Nordic walking beginner course that covers the basics in 4 sessions of 60 minutes each. Walking poles are available to borrow. There is also a 10-session pass for time-limited training participation, valid for 6 months and 10 training sessions. The office is open on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Run on forest and field paths in the Teutoburg Forest Nature Park, on the 2nd Sunday of Advent; easy to reach, with a festive atmosphere in the gym.

name: FT Jahn Nikolauslauf
location: Jahn Vereinsheim, Landsberg am Lech, Bavaria, Germany
description: The FT Jahn Nikolauslauf in Landsberg am Lech is a traditional running event held annually in December. It offers various distances for all age groups and fitness levels, from 1 km for children to 10 km for endurance runners. Nordic walking is also included. The event combines sporting ambition with a friendly community atmosphere in one of Germany’s most beautiful towns, inviting everyone to kick off the Advent season in an active way.
course_highlights: Distances from 1 km to 10 km for different age groups
Winter atmosphere in the historic town of Landsberg am Lech
Combination of running and Nordic walking events
additional: Start times are staggered by distance: the 1 km and 2 km races start at 11:00, the 5 km run and Nordic walking event at 11:30, and the 10 km run at 11:45. Minimum ages vary by distance (6 years for 1 km, 12 years for 2 km, and 16 years for 5 km and 10 km). The event takes place at the Jahn clubhouse in Landsberg am Lech. Running and Nordic walking distances from 1 km to 10 km; various age groups; winter atmosphere; registration required.

name: Heeslinger Nikolauscross
description: The Heeslingen Nikolaus Cross-Country Run is a popular cross-country race held annually in Heeslingen, Lower Saxony. The event attracts athletes and families from the region and is known for its high-level sporting challenges. The races also determine the district champions of Rotenburg/W. The organizer, Heeslinger SC, is an established point of contact for sports enthusiasts and volunteers from the surrounding communities.
course_highlights: Cross-country run through varied terrain
Determination of the district champions of Rotenburg/W.
Event in the Heeslingen region with a family-friendly atmosphere
additional: Courses and participation conditions are available in the relevant event announcement; no entry fee is required. The event is open to runners of all ages, including children, young people, adults and masters.

name: Ilsfelder Nikolauslauf
price_range: 6,00 € bis 12,00 € je nach Lauf und Anmeldung
description: The Ilsfeld St. Nicholas Run is a long-standing running event taking place on December 6, 2026, in Ilsfeld. The races follow scenic loop courses along the Schozach through the municipality. Whether you’re a beginner or a professional, the focus is on enjoying exercise. In addition to individual and group registration, there is also a St. Nicholas costume category for runners dressed as St. Nicholas. The event is approved by the German Athletics Association and takes place in all weather conditions.
course_highlights: Run along the Schozach on a scenic loop course
Distances: 1.6 km children’s run, 5 km Volksbank Run, 10 km TRZ Siegele Run
St. Nicholas costume category for runners dressed as St. Nicholas (except the school run)
additional: Timing is recorded as net time using a disposable transponder system integrated into the race bib. The awards ceremony takes place in the community hall. Prizes are awarded to the St. Nicholas costume winners, the largest group, the fastest group, and solo runners. The courses are not officially measured and are not eligible for records. Run in all weather conditions. St. Nicholas costume requirement: trousers (a skirt is also acceptable), top, and hat. Group and individual starts. St. Nicholas category with gifts. Online registration. Transponder timing. Awards ceremony in the community hall.

name: itdesign-Nikolauslauf Tübingen
description: The itdesign Nikolauslauf Tübingen is a traditional half marathon organized by Post-SV Tübingen since 1976. The course is officially measured and recognized as a road race, making it eligible for rankings. It runs along finely gravelled forest paths and paved sections with moderate climbs, providing a varied challenge. Refreshment stations along the course and at the finish ensure runners are well supplied. In addition to the main race, the event offers a 10 km school competition and a virtual 10 km run.
course_highlights: Officially measured half marathon (21.1 km), eligible for rankings
Finely gravelled forest paths and approx. 8.5 km of paved paths
Maximum elevation difference of approx. 82 metres, total ascent of approx. 300 metres
additional: Start and finish are at Waldhäuser Straße 120, 72076 Tübingen, approx. 200 metres from the runners’ expo. The runners’ expo, race-pack collection and race office are located in the sports hall of Geschwister-Scholl-Schule, Berliner Ring 33, 72076 Tübingen. Refreshments including water, tea and UltraSports products are available at kilometres 5, 11 and 17, as well as at the finish. Raisin rolls from Bäckerei Gehr are served at the finish. A Nikolauslauf app provides current information, race numbers and results. Held annually in December, with practice runs in November; environmentally friendly travel options with the naldo transport association; anniversary and special shirts; courses in Schönbuch Nature Park.

name: Klausdorfer Nikolauslauf
description: The Klausdorf St. Nicholas Run is a longstanding running event on the eastern shore of Kiel Fjord, taking place on December 6, 2026, in Schwentinental, Klausdorf district. This will be the 41st edition of the event, attracting runners from the region. The event offers a festive pre-Christmas atmosphere and is a sporting highlight for all age groups. Official registration is expected to open after the 2026 summer holidays.
course_highlights: Run along the eastern shore of Kiel Fjord
Traditional running event with a festive atmosphere
Event in Schwentinental, Klausdorf district
additional: The official registration page is expected to open after the 2026 summer holidays. Course maps are available as images on the website. Registration is expected to be available on the official website after the 2026 summer holidays; the event is known for its good value for money and family-friendly atmosphere.

name: Kölner Nikolauslauf
organizer: Leichtathletik Team der Deutschen Sporthochschule Köln

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgebühr für den KIDS RUN: 11,00 EUR

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Startgebühr für den Top und FunRun: 21,00 EUR ab dem 02.10.

description: The Cologne St. Nicholas Run is a traditional fun run, taking place for the 29th time on December 6, 2026. The event offers three different races: the competitive 10 km TopRun, the FunRun with a variable distance of 3.4 km to 10 km for all running enthusiasts, and the KidsRun, a 3.4 km race for children. The races follow a course through the beautiful Cologne City Forest on a DLV-measured loop, creating a festive, athletic atmosphere for the whole family. The event is organized by the athletics team of the German Sport University Cologne and emphasizes community and the joy of running.
course_highlights: Loop course through the Cologne City Forest
DLV-measured course with a course certificate
Three laps for the 10 km TopRun; variable distance for the FunRun
additional: Start times: TopRun 10:00, KidsRun 11:30, FunRun 11:35. FunRun participants can choose between 3.4 km, 6.7 km, or 10 km. A preferred bib number is available for an additional €3. On-site late registration is possible for an additional fee of €5. €1 from every St. Nicholas hat sold will be donated to Lindenthaler Tierpark. Race bibs include B-tags for timing; registration is closed, late registration is possible, and race packet pickup is in Cologne.

name: landesoffener Nikolaus-Waldlauf
description: The 46th open Nikolaus Forest Run will take place on December 6, 2026, at the Arnstorf School Centre. The event offers various races for adults, young people and children on hilly forest trails, with distances ranging from 2.7 km to 7.2 km. The start and finish are at the Arnstorf School Centre, which can be reached by a free shuttle bus. The award ceremonies and shower facilities are also at the school centre. The event is part of the Grenzland Running Cup and includes age-group rankings for schoolchildren.
course_highlights: Hilly route through woodland
Start and finish at the Arnstorf School Centre, with shower facilities
Free shuttle bus to the start/finish
additional: Distances range from 300 m to 8.7 km, with age-group rankings for schoolchildren. Races are offered for children, young people and adults, as well as Nordic walking. The route to the school centre is signposted. Various distances; start at the Arnstorf School Centre; free shuttle buses; shower facilities; winter running event in woodland.

name: Lauf 38. Winterlaufserie
description: The LSV Porz Winter Running Series begins with the race in Ochtendung on December 6, 2026. The event offers various distances, including 0.4 km and 8.1 km, and is open to runners of all ability levels, including students and Nordic walkers. Participants who successfully complete the series receive an award such as a trophy or a towel. Dogs are not allowed, and the event is not accessible.
course_highlights: Distances: 0.4 km and 8.1 km
Start location: Ochtendung
Typical December weather, with snow cover on most days
additional: The Winter Running Series offers several distances and is aimed at students, walkers, and road runners. Participants who successfully complete the series exchange their race number for a trophy or a towel. Students receive a commemorative medal at the opening race. Several distances, start in Ochtendung, typical winter weather in December

name: Melsunger Adventslauf Rund um die Koppe
description: The Melsungen Advent Run is a traditional running event held every year on the second Sunday of Advent in Melsungen. Various distances are offered: 1.2 km, 1.6 km, 5 km and 10 km. The 10 km race consists of two laps of the 5 km course. The event attracts runners of all ages and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with special appreciation for children and recreational runners. It is organised by the running group of Melsunger Turngemeinde 1861 e.V. and is a fixture in the North Hesse popular running calendar.
course_highlights: Various distances: 1.2 km, 1.6 km, 5 km and 10 km
The 10 km race consists of two laps of the 5 km course
Family-friendly event with special care for children
additional: Results and certificates are provided via My Race Result. The event takes place every year on the second Sunday of Advent. Children receive a small treat (e.g. chocolate wafers) and a medal at the finish, as well as a certificate at the awards ceremony. The event is organised by the MT Melsungen organising team / recreational sports department / running group. Course distances: 1.2 km, 1.6 km, 5 km and 10 km; registration and results via My Race Result; winter weather is possible.

name: Nat. Nikolaus Volkslauf
description: The 46th Nat. Nikolaus Volkslauf in Mingolsheim (Bad Schönborn) is a traditional running event held on field and forest paths, with the start and finish at Schönbornhalle. The race welcomes children, youth, adults and masters, offering a sporting challenge in a natural setting. The event is organized by SG Bad Schönborn and warmly invites runners of all ages to take part in this popular fun run.
course_highlights: Course on field and forest paths
Start and finish at Schönbornhalle
Natural running environment in Mingolsheim
additional: The entry deadline is December 2, 2023. The event is open to children, youth, adults and masters. Registration is online via the SG Bad Schönborn website. The event category is 6.5.1 Non-stadium events. The race takes place on December 6, 2026, with categories for children, youth, adults and masters. December weather is typically cold, with temperatures around 3°C; snowfall is possible. The event is a lovely opportunity to celebrate the run-up to Christmas actively.

name: Nikolaus - Crosslauf in Alflen - 4. Lauf der 39. Crosslaufserie Cochem - Zell
description: The Nikolaus cross-country race of SV Schwarz-Weiß Alflen is the fourth and final race of the Cochem-Zell cross-country series. It is held on the grounds of the SG Auderath/Alflen sports field on the B259. To be ranked in the series, runners must take part in three of the four races. Last year all age groups from U8 to M/W 70 were represented, and every finisher received a Weckmann pastry.
course_highlights: Final race of the Cochem-Zell cross-country series
Cross-country course at the Auderath sports field
Races for all age groups
additional: Pre-registration closes two days before the race. Entry fees and start times are listed in the Cochem-Zell cross-country series overview.

name: Nikolaus-Lauf in Ochsenfurt
description: The Nikolauslauf in Ochsenfurt is a traditional running event organized annually by Turnverein Ochsenfurt 1862 e. V. The event offers various races for Bambinis, schoolchildren, young people, recreational runners, and a main race. The courses are suitable for all age groups and foster a sense of sporting community in the region. The run traditionally takes place in early December and attracts numerous participants from the surrounding area.
course_highlights: Various race categories for all age groups
Festive December atmosphere in Ochsenfurt
Annual event with a tradition and community spirit
additional: Alongside the races, the Nikolauslauf also offers a sociable atmosphere, ideal for families and running enthusiasts. Results from previous years are available on the website.

name: Oberschwäbische Crosslaufserie 1. Lauf in Blitzenreute
description: The 1st race of the Upper Swabian Cross-Country Running Series in Blitzenreute is a popular running event that brings runners of all ages together in a natural setting. The event offers a variety of routes for children, young people and adults, including cross-country distances from 1.0 km to 7.5 km. It is organized by SV Blitzenreute e.V. Athletics Department, and registration is available via Raceresult. The series is known for its welcoming atmosphere and varied running routes.
course_highlights: A variety of routes for all age groups
Cross-country running in a natural setting
Distances from 1 km to 7.5 km
additional: The race takes place on cross-country terrain. Registration is via Raceresult. No refunds or transfers of race entries are possible.

name: Oelder Nikolauslauf
location: Oelder Jahnstadion, Oelde, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 52nd Oelde St. Nicholas Run takes place on December 6, 2026, at Oelde’s Jahnstadion, welcoming children, young people, and adults to a varied running experience. With four different running distances and a Nordic walking and walking distance recognized as a performance distance for the German Sports Badge, the event offers a suitable challenge for every age and ability level. The routes pass through the stadium and the surrounding countryside, including challenging climbs in Limberger Forest. The event is a popular St. Nicholas Day tradition and promotes recreational sport in the region.
course_highlights: 0.6 km lap in the stadium for children up to age 7
3 km fitness run along paved farm roads through the Bergeler farming community
11.5 km countryside run with climbs in Limberger Forest
additional: The 7.5 km walking and Nordic walking route is barrier-free and also suitable for wheelchairs. Age-group awards are offered for walking. Various running and walking routes, including Nordic walking; barrier-free; performance distances for the German Sports Badge; children's and youth races

name: Saalfelder Winterlauf
description: The Winter Run Around the Katze in Saalfeld an der Saale is a traditional 15 km road race held in winter since 1982. The course starts at the Langenschader Straße sports field, loops around the local landmark “Katze,” passes through Langenschade and Schloßkulm, and returns to the start. The race is officially measured and scored in DLV age groups, making it especially appealing to club runners of all ages. The event is small, usually attracting fewer than 100 participants, and offers straightforward organization with online registration, changing rooms, and showers on site.
course_highlights: Officially measured 15 km road-race course
Loop around the “Katze” landmark in Saalfeld
Course passes through Langenschade and Schloßkulm
additional: Changing rooms and showers are available at the Langenschader Straße sports field. The event usually has fewer than 100 runners. Results are scored in DLV age groups. December weather is typically cold, averaging 3 °C, with frequent snowfall. The race offers online registration, changing rooms, and showers at the venue, and results are scored by age group.

name: Weiterstädter Nikolauslauf
description: The Weiterstadt St. Nicholas Run is a winter running event held on December 6, 2026, in Weiterstadt. Organized by TuS Griesheim, the event offers various distances for children, youths, and adults, including 1 km, 2 km, 5 km, and 10 km. The course runs around the Braunshardter Tännchen and features a flat, scenic route through fields and forests, ideal for recreational runners. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, entry fees, and a chocolate St. Nicholas figure for all finishers.
course_highlights: Flat, scenic route through fields and forests
Various distances for all age groups
Part of the Lang-Lauf Cup series
additional: Run at the Braunshardter Tännchen; online registration available; race number distribution from 09:15; results available online; finishers receive a chocolate St. Nicholas figure

name: Winterlaufserie 2026/2027, 2. Wertungslauf
organizer: SVW 06 Ahnatal e. V. – Orgateam der Winterlaufserie
description: The SVW 06 Ahnatal e. V. Winter Running Series is a long-standing running event in North Hesse that has been held for over 40 years. It is organized by the club’s athletics department and offers runners a series of races during the cold season. The series begins and includes several scoring races, including the 2nd scoring race in Ahnatal-Weimar. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to stay active during the winter.
course_highlights: Traditional winter running series with over 40 years of history
Event in the North Hesse region, Ahnatal-Weimar
Several scoring races over the winter months
additional: Registration is completed by filling out a form, which must be brought to the start. The SVW 06 Ahnatal e. V. office is open on Wednesdays from 19:00 to 20:00 (except during holidays and on public holidays). The Winter Running Series is organized by the club’s athletics department. The 10 km race starts at 9:45, and the 5 km race at 9:55. According to the event information, entries are accepted until 10 minutes before the respective start.

name: Zülpicher Seepark Nikolauslauf mit Fun/Firmenstaffel
description: The Zülpich St. Nicholas Run is organized by the athletics department of TuS Chlodwig Zülpich and Seepark Zülpich. The races take runners through the wintery Seepark, including along the shore of the watersports lake, and feature various events for youth, recreational runners, company and club relays, as well as the main race. The event takes place at the Seehaus in Zülpich and welcomes runners and spectators alike to a festive St. Nicholas celebration with mulled wine and non-alcoholic punch. Changing rooms and showers are available on site, and race numbers can be collected at the pavilion behind the main entrance.
course_highlights: Run through the wintery Seepark Zülpich
Route along the shore of the watersports lake
Start and finish at the Seehaus, with changing rooms and showers
additional: Late entries are possible up to 60 minutes before the respective race for an additional fee of €2.00. Admission to the Seepark is free.

name: Crosslauf Weißenseer Sportverein
description: The cross-country race of Weißenseer Sportverein Rot-Weiss traditionally takes place at Stadion Buschallee in Berlin. The event is part of the club’s diverse athletics program and invites runners of all ages to take part in a well-organized competition. The course offers a varied cross-country experience in a sporting, family-friendly atmosphere. Spectators and participants benefit from the dedicated support of the club and numerous volunteers.
course_highlights: Cross-country race at Stadion Buschallee, Berlin
Traditional race with regional and national participation
Event included in WSV Rot-Weiss’s diverse athletics program
additional: The cross-country race is part of the club’s athletics events and has a long tradition. The event is supported by numerous officials and volunteers. There is no information about different start waves or special participant restrictions. Online registration is possible; the registration deadline is December 1, 2026, at 23:59.

name: ELM-Advents-HALBMARATHON
description: The ELM Advent Half Marathon is a traditional half-marathon race in Königslutter, held annually in December. The course starts and finishes at Lutterspring 1 and offers runners an attractive opportunity to race during the Advent season. The race is open to participants aged 14 and over and is organized by TSV Lelm. A partnership with TSG Königslutter also allows participants to use the sauna and showers for a small fee.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Lutterspring 1, 38154 Königslutter
Half-marathon course through the Königslutter region
Partnership with TSG Königslutter for access to fitness facilities and the sauna
additional: Late entries are accepted only for the main half-marathon race, by WhatsApp or email. The minimum age to participate is 14. The partnership with TSG Königslutter allows participants to use the fitness equipment, sauna and showers for a section fee of 17.50 euros, without paying TSG’s main membership fee. Results and certificates are available online via RUNTIMING.

name: Int. Johannesbad Nikolauslauf
description: The International Johannesbad St. Nicholas Run is a running event in Orscholz, starting and finishing at the Johannesbad Rehabilitation Clinic. The event is organized by Athletic Perl and invites runners to take part in a sporting St. Nicholas run.

name: Nikolauslauf des Ahrensburger TSV
description: The Ahrensburger TSV Saint Nicholas Run is a traditional running event held annually in Ahrensburg in Forst Hagen. The race is open to various age groups, from children to masters, and offers a sporting opportunity in the run-up to Christmas. Organized by Ahrensburger TSV, the event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and the sporting challenge of running outside the stadium.
course_highlights: Route through Forst Hagen, Ahrensburg
Various categories, from children to masters
Traditional Saint Nicholas Run held in December
additional: The entry fee is paid when collecting race materials on the day of the event.

name: Sport-Tahedl-Nikolauslauf
location: Stadion am Oberen Wöhrd, Regensburg, Germany
description: The Sport-Tahedl-Nikolauslauf in Regensburg is a traditional running event taking place on December 6, 2026, at the Stadion am Oberen Wöhrd. Courses of 10 km and 5 km are offered, suitable for both ambitious and recreational runners. The event is organized by LG TELIS FINANZ Regensburg and offers an attractive running opportunity in the run-up to Christmas. Participants can look forward to a well-organized event with live results.
course_highlights: 10 km and 5 km distances
Start and finish at the Stadion am Oberen Wöhrd
Event in the historic city of Regensburg
additional: Live results are available; the event is part of the 2026 race calendar of LG TELIS FINANZ Regensburg.

name: Testlauf 41. OPTIMA Dreikönigslauf
organizer: Turn- und Sportgemeinde Schwäbisch Hall e. V.
description: The 41st OPTIMA Epiphany Run in Schwäbisch Hall is the largest sporting event in the district and traditionally takes place on January 6. The city run covers 5 km and 10 km through the historic old town and the Ackeranlagen, accompanied by professional commentators and an enthusiastic crowd. The event is open to runners of all ages and ability levels and offers a festive atmosphere with Guggenmusik and dance groups. After crossing the finish line, all participants receive a finisher medal, which can be engraved on site.
course_highlights: City run through the historic old town of Schwäbisch Hall
The route passes through the picturesque Ackeranlagen
Entertainment along the route with Guggenmusik and dance groups
additional: Race numbers will be sent by email from 30.12.2026. Race pack collection is available on 4 January 2027 at Intersport Schoell and on 6 January 2027 at the Blendstatthalle. DKL technical shirts are available to the first 1,700 registrants. With every registration, €1 is donated to the association Help! Wir helfen! e.V. The meeting point is in the market square in front of the town hall. Pacers are available for various target paces from 4:00 to 8:00 minutes per kilometer.

name: Winterlauf-/Wanderserie TuS Jaderberg 1.Teil
description: The TuS Jaderberg Winter Running and Walking Series is a popular event held annually in Jaderberg. The first part of the series takes place in November and gives runners and walkers the opportunity to enjoy some friendly sporting competition in a welcoming community. The event is known for its wintry atmosphere and the support of TuS Jaderberg, which organizes the series. Participants can look forward to a well-organized event in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Wintry running and walking routes
A community experience
Part of a popular series in Jaderberg

name: 16. Steinhuder Meer Marathon

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgebühr: 10 Euro, (5 Euro für Teilnehmer der Adventskalender Challenge 2026)

description: The 16th Steinhuder Meer Marathon is a non-competitive event in the Schaumburger Land, designed as an individual health and training session. The route is a loop around Lake Steinhude and starts at the car park in Hagenburg. The event is for runners who wish to complete a valid marathon in accordance with the counting rules of the 100 Marathon Club Deutschland, either alone or in small groups. The field is limited to a maximum of 14 participants. There is no official timing system; participants report their own times.
course_highlights: Loop around Lake Steinhude
Start and finish at the car park in Hagenburg
The flat route follows paved paths by the water and passes through fields, meadows, and forest trails
additional: Participants must bring their own refreshments. There are no showers or toilets on site. Participants time themselves and must send their times to the organizer by email or WhatsApp. The time limit is six hours, plus the organizer’s allowance. The minimum number of participants is 3 runners. Start at 09:00.

name: 22. Bieg Barbórkowy - Rybnik
description: Bieg Barbórkowy is an annual road race in Rybnik organised by MOSiR Rybnik. The 22nd edition takes place on 6 December 2026 on a certified 10 km course. It is the fourth and final race of the 9th Rybnik Running Grand Prix, together with Bieg Wiosny, the Rybnik Moon Half Marathon and Kamień Extreme. The event is part of the MOSiR Rybnik Klub programme.
course_highlights: Certified 10 km course
Final race of the 9th Rybnik Running Grand Prix
Discounts with the Rybka card
additional: Online entries close on 29 November 2026, and up to 30 places are available at the race office on race day from 9:00 to 11:15. The entry fee is 90 zł to 180 zł depending on payment date, or 72 zł to 144 zł with the Rybka card.

name: Festiwal Biegów Świętych Mikołajów – XXIV Półmaraton Świętych Mikołajów
description: The Festival of Santa Claus Runs in Toruń is a Christmas-themed race that the organiser calls the biggest in Poland. The 24th edition takes place on 6 December 2026, starting at 12:00 near the Old Town Market Square and finishing at the City Stadium on ul. Bema 23/29. Distances are half marathon, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km and 5 km nordic walking, plus virtual runs. The organiser is the Maraton Toruński physical culture association.
course_highlights: Start by the Old Town Market Square, finish at the City Stadium
Half marathon, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km and 5 km nordic walking
Polish team championship in the Santa Claus half marathon
additional: The race office is at the MOSiR tennis courts, ul. Szosa Chełmińska 75B, on 5 December from 15:00 to 20:30 and on 6 December from 8:00 to 11:00. Online entry costs 170 zł (5 km) to 220 zł, and 250 zł in cash at the race office. Finishers get a medal, hot soup with bread and hot tea.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a series of 5 km runs in forest settings, and in Katowice the race is held in the State Forests of the Katowice forest district. The finish is at the Rybaczówka centre by Janina pond, with the start about 700 m away inside the forest. The course is always the same, so runners can compare their results across races and seasons. CITY TRAIL Junior runs take place before the main race. The race on 6 December 2026 is the second of four rounds of the 2026/2027 season in Katowice.
course_highlights: Fixed 5 km course in the Katowice forest district
Finish at the Rybaczówka centre by Janina pond
CITY TRAIL Junior runs from about 200 m to 1 km
additional: The race office is open from 8:30 to 10:30 and the main race starts at 11:00. There is no road access near the start and race office; park on ul. Karolinki by the Staszic-Wujek mine, under a kilometre away.

name: II Bieg Mikołajkowy
description: II Bieg Mikołajkowy in Gorenice is organised by the Srebrna Dziesiątka association and the Gorenice volunteer fire brigade. The main run is about 5 km on the course known from the previous edition, with a 5 km nordic walking race as well. Children's runs from 100 m to 300 m take place on the stadium. The base is the Leśnik Gorenice stadium. The event is under the patronage of the Olkusz county head.
course_highlights: Main run of about 5 km with a small climb
5 km nordic walking race
Children's runs from 100 m to 300 m on the stadium
additional: The limit is 200 runners in the main race and 50 children. Online entry costs 70 zł for the run or nordic walking and 40 zł for a children's run, and 80 zł and 50 zł on race day. Online registration is open until 27 November 2026.

name: W pogoni za św. Mikołajem
description: W pogoni za św. Mikołajem (Chasing St Nicholas) is a 7 km Christmas run organised by Radio Wrocław in Millennium Park (Park Tysiąclecia) in Wrocław. The 2026 edition takes place on Sunday 6 December with an 11:30 start. The run is recreational and festive, and runners wear Santa hats. Finishers receive a medal and a hot meal.
course_highlights: 7 km run in Millennium Park
Festive atmosphere and Santa hats
Medal and hot meal at the finish
additional: The field is capped at 250 runners and the time limit is 1 hour. The race is for runners aged 18 and over. Online registration closes on 2 December 2026 at 23:59, and there is no race-day entry. The race office opens on race day at the start, address ul. Karkonoska 10.

name: XIV Bieg Mikołajkowy
description: The 14th St Nicholas Run in Police takes place on Sunday 6 December 2026. It is organised by the BiegamBoLubię Team Police association. The main race over 5 or 10 km starts at 12:00 from the OSiR stadium at ul. Piaskowa 97, and the course follows forest paths. A 5 km Nordic walk starts at 12:10, and children's races and a Christmas tree relay are held earlier. Every runner gets a Santa hat for the race and a Christmas medal at the finish.
course_highlights: 5 or 10 km on forest paths
Start and finish at the OSiR stadium in Police
Christmas Dream Relay carrying Christmas trees
additional: Schedule: 8:00 race office opens, 10:00 children's races, 11:30 Dream Relay, 12:00 main race, 12:10 Nordic walking, 13:30 prize giving. The race office is at Primary School no. 8, ul. Piaskowa 99 (5 December 11:00-15:00, 6 December 8:00-11:30). Entry costs 85 to 120 zł (110 to 130 zł with a shirt) depending on the date, and the field is capped at 800. Online registration closes on 30 November 2026; after that, entry is only at the race office if places remain.

name: XV Grand Prix Krakowa w biegach górskich – Bieg Mikołajkowy
location: Szkoła Podstawowa nr 72, al. Modrzewiowa 23, Kraków
organizer: Grand Prix Krakowa w Biegach Górskich
description: The St Nicholas Run is the second stage of the 15th Kraków Mountain Running Grand Prix, held on Sunday 6 December 2026. There are four distances: Harda Dwudziestka Trójka (23.2 km, start 9:00), Przyjazna Trójka (3.7 km, 9:40), Tradycyjna Piątka (5.7 km, 10:45) and Ambitna Jedenastka (11.6 km, 11:00). A Vertical race and a GPS challenge are held on Saturday 5 December, and children's races on Sunday. The race centre with office, changing rooms, buffet and bag storage is at Primary School no. 72, aleja Modrzewiowa 23.
course_highlights: Four distances from 3.7 to 23.2 km
Vertical GPK on Saturday 5 December
Children's races in several age groups
additional: Single-race entry depends on distance and date: 55 to 80 zł for 3.7 km, 80 to 100 zł for 5.7 km, 80 to 110 zł for 11.6 km and 90 to 120 zł for 23.2 km; the children's race costs 25-30 zł. Children, youth and seniors 65+ get discounts. Single-race entries are capped at 100 per distance. The race office is open only on Sunday 6 December, 8:00-11:00.

name: Mikołajkowy Bieg Świerzawy
organizer: Centrum Kultury, Sportu i Turystyki w Świerzawie
description: Bieg Mikołajkowy in Świerzawa is organised by the Świerzawa Culture, Sport and Tourism Centre together with the local school. Start and finish are on the market square in Świerzawa. Adults aged 16 and over run about 6 km, which is 8 laps, while children and youth run 400 m and 720 m. The race is held together with the Christmas market. In 2026 the adult race starts on 6 December at 10:30.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the market square in Świerzawa
Adult race of about 6 km over 8 laps
Children's and youth runs over 400 m and 720 m
additional: Entries are taken by the CKSiT office until 4 December 2026 or at the race office on race day from 9:00 to 9:55. The entry fee is 30 zł, paid at the race office.

name: XXIII Memoriał  Stefana Mielczarka
organizer: TKKF Jaworzanie, OSiR w Jaworze, LO Jawor
description: The Stefan Mielczarek Memorial is a road race in Jawor in memory of Stefan Mielczarek, an honorary citizen of the town. The 23rd edition takes place on 6 December 2026 at 11:00, with start and finish at the I LO high school, ul. Kościuszki 8. The course is 5.6 km, two laps of 2.8 km through the town streets, including the market square. It is organised by TKKF Jaworzanie, OSiR Jawor and LO Jawor. A St Nicholas run for children and youth starts at 10:30.
course_highlights: 5.6 km, two laps of 2.8 km
Course through Jawor including the market square
Start and finish at I LO, ul. Kościuszki 8
additional: Entry is 70 zł until 2 December 2026 and 90 zł after that and on race day. The field is capped at 120, and online registration closes on 2 December 2026 at 12:00. The race office at LO Jawor opens on race day from 9:00 to 10:30. Runners must be at least 16.

name: Bieg Mikołajkowy Radia Wrocław
description: Bieg Mikołajkowy Radia Wrocław is a festive running event in Tysiąclecia Park in Wrocław, on ul. Graniczna. There are two distances to choose from, 2 km and 7 km, and the organisers stress that records do not matter, only joy and having fun together. The race pack includes a specially designed Santa running cap, and a medal and a hot meal await at the finish.
course_highlights: Two distances: 2 km and 7 km
Specially designed Santa running cap in the race pack
Medal and hot food at the finish
additional: The 2 km race starts at 10:30 (100 runners, 40 min time limit), the 7 km at 11:30 (200 runners, 60 min time limit, age 18+). Race packs are collected on race day at the race office in Tysiąclecia Park. No entries at the race office.

name: I Uliczny Bieg Mikołajkowy
organizer: Urząd Miejski w Nidzicy, MOSiR w Nidzicy, Stowarzyszenie Nidzica Biega
description: The 1st St. Nicholas Street Run is a 5 km road race in Nidzica. The course consists of two 2.5 km laps along Plac Wolności, Warszawska, Kraszewskiego, Kolejowa and Kościuszki streets, with restricted vehicular traffic. The start, finish and race office are located at Plac Wolności. Participants must be at least 13 years old, and the participant limit is 150. The first edition will take place on December 6, 2026, at 10:00.
