course_highlights: Two 2.5 km laps through the streets of Nidzica
Start and finish at Plac Wolności
Every kilometre marked
additional: The race package includes a Santa hat, a race bib and a chip, and everyone who finishes the race will receive a medal. The time limit is 50 minutes. On race day, registration is possible only for any spots that become available.

name: II Górski Bieg Mikołajkowy
location: Altany i Amfiteatr nad Czarnym Potokiem, Rymanów-Zdrój
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Rymanowie
description: II Górski Bieg Mikołajkowy in Rymanów-Zdrój is a mountain run and nordic walking race of about 7 km. The course runs through the hills of Rymanów municipality with about 230 m of climbing. Start and finish are at the arbours and amphitheatre by the Czarny Potok stream. There is also a category for children and youth up to 16. The race takes place on 6 December 2026 at 11:00.
course_highlights: Mountain course of about 7 km with about 230 m of climbing
Start and finish by the Czarny Potok stream in Rymanów-Zdrój
Run and nordic walking race
additional: The time limit is 2 hours. Participants receive a medal, a recovery meal and hot drinks, and runners are encouraged to wear Santa-themed outfits. Entry costs 50 zł online and 60 zł on race day if places remain.

name: Mikołajkowy Charytatywny Bieg i Marsz NW
description: The Charity St Nicholas Run and Nordic Walk is a cross-country run and Nordic walking event in Bielawki, Pelplin municipality, organised by the Pelplin Sports Centre. Start and finish are near the Bielawki forester's lodge, and the race is held on a 3.5 km loop. Participants choose a 7 or 3.5 km run or a 7 or 3.5 km Nordic walk. The 2026 edition takes place on Sunday 6 December with a 12:00 start. Every year the event raises money for residents of the Pelplin municipality in need.
course_highlights: 3.5 km loop near the Bielawki forester's lodge
Run and Nordic walking over 7 or 3.5 km
Charity event for residents of the Pelplin municipality
additional: The entry fee is 10 zł and the field is capped at 450 paid entries. Online registration is open until 3 December 2026 at 23:59. Participants should be in the start area by 11:50. The detailed course will be posted at facebook.com/biegpelplin at least 7 days before the race.

name: Bieg Mikołajkowy
organizer: Biblioteka Publiczna i Centrum Animacji Kultury w Dusznikach
description: The St. Nicholas Run in Duszniki Wielkopolskie is an annual sporting event organized by the Public Library and Cultural Animation Center. The event combines sporting competition with the atmosphere of the approaching holidays, encouraging people to spend time together with family and friends. The run takes place in the city, promoting physical activity and local winter traditions.

name: IX Bieg Pamięci Trenera Emila Wzorka
location: Stadion Lekkoatletyczny im. Trenera Emila Wzorka, Tarnów, Poland
description: The 9th Emil Wzorek Memorial Run is an annual running event held at the Emil Wzorek Athletics Stadium in Tarnów. The race takes place on December 6, 2026, and commemorates the contributions of coach Emil Wzorek. The organizers provide comprehensive event management, electronic timing, and social activities for participants and spectators. The event is open to various age groups, and participants are required to read the regulations and consent to the processing of their personal data.
course_highlights: A flat route of approximately 10 km
Approximately 95% asphalt and 5% paved road
Start and finish at the athletics stadium
additional: The race office is open from 9:30 to 11:30 in Tarnów. Participants must accept the regulations and privacy policy and consent to the processing of their personal data and image. The children’s and youth races will take place at the stadium over distances of 100 m, 250 m, 500 m, and 800 m. The main race uses electronic timing and has a 90-minute time limit.

name: XV Grand Prix Krakowa w biegach górskich – Wielkie Otwarcie
location: Szkoła Podstawowa, al. Modrzewiowa 23, Kraków, Poland
organizer: Grand Prix Krakowa w Biegach Górskich
description: The 15th Krakow Grand Prix in Mountain Running is a series of mountain races held in Krakow, offering a range of distances from 3.7 km to 23.2 km, as well as a Vertical race and races for children. The event features scenic routes of varying difficulty, inviting both recreational and experienced runners to take on the challenge. It is a recurring anniversary event, with a wide range of individual and team categories, as well as special competitions, including one for uniformed services. After the races, participants can use the buffet and water stations at the event center located at Primary School, al. Modrzewiowa 23.
course_highlights: Distances: 3.7 km, 5.7 km, 11.6 km, 23.2 km, and a 1.5 km Vertical race
Scenic mountain routes of varying difficulty
Special races for children and a competition for uniformed services
additional: The GPS competition takes place the day before the main race (December 5). A buffet and water stations are available after the St. Nicholas Day Run. The start and finish are located at Primary School, al. Modrzewiowa 23 in Krakow. Races for children and special categories for uniformed services and teams are also organized during the event. The St. Nicholas Day Run event center is at Primary School, al. Modrzewiowa 23 in Krakow.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 12. kolo
description: Beh 2 míle Bratislava is a regular 2-mile (3.218 km) running race organized by Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team at the Kuchajda swimming pool grounds in Bratislava. The race is open to a wide range of categories, including children, juniors, women, men, and veterans. Registration takes place on site from 9:30, and the race starts at 10:00. The event is part of a series in which runners earn points toward the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team Challenge Cup, with finishing times adjusted using age coefficients based on year of birth.
course_highlights: Course length: 2 miles (3.218 km); children: approx. 200 m
Venue: Kuchajda swimming pool grounds, Bratislava
Check-in beside the volleyball court
additional: Registration takes place on site beside the volleyball court from 9:30. Categories are children (13 and under), juniors, women, men, female veterans, and male veterans. Competitors are awarded points based on the number of participants in their categories; junior men and junior women are scored separately. In the event of a tie, year of birth and the best time that year determine the result. An amnesty is granted for two participations, in which the two months with the lowest point totals are discarded. Races take place in several rounds throughout the year, including the 12th round in December. On-site registration is available; pricing details are not specified, and the course is mostly asphalt in an urban setting.

name: Mikulášsky nočný výbeh na rozhľadňu na Balážke
location: Základná škola Hviezdoslavova, Lipany, Prešov, Slovakia
description: The Mikuláš Night Run to the Balážka lookout tower is an adrenaline-fueled night race for participants over 15 years old. The event starts at 19:00 from Hviezdoslavova Primary School in Lipany. Runners can look forward to a unique nighttime experience with views from the lookout tower. The entry fee is a minimum of €7, and participants must register.
course_highlights: A night run with an adrenaline-fueled atmosphere
The route leads to the Balážka lookout tower
The event is for participants over 15 years old
additional: This is a unique nighttime event with a minimum entry fee of €7. Participants must be over 15 years old.

name: Nitrianska bežecká liga – 12. kolo
location: Entrance to the summer swimming pool, Mestský park na Sihoti, Nitra, Slovakia
price_range: 5 € za hlavný beh; detské behy zdarma
description: The Nitra Running League – Round 12 is a running event held in Nitra, in Sihoť City Park by the entrance to the summer swimming pool. The race takes place on a 5 km asphalt course and is suitable for a wide range of age groups, from juniors to seniors. The event also includes children’s races over distances of 50 to 1,000 metres, with no entry fee and small prizes. After the races, a raffle is held, and the league’s best runners are honoured at an awards ceremony.
course_highlights: A 5 km asphalt course
Children’s races divided by age groups from 0 to 15 years
The race takes place in Sihoť City Park by the entrance to the summer swimming pool
additional: After the races, a raffle is held for all participants in the main race; the league’s best runners are honoured at an awards ceremony. Age categories range from juniors (16–18 years) to men over 70. Children’s races are divided by age, with different course distances ranging from 50 m for toddlers to 1,000 m for schoolchildren. Children’s categories are divided by age from 0 to 15 years. The first three finishers in each category are announced, and a raffle is held after the main race.

name: Beh 2 míle
location: Park Ostredky or Kuchajda swimming pool grounds, Bratislava, Slovakia
description: The 2 Miles Run Bratislava is a running series organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team, held in Bratislava at Park Ostredky and the Kuchajda swimming pool grounds. The race is run on a paved road course measuring 2 miles (3.22 km), and also includes children’s races. The series features a points competition for a perpetual trophy, with points awarded in each round based on participation and placing. Entry is free, allowing the general public to take part without financial burden. Check-in and registration take place on site before the races.
course_highlights: A 2-mile (3.22 km) course on paved roads
The races take place in the pleasant surroundings of Park Ostredky and the Kuchajda swimming pool grounds
Children’s races are also held: 200 m for children under 13
additional: Check-in and registration take place on site behind Komunitné námestie from 9:30. Parking is available in the large car park on Sputniková Street or near OC Budúcnosť. The nearest public transport stops are Súmračná, Clementisova and Maximiliána Hella. There are no public toilets in the park.

name: Mikuláš behá v Jame
location: Park Jama, Nové Mesto, Bratislava, Slovakia

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Nižbor
price_range: 390 Kč za závod, 1 900 Kč za 6 závodů, 2 900 Kč za celou sérii

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Voucher na celou sérii 12 běhů = 2 900 Kč (240 Kč/závod)

description: Běžecká série Berounka je série 12 závodů v krásném okolí řeky Berounky od Radotína po Nižbor, která probíhá od ledna do prosince 2026. Trasy vedou po trailech s nádhernými výhledy a různorodým terénem, často v blízkosti přírodních rezervací a historických míst. Série je vhodná jak pro zkušené běžce, tak pro začátečníky, a jejím cílem je motivovat k pravidelnému běhání. Starty jsou většinou v dostupných místech s vlakovým spojením a zázemím v místních hospůdkách. Na konci série probíhá vyhlášení vítězů a předání cen v 12 kategoriích.
course_highlights: Trasy vedou po trailech s výhledy na řeku Berounku a CHKO Český kras
Náročné stoupání a přírodní rezervace, například Klapice a Radotínské skály
Starty v dostupných místech s vlakovým spojením a zázemím v místních hospůdkách
additional: Na místě závodů je možnost občerstvení, úschovy věcí, šatny se sprchou a startovní čísla. Doporučuje se přinést čelovku. Pořadí se hodnotí na základě 10 nejlepších bodovaných závodů v sérii. Starty jsou většinou v blízkosti vlakových stanic a v místních hospůdkách, které poskytují zázemí. Trailové závody v okolí Berounky, start převážně v dostupnosti vlaku, vyhlášení vítězů v prosinci, 12 kategorií, bodování nejlepších 10 závodů

name: Prosincový běh Smetanovými sady Olomouc
location: Hudební pavilon, Smetanovy sady, Olomouc, Česko
description: Prosincový běh Smetanovými sady Olomouc je závod dlouhý 6,55 km, který vede po asfaltovém okruhu dlouhém 1,3 km v krásném prostředí Smetanových sadů v Olomouci. Závod je součástí Olomoucké běžecké ligy a nabízí příležitost pro běžce všech úrovní vyzkoušet si běh v příjemném městském parku. Trasa je vhodná pro rychlý běh po asfaltu a je ideální pro zimní běžecké aktivity v přírodě blízko centra města.
course_highlights: Délka závodu 6,55 km po asfaltovém okruhu 1,3 km
Okruh vede malebným parkem Smetanovy sady v Olomouci
Součást Olomoucké běžecké ligy

name: 42. Lippesee Marathon
location: Parkplatz beim Gut Lippesee, Paderborn-Sande, Paderborn, Germany
price_range: Keine Startgebühr; eine Spende von 5 € wird erbeten

late_fee.price: Spende von 5 € vor dem Start erbeten

description: The 42nd Lippesee Marathon takes place in Paderborn-Sande at the parking lot by Gut Lippesee. The course consists of seven large loops of 6.1 km each, for a total of 42.7 km. The event is held in accordance with the rules of the 100 Marathon Club Germany and is a private race with a participant limit of 15. Timing is by hand stopwatch, and each completed loop is rewarded with a certificate. There is no official timekeeping, and runners provide their own refreshments, as they pass their cars after every loop.
course_highlights: Seven loops of 6.1 km around Lippesee
The course is measured using a measuring wheel and GPS watch
The course is additionally marked depending on the weather
additional: Timing is by hand stopwatch; a photo of the watch on race day must be sent by email as proof. Showers and changing facilities are not available on site. Participants must be at least 18 years old; the minimum number of participants is 5. The course can be very busy in good weather. Runners provide their own refreshments and timing is manual; the certificate is sent by email. The participant limit is 15, and at least five participants are required.

name: Winter Milada Run
description: WINTER Milada Run je zimní běžecký závod konaný v unikátní krajině bývalého hnědouhelného dolu, který se proměnil v krásné přírodní prostředí jezera Milada na rozmezí Krušných hor a Českého středohoří. Závod se koná 12. prosince 2026 v Chabařovicích a nabízí trasy 12,5 km a 5,3 km, včetně dětských závodů Olympia. Akce je zakončením běžecké sezóny na severu Čech a každoročně přitahuje stovky běžců do kouzelné zasněžené a ledové krajiny jezera. Všechny závody mají rodinnou a přátelskou atmosféru a jsou vhodné pro děti, rodiny i dospělé závodníky.
course_highlights: Trasy vedou v přírodním prostředí bývalého hnědouhelného dolu přeměněného na jezero Milada
Zimní běh v zasněžené a ledové krajině jezera Milada
Dvě hlavní trasy: dlouhá 12,5 km a krátká 5,3 km, plus dětské závody
additional: Startovní balíček a medaile pro všechny závodníky. Oficiální tričko Milada Tour 2026 je možné objednat při registraci a vyzvednout v den závodu. Dětské tričko obdrží zdarma prvních 100 přihlášených dětí. Kapacita závodu je omezena na 500 závodníků. Doprovodný program zahrnuje Mikuláše, čerta a anděla a Olympia dětský koutek. Terén v oblasti bývalého dolu, zimní/ledové podmínky, rodinné a dětské kategorie, registrace na místě, medaile pro všechny účastníky, oficiální trička k zakoupení.

name: Mikulášský běh Úpice
description: Mikulášský běh v Úpici je tradiční běžecký závod pořádaný tělovýchovnou jednotou Maratonstav Úpice. Závod se koná na náměstí v Úpici a nabízí kategorie pro děti i dospělé. Startovní číslo platí na celý seriál závodů pořádaných organizátorem. Akce je vhodná pro všechny věkové kategorie a běžce různých úrovní.
course_highlights: Start a cíl na náměstí v Úpici u divadla A. Jiráska
Kategorie pro děti i dospělé s oddělenými starty
Přátelská atmosféra a možnost účasti v seriálu závodů
additional: Kancelář závodu je otevřena jednu hodinu před startem první kategorie. Konec prezentace je v 13:30 hod pro dětské kategorie a ve 14:00 hod pro dospělé. Startovní číslo platí na celý seriál závodů a je nutné ho mít u sebe na každý další závod. Výsledky nejsou vyhlašovány po jednotlivých závodech, ale jsou zveřejňovány na webu pořadatele. Závod se koná 12. prosince 2026 na náměstí v Úpici, start je naplánován na 14:00 pro děti a 14:30 pro dospělé, registrace probíhá hodinu před startem, výsledky jsou zveřejňovány online.

name: Zručský adventní běh
location: Zruč nad Sázavou, Středočeský kraj, Česko
description: Zručský adventní běh se uskuteční posedmé 12. prosince 2026 a má nadační i závodní charakter. Cílem závodu je motivovat více lidí ke sportu, pomoci potřebným a nabídnout účastníkům uvolnění od předvánočního stresu při běhu vánočně nasvícenou Zručí. Trať vede krásným zámeckým parkem a okolím s vánoční atmosférou, kterou si lze prohlédnout i ve videu nebo stáhnout ve formátu GPX pro chytré hodinky. Po závodě je připravena teplá polévka a svařené víno pro příjemné zakončení akce.
course_highlights: Běh vánočně nasvícenou Zručí
Trasa vede zámeckým parkem a okolím s vánoční atmosférou
Možnost stáhnout GPX soubor trasy pro chytré hodinky
additional: Závod má nadační charakter a po běhu je pro účastníky připravena teplá polévka a svařené víno. Absolutní vítěz a vítězka mají rekordní čas 19:10. Trať je vánočně nasvícená a atmosféra je podpořena vánoční výzdobou. Akce nabízí dvě trasy dlouhé 900 m a 5500 m, je určena pro děti i dospělé, a je spojena s vánoční atmosférou a možností stažení GPX souboru s trasou.

name: Mikulášský běh Petřkovice
location: Stadion MK Seitl, Petřkovice u Starého Jičína, Moravian-Silesian Region, Česko
description: Mikulášský běh Petřkovice je tradiční závod konající se v obci Petřkovice u Starého Jičína v Moravskoslezském kraji. Tato akce je součástí Okresní běžecké ligy a vítá běžce všech úrovní, kteří si chtějí užít sportovní atmosféru v předvánočním období. Přesné délky tratí a podrobnosti o registraci zatím nejsou zveřejněny, avšak závod je pravidelnou součástí regionálního běžeckého kalendáře. Je to skvělá příležitost spojit sport s komunitním zážitkem a oslavit blížící se Vánoce aktivním způsobem.
course_highlights: Začlenění do Okresní běžecké ligy
Tradiční předvánoční atmosféra
Vhodné pro běžce všech úrovní
additional: Závod se koná 12. prosince 2026, v okolí stadionu MK Seitl v Petřkovicích, a je součástí regionálního běžeckého kalendáře.

name: Předvánoční běh
description: Předvánoční běh je tradiční běžecký závod s historií sahající do roku 1984, pořádaný v Frýdku-Místku. Závod nabízí tratě pro mládež i dospělé, přičemž mládež běhá asfaltové okruhy v areálu stadiónu od 180 metrů do 1,7 km. Dospělí běží na kilometrových okruzích, muži 8 km a ženy 3 km, s možností různých délek v areálu stadiónu. Závod je vhodný pro širokou veřejnost a je součástí atletického kalendáře TJ Slezan Frýdek-Místek.
course_highlights: Asfaltové okruhy v areálu stadiónu pro mládež od 180 m do 1,7 km
Kilometrové okruhy ve Starém Městě pro dospělé - muži 8 km, ženy 3 km
Historie závodu od roku 1984 s dlouholetou tradicí
additional: Běh v areálu stadionu s možností registrace na místě, občerstvení v klubovně stadionu, různé tratě od 200 m do 8 km

name: Vranovský noční Trail
location: Samovýčep, Vranov u Brna, South Moravian Region, Česko
description: Vranovský noční trail je zimní závod běžený za tmy v okolí Vranova u Brna, který nabízí náročnou, ale krásnou trať. Závod symbolizuje rovnováhu mezi dnem a nocí a je prvním skutečným běžeckým testem nové sezóny. Start i cíl jsou v areálu Samovýčep, kde je zázemí s vyhřátým stanem, teplou kávou a čajem. Po závodě je připraveno teplé italské jídlo, svařák a afterparty s pohodovou atmosférou. Organizátoři kladou důraz na kvalitní občerstvení a přátelskou atmosféru, kterou si závodníci užívají i po doběhu.
course_highlights: Trať dlouhá 21,3 km v Podkomorských lesích a okolí přehrady
Značení trati červenobílou a žlutou páskou a reflexním sprejem
Závod běžený v zimě a za tmy s náročným terénem
additional: Zázemí závodu v prostoru Samovýčepu s vyhřátým stanem, teplou kávou a čajem. Na trati je dostatek vody a iontových nápojů. Po závodě teplé italské jídlo, svařák a afterparty s možností zpětné vazby a společného posezení. Čelovka je nutností. Zázemí nabízí vyhřátý stan, teplou kávu a čaj, teplé jídlo po závodě a afterparty.

name: CHRISTMAS RUN Praha
location: Rudolfinum, náměstí Jana Palacha, Prague, Česko
description: Christmas Run Praha je zážitkový noční běh na 5 km, který se koná v centru Prahy před Rudolfinem. Akce je součástí série INTERSPORT Christmas Run a nabízí také dětský závod a charitativní běh Fénix Run. Běh je doprovázen vánoční atmosférou, rozcvičkou se Santou a možností zakoupit si červenou čepici "SANTA". Závod je vhodný pro běžce od 12 let a více, mladší mohou startovat s písemným souhlasem zákonného zástupce.
course_highlights: Trať vede centrem Prahy před Rudolfinem
Noční běh s vánoční atmosférou a rozcvičkou se Santou
Možnost zakoupit červenou čepici "SANTA" jako součást akce
additional: Přihlásit se mohou osoby od 12 let, mladší 15 let pouze s písemným souhlasem zákonného zástupce. Registrace je platná až po připsání startovného na účet pořadatele. Po naplnění kapacity závodů není možná další registrace. Součástí balíčku je taška s dárky od partnerů akce. Dětský běh měří 1 km a děti mohou běžet s rodiči. Fénix Run měří 2 km a jeho výtěžek je určen na podporu neziskových organizací. Účastníci hlavního závodu dostávají v cíli medaili.

name: Běh okolo náměšťského zámku
location: Náměšť na Hané, Olomouc District, Olomouc Region, Česko
description: Běh okolo náměšťského zámku je tradiční běžecký závod pořádaný TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, který nabízí běžcům možnost zažít krásy okolí Náměště na Hané. Klub se specializuje na kondiční a výkonnostní běh a pořádá řadu vytrvalostních závodů v Olomouckém kraji. Závod je součástí běžeckých akcí střední Moravy a vítá běžce všech úrovní, kteří chtějí poměřit své síly v malebném prostředí. Organizace klade důraz na přátelskou atmosféru a podporu běžecké komunity.
course_highlights: Okolí Náměště na Hané s výhledem na zámek
Tradiční vytrvalostní běžecký závod v Olomouckém kraji
Malebné přírodní a historické prostředí
additional: V minulém ročníku bylo startovní místo v areálu KVS Náměšť na Hané; termín a místo pro ročník 2026 nejsou v dostupných údajích potvrzeny.

name: Adventscrosslauf
description: The Wilscher Advent Cross-Country Run Gifhorn is a traditional cross-country race held during Advent in Gifhorn, Lower Saxony. The main distance is 7.5 km and runs through the winter landscape of the Wilsche district. The race starts at 14:00 at the meeting point at An der Masch 4. The event is organised by VfR Wilsche/Neubokel, and the entry fee is 7 euros.
course_highlights: Cross-country run through the winter landscape of Gifhorn-Wilsche
Main distance: 7.5 km
Start and meeting point at An der Masch 4
additional: The meeting point and start are at An der Masch 4 in the Wilsche district of Gifhorn. Typical December weather includes temperatures around 3 °C and snow cover on most days. The race starts at 14:00, with the meeting point at An der Masch 4 in Gifhorn. Registration is via the club website. The event is a lovely opportunity to enjoy the Advent season in an active and sociable way.

name: Alten-Busecker Winterlaufserie - 2. Event
description: The Alten-Buseck Winter Running Series is a traditional running event organised by TSG Alten-Buseck. It includes several races over different distances, including 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, 15 km and the half marathon (21.1 km). The races take place during the colder months and offer a great opportunity to enjoy the winter landscape around Alten-Buseck together with other runners. The event is open to all ages and ability levels, with special races for children and young people. After crossing the finish line, participants can enjoy refreshments, followed by an awards ceremony for the fastest runners.
course_highlights: Courses over 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, 15 km and 21.1 km
Start and finish at Harbig Halle in Alten-Buseck
Winter running routes; the course may be changed because of construction work
additional: Timing is provided using passive transponders from Raceresult. The awards ceremony takes place after the races, with awards for the three fastest participants of the day (men/women) and age-group winners. Certificates, results and photos are available online. After crossing the finish line, participants receive a free refreshing drink; coffee and cake are available for purchase. Toilets, showers and changing facilities are available at Harbig Halle. Parking at Harbig Halle is limited. The Bambini run starts at approximately 14:15 (December only). Distance options: 700 m and 15 km; the event is expected to take place in winter conditions; start location: Alten-Buseck, Buseck.

name: Bühlerzeller Winterlauf
distance_verbose: 10 km, 6.5 km, 5 km, 4.5 km, 3000 Meter, 0.9 km
description: The Bühlerzell Winter Run is an established winter running event in Bühlerzell, Germany, organized by Sportfreunde Bühlerzell. With at least 21 editions, the event offers various distances from 900 m to 10 km, including 3 km, 5 km, and 6.5 km. The program is aimed at younger runners, beginners, and experienced road runners, and takes place in typical December weather, with courses usually covered in snow.
course_highlights: Various distances from 900 m to 10 km
Winter running conditions with snow
Start and finish in Bühlerzell
additional: The event offers very short races alongside the 10 km race to include a range of runner groups. Typical December weather, with temperatures around 3 °C and frequent snowfall, shapes the event. Races over various distances, including walking, take place in winter in Bühlerzell; typical temperatures are around 3°C. Check details with the organizer before registering.

name: Ellewicker Adventslauf
price_range: 4 Euro für Kinder- und Schülerlauf, Nachmeldegebühr 2 Euro
description: The Ellewick Advent Run is a traditional running event in Vreden-Ellewick, held annually in December. It offers a 1.5 km children’s and students’ race and a 5 km race, both run over two laps. The event is family-friendly and supported by a dedicated organizing team. It gives runners of all ages the opportunity to get active and enjoy the Advent season together.
course_highlights: 1.5 km children’s/students’ race over 2 laps
5 km race over 2 laps
Route through the built-up area of Ellewick
additional: Photos and videos are taken during the event and used for press coverage and social media. Participant data is used to evaluate the race and can be deleted on request.

name: Jahresendlauf
location: Bad Berka, Weimarer Land, Thuringia, Germany
price_range: bis 16 Jahren: 4,00 EUR, ab 17 Jahren: 8,00 EUR, zusätzliche Servicegebühr bei Anmeldung am Tag vor Ort

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: bis 16 Jahren: 4,00 Euro bei Vor-Anmeldung im Portal

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: ab 17 Jahren: 8,00 EUR bei Vor-Anmeldung im Portal

description: The year-end run in Bad Berka is a traditional running event held every December. The routes pass through the scenic Dreiteichs, Dammbachs and Kohlgrund areas on paved, gravel and forest roads. The event offers various distances, including a free 400 m mini-run for children and longer distances for young people and adults. It is open to all running enthusiasts and is organized by the sports club Spielvereinigung Bad Berka e.V.
course_highlights: Routes through the Dreiteichs, Dammbachs and Kohlgrund areas
Paved, gravel and forest roads
Start and finish at Ilmtalstadion Bad Berka
additional: The 400 m mini-run is free. On-site registration is available on race day, with an additional service fee (€1.00 up to age 16, €2.00 from age 17) and cash payment only. Changing rooms and showers are available. Parking is available at the sports ground and on Tannrodaer Straße (approx. 500 m walk). The race office opens at 9:00 a.m. The routes have a rolling profile. Online registration is available. Showers and changing rooms are available. Parking is available at the sports ground and on Tannrodaer Straße.

name: MB Brandschutz-Nachtwächterlauf
description: The MB Brandschutz Night Watchman Run is a winter race in Ottweiler, usually held before the New Year’s Eve runs. It offers short road-race distances of 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km, suitable for both beginners and club runners. The event is organised by the athletics section of TV Ottweiler. Registration is available for individuals and groups, making it easier for teams to sign up.
course_highlights: Short road-race distances: 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km
Winter race with typical December temperatures around 3 °C; roads are often snow-covered
Starting point in Ottweiler
additional: The race is usually held before the New Year’s Eve runs. Younger runners are eligible for the 2.5 km race; higher minimum age limits apply to the 5 km and 10 km races. Group registration is also available, making it straightforward for teams to sign up. Typical December weather is around 3 °C, with roads often snow-covered. Winter race, road race, individual or group registration available, age limits vary by distance.

name: Dinkelsbühler Wald- und Crosslauf
description: The Dinkelsbühl Relay Race is a sporting family festival full of team spirit and emotion, held annually in Dinkelsbühl. The event features a relay race on a loop course of around 3 kilometres around the historic old town, as well as a Kids’ Run with child-friendly distances. The course is clearly marked and easy for spectators to see, creating a great atmosphere. Alongside the sporting competition, there is a varied programme with a bouncy castle, food, drinks and award ceremonies.
course_highlights: Loop course of around 3 kilometres around the historic old town
Kids’ Run with 700 m (1 lap) and 1200 m (2 laps) on a loop course that is easy for spectators to see
The course runs along gravel paths and is clearly marked with arrows
additional: The relay race starts at 11:00 with all teams starting together. Race pack collection and on-the-day registration begin at 08:45. There is a warm-up for the kids and several age categories in the Kids’ Run. After the race, there will be award ceremonies and a raffle. Participants should bring their own safety pins, although some will also be available. The start and finish are at Mutschachhalle in Dinkelsbühl. The race is part of the Cross Series and is also held alongside the district championships.

name: Eifellauf Pronsfeld
description: The Eifel Runs are an established running series in the Eifel region, welcoming runners of all ability levels. Runs usually take place on Saturdays or Sundays and offer routes between 15 and 22 kilometers, as well as shorter introductory runs of up to 12 kilometers. The event emphasizes community, discovering beautiful running routes, and relaxing together after the run. Runs take place in groups at different speeds, with no race pace.
course_highlights: Running routes of between 15 and 22 kilometers in the Eifel
Beginner-friendly introductory runs of up to 12 kilometers
Running together in groups at a moderate pace
additional: The usual meeting time is 2:30 p.m. on Saturdays or 10:30 a.m. on Sundays at the respective meeting points. After the run, there is usually an opportunity to shower and relax together over coffee, cake, or beer. The running pace is between 5:30 and 7:30 min/km; no race pace is run.

name: Lauf der 39. DJK Winterlaufserie
description: The 39th DJK Winterlaufserie 2026 in Göppingen is the final individual race in the long-standing winter race series organized by DJK SG Göppingen e.V. The event offers races for various age groups and distances, from 1.2 km for children to 10 km for adults. An awards ceremony after the race brings the series to a close. The course winds through the winter landscape and offers a sporting challenge for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: 1.2 km children's race for ages 8–11
2.2 km youth race for ages 12–15
10 km main race with the district running championships
additional: This is the final race of the DJK Winterlaufserie, followed by an awards ceremony. Various distances are available for children, teenagers, and adults. The event marks the end of the DJK SG Göppingen e.V. winter race series.

name: Rietberger Sparkassen Adventslauf
description: The Rietberger Sparkassen Advent Run takes place on 12 December 2026 in the pre-Christmas atmosphere of Rietberg town centre. Runners complete a familiar circuit through the town centre: the 5 km participants run two laps, and the 10 km participants run four. The event offers changing facilities, showers and toilets at the school centre, as well as additional toilets in the start/finish area. The run is known for its friendly, festive atmosphere and welcomes runners of all ability levels.
course_highlights: Familiar circuit through Rietberg town centre
5 km run: 2 laps; 10 km run: 4 laps
Start and finish at the Klostergarten, with changing and shower facilities at the school centre
additional: Race packs are available from 2 p.m. on event day at the Tourist Information office. Changing facilities, showers and toilets are available at the school centre from approximately 4 p.m. to 8:30 p.m. A toilet trailer is located in the start/finish area. Parking is available near the course, including a newly added paved area at the Schützenplatz on Torfweg. For safety reasons, music devices, headphones and mobile phones are not permitted during the run. Race packs are available from 2 p.m. on event day at the Tourist Information office, Rathausstraße 38. Baby joggers, strollers and dogs are not allowed on the course.

name: 9 Bieg Śladami Żubra
description: The Bieg Śladami Żubra is an annual running event organized by the Aktywna Pszczyna Sports Association in Studzienice, held in December. The route follows one or two loops through Studzienice Forest, part of the Pszczyna Forest, offering scenic woodland views. The event features several distances, including the Fancy Dress Run, children’s races, 6 km and 12 km runs and Nordic Walking, as well as a half marathon and marathon. Participants can expect medals, awards for costumes, and traditional pea soup at the finish.
course_highlights: The route runs through Studzienice Forest, part of the Pszczyna Forest
Races cover one or two forest loops
Scenic woodland views and natural mud
additional: Start times are staggered: 08:00 marathon, 08:30 Fancy Dress Run (1.8 km), and 10:10 half marathon. Children’s races are offered over distances of 200 m, 400 m, 800 m and 250 m, 400 m, 850 m, depending on age. Medals and awards for the most creative costumes await at the finish. A team classification is held (the four fastest times after one loop). The route is also used for Nordic Walking. Traditional pea soup is served at the finish. GPX files are available for the half-marathon, marathon, and 6 km and 12 km routes. New marathon distance, changed start and finish location, food and recovery attractions, honorary patronages, additional cross-country races, and team classification.

name: 6 Wigilijny Bieg Charytatywny
price_range: 45–90 zł, zależnie od konkurencji i terminu zapisów
description: The 6th Christmas Eve Charity Run is a cross-country race on a forest course in Lasek Majoński in Luboń, taking place on December 12, 2026. Participants can choose between a 5 km run and a Nordic Walking event on the same course. The event is charitable and supports the Dobro się niesie Foundation, which helps people experiencing homelessness. Shorter distances are available for children, with separate categories for girls and boys. The organizers provide a race pack, a commemorative wooden medal, a meal, and gifts from sponsors.
course_highlights: 5 km run and Nordic Walking on a 100% forest trail course
Babki Forest District grounds — Lasek Majoński in Luboń
Cross-country race with a 50-minute time limit
additional: The race office opens at 9:45 near the cemetery in Luboń, ul. Armii Poznań 51B. The race pack includes a race bib, a wooden medal, a meal (sweet yeast bun and tea), and gifts from sponsors. Timing is provided by reusable chips attached to shoes. Age categories and OPEN, Luboń residents, ZSM Poznań, and four-person team classifications are available. The limit for children's races is 100 participants. An additional race-pack pickup is available on December 10, 2026, in the afternoon (location to be announced by the organizer). The 5 km run and Nordic Walking start at 12:30. The time limit is 50 minutes, and the combined participant limit for these events is 200. The entry fee includes a charitable contribution of 10 or 20 zł.

name: Dwumaraton Olęderski
location: Sątopy, Nowy Tomyśl County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Dwumaraton Olęderski is a series of races organized by the Nowy Tomyśl Chyży Running Club, held off-road in autumn and winter. The event has a social and sporting character and is intended for both experienced and beginner runners. The minimum distance is 10.5 km, while the full marathon distance is 42.2 km, which can be completed by running multiple 10.5 km loops. The event takes place in Sątopy and aims to help participants stay active outdoors during the challenging autumn and winter months.
course_highlights: Off-road course with a 10.5 km loop
Option to complete a full marathon or multiple loops
Races take place in autumn and winter conditions
additional: Dwumaraton Olęderski is a series of races held one weekend per month from October to March, each in a different town. The race office opens at 09:00, and the first race starts at 10:00. The time limit for the first race is 16:00. The second race starts at 09:00 the following day, with a time limit of 15:00. The event is co-funded by Nowy Tomyśl County and is held in accordance with the applicable restrictions. Information for the 2026/2027 edition gives the date as December 12, 2026; the December 13 date provided by the user may refer to another event day or to the weekend.

name: Dwumaraton Pamięci Wojtka Pismenko
description: The Wojtek Pismenko Memorial Double Marathon is an irregular recurring friends’ marathon held in Świdwin. The event is intimate and welcoming, intended for runners who value community and remembering Wojtek Pismenko. The marathon route is available on the organizer’s website. Participants take part at their own risk and agree to follow the regulations. The event is organized by the Sport, Recreation and Volunteering Association “SFX” and aims to bring runners together and promote physical activity.
course_highlights: Double marathon distance: 84.4 km
Race in Świdwin
A friendly, community-oriented event
additional: Registration is via a form available until December 10. After registering, participants appear on the start list with basic details. Participants take part at their own risk and consent to the processing of their personal data and image for the purposes of organizing and promoting the event.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Leśny Park Kultury i Wypoczynku Myślęcinek, Bydgoszcz, Poland
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz
description: The Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in 7 locations, including Bydgoszcz. The race is recreational and competitive, aimed at people aged 16 and over, and promotes outdoor physical activity. The course runs through the forested areas of Myślęcinek and the Żołędowo Forest District, offering beautiful natural surroundings. Races take place regularly, giving participants the opportunity to test themselves on the same course throughout the season.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through the forests of Myślęcinek and the Żołędowo Forest District
Start and finish at Polana Różopole
A cross-country route through forests and urban parks
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. A group warm-up with CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place at 10:45 before the race. Parking is not available at Polana Różopole; participants are advised to use parking areas approximately 1–1.5 km from the start. The event schedule and race-office location remain the same throughout the season. The race is scheduled to start at 11:00. Register via the participant portal at citytrail.pl/zapisy or at the race office on race day.

name: WINTER TRAIL MAŁOPOLSKA
location: Kasinka Mała, Mszana Dolna, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Winter Trail Małopolska 2026 is the tenth edition of the winter mountain running festival and the 19th event in the ULTRA-TRAIL® MAŁOPOLSKA series. The routes pass through the scenic areas of the Beskid Wyspowy and Gorce mountains, through some of Małopolska’s most beautiful forests, in the Myślenice and Limanowa forest districts. The event is exceptionally demanding and intended for true ultrarunners who are not afraid of challenging winter conditions. A hot vegetarian meal and a warm welcome await at the finish.
course_highlights: Routes through the Beskid Wyspowy and Gorce mountains
Routes through forests in the Myślenice and Limanowa forest districts
Challenging winter conditions and demanding elevation gain
additional: Start and finish at the Municipal Stadium in Mszana Dolna, ul. Spadochroniarzy. Race office and baggage drop at the Municipal Cultural Centre in Mszana Dolna, open one hour before the start. No race packs; a finisher pack is provided at the finish. Mandatory equipment is checked during registration and on the course. Vegetarian aid stations and a hot VEGE meal are available on the course and at the finish. A drop bag can be left on the course for the WTM 140 and WTM 105 distances. A GPS tracker is mandatory for WTM 140 and WTM 105. The 2026 edition will take place on 12–13 December. Registration, participant information, FAQ and online tracking are available.

name: Bieg Mikołajkowy
description: Bieg Mikołajkowy is a December race in the Kabacki Forest in Warsaw, organised by ActiveSports as part of the Grand Prix Warszawy series. Runners choose between 5 km and 10 km, and there is also a 5 km Nordic walking class. The 2026 edition is on Saturday 12 December and entries are capped at 450. Race headquarters is at Kabaty, in the clearing next to the metro depot.
course_highlights: Courses in the Kabacki Forest
Special trophy for the oldest man and woman
Award for the funniest costume
additional: The 5 km starts at 10:00, Nordic walking at 10:03 (60-minute limit) and the 10 km at 11:30 (80-minute limit). Race headquarters opens at 09:00 and bibs are only handed out on race day. Entry fee: 80 PLN until 25 November, 90 PLN from 26 November, 100 PLN on race day if places remain. The entry includes a medal, a hot meal and tea.

name: Mikulášsky beh na Tancovú
organizer: Občianske združenie Behači Bytča a okolie
description: Mikulášsky beh na Tancovú is an annual charity run organized by the Behači Bytča a okolie civic association. It will take place on December 12, 2026, in Kaplnka, Bytča. This 6th edition offers runners and outdoor enthusiasts the chance to take part in a 12 km run or a 5 km walk (Nordic walking) in the pleasant surroundings of an old asphalt road through forest and meadow. All proceeds from the event will go toward rehabilitation following a serious accident. The event has a friendly, family atmosphere, with refreshments along the course and at the finish, and the opportunity to enter a raffle.
course_highlights: 12 km run along an old asphalt road through forest and meadow
5 km walk (Nordic walking) along the embankment, suitable for families and seniors
Charity event supporting rehabilitation following a serious accident
additional: Registration is open from 09:00 to 10:30. New participants can also register on race day. Every participant receives a commemorative medal and refreshments along the course and at the finish. The event includes a raffle, with tickets available for purchase at the race base. Parking is available at several locations, including Námestie SR, where it is free on weekends. The organizers provide a heated tent for warming up. The event is charitable; proceeds will go to Rudo Šamánek for rehabilitation following a serious accident. The three-person relay is 12 km.

name: Vianočný beh mesta Zlaté Moravce
location: Mestský štadión Calex, Zlaté Moravce, Slovakia

name: Tony Treadmill Run
distance_verbose: 50 km, Maratón, 16 km, 11.6 km, 10 km, 5 km, 3.2 km

name: Christmas Run Most
price_range: Hlavní závod 650–900 Kč; dětský běh 200–400 Kč; Fénix Run 250–300 Kč
description: Christmas Run Most je zážitkový noční běh, který se koná 13. prosince 2026 v centru města Most. Nabízí tři závodní varianty: 5 km hlavní závod, 2 km charitativní běh Fénix Run a 1 km dětský nezávodní běh. Akce je doplněna rozcvičkou se Santou a slavnostním vyhlášením výsledků. Závod je vhodný pro běžce od 12 let, mladší mohou startovat pouze s písemným souhlasem zákonného zástupce. Pořadatelem je společnost EVENT media s.r.o.
course_highlights: Noční běh v centru města Most
Hlavní trať 5 km (2 x 2,5 km okruh)
Charitativní běh Fénix Run 2 km a dětský běh 1 km
additional: Registrace je platná až po připsání startovného na účet pořadatele. Po naplnění kapacity závodů není možná další registrace. Děti do 15 let musí mít písemný souhlas zákonného zástupce. Startovní balíček obsahuje tašku s dárky od partnerů akce. Kapacita hlavního závodu je 1 000 běžců. Dětský běh je nezávodní a děti mohou běžet s rodiči. Pro účastníky hlavního závodu je připravena medaile; výtěžek z Fénix Run a dobrovolných příspěvků podporuje neziskové organizace.

name: Trailová Závist
location: TJ Sokol Zvole clubhouse, Hlavní 197, 252 45 Zvole, Česko
description: Trailová Závist je běžecký závod přes tři údolí v oblasti divokých strání a zařízlých dolin nad řekou Vltavou. Trasa dlouhá přibližně 17,3 km vede hlubokými lesy a nabízí kombinaci náročných kopců, technických seběhů a běžeckých úseků s krásnými výhledy. Závod je určen pro běžce všech výkonnostních kategorií a je zařazen mezi UTMB Index Races, což umožňuje získat Index 20 km. Start i prezence probíhají v klubovně TJ Sokol Zvole, kde je také zajištěna úschovna zavazadel a občerstvení po doběhu. Po závodě čeká na účastníky polévka, medaile a odznáček jako součást startovného.
course_highlights: Trasa vede přes divoké strání a zařízlé doliny nad řekou Vltavou
Náročné kopce a technické seběhy s kombinací asfaltu, štěrku, bláta a listí
Krásné výhledy a běh v hlubokých lesích s keltským historickým pozadím
additional: Kapacita závodu je 250 startujících. Startovní čísla lze zakoupit i na místě do 9:30. V ceně startovného je zapůjčení čipu na měření času, občerstvení v cíli (polévka), medaile a odznáček. Po závodě je k dispozici venkovní posezení a klubovna jako úkryt před nepříznivým počasím. Není k dispozici sprcha ani vyhřívané převlékárny. Možnost převodu startovného na jinou osobu do 11.12.2026 12:00 přes sportovniservis.cz. K dispozici je také prodej triček, mikin a čepic s motivem závodu. V ceně startovného je zapůjčení časoměrného čipu, občerstvení v cíli, polévka, finišerská medaile a odznáček. Kapacita závodu je 250 běžců.

name: Běh cyklistů
description: Běh cyklistů je náročný kros v pražských Jinonicích, který vede kopcovitým terénem po lesních a lučních cestách. Závod nabízí tratě na 6 km a 3 km; v předchozích ročnících byla delší trať určena mužům a kratší ženám, juniorům a veteránům. Čeká vás svižný terénní závod s opakovanými stoupáními a prudkými seběhy.
course_highlights: Kopcovitý kros po lesních a lučních cestách.
Okruhová trať s ostrými stoupáními a prudkými seběhy.
Dvě délky tratí: 6 km a 3 km.
additional: Zázemí závodu je v Novoveské ulici v Praze-Jinonicích.

name: Adventní charitativní běh Kuňka
location: Ráby, Pardubice District, Pardubice Region, Česko

name: Adventslauf
price_range: 10,00 € bis 16,00 € je nach Strecke und Anmeldedatum
description: The Advent Run in Hamm is a traditional winter race on officially measured out-and-back courses through the Lippeaue nature conservation area and the Kurpark in Bad Hamm. The start and finish are on the tartan track at Jahnstadion, creating a welcoming atmosphere for runners of all ages. The event offers two distances, 5 km and 10 km, with chip-based net and gun timekeeping. Alongside the sporting challenge, charity is also a key focus, with a donation collected for the support association of the hospice in Hamm.
course_highlights: Officially measured out-and-back courses
Lippeaue nature conservation area
Kurpark in Bad Hamm
additional: Young people and young adults up to age group U20 receive a 50% discount on the entry fee (excluding the donation and deposit). An additional €3.00 deposit is charged for the race bib (refunded when returned), along with a €1.00 donation for the support association of the hospice in Hamm. Timing is provided using Race Result systems via a chip in the race bib. The timing is eligible for best-list results and is forwarded to the DLV federation. Headphones, dogs and jogging strollers are prohibited during the race. The awards ceremony takes place approximately 45 minutes after the first runner finishes. Discounted admission is available at the neighboring Maximare adventure swimming pool. Courses are timed using Race Result; race bibs contain a chip; the awards ceremony is approximately 45 minutes after the finish; admission to Maximare is available.

name: Ismaninger Winterlaufserie
description: The Ismaning Winter Running Series is a traditional running event held in several stages from December to February. It offers races for different age groups and distances, including 13 km, 17 km and a half marathon, as well as races for schoolchildren and speed races. The races take place in the beautiful surroundings of Ismaning and are ideal for runners who want to stay active in winter. A free shuttle bus from Ismaning S-Bahn station makes getting there easier, and refreshments at the finish invite participants to linger.
course_highlights: 13 km, 17 km and half marathon courses
Separate races for schoolchildren and speed races for different age groups
Free shuttle bus from Ismaning S-Bahn station
additional: Finish refreshments; participants may bring their own cup. Free shuttle buses from Ismaning S-Bahn station. Races for schoolchildren and speed races for U16 and older. GPX course files are available. The event also includes youth and speed races, with shuttle bus transport from Ismaning S-Bahn station. Results and historical data are available on the website.

name: Lauf am Weißen Kreuz - 5. Lauf der Jedermannlaufserie
location: Sportgelände Am Weißen Kreuz, Oettingen in Bayern
description: The Lauf am Weißen Kreuz in Oettingen is the fifth and final race of the LG Donau-Ries Jedermann running series. The start is at the Am Weißen Kreuz sports ground, and the long course covers about 10 km. There is also a 3 km short course and a 7 km walking course. Late deciders can also register on site.
course_highlights: Long course of about 10 km
3 km short course and 7 km walking
Final race of the LG Donau-Ries Jedermann series
additional: The long course starts at 10:00, the short course and walkers usually follow five minutes later. Online registration via Race Result until the Thursday before the race. Bibs with transponder should be collected at least 25 minutes before the start.

name: Lauf Winterlaufserie 2026/2027
description: The 1st Lauf Winterlaufserie 2026/2027 in Beverstedt-Wellen is a winter running series associated with the traditional Rund um Wellen. The event is organized by the local running community, which also organizes the Wellen Marathon, and offers a family-friendly, club-like atmosphere away from large city events. The course includes several distances and runs through the rural surroundings, supported by local volunteers, sponsors, and the fire brigade. The series preserves its traditional character and offers runners a challenging, authentic winter running experience.
course_highlights: Rural course with a traditional character
Event with a family-friendly, club-like atmosphere
Support from local volunteers and the fire brigade
additional: Typical November weather conditions: around 7 °C, mostly rainy; start location: Beverstedt-Wellen; the event is part of a series with several distances (3 km and 11 km). Distances: 3 km, 11 km; traditional, community-oriented; December weather is usually cool and rainy.

name: Sparkassen Advents-Cross der LG Nordheide
location: Jahnplatz, Schützengehölz, Winsen (Luhe), Lower Saxony, Germany
price_range: U10-U16 2,50 Euro, U18-U20 3,00 Euro, Erwachsene 5,00 Euro
description: The Sparkassen Advent Cross-Country Run hosted by LG Nordheide takes place on December 13, 2026, in Winsen (Luhe), at Schützengehölz by Jahnplatz. The event is open to participants from across the state and offers races for all age groups from U10 to seniors, including age groups up to M/W 95. The races cover various distances of approximately 1,400 meters to 9 kilometers. Team rankings are held separately for male and female participants. Changing rooms and restroom facilities are available, as well as signposted parking nearby.
course_highlights: Various distances from approx. 1,400 m to 9 km
Races from U10 through senior age groups, including M/W 95
Venue in Schützengehölz, with a signposted walking route
additional: Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start, subject to a 50% surcharge. Entries submitted by email incur a surcharge of EUR 1.00 per start. Changing rooms and restroom facilities are available. Parking is available behind the Stadthalle and at the Stadthalle car park; the venue is about a 300-meter walk through Schützengehölz along a signposted route. Registration constitutes consent to the publication of the participant’s name, year of birth, club, and photo and video material in results lists and the media. Distances range from approximately 1,400 m to longer distances; registration is open until December 6, 2026. Late entries are possible for an additional fee. Changing rooms and restroom facilities are available; parking is behind the Stadthalle.

name: Winterlauf
description: The Aachen Winter Run is a traditional 16.1-kilometre race from Bürgerhaus Venwegen to the ATG sports field at Am Chorusberg. Held annually in December, it attracts many runners of all ages. The route passes through the Voreifel and the city of Aachen, offering varied and scenic running. The event is well organised, with race bib collection available on several days, a bus transfer to the start and refreshments at the finish.
course_highlights: 16.1 km route from Bürgerhaus Venwegen to the ATG sports field at Am Chorusberg
Run through the Voreifel and the city of Aachen
Start at Bürgerhaus Venwegen, with a heated indoor area and refreshments
additional: Race bibs can be collected at various locations on several days before the race. Free bus transport from Chorusberg to the start is available from 8:15 a.m.; taking an early bus is recommended. Bürgerhaus Venwegen is heated and serves as a place to wait and get refreshments. Clothing is transported from the start to the finish. Late entries are not possible. Starting places can be transferred up to one hour before the race via the individual change link or by email. The Winter Run takes place on 13 December 2026; further information about start times, registration and logistics is available on the website.

name: X-MAS Trail
description: The X-MAS Trail in Weiskirchen is a challenging winter trail run through the picturesque landscape of the Hunsrück-Hochwald Nature Park. Three demanding courses with singletrack trails and technical sections lead through moss-covered forests, over small bridges and past rock formations. Participants need suitable equipment and experience handling winter conditions, as runners are self-sufficient. The course is marked with flagging tape and spray chalk, and there is a course briefing before the run. This is not a road race, but a genuine trail run with strict cutoff times.
course_highlights: A high proportion of singletrack, with many technical sections
Winter scenery in the Hunsrück-Hochwald Nature Park, with moss-covered forests and waterways
Sections crossing small bridges and passing rock formations and the spectacular Felsenpfad
additional: Mandatory equipment is required, especially for the longer distances. The course will be confirmed shortly before the race and made available to download. The longer distances are part of the ITRA National League Challenge. Cutoff times are strictly enforced, and sweepers may remove very slow participants from the race. The event is not suitable for walkers. Aid stations are available on the longer distances. A headlamp is recommended and mandatory for the long distance. Winter trails, technical sections, no walkers permitted, mandatory equipment required, course changes possible, no dogs allowed.

name: Zeller MEHR Raiffeisenbank-Adventslauf
location: Zell an der Mosel, Cochem-Zell, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
description: The Zeller MEHR Raiffeisenbank Advent Run is an atmospheric race in Zell an der Mosel, traditionally held during Advent. The event offers runners a festive atmosphere and an attractive course through the picturesque Moselle landscape. The race is open to all ages and ability levels, combining sporting ambition with Christmas spirit.
course_highlights: Run through the picturesque Moselle landscape
Festive Advent atmosphere
Suitable for all ages and ability levels
additional: Multiple categories, registration from September to December, event on December 13, 2026

name: Adventlauf der SKV Mörfelden
description: The LG Mörfelden-Walldorf Advent Run takes place every year at the Waldstadion and in the adjacent Mörfelder Wald. It gives runners the opportunity to compete over 5 km or 10 km and serves as a perfect fitness test during Advent. The event is open to all running enthusiasts and also includes the town championships for residents of Mörfelden-Walldorf.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Waldstadion and Mörfelder Wald
5 km and 10 km race distances
Town championship classification for Mörfelden-Walldorf
additional: For residents of Mörfelden-Walldorf, the results also count toward the town championships.

name: Koblenzer Advents-Spendenlauf
description: The Koblenz Advent Charity Run on December 13, 2026, is a community run focused on the joy of running and supporting children in the region. Participation requires a minimum contribution, which is donated in full to the beneficiary organizations. The run lasts 90 minutes and features professional timekeeping as well as a varied supporting program with childcare, craft activities, and a raffle. Children can take part for free; adults pay a minimum contribution of 5 euros, with 10 euros recommended. The event is supported by businesses, so all donations go directly to the projects.
course_highlights: 90 minutes of running fun with professional timekeeping
A community experience with no focus on personal bests
A varied supporting program with childcare and a raffle
additional: Participation is limited to 1,125 people, including children. Payment is made after registration via a donation link sent by email. Food and drinks are available in exchange for donations. If you cannot attend, please let the organizers know so your place can be offered to someone on the waiting list.

name: Rheinzaberner Winterlaufserie 10 km
location: Schulcampus der IGS Rheinzabern, Rheinzabern, Germany
description: The Rheinzabern Winter Running Series is a long-running event in the Southern Palatinate, held annually in winter since 1984. It comprises three races over 10 km, 15 km and 20 km, run on officially measured, paved loop and out-and-back courses around the IGS Rheinzabern school campus. The series offers both gun time and chip time, as well as age-group and team classifications. Alongside the sporting competition, there is a supporting program of runs for beginners, children and families. The event is part of TV 1890 Rheinzabern e.V. and brings together club life and running in the region.
course_highlights: Officially measured, record-eligible 10 km course
Paved loop and out-and-back courses
Refreshments at the finish (for the 15 km and 20 km races, also at km 11)
additional: Maximum of 1,500 participants per race. Race numbers remain valid for all three races in the series and must be brought to each race. Late registration is possible on-site up to 30 minutes before the start (except for the sold-out 10 km race). Both gun time and chip time are recorded; official results are ranked by gun time. Cashless payment is not possible on-site. Results are published on Race Result shortly after the races. The start is at 10:50 a.m. The 10 km distance is sold out; 100 additional places are due to be released online on November 30. On-site late registration is not available for this race.

name: Weihnachtslauf Wismar
organizer: SV Schiffahrt und Hafen Wismar 61 e.V.
description: The Wismar Christmas Run is part of the Strandlaufcup of SV Schiffahrt und Hafen Wismar and runs along Wismar Bay. Start and finish are on the grounds of the Mecklenburg Sailing Club in Wendorf, and the routes cover asphalt, grass, sand and a demanding natural beach section. Options are a 12 km main race, a 4 km run, 7.7 km Nordic walking and a 750 m children's race. Early registration includes a warm soup in the entry fee.
course_highlights: 12 km main race and 4 km with DLV ranking
Route along the Baltic coast with a natural beach section
Start and finish at the Mecklenburg Sailing Club in Wendorf
additional: Start from 10:30. Late entries on race day between 08:45 and 09:45. The routes are signposted and marshalled. The warm soup does not apply to the children's race.

name: Int. Weihnachts-Crosslauf
description: The Int. Christmas Cross-Country Run is a cross-country race held shortly before Christmas at Ravensberger Stadium in Borgholzhausen. The event is organized by LCS Olbä and offers several distances, including 16 km, 10 km, 5 km, and a 7.5 km walking/Nordic walking course. The 16 km course consists of two laps over partly hilly terrain around Borgholzhausen and a loop around Barenberg, which is run twice. It is a true cross-country challenge with climbs and descents. The start and finish sections are on paved paths, where spikes are not allowed. The race attracts a diverse field, from top runners to recreational and older runners, as well as walkers.

name: 37. Bramfelder Winterlaufserie (2. Lauf)
organizer: BMS Die Laufgesellschaft mbH mit sportservice hamburg GmbH, Bramfelder SV
description: The Bramfeld Winter Running Series in Hamburg consists of five races over the winter, and this is the second date. The course is a scenic loop around Lake Bramfeld with a lap length of 4,660 m. The loop can be run one to five times, and you do not need to choose your distance in advance because the timing system records your laps. That way you can vary your distance freely from one date to the next.
course_highlights: 4,660 m loop around Lake Bramfeld
One to five laps, up to 23.3 km
Start and finish at Campus Steilshoop
additional: Start from 9:30, finish closes at 12:00. Open to runners born 2016 or earlier; youth age groups have maximum lap counts. Day entries for single dates are online only.

name: Perly Malopolski Rabka Zdroj Gorce
description: The event is part of the Perły Małopolski running series, which covers various locations in Małopolska and attracts running enthusiasts from different regions. The route passes through the scenic Gorce Mountains, offering participants a unique experience and the chance to admire the beauty of the surrounding nature.
course_highlights: Scenic route in the Gorce Mountains
Part of the prestigious Perły Małopolski series
Various distances suited to runners of different levels
additional: The event features various distances, and registration opens in January 2025. Participants can look forward to beautiful views and a sporting atmosphere.

name: XIV Panewnicki Bieg Dzika (12)
organizer: Akademia Wychowania Fizycznego im. Jerzego Kukuczki w Katowicach
price_range: 20-110 zł, pakiety od 220 zł do 800 zł, opłaty dla pracowników i studentów 30 zł

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: dzieci i młodzież do lat 18 – w wysokości 20 zł przelewem na konto

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: dzieci i młodzież do lat 18 – w dniu biegu 30 zł

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: pozostałe osoby – w wysokości 45 zł przelewem na konto

tiers.label: tier_4
tiers.description: pozostałe osoby – w dniu biegu 60 zł

tiers.label: tier_5
tiers.description: małżeństwa – w wysokości 80 zł przelewem na konto (każda osoba z małżeństwa zapisuje się osobno)

description: Panewnicki Bieg Dzika is a recreational running and Nordic walking event held in the picturesque Panewniki forests in Katowice. The event takes place on a loop approximately 4,882 metres long, which participants can complete up to four times. It promotes an active lifestyle and education about responsible behaviour in forest areas. Participants can compete individually or in pairs, and the event is open to both recreational runners and athletes affiliated with sports clubs.
course_highlights: A route through the Panewniki forests, approximately 4,882 m long
The loop is marked every 1 km
The route can be completed up to 4 times
additional: The time limit for running and Nordic walking is 3 hours. Participants over 18 must sign a declaration accepting responsibility for their participation or provide a medical certificate. Minors must be accompanied by a parent or guardian during verification. Annual race-entry packages are available for purchase. Entry fees are non-refundable but may be transferred to a subsequent race if requested by 3:00 p.m. on the Thursday before the race. The event is recreational, with a 3-hour time limit and online registration; entry fees are non-refundable. It also has an educational aspect, promoting responsible behaviour in forest areas.

name: 5. Pietrasze Cross Country 2/5
description: Pietrasze Cross Country is a series of cross-country races held in Pietrasze Forest in Białystok. The 7.83 km course features varied natural terrain with numerous climbs and descents, requiring versatility and good fitness. The events attract both runners and Nordic walking enthusiasts, bringing together a sporting community and creating a unique atmosphere. It is a great opportunity to compete and spend time actively outdoors during the winter season.
course_highlights: A 7.83 km course with 109 m of elevation gain
Natural terrain: forest floor, grass, sand, mud and puddles, depending on the weather
Numerous climbs and descents requiring versatility and full-body effort
additional: Race packets are available from 8:30 to 9:30 at Primary School No. 32, named after Major Henryk Dobrzański, alias Hubal, at ul. Pietrasze 29. After the race, there is a music event with refreshments (doughnuts and tea) and a chance to socialize. Volunteers and cycling marshals are present along the course, and key points are marked with blue-and-white tape. A GPX file of the course is available to download for users of GPS watches. A pass covering all five races in the series is available. Parking and a GPX course file are provided. Race packets are distributed at Primary School No. 32 at ul. Pietrasze 29.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: ul. Spokojna, Mały Kack, Gdynia, Poland
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata za pojedynczy bieg uiszczona najpóźniej do środy poprzedzającej start

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Karnet można wykupić najpóźniej do środy przed drugim biegiem

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in seven locations, including the Tricity area in the Gdańsk Forest District and around Mały Kack in Gdynia. The races take place in natural settings among forests and urban parks, promoting outdoor physical activity. The series consists of four races in each location, and participants can compete in both local and overall rankings. The races are open to people aged 16 and over; younger participants may take part with a guardian’s consent. The main race starts at 11:00.
course_highlights: The 5 km course runs through forests and urban parks
The Tricity location includes the Gdańsk Forest District and the area around Mały Kack in Gdynia
The race takes place in a natural setting and promotes outdoor activity
additional: The race office opens at 8:30. Race numbers and timing chips are collected on race day. The schedule is the same at all locations. Participants can buy a pass for the entire series or enter individual races. The entry fee is higher on race day. There is no participant limit. Participants under 16 may take part with a guardian’s consent. Pass holders can race for free in another city by registering in advance. Online registration is available through the Participant Portal at citytrail.pl/zapisy or on race day at the race office. A pass for four races at one location is available.

name: III Bieg Crossowy Śladami Bobra
description: The 3rd Cross-Country Beaver Trail Run is a trail race held in Szarlejka, on a 5 km course. The event is organized by the Positive Sport Foundation and is aimed at running and nordic walking enthusiasts. The event takes place in December, and participants can expect professional timekeeping and a friendly atmosphere. The race office is open from 9:00 to 10:30, and the race starts on the same day at 2 Borowa Street.
course_highlights: 5 km course
Trail run in a natural setting
Participation in either the race or nordic walking
additional: The race office is open from 9:00 to 10:30. Organizer: Positive Sport Foundation. Electronic timekeeping. Categories: 5 km run and 5 km nordic walking. The race office is open from 9:00 to 10:30.

name: VII Bieg Mikołajów
organizer: Stowarzyszenie WKR FAN, Superczas.pl i Miejski Ośrodek Kultury w Olsztynie
price_range: od 30 zł; opłata w dniu imprezy od 60 zł

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Podstawowa opłata startowa jest równa 30 zł ale to Ty zdecydujesz jaką kwotą wesprzesz potrzebujące dzieciaki.

description: The 7th Santa Run is an annual charity race held in Olsztyn as part of the Warmia Christmas Market. The 5 km route passes through the picturesque Old Town, Central Park, and Łynostrada. The event is open to adults and young people aged 12 and over. Its aim is to have fun and support the Child and Adolescent Psychiatry Ward in Olsztyn. Participants receive commemorative Santa hats, and the limit is 420 participants.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through Olsztyn’s Old Town
Scenic paths in Central Park
A run along Łynostrada
additional: The race office is open from 9:00 to 11:00 at the Czesław Niemen Amphitheatre, ul. Zamkowa 1. Participants receive commemorative Santa hats. Timing is provided by chips, which must be returned at the finish. All entry fees support the Child and Adolescent Psychiatry Ward in Olsztyn. Participants must be at least 12 years old (born in 2014 or earlier). Online registration is open until December 9, 2026, or until the participant limit is reached. The race office is located at the Czesław Niemen Amphitheatre, ul. Zamkowa 1. Entry fees support the Child and Adolescent Psychiatry Ward in Olsztyn.

name: Białołęcki Bieg Wolności
location: Areszt Śledczy Warszawa-Białołęka, ul. Ciupagi, Warszawa
description: Białołęcki Bieg Wolności is an annual run commemorating the imposition of martial law in Poland on 13 December 1981. The course circles the Białołęka detention centre, where more than 600 opposition activists were interned, and covers a symbolic 13 km in three laps of 4.3 km. The 12th edition is on Sunday 13 December 2026, with the race village, office, start and finish by the prison walls. It is the final stage of the Białołęka Running Triad.
course_highlights: Three 4.3 km laps around the Białołęka detention centre
Exhibition about martial law and music from the era
New: three-person relay, one lap each
additional: Before the start archive recordings from December 1981 and 1989 are played, and coal braziers stand in the event area. Everyone who completes at least one lap gets a medal. Entry for the main race and the relay is 50 PLN, children under 16 pay 10 PLN and people aged 70+ run for free. There are 940 places and registration is through b4sportonline.pl.

name: I Bieg w Krainie Kormoranów
location: Ośrodek Wypoczynkowy Bursztynowo, ul. Morska 9, Sztutowo
description: I Bieg w Krainie Kormoranów is a 5 km run held as part of the 14th Cormorant Land Rally in Sztutowo. A Power Walk and a Nordic walking march over the same distance take place alongside the run. The start is on 13 December 2026 at 11:00 at the Bursztynowo holiday centre, ul. Morska 9. The organiser is the Sztutowo Local Tourism Organisation, with the Sztutowo municipality among the co-organisers.
course_highlights: Joint start for the run, Power Walk and Nordic walking at 11:00
Prizes in age categories
Commemorative medal and refreshments afterwards
additional: Race office opens 10:00-10:50. The closing and prize ceremony is at 13:00-13:30 at the Sztutowo Cultural Centre (SZOK), ul. Obozowa 16. The entry fee is 70 PLN, or 100 PLN on race day, and is non-refundable. Registration is through zapisyvaldano.pl.

name: Łódzkie Biegi Górskie
location: Szkoła Podstawowa nr 61, ul. Okólna 183, Łódź
description: Łódzkie Biegi Górskie is a series of cross-country hill races in the Modrzew forest in Łódź, organised by the UKS Orientuś club. The 2026/2027 season has five races: 22 November and 13 December 2026, and 17 January, 14 February and 14 March 2027. The race is run on a 6.6 km loop, with distances of 6.6 km, 10.5 km or 14.4 km. The race base is at Primary School no. 61, Okólna 183.
course_highlights: 6.6 km loop in the hilly Modrzew forest
6.6, 10.5 and 14.4 km with 140, 220 or 300 m of climbing
Five races per season with an overall series ranking
additional: Every race starts at 11:00 and the race office opens at 09:30 on race day. Entries via the form on gorywlodzi.pl until the Sunday before each race; late entries only at the race office on the day at a higher fee. Minors need consent from a parent or guardian. Parking at the school is limited to a few dozen spaces.

name: Cytadela by Night # 122
description: Cytadela by Night is a series of free monthly timed runs in Cytadela Park in Poznań. Participants cover one lap (5 km) or two (10 km) and may run, walk, jog or use Nordic walking poles. Edition #122 is on Tuesday 15 December 2026 at 19:00 and marks the tenth birthday of the series, which started in December 2016. No registration or fee is needed.
course_highlights: 10th birthday of CBN, first run in December 2016
5 km or 10 km on a loop in Cytadela Park
Free and without registration, with accurate timing
additional: There is always a briefing before the start, plus an extra briefing for first-timers. After the finish a volunteer hands you a token and your result is written down. Latecomers can join but get a gun time. Results are published on Facebook and biegi.xyz.

tiers.description: 1. vlna – prvních 50 přihlášek: 600 Kč za individuální závod / 1 000 Kč za štafetu

description: Vánoční půlmaraton v Hradci Králové je tradiční zimní běžecký závod konaný v městských lesích poblíž bufetu U Vlka. Závod nabízí individuální půlmaraton i tříčlenné smíšené štafety, které běží úseky po 7 km. Na trati i v cíli je zajištěno občerstvení a pro nejlepší běžce jsou připraveny věcné ceny. Akce je pořádána s přátelskou atmosférou a podporuje zdravý životní styl a sportovní komunitu v regionu.
course_highlights: Trať vede městskými lesy v Hradci Králové
Tříčlenná smíšená štafeta s úseky 7,0325 km
Občerstvení na trati a v cíli závodu
additional: Prezentace a výdej startovních čísel probíhá od 9:15 do 10:15. Přihláška je platná až po zaplacení startovného. Kategorie jsou rozděleny podle věku a váhy, včetně speciálních kategorií Santa Klaus (nad 100 kg) a Tři králové (nad 200 kg). Bistro U Vlka bude otevřené po celou dobu akce; občerstvení je připravené také v cíli.

name: Seligenstädter Winterlaufserie, Lauf 2
description: Seligenstadt Winter Running Series Race 2 is a popular winter running event in the picturesque town of Seligenstadt. The series gives runners the opportunity to compete over 1 km, 5 km, and 10 km distances, and regularly attracts many running enthusiasts from the region. The event is organized by the Triathlon Team Seligenstadt and takes place in a friendly and motivating atmosphere. It is an ideal opportunity to maintain your running motivation during the cold season and experience the sporting community.
course_highlights: Races over 1 km, 5 km, and 10 km
Traditional winter running series in Seligenstadt
Event in a picturesque town with a friendly atmosphere
additional: The event takes place on December 19, 2026, and is part of the winter running series held from December to February. Online registration is recommended.

name: Adventslauf Dornstetten
location: Rathaus am Marktplatz, Dornstetten, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The 30th International Advent Run in Dornstetten takes place on December 19, 2026. Due to renovations at the town hall, the start and finish will be at the town hall on the market square. The main race, over 6,600 meters, consists of six laps and is open to recreational and elite runners, with various age-group classifications. The farbtex Cup will also be held alongside it: a team race for recreational runners without a racing license, in which teams of women and men compete against one another. The event offers a festive atmosphere, with refreshments on the market square and an awards ceremony in the town hall’s Bürgersaal.
course_highlights: 6,600-meter main race over six laps
Start and finish at the town hall on the market square due to renovations at the town hall
farbtex Cup team race with mixed teams
additional: The awards ceremony will take place in the town hall’s Bürgersaal. Additional prizes are offered for improving the course record (€100) and for the fastest first lap (a 5-liter keg of beer; the runner must finish the race). Recreational runners can take part in introductory relay teams of up to three runners. The start and finish are at the town hall on the market square; the awards ceremony will be in the Bürgersaal, and refreshments will be served on the market square. The farbtex Cup is a team race with three runners per team and mixed-gender teams. Online registration is available.

name: Crosslauf des VfL Pünderich
description: The VfL Pünderich cross-country race takes place on December 19, 2026, in Pünderich and offers distances from 0.25 to 7.2 kilometers. The races run through the flat vineyards below the village of Pünderich toward Reil. The event is open to runners of all ages and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with changing facilities and refreshments in the multipurpose hall. The start and finish areas are easy to reach, and parking is available along the Moselle riverbank and in the village.
course_highlights: Course through the flat vineyards below Pünderich
Start and finish on Schulstraße and above the sports hall
Event in the multipurpose hall with changing facilities and refreshments
additional: On-site late registration is possible until one hour before the start for an additional fee of €2.00 (except in Bengel). Changing rooms and showers are available at the clubhouse or in the multipurpose hall. The cross-country series includes a raffle with T-shirt giveaways.

name: Bieg po moczkę i makówki
location: Szkoła Podstawowa w Stanowicach, Stanowice, Opole, Poland
