name: 22. Krakowski Bieg Sylwestrowy Smocza Piątka
organizer: Fundacja Vena Sport, Labosport Polska Sp. z o.o.
description: The Kraków New Year's Eve Run goes through the streets of Kraków on the last day of the year, and most runners take part in costume. The 22nd edition is on 31 December 2026, with start and finish on the Main Market Square near Sienna street. There are two distances: 10 km (PZLA certified) and 5 km (GPS measured). Proceeds go to the Schola Cordis foundation for children's heart surgery.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the Main Market Square
Mostly flat PZLA-certified 10 km course
Costume contests for individuals, couples and teams
additional: The 10 km starts at 11:30 and the 5 km at 12:00. Time limits: 1 h 15 min for 5 km and 1 h 45 min for 10 km. Race office and expo at the MOS Kraków Zachód stadium (entrance from Plac Na Groblach). The entry fee rises in steps: 109, 119, 139, 149 and 169 PLN (last step online until 30 December and on race day); under-18s get 15 PLN off. Minimum age for 10 km is 16. The rules also include a virtual run option.

name: V Tarnobrzeski Bieg Sylwestrowy
description: The Tarnobrzeg New Year's Eve Run is a race by Lake Tarnobrzeg organised by the WITAR runners' club. The 5th edition is on Thursday 31 December 2026, starting on the Mariusz Zaruski boulevard on Żeglarska street near the Na Fali restaurant. The course is about 11 km out and back along Żeglarska, Plażowa and Turystyczna streets, on asphalt with one climb. Runners must be 18, or 16 with parental consent.
course_highlights: Course along Lake Tarnobrzeg
Asphalt with one climb
Age categories for women and men
additional: Race office open from 08:00 to 10:00 on Żeglarska street. The main race starts at 11:00, awards at 13:30. Entry fee: 60 PLN until 15 November, 80 PLN until 25 December, 100 PLN on race day. Online entries close on 25 December 2026; on-site entries from 08:00 to 10:00. Runners over 70 and WITAR members run for free.

name: XXXV Gorlicki Bieg Sylwestrowy
description: The Gorlice New Year's Eve Run is an end-of-year race starting from the market square in Gorlice. The 35th edition is on 31 December 2026 at 11:00. There are two distances: 5 km, open to children from age 8, and 10 km. There are open classes for women and men on both distances and 11 age categories on the 10 km.
course_highlights: Start on the Gorlice market square
5 km open to children from age 8
Trophies, prize money and diplomas for the best
additional: Every participant gets a race pack (bib, socks, buff) and finishers receive a medal. The entry fee depends on when you register and pay. Registration is handled by time-sport.pl.

name: VI Szybka Piątka Jurka Siemaszki
organizer: Fundacja Od Zmierzchu Do Świtu, Dobre Czasy s.c.
description: Szybka Piątka Jurka Siemaszki is a New Year's Eve 5 km race on Bolko Island in Opole. The 6th edition is on 31 December 2026. It is organised by the Od Zmierzchu Do Świtu foundation and Dobre Czasy, together with partners including the Opole city sports department and MOSiR Opole. The 5 km course is PZLA certified.
course_highlights: Race on Bolko Island in Opole
PZLA-certified 5 km course
additional: Race office open from 10:00 to 11:30. Registration and timing by ZmierzymyCzas.pl, with a limit of 250 places.

name: XI Bieg Sylwestrowy
description: The TOYOTA New Year's Eve Run in Jelcz-Laskowice is an end-of-year race organised by the KB Harcownik club. The 11th edition is on 31 December 2026. Runners choose between 10 km and 5 km, both PZLA certified, and there is also a 5 km Nordic walking march. Partners include the town hall, the local sports and recreation centre and Toyota Motor Manufacturing Poland.
course_highlights: PZLA-certified 10 km and 5 km courses
5 km Nordic walking march
additional: Race office at the Jelcz-Laskowice sports and recreation centre on 30 December from 18:00 to 19:30 and on 31 December from 08:00 to 10:30, with late entries possible. Minimum age 14 for the 5 km and Nordic walking, 16 for the 10 km. The limit is 1000 places.

name: 42. Bieg Sylwestrowy Trzebnica
organizer: Gmina Trzebnica, Młodzieżowe Centrum Sportu i Rekreacji
description: The Trzebnica New Year's Eve Street Run has been held for more than 40 years and is organised by the Trzebnica municipality and its youth sports centre. The 42nd edition is on Thursday 31 December 2026, starting and finishing at the municipal sports hall at 3 Maja 6. The main race is 10 km (two 5 km laps) and the shorter race is 5 km, both PZLA certified. Entries are capped at 1500 across both distances.
course_highlights: PZLA-certified 5 km loop through Trzebnica
New Year's Eve costume contest, themed 'cats' in 2026
Children's races on 30 December and a free family run
additional: Both races start at 12:00 with a 90-minute limit. Entry fee: 100 PLN until 13 December, then 120 PLN; residents of the municipality 80 PLN until 13 December. 10 PLN of every fee goes to charity. Those registered by 13 December get a shirt. Pack pickup on 30 December from 18:00 to 20:00 and on 31 December from 08:00 to 11:00. Children's races on 30 December at 11:00 (20 PLN), family run on 31 December at 11:00 (free). Minimum age 12 for 5 km and 16 for 10 km.

name: VII Charytatywny Ultramaraton Włoszakowicki
description: The Włoszakowice Charity Ultramarathon is a social off-road run organised by the Sokół gymnastics society in Włoszakowice. The 7th edition is on 31 December 2026, starting and finishing in the Włoszakowice park. The course is about 56 km, mostly on forest and dirt tracks, passing lakes Trzebidzkie, Dominickie and Moszynek and Wilson's Mound. Part of every entry fee goes to charity.
course_highlights: About 56 km on forest and dirt tracks around Włoszakowice
Five mobile aid stations
Medal for every participant
additional: Start at 09:00, check-in at the Sokół clubhouse (Karola Kurpińskiego 29) from 07:30 to 08:30. The course is not marked; participants receive a GPS track by email. Cut-offs at the aid stations: Boguszyn 10:45, Charbielin 12:00, Lake Dominickie 13:00, Papiernia 14:00, Krzyżowiec 15:30. Entry fee 160 PLN, of which 56 PLN goes to charity; registration on datasport.pl until 21 December 2026. Limit 25 runners and 10 cyclists, adults only, no rankings.

name: 27 Szczeciński Bieg Noworoczny
location: Teatr Letni im. Heleny Majdaniec, Szczecin, Poland
description: Szczeciński Bieg Noworoczny 2027 is an annual running event held on January 1 at the Helena Majdaniec Summer Theatre in Szczecin. The program includes the 5 km Main Run, Nordic Walking, and children’s races for different age groups. The Main Run route follows the paths of Jan Kasprowicz Park, passes by Psia Polana, and loops around Jasne Błonia. The start and finish are at the same location. The event is a great opportunity to start the new year actively in a sporting atmosphere, with medals for every participant.
course_highlights: The Main Run route consists of two 2.5 km loops
The route follows the paths of Jan Kasprowicz Park, passes by Psia Polana, and loops around Jasne Błonia
Start and finish at the Helena Majdaniec Summer Theatre
additional: Race bibs are distributed on December 29 and 30, 2026, from 17:00 to 19:30. A baggage deposit is available at the race office throughout the event. Changing rooms are available in the start area by the Summer Theatre from the time the race office opens. Capacity: 470 places for the Main Run and Nordic Walking combined, and 115 places for the children’s races. Children start in three heats according to age group, over distances of approximately 100, 200, and 400 m. Every child participating in a race receives a commemorative medal. The program includes Nordic Walking and children’s races over distances of approximately 100, 200, and 400 m. Places are limited.

name: Horovská desiatka
description: Horovská desiatka is a traditional New Year’s Eve race, now being held for the 40th time. It starts by the Cultural Centre in Horovce. Runners compete on a 10 km course from Horovce to Tušice and back. The event is suitable for the general public and offers categories for different age groups, including children. The atmosphere is friendly, making it an ideal way to end the year with a sporting achievement.
course_highlights: 10 km course from Horovce to Tušice and back
Start and finish by the Cultural Centre in Horovce
Traditional New Year’s Eve race with a long history
additional: There are categories for adults and children based on age. The course is one 10 km lap. The event takes place on 31 December as a New Year’s Eve race. Date: 31.12.2026; terrain: probably road; registration is available via websites; adults start at 11:00 and children at 9:30; several categories for different age groups.

name: Silvestrovský beh
location: Humenné, Mestský atletický štadión, Humenné, Slovakia
organizer: Atletický klub Humenné, Mesto Humenné, ZŠ Hrnčiarska
price_range: dorast a juniori: 10 €, online 15 €, na mieste 18 €, online 25 €
description: The New Year’s Eve Run in Humenné is a traditional running race held at the Municipal Athletics Stadium. This 43rd edition features a main 5.7 km event, with categories for juniors and men and women in different age groups. The race starts on December 31 at 11:00. Registration is available online until 11:00 on race day or in person at the venue from 8:30. Runners can download a GPX course map and view a route animation to help them prepare for the race.
course_highlights: A 5.7 km course at the Municipal Athletics Stadium in Humenné
Categories for juniors and men and women in different age groups
Option to download a GPX course map and view a route animation
additional: Categories are divided by age and gender. Registration is limited; currently, 253 participants have registered and 207 payments have been made. Terrain: municipal stadium; registration: online or in person; categories for different age groups.

name: Silvestrovský beh cez bratislavské mosty
location: Ekonomická univerzita v Bratislave, Bratislava, Slovakia

name: Silvestrovský kros – Dolné Orešany
location: Kultúrny dom, Dolné Orešany, Trnava District, Slovakia

name: ACSPORT.CZ Novoroční půlmaraton | desítka
description: ACSPORT.CZ Novoroční půlmaraton a desítka jsou tradiční běžecké závody pořádané v Brně, které se konají 1. ledna 2027. Závody startují společně ve 13:00 u pavilonu Anthropos v Pisárkách. Trasa je zcela zpevněná, mírně zvlněná a bezpečná bez křižování komunikací, což zajišťuje pohodlný a příjemný běh. Závodníci na desítce absolvují jeden okruh, půlmaratonci dva okruhy. Pořadatelé kladou důraz na pohodovou atmosféru a recyklaci startovních čísel z předchozích ročníků.
course_highlights: Start a cíl u pavilonu Anthropos, Brno - Pisárky
100% zpevněný povrch (asfalt, kostky), mírně zvlněný profil
Trať bez křižování komunikací s cyklistickým doprovodem v prvním kole
additional: Startovní čísla jsou recyklována z předchozích závodů a měření probíhá pomocí čipu. Občerstvení na trati zahrnuje vodu, iontový nápoj, colu a čaj. K dispozici je stan na uložení věcí v místě startu. Startovné je dobrovolné a lze jej uhradit převodem nebo QR kódem. Časový limit pro dokončení závodu je 3 hodiny.

name: Křinecký novoroční běh
price_range: od 200 Kč pro jednotlivce; od 400 Kč za štafetu

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné od 200 Kč při online registraci

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Startovné od 400 Kč při online registraci

description: Křinecký novoroční běh je tradiční závod konaný v zámeckém parku v Křinci, který nabízí běžcům možnost zúčastnit se hlavního závodu na 6 km nebo štafety ve dvoučlenných týmech na 3 + 3 km. Trať vede po 3 km okruhu s převýšením 16 metrů, převážně po asfaltu a zpevněných cestách. Závod je vhodný pro širokou veřejnost včetně kategorií podle věku a štafet. Po závodě je zajištěno občerstvení a vyhlášení výsledků probíhá ihned po doběhu posledního závodníka.
course_highlights: 3 km okruh s převýšením 16 m
Povrch: 80 % asfalt, 20 % zpevněné cesty
Trať vede zámeckým parkem v Křinci
additional: Maximální limit závodníků je 100 dospělých a 100 dětí. Kategorie hlavního závodu jsou rozděleny podle věku a pohlaví, včetně kategorií štafet. Občerstvení je zajištěno v místě startu a cíle. Závodníci startují na vlastní nebezpečí a musí dodržovat pravidla závodu a pokyny pořadatelů. Registrace probíhá pouze online. Kapacita je 100 dospělých a 100 dětí. Občerstvení bude v místě startu a cíle.

name: Eifellauf Oberweis/ Baustert
description: The Eifellauf Oberweis/Baustert is a relaxed run starting on January 1, 2027, at the Kobenborn sports field in Baustert. The event welcomes runners of all ability levels and offers a laid-back atmosphere without a race pace. The aim is to discover scenic running routes in the Eifel and encourage socializing among runners from different clubs. After the run, participants can shower and enjoy some time together over coffee, cake, or a beer.
course_highlights: Running routes in the Eifel with scenic sections
Three running groups at different paces, between 5:30 and 7:30 min/km
Optional hiking group covering approximately 7–8 km
additional: Runners usually meet on Saturdays at 14:30 at the meeting point. They run in groups, with the pace adjusted to the slowest participant. After the run, there is an opportunity to shower and relax together. The start is scheduled for 14:30.

name: Śląski Maraton Noworoczny Cyborg
description: The Silesian New Year’s Marathon CYBORG is an annual running event held on January 1 in Chorzów. Participants can take on the half-marathon or marathon distances. Organized by the W Kręgu Natury Association, the race combines sporting competition with the unique atmosphere of New Year’s celebrations. The event attracts both recreational and experienced runners, offering professional organization and support.
course_highlights: Distances: half-marathon and marathon
Course in Chorzów, in Silesia
New Year’s atmosphere and a sporting challenge
additional: Distances: half-marathon and marathon.

name: Bydgoszcz na Orientację
description: Bydgoszcz Orienteering is a series of orienteering events organized by the Bydgoszcz Orienteering Foundation, held in various forests and areas around Bydgoszcz. It is an activity for everyone, regardless of age or experience, combining sport with adventure and exploring nature using a map and compass. The Foundation promotes accessibility by also creating courses for blind and visually impaired participants. The series includes a variety of courses at different difficulty levels, and participants can earn badges for completing individual rounds.
course_highlights: A variety of forest terrain around Bydgoszcz, changing with each round
Courses for beginners and advanced participants, including courses for blind and visually impaired participants
The opportunity to earn digital badges and collectible stickers for completing rounds
additional: The series consists of six rounds held from November to January in various forests and areas around Bydgoszcz. For each completed round, participants receive a digital badge and a sticker for their collector card. A special final badge is available after completing the entire series. Courses cater to different ability levels, and the final round features a mass start on the semi-open grounds of a former farmstead.

name: Kresowe Trail #1
description: Kresowe Trail is a series of small-scale trail races organized by the Kresowe Marathons Foundation, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in natural surroundings. The races take place on scenic routes in eastern Poland, with respect for nature and local communities. The events are for both beginner and experienced runners, aiming to build a running community based on passion, competition, and friendship. Each race offers carefully marked courses, electronic timekeeping, and a generous race package.
course_highlights: Trail courses ranging from approximately 5 km to over 18 km
Carefully marked trails with colored arrows (green, red, purple)
Aid stations along the course and at the finish; time limit of approximately 2 hours
additional: Registration is available on race day until 08:40 and on-site from 8:00. New race numbers are in use starting with the 2026 season; the first race number is free of charge. The race package includes a hot recovery meal (vegetarian option also available), electronic timekeeping, medical support, aid stations along the course and at the finish, a commemorative medal (for early registration), photography service, and points toward the series’ overall standings. Littering on the course is strictly prohibited. Online registration and race-day on-site registration are available.

name: Lekkoatletyczne Halowe Mistrzostwa Europ... Bieg Uliczny 5 km
description: The 15th European Masters Athletics Indoor Championships will be held in Toruń. As part of the event, a 5 km road race is being organised, offering masters runners an excellent opportunity to compete on the city’s scenic routes. The competition combines sporting rivalry with a spirit of camaraderie among masters athletes.
course_highlights: A 5 km road race in the centre of Toruń
Scenic urban routes with historic views
An accompanying event to the indoor athletics championships
additional: The 5 km road race is part of the programme of the 15th European Masters Athletics Championships Indoor in Toruń. Programme details are available in a PDF on the main website. No information is available about entry fees or online registration. The 5 km road race was also one of the championship events in 2026.

name: XVII Noworoczny Bieg z Ochotą
description: The New Year's Run is an annual running event held in Warsaw, giving participants the chance to run into the New Year full of energy. The course passes through the capital's scenic spots, offering both amateur and more experienced runners a unique sporting experience. The organizers provide professional support and a friendly atmosphere, encouraging everyone to celebrate together and start the new year actively.

name: XX Jubileuszowy Śląski Maraton Noworoczn...
description: The 20th Anniversary Silesian New Year’s Cyborg Marathon took place in Silesian Park in Chorzów. Participants could choose between one and six 7 km loops, covering distances from 7 km to the marathon, while Nordic Walking enthusiasts could take part in a half marathon. The start and finish were by the Silesian Park administration building. It was an opportunity for people to start the new year actively, at their own pace and over a distance of their choice.
course_highlights: 7 km loops, with a choice of one to six
Running distances from 7 km to the marathon
Nordic Walking half marathon over three loops
additional: The start was scheduled for 12:00. The marathon time limit was 360 minutes; participants could change the number of loops during the race. At the finish, participants received a medal, hot tea and a warm meal.

name: Wbiegnij z Nami w Nowy Rok
price_range: Od 20 zł do puszki na cel charytatywny
description: “Run” into the New Year with us is an annual running meet-up held in Szczecin by Lake Głębokie. Participants cover around 5 km together. The event is social and charitable, combining sport with an opportunity to support those in need. There is an option to take an ice bath after the run, and the whole event takes place in a friendly atmosphere that encourages people to exchange New Year’s wishes. This informal running event invites everyone to start the new year actively.
course_highlights: An approximately 5 km route by Lake Głębokie
Option to take an ice bath after the run
A social meet-up with New Year’s wishes
additional: The event takes place on 1 January at 12:00 by Lake Głębokie in Szczecin. There is an option to take an ice bath after the run. The event is charitable, with a minimum donation of 20 zł to the collection tin. It is not a traditional running event, but a social running meet-up. The start is at 12:00 from a forest clearing or car park, approximately 400 m from the roundabout at Głębokie, in the direction of Wołczkowo. Participation is non-competitive and at your own risk. Anyone planning to take an ice bath should bring suitable equipment.

name: Trnavský novoročný beh – Memoriál Ladislava Kmeča
Winterlaufserie Rodgau Jügesheim (3)
description: The Rodgau Winter Running Series is a long-standing running event that has taken place in Rodgau since 1980, attracting both recreational runners and top athletes from Germany and abroad. The series comprises four races during the winter months from November to February, with 5 km and 10 km courses. The three best times out of the four races count toward the series standings, with daily award ceremonies after each race and a major series awards ceremony at the final race. The races take place at the Maingau-Energie-Stadion in Rodgau-Jügesheim and offer a friendly atmosphere for all ability levels.
course_highlights: Four races over 5 km and 10 km during the winter months
The three best times out of four races count
Event at the Maingau-Energie-Stadion in Rodgau-Jügesheim
additional: The series number must be brought to all series races. There is a team competition. The first 250 series registrations receive a gift. Registration is possible until the second race. Bib distribution from 12:00 at the Maingau-Energie-Stadion. Start times: 5 km at 14:00 and 10 km at 15:00. The series comprises four races; the three fastest results count toward the series standings. Organizer: Troia Laufevents.

name: Winterserie PSV Rot-Gold Lehrte 26/27
description: The PSV Rot-Gold Lehrte Winter Series offers a relaxed opportunity to run during the quieter competition season for beginners, advanced runners, experienced runners, and walkers. Runs take place on Saturdays in groups on public roads and paved and unpaved forest and field paths. The focus is on running together and socializing in a friendly atmosphere. The event includes various distances and concludes with a closing event at the club premises.
course_highlights: Running on public roads and paved and unpaved forest and field paths
Group runs accompanied by club runners
Free tea, coffee, and cake at the start area
additional: Meet from 13:45; finish cutoff at 16:30. Changing and shower facilities and parking are available at the start area. Times are not recorded, but running distances are. The closing event, with food and drinks, takes place at the club premises.

name: Warta Challenge
location: Łysy Młyn forest parking, ul. Poznańska 4, 62-003 Biedrusko, Poland
organizer: SPORT CHALLENGE Fundacja Wspierania Aktywności Fizycznej
description: WARTA CHALLENGE Marathon&Half is a winter tournament consisting of a series of four races and Nordic Walking events, held on forest tracks and trails in the Warta River forests. The events offer half-marathon (21.3 km) and marathon (42.2 km) distances, as well as shorter 5 km and 10 km runs and walks. The event has an intimate atmosphere and is intended for both amateur and professional athletes, with themed races and special touches. The start and race office are located by the Łysy Młyn forest car park in Biedrusko, and the race starts at 10:00. The course follows forest trails and tracks, with some paved sections and natural obstacles such as leaves, mud, and puddles.
course_highlights: The half-marathon course is one 21.3 km loop; the marathon consists of two loops.
The course mainly follows the blue cycling trail along the Warta River and the Łysy Młyn running trail.
The forest surface is slippery and uneven, with leaves, mud, and puddles; total elevation gain is 110 m for the half-marathon.
additional: Race packs can be collected on race day from 7:45 to 9:30 at the race office. Themed outfits and touches are encouraged for the individual races. The course is not officially certified and is measured using bicycle odometers and a Garmin device. Nordic Walking events are also held over 21.3 km, as well as runs and walks over 5 km and 10 km. The New Year's Run is event no. 2 in the series. The event centre and race office are by the Łysy Młyn forest car park, ul. Poznańska 4, 62-003 Biedrusko. Race-pack collection on race day is scheduled for 7:45–9:30, and the start is at 10:00. Free parking is available by the event centre.

name: Zimní běh Kobeřicemi
location: Stadion TJ Sokol, Kobeřice, Moravian-Silesian Region, Česko
description: Zimní běh Kobeřicemi je tradiční běžecký závod pořádaný v Kobeřicích na stadionu TJ Sokol. Hlavní závod se koná 3. ledna 2027 s startem v 10:00 hodin a nabízí tratě pro muže na 10 km, ženy na 5 km a dětský běh. Závod je součástí Prajzsko-opavské běžecké ligy a je otevřený různým věkovým kategoriím mužů i žen. Prezentace závodníků začíná od 9:00 hodin přímo na místě startu.
course_highlights: Trať pro muže 10 km a ženy 5 km
Dětský běh jako součást závodu
Start a cíl na stadionu TJ Sokol v Kobeřicích
additional: Prezentace závodníků probíhá od 9:00 hodin na místě startu. Závod je součástí Prajzsko-opavské běžecké ligy s kategoriemi podle věku mužů a žen. V programu je také dětský běh. Prezentace začíná v 9:00 a start je v 10:00.

name: Hülskens Marathon Wesel
organizer: Lauffreunde HADI Wesel e.V. und Hülskens Holding GmbH & Co. KG
description: The Hülskens Marathon Wesel is Germany’s first marathon of the year and offers a shared running experience at the Auesee in Wesel on January 3, 2027. The event includes marathon, half marathon and relay competitions on an officially measured 7.1 km loop. The course runs partly on asphalt and compacted gravel, with the start and finish at the Westenergie-Auestadion. The event combines a sporting challenge with a friendly atmosphere, live music and motivating commentary.
course_highlights: 7.1-kilometer loop around the Auesee with asphalt and gravel paths
Start and finish at the Westenergie-Auestadion in Wesel
Officially measured course in accordance with international standards (WA/AIMS)
additional: Timing is recorded by a chip in the race bib, with a €3 deposit refund. Relay runners receive a back bib and a relay race number to use as a baton. On race day, changing from the marathon to the half marathon is possible for a €5 fee. The event features a heated tent, spectator areas, live commentary and music spots along the course. Every finisher receives a special medal. Relay teams can have three or six runners, with each team member completing one lap.

name: Lauf 38. Winterlaufserie
description: The 38th Winter Running Series “Rund um den Haugnisberg” takes place at the Jakob-Vogt-Stadion in Ochtendung and is a long-standing classic on the running scene in the Mayen-Koblenz district. The series comprises four races over the winter months, with runners completing a loop on asphalt and forest trails through the Eifel foothills. Courses of 4 and 8.1 kilometres are offered, along with a 4-km walking category for Nordic walkers and recreational walkers. The youngest participants can choose shorter distances of 400 and 1,400 metres. The stadium has changing rooms and showers right by the start and finish area.
course_highlights: A loop on asphalt and forest trails through the Eifel foothills
Start and finish at the Jakob-Vogt-Stadion, with changing rooms and showers
Series standings across four races, with the best three races counting
additional: The series consists of four races on December 6, January 3, February 7 and March 7. Three of the four races count toward the standings. Class winners receive prizes in kind, and participants who complete three races receive a certificate. The options are a 4-km and an 8.1-km run, 4-km walking, and children’s races over 400 m and 1,400 m. Three of the four series races count toward the overall standings. Changing rooms and showers are available at the start and finish.

name: Meininger Silvesterlauf
description: The Meininger New Year's Eve Run is a long-standing running event held annually in Meiningen at Elisabethenburg Palace. The event offers various distances for pupils, young people, and adults, including a 10-kilometer main race. The races start in the morning and offer a sporting way to end the year actively. The route runs through Meiningen’s picturesque surroundings and is suitable for both ambitious runners and recreational athletes.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Elisabethenburg Palace
Routes for pupils and young people, plus a 10 km main race
Run through Meiningen’s historic city center and scenic surroundings
additional: Start times: 10:00 a.m. pupils’ race/schools, 10:30 a.m. youth and middle-distance races (4 km, 6 km), 11:30 a.m. 10 km main race. The pupils’ race starts at 10:00 a.m.; the main races start at 10:30 a.m. The three top-ranked schools receive awards. Register via the PSV Meiningen website or Laufservice Jena.

name: Neujahrslauf Wedel
distance_verbose: 113 km, 90 km, Halbmarathon, 12.3 km, 10 km, 7 km, 6.5 km, 1.9 km, 1 km
description: The Lauftreff Wedel e.V. New Year’s Run is an active start to the new year, inviting families, people from Wedel and running enthusiasts to run together in Wedel on January 3, 2027. There are runs for children over 1,000 m, as well as 6.5 km and 10 km routes in three different pace groups, including for walkers. The event is all about fun and community: there is no timing, but all participants receive a race number and a medal. The meeting point and registration are at the Wedel sports hall, and the run starts at 12:00. Proceeds go to the Villa in Wedel.
course_highlights: 1,000 m children’s and family run, with the Roland of Wedel at the start
6.5 km walking route in three pace groups, including for walkers
10 km dyke run, a regular route for Lauftreff Wedel, in three pace groups
additional: The meeting point and registration are at or outside the Wedel sports hall at Bekstraße 18, from 10:45 until 11:45 at the latest. There are no refreshment stations along the route, but after the run all participants receive a chocolate medal and hot non-alcoholic New Year’s punch or water. In extreme weather conditions, changes may be made at short notice; check the Lauftreff Wedel Facebook page for updates. The meeting point and registration are at the Wedel sports hall, Bekstraße 18. No advance registration is required. There are no refreshment stations on the route; non-alcoholic New Year’s punch or water will be available at the finish.

name: Silvesterlauf Wesertal
location: Klinik- und Rehazentrum Lippoldsberg, Wesertal, Germany
description: The Vernawahlshausen New Year's Eve Run takes place on January 3, 2027, in Wesertal-Vernawahlshausen at its new venue, the Lippoldsberg Clinic and Rehabilitation Center. The event offers races for everyone over distances of 5 km, 13.5 km and 21.5 km, as well as a 5 km walk. Refreshments include fruit and tea, followed after the run by sausage, waffles or drinks. Changing rooms and showers are available on site. The run counts toward the Reinhardswald Cup and welcomes both recreational runners and competitive athletes.
course_highlights: 5 km, 13.5 km and 21.5 km routes through the Wesertal region
Start and finish at the Lippoldsberg Clinic and Rehabilitation Center, with changing rooms and showers
Refreshments include fruit and tea, followed after the run by sausage, waffles or drinks
additional: A carpool meeting point is at 10:30 a.m. at Angerstadion Hofgeismar. Late registration is available on site for an additional fee. The run counts toward the Reinhardswald Cup. Changing rooms and showers are available on site. Fruit and tea are offered at the finish; when returning the race number, participants can choose a sausage, a waffle or a drink. The walk is untimed.

name: Winter Crosslaufserie 2026/27 – 7. Termin
description: The TV Goldbach Winter Cross-Country Series invites runners to a series of cross-country races in Goldbach. This event is part of the 43rd edition of the series. It is for everyone who enjoys running cross-country courses during the winter season.

name: Poznański Bieg Noworoczny
description: The Poznań New Year Run is the first race of the Poznań Running Triad, held on cross-country paths around Lake Rusałka. The 2027 edition is on Sunday 3 January 2027, with the race centre at the POSiR Golęcin stadium. There are 5 km and 10 km distances, which can be run or walked with no time limit. It is organised by the Biegiemwlas association and Pracownia Urban Projekt, with a cap of 750 participants.
course_highlights: Cross-country paths around Lake Rusałka
First race of the 2027 Poznań Running Triad
Traditional sweet Poznań treat at the finish
additional: Race office opens at 08:30, the 5 km starts at 10:00 and the 10 km at 11:00, children's races from 12:30. Basic entry: 79 PLN until 30 November, 89 PLN until 18 December, 99 PLN until 31 December; packages with a buff or shirt up to 149 PLN, 120 PLN at the race office if places remain. Registration closes on 31 December 2026 at 23:59. A pass for the whole Triad (3 January, 3 May, 11 November 2027) costs 209-229 PLN. Minimum age 15 with parental consent.

name: 5 Wieluński Bieg Noworoczny
description: The 5th Wieluń New Year’s Run is an annual running event organized by the Atelier Sport Association in Wieluń. The race takes place in early January and attracts runners from various regions. The race is scheduled to start at 12:00, and timing is provided using modern electronic systems. The organizers ensure a high standard of event organization and sporting competition, providing professional support and an atmosphere conducive to racing.
additional: Timing is provided using a state-of-the-art electronic system based on RFID chips and mats at the start and finish lines. The organizer provides telephone contact from 8:00 to 16:00 and support on race day. The event is organized by the Atelier Sport Association. No confirmed details are available about the 2027 edition.

name: Bieg Noworoczny
organizer: Fundacja Duet – Rozwój z Pasją; Stowarzyszenie Wroniecki Klub Biegacza
description: The New Year’s Run kicks off the new year and running season in the Wronki Municipality on January 3, 2027. The running and walking route passes through the picturesque forests and landscapes of the Noteć Forest, offering participants an unforgettable experience. The event is open to runners and walkers of different ages and fitness levels, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity. At the finish, participants can enjoy attractions, prizes, and the chance to connect with fellow running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: The route passes through the picturesque forests of the Noteć Forest
Distances of approximately 5 km and 10 km are available for runners, and 5 km for walkers
The start and finish are on Rzecińska Street in Wronki
additional: The race office will be open on race day from 9:45 to 10:45 on Rzecińska Street. Chip timing will be provided by PLUS TIMING. The winners’ awards ceremony will take place at the Zamość estate community center on Topolowa Street. A food and drink area with hot tea and coffee will be available at the finish. Participants under 18 must submit written consent from a parent or guardian. The organizer does not allow anyone under 15 to take part in the race. Participation is open from age 15; minors need written consent from a guardian.

name: Noworoczny Bydgoszcz FAN Maraton od 2014...
description: Bydgoszcz Fan Marathon is a unique long-distance event held in Bydgoszcz since 2014, mainly at the KS Gwiazda stadium and along the Old Bydgoszcz Canal. The course consists of multiple loops of approximately 4.22 km, following park paths with a gravel-and-asphalt surface and little elevation change. The event is small-scale and friendly, promoting recreational exercise and active leisure while continuing the tradition of similar races in other European cities. Participants time themselves and report their times to the organizers. Both runners and Nordic walkers are welcome. The start is usually in the morning, and the atmosphere is informal and friendly.
course_highlights: The course follows park paths around the Old Bydgoszcz Canal, with 4.22 km loops
Gravel-and-asphalt surface, mostly gravel
Start and finish at the KS Gwiazda stadium; little elevation change (approximately 53 m above sea level at the start and 45.95 m above sea level at the turnaround)
additional: There is no time limit; participants time themselves and report their times by email. People over 18 may take part, including Nordic walkers and walkers. The race office is located on the park path by the KS Gwiazda stadium. No entry fee is planned, except in special circumstances. Participants provide their own drinks and nutrition. The start is usually at 8:00 or 9:00. The course requires completing a multiple of the loop, up to a maximum of 10 loops. Participants arriving after the scheduled start time start together with the first participant. The event has no entry fee and no medals.

name: Zamczyska Winter Trail
location: Wooden shelters above Czarny Potok, Rymanów-Zdrój, Poland
description: The 12.5 km course follows both marked and unmarked hiking trails, additionally marked by the organizer to make navigation easier. The race requires good physical fitness and experience in challenging terrain. Participants must cover a total elevation gain of +650 m within 2 hours and 30 minutes. The participant limit is 200, and the start and finish are by the wooden shelters above Czarny Potok.
course_highlights: 12.5 km course with a total elevation gain of +650 m
Race along marked and unmarked hiking trails
Two checkpoints and water stations along the course
additional: The participant limit is 200, with the possibility of increasing it. The race office is open from 8:00 to 9:45. There are two checkpoints and water stations along the course. The time limit is 2 hours and 30 minutes. Participants must be at least 18 years old and have experience in mountain running. The entry fee must be paid within 48 hours of registration. If withdrawing, a refund of the entry fee is possible until 30.11.2026. The participant limit is 200, and the time limit is 2 hours and 30 minutes. Participation is for adults with experience running in challenging terrain. Registration is via raatiming.pl.

name: 10 Bieg Trzech Króli
description: The 10th Łódź Three Kings Run is a 5 km street race held on January 6, the Feast of the Epiphany. The start and finish are at Manufaktura Market Square, and the route runs through the streets of Łódź, including Piotrkowska Street. Join us to kick off the year with a sporting event in a festive atmosphere.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Manufaktura Market Square
5 km street route
The route includes Piotrkowska Street

name: Ultra CK Maraton
description: Ultra CK Marathon is a winter endurance event featuring running and cycling in the Świętokrzyskie Mountains. Participants can choose from three routes: a 51 km ultra run with substantial elevation gain, a fast 15 km mountain run, and a 30 km MTB ride. The ultra route passes through challenging, snow-covered forests and the freezing Piekło Cave, making it especially demanding and atmospheric. Held in harsh winter conditions, the event offers participants a true challenge and the satisfaction of conquering a hellish course.
course_highlights: Hellish Loop: 51 km ultra run with approximately 1,520 m of elevation gain through snow-covered forests and Piekło Cave
Devil’s Breath: 15 km fast mountain run with approximately 422 m of elevation gain on technical forest trails
Ghostly Thirty: 30 km MTB ride on wintery, slippery singletracks with approximately 828 m of elevation gain
additional: The race office is open on 5.01.2027 from 16:00 to 20:00 and on 6.01.2027 from 6:00 at Hala Legionów Kielce. Mandatory equipment for participants in the 51 km ultra run: a headlamp, an NRC emergency blanket, a charged mobile phone, proof of identity, and clothing suited to the weather conditions. Time limits apply at the individual checkpoints and at the finish. Ultra-run participants must carry safety equipment, including a headlamp, an NRC emergency blanket, and a charged phone.

name: Dreikönigs-Benefizlauf
description: The SV Unterwurmbach Three Kings Charity Run takes place every year on Epiphany and is the first running event of the year. Participation is free and open to all age groups, who can test their performance on three running courses and two Nordic walking courses. The event supports a good cause, as all donations go to local organizations. More than €80,000 has been raised so far.
course_highlights: Three running courses for all age groups
Two Nordic walking courses
Event at the Unterwurmbach sports field in Gunzenhausen
additional: The event raises donations for local organizations. The venue is the Unterwurmbach sports field in Gunzenhausen. All participants start together at 13:30 at the Unterwurmbach sports field. No timekeeping; no age limit. Donations from the 2027 run will support the Hospizverein Landkreis Weißenburg-Gunzenhausen and the Herzpflaster association from Roth.

name: Dreikönigslauf Herbolzheim
location: Sporthalle Neudenau-Herbolzheim, Herbolzheim, Neudenau, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The 15th Herbolzheim Three Kings Run on January 6, 2027, invites all running enthusiasts to start the new year together with some exercise. The run takes place on the original Gänslauf course and offers a relaxed atmosphere with no timing or rankings. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km, or run longer distances if they wish. The focus is on camaraderie, the joy of exercise, and the shared running experience. The event is an official DLV charity run, with voluntary donations benefiting social institutions in Neudenau.
course_highlights: Run on the original Gänslauf course or a suitable alternative route, depending on weather conditions
Suitable for all ability levels, with a free choice of distance from 5 km
Accompanied by experienced running guides offering tips and insights
additional: No entry fee, no timing, no rankings, and no performance pressure. Free drinks and refreshments after the run. Showers and changing facilities are available in the Herbolzheim sports hall. Meet at the Neudenau-Herbolzheim sports hall from 9:30 a.m. to change and greet other participants. Start at 10:00 a.m. at the Neudenau-Herbolzheim sports hall; arrival from 9:30 a.m. is recommended. Hot sausages and tea will be served afterward. Showers and changing facilities are available at the sports hall.

name: Maurener Dreikönigslauf
description: The Mauren Three Kings Run is a traditional winter race held annually on Three Kings’ Day in Mauren. The course takes runners along scenic routes, including in the direction of Fuchsbau, and offers a wintry atmosphere with snow and cold temperatures. The race attracts both competitive athletes and recreational runners and is known for its friendly, encouraging atmosphere. In addition to the main race, there is a short course that is particularly suitable for beginners and young people.
course_highlights: Scenic route in the direction of Fuchsbau
Wintry conditions with snow and cold temperatures
Snow-covered, firm snow surface as a challenge
additional: On-site registration is also possible. Series participants who take part in at least 4 races will receive a non-cash prize at the closing event on 13.12.2026 in Oettingen. Photos of the races are taken by Sebastian Stadali and are available online.

name: Sparkassen Neujahrs-Teamlauf

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Kostenlos (0 €) dank unserer Partner Sparkasse Coburg-Lichtenfels, HUK-COBURG, TSV Scheuerfeld

description: The Sparkassen New Year’s Team Run in Coburg-Scheuerfeld is a team run with no timing or performance pressure, taking place on January 6, 2027. Around 200 runners and Nordic walkers will set off on routes of varying lengths, from 10 km to 30 km, to start the new year actively and socially. The focus is on sharing the experience and enjoying exercise, with plenty of time for conversation along the routes. At the finish, participants can enjoy a generous buffet at the TSV Scheuerfeld clubhouse.
course_highlights: Routes through the area around Scheuerfeld
10 km, 21.1 km and 30 km running routes, plus 10 km Nordic walking
Guided routes with route leaders at different paces
additional: Race number collection is from 09:30 to 10:45. The route is not marked; route leaders are available at different paces. Public transport access is via Coburg Central Station (HBF Coburg), bus line 7 or 8301, to the Scheuerfeld/Dörfles stop, followed by an approximately 10-minute walk to the start. Voluntary donations are welcome. Route leaders accompany groups at different paces. A buffet is available at the finish at the TSV Scheuerfeld clubhouse; GPX files of the routes are provided.

name: TV Lauingen
description: The TV Lauingen VR Triathlon is a varied sporting event taking place on June 13, 2027. It offers several distances, including middle, short, youth, and popular distances, and is aimed at competitive athletes, recreational athletes, and beginners. The races take place around Auwaldsee and the town of Lauingen, with fully closed cycling routes and a flat circuit. The event is distinguished by a strong sense of community and professional organization.
course_highlights: Swimming in Auwaldsee
Cycling on a fully closed course with turnarounds through Lauingen and Weisingen
Flat running circuit
additional: Race-day check-in from 07:00 to 08:30; race briefing at 08:15. Start times: popular triathlon at 08:30, middle distance at 09:00, Olympic distance at 10:15. Finish cutoff at 16:00. Late registration is possible the day before for an additional fee. Drafting is prohibited at all distances. Children’s triathlon for ages 8–13 on June 12, with distances of 0.1/2.5/0.4 km.

name: Aichacher Dreikönigslauf
distance_verbose: 10 km, 5 km, 3000 Meter, 1500 Meter, 1.2 km, 0.4 km

name: 3 Maraton Alei Wielkiej Wyspy
location: Aleja Wielkiej Wyspy, Park Wschodni, Wrocław, Poland
description: The 3rd Great Island Avenue Marathon is a marathon held in Wrocław. The street course runs along Great Island Avenue, and the event is associated with East Park. It is an option for runners looking to take on the full marathon distance in an urban setting.
course_highlights: Street course in Wrocław
Run along Great Island Avenue
Located in the area of East Park

name: Grand Prix Trójmiasta 1/3
location: Brzeźno Pier (Molo w Gdańsku-Brzeźnie), Gdańsk, Poland
description: The 3 Kings Run is the first event in the 2027 Grand Prix of the Tri-City series, held on a 100% sandy beach course in Gdańsk-Brzeźno. The event includes a 6 km cross-country run and 6 km Nordic walking, with age categories and three-person team competitions requiring at least one woman. The event is small-scale, with a participant limit of 500, offering an intimate atmosphere and sporting competition on the scenic coast. The run starts at 9:00, and the winners’ awards ceremony will take place at around 11:30.
course_highlights: 100% beach course
6 km cross-country run
6 km Nordic walking
additional: The event office opens at 07:30. Three-person teams (for both the run and Nordic walking), with at least one woman, must register at the event office. Participant limit: 500. Participants can choose the 6 km cross-country run or Nordic walking. Three-person team competition is also available, with at least one woman on each team.

name: 10 Bieg III Króli
location: Hotel Barczyzna Medical Spa, Barczyzna, Nekla, Poland
description: The 10th Three Kings Run is a 10 km road race taking place on January 6, 2027, in Nekla. The event is an excellent opportunity to start the new year actively and check your running fitness. The organizers encourage participants to prepare using individual training plans tailored to their level. The race is moderately challenging and takes place on an asphalt course.
course_highlights: A 10 km road course
Moderate difficulty
Held in scenic Nekla
additional: Individual training plans of 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level and supported by experts with detailed training instructions.

name: Trojkráľova šestka
location: Športový areál AŠK Slávia Trnava, Trnava, Slovakia

name: Běh kolem Žabárny
location: Rtyně v Podkrkonoší, Královéhradecký kraj, Česko
description: Běh kolem Žabárny je tradiční zimní běžecký závod pořádaný tělovýchovnou jednotou Maratonstav Úpice v Rtyni v Podkrkonoší. Závod nabízí start dětských kategorií a hlavní závod, který navazuje bezprostředně po doběhnutí dětí. Akce je součástí Zimní běžecké ligy a je vhodná pro širokou veřejnost včetně rodin s dětmi. Start i prezentace probíhají přímo v Rtyni v Podkrkonoší, což zajišťuje pohodlný přístup a příjemnou atmosféru závodu.
course_highlights: Zimní běžecký závod v Rtyni v Podkrkonoší
Start dětských kategorií a hlavního závodu na jednom místě
Součást Zimní běžecké ligy s celoroční platností startovného
additional: Prezentace do 9:30 hodin. Parkování u hřbitova ve Rtyni v Podkrkonoší. Číslo startovného platí po celou sérii Zimní běžecké ligy. Závod se koná 9. ledna 2027, start po dětských kategoriích, parkování u hřbitova v Rtyně v Podkrkonoší, závod je veden v češtině

name: Běh Partyzánskou stezkou
location: Restaurace Slavoj, Osek, Středočeský kraj, Česko
organizer: Slavoj Osek u Hořovic, Domeček Hořovice
description: Běh Partyzánskou stezkou je zimní krosový běh vedený převážně lesními cestami s prvními a posledními dvěma kilometry po asfaltu. Trať měří přibližně 9 km a je charakteristická sněhem a blátem, což přidává na náročnosti a atmosféře závodu. Závod startuje v Oseku u Hořovic u restaurace Slavoj a nabízí také dětské závody na asfaltu. Akce je součástí Brdského běžeckého poháru a je vhodná pro milovníky zimního běhu v přírodě.
course_highlights: Trať dlouhá 9 km s kombinací asfaltu a lesních cest
Zimní podmínky s častým sněhem a blátem
Dětské závody na asfaltu
additional: Možnost registrace na místě i předem. Povrch trati je kombinací asfaltu a lesních cest. Pořadatelem je Slavoj Osek u Hořovic. Dětské závody jsou součástí akce. Výsledky jsou dostupné v systému i v PDF. Pořadatelé také pořádají štafetu dvojic a další běžecké akce v rámci poháru. Dětské a dorostenecké tratě měří přibližně 200 až 2 000 metrů a vedou po asfaltu.

name: innogy Winter Run Hradec Králové
description: innogy Winter Run Hradec Králové je zimní běžecký závod pro každého, který se koná za každého počasí v malebném prostředí Smetanova nábřeží. Nabízí individuální běhy na tratích 8 km a 4 km, dále štafetu 2x4 km a dětský závod. Závod je součástí série Winter RUN a je vhodný pro všechny věkové kategorie i výkonnostní úrovně. Start i cíl jsou umístěny v blízkosti Aldisu na Eliščině nábřeží, což zajišťuje pohodlný přístup a příjemnou atmosféru. Po závodě probíhá vyhlášení výsledků a možnost zakoupení oficiálního funkčního trička a čelenky.
course_highlights: Zimní běh za každého počasí v centru Hradce Králové
Individuální tratě 8,6 km a 4,3 km s možností štafety 2x4 km
Dětské závody na 400 m a 800 m
additional: Slevy 30 % pro studenty s průkazem ISIC při online registraci a platbě v řádném termínu. Možnost objednat oficiální funkční tričko za 600 Kč a čelenku za 200 Kč do 20.12.2026. Startovní balíček obsahuje tašku s letáčky a dárky od partnerů. Registrace na místě je možná za vyšší cenu. Dětské závody startují od 10:00, hlavní závody od 12:00 a 13:00. Startovné na hlavní běhy zahrnuje startovní číslo, měřicí čip, občerstvení v cíli a kovovou medaili.

name: Desítka v Bezručáku
description: Desítka v Bezručáku je tradiční silniční běžecký závod na 10 km, který se koná v krásné přírodě Bezručova údolí v Chomutově, vyhlášeného přírodním parkem. Závod má dlouholetou tradici od roku 1977 a start i cíl jsou u ZŠ Heyrovského, odkud se běžci vydávají do zalesněného údolí. Trať mírně stoupá k obrátce za Prvním mlýnem a zpět nabízí příjemné klesání, přičemž závodníci minou památník básníka Petra Bezruče. Závod je známý svým přírodním charakterem a udržitelným přístupem, včetně dřevěných pamětních medailí pro všechny dokončivší.
course_highlights: Trasa vede zalesněným Bezručovým údolím, přírodním parkem s chráněnými živočichy
První polovina trati pozvolna stoupá k obrátce za Prvním mlýnem
Závodníci minou památník básníka Petra Bezruče
additional: Prezentace probíhá od 8:30 do 10:15. Startovné zahrnuje pamětní medaili vyrobenou ze dřeva s ohledem na udržitelný přístup. Z každého startovného je věnováno 50 Kč na podporu vybraného projektu či organizace. Závod se koná v zimním období a je součástí běžeckého kalendáře Chomutova. Start je plánován na 11:00, prezentace probíhá od 8:30 do 10:15. Kapacita závodu je 300 běžců a registrace je online; nové registrace na místě nejsou možné. Z každého uhrazeného startovného pořadatel věnuje 50 Kč vybranému projektu.

name: Atzenkleb-Crosslauf, 3. Lauf zur 17. OIE-Nahe-Crosslaufserie
description: The Atzenkleb Cross-Country Run is the third race in the 17th OIE Nahe Cross-Country Series and takes place at the Atzenkleb sports ground in Oberbrombach. The series comprises several races at different locations in the region and is open to runners of all ability levels. The event offers a varied cross-country course in a natural setting and promotes both sporting competition and camaraderie among participants. The series is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and the support of numerous volunteers.
course_highlights: Natural cross-country course at the Atzenkleb sports ground
Part of a regional race series with several stages
Varied courses for different ability levels
additional: Participants who take part in at least four races in the series receive a series gift (sports socks for the middle and long distances). When registering, participants must provide their sock size to receive the gift. The race starts at 13:00 at the Atzenkleb sports ground on Atzenklebweg.

name: Eifellauf Wißmannsdorf
description: The Eifellauf Wißmannsdorf is a relaxed run in the Eifel, taking place on January 9, 2027, at the Wißmannsdorf sports field. The event is for runners of all ability levels and offers several running groups at easy paces of 5:30 to 7:30 min/km. Routes range from 15 to 22 kilometers, with shorter introductory runs of up to 11–12 km also available. After the run, participants can shower and enjoy some relaxed socializing over coffee, cake, or a beer. The aim is to discover beautiful running routes and encourage runners to connect.
course_highlights: Running routes in the Eifel, 15–22 km long
Easy-paced running groups at 5:30 to 7:30 min/km
Beginner-friendly introductory runs of up to 11–12 km
additional: Runners meet on Saturdays at 14:30 at the meeting point. There are three running groups for different ability levels; this is not a race pace. Runs are usually announced in the Trierischer Volksfreund and on social media. The run is a non-competitive group run and part of the Eifel Winter Running Series.

name: Göttinger Cross-Serie (3. Lauf)
description: The Göttingen Cross-Country Series 2026/27 comprises three long-established cross-country races, held this winter at the University Sports Centre, Hainholzhof/Kehr and Jahnstadion. The third race, at Jahnstadion Göttingen, offers runners a range of distances, from schoolchildren’s races to the long-distance race. Multiple starts are allowed, and the event takes place in all weather, with the organizer excluding liability. Registration is online and requires personal details and a choice of race distance.
course_highlights: Traditional cross-country races at three different locations in Göttingen
A variety of distances, from approx. 900 m to approx. 10,000 m
Terrain with typical cross-country conditions at Jahnstadion
additional: Multiple starts are allowed. The races take place in all weather. Registration is via an online form, with required details about the race distance and personal information, as well as confirmation of the liability disclaimer and data protection provisions. Multiple starts are allowed; the event takes place in all weather.

name: Hersbrucker Trainingsmarathon
location: Kletterwelt Hersbruck, Happurger Straße, Hersbruck, Germany
description: The Hersbruck Training Marathon is an annual running event held in early January that is explicitly not a race. Participants run together in groups over four 10-kilometre stages, around 40 kilometres in total, starting and finishing at Kletterwelt Hersbruck. The event emphasises conviviality, conversation among runners, and a structured training session to prepare for spring races. Refreshments are provided during the run, followed by a group pizza meal at the Kletterwelt bistro.
course_highlights: Four 10 km stages, starting and finishing at Kletterwelt Hersbruck
Two pace groups at 6:00 and 7:00 min/km
Participants can join or leave between stages at any time
additional: Parking is available at the school centre and Plärrer; parking directly at the climbing centre is not allowed. Showers and changing facilities are available at the climbing centre. Drinks and excellent refreshments are available during the run; participants should bring their own cups. After the run, there is a group pizza meal and a convivial get-together at the Kletterwelt Hersbruck bistro. The meeting point is Kletterwelt Hersbruck on Happurger Straße. Two pace groups of approximately 6:00 and 7:00 min/km are offered. Refreshments are provided; participants should bring their own cups.

description: Trail!ON Stawiguda is a series of four 5 km trail races held monthly on the same scenic route near the forests and the Łyna River, close to Ruś. The winter scenery, forest trails and changing terrain create unique running conditions, giving runners a chance to test their fitness and enjoy the excitement of competition throughout the season. The event is for everyone who wants to spend their winter Saturdays actively, regardless of experience level. The organizers help make the event comfortable for participants by offering passes for the full series as well as the option to enter a single race.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through the beautiful forests of Ruś
Start and finish by the beach at the bend of the Łyna River in Stawiguda Municipality
Winter forest scenery with natural, changing terrain
additional: Mini Trail!ON children’s races are held over distances from 300 m to 1,000 m, with age-group divisions. Children’s races take place from 9:45 to 10:15. The race office closes at 10:30. An awards ceremony for the series winners and a bonfire with the Mayor are planned for the final race. Single-race entry can be purchased at the race office on race day. The main race is scheduled to start at 11:00. The program also includes children’s races over distances of approximately 300 m, 500 m and 1,000 m, as well as winter swimming. Online registration is open until January 6, 2027, at 23:59.

name: Backyard Ultra Polska
location: Poligon Wojskowej Akademii Technicznej, Bemowo, Warsaw, Poland
description: Backyard Ultra Warszawa - Bemowo is the first edition of a backyard-format race, held on the grounds of the Military University of Technology training area in Warsaw. The course is 6,706 km long, in accordance with the worldwide backyard rules. The event lasts a maximum of 24 hours, during which runners complete successive loops. The participant limit is 80, and the winner receives cash prizes, a trophy, and gifts from partners. All participants receive a commemorative medal and certificate.
course_highlights: A 6,706 km course in accordance with the backyard rules
The race takes place on the grounds of the Military University of Technology training area in Warsaw
A time limit of 24 hours (24 loops)
additional: The participant limit is 80, with the possibility of an increase at the organizer’s discretion. The winner receives a cash prize, a trophy, and prizes from partners. The winner of the Polish Uniformed Services Open Championships receives a trophy and prizes. The top resident of the Bemowo district receives a statuette and prizes. The limit is 80 runners. Available entry-fee options include a “for fun” participation option of up to 7 loops and a discount for members of the Polish Ultra Sports Association and the Bemowo Biega group.

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in seven locations, including Wrocław’s Osobowicki Forest. The event combines recreation and sport, promotes outdoor physical activity, and offers a friendly atmosphere for sporting competition. The series runs from October to April, and each race starts at 11:00. Participants can enter individually or purchase a season pass for the entire series in their city.
course_highlights: The course runs through Osobowicki Forest, a natural woodland area
A 5 km cross-country course in an urban forest
The series consists of four races in the 2026/2027 season
additional: The race office opens at 8:30. Race bibs and timing chips can be collected on race day. The schedule is the same at all locations. The entry fee is higher on race day. Participants can take part in a charity run in support of the Siepomaga Foundation. There is no participant limit. The main race starts at 11:00, and the event ends at around 12:15. Cars cannot access the area near the start and race office; parking along Osobowicka Street is subject to traffic staff instructions.

description: The Dziewicza Góra Grand Prix Mountain Running Series consists of six races on a scenic course in the Zielonka Forest Landscape Park. The route follows a 5.15 km loop through forest, climbing the highest hill, Dziewicza Góra, twice. The races bring together runners of different ages and abilities across various distances, and also offer Nordic walking and races for children and young people. The organizers provide professional timing and a welcoming atmosphere, creating a unique “Dziewicza Family.”
course_highlights: A 5.15 km loop through the forest
Two climbs to the summit of Dziewicza Góra
The course passes through the event centre, where spectators can cheer on participants
additional: Electronic timing using an ankle-mounted chip band. Race office open from 8:15 to 10:30. Participant limit: 500. The races are held as a series of six stages. Children’s and youth races over 200 m, 500 m, 1,000 m and 1,500 m. The course is marked with orange ribbons and directional arrows. Participants in the 10 km race complete two loops; after the first loop, they cross the finish line and continue onto the second loop. The 2026–2027 season consists of six stages; passes for the whole series were also available.

name: Viva Las Natalin
description: Viva Las Natalin is the 3rd Carnival Run, held in the picturesque forests of Natalin and attracting running and Nordic walking enthusiasts from across the Mazovia region. The event takes place in a wintry setting, and participants start in colorful costumes, creating a unique, lively atmosphere. It is organized by the “Z Biegiem Dwóch Rzek” Association in cooperation with Wyszków Municipality, WOSiR, and the Wyszków Forest District. The event offers several distances, including 5 km and 10 km runs, as well as 5 km Nordic walking, with separate classifications for women and men.
course_highlights: The route runs through the forests of Natalin
Picturesque winter scenery
Carnival atmosphere with participants in colorful costumes
additional: The event is organized by the “Z Biegiem Dwóch Rzek” Association in cooperation with Wyszków Municipality, WOSiR, and the Wyszków Forest District. Participants can take part in 5 km and 10 km runs, as well as 5 km Nordic walking. Prizes are presented by the authorities of Wyszków Municipality. The event has a carnival theme, with participants wearing colorful costumes.

name: Zimowa Strzyżewska Piątka
organizer: Powiatowe Centrum Sportu w Nowym Tomyślu; Zbąszyńskie Centrum Sportu, Turystyki i Rekreacji; ATE Wicher Strzyżewo; Sołectwo Strzyżewo; OSP Strzyżewo; Klub Biegacza TKKF „Łabędź” Zbąszyń
description: Zimowa Strzyżewska Piątka is a 10 km race held on the football pitch in Strzyżewo. The event takes place in a winter setting, adding a unique character to the competition. The start is scheduled for 8:00, and the event is organized by local sports and community institutions. The race attracts both amateur and more experienced runners, offering a friendly atmosphere and sporting excitement.
course_highlights: 10 km course
Start and finish at the football pitch, Strzyżewo 46A
Scenic winter setting in Strzyżewo
additional: The start and registration take place at the football pitch, Strzyżewo 46A. Registration and start hours are 8:00–8:45. The organizers are Powiatowe Centrum Sportu w Nowym Tomyślu, Zbąszyńskie Centrum Sportu, Turystyki i Rekreacji, and local community and sports organizations. The race office and start are at the football pitch in Strzyżewo 46A. On race day, participant registration runs from 8:00 to 8:45.

name: Trojkráľový beh na Hrad Lietava
description: The Three Kings Run to Lietava Castle is a mountain trail race with 367 metres of elevation gain, running from the grounds of the primary school in Lietava to the upper courtyard of Lietava Castle. The course is 8.3 km long, with approximately 1 km on asphalt and the rest on marked forest trails and meadows. The race is open to adults and younger runners with parental consent, and mountain insurance is required. Each participant receives a race pack with a bag, a baguette and presents, as well as a finisher’s medal at the finish. The race results and prize-giving will take place after all participants have finished.
course_highlights: 367 metres of elevation gain
Approximately 1 km on asphalt, with the rest on forest trails and meadows
Finish in the upper courtyard of Lietava Castle
additional: Race check-in and bib collection take place on 9 January 2027 from 08:00 to 09:30 in the primary school building in Lietava. On-site registration is possible only if places are available, for €15 in cash. There is space to change and a storage area for personal belongings on the school grounds. The time limit for completing the course is 2 hours. Race check-in and bib distribution take place on the grounds of Lietava Primary School. Mountain insurance covering mountain rescue intervention is compulsory.

name: hkk-Winterlaufserie
description: The 47th hkk Winter Running Series 2027 takes place in Bremen’s Bürgerpark and offers runners of all ability levels a varied winter race series. With distances ranging from 1.8 km for children to 20 km for experienced runners, there is something for everyone. The races take place on three dates in January, February and March and can be run individually or as a series. The wintry atmosphere and the option to order a medal make this a special sporting experience.
course_highlights: Races in wintry Bremen’s Bürgerpark, with its typical winter scenery
A range of distances from 1.8 km to 20 km across three dates
Routes on paved paths in winter conditions
additional: The Kids Series starts at 09:30 and the other series at 10:00. The event comprises five different series with varying distances and dates. After each race, there is a relaxed atmosphere in which to celebrate participants’ achievements. Races take place in winter conditions, so participants should dress accordingly. Walkers can also participate and receive a certificate showing their time and distance. The children’s races start at 09:30 and the remaining races at 10:00. The entry fee includes a €1 donation to Bürgerpark.

name: Crosslaufserie Vulkaneifel 2027 (Lauf 1)
location: Sportstätte Josef Ring am Sportplatz, Mehren, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
description: The Vulkaneifel Cross-Country Series is a long-standing race series featuring varied and challenging cross-country courses in the beautiful Vulkaneifel region. The race in Mehren takes place on natural forest trails and offers a friendly atmosphere, with loud applause in the finish area. The event is open to runners of all ability levels, from promising young athletes to recreational runners, combining sporting ambition with an experience of nature.
course_highlights: Varied forest trails instead of asphalt
Friendly atmosphere with loud applause in the finish area
Challenging cross-country courses in the Vulkaneifel
additional: The cross-country series consists of several races at different locations in the Vulkaneifel. To qualify for the overall standings, runners must complete three of the four races; one result may be discarded. The series is supported by Sparkasse Vulkaneifel. The race is approved as a public race by the Rheinhessen-Rheinland Athletics Association.

description: The reporter run is a cross-country race in Neustadt in Holstein, taking place on January 10, 2027. The event offers various distances from 800 m to 10 km for different age groups. The races start at the sports field at Gogenkrog and are known for their family-friendly atmosphere, with certificates and prizes for the top participants. Timing is provided by a transponder system, and changing rooms and showers are available on site.
course_highlights: Cross-country routes over 10 km, 5 km, 2 km and an 800 m Bambini run
Start and finish at the sports field at Gogenkrog
Family-friendly event with certificates and prizes for all age groups
additional: Late entries are possible until shortly before the start for a fee of €2.00. Changing rooms and showers are available at TSV Neustadt’s sports field at Gogenkrog. Parking is available at Zuckerdamm. Timing is provided by transponder. The main races are scheduled to start in the late morning.

name: Lorsbacher Winterlauf- und Walkingserie
location: Sporthalle Am Schinderwald, Lorsbach, Hofheim am Taunus, Germany
description: The Lorsbach Winter Running and Walking Series is a long-established event held in winter in Hofheim-Lorsbach. The series consists of five dates from late November to mid-February, when participants can start individually, without timekeeping. Two distances are offered, 10 km and 20 km, on varied routes through the forest that are permanently marked. The event is free, though a small donation is requested. After the run, refreshments include tea, coffee and cookies; soup and wheat beer are also served on the final date.
course_highlights: The 10 km route is permanently marked; the 20 km route is marked at intervals from late November to mid-February
The route runs mostly on paved forest paths and includes approximately 260 metres of elevation gain
Tea station at km 6.4 serving hot tea; start and finish at the sports hall at Schinderwald
additional: Participants start individually, without timekeeping; registration is not required. Changing rooms are open on running days from 8:00 to 13:00. The route is also available as a GPS track via Komoot. On the final date, soup, wheat beer, coffee and cake are served. The start and finish are at the sports hall at Schinderwald, Bornstraße 77, Hofheim-Lorsbach. Parking is available at the sports field and Hofheim-Lorsbach station. No registration is required; participants can take part in individual dates or the entire series. Hot tea is served on Sundays from 9:00 to 12:00 near the Bahai’i forest car park; please bring your own collapsible cup.

name: Rheinzaberner Winterlaufserie
location: Schulcampus der IGS Rheinzabern, Rheinzabern, Germany
description: The Rheinzabern Winter Running Series is a long-standing running event in the Southern Palatinate that has taken place annually since 1984. It consists of three winter races over 10 km, 15 km and 20 km, held on paved loop and out-and-back courses around the school campus of IGS Rheinzabern. The series offers both gun-time and chip-time results, with results published promptly. In addition to the main races, there is a supporting programme of events for beginners, children and families.
course_highlights: Paved loop and out-and-back courses
Officially measured 10 km course eligible for record lists
Refreshment stations for the 15 km and 20 km races, as well as at the finish
additional: Maximum of 1,500 participants per race. Bib numbers remain valid for all three races in the series and must be brought to each race. Refreshments for the 15 km and 20 km races are available at approximately km 11 and at the finish. The 10 km race is sold out; on-site registration for the 10 km race is not possible. Participants may enter the entire series or individual races. The series standings include the three main races; the bib number is valid throughout the series.

name: Sandkruger Schleife
description: The Sandkruger Schleife is a traditional race in the district of Oldenburg, celebrating its 30th edition on 10 January 2027. The event offers challenging 13-kilometre forest and asphalt courses, as well as a fast 5-kilometre loop and a children’s race. The course is well marked and passes through varied landscapes, with gently rolling sections in the forest and flat stretches. The event is especially popular and sells out well in advance, underscoring the strong demand and the race’s importance.
course_highlights: 13 km loop on forest and asphalt paths, with gently rolling terrain in the forest
5 km course follows a single loop through the forest
The course is clearly marked with barrier tape and arrows
additional: Race bib collection on 09.01.2027 from 11:00 to 13:00 and on race day from 07:30 at the sports hall at Schultredde 17. Late entries and transfers are possible up to 60 minutes before the respective start, for a fee of 3,00 euros. Timing is recorded using a chip on the race bib, which does not need to be returned. Showers and changing rooms are available in the sports hall. Parking is limited at Schultredde, as well as in the industrial park and on public grounds. Public transport stops at Sandkrug station, a 750-metre walk from the sports hall. The event is sold out; a race-entry exchange is available via the social media channels.

name: Winterlauf-/Wanderserie TuS Jaderberg (2. Teil)
description: The TuS Jaderberg winter running and walking series is a long-standing event in the Wesermarsch region. It gives runners and walkers the opportunity to stay active during the colder months and take on sporting challenges together. The series is open to all ages and ability levels and fosters a sense of community within the club and the region. The event takes place in the municipality of Jaderberg and is part of the wide range of sports offered by TuS Jaderberg e.V.
additional: The winter running series is currently looking for successors to take over its organization. The event is part of the club’s vibrant community, which offers numerous sports and activities at TuS Jaderberg.

name: Winterlaufserie
description: The Stadthagen Winter Running Series is a relaxed running and Nordic walking event consisting of 10 individual events. Participants can choose from four signposted loop courses of varying difficulty in the scenic Bückeberge hills. There is no mass start or timing, making it a stress-free way to assess your own performance. All participants receive a warm tea at the finish in the sports center.

description: The Kraków Mountain Running Grand Prix is a series of mountain races held in Kraków’s scenic terrain. Participants can choose from a variety of distances, from short children’s races to challenging mountain routes, including the Vertical. The event attracts both recreational and experienced runners, offering exciting competition and beautiful views. The organizers ensure professional race management and a rich program of additional events, including team classifications and relays. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and take on a sporting challenge.
course_highlights: Routes of varying lengths: 3.7 km, 5.7 km, 11.6 km, 23.2 km, and the 1.5 km Vertical
Scenic mountain terrain in Kraków with varied courses
Special races for children, as well as team competitions and relays
additional: Races start at various times on Sunday, including 9:00 (Harda Dwudziestka Trójka), 9:10 and 9:20 (children’s races), 9:40 (Przyjazna Trójka), 10:45 (Tradycyjna Piątka), and 11:00 (Ambitna Jedenastka). The Vertical GPK competition takes place on Saturday from 10:00 to 12:00. Team classifications, relays, and additional competitions such as GPK4Business and Iron GPK are also organized. The series also includes races for children. The date given falls on the 15th edition of the New Year’s Run, although the event name indicates the 14th Kraków Grand Prix.
