The running calendar lists the distance as 10 km, although route details are unavailable.
The event takes place on the day of the WOŚP Grand Finale.

name: XIII Bieg z Termami
description: The Run with the Thermal Baths is a running event in Mszczonów, inviting running enthusiasts and those who enjoy an active lifestyle. It’s an opportunity to meet at the starting line and run in the surrounding area.

name: XX Indywidualny Bieg dla WOŚP
description: The 20th Individual Run for WOŚP in Radom is an annual running event organized to support the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity. The race takes place on city routes that combine sporting competition with bringing the local community together. The organizers provide professional timekeeping and comprehensive technical support, ensuring participants’ comfort and safety. The event is for runners of various ability levels and promotes an active lifestyle and charitable causes.
course_highlights: City route in Radom
Professional RFID electronic timekeeping
Charity event supporting WOŚP
additional: Timekeeping and technical support are provided by Time-Sport.pl, a leader in professional timing for sporting events with many years of experience. The event uses RFID technology to ensure accurate timekeeping. Results from previous editions and a complaints form are available on the website. The event is part of a broader calendar of races organized by Time-Sport.pl in the region.

name: JIBE JAHA
location: Jablonec Dam, Jablonec nad Nisou, Liberec Region, Česko
description: JIBE JAHA je nejdelší zimní ultra maratonská výzva v Evropě, která vede z Jablonce nad Nisou do Havířova přes Jizerské hory a Beskydy. Tento závod není klasický organizovaný závod, ale spíše dobrodružství, kde závodníci čelí náročným zimním podmínkám a musí se spolehnout na vlastní navigační schopnosti. Trasa je pevně daná a vede často po turistických značkách, které v zimě nejsou upravované, což zvyšuje náročnost. Účastníci absolvují 150, 300 nebo 600 km a závod začíná hromadným startem 29. ledna v 9:00 na hrázi mezi první a druhou přehradou v Jablonci nad Nisou.
course_highlights: Trasa vede přes Jizerské hory a Beskydy, z Jablonce nad Nisou do Havířova
Náročné zimní podmínky s možností hlubokého sněhu nebo jeho absence
Trasa není značená, vyžaduje dobrý cit pro navigaci a používání GPS
additional: Účastníci musí absolvovat závod s pronajatým GPS trackerem, který slouží pro bezpečnost. V ceně trackeru je zahrnuto ubytování a občerstvení na kontrolních bodech, tričko závodu, finisher medaile, startovní balíček od Montane, společný raut během registrace, fotodokumentace a sleva na produkty Montane. Trasa je dostupná online na mapy.cz. Trasa není značená; účastníci dostanou GPX a musí mít GPS tracker. Akce není zdravotnicky ani organizačně zajištěna a účast je na vlastní nebezpečí.

name: Běh Velbabou
description: Běh Velbabou je tradiční zimní běžecký závod pořádaný Maratonstav tělovýchovnou jednotou Úpice v obci Radeč. Závod se koná v rámci Zimní běžecké ligy a nabízí starty dětských kategorií i hlavní závod. Trať vede malebným prostředím s muzeem v Radeči jako startovním místem. Akce je vhodná pro všechny věkové kategorie a běžce, kteří si chtějí užít zimní běh v přátelské atmosféře.
course_highlights: Start a cíl u muzea v Radeči
Součást Zimní běžecké ligy s celkovou platností startovného
Závodní tratě pro děti i dospělé
additional: Start hlavního závodu je bezprostředně po doběhnutí dětských kategorií. Prezentace je možná do 9:30 hodin v kanceláři závodu na místě startu. Číslo startujícího platí po celou sérii Zimní běžecké ligy. závod se koná v zimním období, registrace zahrnuje poplatky, trať není specifikována

name: LH24 – Winter Extreme Race
location: Arcibiskupská pila, Ostravice, Moravian-Silesian Region, Česko
organizer: SK K2 z. s.; Beskydská sportovní akademie s.r.o.
description: IMOS LH24 je extrémní vytrvalostní závod trvající 24 hodin, který je určen široké sportovní veřejnosti. Závod probíhá formou horské štafety dvojic a zároveň jednotlivců, kteří během závodu absolvují co nejvíce výstupů a sestupů na náročném okruhu vedoucím z Ostravice na vrchol Lysé hory. Trať je pevně daná a závodníci se pohybují v horském terénu s výrazným převýšením. Akreditace a start probíhají v areálu Arcibiskupské pily v Ostravici, kde je také zajištěno občerstvení a vyhřívaný prostor pro závodníky.
course_highlights: Okruh dlouhý 13,2 km s převýšením 850 m
Náročný horský terén vedoucí na vrchol Lysé hory
Start a cíl v areálu Arcibiskupské pily v Ostravici
additional: Akreditace probíhá 29. ledna od 16:00 do 20:00 a 30. ledna od 7:00 do 9:00 v Arcibiskupské pile. Závodníci jsou označeni ID čipem a startovními čísly na batohu či svrchním oděvu. Občerstvení je zajištěno v zastřešeném a vyhřívaném prostoru před restaurací hotelu Sepetná. Ubytování je možné v hotelu Sepetná a hotelu Ondráš. Závod nabízí individuální i štafetovou účast ve dvojicích.

name: Hamelner Cross-Winterlaufserie
location: Sportgelände beim Jugendgästehaus Finkenborn, Hameln, Germany
description: The Hameln Cross Winter Running Series 2026/2027 is a running event in the Klütwald forest near Hameln, held on paved and unpaved paths. The series comprises six races, all starting at 14:00 on their respective event days. Each participant’s three best races count toward the overall standings, and the overall winners are honored after the final race. The event is organized by the athletics division of ESV Eintracht Hameln and offers a relaxed atmosphere, followed by an awards ceremony and social gathering at the Finkenborn Youth Hostel.
course_highlights: Races in the Klütwald forest on paved and unpaved paths
Start and finish at the sports grounds by the Finkenborn Youth Hostel
All distances start together at 14:00
additional: Entries are accepted only on the day of each race, until 15 minutes before the start. Timing is manual. There is no entry fee; small donations toward equipment costs are welcome. Donations of cakes for the final event are appreciated. The awards ceremony takes place after the final race at the Finkenborn Youth Hostel. Disclaimer: Participation is at your own risk. Photos and videos will be published. All participants start together at 14:00; the course closes at 15:15. Each participant’s three fastest races count toward the series standings.

name: Lauf der 36. Winterlaufserie der LG Dornburg
Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in the beautiful woodland settings of city parks. In Poznań, the course runs around Lake Rusałka, with the start and finish located by the city beach. The races are open to runners of all levels, from beginners to advanced runners, who can regularly check their times on the same course. The races take place throughout the 2026/2027 season, and participants can compete in local and national rankings.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through woodland around Lake Rusałka
Start on Św. Wawrzyńca Street, finish by the city beach
The course is suitable for both run-walkers and fast runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. A group warm-up with the CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place before the start at 10:45. The event also includes races for children in various age categories. The event is co-financed from the budget of the City of Poznań. The CITY TRAIL program also includes races for children.

name: KOLIBA ŁOMNICKA
description: Koliba Łomnicka is a winter mountain race in Łomnica in the Głuszyca municipality, organised by the Walim Na Żądanie association. The 2027 edition is on Saturday 30 January 2027. The course is 15 km through mountain terrain around Łomnica. Entries are handled through raceresult, and the rules and GPX track are on the organizer's site.
course_highlights: 15 km mountain course
Winter race at the end of January
GPX track published by the organizer
additional: Entries, rules and the GPX file of the course are on the Walim Na Żądanie association's site. The organizer also runs other races in the Sudetes, such as Waligóra Run Cross and Walimskie Biegi Górskie.

name: Bieg Charytatywny 35. Finału WOŚP Gminy Kąty Wrocławskie
organizer: Klub Biegacza Kąty Wrocławskie i Sztab WOŚP #7352 Gmina Kąty Wrocławskie
price_range: darowizna min. 50 zł na WOŚP lub pakiet 21. Biegu WOŚP 85 zł
description: A charity 5 km cross-country run held as part of the 35th Grand Finale of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity (WOŚP). Start and finish at 27 Zwycięstwa Street in Kąty Wrocławskie, Saturday, January 30, 2027, at 11:00. Participation is available with a donation of at least 50 PLN to WOŚP or with the 21st WOŚP Run package for 85 PLN. Limit: 200 participants. Registration via Datasport. Organizers: Kąty Wrocławskie Running Club and WOŚP Headquarters #7352 Gmina Kąty Wrocławskie.
additional: NOTE: This submission replaces an existing estimated listing (incorrect date: January 23, 2027): https://www.biegajpl.com/strony_biegow/bieg_charytatywny/ . Correct date: Saturday, January 30, 2027, start at 11:00. name: Botaniczna Piątka Bydgoszcz
location: Ogród Botaniczny, Leśny Park Kultury i Wypoczynku Myślęcinek, Bydgoszcz, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Bydgoszcz is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts who have been promoting the sport in Wielkopolska and beyond since 2014. The event takes place in the picturesque surroundings of the Botanical Garden in Myślęcinek Forest Park of Culture and Recreation, adding to the scenic appeal of the course. The race is part of the Botaniczna Piątka series, which is popular and combines sport with the beauty of nature. The organizers place particular emphasis on attractive courses and the event atmosphere.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in the Botanical Garden and Myślęcinek Forest Park of Culture and Recreation
Picturesque, scenic surroundings ideal for running
Races organized since 2014, with a focus on natural scenery
additional: The organizer is Stowarzyszenie Biegiem w Las from Poznań. In summer 2026, the 10th anniversary of Botaniczna Piątka was celebrated. The event is part of a cross-country race series held in various locations across Wielkopolska and the surrounding area. The organizers encourage people to sign up for the newsletter to stay up to date with events.

name: Gliwicka Parkowa Prowokacja Biegowa
location: Polana przy ul. Chorzowskiej za Stadionem Piasta Gliwice, Gliwice, Poland

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: opłata za każdy start: 15 zł - roczniki 2007-2026

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: opłata za każdy start: 20 zł – roczniki 1927-1956

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: opłata za każdy start: 35 zł - roczniki 1957-2006

description: Gliwicka Parkowa Prowokacja Biegowa is a series of 12 running and Nordic Walking events held in Gliwice in 2027, on a clearing on Chorzowska Street behind the Piast Gliwice stadium. The 4,219.5 m course runs mainly along forest trails and gravel paths, with some asphalt sections. The events aim to promote healthy, active outdoor recreation. Participants can choose from 1 to 5 laps, covering distances from approximately 4.2 km to a half marathon. The events are organized by the Amatorski Klub Miłośników Biegania „Pędziwiatr” Gliwice and take place on Saturdays at 10:00 (running) and 10:03 (Nordic Walking).
course_highlights: A 4,219.5 m course along forest trails, gravel paths and asphalt
Start and finish on the clearing near the Piast Gliwice stadium
A refreshment point with drinks available after each lap
additional: The events take place once a month on Saturdays. The time limit for running and Nordic Walking is 3 hours; e-Prowokacja has no time limit. Participants can complete 1 to 5 laps (from approximately 4.2 km to a half marathon). After the event, participants should return their race bib and can collect a drink, sausage or banana, and a snack bar in a prize draw (if sanitary regulations allow). There is a perseverance classification for participants who take part in at least 9 events. Registration is annual, and changing disciplines requires a new registration and race bib. Available schedule information refers to previous editions: the race office opened at 9:00, and the start was at 10:00.

name: Przybij Piątkę
description: Przybij Piątkę is a winter 5 km race organized by the Nowotomyski Klub Biegacza Chyży in the Municipal Park in Nowy Tomyśl. The course is 90% on unpaved surfaces and is not officially certified. The race is free, and every participant who finishes will receive a commemorative medal. Trophies will be awarded to the top finishers. The participant limit is 200.
course_highlights: 5 km distance
90% unpaved surface
Start and finish in the Municipal Park in Nowy Tomyśl
additional: The results are scheduled to be announced at 10:00 on the same day. The race is part of the Winter Grand Prix of Nowy Tomyśl County. The race is part of the Winter Grand Prix of Nowy Tomyśl County.

name: Ľudova 50
description: Ľudova 50 is a challenging mountain ultratrail of approximately 51 km with 2,600 metres of elevation gain, passing through the picturesque Vtáčnik Mountains around Uhrovec. Runners pass several checkpoints, including Uhrovec Castle and the Čierny vrch mountain hut, offering beautiful views and technically interesting terrain. The race traditionally starts early in the morning and finishes in Uhrovec. It is a challenge for experienced runners and mountain-trail enthusiasts who want to test their endurance and skills in nature.
course_highlights: The route passes through the Vtáčnik Mountains, which are of volcanic origin
Checkpoints at Uhrovec Castle, the Čierny vrch mountain hut, and Kajtárov
Approximately 2,600 metres of elevation gain over a 51 km course
additional: The race cutoff is 21:00 on race day. The course is marked, and runners have access to three checkpoints. Results are available online after the race.

name: Běh kolem kláštera
location: Restaurace SPLIT, Kadaň, Ústecký kraj, Česko
description: Běh kolem kláštera je součástí Zimního běžeckého poháru v Ústeckém kraji, pořádaný Běžeckým klubem F - C Kadaň. Závod se koná v neděli 31. ledna 2027 s startem a cílem u restaurace SPLIT. Trať dlouhá 5 120 metrů vede čtyřikrát okruhem, který začíná rovinkou, pokračuje prudkým výběhem po schodech a podél klášterní zdi s 25% stoupáním, a končí mírným klesáním do cíle. Závod je náročný svým profilem a zimním počasím, což přidává na výzvě pro všechny účastníky.
course_highlights: Trať dlouhá 5 120 m s čtyřnásobným okruhem
Prudký výběh po schodech a podél klášterní zdi se stoupáním 25%
Mírné klesání do cíle
additional: Prezentace a přihlášky jsou možné na místě startu od 09:30 hodin. Start a cíl jsou u restaurace SPLIT. Závod je součástí Zimního běžeckého poháru, který zahrnuje i další náročné tratě v okolí Kadaně.

name: Winterlaufserie (10 km)
location: Sportzentrum Hamm-Ost, Hamm, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Winter Running Series in Hamm is a traditional running event held at the Hamm-Ost sports centre by Jahnstadion. The officially measured out-and-back course runs through the Lippeaue nature conservation area and the spa gardens in Bad Hamm. The series includes several races over different distances, including 10 km, 15 km and a half marathon, with individual-race and series rankings. Timing is provided by the Race Result system, and awards are presented to the fastest runners as well as age-group prize winners.
course_highlights: Officially measured out-and-back course in accordance with international competition rules
The course runs through the Lippeaue nature conservation area and Bad Hamm spa gardens
Start and finish on the tartan track at Jahnstadion
additional: Timing is provided by the Race Result system using a chip in the race bib. A €3.00 deposit is charged for the race bib with chip (refunded upon return), and a €1.00 donation goes to the support association for the hospice in Hamm. Youths and young adults up to age group U20 receive a 50% discount on the entry fee (excluding the donation and deposit). Awards ceremonies take place approximately 45 minutes after the finish in the marquee at Jahnstadion. The event comprises a series of three 10 km races held in Hamm’s natural landscape and spa gardens. Registration is online, timing is provided by Race Result, and awards are given to the top participants and series winners.

name: Winterlaufserie der Hildener AT
price_range: ab 7 EUR bis 47 EUR je nach Serie
description: The Hilden Winter Running Series is an annual running event that has attracted runners from the region since 2012. The series takes place on three dates in January and February and offers various series for different ability and age groups, including 5 km, 10 km, 15 km and half marathon, as well as walking and children’s races. The races run through the wintry Hilden City Forest and offer a family-friendly atmosphere, with the start and finish at the TC Stadtwald Hilden club grounds. Race numbers can be collected in advance at the HAT fit fitness studio, and on-site late entries are possible.
course_highlights: Races through the wintry Hilden City Forest
Start and finish at the TC Stadtwald Hilden club grounds
Various series with distances from approx. 500 m to the half marathon
additional: Race numbers can be collected in advance at the HAT fit fitness studio, Holterhöfchen 22, in Hilden. Late entries are possible on race day on site for a fee. The walking series does not allow Nordic walking poles. Parking at the Waldbad is signposted. Public transport via bus route 784 (Waldschenke stop) is recommended. Various distances, online registration, race in the city forest, suitable for families and performance-focused runners.

name: Winterlauf in Oldendorf
location: 21726 Oldendorf, Landkreis Stade, Lower Saxony, Germany
distance_verbose: 50 km, 25 km, 20 km, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km

name: Trainingslauf Bottwartal-Marathon
location: Steinheim an der Murr, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
distance_verbose: 51 km, Marathon, 32 km, Halbmarathon, 10 km, 5 km
description: The Bottwartal Marathon is a running event in one of the most beautiful landscapes in southern Germany, taking runners through gentle vineyard slopes, idyllic old towns and an electric atmosphere along the course. The route is a loop through the southern and northern Bottwartal, starting and finishing in Steinheim an der Murr. Whether you’re a beginner or an ambitious runner, there’s a highlight here for everyone. The event offers a range of distances and is a fixture on the sporting calendar in Baden-Württemberg.
course_highlights: Loop through the southern and northern Bottwartal
The route passes through historic old towns including Steinheim, Murr, Gronau, Beilstein, Oberstenfeld and Großbottwar
Flat finish at the Steppi roundabout in Steinheim, ideal for a strong final sprint
additional: The start and finish are at the Steppi roundabout in Steinheim a.d. Murr. Race packets are distributed at Blankensteinhalle in Steinheim. Shuttle buses run from Riedstadion to the start area. A bus transfer from Steinheim to Gronau is available for the half marathon. The Bottwartal is closed to traffic over a wide area on event day. Parking is available at Wellarium and in nearby areas. Runners are asked to line up in the start area according to their running pace.

name: Zitronenkrämerlauf
distance_verbose: 57.4 km, 57 km, 33 km, Halbmarathon, 15 km, 10 km, 6 km, 5 km

name: XVIII Jelczańsko-Oławski Zimowy Maraton
description: The XIX Jelczańsko-Oławski Toyota Winter Marathon in Stages is a series of seven races, each covering 7.033 km, held at various locations around Oława and Jelcz-Laskowice. The event combines running and Nordic walking, with a joint start and electronic timing. Participants can collect their race packs the day before the first stage or on race day. The event has a winter and commemorative character, including a race in memory of Zygmunt Pawlik.
course_highlights: A series of seven stages, each 7.033 km long
Routes pass through Chwałowice, Oława, Jelcz-Laskowice, Janików and Miłoszyce
Nordic walking and running start together, with electronic timing
additional: Race packs can be collected the day before the first stage at Termy Jakuba in Oława or at the Jelcz-Laskowice Town and Municipality Office. The organizer allows a race pack to be collected by an authorized person with a signed form. Nordic walking starts at 10:30 and the running races at 11:00. On race day, the race office is open from 9:00 to 10:30 for the first stage or from 10:00 for subsequent stages. The Nordic walking start is scheduled for 10:30 and the running race for 11:00.

name: 5 Winter Run - Górnolotni
description: Winter Run - Górnolotni is a winter running event held in Tarnów and associated with the Górnolotni Festival at the Mościce Centre for Art. Previous editions included a main race of approximately 12 km, with the start and finish at the Mościce Centre for Art. The event promotes running as a form of exercise and a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: The main race distance in previous editions was approximately 12 km.
The route in previous editions was entirely on asphalt.
The start and finish were at the Mościce Centre for Art.
additional: Previous editions also featured children's races. Earlier information indicates that the main race used electronic timing and had a 90-minute time limit.

name: Bieg 3 Jezior
description: Bieg 3 Jezior is a series of races held in Chodzież, comprising three events over 5 km and 10 km distances, taking place by three lakes: Karczewnik, Miejskie and Strzeleckie. The event has an intimate feel, with a limit of 130 participants. Participants can purchase a pass for the entire series, which includes all three races and a commemorative T-shirt. A permanent race number with a timing chip makes participation convenient, without needing to collect a number separately for each event. The race takes place on Sundays at 10:00, making it a great way to spend an active weekend in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: Race routes by three lakes: Karczewnik, Miejskie and Strzeleckie
5 km and 10 km distances
Scenic areas of Chodzież
additional: The participant limit is 130. Pass holders receive a permanent race number with a timing chip, used for all three races, so they only need to visit the race office once. In the 2026 edition, the limit was 130 participants; the pass included a commemorative T-shirt and a permanent race number with a chip.

name: Bieg Wedla
description: Bieg Wedla is a non-profit running event organized by enthusiasts from the PTTK Warsaw-Praga Branch. It takes place in the picturesque Skaryszewski Park in Warsaw. The routes follow a paved loop, with connecting sections on mineral-surfaced paths, and participants can enjoy the special atmosphere and historic park. The event is held in winter, which gives it a unique character, while the organizers take care to minimize its impact on the environment and local residents. After the race, participants receive medals and gifts, and can also enjoy free pea soup and hot tea.
course_highlights: Running routes on a paved loop, with connecting sections on mineral-surfaced paths
Picturesque, historic Skaryszewski Park in Warsaw
Routes covered with compacted snow and sand, providing winter running conditions
additional: Starts are held over various distances: Nordic walking at 10:00; O-run from 10:30 to 12:00; running routes of 1.86 km (for children and young people up to age 15), 5.43 km, and 9 km; and a 250 m route for children up to age 7. Race bibs and T-shirts can be collected in the days before the race at the Decathlon City store in Warsaw, or on event day at the Drukarz Sports Club. After the race, participants receive medals and a gift. Free pea soup (including a vegetarian option) and hot tea are available on site, but water is not provided. Parking is available in public spaces around the park; vehicles are not permitted to enter the park. Archived results confirm that the event has been held regularly from 2011 to 2026. The distances and schedule provided are for the 2026 edition; registration and fee details for 2027 are not available.

name: IV Cross Smolarza
description: The 4th Cross Smolarza is a cross-country race held in the scenic area around Krzyżowiec. The event takes place on natural forest and off-road trails, offering a challenge for runners who enjoy being close to nature. The participant limit is 170, divided among three categories: two running distances and Nordic walking. Entries are accepted online only until January 23, helping ensure the event is well organized.
course_highlights: Forest and off-road trails in the area around Krzyżowiec
Natural terrain suited to cross-country running
Limit of 70 participants for each running distance and 30 for Nordic walking
additional: The participant limit is 170: 70 for each running distance and 30 for Nordic walking. Entries are accepted online only. The event runs from 11:00 to 16:00. Participants are offered grilled sausage, bread, and tea.

name: IX Cross wokół Małego Giewontu
description: Cross around Mały Giewont is one of the toughest and most beautiful cross-country races in Poland, held in the scenic area of Olsztyn. The route takes runners through challenging terrain, offering them a unique running experience and a chance to connect with nature. The event attracts runners who appreciate tough conditions and beautiful views.
course_highlights: Challenging cross-country terrain
Scenic views around Mały Giewont
Natural trails and forest sections

name: Marceliński Bieg Zimowy
description: The Marcelin Winter Run is a trail race in Poznań’s Marcelin Forest, opening a year-round series of runs in the area. Participants can choose a 5 km or 10 km route and run along forest paths. It’s an option for both experienced runners and anyone looking to start the season actively over a shorter distance.
course_highlights: Forest route in Marcelin Forest
Choose between a 5 km or 10 km distance
The race opens a series of events held in the area
additional: In the edition described by the city, the start was at 100 Ptasia Street. The series includes four races, and the medals from the individual events fit together like a puzzle.

name: Międzyzdrojska Liga Biegowa
description: The Międzyzdrojska Running League is an annual, friendly, family-oriented running and Nordic walking league held on the scenic routes of the Międzyzdroje Municipality. In the 2026/2027 season, participants compete over distances of approximately 5 and 10 km running, and 5 and 7 km Nordic walking. The league is known for healthy competition and fun, welcoming both regular participants and newcomers who enjoy active recreation. Participation is free, and the overall standings require taking part in at least four races or walks over the specified distances.
course_highlights: Running routes of approximately 5 and 10 km
Nordic walking routes of approximately 5 and 7 km
Scenic routes in the Międzyzdroje Municipality
additional: Participants must be at least 14 years old. Minors may take part with written permission from a parent or guardian and under their supervision. To be included in the league standings, participants must finish at least four events over the required distances. This is a series of events for the 2026/2027 season. Participants must be at least 14; minors need written permission from a parent or guardian and must compete under their supervision. Participation in at least four events is required for the overall standings.

name: VI Zimowy Ultramarton Kurpiowski
location: Wiata Leśnictwa Lelis, Łęg Starościński, Poland
description: The 6th Kurpie Winter Ultramarathon is a winter running event held in Łęg Starościński, in the Lelis Forest District. The event offers four distances: 10 km Nordic Walking and 10 km, 28 km, and 56 km runs. The routes follow forest trails with a few climbs, and the start and finish are at the Running Shelter. Participants in the longer distances have access to refreshment stations along the route. The event has an intimate atmosphere, with a limit of 150 paid participants.
course_highlights: Routes follow forest trails with a few climbs
Refreshment stations on the 56 km route (at 19, 35, and 44 km) and the 28 km route (at 8 and 19 km)
Start and finish at the Running Shelter
additional: The participant limit is 150 paid runners. The 56 km and 28 km routes are forest loops, with refreshment stations available at specified times. Nordic Walking and the 10 km run each consist of two 5 km loops. Starts are in waves: 56 km at 7:00, 28 km at 9:00, 10 km Nordic Walking at 10:00, and the 10 km run at 11:00. The calendar lists the next edition for 2027 but provides no details.

name: Zimowy Bieg Zbója
description: The Zimowy Bieg Zbója is a mountain race in Bielsko-Biała inspired by the legend of the Klimczok outlaw. The course follows scenic but demanding mountain trails, offering participants exceptional views and an intense challenge. The 18 km and 13 km distances, with substantial elevation gain, will test every runner’s strength and determination. It’s a great opportunity to kick off the running season in a winter setting and experience the atmosphere of a true mountain race.
course_highlights: 18 km course with 996 m of elevation gain, starting below the Szyndzielnia cable car
Klimczok summit as the course’s high point
A fast, rugged descent that demands stamina and courage
additional: The Zbójnik 18 km starts at 09:00, and the Piechur 13 km at 09:45. GPX files of the routes are available to download. The entry fee depends on the payment date, not the registration date. Payment by PayU, PayPal, or bank transfer is available. Organizer: Alpas Artur Sarosiek, Bielsko-Biała. Registration for the 2027 edition is open. Detailed elevation figures and route information are based on descriptions from previous editions.

name: Běh po cyklostezce
description: Běh po cyklostezce je tradiční běžecký závod pořádaný tělovýchovnou jednotou Maratonstav Úpice. Závod se koná v Úpici u tenisových kurtů poblíž řeky Labe a je součástí Zimní běžecké ligy. Start hlavního závodu následuje ihned po doběhnutí dětských kategorií, což vytváří přátelskou atmosféru pro všechny věkové skupiny. Účastníci si mohou užít běh v malebném prostředí s kvalitní organizací a dlouholetou tradicí.
course_highlights: Start a cíl u tenisových kurtů v Úpici
Trasa vede podél cyklostezky u řeky Labe
Součást Zimní běžecké ligy s dětskými kategoriemi
additional: Prezentace do 9:30 hodin. Hlavní závod startuje ihned po doběhnutí dětských kategorií. Číslo platí po celou sérii Zimní běžecké ligy. Závod se koná v únoru 2027, registrace je možná na místě nebo přes webové stránky, trať měří přibližně 4,6 km, start je u tenisových kurtů v Úpici.

name: ČEZ RunTour Winter Edition – Praha
location: Výstaviště Praha, Holešovice, Prague 7, Prague, Česko
distance_verbose: Půlmaraton, 10 km, 5 km, 3000 meter, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: ČEZ RunTour Winter Edition v Praze je zimní běžecký závod vhodný pro hobíky i elitní běžce s tratěmi 3, 5, 10 a 21,1 km a dětskými běhy na 500 a 1000 m. Závod nabízí rodinnou atmosféru, krásné kovové medaile a zázemí ve vyhřátých pavilonech Výstaviště Holešovice. Doprovodný program zahrnuje rozhovory a aktivity partnerů, což činí závod celodenním zážitkem pro běžce i jejich rodiny. Organizátoři kladou důraz na bezpečnost a pohodlí účastníků s občerstvovacími stanicemi a zdravotnickým týmem.
course_highlights: Tratě 3, 5, 10 a 21,1 km v zimním prostředí Prahy
Dětské běhy na 500 a 1000 m s rodinnou atmosférou
Zázemí ve vyhřátých pavilonech Výstaviště Holešovice
additional: Pro závod je připraven speciální tým vodičů, zdravotnická služba a občerstvovací stanice na trase i v cíli. Děti mají vlastní závody a rozcvičky. Po závodě je tombola s hodnotnými cenami a možnost rytí výsledného času do kovové medaile. Zázemí zahrnuje občerstvení, šatny a úschovnu v teplých pavilonech. V areálu je k dispozici šatna, úschovna a toalety.

name: Lipno Ice Marathon
location: Kemp Jestřábí, Černá v Pošumaví, Jihočeský kraj, Česko
description: Lipno Ice Marathon je extrémní zimní závod na ledové ploše Lipenského jezera, který prověří vytrvalost a odhodlání běžců v náročných mrazivých podmínkách. Závod nabízí klasickou maratonskou trať dlouhou 42,195 km, půlmaraton 22 km a trať 10 km pro mladší sportovce. Kromě běžeckých kategorií je možné závod absolvovat i ve freestyle variantě s využitím bruslí, běžeckých lyží, kola, kitu či ledové jachty. Start a cíl jsou v Kemp Jestřábí v Černé v Pošumaví, kde je také zajištěno ubytování ve vlastních stanech přímo v lokalitě závodu. Lipno Ice Marathon je výzvou pro všechny, kdo chtějí zažít ledový adrenalin a připravit se na extrémní závody jako Antarctic Ice Marathon.
course_highlights: Trať vede po ledové ploše Lipenského jezera a podél jeho břehu
Možnost absolvovat trať běžecky nebo ve freestyle kategorii s různými zimními dopravními prostředky
Koridor trati je vyznačen kolíky a páskou, s možností pohybu do 15 metrů od značek
additional: Startovní prezentace probíhá v den závodu od 8:00 do 9:30 v prostoru Bike Point - Kemp Jestřábí I. V ceně startovného je zahrnuto ubytování ve vlastním stanu přímo v kempu. Trať může být vedena po ledě, po souši nebo kombinovaně v závislosti na aktuálních podmínkách. Závodníci v kategorii freestyle mohou využívat různé dopravní prostředky na ledě, včetně kombinací. Doporučené vybavení zahrnuje nesmeky a čelenku místo čepice. Pořadatel si vyhrazuje právo uvolnit zvýhodněné startovné. Startovní pole je omezeno na 200 účastníků. Startovné zahrnuje možnost ubytování ve vlastním stanu v kempu; pro maraton a půlmaraton také občerstvení. Pro závodníky je povinný mobilní telefon ve vodotěsném pouzdře a izotermická fólie.

name: Kubátecký běh

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 150 Kč - při prezentaci v den závodu

description: Kubátecký běh je součástí Železnohorského poháru, seriálu běhů do vrchu v krásné přírodě Železných hor. Závod nabízí sportovní výzvu v kopcovitém terénu a je vhodný jak pro závodníky usilující o nejlepší čas, tak pro ty, kteří běží pro radost z pohybu. Startuje se hromadně v 13:00 z fotbalového hřiště v Malči a cíl je v lese v Nohavicích ve výšce 620 m n. m. Kategorie jsou rozděleny podle věku a pohlaví, přičemž mladší 18 let mohou startovat se souhlasem zákonného zástupce.
course_highlights: Běh do vrchu v přírodě Železných hor
Start na fotbalovém hřišti v Malči, cíl v lese v Nohavicích (620 m n. m.)
Kopcovitý terén s výzvou pro všechny věkové kategorie
additional: Registrace je možná online do půlnoci 4. února nebo na místě v den závodu od 11:30 do 12:40. Závodníci s trvalým pobytem v Malči mají startovné zdarma.

name: Grand Prix Dziewiczej Góry w Biegach Gór...

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 74 zł – w przypadku rejestracji do ostatniego poniedziałku poprzedzającego zawody.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 84zł – w przypadku rejestracji w ostatni wtorek, środę i czwartek przed zawodami.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 25zł – w przypadku rejestracji do ostatniego poniedziałku poprzedzającego zawody.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 35zł – w przypadku rejestracji po ostatnim poniedziałku.

description: The Grand Prix of Dziewicza Góra Mountain Running is a series of races held in the Zielonka Forest Landscape Park, promoting physical activity and environmental protection. The course follows forest paths around Dziewicza Góra, the park’s highest hill, offering challenging climbs and scenic views. The event includes 5 km and 10 km races, a Nordic walking event, and children’s races over shorter distances. The organizers foster a welcoming sporting atmosphere that brings participants and families together.
course_highlights: A fully forested 5.15 km loop
Two climbs to the summit of Dziewicza Góra
The course passes through the event center, where spectators can cheer on runners
additional: Children’s races are held over 200m, 500m, 1000m, and 1500m. The race office is open from 8:15 to 10:30. Participants in the 10 km race complete two laps of the course. After emerging from the forest at the finish, runners head to the left or right side of the balloon marked “Finish,” depending on their race distance. The participant limit is 500. People who have purchased a pass for the entire series are automatically added to the start list.

name: Cross maraton u Ryśka vol 80
location: Ruda, Wieluń County, Łódź Voivodeship, Poland

name: Trail!ON Stawiguda #3

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 165 zł przy rejestracji po 31.10.2026 – karnet na 4 biegi

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 90 zł przy rejestracji po 31.10.2026 – karnet na 4 biegi

description: Trail!ON Stawiguda is a series of four 5 km trail races held monthly on the same scenic route near the forests and bend of the Łyna River, close to Ruś. Winter weather is no obstacle to staying active—the forest route, with its varied terrain, offers a chance to experience the unique atmosphere of nature. It’s a great opportunity to regularly check your fitness, enjoy the excitement of competition, and spend time outdoors. Shorter, age-appropriate distances are planned for children. At the end of the series, there will be an awards ceremony and a bonfire with the Mayor.
course_highlights: 5 km route through the beautiful forests of Ruś
Start and finish by the beach at the bend of the Łyna River in Stawiguda municipality
Winter forest route with varied terrain
additional: Three children’s races are planned over distances of approximately 300 m, 500 m, and 1,000 m, starting at 9:45, 10:00, and 10:15, respectively. The race office closes at 10:30. At the final event in the series, there will be an awards ceremony and a bonfire with the Mayor. The season-pass bib number remains the same throughout the series and must be brought to every race. A single-race entry can be purchased at the race office on the day of the event. The main race is scheduled to start on February 6, 2027, at 11:00. The programme also includes children’s races over distances of approximately 300 m to 1,000 m. Online registration is open until February 3, 2027, at 23:59; the listed fee of PLN 60 is for a single-race entry purchased on the day of the event.

name: Warta Challenge
location: Parking leśny Łysy Młyn, ul. Poznańska 4, Biedrusko, Poland
organizer: SPORT CHALLENGE Fundacja Wspierania Aktywności Fizycznej
description: WARTA CHALLENGE Marathon&Half is a winter tournament consisting of a series of four races and Nordic walking events, offering half-marathon and marathon distances on forest tracks and trails in the Warta River forests. The event is open to both amateur and professional athletes, who can compete in small cross-country races. Each race has its own theme, and the start and race office are located by the Łysy Młyn forest car park in Biedrusko. Additional races and walks are held over 5 km and 10 km distances, as well as a summer night edition, WARTA CHALLENGE Night Express.
course_highlights: The course follows forest tracks and trails along the Warta River, with sections of asphalt and natural surfaces featuring leaves, mud and puddles.
The half marathon is one 21.3 km loop with 110 m of elevation gain; the marathon is two loops, for a total distance of 42.6 km.
The route is marked with red-and-white tape and signs for the “Łysy Młyn” running trail. The largest climb is 35 m over a 1 km section.
additional: Race packets can be collected on race day from 7:45 to 9:30 at the race office. Themed outfits and accessories are recommended for the individual races. The race centre is by the Łysy Młyn forest car park, ul. Poznańska 4, Biedrusko. The course is not officially certified; it is measured using bike computers and a Garmin device. The race centre is by Lake Łyse, next to the Łysy Młyn forest car park, ul. Poznańska 4, 62-003 Biedrusko. The start is scheduled for 10:00, and race packets can be collected on race day from 7:45 to 9:30. The venue can be reached by car or public and suburban transport; free parking is available.

name: 3. Bieg Zwycięskiego Powstania
description: Bieg Zwycięskiego Powstania commemorates the victory of the Greater Poland Uprising. The third edition is on Saturday 6 February 2027 at Lake Strzeszyńskie in Poznań, on the 108th anniversary of the uprising's victory. Participants choose a 5 km run, a 10 km run or 5 km Nordic walking. Every participant receives a cast commemorative medal.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km runs at Lake Strzeszyńskie
5 km Nordic walking
Cast medal and a hot meal at the finish
additional: The 5 and 10 km runs start at 11:00 and Nordic walking at 11:01. The fee is the same for all distances: 75 PLN until 10 January 2027, 85 PLN from 11 January to 3 February 2027 and 90 PLN on race day if places remain. Places are limited.

name: 5 Zmrożona Połówka
location: Zajazd Jowisz, ul. Harcerska 2, Turawa, Poland
description: The 6th Frozen Half is a 5 km race held in Turawa at Zajazd Jowisz. The event takes place on February 6, 2027, and is organized by the From Dusk Till Dawn Foundation in cooperation with the Turawa Municipal Office. The race offers electronic timing and is an excellent opportunity for a sporting challenge in winter scenery. The race office is open from 8:30 to 10:30, and the race starts in the morning.
course_highlights: 5 km race
Winter course in Turawa
Electronic timing
additional: The organizer provides electronic timing. The Turawa Municipal Office is a co-organizer. The race office is open from 8:30 to 10:30. The participant limit for the 5 km distance is 100.

name: Bieg Pamięci Sybiru
description: The Sybir Memorial Run is an annual sporting event commemorating the first mass deportation of Polish citizens to Siberia on February 10, 1940. The race takes place in two cities: Białystok and Wrocław, offering 5 km and 10 km distances in Białystok and a 5 km distance in Wrocław. The route in Białystok runs through the picturesque Turczyński Forest, with evening starts using a wave-start system. The event combines sporting competition with historical remembrance and the emotional significance of commemoration.
course_highlights: The route through Turczyński Forest in Białystok
Evening starts with a wave-start system
Winter scenery and an unobstructed running route
additional: The 10 km race uses wave starts, with starting groups based on declared finish times. Start lines close 10 minutes after the last wave starts. Participants should report 30 minutes before the start. A 50% discount is available to people born in 1961 or earlier. The 2026 edition also offered virtual participation, requiring participants to cover at least 5 km in a single run. Participants received a race package and a commemorative medal.

name: Janosik Winter Race
description: Janosik Winter Race is a unique winter mountain race held in the heart of Spiš, at the foot of the majestic Tatras, in Niedzica. The route passes through scenic areas, including trails such as Spacer Murgrabiego, Bedzies, Kwicoł, Zawiany, Pyzdra, Kierpce, and Maryny. The event is part of the Janosik Race Series, organized by a foundation with a passion for sport and development. It also offers races for children and young people, creating a family-friendly atmosphere and promoting physical activity in winter conditions.
course_highlights: Routes through the scenic areas of Spiš and the foothills of the Tatras
The Spacer Murgrabiego, Bedzies, Kwicoł, Zawiany, Pyzdra, Kierpce, and Maryny trails
A winter mountain race with varied, challenging terrain
additional: Routes of varying lengths and difficulty. The event takes place in winter mountain conditions. Photo and video galleries from previous editions are available. Parking and a race office are provided. The program also includes Janosik Kids races. The available routes in the edition described by the sources are 10, 21, 30, and 55 km.

name: Silesia Race
description: Silesia Race is an orienteering event held in the Silesian Voivodeship, taking place in interesting and attractive locations across the region. The tourist-recreational course is 10 to 15 km long and includes family and adult categories. The event is exploratory in nature, giving participants the chance to discover places they may not have visited before, including unique UNESCO sites in Tarnowskie Góry. The organizers prepare engaging special tasks and work with local cultural institutions and communities. The next edition is planned for February 6, 2027.
course_highlights: A 10–15 km tourist-recreational course
Family and adult categories
Discover attractive, lesser-known places in Tarnowskie Góry, including a UNESCO site
additional: The event is organized by the Association of Lovers of the Tarnowskie Góry Region (SMZT). It is held in cooperation with local institutions and volunteers. Special tasks are located at various cultural and historical sites in Tarnowskie Góry. Photos and results are published on the organizer’s Facebook page. The edition in Knurów is planned for February 6, 2027; the organizer says that work on the courses is ongoing.

name: XXIII Zimowy Bieg Trzech Jezior
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Trzemesznie
description: The XXIII Winter Three Lakes Run is a winter running event held in Trzemeszno. The 23rd edition took place. The event includes classifications for residents of the Trzemeszno municipality, employees of the State Forests, and PAROC company employees.
additional: For the 2026 edition, race packs could be collected on race day at the OSiR Sports Hall at ul. Piastowska 11 in Trzemeszno, from 7:30 to 9:45.

name: Zimowy Bieg Górski
location: Stok narciarski Na Complu, Rajcza, Poland
organizer: Centrum Kultury i Sportu w Rajczy
description: The Wilcze Gronie Winter Mountain Run is an annual running event held on the Na Complu ski slopes in Rajcza. The race features a winter mountain course that challenges participants and offers an active way to enjoy the scenic surroundings of the Żywiec Beskids. The organizers invite runners to take part in this sporting competition, which combines a passion for running with the beauty of winter nature.
course_highlights: The course runs along the Na Complu ski slopes
Winter mountain scenery in the Żywiec Beskids
Scenic views and challenging terrain
additional: For the 2025 edition, the race office was located in the sports hall at Pod Complem.

name: Lauf 38. Winterlaufserie
description: The 38th Winter Running Series “Rund um den Haugnisberg” is a traditional running and Nordic walking event in the Mayen-Koblenz district, held at the Jakob-Vogt-Stadion in Ochtendung. The series comprises four races over the winter months, with distances of 4 and 8.1 kilometers, as well as Nordic walking and children’s races. The course follows paved roads and forest trails through the scenic Eifel foothills. Participants can use changing rooms and showers right by the start and finish area. Results are based on three of the four races, with prizes for class winners and certificates for participants who take part in three races.
course_highlights: A loop on paved roads and forest trails through the Eifel foothills
Start and finish at the Jakob-Vogt-Stadion, with changing rooms and showers
A four-race series, with results based on three races
additional: The series consists of four dates: December 6, January 3, February 7, and March 7. The youngest participants race over 400 meters (Bambini) or 1,400 meters. There is a 4-kilometer walking category for Nordic walkers and leisurely walkers. Registration is via an external website (my.raceresult.com). The series comprises four races, of which three count toward the series standings. Changing rooms and showers are available at the Jakob-Vogt-Stadion.

name: Rheinzaberner Winterlaufserie
location: Schulcampus der IGS Rheinzabern, Rheinzabern, Germany
price_range: 12-19 € pro Serienlauf; 42 € für alle drei Läufe
description: The Rheinzabern Winter Running Series is a traditional running event in the Southern Palatinate that has been held annually since 1984. It comprises three winter races over 10 km, 15 km, and 20 km, run on paved loop and out-and-back courses around the IGS Rheinzabern school campus. The series offers both gun-time and chip-time results, which are published promptly. In addition to the main races, the second and third races include extra events for beginners, children, and families.
course_highlights: Paved loop and out-and-back courses
Officially measured 10 km course eligible for record lists
Aid stations during the 15 km and 20 km races, as well as at the finish
additional: Maximum 1,500 participants per race. Race bibs remain valid for all three races in the series. Refreshments during the 15 km and 20 km races are provided at approximately km 11 and at the finish. The second and third races include extra events for beginners, children, and families. It is possible to enter individual races. The supporting program includes a 5 km beginners' race, as well as 300 m Bambini and 1,000 m schoolchildren's races. All three races count toward the series standings; there is also a team competition.

name: 5 Półmaraton Górski
location: Pałac Jedlinka, ul. Zamkowa 4, Jedlina-Zdrój, Poland
price_range: 160–240 zł; 250 zł w biurze zawodów; 70 zł dla mieszkańców gminy Jedlina-Zdrój

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Mieszkańcy gminy Jedlina-Zdrój opłata startowa 70 zł przez cały okres trwania zapisów

description: The Mountain Half Marathon in Jedlina-Zdrój is a challenging mountain race set in the picturesque Wałbrzych Mountains. The course follows natural trails, technical sections and varied terrain, offering runners a sporting challenge and contact with nature. The event has an intimate atmosphere and is supported by the local community, creating a unique experience for participants. The start and finish are at Jedlinka Palace in Jedlina-Zdrój. The event offers several distances, including a mountain half marathon, a 10 km race and an ultra, as well as the accompanying Mountain Festival.
course_highlights: The course follows natural trails and technical sections in the Wałbrzych Mountains
Several refreshment and nutrition points along the course
Start and finish at Jedlinka Palace, ul. Zamkowa 4, Jedlina-Zdrój
additional: The field is limited to 300 participants for the Winter Half Marathon and Winter 10K. The course is marked with orange ribbons and arrows. Refreshment and nutrition points are provided along the course. Race numbers and race packs (socks, isotonic drink) can be collected at Hotel Jedlinka. All participants must wear their race number visibly on their torso. Winners are awarded during the event. Carrying a charged phone and a GPS track or course map is recommended. The race starts on 7 February 2027 at 10:00 from Jedlinka Palace, ul. Zamkowa 4. The total participant limit is 300 for the half marathon and Winter 10K combined. The organizer provides baggage storage, changing rooms, a post-race meal, hot drinks, and refreshment and nutrition points.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Polana Różopole, Leśny Park Kultury i Wypoczynku Myślęcinek, Bydgoszcz, Poland
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in scenic woodland and parkland. In Bydgoszcz, the route passes through the Myślęcinek Forest Park of Culture and Recreation and the Żołędowo Forest District, with the start and finish at Różopole Clearing. The races are open to runners of all abilities, from beginners to advanced athletes, who can compete on the same course year after year. The event promotes outdoor physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. Races take place throughout the 2026/2027 season, and participants can compete for overall standings and prizes.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through the woodland scenery of Myślęcinek and the Żołędowo Forest District
Start and finish at Różopole Clearing
The route is suitable for both run-walkers and fast runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. Before the main race at 11:00, there is a group warm-up with the CITY TRAIL Ambassadors. Parking is not available at Różopole Clearing; participants are advised to use car parks approximately 1–1.5 km from the start. The race schedule and race-office location remain the same throughout the season. The main race starts at 11:00. Registration is available online through the Competitor Panel or at the race office on race day.

name: XIV Grand Prix Krakowa
description: The Krakow Mountain Running Grand Prix is a series of mountain races held in Krakow, offering a range of distances from 3.7 km to 23.2 km, as well as a Vertical race. The races take place on scenic routes with varying levels of difficulty, inviting both beginners and experienced runners to take on the challenge. The event is a recurring series with an anniversary edition, attracting hundreds of participants and offering individual and team classifications. The organizers provide a varied program, including races for children and relays, creating a welcoming sporting atmosphere for the whole family.
course_highlights: Distances: 3.7 km, 5.7 km, 11.6 km, 23.2 km, and Vertical 1.5 km
Scenic mountain routes around Krakow with varied terrain
Special races for children and an anniversary relay
additional: Starts take place at various times on Sunday, including the 23.2 km race at 9:00. The Vertical GPK competition takes place on Saturday from 10:00 to 12:00. The series also includes races for children and an anniversary relay. The courses can already be tested during the summer. The series also includes the 5.7 km distance, the Vertical race (1.5 km), and races for children. The prices listed apply to a single race in the 14th edition and depend on the distance, registration date, and discounts.

name: Trail Kamieńsk
description: Trail Kamieńsk is a winter mountain race on Góra Kamieńsk in the Łódź region. The 11th edition takes place on 7 February 2027. There are three distances: 6 km, 14 km and 30 km. Registration for the 2027 edition opened in November 2026.
course_highlights: Hill routes on Góra Kamieńsk
Three distances: 6, 14 and 30 km
Winter edition of the Ultra Kamieńsk events

name: Bydgoszcz na Orientację
description: Bydgoszcz Orienteering is a series of orienteering events organized by the Bydgoszcz Orienteering Foundation, aimed at people of all ages and skill levels. Participants use a map and compass to explore varied woodland and urban areas around Bydgoszcz. The event promotes outdoor activity, family participation, and the development of navigation skills, offering courses suited to both beginners and advanced runners. The Foundation is also committed to creating courses for blind and visually impaired people, making the event accessible to everyone.
course_highlights: Varied woodland and urban areas around Bydgoszcz
Courses for beginners, advanced participants, and blind and visually impaired people
A series of several races during the season, with an overall series classification
additional: The Autumn-Winter Series consists of six orienteering rounds in various forests around Bydgoszcz and nearby areas, with courses of varying difficulty. For each completed round, participants receive a digital badge and a sticker for a collectible coupon. Completing the entire series is rewarded with a special final badge and discounts on the Bydgoszcz and Surrounding Areas Championships. The project is supported by the Ministry of Sport and Tourism and the Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship Government.

name: 43 Bieg Chomiczówki

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: W listopadzie pakiety są w wyjątkowo atrakcyjnej cenie.

price_tiers.distance: XX Bieg o Puchar Bielan (5 km)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: W listopadzie pakiety są w wyjątkowo atrakcyjnej cenie.

description: The Bieg Chomiczówki is a historic running event held in Bielany, Warsaw, with traditions dating back to 1984. The main race is approximately 15 km long and attracts runners from across Poland, bringing together the local community and running enthusiasts. The event is a great opportunity to start the year actively and in a sporting spirit, with a rich history and a welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: A route of approximately 15 km through the Bielany district
Historic start and finish locations tied to a running tradition dating back to 1984
Picturesque urban areas of Warsaw with Bielany’s distinctive atmosphere
additional: The participant limit is 3,000: 1,800 places for the 15 km race and 1,200 places for the 5 km race. Registration is available exclusively online via the datasport.pl system. The entry fee must be paid within 48 hours of registration; otherwise, the place may be released. It may be possible to register at the Race Office a few days before the race if the participant limit has not been reached. During registration, participants can purchase clothing and running shirts from the Bieg Chomiczówki collection.

name: Bieg Urodzinowy z Portem Gdynia Bieg 1926
location: Aleja Jana Pawła II, Gdynia, Poland
description: The Birthday Run with the Port of Gdynia is an annual running event held in Gdynia and part of the Gdynia Grand Prix. The race takes place on city streets, offering participants the chance to compete over routes of varying lengths. It is open and welcoming to runners of different ability levels, and promotes physical activity and a sense of community.
course_highlights: A street route in central Gdynia
Views of the port and coastal surroundings
A range of distances suited to different age groups and ability levels
additional: Information about the distance and route is from the 2026 edition.

name: V Dziki Cross 2026 – Edycja II
location: Leśny parking w Kozłowie, Kozienicki Park Krajobrazowy, Poland
description: The 5th Dziki Cross 2026 – Edition II is a race organized by the “Biegiem Radom!” Association. The event will take place at the forest parking area in Kozłów, in the scenic Kozienice Landscape Park. It features several categories, including a 10 km race, Nordic walking, and a half marathon, welcoming runners of all experience levels. The organizers promote active recreation and bring together the running community from Radom and the surrounding area.
course_highlights: The route runs through Kozienice Landscape Park
Forest terrain with natural obstacles
Scenic views and close contact with nature
additional: Timing for the 2026 edition is provided by Time-Sport.pl.

name: XII Parkowe Hercklekoty
location: Park Leśny w Dolinie Trzech Stawów, Katowice, Poland
description: The 12th Parkowe Hercklekoty is an annual race held in Forest Park in the Three Ponds Valley in Katowice. It is the first race in the 2026 MK team Grand Prix series and is held under the Honorary Patronage of the Mayor of Katowice. The event includes short-distance races for children, main races of approximately 6 km and 12 km, and an approximately 6 km Nordic walking event. The routes pass through the scenic Three Ponds Valley, offering participants an attractive setting for competition and recreation.
course_highlights: The routes run entirely through the charming Three Ponds Valley
The approximately 6 km distance is one 5.8 km loop
The approximately 12 km distance is two loops, totaling 11.6 km
additional: Children’s races are held over distances from 50 to 700 metres. The course is not certified by the PZLA.

name: XIX Bieg o Puchar Bielan
location: Ulice Conrada i Pabla Nerudy, Bielany, Warsaw, Poland
description: The 19th Bieg o Puchar Bielan is an annual road race held in the Bielany district of Warsaw. Runners start on the streets of Conrada and Pablo Neruda, and the organizers provide convenient facilities, including changing rooms, baggage drop-off and a post-race meal at the finish. The event takes place on a Sunday when shops are closed. Participants can use the parking facilities and access washbasins, toilets and showers free of charge. The race atmosphere welcomes both recreational and more experienced runners.
course_highlights: Road course in the Bielany district of Warsaw
Start on Conrada Street, finish on Pablo Neruda Street
Portable toilets available at the start and finish
additional: The race office is located in Bemowo Shopping Centre at 126 Powstańców Śląskich Street. Changing rooms and baggage drop-off are at Primary School No. 352 at 6 Conrada Street, where runners can use washbasins, toilets and showers. A post-race meal at the finish consists of soup (meat and vegetarian options), bread and hot tea. The organizer provides baggage-drop bags, tents, benches and tables for eating. The parking area is approximately 1 km from the start line. The race office and race-pack collection were located in Bemowo Shopping Centre. Changing rooms and baggage drop-off were available at Primary School No. 352 at 6 Conrada Street; the organizer also provided toilets, washbasins, showers, parking and a post-race meal.

name: Zimowa Zawierucha
organizer: Klub Biegacza Warta i Atelier Sportu
description: Zimowa Zawierucha is a race organized by the Atelier Sportu Association and held in Bobrowniki. The event has a winter theme and attracts runners who enjoy competing on a 21 km course. Timing is provided using modern electronic systems to ensure accurate results. The event is a great opportunity to test your fitness in winter conditions and connect with the running community.
course_highlights: 21 km course
Winter trail race in Bobrowniki
Professional timing using RFID chips
additional: Online registration closes on January 21, 2027, at 23:59. Timing is provided using a state-of-the-art electronic system based on RFID chips and start/finish mats. The organizer provides phone support on race day and on business days from 8:00 to 16:00.

name: Račiansky kros ZIMA
location: Amfiteáter, Knižkova dolina, Rača, Bratislava, Slovakia
description: Račiansky kros ZIMA is a forest run in Rača, Bratislava, along paths in the Little Carpathians. The start and finish are in Knižkova dolina, near the amphitheatre. Runners can choose between two courses, 9.5 km and 16 km long. The event is organised by OZ PERUN.
course_highlights: Forest paths in the Little Carpathians
Two courses: 9.5 km and 16 km
Start and finish near the amphitheatre in Knižkova dolina
additional: Timing is provided by an RFID chip system.

name: Silgan Ćwierćmaraton
location: SILGAN Metal Packaging, ul. Rokicka 13, Tczew, Poland
description: The Silgan Quarter Marathon is a 10.54 km race taking place in Tczew County. The start and finish are located at the SILGAN Metal Packaging premises in Tczew at 13 Rokicka Street. The route runs through Tczew, Rokitki and Śliwiny, with its final course to be announced two weeks before the event. The surface varies, with asphalt and gravel sections, and the race takes place with restricted vehicular traffic. The start line will close 15 minutes after the starter’s pistol, and the route is marked with road markings every 1 km.
course_highlights: A 10.54 km route through Tczew, Rokitki and Śliwiny
A mix of asphalt and gravel surfaces
The route is marked with road markings every 1 km
additional: The participant limit is 200 entrants who have paid their entry fee. The start and finish are at the premises of SILGAN Metal Packaging Tczew S.A. The race route takes place with restricted vehicular traffic. Previous editions were held in May.

name: Běh Kvíčalou
description: Běh Kvíčalou je tradiční zimní běžecký závod pořádaný Maratonstav tělovýchovnou jednotou Úpice. Závod se koná v Úpici v Královéhradeckém kraji a je součástí Zimní běžecké ligy. Startuje se v sobotu dopoledne, přičemž nejprve běží dětské kategorie a hlavní závod začíná ihned po doběhnutí dětí. Závod nabízí přátelskou atmosféru a je vhodný pro širokou veřejnost včetně dětí i dospělých.
course_highlights: Zimní běžecký závod v Úpici (Kvíčala)
Start dětských kategorií od 10:00, hlavní závod po doběhnutí dětí
Součást Zimní běžecké ligy s tradicí a komunitou
additional: Prezentace do 9:30 hodin. Číslo platí po celou sérii Zimní běžecké ligy. Hlavní závod startuje ihned po doběhnutí dětských kategorií. Registrace je možná online, závod se koná v únoru a je vhodný pro širokou veřejnost včetně rodin s dětmi.

name: Letiště Praha Valentýnský běh 7 km
description: Letiště Praha Valentýnský běh 7 km je tradiční závod konaný v pražské Stromovce, který je otevřený pro všechny běžce od začátečníků po zkušené sportovce. Trasa dlouhá 7 km nabízí příjemný běžecký zážitek v přírodním prostředí parku. Závod má charitativní rozměr a kompletní výsledkový servis. Start probíhá ve dvou vlnách, což umožňuje pohodlný průběh akce.
course_highlights: Trasa vede v parku Stromovka v Praze
Délka trasy je 7 km
Závod má charitativní rozměr
additional: Start závodu je rozdělen do dvou vln: první od 11:00 a druhá od 12:30. Kapacita závodu je naplněna, registrace je možná pouze s registračním kódem. Startovní číslo si závodníci vyzvednou v Running Mallu, kde je také možnost nákupu běžeckého vybavení v RunCzech Storu. Jsou vypsány starty v 11:00 a 12:30. Startovní číslo se vyzvedává v Running Mallu.

name: INNOGY WINTER RUN Olomouc
location: Pavilion G, Výstaviště Flora, Olomouc, Česko
description: INNOGY WINTER RUN Olomouc je zimní běžecký závod pořádaný v Olomouci, který nabízí tratě o délce 4 km, 8 km a štafetu 2×4 km. Akce je vhodná pro širokou veřejnost včetně dětí, které mohou závodit v dětském závodě KIDS CUP na 400 a 800 metrů. Závod se koná v areálu Výstaviště Flora a je součástí série Winter RUN. Pořadatelé kladou důraz na příjemnou atmosféru a kvalitní zázemí pro běžce i diváky.
course_highlights: Trasy vedou areálem Výstaviště Flora v Olomouci
Dětské závody na 400 a 800 metrů
Možnost štafetového závodu 2×4 km
additional: Starty dětí na 400 a 800 m od 11:00, vyzvednutí balíčků od 10:00, možnost objednat oficiální funkční tričko a čelenku do 20.12.2026, studenti s průkazem ISIC mají 30% slevu při včasné registraci. Zázemí závodu, registrace, start i cíl jsou v pavilonu G na Výstavišti Flora. Startovní balíček pro tratě 4 a 8 km zahrnuje měřicí čip, občerstvení v cíli a medaili.

name: Lauf der 36. Winterlaufserie der LG Dornburg
Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata za pojedynczy bieg uiszczona najpóźniej do środy poprzedzającej start

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Karnet można wykupić najpóźniej do środy przed drugim biegiem

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in seven locations, including Warsaw’s Młociński Park. The races take place in forests and urban parks, promoting outdoor physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The series runs from October to April, and participants can compete in local and overall standings. The event is open to people aged 16 and over, as well as younger participants with parental permission. The main race starts at 11:00.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through forests and urban parks
Location in Młociński Park in Warsaw
Recurring races in seven cities across Poland
additional: The race office opens at 8:30, and race bibs and chips can be collected on race day. In Warsaw, the warm-up for the main race takes place at 10:30. Participants can buy a pass for the entire series or enter individual races. Participants can run for charity in support of the Siepomaga Foundation. There is no participant limit. Race bibs must be collected in person; an identity document is sufficient for collection. The minimum age for the main race is 16 (or turning 16 in 2026). Online registration is available through the Participant Portal at citytrail.pl/zapisy, as well as at the race office on race day.

name: Bieg Walentynkowy
description: The Poznań Valentine’s Day Run is an annual running event held by Lake Rusałka, bringing together couples, singles, and families to celebrate Valentine’s Day through physical activity. Traditionally, it features 5 km and 10 km runs, as well as Nordic walking, with individual and pairs categories. The event is inclusive and family-friendly, promoting a healthy lifestyle and the joy of exercising outdoors.
course_highlights: Course around Lake Rusałka in Poznań
5 km and 10 km running distances, plus Nordic walking
Option to participate individually or in pairs
additional: The event also includes runs for children. It is family-friendly and inclusive, and takes place annually around Valentine’s Day by Lake Rusałka. The 12th edition has been announced for 13 February 2027 at 12:00. Prices from the 2026 edition may not apply in 2027.

name: Walentynkowy Marsz Nordic Walking
location: Leśny kompleks przy ul. Szybowej, Knurów, Poland
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Knurowie
description: The Valentine’s Day Nordic Walking March is an annual event organized by the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Knurów. It takes place on Valentine’s Day, February 14. Participants follow a route of about 6 kilometres through the forest complex near Szybowa Street. The event is open to everyone, not just couples, and promotes active outdoor recreation. Registration is open until February 9, and the start is scheduled for 11:00.
course_highlights: A route of about 6 km through the forest complex near Szybowa Street
The event takes place on February 14, Valentine’s Day
Organized by the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Knurów
additional: Registration for the march is open until February 9. The event takes place in a forest complex, offering participants a chance to connect with nature while walking.

name: Walentynkowo Szwungiem przez Przyłęk
location: Nowy Tomyśl, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: ARM Race Walentynki
location: Zbiornik Kępina, Zduńska Wola, Łódź Voivodeship, Poland
description: ARM RACE is an extreme obstacle race offering a sporting challenge for people who want to tackle a course packed with obstacles and do something more than an ordinary run. The event offers a variety of formats, from classic 5 km and 10 km distances to multi-hour Selection challenges, dynamic OCR100 races, and family adventures. The starting line brings together both results-focused athletes and people new to OCR, as well as whole families, creating a unique atmosphere of competition and excitement. ARM RACE combines physical activity, technique, and the satisfaction of overcoming obstacles along the course.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km courses with around 25 and 40 obstacles, respectively
A variety of formats: PRO, OPEN, FUN, Selection 12H/24H, OCR100, and a family course
An approximately 1 km family course with obstacles for children and parents, with no pressure to achieve a particular result
additional: Season 2027 passes are available, covering 3 ARM RACE starts (5 km or 10 km, PRO/ELITE with no extra charge) or 2 Selection starts for 699 zł, with an ARM RACE technical cap as a gift. Passes can be purchased by bank transfer to the account of the Rajsport Active Association. The event offers different formats suited to participants’ ability levels, including a format in which participants choose which obstacles to tackle. Races for young competitors aged 6–13 are also available, with timing and rankings.

name: Bieg Karnawałowy
description: The Carnival Run is a 10-kilometer running event held in Puszczykowo. It combines sporting competition with running together in a carnival atmosphere and is part of the local running calendar. It’s an option for people who want to spend their time actively and take on a 10 km course.
course_highlights: 10 km distance
The race takes place in Puszczykowo
The event has a carnival theme

name: Bieg Walentynkowy Run in Sopot II
description: Valentine’s Day Run - Grand Prix of the Tri-City 2/3 - Run in Sopot II is a cross-country race held on Sopot beach, starting near the pier. Participants run towards Gdańsk and back, enjoying scenic coastal views. The event is part of the Winter Grand Prix of Cross-Country Races in Sopot series and includes age categories for runners and Nordic walkers. The race office is located in the concert shell at Skwer Kuracyjny, and the race starts at 10:00.
course_highlights: Cross-country route along the beach with sea views
Start and finish near the pier in Sopot
Run towards Gdańsk and back
additional: The participant limit is 600. The race office is located in the concert shell at Skwer Kuracyjny, before the entrance to the pier. The Nordic walking start is 5 minutes after the race start.

name: Bieg Zdobywców Modyni
description: The Bieg Zdobywców Modyni is an annual mountain race held in the Beskid Wyspowy, attracting runners from across Poland and Europe. The event offers a range of running and Nordic walking courses for different ability levels, as well as children’s races. It combines sporting competition with a family-friendly atmosphere and promotes the scenic Modyń mountain and the Beskid Wyspowy region. The organizers support local community engagement and an active lifestyle, and also offer additional activities and attractions for participants.
course_highlights: Mountain courses of 8.5 km and 17 km through the scenic Beskid Wyspowy
The longest course is 36 km and has ITRA certification (Bieg 6 Szczytów)
Courses are available as GPS files
additional: The event features races for adults and children, Nordic walking, and additional family attractions, such as sweets dropped from a light aircraft and sensory activities for children. The organizers provide GPS files for the courses. The Bieg 6 Szczytów (36 km) is certified by ITRA and included in the international trail-running rankings.

name: Wrocławska Dycha
description: Wrocławska Dycha is an annual running event held in Wrocław, offering 5 km and 10 km distances. The race attracts both recreational and more experienced runners, with an appealing route through the urban surroundings. The event is open and welcoming to participants, promoting an active lifestyle and sporting competition in the heart of the city.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances
Urban route in Wrocław
A race for recreational and experienced runners

name: XVI Bieg Górski
description: The 16th Leszno–Grzybowo Mountain Run is a forest trail race organised by the „Aktywna Trz” Physical Culture Association. The event takes place in the scenic area around Leszno and Grzybowo, offering participants a challenging route through forest terrain. It is held regularly and is popular with mountain runners. It is a great opportunity to test your abilities on natural trails and enjoy some time outdoors.
course_highlights: A forest route with a mountain-running character
Scenic areas around Leszno and Grzybowo
A challenging run on natural terrain
additional: The edition scheduled for 13 February 2027 is listed as the 17th Leszno–Grzybowo Mountain Run.

name: XXVI Bieg Grzmią Pod Stoczkiem Armaty
description: The XXVI Bieg Grzmią Pod Stoczkiem Armaty is an annual road race held in Stoczek Łukowski. The event attracts runners from various regions, offering a unique atmosphere and sporting excitement. The course runs through the town’s picturesque areas, combining elements of history and local culture. The organizers ensure professional event management and participant safety.
course_highlights: Road race course through the center of Stoczek Łukowski
Picturesque views and historic sites along the course
A local community atmosphere and sporting celebration

name: Zimowy Bieg Piasta
description: The Winter Piast Run is the 22nd edition of an annual winter race organized by WKB Piast Wrocław, held in Wilkszyn, Miękinia. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in a friendly atmosphere, welcoming both fast and slower runners. Participants can also take part in the Valentine’s Run, an opportunity to celebrate Valentine’s Day together. The course is adapted to winter conditions, and the organizers make sure the event is fun and brings runners together.
course_highlights: Winter scenery and a course adapted to winter conditions
A friendly atmosphere and the chance to run alongside a loved one
The course has changed and been adapted many times, with starts including the Olympic Stadium and the Agricultural Academy
additional: Participants are encouraged to dress up for the Valentine’s Run. The race is held in changeable winter conditions, and the course is sometimes altered due to terrain conditions. Volunteers and sponsors provide support, and the event brings runners together. Distance information comes from previous editions.

name: Valentýnský běh Hradec Králové
description: Valentýnský běh 2027 se koná 14. února v centru Hradce Králové na Tylově nábřeží. Běžci si mohou vybrat z tratí 5 km, 10 km, půlmaratonu a rodinného běhu určeného dětem a jejich doprovodu. Novinkou je půlmaraton, který doplňuje tradiční závody. Akce nabízí sportovní den v příjemné atmosféře s originální medailí, dárkem, startovním balíčkem a doprovodným programem. Valentýnský běh je určen nejen zamilovaným, ale všem, kdo mají rádi běh a společné zážitky.
course_highlights: Rovinatá trasa po zpěvněných cestách a chodnících
Trasy vedou městem a jeho okolím
Start a zázemí na Tylově nábřeží v centru Hradce Králové
additional: Startovní balíček obsahuje originální medaili, dárek, startovní číslo a elektronický čip pro měření času. K dispozici jsou šatny, úschovna zavazadel, toalety, zdravotnická služba a občerstvení v cíli. Fotografie z akce jsou pořizovány, ale nejsou garantovány všem účastníkům. K dispozici je doprovodný program a ceny pro první tři v kategoriích. Start hlavního závodu je v 11:00 a časy se měří čipem. Trasa není certifikována. V rodinném běhu nejsou povolena jízdní kola.

name: Bertlicher Straßenläufe
description: The Bertlich Road Races in Herten are a traditional running event offering a range of distances from 850 meters to the marathon. The races take place on flat, paved courses around Bertlich and are suitable for both recreational runners and ambitious athletes. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, online registration, and wide range of races. It is organized by SuS Bertlich 1945 e.V. and offers a great opportunity to experience the running community in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: A range of distances from 850 meters to the marathon
Flat, paved courses through the Bertlich recreational area
Family- and recreational-runner-friendly event with activities for children
additional: The event takes place on February 14, 2027. On-site registration is available, and the event offers a friendly atmosphere for runners of all ages.

name: Lorsbacher Winterlauf- und Walkingserie
location: Sporthalle am Schinderwald, Bornstraße 77, Hofheim-Lorsbach, Hofheim am Taunus, Germany
description: The Lorsbach Winter Running and Walking Series is a long-standing series held in winter in Hofheim-Lorsbach. It comprises five events from late November to mid-February, where participants can start individually, with no timing. Two distances are offered, 10 km and 20 km, on varied routes through the forest that are permanently marked. The event is free, but a small donation is requested. After the run, refreshments are served in a relaxed setting, including tea, coffee, cookies, and, on the final date, soup and wheat beer.
course_highlights: Permanently marked 10 km route with 260 metres of elevation gain
20 km loop with an additional loop, marked from late November to mid-February
