Run through the Langenhain Forest, with viewpoints such as the Bahá’í Temple and ‘Mainhatten View’
additional: Starts are individual, with no timing; everyone runs together, not against each other. Changing rooms are open on running days from 8:00 to 13:00. A tea station serving hot tea is available from 9:00 to 12:00 at the Bahai’i forest car park (km 6.4). Participants should bring their own collapsible cups. Travel by S-Bahn S2 to Hofheim-Lorsbach station, a 3-minute walk to the sports hall. Parking is available at the ‘Am Schinderwald’ sports ground and at the park-and-ride facility at the station. No registration required. Start at the sports hall at Schinderwald, Bornstraße 77; changing rooms are open on Sundays from 8:00 to 13:00.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in beautiful woodland settings. In Katowice, the course runs through the State Forests of the Katowice Forest District, with the start about 700 metres from the finish, near the “Rybaczówka” centre by Janina Pond. The races are open to runners of all abilities, from beginners to advanced athletes, who can regularly track their results on the same course. The event promotes outdoor physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, and races take place regularly during the 2026/2027 season.
course_highlights: A 5 km course in the woodland setting of the State Forests of the Katowice Forest District
The start is about 700 m from the finish, near the “Rybaczówka” centre by Janina Pond
The course is suitable for both beginner and advanced runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30, and the main race starts at 11:00. It is not possible to drive directly to the start; parking is available on Karolinki Street, about 1 km from the race office. The course remains unchanged, allowing runners to compare results over the months and years. The event also includes races for children in various age categories.

name: XVIII Jelczańsko-Oławski Zimowy Maraton
description: The 19th Jelczańsko-Oławski Toyota Winter Marathon in Stages is a series of seven races, each 7.033 km long, held in different towns in the region, including Janików. The event combines running and Nordic walking in a winter setting, and participants can collect their race packs the day before the first stage. The organizers provide electronic timing and allow authorized persons to collect race numbers. The staged format offers competition and fun throughout February 2027.
course_highlights: Seven stages, each 7.033 km long
Routes pass through Chwałowice, Oława, Jelcz-Laskowice, Janików, and Miłoszyce
Nordic walking and running start together, with the running races starting at 11:00
additional: Race packs can be collected the day before the first stage at Termy Jakuba in Oława and at the Jelcz-Laskowice Municipal and District Office. The organizer allows an authorized person to collect a race pack with a signed form. Nordic walking starts at 10:30 and running races at 11:00. On race day, the race office is open from 9:00 to 10:30 (or from 10:00 starting with the second stage). The Nordic walking start is scheduled for 10:30 and the running race for 11:00.

name: 10 Krakowski Bieg Walentynkowy
location: Błonia Krakowskie and Park Jordana, Kraków, Poland
description: The Kraków Valentine’s Run is Poland’s largest running event dedicated to all those in love, including couples, married couples, and singles. The 5 km route runs through the heart of Kraków, including the picturesque paths of Jordan Park, laid out in the shape of a heart. Participants receive a race pack with a bib and timing chip, as well as a unique item featuring the slogan “all you need is RUN!”. After the race, they can enjoy a traditional wuzetka cake and a commemorative medal designed especially for the occasion. The run is a great opportunity to celebrate Valentine’s Day actively and connect with fellow runners.
course_highlights: A heart-shaped route through Jordan Park in Kraków
Picturesque lanes and paths in the heart of the city
A couples’ race and the “Up for Grabs” category for singles
additional: The race pack includes a bib with a timing chip and a unique item featuring the slogan “all you need is RUN!”. After the race, participants receive a traditional wuzetka cake and a commemorative medal. The run takes place in pairs or in the “Up for Grabs” category for singles. In the previous edition, the race pack included a bib with a timing chip and an item, and participants received a medal and a sweet treat after the race.

name: 13. Walentynkowy Bieg pod Najstarszą Sosną
description: The Valentine’s Run by the Oldest Pine is a special running event held in Mińsk Mazowiecki. It is not a race, but a run for people who love running and want to spend time actively and celebrate their passion for sport. The atmosphere is friendly and full of positive energy, and participants run for the love of movement and nature.
course_highlights: The run takes place near the Oldest Pine in Poland.
The event is recreational, with no emphasis on competition.
The Valentine’s Day timing gives the gathering a special atmosphere.

name: Bieg Walentynkowy
description: The Valentine’s Day Run, organized by WKB Piast Wrocław, is an annual running event held in wintry conditions in Skowroni Park in Wrocław. This is the 22nd edition of the event, which promotes a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in a friendly atmosphere. The run welcomes both fast and slower runners and invites them to celebrate Valentine’s Day together with a loved one. Participants can also dress up in themed costumes, adding a special touch to the event.
course_highlights: A route through Skowroni Park in wintry conditions
A friendly atmosphere and the chance to run together with a partner
The option to dress up in a Valentine’s Day theme
additional: Registration is through the Datasport portal. The run is an inclusive event that encourages couples to take part and dress up for Valentine’s Day. The route may be modified depending on conditions, and the organizers appreciate the help of volunteers and support from sponsors. WKB Piast states that the event is being held as its 22nd edition. Registration is through Datasport.

name: Botaniczna Piątka
location: Ogród Dendrologiczny w Przelewicach, Przelewice, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Przelewice is the winter edition of a popular cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts from Wielkopolska. The event takes place in the picturesque Przelewice Dendrological Garden, where participants can enjoy the beauty of nature and the scenic course. Since 2014, the organizers have focused on promoting cross-country running and exceptional locations, offering runners unforgettable sporting experiences. The event attracts both recreational and more experienced runners who want to spend time actively in a winter setting.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in the Przelewice Dendrological Garden
Picturesque natural surroundings
Winter race edition with a unique atmosphere
additional: Registration for the main distance and children’s race has closed. The organizers emphasize the scenic appeal of the locations they choose and the promotion of cross-country running. The 10th anniversary of Botaniczna Piątka is planned for summer 2026. The previous edition featured a main distance and children’s races.

name: Górski Bieg Nawoja
location: Nawojowa Góra, Krzeszowice, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Górski Bieg Nawoja is a mountain race held in Nawojowa Góra, showcasing the terrain of Górzanka and its surroundings. The course is marked with arrows and tape, with distance markers to the finish every kilometre. The event is held regularly and attracts runners who enjoy mountain challenges and beautiful scenery. The race office is located at the LKS Górzanka sports field, where changing rooms, restrooms and a refreshment point are available.
course_highlights: Mountain course with markers every kilometre
Marked with arrows and red-and-white tape on more difficult sections
Start and finish near the LKS Górzanka sports field
additional: The race office is open from 10:00 to 10:50 at the LKS Górzanka sports field. The 7 km race starts at 11:00, and the 3 km race starts at 11:01. Participant parking is available by the sports field. The race concludes at 12:30. There is a refreshment point on the course, along with distance markers to the finish.

name: Pięćsetny Maraton Drago Boroji
description: The Five Hundredth Marathon of Drago Boroji and the Hundredth Marathon of Piotr Kopec is a special running event held in Tychy. The marathon is organized by Piotr and Drago together with the 40-latek Running Club, offering participants a premium sporting experience. The event combines athletic competition with a rich program of discussions and workshops about running, led by well-known experts and athletes. It is an excellent opportunity for amateur and professional runners to develop their skills and enjoy the race atmosphere.
course_highlights: Road race in Tychy
Marathon distance
The calendar also lists distances of 35, 28, and 21 km
additional: The event includes lectures, workshops, and panel discussions about different forms of running, led by experts and well-known athletes. The program includes, among other things, an opening panel, an expert debate, and a warm-up with athletics stars.

name: Turbacz Winter Trail
description: Turbacz Winter Trail is a winter mountain race held in the magical Gorce Mountains, offering seven different distances so every participant can find a suitable route. The event takes place on 13–14 February 2027 in Nowy Targ, with the start and finish at the Kowaniec municipal car park, and in Waksmund for selected distances. The race is known for challenging winter conditions, beautiful views and a unique atmosphere. Participants receive unique medals and a generous race pack. The event is held under the honorary patronage of the Ministry of Sport and Tourism and is an important event in the Mountain Running League.
course_highlights: Routes through the Gorce Mountains in winter conditions, with beautiful views
Start and finish in Nowy Targ and Waksmund
Seven distances with varying levels of difficulty
additional: The start and finish for the 12, 22 and 48 km distances are at the Kowaniec municipal car park in Nowy Targ. The Turbaczowe Love distance starts at the Primary School in Waksmund, with transport to the start provided. Participants receive a personalized race bib, electronic timekeeping, a commemorative medal and a generous race pack. Refreshment points are available along the route, depending on the distance. Participants can choose from various race formats, including Mizuno Nocna zaDycha, Zimna Połówka, Bez Barier, TWT na 6 Łap and AK-47. The organizer reserves the right to possible discrepancies in route elevation measurements. The 2027 edition is scheduled for 13–14 February; details of the distances and routes may be finalized by the organizer.

name: X Zimowe Grand Prix Zadyszki
location: Animal shelter near ul. Kamieniec, Oświęcim, Poland
description: The X Zadyszka Winter Grand Prix is a series of winter road races organized by the Oświęcimski Klub Biegacza „Zadyszka”. The races cover a distance of 7 km in Oświęcim, in the area of Kamieniec Street, next to the animal shelter. It is one of the region’s most popular winter running events, attracting both local competitors and runners from across Małopolska. Registration is available only on race day, and each race is scheduled to start at 11:00.
course_highlights: A 7 km road course
Location on Kamieniec Street, next to the animal shelter
A winter atmosphere and sporting competition in the Oświęcim area
additional: Participant registration is available only on race day from 10:00 to 10:45. After the race, participants can use the sauna and take an ice bath at Sole (during the 2025/2026 season). In the previous edition, registration was available only on race day from 10:00 to 10:45, and the start was scheduled for 11:00.

name: XI Oleszyce Trail Półmaraton
description: The XI Oleszyce Trail Half Marathon is a winter running event held in the picturesque forests of the Oleszyce Forest District. The 21.09 km half-marathon route follows challenging forest paths with natural obstacles and varied terrain, presenting a real challenge for participants. The event is organised by the Czas na Las Association, which has promoted sport, recreation and environmental protection for years. In addition to the race, there is a Nordic Walking event covering approximately 9 km, and all participants receive race packs and commemorative medals.
course_highlights: The route passes through the forests of the Oleszyce Forest District, with natural obstacles and challenging terrain
The route passes through the historic site of the former village of Miłków, with a replica cottage and the Miłkowskie Ponds
The winter atmosphere and forest paths create a unique experience and challenge for runners
additional: The Nordic Walking route is approximately 8.92 km long and requires participants to maintain their rhythm and technique on slippery sections. The event is held in close cooperation with the Oleszyce Forest District and local governments. The forest routes are available to athletes year-round as a natural training space. The date of 15 February 2027 is marked as tentative in the race calendar.

name: XIX Grand Prix Tychów w Biegach Długodystansowych
organizer: MOSiR Tychy i Stowarzyszenie Promocji Lekkiej Atletyki w Tychach
price_range: 30 zł za bieg; 150 zł za cały cykl
description: The 19th Tychy Grand Prix is a series of long-distance races organized in Tychy by the Athletics Promotion Association. Six races are scheduled for the 2026 season, taking place from February to December. The event includes women’s and men’s classifications over 5 km and 10 km. The entry fee can be paid on the day of the event or in advance for the entire series.
course_highlights: Races over 5 km and 10 km
A series of six races held throughout the year
Separate classifications for women and men
additional: Classifications after three races for women and men over 5 km and 10 km. The fee for the entire race series must be paid before the first race. The 2026 schedule includes six races. The series consists of six races. Participants who complete at least four receive a commemorative gift.

name: Zamieć 24h
description: ZAMIEĆ 2027 is an extreme winter mountain ultramarathon held in the Beskids, starting and finishing at the Amphitheatre in Szczyrk. Participants take on a demanding route leading to the summit of Skrzyczne (1,257 m above sea level), completing it repeatedly over 6, 12 or 24 hours. It is a solitary battle against the winter elements—snow, wind and frost—and their own limits. The event attracts an elite community of runners ready for extreme challenges in the mountains.
course_highlights: A 14.12 km route with significant elevation gain to Skrzyczne (1,257 m above sea level)
Start and finish at the Amphitheatre in Szczyrk
Warm refreshment points along the route, including at the highest point
additional: All distances take place simultaneously. Participants receive a commemorative medal and accident insurance. Warm refreshment points are available along the route. Places are limited. The 2027 edition is scheduled for 22–23 January; in the previous edition, the start and event location were associated with the amphitheatre in Szczyrk.

name: XVIII Półmaraton Komandosa
organizer: Wojskowy Klub Biegacza Meta Lubliniec, Klub Uczelniany AZS WAT, Fundacja Wspierania Inicjatyw Niekonwencjonalnych „SUB VENTUM”
description: Półmaraton Komandosa (Commando Half Marathon) is a race in Warsaw that opens the Wielki Szlem Komandosa series. The 18th edition is on 19 and 20 February 2027. On Friday 19 February the international military universities championship is held, and on Saturday 20 February the elite race and the open race. The series also includes Setka Komandosa in Lubliniec, Ćwierćmaraton Komandosa in Słupsk, the O Nóż Komandosa cross-country race and Maraton Komandosa.
course_highlights: Half marathon distance in Warsaw
Separate races for military universities, elite and open
First of five races in the Wielki Szlem Komandosa series
additional: Schedule: 19 February at 11:00 the international military universities championship, 20 February at 09:30 the elite race (Szturm) and at 12:45 the open race (Misja). Entries for the whole series are on the ZmierzymyCzas portal. The series is organised by WKB Meta Lubliniec, the AZS club of the Military University of Technology and the SUB VENTUM foundation.

name: innogy Winter Run Praha
description: innogy Winter Run Praha je zimní běžecký závod konaný v parku Ladronka v Praze 6. Nabízí tratě na 4 km a 8 km, včetně štafety 2x4 km a dětských závodů. Akce je vhodná pro běžce všech úrovní a je součástí Českého poháru v zimním běhu. Závod je známý svou přátelskou atmosférou a podporou pohybu v zimním období.
course_highlights: Zimní běžecký výběh v parku Ladronka s tratěmi 8,4 km a 4,2 km
Možnost účasti ve štafetě 2x4 km
Dětské závody na 400 a 800 metrů
additional: Registrace a vyzvednutí startovních balíčků probíhá od 08:30 do 11:30 v den závodu. Pořadatel nabízí oficiální funkční tričko a čelenku k objednání do 20.12.2026. Vyhlášení výsledků probíhá postupně od 10:30 do 13:40. Závod je součástí Českého poháru v zimním běhu. Hlavní tratě jsou určeny běžcům od 12 let. Startovné zahrnuje startovní číslo s čipem, medaili, startovní tašku, zdravotnický dozor a online výsledky.

name: Lauf der 39. DJK Winterlaufserie
description: The 39th DJK Winter Series race in Göppingen is the final individual race in the long-running winter series organized by DJK SG Göppingen e.V. It gives runners of different age groups and ability levels the opportunity to take part in distances from 1.2 km to 10 km. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and closing awards ceremony. It is a popular race for children, young people, and recreational runners in the region.
course_highlights: Distances from 1.2 km to 10 km
Children’s race, youth race, and main race open to all
Final individual race with awards ceremony
additional: The event is the final race in the DJK Winter Series, followed by an awards ceremony. There are dedicated races for children (ages 8–11) and young people (ages 12–15), as well as a 5 km youth and recreational race and a 10 km main race.

name: Lauf Seriencross in Schöneiche - 32. Seriencross MOL
41 Bieg Gąsieniców
location: COS OPO, under Średnia Krokiew ski jump, Zakopane, Poland
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Zakopanem
description: The 41st Gąsienica National Run is an annual running event organized by the Zakopane Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre. The race takes place at COS OPO, below the Średnia Krokiew ski jump, offering participants a unique atmosphere and a picturesque mountain setting. The event attracts both recreational and experienced runners looking to take on a challenging course in winter conditions. It’s a great opportunity for sporting competition and an active day out in the heart of the Tatras.
course_highlights: The course runs through COS OPO, below the Średnia Krokiew ski jump
Picturesque mountain surroundings in Zakopane
Winter conditions and challenging terrain
additional: Details of the edition scheduled for 2027 have not been provided in the available sources.

name: Bieg ku Korzeniom Miłości
description: The Bieg ku Korzeniom Miłości is a unique sporting event held in the picturesque Park Korzonek in the Municipality of Konopiska. The event combines sporting competition with a friendly atmosphere, welcoming both experienced runners and those just starting out. The main race covers a distance of 5 km along the park’s charming paths, offering close contact with nature. The programme also includes accompanying races for children and young people, as well as a special couples’ classification that promotes teamwork.
course_highlights: 5 km route along the charming paths of Park Korzonek
Picturesque winter scenery in the park
Close contact with nature during the race
additional: The organisers are Atelier Sportu, GCKiS Konopiska and Park Korzonek. Timing is provided by Pomiar Czasu Atelier Sportu using modern RFID timing systems. The 2026 edition will also feature races for children and young people, as well as a MIXT couples’ classification.

name: Bieg Pamięci Sybiru
description: The Siberian Deportations Memorial Run is an annual running event commemorating the victims of deportations to Siberia. In 2027, the race will take place in Osobowicki Forest in Wrocław, giving participants the chance to compete over a distance of 5 km. The event combines sport with historical remembrance, creating a unique atmosphere filled with emotion and poignancy. The organizers provide a wave start for the 10 km distance, and the course is prepared to be safe and suitable for winter conditions.
course_highlights: The course runs through Osobowicki Forest in Wrocław
Wave start for the 10 km distance due to the large number of participants
The course is prepared for winter conditions, with no icy sections
additional: The event is held in both in-person and virtual formats. In Wrocław, the race is 5 km, while a wave start is used for the 10 km distance due to the large number of participants. The course is adapted to winter conditions, with no icy sections. The organizers prepare an information bulletin for participants with key details before the start. According to information from the previous edition, the race office in Wrocław was open on race day from 15:00 to 17:30.

name: Bieg Powstania Styczniowego
description: The January Uprising Run is an annual running event organized by the Stryków Municipality to commemorate the historical events of the January Uprising. The run and walk take place in the municipality, bringing together the local community and fans of physical activity. The event has a patriotic and sporting character, promoting a healthy lifestyle and historical remembrance.
course_highlights: 10 km run
6.5 km Nordic Walking march
Route near Dobra, associated with commemorating a skirmish from 1863
additional: The event is supported by the Stryków Municipality, OKiR Stryków, and Volunteer Fire Brigades. The race calendar tentatively lists 21 February 2027.

name: Bieg Wyzwolenia
organizer: Miejsko-Gminne Centrum Kultury i Sportu w Choroszczy oraz Burmistrz Choroszczy
description: The Municipal and Communal Cultural and Sports Centre in Choroszcz and the Mayor of Choroszcz invite you to the Run marking the 107th anniversary of the Liberation of Choroszcz, an important sporting and promotional event for the town. The event includes a 10 km main race, which will determine the top runners, and an inclusive 1,700 m Nordic walking march for seniors, families with children and anyone else interested. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle, physical activity and social integration. The race and march will start at 12:00 on 21 February at 11 Listopada Square in Choroszcz. After the competitions, participants are expected to light candles together at the Independence Monument.
course_highlights: 10 km main race on a certified course
Inclusive 1,700 m Nordic walking march for families and seniors
Start and finish at 11 Listopada Square in Choroszcz
additional: A group warm-up with a fitness instructor will take place before the start. After the race and march, participants are expected to light candles in the colours of Choroszcz’s flag at the Independence Monument. Entry fees can be paid only by online bank transfer or in cash on race day, if places are still available. The main race course is certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA). The previous edition also included an inclusive Nordic walking march.

name: Botaniczna Piątka
location: Ogród Botaniczny Uniwersytetu Zielonogórskiego, Zielona Góra, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka is a series of cross-country races organized since 2014 by running enthusiasts who focus on the aesthetic qualities of their routes. The event takes place in scenic locations, such as the University of Zielona Góra Botanical Garden in Zielona Góra. It attracts both recreational and more experienced runners, offering a unique atmosphere and the chance to spend time actively outdoors. The organizers promote running and make cross-country routes appealing.
course_highlights: Cross-country route through the University of Zielona Góra Botanical Garden
Scenic, attractive surroundings along the route
The autumn route follows a two-lap course
additional: The race takes place on a two-lap course. The organizers celebrate the 10th anniversary of Botaniczna Piątka in 2026. The event is part of a series of cross-country races held at various locations in Wielkopolska and beyond.

name: 14 Cross Trzebnicki
description: Cross Trzebnicki is a challenging trail race set amid the picturesque beech forest and green spaces around Stawy Trzebnickie. Participants cover 10 km, divided into three laps of approximately 3,333 metres each, on a hilly course with numerous climbs and descents. The race is popular with fans of mountain and trail running, offering beautiful views and varied surfaces, mainly forest paths, gravel, and sections of asphalt. Participants receive a race pack with practical items and a commemorative medal.
course_highlights: A 10 km cross-country course divided into 3 laps of approximately 3,333 m each
Hilly terrain with numerous climbs and descents at varying gradients
Surface: 90% forest paths and gravel, 10% asphalt and paving stones
additional: The race office is open from 9:00 on race day by Stawy Trzebnickie. The start and finish are at the same location. The race pack includes sports socks. Timing is provided by chips in the race bibs. A refreshment point is located at the start/finish. Parking is available at Aqua-Zdrój Trzebnica and Hala Sportowa Trzebnica. The winners’ awards ceremony begins at 12:30. Bag storage and changing rooms are available by the race office.

name: Žarnovický beh
location: Žarnovica, Okres Žarnovica, Banskobystrický kraj, Slovakia

name: 5. Pietrasze Cross Country 4/5
description: Pietrasze Cross Country is a series of five cross-country races and Nordic walking events held in Białystok. Each race is approximately 7.8 km long and attracts runners who enjoy outdoor activity in scenic surroundings. The participant limit is 135, ensuring an intimate atmosphere and comfortable competition. The event is organized by the Podlaskie Running Center Pędziwiatr and takes place on various dates from November to March.
course_highlights: Race and walk distance: 7.83 km
Cross-country course in Białystok
Participant limit: 135
additional: The participant limit is 135. The entry fee is 30 PLN for the first registration period, 35 PLN for the second period, and on-site. The cross-country course is 7.83 km long.

name: Dwumaraton Olęderski
description: The Olęder Double Marathon is a recurring race organized by the Nowy Tomyśl Chyży Running Club, held on scenic routes around Jastrzębsko Stare. The event is part of an autumn-winter race series that passes through various towns, offering participants varied and challenging courses. It attracts both recreational and more experienced runners looking to test their endurance over the marathon distance. The organizers foster a welcoming atmosphere and support runners at every stage of preparation and competition.
course_highlights: Scenic routes around Jastrzębsko Stare
Varied and challenging running sections
Part of a regional autumn-winter race series
additional: The Olęder Double Marathon is co-financed by the Nowy Tomyśl County. Registration for the races usually opens several months before the event. The event takes place on weekends, and the routes change as the series moves to different locations. It is part of a series held in the autumn-winter period; the available information about the format comes from the 2025/2026 edition.

name: XI Bieg Zaślubinowy
description: The 11th Betrothal Run “From Haller to Haller” is a much-loved race linking the two monuments to Józef Haller in Władysławowo and Puck, and kicking off the running season in the region. Set against a picturesque seaside backdrop, the event offers participants a unique atmosphere and professional organization. It’s a race for everyone who wants to start the season actively, without unnecessary pressure, in a friendly atmosphere. The course is well prepared and accurately measured, as confirmed by numerous positive participant reviews.
course_highlights: A course linking the two monuments to Józef Haller in Władysławowo and Puck
Picturesque seaside scenery
Accurately measured and professionally prepared courses
additional: The event is part of the Puck Running Triad and the STONE TRI & RUN series. Enjoy a relaxed, pressure-free atmosphere, with prizes and additional attractions such as massages and refreshments. This event is for runners of all abilities.

name: 46 Półmaraton Wiązowski
description: The 46th Wiązowna Half Marathon is a traditional 21.0975 km race held in Wiązowna. In 2027, the event will adopt a new two-day format, with children’s and youth races on Saturday and the main half marathon and accompanying 5 km race on Sunday. This event opens the running season and attracts runners of different ages and ability levels. The organizers ensure an engaging program and a great atmosphere.
course_highlights: Half marathon distance: 21.0975 km
Wiązowna Five — a 5 km race
Children’s and youth races over distances from 100 m to 2,000 m
additional: In 2027, the half marathon will take place in a new two-day format: Saturday is set aside for children’s and youth races, while Sunday features the half marathon and the 5 km race. The event is scheduled for February 28, 2027.

name: 20 Jubileuszowy Bieg Twardziela
description: The 20th Jubilee Twardziel Run is a 10 km race held in Wodzisław Śląski. Participants can prepare for the start using training plans tailored to their level and VDOT, offering detailed instructions and expert support. The event is an excellent opportunity for road runners to test their fitness on a challenging course. The organizers encourage professional management of race information and marketing collaboration, reflecting the event’s high standard of organization.
course_highlights: A 10 km route through the streets of Wodzisław Śląski
A paved course of moderate difficulty
Runners can prepare using training plans tailored to their level
additional: Training plans are available for 8 to 20 weeks, with instructions and expert support. Organizers can manage the race listing and explore marketing collaboration.

name: Bieg Zimowy Jarocin
location: Forest near the intersection of al. Niepodległości and ul. Przemysłowej, Jarocin, Poland
description: The Jarocin Winter Run is a unique race of approximately 8 km, held in the picturesque forest in Jarocin. Runners start at 15-second intervals, ensuring safety and an exciting race against the clock. The course is a fast, marked forest loop, ideal for fans of winter running and woodland scenery. The race pack includes a bib with a chip, a commemorative medal, and a hot recovery meal. Participation is limited to 300 people, and the race is open to all fitness enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Approximately 8 km on a fast, marked forest loop
Staggered starts every 15 seconds — an individual race against the clock
The course winds among snow-covered trees in Jarocin’s picturesque forest
additional: Time limit on the course: 90 minutes. The race office and Finisher Zone, serving a hot recovery meal, are open from 11:30 to 15:00 at the Social Schools Complex in Jarocin, ul. Przemysłowa 1. Participant limit: 300; time limit: 90 minutes. The race office is located at the Social Schools Complex in Jarocin, ul. Przemysłowa 1. Available sources give the date as 28 February 2027, not 21 February.

name: Maraton Jagodno
description: Jagodno Marathon is a race held in the Jagodno district of Wrocław. It’s an opportunity to take on the marathon distance and run in a local, neighborly atmosphere.

name: Sztafeta Pomocy
description: The Sztafeta Pomocy is a charity running event organized by the Sportplus Foundation to support children’s rehabilitation. The race takes place in the scenic Marcelin Forest in Poznań, on a forest route approximately 3.3 km long. Participants compete in teams of four, and the event promotes physical activity and social integration. It is a unique opportunity to combine sport with helping those in need.
course_highlights: A route approximately 3.3 km long along the paths of Marcelin Forest
100% forest surface
Start and finish on the clearing on the side of Strzegomska Street
additional: The limit is 125 teams of four. Participants must be at least 15 years old; those under 18 need parental consent. The time limit for completing the route is 2 hours. The route remains open to pedestrians, and medical staff are on hand to ensure safety. The fundraiser supports the rehabilitation of Oliwier Jabłoński. The route map is available on AllTrails.

name: XI Bieg Zaślubin Polski z Morzem
description: The 11th Run to Commemorate Poland’s Wedding to the Sea is a historic race linking two monuments to Józef Haller, from Władysławowo to Puck. The route is inspired by the events of 1920 and marks the opening of the Puck Running Trilogy. Organized by STONE TRI & RUN, the race is a signature event that kicks off the running season in the Pomeranian region. Participants can expect professional organization and a rich program of accompanying events.
course_highlights: Historic route from Władysławowo to Puck
Route linking two monuments to Józef Haller
Opening event of the Puck Running Trilogy
additional: Participants receive a race guide containing the current route, a site map, rules and tips for runners, information about bus departures and parking, the event schedule, and start lists. In the 2026 edition, the race distance was 11.5 km; a Nordic Walking event over the same distance was also held.

name: Liga Biegowa i Nordic Walking
description: Liga Biegowa i Nordic Walking TSA Sandomierz is a six-race series organised by the TSA Sandomierz association. The 2027 season opens on Sunday 21 February 2027 with a stage in Sandomierz, followed by stages on 10 April, 20 June, 7 August, 10 October and 11 December 2027. Each stage has a 10 km run and Nordic walking of about 5 km. All stages are within 50 km of Sandomierz.
course_highlights: 10 km run and about 5 km Nordic walking
Six stages from February to December
Season ranking with a 3,000 PLN prize pool
additional: Stage 1 starts on 21 February 2027 at 12:00; the organizer announces the venues of later stages at least 60 days ahead. A single start costs 85 PLN, or 100 PLN from the Monday of race week. The season pass for all 6 stages costs 390 PLN until 31 December 2026 and 420 PLN until 14 February 2027. The limit is 250 per stage and participants must be adults. The overall ranking counts the best 4 of 6 stages.

name: HaWei50
distance_verbose: 50 km, 10 km, 5 km, 3000 Meter, 1.8 km, 0.6 km

name: HaWei by night - 5/10 km Nachtlauf rund um den Hardtsee
Winter TRAIL 2026
price_range: Early od 0 Kč, běžná od 149 Kč
description: Winter TRAIL 2027 je silniční běh s duší výletu, který nabízí tratě 5 km, 10 km, půlmaraton a 21 km štafetu vedoucí mezi loukami a vyhlídkovými kopci Chřibů. Závod se koná v Halenkovicích a nabízí krásné výhledy, rozmanitý terén a příjemnou atmosféru. Součástí je také 2km rodinný orientační běh pro rodiče s dětmi. Start je u Nové ZŠ Halenkovice a výdej startovních čísel probíhá od 8:00 do 9:30. Závod je vhodný pro širokou veřejnost a klade důraz na bezpečnost a zábavu v přírodě.
course_highlights: Rozmanitý terén mezi loukami a vyhlídkovými kopci Chřibů
Krásné výhledy během běhu
Rodinný orientační běh 2 km pro rodiče s dětmi
additional: Výdej startovních čísel probíhá od 8:00 do 9:30 hod. Běh se koná na vlastní nebezpečí, na trati je zajištěna první pomoc. Doporučuje se zvýšená opatrnost na místech křížení s pozemními komunikacemi. Virtuální trail race s převýšením, flexibilní časování, bez pevné trasy, účastníci si mohou zvolit čas a místo běhu, více délek tratí, registrace přes e-mail, možnost zakoupit odměny a merche

name: Lysacup – Malenovice, Rajská bouda – finále
location: Rajská bouda, Malenovice, Frýdlant nad Ostravicí, Moravian-Silesian Region, Česko
description: Lysacup je zimní etapový pohár v běhu, který se koná převážně na Lysé hoře v Beskydech. Každý víkend se běží z jiného místa, přičemž závod v Malenovicích u Rajské boudy je finálovou etapou. Soutěž je určena jak jednotlivcům, tak týmům, a nabízí jedinečnou příležitost vyzkoušet si běh v zimních podmínkách s krásnými horskými výhledy. Start je obvykle v 10:00 a účastníci používají čipy aktivované na celý ročník za dobrovolný příspěvek.
course_highlights: Zimní běh v horském terénu Beskyd
Etapový závod s různými startovními místy každý víkend
Finálová etapa v Malenovicích u Rajské boudy
additional: Startovní čip se aktivuje na celý ročník zasláním dobrovolného příspěvku na účet. Jednorázová cena čipu je 100 Kč. Čipy lze odkoupit od jiných závodníků nebo získat od pořadatelů, obvykle v září. V závodě je možné se účastnit i jako chodec, který získává body podle pravidel poháru. Závěrečná etapa je bodována dvojnásobně. Týmová soutěž sčítá nejlepší výsledky tří závodníků z týmu. Finálová etapa je dvojnásobně bodovaná. Závěr seriálu zahrnuje vyhlášení celkového pořadí.

name: Železnohorák
description: Železnohorák je součástí Železnohorského poháru, seriálu běhů do vrchu v krásné přírodě Železných hor. Závod nabízí sportovní výzvu v kopcovitém terénu s cílem na nejvyšším bodě Železných hor, Horním Vestci. Běží se v malebné obci Bezděkov u Chotěboře a je vhodný jak pro závodníky usilující o nejlepší čas, tak pro běžce běžící pro radost z pohybu. Start je hromadný v 13:00 na návsi v Bezděkově.
course_highlights: Běh do vrchu v kopcovitém terénu Železných hor
Cíl na nejvyšším bodě Železných hor, Horním Vestci (668 m n. m.)
Start a cíl v malebné obci Bezděkov u Chotěboře
additional: Startovné je zdarma pro závodníky v úboru Železnohoráka (bílé triko, červené trenýrky, zmijovka/rádiovka) a startovné jim bude vráceno při slavnostním ceremoniálu. Přihlášky jsou možné on-line do půlnoci 25. února nebo na místě v den závodu od 11:30 do 12:40.

name: Lauf der 36. Winterlaufserie der LG Dornburg
Gorce Ultra-Trail Winter
description: Gorce Ultra-Trail is a mountain running festival held in the heart of the Gorce Mountains, in Ochotnica Dolna. It offers seven varied race routes, from a short 5 km sprint to a 102 km ultramarathon, all finishing in Ochotnica Dolna. The routes carry ITRA points, reflecting their high standards and appeal to mountain runners. The event combines sporting competition with the opportunity to discover the beauty of Gorce’s trails and its local culture and traditions.
course_highlights: Seven routes ranging from 5 km to 102 km
Routes awarded points by the international ITRA organization
All routes finish in scenic Ochotnica Dolna
additional: Mandatory equipment: a visible race bib; a timing chip attached to your shoe or ankle; a charged phone with the GUT emergency number, +48 533 826 321; and your own cup or drinks container (GUT ECO-CODE: no disposable cups). Race packs must be collected in person. Information about distances and the organizer comes from the 2026 edition registration details.

name: XII Zimowy Ultramaraton Karkonoski
description: The Winter Karkonosze Ultramarathon is a demanding winter mountain race of approximately 47.5 km, crossing the entire Karkonosze ridge. Competitors will face challenging winter conditions, passing, among other places, Szrenica, Śnieżne Kotły, Karkonoska Pass, and the summit of Śnieżka. The race commemorates Tomek Kowalski, an ultramarathon runner and mountaineer whose passion for the mountains inspires participants. The time limit is 10.5 hours, and aid stations are positioned along the course. The finish is on the pedestrian promenade in Karpacz, where runners can look forward to a hot meal and prizes.
course_highlights: The course crosses the entire Karkonosze ridge and is approximately 47.5 km long
Passes Szrenica, Śnieżne Kotły, Karkonoska Pass, and the summit of Śnieżka
Winter mountain conditions, with aid stations every 10–15 km
additional: The race starts in Szklarska Poręba (the parking lot below Kamieńczyk Waterfall). Transport for runners from Karpacz to the start is provided, with checks of mandatory equipment. Toilets, showers, and bag drop are available at the finish. Race packs can be collected at the race office in Karpacz the day before the start (15:00–22:00). After the race, there will be an awards ceremony, a concert, and a gathering at Chata Karkonoska. The edition is scheduled for 27 February 2027. The start list following the draw is to be published on 10 November.

name: 11 Bieg Pamięci Żołnierzy Wyklętych
description: The 11th Captain Witold Pilecki Memorial Run for the Cursed Soldiers is an annual running event held in Oborniki. Runners start on Droga Leśna–Przylesie Street and complete laps of approximately 2 km, running as many laps as they wish, with a minimum of two. The run lasts a maximum of 1.5 hours, and a fire siren signals its end. The evening setting gives the event a distinctive atmosphere of remembrance and reflection.
course_highlights: Start on Droga Leśna–Przylesie Street
Approximately 2 km lap with a turnaround at Juliana Kubiaka Street
1.5-hour time limit; a fire siren signals the finish
additional: Runners may complete as many laps as they wish, with a minimum of 2. The run has a time limit of 1.5 hours. A fire siren signals the end of the run. The 1.5-hour time limit is signaled by a fire siren when it ends. Information about the 2027 edition is marked as provisional in the calendar.

name: Gliwicka Parkowa Prowokacja Biegowa
description: Gliwice Park Running Challenge is a series of 12 running and Nordic Walking events held in Gliwice in 2026, organized by the “Pędziwiatr” Amateur Running Enthusiasts Club. The events aim to promote healthy, active outdoor recreation and take place on Saturdays once a month in the municipal forest. Each lap is 4,219.5 metres long and runs mainly on forest and gravel paths, with some asphalt. Participants can choose from 1 to 5 laps, covering approximately 4.2 km to a half marathon, and compete in running or Nordic Walking.
course_highlights: Each lap is 4,219.5 m long
Runs mainly on forest and gravel paths, with some asphalt
Start and finish in the municipal forest near the Piast stadium
additional: Participants can take part in running or Nordic Walking, or join the e-Prowokacja using any activity. The time limit is 3 hours. A refreshment point with drinks is available after each lap. Race numbers are valid for the whole year and must be returned after the event. After the race, participants receive a drink and a snack (sausage or banana), as well as a chocolate bar through a prize draw, if sanitary regulations allow. The official website confirms running and Nordic Walking but does not provide details about the edition on 27 February 2027.

name: Grand Prix Biskupca
organizer: Centrum Kultury, Turystyki i Sportu w Biskupcu
description: The Biskupiec Grand Prix is a series of four races held in the scenic surroundings of Biskupiec, including events over approximately 5 km, 8 km and 10 km. The races take place on urban and park courses, with electronic timing and overall standings based on gun time. The event attracts both individual runners and four-person relay teams, offering a range of race formats. The organizers set a participant limit and allow registration online and on race day. The Biskupiec Grand Prix is an excellent opportunity for sporting competition and an active day out in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: The approximately 5 km Southern Run course passes near the retention reservoir and Municipal Park.
The approximately 5 km Morning Run course goes around Lake Kraksy Małe and allotment gardens.
The approximately 8 km Night Run course follows paths, cycling routes and Municipal Park.
additional: The participant limit for each event is 200. Registration and payment of the entry fee are available online and on race day, up to 30 minutes before the start (at a higher fee). Electronic timing uses a returnable chip. Race numbers must be attached at the front, at chest or waist height. The Southern Run is an individual race over approximately 5 km. Overall standings are based on gun times. Four-person relay teams compete in a format in which the winning team is the one whose fourth runner crosses the finish line first. The 2026 Biskupiec Grand Prix series consisted of four races.

description: The Grand Prix Dziewicza Góra Mountain Running Series consists of six races on a scenic route in the Zielonka Forest Landscape Park. The course follows a 5.15 km loop entirely through the forest, with two climbs to the summit of Dziewicza Góra. The races attract both recreational and experienced runners, bringing together a unique running community known as the “Dziewicza Family.”
course_highlights: A 5.15 km loop through the forest
Two climbs to the summit of Dziewicza Góra
Passes through the event center, where spectators can cheer on runners
additional: Electronic timing using an ankle-mounted CHIP. The race office is open from 8:15 to 10:30. Participant limit: 500. The event takes place as a series of six stages. Runners in the 10 km race complete two laps of the course. Children’s and youth races are held over 200 m, 500 m, 1,000 m, and 1,500 m. Registration at the race office is available until 10:00 only for adult races and the Nordic Walking event. The 2026–2027 edition program also includes children’s races. The organizer’s website states that registration for individual stages opens successively; a limited number of passes for the whole series are also available.

name: Mistrzowski Bieg
description: The Mistrzowski Bieg in Toruń is a 10 km race taking place on Sunday, February 28, 2027. It’s an excellent opportunity to test your fitness on a moderately challenging asphalt course. The organizers encourage participants to prepare using personalized training plans tailored to their running level, with expert support and detailed instructions. The event is open to runners of varying experience levels who want to take on the classic 10 km distance in the picturesque city of Toruń.
course_highlights: Moderately challenging asphalt course
10 km distance in central Toruń
Option to prepare with a personalized training plan
additional: Training plans of 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level and including daily expert support. The organizer offers a platform for managing the race listing and marketing collaboration. Runners can also work with a personal online running coach, with daily support and progress monitoring.

name: Łemkowyna Winter Trail
description: Łemkowyna Winter Trail is the winter edition of a mountain race through the picturesque Low Beskids, held at the end of February. The course passes through new corners of the region not featured in the autumn edition, with scenic ridges and unique places along the way. The race base is in Iwonicz-Zdrój, while the longest distances start in Jaśliska; transport is provided for participants. It’s a special opportunity to experience the beauty of the Low Beskids in a winter setting and enjoy unforgettable moments on the course.
course_highlights: Scenic ridges of the Low Beskids
Unusual places along the course
The course passes through new, winter corners of the region
additional: Race office and start of the shortest distance in Iwonicz-Zdrój. The 33 km and 50 km distances start in Jaśliska. Bus transport from Iwonicz-Zdrój to Jaśliska is provided in the morning on race day. Participants may switch between courses until 1 October 2027. Participant limits for individual courses range from 150 to 550. Technical briefing on the eve of the race in Iwonicz-Zdrój.

name: Trainingslauf Bottwartal-Marathon
location: Kreisverkehr bei Steppi, Steinheim an der Murr, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
distance_verbose: 51 km, Marathon, 32 km, 30 km, Halbmarathon, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km
description: The Bottwartal Marathon is a running event in one of the most beautiful landscapes in southern Germany, taking runners through gentle vineyard slopes, picturesque old towns, and lively crowds along the course. The route forms a loop through the southern and northern Bottwartal, with the start and finish at the Steppi roundabout in Steinheim an der Murr. Whether you’re a beginner or an ambitious runner, there’s a highlight for everyone. In addition to the marathon, the event includes a half marathon, marathon relay, ultra run, and other distances suitable for different age groups and ability levels.
course_highlights: A loop through the southern and northern Bottwartal, starting and finishing at the Steppi roundabout in Steinheim
The course passes through historic old towns including Steinheim, Murr, Gronau, Beilstein, Oberstenfeld, and Großbottwar
A flat finish with the opportunity to sprint to the line at the roundabout in Steinheim
additional: Race-bib pickup and late registration take place at Blankensteinhalle in Steinheim. Shuttle buses run from Riedstadion to the start area at the Steppi roundabout for the 10 km, 32 km, marathon, and ultra races. Half-marathon participants can take a bus from Steinheim to Gronau. The half-marathon starts in 4–5 waves, approximately 5 minutes apart. Parking is available at Wellarium and in surrounding areas. On race day, the Bottwartal is closed to through traffic over a wide area, and traffic around Riedstadion is restricted.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Leśny Park Kultury i Wypoczynku Myślęcinek, Bydgoszcz, Poland
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide cross-country running series over a distance of 5 km, held in picturesque forests and city parks. In Bydgoszcz, the course runs through Myślęcinek Forest Park of Culture and Recreation and the Żołędowo Forest District, giving participants the chance to compete on a permanent, proven route. The races are open to people aged 16 and over, and aim to promote running and outdoor physical activity. The start and finish are at Polana Różopole, and the organizers provide professional event support and a regular schedule.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through the wooded setting of Myślęcinek and the Żołędowo Forest District
Start and finish at Polana Różopole
The route is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. A group warm-up with CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place before the 10:45 start. Parking is not available at Polana Różopole; parking lots approximately 1–1.5 km from the start are recommended. In the 2026/2027 season, races in Bydgoszcz take place in Myślęcinek Forest Park of Culture and Recreation and the Żołędowo Forest District. Registration is available online through the Competitor Portal or at the race office on race day.

name: Tropem Wilczym
description: The Tropem Wilczym Run in Zalesie is an annual running event commemorating the Cursed Soldiers, Polish heroes of the anti-communist underground from 1944 to 1963. Organized by the Ryki Municipality, the World Association of Home Army Soldiers, and the biegusiem.pl group, the run offers two distances: 1963 meters and 5 kilometers. The run starts at 11:00, and participants can honor the soldiers by running along a scenic route near Zalesie. The event is open and welcoming to runners of different ages and ability levels.
course_highlights: Two distances to choose from: 1963 m and 5 km
Route near Zalesie, close to Ryki
A commemorative run honoring the Cursed Soldiers, with historical significance
additional: The run is organized by the Ryki Municipality, the Ryki branch of the World Association of Home Army Soldiers, named after Marian Bernaciak “Orlik,” and the biegusiem.pl group. The event is commemorative and patriotic in nature. A sample consent form for minors is available. Information about the run is published on its Facebook event page. Start and finish in Zalesie, close to Ryki.

name: Tropem Wilczym
organizer: Stowarzyszenie na Rzecz Sołectw Gminy Bytów w Mądrzechowie, Fundacja Wolność i Demokracja
description: The “Tropem Wilczym” Run and Nordic Walking event in Mądrzechowo is a local edition of the nationwide run commemorating the Cursed Soldiers. Choose between two distances: 1963 m and 5 km. Both can be run or walked with poles. The 1963 m distance refers to the year Józef Franczak “Lalek” died. There is no timing or ranking, making this an event for the whole family.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Recreation and Sports Square on Sportowców Street in Mądrzechowo
Distances of 1963 m and 5 km, for running or Nordic walking
No timing or age categories
additional: The limit is 200 participants across both distances. The race package includes a T-shirt, bag, medal, and post-race meal.

name: Bieg Niezłomnych
description: The Major Zenon Wechmann Indomitable Run has been held in Luboń since 2017 and was called “Tropem Wilczym” until 2024. The event takes place in Majoński Woods. Adults can choose a run or Nordic walking over approximately 5 km, or a run over approximately 2 km. Shorter races of 200 to 800 m are available for children. The 10th edition will take place in 2027.
course_highlights: Course in Majoński Woods in Luboń
Run or Nordic walking over approximately 5 km
Run over approximately 2 km and children’s races from 200 to 800 m
additional: The organizer publishes current information on the event’s fan page.

name: Bieg Pamięci Żołnierzy Wyklętych
location: Stadion Miejski, ul. Sportowa 3, Kamieńsk, Poland
organizer: Gmina Kamieńsk i Stowarzyszenie Aktywni Kamieńsk
description: The Bieg Tropem Wilczym is an annual sporting and patriotic event commemorating the Cursed Soldiers, held in Kamieńsk. The race starts at the Municipal Stadium at 3 Sportowa Street. The event brings families together and offers an opportunity to pay tribute to KWP soldiers who fought for Poland’s independence. Before the start, at 14:30, a ceremony is held to lay flowers and light candles at the monument to Stanisław Sojczyński, known by the codename Warszyc. The race is scheduled to start at 15:00.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Municipal Stadium in Kamieńsk
Patriotic race commemorating the Cursed Soldiers
Pre-race ceremony at the monument to Stanisław Sojczyński, known by the codename Warszyc
additional: The race is limited to 100 participants. The event is organized jointly with the Aktywni Kamieńsk Association. At 14:30, flowers are laid and candles lit at the monument before the race start. In 2026, the start is scheduled for 15:00; beforehand, a ceremony was held to lay flowers and light candles at the monument to Stanisław Sojczyński, known by the codename Warszyc.

name: Biegi Hrabiego
location: Kosina, Łańcut County, Podkarpackie Voivodeship, Poland
description: Biegi Hrabiego is a series of mountain races held in the scenic surroundings of Kosina and Łańcut. Participants can choose from various distances, from 10 km to over 70 km, running along well-marked hiking trails with numerous aid stations. The courses feature varied elevation gain and beautiful views, and the organizers provide transport to the start and professional timing. This event is for runners looking for adventure and a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Courses follow well-marked hiking trails
Beautiful views and varied elevation gain of approximately 290 m to 664 m
Several aid stations along the course, with food in sealed packaging
additional: Participants are transported by bus from the MOSiR car park to the start of each race. Mandatory equipment includes a race bib, timing chip, a charged phone with the coordinator’s number, a cup or bottle for drinks (no disposable cups at aid stations), a bottle or soft flask with a minimum capacity of 0.5 l, and an NRC emergency blanket. The participant limit for most distances is 140. Time limits depend on the distance, for example, 4 hours for 20 km, 6 hours for 35 km, and 8 hours for 50 km. Participants in Mały Panicza are transported by bus to the start; the meeting point is the MOSiR car park, one hour before the start. Participants must bring their own cup or bottle and a race bib with a timing chip; there will be no disposable cups at the aid stations.

name: I Uliczny Bieg i Marsz Pamięci Żołnierzy...
Kołobrzeska Odysea
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Nadmorscy Biegacze oraz Seaside Park Hotel Kołobrzeg
description: Kołobrzeska Odysea is a new running series in Kołobrzeg, bringing together three races held by the Baltic Sea over the course of a year. Participants can take part in a half marathon, a marathon or a 10 km race, earning three unique medals that form a single design. The event offers not only sporting excitement, but also beautiful coastal views and a unique atmosphere. The organizers provide full sanitary facilities, professional timekeeping, attractive prizes and refreshments for finishers. Kołobrzeska Odysea is for runners who appreciate sport and the atmosphere of a seaside town.
course_highlights: Half marathon along the Baltic coast — 21.0975 km
Marathon or 10 km race — 42.195 km or 10 km
Beautiful coastal views of Kołobrzeg
additional: Participants receive three unique medals that form a single design. After the races, a finisher zone offers a hot meal, snacks, isotonic drinks and water. An awards gala with a quiz and prizes is held at Seaside Park Hotel. Full sanitary facilities are provided, including baggage storage, changing rooms, showers and toilets. Special discounts are available for stays at Seaside Park Hotel during the event. The organizers promise professional timekeeping, food and drinks in the finisher zone, prizes and a gala at Seaside Park Hotel.

name: Prusice biegają
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Kultury i Sportu w Prusicach
description: Prusice Biegają is a series of races organized by the Municipal Cultural and Sports Centre in Prusice, bringing together residents of all ages—from the youngest to adults. In the 14th edition, runners compete across four stages of the overall standings and receive a medal at the end for completing the entire series. Children can take part in the special “Prusice Biegają od Małego” category, combining sporting fun with their first race-day excitement and a medal at the finish. The event is about more than running: it also offers shared cheering and a great atmosphere in Prusice.
course_highlights: Four stages in the overall standings
Special category for the youngest participants: “Prusice Biegają od Małego”
Medal for completing the entire series
additional: The event has a family-friendly atmosphere and encourages participation with family and friends. It is about more than competition, with shared cheering and a friendly atmosphere. Participants who complete the entire series and children in the younger category receive medals. In the previous edition, medals were planned for completing the entire series, including for children.

name: Sielska Piątka
description: Sielska Piątka is a 5 km race held in Lublin. The event is part of the wide range of running events organized by the Sports Development Foundation in Lublin, which promotes physical activity and social integration through sport. The race takes place in the picturesque setting of the Lublin Village Museum, allowing participants to enjoy both sporting competition and the beauty of their surroundings. It’s a great opportunity for runners of all abilities to test themselves and experience the spirit of the running community.
course_highlights: 5 km distance
The course runs through the grounds of the Lublin Village Museum
Picturesque, peaceful surroundings ideal for recreation
additional: The race is organized by the Sports Development Foundation in Lublin, which has promoted physical culture and the development of sport in the Lublin region since 2011. Lublin is one of Poland’s most running-friendly cities, and Sielska Piątka is one of many races held there. The race starts at 09:00.

name: Sopocki Bieg Inki
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Sopocie (MOSiR)
description: The Sopot “Inka” Run commemorates Danuta Siedzikówna, known as “Inka.” It is organized by the Sopot Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre under the patronage of the Mayor of Sopot. The event is held as part of the observances of the National Remembrance Day for the “Cursed Soldiers” and is symbolic, with no timekeeping. Participants complete a running distance of their choice, and each receives a commemorative medal. After the run, participants sing soldiers’ songs together and enjoy food from a field kitchen, creating a special atmosphere of remembrance and fellowship.
course_highlights: A run commemorating Danuta Siedzikówna, known as “Inka”
No timekeeping—the tribute is more important than the result
Group singing of soldiers’ songs and food from a field kitchen
additional: The run is not timed. Each participant receives a commemorative medal. After the run, there is group singing of soldiers’ songs and food served from a field kitchen. In previous editions, participants received a commemorative medal, followed by group singing of soldiers’ songs and food from a field kitchen.

name: VIII Tropem Wilczym
location: Altana Miejska, osiedle Bór, Skarżysko-Kamienna, Poland
description: The 8th Skarżysko edition of the nationwide Tropem Wilczym Run is an annual sporting event held on the first Sunday in March in Skarżysko-Kamienna. The run pays tribute to the Indomitable Soldiers and combines sporting competition with a patriotic message. Participants meet at the Municipal Gazebo in the Bór housing estate to honor the memory of these heroes together.
course_highlights: The run takes place in the urban setting of the Bór housing estate
A patriotic event commemorating the Indomitable Soldiers
Organized by the local associations Aktywisko and Kultura Sportu
additional: The run takes place from 08:30 to 13:15. The organizers are the Aktywisko and Kultura Sportu associations. The event has a patriotic and educational character, combining sport with remembrance of history.

name: XIV Bieg Pamięci Żołnierzy Wyklętych
description: The “Tropem Wilczym” Run in Memory of the Cursed Soldiers is a running event held in Kluczbork, combining physical activity with commemorating the Cursed Soldiers. The 14th edition was announced at the Provincial Training Center. The running calendar lists a distance of 10 km, but the event date is approximate.
course_highlights: 10 km distance according to the running calendar
Location at the Provincial Training Center
A run commemorating the Cursed Soldiers as part of the “Tropem Wilczym” initiative

name: XIV Bieg Tropem Wilczym
location: MOSiR przy Parku Miejskim, ul. Parkowa, Lubartów, Poland
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Lubartowie oraz Stowarzyszenie „Aktywny Lubartów”
description: The Tropem Wilczym Run is an annual sports and educational event commemorating the Cursed Soldiers, held since 2013. In 2027, its 15th edition will bring together sport, history, and local communities across Poland and beyond. A distinctive feature of the event is the symbolic distance of 1,963 metres, referring to the year Józef Franczak, known by the alias “Lalek,” died. The event is open to everyone, regardless of age or running experience. Many locations also organise additional races, Nordic Walking marches, and family activities.
course_highlights: A symbolic 1,963-metre distance commemorating the year Józef Franczak, known by the alias “Lalek,” died
An event combining sport with historical education and local involvement
Additional races, Nordic Walking marches, and family activities in many locations
additional: The event takes place on 28 February 2027. Local organisers decide on the scale of the event, additional distances, and accompanying activities. A separate edition of the “Tropem Wilczym at School” project takes place in schools on 1 March 2027. It is free and aimed at students. Previous editions have featured history meetings, historical reenactment groups, exhibitions, and family activities. In the 14th edition, the start and finish were on Parkowa Street, at the MOSiR grounds by the Municipal Park. The 1,963-metre commemorative run was free in the 2026 edition.

name: Bolechowo na Sportowo # 73
location: Bolechowo, Czerwonak, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Centrum Rozwoju Kultury Fizycznej AKWEN w Czerwonaku
description: Bolechowo Na Sportowo, or Active Czerwonak at Night #73, is a free sporting event held in Bolechowo. It is an active gathering for the local community, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in a friendly atmosphere. The event takes place in the evening and is part of a series of gatherings organized by the Centre for the Development of Physical Culture in Czerwonak. It’s a great opportunity to spend time together outdoors and connect with others.
course_highlights: Choose between 5 km and 10 km distances
An evening edition of the Active Czerwonak at Night series
Located in Bolechowo
additional: The event is free and takes place from 19:30 to 22:00. This is the 73rd edition of the Active Czerwonak at Night gathering. The event is part of the Grand Prix of Czerwonak series. No information is available about participant limits, start waves, or fees.

name: KoKaIno nr 34 Tysiącznik (2) Północny
description: KoKaIno No. 34 Tysiącznik (2) Północny is a 10 km night race taking place in Częstochowa. It is a moderately challenging road course, ideal for runners looking for a challenge in a nighttime atmosphere. Participants can use training plans tailored to different ability levels, allowing them to prepare optimally for the start. The event is part of Poland’s night-race calendar, attracting runners from across the country.
course_highlights: Moderately challenging road course
10 km night race
Held in Częstochowa, Silesian Voivodeship
additional: Training plans of 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level and accompanied by training instructions and expert support. The date in the available calendar is marked as tentative and listed as 6 March 2027, the day after the date given for the event.

name: Ludgeřovická 15
description: Ludgeřovická 15 je běžecký závod v Ludgeřovicích s hlavní tratí dlouhou 15 km. Součástí programu bývá také kratší běh na 3 km, patnáctikilometrový závod pro chodce a dětský běh na 500 m. Závod je součástí Prajzsko-opavské běžecké ligy a Moravskoslezského běžeckého poháru.
course_highlights: Patnáctikilometrová trasa vede převážně Černým lesem.
Trať míjí vojenské bunkry.
Povrch trasy tvoří přibližně 90 % silnice a 10 % trailu.
additional: Program zahrnuje také dětský běh na 500 m a závod pro chodce na 15 km.

name: Festiwal Biegowy Ultra Zadek
location: Szkoła Podstawowa nr 3, osiedle Azoty, Kędzierzyn-Koźle, Poland
description: The Ultra Zadek Running Festival is an event organized by Fabryka Aktywności XYZ in Kędzierzyn-Koźle, combining a passion for running with an active lifestyle. The event takes place in the city’s industrial surroundings, promoting a variety of distances and forms of running. Ultra Zadek is part of a wider running series that engages the local community and runners from the region, offering unique experiences on routes with varied surfaces. The organizers emphasize community, sporting competition, and a great atmosphere.
course_highlights: Routes with varied surfaces, including gravel sections
The races take place in the industrial area of Kędzierzyn-Koźle
The event is part of a running festival featuring different distances and forms of activity
additional: The event description lists a limit of 400 places. In the previous edition covered in a report, the start and finish were at Primary School No. 3 in the Azoty housing estate.

description: The Dziewicza Góra Grand Prix Mountain Running series takes place in the Puszcza Zielonka Landscape Park and promotes physical activity and environmental protection. The event is run on a 5.15 km loop, with 5 km and 10 km races and a Nordic Walking event. Children’s and youth races cover distances from 200 to 1,500 metres. The event brings together runners of different ages and abilities in a scenic forest setting, with two climbs to the summit of Dziewicza Góra.
course_highlights: A 5.15 km loop entirely through the forest
Two climbs to the summit of Dziewicza Góra, the highest point in the Puszcza Zielonka Landscape Park
The route passes through the event village, where spectators can cheer on the runners
additional: The race office is open from 8:15 to 10:30 in the building of the Łopuchówko Forest District Education Centre. The participant limit is 500. Races are held over various distances, including children’s races from 200 to 1,500 m. Participants in the 10 km race complete two laps. After runners emerge from the forest, the finish area is marked with a finish balloon, with separate lanes for runners finishing the race and those continuing for a second lap. Children’s race entries are online only. Adult race entries are also available at the race office until 10:00 on race day, subject to remaining race packs. The series also includes Nordic Walking and races for children and youth.

description: Trail!ON Stawiguda is a series of four 5 km trail races held monthly on the same scenic route near the forests and the Łyna River, close to Ruś. Winter weather is no obstacle to staying active: the crisp air and forest trails create a unique atmosphere for running. It’s a great opportunity to check your fitness regularly, enjoy the excitement of competition, and spend time outdoors. The organizers make things comfortable for participants, offering passes for the entire series as well as the option to enter a single race.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through the beautiful forests of Ruś
Start and finish on the beach at a bend in the Łyna River in Stawiguda municipality
Varied forest terrain and natural winter conditions
additional: Children’s Mini Trail!ON races cover distances from 300 m to 1,000 m, depending on age. You can buy a pass for all four races or enter a single race. Single-race entries can be purchased at the race office on race day. At the final race, winners will be presented with awards, followed by a bonfire with the Mayor. The bib number issued with a series pass is the same for the entire series and must be brought to every race. The main race is scheduled to start at 11:00. The program also includes children’s races over short distances; online registration is open until March 3, 2027, at 23:59.

name: Warta Challenge
location: Łysy Młyn forest parking, Biedrusko, Poland
organizer: SPORT CHALLENGE Fundacja Wspierania Aktywności Fizycznej
description: WARTA CHALLENGE is a winter running series consisting of four events, as well as Nordic Walking events, held on forest tracks and trails in the Warta River forests. The events offer half-marathon (21.3 km) and marathon (42.6 km) distances, along with a half-marathon-distance Nordic Walking event. The route mainly follows the blue cycling trail along the Warta River, with sections on forest paths and a short stretch of asphalt. It has a natural cross-country character, with potentially slippery and uneven sections. The start and race office are located by the Łysy Młyn forest car park, by Lake Łyse in Biedrusko. The race start is scheduled for 10:00.
course_highlights: The half-marathon route is one 21.3 km loop; the marathon is two loops.
The route mainly follows the blue cycling trail along the Warta River, as well as forest tracks and paths.
The route is cross-country, with potentially slippery and uneven sections due to leaves, puddles and mud.
additional: Race packs can be collected at the race office on race day from 7:45 to 9:30. The marathon and half-marathon routes are not officially certified. In the 2026/2027 winter season, each race has a theme, with suggested outfits and themed accents. Additional races and Nordic Walking events are also held over 5 km and 10 km distances. The start and finish are by the Łysy Młyn forest car park at 4 Poznańska Street in Biedrusko. The start is scheduled for 10:00. The race office and start/finish are by the Łysy Młyn forest car park, beside Lake Łyse; free parking and bus access are available. Race packs can be collected on race day from 7:45 to 9:30.

name: IX Chwaszczyńska 10
location: Szkoła Podstawowa im. A. Mickiewicza, Chwaszczyno, Poland
organizer: Kaszubskie Stowarzyszenie Kultury Fizycznej, Fundacja Aktywne Kaszuby oraz Sołectwo Chwaszczyno
description: The IX Chwaszczyńska 10 is a 10 km race and the prologue to the Kaszuby Biegają series. The event takes place in Chwaszczyno. In 2026, due to snowy conditions, the course was changed to a temporary 5 km loop with a hard surface of asphalt and jombo slabs. The event also includes shorter-distance races for children and young people, which are free and do not require advance registration. After the main races, the winners’ awards ceremony and a prize draw take place. The organizers prioritize participants’ safety and comfort, adapting the course to current conditions.
course_highlights: The 10 km course consists of two laps of a 5 km loop
Hard surface: asphalt and jombo slabs
Additional races for children and young people over 100 m, 300 m and 600 m
additional: The race office and baggage storage open at 08:30 in the sports hall. The children’s races start at the blue inflatable arch. A post-race recovery snack is provided after the 10 km race. The winners’ awards ceremony takes place at 12:40 in the sports hall. The prize draw is at 13:10; participants must be present with their race number. The limit for race packages for the main races has been reached, and registration is closed. Previous editions also included 5 km races and children’s races.

name: Letecká stovka
description: Letecká Stovka is a mountain ultramarathon and long-distance hike covering 106 km with +3,590 m of elevation gain. It takes place in the Považský Inovec and Strážovské vrchy mountains. The start and finish are in Trenčín, and the route runs mainly along marked hiking trails. It is ITRA-certified. The event is part of the Slovak Ultratrail League and is also a qualifying race for the 2028 Western States Endurance Run. It is organized by o.z. SLOVAK ULTRA TRAIL, an ITRA member since 2015. The race is open to individuals aged 18 and over; participants aged 17 may also take part if accompanied by a legal guardian.

name: Úpická desítka
description: Úpická desítka je tradiční silniční běh na 10 km, který se koná v Úpici. Trať je přesně změřená, rovinatá a vede po asfaltové silnici z centra města směrem na Havlovice do Ratibořického údolí a zpět. Závod je vhodný pro širokou veřejnost včetně dorostenců, kteří mohou startovat po schválení ředitelem závodu. Po závodě probíhá vyhlášení výsledků v Městském sále v Úpici s finančními cenami pro nejlepší v kategoriích dospělých.
course_highlights: Přesně změřená trať 10 km
Rovinatá asfaltová silnice
Start i cíl před Městským sálem v Úpici
additional: Dětské kategorie startují bez startovného a přihlašují se pouze na místě. Dorostenci (ročníky 2009-2010) mohou startovat na hlavním závodě po schválení ředitelem. Prezentace probíhá do 12:00 hod pro děti a do 12:30 hod pro dorost a dospělé. Vyhlášení výsledků je v 15:00 v Městském sále v Úpici. Závod se řídí pravidly atletiky a silničního provozu, účast je na vlastní nebezpečí. Registrace je možná online i na místě, závod se koná za příznivých podmínek na asfaltové silnici, jsou zde kategorie pro děti i dospělé, vítězové v kategoriích obdrží ceny.

name: Lauf 38. Winterlaufserie
description: The 38th Winter Race Series “Rund um den Haugnisberg” takes place at Jakob-Vogt-Stadion in Ochtendung and is a long-standing classic in the running scene in the Mayen-Koblenz district. The series comprises four races over the winter months, on a varied course across tarmac and forest trails in the Eifel foothills. Distances of 4 and 8.1 kilometres are offered, along with a 4-km walking category for Nordic walkers and walkers. The races start and finish at the stadium, which has changing rooms and showers. The series is scored based on three of the four races, with prizes for category winners and certificates for participants who take part in three races.
course_highlights: A loop over tarmac and forest trails through the Eifel foothills
Start and finish at Jakob-Vogt-Stadion, with changing rooms and showers
A series of four winter races, with three races counting towards the overall standings
additional: The series has four dates: 6 December 2026, 3 January 2027, 7 February 2027 and 7 March 2027. The youngest participants race over 400 metres (Bambini) or 1,400 metres. Registration is via an external website. Participation is open from age 2, with different minimum and maximum age limits depending on the category. The start and finish are at Jakob-Vogt-Stadion on Schillerstraße. Changing rooms and showers are available at the stadium. Three of the four races count towards the series standings.
