name: XIV Grand Prix Krakowa
organizer: Grand Prix Krakowa w Biegach Górskich
description: The Kraków Mountain Running Grand Prix is a series of mountain races held in Kraków, offering a range of distances from 3.7 km to 23.2 km, as well as a Vertical race. The event attracts runners of varying abilities, including children and seniors, and also offers team and additional classifications. The courses feature varied terrain, encouraging runners to try them outside the race season as well. This is the 15th anniversary edition, combining sporting competition with the beauty of Kraków’s natural areas.
course_highlights: Race distances: 3.7 km, 5.7 km, 11.6 km, 23.2 km, and a 1.5 km Vertical
Varied mountain-running terrain in Kraków
Special races for children, plus team and additional classifications
additional: The entry limit for each race is 100 people per distance. Discounts are available for children, young people under 18, and seniors aged 65+. The series includes team classifications, a uniformed services competition, relays, and special passes for 5 races. Races start at various times on Sundays, with the first start at 09:00.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata za pojedynczy bieg uiszczona najpóźniej do środy poprzedzającej start

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Karnet na cały cykl w jednym mieście (4 imprezy) można wykupić najpóźniej do środy przed drugim biegiem

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in seven locations, including the Tricity, on Spokojna Street in Gdynia. The races take place in forests and urban parks, combining a city atmosphere with contact with nature. The series includes four races in each location, and participants can compete in the overall and local standings. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, and also offers races for children and young people.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through forests and urban parks
Location in the Gdańsk Forest District and around the Mały Kack estate in Gdynia
Races take place in the natural setting of the Tricity Landscape Park
additional: The race office opens at 8:30, and race bibs and chips can be collected on race day. The schedule includes the main race starting at 11:00 and CITY TRAIL Junior races for children in different age categories. A pass for the entire series also includes one free race in a city other than the main location, provided participants notify the organizers by email in advance. Register online at citytrail.pl/zapisy or on race day at the race office. The race starts at 11:00.

name: 12 Nocna Recordowa Piątka
description: Nocna Recordowa Piątka is a 5 km race held after dark in Poznań. The fast course encourages runners to chase a personal best, while the evening setting and city lights give the event a special atmosphere. It’s a great option for both ambitious recreational runners and experienced athletes.
course_highlights: 5 km distance
A fast course suited to achieving a good time
A race after dark amid Poznań’s illuminated cityscape
additional: The event takes place in the evening.

name: 3 Krakowski Bieg Kobiet
location: Plac Wielkiej Armii Napoleona, Kraków, Poland
description: The Kraków Women’s Run is an annual running event dedicated to women, held in central Kraków since 2024. Participants can choose between two distances, 5 km and 10 km, along scenic routes near Plac Wielkiej Armii Napoleona and Wawel Castle. The race promotes women’s solidarity and physical activity, providing participants with race shirts and commemorative medals. The event attracts an increasing number of runners, creating a unique atmosphere of sporting competition and support.
course_highlights: The route runs through central Kraków near Plac Wielkiej Armii Napoleona and Wawel Castle
Two distances to choose from: 5 km and 10 km
Scenic urban surroundings with historic views
additional: The start and finish are on ul. Podzamcze, next to Plac Wielkiej Armii Napoleona. In addition to the overall rankings, age categories and a “Team Mother - Daughter” ranking for pairs running the 5 km are planned. Each participant receives a race shirt and a commemorative medal after completing the race within the time limit. Details of the 2027 edition have not been provided in the available sources.

name: Bieg Kobiet
organizer: Ruchowa Akademia Zdrowia w Szczecinie oraz RAZ Event
description: SANPROBI Women’s Run is an annual sporting event held in Szczecin, dedicated to active women and girls. The race follows a scenic route through Kasprowicza Park, with the start and finish on Jasne Błonia. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle, physical activity and women’s strength, while bringing participants together in an atmosphere of joy and support. It includes a 5 km main race, a Nordic walking event and mini-races for younger participants. The organizers provide a varied program of activities, partner zones and attractions for the whole family.
course_highlights: The main race follows two 2.5 km loops along the paths of Kasprowicza Park
Start and finish on Jasne Błonia, a beautiful green area in Szczecin
No time limit for the 5 km distance; Nordic walking is also available
additional: Mini-races for girls up to 11 years old over 200 m and 1 km. The limit for mini-race participants is 300; once this limit is reached, registration is possible only at the race office (limit of 20 bib numbers). Official race shirts are available for both races. There is no time limit for the main race. The race and Nordic walking routes follow the paths of Kasprowicza Park. The 2026 edition offered a 5 km race, 5 km Nordic Walking and mini-races. The organizer announced that registration for the next edition would open on December 12, 2026, at 12:00.

name: I Bieg Charytatywny
price_range: 20–70 zł online; 30–80 zł w dniu wydarzenia
description: The 1st Damian Wieczorek Charity Run is a running event in Będzin featuring a half marathon, a 10 km race, and runs and Nordic walking events for children and families. The event is open to all, with overall classifications for women and men in the 21 km and 10 km races, and for the 10 km Nordic walking event. The main half marathon is scheduled to start at 10:00, and the event aims to provide charitable support. It is a great opportunity to spend time actively and help those in need.
course_highlights: Main half marathon: 21 km
Additional race: 10 km
Nordic walking: 10 km, plus family runs: 2.3 km
additional: The races and walks start in waves: the half marathon at 10:00, the 10 km race and Nordic walking at 10:30, and the children’s and family run and Nordic walking at 11:00. Overall OPEN classifications for women and men are offered for the 21 km and 10 km races, and for the 10 km Nordic walking event. In the 2026 edition, the half marathon started at 10:00, the 10 km race and Nordic walking at 10:30, and the family events at 11:00.

name: Legendarna Piątka Legendarna Dycha
description: The Legendary Five and Legendary Ten are exciting races organized as part of the Toruń Legends Trilogy, held in the picturesque Old Town Market Square in Toruń. The events combine professional organization with a friendly, family atmosphere, offering participants fast courses with nationwide reach. They are an excellent opportunity to take on the 5 km and 10 km distances while enjoying the beauty of Toruń’s Old Town and local attractions.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Old Town Market Square in Toruń
Fast and exciting 5 km and 10 km distances
The race takes place in the historic city center, with views of UNESCO-listed monuments
additional: Children’s races take place at every edition; in March, they are held alongside the main race. After that date, registration is possible only at the race office. The organizer provides professional service and a friendly atmosphere.

name: Piątka dla Kobiet
organizer: Miejskie Centrum Kultury i Sportu w Jaworznie
description: Piątka dla Kobiet is a special sporting event held to celebrate International Women's Day at OWR Sosina in Jaworzno. Participants can choose between a 5 km race with competitive and age-group classifications, or a 5 km Nordic walking event for those who prefer a recreational activity. The event is free and offers a great opportunity to celebrate Women's Day actively. The race is limited to 200 participants and the walk to 150. The race starts at 11:00, and the walk at 11:15.
course_highlights: 5 km race and Nordic walking event
Age-group classifications in the race: K16 (ages 16–35), K36 (ages 36–49), K50 (ages 50 and over)
Course at OWR Sosina in Jaworzno
additional: The race is limited to 200 participants, and the Nordic walking event to 150. Women over the age of 16 may take part in the race; younger participants must have parental consent. Schedule: 9:30 race office opens, 10:45 race office closes, 11:00 race starts, 11:15 walk starts, awards ceremony immediately after the race. In previous editions, the race was open to women over the age of 16.

name: Run4Her - Bieg nad Klimkówką
location: Czarna Chata LUXURY RESORT, Klimkówka, Poland
description: Run 4 Her by Lake Klimkówka is a new sporting initiative organised to mark International Women’s Day in the Low Beskids. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km distances, which follow scenic paths along the shore of Lake Klimkówka. The route is gentle, paved and marked, with minimal elevation gain, making it suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. After the race, participants receive a commemorative T-shirt and gifts, while attractive prizes and bonuses await the top finishers.
course_highlights: Paved route, 100% asphalt
Scenic paths along the shore of Lake Klimkówka
Gentle route profile with minimal elevation gain (15 m for 5 km, 30 m for 10 km)
additional: The race office is open from 9:00 to 10:45 at Czarna Chata LUXURY RESORT, Klimkówka 188. The race pack includes a clothing bag for the baggage storage area, vouchers for a hot meal and tea, electronic and manual timekeeping, medical cover, a commemorative T-shirt from the Ropa Municipality, and a gift from the Uście Gorlickie Municipality. Prizes for the top finishers include bonuses in the form of stays at Czarna Chata, spa vouchers, and magnetic electrostimulation treatments. The organisers will also hold a raffle for prizes, including the grand prize: a weekend stay for 2 people at Czarna Chata with breakfast, worth 2500 PLN. The previous edition took place at Czarna Chata LUXURY RESORT and also included children’s races. It was a charity event; a concert by the band Krucabanda was scheduled after the race.

name: XRUN Tajemnicze Kopce
description: XRUN Mysterious Hills is a mountain trail race held in the scenic Glichowiec Range near Dobczyce. Participants can choose from several distances, from short children’s races to the demanding 32 km Long Trail with 1,100 m of elevation gain. The route passes through dense forests, technical climbs, ravines and winding forest trails, with the finish in Dobczyce at Hotel Dobczyce. It’s a great opportunity to experience the spirit of XRUN and take on challenging natural terrain.
course_highlights: Mountain route through the Glichowiec Range, with technical climbs and descents
Route passes through Kacza Góra, Trupielec and Glichowiec
Finish in Dobczyce, passing through the Old Town and over the Dobczyce Dam
additional: Available distances: 32 km (6-hour time limit), 21 km (4-hour time limit), 14 km (4-hour time limit), 6 km (2-hour time limit), and children’s races from 150 to 1,000 m. The start and finish locations for the main distances are in Kornatka and Dobczyce. Age categories for the children’s races range from 3 to 15 years. The routes partially overlap, and the longest distance involves completing the loop through the Glichowiec Range twice. The 32 km, 21 km and 14 km races start in Kornatka; their time limits are 6, 4 and 4 hours, respectively. The 6 km route has a 2-hour time limit. Children’s races from 150 to 1,000 m are also planned.

name: XVIII Bieg Kazików
description: The 18th Kaziki Run is an annual street-running celebration in Radom, attracting both amateur and experienced runners. The 10 km course runs through the city centre and offers a challenging race with a fast pace from the start. The event combines sport, community spirit and charitable initiatives, making it an important fixture in the region’s sporting calendar.
course_highlights: A 10 km course through central Radom
A fast-paced, challenging race from the first metres
A street race with a history and sporting tradition
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Radom City Hall, ul. Żeromskiego 53. The organisers provide race T-shirts and medals for participants. The event also includes races for children and young people, as well as charitable initiatives. It brings the community together and promotes outdoor physical activity.

name: Majcichovská desiatka
location: Majcichov Municipal Office, Majcichov, Trnava District, Slovakia

name: Pomerania Winter Trail
description: Pomerania Winter Trail is a winter trail race held in the picturesque area of Szemud. The course follows varied forest paths and natural terrain, offering runners a challenge and a chance to connect with nature. The event is part of the Pomerania Sports series, known for its professional organization and friendly atmosphere. It is a great opportunity for trail running enthusiasts to test their endurance in winter conditions.
course_highlights: Forest paths and natural terrain
Winter running conditions
Picturesque area of Szemud

name: ČEZ RunTour Winter Edition – Olomouc
distance_verbose: Půlmaraton, 10 km, 5 km, 3000 meter, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: ČEZ RunTour Winter Edition v Olomouci je zimní běžecký závod vhodný pro hobíky i elitní běžce s tratěmi 3, 5, 10 a 21,1 km a dětskými běhy na 500 a 1000 m. Závod nabízí rodinnou atmosféru, krásné kovové medaile a zázemí ve vyhřátých pavilonech. Běžecký den je doplněn doprovodným programem, rozhovory a aktivitami pro celou rodinu. Organizátoři se starají o perfektní servis včetně zdravotnické podpory a vodičského týmu, který pomáhá běžcům dosáhnout cílového času.
course_highlights: Tratě 3, 5, 10 a 21,1 km v zimním prostředí Olomouce
Dětské běhy na tratích 500 a 1000 m
Zázemí ve vyhřátých pavilonech s občerstvením a doprovodným programem
additional: Závodníci mají k dispozici vodičský tým s vlaječkami, zdravotnickou podporu a speciální telefonní linku během závodu. Na trase jsou občerstvovací stanice, počet a umístění závisí na délce tratě. Pro děti je připraveno občerstvení v cíli. Po závodě je možnost rytí výsledného času do kovové medaile a tradiční tombola s hodnotnými cenami. Zázemí nabízí vyhřívané pavilony, šatny a úschovnu. Účastníci mohou využít vyhřívané zázemí na Výstavišti Flora Olomouc v pavilonech G a H. Součástí dne je běžecký servis a doprovodný program; závodníci obdrží kovovou medaili.

name: Deset jarních kilometrů
description: Jarní běžecký závod v Kunčině u Moravské Třebové, 11. ročník. Hlavní závod na 10 km po zvlněné trati (z 95 % asfalt, 400 m zpevněná prašná cesta), hobby závod na 3,8 km a dětské závody na 40–919 m. Závod je součástí Iscarex poháru.
additional:
Starty: děti od 13:00, hobby 15:00, hlavní závod 15:05.
Prezentace: děti 11:30–12:30, 10 km a hobby 12:00–14:00.
Startovné předem / na místě: 10 km 250 / 350 Kč, hobby 150 / 250 Kč, děti 50 / 100 Kč.
Prémie 1 000 Kč pro nejrychlejšího muže (pod 35 min) a ženu (pod 40 min), 2 000 Kč za rekord trati. Soutěž o nejlepšího vrchaře a sprintera přes Stravu.
Doprava vlakem do stanice Kunčina. Online registrace na desetjarnichkm.cz (přihlašování spouštíme začátkem listopadu).

Start závodu Deset jarních kilometrů s běžci připravenými ke startu pod nafukovacím obloukem
Děti s čísly na hrudi připravené na start běžeckého závodu na trávě
Dva běžci s medailemi a dárkovými taškami slaví po závodě.

distance_verbose: 20 km, 15 km, 13 km, 10 km, 3000 Meter, 2 km

name: Seriencross in Erkner - Offener Seriencross MOL
IV Ultra Kocioł
description: IV Ultra Kocioł is an ultramarathon in Świdwin, previously held as the Ultramarathon Along the Świdwin Kocioł Trail. In the previous edition, participants covered 60 km through the area around the Świdwin Kocioł in the central part of Western Pomerania. The race combines a long distance with a historical theme.
course_highlights: A 60 km ultramarathon course, according to information about the previous edition
A race in the area around the Świdwin Kocioł
Świdwin and the central part of Western Pomerania

name: XIV Zimowy Bieg Dębowy
location: Zespół Szkół, ul. Sportowa, Dąbrowa, Gmina Dąbrowa, Poland
description: The Winter Oak Run is an annual sporting event held since 2012. It attracts an ever-growing number of participants and is an important sporting event in Mogilno County. The race promotes physical activity among people of all ages and is part of the Mogilno County Crown series. The main race route passes through the villages of Dąbrowa, Parlin and Parlinek, and runs on asphalt certified by the Polish Athletics Association. The organizers warmly invite everyone to take part and celebrate their passion for sport together.
course_highlights: Route certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA)
Asphalt surface with markers every kilometer
Water stations along the route in Parlin and Parlinek
additional: The start and finish are by the school sports field of the School Complex in Dąbrowa, ul. Sportowa. The event includes children's races over distances from 60 m to 1,000 m and a 7.5 km Nordic walking event. Electronic timing. Awards ceremonies and prize drawings take place in the sports hall in Dąbrowa. The race office is open from 07:00; registration closes at 10:45. The start and finish are by the School Complex sports field on ul. Sportowa; the race office is in the sports hall. The race pack includes, among other things, a medal, a hot meal and an SMS with the result. Registration is open until 3 March 2027; there is no race-day registration or fee.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Boisko w Lesie Osobowickim, Wrocław, Poland
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in beautiful woodland settings in city parks. The Wrocław event takes place in Osobowicki Forest, with the start and finish located by the sports field. The races are open to runners of different ages and ability levels, promoting outdoor physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The series is held regularly, and participants can compete in both local and national rankings. The course remains unchanged, allowing runners to compare their results over the years.
course_highlights: A 5 km course in the woodland setting of Osobowicki Forest
Start and finish by the sports field in Osobowicki Forest
A course suitable for both beginners and experienced runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. The main race is open to participants aged 16 and over. It is not possible to drive directly to the start or race office; parking is available along Osobowicka Street, with traffic management in place. CITY TRAIL Junior races over shorter distances also take place on race day. A group warm-up before the main race starts at 10:45. The event follows a fixed schedule, and the race office remains in the same location throughout the season. The start is scheduled for 11:00. Registration is available online at citytrail.pl/zapisy or at the race office on race day. Driving near the start and race office is not possible; parking is available along Osobowicka Street.

name: 1 Gibko Piątka
description: Gibko Piątka is a fast 5 km race on a PZLA-certified course, held in Frydek, Miedźna Municipality. The course is flat with minimal elevation gain, making it ideal both for beginner runners and for those looking to improve their personal best. The event also includes the Wartki Bajtel race for children and young people up to 16 years old, divided into three age groups, offering competition suited to their level and plenty of fun. The event attracts hundreds of runners and is a great opportunity for sporting competition and a good time.
course_highlights: PZLA-certified 5 km course
Flat, fast course with minimal elevation gain
Course ideal for a personal best
additional: The event includes the Wartki Bajtel race for children and young people up to 16 years old, divided into three age groups (ages 3–6, 7–10, and 11–16). The awards ceremony is planned for after the race, and the race office is on site. The course is certified by the Polish Athletics Association. Registration is open until race day.

name: 42 Strzeliński Rogaining
location: Kuropatnik, Strzelin County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Polskie Towarzystwo Turystyczno-Krajoznawcze Oddział Ziemi Strzelińskiej
description: Strzeliński Rogaining is a foot-based orienteering event in which teams of 2–5 plan their own routes to visit as many checkpoints as possible within a set time. The checkpoints are spread across the terrain and marked on a map. The event is open to participants of different ages and experience levels, from enthusiasts to recreational participants. Rogaining combines tourism and sport and is an excellent way to enjoy an active day outdoors. Organized by the Polish Tourist and Sightseeing Society, Strzelin District Branch, it has a long tradition and is popular with orienteering enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Teams travel on foot only, using a map and compass to navigate the terrain
Checkpoints have different point values depending on how difficult they are to find
Participants can choose and change their own route of any length, from around 5 km to 70 km
additional: Teams consist of 2–5 people. Each team independently decides which checkpoints to visit and in what order. Rogaining is open to all age groups and genders. The event combines tourism and sport and is also appealing to families. Night rogaining events have also been held in the past. Checkpoints have different values depending on their difficulty. Information about the participation fee is not available in the provided sources.

name: Baran Trail Races
organizer: Michał Loska, Piotr Winter, MWC sp. z o.o. i Gmina Węgierska Górka
description: Baran Trail Race is a mountain race taking place on March 13, 2027, in Węgierska Górka. Runners can choose from several distances, including 10 km, 25 km, and 60 km, featuring significant elevation gain and challenging mountain terrain in the Silesian Beskids. The 10 km course is a loop with numerous climbs and descents, following scenic trails, including a section of the Main Beskid Trail. The race is officially scored in the ITRA and UTMB systems, highlighting its sporting nature and endurance challenge.
course_highlights: The 10 km course is an 11-kilometer loop with around 550 m of elevation gain
A section of the course follows the Main Beskid Trail (red trail)
Varied terrain: narrow, muddy trails, paved descents, and scenic sections
additional: There are no aid stations on the 10 km course. The intermediate cutoff for the 25 km race is 5 hours and is located at the hall in Węgierska Górka. Mandatory equipment includes, among other items, a switched-on, fully charged phone with emergency numbers and the organizer’s number saved, a visible race number, and a chip attached to the shoe. There are no disposable cups at the aid stations. Navigation using the latest GPX file is recommended; supplementary course markings are permitted in accordance with the regulations. BTR 25 is a UTMB Index 20K category and awards 1 ITRA point; BTR 60 is a UTMB Index 50K category and awards 3 ITRA points. BTR 60 has an intermediate cutoff of 5 hours at the 25th kilometer. The organizer recommends using the latest GPX file for navigation.

name: Bieg Liczby Pi
description: The Pi Number Run is a 10 km race held in Kraków. Participants can prepare for the start using training plans tailored to different ability levels, with detailed instructions and expert support. The event is a great opportunity to test your fitness on the city streets and join a running community. The organizers encourage professional management of race information and marketing cooperation.
course_highlights: 10 km road race
Moderately difficult course
Training plans tailored to VDOT levels available to help you prepare
additional: Training plans of 8 to 20 weeks are available, with instructions and expert support. You can manage the race listing and arrange marketing cooperation on the organizer’s platform.

name: III Beskidzkie Grónie Zima
description: Beskidzkie Grónie Zima is a winter mountain race held in the picturesque town of Istebna. Participants can choose from three routes of different lengths: Rodzinna 15 km, Beskidzkie Grónie 30 km, and Beskidzkie Grónie 50 km. The routes wind through the varied mountain terrain of the Beskids, offering both challenging trails and beautiful views. The event is part of the Beskidzkie Grónie series and is growing in popularity among mountain running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: The routes cross the varied mountain terrain of the Beskids
Three distances available: 15 km, 30 km, and 50 km
Picturesque views and natural winter trail conditions
additional: The routes are available to download in GPX format. The event is available in the UTRA app, which provides easy access to event information. It includes three distances of varying difficulty to suit runners of different experience levels. This is a mountain hiking event, not a race. The family route has an elevation gain of approximately 410 m and a time limit of 7 hours.

name: IX Cross Maraton Jana Kulbaczyńskiego
description: The 9th Jan Kulbaczyński Cross Marathon is a marathon held in picturesque Kodeń, in the Masovian Voivodeship. The event takes place on Sunday, March 14, 2027, and offers an excellent opportunity to test your fitness on a moderately difficult course. The organizers provide training plans tailored to different experience levels, helping participants prepare optimally for the start. The event is part of the TreningBiegacza.pl running calendar, which promotes running and athletic development.
course_highlights: A marathon course measuring 42.195 km
A moderately difficult cross-country run
Picturesque landscapes of Kodeń and the surrounding area
additional: The organizers offer training plans lasting 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to runners’ VDOT levels, with instructions and expert support. You can manage the race listing and arrange marketing cooperation through the TreningBiegacza.pl platform.

name: Ladies & Gentlemen

price_tiers.distance: Bieg 5 km i 10 km oraz Nordic Walking 5 km

description: The Ladies & Gentlemen Run 2026 will take place on March 14 in Kabaty Forest in Warsaw as part of the Warsaw Grand Prix. This running event gives participants the opportunity to compete over different distances, with age and gender categories. The race office is located in Kabaty, and the different distances will start at different times. The organizer provides a race pack, a commemorative medal, and prizes for the top finishers and oldest participants.
course_highlights: Routes in Kabaty Forest—natural forest paths
5 km and 10 km races, plus 5 km Nordic walking
Time limits: 60 minutes for the 5 km run and 80 minutes for the 10 km run
additional: The race office opens at 09:00 in the clearing next to the Kabaty Metro Technical Depot. Race bibs will be distributed only on race day. A special trophy will be awarded to the oldest male and female participants, along with recognition for the funniest outfit. Prizes will be awarded in the overall standings and age categories, separately for women and men. 120 participants took part in the race.

name: Mistrzostwa Polski Masters w Biegach Prz...
description: The Polish Masters Cross Country Championships are national championships for masters runners, held in the scenic Rudelka Park in Toruń. The event brings together experienced runners in various age categories, offering competition on challenging cross-country courses. It is an excellent opportunity for sporting camaraderie and to test your abilities in a natural setting.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in Rudelka Park
Varied natural terrain
Scenic park surroundings in Toruń
additional: Contact and organizational matters are handled through the registration form on the contact page, enabling quick contact with the organizer and system administrator. Online registration is open until 4 March 2027 at 23:59; the rules also allow registration at the race office on event day from 9:00.

name: Odlotowa 5 - Olsztyn Mazury
description: Odlotowa 5 - Olsztyn Mazury is a 5 km race held in the scenic area around Olsztyn-Mazury Airport in Szymany. The event takes place annually and attracts runners from different age categories, offering a friendly atmosphere and professional organization. The course is fast and accessible to runners of varying ability levels. Participants can expect efficient service and the option to collect their race packs on race day or the day before.
course_highlights: 5 km course
Start and finish at Olsztyn-Mazury Airport in Szymany
Fast, flat course conducive to good results
additional: Authorization is required to collect a race pack, and parental consent is required for minors. Olsztyn-Mazury Airport co-organized the 2026 edition. Sources for this edition stated a limit of 600 participants and a time limit of 60 minutes for the 5 km distance.

name: Run in Sopot - III
location: Entrance No. 23, Sopot Pier, Sopot, Poland
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Sopocie
price_range: 49 zł; 40 zł z Kartą Sopocką; osoby w wieku 65 lat i starsze bez opłaty
description: Run in Sopot III is a 5 km beach run held on a scenic route along the Sopot pier. The start and finish are on the beach by the pier, and participants run on sand, making the race a unique and appealing event for lovers of coastal scenery. The event is limited to 250 participants, and the start is scheduled for 10:00. The race is held regularly, and the organizers mark and secure the route.
course_highlights: The route runs along the beach by the Sopot pier
The start and finish are on the beach by the pier
A 5 km distance on sand
additional: The participant limit is 250. People over 65 may take part free of charge. Only runners wearing race bibs and race organizers may be on the route. Runners must assemble in the designated start zone.

name: Test Coopera - wiosna
description: The Cooper Test is a recurring race organized by the Mafia Team Sports Club in Lubliniec. The event is amateur and recreational in nature, promoting health, fun, and sport in the spirit of fair play. The race lasts 12 minutes, during which participants measure their physical endurance. The event is part of a local running series and has a long tradition, attracting strong interest among runners from the region.
course_highlights: A 12-minute timed run (Cooper Test)
Held in Lubliniec, in an urban and park setting
An amateur event promoting health and recreation
additional: The Mafia Team Sports Club promotes health, fun, and sport as its core values. No information is available about entry fees or the start time. The club’s contact details are available on its contact page, but no email address is provided. Results from previous editions are available on the website. Results from earlier editions are available on the organizer’s website.

name: Zimowy Bieg Trasą Mokrzyny
location: Nowy Tomyśl, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Kobeřická dvacítka
location: TJ Sokol Kobeřice sports ground, Kobeřice, Moravian-Silesian Region, Česko
description: Kobeřická dvacítka je tradiční atletický běh pořádaný TJ Sokol Kobeřice, který má dlouholetou historii sahající až do roku 1982. Závod se koná v areálu hřiště TJ Sokol Kobeřice v Moravskoslezském kraji a je součástí série Kobeřických běhů, které zahrnují i půlmaraton a zimní běh. Tento závod je určen pro širokou veřejnost včetně mládeže i dospělých a je známý svou přátelskou atmosférou a podporou atletického oddílu zaměřeného na rozvoj běžeckých talentů. Pořadatelé kladou důraz na tradici a sportovní hodnoty, které jsou součástí místní běžecké komunity.
course_highlights: Silniční tratě vedou po mírně členitém okruhu v okolí Kobeřic.
Na výběr jsou vzdálenosti 20, 10 a 6 km.
Dětské a mládežnické běhy se konají v okolí hřiště TJ Sokol Kobeřice.
additional: Kobeřická dvacítka je součástí tří veřejných závodů pořádaných TJ Sokol Kobeřice, které jsou určeny jak pro mládež, tak pro dospělé. Atletický oddíl se zaměřuje na rozvoj mladých běžců a má za sebou řadu úspěšných sportovců včetně maratónců. Závody se konají v areálu hřiště TJ Sokol Kobeřice, který je centrem místní atletické činnosti. Závod je součástí Prajzsko-opavské běžecké ligy (POBL).

name: Königsforst Marathon
description: One of Germany’s six oldest marathons. With 17 small start groups from 08:45 to 14:00. With prizes for course and age-group records. With a single entry fee for all three distances, so you can switch distances at any time at no extra cost. With a reforestation initiative to offset the environmental impact of travel. With a DLV-certified course through nature.
additional:
The course:
The loop through the Königsforst includes several sections of the original 1973 course. The website has a dynamic GPX map of the course and an option to download the GPX file.

The course has only two longer, steeper climbs:

From km 3 to km 4, the route climbs 28 m to “Monte Troodelöh” (Cologne’s highest point). It then descends to the first aid station at km 5.
After km 15, at the “Wassertretstelle” (water-treading pool), you climb 40 m over a distance of 630 m. The third aid station comes shortly afterwards.

You reach the highest point shortly after the third aid station. From here, the route is flat along the path of the former railway line back to Bensberg. In the final kilometre, it leaves the forest after the underpass. 400 m before the finish, turn right and head up Schloßfeldweg.

Drei Läufer auf einem Waldweg beim Königsforst Marathon im Gelände

Ellwanger Sparkassen - Lauf in den Frühling
23 Recordowa Dziesiątka
description: Recordowa Dziesiątka is a 10 km race in Poznań, previously known as Maniacka Dziesiątka and held since 2005. The organizers promote it as the fastest 10 km race in Poland, and the course has no hills. The 23rd edition will take place in 2027. The day before, the Nocna Recordowa Piątka 5 km race is held.
course_highlights: Flat course with no hills
10 km distance
The Nocna Recordowa Piątka 5 km race takes place the evening before

name: BeMore5K
description: BeMore5K is a unique 5 km race held in Bemowo, Warsaw. Its fast, certified course is ideal for setting a personal best and combines high-level competition with the joy of running. The event attracts both experienced runners and people just starting out, offering attractive prizes, cheering zones, and professional photo and video coverage. The race takes place in an atmosphere of community and motivation, encouraging participants to push their limits and draw inspiration from others’ achievements.
course_highlights: Fast, PZLA-certified 5 km course
Start and finish on the westbound carriageway of Powstańców Śląskich, beyond Górczewska
The course follows Powstańców Śląskich and Radiowa streets, with a turnaround near the Stare Bemowo stop
additional: Participant limit: 3,000 race packages. You can change your T-shirt size after logging in to b4sportonline.pl. The start and finish area is close to the metro line. Open 5 km Championships in age categories every 5 years. Race time limit: 12:00; winners’ awards ceremony at 12:15. Race office and race-package pickup at the Bemowo District Office on March 14 (14:00–20:00) and March 15 (09:00–10:30). Side event: sports EXPO and cheering zone. The official website lists the date as March 7, 2027, which differs from the March 14, 2027 date given in the race metadata.

name: Bieg Dnia Kobiet
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Orzyszu
price_range: Udział bezpłatny; pamiątkowa koszulka za 30 zł (edycja 2026)
description: The Women’s Day Run in Orzysz is an open, recreational event over a symbolic distance of 2.5 km. In the 2026 edition, participants started and finished at Ogródek Jordanowski, and the route followed sidewalks and unpaved roads. The run was a community event with no final rankings. Participants received a commemorative medal at the finish.
course_highlights: Symbolic distance of 2.5 km
Start and finish at Ogródek Jordanowski in Orzysz
The route follows sidewalks and unpaved roads
additional: There are no final rankings. Distance and route information is from the 2026 edition.

name: Cross Śrem Grand Prix

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 40 zł – przy zapisie online na jeden bieg

description: Cross Śrem Grand Prix is a series of cross-country races held in woodland near the Orlik sports field in Psarskie, Śrem. The approximately 5.4 km course runs along forest paths and paved paths, offering runners a chance to enjoy nature and a unique atmosphere of sporting competition. The start and finish are in the same location, making it easier to organise the event and cheer on the runners. Participants receive a medal, a recovery meal and prizes in the age-group categories. The race is organised by Śremski Sport together with the Municipality of Śrem and the Konstantynowo Forest District.
course_highlights: An approximately 5.4 km course along forest paths and paved paths
Start and finish at the Orlik sports field in Psarskie—a single location for the convenience of runners and spectators
A race through woodland close to the centre of Śrem
additional: The race office, warm-up and official opening take place at the Orlik sports field in Psarskie. The warm-up and opening are scheduled for around 11:45. Participants have access to water, hot tea and coffee in the new building with changing rooms. The start and finish are at the Orlik sports field in Psarskie.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Zajazd Szmaragd, ul. Kopalniana, Szczecin, Poland
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in the beautiful forest setting beside Lake Szmaragdowe in Szczecin. The varied course includes several uphill and downhill sections, making the race appealing to both beginners and experienced runners. The races are part of a series that promotes outdoor physical activity and allows participants to compete on the same course throughout the season. The start and finish are by Zajazd Szmaragd, and the race office is located next to the start.
course_highlights: A 5 km course in the forest setting beside Lake Szmaragdowe
Varied uphill and downhill sections, including the most difficult stretch about 1.7 km from the start
The start and finish are located behind Zajazd Szmaragd on Kopalniana Street
additional: The race office opens at 8:30, and the main race starts at 11:00. Before the race, there is a group warm-up with the CITY TRAIL Ambassadors. The series consists of 7 locations, with 4 races at each, and includes overall and local standings. Participants must be at least 16 years old or, if younger, have parental consent. The organizer lists the Szczecin dates for the 2026/2027 season as October 18, November 15, January 10, and April 4; March 14 is listed on the calendar for Katowice. CITY TRAIL Junior races accompany the main race.

name: Herbatka u Tadka #334
description: Tea with Tadek, or the Run to the Tea House, is a social running event held in Bródno Park in Warsaw. The event has an intimate atmosphere and brings together running enthusiasts who want to spend time actively outdoors. The run takes place in the park’s picturesque surroundings, making it ideal for recreation and socializing.
course_highlights: The course runs through Bródno Park in Warsaw
Picturesque, green surroundings ideal for recreation
An intimate, social event
additional: The run has a results and statistics page available to participants.

name: II Bieg Trzech Wież
description: The 2nd Three Towers Run in Biała is a unique sporting event held among the oldest historic landmarks in the Opole region. Following the success of the first edition, the organizers invite participants to another edition with new features, including children’s categories that bring generations together. Participants can choose from 5 km and 10 km runs, as well as 5 km Nordic walking. The race package includes a hot meal, a race pack, a recovery bar, drinks, sports merchandise, and a commemorative medal. Trophies and attractive prizes, including cash prizes, are planned for the top finishers.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km running routes in the historic surroundings of Biała
5 km Nordic walking
Children’s categories bringing different generations together
additional: The event takes place among the oldest historic landmarks in the Opole region. The children’s categories encourage whole families to take part. The 2026 edition’s program included races for children and young people; the package included, among other things, a commemorative medal, a hot meal, and drinks.

name: Krakoski Kros
description: Krakoskikros is a cross-country running event held on unpaved paths and clearings in Kraków’s parks. The competition is open to people of various ages, from children to adults, and does not require a PZLA licence or club membership. The event features a range of athletics competitions, including sprints, middle-distance races, long jump, softball throw, and relays. The competitions take place in green spaces and at the AKF stadium in Kraków, with age- and gender-based categories.
course_highlights: A course on unpaved paths and clearings
Competitions in green spaces and at the AKF stadium in Kraków
A range of athletics competitions for children and adults
additional: Categories are organised by age and gender for children, young people, and adults. The project is carried out with financial support from the Małopolska Voivodeship.

name: Międzyzdrojska Liga Biegowa
location: Wapnica, Międzyzdroje, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Międzyzdroje Running League is an annual, friendly, family-oriented sporting event that invites running and nordic walking enthusiasts to compete on courses of approximately 5 and 10 km for runners and 5 and 7 km for nordic walking participants. Participation is free, and participants can enjoy healthy competition in a fun atmosphere on the beautiful routes of the Międzyzdroje Municipality. To be included in the overall standings, participants must complete the required distances in at least four events. Both regulars and newcomers are welcome to run and walk together.
course_highlights: Running routes of approximately 5 and 10 km
Nordic walking routes of approximately 5 and 7 km
Beautiful routes in the Międzyzdroje Municipality
additional: Participants must be at least 14 years old. Minors may participate with written consent from a parent or guardian and under their supervision. To be ranked in the league, participants must enter at least four events and complete the required distances: two 5 km and two 10 km races, or two 5 km and two 7 km nordic walking events. The league is known for healthy competition in a friendly, family atmosphere full of smiles and fun. The official schedule lists the March round in Wapnica on 21 March 2027, not 14 March. To qualify for the overall standings, participants must complete at least four events; the minimum age is 14.

name: Murowana Goślina Półmaraton
organizer: Centrum Kultury i Sportu w Murowanej Goślinie
description: The Murowana Goślina Half Marathon is a historic race dating back to 1978. Initially organized for masters athletes, it is now open to everyone who wants to take on the half-marathon distance of 21.097 km. The race has a rich tradition and runs through the scenic surroundings of Murowana Goślina. After a break caused by the coronavirus pandemic, the race was revived in 2025 by the Centre for Culture and Sport in Murowana Goślina.
course_highlights: A classic half-marathon distance of 21.097 km
Scenic surroundings of Murowana Goślina
A tradition dating back to 1978, with a history of races for masters athletes
additional: The race is open to everyone, not just masters athletes. Entry fees increase across three registration periods, and registration is also available at the race office for a higher fee. The half-marathon has a long tradition and has been organized intermittently since 1978. The event is part of the Grand Prix series. The entry fees listed on the website are 99 zł, 119 zł, or 139 zł for the successive registration periods, and 200 zł at the race office.

name: Półmaraton i Piątka Raduni
location: Centrum Kultury i Sportu, ul. Chopina 34, Pruszcz Gdański, Poland
description: The Pruszcz Gdański Half Marathon and the Piątka nad Radunią are annual running events held in Pruszcz Gdański. Both race courses are certified by the PZLA, and the start and finish are located at the Centre for Culture and Sport. Runners start in time zones based on their declared finish time, making for a more comfortable race. After the races, there are award ceremonies and a prize draw, creating a friendly atmosphere for participants.
course_highlights: PZLA-certified half-marathon and 5 km courses
Start and finish at the Centre for Culture and Sport in Pruszcz Gdański
Start divided into time zones based on declared finish times
additional: The start takes place in front of the Centre for Culture and Sport building, with runners divided into time zones based on their declared finish time (red, blue and yellow). The race office is in the Centre for Culture and Sport’s glass-enclosed terrace; bag drop and changing rooms are inside the building. Parking is on the stadium grounds, with access from Bora-Komorowskiego Street. Award ceremonies and the prize draw take place after the races. In previous editions, the start, finish and race office were at the Centre for Culture and Sport, ul. Chopina 34. The courses were certified by the PZLA.

name: Wrocławska Trzydziestka
distance_verbose: 30 km, 25 km, 20 km, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km
description: Wrocławska Trzydziestka is a training run to prepare for a marathon, organized by the Pro-Run Wrocław Association. Participants can choose distances from 5 to 30 km, completed on a 5 km loop. The route runs along gravel and cobblestone surfaces, with the start and finish at the Olympic Stadium in Wrocław. The run promotes running and physical activity among Wrocław residents, as well as showcasing the city’s running routes.
course_highlights: A 5 km loop with gravel and cobblestone surfaces
Start and finish at the Olympic Stadium, al. Paderewskiego 35
One hydration and refreshment station on the route, approximately every 5 km
additional: The time limit for completing the route is 4 hours. Times are recorded using chips attached to the race bibs; these are required for participants to be officially classified. The race office opens at 8:00 on race day. The route is a 5 km loop, and participants can choose a distance of 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, or 30 km. In previous editions, the start was at 9:00, the time limit was 4 hours, and a hydration and refreshment station was located approximately every 5 km.

name: X Zimowe Grand Prix Zadyszki
location: ul. Kamieniec, near the animal shelter, Oświęcim, Poland
description: The 10th Zadyszka Winter Grand Prix is a series of races organized by the Oświęcim Running Club “Zadyszka,” which promotes running as a form of recreation and a healthy lifestyle. The event takes place in the scenic area around Kamieniec Street, near the animal shelter in Oświęcim. The club welcomes runners of all ability levels to take part together, enjoy the sporting atmosphere, and connect with the local running community. The events have a friendly atmosphere and offer a chance to spend time actively outdoors.
course_highlights: The route runs around Kamieniec Street, near the animal shelter in Oświęcim
The races take place in a winter setting, adding a distinctive character
The event brings the local running community together and promotes a healthy lifestyle
additional: The club holds meetings on the first Wednesday of every month at 17:00 at MOSiR, 15 Legionów Street, Oświęcim. The events are open to runners of all ability levels. The club maintains an events calendar and actively communicates through social media. The website does not provide details about start waves, participant limits, or entry fees. In the previous edition, registration was available only on race day, and the start was scheduled for 11:00.

name: XI Myślenicki Bieg Uliczny
location: Stadion KS Dalin Myślenice im. Gustawa Grochala, Myślenice, Poland
organizer: KS Dalin Myślenice – Sekcja Biegowa i Miasto i Gmina Myślenice
description: The Myślenice Street Run is a 10 km race held on the streets of Myślenice. A total of 389 runners took part in the 11th edition. The event is organised by the KS Dalin Myślenice running community in cooperation with the City and Municipality of Myślenice.
course_highlights: A 10 km road course in Myślenice
The start and finish are associated with the Gustaw Grochal KS Dalin Myślenice Stadium
The race is organised as part of a local running event

name: Łódzkie Biegi Górskie
location: Szkoła Podstawowa nr 61, ul. Okólna 183, Łódź, Poland
description: Łódź Mountain Runs is a series of cross-country mountain races held in Łagiewnicki Forest over distances of 6.6 km, 10.5 km and 14.4 km, with elevation gains of 140, 220 and 300 metres, respectively. The races are organised by the “Orientuś” Student Sports Club and take place at Primary School No. 61 in Łódź. Each participant receives a cast medal and a meal at every stage. Competitors race in the junior and OPEN categories. The series promotes physical activity and sporting competition in scenic woodland.
course_highlights: Routes in Modrzew Forest measuring 6.6 km, 10.5 km and 14.4 km
Elevation gains of 140 to 300 metres on the running loops
Scenic woodland routes with multiple loops (two or three laps)
additional: A free stage is available when registering for the entire series. The overall standings are based on 4 of the 5 stages. Stage closing ceremonies start at 12:35, and gifts are handed out from 12:40. The race office is open from 9:30 on race day. Parking is limited near the race base; parking near the Shrine of St Anthony of Padua and other designated locations is recommended. Electronic timing is used, with a mass start. The fifth race in the series will take place on 14 March 2027 at 11:00. The race base is at Primary School No. 61, 183 Okólna Street. Entry fees for a single race are PLN 30 for juniors and PLN 55, 60 or 65 for the OPEN category, depending on the distance; a medal and a meal are provided at every stage.

name: 106 Vejvanovických
location: Hostinec na Křižovatce, Vejvanovice, Pardubický kraj, Česko
description: Závod 106 Vejvanovických je ultramaraton a týmový běžecký závod, který měří přibližně 106 km rozdělených do 6 úseků dlouhých 14 až 20 km. Závod vede z obce Vejvanovice do Železných hor a zpět. Účastníci mohou běžet jako jednotlivci v kategorii Ultra nebo v týmech od 2 do 6 běžců. Start ultramaratonu je v pátek 19. března 2027 o půlnoci, štafety startují následující den ráno v 5:00. Cíl je v obci Vejvanovice do 5:00 21. března 2027.
course_highlights: Trasa vede z Vejvanovic do Železných hor a zpět
Závod je rozdělen do 6 úseků dlouhých 14 až 20 km
Kontrola trasy probíhá pomocí GPS trackerů a navigace
additional: Startovní balíčky se vydávají v pátek 19.3.2027 od 20:00 do 23:30 v místě startu a obsahují startovní číslo a GPS čip. Maximální počet běžců v týmu je 6, maximální počet jednotlivců v kategorii Ultra je 20. Pořadatel zašle účastníkům trasu ve formátu GPX minimálně 5 dní před startem. Štafety jsou určené pro týmy o 2 - 6 běžcích. Trasa bude k dispozici ve formátu GPX a závod bude kontrolován pomocí GPS trackerů. U startu a cíle je zdarma parkování a sociální zařízení.

name: BackYard Ultra Warmia
location: Parking Leśny nad jeziorem Kielarskim, Polana Kielarska
description: BackYard Ultra Warmia is a backyard ultra held at Lake Kielarskie near Olsztyn. Every full hour runners start a 6706 m loop and must finish it before the next start. The last runner still going wins. The race has Bronze Ticket status in the international Backyard Ultra rankings, and the best Polish results in the format have been set here.
course_highlights: 6706 m loop around Lake Kielarskie
About 85% forest roads, gravel and trails, 15% paved surface
About 100 m of climbing per loop
additional: The start and finish of each loop, race office and aid station are at the forest car park by Lake Kielarskie. Runners must be 18 on race day. Online registration is open until 28 February 2027.

name: X Setka Komandosa
location: Ośrodek Harcerski, ul. Pusta, Lubliniec, Poland
description: The X Setka Komandosa is a 100 km ultramarathon held in challenging woodland conditions around Lubliniec. Runners complete the course in full field or training uniform, carrying a mandatory backpack weighing at least 10 kg. The race is part of the Komandos Grand Slam and promotes competition among uniformed services and awareness of service in special forces units. The start and finish are at the Scout Centre on Pusta Street in Lubliniec, and the time limit is 20 hours.
course_highlights: The 100 km course consists of five laps on forest roads
Full field or training uniform and tactical boots covering the ankles are required
A backpack measuring at least 45 × 30 cm and weighing at least 10 kg is mandatory
additional: The participant limit is 999. The race course consists of five laps on forest roads. Clothing and equipment requirements are strict, including a mandatory uniform, tactical boots, and a backpack weighing at least 10 kg. The race counts toward the Komandos Grand Slam. The “Setki Komandosa” badge can be ordered for an additional fee. The X edition took place in March 2026, with more than 1,000 participants.

name: Würzburger Gedächtnislauf
distance_verbose: 44 km, 28 km, Halbmarathon, 16 km, 10 km, 5 km

name: IKK Run Up 24. Freundschaftslauf TV Rußhütte
Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in the beautiful woodland setting by Lake Rusałka in Poznań. The races are open to runners of all abilities, from beginners to advanced athletes, who can regularly test themselves on the same course. The event is recreational and competitive in nature, promoting outdoor physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The start and finish are near Św. Wawrzyńca Street, and the course runs through picturesque woodland and the city beach. The races are part of the Grand Prix CITY TRAIL 2026/2027 series, which includes four races in Poznań, with an overall classification and a separate classification for each city.
course_highlights: A 5 km course in the woodland setting by Lake Rusałka
Start near Św. Wawrzyńca Street, with the finish by the city beach
The course is suitable for both beginner and advanced runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. A group warm-up with the CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place before the 10:45 start. The event follows a consistent schedule, and the race office remains in the same location throughout the season. Participants can choose charity packages supporting the Siepomaga Foundation. The event receives funding from the budget of the City of Poznań. The series also includes races for children.

name: Zimowe Biegi Górskie Falenica
location: Wydma Falenicka, Mazowiecki Park Krajobrazowy, Warszawa, Poland
description: The Falenica Winter Mountain Runs are an annual running event held on the Falenica dune in the Masovian Landscape Park in Warsaw. Participants can choose from three distances: 3.33 km, 6.66 km, or 10 km, which differ in the number of loops and elevation gain. The race office is located at Primary School No. 124 and is open from 9:00 to 10:30. The course is marked on the ground, and the event has a long tradition spanning many years.
course_highlights: Course on the Falenica dune
Distances: 3.33 km (1 loop), 6.66 km (2 loops), 10 km (3 loops)
Elevation gains of 85 m, 170 m, and 255 m, respectively
additional: The race office is open from 9:00 to 10:30 at Primary School No. 124, 45/47 Bartoszycka Street. In the event of epidemic restrictions, the office may operate outdoors near the start, without changing facilities. The race office is located at Primary School No. 124, 45/47 Bartoszycka Street, and is open from 9:00 to 10:30; if the school cannot be used, it may operate outdoors near the start.

name: 10 KonstantyNOVA Dycha by Night
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Mosinie
description: The 11th KonstantyNOVA DYCHA by NIGHT is a unique 10-kilometer race through the scenic areas of the Konstantynowo Forest District. In 2027, its night edition will be held for the second time, with runners taking on the 10 km distance after dark and required to wear headlamps or carry flashlights. Children’s and youth races take place during the day over shorter distances tailored to different age groups. The event is inclusive and charitable, with an opportunity to support a local association when collecting race packs.
course_highlights: The route passes through the scenic areas of the Konstantynowo Forest District
Night edition of the main 10 km race
Children’s and youth races over distances from 150 m to 1,000 m
additional: Children’s and youth races start at 16:30. Participants in the main race are required to have a headlamp or flashlight. When collecting race packs, participants can voluntarily support a local association by putting a donation in the collection box. The main race will take place on March 20, 2027; children’s and youth races are scheduled from 16:30. When collecting race packs, participants will be able to make a voluntary donation to support an association from the Municipality of Mosina.

name: 14 Luboń Track
location: Stadion Miejski w Luboniu, Luboń, Poland
description: The 15th Luboń Track is an athletics event held at the municipal stadium in Luboń. The event is scheduled to include races over 3000 m and 1609 m, as well as children’s races over shorter distances suited to participants’ ages. Races are divided into heats according to the times submitted at registration, with classifications by sex and age category. Timing is handled by PZLA judges, and each heat is limited to 15–20 participants. The detailed timetable will be published on the official Facebook fan page.
course_highlights: Races at the municipal stadium in Luboń
Starting heats divided according to times submitted at registration
Classifications by sex and age category
additional: Heats are assigned based on submitted times. Timing is handled by PZLA judges without photo-finish equipment. Children’s races are held in different age categories, with separate classifications by sex. The detailed timetable is published on the Facebook fan page two days before the event. Heats are assigned based on submitted times. The 1609 m and 3000 m races are for participants aged 13 and over.

name: 40 Kołobrzeska 15-stka Zaślubin
description: Kołobrzeska 15-stka Zaślubin is an annual 15 km race held in Kołobrzeg, commemorating Poland’s Wedding to the Sea and the end of the fighting for the city. Certified by the Polish Athletics Association, the course runs along scenic seaside promenades and city streets, offering participants beautiful views and sporting competition. The race has a rich tradition dating back to 1987 and attracts both experienced runners and those just starting out. The organizers provide a great atmosphere, support from partners and sponsors, and prizes for the top finishers.
course_highlights: Course certified by the Polish Athletics Association
Three laps: two longer laps of approximately 6.4 km each and one shorter lap of approximately 2.18 km
Scenic seaside promenades and Kołobrzeg streets with sea views
additional: The course consists of three laps: two longer laps and one shorter lap. The start and finish are by the IKAR and Perła Bałtyku sanatoriums. The race commemorates the 82nd anniversary of the end of the fighting for Kołobrzeg and Poland’s Wedding to the Sea. The organizers provide medical and recovery support for runners. The race is certified by the Polish Athletics Association. The 41st edition is scheduled to start on 20 March 2027 at 11:30. Registration is open; the rules and course information are also available. Holders of the Kołobrzeska Resident Card can receive discounts.

name: 8 Dycha z Górką
description: The 8th Dycha z Górką is a cross-country race organized by the Oborygeni Running Group in Oborniki Śląskie. The course consists of two five-kilometer laps over the hilly terrain known as “Grzybek.” The event takes place on Kasztanowa Street, with the start scheduled for the first day of spring, adding a special character to the race. It is a great opportunity to test your fitness on a challenging course in picturesque surroundings.
course_highlights: Cross-country race over the hilly terrain of “Grzybek”
Two five-kilometer laps
Start and finish on Kasztanowa Street in Oborniki Śląskie
additional: Ticketed entry. The race takes place from 10:00 to 13:00. Organizer: Oborygeni Running Group. Information about the course, start, and finish comes from the announcement for the 2026 edition.

name: Bieg Stolarza
description: The 7th Stolarz Run is an annual running event organized in Radomsko by the Radomsko Cycling and Running Sports Club. The race takes place on a route suited to runners, and timing is provided using a modern electronic system based on RFID chips. The race is scheduled to start at 16:00, and participants can expect professional organization and a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Running route in Radomsko
Electronic timing with RFID chips
High-quality organization by a local sports club
additional: Online registration closes the day before the race at 23:59. Timing is provided by Pomiar Czasu Atelier Sportu, which uses systems used at the world’s largest marathons. Telephone contact is available from 8:00 to 16:00 and on race day via the emergency number. In 2026, the event was accompanied by a picnic and a charity drive. The previous edition was scheduled to start at 16:00.

name: Bieg Wiosenny
description: The 13th Spring Run in TAURON Silesian Park is an annual running event held in Chorzów, in one of the largest urban parks in Europe. The route winds through the scenic grounds of Silesian Park, offering participants a chance to connect with nature and enjoy the unique atmosphere of a sporting celebration. The finish is at Superauto.pl Silesian Stadium. To mark the 13th edition, all participants whose race number contains the digit “13” will receive a gift. The event attracts both recreational and more experienced runners, encouraging people to spend time actively outdoors.
course_highlights: The route passes through more than 600 hectares of meadows, forests and gardens in Silesian Park
Finish at Superauto.pl Silesian Stadium
Scenic running paths in a unique urban oasis of greenery
additional: To mark the 13th edition, all participants whose race number contains the digit “13” will receive a gift. The route runs through Silesian Park, one of the largest urban parks in Europe, with diverse vegetation and landscapes. The start and finish are at Superauto.pl Silesian Stadium. In previous editions, the number of places was limited.

name: Mistrzostwa Gminy Kąty Wrocławskie w Bie...
description: The Mayor of Kąty Wrocławskie Cup is an annual running event held in Kąty Wrocławskie, attracting runners of different age groups and skill levels. The races take place on scenic routes around Krobielowice, giving participants the opportunity to compete and spend time outdoors. The event has a local character and provides an opportunity to bring the community together and promote a healthy lifestyle. The atmosphere is friendly and welcoming to both runners and spectators.

name: Ultramaraton Zielonogórski
description: The Zielonogórski Nowe Granice Ultramarathon is a unique running event held in the picturesque Piast Hills in Zielona Góra. As part of the anniversary edition, participants can choose between two distances: 13 km and a new, demanding 23 km course featuring technical sections, significant elevation gain and beautiful views. It’s an excellent choice for trail-running enthusiasts who want to experience a mountain atmosphere without leaving the city. The event has a welcoming atmosphere for both beginners and experienced runners, promising sporting excitement and unforgettable experiences.
course_highlights: The 13 km course features dynamic changes of pace, forest singletrack and challenging climbs
The new 23 km course has technical sections, numerous climbs and fast descents
Picturesque trails in the Piast Hills, with beautiful views and a natural trail-running character
additional: The Ultramarathon offers several running distances: 23 km, 48 km and 103 km, as well as a 103 km solo duathlon and a 103 km cycling race. The 48 km and 23 km courses start at checkpoints in Nowy Kisielin and Jarogniewice. The organizer provides professional catering during the event. GPX files of the routes are available to download.

name: VI Koleżeński Bieg Henryka Brauna
description: The 6th Henryk Braun Friendly Run is an annual running event held in Radzyny to commemorate Henryk Braun. It attracts both recreational and more experienced runners, offering a welcoming atmosphere and the chance to compete on scenic routes. The event brings people together and promotes an active lifestyle among residents and visitors. The organizers ensure smooth event operations and participant safety.
course_highlights: The route passes through the scenic areas of Radzyny
An event that brings people together and commemorates Henryk Braun
A welcoming atmosphere for both recreational and experienced runners

name: Wiosenny Ultra Świr
description: Wiosenny Ultra Świr is a mountain race run on a 15.5 km loop with 650 m of elevation gain. It starts at the Winter Sports Centre in Ptaszkowa, near Grybów. The route features a steep climb to the summit of Góra Jaworze (882 m above sea level), followed by a fast descent to a refreshment point in the valley. Within the time limit, runners can choose how many loops to complete, tailoring the distance to their abilities. The race combines a mountain challenge with a comfortable event base offering changing rooms, showers, a hot meal and a support area. Organizers provide B4Sport chip timing and course safety.
course_highlights: 15.5 km loop with 650 m of elevation gain
Steep climb to the summit of Góra Jaworze (882 m above sea level)
90% trails and gravel; 2 refreshment points per loop
additional: Ample parking by race headquarters. A comfortable base at the Winter Sports Centre in Ptaszkowa, with changing rooms, showers, hot water and lockable lockers. A hot recovery meal for every participant, including vegetarian options. A support area with space for a deck chair or tent for 12-hour and 24-hour teams. Mandatory kit must be checked off before packing your backpack. The time limit allows runners to choose how many loops to complete. A 17 km Nordic Walking event is also available. In the 6- and 12-hour races, refreshments are available after every loop.

name: Wiosna z kompasem
description: Spring with a Compass is a 10 km race held in Bobrowniki, Mazowieckie. It is an excellent opportunity to prepare for a spring race using training plans tailored to individual ability and VDOT. The organizers offer detailed training instructions and expert support, helping runners prepare optimally for the race. The event is aimed at runners looking for a challenge on a moderately difficult asphalt course.
course_highlights: Asphalt course
10 km distance
Intermediate level
additional: Training plans of 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to the runner’s ability and VDOT. Organizers can manage the race listing and collaborate on marketing. The date of March 21, 2027, shown in calendars is tentative; it has not been confirmed whether the event will take place.

name: XX Bieg Wiosny
organizer: Wydział Kultury i Sportu Urzędu Miasta Siemianowice Śląskie oraz Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji „Pszczelnik”
description: The XX Spring Run and Nordic Walking is an annual sporting event organized by the “Pszczelnik” Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Siemianowice Śląskie. Participants cover a 5.5-kilometre route along the paths of Pszczelnik Park, passing the Golf Course, Bażantarnia and Rzęsa Pond, with the finish in Pszczelnik Park. The event takes place in a friendly atmosphere, and every participant receives a sweet treat and a drink. Registration is accepted by email until March 18 and on race day at the Race Office.
course_highlights: 5.5 km route along the paths of Pszczelnik Park
Passes the Golf Course and Bażantarnia
Views of Rzęsa Pond
additional: Race registration is accepted by email until March 18 at 11:00, and after that in paper form at the Race Office on race day from 10:15 to 10:50. The route follows park paths amid natural scenery and recreational areas.

name: ALS charitatívny beh
description: ALS Charity Run – Ján Svočák Memorial is a charity running event taking place on March 20, 2027, at Penzión Koliba in Svit. It offers several disciplines, including children’s races, relays, Nordic Walking, and a challenging 21 km trail run with significant elevation gain. The course runs mainly through forest and meadow terrain and includes refreshment stations. It is ITRA-certified and offers a qualifying point. The event is organized by Športuj srdcom o.z. and is part of the 2027 charity running series.
course_highlights: 21 km trail with 950 m elevation gain; 80% forest, 20% meadow
3 × 1.7 km relay; surface: 60% forest, 34% meadow, 3% asphalt, 3% gravel
5.1 km Nordic Walking; surface: 90% forest, 10% asphalt
additional: A personal drinking cup is mandatory for all disciplines. The ALS 21 km course has two refreshment stations at the 8 km and 16 km marks. The relay consists of three 1.7 km legs, with the same start and finish at Penzión Koliba. Age categories vary by discipline. The best participants in each category will be awarded, and all participants will receive a medal or an award depending on the discipline. Starts take place at Penzión Koliba in Svit. A personal drinking cup is mandatory for several disciplines.

name: Gazdovská 50
organizer: Atletický oddiel TJ Tatran v spolupráci s mestom Krásno nad Kysucou
description: Gazdovská 50 is a challenging mountain ultra run in Krásno nad Kysucou, offering two courses: a 50 km ultramarathon with nearly 2,000 metres of elevation gain and a classic 42 km marathon with approximately 1,500 metres of elevation gain. The route passes through picturesque settlements and offers unique views of local landmarks such as the Bridge of Love and Friendship and the Surovina and Hladký vrch lookout towers. The event is organized by the TJ Tatran Athletics Club in cooperation with the town of Krásno nad Kysucou, with support from volunteers from hiking clubs and the fire brigade. Gazdovská 50 has the potential to become a traditional sporting event in the region.
course_highlights: Challenging mountain terrain with up to 2,000 metres of elevation gain
The route passes through picturesque settlements around Krásno
Views of the Bridge of Love and Friendship and the Surovina and Hladký vrch lookout towers
additional: The event is supported by volunteers from hiking clubs and the Krásno nad Kysucou Volunteer Fire Brigade. The course is challenging, but offers beautiful scenery and unique views.

name: Nitrianska 24 hodinovka – Memoriál Alexandra Bögiho
location: Atletický štadión TJ Stavbár Nitra, Nitra, Slovakia

name: Jarní desítka Kravaře
location: Sportovní areál Olšinky, Kravaře-Kouty, Kravaře, Česko
description: Jarní desítka Kravaře je silniční běžecký závod na 10 km se startem a cílem ve sportovním areálu Olšinky v Kravařích-Koutech. Převážně rovinatá trať vede po cyklostezce mezi poli a loukami, mimo běžný silniční provoz. Závod je součástí Prajzsko-opavské běžecké ligy.
course_highlights: Rovinatá cyklostezka otevřenou krajinou mezi poli a loukami.
Trať vede směrem na Kravaře a Zábřeh, s otočkou a smyčkou.
Přibližně 200 metrů trasy tvoří krosový úsek.
additional: Start i cíl jsou ve sportovním areálu Olšinky.

distance_verbose: 10 km, 9.3 km, 8.7 km, 7 km, 5 km, 3.6 km, 3000 Meter

name: Hamburger Halbmarathon durch das Alte Land
KÖZON21
location: Blackfoot Beach Köln / Burg Friedestrom Zons in Dormagen
description: On March 21, 2027, the inaugural Fühlingen–Zons Half Marathon gets underway. For the first time, a running event will connect Blackfoot Beach in Cologne-Fühlingen with the historic Zons customs fortress on a unique route along the Rhine.
additional: The start and finish are in different locations, and the route runs along the Rhine.

images.alt_text: Läufer vor Kölner Dom und Zons mit Datum und Halbmarathon-Text für KÖZON21 Laufveranstaltung

name: Trainingslauf Bottwartal-Marathon
location: Steppi/Kreisverkehr, Steinheim an der Murr, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
distance_verbose: 51 km, Marathon, 32 km, Halbmarathon, 10 km, 5 km
description: The Bottwartal Marathon training run offers a varied route through the picturesque Bottwartal, starting and finishing at the Steppi roundabout in Steinheim an der Murr. The route passes through idyllic old towns, along the Bottwar River and through vineyards, creating a unique atmosphere. The flat finish encourages a strong final sprint. The event is open to runners aged 18 and over and is part of a diverse running program in the Bottwartal.
course_highlights: Loop through the southern and northern Bottwartal, starting at the Steppi roundabout
Passage through historic old towns such as Steinheim, Murr, Gronau, Beilstein, Oberstenfeld and Großbottwar
Flat finish at the roundabout in Steinheim for a strong final sprint
additional: Bib pickup and late registration take place at Blankensteinhalle in Steinheim. Parking is available at Wellarium and in surrounding areas. Shuttle buses run from Riedstadion to the start at the Steppi roundabout. Half-marathon runners can take a bus transfer from Steinheim to Gronau. On the day of the event, large areas of the Bottwartal are closed, and traffic restrictions are in place.

name: Deggendorfer Halbmarathon mit 7km-, 4km- und 1km-Lauf
distance_verbose: 180 km, 90 km, Marathon, Halbmarathon, 5 km, 4 km, 3.8 km, 2 km

name: Dwumaraton Olęderski
description: The Olęder Double Marathon is a series of running events organized by the Chyży Nowy Tomyśl Running Club, held off-road on a 10.5 km loop. The event combines a social and sporting atmosphere and is open to both experienced runners and beginners. The races take place over several weekends from October to March, giving participants the chance to train through the challenging autumn and winter period. The minimum distance is one loop, while the full double marathon is 42.2 km or a multiple of the loop distance.
course_highlights: Off-road course on a 10.5 km loop
Option to run a marathon or a multiple of the loop distance
A series of races held over several weekends in different locations
additional: The races are held in accordance with the current restrictions in force on race day. The race office opens one hour before the start. The time limit for each race is 6 hours. The event is co-financed by Nowy Tomyśl County.

name: 14 Pabianicki Półmaraton Wszystko Gra
description: The 14th Pabianicki Półmaraton Wszystko Gra is one of the largest running events in the Pabianice region and will take place on March 21, 2027. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle, mass-participation running, and physical activity, as well as popularizing running as a form of recreation. The organizers promise a great atmosphere and professional organization, and participants can expect an official technical T-shirt. Registration is open, and the earlier you sign up, the lower the entry fee.
course_highlights: The half-marathon course runs through the city of Pabianice
The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and mass-participation running
Participants receive an official thermal technical T-shirt
additional: The official half-marathon T-shirt is a thermal technical shirt (95% polyester, 5% elastane, 135 g/m²), available in men's sizes S–XXXL for PLN 65. Registration and T-shirt purchases are made through an account on the registration website. The event also features the Pabianicki Półmaratonik, a 5 km race, a high-heels race, and the Bieg Januszów. The program also lists the high-heels race and the Bieg Januszów; an optional technical T-shirt is available for PLN 65.

location: Zamek Królewski na Wawelu, ul. Podzamcze, Kraków, Poland
