Startovné se podle dostupných informací platí při prezenci.

name: Běh Klobasnou
location: Stadium TJ Lokomotiva, Veselí nad Lužnicí, Česko
description: Běh Klobasnou je tradiční běžecký závod pořádaný atletickým klubem TJ Lokomotiva Veselí nad Lužnicí. Závod je určen pro širokou veřejnost včetně dětí i dospělých a nabízí různé kategorie a délky tratí. Start probíhá na stadionu TJ Lokomotiva ve Veselí nad Lužnicí a účastníci se mohou těšit na příjemnou atmosféru, ocenění nejlepších běžců a doprovodný program pro děti. Závod je součástí bohaté běžecké tradice v regionu Jihočeský kraj.
course_highlights: Start a cíl na stadionu TJ Lokomotiva Veselí nad Lužnicí
Kategorie pro všechny věkové skupiny od přípravky po dospělé
Krátké tratě pro děti probíhají přímo na stadionu
additional: Veselští atleti mají startovné zdarma. Pro děti je připraven nafukovací hrad a malování na obličej. V cíli je pro všechny účastníky dětských kategorií medaile a občerstvení. Parkování je možné ve sportovním areálu.

name: Nieder Erlenbacher Volkslauf
location: Nieder-Erlenbach, Frankfurt am Main, Hesse, Germany

distance_verbose: Halbmarathon, 9 km, 6 km, 3000 Meter, 2.7 km, 0.4 km

location: Lauf an der Pegnitz, Bavaria, Germany

name: 12 Półmaraton Grudziądz-Rulewo
organizer: Gmina Miasto Grudziądz, Miejski Ośrodek Rekreacji i Wypoczynku w Grudziądzu
description: The 12th Grudziądz-Rulewo Half Marathon in the Footsteps of Bronisław Malinowski is a race with a unique character, deeply rooted in the history of the city and the life of its namesake, Olympic champion Bronisław Malinowski. The course passes places connected with Bronisław’s life and training, starting at the Olimpia Grudziądz stadium, crossing the Bronisław Malinowski Bridge, and finishing at Hanza Pałac Hotel in Rulewo. The race combines a passion for sport with the memory of an outstanding athlete, offering participants an exciting experience and a sporting spirit that unites generations. The event takes place on the first weekend of May, and participants can look forward to a varied accompanying program and organizational support.
course_highlights: The course passes historic places connected with Bronisław Malinowski, including the Bronisław Malinowski Bridge in Grudziądz
Start at the Olimpia Grudziądz stadium; finish at Hanza Pałac Hotel in Rulewo
A course with varied surfaces, aid stations every 5 km, and markers every 1 km
additional: The race office is open on April 30 (16:00–20:00) at Marina Grudziądz and on May 1 (8:00–10:30) at the Olimpia stadium. The time limit for completing the course is 3 hours; the course closes at 14:00. There are at least 3 aid stations on the course (water, isotonic drink, fruit). After the race, participants receive a medal and diploma and can enjoy a recovery meal, massages from physiotherapists, and free MZK bus transport for runners. On race day, warm-ups are led by Fit House instructors. Children can take part in the accompanying “Be Like Bronek” races. Information for the 12th edition lists the race office at Marina Grudziądz and at the GKS Olimpia Stadium.

name: 42 Krapkowicki Bieg Uliczny
description: The Krapkowice Street Run is an annual running event held in Krapkowice, with a tradition dating back to the 1980s. The race is certified by the Polish Athletics Association and takes place on a new route through the city streets, starting and finishing at 3 Kilińskiego Street. The event attracts runners of different ages and abilities, offering an exciting atmosphere and the chance to compete on the streets of Krapkowice. The organizers provide a range of activities, including a spectator zone and contests for participants and spectators.
course_highlights: A 42 km street course certified by the Polish Athletics Association
Start and finish at 3 Kilińskiego Street in Krapkowice
The route passes along the city's main streets, including Opolska Street, 1 Maja Street, and Mickiewicza Street
additional: The organizers make the rules and entry forms available in PDF format. The website features photo galleries from previous editions and an archive of results. The event has a spectator zone with contests for spectators. The race route was recently changed and has official certification. The 42nd edition in 2026 took place over a distance of 10 km.

name: Botaniczna Piątka
description: Botaniczna Piątka is a series of cross-country races organized since 2014 by running enthusiasts who emphasize scenic and attractive routes. The spring edition in Mikołów takes place in the beautiful Botanical Garden, offering participants a unique experience surrounded by nature. The event promotes physical activity and running among people of different ages and ability levels.
course_highlights: Cross-country route in the Botanical Garden in Mikołów
Scenic and attractive natural surroundings
Races organized to promote running and physical activity
additional: The organizer is the Biegiem w Las Association. In summer 2026, Botaniczna Piątka will celebrate its 10th anniversary. The event places particular emphasis on the aesthetic qualities of its chosen locations and on cross-country races.

name: III Aleksandryjska Piątka po Lesie
location: Parking at the end of ul. Sosnowa, Aleksandria Druga, Poland
description: The 3rd Aleksandria Forest Five is a race organized by the Atelier Sport Association, held in the picturesque surroundings of Aleksandria Druga. The event is a 5 km forest run, starting at 11:00 from the parking lot at the end of Sosnowa Street. The organizers provide professional timing and a friendly atmosphere for runners of all experience levels.
course_highlights: A 5 km forest course
Start and finish at the parking lot on Sosnowa Street
Picturesque surroundings of Aleksandria Druga
additional: Timing is provided using a modern electronic system based on RFID chips and start/finish mats. The organizer provides telephone support from 8:00 to 16:00 and on race day via a dedicated number. The event is held under the patronage of the Atelier Sport Association. The time limit is 1 hour 30 minutes; the 5 km race is limited to 200 participants. The start and finish are at the parking lot at the end of Sosnowa Street in Aleksandria.

name: LENART XI Bieg Uliczny o Puchar Starosty Powiatu Kępińskiego
organizer: Powiat Kępiński, przy współudziale Stowarzyszenia Nasz Bezpieczny Powiat Kępiński oraz Spółdzielni Socjalnej Green Service
description: LENART 11th Street Race for the Kępno County Starosta’s Cup is an annual running event held in Kępno. The 10 km main race starts on Dąbrowskiego Street and includes OPEN, uniformed services, team, county championship, and disability categories. The organizers have provided cash prizes for the winners and special awards for the best athletes from Poland. The event also includes a Preschoolers’ Run, which starts before the main race. Registration for the main race is available via maratonypolskie.pl.
course_highlights: 10 km main race on the streets of Kępno
Categories: OPEN, uniformed services, team, county championship, and people with disabilities
Cash prizes for the winners and awards for the best athletes from Poland
additional: The Preschoolers’ Run has race-day registration from 9:00, with the start at 11:40. Awards for the best male and female athletes from Poland in the OPEN category. Organizers: Kępno County, Nasz Bezpieczny Powiat Kępiński Association, and Green Service Social Cooperative. The main race is scheduled to start at 12:00. Registration for the Preschoolers’ Run takes place on race day from 9:00, and its start is scheduled for 11:40. Sources for this edition give the date as May 1, not April 30, 2027.

name: Sianowska Dyszka
organizer: Fundacja Zastopuj Sportowiec.info oraz Gmina i Miasto Sianów

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Wpisowe to wśród dorosłych 40 zł do 02.12.2026 r.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Wpisowe wśród dzieci to 20 zł do 02.12.2026 r.

description: Sianowska Dyszka is a 10-kilometre race and part of a series of five races held in Sianów. The event promotes running as a natural form of physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, as well as the scenic running routes of the Sianów municipality. The races count towards the overall RUNking of Runners standings, which are summed up at the Runners’ Gala. The event is open to adults and children, with separate children’s races over shorter distances.
course_highlights: A 10 km race as part of the Sianowska Dyszka series
Scenic running routes in the Sianów municipality
Children’s races over distances from 100 to 1,000 metres
additional: Race packs can be collected from 9:30 to 10:45. Children’s races start between 11:00 and 11:30 over distances from 100 to 1,000 metres. A total of 120 medals have been prepared for participants. Prizes will be awarded to the three fastest women and men. Participants must register and verify their identity at the Race Office by presenting an identity document, and sign a declaration confirming that they are familiar with the regulations. Results from the Sianowska race series count towards the overall standings, which are summed up at the RUNking Runners’ Gala.

name: VIII Rydzewski przełaj - bieg dla trzeźw...
description: The VIII Rydzewski Cross-Country Run promotes a healthy lifestyle, sobriety, and running as a form of physical recreation. The event takes place on the sports field in Rydzewo and is open to everyone, regardless of age, gender, or place of residence. The organizers emphasize fair play and compliance with PZLA regulations. Participants run a cross-country course and discover the scenic and tourist attractions of the Miastkowo municipality. The run is co-funded by the Miastkowo Municipality from funds for preventing alcohol-related problems and also aims to promote local villages.
course_highlights: Cross-country run on the sports field in Rydzewo
Course showcasing the scenic and tourist attractions of the Miastkowo municipality
Open competition for children, young people, and adults, held in the spirit of fair play
additional: Start and finish on the sports field in Rydzewo. Race office opens at 13:00; group warm-up at 14:30; results announcement and awards ceremony at 16:30; event ends at 18:00. Participant limit: 100. Registration is under the participant’s full name via the website. Minors need written consent from a parent/guardian and must sign a declaration stating that they have no contraindications to taking part. On-the-day registration is possible from 13:00 to 14:30 if places remain available. Details for this date have not been confirmed in the available materials. In the edition described on the registration website, the event began at 13:00 and the run at 15:00; the limit was 100 participants.

name: XI Bieg o Strzałę Widanta
location: Park Miejski w Resku, Resko, Poland
description: The 11th Widant’s Arrow Run is an annual running event held in Resko Municipal Park. The competition includes 5 km and 10 km races, as well as a 5 km Nordic walking event. The course runs through the park and nearby forests along the Rega River, on natural, gravel, and paved surfaces. The event promotes physical activity, a healthy lifestyle, and outdoor recreation for runners and enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Course through Resko Municipal Park and nearby forests along the Rega River
Natural, gravel, and paved surfaces
Two laps for the 10 km race and one lap for the 5 km race and Nordic walking event
additional: Children’s and youth races take place from 10:00 in the Municipal Park area by Górka Borków. A professional warm-up is held by the park stage at 11:45, before the races. Participants over 70 are entitled to free entry after registering. In the previous edition, the start and finish were in Resko Municipal Park; the programme also included children’s and youth races. Wierzbicki Running Project was a co-organizer.

name: XIII Bieg Borków
location: Osieczna, Leszno County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 13th Bieg Borków is an annual running event held in Osieczna, offering a great opportunity to enjoy an active May holiday weekend. The event includes main races over 5 km and 10 km, as well as a free 1 km children’s race held on race day. Every participant receives a race pack and a medal, and the top runners are awarded trophies. The atmosphere encourages families and the local community to enjoy sport together.
course_highlights: Main races over 5 km and 10 km
1 km children’s race with age categories ranging from preschoolers to grades 7–8
Start and finish at the Centre for Culture and Library in Osieczna
additional: The 1 km children’s race is free. Registration takes place on race day at the Centre for Culture and Library in Osieczna, from 8:00 to 9:45. The children’s race is limited to 250 participants. Every child receives a medal and a race pack; trophies and a prize draw are planned for the age categories. In 2026, participants received a race pack and a medal, and the top runners received prizes.

name: XIII Bieg Tropami Śląskich Dinozaurów
location: Lisowice, Gmina Pawonków, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 13th National Run in the Footsteps of Silesian Dinosaurs is a running event held in Lisowice, in the Pawonków municipality. The race is open to participants of all ages who want to spend time actively in a family-friendly atmosphere. The course draws on the region’s paleontological history, making it a unique sporting and educational event. Registration is online, and participants can enjoy being active together outdoors.
course_highlights: A course inspired by the region’s paleontological history
A family-friendly event for runners of all ages
The race takes place in the picturesque village of Lisowice
additional: Register online at https://formularz.ultimasport.pl/458. The event is family-friendly and offers an opportunity to enjoy outdoor activity. No information is available about the start time, start waves, participant limits, or race packages.

name: XIII Dycha po Piachu
description: Dycha po Piachu is a race held in Czołpino, in the Smołdzino municipality. The 13th edition is scheduled for April 30, 2027. The event’s name refers to the sandy nature of the course and the local landscape. It is an option for runners looking to race in a coastal area.
course_highlights: Start in Czołpino, in the Smołdzino municipality
The event’s name suggests the race has a sandy character
Course in a coastal area

name: XXII Maraton Jelcz-Laskowice

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Maraton, Półmaraton, 10 km wpisowe do 31.03. - 100 zł

description: We warmly invite you to the 22nd Toyota Jelcz-Laskowice Marathon, which will take place on the streets of Jelcz-Laskowice. The event features three main races: a marathon of 42.195 km, a half marathon of 21.097 km, and a 10 km run and Nordic Walking march. The event is held in memory of Barbara Szlachetka and offers participants a commemorative T-shirt, access to a swimming pool, massages, and a post-race meal. Shorter distances on a school track are planned for children and young people, with a separate online registration system.
course_highlights: Course on the streets of Jelcz-Laskowice
Distances: marathon, half marathon, and 10 km run and Nordic Walking march
Access to a swimming pool and massages after the race
additional: After the race, participants can use the swimming pool, enjoy massages, and have a meal. Children and young people can take part in races over distances from 50 to 600 metres on the track at PSP No. 2; the start is at 11:00. The race package includes a commemorative T-shirt. According to the published information, the marathon starts at 8:00, while the half marathon and the 10 km run and march start at 9:00. The entry for the 22nd edition lists prices of PLN 100 until 31 March and PLN 120 in April.

name: XXII Półmaraton Chełmżyński Chełmżyńska Dziesiątka
description: The 22nd Chełmża Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Chełmża, attracting runners from various regions. The half-marathon course runs through scenic areas of the town and its surroundings, offering participants attractive views and sporting challenges. The event is open to all and promotes an active lifestyle and integration within the local community. The organizers provide professional support and an atmosphere suited to both competition and recreation.
course_highlights: The half-marathon course passes through central Chełmża and the surrounding areas
Scenic views and varied terrain
A well-marked and secured course

name: 12 Wołowski Bieg Flagi Narodowej
location: Hala Widowiskowo-Sportowa, ul. Panieńska 4a, Wołów, Poland
organizer: Wydział Sportu, Turystyki i Rekreacji Urzędu Miejskiego w Wołowie
description: The 12th Wołów National Flag Run is an annual running event held in Wołów at the sports and entertainment hall at 4a Panieńska Street. The competition takes place and offers an opportunity to celebrate through sport and bring runners together. The organizers provide a secure marketplace for race packages and support from the Sports, Tourism and Recreation Department of the Wołów Municipal Office. The event attracts both recreational and more experienced runners.
course_highlights: The 10 km race was part of the previous edition.
The start and event are located at the Sports and Entertainment Hall in Wołów.
The May race is associated with National Flag Day celebrations.
additional: The race package marketplace lets participants safely buy a package from another runner or list their own. The race office operates on event day from 15:00 to 17:30 at the Sports and Entertainment Hall in Wołów, 4a Panieńska Street. The registration portal for the 12th edition includes a marketplace where race packages can be resold.

name: 2 Bieg dla Flagi
description: The 2nd Run for the Flag is an annual running event held in the picturesque Silesian Park in Chorzów. It offers a chance to spend time actively outdoors, surrounded by greenery and the park’s many attractions. The course passes through varied parts of the park, offering participants both challenges and beautiful views. The event has a family-friendly and patriotic character, bringing the local community together and promoting a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: The course passes through more than 600 hectares of meadows, forests and gardens in Silesian Park
The run takes place on varied terrain, including forest trails and park paths
Picturesque views and proximity to attractions such as the Elka Cableway and the Rosarium
additional: The park offers numerous attractions for participants and their families, including the Elka Cableway and extensive green spaces ideal for recreation. The Silesian Park mobile app is available to help with navigation and planning your visit. The park has parking facilities and house rules available on its website. In previous editions, participants could run or walk with poles; the event was recreational in nature.

name: 42 Chojnickie Biegi Strażackie
description: The Chojnice Firefighters’ Run is a traditional 10 km road race held in Chojnice since 1985. The event is open to all running enthusiasts, not just firefighters. It takes place annually in early May and attracts runners from a variety of backgrounds. The start is scheduled for 11:00, and the event’s atmosphere highlights sporting competition and local community spirit.
course_highlights: A 10 km road race
A tradition dating back to 1985
Open to everyone, not just firefighters
additional: More than 200 people took part in the race in 2026.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Kielce
location: Geonatura Kielce – Botanical Garden, ul. Jagiellońska 78, Kielce, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Kielce is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014, focused on promoting the sport and the scenic appeal of its courses. The event takes place in the picturesque Botanical Garden in Kielce, offering participants a unique experience on a route full of natural charm. It’s a great opportunity to spend time outdoors and stay active in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Cross-country route in the Botanical Garden in Kielce
Picturesque natural surroundings
Race organized by experienced running enthusiasts since 2014
additional: Location: Geonatura Kielce - Botanical Garden, ul. Jagiellońska 78, Kielce.

name: Maraton Górski Leśnik
description: Leśnik Mountain Marathon is an ultra-style mountain race held in the scenic area around Szczyrk. The course features challenging climbs and varied terrain, offering participants a unique challenge and beautiful views. The event offers several distances, including a full marathon, a half marathon, and shorter races, welcoming runners of different experience levels. The event is very popular and provides an excellent opportunity to test yourself in a mountain race.
course_highlights: Mountain course with significant elevation gain
Scenic views of the Beskids
Various distances: 49 km, 28 km, 10 km
additional: A GPX file for the 169 km Stumilak course, with 7,736 m of elevation gain, is available to download and use for planning. An unsupported race option is available (without support). Information about the race headquarters by the Skalite amphitheatre and the distances comes from the 2026 edition description; the 2027 edition schedule may differ.

name: Puszcza Festiwal
description: Puszcza Festival is a sports and recreation event held in the Niepołomice Forest, with its base at Sitowiec Clearing. Participants can choose a running or cycling event and find checkpoints themselves using a map. The routes follow forest paths and roads, and the festival encourages active exploration of the area.
course_highlights: Routes in the forest surroundings of the Niepołomice Forest
Map navigation and finding checkpoints
Running and cycling options, including night routes in previous editions
additional: Previous editions started and finished at Sitowiec Clearing.

name: VII Półmaraton Bitwa pod Gorlicami
location: Cmentarz Wojenny nr 91 na Górze Cmentarnej, Gorlice, Poland
organizer: Akademickie Koło Polskiego Czerwonego Krzyża i Klub Honorowych Dawców Krwi przy Akademii Górniczo-Hutniczej im. Stanisława Staszica w Krakowie oraz Oddział Rejonowy PCK w Gorlicach
description: The 7th International “Battle of Gorlice” Half Marathon is a 21 km road race taking place on May 1, 2027, in Gorlice. The start and finish are located at War Cemetery No. 91 on Cemetery Hill and in the Historical Park in Siary, respectively. The course runs through the city streets and scenic surrounding areas, with a time limit of 2.5 hours. The event has a sporting, historical and promotional character, commemorating the significance of the Battle of Gorlice in World War I and promoting international participation.
course_highlights: A 21 km road course with a time limit of 2.5 hours
Start at War Cemetery No. 91 on Cemetery Hill in Gorlice
Finish in the Historical Park in Siary, with the course passing through scenic localities and along cycle paths
additional: The race office and race-pack collection will be available on race day from 8:00 to 10:30 in the Historical Park in Siary. The race time limit is 2.5 hours. The event has a sporting, historical and promotional character, with international participants. The organizer provides electronic timing. Materials for the 7th edition give a start time of 11:00 and a limit of 250 paid entries. The race pack includes a bib number, medal, finish-line meal and gifts from sponsors.

name: X Dębiński Bieg po Flagę
location: Publiczna Szkoła Podstawowa w Woli Dębińskiej, Wola Dębińska, Poland
description: The 10th Dębiński Run for the Flag is an annual sporting event held at the sports field by the Public Primary School in Wola Dębińska. The event takes place on May 1 and includes races over various distances, including 2.5 km and 10 km, as well as a 4.5 km Nordic walking event and shorter races for children. This family-friendly event is full of sporting excitement and offers activities for children and a food zone, encouraging active recreation and bringing the local community together. The race is held under the honorary patronage of the Mayor of Dębno Municipality and is an opportunity to celebrate the May holiday together.
course_highlights: Races over 2.5 km and 10 km
Nordic walking over 4.5 km
Children’s races over 150 m, 300 m and 600 m
additional: The event offers free activities for children and a food zone. It is family-friendly and held under the honorary patronage of Dębno Municipality Mayor Wiesław Kozłowski. In the previous, anniversary edition, the start and accompanying events took place at the sports field by the Public Primary School in Wola Dębińska. Participants received a commemorative medal and flag.

name: XII Bieg Flagi
location: Park Kępa Potocka, Żoliborz, Warsaw, Poland

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata za udział w XII Biegu Flagi na dystansie 5 lub 10 km to 50 złotych.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Biegi dla dzieci 0-12 lat na dystansach 200, 400 i 800 metrów są bezpłatne.

description: The 12th Flag Run is an annual race held in Kępa Potocka Park in Warsaw to commemorate the Day of the Flag of the Republic of Poland. The route runs through the picturesque park, giving participants the opportunity to celebrate Polish identity and national symbols through sport. The event includes 5 km and 10 km races, as well as shorter races for children, creating a family-friendly and patriotic atmosphere.
course_highlights: Route through Kępa Potocka Park in Warsaw
5 km: one lap; 10 km: two laps
Children’s races over 200, 400 and 800 metres in the central part of the park
additional: The adult race route is a 5 km loop through the park; the 10 km race consists of two laps. Children’s races take place over shorter distances in the central part of the park. The organizer is the Żoliborz District Office of the Capital City of Warsaw.

name: Katowice Night Half Marathon
description: The Katowice Night Half Marathon is the first edition of a night half marathon in Katowice, planned for 1 May 2027. The start is announced for 20:00 near the Market Square, and alongside the 21.0975 km half marathon there is a 5 km run. The route will use streets with closed or restricted traffic. The organizer is the Silesia Marathon Foundation, with registration handled by Silesia Run.
course_highlights: Night half marathon through the streets of Katowice
Additional 5 km run
Start and finish near the Market Square
additional: Registration is through a form on events.silesia.run until places run out or until 20 April 2027, and the deadline may be extended if places remain. The start time may change and the exact route is to be published on the race website.

name: Mintal Nemčiansky beh
organizer: Marathon Banska Bystrica, s.r.o., ON-POINT o.z.
description: Mintal Nemčiansky Run is a running event in the village of Nemce, offering races for both children and adults. The races cover various distances, from 1,000 m for children to 10.6 km for adults. The course follows a dirt road and a paved hiking trail, offering a pleasant running experience in nature. The event is organized by Marathon Banská Bystrica, s.r.o., ON-POINT o.z. and Nemciansky Beh OZ, and is suitable for runners across a wide range of age groups.

name: Podvihorlatský maratón, Michalovský polmaratón
location: Michalovce, Michalovce, pred MsÚ v Michalovciach
organizer: Mesto Michalovce, Atletický klub Michalovce, Obec Vinné
description: The Podvihorlatský Marathon and Michalovce Half Marathon are traditional running events held in the beautiful surroundings of Zemplínska šírava and the city of Michalovce. The races offer a marathon, a half marathon, and a half-marathon relay, making them suitable for a wide range of participants, from experienced runners to recreational athletes. The organizers provide quality services, including electronic timing, refreshments along the course and at the finish, stylish T-shirts, and participant medals. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and support for the region’s running community.

name: ETHOS Májový beh cyklotrasou
location: Krásno nad Kysucou, Krásno nad Kysucou, Námestie pred Kultúrnym domom
description: The ETHOS May Cycling Path Run is the fourth edition of a running competition taking place in Krásno nad Kysucou. The race follows a cycling path through beautiful natural mountain scenery with minimal traffic, ensuring a safe and enjoyable experience. Runners can compete on certified courses in men’s and women’s categories, with different age groups. The organizer encourages online registration and provides refreshments and medals for all participants.

name: Medzinárodný pouličný beh Komárom – Komárno
organizer: Bežecký spolok Komárom - Európa (KEFE), Komárom-Európa Futó Egyesület (KEFE)
description: The Komárom–Komárno International Street Run is a traditional race held in Komárno, starting near the Municipal Sports Hall. The event offers 5.5 km and 10 km courses, as well as a children’s race. The start is at the intersection of Arany János and Vág streets in Komárom. The event is organised by the Komárom–Európa Running Association (KEFE) and is suitable for runners of a wide range of ages. The atmosphere is international and friendly, with an emphasis on athletic performance and a shared community experience.

name: Pečovskonovoveský šľapák – prvomájový beh zdravia
location: Pečovská Nová Ves okr. Sabinov, Pečovská Nová Ves okr. Sabinov, Základná škola Pečovská Nová Ves
organizer: Obecný úrad Pečovská Nová Ves, základná škola s materskou školou Pečovská Nová Ves
description: The Pečovská Nová Ves Walking Run – May Day Health Run is a traditional running race organized by the Pečovská Nová Ves Municipal Office and the Pečovská Nová Ves Primary School and Kindergarten. The race is open to the general public, including children, juniors, and adults in various age categories. Competitors are divided by age and gender, including a 5 km race for the Mayor’s Prize. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and sporting activities in the community.

name: Primátorská desiatka
location: Poprad,, Poprad,, Poprad Kvetnica časť Strelnica
organizer: Mesto Poprad, MsÚ Poprad, Centrum voľného času Poprad, Mestské lesy Poprad, Triklub Poprad
description: The Mayor’s Ten is a traditional running race in Poprad, held in the Kvetnica - Strelnica area. The race is open to children, young people and adults, with categories divided by age and gender. The children’s and youth races start at 10:00, and the main category starts at 10:45. The organizers are the City of Poprad, Poprad Municipal Office, Poprad Leisure Centre, Poprad Municipal Forests and Triklub Poprad. The race offers a pleasant atmosphere and the opportunity to enjoy sport for all age groups.

name: Zay Cross
organizer: Čachtické podzemie o.z., PD Uhrovec, člen skupiny AGRAVITAL, RZP a.s.
description: Zay Cross is a running event held in the village of Žitná-Radiša, at the football pitch. Runners can choose between two courses: the main 14 km course with 550 m of elevation gain and the shorter 5 km course with 200 m of elevation gain. The routes combine paved roads, forest roads, trails and grassy meadows. They are well marked and have refreshment stations. The event also features children’s races and attractions in the safe start and finish area. It is organised by the Čachtické podzemie civic association, together with its partners and the village of Žitná-Radiša.

name: Charitatívny beh Liskovským chotárom
location: Lisková, Lisková, Základná škola, ul. Pod Chočom 550
description: The Lisková Countryside Charity Run is a running event in Lisková offering categories for children, youth, juniors, adults, and hobby runners, including Nordic Walking. The start is at the Primary School at 550 Pod Chočom Street. The schoolchildren’s race starts at 9:00, while the main and hobby races start at 10:45. The event is suitable for the general public and supports charitable causes. The organizer is Jozef Bukový, who provides information about the event.

name: Behaj lesmi – Smolenice
description: Behaj lesmi Smolenice is part of a series of seven races set in beautiful Slovak countryside, offering routes mostly on soft surfaces and in fresh air. The race is included in the UTMB Index Races, which means that trail races are rated internationally. The routes pass below Smolenice Castle, where themed characters cheer on the runners and create a unique atmosphere. You can compete on two main routes—12 km and 19 km—and there is also a Conti Speed Section on the course, with a valuable prize.

name: Tlmačský polmaratón
location: Tlmače okr. Levice, Tlmače okr. Levice, Tlmače – Lipník, Nám. odborárov
description: The Tlmače Half Marathon and 10K is a traditional running race held in the town of Tlmače. This 43rd edition offers a 21 km half-marathon course and a 10K, as well as a 3.5 km fun run and Nordic walking event. The event is part of the Patriots Running League and is organized by the town of Tlmače together with local sports clubs. Runners can enjoy high-quality organization, electronic timekeeping, and race packs with promotional items and a meal voucher.

name: Jarný charitatívny beh Nitra
organizer: Mgr. Lukáš Čelinák, Rotary klub Nitra Harmony
description: The Nitra Spring Charity Run is a community sporting event that brings together exercise, solidarity, and support for healthcare in the city of Nitra. It raises funds for the emergency department of Nitra University Hospital and is organized by the Rotary Club Nitra Harmony together with the Oktoberfest Run Nitra team. The event offers various distances, including 10 km, 5 km, and 1.2 km, and participants can also take part as a team. Runners can contribute to a charitable cause while enjoying the sporting atmosphere in Nitra.

name: Sklené sa hýbe
location: Sklené (okr. Turčianske Teplice), Sklené (okr. Turčianske Teplice), futbalové ihrisko
description: Sklené sa hýbe is a running event held at the football pitch in Sklené, in the Turčianske Teplice District. The race features three courses of varying lengths and elevation gain: a half marathon (21.5 km, 740 m+), 14 km (420 m+) and 8 km (320 m+). Children’s activities are also planned alongside the main categories. The main races start at 10:30, and the children’s races begin at 10:45. The event is part of the Beh tromi krajmi and Beh dvomi krajmi series.

name: Plesnivec VerticalRun
location: Parkovisko chata Plesnivec - Tatranská Kotlina, Parkovisko chata Plesnivec - Tatranská Kotlina, Parkovisko chata Plesnivec - Tatranská Kotlina
description: Plesnivec VerticalRun is a mountain race covering 5 km with 530 metres of elevation gain. It takes place in Tatranská Kotlina, near Plesnivec Hut. Runners will enjoy a demanding vertical course profile that tests their fitness and endurance. Registration is online, and runners are added to the start list once the entry fee has been paid. The event is suitable for all mountain-running enthusiasts looking for a challenge in beautiful natural surroundings.

name: Beh oslobodenia obce Budča
location: Budča, okr. Zvolen, Budča, okr. Zvolen, pred Obecným úradom
description: The Budča Liberation Run is a traditional race held in the village of Budča to commemorate its liberation. The main race is 8.4 km long, with 232 metres of elevation gain, and loops around the village along forest roads and paved roads. The start and finish are by the municipal office. The event also includes children’s categories with shorter courses suited to the runners’ ages, and a “Ride for Health” category open to everyone, regardless of age or ability. The race is part of the Zvolen Running League and offers electronic timing, refreshments, and medals for participants.

name: Mistrovství ČR v maratonu mužů a žen
description: Mistrovství České republiky v maratonu mužů a žen je prestižní závod na klasické maratonské vzdálenosti 42,195 km, který se koná v historickém centru Prahy se startem na Staroměstském náměstí. Závod je určen pro muže a ženy starší 18 let, kteří splnili kvalifikační limity v předchozích letech. Organizátorem je Juniorský maratonský klub, z.s. ve spolupráci se společností RunCzech. Závodníci mohou využít moderní časomíru a po závodě je k dispozici profesionální fotografická služba. Start je tradičně v 08:00 hodin ráno.
course_highlights: Start a cíl na historickém Staroměstském náměstí v Praze
Trasa dlouhá 42,195 km vedoucí centrem Prahy
Profesionální časomíra a možnost stažení GPX trasy
additional: Fotografie zajišťuje společnost witisi.photo s možností předobjednání během registrace a objednání po závodě. Přihlášky jsou přijímány pouze od závodníků, kteří splnili kvalifikační limity od 1. ledna 2025 do uzávěrky přihlášek. Účast podléhá kvalifikačním limitům a zařazení technickým delegátem. Dostupné informace se vztahují k ročníkům 2025 a 2026, nikoli k datu 9. května 2027.

name: Prague International Marathon 2026
description: Pražský mezinárodní maraton je tradiční běžecký závod, který se koná v historickém centru Prahy. Závod nabízí jedinečnou příležitost proběhnout se malebnými ulicemi a kolem ikonických památek města. Start i cíl jsou na Staroměstském náměstí, což dodává závodu slavnostní atmosféru. Maraton je součástí běžecké série RunCzech a přitahuje širokou škálu běžců od amatérů po profesionály.
course_highlights: Start a cíl na Staroměstském náměstí
Trasa vede historickým centrem Prahy s výhledy na památky
Pevný asfaltový povrch s minimálními převýšeními
additional: Maratonský víkend zahrnuje doprovodné běhy jako LAVAZZA Active Breakfast Run (4,2 km), dm rodinná míle (1,609 km) a dm bambini run (100-200 m). Fotografie zajišťuje společnost witisi.photo, které si lze předobjednat během registrace nebo objednat po závodě. Časový limit a pravidla jsou k dispozici na webu RunCzech. Startovní balíček a další informace jsou dostupné v mobilní aplikaci RunCzech.

name: ORLEN Maraton Praha, MČR v maratonu mužů a žen
description: ORLEN Maraton Praha je prestižní maratonský závod konaný v historickém centru Prahy, který zároveň slouží jako Mistrovství České republiky v maratonu mužů a žen. Závod nabízí jedinečnou příležitost běžcům zažít atmosféru města s bohatou historií a krásnými výhledy. Trasa vede po ikonických pražských památkách a je vhodná pro zkušené i rekreační běžce. Běžecký víkend zahrnuje i doprovodné závody pro rodiny a děti, což podtrhuje komunitní charakter akce.
course_highlights: Trasa vede historickým centrem Prahy s výhledy na památky
Plochý a rychlý profil vhodný pro osobní rekordy
Součástí je i Mistrovství ČR v maratonu mužů a žen
additional: Startovní balíček obsahuje vše potřebné pro závodníky. Časomíra je elektronická s oficiálním měřením výsledků. Fotografie zajišťuje witisi.photo, které si lze předobjednat při registraci nebo zakoupit po závodě. Běžecký víkend zahrnuje i rodinné a dětské závody, doprovodný program a virtuální balíček v mobilní aplikaci RunCzech.

name: Sparkassenlauf und Wandertag TuS Bergen von 1867 e.V.
Ultra Wysoczyzna
description: Ultra Wysoczyzna is a unique trail race held in the scenic Elbląg Upland, featuring five distances of varying difficulty. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, as well as the natural attractions of the region. The start and finish for most distances are in Elbląg, except for the 54 km distance, which starts in Tolkmicko. The event takes place on April 16–18, 2027, and attracts runners from across Poland.
course_highlights: Deer’s Roar — 103 km, elevation gain/loss +/- 2,300 m, 17-hour time limit
Wolf’s Howl — 54 km, elevation gain/loss +/- 1,160 m, 10-hour time limit, starts in Tolkmicko
Boar’s Squeal — 22 km, elevation gain/loss +/- 800 m, 5-hour time limit
additional: The start and finish for Deer’s Roar (103 km), Boar’s Squeal (22 km), Fox’s Squeak (13 km) and Owl’s Hoot (6 km) are in Elbląg at 6 Marymoncka Street (Bażantarnia Municipal Park). The 54 km Wolf’s Howl starts in Tolkmicko and finishes in Elbląg. Time limits range from 1.5 hours (6 km) to 17 hours (103 km). The technical briefing is held online on Facebook the day before the start. Bus transport to the 54 km start is available for registered participants who have paid their entry fee. Award ceremonies take place after each distance. The races are held on April 16–18, 2027; the event programme also includes junior races. The 54 km race starts in Tolkmicko.

name: 10 Bieg Króla Eryka
description: The 10th King Eric Run is an annual running event organized by the Darłowskie Charty Running Club in Darłowo. The event features a variety of distances, including races for children and a main race, attracting both recreational and more experienced runners. The participant limit is 300 for the main race and 250 for the children’s races. Registration is available online until the end of April or until places are filled. The event has a family-friendly character and promotes physical activity among residents and visitors.
course_highlights: The course includes different distances suited to participants’ ages and categories
Children’s races range from 200 to 1,200 meters and are divided by birth year and gender
Participant limits: 300 for the main race and 250 for the children’s races
additional: The children’s races are divided into age categories, with distances ranging from 200 m to 1,200 m. In the 2026 edition, the children’s and youth races took place on May 2, and the main race took place on May 3. Entry fees from the children’s races were allocated to charity.

name: 10 Transgraniczny Festiwal Biegowy
description: The 10th Gryfino Cross-Border Running Festival is an annual event held in Gryfino to commemorate the anniversary of the Constitution of 3 May. Participants can choose from three options: a 10 km race, a half marathon, or 10 km Nordic walking. Participants check in at the Tavern on the Quay of the Polak spod znaku Rodła, and everyone must collect their race packet in person. The festival combines sporting competition with local tradition and the atmosphere of a national holiday.
course_highlights: Three options: 10 km race, half marathon, and 10 km Nordic walking
Start and check-in at the Tavern on the Quay of the Polak spod znaku Rodła
Event commemorating the anniversary of the Constitution of 3 May
additional: Participants check in in person at the Tavern on the Quay of the Polak spod znaku Rodła, 5 Energetyków Street, Gryfino. Race packets can be collected on the day before the event or on race day. Participants over 18 must sign a declaration stating that they are running at their own risk. For the edition described, participants checked in in person at the Tavern at 5 Energetyków Street, Gryfino.

name: IX Rzekuńska Szybka Dycha
description: The 9th Rzekuń Fast Ten is an annual sporting event in Rzekuń that attracts running and Nordic walking enthusiasts. It is not only a competition, but also a great atmosphere and an opportunity to spend time actively. The race takes place on a course in Rzekuń, and participants can look forward to excitement and positive energy throughout the event.
course_highlights: Main race over a distance of 10 km
Nordic walking event
Children’s and youth races were also held in the previous edition
additional: The event includes a race and a Nordic walking event. The regulations are available on the organizer’s website. Registration is through the dostartu.pl platform. In the previous edition, the Nordic walking event was 5 km, and the children’s and youth races were held over distances of 350 m, 700 m, and 1,050 m.

name: Lidzbarska 10-tka
description: The Lidzbarska 10-tka Running Festival is an annual running event held in Garbuzy Park in Lidzbark Welski. The race offers two distances, 5 km and 10 km, which start together. The event attracts runners of different age groups and ability levels, with professional organization and timing. The festival atmosphere encourages sporting competition and brings the local community together.
course_highlights: The route runs through scenic Garbuzy Park
Two distances to choose from: 5 km and 10 km
Both distances start together at 13:00
additional: The race office opens at 11:00. The participant limit has been reached, and online registration is closed. Residents of the Lidzbark Municipality can take advantage of a special discount by registering in advance. Previous editions included 5 km and 10 km distances.

name: X Bieg Warcki
description: The X Warta Run is an annual running event held at Jutrzenka Stadium in Warta. It attracts entire families, offering 5 km and 10 km races as well as a children’s race. During the event, a special play zone with inflatable slides and obstacle courses is available, making it appealing to participants of all ages. The run combines sport and recreation and is an opportunity to spend time together and cheer on the runners.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km races
Children’s race
Play zone with inflatable slides and obstacle courses
additional: Schedule: 13:00 — Race Office opens; 15:00 — children’s race starts; 16:00 — 5 km and 10 km races start; 17:30 — street traffic resumes; around 18:00 — awards ceremony. Please do not park along the race route and follow the instructions of event staff. The 5 km and 10 km races are scheduled to start at 16:00.

name: XVIII Bieg bez Granic
description: The 18th Run Without Borders in Racibórz is a unique sporting event held as part of the Michał Kędzierski Memorial. The event combines a passion for sport with an atmosphere of unity and determination, offering categories for different age groups and ability levels. Participants can choose from 1.7 km, 5 km and 10 km races, as well as Nordic Walking events. Categories for people with disabilities are also available. Places are limited, highlighting the event’s distinctive and intimate character.
course_highlights: Youth Run — 1.7 km, ideal for the youngest participants to get started
5 km Run and 5 km Nordic Walking — for enthusiasts of exercise and walking with poles
Main Run — 10 km, a challenge for determined runners
additional: Categories for people with disabilities are available at the 5 km and 10 km distances.

name: XXXIII Bieg im. Jana Kilińskiego
location: Stadion Miejski w Trzemesznie, Trzemeszno, Poland
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Trzemesznie
description: The 33rd Jan Kiliński National Run is a half marathon held with the participation of Trzemeszno and Mogilno. The course is 21.097 km long, with the start and race-pack collection scheduled at the Municipal Stadium in Trzemeszno. The event is organized by the Sports and Recreation Centre in Trzemeszno.
course_highlights: Half marathon covering 21.097 km
The course connects Trzemeszno and Mogilno
Start in Trzemeszno, at the Municipal Stadium
additional: Race packs can be collected at the Municipal Stadium in Trzemeszno on event day, from 7:30 to 9:15. A race-pack exchange is available.

name: XXXV Bieg Orłów
location: Kompleks sportowo-rekreacyjny, ul. Słupska 26a, Czarna Dąbrówka, Poland
description: The 35th National Eagles Run is an annual running event held at the sports and recreation complex in Czarna Dąbrówka. The event attracts runners of all ages, starting with children’s and youth races as part of the Cross Festival. The race office opens at 8:30, and the first races are scheduled to start at 10:00. It is an excellent opportunity for sporting competition and bringing the local community together.
course_highlights: 10 km main race
5 km race and 5 km Nordic walking event
Children’s and youth races, including distances from 150 to 1,200 m
additional: The race office is open from 8:30. Children’s and youth races are held as part of the Cross Festival. The start and finish are at the sports and recreation complex in Czarna Dąbrówka, at 26a Słupska Street. For the 2026 edition, the event venue was listed as the sports and recreation complex at 26a Słupska Street; the race office was scheduled to open at 8:30.

name: Baca Run
description: Baca Run is a unique running festival held in the picturesque Gorce Mountains in Rabka-Zdrój. It offers mountain courses suited to both beginners and experienced runners, with beautiful views and challenging sections. The event includes races for children and adults at various distances, with professional support and a generous race package. It is a great opportunity to take on a mountain challenge and enjoy the atmosphere of a sporting celebration.
course_highlights: Mountain courses in the picturesque Gorce Mountains
Distances of 8 km, 15 km and 22.5 km, with aid stations along the course
Free transport to the start for the 15 km and 22.5 km distances
additional: The race package includes professional photography and video coverage, aid stations along the course with water, isotonic drinks, cola, fruit and sweets, a post-race meal, and glass trophies and prizes in the overall and age-group classifications. Children’s races cover distances from approximately 100 m to 1.5 km. The event is held under the patronage of the Mayor of Rabka-Zdrój. Free transport to the start is provided for the 15 km and 22.5 km races. Participants can expect aid stations along the course and a post-race meal. Details of the distances and race benefits may vary between editions.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 4. kolo
description: The 2 Miles Bratislava Run is a regular 2-mile (3.218 km) running race held at the Kuchajda swimming complex in Bratislava. It is organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team and is open to the general public, including children, juniors, women, men, and veterans. Registration takes place at the venue on race day from 9:30, with the start at 10:00. The race is part of a series in which runners earn points toward a traveling trophy based on their categories and performances.

name: Beh 2 míle
description: The 2-Mile Run in Bratislava at Kuchajda is a regular running race over 2 miles (3.218 km), organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team. Check-in and registration take place at the venue by the volleyball court from 9:30; the race starts at 10:00. The race is open to various age categories, including children, juniors, women, men, and veterans. It is part of the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team traveling cup, where finishing times are adjusted using age coefficients and runners earn points based on participation and performance.

name: Stropkovská dvadsiatka
description: The Stropkov Twenty is a traditional road race with a rich history dating back to 1977, held in the town of Stropkov. The course passes through several villages and gives runners the chance to compete over 20 km, with refreshments along the route and at the finish. The event is organized by Klub Bežcov Stropkov, which supports the development of running in the region. Runners can expect high-quality organization, race packs, and the chance to recover after the race at the indoor swimming pool. The race is part of the Michalovce–Sobrance Regional Running League.

name: Stropkovská desiatka a  I. ročník Barefoot
location: Stropkov, Stropkov, Námestie SNP v Stropkove
description: The Stropkov 10K and the 1st Barefoot edition are part of the traditional road races in Stropkov, which have a rich history dating back to 1977. The event is organized by the Stropkov Runners Club to support the running movement in the region and across Slovakia. Runners can look forward to well-prepared courses and an atmosphere created each year by hundreds of fans and runners. In addition to the main race, the program also includes a barefoot run, offering participants a new experience.

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Řevnice

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 240 Kč (v rámci voucheru na celou sérii 12 závodů)

description: Běžecká série Berounka v Řevnicích je závod konaný v krásném přírodním prostředí s startem i cílem v pivovaru Řevnice. Trasa vede převážně po zelené naučné stezce, je dobře značená červeno-bílými fáborky a nabízí kombinaci táhlých stoupání a klesání s výhledy na okolní pole, louky a lesy. Závod je vhodný pro běžce, kteří si chtějí užít příjemný běh v malebné krajině s možností občerstvení a úschovy věcí na místě. Po závodě jsou oceněni nejlepší v kategoriích diplomy.
course_highlights: Trasa vede převážně po zelené naučné stezce s červeno-bílým značením
Dvě táhlá stoupání, včetně přes Lesní divadlo k rybníku Píšťák
Výhledy na okolní pole, louky a lesy při klesání zpět do Řevnic
additional: Registrace možná online či na místě od 17:00, prosíme dorazit nejpozději do 17:30. Na místě je možnost občerstvení a úschovy věcí. První tři místa v kategoriích obdrží diplomy. Start a cíl jsou v pivovaru Řevnice; na místě je občerstvení a úschova věcí.

name: 10 Kobierzycki Bieg z Konstytucją
location: Hala Sportowo-Widowiskowa im. Adama Wójcika, ul. Dębowa 20, Kobierzyce, Poland
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Kobierzycach (KOSiR)
description: The 10th Kobierzyce Run with the Constitution is an annual running event held in Kobierzyce, offering distances of 5 km, 10 km, a half marathon, and 5 km Nordic Walking. The event also includes youth races of 1,350 m and 2,700 m, and a roughly 340 m Little Dwarf Run for the youngest participants. The start and finish are at the Adam Wójcik Sports and Entertainment Hall. Participants receive race packs with a T-shirt and medal, and a recovery meal is served after the race.
course_highlights: Course certified by PZLA
Refreshment points on all distances, with additional snacks on the half-marathon course
Start and finish at the Adam Wójcik Sports and Entertainment Hall, ul. Dębowa 20
additional: The race office is open from 08:30 to 10:30 at the Sports and Entertainment Hall. After the race, participants can choose a recovery meal: soup or bigos. Participants in the youth races receive a personalized race bib, water, a wafer bar, and a medal. The limit for the main races is 600 participants. The Little Dwarf Run (approx. 340 m) is free; registration is available on race day, with a limit of 200 children. The youth races and Little Dwarf Run start at 10:00. Award ceremonies and a prize draw are included in the programme. Start and finish: Adam Wójcik Sports and Entertainment Hall, ul. Dębowa 20, Kobierzyce.

name: 32 Łaskarzewski Bieg Konstytucji 3 Maja
location: Krępa to Łaskarzew, Garwolin County, Masovian Voivodeship, Poland
price_range: 50 zł (bieg główny w 2026 r.); biegi dziecięce bezpłatne

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata startowa za udział w biegu

description: The 32nd Łaskarzew Constitution Day 3 May Run is an annual sporting and patriotic event held on the anniversary of the adoption of the Constitution of 3 May 1791. The 7 km main race runs from Krępa to Łaskarzew and is held under the honorary patronage of the Marshal of the Mazowieckie Voivodeship and the Mayor of Łaskarzew. The event also includes a running picnic for children and young people, with free races over shorter distances. The organizers emphasize participants’ health and sobriety, promoting the slogan “FIT BECAUSE SOBER – SOBER BECAUSE FIT.”
course_highlights: A 7 km main route from Krępa to Łaskarzew
A running picnic for children and young people, with races over 100 m, 400 m and 800 m
An event held under the honorary patronage of local authorities and with a patriotic character
additional: The entry fee is treated as a donation and is non-refundable. Participants must pay within 3 days of registration; otherwise, they will be removed from the start list. The organizer decides the order in which race numbers are assigned. Complaints concerning the start list will not be accepted on race day. Participation in the children’s races is free.

name: 34 Bieg Konstytucji 3 Maja

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata na nordic walking jest stała i wynosi 89 złotych.

description: The May 3 Constitution Day Run is an annual, joyful running event held in central Warsaw, combining sport with a patriotic atmosphere and urban energy. Participants cover a 5-kilometre course along some of the capital’s most prestigious streets, starting and finishing at Three Crosses Square. The run is part of the Warsaw Running Triad, “Run for Remembrance,” commemorating important moments in Polish history. In addition to the run, a Nordic walking option is available, allowing people who prefer a more leisurely pace to take part. It is a great opportunity to enjoy an active May holiday in a spirit of community and sporting competition.
course_highlights: A certified 5 km course through central Warsaw
Scenic sections along Ujazdów Avenue, Savior Square and Constitution Square
A fast, visually appealing course that is ideal for chasing personal bests
additional: Participant limit: 6,500 in the running category and 250 in Nordic walking. The time limit for completing the run is 55 minutes. Start and finish at Three Crosses Square. Race packs can be collected on April 30 and May 2, and on race day only by people from outside Warsaw. The medal has space for an engraved time and name; engraving can be purchased. A technical T-shirt can be purchased during registration or by editing an entry. Nordic walking starts in the final wave, allowing participants to maintain a comfortable pace. Results are published online by STS TIMING; Nordic walking and 5 km wheelchair classifications are also available.

name: Bieg Konstytucji 3 Maja (Strzyżów)
location: Stadion Miejski w Strzyżowie, Strzyżów, Poland
description: The Constitution of May 3 Run in Strzyżów is an annual sporting event commemorating the adoption of the Constitution of May 3. The competition takes place at the Municipal Stadium in Strzyżów and includes various distances, including a half marathon, a run of around 10 km, and a Nordic Walking march. The event promotes physical activity, a healthy lifestyle, the local community, and local culture. It is organized by the Strzyżów Municipality and the Sports, Tourism and Recreation Centre in Strzyżów, together with local partners and patrons.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Municipal Stadium in Strzyżów
Distances: 21 km half marathon, and a run and Nordic Walking march of around 10 km
Age categories for children and young people, with shorter distances
additional: The race office opens at 11:00 at the Municipal Sports Stadium on 1 Maja Street in Strzyżów. Starts take place in waves: the half marathon at 15:00, the run and Nordic Walking march of around 10 km at 15:10, followed by children’s races over distances from 60 m to 800 m in various age categories. The event is held under the patronage of the Mayor of Strzyżów and the Strzyżów County Head. Previous editions have also included a 10 km run, a 10 km Nordic Walking march, a sprint for adults, and children’s races over various distances. The start and finish are at the Municipal Stadium in Strzyżów.

name: Grybowski Bieg Majowy
location: Stadion Sportowy, ul. Grunwaldzka 47, Grybów, Poland
organizer: Burmistrz Miasta Grybów oraz Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Grybowie
description: The Grybów May Run is an annual running event organized by the Municipal Sports and Recreation Center in Grybów and held at the Sports Stadium at 47 Grunwaldzka Street. The event promotes national traditions, a healthy lifestyle, and physical activity through children’s races, an 8 km main race, and a Nordic Walking event. The course is marked and has medical support. Participants receive race packs, commemorative T-shirts, and medals. After the race, the organizers provide refreshments and baggage storage at MOSiR Grybów.
course_highlights: An 8 km course for the run and Nordic Walking event
Marked course with medical support
Start and finish at the Sports Stadium in Grybów
additional: Time limits: Nordic Walking 8 km — 2 hours; 8 km run — 1.5 hours; children’s races of 60 m, 100 m, and 400 m — 5 minutes. Race office open from 11:00 to 12:45. Post-race refreshments: grilled sausage, bread, ketchup, and tea. Electronic timing and baggage storage at MOSiR Grybów. In previous editions, the start and finish were at the sports stadium at 47 Grunwaldzka Street. Participants received commemorative medals, and refreshments were provided after the race.

name: Poznański Bieg Konstytucji
location: Polana Harcerza, POSiR Malta, Poznań, Poland
description: The Poznań Constitution Run is a race held in Poznań to celebrate Constitution Day on May 3. In the 2026 edition, participants could choose between 5 km and 10 km, with the start scheduled at Polana Harcerza near POSiR Malta.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances in the 2026 edition
Start and finish at Polana Harcerza
Race in the area around POSiR Malta in Poznań

name: XII Biegu Konstytucji 3 Maja
description: The 12th May 3rd Constitution Run in Radom is an annual running event held to mark Constitution Day on May 3rd. The race takes place on city streets and starts at 09:00, attracting runners of various ages, including children. It is organized by Biegiem Radom, with timing provided using professional RFID technology to ensure accurate results. This sporting event combines patriotic and recreational elements, bringing together athletic competition and a tribute to an important historical event.
course_highlights: City-street course in Radom
Start at 09:00
Race with professional RFID timing
additional: The event is organized by Biegiem Radom and uses electronic RFID timing. It also includes children's races. Registration for the 2026 edition included a separate children's races category; timing was provided by Time-Sport.pl.

name: XXVI Krośnieński Bieg Konstytucji 3 Maja
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Krośnie i Krośnieński Klub Biegacza
description: The 26th Krosno Constitution Day Run is an annual running event held in Krosno to commemorate an important historical event. The race follows a route through the city center, finishing at Constitution of May 3 Square. The event is a great opportunity to spend time actively and bring the local community together. The organizers provide professional service and an atmosphere conducive to sporting competition.
course_highlights: The route passes through the center of Krosno
Finish at Constitution of May 3 Square
The race commemorates the historic event of the May 3 Constitution
additional: The previous edition also featured a 5 km Nordic Walking event and races for children and young people.

name: XXXIII Sztumski Bieg Solidarności 3 maja
description: The 33rd International Sztum Solidarity Run is an annual running event held on May 3 in Sztum at the Municipal Beach. The event includes races for children, a 10 km run, and a Nordic Walking march, welcoming both recreational and more experienced runners. This sporting celebration combines tradition with outdoor recreation, promoting solidarity and a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: The route runs along the scenic Municipal Beach in Sztum
A range of distances is available: races for children, 10 km, and Nordic Walking
The event is international in nature, attracting participants from various countries
additional: The event includes races for children and a Nordic Walking march. The start and finish are at the Municipal Beach in Sztum. The event is held annually on May 3, promoting physical activity and solidarity. The program also includes races for children.

name: Łódzki Bieg Konstytucji 3 Maja
location: Park im. Adama Mickiewicza, Łódź, Poland

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata na nordic walking jest stała i wynosi 89 złotych.

description: The Łódź Constitution Day 3 May Run is a joyful annual running event held in the center of Warsaw, attracting thousands of participants who want to actively celebrate an important day in Polish history. The 5-kilometer course passes through the city’s most representative and picturesque locations, offering both sporting competition and the chance to enjoy urban views. The run is part of the Warsaw Running Triad “Run for Remembrance” and also offers a Nordic walking option for those who prefer a more relaxed pace. Participants receive commemorative medals, and the event’s atmosphere is perfect for celebrating the May holiday together through sport.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through central Warsaw, with views of Łazienki Park, the Botanical Garden, and Zbawiciela Square
Start and finish at Three Crosses Square; the route passes along Ujazdowskie Avenue and Marszałkowska Street, and through Constitution Square
A fast, scenic course suited both to personal-best attempts and to completing the distance at a comfortable pace
additional: Participant limit: 6,500 in the running category and 250 in Nordic walking. The time limit for completing the run is 55 minutes. Medal engraving and a technical T-shirt can be purchased during registration. Race numbers can be collected at the Race Office; on race day, collection is available only to people from outside Warsaw. The course is PZLA-certified and marked every 1 km. Start and finish at Three Crosses Square. Nordic walkers start in the final wave, after the runners.

name: Bieg Konstytucji
organizer: WKB META Lubliniec oraz Burmistrz Miasta Lublińca
description: The 3 May Constitution Day Run in Lubliniec is a patriotic sporting event organized by WKB META Lubliniec and the Mayor of Lubliniec. The 2.5 km run is open to everyone, including children, young people, adults, and seniors. Entry is free, encouraging a wide range of participants to take part. The event combines sporting competition with commemorating an important historical event, creating a unique atmosphere.
course_highlights: A 2.5 km distance open to all age groups
A course suitable for children, young people, adults, and seniors
A patriotic event combining sport and history
additional: The 2.5 km distance is suitable for participants of different ages and experience levels. A patriotic sporting event organized to mark the National Third of May Holiday.

name: Charity-Lauf des PSV Grün-Weiß Kassel e. V.
Małopolski Bieg Przełajowy
description: The Małopolska Cross-Country Run is an annual cross-country race held in Kraków as part of the University of Economics’ Juwenalia. The event attracts amateur runners and students, offering the chance to compete on scenic off-road courses. The race takes place in Park Lotników Polskich, giving participants a chance to enjoy nature and a sporting atmosphere. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and bring the academic community together.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in Park Lotników Polskich
Scenic green spaces of Kraków
Juwenalia atmosphere and sporting competition
additional: No information is available about entry fees or the start time. The event is open to all and brings people together.

location: Zvolen, Okres Zvolen, Banskobystrický kraj, Slovakia

name: Běh lesoparkem Praha Hostivař
location: Hostivař Forest Park, Prague 10, Prague, Česko
description: Běh lesoparkem Praha Hostivař je terénní závod, který nabízí dvě varianty délky trati: 3,5 km pro ženy a 7 km pro muže. Závod je součástí seriálu SABZO a probíhá v malebném prostředí lesoparku Hostivař v Praze 10. Tento závod je vhodný pro běžce, kteří hledají výzvu v přírodním terénu s různorodým povrchem. Přijďte si užít běh v krásné přírodě a poměřit své síly s ostatními běžci.
course_highlights: Terénní trať v lesoparku Hostivař
Dvě délky tratí: 3,5 km pro ženy a 7 km pro muže
Součást seriálu SABZO

name: Žďárák – Čerňák
location: Parking lot by the Church of St. John of Nepomuk on Zelená hora, Žďár nad Sázavou, Česko
description: Čerňák je trailový závod vedený po pěšinkách Černého lesa v okolí Zelené hory a loukách směrem k Vysokému. Trasa dlouhá 7 km s převýšením 180 m nabízí náročné výběhy i seběhy, včetně dvou průchodů přes vrchol Černý les. Závod začíná a končí na parkovišti u kostela na Zelené hoře, významné památce UNESCO, a nabízí krásné výhledy na město Žďár nad Sázavou a okolní přírodu. Doporučuje se terénní obuv, protože 90 % trasy vede terénem a 10 % po asfaltu.
course_highlights: Trasa vede dvakrát přes vrchol Černý les s převýšením 180 m
Oběhnutí poutního kostela sv. Jana Nepomuckého na Zelené hoře (památka UNESCO)
Výhledy na město Žďár nad Sázavou a krásy Černého lesa a okolí Konventského rybníku
additional: Start a cíl závodu je na parkovišti u kostela na Zelené hoře. Trasa je značena. Doporučují se terénní boty. Fotografie ze závodu jsou dostupné na webu klubu za roky 2023, 2024 a 2025. Start i cíl jsou u parkoviště u kostela na Zelené hoře. Startovné je určeno na dobročinnou sbírku na sportovní protézu pro studenta Alexe Vondru.

name: Noční běh pro Světlušku České Budějovice
location: Sportovní hala u Stromovky, České Budějovice, Česko

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Cena startovného je 500 Kč. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do projektu Světluška na úhradu nákladů běhu. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do veřejné sbírky Světluška na přímou pomoc těžce zrakově postiženým.

description: Noční běh pro Světlušku v Českých Budějovicích je charitativní běh pořádaný na podporu těžce zrakově postižených. Startuje se večer ve 21:00 u sportovní haly u Stromovky a účastníci si mohou vybrat mezi tratí 2,3 km (1 okruh) a 4,6 km (2 okruhy). Akce nabízí doprovodný program včetně koncertu a registrace je možná přes portál GoOut.cz. Startovné je 500 Kč, z čehož polovina jde na přímou pomoc zrakově postiženým, a běh je omezen kapacitou pro bezpečnost a pohodlí účastníků.
course_highlights: Noční běh s možností výběru mezi 2,3 km a 4,6 km tratí
Start a cíl u sportovní haly u Stromovky v Českých Budějovicích
Charitativní běh s doprovodným programem a koncertem
additional: Registrace probíhá přes portál GoOut.cz, kde si lze vybrat variantu startovného s čelovkou nebo se sportovní čelenkou. Držitelé průkazů TP, ZTP a ZTP/P mají vstup zdarma, ale bez nároku na čelovku či čelenku. Na místě je k dispozici šatna a úschovna, zajištěno je občerstvení a zdravotní služba. Kapacita běhu je omezena pro bezpečnost účastníků.

name: RHEIN-VOLKSLAUF Maximiliansau
location: Maximiliansau, Wörth am Rhein, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany

name: Top Cross Torunia
description: Top Cross is a series of 12 cross-country races held in Rudelka Forest Park in Toruń. Each race consists of five laps plus a short run-in, for a total distance of approximately 6,666 metres. Participants earn points for taking part, and their eight best results count toward the overall standings. To receive a commemorative medal, participants must take part in at least eight races. It is also possible to complete a race individually without earning points.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in Rudelka Forest Park
The course consists of five laps plus an approximately 200 m run-in
Course length: approximately 6,666 metres
additional: Registration takes place at V LO Toruń, at ul. Sienkiewicza / Fałata. The race office opens one hour before the race. Participants can complete a race individually without earning points. In the series, points are awarded for the eight best results out of 12 races. Points from individual races contribute to the overall standings, which are based on the eight best results. The commemorative medal is awarded for taking part in at least eight races.

name: VSE City run Košice
description: VSE City Run in Košice is a 4 km charity run. The event is open to the general public, including children, students, seniors, and people with disabilities. Entry fees are donated to support the Platform of Families of Children with Disabilities. The run takes place in the centre of Košice and is known for its inclusive atmosphere and community spirit. The organisers work with the Košice Marathon Club and other partners. The aim is not only to promote sport, but also to support families with children with disabilities.

tiers.description: III pula: 250 pakietów na 10 km (suma pakietów podstawowych i rozszerzonych)

tiers.label: tier_4
tiers.description: IV pula: do wyczerpania limitu miejsc

description: The 7th Szczecin Night Run is an exciting sporting event held at night on the streets of Szczecin. Participants can choose between 5- and 10-kilometre routes through the city centre. The event offers a unique atmosphere with striking light displays and numerous attractions in the race village. Every participant will receive a commemorative medal, and the course is certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA).
course_highlights: The course runs through the heart of Szczecin.
Course length: approximately 5 km (one loop) or 10 km (two loops).
The course is certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA).
additional: The race pack includes a race number with a timing chip and 4 safety pins, a commemorative medal, photographers along the course, water at the refreshment point for the 10 km distance, and access to a baggage deposit. The race office is open on 7 May (14:00–20:00) at GALAXY Shopping and Entertainment Centre and on 8 May (16:00–23:00) at the Race Village on Jasne Błonia. The participant limit was 2,000. The 5 km and 10 km distances listed for the 2026 edition were certified by the PZLA.

name: Varínsky lesný beh
organizer: Žilinský pedál, XIRIS, AUTOSKLO Stehlík, Obec Varín
description: The Varín Forest Run is a running event in the foothills of the Malá Fatra, offering beautiful routes with views of the Malá Fatra ridge. Competitors can choose between a longer route of 13.7 km with 600 m of elevation gain and a shorter route of 6.5 km with 120 m of elevation gain. The event is suitable for runners and nature lovers who want to enjoy a run in scenic surroundings. The program also includes children’s races, and a raffle takes place after the results are announced. The organizers are Žilinský pedál, XIRIS, AUTOSKLO Stehlík, and the municipality of Varín.

name: Mistrovství ČR v silničním běhu na 1 míli a 5 km mužů a žen
description: Mistrovství ČR v silničním běhu na 1 míli a 5 km mužů a žen se koná v krásném prostředí lázeňského parku v Poděbradech. Trať je velmi rychlá, s nulovým převýšením a přesně změřenými kilometrovými okruhy lázeňské kolonády, což nabízí ideální podmínky pro osobní rekordy. Závod je oficiálně oceněn Českým atletickým svazem a je součástí prestižního programu Poděbrady Walking. Součástí akce je i doprovodný program a možnost získat originální finišerskou medaili s motivem lázeňské fontány.
course_highlights: 5 km závod na 5x 1 km okruhu lázeňskou kolonádou
1 míle závod s úvodních 609 m a 1 km okruhem lázeňskou kolonádou
Velice rychlá trať s nulovým převýšením, certifikovaná pro Mistrovství Evropy v chůzi
additional: Registrace je možná pouze elektronicky s platbou do 7 dnů od registrace. Pozdější registrace bez jména na startovním čísle. Registrace na místě možná do 30 minut před startem závodu. Finišerská medaile s motivem lázeňské fontány. Doprovodný program po celý den na lázeňské kolonádě. Dostupné informace o programu, přihláškách a cenách se vztahují k ročníku 2026; podrobnosti pro datum 14. 5. 2027 nejsou potvrzeny.

name: Běh vítězství zámeckým parkem Lány
organizer: TJ Sokol Lány a Základní škola Charlotty Garrigue Masarykové
description: Běh vítězství zámeckým parkem Lány je tradiční běžecký závod s historií sahající až do roku 1972, který se koná každoročně 7. května v zámeckém parku v Lánech. Závod nabízí širokou škálu kategorií pro děti i dospělé s tratěmi od 60 metrů až do 7800 metrů, vedenými převážně po pískových cestách a trávě. Pořádají jej TJ Sokol Lány a Základní škola Charlotty Garrigue Masarykové Lány pod záštitou Obce Lány. Závod je vhodný pro všechny věkové kategorie a nabízí příjemné prostředí v krásném parku.
course_highlights: Tratě vedou převážně po pískových cestách a trávě v zámeckém parku
Hlavní závod červeným okruhem 3900 m, muži běží dvě kola, ženy jedno
Dětské tratě od 60 m až po 1500 m s barevně označenými okruhy
additional: Registrace je možná elektronicky do 14:00 dne před závodem nebo v den závodu na místě nejpozději 30 minut před startem kategorie. Prezence probíhá v den závodu od 7:30 u hlavního vstupu do zámeckého parku pod zámeckým skleníkem. Startovní čísla se vyzvedávají při prezenci a řazení na start probíhá 5 minut před startem kategorie. Účastníci "Běhu pro zdraví" startovné neplatí. Závod se tradičně koná 8. května; uvedené datum ročníku 2027 je 7. května.

name: Čavisovská stovka
location: TJ Sokol sports field, Čavisov, Moravian-Silesian Region, Česko
description: Čavisovská stovka je dálkový pochod v okolí Čavisova s trasami o délce 30, 50 a 100 km. Tento tradiční závod nabízí různé náročnosti tras, od pohodové 30 km přes náročnou 50 km až po královskou 100 km trasu pro zkušené účastníky. Start i cíl jsou na hřišti TJ Sokol v Čavisově. Akce je vhodná pro sportovce, kteří chtějí zažít krásy Moravskoslezského kraje v rámci dálkového pochodu.
course_highlights: Trasy 30, 50 a 100 km v okolí Čavisova
Královská 100 km trasa pro zkušené
Start a cíl na hřišti TJ Sokol v Čavisově
additional: Trasy jsou rozděleny na pohodovou 30 km, náročnou 50 km a královskou 100 km. GPS souřadnice startu a cíle: 49° 49' 47.4'' N, 18° 04' 59.1'' E. Registrace probíhá přes formulář na webu, který se spouští automaticky po vypršení časového intervalu. Na webu jsou k dispozici turistické i letecké mapy a výškový profil trasy. Pořadatelé zajišťují na startu občerstvení, WC a sprchu. Účast se psy je možná bez časového limitu.

name: Memoriál obětí fašizmu Čechtice
description: Memoriál obětí fašizmu Čechtice je běžecký závod dlouhý 6 km, který vede terénem v okolí obce Čechtice ve Středočeském kraji. Závod je součástí poháru Běžec Podblanicka a nabízí běžcům možnost změřit síly v přírodním prostředí s mírnými terénními nástrahami. Akce je vhodná pro všechny běžecké nadšence, kteří hledají kvalitní závod s tradicí v regionu.
course_highlights: Terénní trať v okolí obce Čechtice
Délka závodu 6 km
Součást poháru Běžec Podblanicka

name: Strážnická stovka

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné dle datumu přihlášení (pouze pro prvních 150 registrací)

description: Strážnická stovka je extrémní ultra trail maraton dlouhý 100 km, který vede nádhernou přírodou Bílých Karpat v srdci Jižní Moravy. Tento závod je určen pouze pro osoby starší 18 let a vyžaduje skutečné odhodlání a fyzickou připravenost. Trasa je pečlivě značená a závodníci mají k dispozici občerstvovací stanice i možnost převozu drop bagů. Součástí startovného je originální startovní číslo se jménem a odměna za pokoření limitů v podobě kovové placky. Akce nabízí dvě startovní vlny s limity 15 a 24 hodin, aby si každý mohl zvolit svůj závodní cíl.
course_highlights: Trasa vede přes nádhernou přírodu Bílých Karpat a srdce Jižní Moravy
Značení trasy pomocí červených vlajek, šipek sprejem a reflexních nálepek
Občerstvovací stanice a možnost převozu drop bagů na OS Května
additional: Závod nabízí dvě startovní vlny: Limit 24h startuje v pátek v 19:30, Limit 15h startuje v sobotu v 5:00. Akreditace probíhá v pátek od 17:00 do 19:00, náhradníci se hlásí v 18:45. Drop bag musí být menší než 30l, označen startovním číslem a odevzdán v pátek v 18:45. Po závodě je možné věci vyzvednout od soboty 14:00. Součástí startovného je občerstvení v zázemí závodu a na občerstvovacích stanicích, originální startovní číslo se jménem a tričko s logem (pokud bylo objednáno). Startovní číslo a čip obdrží závodníci při akreditaci. Startovní číslo se jménem není součástí startovného pro prvních 150 registrací. Závod je určen pouze osobám starším 18 let.

name: Poděbrady Running - MČR v silničním běhu na 1 míli a 5 km a veřejný běh na 5 km
description: Poděbrady Running je premiérové otevřené mistrovství České republiky v silničním běhu na 1 míli a 5 km, doplněné veřejným během na 5 km.
