Runners can choose from a 50 km course with 2,000 m of elevation gain, a 27 km course with 1,000 m of elevation gain, or an 8.4 km course with 380 m of elevation gain. Each course has its own time limit and categories for women and men under and over 40. The race starts at a farm below Vtáčnik, with refreshments available at several points along the route. The organizer emphasizes mandatory equipment and runner safety.

name: Petržalská 10
description: Petržalská 10 is a popular running race in Bratislava, held at Námestie Republiky in Petržalka. The race offers various categories, including a children’s run, a 10 km main race, Nordic walking, and a family run with a dog. The children’s races start at 10:00 and the main race at 11:30. The organizer, Športová Nadácia Kotrmelec, provides a welcoming atmosphere and high-quality organization for all participants.

name: Medzinárodný Novohradský Maratón štafety
location: Salgótarján (HU) - Lučenec, Salgótarján (HU) - Lučenec, Hlavné námestie
description: The International Novohrad Marathon Relay is a running relay marathon held along a route between the cities of Salgótarján in Hungary and Lučenec in Slovakia. The course is 42.2 km long and is divided into four legs, run by four relay team members. The race is open to men’s, women’s, and mixed teams, with mixed teams required to have at least 50% women and 50% men. Refreshment stations are provided along the course, and at the finish there is goulash, sports trophies, and cash prizes for the top relay teams. The race starts at 10:00, and registration is available online or on site if places remain.

name: Hlbocký boyard – extrémny beh s prekážkami
location: Hlboké nad Váhom, Hlboké nad Váhom, Areál pri futbalovom ihrisku
description: Hlbocký Boyard is an extreme individual race held in the village of Hlboké nad Váhom. This 6th edition features one lap with plenty of adrenaline-fueled obstacles and steep hills on a motocross track. Competitors will race in nine categories by age and gender, including children’s categories. Runners can enjoy the fresh air, challenges on the course, and, after the race, awards, refreshments, and commemorative items.

name: Jacovská dvadsiatka
description: Jacovská dvadsiatka is a running race held in Jacovce at the football stadium. The event offers two courses: the main 22 km race and an 8 km hobby run, both along asphalt and gravel farm roads. The 22 km race starts at 10:00 and the 8 km run at 10:15. The event is suitable for various age groups and genders and is organized by ATK Javorina Jacovce. Entry fees are affordable, making the event accessible to a wide running community.

name: Kostolanský májovec
location: Veľké Kostoľany, Veľké Kostoľany, futbalový štadión
description: Kostolanský májovec is a running event organized by run ForRest run o.z., held at the Michal Podolan Football Stadium in Veľké Kostoľany. Runners can choose between two courses, 10.90 km and 5.40 km long, both with 64 meters of elevation gain and a surface combining asphalt and meadow. The start is scheduled for 11:00. Competitors are divided into age categories, with awards for the fastest Kostolanec and Kostolanka. The event offers a refreshment station and is suitable for runners looking for a pleasant run with moderate elevation gain in a beautiful setting.

name: Sninský trailový polmaratón
description: The Snina Trail Half Marathon is a running event in Snina, Slovakia, offering two courses: the main 21 km course and a shorter 7.5 km course. The race is for all trail-running enthusiasts who want to enjoy the beauty of nature and the challenges of the terrain. The organizers welcome runners of all levels and offer the lively atmosphere of a quality sporting event.

name: Beh Soviou Poľanou
location: Podolínec - Podolínske lesy, Podolínec - Podolínske lesy, Kaplnka sv. Huberta
description: The Run Under Soviou Poľanou in Podolínec is a forest running race that offers quality training and a chance to test your abilities on mountain terrain. The race is suitable for runners who want to enjoy an exhilarating day in nature and prepare for important races in the season. The route passes through picturesque forests around Podolínec and offers a challenge even for experienced runners.

name: Mravenčárska míľa
location: Plavecký Štvrtok okr. Malacky, Plavecký Štvrtok okr. Malacky, futbalový štadión
description: The Ant Mile is a running event held at the football stadium in Plavecký Štvrtok. The races offer categories for men and women across various age groups, as well as for children, school-age participants, youth, juniors, Nordic walking, and canicross. The school-age race starts at 10:10 and the main category at 12:00. The event is organized by the Plavecký Štvrtok Municipal Office, which provides a pleasant atmosphere and quality organization for all participants.

name: Niže Linča
location: Zeleneč,, okr. rnava, Zeleneč,, okr. rnava, Vinohrady Zeleneč
organizer: Dobrovoľníci z obce Zeleneč, Obecný úrad Zeleneč, Vinársky spolok vinárov a vinohradníkov Zeleneč, DHZ Zeleneč, Zdravotnícka služba Zeleneč
description: Niže Linča is a running event in Zeleneč, organized by volunteers from the village together with local associations and the medical service. The race is open to men, women, and juniors under 18, with prizes also awarded to the fastest man and woman from Linč. The entry fee includes admission to a wine tasting during the St. Urban Festival, giving the event a unique atmosphere and bringing sport and culture together. Online registration will open and the race will take place.

name: Martinský offroad maratón a polmaratón
description: The Martin Off-Road Marathon and Half Marathon is a running event held in the beautiful natural surroundings of the Fatra region, in Tomčany near Martin. Runners can enjoy running across meadows, hills, and the foothills of the Fatra, with stunning views of the Lúčanská, Krivánska, and Veľká Fatra ranges. The course is off-road, with natural obstacles such as mud and fallen trees, adding to its appeal and challenge for runners. The event is intended for runners of different abilities, who can choose a trail that suits their skills and preferences.

name: AZ-Pneu Vertical – Dúbravský beh na Kobylu
location: Bratislava, Bratislava, Mestská časť Dúbravka, Ul. Pod záhradami (pri Lidli)
description: AZ-Pneu Vertical – Dúbravský beh na Kobylu is a running event in Bratislava offering races for children and adults. The race takes place in the Dúbravka district, starting on Pod záhradami Street (by Lidl). You can compete in the 10 km AZ-pneu Vertical, the 5 km Dôverun, or the children’s races. The event is organized by Beh si ty, o.z., together with the Dúbravka District Municipality. The race is suitable for the general public and offers categories by age and gender.

name: Beh s vlkmi pre život
description: Run with the Wolves for Life is a charity running event organized by the CHADIM’S CHARITY Foundation. It takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Čierne, at the tripoint of Slovakia, Czechia, and Poland. The event offers six different courses, including a half marathon, a 10K, a 5K, Nordic walking, and children’s races. The courses run mainly along paved and forest roads, with beautiful mountain views. Runners can expect well-organized routes with clear markings, refreshment stations, and a support vehicle carrying water. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes a healthy lifestyle and charitable causes.

name: Hutňanská šelma
location: Novoveská Huta, Novoveská Huta, Remeselný šenk za Holubnicou
description: Hutňanská šelma is a running event in Novoveská Huta, offering races for both children and adults. The races take place in the pleasant setting of Remeselný šenk za Holubnicou and are divided into several age categories, with awards for the top three finishers. The children’s races start at 10:00, and the races for adults and older children start at 13:00. The event is suitable for runners of different ages and ability levels.

name: Vysocká pětka - vzpomínka na Jirku S.
location: Vysoká nad Labem, Hradec Králové, Česko
description: Vysocká pětka je běžecký závod na 5 km, který se koná v obci Vysoká nad Labem. Závod je vzpomínkou na Jirku S. a tradičně se běží po cyklostezce. Start je plánován na 9:00 s prezentací od 8:00. Akce je otevřená všem běžcům a nabízí příjemnou atmosféru s možností výhry v tombole.
course_highlights: Délka trati 5 km
Závod po cyklostezce
Přátelská atmosféra s tombolou
additional: Prezentace účastníků od 8:00, start závodu v 9:00, závod se běží po cyklostezce, možnost výhry v tombole. Závod je součástí místního sportovního kalendáře a je otevřený široké veřejnosti. Přesné délky tratí a registrační informace zatím nejsou zveřejněny.

name: Běh pro Paměť národa - Kladno
description: Běh pro Paměť národa v Libčicích nad Vltavou je sportovně-společenská akce pořádaná na podporu neziskové organizace Post Bellum, která dokumentuje osudy pamětníků a pomáhá jim. Závod nabízí měřené běhy na 5 km a 10 km s hromadným startem, které vedou zpevněnými cestami a asfaltem v lesoparku a po cyklostezce. Akce je vhodná pro všechny věkové kategorie a podporuje připomínání historie a odvahy bojovníků za svobodu. Startovní čísla se vydávají v den závodu na místě registrace. Součástí je i dětský běh a možnost symbolického běhu "Kdekoli!" mimo oficiální tratě.

name: Půlmaraton údolím Moravské Sázavy
description: Půlmaraton údolím Moravské Sázavy je tradiční běžecký závod konaný v malebném prostředí Zábřehu na Moravě. Trať o délce 21,0975 km je certifikovaná podle pravidel IAAF a vede převážně rovinatým terénem s mírným stoupáním mezi Nemilí a Hněvkovem. Závod je součástí Velké ceny vytrvalců Olomouckého kraje a nabízí kvalitní zázemí včetně občerstvovacích stanic a dětského závodu. Startuje se od Plaveckého areálu v Zábřehu, kde je také cíl závodu, a účastníci obdrží symbolickou medaili a občerstvení v cíli.

name: Lesní půlmaraton Říčany
location: Sportovní areál U školy - Říčany, Středočeský
description: Lesní půlmaraton Říčany je běžecký závod vedený výhradně po krásných lesních cestách a pěšinách bez asfaltu. Okolní příroda v oblasti Říčan je koncem května velmi malebná, což přispívá k příjemnému zážitku z běhu. Závod je vhodný pro milovníky přírodního terénu a krosového běhu, kteří chtějí zažít lesní atmosféru a výzvu v podobě půlmaratonské vzdálenosti. Organizátoři vítají běžce všech úrovní a podporují sdílení zkušeností ze závodu.

name: Příbramský půlmaraton
description: Příbramský půlmaraton je tradiční běžecký závod v Příbrami, který nabízí půlmaratonskou trať, štafetový závod, fitness běh a závody dětí. Závod je známý svou novou trasou a magickou atmosférou zejména při seběhu na náměstí. Každoročně přitahuje širokou běžeckou komunitu a nabízí kvalitní zázemí včetně občerstvení a parkování.

name: Běh cestou necestou 13 km Prahou 13
location: Centrální park Stodůlky, Praha 13, Prague, Česko
description: Běh cestou necestou je běžecký závod konaný v Praze 13, který nabízí tratě na 13 a 5 km. Závod vede malebnými zákoutími Centrálního parku Stodůlky a Přírodního parku Prokopské údolí. Start je ve 13:13:13 hod. a závodníci mohou využít občerstvení na trati i v cíli. Závod je otevřen všem a probíhá v duchu fair play s důrazem na dodržování vyznačené trasy.

name: Teplýšovický běh
description: Teplýšovický běh je charitativní závod konaný v malebné vesničce Teplýšovice nedaleko Benešova. V roce 2026 se uskuteční již 6. ročník s tratěmi 5 km, 10 km, 15 km trail, Nordic Walking 11 km a dětskými závody. Hlavní trať vede přes rozhlednu Špulka a nabízí krásnou přírodu a náročnost. Všechny tratě jsou měřeny čipovou časomírou a každý účastník obdrží medaili. Startovné částečně přispívá na obnovu ovocných alejí v okolí.

name: Suchdol běží
description: Suchdol běží je součástí sedmého ročníku běžeckého seriálu Běhej s námi 2026, který je určen široké veřejnosti. Závod se koná v Praze 6 - Suchdole, start a cíl jsou v prostoru Komunitní zahrady. Trať vede po zpevněných polních a lesních cestách s převýšením 96 metrů, nabízí běžcům příjemný běh po rovině i seběh dolů do údolí a návrat lesními cestami. Kategorie jsou rozděleny na děti a dospělé podle věkových skupin, přičemž závodníci mladší 18 let mohou startovat jen s písemným souhlasem zákonného zástupce.

name: 23. Rintelner Volksbank-Lauf
description: The Rintelner Volksbank Run takes place on May 23, 2027, in the historic old town of Rinteln. The course runs through the old town and the ramparts over cobblestones, paved roads, and footpaths. A range of events is offered for children, young people, and adults, including a Bambini run, school races, walking, and 5 km and 10 km races. The event is family-friendly and features electronic timing with a disposable chip. The Vereinigte Turnerschaft Rinteln 1848 e.V. organizes the run and is strongly committed to recreational and health-focused sports in the region.
course_highlights: Course through Rinteln’s old town and ramparts
Run over cobblestones, paved roads, and footpaths
The 5 km and 10 km courses are DLV-measured and eligible for official rankings
additional: Race bibs can be collected the day before from 17:00 to 19:00 and on race day until 60 minutes before the start at the Westliches Weserbergland tourism office. Timing is electronic, using a disposable chip in the race bib (RACE RESULT). Personal chips are not permitted. Running shoes with spikes are not allowed. Late entries are possible for a fee of €2. The program includes Bambini and school races, as well as walking and Nordic walking alongside the running events. Participants receive a commemorative medal.

name: Brunnenfestlauf 2026
organizer: Turn- und Sportgemeinde 1861 e. V. Oberursel (TSGO)
description: The Brunnenfestlauf Oberursel is a long-standing race that starts and finishes at the historic market square in the heart of Oberursel. The course runs through pleasant residential areas, woodland and meadows, offering runners of all ages a varied running experience. In addition to the main races over 10 km, the half marathon and 5 km, there is also a 3 km schoolchildren’s and Sports Badge race, as well as a Bambini run for the youngest participants. The event is part of the Brunnenfest and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with categories for different age groups and youth divisions.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Oberursel’s historic market square
Course through residential areas, woodland and meadows
Varied race distances from 0.8 km to the half marathon
additional: Late entries are possible on race day until 09:30. The races start in staggered order: 10:00 — 10 km & half marathon; 10:10 — 5 km; 12:35 — 3 km schoolchildren’s and Sports Badge race; 13:05 — Bambini run. There is a €5 late-entry fee for all races except the 3 km race. The event supports the German Sports Badge and offers a 3 km Sports Badge race. Supported by local sports clubs, with a focus on youth races and the Sports Badge, at historic venues.

name: Freigerichter Benzinglauf
description: The Freigerichter Benzinglauf is a scenic fun run that follows varied trails over the first hills of the Spessart. The start and finish for all routes are at the DJK clubhouse in Freigericht-Neuses. The three different routes mainly follow woodland, forest and gravel paths, with a small proportion on asphalt. Plenty of refreshments are available along the course and at the finish. The event offers various distances for runners, walkers and children, with suitable options for all age groups and ability levels.
course_highlights: 90% woodland, forest and gravel paths; 10% asphalt
Routes climb the first hills of the Spessart
Start and finish at the DJK clubhouse in Freigericht-Neuses
additional: Bib pickup and late registration at the DJK clubhouse in Neuses. Starts for the half marathon (21.2 km), 10 km and 5 km runs, as well as 10 km and 5 km walking/Nordic walking. Bambini and schoolchildren’s races for different age groups. Food and refreshments are provided. A running event with several distances, including races for children and young people, starting and finishing at the DJK clubhouse in Neuses. The event offers a challenge ranking for participants who take part in several races.

name: Pi Lauf 2026
description: The Pi Run 2026 in Neunkirchen-Seelscheid offers a diverse range of races for all age groups and ability levels. The event includes distances ranging from Bambini and children’s races to a 13.4-kilometer main race, as well as walking. The course is scenic, with refreshment stations and good on-site facilities. Every finisher receives a medal, and the top runners are honored. The Lions Club will provide cakes and drinks.
course_highlights: 13.431 km main race with two refreshment stations at km 6.5 and 11.5
Short Bambini and children’s races (approx. 600 m and 1,100 m)
Refreshment station on the recreational race course at approx. 3 km
additional: Race number pickup is available from 08:00 on race day in the start/finish area or in the nearby school building. Late registration is possible until 60 minutes before each start, with a €2 late registration fee. Changing facilities and toilets are available in school buildings and nearby halls. There is ample parking nearby. Every finisher receives a medal, and Bambini runners can get a scoop of ice cream from the sponsor. Registration is through the Race Result platform; participants receive running shirts and a multifunctional scarf. The event takes place in typical temperatures of around 20°C.

name: Ra(h)ser-Run
description: The Ra(h)ser-Run is a flat race through the Rahser district of Viersen, with distances from 1 km to 10 km. The 5 km and 10 km courses are measured by the DLV and eligible for ranking lists, and run mostly along paved paths beside the Niers floodplains. The event offers races for different age groups, including a Bambini run for the youngest participants and a schools’ city championship. Timing is electronic, using transponders in the race bibs. Registration is online only; late registration is available until 60 minutes before the start.
course_highlights: Flat, paved loops through Rahser and along the Niers floodplains
The 5 km and 10 km courses are measured by the DLV and eligible for ranking lists
Kilometre markers and course marshals along the route
additional: Late registration is available until 60 minutes before each start for an additional fee of €5. Race bibs contain an integrated transponder for electronic timing, with both gun and net times. Sittarder Straße will be closed to through traffic between Kränkelsweg and Oberrahserstraße for the duration of the event. Participants can purchase an event T-shirt as part of online registration until 07.05. School and children’s races, free training sessions at Hoher Busch Stadium, race distances for different grade levels.

name: Spatzenberg-Lauf
description: The Spatzenberg Run is a traditional fun run in Löhne, following a hilly circular course around and over the Spatzenberg in the nature reserve. The route runs mostly on paved paths and roads and offers an attractive running opportunity for all age groups. In addition to the 9 km main race, there are shorter 6 km and 3 km races for schoolchildren. The event is organised by Turn- und Rasensportverein Löhne 1910 e.V., running group, and takes place at the Obernfeld sports field.
course_highlights: Hilly circular course around and over the Spatzenberg (nature reserve)
Route on paved paths and roads
Distances: 9 km, 6 km and 3 km schoolchildren’s race
additional: Timing is provided by a disposable chip attached to the back of the race bib. Race materials can be collected from 9:00 on the event day at the Obernfeld sports field. Late entries are possible on the event day until 10:15, while race bibs are available. Payment by SEPA direct debit for online registration or in cash when collecting race materials. Hilly course around the Spatzenberg, registration online or on the event day, timing with a disposable chip, water at the finish station

name: Sponsorenlauf Brustkrebshilfe Dorsten
location: Bürgerpark Maria Lindenhof, Dorsten, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
organizer: Khadijeh Mohri, Andreas Schilasky, Ali Abdali
description: The Sponsorship Run for Breast Cancer Support Dorsten is a charity event in Dorsten focused on supporting breast cancer services and raising awareness. It takes place in Bürgerpark Maria Lindenhof and offers various running and walking routes accessible to all ages and fitness levels. Alongside the sporting activities, supporting breast cancer services is the main focus. A minimum participation fee is charged, and participants can contribute additional donations. Participants can run, walk, or support the cause with a donation without taking part in the race.
course_highlights: Event in Bürgerpark Maria Lindenhof, with wide paths and plenty of green space
Distances: 800 m for children, 2.5 km and 5 km for running or walking
Accessible changing rooms and showers on site
additional: More than 2,000 participants are expected, with a fundraising goal of over 50,000 euros.

name: Steinberger Wald-Volkslauf
description: The 49th Steinberger Wald-Volkslauf takes place in Dietzenbach-Steinberg. The event is organized by SC Steinberg and offers runners a sporting challenge in a natural woodland setting. Participants can look forward to well-marked courses suitable for both competitive and recreational runners. A longstanding tradition, the event warmly invites everyone who enjoys running to take part.
course_highlights: Woodland courses in a natural setting
Well-marked 5 km and 10 km courses
Varied routes with moderate terrain
additional: There are two main courses, 5 km and 10 km long. Designed as woodland runs, they offer varied surroundings. The event is organized by SC Steinberg, which also offers other sporting activities such as cross-country skiing, triathlon and running groups. Courses: 5 km and 10 km; online registration; sporting activities; club race

name: MAXiLauf 2026
organizer: Stadt Hamm, Amt für Konzernsteuerung und Sport
description: The MAXiLAUF in Hamm is an annual running event featuring flat, record-eligible courses that appeal to runners of all ability levels. Events include a half marathon, a 10 km run, a 5 km run, and children’s and toddlers’ races. The courses run through the city of Hamm and offer an attractive, approved circuit route passing many landmarks. All participants receive an exclusive medal, and trophies are awarded to the leading runners. The event is family-friendly and part of the Landesturnfest LTF26.
course_highlights: Flat, DLV-measured circuit courses through the city of Hamm
Courses eligible for inclusion in best lists
Attractive routes passing many landmarks
additional: Bib-number distribution from approx. 8:30 a.m. at the Stadtsportbund tent. Timing uses a race|result® chip attached to the bib. On-site registration is available. Cut-off times: half marathon 150 min, 10 km 90 min, 5 km 50 min. Personalised medal engraving can be booked for an additional fee. Certificates are available on-site and online. Official merchandise is available in the shop. The race features a DLV-measured circuit, medals for all finishers, online and on-site registration, and a festive atmosphere for runners and spectators.

name: Wachtelrun - Volkslauf mit Hauptlauf und Schülerläufen & Nordic Walking
Myślenicki Festiwal Biegowy
description: Myślenice Running Festival 2027 is the first edition of a half marathon in Myślenice, taking place on 23 May 2027. The start and finish are located in picturesque Zarabie, and the course is flat and runs through the city centre. The 21.0975 km race is certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA), ensuring professional timekeeping and high-quality organization. The festival will also feature other running events, including a corporate relay, children’s races, and the night-time Rave Run. The organizers invite runners to join group training sessions with the DALIN running section and to volunteer.
course_highlights: A flat, PZLA-certified 21.0975 km course
Start and finish in picturesque Zarabie, Myślenice
The course runs through the city centre, with markings every 1 km and 4 refreshment stations
additional: The half marathon is limited to 800 participants. The start may be organized in waves based on declared finish times. There are 4 refreshment stations along the course, spaced approximately 5 km apart, and a station at the finish. The race pack includes a race bib with a timing chip, accident insurance, a medal, water, and a post-race meal. The organizers invite runners to join group training sessions with Dalin Myślenice Sports Club and to volunteer; recruitment opens in January 2027. The program also includes a 4×5 km corporate relay, children’s races over 400 and 800 m, and the 5 km night-time Rave Run. Register via dostartu.pl by 16 May 2027 or until places are filled. Half-marathon participants must be at least 16 years old; those aged 16–17 need a parent or guardian’s consent.

name: Biegi Śnieżnickie
description: The Śnieżnickie Runs are legendary mountain races held in picturesque Międzygórze, in the heart of the Śnieżnik Massif. The routes feature challenging climbs and technical descents, taking runners along beautiful forest trails and gravel roads, as well as to the very summit of Śnieżnik. This event has a rich tradition dating back to the 1990s and attracts both recreational runners and elite athletes from across Europe. Participants can choose between the classic 9.6 km alpine race and the Śnieżnik Half Marathon, approximately 21 km long, which loops around the Crown of Śnieżnik.

name: 14. Bieg Firmowy Wrocław
description: Bieg Firmowy is Poland’s largest charity relay, held in Wrocław. Corporate teams of five cover a total distance of 25 km, with each participant running or walking 5 km. The event combines sport, team building, and support for the beneficiaries of the Everest Foundation, who are facing serious health challenges. Participants can choose the in-person format at the University of Physical Education and the Olympic Stadium in Wrocław, or run online from anywhere in the world. Bieg Firmowy is not only a sporting event, but also an important social and charitable initiative.

name: 12 Bieg Elegant na 5
description: The 12th Elegant na 5 Run is an annual running event held in Mosina, scheduled for May 24 in 2026. The event offers a variety of distances for children, young people and people with disabilities, as well as a 5 km main race that runs through the streets of the Mosina municipality. The start and finish are at Plac 20 Października, and the main race begins at 11:15. Participants can choose a basic or extended package with a T-shirt, making the event appealing to a wide range of runners.

name: Bieg o rogatywkę rotmistrza Witolda Pile...
description: The Captain Witold Pilecki’s Cap Race is organized by the “Zielone Światło Dla Wrząsowic” Association in Wrząsowice. The race starts at 10:00. Timing is provided electronically by Time-Sport.pl, a leader in timing at sporting events in Poland. This sporting event combines the spirit of competition with a tribute to Captain Witold Pilecki, giving it a unique character.

name: Biegamy, nie klikamy!
organizer: Biegamy, nie klikamy i Rotary Club Warszawa Konstancin
description: Biegamy, nie klikamy! is a charity 5 km run held in the picturesque Chojnów Landscape Park in Konstancin-Jeziorna. The course consists of two 2.5 km loops through pine and mixed forests, with gentle terrain suitable for runners of all levels. The start and finish are located at the forest car park on Od Lasu Street, providing easy access and convenient conditions for spectators. The event promotes inclusion and supports a charitable cause, with all proceeds going to the Special Education School Complex in Pęchery. Participation is free for primary and secondary school students.

name: BoryRun
description: The event brings together sport, health and mindful time spent offline, promoting intergenerational inclusion and the joy of movement without the pressure of competition. The routes pass through the scenic Lower Silesian Forests and the historic grounds of Kliczków Castle, offering a chance to connect with nature and the region’s history. Children can take part in the special Boryrun Active race, featuring activities that develop fitness and confidence.

name: Gontyniec Ultra Trail
description: Gontyniec Ultra Trail is a mountain trail race held on the picturesque Gontyniec Hill in Chodzież, the highest elevation in the Greater Poland Lake District. The courses run mainly along forest trails marked with red and yellow signs, offering runners a variety of distances and elevation gains. Organized by the Gontyniec Ultra Trail Foundation, the event attracts cross-country and ultrarunning enthusiasts from across Poland, offering unique challenges over distances from 12 to 52 km. This iconic event combines sporting competition with the beauty of nature and the history of the region.

name: II Charytatywny Bieg Świetlika
organizer: Fundacja Śląskie Hospicjum dla Dzieci Świetlikowo
description: The Świetlik Charity Run is a family-friendly event at the Paprocany Leisure Centre in Tychy, organised by the Silesian Hospice for Children Świetlikowo Foundation in cooperation with MOSiR Tychy. The aim of the run is to support the construction of the Silesian Inpatient Hospice for Children “TuSieTuli”. The second edition took place, with the main race starting at 11:00. Participants could choose between 5 km and 10 km races, or a 5 km Nordic walking event beside Paprocany Lake.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km routes beside Paprocany Lake
5 km Nordic walking event
Children’s and youth races from 100 to 800 m
additional: In 2026, the children’s and youth races started at 10:00, and registration was online. The date of the 2027 edition has not yet been announced.

name: IV Honorowy Bieg Kadecki
description: The 4th Honorary Cadet Run is a special sporting event organized by I LO PUL Kutno – Uniformed Services High School, held to mark the Regimental Day of the 37th Infantry Regiment. The run pays tribute to local history and uniformed services traditions. Participants tackle a 5.5 km obstacle course at the military training ground in Kutno. The event is held under the honorary patronage of the Mayor of Kutno, Mariusz Sikora, and invites everyone who enjoys physical activity to compete and have fun. The run starts at 13:00 at the AMZ S.A. training ground in Kutno, on Metalowa Street.

name: Kęcka Piątka
description: Kęcka Piątka is a 5 km road race held in the picturesque town of Kęty. The certified course runs through the town streets, with key turns and junctions secured to ensure participants’ safety. The race is a local sporting celebration that promotes a healthy lifestyle and physical activity among residents and visitors. It is organized by the Kęty Sports and Recreation Centre under the patronage of the Mayor of the Kęty Municipality. Runners aged 14 and over are invited to take part in this energetic event.

name: Mucharskie Pętle
description: Mucharskie Pętle Run is a unique running event set in the picturesque surroundings of Lake Mucharskie and the hills of the Little Beskids. The course is suitable for both beginner runners and those looking for a more challenging trail run. The organizers invite all running enthusiasts and anyone who enjoys a great sporting atmosphere to take part in the event, which will be held in Mucharz. Places are limited, and registration is online.

name: Prusice Biegają - etap 2
description: The 13th edition of Prusice Biegają is a sporting event held on Żmigrodzka Street, next to the Prusice Fitness Center in Prusice. The course runs along the streets of Prusice and through Pietrowice Małe, offering participants scenic and runner-friendly conditions. The event is a great opportunity to spend time actively and compete within the local running community.

name: VI Niechanowska Dyszka i Piątka
description: The 6th Niechanowo 10K and 5K is an annual race held in the picturesque Planty Park in Niechanowo. The event offers two popular race distances: 10 km and 5 km, attracting both recreational and more experienced runners. It is an athletics event and a great opportunity to spend time outdoors in a friendly atmosphere. The organizers provide professional timekeeping and technical support.

name: XII Bieg z książką
description: The 12th Run with a Book, ON THE TRAIL TO THE FINISH, is an open running event organized by the Nicolaus Copernicus University Alumni Program and the NCUM Marathon Club. It is dedicated to the Nicolaus Copernicus University in Toruń community and to fans of running and reading. The race takes place on the university campus in Bielany, Toruń, and its route follows forest paths and lanes through the campus woodland. Participants must complete the course while holding a book weighing at least 100 grams, highlighting the event’s unique combination of sport and the promotion of reading. The race is sponsored by Robert Małecki, a crime fiction author and NCUM alumnus, who takes part in the race and meets participants after the competition.

name: XVII Bieg Uliczny o Łaziskie Liście
organizer: Miasto Łaziska Górne, MOSiR Łaziska Górne
description: The 17th A. Kaleja “Łaziskie Liście” Street Race is an annual running event held in Łaziska Górne. In 2026, it will take place on May 24 at the municipal stadium. Runners can compete over 5 km and 10 km distances; the 10 km course consists of two laps of the 5 km course. The event also includes races for children, young people and seniors, held the day before, bringing generations together through sport. Registration for the main races and Nordic walking is online only. The event is organized by the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Łaziska Górne, which works to ensure accessibility and support for all participants.

name: XXII Bieg Sanguszków
organizer: Uczniowski Klub Sportowy „OGRODNIK” i Zespół Szkół Ekonomiczno-Ogrodniczych w Tarnowie
description: The 22nd Sanguszko Run is an annual running event held in Sanguszko Park in Tarnów. The event is organised by Kępa Sport, LKS Burzyn and the “OGRODNIK” Student Sports Club. The run aims to promote running and bring the running community together. Participants can expect electronic timekeeping and professional event organisation.

name: 4 Bieg pamięci Stanisława Dzięgielewskiego
description: Bieg ku pamięci Stanisława Dzięgielewskiego is a run in Obierwia honouring the first marathon runner of the Kurpie region. It is organised by the Projekt Radomir association. The 2026 edition took place on Sunday 24 May. The routes run through pine forests, sandy roads and the countryside along the Omulew river, with running and nordic walking categories.
course_highlights: Routes through pine forest and sandy roads
5 km and 10 km runs plus 5 km nordic walking
Family walk for those not racing
additional: Participants were offered food after the race. The 2027 date has not been announced yet.

name: Bieg 760-lecia Bierutowa
organizer: Ośrodek Kultury i Sportu w Bierutowie
price_range: Bieg główny: 50 zł; biegi honorowy i dziecięcy: bezpłatnie
description: The 760th Anniversary of Bierutów Run is a unique sporting event organized by the Bierutów Culture and Sport Centre to commemorate the 760th anniversary of Bierutów being granted town rights. The run follows a route around Bierutów’s Old Town, giving participants the chance to celebrate local history and bring the community together. The event combines family-friendly activities and sport, with different participant categories, including the main race and Nordic walking. The organizers provide professional event support, with the start and finish set in an attractive location on the Market Square in Bierutów.
course_highlights: The 7,600 m main race route runs around Bierutów’s Old Town
A mix of surfaces: asphalt, unpaved road, and cobblestones
Start and finish on the Market Square in Bierutów
additional: The race office is located at the Sports and Entertainment Hall at 3 Krasińskiego Street. After the main race, a family picnic is held with activities for children and adults, followed by a trophy presentation for the winners. The main race is limited to 100 participants registering online. In previous editions, the children’s race covered 200 m around the town hall tower. Information about distances, the route, and fees comes from the invitation to the 2026 edition.

name: IX Bieg Uliczny Z Siódemką na 7-kę
organizer: Szkoła Podstawowa nr 7 im. Konstantego Ildefonsa Gałczyńskiego w Częstochowie
description: The 9th Z Siódemką na 7-kę Street Run is an annual running event organized by Konstanty Ildefons Gałczyński Primary School No. 7 in Częstochowa. The event takes place in the picturesque Lisiniec Park, offering participants the chance to compete on a street-running course. The run promotes physical activity and brings the local community together, particularly students and residents of Częstochowa. The organizers ensure a sporting atmosphere and participant safety.
course_highlights: Street course in Lisiniec Park in Częstochowa
Picturesque park surroundings make for an enjoyable run
Organized by a local school with a sporting tradition
additional: Information about the course and children’s races comes from the 2023 edition.

name: XII Bieg Ulicami Bohaterów
location: Rynek, Plac Tadeusza Kościuszki, Małogoszcz, Poland
description: The Małogoszcz Streets Run – Heroes’ Run is an annual running event held in Małogoszcz that combines athletic competition with a voluntary blood donation campaign. Races are held over various distances suited to different age groups, from the youngest children to adults. The start and finish are at the Market Square, at Tadeusz Kościuszko Square, and the courses run through the town streets. The event promotes physical activity and remembrance of heroes, offering prizes in age categories and special cash cards for the winners.
course_highlights: Race distances range from 300 m to 10,000 m
Start and finish at the Market Square, Tadeusz Kościuszko Square, in Małogoszcz
Courses suited to different age categories
additional: Residents of Małogoszcz municipality are eligible to compete in the children’s and youth categories (ages 4–15); other participants may run out of competition and are not eligible for the main prizes. Prizes are cash cards redeemable at stores with a payment terminal anywhere in the country. The event program runs from 15:00 to 16:55. The registration form allows you to quickly contact the organizer and system administrator. Previous editions included children’s and youth categories for ages 4–15; these were open to residents of Małogoszcz municipality, while others ran out of competition. Participants who finished the race received a commemorative medal.

name: XVII Bieg Wegański
description: The Vegan Run is an annual running event held in Warsaw that promotes a healthy, vegan lifestyle. The route runs mainly along the path by the Vistula River, offering participants scenic views and pleasant running conditions. The event is open to everyone who wants to combine sport with veganism and an active lifestyle. The organizers provide professional support and assistance from volunteers.
course_highlights: The route runs mainly along the path by the Vistula River
Scenic views along the river
Pleasant running conditions in Warsaw
additional: Before collecting their race packs, participants should check that their names are on the start list. This helps the volunteers work efficiently and reduces waiting times. For errors in registration or questions, participants can contact the organizers by email: info@runvegan.pl.

name: XXII Bieg Patrona Miasta św. Andrzeja Boboli
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Czechowicach-Dziedzicach
description: The 22nd St. Andrew Bobola City Patron Run is an annual road race held at the MOSiR Stadium in Czechowice-Dziedzice. The 10 km course is clearly marked and designed for runners of various ability levels. Participants can expect electronic timekeeping and water stations. After finishing, each runner receives a commemorative medal, water, and a recovery meal, reflecting the organizers’ commitment to participants’ comfort and satisfaction.
course_highlights: 10 km course marked every 1 km
Water station near the 6.2 km mark
Electronic timekeeping using a chip in the race bib
additional: The race office is open from 10:30 to 12:30 before the main stadium entrance. The time limit for 5 km is 45 minutes, and the time limit for the full race is 90 minutes. The race bib with the timing chip must be worn on the front of the shirt and cannot be exchanged. The winners’ awards ceremony is scheduled for 15:00. In 2026, the event was held as part of the “Run for Health 2026” series; a charity collection for Nikos was held during the event.

name: Myślenicki Półmaraton
description:
As part of the First Myślenice Running Festival, the organizers are planning four race formats: a PZLA-certified half marathon, the 4×5 km Business Relay, the 5 km Saturday Night Rave Run, and children’s races.
The event will also feature a Runner’s Village with an EXPO zone and space for families.
The organizers are especially keen to welcome people who will run their first half marathon in Myślenice.

images.alt_text: Stadion lekkoatletyczny z widokiem na bieżnię i boisko przy zachodzie słońca
Biegacze biegnący przez most nad rzeką w otoczeniu zieleni o zmierzchu
Widok z lotu ptaka na rynek i zabudowania Myślenic w słoneczny dzień
Rynek w Myślenicach z widokiem na góry i budynki w tle

name: VeganRun
description: VeganRun Slovakia is the first official Slovak vegan running event, organized by the Slovak Vegan Society. The event brings together sport, health, and compassion, offering more than just a run—it is a shared step toward a healthier body, a cleaner planet, and a more informed society. The routes start at the iconic Rača Amphitheatre and follow the boundary between the Carpathian forest and vineyards, offering forest therapy, varied terrain, and epic views of Bratislava. Runners can choose between 5 km, 10 km, and Canicross, which lets them run with their dog.

name: Bytčiansky Kros
organizer: Behači Bytča a okolie, v spolupráci s Mesto Bytča
description: Bytčiansky Kros is a traditional running race in Bytča, offering four courses of varying lengths and difficulty, including the 21 km Super Kros with 500 m of elevation gain. The course runs mostly over natural terrain, such as farm tracks, meadows and cycle paths, with 80% off-road and 20% paved surfaces. Runners can expect three refreshment stations on the longer courses and clearly marked routes. Competitions are divided into age categories for both men and women, with the top three in each category receiving awards.

name: 01. Godelheimer See Marathon
description: The 1st Godelheimer See Marathon/Ultra in Höxter is taking place and is a premiere event with DUV recognition. The event gives runners the opportunity to experience a new route around Godelheimer See. The race is aimed at marathon and ultramarathon runners and promises a varied and challenging course in a natural setting. The organizer is 100 Marathon Club Deutschland, a club for experienced marathon runners.

name: TEMPO MAKERS RUN Plzeň – květnový závod
description: TEMPO MAKERS RUN Plzeň je pravidelný běžecký závod pořádaný v Plzni, který nabízí trať dlouhou 8 km. Závod se koná na cyklostezce v lokalitě Pytel a je otevřený všem věkovým kategoriím. Start je plánován na večer, což umožňuje běžcům užít si příjemnou atmosféru a společný čas s ostatními nadšenci běhu. Pořadatelé kladou důraz na bezpečnost a férovost závodu, který je měřen ručně a probíhá za každého počasí s výjimkou extrémních podmínek.

name: Tempo Makers Run Plzeň v Pytli - květen
description: Tempo Makers Run Plzeň v Pytli je běžecký závod pořádaný skupinou Plzeňští Tempo Makers, kteří se věnují organizaci běžeckých závodů, charitativních běhů a běžeckých tréninků. Akce se koná v malebné lokalitě Pytle v Plzni a nabízí příležitost pro běžce všech úrovní. Závod je součástí běžecké komunity, která podporuje aktivní životní styl a sportovní nadšení.

name: Okolo svaté Juliány
description: Okolo svaté Juliány je běžecký závod v Praze-Přední Kopanině s tratí dlouhou 5600 metrů, která vede převážně po lesních cestách s minimálním převýšením. Start i prezentace probíhají u turistického přístřešku na cyklostezce v ulici K Juliáně, snadno dostupném MHD. Závod je otevřený různým kategoriím včetně juniorů, dospělých a veteránů, a nabízí přátelskou atmosféru s možností parkování v blízkém okolí. Startovné je symbolické, s dobrovolným poplatkem pro některé kategorie.

name: Koutecká vertikála
description: Koutecká vertikála je závod do vrchu dlouhý 2,5 km s převýšením 510 metrů, který se koná v lyžařském areálu Kouty nad Desnou. Závod má intervalový start a je součástí seriálu Chlapácký běh, který zahrnuje krosové závody v Šumperku a okolí. Tento závod nabízí náročný a dynamický běh do kopce, ideální pro milovníky horského běhu a vertikálních výzev.

name: Rasokros
description: Rasokros je běžecký závod v Krčském lese v Praze 4, který nabízí mužům trať dlouhou 7,5 km a ženám 2,5 km. Závod je součástí seriálu SABZO a je vhodný pro běžce, kteří hledají příjemný krosový běh v přírodním prostředí. Trasa vede lesním terénem a nabízí příležitost vychutnat si běh v klidné části Prahy. Závod je otevřený široké veřejnosti a vítá všechny běžce, kteří chtějí změřit své síly v tomto atraktivním závodě.

name: 3. Pekelný kilometr
description: Pekelný kilometr je běžecký závod do vrchu konaný v lyžařském areálu Peklák v České Třebové. Závod je součástí seriálu ISCAREX poháru 2026 a nabízí trať dlouhou 1 km s intervalovým startem, která vede do sjezdovky po trávě, sněhu a cestách podle aktuálního počasí. Start dětí je v 17:00, hlavní závod na 1 km začíná v 18:00. Závod je vhodný pro širokou škálu věkových kategorií a je známý svou atmosférou a náročností stoupání.

name: BĚKODO – květen III
description: BĚKODO je tradiční 40. ročník běžeckého etapového závodu v Teplicích, určený pro kondiční, rekreační i výkonnostní běžce od 15 let. Závod se skládá z deseti nejlépe bodovaných startů během sezóny, přičemž rozhoduje lepší čas v případě rovnosti bodů. Limit pro měření rozhodčích je 35 minut, po jehož překročení je běžci zapsán čas 35+. Pro mladší běžce je připravena samostatná série Mladé BĚKODO. Pořadatelem je TJ Lokomotiva Teplice a BK Běkodo.

name: Sternchenlauf
description: The Sternchenlauf in Schloß Holte-Stukenbrock is a traditional fun run held annually on the Wednesday before Corpus Christi. The event offers various races for all age groups, from races for toddlers and children to 5 km and 10 km races, as well as walking. The course follows a varied 2.5 km loop with forest trails, gravel and asphalt, lined with enthusiastic spectators. In addition to individual categories, there are team and relay categories, making the race especially appealing to groups.
course_highlights: A varied 2.5 km loop with forest trails, gravel and asphalt
Flat course with clear signage
Out-and-back courses for the toddler, children’s and schoolchildren’s races on Falkenstraße
additional: Start times: toddler race 17:00, children’s race 17:15, 1.0 km schoolchildren’s race 17:30, 2.5 km schoolchildren’s race 17:45, 5 km race 18:30, 10 km race and 5 km walk 19:30. The walk starts at the same time as the 10 km race, at the back of the field. Participant limit: approximately 2,000; relays are limited to 50. Event shirts can be purchased during registration or on site. Changing rooms and showers are available. Start and finish at the Waldstadion Schwarz-Weiß Sende e.V. Registration is available for individual and group races. The 5 km race is fully booked; remaining places will be available on site from 16:00 on the day of the event. The event is part of the region’s running events and offers a welcoming, family atmosphere.

name: B2Run Hannover
description: B2Run Hannover is a corporate run covering a mostly flat route of around 6.5 km along the Maschsee, with a spectacular finish in the Heinz von Heiden Arena. The run is open to companies, organisations and individual participants from Hannover and the surrounding area, and promotes team spirit, motivation and a sense of community. The event features a professional supporting programme with hosting and music, and is ideal for beginners, walkers and experienced runners. The focus is on fun, togetherness and team building, not on personal bests.

name: Seligenstädter Marathonstaffel
description: The 44th Seligenstadt Asklepios Marathon Relay is a unique relay race for teams of six from clubs, recreational groups, and companies. It takes place on the banks of the Main in Seligenstadt. The fast out-and-back course along the river offers an attractive route, with the start and finish at the newly redesigned festival grounds. The event is organized by LG Seligenstadt and the Förderverein Freunde der LG Seligenstadt e.V. In addition to the sporting experience, food is available, including pasta dishes from MAIN'E KÜCHE. Bib number distribution and the awards ceremony also take place at the festival grounds.

name: Steglitzer Volkslauf
description: The Steglitz People’s Run is a traditional running event held at Lichterfelde Stadium in Berlin-Lichterfelde. Organized by TuS Lichterfelde von 1887 e.V., the event offers runners of all ages a sporting opportunity. It is known for its friendly atmosphere and well-organized event. The races start and finish at Lichterfelde Stadium, providing an attractive setting for participants and spectators.

name: X Wojewódzkie Mistrzostwa Policji
location: Zespół Boisk Piłkarskich OSiR Bytom, ul. Ostatnia 10, Bytom, Poland
organizer: Komenda Miejska Policji w Bytomiu, Komenda Wojewódzka Policji w Katowicach, Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Bytomiu, NSZZ Policjantów województwa śląskiego oraz NSZZ „Solidarność”
description: The 10th Provincial Police Cross-Country Championships, named in memory of Senior Sergeant Marek Sienicki, is a special sporting event held in Bytom. It aims to promote physical activity and commemorate an officer who tragically lost his life in the line of duty. The event will take place in the Bytomka Valley at 10 Ostatnia Street, where participants will tackle an 8-kilometre course along unpaved roads. The race is open to uniformed service officers, civilian employees, students in uniformed-service classes, and all running enthusiasts in the OPEN category. The organisers have prizes for the top finishers and commemorative medals for everyone who completes the race.
course_highlights: An 8-kilometre course along unpaved roads
Start, finish and race office at the OSiR Bytom Football Pitches Complex
The course runs through the Bytomka Valley
additional: Prizes for the top finishers include trophies, certificates and in-kind prizes. Every participant who completes the race will receive a commemorative medal. In the 2026 edition, the start is scheduled for 11:00. Participants who completed the race received commemorative medals.

name: Tolarova pětka
description: Tolarova pětka je běžecký závod konaný v Stříbře, který nabízí trať o délce 5 kilometrů. Závod je součástí kalendáře Sdružení vytrvalců Stříbro a je určen pro amatérské i rekreační běžce. Trasa vede městským parkem a je vhodná pro všechny věkové kategorie. Po závodě je připraveno vyhlášení výsledků a občerstvení pro účastníky.

name: Černovírská osmička
description: Černovírská osmička je tradiční běžecký závod pořádaný Středomoravským sdružením vytrvalostních sportů v Olomouci-Černovíru. Závod je součástí Hanáckého běžeckého poháru, který nabízí tratě různých délek a je otevřen všem běžcům bez ohledu na věk či výkonnost. Trať vede malebným prostředím Olomouckého kraje a je vhodná jak pro začátečníky, tak pro zkušené vytrvalce. Pořadatelé kladou důraz na pohodovou atmosféru a kvalitní organizaci závodu.

name: Int. Oberweiser Straßen- und Volkslauf
description: The International Oberweis Fun Run takes place in Oberweis and offers races for all age groups, from Bambinis to adults. The event includes various distances, including a Bambini run, children’s run, youth run, fitness run, walking, and a 10 km main race. The course passes through the scenic surroundings of Oberweis and is suitable for both recreational runners and ambitious athletes. The event is family-friendly and promotes recreational sports in the region.
course_highlights: A variety of distances from 400 m to 10 km
Races for all age groups from 1 to 99 years
Scenic course in Oberweis
additional: Start times are staggered by discipline from 16:00 to 18:30. Event address: Neuerburger Str. 16, 54636 Oberweis. Contact via the online contact form. It usually takes place in June, typically in good weather.

name: Int. Volkslauf, 38. Int. Halbmarathon, 22. Walkinglauf
description: TV Schwafheim is hosting the 52nd International Fun Run, the 38th International Half Marathon, and the 22nd Walking Event in Moers-Schwafheim. Races for children, adults, and walkers range in distance from 500 m to the half marathon. The course is closed to traffic, with several aid stations and timing by the Race Result system. The event is family-friendly and welcomes local club runners as well as half-marathon runners looking for a community atmosphere.
course_highlights: Roads closed to traffic, with traffic rules to be observed
Several aid stations along the course
Timing with the Race Result system and two chips attached to the shoelaces
additional: Race number pickup in the morning at the clubhouse; late entries accepted until shortly before each start; showers at the clubhouse and in the Waldschule gym; certificates can be printed directly at the finish. Course maps, 2025 results, water stations, showers, registration from 08:00, late entries up to 30 minutes before the start, family-friendly

name: Klingenlauf
price_range: Erwachsene: 16,00 € bis 18,00 €, Jugendliche/Kinder: 8,00 €, Firmenstaffeln: 65,00 €, Staffeln: 10,00 €, Schul- und Gruppenstaffeln: 30,00 € bis 60,00 €
description: The Klingenlauf is a long-standing running event in Solingen, held in Südpark. With various events ranging from 1 km to 10 km, relay races, and a company run, the Klingenlauf offers suitable running options for all age groups and ability levels. The course runs through Solingen’s Südpark and along the Korkenziehertrasse. More than 1,500 runners take part each year, making the Klingenlauf a sporting highlight in the region.
course_highlights: Course through Solingen’s Südpark
Section along the Korkenziehertrasse
A variety of distances from 1 km to 10 km, as well as relay races
additional: Late registration is possible on the day of the event until 30 minutes before the respective start, provided the participant limit has not been reached. The late registration fee is €2.00. The 5 km run is divided into two races: Speed Run (max. 30 min.) at 18:15 and Fun Run (over 30 min.) at 18:45. Changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available on site. Various running categories, online registration, changing rooms, toilets, showers in the ice sports hall, limited baggage storage, certificates and honorary awards, award ceremonies at the event venue

name: Leihgesterner Volkslauf
description: The Leihgestern Fun Run takes place annually on Corpus Christi in the beautiful woodland landscape of Linden. The event offers runners and walkers a choice of a 5 km walk, a 5 km run, and a 10 km run. The courses run mostly on comfortable forest paths with moderate elevation changes and are suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. Timing is done with a transponder, and race bibs require a deposit that is refunded when returned.
course_highlights: 5 km loop course with 95% forest paths and approximately 50 m of elevation gain
10 km loop course with 95% forest paths and approximately 110 m of elevation gain
A scenic route through the woodland landscape of Linden
additional: Race bib deposit of 2 EUR, refunded when the bib is returned. On-site registration is not possible. Gross and net times are recorded with a transponder. The start location is the TSG Leihgestern sports clubhouse, Waldstraße 32, 35440 Linden.

name: Volkslauf „Rund um Köchel“
description: The “Rund um Köchel” fun run is a traditional running competition held as part of the annual sports festival of SG Sportfreunde 69 Marmagen-Nettersheim. It gives runners of all ages and ability levels the opportunity to compete in four events (1,000 m, 2,000 m, 5,000 m, and 10,000 m). The event is part of a week of sport filled with action and team spirit at the grass sports facility in Marmagen. A children’s obstacle run is being offered for the first time, making the event family-friendly and varied.
course_highlights: Four events: 1,000 m, 2,000 m, 5,000 m, and 10,000 m
Event at the Marmagen grass sports facility
Part of a major sports festival with a varied program
additional: There are four running distances for different age and ability levels. A children’s obstacle run of 700 m and 1,400 m is also offered. The event is part of a multi-day sports festival featuring other sporting and family-friendly activities. Participation in four running events, including an obstacle run for children

name: Leśna Piątka Pikuś
location: Parking Nadleśnictwa Karnieszewice, ul. Słupska, Koszalin, Poland

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Udział jest bezpłatny, zachęcamy do dobrowolnych wpłat wspierających organizację

description: Leśna Piątka Pikuś is an annual cross-country run held in Koszalin on the forest educational trail of the Karnieszewice Forest District. The route starts and finishes at the car park on Słupska Street and is open to participants of all ages and experience levels. There is no timing or racing; the event promotes recreation and spending time outdoors as a family. Participants are encouraged to wear fairytale costumes, creating a unique and welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: The route follows the forest educational trail of the Karnieszewice Forest District
Start and finish at the car park on Słupska Street in Koszalin
A recreational cross-country run with no timing
additional: Participation is open to everyone, regardless of age or ability. Participants are encouraged to dress in fairytale costumes, creating a unique atmosphere. On-site registration is also possible, but keepsakes and participation in the prize quiz are not guaranteed.

name: Kamenická 15
description: Kamenická 15 je tradiční běžecký závod v Kamenici u Jihlavy, který nabízí dospělým běžcům 15 km velký okruh po asfaltových silnicích a cestách. Mládež má k dispozici kratší okruhy 1,75 km a 0,4 km vedené po asfaltových komunikacích v obci. Trať vede přes malebné části okolí, včetně osady Brodek, zámečku Zátiší a hájovny Cípy, s cílem v místě startu. Závod je vhodný pro širokou věkovou škálu od 3 let a nabízí příjemnou atmosféru s občerstvením a cenami pro vítěze i mládež.

name: Kapličkobraní
location: Hřiště TJ Ludgeřovice, Ludgeřovice, Moravian-Silesian Region, Česko
description: Kapličkobraní je charitativní nesoutěžní běh, který vede kolem 13 kapliček v okolí Ludgeřovic a Markvartovic s celkem 14 zastaveními včetně cíle. Trasa dlouhá 10-12 km je vhodná pro běh, chůzi, jízdu na kole, Nordic walking nebo i s kočárkem. Akce má hlubší přesah a veškerý výtěžek jde rodině Jana Riemla na podporu jeho synů Šimona a Matěje. Pro účastníky je připravena pamětní magnetka, drobné občerstvení v cíli a ochutnávka mešního vína na jedné z kapliček. Kapličkobraní získalo ocenění za nejlepší sportovní projekt s nízkým rozpočtem pro malé organizace.

name: Běh mimoňským parkem
description: Běh mimoňským parkem je závod konaný v zámeckém parku v Mimoni, který nabízí rovinatou trať po zpevněných cestách podél řeky Ploučnice. Závod je rozdělen do okruhů o délce 7 kilometrů, přičemž jsou k dispozici tratě 7 km a 21 km. Akce je vhodná pro širokou veřejnost i výkonnostní běžce a pořadatelem je Lenka Zeťová. Start hlavní kategorie je v 17:00, první kategorie startuje již v 9:00. Závod je součástí Českého běžeckého klubu a je pořádán pod záštitou Českého atletického svazu.

name: Běh pro Paměť národa - Nové Město na Moravě
description: Běh pro Paměť národa v Novém Městě na Moravě je dobročinná akce pořádaná na podporu neziskové organizace Post Bellum, která dokumentuje osudy pamětníků a pomáhá uchovat historické vzpomínky. Závod se koná ve Vysočina Areně a jejím okolí s trasami 2 km, 5 km a 10 km, přičemž 5 km je jeden okruh a 10 km dva okruhy. Akce nabízí měřené i neměřené běhy, včetně rodinného a dětského závodu, a je vhodná pro širokou veřejnost včetně žáků, studentů a seniorů s možností slevy na startovném. Start a cíl jsou na stadionu Vysočina Arena, kde je zajištěno zázemí včetně šatny, úschovny a občerstvení.

name: Abendlauf Wilstedt bei Nacht
description: The Wilstedt Night Run takes place at night and transforms the village of Wilstedt into an atmospheric running course. The event is family-friendly and welcomes everyone, from beginners to experienced runners. The new route offers lovely views of the village at night. The atmosphere is rounded off by cheering spectators and an evening fireworks display.
course_highlights: New running route through Wilstedt with lovely views of the village
Atmospheric event with cheering spectators along the route
Floodlit swimming at Heidebad Wilstedt after the run until 22:30
additional: The start and finish are at the Wilstedt sports grounds. The event begins with the mini run at 20:15, followed by the jogging and walking starts. Late registrations are possible on the day of the event from 18:30 to 20:00; the entry fee is then 9 euros. T-shirts or technical shirts are available only to those who register in advance and will be handed out on the day of the event. After the run, floodlit swimming at Heidebad Wilstedt is free until 22:30. Fireworks bring the event to a close at around 22:45. Nordic walking poles are not permitted on the running route. Children’s buggies and running strollers are permitted only for hiking/walking. Shower and changing facilities are available to a limited extent. New running route through Wilstedt, family-friendly, in the evening, registration until 17 May, including a mini run, fireworks and musical entertainment.

name: Raesfelder Mai-Lauf
description: The Raesfeld May Run takes place annually on the last Friday in May and offers a varied running programme for all age groups. From the 400 m Bambini races for kindergarten children to the 5 km and 10 km races for adults, there is something for everyone. There is also a 5 km team run, encouraging the fun of running together. The 5 km and 10 km courses are measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and are therefore eligible for inclusion in rankings.
course_highlights: 400 m child-friendly course for Bambinis
1,000 m and 2.3 km courses for children and teenagers
5 km and 10 km courses for adults, measured by the DLV
additional: Start times: 16:00 Bambini races (400 m), 17:00 1,000 m schoolchildren’s race, 17:30 2.3 km schoolchildren’s race, 18:00 10 km Volksbank Run, 18:05 5 km walking race, 19:30 5 km company, family and team run. The 10 km course consists of two laps of the 5 km loop. Part of the Lippe-Issel Cup, registration required, family-friendly, various categories.

name: Rohrener Volkslauf
description: The 48th Rohrener Volkslauf takes place on Friday evening in Monschau, Germany. Various events are offered, including a 4.2 km and a 10 km race for adults, as well as a separate 10 km event for walkers and Nordic walkers. The races follow a rolling course and all finish at Im Johannesfeld in Monschau. Younger runners also take part, and registration is online through the organizer.
course_highlights: Rolling course through Monschau
Finish at Im Johannesfeld
Separate 10 km event for walkers and Nordic walkers
additional: The shorter races start first, followed by the walkers and Nordic walkers, with the 10 km runners starting last. Typical June weather is around 23 °C, with mostly sunny days. Event with a rolling course, online registration, children’s and youth races, and walking events.

name: Lauf Rund um Burg
description: The 37th Run Around the Castle is part of the Cross and Forest Run Series and takes place around Burg in Dithmarschen. The event gives runners the opportunity to run scenic routes of 4.8 km and 10 km. The race is distinguished by its natural surroundings and varied course. Participants can look forward to a friendly atmosphere and a well-organized event.

name: Mühlhäuser Röblinglauf
description: The Mühlhäuser Röblinglauf is a charity run with the unique concept “Sport meets Music,” supporting the Mitteldeutschland Children’s Hospice. The event offers various races for children, teenagers, companies and individual runners, as well as walkers. Alongside the sporting event, there is musical entertainment and a KinderGarten concert, making the run a special experience for participants and spectators. Race materials can be collected the day before, and an AfterRöblinglauf Party takes place after the run.

name: Nacht von Hasbergen
description: The Night of Hasbergen is a traditional road race held in Hasbergen. The event offers exciting races for all age groups, from the Bambini run and relay race to the 10 km main race. The races take place on a new course, which was adapted due to construction work. The event begins with an opening ceremony and a show act for the Bambinis and ends with award ceremonies for the various competitions.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Warszawa – edycja nocna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Warszawa - Night Edition 2026 is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts who have been promoting the sport since 2014. The event takes place in picturesque locations, and the night edition stands out for its unique medals for participants. The race is ideal for runners who value scenic routes and a sense of community.

name: Night Run Zakopane
description: Night Run Zakopane is a unique evening race held in the heart of the Tatra Mountains, in picturesque Zakopane. Participants can choose from three distances: a dynamic 10 km route through the city center, a fast 5 km run, and a special children’s race focused on fun and movement. It’s an unforgettable nighttime running experience that attracts both experienced runners and those just starting out.
course_highlights: 10 km route through the heart of Zakopane
Fast 5 km route with a nighttime atmosphere
Special children’s race focused on fun
additional: Official regulations in Polish and Slovak are available for the main races and the children’s race. The available information relates to the previous edition.

name: XXVII Bieg na Groń Jana Pawła II
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Szkoła dla Regionu, LKS Orkan, ZSCKU w Radoczy
description: The Hiking Rally and Run to Groń Jana Pawła II is an annual event in the Little Beskids, organized by the Szkoła dla Regionu Association, LKS “Orkan” and the Radocza School Complex for Continuing Education. The 27th edition was held to mark the 106th anniversary of the birth of St. John Paul II. Participants set off from Ponikiew and followed the blue trail to Groń Jana Pawła II. The run has school and open categories, and around 150 people took part in the event.
course_highlights: Start in Ponikiew and run along the blue trail to Groń Jana Pawła II
School and open categories
Trophies and prizes for the top finishers
additional: After reaching the summit, participants descended to the “Czartak” pizzeria for refreshments and a recap. The route distance was not provided. The date of the 2027 edition has not yet been announced.

name: Ružindolský víchor
location: Ružindol okr. Trnava, Ružindol okr. Trnava, športový areál Ružindol
description: Ružindolský Víchor Run is the 12th edition of a road race held at the Ružindol sports complex. The course runs on asphalt and dirt roads through the village and includes a grass loop around the stadium. Runners can choose between a 7 km run and 4 km Nordic Walking. The start is scheduled for 17:30, with categories for men, women, local runners and Nordic Walking. Participants receive a race number, a timing chip, refreshments and a participant medal.

name: Běh osvobození – Lišanská silniční sedmička
description: Běh osvobození - Lišanská silniční sedmička je tradiční silniční běžecký závod konaný na 7 km trati mezi obcemi Lišany a Lužná. Závod se běží na málo frekventované silnici 3. třídy a je součástí Poháru běžců Kladenska a Rakovnicka. Startuje se v Lišanech, kde je i prezentace a cíl u restaurace U Hřiště. Závod je vypsán ve čtyřech mužských a dvou ženských kategoriích a nabízí finanční ceny i prémii za překonání traťových rekordů. Startovní čas je v 11:15 hodin, přihlášky se podávají na místě v den závodu.

name: Běh Emericha Ratha
description: Běh Emericha Ratha je obnovený přespolní závod pořádaný v Broumově, který zve běžce k účasti v malebném prostředí Schrollova parku u Cyklodomu Broumov. Závod nabízí příležitost užít si běh v přírodě s možností využití služeb jako půjčovna kol, úschovna zavazadel a dobíjecí stanice pro elektrokola. Prezentace probíhá ráno před startem, který je tradičně v 10:00. Organizátoři srdečně zvou všechny běžce k účasti na této sportovní události s přátelskou atmosférou.

name: Tuháčkův běh
description: Tuháčkův běh je tradiční běžecký závod pořádaný obcí Chrást u Příbrami jako součást Brdského běžeckého poháru. Hlavní závod měří přibližně 8,2 km a vede převážně po asfaltových a šotolinových cyklostezkách v okolí Chrástu. Závod je vhodný pro širokou veřejnost včetně dětí, pro které jsou připraveny dětské závody. Start hlavního závodu je v 11:00 v areálu Valcha. Závod nabízí příjemnou atmosféru a možnost poměřit síly s ostatními běžci v krásném přírodním prostředí.

name: Mattoni 1/2Maraton České Budějovice 2026
location: Náměstí Přemysla Otakara II., České Budějovice, Česko
description: Mattoni Running Festival České Budějovice 2026 vás zve na nezapomenutelný půlmaraton, který vede srdcem historického centra města. Start je na druhém největším náměstí v České republice, Náměstí Přemysla Otakara II., a trasa nabízí jedinečnou atmosféru a pohledy na historické budovy a unikátní místa. Tento závod je součástí oblíbené běžecké série RunCzech a je vhodný pro všechny běžce, kteří chtějí zažít kouzlo jihočeské metropole během sportovního dne. Připojte se k tisícům běžců a užijte si skvělou sportovní akci v Českých Budějovicích.

name: Chlum třikrát jinak
description: Závod Chlum třikrát jinak je čtvrtým závodem série Rozhledny v pohybu, který se koná v okolí Plzně. Závodníci zdolávají dominantní vrchol Chlumu třemi způsoby: během do vrchu s hromadným startem, intervalovým výběhem svahu a výběhem schodů na rozhlednu. Celková klasifikace se sestavuje ze součtu časů všech tří dílčích závodů s bonifikacemi pro první tři místa. Pro děti je připraveno deset věkových kategorií s okruhy v okolí rozhledny. K dispozici je také štafetový běh, kde tým tří běžců zvládne všechny tři disciplíny.

name: Třanovická 10
description: Třanovická 10 je tradiční běžecký závod konaný v obci Třanovice v Moravskoslezském kraji. Závod nabízí tratě vedoucí po hlinito-štěrkových, lesních, polních a asfaltových cestách v katastru obce Třanovice a Dolní Domaslavice. Akce je určena pro širokou veřejnost a zahrnuje hlavní závod na 10 km, závod na 5 km a štafetu. Start a cíl jsou u obecního úřadu, závod začíná v 9:00 hodin. Registrace je možná online i na místě, s možností převzetí startovních čísel a medailí pro včas registrované.

name: DEVIL’S CHALLENGE – ČERTOVSKÁ VÝZVA – 666km aneb superantikontramultiextraunikátní běžecký závod
location: Hamr na Jezeře, Liberec Region, Česko
description: Čertovská výzva 666 km je 8denní etapový běžecký závod v krásné přírodě severních Čech, který nabízí trasu dlouhou 666 km nebo zkrácenou variantu na 4 etapy. Závod vede přes Kokořínsko, Máchův kraj, Lužické hory, Ještědský hřeben a Český ráj, přičemž poslední etapa je shodná s tratí Čertovského ultratrailu 66,6 km. Závod je určen jednotlivcům, dvojicím i trojicím s možností střídání po etapách a nabízí i možnost výběru jednotlivých etap. Start i cíl jsou v Hamru na Jezeře, s hromadnými přesuny na starty etap a GPS navigací. V ceně startovného je zahrnut předzávodní raut.

name: 1/2Maraton Bělský les
description: 1/2Maraton Bělský les je tradiční běžecký závod konaný v malebném prostředí Bělského lesa v Ostravě-Zábřehu. Nabízí různé tratě včetně půlmaratonu, 10 km, 5 km, štafet 4x5 km a turistického pochodu Nachmelená 25 km. Závod je vhodný jak pro výkonnostní běžce, tak pro širokou veřejnost, a je spojen s charitativní podporou. Start i cíl jsou u Vodního areálu Jih, což zajišťuje příjemnou atmosféru a dobré zázemí pro účastníky.

name: Běh pro Paměť Národa – Ostrava
description: Běh pro Paměť Národa v Ostravě je dobročinná sportovně-společenská akce pořádaná na podporu neziskové organizace Post Bellum, která dokumentuje osudy pamětníků a pomáhá jim. Závod se koná v Komenského sadech s měřenými běhy na 4 km (1 okruh) a 8 km (2 okruhy). Akce je určena pro všechny věkové kategorie včetně dětských závodů a nabízí možnost symbolického běhu kdekoliv. Start a cíl jsou u sochy J. A. Komenského, s občerstvením a hygienickým zázemím pro účastníky.

name: Běh přes tři vsi
description: Běh přes tři vsi je novodobý přespolní kros, který navazuje na tradiční silniční závod pořádaný Spartakem Sedlec. Závod je určen jak pro sportovce, tak pro běžce, kteří si chtějí užít krásy krajiny. Nezapomíná se ani na nejmenší běžce, pro které je běh celoživotní radostí. Trasa vede přes tři vesnice Sedlec, Lhůta a Tymákov v okolí Starého Plzence.

name: Chlum třikrát jinak
description: Závod Chlum třikrát jinak nabízí běh do vrchu na dominantní vrchol v okolí Plzně, Chlum, který je zdoláván třemi různými způsoby. Startuje se hromadným během do vrchu o délce 1,75 km. Tento závod je atraktivní pro běžce, kteří hledají výzvu v kopcovitém terénu a chtějí si vyzkoušet různé varianty stoupání na jeden kopec. Akce je součástí běžecké komunity a přináší zajímavý zážitek v přírodě blízko Plzně.

name: Běh na Děvín
description: Běh na Děvín je závod v běhu do vrchu, který nabízí dvě trasy o délce 4,4 km a 9,1 km. Trasa vede převážně terénem s cílem na vrcholu Děvína, což přináší krásné výhledy a náročný profil. Závod je součástí Českého poháru v běhu do vrchu a je vhodný pro běžce, kteří hledají výzvu v přírodním prostředí Jihomoravského kraje. Startuje se u kostela v Perné a cíl je na vrcholu Děvína, což zaručuje jedinečný zážitek z horského běhu.

name: Běžecké závody AC Praha 1890
description: Běžecké závody AC Praha 1890 Praha - Brandýs jsou tradiční chodecké závody s historií sahající až do roku 1892. Závod se koná v lesoparku Arborka v Praze 14 a nabízí tratě pro muže, ženy, dorost a děti. Trať je asfaltový okruh vhodný pro rychlý běh a chůzi. Závod je součástí ligy mužů a žen a je otevřený amatérským i klubovým závodníkům. Startovní čísla a čipy se vydávají při prezentaci, měření zajišťují čipy a cílová kamera.

name: Čertovská výzva - jednotlivé etapy
description: Čertovská výzva je unikátní 8denní etapový běžecký závod na 666 km v krásné přírodě severních Čech, který nabízí i zkrácené varianty na 4 etapy nebo jednotlivé etapy. Trasa vede přes Kokořínsko, Máchův kraj, Lužické hory, Ještědský hřeben a Český ráj, přičemž poslední etapa je shodná s tratí Čertovského ultratrailu 66,6 km. Závod je vhodný pro jednotlivce, dvojice i trojice s možností střídání a je doplněn o čipovou časomíru a GPS tracker. Start i cíl jsou v Hamru na Jezeře, s možností hromadných přesunů na starty etap. V ceně startovného je zahrnut předzávodní raut.

name: WEBER Jičínská10 (CityRun Jičín)
description: Jičínská 10 je tradiční běžecký závod konaný v malebném městě Jičín. Závod nabízí trať dlouhou 10 km, která je vhodná pro širokou veřejnost a běžce všech úrovní. Akce se koná a je doplněna o tréninkové proběhnutí trasy, které umožňuje závodníkům lépe se připravit. Atmosféra závodu je přátelská a vítá všechny běžce, kteří chtějí zažít sportovní výzvu v krásném prostředí.

name: HIT-felder Volkslauf
description: The HIT-felder Volkslauf is a long-established race in Seevetal, organized by TSV Eintracht Hittfeld. It offers courses for the whole family, from short races at the Peperdieksberg sports facility to longer routes on field and forest paths. The event starts at 13:30 and is known for its friendly atmosphere and extensive supporting program. All participants receive a finisher medal, and there are team classifications as well as cash prizes for the largest groups registered in advance.
course_highlights: Routes on field and forest paths, as well as partly paved side roads
Races over 600 m, 1000 m, 2.5 km, 4.5 km and 10.6 km, with short and long loops
Electronic timing; spikes are not allowed
additional: Start and finish at Hittfeld School Center, Peperdieksberg sports facility. Changing rooms and showers are available at the school center. Late registration is possible on the day of the event, up to 30 minutes before the start, with cash payment (except for the Roland-Witt Family Run). Supporting program with coffee, cake, grilled sausages and drinks. Certificates are available online at www.stgk.de. Team classifications apply to certain races. The group with the most advance registrations receives a challenge trophy and cash prizes. The event takes place in May, with typical temperatures around 20°C (high) and 10°C (low), and offers children’s races, walking and Nordic walking in addition to the running courses.

name: Johannes-Lauf Lette
location: Ernsting's family Sportpark, Lette, Coesfeld, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Johanneslauf in Lette is a long-standing running event that has been held annually at the Ernsting's family Sportpark since 1998. The race attracts participants from across the region and is a regular fixture on the regional sporting calendar. It is organised by DJK Vorwärts Lette e.V., a club with a long tradition and a strong commitment to grassroots sport. The event offers a sporting challenge in a friendly and inclusive atmosphere.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Ernsting's family Sportpark
5-kilometre race
A tradition since 1998 with regional significance
additional: The race is part of the Streiflicher running series. Previous events have attracted around 400 participants and included a 5-kilometre walking route.

name: Leegebrucher Straßenlauf am 30.05.2026
price_range: Kinder frei; Jugendliche 3 Euro; Erwachsene 4 Euro
description: The Leegebruch Road Race takes place as a traditional running event in Leegebruch, welcoming runners of almost every age. Participants complete laps on the sports field and streets of Leegebruch. The event promises a lively atmosphere and is open to athletes of all ability levels. Registration is online via an external platform.
course_highlights: Laps on the sports field and streets of Leegebruch
Traditional running event with a family-friendly character
Suitable for runners of almost every age
additional: Registration is online only; on-site registration is not possible. There are no age-group categories and no awards ceremony. Changing rooms and showers are not available. Cold and hot drinks and snacks are available at the kiosk. Parking is available at the festival grounds on Lindenstraße. The race takes place on roads and in the stadium; registration is online; no changing rooms or showers; parking on Lindenstraße

name: 08. Dünenfeld Marathon
