description: The Dünenfeld Marathon in Augustdorf is a special race held according to the rules of the 100 Marathon Club Germany. The course consists of seven large loops of 6.1 km each, for a total of 42.7 km, and is partly trail-like. The start is at the level of the viewing platform, where runners can enjoy a beautiful view of the large dune fields. This is a private race with self-support and manual timekeeping; a photo of the clock must be submitted by email as proof.

name: 6. Wehrheimer Backyard Ultra
description: The Wehrheim Backyard Ultra (WEHBU) is being held for the sixth time. This private event, held among family and friends, is open only by personal invitation, as the start and finish area are on private property. The course follows gravel and paved paths, with some challenging climbs, and offers fantastic views of Wehrheim and the Taunus Mountains, including the Feldberg. A particular challenge is the “Meadow of Horror,” which can get muddy depending on the weather. The winner receives an original Bembel as a perpetual trophy, fitting for Wehrheim’s nickname, the “Apple Village.”

name: Aegidius-Lauf
description: The Aegidius Run is a charity race in Hanover that has been established for over 20 years. The event offers several race distances, including children’s races, a wheelchair race, 5 km and 10 km runs, and walking options. The start and finish are at Aegidiushaus AUF DER BULT, and all entry fees go exclusively to charity. The course is attractive, and times are recorded with a stopwatch rather than chip timing. All participants receive a certificate, and the top runners are honored with non-cash prizes.

name: Allbaulauf 2026
description: The AllbauLauf 2026 takes place on May 30 around Niederfeldsee and Krupp Park in Altendorf, Essen. The event offers a varied selection of races for schoolchildren, young people, company runners, recreational runners and competitive athletes. The short races for toddlers and schoolchildren are especially popular; they run along the lakeside promenade and over a bridge. The event is a sporting highlight with a wide range of races for all ages and ability levels.

name: Charity Trail Mannebach 111
description: The Charity Trail Mannebach 111 is a challenging trail run held in Mannebach. The event offers four distances from 12 km to 48 km, with varying elevation gains, along the scenic Traumschleife. The course is varied and features aid stations, and all participants receive a finisher’s medal. 100% of the entry fee is donated to charitable organizations, making this a special event with a social mission.

name: Illinger City-Lauf
description: The Illingen City Run is a long-standing running event in Illingen, organised by Langlaufgemeinschaft Wustweiler e.V. The course runs through the town of Illingen, starting and finishing at the Illingen indoor swimming pool. The event offers a friendly, family atmosphere, with an awards ceremony and a relaxed get-together in the hall’s forecourt. Showers, parking and medical services are available on site, and the races are insured through the Saarland State Sports Association.

name: Limbacher Marktlauf
description: The Limbach Market Run will take place for the 30th time at the Waldstadion in Limbach-Oberfrohna. The event offers a great running atmosphere, with new courses, new events and a finisher medal. In addition to the sporting competition, participants can look forward to an extensive supporting programme. The race is organised by LV Limbach 2000 e.V. and is a popular event in the region.

name: Turm zu Turm Lauf
description: The 21st Turm zu Turm Run in Georgsmarienhütte offers runners a varied and scenic experience. The main 24-kilometer course links the prominent viewpoints Hermannsturm and Varusturm and passes through woodland, with around 520 meters of elevation gain. There are also races for children, a fun run, a 10-kilometer scenic run, and a walking course. The event is a sporting highlight for the Osnabrück and Westphalia region, with suitable courses for all ages and ability levels.

name: Hahnenkammlauf
description: The Hahnenkamm Run in Edelsfeld is an idyllic forest run, taking place for the 23rd time in 2026. The event is open to runners of all ages, from children to experienced athletes, and offers varied routes around the sports grounds at Hahnenkamm. The course has been adjusted due to renovations to the sports field. The run is part of the Amberg-Sulzbach District Cup and motivates around 250 participants each year to achieve sporting success in a natural setting.

name: XIII Smolecka (za)Dyszka
location: Smolec, Kąty Wrocławskie, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 13th Smolec (za)Dyszka is a 10 km road race around the village of Smolec, starting at 18:00. The race takes place on a certified course and is organized by running enthusiasts and volunteers who ensure plenty of fun and sporting excitement. The event attracts recreational runners, families, and residents of the Kąty Wrocławskie Municipality and Lower Silesia. The organizers provide professional event management and a friendly atmosphere.

name: Bieg na Sleze
description: The Bieg na Ślężę is one of the oldest mountain races in Poland, held in Sobótka on the slopes of the Ślęża Massif. The approximately 5 km course, with over 500 metres of elevation gain, follows scenic, challenging mountain trails and finishes at the summit of Ślęża, next to the mountain shelter. The race attracts both top competitors and amateurs who want to take on the legendary climb to the “Ślężański Olympus.”

name: Ultraroztocze
description: Roztocze Ultra Race is a unique running event held in Józefów, in the Roztocze region. Participants can choose from a variety of routes, from short night races to ultra distances of 60 km and 120 km, which take them through the scenic landscapes of Roztocze. The event is organized by the Janosik Race Series Foundation, which has promoted an active and mindful lifestyle through sport since 2014. The race attracts both recreational and experienced runners, offering unforgettable experiences and a chance to connect with nature.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Zielona Góra – edycja wiosenna 2026
location: Ogród Botaniczny Uniwersytetu Zielonogórskiego, Zielona Góra
description: Botaniczna Piątka Zielona Góra is a 5 km run and walk in the University of Zielona Góra Botanical Garden, part of the nationwide Botaniczna Piątka series. The 2026 spring edition took place on 30 May. The spring course was two loops. The series is run by a group of runners who have organised mainly cross-country events since 2014.
course_highlights: 5 km course in the University of Zielona Góra Botanical Garden
Two loops through the garden
Part of a series of races in botanical gardens
additional: The organiser ran separate registration for adults and children. The 2027 spring date in Zielona Góra has not been announced yet.

name: RockRun Jarocin
description: RockRun Jarocin is a running event in Jarocin, Poland's city of music, mixing sport with a rock atmosphere. The programme has a night half marathon, a 10 km race and junior runs. The course passes through the most interesting parts of Jarocin municipality, and the half marathon is part of the Wielkopolska half marathon Grand Prix. The 2026 edition took place on 30 May with close to 1000 participants.
course_highlights: Night half marathon through Jarocin
10 km race at the same event
Part of the Wielkopolska half marathon Grand Prix
additional: The 2026 ambassador was Olympian Adam Nowicki. The main partner in 2026 was BAU-TECHNIK. The 2027 date has not been announced yet.

name: XIII IONWAY Bieg Nyski
description: The Nyski Run is the region’s largest road race, held over a PZLA-certified 10 km course through the streets of Nysa. The 13th edition of the IONWAY Nyski Run took place unusually in May, at 19:00. The start and finish were on Sudecka Street by the Sports and Entertainment Hall. The free Family Mile starts one hour earlier. The event is organised by the “W działaniu” foundation from Nysa.
course_highlights: Flat, certified 10 km course past Nysa’s historic landmarks
Evening start at 19:00
Free Family Mile open to everyone
additional: In 2026, the Nysa Children’s and Youth Races were also held at the Polonia stadium. The entry fee increased across several price tiers. The date of the 2027 edition has not yet been announced.

name: 13 Bieg Konopielki
description: The 13th Bieg Konopielki is an annual running event held in Juchnowiec Kościelny, attracting both local runners and visitors from other towns. The main 10 km race runs along the streets of Juchnowiec Dolny, with the start and finish at the stadium. After the race, participants can join a social picnic in Frampol, the birthplace of Edward Redliński, featuring regional food, a concert, and a book prize drawing. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere, with a family run and numerous other activities.
course_highlights: A 10 km route along the streets of Juchnowiec Dolny, with a loop in Wólka
Start and finish at the stadium in Juchnowiec Dolny
Sandy roads and local streets along the route
additional: Registration is available on race day from 9:00 to 11:30 at the Race Office at the stadium. After the race, a social picnic will be held in Frampol, featuring regional food, a visit to Edward Redliński’s House of Creativity, a concert, and a book prize drawing. Race packages include an invitation to the feast. Meals can be reserved for accompanying guests (adults and children, including meat-free options).

name: Bieg o Złotą Kaczkę
description: The Golden Duck Run is an annual running event held in Toszek. Its aim is to promote running and Nordic walking as recreational activities, encourage a healthy lifestyle, and foster social integration, including for people with disabilities. The main race course is approximately 10 km long and runs over mixed terrain, including cobblestones, asphalt, country roads, and park paths, with soft surfaces predominating. The start and finish are at Toszek Castle. The organizers offer numerous age and special categories, as well as trophies for the top competitors.

name: Bieg Tropem Kaszubskiego Stolema
location: Żelkowo, Gmina Główczyce, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Tropem Kaszubskiego Stolema Run is a 10 km race held in Żelkowo, in the Pomeranian Voivodeship. The event is an excellent opportunity to test your fitness on a moderately challenging asphalt course. The organizers encourage participants to prepare using training plans tailored to different experience levels, with support from experts. The event is a road race for runners looking to improve their 10 km times.
course_highlights: Moderately challenging asphalt course
10 km distance
Location: Żelkowo, Pomeranian Voivodeship
additional: The organizers offer training plans lasting 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level, with instructions and expert support. There is also an opportunity to manage the race listing and collaborate on marketing through the TreningBiegacza.pl platform.

name: Biegowe Grand Prix Mazur
organizer: Silent Hill Resort Sp. z o.o.
price_range: 50 zł za pojedynczy bieg lub 150 zł za cały cykl; biegi dziecięce i młodzieżowe bezpłatne

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Start w biegach głównych: 150,00 zł wpłata jednorazowa za cały cykl biegowy (opcja dostępna w elektronicznym formularzu zgłoszeniowym)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Start w biegach dziecięcych i młodzieżowych jest bezpłatny.

description: The Masurian Running Grand Prix is a series of races held in scenic towns across Masuria, including Sorkwity. The 5 to 10 km courses run along paved, cobbled, and forest paths, offering participants a chance to enjoy nature. The event also includes races for children and teenagers in various age categories, with separate starts for girls and boys. Every participant in the main race receives a commemorative medal, and the organizer provides water and a hot meal. It’s a great opportunity to spend time outdoors and enjoy the beautiful Masurian scenery.
course_highlights: Courses from 5 to 10 km on paved roads, cobblestones, and forest paths
Races for children and teenagers in several age categories, with separate starts for girls and boys
Scenic Masurian surroundings near Sorkwity
additional: The participant limit for all distances at each race is 400. The race office opens 1.5 hours before the start. Race packs can be collected up to 30 minutes before the race. The organizer provides water and a hot meal prepared by local Rural Housewives’ Circles. The limit for the 2026 edition was 400 participants.

name: Dolska Dycha
description: Dolska Dycha is a 10 km road race held in Dolsk, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity among the local community. The course is certified by the PZLA and marked every kilometre. It runs on roads closed to traffic within the Dolsk municipality. The event also includes a 3 km race, “Kozia Trójka.” Runners can expect refreshment stations, medical care, and a post-race recovery meal. The start and finish are at the Janusz Kusociński Primary School.
course_highlights: Course certified by the PZLA
Markers every kilometre and volunteers on more challenging sections
The race takes place on roads closed to traffic
additional: Race packs can be collected at the Race Office on event day from 16:00 to 17:30. A race pack may be collected by a third party or transferred to another person. No bag drop is available for participants. The time limit is 1 hour 30 minutes for the 10 km and 60 minutes for the 3 km. A refreshment point with water is located at the 5 km mark.

name: Gliwicka Prowokacja biegowa
description: Gliwicka Parkowa Prowokacja Biegowa is a series of 12 running and Nordic Walking events held in Gliwice, in the municipal forest. The course is 4,219.5 metres per lap and runs mainly along forest trails and gravel paths, with some asphalt sections. The events are amateur and promote a healthy, active outdoor lifestyle. Participants can take part in running or Nordic Walking, as well as e-Prowokacja, an online competition. Events take place on Saturdays, with a 10:00 start and a 3-hour time limit for running and Nordic Walking.
course_highlights: The course is 4,219.5 m per lap
Runs along forest trails and gravel paths, with some asphalt sections
Start and finish are on a clearing near Piast Stadium in the municipal forest
additional: Participants can take part in running or Nordic Walking, as well as e-Prowokacja (an online competition). The time limit is 3 hours for running and Nordic Walking; there is no time limit for e-Prowokacja. Participants can complete 1 to 5 laps (approximately 4.2 km to approximately 21 km). After the event, participants must return their race number and collect a drink and a snack (sausage or banana; a bar is awarded in a prize draw). The race number is valid for the whole year and assigned to the participant. Events take place on Saturdays once a month throughout the year. The event recurs monthly.

name: Kresowe Trail #6
description: Kresowe Trail is an intimate series of trail races held on scenic routes in eastern Poland, promoting a healthy lifestyle and respect for nature. The races offer two distances: the shorter Szpurt (approx. 6–8 km) and the longer Wertep (approx. 17–21 km), as well as Nordic Walking competition. Organized by the Maratony Kresowe Foundation, the races combine passion, competition, and friendship, creating a welcoming atmosphere for runners of varying ability levels. The events are held with respect for local communities and the natural environment.
course_highlights: Trail routes of approximately 6–8 km (Szpurt) and 17–21 km (Wertep)
Scenic areas of Podlasie and its surroundings, including hilly terrain and forest paths
Carefully marked routes with aid stations on the longer distance
additional: Starts are organized in corrals according to results from the previous season. The race package includes a race bib with a timing chip valid for the entire season, a hot post-race meal (with a vegetarian option), medical cover, aid stations along the route and at the finish, a commemorative medal (for early registration), photography services, and prizes for the top competitors. Online registration is also available on race day until 08:40. Littering on the course is strictly prohibited.

name: Roztocze Ultra Race
location: Józefów, Biłgoraj County, Lublin Voivodeship, Poland
description: Roztocze Ultra Race is a challenging ultrarunning event held in the picturesque Roztocze region, near Józefów. The course passes through diverse landscapes, including forests, hills, and valleys, offering participants unforgettable views and off-road challenges. The event is part of the Janosik Race Series, organized by a foundation with a passion for sport and development. It attracts runners looking for challenging courses and a sense of community.
course_highlights: The course runs through Roztocze National Park and the surrounding forests
Varied terrain: forest trails, gravel roads, and dirt roads
Picturesque views of the Roztocze hills and valleys
additional: The event offers live GPS tracking and live results. The varied routes range in distance from 3 km (Nocna Trójka) to 100 km (Roztoczańska Setka). The event is part of the Janosik Race Series, which also organizes other races in Poland. Participants can expect professional organization and support along the course.

name: Run4aSmile
description: Run4aSmile is a 10 km race held in Nowy Sącz. Participants can prepare for the race with training plans tailored to different ability levels, featuring detailed instructions and expert support. The event is a great opportunity to test your fitness on a paved course and join a running community. The organizers encourage professional management of race information and marketing collaboration, demonstrating their commitment to the event’s quality and growth.
course_highlights: 10 km distance on a paved course
Training plans lasting 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to VDOT level
Expert support during preparation
additional: Training plans lasting 8 to 20 weeks, with instructions and expert support, are available. Organizers can manage the race listing and collaborate on marketing. The website provides no information about the start time, prices, or registration.

name: Wadowicka Dycha
description: Wadowicka Dycha is a 10 km road race in Wadowice. Start and finish are on Jana Pawła II Square, and the asphalt course runs through Wadowice, Zawadka and Chocznia. The time limit is 1 hour 20 minutes. Children's runs over 200 m and 400 m take place before the main race. In 2026 the race started on 30 May at 15:30.
course_highlights: Start and finish on Jana Pawła II Square in Wadowice
Asphalt course through Wadowice, Zawadka and Chocznia
Refreshment point in Zawadka at about 5 km
additional: In 2026 the entry fee was 89 to 150 zł depending on the registration date, and the main race was capped at 500 runners. The date of the 2027 edition has not been announced yet.

name: XI Bieg Memoriałowy
description: The 11th Adam Lewandowski Memorial Run in Orchowo is an annual running event organized by the Orchowo Municipality. The run commemorates Adam Lewandowski and attracts runners of various age groups and skill levels. The races take place on routes around Orchowo, giving participants the opportunity to compete and connect in a sporting atmosphere. The organizers provide professional support and attractive race conditions.

name: XI Bieg Pamięci Grupy Kampinos Żołnierzy...
location: Zespół Sportowo-Rekreacyjny, Leszno, Masovian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 11th Kampinos Group Home Army Soldiers Memorial Run is a race commemorating the soldiers of the Kampinos Group of the Home Army. The event takes place in Leszno, and the start and finish of the main race and the Children’s Races are on the track at the Sports and Recreation Complex. The main race is 11 km long and is held in a spirit of historical remembrance.

name: XV Kwidzyński Bieg Papiernika
description: The Kwidzyn Paper Run is an annual running event that began in 2010, born from a passion for running and promoting physical activity for health and fun. The 10 km race runs through the center of Kwidzyn, bringing together the local community and runners from across Poland. The event accompanies Paperworker’s Day, a celebration for MM Kwidzyn employees, and participants can enjoy a range of free activities. It is organized by MM Kwidzyn sp. z o.o. and the MM Kwidzyn Care Foundation. Join the running community and celebrate sport and a healthy lifestyle together.
course_highlights: The course is 10,000 meters long and runs through the center of Kwidzyn
There are two checkpoints and two water stations along the course
The course provides participants with comfort and safety
additional: The event accompanies Paperworker’s Day—a celebration for MM Kwidzyn employees—with many free activities throughout the day. The schedule includes the opening of the race office, a group warm-up, yoga and mobility, a meeting with champion Robert Korzeniowski, the awards ceremony, and a children’s race. Photos and video footage are taken during the race for promotional purposes.

name: XV Żmigrodzki Bieg Smoka
description: The 15th Żmigród Dragon Run is an annual running event held on the streets of Żmigród. Participants run a 10-kilometre course that combines sporting competition with the unique atmosphere of a local event. The race attracts both experienced runners and people looking to spend time actively and promote a healthy lifestyle. The fifteenth edition highlights the event’s tradition and its place in the region’s sporting calendar. The organisers warmly invite everyone who enjoys exercise and a challenge to take part in this sporting celebration.
course_highlights: A 10-kilometre route through the streets of Żmigród
An event with a unique atmosphere and local character
A race combining sporting competition with the promotion of a healthy lifestyle
additional: The race is part of local sporting events and promotes a healthy lifestyle. It brings together experienced runners and amateurs alike. Registration is online. The start and finish are in the centre of Żmigród.

name: 12 Leżajski Bieg Zośki Turosz
organizer: Burmistrz Leżajska; Miejskie Centrum Kultury w Leżajsku; Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Leżajsku; Uczniowski Klub Sportowy przy SP1 w Leżajsku
description: The 12th Leżajski Bieg Zośki Turosz is an annual street race held in Leżajsk that brings generations together and promotes physical activity. The event features races at various distances for children, teenagers and adults, including a 15 km main race and additional races of 8 km, 3 km and 0.5 km. The event combines sport and community, commemorating Zośka Turosz. The organizers provide professional event services and support from the relevant services, and participants can look forward to an unforgettable atmosphere.
course_highlights: 15 km main race through the streets of Leżajsk
Additional 8 km, 3 km and 0.5 km races for children and teenagers
Street course with support from event organizers and the relevant services
additional: The event also includes 3 km races for adults and teenagers and a 0.5 km race for children. Consent forms for underage participants must be submitted to the Race Office on race day. The organizers include the Mayor of Leżajsk, the Municipal Cultural Centre, and the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Leżajsk.

name: Ostrowski Bieg Biznesu
organizer: Zespół Szkół Ekonomicznych im. Józefa Gniazdowskiego w Ostrowie Wielkopolskim
description: Ostrowski Bieg Biznesu is a run organised by the Józef Gniazdowski School of Economics in Ostrów Wielkopolski. It takes place at the Piaski-Szczygliczka recreation area, on two loops around a large reservoir of about 5.8 km in total. Local company teams and individual runners take part. The event is held under the honorary patronage of the Ostrów county head, and the largest team receives the county head's cup. In 2026 the race took place on 30 May.
course_highlights: Two loops around the Piaski-Szczygliczka reservoir
Company teams and individual runners
County head's cup for the largest team
additional: The date of the 2027 edition has not been announced yet.

name: RUNGDN Hevelianum
description: #RUNGDN Hevelianum is a run on Gradowa Hill in Gdańsk, around the Hevelianum Centre, organised by Gdańsk Sports Centre (GOS). It is the final event of the spring #RUNGDN series, where the best three of four results count. Besides the main run there is a nordic walking race and children's runs. The best athletes of the whole series are honoured at the end. In 2026 the start was on 30 May at 11:00.
course_highlights: Hilly course on Gradowa Hill around the Hevelianum Centre
Sections over stones and cobbles
Finale of the #RUNGDN series with overall standings
additional: The race office opens one hour before the start. The date of the 2027 edition has not been announced yet.

name: Beh v Raji – prológ
location: Stratená, okr. Rožňava, Stratená, okr. Rožňava, Dobšinská Ľadová Jaskyňa - parkovisko
description: The Run in Paradise is a traditional running race held in the beautiful surroundings of the Dobšinská Ice Cave and its vicinity. Participants can choose from several distances, including a prologue, half marathon, 10 km and 5 km races, which run mainly on asphalt roads with partial traffic closures. The prologue is a hilly 1 km run along a forest trail from the car park to the ice cave. The event is suitable for the general public and also offers Nordic walking.

name: Salibský polmaratón, Hornosalibská desiatka, Hornosalibská trojka
location: Horné Saliby okr. Galanta, Horné Saliby okr. Galanta, Areál futbalového ihriska TJ Horné Saliby
organizer: Obce Horné Saliby a Dolné Saliby
description: The Saliby Half Marathon, Hornosalibská 10 and Hornosalibská 3 are traditional running events organized by RoniRun Club in the village of Horné Saliby. The races offer certified courses of 21.1 km, 10 km and 3 km, running through a picturesque area, with refreshment stations and chip timing. The event is suitable for the general public, including children, who can take part in special kids’ races. Alongside the sporting experience, visitors can look forward to a varied accompanying program featuring music, martial arts demonstrations and a raffle.

name: Self-Transcendence 6/12h a 100km beh / Sri Chinmoy Self-Transcendence 100km beh
location: Šamorín, Okres Dunajská Streda, Trnavský kraj
description: The Sri Chinmoy Self-Transcendence 6/12-hour and 100 km Run in Šamorín is a traditional ultrarunning race held in Pomlé City Park. This is the 24th edition of the 6-hour run and the 15th edition of the 12-hour and 100 km runs, with categories for individuals and relay teams. Runners can compete in various age categories, including men’s and women’s veterans over 50. Relay teams may have up to three runners, who can take turns in any order, with each team member required to complete at least one lap after taking over. Results are measured by the actual distance covered, to the nearest metre.

name: Hore Lótom Dole Lótom
location: Veľké Lovce (okr. Nové Zámky), Veľké Lovce (okr. Nové Zámky), Športový areál
description: Hore Lótom Dole Lótom is the fourth edition of a running event held at the sports complex in Veľké Lovce. The races follow the village streets and surrounding countryside along asphalt and dirt roads. The event also includes children’s categories with different course distances according to age, as well as the main 5 km and 10 km races. The event is suitable for the general public and offers awards in age and gender categories. The organizers emphasize convenient online registration and accurate chip timing.

name: Memoriál Jozefa Gabčíka
location: Žilina - Poluvsie, Žilina - Poluvsie, rodný dom Jozefa Gabčíka
organizer: Žilinský pluk Jozefa Gabčíka, Klub vojenských výsadkárov Slovenskej republiky, Železničná spoločnosť Slovensko, Ministerstvo obrany SR
description: The Jozef Gabčík Memorial is an annual running race held in honour of paratrooper and hero Jozef Gabčík, a prominent figure in the anti-fascist resistance. This 11 km cross-country race over mixed terrain runs from Žilina–Poluvsie, the birthplace of Jozef Gabčík, to the sports complex of the 5th Special Forces Regiment in Žilina. The event brings together civilian and military runners and promotes physical fitness and community spirit. The entry fee includes a race pack, refreshments, a commemorative medal, and chip timing.

name: Kurimské pobehaňe
location: Kurima, (okres Bardejov), Kurima, (okres Bardejov), Pred kaštieľom
description: Kurimské pobehaňe is a running event organized by the Aktívna Kurima civic association, held in the village of Kurima in front of the manor house. The course follows asphalt and dirt roads, with dirt and gravel surfaces. The race is open to a range of age groups, from schoolchildren to veterans, with men and women competing in different age categories. Online registration is available, with different entry fees depending on when you register. A school run for children is also provided. The event is ideal for runners looking for an enjoyable, community-oriented running experience in nature.

name: Telekom Night Run Štrbské Pleso
location: Štrbské Pleso, Štrbské Pleso, na hlavnej ceste medzi hotelom FIS (adresa: k Vodopádom 26) a hotelom Patria
description: Telekom Night Run Štrbské Pleso is a traditional night run in the stunning surroundings of the High Tatras, now being held for the 14th year. Runners can choose between 5 km and 10 km routes that pass around Malé and Veľké Štrbské Pleso, Jazierka lásky, and through the Snow Cross-Country Skiing Area. The event is part of the Grand Prix series and offers an unmistakable atmosphere, with views of Rysy and a nighttime finish in the dark. In addition to the adult races, children’s runs and Nordic walking are also on offer. Telekom Night Run is a popular annual stop for runners who enjoy beautiful running experiences in a mountain setting.

name: Turbo TV detské behy Štrbské Pleso
location: Štrbské Pleso, Štrbské Pleso, na hlavnej ceste medzi hotelom FIS (adresa: k Vodopádom 26) a hotelom Patria
description: Telekom Night Run Štrbské Pleso is a traditional night run in the stunning surroundings of the High Tatras, taking place for the 14th time. Runners can choose between 5 km and 10 km routes leading around Malé Štrbské Pleso and Veľké Štrbské Pleso, with beautiful views of the Tatra peaks. The event also includes Turbo TV children’s races, with various distances for everyone from the youngest runners to teenagers, offering unforgettable experiences and medals. The atmosphere is exceptional, with spectators cheering along the route and runners crossing the finish line after dark, making this run a popular fixture in the season.

name: Fatranský Vĺčko
location: určianske Jaseno, určianske Jaseno, Lezecká stena Ovčín
description: Fatranský Vĺčko is a canine endurance sport that combines hiking and running with a dog in the beautiful surroundings of the Veľká Fatra mountains. The event will take place in Turčianske Jaseno and offers two routes: the longer MID, measuring 44 km with 2,350 m of elevation gain, and the shorter SHORT, measuring 14 km with 500 m of elevation gain. You can compete in the dog trekking category (person with a dog) or the trail category (running without a dog). Dogs must be kept on a leash or harness throughout the entire route; allowing a dog to roam freely results in disqualification. The organizers recommend the MID route for experienced participants and the SHORT route for beginners or those who are less trained.

name: Nekořský kros
description: Nekořský kros je tradiční běžecký závod konaný v Nekoři v Pardubickém kraji, který je součástí ISCAREX poháru. Závod nabízí tratě vedoucí velmi členitým terénem po lesních cestách, loukách a částečně po asfaltu, což zaručuje zajímavý a pestrý běžecký zážitek. Start i cíl jsou u zimního stadionu v Nekoři, kde se také koná registrace. Závod je vhodný pro širokou škálu běžců včetně mládeže a je známý svou přátelskou atmosférou a věcnými cenami pro vítěze v jednotlivých kategoriích.

name: Běh mezi náměstími
description: Běh mezi náměstími je tradiční běžecký závod konaný na náměstí Svobody ve Frýdku-Místku, který přitahuje širokou škálu účastníků od dětí až po dospělé. Závod nabízí příjemnou atmosféru, krásné počasí a možnost soutěžit na trati vedoucí na Zámecké náměstí a zpět. Pro děti jsou připraveny speciální závody s medailemi, cenami a občerstvením, zatímco dospělí běží hlavní trať dlouhou přibližně 4,7 km. Vítězové i všichni účastníci si odnášejí nejen ceny, ale i radost z pohybu a společenského setkání.

name: Chodsko Grand Prix
location: Klenčí pod Čerchovem, Plzeň Region, Česko
description: Chodsko Grand Prix je závod dlouhý 9,6 km s převýšením 130 metrů, který vede převážně po silnici z obce Klenčí pod Čerchovem na vrch Hrádek. Tento závod je součástí soutěže Běžec Chodska a nabízí běžcům zajímavou trasu s mírným stoupáním. Je vhodný pro běžce, kteří hledají výzvu v malebném prostředí Plzeňského kraje.

name: Festivalový půlmaraton MONET+ Zlín 2026
description: Festivalový půlmaraton MONET+ Zlín 2026 je silniční běžecký závod na 21,097 km určený široké veřejnosti bez nutnosti členství v klubu. Závod se koná v ulicích Zlína s startem u Kongresového centra Zlín a nabízí i další varianty jako čtvrtmaraton, štafety a pětikilometrový běh. Součástí programu je také Rodinný běh na 1400 metrů. Akce je součástí festivalového Zlína a přináší jedinečnou atmosféru a možnost běžet po boku známých osobností.

name: Zahořanská 10 (Běh okolo Pleše)
description: BOS Zahořanská 10 je tradiční běžecký závod pořádaný SK Zahořany pod záštitou obce Zahořany. Osmý ročník se uskuteční a nabízí hlavní závod mužů a žen na 10,2 km s převýšením +250 m v lesním terénu kolem Zahořan a Pleše. Kromě hlavního závodu je připraven doprovodný běh na 5,5 km a dětské běhy různých délek. Měření času a výsledky zajišťuje agentura 4Timing pomocí čipové technologie. Registrace probíhá online i na místě s různými cenovými kategoriemi pro dospělé, juniory a děti.

name: Maraton a půlmaraton okolo Hracholuské přehrady
description: Maraton a půlmaraton okolo Hracholuské přehrady je závod, který nabízí nádherný přírodní okruh kolem přehrady. Trasa vede převážně po zpevněných cestách podél vodní hladiny s několika krátkými úseky přírodního terénu, což jí dává lehce trailový charakter bez zbytečných obtíží. Výjimečným zážitkem je přeběh přes Pňovanský most s dechberoucími výhledy na přehradu a okolní krajinu. Závodní okruh měří 21,1 km, tedy přesnou vzdálenost půlmaratonu, a je vhodný pro běžce hledající kombinaci krásné přírody, motivující atmosféry a příjemného profilu trati.

name: Běžím Krušnohořím Lesná
organizer: Živé Sokolovsko z.s. a Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s.
description: Běžím Krušnohořím je běžecký a canicrossový seriál, který vás provede krásami Krušných hor. Seriál zahrnuje 6 závodů v různých destinacích, včetně Lesné, kde se koná hlavní závod na 6 až 9 km, zážitková trasa 20 až 30 km a dětské závody. Trasy jsou vhodné pro běžce, canicrossaře, děti i chodce, a nabízí tak pestrou sportovní výzvu pro všechny věkové kategorie. Seriál pořádají Živé Sokolovsko z.s. a Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s. ve spolupráci s místními obcemi.

name: Mezinárodní běh Měška a Doubravky
description: Mezinárodní běh Měška a Doubravky je letní běžecký závod pro dospělé s délkou trati 12,5 km, který startuje v Mirošově a končí v Meziměstí na koupališti AQA Land. Závod je součástí velké ceny Východních Čech a vede malebnou krajinou polsko-českého pohraničí mezi loukami a lesy. Start je u amfiteátru na Parkowé hoře v 11:00, cíl a vyhlášení vítězů probíhá na koupališti. Pro české závodníky je zajištěna bezplatná doprava autobusem z Meziměstí do Mieroszowa. Registrace je zdarma a probíhá online nebo v den závodu na místě.

name: Elsterlauf
organizer: SG Medizin Bad Liebenwerda e.V. und Lauf- und Walkingverein 05 Bad Liebenwerda e.V.
description: The Elsterlauf in Bad Liebenwerda is a traditional running and walking event, taking place for the 46th time. The event offers a variety of distances, including a marathon, half marathon, several walking and hiking routes, and children’s races. The course runs through the spa town of Bad Liebenwerda, with a family-friendly atmosphere and competitions for individuals, teams, and companies. All participants receive a finisher’s medal and certificate, and awards are presented by age group. The event is organized by SG Medizin Bad Liebenwerda and Lauf- und Walkingverein 05 Bad Liebenwerda e.V.
course_highlights: A variety of distances: marathon, half marathon, 11 km, 5.7 km, 2 km, walking, and hiking
Start and finish at Roßmarkt in Bad Liebenwerda, near the primary school center, which has changing rooms and showers
Guided 11 km hike and family-friendly races such as the Bambini and fun runs
additional: Changing rooms and showers are available at the primary school center in Bad Liebenwerda. Bag storage is available from 7:00 to 14:00. The course closes for all distances at 13:15. There are company and club competitions with teams of three participants. Cyclists and hikers start without timing or rankings. Results are published online. Running event with online registration and various categories for runners, walkers, and families, including awards ceremonies and finisher’s medals.

name: Urwaldlauf
description: The Urwaldlauf is a six-hour race in which participants can run as many laps as they like on a 1.85 km course through the forest near Saarbrücken within six hours. The start time is flexible from 10 a.m., and participants can enter individually or as part of a team. The course combines wide forest paths with idyllic singletrack trails and offers a challenging 46 metres of elevation gain per lap. The event places great emphasis on flexibility and fun, with an electronic lap counter and refreshments at the Urwaldscheune Neuhaus.
course_highlights: 1.85 km lap through the forest near Saarbrücken
46 metres of elevation gain per lap; more than 1,000 metres over marathon distance
A mix of wide forest paths and idyllic singletrack trails
additional: Bib pickup is available on site from 9 a.m. Flexible start time from 10 a.m.; the finish closes at 4 p.m. Electronic lap counter and refreshment station at the Urwaldscheune Neuhaus. The field is limited to 350 participants. Late registration is possible online or on site; the late-registration fee is payable on site. Team classification available; make sure the team name is spelled consistently. Six-hour race, 1.85 km lap, approximately 46 metres of elevation gain per lap, forest paths and singletrack trails, flexible start time from 10 a.m., finish at 4 p.m., online registration until the Friday before the event, participant limit of 350.

name: Lamer Woid-Reim
description: The Lamer “Woid-Reim” is a varied race starting in Lambach, with over 70% trail terrain, promising plenty of fun and variety for runners of all ages and ability levels. The event welcomes both competitive and recreational runners and is supported by numerous volunteers. Refreshments are available, and spectators are welcome to cheer on participants along the course. Its special atmosphere makes the Lamer “Woid-Reim” a popular race in the Laufcup Cham.
course_highlights: Start in Lambach
Over 70% trail terrain
Varied course
additional: The event is part of the Laufcup Cham. There are classifications for different age groups and distances. The course is predominantly trail. Several race categories, including children’s, youth, recreational and main races; start at 10:00.

name: Freystädter Volksfestlauf
price_range: Erwachsene: 10,00 Euro, Schüler: 5,00 Euro, Bambini: 4,00 Euro
description: The Freystädter Volksfestlauf is a traditional running event in Freystadt, Bavaria, held annually as part of the Freystädter Volksfest. The races start and finish at the town hall on the market square and offer various distances for adults, schoolchildren, and Bambini. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, with awards for the best runners and teams as well as special categories. Changing rooms and showers are available at the TSV sports clubhouse, and the awards ceremonies take place in the festival tent or outdoors.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the town hall on the market square in Freystadt
Course routes can be viewed online in advance
Race distances for different age and ability groups
additional: Late entries are possible at the town hall until 1 hour before the respective start; a late entry fee of 3.00 euros applies. The awards ceremony for schoolchildren takes place at around 11:00 at the town hall, and the ceremony for adults and youth takes place from around 13:00 in the festival tent or outdoors. Changing rooms and showers are available at the TSV sports clubhouse, Allersberger-Straße 23, Freystadt. There are honorary prizes for the top finishers, certificates for places 1–3, and additional certificates available online. Special and team categories are also included. Courses for different age groups, online registration, awards ceremonies at the town hall and in the festival tent, changing rooms at the TSV sports clubhouse

name: 10K Hamburg - Elbe
description: The 10K Hamburg - Elbe is an exciting 10-kilometer race held at attractive spots in Hamburg, the city on the Elbe. The course follows fully closed and secured out-and-back routes on paved and asphalt paths. The race is open to runners of all ability levels and is officially measured in accordance with international competition regulations. The event is part of a cup series spanning several 10K Hamburg races, with attractive prizes.

name: 16. Campuslauf Technische Universität Braunschweig
description: The 16th Campus Run of the Technical University of Braunschweig takes place on the university campus. The run gives students and staff the opportunity to get active and spend time together on the university grounds. The event is part of the university sports program and promotes a sense of community and participants’ health.

name: 32. Tangerlauf
description: The 32nd Tanger Run in Tangerhütte is a traditional race through the Tanger lowlands, organized by SV Germania Tangerhütte. The course follows the River Tanger through the scenic Altmark countryside, which is especially beautiful in spring. The race has a long history dating back to the GDR era and was revived after reunification. The organizers wish all participants good weather and an enjoyable race.

name: 40. Göttinger Frühjahrs-Volkslauf
description: The 40th Göttingen Sparkasse Volkslauf takes place at Jahnstadion Göttingen and offers a varied range of races for runners of all ability levels. The event combines tradition and community, inviting both experienced runners and recreational joggers to enjoy an active day of fun and exercise. The distances are 2 km, 5.4 km and 10.8 km; unfortunately, the half marathon is not taking place this year. The event emphasizes health, well-being and togetherness in the region.

name: 5. Urwaldsteig-Ultratrail
description: The Urwaldsteig Ultratrail is a challenging ultratrail race covering approximately 66 km with around 2,000 metres of elevation gain around Lake Edersee. Starting in Waldeck, the route runs counterclockwise through varied natural landscapes, including dense forests, narrow paths, the Kahle Haardt nature reserve and Kellerwald-Edersee National Park. Runners can look forward to impressive views of the lake, historic sites such as Hünselburg, and varied trail sections rich in natural beauty and memorable experiences. The start and finish are at the Schloss Waldeck car park, and the race begins at 8 a.m.

name: 9. Hellmich Parkhauslauf
description: The HELLMICH Parking Garage Run in Lehrte is a unique running event held in the Lehrte parking garage. Participants run a course of about 1 km through the garage, with the inclines and views of the city creating a special running experience. There are three different races with varying numbers of laps, suitable for both children and adults. Each race is limited to 50 participants to ensure safety, and every finisher receives a medal as a keepsake.

name: Frankfurter Runden
description: The Frankfurter Runden is a unique mass-participation running event in the heart of Frankfurt am Main, taking place for the sixth time. During the run, participants can freely choose between 10, 20, 30 or 40 km by completing one to four laps on a flat, scenic route along the Main with views of the skyline. The event is open to runners of all levels and offers professional timing, medical support and on-course refreshments. A high-quality organic cotton T-shirt and digital live tracking features round out the offering.

name: Erfurtshäuser Lauf
description: The Erfurtshausen Run is a traditional running event in Amöneburg-Erfurtshausen that welcomes runners of all ages. It offers various races, including Bambini, youth, fun run, and main race, as well as walking/Nordic walking. The course is marked, every kilometer is indicated, and refreshment stations are set up along the route. At the finish, the organizer provides food and drink for participants. Times are recorded electronically, with stopwatches as a backup, and certificates can be issued on request.

name: Trainingslauf Bottwartal-Marathon
location: Steinheim an der Murr, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
distance_verbose: 51 km, Marathon, 32 km, Halbmarathon, 10 km, 5 km
description: The Bottwartal Marathon is a running event in one of the most beautiful landscapes in southern Germany, taking runners through gentle vineyard slopes, idyllic old towns and an electrifying atmosphere along the course. The route is a loop through the southern and northern Bottwartal, starting and finishing in Steinheim an der Murr. The marathon is open to runners aged 18 and over and offers a varied course featuring paved farm tracks and historic town sections. Whether you’re a beginner or an ambitious runner, you’ll find a highlight here in a unique atmosphere.
course_highlights: Loop through the southern and northern Bottwartal, starting and finishing in Steinheim a.d. Murr
The route passes through historic old towns such as Murr, Gronau, Beilstein, Oberstenfeld and Großbottwar
Flat finish at the Steppi roundabout in Steinheim for a strong final sprint
additional: Race number collection and late registration take place at Blankensteinhalle in Steinheim a.d. Murr on Saturday from 09:00 to 17:00 and on Sunday from 07:30 until approximately one hour before the race. Shuttle buses run from Riedstadion to the start at the Steppi roundabout for the 10 km, 32 km, marathon and ultra races, and a bus transfer takes half-marathon participants from Steinheim to Gronau. On Sunday, the Bottwartal is closed to through traffic over a wide area, and traffic is restricted around Riedstadion. Runners are asked to line up in the start area according to their running pace.

name: Wachtelrun Liederbach
description: The Wachtel-Run organized by TSG Niederhofheim takes place in Liederbach and invites runners of all ages to enjoy a day of sport. Various distances are offered, including 10 km, 5 km, school races, and a Bambini run. There is also a 5 km Wachtel-Walk for beginner walkers and speed walkers, with no rankings. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with the start and finish at the Liederbach sports field.

name: Wandermarathon TSV Bollensen
description: The TSV Bollensen Hiking Marathon warmly invites all fans of recreational sports to enjoy a pleasant hike through the beautiful Solling Vogler forest. The routes are circuits starting and finishing at the TSV Bollensen sports center and run exclusively along forest trails. In 2022, the region was awarded the “Wanderbares Deutschland” quality designation. Refreshment stations along the route, as well as food and drinks at the finish, are provided. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and a relaxed get-together after the hike.

name: 1. Zielony Półmaraton
location: Konstancin-Jeziorna (Park Zdrojowy im. hrabiego Witolda Skórzewskiego)
description: The course consists of two 2.5 km loops through pine and mixed forests, with gentle terrain suitable for runners of all ability levels. The start and finish are at the forest car park on Od Lasu Street, offering easy access and convenient viewing for spectators. The event combines sporting competition with community spirit and support for the local community, and all funds raised will be donated to the Special Education School Complex in Pęchery.

name: 13. Bieg 10km Szpot Swarzędz
description: The 13th Szpot Swarzędz 10 km Run is one of the most important 10 km running events in Wielkopolska, held since 2012. It attracts leading Polish athletes as well as runners from abroad, creating a unique atmosphere filled with sporting excitement and energy. The course is interesting and varied, with wooded sections and a route through the streets of Swarzędz. The event also includes a Family Run and a start for athletes using active wheelchairs. In 2026, the Szpot Swarzędz Half Marathon returns, adding even more excitement to the running festival.

name: 45. Bieg Krotosa
description: Bieg Krotosa is an annual race in Krotoszyn, held for the 45th time in 2026 with a record field of more than 1,150 runners. The main race is 10 km, with an accompanying 5 km run. The day before, children's and youth runs from 100 m to 1,200 m take place during the family sports festival on the Błonie in Krotoszyn. In 2026 the 10 km started on 31 May at 10:00 and the 5 km at 10:10.
course_highlights: Main 10 km race and a 5 km run
Children's and youth runs from 100 m to 1,200 m the day before
Family sports weekend on the Błonie in Krotoszyn
additional: Race packs can be collected on the Friday and Saturday before the race and on race morning. The date of the 2027 edition has not been announced yet.

name: 2. Uliczna Mila / 3. Parkowa Piątka
description: Uliczna Mila (1609 m) and Parkowa Piątka (5 km) are road races held entirely on the paths of TAURON Park Śląski in Chorzów. The courses are certified by PZLA and World Athletics, ensuring high quality and the opportunity to achieve official results. Uliczna Mila will also host the Polish Masters Championships in 2027. The races are designed to help competitors achieve their best results on flat, fast courses.
course_highlights: Courses run entirely along the paths of TAURON Park Śląski
Certified by PZLA and World Athletics
Flat, fast courses conducive to good results
additional: Registration for the 2027 edition opens on 30 November 2026. Uliczna Mila is a 1609 m race, while Parkowa Piątka is 5 km.

name: 5. Półmaraton Szpot Swarzędz
description: Półmaraton Szpot Swarzędz is a 21.097 km half marathon in Swarzędz. The course consists of two loops around Lake Swarzędz. The race is part of the Szpot Swarzędz Running Festival, which also includes a 10 km race and a family run. The event combines sport with educational and charity activities. The 5th edition took place on 31 May 2026.
course_highlights: Two loops around Lake Swarzędz
Part of the Szpot Swarzędz Running Festival
Pacemakers, massage and a recovery meal after the race
additional: The date of the 2027 edition has not been announced yet.

name: Bieg z okazji Dni Ziemi Ropczyckiej 2026
description: The Run on the Occasion of the Ropczyce Land Days is a 10 km race taking place in Ropczyce. This running event is organized to mark a local celebration and attracts runners looking to spend time actively on a moderately long course. The route runs through the scenic surroundings of Ropczyce, and participants can expect typical May weather, with temperatures around 20 degrees Celsius. All running enthusiasts are welcome to take part in the event.

name: Szybka Piątka 5K FAST RUN Kupienino 31.05.2026
description: Szybka Piątka 5K FAST RUN in Kupienin is a new running event taking place for the first time. The race offers a dynamic 5-kilometre course, ideal for fans of fast-paced running and sporting competition. The organisers invite all runners to take part in this event, which is intended to become a regular fixture on the region’s running calendar.
course_highlights: 5 km course
Fast, flat course profile
Picturesque surroundings of Kupienin

name: 16 Kogeneracja Biegaj w Siechnicach

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 20 zł za udział w biegach młodzieżowych (zapisy do 20.05.2027)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Bieg symboliczny ok. 200 m, bez zapisów internetowych

description: The 16th Kogeneracja Biegaj w Siechnicach is a road race over 5 km and 10 km, taking place on June 6, 2027. Runners compete on a 5 km loop, with the 10 km distance consisting of two loops. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle, physical activity, and the recreational attractions of the Siechnice municipality. The Polish Engineers’ Championships over 10 km will also be held for the third time. Organizers offer attractive prizes, commemorative medals, and participant T-shirts.
course_highlights: Road course through Siechnice with a 5 km loop
Start and finish on Kościelna Street, by the intersection with Jana Pawła II Street
The 10 km distance consists of two 5 km loops
additional: Race packs for the 5 km and 10 km distances include a race number, T-shirt, Primator drink, and Eatyx product. Youth races include a race number and medal. The race office is open on the days before the race and on race day from 7:00 to 8:30. The participant limit is 900. Free parking is available by the LA/Błękitna Laguna stadium; parking by the railway station and Toro Park shopping center is recommended. Race numbers are issued upon presentation of a QR code sent to a phone or email.

name: 3 Zduńskowolski Festiwal Biegowy
description: The Zduńska Wola Running Festival is a jubilee running event held to mark the 200th anniversary of Zduńska Wola being granted town rights. The races take place on the town’s streets and in nearby municipalities, starting and finishing at the Municipal Stadium on Łaska Street. Participants can compete in the 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, and family run. The event attracts many runners, offering attractive routes and a sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: Route through the streets of Zduńska Wola
Half-marathon turnaround in the village of Brzeski in Sędziejowice Municipality
Start and finish at the Municipal Stadium on Łaska Street
additional: The event is organized by the Zduńska Wola City Office. Previous editions have seen several hundred participants, including 151 in the 5 km, 111 in the 10 km, and 151 in the half marathon. The half-marathon route passes through Zapolice Municipality to the village of Brzeski.

name: 4 Bieg Zawierciański
description: The 4th Zawiercie Run is a running event organized by the “Warto Biegać” Sports Club and the Sports and Recreation Center in Zawiercie. The event aims to promote running among all age groups and bring runners from across Poland together. The main race is 10 km, with a companion 5 km race; both routes run along the streets of Zawiercie. The start and finish are at the OSIR Stadium in Zawiercie, and the course is properly secured and marked. Runners compete in age categories and for the title of largest team in the business/club category.
course_highlights: Race route through the streets of Zawiercie
Each kilometer of the route is marked
Course closed to traffic and secured, but not certified by the PZLA
additional: The limit is 500 participants with paid entries. The race office is open from 7:00 to 8:30 on race day. Race packs can also be collected on Saturday from 16:00 to 19:00. The time limit is 1:30 for 10 km and 1:00 for 5 km. Electronic timing uses a returnable chip attached to the shoe. Participants with strollers start from the last wave after receiving the organizer’s approval.

name: Bieg o Koronę Księżnej Dąbrówki
description: The Crown of Princess Dąbrówka Run is an annual running event held on the last Sunday of May in Dąbrówka. The main 10 km race follows forest trails surrounded by greenery. There is also a 7.5 km Nordic walking event and shorter races for children. The event is family-friendly and inclusive, promoting physical activity among local residents and running enthusiasts. The organizers foster a welcoming atmosphere and offer a range of classifications, including team categories and categories for people with disabilities.
course_highlights: Main 10 km race along forest trails surrounded by greenery
7.5 km Nordic walking event
Children’s races over distances from 200 to 1,000 metres
additional: The start and finish for the run and Nordic walking event are at the edge of the Palędzie-Zakrzewo forest, on Parkowa Street in Dąbrówka. Race packets can be collected in the days before the event at the GOSiR Dopiewo sports hall and on race day at the race office. There are numerous classifications, including a team category for mixed teams of five, age categories, categories for people with disabilities, and awards for residents of Dopiewo Municipality and LINEA Developer housing estates. The children’s races take place from 9:00 to 12:00, over distances suited to participants’ ages. The event is a jubilee celebration and a festival of running for the local community.

name: Bieg Rodzinny Radia Wrocław
description: The Radio Wrocław Family Run is an annual running event held in East Park in Wrocław, aimed at families and children. Participants run in pairs—a child with an adult guardian—on a recreational 2.8 km route. The focus is on having fun together, building family bonds, and promoting physical activity among children. The event takes place in a friendly, sporty atmosphere, with commemorative medals and gifts for participants.
course_highlights: A 2.8 km route in East Park in Wrocław
Start and finish by the Radio Wrocław running path on Krakowska Street
A family run—children run in pairs with adult guardians
additional: All participants receive commemorative medals, and children receive gifts. Refreshments are available after the run. The event’s partner is Wrocław—The Meeting Place, and the Municipal Greenery Board supports its organization.

name: Bukowica Run
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Kultury w Babicach, KS Zagórzanka Zagórze
description: Bukowica Run, the Spring Run, is a race in Zagórze in Babice municipality. Runners can choose between 5 km and 10 km. The start is at the sports ground on ul. Wieczysta in Zagórze. It is organised by the Babice Municipal Culture Centre with the sports club Zagórzanka Zagórze. The 10th anniversary edition took place on 31 May 2026 at 11:00.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances
Start at the sports ground on ul. Wieczysta in Zagórze
Scenic course for beginners and experienced runners
additional: The date of the 2027 edition has not been announced yet.

name: Krakowski Bieg Swoszowicki
location: Park Zdrojowy w Swoszowicach, Kraków, Poland
description: The Kraków Swoszowice Run is a special sporting event held in the southern part of Kraków, in the Swoszowice district. The event brings generations together, offering 10 km and 5 km races, a family mile, and races for children aged 1 to 11. The main race route follows the streets of Swoszowice and the surrounding area, giving participants a chance to discover beautiful parts of the city. In addition to the sporting competition, the event takes the form of a family picnic, making it an ideal way to spend time with loved ones.
course_highlights: The 10 km main race route follows the streets of district X, Swoszowice, and the surrounding area
Intergenerational competition in the family mile
Races for children aged 1 to 11
additional: The race pack includes sponsor merchandise, a race bib, and a commemorative medal. The event takes place on the weekend before Children's Day and is held as a family picnic in the Spa Park in Swoszowice. The organizers provide numerous attractions for the whole family, as well as prizes for the fastest three-person family teams in the mile race.

name: LoveLasTrail
description: LoveLas Trail is a unique sports and recreation event held in the heart of the Masovian forests in the village of Przystań, Olszewo-Borki Municipality. This forest race brings together a passion for physical activity, a love of nature, and social connection. Courses of varying difficulty are available to runners of different skill levels, as well as families and Nordic Walking enthusiasts. The event has an atmosphere full of positive energy and respect for nature, making LoveLas Trail a special celebration of sport and a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: Cross-country routes along forest trails of varying difficulty
The Król Lasu distance of approximately 20 km for determined runners
The 2 km family race Zielona Przygoda, open to everyone, including the youngest participants
additional: Race office open from 7:30 to 9:30. Start times: 09:00 - Król Lasu (approx. 20 km), 10:00 - Bieg Wiatrów (5 km) and Trasa Wilka (10 km), 10:05 - Spacer Szakala (Nordic Walking 5 km), 10:15 - Zielona Przygoda (2 km family run/walk). The entry fee includes a race bib, returnable timing chip, commemorative gift, medal, recovery meal, and sweet treat. Open classifications for women and men are held for the 5, 10, and 20 km distances and Nordic Walking, with trophies for the top finishers.

name: Mazowiecka Piętnastka
description: Mazowiecka Piętnastka is a celebratory road race organized by the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Mińsk Mazowiecki. Held annually, the event attracts runners from across Poland and offers an appealing 15-kilometre course. It is a great opportunity to celebrate through sport and connect in the picturesque city of Mińsk Mazowiecki. In 2026, the race takes place on May 31, and MOSiR celebrates 50 years of operation.
course_highlights: A 15 km course along the streets of Mińsk Mazowiecki
Picturesque views and a clearly marked course
A celebratory edition organized by MOSiR, which has 50 years of experience
additional: The organizer is the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Mińsk Mazowiecki, open from 8:00 to 16:00 Monday through Friday. The course is statically marked on a map available on the organizer's website.

name: Mokotowski Bieg SGH
description: The Mokotów SGH Run is Poland’s largest student-organized charity run, combining sport with support for people in need. The event’s 13th edition is an opportunity to cover the streets of Mokotów together, in an atmosphere of sporting passion and community spirit. Participants can look forward to a gathering area, a group warm-up and a medal ceremony. The run supports the “Akogo?” Foundation, helping people in comas. It brings together sport, solidarity and the energy of student involvement.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km routes through Mokotów
Finish line in the SGH Rector’s Gardens
A run for children and whole families
additional: A race village with partner activities, a group warm-up before the start, a medal ceremony after the run, the option for whole families to take part, a charity run supporting the “Akogo?” Foundation.

name: Stryszów w Biegu
description: Stryszów w Biegu is a running event organised by Stryszów municipality with three distances. The 6 km Rodzinna Szóstka is a recreational family run, Stryszowska Zadyszka covers 10 km, and the 21 km Stryszowski Półmaraton Górski is a demanding mountain race. The courses run through fields and forests with views of Lake Mucharskie and the surrounding hills. In 2026 the event took place on 31 May.
course_highlights: Three distances: 6 km, 10 km and 21 km
Views of Lake Mucharskie
Mountain half marathon for experienced runners
additional: The organiser provides course and parking maps and GPX files. The date of the 2027 edition has not been announced yet.

name: UltraPark Weekend
description: UltraPark Weekend is an ultrarunning festival held in Pabianice, featuring three main events: UltraPark 48h, UltraPark 24h, and UltraPark 100 km. The competition also serves as the Polish Cup of the Polish Ultra Sports Association and the PZLA Polish Championships in ultrarunning. This unique event attracts long-distance runners, offering challenging courses and a top-level competitive atmosphere.
course_highlights: UltraPark 48h and UltraPark 24h courses — timed races that test endurance
UltraPark 100 km — a classic ultra distance certified by PZLA
High-level organization with professional support and timing

name: V Półmaraton Po Kolei
location: Lemany, Szczytno County, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 5th Po Kolei Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Lemany, near Szczytno. The half-marathon course is approximately 21.1 km long and follows scenic routes around the village. In addition to the half marathon, the event includes children’s races over various distances and a 5 km race, making it appealing to participants of different ages and ability levels. The event combines sport and recreation and is organized by the District Sports, Tourism and Recreation Centre in Szczytno together with local partners. The main race is scheduled to start at 9:00. Participants can collect their race packets the day before or on race day.
course_highlights: Half-marathon course of approximately 21.1 km
Children’s races over distances from 100 m to 800 m
A 5 km race as an additional event
additional: On race day, registration is available only for race packets that have been released. The race office is open from 7:00. Participants must start with a chip and race bib, which must be returned after the race. Minors must have written consent from their legal guardians. The awards ceremony is scheduled for around 12:30.

name: X Charytatywny Gminny Bieg Między Wiatra...
location: Łukaszów, Gmina Zagrodno, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 10th Municipal Charity Run Between the Windmills is an annual running event held in Łukaszów, aimed at promoting running, sport, and a healthy lifestyle. The event is charitable, and all funds raised are donated to support those in need. The route follows a scenic loop around the windmills in Łukaszów, and participants can choose from several distances, including a children’s race and 5 km and 10 km runs. The organizers provide chip timing, as well as a hot meal and drinks for participants.
course_highlights: A loop around the windmills in Łukaszów
5 km and 10 km routes with a time limit of 1 hour 30 minutes
A children’s race of approximately 500 m on the recreation grounds
additional: The total participant limit is 200 across all distances. Timing is provided by Sports Timing Poland using reusable electronic chips worn on the leg. Chips must be returned after the race; a fee of 50 zł applies for a lost chip. Participants must check in at the race office, which is open on race day from 8:30 to 10:35. The organizers provide a hot meal, cakes, water, coffee, and tea.

name: XI Sieradzki Cross Towarzyski
location: Park Miejski im. Adama Mickiewicza, Sieradz, Poland
description: The 11th Sieradz Friendly Cross is organized by the Sieradz Biega Sports Club. It promotes running as a simple form of physical activity and brings together the running community of Sieradz. The event takes place in A. Mickiewicz Municipal Park, where participants compete on a 2-kilometer gravel loop. The race lasts 6 hours, and the winner is the runner who completes the most laps in that time. Runners receive bibs with chips for electronic lap and time tracking.
course_highlights: 2 km loop in Sieradz Municipal Park
100% gravel surface
Lap markers every 500 m
additional: The race runs from 11:00 to 17:00. Participants may stop and resume running at any time, but during breaks they must remain in the designated transition area. The participant limit is 250. Participants receive a returnable race bib with a chip to track laps and time. Minors may take part with parental consent and may run a maximum of 10 km (5 laps).

name: XII Biegnij Dla Aniołów
description: TAURON Run for the Angels is a charity race held in Katowice to support the children cared for by the Angels’ Guard House. The event takes place in Kościuszko Park and combines sporting competition with a family picnic full of attractions. Participants can choose the main 5 km race, children’s races in various age categories, or a virtual race. All entry fees go toward helping children from disadvantaged backgrounds by providing them with educational, therapeutic, and academic support. The event is for people of all ages who want to combine physical activity with helping those in need.
course_highlights: Main 5 km race in Kościuszko Park in Katowice
Three races for children in various age categories
Option to take part in the virtual race from anywhere
additional: Children aged 0–6 may accompany a guardian on the main race route free of charge, provided they are registered in advance on the form. Every participant receives a commemorative medal and a small gift. Prizes and trophies are awarded to the top three finishers in the women’s and men’s categories and in the children’s races. The maximum number of participants in the main race is 550. The event runs from 09:00 to 14:00 and is combined with a Family Picnic.

name: XIV Kurdeszowa (Za)Dyszka
description: The 14th Kurdeszowa (Za)Dyszka in Kostrzyn is an annual running event organized by the Municipal Sports, Tourism and Recreation Centre in Kostrzyn. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle among residents and visitors. The race takes place on a course in Kostrzyn, engaging the local community and fostering integration. The organizers ensure participants’ comfort and safety by providing well-prepared sports facilities.

name: XXXIX Bieg Stolemów
description: The 39th Stolemów Run is an annual 10 km race held in Gniewino, attracting runners from different age categories. The event takes place at the Arena Mistrzów sports stadium and also includes children’s races, a Nordic Walking march, and a recreational run-walk. Participants are timed electronically, and medals and prizes for the top finishers await them at the finish. For those unable to attend in person, a virtual race option is also available during a designated period.
course_highlights: Certified 10 km main race
5 km Nordic Walking march
Children’s races over distances from 80 m to 800 m
additional: 11:00, official warm-up at 13:10.

name: Świętokrzyski Bieg Europejski
description: The Świętokrzyski European Run is an annual road race held in Kielce that promotes physical activity and social integration. The 5-kilometer course runs through the city streets, offering participants a sporting challenge in a friendly atmosphere. The event is part of the May Funds events in the Świętokrzyskie Voivodeship, highlighting European values and the local community.
course_highlights: A 5 km road course
The race takes place in central Kielce
The event promotes physical activity and social integration

name: 11 Mazowiecka Piątka
location: MOSiR Aquapark Miejski, ul. Wyszyńskiego 56, Mińsk Mazowiecki
organizer: MOSiR w Mińsku Mazowieckim, Stowarzyszenie Klub Sportowy Barakuda
description: Mazowiecka Piątka is a 5 km road race in Mińsk Mazowiecki, held as part of the national street races together with Mazowiecka Piętnastka. Start, finish and race office are at the MOSiR Aquapark on ul. Wyszyńskiego 56. A 5 km nordic walking race starts just after the run. It is organised by MOSiR Mińsk Mazowiecki and the Barakuda sports club. The 11th edition started on 31 May 2026 at 11:00.
course_highlights: Course through the streets of Mińsk Mazowiecki
Start and finish at the MOSiR Aquapark
5 km nordic walking race right after the run start
additional: In 2026 the 5 km entry fee was 65 to 100 zł depending on the registration date and T-shirt option. The date of the 2027 edition has not been announced yet.

name: Bieg Papieski
description: Bieg Papieski is a 10 km race in Pelplin, held as part of the Pelplin Days. The base is the Municipal Stadium, where the start and finish are located. The main course is two 5 km loops through the streets of Pelplin on asphalt, field roads and paved sidewalks. Children and youth race over 100 m to 800 m. In 2026 the main race started on 31 May at 16:00.
course_highlights: Two 5 km loops through Pelplin
Start and finish at the Municipal Stadium
Children's and youth runs from 100 m to 800 m
additional: In 2026 registration was open until 28 May or until the limit of 250 paid runners was reached. The date of the 2027 edition has not been announced yet.

name: Dycha nad Regą
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Świdwinie
description: Dycha nad Regą, the Wojtek Pismenko Memorial, is a 10 km road race in Świdwin, organized by MOSiR Świdwin in cooperation with the 21st Tactical Air Base. The race commemorates Wojtek Pismenko, a marathon runner from Świdwin and a soldier in the Polish Armed Forces. The 11th edition started at 10:00 on 1 Maja Street. At the finish, participants received a medal and military pea soup prepared by the 21st Tactical Air Base. The date of the 2027 edition has not yet been announced.
course_highlights: A 10 km road race in Świdwin
Cash prizes of 1000, 500 and 300 zł for the top three women and men
A medal and pea soup prepared by the 21st Tactical Air Base
additional: In 2026, the race package included a technical T-shirt, promotional materials and a one-hour swimming pool pass for race day. Registration was available on biegnijmy.pl.

name: III Bieg Izabeli Czartoryskiej
description: The Izabela Czartoryska Run is a 5 km and 10 km race in Gołuchów. The start and finish are at the Forest Culture Centre, and the course follows the streets of Gołuchów and roads towards Jedlec and Macew. The third edition has taken place. The children’s races started at 10:00, and the main races at 12:00. The date of the 2027 edition has not yet been announced.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances
Start and finish at the Forest Culture Centre in Gołuchów
Course through the streets of Gołuchów towards Jedlec and Macew
additional: In 2026, families with children could enjoy bouncy castles, activities, mascots, cotton candy and popcorn.

name: IV Marszobieg Politechniki Częstochowskiej
organizer: Studium Wychowania Fizycznego i Sportu Politechniki Częstochowskiej, Miasto i Gmina Olsztyn
description: The Prof. Maciej Mrowiec Częstochowa University of Technology Run-Walk is a running and Nordic walking event in Olsztyn near Częstochowa, in the Kraków-Częstochowa Upland. It is organized by the Physical Education and Sports Centre of Częstochowa University of Technology and the Town and Municipality of Olsztyn. The event base is at GOSiR, 66 Zielona Street. Participants can choose a 5 or 10 km run or a 5 km Nordic walk, while children compete in 100 m and 400 m races. The fourth edition’s run-walk started at 11:20.
course_highlights: 5 or 10 km run and 5 km Nordic walk
Route through the Kraków-Częstochowa Upland
Children’s races: 100 m (ages 5–8) and 400 m (ages 9–12)
additional: In 2026, race packets were distributed from 9:00 to 11:00, and registration was available on dostartu.pl. The date of the 2027 edition has not yet been announced.

name: Beh Rajeckým rínkom
description: The Run Around Rajec Square is a traditional running race organized by Maratón klub Rajec, held at SNP Square in Rajec. The race gives runners the opportunity to enjoy the natural beauty and surroundings of Rajec on a May day. The event is suitable for the general public, including children and minors, who must have the consent of a legal guardian. The organizers emphasize safety and thorough preparation for participants.

name: Beh na Zniev
location: Kláštor pod Znievom okr. Martin, Kláštor pod Znievom okr. Martin, areál bývalého Prvého slovenského gymnázia
description: Beh na Zniev is a championship uphill race held in Kláštor pod Znievom, offering a challenging 5,650-metre course with 475 metres of elevation gain. The race is open to a wide range of categories, from children to veterans, including men, women, juniors and youth. The main race starts at 14:00 in the grounds of the former grammar school. The organizers are the Kláštor pod Znievom Municipal Office, Strive sport, TRIMAT and the Slovak Athletics Association. The race is part of the Slovak Mountain Running Cup.

name: Pivovarsko-hradná sedemtisícovka
location: Veľký Šariš okr. Prešov, Veľký Šariš okr. Prešov, areál TJ Slavoj V. Šariš
description: The Brewery-Castle Seven-Thousander is a running event organized by the town of Veľký Šariš in cooperation with Šariš Brewery and the Sports Commission of the Municipal Council in Veľký Šariš. The race takes place at the TJ Slavoj Veľký Šariš grounds and offers categories for various age groups, as well as Nordic walking. The start is scheduled for 15:00 for the run and 15:05 for Nordic walking. The event is suitable for the general public, including adolescents, juniors, and women and men in various age categories.

name: Beh rajeckým rínkom
location: Rajec, Žilina District, Žilina Region, Slovakia
description: The Rajec Square Run is a traditional running race organized by the town of Rajec, held at SNP Square. The event is part of the town’s sporting and cultural life and offers an opportunity for runners of different age groups and ability levels. The course passes through the town’s scenic surroundings, combining sport with an enjoyable experience of the local area. The run is part of a broader program of sporting and cultural activities in Rajec.
course_highlights: The course runs through the center of Rajec
Scenic surroundings in the Žilina Region
An opportunity for runners of different age groups

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Zadní Třebaň
description: Běžecká série Berounka v Zadní Třebani je malebný závod konaný v krásné přírodě Středočeského kraje. Trasa vede podél řeky Berounky, přes louky s výhledy, naučnou stezku Liteň a malebnou krajinu připomínající Toskánsko. Závod vrcholí výběhem na nejvyšší bod trati v Doubcích a závěrečným seběhem do cíle v příjemném kempu s občerstvením. Každý účastník obdrží startovní číslo a první tři v kategoriích získají diplomy a medaile.

name: Běh Advenťáka PLZEŇ
description: Běh Advenťáka Plzeň 2026 je charitativní běh pořádaný na podporu lidí, kteří to v životě nemají jednoduché. Závod se koná v Krašovském aktivitním centru a nabízí trať dlouhou 6,45 km vedoucí po zpevněných cestách v okolí Krkavce. Součástí jsou také dětské kategorie s kratšími tratěmi. Účastníci získají startovní číslo, diplom s časem, perníček a další dárky, přičemž část startovného jde na podporu hrdinů.

name: COOL-BEACH-TRAIL Bad Teinach
description: The COOL-BEACH-TRAIL Bad Teinach is a trail running event in the scenic surroundings of Bad Teinach. The course is short at 1.61 km and is ideal for beginners and anyone who enjoys running off-road. The event is part of the Sauerland Trailrunning Challenge and features a varied route with sections close to nature. Participants can look forward to a sporting challenge in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Trail running course covering 1.61 km
Sections close to nature in the Bad Teinach area
Part of the Sauerland Trailrunning Challenge

name: dm Firmenlauf Saarbrücken
description: The dm Company Run Saarbrücken is a sporting event for teams and companies held in Saarbrücken city centre. The 5 km flat, paved route starts at the State Theatre and follows the Saar before passing through the city centre, accompanied by a great atmosphere and cheers from spectators.
