Changing facilities and restrooms are available in the Bäumerstraße gym, about 500 m from the market square. Timing is recorded using transponders attached to the bib numbers, which must be handed in after the race. Parking is available, among other places, in the Marktplatz underground car park and at the Alter Pferdemarkt car park. Due to road closures, access to parking in the city centre will be restricted on the event day. Start and finish on Lingener Market Square, parking in the city centre, changing facilities at the Bäumerstraße gym, no timing for the children's race

name: Mainauenlauf 2026
description: The scenic, challenging undulating course runs through green parks with wonderful panoramas over the city. Various distances are offered, including 5 km, 10 km, a half marathon, Nordic walking, and children’s and youth races. A special highlight is the atmospheric finish in the Finisher Park, with excellent refreshments and a unique finisher medal. City championships will also be held for the first time across all distances.
course_highlights: Challenging, undulating 5 km loop with 85 metres of elevation gain per lap
Highest point on the course: Col Bellota
Finish in the Mainauenlauf Finisher Park, with refreshments and a medal
additional: Showers are available at the Ost School Centre until 15:00. There is a photo booth in the start/finish area. Bags can be dropped off in the Finisher Park and collected by 15:00. Group warm-up run on Saturday at 18:30 in the Finisher Park. Refreshment stations at km 2, 3, 6 and 7 with water, isotonic drinks, pastries and fruit. Toilets are available near the finish area and at the Ost Sports Centre. Distances: 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, relays, Nordic walking, children’s and youth races; start on the grounds of the State Garden Show; refreshments at several points; finish in the Finisher Park

name: Taunussteiner Waldlauf 30.7
description: The Taunusstein Forest Run is a long-established running event that has attracted around 700 runners to the scenic forests and hills of the Lower Taunus every year for over 30 years. The main 15-kilometre course offers a demanding challenge, with varied terrain and around 250 metres of elevation gain. Shorter distances of 5 and 2 kilometres are available for beginners and children, making them ideal for getting a taste of competition. The event stands out for its varied scenery and lively programme in the finish area.
course_highlights: Scenic, varied routes through forests and fields between Hahn, Wingsbach and Watzhahn
Main 15 km course with around 250 metres of elevation gain and demanding terrain
Refreshment stations at km 3, 6, 7, 10 and 13 on the 15 km course
additional: Start and finish at Gesamtschule Obere Aar (Pestalozzistraße 3, 65232 Taunusstein). Race-number collection from 07:30 in the cafeteria of IGS Obere Aar; runners are advised to collect their numbers at least 40 minutes before the start. The time limit for the 15 km race is 2:30 hours. All finishers receive a medal. The fastest men and women in each distance receive prizes, which are awarded only on race day. Participants in the 2 km race take part in a raffle. Showers and changing facilities are available on site. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Walkers are welcome and are classified separately, but receive no prizes. On-site late registration is available for a €2 fee. Results and certificates are available online. Refreshments, cake, grilled food and drinks are available in the start/finish area. The event is family-friendly, welcomes walkers, and offers refreshments and drinks in the finish area. Registration is available both online and on site.

name: Neustädter Stadtlauf
location: Neustadt am Rübenberge, Lower Saxony, Germany

name: 14. Stadtlauf des TSV Neustadt
location: Neustadt am Rübenberge, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The 14th TSV Neustadt am Rübenberge City Run is an accessible fun run that fosters community and social connection. The event promotes inclusion and is open to runners of all ages and ability levels. Held in the city of Neustadt am Rübenberge, it offers a sporting opportunity for young and old to be active together.
course_highlights: Accessible run promoting inclusive participation
Community spirit and social connection
Event in Neustadt am Rübenberge

name: 21. ProPotsdam Schlösserlauf
description: The ProPotsdam Schlösserlauf in Potsdam is a unique running event that combines tradition, culture, and sporting challenge. The course passes through the historic palaces, gardens, and landmarks of the state capital of Brandenburg, offering runners an unforgettable experience in a UNESCO World Heritage Site. With more than 4,500 participants, the race is a popular event for runners of all abilities. Experience the special atmosphere and the diverse sights along the route through the city’s history.

name: 45. Wehlheider Volkslauf
description: The Wehlheider Volkslauf is a traditional recreational running event in Schönfeld Park in Kassel-Wehlheiden and is part of the Nordhessencup. The course runs mainly along paved paths and through wooded areas, with various distances for all age groups. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere and is open to everyone, regardless of club membership. Changing and shower facilities are available, and runners are provided with refreshments along the course.

name: Bleicheröder Vogelberglauf
organizer: Ski- und Wanderverein 1954 Bleicherode e.V. und Freunde des Vogelberglaufes
description: The Bleicheröder Vogelberglauf is a traditional race held in Bleicherode. The event offers four distances (2 km, 5 km, 10 km and 20 km) on road and trail courses, starting at the former Schneckenhengst youth hostel building. The race is organized by Ski- und Wanderverein 1954 Bleicherode e.V. and Freunde des Vogelberglaufes. Results are scored according to the age-group system of the German Athletics Association, with specific age restrictions for younger participants. Trophies and certificates are awarded to the top runners in various categories.

name: Norderstedter Stadtlauf
description: The Norderstedt City Run is a popular running event held annually by Norderstedter Sportverein e.V. Runners of all ages and ability levels can take part in various races, including the 5-kilometer race, 10-kilometer race, fun run and children’s run. The event offers a sporting atmosphere on closed, traffic-free routes and is supported by the police, the THW and volunteers. The run promotes community, fun and health and is a highlight of the regional sports calendar.

name: Altöttinger Intersp. Siebzehnrübl Dultlauf mit Staffeln
description: The Altöttinger Siebzehnrübl Dultlauf is a traditional running event in Altötting, offering various distances for all age groups. The races take place on a road circuit and include both individual and relay events. The event is family-friendly and has a warm atmosphere, with every participant receiving a Dult pretzel. The awards ceremony takes place at the Dult after the races.
course_highlights: Road circuit
4 x 2.5 km relay
Family-friendly distances from 500 m to 10 km
additional: Race bibs can be picked up from 7:45 a.m. at the stadium and must be collected no later than 60 minutes before the start. Late entries are accepted at the event venue up to 1 hour before the start for an additional fee of €5. Results will be published online.

name: Everstener Brunnenlauf 2026
description: The Everstener Brunnenlauf is a long-standing running event in Oldenburg. Various races are offered, including races for schoolchildren, a 6.3 km corporate and taster run, and a 10 km fun run. The route passes through the Eversten district, starting on Wienstraße and finishing in Eversten Holz. The event is known for its large number of participants and family-friendly atmosphere, appealing to both recreational and competitive runners.

name: FLVW Halbmarathonmeisterschaften
description: The FLVW Half Marathon Championships will take place on June 6, 2027, in Salzkotten and are organized by the Westphalian Football and Athletics Association (FLVW). The event is for runners who wish to qualify for the Westphalian Half Marathon Championships. The championships offer a sporting challenge on a half marathon course and promote regional running. Interested participants are encouraged to register promptly to take part in this long-standing competition.

name: Haster Volkslauf
description: The Haster Volkslauf 2026 takes place on June 7 in Osnabrück-Haste and offers races for all age groups and ability levels. The event includes Bambini races, an inclusive fun run, and short- and long-distance races. The course passes through the beautiful surroundings of Haste and is recognized as an officially sanctioned race by the German Athletics Association. Participants receive medals and trophies, with the awards ceremony held immediately afterward at the sports field. The entry fee also supports a fundraising campaign for “Jede Oma zählt.”

name: Hopfengarten-Pokallauf - Landescup 9
description: The Hopfengarten Cup Race is part of the Novo Nordisk State Cup Saxony-Anhalt and takes place in Magdeburg. The event is organized by the Saxony-Anhalt Athletics Association (Leichtathletik-Verband Sachsen-Anhalt e.V.) and is open to runners of all age groups. The State Cup provides a sporting platform for ambitious runners and promotes running in the region. Runners must register through the LADV registration portal, and the association’s age-group and course recommendations apply.

name: Lauf um die Himmelsschaukel Bründersen 2026
description: The Run around the Sky Swing in Bründersen is a traditional scoring race in the Waldeck-Frankenberg Running Cup. Various distances are offered, from 400 meters to 20 kilometers, suitable for all age groups, from Bambini to seniors. The event takes place at the Bründersen sports field and offers a varied course through the beautiful surrounding area. The race is part of TSV Bründersen 1967 e.V. and combines sporting competition with community and regional ties.

name: Pfreimdtaltrail 2026
description: The Pfreimdtal Trail is a trail half marathon around Trausnitz. The course covers approximately 21 kilometers with about 450 meters of elevation gain and offers varied landscapes along the Pfreimd, including steep climbs, downhill sections, and scenic stretches on the Goldsteig. The event is registered as a UTMB Index Race and is open to runners aged 16 and over. Alongside the athletic challenge, the race offers a family-friendly atmosphere with refreshments, an awards ceremony, and food and drink provided by TSV Trausnitz.

name: Schwäbische Zeitung Halbmarathon
description: The Schwäbische Zeitung Half Marathon in Sigmaringen is a challenging and inspiring running event, organized by a dedicated team of runners for runners. The event offers a beautiful setting and ideal conditions for personal bests or running for a good cause. The organizing team places great importance on community, safety, and a great atmosphere along the course. The Limitless Hybrid Running Club supports participants with group training sessions and individual training plans.

name: Spechaa Lauf Spöck
description: The 5th Spechaa Run takes place as part of the TV sports festival in Stutensee-Spöck. Events include a 10 km main race, a 5 km beginner’s race, and a 5 km walking course. The routes follow forest and agricultural paths, with the start and finish at the TV sports grounds. The races are part of the Stutensee Cup, which features individual and team rankings across several events in the region.

name: ZVO Energie-Straßen-Lauf Rund um Ratekau
description: The ZVO Energie-Straßen-Lauf Rund um Ratekau is being held for the 36th time and offers races over 2 km, 5 km, 10 km and 15 km, as well as a 400 m Bambini run. The courses are officially measured and suitable for record attempts, with the start and finish at the TSV Ratekau sports field. There are suitable races for all ability levels, including a schoolchildren’s cup that runs throughout the calendar year. The event places great emphasis on safety, with road closures, and provides refreshments along the course and in the finish area.

name: La Sportiva Sauerland Trailrun powered by Sport Schneider
Coconaut Pomerania Summer Trail
description: Pomerania Summer Trail is a summer trail running event in the Pomerania Trail series, held on hilly and technical trails in Kashubia. It has four distances from 55 km down to 10 km plus a Junior Trail for young runners. The race is part of the Pomerania Trail 2027 Ultra Kaszub series.
course_highlights: Four distances: 55, 42, 25 and 10 km
Hilly and technical Pomeranian trails
Junior Trail for young runners
additional: Rules in Polish and English, the courses and results are published on the race website.

name: Bieg po zdrowie
description: The Władysław Zamoyski Run for Health is held by Lake Rusałka in Poznań. It combines competition with the promotion of health and preventive care, particularly among men. The course follows paths around the lake. Participants can choose between 10 km and 5 km, a 5 km Nordic walking event, and children’s races. The third edition took place.
course_highlights: Course on paths around Lake Rusałka
10 km and 5 km races, plus 5 km Nordic walking
Children’s races
additional: In 2026, the entry fee was 49 zł for registrations by 15 April and 69 zł from 16 April to 22 May; fees for children were 15 zł and 30 zł. Each participant received a race pack with a chip, a T-shirt, and a medal. The date of the 2027 edition has not yet been announced.

name: Bieg pod Tysiącletnimi Dębami
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Aktywny Kazimierz Biskupi, Gmina Kazimierz Biskupi
description: Bieg pod Tysiącletnimi Dębami is a run in Kazimierz Biskupi that returned to the calendar in 2025. The main race is 10 km, with a 5 km run and a 5 km Nordic walking event alongside it. Children and teenagers run the Biegi Szewczyków over 100 to 800 m. The 2026 edition took place on 7 June.
course_highlights: 10 km main race starting at 13:00
5 km run and 5 km Nordic walking at 13:10
Biegi Szewczyków kids' races from 100 to 800 m
additional: In 2026 bibs were handed out the day before from 17:00 to 20:00 and on race day from 8:30 to 12:15. The time limit ended at 14:40. The 2027 date has not been announced yet.

name: Bieg Śladem Konia
description: The Bieg Śladem Konia is an annual race organized by WKB Piast Wrocław, held in the picturesque areas of Wrocław. The course runs along a variety of paths and through green spaces, offering participants a unique running experience. The event is amateur in nature and is part of the club race calendar, promoting physical activity and bringing runners together. The race is well known in the local community and has a long tradition.
course_highlights: The course passes through Wrocław’s green spaces
A variety of surfaces, including forest and urban paths
Picturesque views and natural surroundings
additional: The organizer is WKB Piast Wrocław. Results from previous years are available on the website. No detailed information about entry fees or the start time is available on the main website or in archived race regulations.

name: I Bieg po Jagodę Kamczacką
description: The Haskap Berry Run is held in Muniakowice, near Kraków, with the event base, start and finish at PLANTIN’s haskap berry plantation. The main race is 10 km, alongside a 10 km Nordic walking event and races for children. The first edition was held as the first race in the Berry Relay. The event was organized in cooperation with the Bieg Rolnika Foundation.
course_highlights: Start and finish at a haskap berry plantation
10 km run and 10 km Nordic walking event
Races for children
additional: The event was held under the honorary patronage of the Słomniki Municipality and the Miechów Municipality. The date of the 2027 edition has not yet been announced.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Warszawa
description: IRONMAN 70.3 Warsaw is a prestigious triathlon held in the heart of Poland’s capital, combining swimming, cycling, and running over the half-Ironman distance. The race starts at Zegrze Reservoir, and the cycling course passes through scenic municipalities and Warsaw streets, followed by a run in the Multimedia Fountain Park. This exceptional sporting event attracts athletes from around the world, offering not only a sporting challenge but also an opportunity to discover Warsaw’s cultural and historical riches.
course_highlights: A 1.9 km swim in Zegrze Lake, with a time limit of 1 hour 10 minutes
A 90 km cycling course through the municipalities of Nieporęt, Marki, and Radzymin, as well as the streets of Warsaw
A 21.1 km run over three laps through the streets of Warsaw’s historic center, finishing at the Multimedia Fountain Park
additional: The event offers services including bike rental, bike transfer, bike build & pack, medal engraving, finisher photos, and a camper park. The course is fully secured and closed off, with street closures and traffic control. A helpline for drivers is available during the event at 500 261 000. The start is at Zegrze Reservoir, and the finish is at the Multimedia Fountain Park. The time limit for completing the entire race is 8 hours 30 minutes.

name: Pogórzański Festiwal Biegowy - Lato
description: Pogórzański Running Festival – Summer is an annual sporting event held in Burzyn near Tuchów, promoting running and a healthy lifestyle among residents of Małopolska. The event includes races at various distances, including a 22 km mountain race with 800 m of elevation gain, a 10 km race, a 5.5 km race, and a 5.5 km Nordic Walking event. The start and finish are at the LKS Burzyn stadium by the Primary School in Burzyn, and participants receive a race pack with a gift and snacks. The event is held under the honorary patronage of the Mayor of Tuchów Municipality and is organized by LKS Burzyn and Kępa Sport.
course_highlights: 22 km mountain race with 800 m of total elevation gain
4 aid stations along the 22 km race route
Start and finish at the LKS Burzyn stadium by the Primary School in Burzyn
additional: On race day, 30 additional race packs are available. The children’s races begin at 9:30 at the stadium, with a new race starting every 5 minutes. The awards ceremony is scheduled for approximately 13:30–14:00. The race office, baggage storage, changing rooms, and showers are located in the hall of the Primary School in Burzyn, next to the stadium.

name: Test Coopera dla wszystkich
location: Stadion im. Opolskich Olimpijczyków, ul. Sosnkowskiego 12, Opole
description: Test Coopera dla Wszystkich is a free nationwide fitness test, held in Opole at the Stadion im. Opolskich Olimpijczyków. The aim is to cover as much distance as possible in 12 minutes, running or walking. Heats start about every 15 minutes in groups of around 25. The 2026 spring edition took place on 7 June from 10:00 to 15:00.
course_highlights: Timed run: 12 minutes on the track
Free entry, bib and certificate with your result
Heats about every 15 minutes in groups of 25
additional: Sign-up is at the stadium on the day, at the race office by the track. Minors need a guardian's consent. The 2027 date has not been announced yet.

name: VI EKO Bieg z Gwizdkiem po Zdrowie
description: The 6th Eko Bieg z Gwizdkiem po Zdrowie is an annual running event held in Jerzmanowice-Przeginia that promotes a healthy lifestyle and physical activity. The race takes place in a scenic area, and participants can compete on courses suited to different experience levels. The organizers provide safe, official registration and the option to purchase race packages from other participants. The event is eco-friendly and inclusive, encouraging regular training from registration through race day.
course_highlights: The course runs through the municipality of Jerzmanowice-Przeginia
Scenic landscapes and natural surroundings
Training counts from registration through race day
additional: Race packages can be bought or listed on the official package exchange safely. The race office is located at Chochołowy Dwór, ul. Jana III Sobieskiego 172, and is open from 8:00 to 9:15.

name: X Festiwal Biegów Polski Północnej i Akt...
location: Boisko przy ul. Leśnej, Wdzydze Kiszewskie, Poland
description: The Northern Poland Running and Physical Activity Festival in Wdzydze is the tenth anniversary edition of an event promoting running and physical activity in the picturesque landscapes of Kashubia. The event takes place June 5–7 and features five main races in the Hard Runner series, with distances ranging from 1.6 km to a half marathon. Participants compete for an overall ranking based on the total points earned across all races. The festival brings together the running community of Northern Poland while also promoting local culture and nature.
course_highlights: Routes of 1.6 km, 5 km, 10 km, 15 km, and a half marathon (21 km)
Picturesque landscapes of Kashubia and the forests of the Kościerzyna Forest District
Routes available to view on the Traseo platform
additional: Race number with a timing chip (returnable). The race office is open during the festival. The overall ranking is based on the total points earned across five races. Recognition for the top competitors from the Municipality of Kościerzyna.

name: XIII Maraton i Półmaraton Fundacji DASZR...
location: Opalenie, Gmina Gniew, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The XIII DASZRADE Foundation Marathon and Half Marathon in Memory of Barbara Karaczyńska is a small-scale running event held in Opalenie to coincide with the anniversary of the founding of the “Zapowiednik” Addiction Treatment Center. The marathon course is entirely paved, runs through the picturesque fields and forests of Kociewie, is certified by the Polish Athletics Association, and features numerous fairly steep climbs, with a total elevation gain of 646 m. The race is demanding due to the terrain and thermal conditions, but offers beautiful views and an unforgettable atmosphere. After the race, participants can enjoy a recovery meal, and everyone receives a commemorative medal, diploma, and T-shirt.
course_highlights: An entirely paved course through the fields and forests of Kociewie
646 m of total elevation gain with numerous steep climbs
The course is marked every 1 km, with refreshment stations every 5 km and mobile refreshment stations
additional: A recovery meal is served after the race. The 10 km “Olka” course is paved and partially follows the half-marathon course. The entry fee is donated in full to the DASZRADE Foundation, which supports people recovering from addiction.

name: XV Bieg Pszczyński
description: The 15th Carbo Asecura Pszczyna Run is an annual running event held in Pszczyna since 2012. The main race follows a well-known and popular 10 km course, and the event also includes races for children and young people. The main race course is not certified by the Polish Athletic Association (PZLA), but participants can expect a tried-and-tested and attractive route. The event attracts runners of various age groups, offering sporting competition and a great atmosphere.
course_highlights: 10 km main race course
Two water stations on the course (at approximately 4 km and 7.8 km)
Races for children and young people as part of the event
additional: The race office is located in the MORiS sports hall in Pszczyna, at 4 Basztowa Street. Race packs can be collected on Saturday and Sunday using a QR code. There are two water stations on the main race course, serving water in plastic cups. The main race starts from the Market Square at 09:30. Paid and free parking is available near the start. After the race, gross time is recorded using a chip in the race bib.

name: 10 Bieg po Gminie Świerczów
location: Dąbrowa, Świerczów Municipality, Opole Voivodeship, Poland

name: 47 Biegu V Stawów
description: The International Five Ponds Run is a trail race in Myszków, held at the Dotyk Jury complex in the Kraków-Częstochowa Upland. The longest distance is the 21 km half marathon, alongside an 11 km quarter marathon and the 5 km Jurajska Piątka. There is also an 11 km Nordic walking event.
course_highlights: 21 km half marathon with fast and technical sections
11 km quarter marathon around the ponds, also available for Nordic walking
5 km Jurajska Piątka for beginners and families
additional: The routes are marked by color: blue for 21 km, green for 11 km and Nordic walking, and orange for 5 km. The date of the 2027 edition has not yet been announced.

name: III Bieg Charytatywny Dookoła Jeziora Cz...
IV Bieg Charytatywny Nagronik
organizer: OREW w Tarnawie Górnej (PSONI Koło w Zawoi), Urząd Gminy Stryszawa
description: The Charity Run and Nordic Walking March Na Gronik for the Mayor of Stryszawa Municipality Cup is a race in Stryszawa, based at Primary School No. 2 and Jałowiec Sports Club. The run and Nordic walking march are both 5 km long. The route starts at the sports field and heads uphill through the Gawrony housing estate. Proceeds support the Rehabilitation, Education and Care Centre in Tarnawa Górna. The fourth edition took place.
course_highlights: 5 km run starting at 9:30
5 km Nordic walking march at 9:45
Family run: one lap of the Jałowiec grounds
additional: In 2026, the entry fee was 80 zł, and the family run cost 50 zł per family. Every participant received a commemorative medal. The date of the 2027 edition has not yet been announced.

name: Jędrzejowski Bieg Uliczny
organizer: UMKS NADIR Jędrzejów, Urząd Miejski w Jędrzejowie
description: Jędrzejowski Bieg Uliczny im. Kazimierza Mazurkiewicza is a 10 km road race held as part of the Bieg Lisów event in Jędrzejów. The course loops through the town streets, past the market square, and is not certified. Start and finish are on Świętej Barbary street by the Zalew reservoir, which is also the race centre. The 2026 edition took place on 7 June, starting at 11:00.
course_highlights: 10 km on the streets around Jędrzejów
Start and finish by the Zalew on Świętej Barbary street
Course through the market square
additional: In 2026 the race office was open from 8:00 to 10:30, with on-site entry possible. Runners aged 16 to 18 needed parental consent. The 2027 date has not been announced yet.

name: V Bieg Szczuków
description: Bieg Szczuków is a run in Szczuczyn based at the Transgraniczne Centrum Dialogu Kultur on Sportowa street. Since the fifth edition the main race is a certified 10 km with electronic timing. The programme also has kids' runs and an integration run. The 2026 edition took place on 7 June.
course_highlights: Certified 10 km course
Electronic timing with results by SMS
Kids' runs and an integration run
additional: Runners got a recovery meal and there was an activity zone for children. The 2027 date has not been announced yet.

name: XXXVII Policka Piętnastka
description: Policka Piętnastka is a road race in Police, with a 15 km main race. It also features 10 km and 5 km races, as well as a 5 km Nordic walking event, and all distances are certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA). The start is at the intersection of Piaskowa and Zamenhofa streets, and the race office is at the athletics stadium. The 37th edition has taken place, and children and young people raced the day before.
course_highlights: The certified-by-PZLA main 15 km race, plus 10 km and 5 km races
Races start at 9:30; Nordic walking starts at 10:30
Children’s and youth races take place on Saturday before the main race
additional: In 2026, the race office operated at the athletics stadium at 97 Piaskowa Street. The children’s and youth races took place on June 6 in the clearing behind SP8. The date of the 2027 edition has not yet been announced.

name: XXX Bieg Łagowskiego Lata
organizer: Wójt Gminy Łagów, Starostwo Powiatowe w Świebodzinie, Szkoła Podstawowa w Łagowie
description: The Bieg Łagowskiego Lata is a race of approximately 10 km in Łagów, starting and finishing at the amphitheatre. The course runs along the town’s streets, through a forest section and along the shore of Lake Łagowskie. The main race is part of the Świebodzin County Grand Prix, followed by races for children and young people.
course_highlights: Approximately 10 km along the streets of Łagów and the shore of Lake Łagowskie
Start and finish at the amphitheatre
Races for children and young people from 100 to 1,000 m
additional: In 2026, the main race started at 9:30, the time limit was 90 minutes, and the participant limit was 230. The entry fee was 60 zł, and online registration was open until 22 May. The date of the 2027 edition has not yet been announced.

name: Bathory Run
location: Sedliska, (okr. Vranov nad Topľou), Sedliska, (okr. Vranov nad Topľou), futbalové ihrisko
organizer: Obec Sedliska a MV Running team Sedliska
description: Bathory Run is a running event in the village of Sedliska near Vranov nad Topľou, offering courses for children, juniors and adults. Runners follow a varied route through an orchard, giving the race a pleasant natural character. The children’s categories start at 10:30, while the men’s and women’s races start at 13:00. The event is organized by the Municipality of Sedliska and MV Running team Sedliska, who ensure a high-quality race experience for all age groups.

name: Spoznaj Trebišov behom – Charity Run
location: Trebišov, Trebišov, námestie pod OD Billa
organizer: Mesto Trebišov, Stredná odborná škola služieb a priemyslu sv. Jozafáta
description: The Charity Run in Trebišov is a traditional event that brings together running, walking, Nordic walking and cycling. This charity run offers an opportunity to discover the city of Trebišov while supporting a good cause. The event is organised by Majcher-Production s.r.o. and is suitable for the general public who want to spend time actively and contribute to charity.

name: Šebešská pätnástka
location: Vyšná Šebastová okr. Prešov, Vyšná Šebastová okr. Prešov, futbalové ihrisko Vyšná Šebastová
description: Šebešská Pätnástka is a running race organized by the MTC Vyšná Šebastová club in cooperation with the Vyšná Šebastová municipal office and sports associations. The main course is 15.5 km long and includes a climb to Nevická chata, complemented by a recreational 3 km course and children’s events for various age groups. The race takes place every year on the Sunday of the first weekend in June, with a morning start and a rich cultural and social program that attracts hundreds of visitors. The event is part of several running competitions and a league, and the organizers emphasize promoting sport and building the village’s reputation. Šebešská Pätnástka received the Running Diamond award in 2011 and 2012.

name: Mladé BĚKODO
description: Mladé Běkodo je seriál běžeckých závodů určený dětem a mládeži ve věku od 2 do 15 let, který se koná v okolí Doubravky v Teplicích. Závody nabízejí tratě od 200 do 1650 metrů a jsou rozděleny do kategorií podle věku. Po každém závodě následuje vyhlašování výsledků jednotlivců i družstev. BK Běkodo je součástí TJ Lokomotiva Teplice a má dlouholetou tradici od roku 2001.

name: Běh Advenťáka BRNO
description: Běh Advenťáka Brno 2026 je charitativní běžecký závod konaný 9. června u Medláneckého rybníka v Brně. Závod nabízí trať dlouhou 6,45 km po zpevněných cestách, vhodnou pro běžce všech úrovní, s doporučením používat trailové boty. Součástí akce jsou také dětské kategorie s kratšími tratěmi. Účastníci svým startovným přispívají na podporu lidí, kteří to v životě nemají jednoduché, a mohou si užít příjemnou atmosféru, sportovní ceny a další benefity.

name: Pivní míle Heřmanův Městec
description: Pivní míle v Heřmanově Městci je originální závod na atletickém oválu Bažantnice, kde závodníci absolvují čtyřnásobek 400 metrů s přestávkami na pivo. Tento netradiční sportovní zážitek kombinuje běh a zábavu v přátelské atmosféře. Letos se koná již 10. ročník této oblíbené akce, která je součástí běžeckého klubu Heřmanův Městec.

name: Otevřený přebor SABZO v přespolním běhu
description: Otevřený přebor SABZO v přespolním běhu je tradiční běžecký závod pořádaný Běžeckým klubem SABZO v Praze. Závod nabízí možnost poměřit síly amatérských běžců v přespolním běhu v příjemné sportovní atmosféře. Klub SABZO je známý dlouholetou historií a pravidelným pořádáním běžeckých akcí v Praze a okolí. Závod je součástí širšího kalendáře běžeckých akcí klubu, který podporuje aktivní životní styl a komunitu běžců.

name: 37. Campuslauf Technische Universität Clausthal
description: The 37th Campus Run at Clausthal University of Technology is taking place, offering runners a sporting challenge on campus. The event includes several race distances, including one lap, three laps, and a children’s run. The run is a popular university sports event that welcomes students, staff, and guests alike. There is also a Campus Open Air, creating a pleasant atmosphere.

name: Běh Advenťáka OSTRAVA
description: Běh Advenťáka Ostrava 2026 je charitativní běžecký závod, který se koná 10. června v Komenského sadech. Závod nabízí dvě hlavní kategorie - dospělé na 6,45 km a dětské skřítky na tratích od 0,2 do 1 km. Trasa vede po asfaltových a zpevněných cestách, doporučuje se silniční obuv. Startovné z velké části podporuje hrdiny, kteří to v životě nemají snadné, a účastníci získají startovní číslo, diplom, perníček a další benefity. Akce je přátelská, charitativní a vhodná pro všechny věkové kategorie.

name: Trail Zlíchovskými vyhlídkami VAŠÍ LIGY 2026
description: Trail Zlíchovskými vyhlídkami VAŠÍ LIGY je amatérský trailový běh pořádaný v Praze, který nabízí běžcům zážitky z běhu v přírodě s různorodým terénem a zajímavými výhledy. Závody jsou součástí VAŠÍ LIGY, největší amatérské ligy v ČR, která podporuje radost ze sportu a komunitní atmosféru. Účastníci se mohou těšit na přátelské prostředí a možnost poměřit síly s běžci všech věkových kategorií. Závody jsou pravidelně vyhlašovány a dekorovány medailemi pro nejlepší v kategoriích do 40 let a 40+.

name: Mittsommernachtslauf
description: The 19th MittSommerNachtsLauf is an open race for everyone, with a steady pace of approx. 6 min/km, or 6 km/h for walking. The race starts at 7 p.m. in the village center of Marklohe and finishes at the heated outdoor pool in Wietzen, where the swimming pool will remain open until 10 p.m. and the support association will provide refreshments. The running route is up to 18 km, with additional starting points at 13, 10 and 5 km. The walking route is up to 10 km or 5 km. The event promises a sporting evening in beautiful surroundings and is open to everyone who enjoys running or walking.

name: Červnová Krásná Morava
description: Červnová Krásná Morava je běžecký závod pořádaný Středomoravským sdružením vytrvalostních sportů v Olomouci-Hejčíně. Tento závod je součástí bohaté tradice běžeckých akcí v Olomouckém kraji, které jsou otevřené všem věkovým kategoriím a úrovním běžců. Závod nabízí možnost zažít malebnou hanáckou krajinu a připojit se ke komunitě sportovních nadšenců. STMSVS je známý svou dlouholetou organizací vytrvalostních sportů a podporou běžeckých, cyklistických a triatlonových disciplín v regionu.

name: Lysolajský běh
location: Tělocvična ZŠ, Kovárenská ulice, Lysolaje, Prague, Česko
description: Lysolajský běh je tradiční běžecká akce pořádaná v městské části Praha - Lysolaje. Start i cíl jsou u tělocvičny základní školy na Kovárenské ulici. Běh nabízí příležitost pro sportovce i rekreační běžce užít si běh v příjemném prostředí Lysolaj a okolí. Akce je vhodná pro širokou veřejnost a podporuje aktivní životní styl v komunitě.
course_highlights: Start a cíl u tělocvičny ZŠ na Kovárenské ulici
Běh v přírodním prostředí Lysolaj a okolí
Tradiční sportovní událost v městské části Praha - Lysolaje
additional: Registrace je možná přednostně online na uvedené adrese nebo přímo na místě startu do 18:00 hod.

name: 42. Bugasee-Marathon
description: The 42nd Bugasee Marathon takes place in Kassel and is organized by Laufwerk Kassel under the direction of Sylke Kuhn. The course is 42.3 km long and runs on flat, paved park paths around Bugasee in the Fuldaaue. The marathon consists of a 1.7 km opening section followed by 10 laps of 4.06 km each. The event is designed as a birthday marathon and offers a personal atmosphere without an entry fee, as this is covered by the birthday celebrant.

name: AOK Firmenlauf Reutlingen
description: The AOK Reutlingen Company Run is a popular team event held at Kreuzeiche Stadium. The course is approximately 4.5 km long and is aimed at company teams who want to run together and strengthen team spirit. In addition to the sporting competition, participants can enjoy a varied supporting program with a DJ, a group warm-up, and refreshments at the finish, including drinks and fruit. The event promotes inclusion and combines exercise with a shared experience.

name: 189 Pobino i 73 popekspres
location: Brynek, Tarnowskie Góry County, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Přes tři hráze Opatov
description: Přes tři hráze Opatov je tradiční běžecký závod konaný v Opatově na Vysočině, který je součástí seriálu Pohár Běžce Vysočiny. Závod nabízí různé tratě, včetně hlavní trasy dlouhé 8,8 km pro muže a veterány do 69 let, a kratších tratí pro ženy, veterány nad 70 let, juniory, dorostence i děti. Trať vede převážně po polních a lesních cestách, včetně průchodu třemi hrázemi místních rybníků, což dodává závodu jedinečný charakter. Akce je otevřená široké věkové kategorii a klade důraz na sportovní zážitky a podporu běžecké komunity v regionu.

name: 41. AZ-Abendvolkslauf
description: The 41st AZ Evening Fun Run takes place in Uelzen and offers a varied program for runners of all ages. From short introductory runs for children to the 5 km and 10 km main races, as well as walking, Nordic walking and recreational hiking, there is something for everyone. The course passes through Uelzen’s historic city center and along the Ilmenau meadows, among other places. The race is an established event supported by dedicated volunteers and numerous sponsors from the region.
course_highlights: The course passes through Uelzen’s historic city center
The 10 km loop is run twice
Sections along the Ilmenau meadows and over the Katzenbuckel Bridge
additional: Late registration is possible on race day until approximately 1 hour before each event; the late registration fee is €3.00 (except for the introductory run and hiking). All children’s and school-age races up to 2.0 km award medals at the finish. Certificates can be printed online after the event. The start for all events is on Albertstraße, in front of the turning area.

name: Citylauf Grevenbroich
description: The Citylauf Grevenbroich is a family-friendly running event featuring nine different races for sports enthusiasts of all ages. The event offers ideal courses, great entertainment and top-notch organization, supported by the entire city. Alongside the sporting competition, there is an attractive entertainment program and coveted prizes for the top finishers. The races range from short Bambini and schoolchildren’s races to open and city championship races over 5 km and 10 km.
course_highlights: A variety of distances from 700 m to 10 km
City championship race in the Sparkassen-Lauf over 10 km
Family-friendly event with nine races and a great entertainment program
additional: Nine races with start times from 17:30 to 20:40, including Bambini, schoolchildren’s and relay races. Certificates for all participants, plus medals and prizes for the top finishers. Timing provided by TAF-Timing. The event is a major city event with plenty of support and an entertainment program. Multiple race distances, online registration, chip timing, results since 2015, anniversary event in 2026

name: Holstenköstenlauf
organizer: SVT Neumünster in Kooperation mit BMS Die Laufgesellschaft mbH
price_range: 10 km Lauf: 23,00 Euro bis 26,00 Euro, 5 km Lauf: 13,00 Euro bis 16,00 Euro, Holstenkösten-Becher: 12,00 Euro
description: The Holstenköstenlauf in Neumünster is a traditional city race held as part of Schleswig-Holstein’s largest city festival, the Holstenköste. The event offers races for all age groups, from Bambini to adults, and takes runners through various parts of Neumünster. The 10 km course is officially measured according to DLV rules and offers an attractive route through the city center, Tungendorf, and Brachenfeld. All finishers receive a coveted festival medal as a memento of the event.
course_highlights: Attractive course through the city center, Tungendorf, and Brachenfeld
10 km course officially measured according to DLV rules
Start and finish at Kleinflecken, with the same start and finish line
additional: Participation available for various age groups; registration online or on site; bib number collection in the foyer of the Stadthalle; refreshments on the course and at the finish; award ceremonies in the evening

name: Oesterweger Feuerwehrlauf
description: The Oesterweg Fun Run and Fire Brigade Run in Versmold offers a varied running program for all ages and ability levels. From short Bambini and school runs with no entry fee to an officially measured 10 km road race and a 6 km team and fire brigade run, there is something for everyone. The flat, asphalted routes pass through the town center, with spectators providing plenty of encouragement. Walkers can also enjoy a scenic 6 km tour through the rural countryside alongside the event.
course_highlights: Flat, asphalted routes through the center of Oesterweg
10 km loop course with four identical laps plus an introductory lap
6 km loops for the team and fire brigade runs, as well as walking
additional: The Bambini run (450 m) and school run (1.2 km) have no entry fee. Participants up to age 11 are eligible for the school run standings; the taster run is for participants up to age 15. The team and fire brigade run consists of teams of four participants each. Walkers start alongside the fire brigade run from the rear rows so they do not interfere with the runners. Various distances, online registration, downloadable race brochures, special categories for fire brigades and teams, results on TimeTeamJung.

name: Schwerter Ruhrstadtlauf
description: The Schwerter Ruhrstadtlauf takes place at the GWG-Schwerte-Arena and welcomes numerous runners in its established format. The afternoon is dedicated to younger participants with shorter distances, while the longer races are the main attraction in the evening. Particularly popular are the relay races for Bambini and youth, as well as the Nordic walking event along the scenic Ruhr Valley Cycle Path. The 10 km course is measured in accordance with DLV criteria and follows a loop over paved and surfaced paths through a wooded area, finishing in the stadium.
course_highlights: 10 km course measured in accordance with DLV criteria
Loop course along the paved Ruhr Valley Cycle Path and surfaced forest paths
Finish in the stadium at the GWG Schwerte Arena
additional: Late entries are possible up to 60 minutes before the start of the relevant race for a fee of €3 (Bambini entries are free). The entry fee includes timing via a single-use transponder, a personalized certificate, shower facilities at the VfB Westhofen clubhouse, baggage storage (no liability accepted), water stations for the 5 km and 10 km races, and drinks in the finish area. The event takes place in all weather. The event offers a variety of running opportunities for all age groups and supports community sports. Registration is through the official website, and the event takes place on a Friday in June.

name: Volksbank Ettlinger Altstadt-Lauf
location: Volksbank Arena, Stadtgarten Ettlingen, Ettlingen, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Volksbank Ettlingen Old Town Run takes place at the Volksbank Arena in Ettlingen’s Stadtgarten. The course passes through the historic old town, combining paved roads and cobbled lanes, and goes by landmarks such as the Baroque Ettlingen Palace and the Rathaus Bridge with its stone statue of St. Nepomuk. Various races are offered for schoolchildren and young people, along with a 10 km main race and an inclusive race. The event is family-friendly, with suitable competitions for all age groups.
course_highlights: Course through historic old-town lanes and paved streets
Passes the Baroque Ettlingen Palace and the Rathaus Bridge with its statue of St. Nepomuk
Loop course starting and finishing on Schöllbronner Straße
additional: A pacer service is available, with pacemakers for target times of 40 to 60 minutes, identified by large balloons. Distances: 1 km schoolchildren’s race, 2.95 km schoolchildren’s race, 10 km main race, 3.525 km inclusive race; start times from 18:00; venue: Volksbank Arena, Stadtgarten Ettlingen; around 1,500 participants; inclusive running tandems for the inclusive race; large after-race party

name: Voxtruper Volkslauf
description: The 13th Voxtrup Fun Run in Osnabrück offers a varied selection of races for all age groups and ability levels. The event includes distances from 0.4 km for Bambinis to the 9.8 km main race with 182 metres of elevation gain. The races take runners through very scenic countryside, with several refreshment stations to support participants. Late entries are possible on the day of the event, and the event prioritises a safe and smooth race experience. Dogs and baby joggers are not allowed.
course_highlights: Very scenic countryside run with a range of distances
9.8 km main race with 182 metres of elevation gain
Several refreshment stations depending on the distance (up to four for 9.8 km)
additional: Late entries are possible on the day of the event, up to 45 minutes before the respective race. Dogs and baby joggers are not allowed. Certificates can be printed online, and results are available at www.laufen-os.de. Refreshment stations: 1 at 3.9 km, 2 at 5.5 km, and 4 at 9.8 km. Participants can register on site; dogs and baby joggers are not allowed. The courses are designed to take runners through scenic countryside.

name: Internationaler Brüder-Grimm-Lauf
organizer: Verein zur Förderung des Brüder-Grimm-Laufes e.V.
price_range: Startgebühr, ermäßigt für Mitglieder: 5 Euro Rabatt, sonst unklar
description: The International Brothers Grimm Run is a traditional 3-day event that covers approximately 82 km from Hanau, the birthplace of the Brothers Grimm, to Steinau, where the collectors of fairy tales spent their childhood. The route is divided into 5 stages and offers a challenge for recreational runners as well as competitive athletes. It follows historic trade routes, passing historic buildings, scenic attractions, and spa and resort towns in the Spessart and picturesque villages in the Kinzig Valley.
course_highlights: Approximately 82 km from Hanau to Steinau over 5 stages
Follows centuries-old trade routes and passes historic buildings
Scenic attractions and spa towns in the Spessart and Kinzig Valley
additional: The route is mostly paved, with some sections through open countryside and forest. The elevation profile is flat, with minimal inclines (maximum elevation approx. 130 m). The stages include, among other things, cycle paths, forest trails, and paved paths. The start and finish of each stage are in different towns along the route, such as Niederrodenbach and Neuenhaßlau. The event is intended for recreational runners and competitive athletes alike.

name: 14. Garbsener Citylauf
description: The 14th Garbsen City Run is Garbsen’s largest sporting event and offers races for all age groups and ability levels. There are six different races, from a 500-meter parent-child run to the 10,000-meter Agon Tax Run. The courses pass through Rathausplatz, the IGS grounds, along Meyenfelder Straße, and by Berenbosteler See. The event is family-friendly and emphasizes fun and community, supported by a dedicated organizing team and numerous volunteers.

name: Lippe-Sommer-Serie 2026 Lauf 1: 36. Donoper Volkslauf
description: The first race, the 36th Donoper Volkslauf, is organized by SC Donop 1948 e.V. and offers a varied 7,777-meter route around the Donop sports field in Blomberg-Donop. The series combines a sporting challenge with nature and community, and is open to runners, walkers, and hikers.

name: Aschauer Bankerl-Lauf
description: The Aschauer Bankerl-Lauf is a sociable evening run in the idyllic Chiemgau countryside, open to everyone who enjoys running. For the fifth time, organizer Lauffeuer Chiemgau e.V. invites runners to an untimed event where the joy of running takes center stage. Various distances are offered, from approximately 1 km (children’s run) to 7 km. Part of the proceeds will be donated to charity, making the event a socially minded one as well.

name: Deichlauf Neuwied
description: The Deichlauf Neuwied is a long-standing running event in Rhineland-Palatinate that welcomes runners of all ages. Events include races for children and young people, an Olympic school relay, 5 km and 10 km races, and walking/Nordic walking. The course runs along the dike and offers an attractive setting. The event is sanctioned by the German Athletics Association and attracts around 2,000 participants each year.

name: Derentaler Löwenlauf
description: The Derental Lion Run is a traditional race in the Weser Uplands, designed as a family-friendly sporting event for all ages. The event offers various distances through the beautiful Derental countryside and the Steinbach Valley. It places particular emphasis on diversity, tolerance, and working together, supported by a donation to the “augen auf!” Foundation for every participant. The race is organized with great care by the Weserbergland Runners Derental and promises an unforgettable day for children, young people, adults, and seniors.

name: Kleinbahn-Lauf
description: The Kleinbahn Run in Rhauderfehn is a fun run without timekeeping, welcoming runners and walkers on 5- and 10-kilometer routes. There are also children’s races for kindergarten and primary school children, enthusiastically cheered on by parents and grandparents. The 10 km loop starts at the marketplace and runs along the Hauptfehn Canal, through the villages of Holtermoor and Rhaude, and back to the finish via the Ostfriesland hiking trail. The 5 km route also starts at the marketplace and follows the Ostfriesland hiking trail back to the finish. The race offers a lovely opportunity to experience the region along varied routes.

name: Krackenlauf 2026
description: The Krackenlauf Großlangheim takes place on Friday and offers races for various age groups and ability levels. Events include an 800-meter Bambini run, a 2,000-meter schoolchildren’s run, a 7,500-meter main race, and a 6,000-meter walking event. This popular local running event has unchanged start times and distances and is open to all running enthusiasts. Registration is via the RaceResult platform.

name: Sommer-Abend-Lauf
description: The Summer Evening Run in Steinach is a popular running event celebrating its 10th edition. It offers 5 km and 10 km main races on a scenic, flat course, as well as various children’s races. The event attracts many running enthusiasts from the region and beyond each year and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with the start and finish at the school. The races take place in the evening, making for a special running experience in a pleasant atmosphere.

name: Spendenlauf LT Phoenix Dudweiler
description: The LT Phoenix Dudweiler charity run is a fundraising event where all entry fees and donations go to the Saar Children's Hospice and Palliative Care Team. Participants can learn about the organization's important work at the event. The run promotes the health and well-being of runners while supporting an important social cause in the Saarbrücken region.

name: Mittsommerlauf
distance_verbose: 10.2 km, 10 km, 7 km, 5.2 km, 3000 Meter, 1 km

name: Sparkassenlauf Geislingen
location: 73312 Geislingen an der Steige, Baden-Württemberg, Germany

name: Meine Nacht – Kirche laufend erleben
description: Meine Nacht - Kirche laufend erleben is a running event in Meine, taking place on June 11, 2027. The event offers a 10 km race and a relay competition with teams of five, each running a 2 km leg. The course is flat overall. The race starts at 20:00, making it a special evening event. Separate races are also offered for children and teenagers.
course_highlights: Flat 10 km course
Relay competition with teams of five and 2 km legs
Evening race starting at 20:00
additional: The start and finish are the same for all races. The exact location is shown only to RUNME Premium members. Races are offered for children and teenagers. The course is flat and therefore suitable for many runners.

name: Nocny Półmaraton Piotrkowski
location: Amfiteatr Miejski, ul. Gabriela Narutowicza, Piotrków Trybunalski, Poland
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Piotrkowie Trybunalskim
description: The Piotrków Night Half Marathon is an annual running event held on the streets of Piotrków Trybunalski. The half marathon course is 21.0975 km long and runs through the city streets, offering participants a unique nighttime running experience. The event also includes a Quarter Half Marathon over a distance of 5.2 km. The race starts at 21:00, and the race office is located at the Municipal Amphitheatre on Gabriela Narutowicza Street. The event is organised by the Sports and Recreation Centre in Piotrków Trybunalski.
course_highlights: Half marathon course on the streets of Piotrków Trybunalski
Half marathon distance of 21.0975 km
Night race start at 21:00
additional: The race office is open on 12.06.2027 from 12:00 to 20:00 at the Municipal Amphitheatre. The event centre is located at the Municipal Amphitheatre on Gabriela Narutowicza Street.

name: Angličák night run Pezinok
description: Angličák Night Run Pezinok is a 5-kilometre night race held at the Rozálka Sports and Recreation Area in Pezinok. Runners can enjoy a fast, dynamic run along a route through the Malé Karpaty region, illuminated by artificial lights to create a unique atmosphere. The event is open to everyone aged 15 and over, with starting corrals divided according to ability. The organizers prioritize safety, so headphones are prohibited, and reflective gear or headlamps are recommended. Registration is available online and is tied to the runner’s name; preregistration is also possible.

name: Runway Run
location: Kamenica nad Cirochou Airport, Kamenica nad Cirochou, Slovakia
description: Runway Run is a unique running race held at the airport in Kamenica nad Cirochou, giving runners the chance to experience an unusual course directly on the airport runway. The race is suitable for the general public and creates a welcoming atmosphere with race instructions and accompanying activities. The event is known for its security check and opening of the runway entrance to runners, ensuring the race runs professionally.
course_highlights: The course runs directly along the airport runway
Security check before entering the runway
An atmosphere featuring partner presentations and accompanying competitions
additional: The program includes the opening and partner presentations at 18:00, a competition for runners with Rádio Košice at 18:30, opening of the runway entrance and a security check at 18:30, and the announcement of results at 20:45. Registration is available by bank transfer or in person during late registration at the venue.

name: The Run Slovakia
location: naprieč Slovenskom, naprieč Slovenskom, Košice, ul. Hlavná, resp. Teplička nad Váhom
description: THE RUN SLOVAKIA 2026 is a national relay race across Slovakia, held over three days. Runners cover more than 530 km together from Košice to Bratislava, passing through beautiful natural scenery, historic landmarks and picturesque towns. The event offers a unique sporting atmosphere, teamwork and many unforgettable experiences. The route passes notable sites such as Spiš Castle, the High Tatras, Orava Castle and the Little Carpathians, and runners can also enjoy a varied programme of accompanying activities.

name: Mattoni 1/2Maraton Olomouc 2026
description: Mattoni Running Festival Olomouc 2026 je tradiční půlmaraton, který vás provede krásami historického centra Olomouce. Start i cíl jsou na Horním náměstí, kde můžete obdivovat Sloup Nejsvětější Trojice a radnici s unikátním orlojem. Během závodu si užijete atmosféru města, historické budovy a nádherné parky. Akce je vhodná pro běžce všech úrovní a nabízí i doprovodný program.

name: Horem dolem Chospílem
description: Horem dolem Chospílem je intervalový běžecký závod dlouhý 9,2 km, který vede po loukách a polních cestách v okolí Postřekova v oblasti Chospíl. Závod je součástí seriálu Běžec Chodska a nabízí běžcům příjemný terén s přírodní atmosférou. Startuje se intervalově, což přináší zajímavý závodní formát. Tento závod je vhodný pro běžce, kteří hledají kombinaci přírody a sportovní výzvy v Plzeňském kraji.

name: Sokolovský  ¼ maraton
organizer: Živý kraj – Destinační agentura pro Karlovarský kraj, z.s.
description: Sokolovský ¼ maraton je běžecká událost, která se uskuteční v Sokolově v Karlovarském kraji. Trať vede především malebnými částmi města a okolní přírodou, přičemž délka závodu je přibližně 10,5 km. Akce je určena jak pro rekreační běžce, tak i pro ty, kteří chtějí zažít atmosféru závodu v krásném prostředí. Organizátoři kladou důraz na přátelskou atmosféru a sportovní zážitky pro všechny účastníky.

name: Dobročinný běh po stopách Silver A
description: Zveme vás na 3. ročník dobročinného běhu a pochodu Po stopách Silver A, který pořádá Památník Zámeček v Pardubicích. Akce je vhodná pro sportovce i nesportovce, děti i dospělé, a startovné je věnováno charitativním účelům. Běh nabízí dvě trasy - kratší pětikilometrovou a delší desetikilometrovou, dále je připraven dětský závod přibližně na jeden kilometr. Součástí je také komentovaná procházka městem na místa spojená s výsadkem Silver A, startující od Památníku Zámeček.

name: Hradecký koloběh
description: Hradecký koloběh je závod smíšených dvojic, který se koná v krásném prostředí městských lesů s výchozím bodem na Biřičce. Závod kombinuje běh a jízdu na kole, kdy jeden člen týmu běží a druhý jede na kole, přičemž výměna mezi závodníky je možná kdykoli během závodu, což přidává na strategii a dynamice. Akce podporuje týmového ducha a radost z pohybu a nabízí kategorie OPEN a FAMILY. Závod se koná za podpory města Hradec Králové a je známý svou přátelskou atmosférou a kvalitním organizačním servisem.

name: Jinecký kros
organizer: Městys Jince a Jinečáček, z. s.
description: Jinecký kros je tradiční běžecký závod pořádaný v Jincích, který nabízí náročnou trasu o délce přibližně 5,7 km s převýšením kolem 178 metrů. Start i cíl jsou umístěny na fotbalovém hřišti u Biokoupaliště, kde je zázemí pro závodníky včetně parkoviště, šaten, sprch a občerstvení. Trať vede po asfaltu, lesních cestách a loukách, zahrnuje běh přes dřevěnou lávku, asfaltové silnice i stoupání na kopec Vystrkov. Závod je vhodný pro dospělé i děti, které mají vlastní kategorie. Start hlavního závodu je v 11:00.

name: Jindřichohradecký půlmaraton
description: Jindřichohradecký půlmaraton 2026 je jubilejní desátý ročník běžeckého závodu, který nabízí jedinečný zážitek kombinující malebné historické centrum města, úseky podél vody a přírodní pasáže s výrazným převýšením. Závod je určen jak jednotlivcům na 21,1 km, tak týmům ve štafetě, rodinám a školám v kratších bězích. Atmosféra je podpořena fanoušky, hudbou a organizačním servisem včetně občerstvovacích stanic a sprch. Připraven je také speciální Rebel Run pro školy, kde jde o týmovou spolupráci, nikoliv o čas. Start závodu je a účastníci obdrží originální medaile a mohou získat věcné ceny.

name: Neveklovské běhy
organizer: kulturní a sportovní komise města Neveklov
description: Neveklovské běhy jsou tradiční běžeckou akcí pořádanou v malebném Zámeckém parku v Neveklově. Tento závod nabízí příležitost pro běžce všech úrovní užít si běh v příjemném prostředí parku s přátelskou atmosférou. Akce je součástí širšího kalendáře běžeckých závodů Běžce Podblanicka, které podporují aktivní životní styl a komunitní setkávání sportovců v regionu.

name: 7 pohoří Jeseníky
description: Závod Jeseníky 2026 je technický trailový běh v krásné přírodě pod Kralickým Sněžníkem, který nabízí tři tratě různých délek a převýšení. Trasy jsou připraveny členy místní horské služby a vedou převážně terénem přírodou. Účastníci si užijí profesionálně označenou trasu, měření časů čipem, občerstvení na trase i v cíli a pamětní medaili. Akce se koná za každého počasí a je vhodná pro všechny milovníky trailového běhu, kteří chtějí zažít epické výhledy a atmosféru, kterou jinde nenajdou.

name: Okrouhelský běh
description: Okrouhelský běh je tradiční závod v rámci Okresní běžecké ligy Českolipsko, který se koná v malebné obci Okrouhlá v Libereckém kraji. Závod nabízí příležitost pro běžce všech úrovní, kteří si chtějí užít běh v přírodním prostředí s přátelskou atmosférou. Okrouhelský běh je součástí série regionálních běžeckých závodů, které podporují aktivní životní styl a komunitní sportování.

name: Extrem Run 5Hills
description: Extrem Run 5 Hills je ultratrailový běžecký závod v nejzápadnějším výběžku České republiky, který nabízí 91 kilometrů náročné trasy s převýšením 2174 metrů. Trať vede přes pět vrcholů Egerlandu a kombinuje asfaltové cesty, cykloturistické stezky a lesní terén. Závod je určen pro zkušené běžce, kteří chtějí zažít extrémní sportovní výzvu a nádherná panoramata. Pořadatelé kladou důraz na přesné měření časů a bezpečnost závodníků. Závod se koná v malebné oblasti Vojtanova a nabízí také varianty pro štafety a duatlon dvojic.

name: Běh na Pajrek
description: Běh na Pajrek je druhý ročník běžeckého závodu pořádaného TJ Nýrsko, který se koná v areálu pod sjezdovkou v Nýrsku. Závod nabízí mužům trať dlouhou 8,6 km (2 kola) a ženám 4,2 km (1 kolo) s převýšením 152 metrů na jedno kolo. Cíl je umístěn na stejném místě jako start. Závod je součástí Českého poháru v běhu do vrchu a Ešus ligy, s občerstvením zajištěným v areálu. Pořadatelé upozorňují na možné změny trasy kvůli stavebním úpravám a zajišťují věcné ceny pro nejlepší závodníky v kategoriích.

name: 55. Bartenwetzer Volkslauf
description: The Bartenwetzer Volkslauf is the oldest fun run in North Hesse and takes place at Waldstadion Melsungen. The event includes children’s and schoolchildren’s races over 400 m and 1000 m, as well as 5 km, 10 km and 19 km races on paved paths through Melsungen city forest. As the 10th scoring race in the Nordhessencup, it offers a family-friendly atmosphere with refreshments, award ceremonies and a buffet. The start and finish areas are centrally located at Waldstadion, which also has changing facilities.
course_highlights: Races on paved paths through the beautiful Melsungen city forest
Start and finish at Waldstadion Melsungen, on the edge of the city forest
Distances: 5 km, 10 km and 19 km, plus children’s races on the track
additional: Race-pack pickup from 14:30 at the MT clubhouse at Waldstadion. Race-day entries are not possible. Changing facilities are available at the MT clubhouse. Refreshments include water on the longer courses, hot tea at the finish, and a buffet with coffee, cake and bratwurst from 15:30. Medical support is provided by the German Red Cross. Certificates and medals for the Bambini and 1000 m races; certificates can be printed on site or accessed online. The event is subject to the applicable regulations for road and off-stadium running events. Register online via RaceResult. The event at Waldstadion Melsungen includes award ceremonies, refreshments and medical support.

name: SV Greven Deichlauf
description: The SV Greven Deichlauf offers an unforgettable running experience along the picturesque Ems dike and through the town forest. The route, surrounded by nature, is suitable for both recreational runners and ambitious athletes, and is lined by numerous spectators. Around 1,000 runners take part, seeking both an athletic challenge and an experience in nature.
course_highlights: Circuit from Stadion Emsaue along the Ems dike
The route runs through the town forest
Nature-filled running route with many spectators
additional: Running event, circuit, experience in nature, approx. 1,000 participants, official timing, medals for children and age groups

name: Hohenlimburger Lennelauf
description: The 3rd Hohenlimburg Lennelauf takes place around Lennepark in Hohenlimburg. The event is open to runners and walkers of all ages and offers a suitable distance for every age group. It is organised by Elseyer Turnverein 1881 e.V., known for its wide range of sports activities for the whole family. The event promises a friendly, active atmosphere in a beautiful park setting.
course_highlights: Loop course around Lennepark in Hohenlimburg
Suitable for runners and walkers of all ages
Family-friendly event
additional: The event offers various running and walking distances suitable for all age groups. Registration is through Elseyer Turnverein. Telephone enquiries are possible at certain times on Mondays, Tuesdays and Fridays. The course is on asphalt; spikes are not allowed. Places are limited. Refreshments are available on site. Transponders are used for timekeeping.

name: Ketteler-Lauf, Lauf dem Krebs davon
description: The Ketteler Run is a charity run held in Offenbach under the motto “Run away from cancer.” Proceeds from the run support care for cancer patients. The starting signal sounds at 15:00 on Obere Grenzstraße in Offenbach. Those who register in advance can collect their race numbers and finisher T-shirts at Ketteler Hospital as early as 12 June. The event is an established tradition that combines sporting commitment with a social purpose.
course_highlights: Start on Obere Grenzstraße, approximately opposite house number 119, Offenbach
Charity run supporting care for cancer patients
Race numbers and finisher T-shirts can be collected in advance at Ketteler Hospital
additional: On the event day, collection is also possible from 12:00 to 14:00 in the hospital courtyard. The run offers distances of 5 km and 7 km, with on-site registration available. The event is part of an annual series of charity runs to fight cancer and offers finisher T-shirts to participants.

name: Kurparklauf Bad Nenndorf
location: Kurpark Bad Nenndorf, Bad Nenndorf, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Kurparklauf Bad Nenndorf is a long-standing, DLV-approved public race and part of the Schaumburg Running Series. It takes place in the beautiful Kurpark in Bad Nenndorf and offers distances for different age and ability groups, including 1,000 m, 2,500 m, 5 km, 10 km, and 5 km walking and Nordic walking. The event is family-friendly and attracts many participants, who run on paved paths through the park. In addition to the sporting competition, there is an attractive supporting program and good facilities, including changing rooms and showers.
course_highlights: The course follows paved paths through the Kurpark
Start and finish on Kurpromenade by the Wandelhalle
A range of distances from 1,000 m to 10 km, plus walking options
additional: Changing rooms and showers are available at the sports center, which can be reached by bus shuttle. Insurance coverage is provided through an LSB contract. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Medical support is provided. A maximum of 300 participants in the 1,000 m and 2.5 km races. The 5 km Nordic walking and walking events are timed, with no placings. First race for the Samtgemeinde Cup. Scoring race in the Schaumburg Running Series. The race takes place as part of the State Garden Show, with various distances and a family-friendly atmosphere. Early registration is possible, and the event is open to all age groups.

name: Mut-Lauf
description: The MUT-LAUF Kiel is an annual running event that promotes greater openness and courage in dealing with mental illness. Its aim is to take a stand against stigma and raise awareness of mental health. The run celebrates moving together without pressure to perform and is open to everyone, regardless of age, fitness level, or physical limitations. Alongside the run, there is a varied program featuring music, interviews, food and drink, and a marketplace with information about mental health and prevention.
course_highlights: A run open to everyone, with no pressure to perform, including wheelchair users
Event held at the Moorteichwiesen in Kiel
Program featuring music, interviews, and a marketplace
additional: Registration is available online through the Davengo portal or in person at KIELER FENSTER, Ambulantes Zentrum. The event takes place every year on the Saturday before Kiel Week begins. The program includes activities for the whole family and a marketplace featuring self-help groups and social organizations. Entry fees are €10 for adults and €5 for children. Information about self-help groups and a sociable program are provided.

name: Oelder Citylauf
description: The Oelde City Run is a traditional running classic in the heart of Oelde that has delighted runners of all ages for over 45 years. The event offers a varied programme featuring Bambini, schoolchildren’s and inclusive races, as well as 5 km and 10 km road races. The races take place before a large crowd in a festival-like atmosphere and are part of the Volksbank Cup race series. The course is measured to international standards and runs through Oelde city centre, with the start and finish at the Market Square.
course_highlights: An internationally measured 2.5 km lap, repeated as required for each distance
The course runs through Oelde city centre, with the start and finish at the Market Square
A variety of races for all ages, including Bambini and inclusive races
additional: Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start, subject to a late-entry fee of EUR 3.00. Race packets can be collected at the event centre on the Market Square. Certificates for the schoolchildren’s and Bambini races are available on site; certificates for the other races are available online. Showers are available at the Oelde Comprehensive School sports hall, approximately 300 m from the finish. Registration is via Raceresult; the event is known for its diverse categories and friendly atmosphere.

name: Rettichfestlauf
description: The Rettichfestlauf in Schifferstadt is a long-standing running event. The races follow fast, varied routes around the Waldfesthalle, partly on paved paths and partly on forest trails. Distances of 5 km and 10 km are offered, as well as shorter races for schoolchildren, Bambinis and Minis. The event is family-friendly and offers suitable running opportunities for all age groups.
course_highlights: Route near the Waldfesthalle, with paved paths and forest trails
Main race lap length: 2.5 km
Fast, varied running routes
additional: Start times: schoolchildren’s race (1,200 m) at 17:30, Bambini race (650 m) at 17:45. There is also a 200 m mini race without timing. The event takes place at the Waldfesthalle in Schifferstadt. Start and finish at the Waldfesthalle, online registration, children’s and schoolchildren’s races, transponder timing, refreshments in the finish area

name: Steinfurter Altstadt - Abendlauf
description: The Steinfurt Old Town Evening Run is a long-standing race competition, now being held for the 38th time. Organized by Turnerbund Burgsteinfurt, the event offers various age categories and race distances through the historic old town of Steinfurt. It is particularly family-friendly and is known for its lively atmosphere and large fields of starters. Young runners receive medals and trophies, making the race a popular event for all ages.
course_highlights: Races through the historic old town of Steinfurt
Age categories from Bambini to masters athletes
A medal and water bottle for every young runner at the finish
additional: Race packets can be collected at the old town hall on the market square from 1 p.m. on the day of the event. Late entries are possible up to 45 minutes before the respective start. Every young runner receives a medal and a water bottle; the first three in each age category are awarded trophies. Races for different age groups, on-site registration, medals, trophies, reusable race bibs, entry fee payable by SEPA direct debit mandate, no refunds possible

name: Straßenlauf Gollhofen mit Mittelfränkischer Meisterschaft über 10 km
location: Gollhofen, Landkreis Neustadt an der Aisch-Bad Windsheim, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Gollhofen Road Race is being held for the 26th time and includes the Central Franconian 10 km Championship. The event is hosted by FC Gollhofen and gives runners the opportunity to take part in a long-standing competition. Further details and information are available in the announcement on the website. The event is aimed at competitive runners and running enthusiasts from the region.
course_highlights: 10 km road race with the Central Franconian Championship
Traditional race with more than 25 years of history
Event in the municipality of Gollhofen, Würzburg district
additional: Registration for the Gollhofen Road Race is via the link provided on the website. Further details are included in the flyer and announcement. The race takes place on a road course at Gollhofen’s sports grounds. Registration is online, and the event also includes youth categories. The event offers a great opportunity to meet the running community in the region.

name: Söltjerlauf
description: The Söltjerlauf in Bad Münder is a charity run in the beautiful Süntel hills, where every lap counts. The event welcomes all age groups and fitness levels, from children to marathon runners, and features a shaded forest loop of approximately 3.8 km with a refreshment point. Participants have four hours to run as many laps as possible, with the proceeds going to a good cause. The event promotes team spirit and health, and invites participants to stay after the run for catering and the awards ceremony.
course_highlights: Shaded forest loop of approximately 3.8 km
Refreshment point along the course
Atmosphere at the Bergschmiede restaurant, with catering
additional: A shuttle service is available from 09:30 to help participants arrive in time for the 11:00 start. Every participant receives a certificate stating the distance covered. The top individual runners and the top 10 teams receive prizes. Parking is limited, so using the overflow parking areas and bus shuttle is recommended. Dogs must be kept on a short leash and are not allowed to participate as team members. Competition open to all age groups; sponsors donate for each lap to local projects. The event takes place on the Bergschmiede grounds, with support from local sponsors such as Sparkasse Hameln-Weserbergland and Ardagh Group.

name: Volksbank Haren Citylauf
description: The 27th Volksbank Haren City Run takes place on an attractive, fast course through Haren city centre. The 5 km and 10 km races are measured by the DLV and eligible for rankings, making them ideal for competitive athletes and recreational runners. Children and young people can take part in special races over 400 m, 750 m and 1.5 km. There is also a team competition in the 5 km race for teams from companies, clubs or groups.
course_highlights: Attractive, fast course through Haren city centre
The 5 km and 10 km courses are measured by the DLV and eligible for rankings
Special races for children and young people over 400 m, 750 m and 1.5 km
additional: All participants in the 5 km and 10 km races receive finisher shirts. Entry fees are paid by direct debit. The 5 km race includes a team competition for teams of at least 3 people. Children from Haren daycare centres and schools can take part for free if their institution participates. Large trophies and certificates are awarded for school competitions.

name: Werner Volksbank Stadtlauf 20. Team- / Firmenlauf
description: The 24th Werner Volksbank City Run 20th Team / Company Run takes place in Werne. This running event offers the opportunity to get active with colleagues or friends and strengthen team spirit. The event includes two distances, 1 km and 10 km, and is aimed especially at teams and companies who want to run together.
course_highlights: Distances: 1 km and 10 km
Starting point in Werne
Typical June weather, with an average of 23 °C and mostly sunny days
additional: Please check the event details with the organizer before registering. The event promotes physical activity and team spirit, with registration via Raceresult. June weather is expected to be warm and sunny, at around 23°C.

name: Zechenlauf - Neue Zeche Westerholt
organizer: „Jecken vom Pütt“ in Kooperation mit dem SuS Bertlich
description: The Zechenlauf takes place on the grounds of the Neue Zeche Westerholt in Gelsenkirchen, combining the fun of running with the distinctive setting of the former mine site. The event offers a short children’s course and a 5-kilometer loop. Held as part of a family festival, it welcomes running enthusiasts of various ages.
course_highlights: Short children’s course of approximately 750 to 800 meters
5-kilometer loop on and around the mine grounds
The course also passes through Stadtteilpark Hassel

name: Enni Donkenlauf
description: The ENNI-Donkenlauf in Neukirchen-Vluyn offers a variety of running events for all ages and ability levels. The routes run mostly along flat, paved, low-traffic country roads and side streets, making them ideal for fast times. Alongside competitive races, there are also non-competitive runs and walking events open to everyone. The event is family-friendly and includes special scoring for schools and youth groups.
course_highlights: Flat, mostly paved, low-traffic country roads and side streets
Officially measured 5 km and 10 km routes
Minis-Run and Donki@school on the sports centre’s synthetic track
additional: Late entries are possible on event day from 11:30 a.m. in Building “G”. The Minis-Run and Donki@school take place on the sports centre’s synthetic track. For safety reasons, dogs, jogging strollers and bicycle escorts are not permitted. Parking is limited; travel by bicycle or public transport is recommended. Smoking is prohibited throughout the school grounds, and dogs are prohibited on the sports grounds. Various distances (500 m to 10 km); registration possible on site or online; no age-group scoring in some races.

name: Gellershäuser Abendlauf
location: Sportplatz in Gellershausen, Edertal, Hesse, Germany
organizer: Turn und Sportverein Hessen 1848 Frankenberg Eder e.V.
description: The Gellershausen Evening Run takes place at the sports ground in Gellershausen, Edertal, and offers races for children and school students, as well as a 10-kilometer race and a half marathon. The event is part of the Waldeck-Frankenberg Running Cup and attracts runners of various age groups. The course runs through scenic surroundings and offers a pleasant running atmosphere in June. Information about registration, the course, results, and photos is available.
course_highlights: Half-marathon and 10-kilometer courses starting at Gellershausen Sports Ground
Children’s and school students’ races included
Part of the Waldeck-Frankenberg Running Cup
additional: Typical June weather: around 23 °C during the day and 13 °C at night, mostly sunny, with an average of 65 mm of precipitation. Children’s and youth races with distances of around 400 m and 1,000 m; the event promotes community and sporting exchange in the region.

name: 12. Heilwald Marathon
description: The 12th Heilwald Marathon takes place in Bad Lippspringe.
