The course consists of six large laps of 7.05 km each, for a total of 42.3 km, and runs through the unique Heilwald, whose soothing low-mountain climate and species-rich forest offer a special running experience. The event is a private, self-supported race, with times recorded by hand; a photo of the clock must be submitted as proof. Participation is at your own risk, and a voluntary donation for tree planting is requested.

name: 13. Himmelswegelauf
description: The Himmelswegelauf is a long-standing race around the Nebra Sky Disc, held every year in June. The event offers various disciplines, including a marathon, half marathon, the 10-kilometer Sky Disc Run, walking, a bike tour, and guided hikes to the site where the Sky Disc was found. The routes pass historical and archaeological sites such as the Goseck Solar Observatory, the Dolmengöttin of Langeneichstädt, and the Arche Nebra visitor center. The start and finish are usually at Arche Nebra, near where the Sky Disc was found; the disc is considered the oldest concrete depiction of the cosmos. The race combines a sporting challenge with cultural experiences in a unique landscape.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Arche Nebra, near where the Sky Disc was found
Marathon starts at the 7,000-year-old Goseck Solar Observatory
Route through the Ziegelroda Forest and past archaeological sites
additional: In addition to the races, the event includes walking, bike tours, and guided hikes to the site where the Sky Disc was found. All routes are subject to approval by the relevant authorities. The medal is awarded in an exclusive design.

name: 15. Fullestrand-Ultramarathon
description: The Fullestrand Ultramarathon takes place in Kassel and features a challenging 46.5 km route along the Fulda, with around 350 metres of elevation gain. The route heads upstream from Kassel, follows the Fuldahöhenweg and returns along the Fuldaradweg, passing through varied landscapes and natural areas. The event is organised by Laufwerk Kassel, led by Sylke Kuhn, and combines a sporting challenge with the beauty of northern Hesse’s nature and culture.

name: 18. Edeka Ladage-Lauf
description: The EDEKA Ladage Run in Wennigsen is a long-standing community race with a variety of events for all age groups. The event takes place at the Sophie Scholl Comprehensive School sports facility and offers varied loop courses for everyone from kindergarten children to experienced runners. The longer races follow a slightly modified 2.5 km loop, with the start and finish close to the event area, creating a special atmosphere. Alongside the competition, the event also emphasizes a sense of community, supported by a prize draw and a dedicated team of volunteers.

name: 23. Sudenburg-Lauf - Der Lauf mit dem Lächeln
description: The Sudenburg Run is an event with the motto “By runners, for runners” and takes place at Heinrich Germer Stadium in Magdeburg. The event is distinguished by enthusiasm for running and for the Sudenburg district. There are various race routes for children, teenagers, and adults, which lead through the city and the stadium. The focus is on getting as many people as possible running and putting a smile on their faces.

name: 5. Biber Backyard Ultra
description: The Biber Backyard Ultra is a unique ultrarun in Simmerath/Lammersdorf. Participants run a 6.7-kilometer loop every hour, with varying elevation, until only one runner remains. The course follows forest and farm tracks as well as trails, including a challenging ramp. The event stands out for its special ultra-backyard format, in which each loop must be completed within one hour. The event offers a welcoming atmosphere and tests endurance and tactics equally.

name: Ottermeerlauf
description: The Ottermeer Run in Wiesmoor is a long-standing event. It offers a varied course and a motivating atmosphere, and is open to both individual runners and relay teams. A particular highlight is the 6-hour ultramarathon, which is part of the Nordcup and open to runners aged 18 and over. Every finisher receives a custom medal shaped like the outline of the Ottermeer, featuring the mascot Otti.

name: 24h Lauf Halberstadt
description: The 24-hour run at Friedensstadion Halberstadt starts at 18:00 and is organized by VfB Germania Halberstadt in collaboration with the Halberstadt Leisure and Sports Center. The goal is to keep runners on the tartan track continuously throughout the 24 hours. The event is part of VfB Germania’s club festival, where various sports departments introduce themselves and invite visitors to join in. In addition to the run, traditional activities include pulling a coach on the track. The event offers a sporting challenge and a sociable program for participants and spectators.

name: Ahrathon Erlebnislauf
description: The Ahrathon Erlebnislauf in Bad Neuenahr-Ahrweiler offers a varied running experience, from a 500m Bambini run to a 42km marathon. The start and finish are at Weingut Sonnenberg, which also hosts a family festival and a closing festival with live music. The course runs through the picturesque Ahr Valley, with aid stations offering water and fruit as well as wine and gourmet bites. The event is known for its special atmosphere, wine presentations, and creative costume runs.

name: Fischland-Darss-Zingst-Ultramarathon (FDZU)
description: The Fischland-Darss-Zingst Ultramarathon (FDZU) is the longest nature-experience run in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania and is being held for the 10th time. The route passes through the unique Baltic Sea coastal landscape from Rostock to Stralsund, offering runners a special experience of nature along the region’s peninsulas and islands. The race is defined by its tradition and distinctive atmosphere, created by the combination of nature, challenge and community.

name: Gaißeschennerlauf Kieselbronn
description: The Gaißeschennerlauf is an annual running event organized by Turnverein Kieselbronn in Kieselbronn, Baden-Württemberg. The race has been held regularly since 2003 and is part of a local running series. The event gives runners the opportunity to enjoy a scenic route, which is presented on the website with a video and external profiles on AllTrails. The name Gaißeschennerlauf gives the event a distinctive local identity.

name: Harsefelder Lauf- und Musikfestival
organizer: Lauftreff Harsefeld, LSC Harsefeld, Stadtmarketing Harsefeld
description: The 20th Running and Music Festival takes place in Harsefeld, combining sporting challenges with musical entertainment. Runners of all ages can take part in a range of distances, from children’s and Bambini runs to short and long-distance races and relays. In the evening, Marktstraße becomes a lively party strip with an open-air disco and live music. The festival is a regular fixture on Harsefeld’s event calendar and, alongside the sporting events, offers a varied children’s program and food stalls.

name: Himmelgeister Brückenlauf
description: The Himmelgeister Brückenlauf is a traditional half marathon that has been held annually in Düsseldorf-Himmelgeist since 2004. The route follows the Rhine almost to the heart of Düsseldorf and offers a scenic running course. The race starts early in the morning, at around 8 a.m., at Steinkaul in Himmelgeist. It is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and the after-run party in the beer garden at Haus Krevet. The 2026 race will be the last, as the organizing team is stepping down after the anniversary.

name: Holzgerlinger Lauf - Waldtrail
description: The Holzgerlingen Lauf - Waldtrail takes place for the 41st time in 2026 and is part of the Schönbuch Cup as its third scoring race. The course covers two laps over a tartan track, asphalt and forest trails through the beautiful Holzgerlingen forest. The first half is mostly flat, while the second half is rolling, with a final climb accompanied by the sound of drums. Runners pass through the packed stadium three times, where spectators cheer them on with music: at the start, after the first 5 km lap and at the finish.

name: Kalimandscharolauf 2026
description: The event is organized by K+S Minerals and Agriculture GmbH, Zielitz plant. The race takes place away from the stadium and offers runners an attractive course in the Magdeburg/Börde region. Registration is open.

name: Kehler-Rheinuferlauf
description: The Kehler Riverside Run is a long-standing running event celebrating its 10th anniversary in Kehl am Rhein. The event offers races for children and young people, a 5 km company run, and 5 km and 10 km main races on measured circuits. The attractive course runs along the Rhine and through the Rhine floodplain, with musical entertainment along the route. Part of the entry fees will be donated to the Kehl animal shelter, making the event socially engaged as well.

name: Kidsmarathon
description: The Pillenstein KIDSmarathon is an inclusive running event for up to 4,000 children aged 1 to 11. Children can choose their own distance, with fun and participation taking priority. There is no timekeeping, and every participant is a winner. The event offers a great atmosphere and a varied program, and is designed to be accessible so children with disabilities can take part.

name: Lauf um den Senftenberger See
description: The 49th Run Around Lake Senftenberg offers runners a choice of distances around picturesque Lake Senftenberg. The event is open to all ages and ability levels, from the Bambini race to the challenging 17.7 km lake loop. Races start at 09:00 in front of the Seesporthalle Großkoschen, with a friendly atmosphere, ample refreshments, and changing and washing facilities. Register online via myRacePartner; late registration is available until race day for a small fee.

name: Luckenwalder Turmfestlauf
description: The 35th Luckenwalder Turmfest takes place from 11 to 13 June 2027 around the Market Tower. The city centre will be transformed into one of the largest festival areas in the Teltow-Fläming region, with modern amusement rides, numerous market stalls and a varied stage programme. The festival is open to all visitors, regardless of their means, as there will be no standard cultural contribution in 2027. Supporters can make a voluntary donation or purchase a supporter wristband to help preserve and develop the tradition of the city festival.
additional: The Turmfest starts at 12:00 on all three days. The festival closes at 01:00 on Friday and Saturday, and at 22:00 on Sunday. There is no standard admission fee; voluntary donations are requested instead. Supporter wristbands are available for 10 euros at the Tourist Information Centre. The Tourist Information Centre is open at varying times from Monday to Friday, but is closed from 24 December 2026 to 1 January 2027.

name: Nordheimlauf
description: The Nordheim Run takes place in Nordheim (Württemberg) and is celebrating its 25th anniversary. Five different races are offered, including children’s races, a para race, a school race, a fun run, and the 10 km main race. The course is varied and fully paved, with around 150 meters of elevation gain in the main race. Timing is electronic using transponders, and refreshments are available along the course and at the finish. The race is part of the 2026 Ensinger Zabergäu Cup and offers a friendly, family-oriented and athletic atmosphere for all ages and ability levels.

name: OSTSEE Run
description: The OSTSEE Run by ROTEC is a sporting highlight as part of the OSTSEE Sports Games in Cottbus. The race offers an attractive course for runners and walkers and is part of a varied sports and leisure program featuring numerous other competitions and activities. The event welcomes sports enthusiasts of all ages and, in addition to the sporting competition, offers a lively program of activities and a large OSTSEE party with free admission. This combination of sporting event and celebration makes the OSTSEE Run a special experience in the region.

name: OSTSEE Sparkassen Halbmarathon
description: The SPARKASSEN Half Marathon takes place in Timmendorfer Strand and Niendorf/Ostsee. The 21-kilometer course starts at 10:00 a.m. from the Möbel Höffner grounds. Race materials can be collected from 7:00 a.m. in the start and finish area. The race is open to participants aged 18 and over and offers an attractive route along the Baltic Sea coast. On-site registration is not available; participants must register in advance.

name: Panorama-Baumwipfel-Lauf 2026
description: The Panorama Treetop Run 2026 is an appealing running event in the Steigerwald that attracts runners from all over Germany. The varied routes pass through vineyards and the Steigerwald Nature Park, along winding trails and forest paths. The half-marathon and 12 km routes go via the tower of the Steigerwald Treetop Walk and return via Oberschwarzach Herrenberg. The start and finish are at the Panorama Terrace at the sports facility / Sebastianihaus Oberschwarzach, and the course offers beautiful new views around every bend.

name: ROCKS AND RUN 3. Rielingshäuser Steinbruch-Lauf
description: The ROCKS AND RUN 3rd Rielingshausen Quarry Run takes place in Marbach am Neckar. The race offers 2.5 km events for all age groups, including special races for children and teenagers. It’s a great opportunity for families to get active together and enjoy the sporting atmosphere. The event takes place in typical June weather, with pleasant temperatures and mostly sunny days.

name: Skatstadtmarathon Altenburg
description: The Skatstadtmarathon Altenburg is a challenging running event held in Altenburg. Participants can choose from various distances, including the marathon, two-person marathon relay, half marathon, 13.3 km run, fitness run, children’s and students’ races, and walking events. The course takes runners through the historic city of Altenburg, with varied sections that include climbs in the city forest and along the Großer Teich. In addition to the sporting challenge, the supporting program offers a wide range of entertainment, including music, a children’s festival, and a talk by running legend Uta Pippig.

name: Tollenseseelauf
description: The Neubrandenburg Tollensesee Run is a scenic race around Lake Tollensesee that attracts more than 2,000 runners each year. With distances for young and old, the event offers a varied running festival in a family-friendly atmosphere. The course is challenging, with several climbs, which is why the race is also known as “The Toughest in the North.” More than 300 volunteers help create an unforgettable running experience, with certificates, technical T-shirts, and trophies for the top finishers.

name: Waaker Bystopen-Attacke
description: The Waaker Bystopen Attack is an obstacle race in Lower Saxony, held around the Waaker Büsteppe in the Göttingen Forest. The event offers distances of 2.5 km (family run), 5 km and 10 km, with more than 30 natural and artificial obstacles. You can participate individually or as part of a team; team scoring requires at least 4 runners. Alongside the main race, there is also a Bambini Attack for the youngest participants, which does not require registration. The event focuses on fun, team spirit and exercise in nature.

name: Autohaus Lutz Nightrun
organizer: SV 1911 Traisa e.V. und Turngemeinde 1879 Traisa
description: The Autohaus Lutz Nightrun is a short running race held in Mühltal-Traisa. The event offers two distances, 650 meters and 5.6 kilometers, and takes place in typical June weather, with pleasant temperatures and mostly sunny conditions. The race is ideal for runners looking for a short, fast challenge. Please check the details directly with the organizer before registering.

name: Bürgerlauf Visbek
description: The 1st Visbek Community Run takes place in Visbek Park (Pastors Wisk) and offers a varied program for runners of different age groups and ability levels. The event includes Bambini and schoolchildren’s races, as well as intermediate and main races over 5 km and 10 km, complemented by a walking or hiking route. Race bibs can be collected on the day of the event from 15:00, and all races are professionally measured. Proceeds benefit the Visbek Community Foundation, making the run a sporting event with a charitable purpose.

name: Drebber-Marathon
description: The Drebber Run offers a wide range of competitions for all ages and ability levels. The course follows an officially measured 2.34 km loop through the Jacobidrebber district, with the start and finish at the sports field. In addition to individual and relay events ranging from a children’s run to a marathon, there is an attractive supporting program for spectators and participants. Emergency services personnel are especially invited to take part in the Blue Light Cup as a relay team and showcase their performance.

name: Dünenlauf
description: The Dünenlauf Sandhausen takes place annually and offers runners a sporting challenge in the Sandhausen region. The race is an established event and also includes a timed Bambini Run for children up to 10 years old. The event is organized by the Dünenlauf team and the TG Sandhausen running group, and warmly invites all running enthusiasts to take part on June 5, 2027.
additional: The Bambini races start in several waves from 15:00 at Walter-Reinhard-Stadion, Sandhausen. The Bambini races are for children up to and including 10 years old and cover distances of 200 m and 400 m (half a lap or one lap of the stadium), with timing.

name: h Lauf Reichenau
description: The Reichenau 24-Hour Run is an extraordinary ultrarun on the island of Reichenau, welcoming individual runners as well as teams of six and corporate teams. The event runs around the clock, from Saturday noon to Sunday noon, and tests participants’ endurance and fitness on a prepared course around the Hochwart. The run has established itself as an impressive sporting challenge, attracting both recreational runners and ambitious athletes. The atmosphere is shaped by community spirit and sporting ambition, supported by a runners’ camp and a dedicated organizing team.

name: 4 Skolwińska Mila
description: The 4th Skolwińska Mile is an annual road race held in Szczecin, attracting both adults and children. The event is taking place and continues the tradition of previous editions, offering participants the chance to compete over a short distance. The race is a great opportunity to spend time actively and bring the local community together. The organizers provide an easy way to get in touch via the registration form, as well as administrative support.
course_highlights: A 1-mile distance (1,609 meters) on scenic recreational grounds
Online registration and timing by Sport-Time
Prizes for the top finishers and medals for everyone who finishes
additional: Children’s races of approximately 200 meters are also held as part of the event. Participants can use the registration form available on the website to quickly contact the organizer and system administrator. Participants can use training plans ranging from 8 to 20 weeks. The event is supported by a local building supply store, and the participant limit is 60.

name: IV Bilczańska Dycha
description: The 4th Bilcza 10K is a road race held in Morawica, attracting running enthusiasts to its 10 km course. The event takes place in the recreational area of Bilcza Park and is part of the Bilcza Road Races, which also include races for children. A family festival accompanies the event, creating a welcoming and inclusive atmosphere for participants and their loved ones.
course_highlights: The course runs through the recreational area of Bilcza Park
A 10 km road race
An accompanying family festival
additional: A family festival is held on race day, adding to the event for participants and their families.

name: 7 Szamotulska Nocna Piątka
description: Szamotulska Nocna Piątka is an annual, officially certified 5 km race held in Szamotuły. The course runs through the city streets, giving participants the opportunity to compete at a professional level and achieve officially recognized results. The event is open to everyone, including children and families, who can take part in accompanying races over shorter distances. The main race starts in the evening, giving the event its distinctive nighttime character. The organizers look after participants’ comfort by providing refreshments after the race and awards for the winners.
course_highlights: Course certified by the Polish Athletics Association
Night race starting at 21:55
Urban course through the streets of Szamotuły
additional: Temporary traffic changes apply on race day, with parking restrictions and designated detours. Race packet collection is available from 17:00 to 21:30. Refreshments for participants and awards for the winners are planned after the race. There are 26 free race packets available for people with disabilities in the family race, accompanied by a caregiver; apply by email.

name: 8 Bieg Chwalisza
description: The 8th edition of the Chwalisz Run is an annual charity race held in Ściernie, combining sport with support for children in need. The course is well marked and varied, making it ideal for both recreational and experienced runners. A family festival accompanies the event, creating a cheerful, welcoming atmosphere for the whole family. The organizers also invite participants to group training sessions every Thursday at 19:00. Every race participant supports a worthy cause, and the event’s atmosphere encourages the local community to come together.
course_highlights: A varied, well-marked cross-country course
Suitable for recreational and experienced runners
A family-friendly atmosphere with a festival alongside the race
additional: Group training sessions take place every Thursday at 19:00, starting outside the kindergarten in Ściernie, ul. Kamienna 17. The event is a charity race supporting children in need. A family festival accompanies the race, offering additional activities and bringing participants together.

name: Bieg Iskry
description: Bieg Iskry is an evening race on the runway of Mielec airport, organized by Studio Wizualne with partners including the City of Mielec, Mielec Airport and MOSiR Mielec. In 2026 it was held on 13 June at 20:00. Runners cover 6.5 km with the runway lights on and the sun setting. Start, finish and the prize giving are at the hangars of the Biało-Czerwone Skrzydła foundation.
course_highlights: 6.5 km on the Mielec airport runway
Start and finish by hangars full of aircraft
Medal and shirt featuring the Iskra jet once built in Mielec
additional: The 2026 entry fee was 140 zł. There are age categories and an open category, with aircraft themed trophies. Water, supplements and a recovery meal wait at the finish, and a glider flight is drawn among runners present.

name: Bieg Recepta na Zdrowie
description: Bieg Recepta na Zdrowie is a national running event in Arturówek, Łódź, at ul. Skrzydlata 75. The eighth edition was held on 13 June 2026. Runners choose between 5 km and 10 km, there is a 5 km Nordic walking event, and children and teenagers have their own races. The 10 km course is two 5 km loops.
course_highlights: Exact 5 km and 10 km courses, the 10 km is two 5 km loops
5 km Nordic walking
Children's and youth races from 12:00
additional: The 5 km run and Nordic walking start at 10:00 and the 10 km at 13:30. The race office opens at 8:00 on race day in the race village in Arturówek. A family picnic with blood pressure and blood sugar checks runs near the start and finish. There are separate registrations for adults, pharmacists and children.

name: II Leśny Bieg Gminy Brzeźnio - Tumidaj
Leśna ZaDyszka
description: Leśna ZaDyszka is a race held in the picturesque Szulmierz Forest District in the Regimin Municipality, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in forest areas. The course is a 5 km loop through forest tracks and an asphalt section, showcasing the beauty of the Masovian countryside. Participants can choose from three events: 5 km, 10 km (2 loops), and a 5 km Nordic Walking event. Children can take part in a 1,500 m run with no rankings. The start and finish are in a forest clearing by the Szulmierz–Regimin road, and times are recorded using a professional chip timing system.
course_highlights: A 5 km loop through forest tracks and asphalt (4 km through the forest, 1 km on asphalt)
Picturesque Masovian countryside
Start and finish in a forest clearing by the Szulmierz–Regimin road
additional: Times are recorded using chips attached to participants’ shoes. The race office opens at 9:00. All participants receive a commemorative medal and a recovery meal. Prizes are awarded for places in age-group and open categories. Participants can choose a standard T-shirt at no extra cost or a Premium LAS T-shirt for an additional 20 zł. Volunteers provide course support.

name: Memoriał Mariana Szymańskiego
description: The 13th Radomszczański Street Run, the Marian Szymański Memorial, is an annual running event held in Radomsko to honor Marian Szymański. The race takes place on the city streets, offering participants the chance to compete in a friendly atmosphere. It is organized by the City of Radomsko and the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Radomsko, with timing provided by the professional company Pomiar Czasu Atelier Sportu. The race is scheduled to start at 17:30, and online registration closes a few days before the event.
course_highlights: A street race in central Radomsko
High-quality organization with professional timing
Evening start at 17:30

name: VIII Kwidzyńska zaDyszka
description: The VIII Kwidzyńska zaDyszka is a 10 km race in Kwidzyn, in the Pomeranian Voivodeship. The event is scheduled for Saturday, 12 June 2027. It is a great opportunity to test your fitness on a moderately challenging paved course. The organizers offer training plans tailored to different experience levels to help participants prepare optimally for race day.
course_highlights: Moderately challenging paved course
10 km distance
Road race in scenic Kwidzyn
additional: The organizers offer training plans lasting 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to a runner’s VDOT level, with detailed instructions and expert support.

name: XII Wojewódzki Bieg Przełajowy o Puchar ...
description: The 12th Voivodeship Cross-Country Run for the Badger Cup is a traditional cross-country race held in the picturesque village of Zagwiździe. The event attracts runners who enjoy natural forest trails and competition on challenging terrain. It is an excellent opportunity to test your fitness alongside fellow trail-running enthusiasts and spend time actively outdoors. The organizers ensure professional timekeeping and smooth event management.
course_highlights: A cross-country route through natural forest terrain
Challenging climbs and varied surfaces
Picturesque views and a close connection with nature

name: XIX Bieg Marszałka
description: Bieg Marszałka is an annual running event in Sulejówek, inspired by the pre-war Sulejówek–Belweder marches over a distance of 26 km. The event includes a 10 km main race and accompanying races for children and young people. The course runs along the streets of Sulejówek, mainly on asphalt, with a short section on cobblestones. The start and finish are at 94 Paderewskiego Street, next to Willa Bzów. The race has historical and sporting significance, combining tradition with physical activity.
course_highlights: The 10 km main-race course runs along the streets of Sulejówek, mainly on asphalt
A short section of the course is on cobblestones
Start and finish at 94 Paderewskiego Street, next to Willa Bzów
additional: The Bieg Marszałka also includes accompanying races: the Halina Zielińska Memorial (approx. 3.6 km), the Little Ones’ Race (approx. 100 m) and the Older Kids’ Race (approx. 200 m). The Little Ones’ Race starts at 09:30 and the Older Kids’ Race at 09:40. Before the main race and the Memorial start at 09:50, a ceremony is held to lay flowers at the monument to Marshal Józef Piłsudski. 17:00–19:00 and on race day from 7:00 to 9:45. The organizer provides a recovery meal and water. Museum parking is available at the junction of Piłsudski Avenue and Matejki Street. The food area is in the Museum building and in the Museum courtyard.

name: XV Bieg Szlakiem Króla Zygmunta Starego
XV Siemiatycka Wieczorna Dycha
description: Siemiatycze Evening 10K is an evening road race in Siemiatycze organized by the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre. The 15th edition took place. The start and finish are at the municipal amphitheater at 31 Grodzieńska Street. Participants can choose between 10 km and 5 km races, as well as a children’s race.
course_highlights: Evening start at 18:00
Start and finish at the municipal amphitheater
10 km and 5 km races, plus a children’s race
additional: The 10 km race is open to people aged 18 and over. The 5 km race is open to people aged 16 and over with a declaration or certificate. Children can be registered by a parent or guardian directly at the start.

name: 200 setny maraton - święto biegania z Ze...
44 Półmaraton Gochów
description: The Gochów Half Marathon is a half marathon in Bytów organized by Klub Biegacza Goch 2 Bytów. The start and finish are by Bytów Castle. The 44th edition started at 10:00. The club also organizes other running events and Nordic Walking marches in Bytów.
course_highlights: Half marathon distance of 21.1 km
Start and finish by Bytów Castle
One of the oldest half marathons in the region; the 44th edition takes place in 2026
additional: Registration, the participant list and the race rules are available on the Klub Biegacza Goch 2 Bytów registration website. Timing is provided by Herkules.

name: Bieg galopem po rodzinę
location: Stadion Miejski, ul. Jana Pawła II 14, Szubin
description: Galopem po rodzinę is a race at the Municipal Stadium in Szubin, ul. Jana Pawła II 14. In 2026 it was held on 13 June. The main race is 3 km and a Nordic walking event uses the same distance. Children's and youth races from 200 m to 1500 m are held first. Entry is free.
course_highlights: 3 km main race with start and finish at the stadium
3 km Nordic walking
Children's and youth races over 200, 400, 800 and 1500 m
additional: In 2026 the children's and youth races ran from 10:00 to 11:45, the 3 km started at 12:00 and the Nordic walking at 12:03. Online entries closed on 5 June. The 200 m is a joint race for children with their parents.

name: Bieg Nocny Marek
description: Bieg Nocny Marek is an evening race in Marki, based at the Marek Educational and Recreational Centre at ul. Wspólna 40/42. The 12th edition took place. The main race is a PZLA-certified 10 km, accompanied by a 5 km race, an approximately 5 km Nordic Walking event, and races for children and young people. The race is part of the Marek Running Triad.
course_highlights: PZLA-certified 10 km course starting on the MCER running track
The main race starts at 21:00 at night
5 km race, Nordic Walking event, and races for children
additional: In 2026, the Nordic Walking event started at 16:00, the races for children and young people at 18:30, the 5 km race at 20:10, and the main 10 km race at 21:00. The race office, changing rooms, and baggage storage are located at Primary School No. 4 at MCER. The event is organised by the Marek Economic Association together with the City of Marki, Marki Runners Sports Club, and Marek Municipal Investments.

name: IX Memoriał im. Zofii Morawskiej
description: The Zofia Morawska Charity Memorial is a race in Laski organized by the Society for the Care of the Blind. The course is a loop of approximately 3.3 km through the so-called Lipówka area, along Partyzantów Street and forest trails in Kampinos Forest. Participants can complete one loop, several loops, or run for the entire duration of the event. The 9th edition took place, with each loop supporting a fundraiser for the Center.
course_highlights: An approximately 3.3 km loop through Lipówka and Kampinos Forest
Choose how many loops to complete
A ceramic medal for completing at least one loop
additional: The start and finish are near the Center’s main gate in Laski, while race registration and baggage storage are at the Friends of the Blind House. Participants in the main race receive a race number with a timing chip and a meal voucher. Parking is not allowed on the Center’s grounds on race day; parking is available on Brzozowa Street. In 2026, the fundraiser supported the renovation and adaptation of the Center’s bathrooms.

name: KrwioBieg Warszawa
organizer: Mazowiecki Oddział Okręgowy Polskiego Czerwonego Krzyża i Adliner
description: KrwioBieg Warszawa is an annual race promoting blood donation, organized by the Masovian branch of the Polish Red Cross and the agency Adliner. It takes place on the Vistula riverside next to the Polish Olympic Centre at Wybrzeże Gdyńskie 4. In 2026 the 9th edition ran over two days, 13 and 14 June. Distances are 5 km and 10 km, 5 km Nordic walking, 50 km and 100 km ultramarathons, a 50 km relay and children's races.
course_highlights: Riverside course by the Polish Olympic Centre
Distances from 5 km up to a 100 km ultra
Children's races from 100 m to 1000 m
additional: In 2026 the 100 km started on 13 June and the other races on 14 June, World Blood Donor Day. Field limits: 125 runners each for 5 km and 10 km, 80 for the 5 km walk, 50 each for 50 km and 100 km, and 20 relay teams. Funds raised went to educational support for children and young people in Masovia.

name: Niezależny Festiwal Biegowy
description: Niezależny Festiwal Biegowy is a friendly running event in Milanówek organized by Wsparcie Treningowe, a Warsaw coaching group. Distances are 5 km, 10 km, half marathon and marathon. Every runner has individual timing.
course_highlights: 5 km, 10 km, half marathon and marathon
Individual timing
Small, friendly event in Milanówek
additional: Partners include Społeczne Liceum Ogólnokształcące nr 5 in Milanówek and UKS MTE Milanówek.

name: XIX Bieg Zajączkowski
location: Zajączki Drugie, Gmina Krzepice, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: XVI Grand Prix Stargardu Cztery Pory Roku
location: Morzyczyn, Stargard County, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Ultra Nízke Tatry
description: Ultra Nízke Tatry is the inaugural edition of a mountain running event that follows the ridge of the Low Tatras from west to east. The course is 49.7 km long with 2,650 metres of elevation gain, following marked hiking trails from Donovaly to Srdiečko. The event is part of the Slovak Skyrunning Association calendar and also serves as the Milan Styko Memorial, honouring a prominent runner and mountaineer who tragically died in 2025. The start is scheduled for 7:00 in Donovaly, by the Donovaly Brewery.

name: Strečnianska mašľa
description: Strečnianska mašľa is a mountain ultramarathon and long-distance hike around Strečno. The race offers two routes: a challenging 50 km route with approximately 2,985 metres of elevation gain, and a shorter 25 km route, which is also suitable for runners with dogs. The routes follow marked hiking trails through both parts of the Malá Fatra and part of the national park, with the start and finish at the Radinové football field in Strečno. The organizers provide race packs, prizes for the top finishers, and quality conditions for participants.

name: Krosak pod hradom
location: Trnava pri Laborci, okr. Michalovce, Trnava pri Laborci, okr. Michalovce, Obecný úrad
organizer: Mgr. Ján Podstavský, Vladimír Adam, Ing. Ladislav Ondrik, Vladimír Sikorai, Gabriel Sabo, Štefan Karafa
description: Krosák pod hradom is a running race in Trnava pri Laborci, offering various categories, including the 10 km Big Cross, the 5 km Small Cross, a health run, and Nordic walking. The course follows farm and forest roads with asphalt surfaces, and the Big Cross consists of two 5 km loops. The race is part of the Michalovce–Sobrance Running League and is suitable for a wide range of runners, from juniors to veterans. The race starts at the Municipal Office in Trnava pri Laborci, with children’s categories starting at 9:00 and the main race at 11:00.

name: Kysucký maratón
location: Čadca, Čadca, Matičné námestie - pred Domom kultúry Čadca
description: The Kysuce Marathon is the second-oldest marathon in Slovakia and a major sporting and social event in the Kysuce region. The course follows the picturesque Kysuce Valley along the Kysuca River, with a safer and more attractive route on the cycling path for runners from 2025. In addition to the marathon, the event includes a half marathon, a marathon relay, and a minimarathon for children. The start and finish are at Matičné Square in Čadca, in front of the House of Culture. Runners compete in various age categories and have access to aid stations and facilities including changing rooms and wellness services.

name: Beh Hodkovským parkom
location: Žehra časť Hodkovce, Žehra časť Hodkovce, Kaštieľ Hodkovce 1, Žehra, areál DSS DOMOVINA no.
description: The Run Through Hodkovce Park is a running event held in the grounds of Hodkovce Manor in Žehra. The course runs mainly along field and forest roads with an asphalt surface. The event is divided into categories: an 8 km competitive run for men and women in various age groups, and non-competitive 4 km categories for Run for Health and Nordic walking, with no age limit. The organizer, DOMOVINA n.o., ensures a welcoming atmosphere and quality organization for all participants. Online entry is available at a discounted price, encouraging early registration.

name: Beh Kalváriou
description: The Kalvária Run is a charity race held in the beautiful surroundings of Kalvária in Považská Bystrica. The event offers courses for both adults and children, with forest roads making up the course surface. This fourth edition is an opportunity to experience community, exercise and joy, while the proceeds from the run go to children in need. The organizers emphasize high-quality organization and support for charitable causes.

name: Lemešanská bežecká liga 2. Letné kolo
location: Lemešany, Lemešany, Lúka nad obcou Lemešany
organizer: Obec Lemešany, Športová komisia obce Lemešany, Záhrada pohybu
description: The 2nd Summer Round of the Lemešany Running League is a running event held in Lemešany, on the meadow above the village. The race is divided into several categories by age and gender, including children’s categories and Nordic walking. The main categories start at 17:00, and the children’s categories start at 17:10. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant atmosphere for a summer race.

name: Beh na chatu pri Zelenom plese – Memoriál K. Jakeša
location: Tatranské Matliare, Tatranské Matliare, Kežmarská Biela voda, pri zastávke SAD
description: The Run to the Green Lake Hut is a mountain race for sports and nature enthusiasts, suitable for both amateur and professional athletes. The event has been held regularly since 2005 on the second weekend of June and commemorates Karel Jakeš, a prominent Czechoslovak mountaineer. The route crosses challenging mountain terrain with significant elevation gain, making the race a test for all participants. The aim is to bring together different sporting groups and offer them a unique experience in the beautiful surroundings of the High Tatras.

name: Běh zámeckým parkem Kravaře
location: Fotbalový stadion, Alejní ulice, Kravaře, Česko
description: Běh zámeckým parkem Kravaře je běžecký závod vedený převážně po šotolinových cestičkách v zámeckém parku s rovinatým profilem. Závod se koná na fotbalovém stadionu v Kravařích a nabízí také vložené závody pro děti. Pořadatelem je Prajzský BK Kravaře, který zve všechny běžce k účasti na této příjemné a přátelské akci.
course_highlights: Trať vede z větší části přes šotolinové cestičky v zámeckém parku
Rovinatý profil trati
Vložené závody dětí
additional: Start první kategorie je v 9:15, hlavní kategorie startuje v 10:00. Pořadatelem je Prajzský BK Kravaře, kontaktní osoba Jan Ferenz. Závod je smíšený a koná se v Moravskoslezském kraji na fotbalovém stadionu v Alejní ulici v Kravařích. V roce 2026 byl start u fotbalového stadionu v Alejní ulici. Informace o ceně se vztahují k ročníku 2026 a nejsou potvrzené pro rok 2027.

name: Půlmaraton okolo Prahy 4
description: Půlmaraton okolo Prahy 4 je jedinečný individuální běžecký závod, který nabízí meditační běžecký zážitek v členitém profilu městského trailu. Trať měří přibližně 21 kilometrů a vede okolo obvodu městské části Praha 4, což umožňuje účastníkům poznat místopis i vlastní běžeckou formu. Závod se koná bez hromadného startu, běžci vyrážejí mezi 9:00 a 10:00 individuálně nebo ve skupinkách, což eliminuje stres a tlačenice na startu i na trati. Po úspěšné premiéře je tento půlmaraton pořádán již podruhé a je vhodný pro všechny, kdo chtějí spojit sportovní výkon s příjemným zážitkem v přírodě i ve městě.

name: Chaloupecký kros
description: Chaloupecký kros je tradiční běžecký závod konaný v malebném prostředí Chaloupek u Komárova. Závod nabízí dvě hlavní trasy o délce přibližně 8 km a 4 km, které vedou po asfaltu, lesních cestách a loukách. Start hlavního závodu je v 10:00 a účastníci si mohou užít kombinaci přírodních krás a sportovní výzvy. Závod je součástí Brdského běžeckého poháru a je vhodný pro širokou veřejnost bez dětských kategorií.

name: Běh na Hraničář
description: Běh na Hraničář je tradiční a prestižní závod v běhu do vrchu, který se koná v malebném prostředí u lesního divadla u Úhlavy v Nýrsku. Trasa dlouhá 5 km s převýšením 380 metrů vede přes zříceninu hrádku Pajrek a končí na vrcholu Hraničáře s nádherným výhledem na vrch Ostrý. Závod je součástí Českého poháru běhu do vrchu a po tříleté pauze se od roku 2020 opět koná. Po závodě je nutné se vrátit zpět ke startu po vlastní ose.

name: Dobývání Dívčích hradů
description: Dobývání Dívčích hradů je závod do kopce dlouhý 2 km s převýšením 135 metrů, který se koná v Hlubočepích, Praha 5. Tento závod je součástí seriálu Běhy do kopců v Praze a okolí a nabízí běžcům výzvu v podobě náročného stoupání. Trať vede malebným terénem s krásnými výhledy, což dělá závod atraktivním pro milovníky horského běhu i běhu do kopce. Závod je vhodný pro všechny, kteří chtějí otestovat svou vytrvalost a sílu v kopcovitém prostředí.

name: Kefenröder Dorflauf
description: The 35th Dorflauf in Kefenrod is taking place and is organized by Turnverein 1908 Kefenrod e.V. The event gives runners of all ages the opportunity to take part in a traditional race in the idyllic surroundings of Kefenrod. Registration is through the Oberhessencup website, making it easy to sign up in advance. The race is a regular part of club life and promotes community and sporting exchange in the region.
course_highlights: Four laps through Kefenrod on a varied elevation profile
Distances of 1 km and 10 km for different ability levels
Festive awards ceremony with food and a communal atmosphere
additional: Registration is through the Oberhessencup website (ohc18). No start times or pricing tiers are listed directly on the website. The race is part of the club life of TV 1908 Kefenrod e.V. It is part of the local running calendar and, alongside the competition, offers a convivial atmosphere with coffee, cake, beer, and grilled food at the awards ceremony.

name: Eschathlon - Der Eschborner Halbmarathon
description: The Eschathlon is a popular city race in Eschborn that attracts many running enthusiasts each year. The half marathon is the main event, featuring an attractive course around Eschenplatz. Other events include a 10 km run, 5 km run, 20 km relay, FIT walk, and children’s races. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with a supporting program and refreshments, making it ideal for runners of all ages and ability levels.
course_highlights: Circuit around Eschenplatz in Eschborn
Relay changeover zone at Neugasse 1A
Course with refreshment stations and volunteer positions
additional: The start and finish are at Eschenplatz in Eschborn. The 20 km relay consists of 4 x 5 km laps, with the changeover zone at Neugasse 1A. A race shirt is guaranteed for registrations received by 30 April. Late registrations are possible up to race day, but without a shirt guarantee. The supporting program and refreshments are available on-site from 09:00 to 14:00.

name: EVL-HalbMarathon Leverkusen
description: The EVL Half Marathon in Leverkusen is a traditional and challenging half marathon, taking place for the 24th time. The 21.1-kilometre course runs through the sports city of Leverkusen and includes a special highlight: passing through the BayArena, home ground of Bayer 04 Leverkusen. The hill climb on Sauerberg is another challenge. The race is open to all abilities, from beginners to elite runners, and offers a unique running experience with plenty of atmosphere and a strong sense of community.
course_highlights: The course passes right through the BayArena
Hill climb on Sauerberg
A varied 21.1-kilometre route through Leverkusen
additional: Start and finish on Bismarckstraße, between the Ostermann-Arena and the BayArena. Runners born in 2010 or earlier may enter the half marathon, those born in 2016 or earlier may enter the 10-km race, and those born in 2018 or earlier may enter the 5-km race. Race bibs are non-transferable and must be worn clearly visible. Places are still available in the Bambini runs. The 2026 event shirt is available. The organiser recommends a good training structure, including recovery and nutrition tips from running coach Andrea von Horn. The event takes place in all weather conditions. The course runs through Leverkusen, including the BayArena; registration for the Bambini runs; event shirt and merchandise; podcast with tips and stories.

name: Niederelberter Gickellauf
description: The Niederelbert Gickellauf is a popular running event in Niederelbert, offering various race distances for children and adults. In addition to the children’s races over 800 metres and 2 kilometres, there are also 5- and 10-kilometre races. The event is part of a family festival that creates a sociable atmosphere and highlights the commitment to grassroots sport of SV Blau-Weiss 1908 Niederelbert e.V. The race encourages both sporting ambition and a sense of community in the region.
course_highlights: Children’s races over 800 m and 2 km
5 km and 10 km race distances
Family festival with a variety of highlights
additional: The Gickellauf takes place as part of a family festival that promotes social cohesion across the club’s departments. Races for children and adults are offered, and the event is part of the grassroots sports programme of SV Blau-Weiss 1908 Niederelbert e.V. Various distances; online registration available; no entry fee.

name: Sauerland-Höhenflug-Trailrun
description: The Sauerland Höhenflug Trail Run is a popular running event in the Sauerland region. It offers a range of distances from 0.4 km to a half marathon, winding through the varied landscape of the Sauerland Höhenflug. The trail run is open to runners of all ages and ability levels and is organized by Skiclub Hagen-Wildewiese e.V. in cooperation with Sauerland Tourism and Sauerland-Rothaargebirge Nature Park. The event is part of the Volksbank Sauerland Running Cup and features a special sprint classification over the final 200 meters of the longer distances.
course_highlights: Distances from 0.4 km to a half marathon through the Sauerland region
Sprint classification over the final 200 meters of the 5 km, 10 km and half-marathon races
Various age groups and classifications, including school races
additional: The trail run includes several age groups and distances, including a Bambini race, school races and main races. Timing is provided by RaceResult through Time and Voice. The half-marathon cutoff time is 3:15 hours. The event is part of the 2025 Volksbank Sauerland Running Cup. Late registration is available on site for an additional fee of €3. Distances: 5 km, 10 km and half marathon; online registration; a nature experience in the Sauerland region; annual event in June.

name: Barmstedter Stadtlauf
description: The 22nd Barmstedt City Run takes place in Barmstedt. The event offers measured 5 km and 10 km circuits that are eligible for rankings. In addition to the main races, there are Nordic walking, walking, children’s and toddlers’ races. The start and finish are at the market square in Barmstedt, and the route runs through the town centre and around Lake Rantzau, on a variety of surfaces including cobblestones, asphalt and firm sandy paths.
course_highlights: Measured 5 km and 10 km circuits, eligible for rankings
Route through Barmstedt’s town centre and around Lake Rantzau
Varied surfaces: cobblestones, asphalt and firm sandy paths
additional: Timing is done with a loan chip worn around the ankle (except for the children’s races), which is collected at the finish. Unreturned chips will be charged at 40 euros. Jogging strollers and dogs are not permitted for safety reasons. The races have different age categories and minimum ages. The route may vary slightly due to construction work; updates will be posted on the website. Routes are measured; surfaces vary; online registration is available; no late registrations; refreshments and medals are included.

name: Donatus-Lauf
location: Sportgelände SC Fortuna Liblar, Hamburg-Rissen, Hamburg, Germany
description: The Donatuslauf takes place around Lake Donatus on the SC Fortuna Liblar sports grounds in Hamburg-Rissen. The event offers a range of race distances, from a 400 m toddlers’ run and 1,200 m schoolchildren’s races to a half marathon and a 10 km main race. The races are designed for different age groups and offer a family-friendly atmosphere, with additional walking and family races. The course is varied and clearly marked, with the start and finish area close to Erftstadt railway station. Awards ceremonies take place shortly after the races, and certificates can be downloaded online.
course_highlights: A range of distances from 400 m to a half marathon
Start and finish area near Erftstadt railway station, with easy access
Family race and Nordic walking as additional offerings
additional: Late entries are accepted only until the participant limit is reached and incur a €3 late-entry fee. Awards ceremonies take place on the sports grounds immediately after the respective races. Parking is available only at Erftstadt railway station, just 100 m from the start and finish area. Certificates can be downloaded online as PDFs and printed. Courses around Lake Donatus, online registration, parking at Erftstadt railway station, start and finish area at the SC Fortuna Liblar sports grounds

name: Eifelmarathon
description: The Eifel Marathon in Waxweiler offers a varied running event with a marathon, ultramarathon, trail run, half marathon, 10 km fitness run, hiking marathon and children’s race. The routes pass through the scenic Eifel region, with varied elevation and well-equipped aid stations. The start and finish are in Waxweiler, with a shuttle service for the half-marathon start in Hamm. The event is part of the new Mini-Cup Deutschland and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with medals for all participants.
course_highlights: Marathon route: 42.195 km with 764 metres of elevation gain
Ultramarathon: 51.4 km with 983 metres of elevation gain, including a scenic forest loop
The half marathon starts in Hamm, with a shuttle service, and follows the reservoir and the River Prüm back to Waxweiler
additional: The time limit for all races is 16:00. Every participant receives a medal. Aid stations are staffed from 09:30. Shuttle service for the half marathon from Waxweiler to Hamm. Hiking marathon: approx. 30 km on the Eifel Marathon route. Part of Mini-Cup Deutschland, with prize money for participants who complete three races in Germany. Route approx. 30 km (Waxweiler - Hamm - Waxweiler), start at 08:00, time limit 16:00, aid stations from 09:30, marked route, medal for all participants

name: Hahner Kitzenhauslauf
description: The Hahner Kitzenhauslauf is a popular running event in the border region of Germany, Belgium and the Netherlands. The natural, hilly and varied courses in the south of Aachen offer runners a challenging and scenic experience. The event has a long tradition and attracts runners from the region and beyond. It is known for its friendly atmosphere and well-organised races.
course_highlights: Natural running courses in the south of Aachen
Hilly and varied terrain
Scenic routes
additional: Courses for Bambini, schoolchildren, the one-tenth marathon and the half marathon; races counting toward the Regio Aachen Laufcup; refreshments, certificates, photos and live results

name: Integrationslauf des VfB Reichenbach
description: The VfB Reichenbach Integration Run in Reichenbach-Steegen is an annual running event that has been part of the municipality’s event calendar since 2016. The run promotes inclusion and integration through sport by overcoming barriers and enabling people to build connections. The event is open to runners of all ages and offers a shared sporting experience in the region.
course_highlights: Fun run in the municipality of Reichenbach-Steegen
Promotes integration and community through sport
Held since 2016, with a break during the COVID-19 pandemic
additional: The event takes place at the sports grounds in Reichenbach-Steegen and promotes a sense of community through sporting activities for all ages.

name: Kirschlauf
description: The Kirschlauf in Kleinfahner, organized by USV Erfurt, is a traditional race with a history spanning more than 20 years. The 24th edition takes runners along scenic routes with challenging highland trails. The event offers various distances, including a 14-kilometer main race, a 4.5-kilometer fun run, and races for schoolchildren and young children. The awards ceremony is traditionally conducted by the Thuringian Cherry Queen, and the race is part of the TLV Running Cup.
course_highlights: 14-kilometer main race along a scenic highland trail with views across the northern Thuringian Basin
4.5 km fun run with challenging terrain in the Imtal valley
Finish through a cherry orchard above Kleinfahner with magnificent views
additional: Race packet pickup from 8:00 a.m. at the event tent by the mill. Late entries are possible online from June 13 at 2:00 a.m. and on race day until 30 minutes before the race, with a €5 late entry fee. Awards ceremonies take place from approximately 9:45 a.m. for the schoolchildren’s races and from approximately 11:30 a.m. for the other races.

name: Kurt-Roth Lauf
description: The Kurt-Roth-Lauf in Wersau is a traditional running event held annually by TV 1908 Wersau. The event gives runners of different ages and ability levels the opportunity to be active and enjoy running together. The course passes through the scenic surroundings of Wersau and is suitable for both recreational runners and competitive athletes. The race promotes community and recreational sport within the club.
course_highlights: Children’s race through the streets of Wersau
Field and forest trails in the Gersprenz Valley
Moderate elevation changes
additional: Distances offered: 1.1 km, 5 km, 10 km and half marathon.

name: Melibokuslauf mit 3. Mountainbike-Gipfelsprint
description: The Melibokus Run is a long-standing running and mountain biking event in Alsbach-Hähnlein, taking place for the 55th time in 2026. It offers several running distances, including a half-marathon trail, 10 km and 5 km running trails, and races for children and teenagers. The Mountain Bike Summit Sprint is also held, featuring a challenging course with 450 m of climbing and 130 m of descent over approximately 13.4 km. The running courses have been evaluated by ITRA and offer varied trails through the countryside around the Melibokus. The event is open to runners and mountain bikers; e-bikes are not allowed.
course_highlights: Half-marathon trail covering 21.2 km
Mountain Bike Summit Sprint with 450 m of climbing and 130 m of descent over approximately 13.4 km
ITRA-evaluated running courses with varied trails
additional: Race-pack collection and late registration from 8:00 a.m. at Sperbergrund, 500 m above Bürgerhaus Sonne. The Mountain Bike Summit Sprint starts at 9:00 a.m., the half-marathon at 9:30 a.m., the 10 km run at 9:45 a.m., and the 5 km run at 10:00 a.m. The children’s races start from 11:00 a.m. Gravel bikes are permitted in the Mountain Bike Summit Sprint; e-bikes are not. Results are processed immediately after the race at the Großsporthalle at Melibokusschule. GPX files of the courses are available. Mountain Bike Summit Sprint distance: approximately 13.4 km. Online registration is available, along with GPX downloads. Public transport stops are in Alsbach-Hähnlein. Age restrictions apply to the competitions.

name: Sohrener Sommerlauf
description: The Sohrener Summer Run is a regional running event in Sohren and part of the Hunsrück Running Series. It is organized by TuS Sohren, a local sports club with a variety of departments, making the event community-focused and non-commercial. Two distances are offered: a short 150-meter run and a 10-kilometer road race. The race typically takes place in pleasant summer weather and gives runners from the region a great opportunity to get active.
course_highlights: Part of the Hunsrück Running Series, which features regional road races
Distances: 150 m and 10 km
Organized by the local sports club TuS Sohren
additional: Typical June weather: approx. 23°C, low of 13°C, mostly sunny with an average of 65 mm of precipitation. Events for children and teenagers; registration required. Start/finish nearby. Typical June weather: around 23°C high, 13°C low, 65 mm of precipitation.

name: Drei-Länder-Lauf
description: The Three-Country Run takes place in Arenshausen and connects the regions of Thuringia, Lower Saxony and Hesse. The event offers various race distances, including 1.2 km, 2 km, 5 km and 13 km, some of which are loop courses and others out-and-back races. In addition to the main races, there is a fun run for preschool children with no timing, as well as Nordic walking as a non-competitive event. The run has a long tradition as a symbol of the region growing together after German reunification.

name: Schackenslebener Hopfenlauf
description: The Schackenslebener Hopfenlauf is a long-standing running event in Schackensleben, about 25 km west of Magdeburg. Distances of 400 m, 1.4 km, 6.0 km and 10.8 km are offered, running through the village and the surrounding countryside with the gently undulating profile typical of the Börde region. The races take place on roads and paved farm tracks and feature several drink stations. Participants have access to good changing and shower facilities, as well as extensive refreshments including coffee, cake, drinks and grilled food. After finishing, runners can refuel with drinks and fruit, and there is a traditional raffle with attractive prizes.
course_highlights: Route through Schackensleben and the surrounding countryside, with a gently undulating profile
Running on roads and paved farm tracks
Several drink stations along the route
additional: The start and finish for all distances are at the sports field, with changing and shower facilities in the clubhouse. Refreshments include coffee, cake, lard sandwiches, drinks and grilled food. After finishing, participants are offered drinks and fruit. A raffle with attractive prizes takes place alongside the awards ceremony. The Hopfenlauf is part of the Novo Nordisk Landescup and the Elbe-Ohre-Cup.

name: REWE Women´s Run Hamburg
description: The REWE Women’s Run Hamburg is a road race for beginners and ambitious runners in the Elbe metropolis of Hamburg. The event offers a measured 10 km loop course starting and finishing at Ballindamm. In addition to the main race, there is also the REWE Girl’s Run for girls aged 5 to 10 over 1 kilometer. Participants receive a finisher medal and can use showers and changing facilities after the race.

name: Heidenheimer Sparkassen-Stadtlauf
description: The Heidenheimer Sparkasse City Run offers a variety of races for everyone from beginners to half-marathon runners through downtown Heidenheim. The half marathon follows two almost identical laps through the city, passing landmarks such as Pauluskirche, the city library, and Brenzpark. The event also includes 10 km and 5 km races, as well as races for schoolchildren and young children. All participants receive chip timing with a transponder integrated into their race number and a generous selection of refreshments at the finish.

name: Herzogstadtlauf Straubing
description: The Herzogstadtlauf in Straubing is a long-standing popular race that welcomes runners of all ages. From the children’s race and a range of distances to the BMW Half Marathon, the event offers a varied program with attractive routes through the historic city and city park. Alongside the sporting challenge, an extensive supporting program featuring stage performances and DJ music creates a lively atmosphere. The event promotes community and health and is a highlight of the Eastern Bavarian running calendar.

name: Hohenneuffen-Berglauf mit BW Trail
description: The 37th Hohenneuffen Mountain Run takes place in Linsenhofen and finishes at Hohenneuffen Castle. The main course covers 9.3 km, with approximately 535 metres of ascent and 180 metres of descent. There is also the 24th Schoolchildren’s Mountain Run, with various distances and elevation gains, open to children from Year 1 onwards. The start is at the town hall in Balzholz, and the finish is at the kindergarten on Jahnstraße. We look forward to welcoming many runners from near and far.

name: Metropolmarathon
organizer: Laufteam Fürth 2010 und Team Klinikum Nürnberg
description: The Sparkassen Metropolmarathon 2026 will take place on June 13 and 14 in the cities of Fürth and Nuremberg. The running event connects two cities with varied routes, numerous competitions and a colorful supporting program. With around 9,000 participants and 600 volunteers, the Metropolmarathon offers a weekend full of exercise, fun and community. The events range from the marathon and half marathon to 10 km races, Nordic walking, and races for children and young people.

name: Nesselwanger Seenlauf
description: The 1st Nesselwang Lakes Run, presented by Endress+Hauser and organised by Skiklub Nesselwang e. V., is the successor to the former company run and is aimed at people of all ages. The run promotes exercise and community and offers various routes for children, young people, adults and families, including routes suitable for strollers. The start and finish are at the Trendsportzentrum Allgäu. The event welcomes individuals, companies, clubs and running groups.

name: NEW-Citylauf
description: The 25th NEW-Citylauf in Erkelenz is a popular running event that takes runners of all ability levels through the city center. The event offers a sporty, friendly atmosphere that appeals to both beginners and ambitious athletes. With a varied course and an exciting atmosphere, the NEW-Citylauf is a highlight of the regional events calendar. Taking part is an opportunity to enjoy the fun of running together with family and friends.

name: saarBRÜCKENlauf
description: The Saarbrücken Running Group warmly invites you to the saarBRÜCKENlauf, a guided run across (almost) all of the state capital Saarbrücken’s bridges. Two distances are offered: a 10 km loop with 7 bridges and a 20 km loop with 17 different bridges. This is not a race but a social run with groups at different paces, allowing everyone to tackle the challenging route—with ramps, stairs and many changes of direction—together. The run starts at 10 a.m. at the Kulturbiergarten, opposite the Römerbrücke power plant.

name: Sparkassenlauf
description: The Gladbeck Sparkassenlauf is a long-established running event with DLV-certified courses over 1.5 km, 5 km, 10 km and the half marathon. The races take runners through Wittringer Wald on a flat, fast loop course featuring paved walking paths, asphalt and a tartan track. All participants receive a personalised race number bearing their name and a finisher’s medal. The event also hosts the district road running championships and offers net times and live timing.

name: TVE-Sommerlauf 2026
description: The TVE Summer Run is a traditional road race organized by Turnverein 1890 Edingen e.V. in Edingen-Neckarhausen. The event offers races for various age groups, from the youngest runners to seniors, with official timing and certificates. The course is measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and is eligible for ranking lists. Runners enjoy a varied route along the Neckar, with the start and finish in the stadium.

name: Alfelder Bernd Meyer Staffelmarathon
description: The Alfelder Bernd Meyer Relay Marathon is a long-standing relay marathon held in Alfeld (Leine). The event is open to runners from across the region and is organized jointly by several local running clubs and the town of Alfeld. The course is an approximately 3 km loop, run twice, with the start and finish on the market square. Each team consists of 7 runners, who must be registered by name. Timing is electronic, using disposable transponders. There is also a children’s race of approximately 700 m.

name: Bad Kohlgruber Schluchtlauf
description: The Bad Kohlgrub Gorge Run is a scenic race in the Alpine foothills that, despite its name, is not a mountain race. The course is gently undulating and consists of 20% asphalt and 80% forest paths. The event takes place at the Sport and Leisure Center at Erle in Bad Kohlgrub and offers free drinks along the route and at the finish. Coffee, cake, food, and drinks are available, and all participants receive certificates, with trophies for the age-group winners.

name: Barsbütteler Volkslauf
description: The Barsbüttel Fun Run is a long-standing running event held every June at the sports field in the Barsbüttel Sports Center. It offers a range of distances from 400 m to 10 km, which are mostly flat and run along paved or firm, sandy farm tracks. Most of the routes pass through the traffic-free Barsbüttel countryside and offer scenic views, particularly the longer 5 km and 10 km routes. Times are measured electronically, and all participants receive a certificate afterward. Food and refreshments are also available for runners and spectators.

name: BORNE TO RUN (48-Stunden-Lauf)
description: BORNE TO RUN is a 48-hour charity run in Unna that presents an extreme challenge to endurance and willpower. Participants are pushed to their limits over long, demanding hours. This race is for runners ready to take on a true test while supporting a good cause.

name: Famberglauf
description: The Famberglauf is a running event held in June in Fambach, organized by SV Schwarz-Weiß Fambach 09 e.V. The program offers four distances: a half marathon of 21.1 km, the 10.9 km Famberglauf, the 5 km Famberg Sprint, and a 1000 m children’s race. The event is aimed at runners of all ages and abilities and has more of the feel of a family-friendly club run than a major competition.

name: KarlsruheLäuft 100 Jahre Berufsfeuerwehr Karlsruhe
description: In 2026, the Karlsruhe professional fire brigade celebrates its 100th anniversary with a varied program of events for the whole city. The anniversary includes sporting competitions, historical highlights such as vintage vehicle gatherings and hand-pump fire engine competitions, as well as ceremonies and the Schlosslichtspiele. The events offer fascinating insights into the history and technology of the fire brigade and invite everyone to celebrate and remember.

name: Kirchenkirnberger Wald- und Wiesenlauf
description: The 3rd Kirchenkirnberg Forest and Meadow Run takes place in Murrhardt. It is a short running race with two distances, taking runners through forest and meadow landscapes. The race offers a pleasant running atmosphere in typical June weather, with mild temperatures and mostly sunny days. Runners of all ages are warmly invited to take part and enjoy the nature around Murrhardt.

name: Ludwigsluster Schlossgartenlauf
description: The Ludwigslust Palace Garden Run takes place in Ludwigslust Palace Park and offers runners of all ages a varied choice of distances. The routes range from 2 km for children to 15 km for experienced runners, with additional walking events over 5 and 10 km. New to the program is a fun run for the youngest children, with no registration or timing, who receive an official medal at the finish. This traditional event warmly welcomes beginners and professionals alike to enjoy the beautiful park landscape.

name: Ortslauf Wallertheim
description: The Wallertheim Town Run is a traditional running event held annually in Wallertheim and is part of the Wingertscup. A range of distances is offered, from 900 m for children to 10 km for experienced runners, as well as a 5 km walking course. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, electronic timing with transponder technology, and convenient online registration. It welcomes runners of all abilities and offers a shared sporting experience in the beautiful Rheinhessen countryside.

name: 55. Melibokus Lauf
description: The Melibokuslauf is a long-standing running event in Alsbach-Hähnlein, taking place for the 55th time. The event offers several race distances, including a half-marathon trail, 10 km and 5 km running trails, and a mountain-bike summit sprint. The courses have been evaluated by ITRA and feature varied trails with challenging climbs and scenic views. There are also dedicated school races for children and teenagers over 400 m, 800 m, and 1,500 m. The event is open to runners of all ages and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with the start and finish in Sperbergrund.

name: VerenaLauf
location: Hausen ob Verena, Tuttlingen, Baden-Württemberg, Germany

name: Nocny Maraton Kanału Bydgoskiego od 2007r.
description: The Bydgoszcz Canal Night Marathon is Poland’s oldest continuously held night marathon, taking place since 2007. The race is run in the unique nighttime setting of the Bydgoszcz Planty and along the Bydgoszcz Canal’s distinctive historic hydraulic structures: its 18th-century locks. The canal is the oldest inland waterway in Poland. The event attracts runners from across Poland and abroad, offering generous race packs, original medals and T-shirts, and professional timekeeping. It is growing in prestige and is known for its lively atmosphere, live music, and numerous accompanying attractions.
course_highlights: A night race in the setting of the Bydgoszcz Planty
A route along the historic 18th-century locks of the Bydgoszcz Canal
A unique atmosphere with live music and artistic experiences
additional: There are 6 distances. Participants receive original medals, commemorative T-shirts, and generous race packs. Professional electronic timekeeping and race numbers are provided. Live music adds to the event’s appeal for runners and spectators. The event features 6 distances, electronic timekeeping, commemorative medals and T-shirts, and generous race packs. Participants can expect professional course markings and artistic entertainment during the race.

name: 15 Piknik Biegowy Biała Biega
description: The 15th Biała Biega Running Picnic is a family-friendly running event held in Biała Podlaska, attracting runners of different ages and abilities. The event has a picnic atmosphere, combining sporting competition with fun and a chance for the local community to come together. More than 260 people are already on the participant list, reflecting the event’s strong appeal and friendly atmosphere.
additional: More than 260 people have already registered, indicating the event’s popularity. The event is a family running picnic, suggesting activities for different age groups and opportunities for participants to connect.

name: TATRA FEST 2026
description: Tatra Fest is a unique mountain festival held in Zakopane, offering a variety of running, climbing, and trekking activities. Its best-known event is the TATRA FEST BIEG 68 km, a demanding skyrunning race on Tatra trails, with a course that reaches above 2,000 m above sea level and includes significant elevation gain. The festival promotes a connection with nature, physical activity, and environmental responsibility, inviting people to celebrate life and the Tatras outdoors.
course_highlights: The TATRA FEST BIEG 68 km course follows Tatra trails above 2,000 m above sea level.
The longest ascent and descent each have approximately 1,100 m of elevation change.
Exposed mountain trails, with fixed ropes on some sections.
additional: The race office is located at Sokolnia, ul. Orkana 2. The 68 km race course has cutoff checkpoints at Kasprowy Wierch, Hala Ornak, Polana Chochołowska, and Zahradziska. The start and finish are at the Municipal Park in Zakopane. Mandatory gear is checked before the start. The festival also includes workshops, hikes, and other outdoor activities.

name: Zawojski Festiwal Biegowy
description: The Zawoja Running Festival is one of the largest sporting events in the region, held amid the picturesque scenery of Babia Góra and the Policy Range. The festival promotes mountain running and an active lifestyle, offering participants sporting challenges and the chance to discover the natural and cultural richness of Babia Góra National Park. The event attracts runners from across Poland and abroad, combining a passion for running with the beauty of mountain nature. The program features a variety of distances, from short children’s races to a mountain ultramarathon.
course_highlights: A 63 km ultramarathon course with 3,340 m of elevation gain
Picturesque views of Babia Góra and the Policy Range
A variety of distances suited to different age groups and ability levels
additional: Participant limits: 200 runners for the 63 km and 42.9 km distances, 300 for the half-marathon, and 250 for the 6.2 km distance. Starts are scheduled at different times: 5:00 (63 km), 10:00 (42.9 km), and 15:00 (half-marathon and 6.2 km). The time limit for the longest distance is 15 hours. The program also includes children’s races from 100 m to 800 m, divided into age categories.

name: XVII Elbląski Bieg Piekarczyka Mini Bieg Piekarczyka
description: The Elbląg Piekarczyk Run is one of the largest and best-known running events in Elbląg, held every year in June. The two-day event combines sporting competition with numerous side attractions, including races at various distances and activities for children. The route runs through the streets of the city centre and features a flat asphalt-and-cobblestone surface with one hill, making it suitable for fast times. The race attracts both amateur and more experienced runners, as well as many spectators cheering participants along the route.
course_highlights: Flat route with one hill on Teatralna Street
Asphalt (80%) and cobblestones (20%)
Route certified by the Polish Athletics Association
additional: The time limit for completing the race is 1 hour and 30 minutes. The Mini Piekarczyk Run takes place on loops of Teatralna Street ranging from 50 to 600 metres, adjusted to the children's ages. Race packs are distributed at two locations: Ogrody Shopping Centre (13 June) and the “Helena” MOSiR ice rink (14 June). Participants over the age of 70 are exempt from the entry fee after registering.

name: Bieg Charytatywny
location: Park przy dworcu kolejowym, Oława, Poland
organizer: Urząd Miejski w Oławie; Stowarzyszenie Ludzi Aktywnych „Biegnij Oławo”
description: The FOUR SEASONS Charity Run – Stage IV is a sporting event held in Oława, in the park by the railway station. Participants can take part in a run of approximately 5 km or a Nordic Walking march on the same route. The event is charitable and is coordinated by a local association and the Oława Municipal Office. The race office operates on race day, and electronic timing ensures professional organization.
course_highlights: A run and walking route approximately 5 km long
Start and finish in the park by the railway station in Oława
Electronic timing provided by ZmierzymyCzas.pl
additional: The race office is open on race day from 09:30 to 10:30 near the start. Categories: run of approximately 5 km and Nordic Walking march of approximately 5 km. The organizers provide the rules and consent forms for parents/guardians and participants. Race coordinators: Mariusz Jarławski and Mateusz Bularz. Information about the available distances and event location comes from the description of Stage IV of the series.

name: Dziki Trail
description: Dziki Groń is a mountain ultra race held in the picturesque Pieniny region, starting and finishing at Dietl Square in Szczawnica. The approximately 54 km course crosses demanding natural terrain and has five aid stations, offering participants exceptional views and challenges. The race is part of Pieniny Ultra-Trail®, and participants receive commemorative medals, with prizes and trophies available for the top finishers. The organizers care for the environment by eliminating plastic cups at aid stations.
course_highlights: Approximately 54 km through the Pieniny Mountains, with five aid stations
Start and finish at Dietl Square in Szczawnica
Natural mountain terrain with a demanding elevation profile
additional: Mandatory equipment: race bib and shoe chip, a water container with a capacity of at least 0.5 litres, and a mobile phone with a charged battery. There are 5 aid stations on the course, including one serving water only. The organizer does not provide plastic cups at aid stations. Commemorative medals for all finishers and prizes for the top finishers. Prize details will be published by 31.03.2027.

name: IV Charytatywny Bieg z Żonkilem
location: Klubokawiarnia Laba, Wyspa Bolko, Opole, Poland
description: The 4th Charity Daffodil Run is a sporting event held in Opole that combines a passion for running with charitable causes. The run is inclusive and promotes physical activity and support for those in need. Participants can expect professional timekeeping and a welcoming atmosphere. The event takes place in the scenic surroundings of Opole and welcomes runners of all experience levels.

name: Suszecki dziki bieg

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Zapisy i wpłaty drogą elektroniczną na stronie: https://bgtimesport.pl/ do dnia 10.06.2027 r. do godz. 21:59 - biegi dla dorosłych

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Zapisy i wpłaty drogą elektroniczną na stronie: https://bgtimesport.pl/ do dnia 11.06.2027 r. do godz. 21:59 - biegi dla dzieci i młodzieży

late_fee.price: 25 zł do 50 zł (gotówką w biurze zawodów, jeśli będą wolne pakiety)

description: The Suszec Running Festival is an annual running event organized by the Suszec Municipal Sports Centre, promoting an active lifestyle among children, young people, and adults. The event takes place at the “Gwaruś” Recreation Centre and features a variety of cross-country obstacle races for the youngest participants, youth races over 800 and 1,600 metres, and adult distances, including the Wild Super Double over 10 and 21 km. The event has a family-friendly, community-building atmosphere, with numerous attractions for participants of all ages.
course_highlights: Cross-country obstacle races for children up to 9 years old
Youth races over 800 m and 1,600 m
Wild Super Double: 10 km and 21 km on cross-country courses
additional: Race office hours: Saturday 12:00–14:55, Sunday 8:00–10:00. Participants must register for each race no later than 30 minutes before the start. An obstacle course is available for children and young people. Award ceremonies take place after the children’s races and the half marathon.
