The event is family-friendly and, in addition to the races, offers a raffle with attractive prizes as well as refreshments for spectators and participants.
course_highlights: Challenging 3.3 km loop with approximately 50 metres of elevation gain
Course passes through woodland and open farmland
Separate, flat out-and-back course for children under 12
additional: Start and finish at the sports field of Matthias-Claudius-Gymnasium, Knülweg 10, 30989 Gehrden. Changing rooms and showers are available in the sports hall. Parking is not available in the event area. Race bib collection from 11:00 a.m. in the sports hall. Fully electronic timing via a chip attached to the shoe; return the chip after finishing (a €10 fee applies if it is lost). Raffle with attractive prizes; the grand prize is a pizza oven. The Bambini races (300 m and 700 m) start from 2:00 p.m. Bambini entries are also accepted on site on race day (€3, cash only). Refreshments for spectators include bratwurst, drinks and ice cream. Course: challenging 3.3 km loop, woodland trails, paved; online registration only; race bibs collected in the sports hall; no parking in the event area; Bambini races have no placings and include a medal.

name: Abendlauf TSV Blau-Weiß Ippinghausen
description: The TSV Blau-Weiß Ippinghausen Evening Run takes place in Wolfhagen-Ippinghausen. The event offers 10 km, half marathon, and marathon races on firm, paved forest paths, starting and finishing at Weidelsburg Stadium. The course runs through the town forest, including scenic sections such as Stöcketeich, and has several aid stations. The event is open to all age groups and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with certificates for all participants.
course_highlights: 21 km loop for the half marathon; the marathon covers the loop twice
Start and finish at Weidelsburg Stadium, with a scenic loop through the town forest
Several aid stations (4 for the half marathon, 9 for the marathon); showers and changing rooms available
additional: Spikes are not allowed in any weather conditions. Start times are staggered by age group, from 16:30 (Bambini) to 17:00 (10 km/half marathon/marathon). Every participant receives a certificate. Parking is available at the sports ground, Waldecker Straße, and Vor dem Busche. HLV insurance covers all participants, including non-club members. Courses are on firm forest paths and the sports ground; spikes are not permitted. Registration via Raceresult; insurance provided by HLV.

name: City Marathon Wiesbaden
description: The City Marathon Wiesbaden takes place in the Hessian state capital and offers a varied weekend of running. Organized by Sporthilfe Wiesbaden e.V., the event includes a marathon, half marathon, 10- and 5-kilometer races, a 3-kilometer children’s race, and relay competitions. The weekend traditionally begins with a school class run for children in grades 1 through 10. The event promises a sporting highlight for runners of all ages and ability levels.
course_highlights: A variety of distances: marathon, half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, and 3 km children’s race
Popular relay competitions
School class run for children in grades 1 through 10
additional: The running weekend is organized by Sporthilfe Wiesbaden e.V. The website provides no information about start times or entry fees. In addition to the main races, the event includes children’s and relay competitions. It features several running distances, including school class races, and offers a weekend full of sporting highlights in Wiesbaden.

name: Die 49. Nacht von Borgholzhausen
description: The Night of Borgholzhausen is a special running event held in the town centre of Borgholzhausen. From the Bambini Run and Schoolrunning to the atmospheric 10 km night run, there is something for all ages and ability levels. The event is known for its unique atmosphere, created by live music, cheerleaders, DJs and torches along the route. Teams, beginners and ambitious runners can enjoy an unforgettable evening filled with community spirit and a passion for running.
course_highlights: Paved streets through the town centre of Borgholzhausen
Cheerleaders, live music and DJs creating a lively atmosphere along the route
Torch-lit route and garden parties along the course
additional: The event starts with the Bambini Run at 18:00 (300 m, untimed, registration through kindergartens). This is followed by two Schoolrunning races: one for primary school pupils (approx. 1.6 km) and one for secondary school pupils (approx. 3 km). The company run (5 km) and the 5 km run are suitable for beginners and teams. The highlight is the 10 km night run, which is enlivened by a special atmosphere, with plenty of spectators and music. Individual registration is available online until shortly before the final start at 21:30. Various running distances, a running course for beginners, an atmosphere with music and torches, online registration

name: Dieburger Stadtlauf
description: The Dieburg City Run takes place annually in Dieburg town centre and offers races for various age groups, from Bambinis to the 10 km main race. The route starts in the market square and runs through the old town, making it accessible to all participants. Alongside the sporting competition, the team and school competitions are also a focus, making the run a popular event for the whole family and local community. The event is part of the Lang-Lauf-Cup and is known for its friendly atmosphere and good organisation.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Dieburg market square
Route runs through the historic old town
Loop races with a clearly marked route (from Bambinis to the 10 km main race)
additional: Race number collection from 2 p.m. at the Pater-Delp-Haus near the town hall/market square. Late registration is possible until 4 p.m. on event day, subject to availability. There are no showers or changing rooms near the start and finish. The 4 km race includes school and team competitions. The main race is part of the Lang-Lauf-Cup. Routes in the market square, various race distances, online registration, no showers/changing rooms nearby.

name: Europalauf 2026
location: Hennef, Siegtal, Allner See, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 20th Hennef Europalauf offers a wide range of races, from 1,000 metres to the half marathon (21.1 km). The routes run through the centre of Hennef, along Allner Lake and through the picturesque Sieg Valley. The event is for the whole family, with beginner-friendly races for children and beginners as well as challenging courses for ambitious runners. Particular emphasis is placed on inclusion, and special races are offered for people with disabilities. The event is organised by Hennefer Turnverein in cooperation with the City of Hennef and takes place in a friendly, volunteer-run atmosphere.
course_highlights: A range of courses from 1,000 m to 21.1 km through Hennef, Allner Lake and the Sieg Valley
Half marathon with more than 150 metres of elevation gain and five bridge crossings
Panoramic routes with views across the Sieg Valley to the Siebengebirge
additional: Late registration is available at the Town Hall on event day from 8 a.m. until 60 minutes before the respective start, with a late-registration fee of €2 per person per race. The start and finish are at the Historic Hennef Town Hall (Frankfurter Straße 97). Changing rooms and showers are available at the Kronos Aktivclub. Timing is provided professionally using disposable chips from runtiming. The awards ceremony takes place in front of the Town Hall at 1 p.m. There is a team challenge with cash prizes for the top teams in the HIT Panorama Run. The courses are not suitable for wheelchair users, and coaching from a bicycle will result in disqualification. The event offers a variety of courses, including accessible and panoramic routes, as well as a challenging half marathon with elevation gain and bridge crossings.

name: Feldbergfestlauf
description: The Feldbergfest Run is a traditional cross-country race around the Großer Feldberg in the Taunus, held as part of the oldest mountain sports festival in the German-speaking world. The approximately 6,300-metre course crosses varied terrain and offers runners a challenging experience in a natural setting. The event attracts numerous participants each year and is an established part of the Feldbergfest.
course_highlights: Cross-country race around the Großer Feldberg
Course approximately 6,300 metres long
Natural, varied running route in the Taunus
additional: The race takes place in typical June weather. The start is on the Großer Feldberg, and the event includes various sporting activities around the Feldberg.

name: Mittsommernachtslauf
price_range: 2 € Nachmeldegebühr (bei Anmeldung bis 18.06.2026, sonst 30 Minuten vor Start)
description: The 46th Midsummer Night Run in Konzen offers a varied running program for all ages and ability levels. The event includes children’s races, fun runs over 4.2 km, 6 km and 10 km, as well as walking routes through the picturesque hedgerow and meadow landscape of the Eifel. The short 4.2 km course is a one-tenth marathon and part of the Regio Aachen Running Cup; it is especially suitable for beginners and fit children. The Running Team Konzen looks forward to welcoming many participants to enjoy the run together in a relaxed atmosphere.
course_highlights: Routes through the beautiful hedgerow and meadow landscape of the Eifel
A pleasantly flat course by Eifel standards
10 km walking route following the same course as the running route
additional: The children’s races start at 3 p.m. and are free to enter. Food and refreshments are available before, during and after the races.

name: Nordholzer Windmühlenlauf
price_range: Kinder/Jugendliche/Wanderer/Walker 4,00 Euro; Erwachsene 8,00 Euro; Halbmarathon 12,00 Euro; Nachmeldung 2,00 Euro
description: The Nordholz Windmill Run is a long-standing running event in Wurster North Sea Coast offering various distances for children, young people and adults. The courses follow measured road routes officially recognised by the German Athletics Association (DLV). There are also hiking and walking options open to all age groups. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere, and every participant receives a medal and certificate.
course_highlights: Measured road courses with DLV certification
Distances from the 400 m Bambini run to the half marathon (21.0975 km)
Competition at Willi-Wicke Sports Ground, serving as the start and finish area
additional: Race-pack collection from 14:00 at the clubhouse at Willi-Wicke Sports Ground. Timing is by transponder, loaned with the race pack (20 euro fee if not returned). Changing rooms, showers and toilets are available at the start/finish area. The Bambini run is free, and accompaniment is permitted but not timed. The 5 km race counts as the district championship. Late entries are possible up to 1 hour before the start for an additional fee. Every participant receives a medal and certificate; walkers and hikers receive a certificate of participation. Courses are measured; timing is by transponder; changing rooms, showers and toilets are available; district championship on the 5 km course.

name: Samstagslauf Großenmeer
description: The Großenmeer Saturday Run is a long-standing grassroots running event, taking place for the 15th time. Organized by Großenmeerer Turnverein 1921 e.V., it offers a sporting opportunity for runners from the region and beyond. The event is open to various distances and welcomes all age groups. Registration is available via Laufmanager.net, and the organizers look forward to welcoming numerous participants.
course_highlights: A variety of routes for different ability levels
A run through the scenic region around Großenmeer and Ovelgönne
A traditional event with a friendly atmosphere and strong regional ties
additional: The run is organized by Großenmeerer Turnverein 1921 e.V., which also supports other sporting activities in the region. No start times or pricing tiers are explicitly listed on the website. The event is part of the Ovelgönne-Jade sports association. Routes, online registration, various running distances, regional sports activities

name: Stunden-Lauf Herne
location: Sportpark Eickel, Herne, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 24-hour run in Herne takes place at Sportpark Eickel, a modern sporting venue with a paved 2 km loop. The challenge is to run as many kilometres as possible within 24 hours, either as an individual or as part of a relay team. Alongside the sporting competition, the event offers entertainment with mini golf and on-site refreshments. Timing is electronic, using a transponder attached to the race bib, and camping is possible right at the venue.
course_highlights: Paved 2 km loop at Sportpark Eickel
Electronic lap counting with a transponder attached to the race bib
Start and finish directly beside the mini golf course
additional: Race packs will be available on the event day from 08:00 to 11:00 at the mini golf course. Timing is electronic using a transponder, which is passed on like a relay baton during team changes. Refreshment stations serving drinks and food are available, and runners may store their own supplies. Camping is possible on site. The course is a paved 2 km loop at Sportpark Eickel. Course: loop around Sportpark Eickel; participate individually or as part of a relay team; fun and refreshments on site

name: Taunus Trailrun
description: The 8th Kreissparkasse Limburg Taunus Trail Run is a nature-focused trail run that takes place mainly on natural field and forest paths and singletracks in the Selters-Eisenbach region. Depending on the weather, the course may include muddy and slippery sections, making the run particularly challenging. The long-distance course is highly valued by the regional trail-running community. The event offers electronic timing, a race briefing before the start, and an awards ceremony after runners cross the finish line.
course_highlights: Natural field and forest paths and singletracks
Muddy and slippery sections depending on the weather
The long-distance course is praised by the regional trail-running community
additional: The event takes place in all weather conditions. Late entries are possible up to 60 minutes before the relevant start, but without a guaranteed starting place and with a €1 surcharge. Race-number collection, changing rooms, showers, drinks, and refreshments are available on site at Eisenbach sports field. All participants receive a finisher sausage or a meat-free alternative. Timing is provided electronically by RaceR. A German Red Cross vehicle is stationed in the finish area. The event is officially registered with the Limburg-Weilburg Athletics District and the Hessian Athletics Association. The event is organized by volunteers and emphasizes runners’ autonomy through GPS-assisted navigation. It is recommended to plan overnight stays in the region.

name: Nottulner Stiftslauf - SV DJK GW Nottuln
3. Schluchthof Backyard Ultra
description: The 3rd Schluchthof Backyard Ultra takes place in Kleinostheim on the Main, near Aschaffenburg. This thoughtfully organized, privately run Backyard Ultra is not a mass event, but a race among like-minded people with a special focus on atmosphere. The small number of participants means every lap is run together, and the line between runners and spectators is fluid. The race tests endurance hour after hour, until only one runner remains. The event takes place in summer in a green corner between the Rhine-Main region and the Spessart, offering a distinctive setting for a unique running experience.
course_highlights: A small, distinctive running setting at Schluchthof in Kleinostheim
Every lap is run together, with a fluid transition between participants and spectators
A summer race in the green region between the Rhine-Main area and the Spessart
additional: The race is deliberately kept small to create a family atmosphere. It is a Backyard Ultra where every lap is run together until only one participant remains.

name: 41. Volkslauf in Baunatal
description: The 41st Baunatal Fun Run is a mass-participation sporting event with the motto “Baunatal Runs,” open to everyone regardless of club membership. The running routes are mostly on paved paths and largely through wooded areas. The 5 km route is an out-and-back course, while the shorter races, from 200 m to 1,000 m, take place in Parkstadion. The event is part of the Nordhessencup, a popular running series in the region.

name: Hennigsdorfer Feuerwehr- und Bahnenlauf
description: The Hennigsdorf Fire Service and Railways Run is a sporting event in Hennigsdorf, held annually in June at the OSZ sports ground. A range of races from 400 m to 5 km, including a fun run, children’s race, Nordic walking and a HandiCap race, offers suitable competitions for all ages and ability levels. The event is organised by the Stahl track and field athletes and also attracts runners from the volunteer fire service and the Berlin Fire Service. Entertainment and refreshments are provided, along with a children’s obstacle course, emergency vehicles, medical cover by the DLRG and an information stand.
course_highlights: Various distances from 400 m to 5 km
Start and finish at the OSZ sports ground in Hennigsdorf
Participation by fire service runners and a varied supporting programme
additional: Medals and certificates for all finishers. Event hours: approximately 8:30 to 14:30. Supporting programme with a children’s obstacle course, fire service emergency vehicles and medical cover by the DLRG. Refreshments for participants, volunteers and spectators.

name: Suderburger Abendlauf
description: The Suderburg Evening Run is a recreational sporting event for the whole family, held annually in June in Suderburg since 2022. The races run through the heathland and surrounding forests of the Lüneburg Heath on sandy, all-weather forest and farm tracks. In addition to traditional individual races, there is also a 3 x 1.9 km relay. The start and finish are at the sports ground on Tannrähm, and the event is attracting growing numbers of participants.

name: Tiergartenlauf 2026
description: The Tiergartenlauf Velen is a family-friendly community race taking place for the 18th time. With a total of 11 races, it offers distances for all age groups and fitness levels, from the mini marathon and school races to the 5 km, 10 km and half marathon, as well as Nordic walking. A special highlight is the relay race for families, friends and colleagues, in which four people run 1,400 m each in succession. The event takes place at Gesamtschule Velen and offers an extensive supporting program with refreshments, music and showers. Proceeds will be donated to charitable organizations.

name: Fuffy Twister - From Dusk Till Dawn
description: The Fuffy Twister - From Dusk Till Dawn is a 50 km trail ultra in Langenhagen, Germany. It starts at night and has an 8-hour time limit. The race takes place in June and features straightforward organization, a low entry fee, an on-site finisher medal, and results and certificates published online. The small field makes it a more local and challenging test of endurance. The route runs along the northern edge of Hanover, near Hanover Airport, through the Bissendorfer Moor and Kananoher Forst, over varied terrain with moderate elevation gain.

name: AlbChallenge 2026 der Jubiläumsrun
description: The Alb Challenge 2026 is a varied obstacle race held as part of the 100th anniversary celebrations of the Bad Herrenalb Ski Club. The course runs across Schweizerwiese and features various obstacles designed to encourage fun, challenge, and team spirit. Participants aged 16 and over can enter individually or in teams of two or four. Alongside the sporting challenge, there is a team category with an evening at a mountain hut as the prize, as well as an award for the best costume.

name: Babenberger Volkslauf
description: The Babenberger Volkslauf is a family-friendly scenic run that has been held on the Saturday of the Kirchweih festival at St. Urban in Bamberg since 1999. The event offers running enthusiasts a wonderful opportunity to meet in a friendly atmosphere and run together for a good cause. The start and finish are at St. Urban Church, and the event supports social projects in the district each year. The organizers look forward to welcoming many participants and putting on a successful event.

name: Binner Abendlauf
description: The Binner Evening Run is a long-standing running event held as part of the sports festival of Sport- und Jugendbund Binnen e.V. The run offers a sporting challenge in a friendly, family atmosphere in Binnen. The event attracts runners of all ages and is a fixture on the regional sports calendar. Alongside the run, there is a varied sports festival with other activities and offerings for the whole family.

name: FORT FUN Westernlauf
description: The FORT FUN Western Run is a popular running event at FORT FUN Abenteuerland amusement park in Bestwig-Wasserfall. On the park grounds and in the surrounding forests, families and runners of all ages can choose from a total of 12 different races. The event is especially family-friendly and offers wonderful views, as well as the chance to enjoy the amusement park’s attractions afterward. The event is held in collaboration with TuS Valmetal and is ideal for active children, young people, and families.

name: Freundschaftslauf LT Rennschnecke Dudweiler
description: The friendship run organized by the “Rennschnecke” Dudweiler e.V. running club takes place in Dudweiler City Forest around Gehlenberg. The event offers an opportunity to enjoy recreational sport in a friendly atmosphere and is open to runners of all ability levels. Food and drinks will be available. The three groups with the highest participation will also receive awards, highlighting the event’s community spirit.

name: GVG Horremer Abendlauf
description: The GVG Horremer Abendlauf is a running event organized by SCB Horrem and Aktion Horrem, held in accordance with the guidelines of the German Athletics Association (DLV). Various races are offered, including children’s races over 400 m, 800 m and 1,200 m, as well as longer distances of 5 km and 10 km. The event emphasizes recreational sport and fun, with rankings and awards for various age groups and overall categories. Race materials are distributed on the day of the event, and refreshments, changing and shower facilities, and free massages are available for runners.
course_highlights: 5 km course, covered twice during the 10 km race
Children’s races with laps of 400 m, 800 m and 1,200 m
Event held in accordance with the guidelines of the German Athletics Association (DLV)
additional: Race materials are available on the day of the event from 2 p.m. at Friedrich-Ebert-Platz (Horremer Marktplatz). Refreshments available on site. Changing and shower facilities at the Horremer Halle. Free massages provided by the Physiotherapy Training Institute in Kerpen-Horrem. Timing by disposable transponder. A preferred race number is available for an additional fee with advance registration. Participation is also possible with walking poles, walking aids, a rollator or a wheelchair.

name: Hofmann-Flechtkulturlauf-Obermain
description: The Hofmann-Flechtkulturlauf Obermain (FKLO) is a large-scale fun run in Lichtenfels, taking place for the 14th time. The event offers a variety of running and Nordic walking routes along the flat “Path of Basketry Culture” and welcomes both recreational and ambitious runners without a strong focus on performance. The Lichtenfels Wine Festival takes place alongside the race, making the day a sporting and sociable community event. Highlights include the Blue Light Championship for emergency services and competitions for company managers and teams on the 10.4 km course.

name: Hüttlinger Muffigellauf
description: The Hüttlingen Muffigelläufe offer a varied running and movement experience for all ages and ability levels. From the Bambini run for the youngest participants to children’s, school-age and youth races, as well as more challenging routes such as the 10 km run at Kocherknie and the 7 km run at the Limes, there is something for everyone. The Walk around the Limes also invites participants to take part at a relaxed pace. The event is organized by the dedicated running group of TSV Hüttlingen and places great emphasis on fun, community and unforgettable moments.

name: km Staffellauf-100 jahre TSV Brokstedt
description: The 100 km relay race celebrating the 100th anniversary of TSV Brokstedt is a special running event in which teams of young people and adults complete 50 laps in pairs to cover the total distance of 100 km. Children aged 13 and under can take part in a shorter version of 25 laps over 50 km. The event promotes team spirit and endurance and takes place at the sports ground in Brokstedt. Participation is limited to a maximum of 100 teams, and mixed teams with at least two women are encouraged.
course_highlights: Relay race with teams running in pairs
50 laps for 100 km (adults/young people); 25 laps for 50 km (children)
Event at the sports ground in Brokstedt
additional: Registration is by email to staffellauf@tsvbrokstedt.de. Please include the team captain and the expected number of runners. Withdrawal of the entire team is not possible.

name: Never Give Up Hindernislauf
description: The Never Give Up Obstacle Run 2026 takes place on June 20 in Heinum near Gronau and offers a unique running experience for the whole family. Adults can take on a challenging main course of approx. 12 km with more than 30 varied obstacles along idyllic forest and field paths on the edge of the Sieben Berge hills. There is also a 5 km run with more than 25 obstacles for children and adults, as well as a Kids Run for ages 4 and up, covering approx. 2 km and packed with exciting obstacles. Fun, team spirit and crossing the finish line together are the focus, alongside professional timing, medals for all finishers and refreshments in the finish area.

name: Referees Run
description: The Referees Run is a 10-kilometer race held annually in Borgholzhausen since 2005 as part of the “Nacht von Borgholzhausen” fun run. The Gelsenkirchen Referees’ Association traditionally forms one of the largest groups at the race. The event promotes camaraderie among referees through sport and offers an athletic challenge in a friendly atmosphere. The race takes place and is managed by Stefan Tendyck.

name: Saucony Berlin 10K
description: The Saucony BLN 10K is a spectacular new race at Berlin’s historic Tempelhofer Feld. The event combines fast-paced urban running with a unique atmosphere at one of the city’s most historic sites. The start and finish are in the heritage-listed Hangar 6, alongside a cool-down zone with DJs, drinks, and street food. The course consists of two fast 5-kilometer laps, passing historic aircraft and running through the hangar, for an unforgettable experience combining urban lifestyle and music.

name: Sommerlauf Waren(Müritz) (LC/NLC)
description: The 4th Summer Run Waren (Müritz) is a running event organized by the SV Waren 09 e.V. running team. The race takes place at Müritzstadion in Waren (Müritz) and is open to children, young people, active runners and Masters. The event offers runners of all ages a sporting opportunity in beautiful surroundings. Registration is through the tollense-timing.de platform.

name: Stuifenläufe
description: The Stuifenläufe in Wißgoldingen is a traditional running event being held for the 74th time. The event includes various races, including races for schoolchildren, a kindergarten run, the Stuifen circuit, a mountain run, and Nordic walking. The routes cross varied terrain, with forest roads and a challenging steep climb to the summit. The races are suitable for runners of all ages and ability levels, offering a lovely combination of experiencing nature and sporting challenge.

name: Zeutschel-Spitzberglauf
description: The Zeutschel-Spitzberglauf is a scenic race around Tübingen, featuring varied forest trails and panoramic routes along the vineyard slopes near Wurmlinger Chapel. The race takes place as part of Hirschau Sports Weekend and offers various distances for main-race runners, recreational runners, Nordic walkers, and children and youth. The event is part of the VR-Cup and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and attractive supporting program.

name: 54 Memoriał Żylewicza - Bieg Amatorów
description: The 54th Józef Żylewicz Memorial is a prestigious athletics meet organized annually since 1973 by the LECHIA Gdańsk Athletics Club. The event commemorates Józef Żylewicz, an outstanding coach and sports official, one of the founders of KS LECHIA Gdańsk and a contributor to the Polish national athletics team’s successes. The Memorial takes place at the Athletics and Rugby Stadium in Gdańsk and combines sporting professionalism with a welcoming atmosphere for the local community, attracting athletes from Poland and abroad. The event also includes the amateur 3,000 m race “Fast Arrow of the North,” open to all running enthusiasts, with no age limits or athletic requirements.

name: Drabina Wałbrzyska
description: The Wałbrzych Ladder is a physically demanding mountain route in the Sudetes, passing through the Wałbrzych and Kamienne Mountains. Over a distance of approximately 78 km, participants climb nearly 4,000 metres of elevation gain and summit more than 30 peaks. The route forms a loop, and the start and finish can be at any point along the course. It is an excellent choice for anyone wishing to discover the scenic and natural attractions of this part of the Sudetes, offering an ambitious challenge without having to travel to high mountains.

name: I Nocny Półmaraton Piaseczyńśki
description: The Piaseczno Night Half Marathon is a unique 21.0975 km road race held at night along the scenic, illuminated streets of Piaseczno and nearby towns. The course is certified by the PZLA, flat and fast, making it ideal for runners looking to improve their personal bests. Participants can expect professional organization, comprehensive medical coverage and well-stocked refreshment stations. Every finisher receives a commemorative medal, and a recovery area with drinks and a meal awaits at the finish. The event also offers an unforgettable atmosphere of running beneath the stars, with plenty of attractions and competitions for spectators.
course_highlights: PZLA-certified course, 21.0975 km long
Flat, fast course with minimal elevation changes
The course passes through Piaseczno, Górki Szymona, Głosków and Jazgarzew
additional: Race packs can be collected from 15–19 June at Decathlon Piaseczno and on 20 June at the Race Office. The half marathon is limited to 2,000 participants. The time limit for completing the half marathon is 3 hours gun time, with a 1.5-hour limit at the halfway point. There are three refreshment stations along the course (at approximately 5, 10 and 15 km). After the race, a finish area will offer water, isotonic drinks, a recovery meal, music and an LED screen. A competition will be held for the best spectator area. Race-pack transfers are available until 31.05.2027 for a fee of 20 PLN. A commemorative T-shirt is available separately for 75 PLN (orders accepted until 29.05.2027).

name: XII BIEG WIERCHAMI

late_fee.price: wg stawki obowiązującej w dniu dokonania wpłaty
wg stawki obowiązującej w dniu dokonania wpłaty

description: Bieg Wierchami is a mountain challenge held in the Beskid Sądecki, offering a range of distances from 11 km to 100 km. The routes follow scenic trails with substantial elevation gain, giving runners a chance to connect with nature and tackle demanding climbs. The event is organized by the Visegrad Maraton Association in Rytro, which ensures professional organization and a generous race pack. Starts take place at the RyterSKI Resort, and participants can expect aid stations and beautiful scenery.
course_highlights: Corno Owca: 11 km with approximately +394 m/-393 m elevation change
Waligóra: 30 km with approximately +1124 m/-1124 m elevation change, including a climb up Wielki Rogacz and the route’s highest point, Radziejowa
The routes pass through the Beskid Sądecki, taking in landmarks such as a windmill and the Rytro bunker
additional: A race pack is provided to participants who register and pay before the deadline. The race office is located at the RyterSKI Resort. Aid stations are available on the routes, and the finish is by an asphalt road after passing landmarks such as the windmill and bunker.

name: 16. PKO Rybnicki Półmaraton Księżycowy
description: The Rybnik Moonlight Half Marathon is an annual running event organized by MOSiR Rybnik, attracting runners from various regions. The race takes place in the picturesque city of Rybnik, offering participants a unique atmosphere and sporting excitement. It is an event with a well-established tradition that promotes an active lifestyle and brings the local community together.

name: Mistrzostwa Gminy Kąty Wrocławskie w Biegach Przełajowych. Bieg 4: Kąty Wrocławskie
location: Kąty Wrocławskie, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Kąty Wrocławskie Municipality Cross-Country Running Championships are a series of four races held on scenic routes in the Kąty Wrocławskie municipality. The routes impress with their varied terrain and the natural beauty of the Bystrzyca Valley Landscape Park. Participants can enter individual races or the entire series. Those who complete at least three races are included in the overall standings. After each race, participants receive a commemorative medal; once all four medals have been collected, they form a complete design featuring the outline of the municipality’s boundaries. The final race takes place in Kąty Wrocławskie on a 5 km course.
course_highlights: Routes pass through the Bystrzyca Valley Landscape Park
Varied surfaces and terrain, including hills, vineyards and forests
The final 5 km route runs between Kąty Wrocławskie, Jurczyce and Sośnica
additional: Participants can enter individual races or the entire series. To be included in the overall standings, runners must complete at least 3 of the 4 races. OPEN categories for women and men, as well as team standings (minimum 3 runners). Trophies are awarded at a formal ceremony at the end of the series.

name: ULTRA TURNICKI
description: Ultra Turnicki is a unique running festival held in the scenic region of the Przemyśl Foothills and the Sanok-Turka Mountains. The event offers both winter and summer races over various distances, combining sporting competition with a rich cultural and festival program. The routes pass through distinctive landscapes, and participants can count on well-stocked aid stations and opportunities to connect with the local community. The start and finish are in Huwniki, offering easy access and attractive accommodation options.
course_highlights: Routes pass through the Przemyśl Foothills and the Sanok-Turka Mountains
The summer race takes place during the Wianki festival, featuring workshops and concerts
The winter race offers views from the Żytnia Pass and has two aid stations along the route
additional: The summer race offers four distances: 10 km, 24 km, 48 km, and 75 km, with transport to the start and a rich festival program. The winter race has two distances: 15 km and 36 km, with transport to the start and aid stations along the route. After the races, there are social gatherings, talks, and an awards ceremony. Accommodation is available at agritourism farms, and camping is possible during the summer season. Public transport is available, and Huwniki can be reached by motorway and train.

name: Wieczorna Piątka
description: Wieczorna Piątka is a 5,000-meter race held on the tartan track at the Municipal Stadium in Maków Mazowiecki. The race is scheduled for 6:00 PM and will be divided into heats based on participants’ predicted times. It is organized by Lekkoatletyczny Klub Sportowy Maków Mazowiecki, with a limit of 200 participants. The race is open to people over 15 years of age; minors must provide written consent from a guardian.
course_highlights: 5,000 m on the stadium’s tartan track
One lap is 400 m
Heats are based on predicted race times
additional: The limit is 200 race packages. Payments can be made online through the Przelewy24 platform or by bank transfer to the club’s account. The detailed schedule, including the heats, will be published on the website during the week before the race.

name: 15 Górski Półmaraton Pętli Tatrzańskiej
description: The Górski Półmaraton Pętli Tatrzańskiej is a mountain race held in Koszalin on a course around Góra Chełmska. Participants can choose between 10.55 km (quarter marathon) and 21.1 km (half marathon), which consists of two loops. The start and finish are at plac Gościńcowy near the summit of Góra Chełmska, and the course runs through scenic forest areas with views. The race is organized by the Stowarzyszenie Sport, rekreacja i wolontariat „SFX” and is recreational and sporting in nature, promoting an active lifestyle and forest tourism.
course_highlights: Mountain course around Góra Chełmska, reaching an elevation of 136.2 m above sea level
Two distances to choose from: 10.55 km (one loop) and 21.1 km (two loops)
Start and finish at plac Gościńcowy, between the sanctuary and the observation tower
additional: The race office is open from 9:00 to 10:30. The ceremonial start is from the square between the sanctuary and the observation tower. Awards will be presented at around 14:30. The course is well marked and measured. Participants can choose their distance during the race. Donations toward the statutory objectives of the SFX Association are required to participate and are non-refundable and non-transferable.

name: 43 Strzeliński Rogaining
location: Kamiennik, Strzelin County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Strzeliński Rogaining is an orienteering event on foot in which teams of 2–5 plan their own route to visit as many checkpoints as possible within a set time. The checkpoints are spread across the terrain and marked on the map. The event is open to participants of all ages and experience levels, from enthusiasts to those taking part recreationally. Rogaining combines tourism and sport and is an excellent way to enjoy outdoor activity and take a break from everyday life. Organized by the Polish Tourist and Sightseeing Society, Strzelin Land Branch, it has a long tradition and attracts international interest.
course_highlights: Teams choose their own route and can select checkpoints of varying difficulty
Checkpoints are spread across the terrain, shown on the map and marked on the ground with navigation flags
Distances range from a few to several dozen kilometres, and the route can be changed during the event
additional: Teams travel only on foot, using a map and compass to navigate. The event is open to everyone, regardless of age or gender. Participants can plan their own route of any length, from around 5 km to as much as 70 km, and change it while on the course. The event combines tourism and sport and is also suitable for families and people who take part in sport recreationally.

name: Bieg Dwie Wieże
description: Bieg Dwie Wieże is a race of approximately 15 km held in Kopalino. The course follows a dirt road, the beach, and a sidewalk, offering varied terrain and scenic views. The time limit is 2.5 hours, and participation is limited to 250 people. Runners receive a timing chip and a race bib. Water stations are available along the course, and a recovery meal is provided at the finish. The event has professional medical coverage and is photographed.
course_highlights: Approximately 15 km course
Race along a dirt road, the beach, and a sidewalk
Water stations at 4, 8, and 12 km, and at the finish
additional: Race office hours: 19.06, 13:00–19:00, and 20.06, 8:00–9:45 (verification closes at 9:45). Identity verification is mandatory (ID card/student ID). The timing chip is mandatory, collected at the race office and returned at the finish. Water and a recovery meal are available at the finish. Medical coverage is provided. Participation constitutes consent to the use of one’s image. Runners are asked to follow event rules and road traffic regulations.

name: Challenge Poland
description: Challenge Poland is a prestigious triathlon held in Gdańsk, offering a range of distances, including the popular T100 distance. The event takes place on the Baltic Sea, with a fast, flat cycling course and a scenic run along the beach and through Ronald Reagan Park. The start and finish are on the beautiful pier in Gdańsk, making it a unique attraction for athletes and spectators. The event is an official qualifier and is highly regarded by triathletes around the world.
course_highlights: 2.0 km swim at the city beach by Brzeźno Pier
80 km flat and fast cycling course through the Vistula Żuławy
18 km run along Gdańsk Beach and through Ronald Reagan Park, finishing with a scenic stretch on the pier
additional: Option to purchase registration cancellation coverage until 31 May 2027. Special discounts for teams of 10 or more. The cycling course passes, among other places, by Polsat Plus Arena stadium. Races are held in several categories and distances, including solo and relay. The race office and expo are located at Brzeźno Beach. Awards ceremonies take place on the pier in Gdańsk.

name: VI Bieg Świętojański
description: The VI Świętojański Run is a 10 km race held in picturesque Zawichost, in the Świętokrzyskie Voivodeship. Runners can choose training plans tailored to different experience levels to help them prepare optimally for race day. The event is a great opportunity to test your fitness on a moderately challenging asphalt course. The organizers provide expert support and the option to manage race information through an online platform.
course_highlights: 10 km distance on an asphalt course
Moderately challenging course
Picturesque location in Zawichost
additional: Training plans of 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level. Expert support is provided, along with the option to use a platform to manage the race listing and marketing collaborations.

name: VIII Nocny Bieg
description: The 8th Open Academic Championships of Łomża in night road running is an annual event organized by Łomża Academy and the AZS University Club of Łomża Academy. The race takes place on the streets of Łomża and aims to commemorate the founding of the Academy and promote physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km distances, with the 10 km course certified by PZLA. The race starts in the evening, giving it a distinctive nighttime character.
course_highlights: 10 km course certified by PZLA
Road race through Łomża
Time limit: 1.5 hours from the start
additional: Participant limit: 100 runners for the 5 km and 100 for the 10 km, plus an organizer’s allocation. Runner check-in at the Race Office on the day of the event from 19:00 to 20:45. Runners must complete the entire declared distance on asphalt; taking a shortcut results in disqualification. Distance changes are possible on the day of the event at the timing tent.

name: XII Półmaraton Wierchami
description: The XII Półmaraton Wierchami is a mountain race held in the picturesque Beskid Sądecki, near Rytro. The route follows demanding mountain trails with beautiful views and significant elevation gain, making it a real challenge for mountain runners. The event is organized by the Visegrad Maraton Association and attracts fans of ultra-running as well as shorter distances. Participants can choose from several routes of varying lengths and difficulty levels.
course_highlights: Mountain route with significant elevation changes (e.g. +1124 m / -1124 m over 30 km)
Route through the Beskid Sądecki with aid stations along the way
Views of peaks such as Wielki Rogacz and Radziejowa
additional: Races start at the Ryterski Resort. The 11 km Corno Owca starts at 12:00, and the 30 km Waligóra starts at 9:00. The routes follow marked mountain trails with aid stations. A race pack is provided to participants who register and pay by a specified deadline. Payment is available via DotPay or at the race office.

name: XIX Bieg O Błękitną Wstęgę
description: The 19th International Run for the Blue Ribbon is an annual event organized by the Stargard Athletics Club, which has been promoting health, fitness, and positive energy for 19 years. The main race takes place at night, giving it a unique atmosphere, and the route runs through the streets of Stargard, allowing participants to admire the city’s most beautiful historic landmarks in the moonlight. It’s an excellent opportunity to spend time actively and build physical and mental endurance. The organizers invite both amateurs and experienced athletes to celebrate exercise and a healthy lifestyle together.
course_highlights: An atmospheric night run at 9:00 p.m.
The route starts at the Amphitheatre and runs around the Jewel of Pomerania
Views of Stargard’s most beautiful historic landmarks in the moonlight
additional: The race takes place at night, creating a unique atmosphere. The route is designed to let participants admire Stargard’s historic landmarks. The organizers encourage participants to build physical and mental endurance before the race. The event is international and organized by the Stargard Athletics Club.

name: Wrocławska Dycha
description: Wrocławska Dycha is an annual running event held in Wrocław, offering 5 km and 10 km distances. The race attracts both amateur and more experienced runners, providing a sporting atmosphere and the opportunity to compete on the city’s scenic routes. The event is a great way to spend time actively and bring Wrocław’s running community together.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km routes in central Wrocław
Scenic urban views
A welcoming atmosphere for runners of all experience levels

name: X Bieg Pamięci Powstań Śląskich
location: Góra Świętej Anny, Leśnica, Opole Voivodeship, Poland

name: Beh Ludrovskou dolinou
organizer: Obec Ludrová, OŠK Ludrová, Ružomberskie Strely o.z.
description: The Run Through Ludrovská Valley is a running event held in Ludrovská Valley near the football stadium in Ludrová. The races offer starts for children’s categories on grass and adult categories on forest trails and asphalt. The event is suitable for a wide range of ages, from children to seniors, with categories divided by age. The organizers are the Municipality of Ludrová, OŠK Ludrová, and Ružomberskie Strely o.z., who ensure a welcoming atmosphere and quality organization.

name: Prešov Running Series 2. kolo
description: The 2nd round of the Prešov Running Series, known as Šariš Run, is a running event held on the banks of the ponds in Veľký Šariš, beneath the historic Šariš Castle. This venue is new to the series and has become very popular with runners. The event is full of sporting spirit, community, and a love of nature, and also offers a rich program of activities, including musical performances, health booths, a relaxation zone, and activities for children. The friendly, family atmosphere makes the run an unforgettable experience for all participants.

name: Beh cez Zalužické poľa
location: Zalužice, okr. Michalovce, Zalužice, okr. Michalovce,
description: Run through the Zalužice Fields is the second edition of a running event held in the Zalužice area. This race gives runners the opportunity to experience the nature and beauty of Zemplín in summer. The event is part of the Zemplín Extreme series, which offers a range of running challenges in the region.

name: toRunská vrtuľa
location: Stará Turá, Stará Turá, ATC Dubník (KEMP53 - reštaurácia)
organizer: Zuzana Jankovičová, Lívia Skurská, Monika Tomisová
description: toRunská vrtuľa is a charity running and community day in the beautiful surroundings of the Dubník Reservoir in Stará Turá. The event focuses on exercise and helping others, with all proceeds from entry fees donated to fund rehabilitation for Simonka Zigová. Running pairs have 8 hours to complete as many laps around Dubník as possible, in a friendly and supportive atmosphere. The organizers and volunteers run the event without compensation, emphasizing its community and charitable spirit.

name: Ruskovská deviatka
location: Športový areál, Nový Ruskov, Trebišov District, Slovakia
description: Ruskovská 9ka is a running race held at the sports complex in the village of Nový Ruskov. This traditional event gives runners the opportunity to test themselves on a course approximately 9 kilometres long. The race is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle in the pleasant setting of the village.
course_highlights: The course runs through the sports complex in the village of Nový Ruskov
The course is approximately 9 kilometres long
The race is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners

name: Tatry charity run
location: Tatranská Lomnica, Tatranská Lomnica, Relax Park Jazierko
organizer: Športová Nadácia Kotrmelec, mesto Vysoké Tatry, TANAP
description: Tatry Charity Run is a running event held in Tatranská Lomnica at Relax Park Jazierko. The course is mainly on asphalt and hard-packed terrain, ensuring a comfortable run for all participants. The race is open to the general public and offers categories for men and women in different age groups. It is organized by the Kotrmelec Sports Foundation, the town of Vysoké Tatry, and TANAP, who ensure the event runs smoothly. Online registration is available, with a limit of 300 runners. On-site registration is also available on race day.

name: Beh k Iliašovskej kapličke
description: The Run to the Chapel of Iliašovce is a running event held in Iliašovce at the FK56 football pitch. The race offers two main routes, 5.6 km and 10.8 km long, which run mainly along farm and forest roads. The main category starts at 10:00, and the children’s race starts at 13:00. The event is suitable for runners of a wide range of ages, including children, and offers a pleasant atmosphere in nature.

name: Doby vežu – extrémny prekážkový beh a trail
location: Brezno, Brezno, Lidl Brezno, Československej Armády 2612/68
description: Doby vežu is an extreme obstacle race and trail run held in Brezno, Slovakia. Racers must tackle challenging obstacles and complete a course leading to the top of Slovakia’s second-highest observation tower, which stands 40 metres tall and offers beautiful views. The course runs mainly along forest paths, meadows and a stream, with very little asphalt, and includes steep climbs and descents. In addition to the sporting experience, a fun program of activities is planned for all age groups. The organizer is M.Š.K Jašterice Brezno o.z., and the race director is Marek Janoštiak.

name: Běhej lesy Týmovka - týmový závod
description: Běhej lesy Týmovka je unikátní týmový štafetový běžecký závod konaný v srdci Vysočiny, který nabízí dobrodružství pro týmy o 4 až 8 běžcích. Závod se skládá ze tří různých okruhů o celkové délce přibližně 27,5 km, které musí každý závodník během víkendu absolvovat. Závod probíhá i v nočních hodinách s čelovkami, což přidává na výjimečnosti a náročnosti. Kromě závodu je připraven bohatý doprovodný program včetně sportovních aktivit, kulturních akcí a workshopů, a zázemí nabízí komfortní kemp s hygienickým vybavením a občerstvením.

name: Velichovská sedmička
description: Velichovská sedmička je přátelský rodinný běžecký závod konaný v obci Velichovky, který nabízí hlavní trať dlouhou 7 km vedoucí po lesních cestách a místních komunikacích. Závod je určen pro všechny věkové kategorie, včetně dětí, a podporuje aktivní trávení volného času v přírodě. Akce je součástí série Primátor Cup a je ideální pro sportovní nadšence i rodiny hledající společnou sportovní aktivitu. Závod se koná poslední červnovou sobotu, s možností zúčastnit se i dalších kratších tras a dětských kategorií.

name: ČEZ RunTour Plzeň
description: ČEZ RunTour Plzeň je rodinný běžecký závod s atmosférou radosti a pohody, vhodný jak pro hobíky, tak pro elitní běžce. Nabízí různé tratě od dětských běhů přes 3, 5, 10 km až po půlmaraton. Závod se koná v centru města Plzně a je součástí série závodů po celé České republice. Účastníci si užijí nejen běh, ale i doprovodný program pro celou rodinu a kvalitní servis od startu až do cíle.

name: Dobratický běh
description: Dobratický běh je tradiční běžecký závod v malebné obci Dobratice, který přitahuje sportovní nadšence všech věkových kategorií. Závod nabízí krásné trasy vedoucí přírodou a malebným prostředím, vhodné jak pro zkušené běžce, tak pro rodiny s dětmi. Akce je známá svou přátelskou atmosférou, tematickými kategoriemi a hodnotnými cenami pro vítěze i účastníky. Každý ročník přináší nové téma, které dodává závodu jedinečnou atmosféru a radost z pohybu.

name: Hamelika třikrát jinak
description: Hamelika třikrát jinak je běžecký závod pořádaný agenturou Pro Sport Activities v lokalitě Hamelika u Mariánských Lázní. Závod je součástí seriálu Rozhledny v pohybu a Běžeckého poháru Plzeňska, který nabízí sportovní zážitek pro širokou veřejnost. Akce je vhodná pro běžce všech věkových kategorií a úrovní, přičemž klade důraz na příjemné prostředí a sportovní atmosféru. Pro Sport Activities má dlouholetou tradici v pořádání běžeckých závodů a těší se na účastníky i v roce 2026.

name: Sunrise Marathon / Halfmaraton
description: Sunrise Marathon a Halfmarathon se konají v Olympii Brno, Modřice. Závod startuje brzy ráno v 4:46, aby běžci mohli zažít magickou atmosféru východu slunce během běhu. Trať je rovinatá a sestává z pěti stejně dlouhých okruhů, které vedou částečně v přírodě a částečně v zastíněných úsecích. Organizátoři zajišťují elektronické měření času a podporu na klíčových místech trati. Závod je vhodný pro všechny běžce, kteří chtějí přivítat léto aktivně a zažít jedinečný zážitek z běhu za svítání.

name: Hradecký kros
description: Hradecký kros je tradiční 10 km trailový závod, který se koná v lesích kolem Biřičky v Hradci Králové. Závod nabízí jedinečný zážitek z přírodního terénu s méně asfaltovými úseky, vhodný pro širokou veřejnost i rekreační běžce. Akce je součástí Velké ceny východních Čech v bězích a každoročně přitahuje závodníky všech úrovní. Trať vede dvěma 5 km okruhy v mírně členitém terénu, což podtrhuje krásu a náročnost závodu.

name: Ivčin kopeček
description: Ivčin kopeček je závod do kopce dlouhý 3,4 km s převýšením 240 metrů, který je součástí seriálu Běhy do kopců v Praze a okolí. Tento závod nabízí běžcům náročnou, ale atraktivní trať v krásném přírodním prostředí Berouna ve Středočeském kraji. Je vhodný pro milovníky horského běhu a běhu do kopce, kteří chtějí otestovat svou vytrvalost a sílu na krátké, ale intenzivní trase. Závod je otevřen široké veřejnosti a vítá všechny běžce, kteří si chtějí užít sportovní výzvu v příjemné atmosféře.

name: Gorch-Fock-Lauf Wilhelmshaven
distance_verbose: Marathon, Halbmarathon, 10 km, 5 km, 1500 Meter, 0.6 km
description: The Gorch-Fock-Lauf in Wilhelmshaven takes place every year in June and offers distances for all age groups, including children’s races, 5 km, 10 km, half marathon and marathon. The course runs mostly along the coastline and the inner harbour, starting at Jade-Allee and finishing in Pumpwerk-Park. The course is measured by the DLV, ensuring fair competition. In addition to the sporting competition, there is also a club and school race with attractive prize money to promote youth sports in the region.
course_highlights: DLV-measured course with quality seal
Course along the coastline and inner harbour
Start at Jade-Allee, finish in Pumpwerk-Park
additional: Timing is provided by a chip integrated into the race number. There are several refreshment stations along the course. The club and school race offers prize money for the five clubs/schools with the most participants. Changes of registration can be made online via a self-service link; changes cannot be made on site. The event also includes a running service, club and school competitions, medals, shirts and prize money. Registration is online, with early-bird discounts available. The start is at Jade-Allee and the finish is in Pumpwerk-Park.

name: Mendener Citylauf mit Halbmarathon und Schülerläufen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 5 km 10 € (Team Meldung ab 6 Starter/-innen erhalten 25% Nachlass)

description: The 10th Menden City Run offers an exciting sporting event with fast courses through the city center of Menden. The event includes children’s races, a 5 km race, a 10 km race, and a half marathon. Several event points along the course add to the atmosphere, and participants are enthusiastically welcomed at the finish on Rathausplatz. The Marathon-Club Menden e.V. warmly invites runners of all generations to take part in this traditional race.
course_highlights: Fast courses through the city center of Menden
Several event points along the course add to the atmosphere
Finish on Rathausplatz with an enthusiastic welcome
additional: Entry fees for participants from Menden kindergartens and schools are covered by Mendener Bank eG or Stadtsportverband Menden when registration is submitted centrally through the respective school(s). Teams with 6 or more starters receive a 25% discount on the 5 km race. Online pre-registration is available with direct debit or PayPal. Race-day registration is available. Course in Menden, online registration, race-day registration, parking at Neumarkt

name: Apfellauf der Kelterei Heil
location: Kelterei Heil, Laubuseschbach, Weilmünster, Hessen, Germany
description: The Heil Cider Mill Apple Run takes place in the picturesque countryside around Weilmünster-Laubuseschbach. The route passes orchards, follows forest and field paths, crosses a closed state road, and returns along a cycle path to the start and finish area at the Heil Cider Mill premises. Two distances are offered: 5 km (one lap) and 10 km (two laps). The event is open to everyone, from competitive runners to recreational athletes, and also features a free children’s run for young runners up to age 9.
course_highlights: Route passes orchards and follows forest and field paths
Section on the closed state road L3063
Return along a cycle path to Laubuseschbach
additional: The 5 km race starts at 10:00, and the 10 km race at 10:15. A free children’s run for children up to and including age 9 takes place at 12:00. There is a team competition with special prizes for the largest group and the fastest women’s team. Teams must have at least 8 people, with at least 2 runners in each distance. Only the two fastest runners in each distance count toward the team result. Route passes orchards, forest and field paths, the closed state road L3063, and a cycle path; finisher shirt optional; team competition available.

name: Draisinenlauf Altenglan
description: The Draisinenlauf Altenglan is a half-marathon event featuring individual and relay competitions (2-person and 4-person relays). The course follows the Glan-Blies cycle path alongside the draisine route. It is officially measured, flat with only 45 metres of elevation gain, and almost entirely paved. The event takes place in all weather conditions and offers a unique atmosphere in the Kusel Musician’s Land, with draisines passing by. Safety is provided by the DLRG OG Altenglan and the DRK Kusel District Association. Medals are awarded to all finishers of the children’s and youth races, and prize money is awarded to the fastest half-marathon runners.
course_highlights: Officially measured, flat course with only 45 metres of elevation gain
Follows the Glan-Blies cycle path alongside the draisine route
Course is almost entirely paved
additional: Timing is carried out using disposable transponders issued with the race number. Race numbers must be worn visibly on the chest. There is no walking event. Half-marathon prize money: €150 for 1st place, €100 for 2nd place, and €50 for 3rd place. Special prizes for the clubs and schools with the most participants, as well as for the oldest participants. The event is approved by the DLV (5-year age-group scoring under the DLO). The course is flat, measured, and almost entirely paved; individual and relay starts; refreshments every 2.5 km; registration only via BR-Timing; race numbers with transponders; certificates for all finishers; travel by train is possible; refreshments and award ceremonies on site.

name: Globus-Theißen-Lauf
description: The Globus-Theißen Run is a community running event in Theißen, Saxony-Anhalt, taking place for the sixth time. It offers distances for all age groups, from the Bambini race through 1.5 km, 3 km and 7 km to 14 km. The event takes place at the Bergarbeiter Stadium and is part of the Rangliste-Burgenland for adults and the Wiesen-Grundcup for children and young people. Refreshments include a cake buffet, coffee and savoury food, and children’s entertainment is provided during the awards ceremony. The event is a joint project by Globus-Theissen, local clubs and residents.
course_highlights: Distances from 400 m (Bambini) to 14 km
Start and finish at the Bergarbeiter Stadium in Theißen
Course routes available as GPS tracks and PDFs
additional: Refreshments include homemade cakes and coffee as well as savoury food; proceeds support the clubs’ youth programmes; children’s entertainment during the awards ceremony; start and finish at the Bergarbeiter Stadium; ample parking nearby; certificates for children at the finish; the event is part of the Rangliste-Burgenland and the Wiesen-Grundcup. Courses for children, young people, women, men and seniors; virtual routes available; a community event of regional significance.

name: Hunsrück-Trail
description: The Hunsrück Trail is a running event in Hunsrück-Hochwald National Park, held in Mörschied. The event offers four distances from 3 km to 25 km, taking runners through the national park’s varied natural landscape. The races are suitable for different age and experience levels and offer a great opportunity to experience the scenery. The event is part of the ITRA National League and is known for its friendly atmosphere and good organization.
course_highlights: 25 km trail with 3 aid stations
Start and finish at the TuS Mörschied clubhouse
Automatic timing with reusable race bibs
additional: Race bibs can be collected on event day at the clubhouse. Food and drinks after the race, with coffee and cake for sale as well as food cooked over an open fire. No on-site late registrations are possible. Timing is automatic using race result; race bibs are reusable. GPX routes are available on event day. Trail run in a national park, advance registration only, limited number of participants, post-race refreshments

name: Letter Vituslauf 2026
location: Heimathaus Letter Deele, Beelener Straße, Oelde-Lette, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Letter Vituslauf is a traditional running event in Oelde-Lette, held on flat, paved and surfaced paths. The courses are measured and offer runners of all ages a fair and attractive race environment. The event is organized by VfB Germania Lette e.V. and Leichtathletikverein Oelde e.V. and takes place at the Heimathaus Letter Deele. Alongside the races, there is a family-friendly atmosphere, with awards and vouchers for the fastest runners and for children.
course_highlights: Flat course on asphalt and surfaced paths
Measured 5 km and 10 km courses
Start and finish at the Heimathaus Letter Deele, Oelde-Lette
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 12:30 p.m. at the race office at the Heimathaus. Changing and shower facilities are available at Norbertschule and the sports hall. Late entries are accepted until 30 minutes before the respective start. Results are classified according to DLO age-group categories. Certificates are awarded to the top three in each age group, as well as vouchers for the fastest runners and children.

name: Reinhardswaldwalking
location: VfL Veckerhagen, Reinhardshagen, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: VfL Veckerhagen 1897 e.V. warmly invites you to the 15th Reinhardswald Walking Day. Routes of 3 km, 6 km and 11 km are offered, passing through open countryside, along the edge of the forest and through the Reinhardswald. The start and finish are at VfL Veckerhagen’s Mittelpunkt sports facility. Refreshment stations are available along the way, and drinks, coffee, cake and bratwurst are offered at the finish. The three groups with the most participants will receive cash prizes.
course_highlights: Routes through open countryside, along the edge of the forest and through the Reinhardswald
Start and finish at VfL Veckerhagen’s Mittelpunkt sports facility
Refreshment stations along the way
additional: The three groups with the most participants will receive cash prizes. Participants are advised to bring the completed registration form to speed up registration on site. Participants can choose between 3 km, 6 km, 8 km and 11 km; the event promotes community and experiencing nature; refreshments and prizes are offered for the groups with the most participants.

name: Sachsenlauf Coswig
price_range: 2 € erste Stunde, danach 1,50 € (Parkgebühren im Parkhaus an der Moritzburger Straße)
description: The Sachsenlauf Coswig is a long-standing sporting event held annually in June since 1980. The races follow forest roads, woodland trails and field paths through the Friedewald and into the Moritzburg Hills. A special highlight on the 21.1 km route is running through the Moritzburg State Stud to the castle pond and Pferde-Hügel. In addition to running distances, walking and hiking options cater to different fitness levels and ambitions. The event is part of the Meißner Sparkassencup and the Niederlausitzcup, and also features dedicated races for children and Bambinis, with surprises at the finish.
course_highlights: Running routes on forest roads, woodland trails and field paths in the Friedewald and Moritzburg Hills
Route through the Moritzburg State Stud, past the castle pond and Pferde-Hügel (21.1 km route)
Hiking routes on the Karras circular trails, passing natural features such as Moselwiese and Seerosenteich
additional: Start and finish are at the corner of Friedewaldstraße and Sachsenlaufweg. Awards ceremonies take place in the schoolyard. Changing rooms and restroom facilities are available in the neighboring Spitzgrund sports hall. The course closes for all distances at 14:00. Paid parking is available in the Moritzburger Straße car park. Travel by public transport (VVO bus routes 400, 401 and 405) is recommended. Children and Bambinis have their own out-and-back races (500 m and 800 m) with small surprises at the finish. Race bibs include a single-use timing transponder. Late registrations are possible on race day until 10:00; payment on site is cash only. Course adjustment due to the state championships, parking in the car park, travel by bus and train recommended, refreshments and awards ceremonies in the finish area, children’s and hiking routes

name: Sonnwend-Freundschaftslauf
description: The 3rd Sonnwend Friendship Run in Völklingen offers runners a varied event with historic and modern courses. Participants can choose the traditional 10-mile course, as well as distances of 8 km and 10 km, or Nordic walking. The event is supported by experienced runners and takes place near the Hermann-Neuberger-Halle and the swimming pool. Lauftrefffreunde Köllertal look forward to welcoming many participants and enjoying a sporting event together.
course_highlights: Historic 10-mile course
Additional options: 8 km, 10 km and Nordic walking
Start and finish near the Hermann-Neuberger-Halle / Völklingen swimming pool
additional: Start times: 09:00 for the 10-mile course; 09:30 for 8 km, 10 km and Nordic walking. Running support provided by experienced runners. The event is part of a tradition that promotes community spirit and offers runners a chance to connect and celebrate the start of summer together.

name: Wallernhäuser Dorflauf
description: The Wallernhausen Village Run is a traditional village race in Nidda-Wallernhausen, Germany, starting at 9:00 a.m. on Sunday morning. The event offers two distances: a short 1.6 km run and a longer 10 km run. This makes it suitable for younger runners and beginners, as well as those looking for a classic longer distance. The course runs through the village of Wallernhausen and offers a friendly atmosphere away from large urban areas. Now in its 18th edition, the race is a popular local sporting event.
course_highlights: Run through the village of Wallernhausen
Two distances: 1.6 km and 10 km
Friendly village-run atmosphere
additional: Typical June weather, with an average temperature of 23 °C and mostly sunny days. The event takes place in June, with typical temperatures around 23°C and a low chance of precipitation. It is a local event focused on community and the enjoyment of running.

name: Benefizlauf Aachen
location: Waldstadion Aachen, Aachen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Benefizlauf Aachen is a long-standing running event held at Aachen Forest Stadium. The 24th edition offers various distances for all ages and ability levels, from ambitious runners to recreational runners. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, volunteer commitment and support for charitable organizations. Participants can look forward to a beautiful course in the stadium and a great atmosphere.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Aachen’s most beautiful stadium
A range of distances for young and old, fast and relaxed
A running event with a sunny atmosphere and a great vibe
additional: Registration is via my.race|result. The event is organized by volunteers, and helpers are wanted for course marshal points, refreshment stands, and setup and takedown. Training opportunities are available for members, including beginner running groups and regular training sessions in Aachen Forest. Various distances, registration via the website, charitable event

name: 10K Hamburg - Volkspark
description: The 10K Hamburg Volkspark is an exciting 10-kilometer race on fully closed and secured out-and-back routes along paved and asphalt paths. The race offers attractive sections in the Elbe metropolis of Hamburg and is open to runners of all abilities. The event is part of a cup series, where the fastest participants can win great prizes. Registration is online only, and an official registration confirmation is sent after registration closes.
course_highlights: Fully closed and secured out-and-back routes
Paved and asphalt paths
Attractive spots in the Elbe metropolis of Hamburg
additional: A bag-drop facility for personal belongings is available on the event day. Travel by public transport is recommended. The cup series covers all 10K Hamburg events, with points awarded to the 30 fastest men and women at each event. The course is officially measured in accordance with IWB and AIMS standards; finish times are valid for rankings.

name: Barsinghäuser Fuchsbau Spendenlauf
description: The Barsinghausen Fuchsbau Charity Run is a running event in support of the “FUCHSBAU” association, which provides bereavement support for children and young people. Since 2010, the association has supported young people facing the death of people close to them. The charity run was launched in 2024 to fund Fuchsbau’s important work, as the association has relied entirely on donations since 2023. The event promotes community and social engagement in Barsinghausen and will take place again in 2026.

name: Bestenseer Seenlauf
distance_verbose: Halbmarathon, 15 km, 12 km, 11.5 km, 10 km, 8 km, 7.2 km, 5 km
description: The Bestensee Lakes Run is a traditional race held annually in Bestensee since 2002. It offers three different distances of 2 km, 7.5 km, and 16 km, suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. The race starts at the Landkost Arena, surrounded by the region’s idyllic lakes and woodland. The event is open to all age groups, and children and young people up to age 13 can take part for free.

name: Buchholzer Stadtlauf
location: Buchholz in der Nordheide, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Buchholz City Run is a long-standing race with cult status in the Nordheide. The course runs right through downtown Buchholz and is cheered on by numerous spectators, creating a special atmosphere and providing motivation. A range of distances offers suitable challenges for all age and ability groups, from the children’s race to the popular team relay. There is also running training with certified coaches, and all participants receive special medals and certificates.

name: edge beyond x Duracher Lauf
description: The Duracher Lauf offers suitable distances for runners of all ages and ability levels: 5.5 km, 10 km, a Kids Run and a Schülerlauf. The event focuses on professional organisation, safety and an unforgettable atmosphere. In addition to the sporting competition, there is a large joint awards ceremony, prize money for new course records and a prize draw. Teams and clubs can also take part in special competitions and receive discounts.

name: Eichberglauf
organizer: Kultur- und Heimatverein ‚Rund um den Eichberg‘ e.V.
description: The Eichberglauf has been organized for almost 20 years by the “Rund um den Eichberg” Cultural and Heritage Association and offers summer runs for the whole family. The 19th race starts at the club’s depot at Am Heller. There are six different routes to choose from, mostly over unpaved terrain and through Planitz Forest. The event is suitable for all age groups, including special routes for children and wheelchair users. Participants receive certificates, and prizes are awarded to the top runners, along with team trophies.

name: Grafschafter Ahrtal-Lauf
description: The Grafschafter Ahrtal Run is a traditional running event jointly organized by the clubs SV Dernau, SV Hönningen/Ahr, and Grafschafter SV. The event offers various distances for all age groups, including 400 m and 1 km children’s races, 5 km and 10 km races, and a 5 km walking event. The start and finish are at the sports ground in Grafschaft-Vettelhoven, and the course follows field paths, some of which are gravel and paved. The event is part of the Ahrtal Team Cup race series and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with changing rooms and showers available on site.

name: KSC Schlossparklauf
description: The KSC Schlossparklauf is being held for the 28th time and will take place in summer for the first time. New this year is a partner race for companies. The event includes a main race, a youth and school race, and the partner race, with limited participant numbers. The course is a loop of about 3.25 km from BBBank Wildpark to the palace and back. The main race covers three laps, while the youth race covers one. The start and finish are at BBBank Wildpark.

name: Lamspringer Klosterlauf
description: The Lamspringe Monastery Run is an annual running and walking event starting and finishing at Lamspringe Forest Stadium. The event offers various distances for all age groups, including children’s races, and is part of the South Lower Saxony Cup. Runners, Nordic walkers, and hiking enthusiasts are warmly invited to enjoy the varied routes through the countryside around Lamspringe. The event combines sporting ambition with fun and a sense of community in beautiful surroundings.

name: Lauf in die Sonne
description: The Lauf in die Sonne takes place in 71397 Nellmersbach and is organized by Hot Socks Leutenbach e.V. There are two race distances, 10 km and 5.8 km, which start together at 08:00. The event offers an extensive breakfast buffet and awards trophies to the top runners. A challenge trophy is also awarded to the best team. The number of participants is limited to a maximum of 222 starters.

name: Meilenlauf beim WGV-Leichtathletik-Festival
description: The WGV Athletics Festival in Stuttgart offers a varied program centered on athletics. At its heart is the Straßen-Meile, a new running format in the middle of the city, open to everyone who loves running. The festival also features the KLEINformat! charity run, where every lap completed benefits a good cause, as well as an elite mile with top athletes and a children’s mile for the youngest participants. The festival brings together elite sport, recreational sport and social engagement in a unique event in the heart of Stuttgart.

name: Sababurger Tierparklauf
description: The Sababurg Zoo Run is a popular charity run held in the picturesque Sababurg Zoo and the adjoining Reinhardswald forest. The carefully selected routes pass through an unrivalled natural setting and are lined with enthusiastic spectators. The run is part of the Reinhardswald Running and Walking Cup series and this year supports the planned Amphibian World at the zoo. With a large number of participants and a family-friendly atmosphere, the run offers an unforgettable experience for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Route through Sababurg Zoo and the adjoining Reinhardswald forest
Unrivalled natural setting with enthusiastic spectators along the course
Part of the Reinhardswald Running and Walking Cup series
additional: The run supports the planned Amphibian World, a new nature education project at Sababurg Zoo that lets visitors explore and learn about aquatic habitats. The zoo run regularly attracts large numbers of participants and is a fixture of the regional running series.

name: Schlossinsellauf Lübben
description: The Schlossinsellauf Lübben is a traditional running event held on the idyllic Schlossinsel in the town of Lübben in the Spreewald. It offers races for children, teenagers, and adults, including Bambini races, children’s races, 5 km, 10 km, a half marathon, and a Run & Bike half marathon. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and varied course, which runs both on the Schlossinsel and through the surrounding Spreewald area. The race is part of the Spreewaldcup and attracts numerous runners every year.

name: Spessarthelden - Laufen gegen Gewalt
description: The Spessarthelden Run Against Violence is a charity run in Bad Soden-Salmünster, organized by Tuğçe Albayrak e.V. and the city. The event sends a strong message against violence and is supported by former German President Christian Wulff as its patron. There are various running distances suitable for all age groups, and the event promotes community and social engagement in the region.

name: Töpfermarktlauf Bürgel
description: The Töpfermarktlauf in Bürgel is a long-standing race that has been a sporting highlight in the Saale-Holzland district since the 1990s. The event offers various distances, including the challenging 12 km main race and the 6 km introductory race, which take runners through the varied landscape around Bürgel. All participants receive a handmade, ceramic medal as a memento. The event is family-friendly, with races for children and school students, and takes place on Sunday morning to make it possible for as many running enthusiasts as possible to take part.

name: Urberacher Kinderlauf
description: The ENTEGA Kindergarten Run at MTV Urberach is a thoughtfully organized run for kindergarten children in Rödermark. The run encourages enjoyment of movement and sports activities in a supportive environment. MTV Urberach e.V. places great importance on community, team spirit, and the all-round development of children. The event is part of the club’s diverse sports program and offers its youngest participants their first running experience.

name: Volksbank Überlingen RUN
