description: The Volksbank Überlingen RUN takes place on June 20 and 21, 2027, in the picturesque Überlingen lakeside park, right on the shore of Lake Constance. The event offers exciting competitions against a breathtaking backdrop, with views of Lake Constance and the Alps. The race is a popular sporting event in the region, combining an athletic challenge with an experience of nature.
course_highlights: Run along the shore of Lake Constance in Überlingen lakeside park
Breathtaking views of Lake Constance and the Alps
Atmospheric venue on the former state horticultural show grounds

name: Waiblinger Stadtlauf
description: The Waiblingen City Run is taking place, offering runners of various ages and ability levels the opportunity to take part in different races. The event is family-friendly and is accompanied by a varied entertainment program in Rathausplatz. The VfL Waiblingen athletics department will provide food and refreshments. By participating in the children’s or youth race, runners also support Tour Ginkgo, which helps seriously ill children and their families.

name: Perly Malopolski Wapienne Magura
location: Wapienne, Sękowa, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Perły Małopolski Wapienne - Magura is a mountain race in the area around Wapienne and Magura. Four distances are available: approximately 5, 10, 20 and 50 km, including an ultra route. The event welcomes both people taking their first steps in mountain running and experienced runners looking for a longer challenge.
course_highlights: Four distances: approximately 5, 10, 20 and 50 km.
The routes run through the area around Wapienne and Magura.
The longest distance is an ultra race of approximately 50 km.

name: Bieg Lotnej Kompanii Szturmowej
description: The 8th Lotna Assault Company Run in Haczów is an annual running event commemorating the Lotna Assault Company of Lieutenant Stanisław Maczek and the Haczów heroes who fought for Poland’s independence in 1918–1921. The event features routes of approximately 12 km and 5 km, as well as a 5 km Nordic walking event, mostly on asphalt and gravel roads in the Haczów municipality. The race promotes a healthy lifestyle, physical activity, and community integration. Free shorter races adapted to children’s ages are also organized.
course_highlights: Routes of approximately 12 km and 5 km, plus a 5 km Nordic walking event
Mostly asphalt and gravel roads in the Haczów municipality
One water refreshment point on the route
additional: The participant limit is 150. There is one water refreshment point on the route. Race headquarters and the event base are located in the Manor Park by the Municipal Cultural and Recreation Centre in Haczów, and at the LKS stadium in Haczów. Free children’s races are organized over distances of approximately 200 m to 1,000 m, depending on age category. The participant limit for the children’s races is 200. Adult entry fees are non-refundable. Race packs are distributed from 13:00 to 14:30.

name: Gryf Arena Run
description: Gryf Arena Run is an annual street race held in the town of Gryfice, attracting runners of different ages and abilities across various distances. The route runs through the town streets, offering participants a great atmosphere, sporting excitement, and positive energy. The event also includes races for children, making it a family-friendly and inclusive gathering. This is the ninth edition of the popular race, an important sporting event in the region.
course_highlights: The route runs through the streets of Gryfice
An atmosphere full of sporting excitement and positive energy
Children’s races are part of the program, making the event family-friendly

name: Klon Biega i Chodzi Dla Zdrowia
description: Klon Runs and Walks for Health is a local initiative organized by the Association for the Development of the Village of Klon and Surrounding Areas. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle among residents and supporters of the region. The run and walk take place in the picturesque surroundings of Klon, bringing the local community together. The event is recreational and open to everyone.

name: X Bieg STO-nogi
description: The STO-nogi Run in Milanówek is a traditional 10 km road race held in the picturesque town of Milanówek. The course is T-shaped and consists of two 5 km loops along the town’s streets. The event is organized by a local group of running enthusiasts who promote sport among residents and participants from across Poland. The race has an intimate atmosphere and is a great opportunity to enjoy an active day and connect with fellow runners.
course_highlights: T-shaped course
Two 5 km loops through the streets of Milanówek
Start and finish at SLO No. 5, 41 Herberta Street
additional: The race traditionally starts at SLO No. 5 (41 Herberta Street). The road course consists of two 5 km loops. The organizers are the local STO-nogi Milanówek group, which also organizes other races and running events. Organizer phone contacts: Leszek Janasik - 666 353 600, Jerzy Stypa - 601 825 560.

name: X Ostródzki Półmaraton św. Jerzego
description: The 10th Ostróda St. George’s Half Marathon is a jubilee edition of the event organized by the Ostróda Runners Group, PLAY Sports Club, and the Ostróda Sports and Recreation Centre. The race takes place in picturesque Ostróda, on the shores of Lake Drwęckie. Participants can expect professional timekeeping and comprehensive organizational support. The event attracts local runners as well as visitors from other regions, and offers cash prizes to the top finishers. Race packs are distributed at the race office, and the organizers ensure smooth and safe service for participants.
course_highlights: The half-marathon course follows the picturesque lakeside promenade along Lake Drwęckie in Ostróda
Professional timekeeping with a returnable chip
Race packs can be collected at the lakeside Amphitheatre
additional: 7:00–9:00. Registration after 9:00 on race day is not possible. Race packs are issued upon presentation of an identity document. A race pack may be collected on behalf of another person with a signed authorization and a copy of their ID. The entry fee is non-refundable and cannot be transferred to another participant. Cash prizes for the top female and male athletes are 1000, 700, and 500 PLN, paid into their bank accounts within 3 days of the race. 5 zł from each entry fee is donated to rehabilitation through a charity initiative.

name: XI Bieg Terenowy Zgierz Malinka
description: The 11th Zgierz Malinka Cross-Country Run takes place in the forested grounds of MOSiR Zgierz Malinka. The course features varied terrain, uphill and downhill sections of different lengths and gradients, large sandy patches, and narrow sections through bushes. Its cross-country character attracts runners looking to get off the asphalt or prepare for mountain races. The event offers three distances: 4, 8, and 12 km, as well as races for children and teenagers. Participants receive symbolic medals inspired by raspberries, and the top runners in each distance receive trophies.
course_highlights: The course runs through the forested grounds of MOSiR Zgierz Malinka
Varied terrain with uphill and downhill sections, sand, and narrow sections through bushes
A cross-country course, unusual for an urban area
additional: All runners start at the same time, regardless of distance. The Nordic walking event covers 4 km. Children’s and teenagers’ races are held over 150 m (ages 0–6) and 800 m (ages 7–15). The event village offers attractions including a playground, pump track, water playground, beach volleyball courts, mini soccer and basketball courts, beach soccer courts, bathing areas, kayak rental, a golf driving range, and games and activities for children.

name: Świecie Biega Brzegiem Deczna
location: Centrum Rekreacji i Wypoczynku Deczno, Świecie, Poland
description: Bieg Świecie Biega Brzegiem Deczna is an annual running event held in the picturesque surroundings of the Deczno Recreation and Leisure Centre. The event includes a 10 km main race and free races for children, making it appealing to families and runners of different ability levels. The main race route follows the banks of the Deczna River, offering participants beautiful views and pleasant racing conditions. The organizers provide professional timing and race kits with T-shirts for early registrants. The main race is limited to 240 participants, ensuring an intimate atmosphere.
course_highlights: A 10 km main race route along the banks of the Deczna River
Picturesque views and a natural setting around the Deczno Recreation and Leisure Centre
Additional free races for children, limited to 115 participants
additional: The main race is limited to 240 participants, and the children's races to 115 participants. The children's races start at 10:00, and the main race starts at 11:00. 23:59.

name: XI Cienińska Szóstka
location: Cienin Zaborny, Słupca County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Grobský Runfest
location: Chorvátsky Grob – Čierna Voda, Chorvátsky Grob – Čierna Voda, Areál za MŠ a ZŠ Javorová Alej
organizer: SBT Spid.com, s.r.o., Susedský Hi o.z., PavúčikSport Team o.z., obec Chorvátsky Grob
description: Grobský Runfest is a two-day sports festival in Chorvátsky Grob, bringing together professional athletes and recreational enthusiasts of all ages. It offers running courses of various distances, children’s races, cycling races, and a rich cultural and entertainment program, including a food zone and musical performances. The event promotes community and a healthy lifestyle in a pleasant setting, with a variety of activities for all visitors.

name: Tvrďák – Bratislava
description: Tvrďák Bratislava is Slovakia’s largest obstacle race, held at the Divoká Voda complex in Čunovo. Competitors tackle more than 20 obstacles on a course of approximately 5 km, with different participation options, including a non-competitive fitness mode and timed racing. After the race, participants can relax by the pool, enjoy refreshments and watch strength competitions. The race is also suitable for children aged 8 to 14 and includes a medal, photos and a race video as keepsakes.

name: Behu ulicami mesta Veľký Krtíš
location: Veľký Krtíš, Veľký Krtíš, Veľký Krtíš
description: The Run Through the Streets of Veľký Krtíš is a traditional running race organized by the Bežci VK civic association. It offers various categories, including children, recreational runners, and Nordic Walking. The race takes place in the town of Veľký Krtíš, with distances ranging from 3,000 m to the main 11,000 m race. The children’s race starts at 09:45, and the main category and Nordic Walking start at 11:00. The event is suitable for the general public and offers discounts for seniors over 60.

name: Moldavský pohár Bodvy
location: Moldava nad Bodvou, Moldava nad Bodvou, Hlavné námestie
description: The Moldava Cup of the Bodva is an international road race, cycling and inline skating event held in Moldava nad Bodvou. The event offers various categories for runners, cyclists and inline skaters, with routes passing through the surrounding countryside and villages. It is known for its tradition and high-quality organization, with the start and finish on the Main Square in Moldava nad Bodvou. It also includes a mass run for health, which is open to the general public.

name: Kros Sázava
description: Kros Sázava je běžecký závod v Pikovici, Středočeském kraji, který nabízí tři trasy různých délek a převýšení. Delší trasa měří 15,5 km s převýšením cca 500 m, střední trasa 10 km s převýšením cca 230 m a hobby trasa 5 km s převýšením 120 m. Všechny tratě vedou výhradně přírodou, což zaručuje krásné a náročné běžecké zážitky. Závod je vhodný pro různé úrovně běžců, kteří si chtějí užít krosový běh v malebném prostředí.

name: 18. Osteroder Etappenmarathon - Etappe 2
description: The Osterode Stage Marathon is a unique marathon that divides the classic distance of 42.195 km into seven enjoyable after-work stages of 5 to 7 kilometers each. The route follows loop courses through the beautiful countryside around Osterode in the Harz foothills. The event is open to runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers, and also offers a kids’ stage for younger participants. Organized by regional clubs, the event will take place for the 18th time in 2026.

name: Sommerlauf Baierbrunn
description: The Baierbrunn Summer Run is a traditional race held annually since 2015 that brings the entire Baierbrunn community together. The event is open to professional and recreational runners of all ages and offers various routes through the surrounding forests across varied terrain. After the races for different age groups and distances, a summer party is held for all participants and friends of SC Baierbrunn. The course is marked and closed to traffic, with drink stations along the way.

name: V Charytatywny Bieg dla Dzieci Bohaterów Biegaj - Pomagaj

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Minimum 40 zł, a w przypadku chęci otrzymania prezentu dla dziecka - minimum 50 zł

description: The 5th Charity Run for Children of Heroes is a special initiative by the Dorastaj z Nami Foundation, which supports the children of public service and medical workers who were killed or injured while on duty. Participants choose a 5 km route and can run it at any time between June 1 and 23, submitting a screenshot from their running app. The run symbolically brings together Children’s Day and Father’s Day, highlighting remembrance of the heroes and support for their children. This charitable event combines sport with help and remembrance.
course_highlights: A 5 km route chosen by the participant
The run can take place at any time from June 1 to 23
Participation is possible from anywhere in Poland
additional: After registering, participants receive a link to pay the entry fee and a link to submit a screenshot from the app used to track the run. The event is virtual, allowing participation from any place and at any time during the designated period. After the run, participants should send the organizers a screenshot from the app used to record their activity.

name: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (7) – červnový
description: Přijďte si zaběhnout na příjemnou a rychlou trať podél Vltavy v Praze Braníku, kde často padají osobní rekordy! Závod je součástí 16. ročníku pravidelných běhů 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY, která probíhá každý měsíc. Trať je změřena certifikovaným měřičem a na 10 km je možné si zaběhnout limit pro MČR. Po závodě je možnost zhodnotit výkony a doplnit energii v restauraci v areálu Hamr Braník. Odměňujeme nejlepší běžce i věrné účastníky.

name: Darmstädter Stadtlauf
description: The Darmstädter Merck Stadtlauf is a traditional city race celebrating its 47th edition in 2026. The course runs through Darmstadt city center and has been adjusted due to construction work to include historic sites such as Marktplatz and Kirchstraße. The race attracts numerous participants each year and offers a lively atmosphere with live music and a dedicated team of hosts. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and attractive route through the pedestrian zone.
course_highlights: Route through central historic sites such as Marktplatz and Kirchstraße
Run through the pedestrian zone in a lively atmosphere
Includes Luisenplatz, Ludwigsplatz and Piazza as well-known sections of the route
additional: The course was changed due to construction work to offer an attractive alternative via Ernst-Ludwig-Platz, Marktplatz, Kirchstraße and the Stadtkirche. The event includes seven races with large, closely packed start fields and is run by a dedicated organizing team. Course change due to construction work; race held on Tuesday; includes youth and school groups; cultural events alongside the race

name: 18. Osteroder Etappenmarathon - Etappe 4
description: The Osterode Stage Marathon is a unique marathon held in seven enjoyable after-work stages of 5 to 7 kilometres each around Osterode am Harz. The fourth stage runs through the beautiful Beber nature reserve in Schwiegershausen, along varied paths of gravel, concrete and grass. The start and finish are at the Schwiegershausen sports hall, and the route offers a great view of the Harz as well as a mix of gentle and steep sections. The race is open to everyone physically able to run about 7 kilometres without stopping and promotes community among the regional clubs.

name: EWE Nordseelauf - Etappe 4
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian Islands on the North Sea coast of Lower Saxony. Over eight days, participants run, walk or Nordic walk stages of about 10 km on the islands of Borkum, Juist, Norderney, Baltrum, Langeoog, Spiekeroog and Wangerooge. The event attracts running enthusiasts from all over Germany and abroad, offering a unique running experience with a maritime atmosphere and a chance to enjoy nature. Due to limited capacity, the race is very popular and sells out quickly.

name: Erfurter Campuslauf
description: The Erfurt Campus Run is a sporting event organized by the University of Erfurt in cooperation with Universitätssportverein Erfurt e.V. Runners can take part in various events, including a 10-kilometer individual race, which also counts as the Thuringian University Championship in the 10-kilometer road race. There is also a 25 x 400-meter team relay and a Bambini run for children. The event features a varied course on the university campus and is open to all ages and ability levels.

name: Firmenlauf Renningen
description: The 1st AOK Company Run Renningen takes place in Renningen and offers a great team event for colleagues. The course is approximately 4.6 km long, consisting of two laps of 2.3 km each. The run is part of the BW-Running company run series and emphasizes inclusion, shared experiences, and celebration. After the run, participants can enjoy free refreshments at the finish and an awards ceremony with musical accompaniment.

name: Szczecińska Dobranocka 27 - finał
description: Szczecińska Dobranocka is a series of orienteering races organized by the BnO Szczecin Orienteering Club. The races take place in various areas around Szczecin, giving participants the chance to test their navigation and running skills. The event is open to competitors of all ability levels, from beginners to experienced runners. Its tradition and varied courses make it a popular event in the orienteering community.
course_highlights: Varied woodland areas around Szczecin
Courses suited to different ability levels
The option to confirm control points using pictograms
additional: The event is organized by the BnO Szczecin Orienteering Club. It is a recurring event and forms part of the wider regional orienteering calendar. Maps for the races and instructions for beginners on confirming control points are available on the website.

name: Herbatka u Tadka, czyli Bieg do Herbacia...
description: Herbatka u Tadka, or the Run to the Tea House, is a 10 km race held in Warsaw. Participants can prepare for the start with training plans tailored to different experience levels, offering expert support and detailed instructions. The event is an excellent opportunity to test your fitness on the streets of the capital in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 10 km distance on the streets of Warsaw
Training tailored to the runner’s VDOT level
Expert support and detailed training plans
additional: Training plans are available for 8 to 20 weeks and are tailored to each runner’s individual level. The platform can also be used to manage the race listing and support marketing collaboration.

name: Běh Vídrholcem
description: Běh Vídrholcem je oblíbený běžecký závod, který se koná v Praze 9-Klánovicích. Tento závod je součástí místního běžeckého kalendáře a přitahuje běžce všech úrovní, kteří si chtějí užít sportovní atmosféru v malebném prostředí. Akce je organizována pod záštitou Českého běhu a Českého atletického svazu, a nabízí nejen soutěžení, ale i radost z pohybu v přírodě.

name: 18. Osteroder Etappenmarathon - Etappe 5
organizer: TG LaPeKa, MTV Osterode, MTV Förste, TSV Schwiegershausen, TSC Dorste, MTV Freiheit, SFC Harz-Weser
description: The 18th Osterode Stage Marathon divides the classic marathon distance of 42.195 km into seven pleasant after-work stages of 5 to 7 kilometers each. The runs follow circuits through the beautiful countryside around Osterode in the foothills of the Harz Mountains. The start is on Sunday in Förste, with a new stage each day until Saturday. In addition to runners, walkers and Nordic walkers are also very welcome. There is also a 750-meter kids’ stage on June 27 in Schützenpark.

name: Bremer Firmenlauf zur Spätschicht
description: The Bremen Company Run for the Late Shift is a community running event covering approximately 5 km around the Weser weir in Bremen, with a focus on team spirit and togetherness. The event is for companies, groups of friends, and running clubs who want to run or walk together without the pressure to perform. New for 2026, official timing will be available for the first time for everyone who wants to test their athletic ambition. After the run, a lively after-run party with music, food, and drinks offers a relaxed end to the evening.

name: DAK FIRMENLAUF Nordhessen 2026
description: The DAK Nord Hesse Company Run has been organized by FTSV Heckershausen 1890 e.V. since 2011 and is held under the motto “Running together—for your health. A lifetime long.” The run promotes health and the enjoyment of exercise and is open to teams and individual runners. The course is about 5.3 km long and runs mostly along unpaved paths, with a short asphalt section. The event starts at 18:30 and offers refreshing drinks and changing facilities on site.

name: Firmenlauf Bremerhaven
description: The 9th Bremerhaven Company Run is open to employees and trainees from companies, public authorities, and other organizations. Participants run a 6 km loop from the Nordsee-Stadion through Speckenbüttler Park. With a limit of 500 participants, the event is a great opportunity for teams to compete athletically and have fun together. Groups receive a free-entry discount when at least 10 participants are registered by the end of May. The event is well established and very popular in the region.

name: Excalibur Race MOON Zámek Duchcov
description: Excalibur Race MOON Zámek Duchcov je překážkový závod konaný v historickém prostředí státního zámku Duchcov a jeho okolí. Závodníci se vydají po stopách legendárního Giacoma Casanovy a čeká je rychlá trať s nádhernými výhledy na Krušné hory, České středohoří a úpatí dolu Bílina. Závod nabízí moderní a certifikované překážky na profesionálních ALU konstrukcích, které kladou důraz na bezpečnost a kvalitu. Atmosféra je doplněna o rytířské téma, které propojuje fyzickou výzvu s hodnotami čest, loajalita a spolupráce. Pro závodníky i fanoušky je připraven bohatý program a zázemí včetně občerstvení a servisních služeb.

name: MidSummerRun 2026
description: The MidSummerRun 2026 takes place on June 19 in Hamburg and is being organized for the fifth time by Lauftreff Alstertal e.V. This sustainable running event offers three races: a children’s run of approx. 970 meters, a 5 km run, and a 10 km run along the wild upper course of the Alster, one of Hamburg’s most beautiful running areas. The start and finish are on the lawn in front of Torhaus Wellingsbüttel, where a sustainability fair featuring sustainable partners and a food truck will also be available. The MidSummerRun stands for environmental protection and sustainability and was awarded second place in the Hanse Environmental Prize.
course_highlights: Route along the wild upper course of the Alster
Start and finish on the lawn in front of Torhaus Wellingsbüttel
A sustainably organized race focused on environmental protection and the 17 UN Sustainable Development Goals
additional: The entry fee includes free travel to and from the event on the HVV. The participant limit is 200 for the children’s run and 600 in total across all races. The event provides first aid in the finish area. Picnic blankets made from recycled advertising banners and a food truck will be available for a relaxed get-together after the race. Children’s run approx. 970 m, 5 km, 10 km, sustainable organization, start and finish on the lawn in front of Torhaus Wellingsbüttel, eco-friendly medals, sustainable refreshments

name: Mittsommernachtslauf Hannover
location: Vereinsheim des HRC Hannover, Weddigenufer 23, Hannover, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Midsummer Night Run Hannover is an urban running event held on the longest day of the year along the idyllic Leine meadows in Hannover. Several distances are offered: a 7.7 km individual race, a 21.1 km individual race, and a 23.1 km relay with three participants. The event is part of the Hannover Region Running Pass and offers a special atmosphere, with the start and finish at the HRC Hannover clubhouse. There are two aid stations along the course, and timing is provided using rental chips. Late entries are possible on the day of the event from 17:00.
course_highlights: Route along the idyllic Leine meadows in Hannover
Two aid stations with water, isotonic drinks, and energy gels
Start and finish at the HRC Hannover clubhouse
additional: Timing is provided using rental chips, which are worn on the foot and returned at the finish. Showers and changing rooms are available in limited numbers at the neighboring Angaria clubhouse and at the University Sports Center (100 m walk). Bags can be left at the tent opposite the clubhouse before the start. Travel by light rail to Königsworther Platz, followed by a walk of approx. 500 m; parking is available at the University Sports Center. Distances: 7.7 km, 21.1 km, 23.1 km relay; start and finish at the HRC Hannover clubhouse, Weddigenufer 23

name: Bergdorfmeile
description: The Bergdorfmeile is a traditional race over a historic 8.88889 km course in Karlsruhe-Hohenwettersbach, held on Friday. With around 140 metres of elevation gain, the course is more challenging than a flat city route, but is designed to be manageable for recreational runners too. The race starts at 19:00 on Lindenstraße and finishes at the SV Hohenwettersbach sports ground. In addition to the main race, there is also an approximately 2 km youth race for children and teenagers. Every participant receives a high-quality performance shirt, and net timekeeping is used with a chip bib.
course_highlights: Historic 8.88889 km course with approximately 140 metres of elevation gain
Start on Lindenstraße, finish at the SV Hohenwettersbach sports ground
Refreshments at kilometre 5 and at the finish
additional: Late entries are possible on the event day, subject to the participant limit. Bag storage is available at the start from 17:00; bags can be collected at the finish until 21:00. Showers are available at SV Hohenwettersbach. Net timekeeping is used with a chip bib, which must be worn on the chest. The course closes at 20:15. Participants who reach the hiking car park at Lambrechtshof (approx. km 3.8) after 19:34 will be removed from the results. The event is limited to approximately 1,000 participants, with chip timing and online results. The course is challenging, with around 140 metres of elevation gain.

name: Burg-Lauf Eppstein
description: The Eppstein Castle Run is a traditional Taunus running classic, held annually since 1986 and attracting up to 500 runners as well as numerous spectators. The varied 7.777 km course passes through the forest and the historic old town, loops twice around the medieval castle, then climbs Schmerzberg to the finish at the TSG Eppstein sports ground. Alongside the sporting competition, the event offers a sociable program featuring a cake stand, a Castle Run glass and refreshments. The run is suitable both for ambitious runners and for running enthusiasts who want to enjoy the special atmosphere and challenge of the “old German mile.”
course_highlights: 7.777 km course adapted to the topography
Route through the forest and old town, and twice around the medieval castle
Climb to the finish on Schmerzberg, back to the TSG Eppstein sports ground
additional: Late entries are possible on the day of the event from 17:00 until half an hour before the start at the “Am Bienroth” sports ground. Chip timing is used. Prizes and non-cash awards are available for the fastest participants, and medals are awarded to student relay teams. Please note the important travel information due to the partial closure of the B455. Eppstein railway station is easily reached on the S2; the start is about a 15-minute walk from the station. The run takes place on varied terrain adapted to the topography. Registration is available online and on the day of the event. Awards, medals and prizes are presented to the winners.

name: Mitternachtslauf
description: The Midnight Run in Glan-Münchweiler is a traditional running event organized annually by TuS Glan-Münchweiler. The run takes place on June 25, 2027, and gives runners the opportunity to test their fitness in a friendly, sporting atmosphere. The event prioritizes participants’ safety and health, with medical staff on site. Registration includes acceptance of the liability disclaimers and privacy policy.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the fire station in Glan-Münchweiler
Traditional run with a history spanning more than 30 years
Medical staff on site for participants’ safety
additional: Registration is subject to acceptance of the liability disclaimer and privacy policy. After registering, participants are not entitled to a refund of their entry fees. The organizers reserve the right to exclude participants from the run if there are health risks. Showers are available at the TuS Glan-Münchweiler sports facility.

name: Oberhausener Kleeblatt-Lauf
description: The 1st Oberhausen Kleeblatt Run is a new running event inviting runners of all ages to Niederrhein Stadium. Organized by the Rot-Weiß Oberhausen Endurance Team with support from the Oberhausen City Sports Association, the run aims to bring people from across the city together—from beginners to ambitious athletes. The route runs mostly along a lit, kilometre-marked running path beside the Rhine-Herne Canal, offering an appealing route that can be used year-round. After the run, the City Sports Association’s recreation area invites participants to relax, connect and enjoy the rest of the event together.
course_highlights: 7.8-kilometre loop along the Rhine-Herne Canal
Lit, kilometre-marked running path that can be used year-round
Starting point at Slinky Springs to Fame, with the route extending to Waghalsbrücke
additional: The event is open to all ability levels and aims to become a fixture in Oberhausen’s sporting calendar. After the run, there will be a programme of food and drinks at the City Sports Association’s recreation area, encouraging community and conversation.

name: Sommerabendlauf "Rund um den Sorpesee"
location: Sorpebrücke, Amecke, Sundern, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Summer Evening Run “Rund um den Sorpesee” is an annual summer running event in Sundern-Amecke. Three distances are offered: 15.6 km, 6.4 km, and 8.8 km walking, all around the Sorpesee main basin. The course is mostly paved and about half shaded, making the run especially pleasant. The event is open to runners of all ages and offers trophies for the top finishers, as well as a running-themed memento for all finishers.
course_highlights: 15.6 km course around the Sorpesee main basin, mostly paved and about 50% shaded
6.4 km out-and-back course
8.8 km walking course
additional: Start and finish at the Sorpe Bridge by the main basin. Start times: 15.6 km run at 18:30, 6.4 km run at 18:45, and 8.8 km walk at 18:30. Three refreshment stations along the course and one in the finish area. Free showers at the nearby campsite. Certificates are available on site or later via Race Result. Forest trails are used for the walking and Nordic walking course. The main race course has three refreshment stations, plus another in the finish area; showers are available at the neighboring campsite.

name: Weezer Sommerabendlauf
description: The Weeze Summer Evening Run is a popular running event held annually since 2019 in Vittinghoff-Schell-Park in Weeze. After cancellations due to the pandemic in 2020 and 2021, the event has once again attracted large numbers of participants, with over 380 starters in 2025. The event offers various race distances, including children’s and youth races, and starts at 5 p.m. Timing is done using a chip attached to the race bib, and attractive prizes are awarded to clubs with the most finishers.
course_highlights: A loop around Weeze, crossing the new Niers Bridge and passing through the wildlife park
Children’s race of approximately 300 m, with a loop starting from Bahnstraße
Start and finish in Vittinghoff-Schell-Park
additional: Online registration is via raceresult, with payment by SEPA direct debit. Late registration is available on site by cash or card. Race bibs with chips must be returned on the day of the event; the €3 chip deposit is refunded. There are no changing rooms or showers; toilets are available in the Bürgerhaus. Eight tickets to the 1Live San Hejmo Festival will be awarded to the club with the most adult finishers (excluding TSV Weeze). The run takes place in Vittinghoff-Schell-Park. Online registration is available; late registration is possible on site until 45 minutes before the start. Start times are between 6:00 p.m. and 7:30 p.m.

name: Osnabrücker Mittsommernachtslauf
description: The Charity Midsummer Night Run in Osnabrück-Sutthausen starts at 6:00 p.m. and offers a relaxed running event for all age groups in support of the nonprofit association Zusammen-Bewegen e.V. The route starts at the RW Sutthausen sports field and heads into the Hörner Bruch forest, where one lap is about 3 kilometers long. There are various distances, from 500 m for Bambinis to 10 km for adults, and no individual timing is provided. After the run, participants can wind down the evening over food and drinks.

name: Altstadtfestlauf in Lauf
description: The Altstadtfest Run in Lauf an der Pegnitz takes place every year on Friday evening, opening the Altstadtfest on the last weekend in June. It is considered the world’s largest class reunion and offers runners a special experience, with a setting found nowhere else, such as the runners’ pack on the Laufer Water Bridge. There is a 10 km main race with a turnaround point at Lebenshilfe in Schönberg, as well as a 5 km race, including Nordic walking, with a turnaround point on Ottensooser Straße. The event combines sporting competition with a social gathering and also supports social projects.

name: Bietigheimer Fackellauf
description: The Bietigheim Torch Run is a special running experience held annually in Bietigheim-Bissingen. The 10 km run consists of three laps on a flat, paved dirt track between Bietigheim and Ingersheim, illuminated by torches. The start and finish are at the Olymp company car park, where a unique atmosphere with music, food, and drinks awaits participants. The run starts at 10 p.m. and offers an atmospheric nighttime event for all running enthusiasts.

name: Dr. Ernst van Aaken Gedächtnislauf 2026
description: The Dr. Ernst van Aaken Memorial Run takes place at the Dr. Ernst van Aaken Stadium in Schwalmtal and offers a varied running program on a late June evening. OSC Waldniel organizes ten races with more than 1,000 participants across different age and ability groups, from young people to seniors. The event combines track and road races, including a 5-kilometer road race and the 5000-meter “Race of Aces” for stronger runners. Participants can enter individually, as part of a team, or in the elite field, welcoming both beginners and experienced athletes. The race honors Ernst van Aaken, founder of OSC and a champion of the women’s marathon.

name: levoBank Stadtlauf des TV Lebach
description: The levoBank Stadtlauf, organized by TV Lebach, is a long-standing running event held in the town of Lebach. The start and finish are at the football stadium on Schlesierallee. The race offers an appealing route through the town and is open to runners of all ages and ability levels. The event is a regular fixture on the regional running calendar and is organized by TV Lebach.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the football stadium on Schlesierallee
Route through the town of Lebach
Appealing course for runners of different age groups

name: Lippe-Sommer-Serie 2025 Lauf 3: Sommerlauf um den SchiederSee
description: The event offers two distances, 1 km and 8.3 km, and is suitable for runners of all ability levels. The scenic route goes around SchiederSee, with pleasant summer weather averaging 23°C and mostly sunny days. Results may be included in official athletics rankings.

name: Retzbachlauf Gaimersheim
description: The Retzbachlauf in Gaimersheim is a traditional race featuring a flat loop course that runs mostly on gravel paths. The event offers races for various age groups, from Bambini to the main race, and is part of the Sport IN Laufcup series. Due to high temperatures, start times are being moved later and course distances adjusted to ensure participants’ safety. The event places great importance on providing plenty of water along the course and creating a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Flat loop course, mostly on gravel paths
Start and finish at Retzbachpark Gaimersheim, near EDEKA
Part of the Sport IN Laufcup series
additional: The races have staggered starts from 18:10 to 20:00, with the main race starting at 20:00. Race packets can be collected from 17:00 at the start/finish area. The course has been adjusted due to the heat; the main race consists of 2 laps (6.4 km) instead of 3. Additional water stations are provided along the course. The event is easy to reach by bus and train. Parking is available, but not in the car park of the adjacent Edeka store.

name: Wiesengrundlauf
description: The Wiesengrundlauf in Haselbachtal is a regional running event held every year on the Friday evening after the summer solstice. The municipality of Haselbachtal invites runners of all ages to take part in distances ranging from 600 m to 11.6 km. The event is part of the Sachsen Energie Läufer-Cup and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with awards for overall and age-group winners. The start and finish are at the “Wiesengrund” sports field in Bischheim. The 2025 premiere was a great success, with numerous participants and a varied supporting programme.

name: Osterrönfelder Moorlauf

description: The Osterrönfelder Moorlauf is a traditional race in Osterrönfeld that welcomes runners of all ages. The event offers a 1.17-kilometer children’s run, a 5-kilometer fun run, and the 10-kilometer Moorlauf. The course starts at the sports field on Aukamp Street and runs through the scenic moorland. Timing is chip-based, and participants receive certificates, medals, and trophies, along with a grilled sausage for refreshments.
course_highlights: Start at the sports field on Aukamp Street
Run through the moorland
Three distances: 1.17 km children’s run, 5 km fun run, 10 km Moorlauf
additional: Race packets are available on race day from 16:00 at the sports hall at Fehmarnstraße 2. Timing uses chips worn around the ankle, which must be returned after finishing (a €40 fee applies if lost). Showers and parking are available at the sports hall. The entry fee for the 5 km and 10 km races includes a voucher for a grilled sausage. The children’s run is limited to a maximum of 50 participants.

name: GDYNIA ULTRA WAY
description: Gdynia Ultra Way is a mountain race by the sea, held in Gdynia and the surrounding Kashubian region. Runners can choose from five distances, ranging from 14 km to 160 km, with varied elevation gains and scenic routes. The start and finish are at different locations, and the organizer provides transport to the start of the longest distance. It is a unique opportunity to take on a challenging course and enjoy the beauty of the coastal landscape.
course_highlights: 160 km distance with +/- 2,502 m of elevation gain, starting in Puck at 10:00
100 km distance with +/- 2,267 m of elevation gain, starting in Gdynia at 21:00
Routes run through Kashubia and coastal areas, with checkpoints and time limits
additional: For the start of the longest distance (160 km), runners are transported by coach from outside the Gdynia Sports Centre – National Rugby Stadium (paid transport). The time limit for the 160 km distance is 31 hours. The course has checkpoints with time limits and drop bags. The event includes both summer and winter editions, with routes passing through various towns in the region and providing an unforgettable experience for runners of all ability levels.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań – edycja nocna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań – Night Edition 2026 is a cross-country race held in the picturesque Dendrological Garden of the Poznań University of Life Sciences. The event is part of a series of races organized since 2014 by a group of enthusiasts who focus on the beauty of the courses and promoting running. After the race, participants will receive unique medals, different from those awarded at the spring edition, making them worth collecting. It’s a special opportunity to run in beautiful surroundings and enjoy the atmosphere of the night.

name: Australijska Dyszka w Pszczelniku
description: The Australian Ten in Pszczelnik is a 10 km race taking place in Siemianowice Śląskie, in Pszczelnik Park. The course consists of four laps, and all runners start together. After each lap, the 20 runners who took the longest to complete it are eliminated and receive a so-called “almost medal” at the finish. The fastest runners, competing for the win, complete the final lap. The race is open to anyone over the age of 16.

name: Biegaj z Duchami
description: Run with the Ghosts is a unique night trail run held in Leśniów. Participants can choose between two routes, 15 km and 9 km long, full of dark corners and surprises that create an unforgettable atmosphere with a hint of suspense. Runners are encouraged to dress up as spectres, ghosts and other spooky characters, adding a touch of magic and atmosphere to the event. It’s not just a race, but also a test of endurance and courage in the dark, where participants face their own weaknesses and mysterious figures along the route.

name: Bieg dla Słonia
description: Bieg dla Słonia is a night run commemorating Artur Hajzer, a mountaineer who climbed seven eight-thousanders. Participants cover a symbolic distance of about 7 kilometres on the grounds of the Silesian Stadium and Silesian Park in Chorzów. The run is recreational, with no rankings or timing, and participation is free. The event takes place in the evening, creating a unique atmosphere while keeping the memory of an outstanding mountaineer alive.
course_highlights: A route of about 7 km on the grounds of the Silesian Stadium and Silesian Park
A night run on a partly illuminated route; headlamps are recommended
A symbolic commemoration of the seven eight-thousanders climbed by Artur Hajzer
additional: Participant registration is open from 20:00 to 21:50 at the race office by Gate 4 of the Silesian Stadium. The run takes place regardless of weather conditions. Participants must sign a declaration before the start. Headlamps are recommended because the route takes place at night. Part of the route is poorly lit, so the organisers recommend bringing a headlamp.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Kielce - edycja nocna
description: Botaniczna Piątka is a series of cross-country races organized since 2014, combining a passion for running with the beauty of natural and scenic locations. The event promotes outdoor physical activity, especially in picturesque gardens and green spaces. The night edition in Kielce is a unique opportunity to compete and celebrate sport together in unusual conditions. The organizers focus on a welcoming atmosphere and promoting running among people of different ages and ability levels.
course_highlights: A cross-country course through picturesque green spaces
A run in a unique nighttime atmosphere
A scenic, welcoming setting ideal for recreation
additional: The organizer is a group of running enthusiasts with experience dating back to 2014, specializing in cross-country races. Events take place at various locations, often in botanical gardens and green spaces. In summer 2026, Botaniczna Piątka celebrated its 10th anniversary. The organizer encourages people to subscribe to the newsletter to stay up to date with race news.

name: Běh týnišťskými pralesy
description: Běh týnišťskými pralesy je charitativní běžecký závod pořádaný v krásné přírodě Týniště nad Orlicí, který nabízí tratě pro různé výkonnostní úrovně a věkové kategorie. Závod se koná v lese s převahou zpevněných lesních cest a místy asfaltu. Součástí je rodinný běh zdarma pro děti do 18 let a hlavní závody na 6, 10 a 21 km. Akce propojuje sport, rodiny a pomoc dobré věci, podporuje neziskovou organizaci RENEDA, která pomáhá dětem s neurologickými výzvami.

name: Mistrovství světa veteránů v dlouhém horském běhu
description: Mistrovství světa veteránů v dlouhém horském běhu se uskuteční v malebném prostředí Janské Lázně v Královéhradeckém kraji. Tento závod je určen pro veterány a nabízí náročný dlouhý horský běh, který prověří vytrvalost a sílu běžců v krásné horské krajině. Akce je součástí prestižního kalendáře trailových běhů a přitahuje běžce z různých koutů světa. Pro více informací doporučujeme sledovat oficiální stránky organizace.

name: ROZKOŠný 1/2 Maraton
description: ROZKOŠný 1/2 Maraton je půlmaraton konaný v Česká Skalice, který vede po nové cyklostezce okolo vodní nádrže Rozkoš. Závod nabízí hlavní běh na 21,1 km a doprovodný běh na 2 km určený pro děti a maminky s kočárky. Akce je doplněna zábavou, občerstvením a možností ubytování v kempu, což vytváří příjemnou atmosféru pro všechny účastníky i doprovod. Start hlavní kategorie je v 12:30, první kategorie startuje v 10:00.

name: Běh lužanskými hvozdy
organizer: Obec Lužany, ELMAT Kůtek s.r.o., TJ Sokol Lužany
description: Běh lužanskými hvozdy je tradiční běžecký závod pořádaný v rekreační oblasti obce Lužany u Jičína, konkrétně v kempu u rybníka Marešáku. Jubilejní 50. ročník se uskuteční a nabízí různé kategorie a délky tratí vhodné pro široké spektrum běžců včetně dětí. Závod je podporován Královéhradeckým krajem a pořádají jej Obec Lužany, ELMAT Kůtek s.r.o. a TJ Sokol Lužany. Účastníci mohou očekávat medaile, věcné ceny a finanční odměny pro nejlepší závodníky v jednotlivých kategoriích.

name: Žhavé běhy Slováckého léta
description: Žhavé běhy Slováckého léta jsou tradiční běžecké závody konané v historickém centru Uherského Hradiště. Účastníci si mohou vybrat ze tří tras o délce 5, 10 a 21 kilometrů, které vedou malebnou krajinou podél řeky Moravy, přes lesopark Kunovský les a novoveská jezera. Závody jsou vhodné pro všechny běžce, od začátečníků po zkušené sportovce, a nabízejí jedinečný zážitek z pohybu v krásném prostředí Slovácka. Start i cíl jsou na Masarykově náměstí, což dodává závodu atmosféru historického srdce města.

name: Besenbinder Lauf - Rund um Hainrode
description: The 1st Besenbinder Run – Around Hainrode is a running event in the South Harz, organized by ASV 1902 Sangerhausen. The event takes place in Hainrode and offers runners of different age groups and ability levels the opportunity to take part in a sporting competition. The course runs around Hainrode and promises a varied running environment in nature. The event is open to children, teenagers, active runners, and masters.
course_highlights: Run around Hainrode in the South Harz
Event in a natural setting
Suitable for different age and ability groups
additional: The event venue is Hainröder Hauptstraße 60A, Hainrode; no specific terrain details are available.

name: Remmers-Hasetal-Marathon
description: The Remmers-Hasetal-Marathon in Löningen is an established running event in northern Germany, taking place for the 24th time. The flat, scenic course follows a loop through the Hasetal, half of it along the Hasetal cycle path, and is officially measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and eligible for inclusion in record lists. Alongside the marathon, the event also offers a half marathon, marathon relay, corporate relay, Nordic walking, walking and school races. The event is known for its great atmosphere, support from spectators and volunteers, and the Marathon Night afterwards, featuring a live band on the market square.
course_highlights: Flat course through the scenic Hasetal
Loop course with 2 laps for the marathon, half of it along the Hasetal cycle path
Start and finish on Löningen's market square, followed by the Marathon Night party
additional: Start and finish on Löningen's market square, with information and sales stands and an event stage. The course passes through the Werwer Fuhren forest and varied Geest landscapes. There is a Marathon Night party in the evening with a TOP-40 live band. The Bambini run starts separately from the Gelbrink parking lot. Refreshments are organized by the altar servers of St. Vitus Löningen. The event is certified as a “Three-Star Run.” It also includes the charity initiative “Laufend helfen in Löningen” (Helping Through Running in Löningen) and a marathon brochure, and usually takes place in June.

name: Glückstädter City-Lauf
description: The Glückstadt City Run warmly invites runners of all ages to experience the picturesque town of Glückstadt. The event offers a range of distances from 250 m to 10 km, running through the beautiful town center and along the harbor. Participation is at your own risk. Age-group rankings are provided, with trophies for the top runners in the 5 km and 10 km races. Race packets can be collected on race day from 9:00 a.m., and late entries are possible up to 60 minutes before the respective race.
course_highlights: Routes through the picturesque town center of Glückstadt
Races along the harbor head and past Legendenpark
A range of distances from 250 m to 10 km for all age groups
additional: Late entries are possible up to 60 minutes before the respective race, with a €5 late-entry fee. Changing facilities and tents are available; showers are provided at Fortunabad. For safety reasons, headphones and bringing animals or baby joggers during the race are not permitted. The event provides shower and changing facilities, safety and data-protection policies, and medals and trophies for the winners.

name: Idar-Obersteiner Altstadtlauf
organizer: Stadtjugendamt Idar-Oberstein in Verbindung mit Stadtverband sporttreibender Vereine und TV 1848 Oberstein
price_range: 5 euro für Erwachsene, 2,50 euro für Kinder/Jugend, U8 frei
description: The Idar-Oberstein Old Town Run is a traditional running event in the historic old town of Oberstein, held annually on the last Saturday in June. The event features six different races for various age groups, from U8 children to adults, with distances ranging from 370 metres to around 6.5 kilometres. The route runs through the pedestrian zone below the striking Felsenkirche, a city landmark. The start and finish are behind the Tourist Information in Oberstein. Entry fees are deliberately kept low to encourage broad participation.
course_highlights: Route through the pedestrian zone below the Felsenkirche
Start and finish behind the Oberstein Tourist Information
A range of distances from 370 m to 6.5 km for all age groups
additional: Late entries are not possible after the registration deadline. The event features six separate races for different age groups. Typical June weather is around 23 °C and mostly sunny. Running event in the old town; online registration is available; start and finish at the Oberstein Tourist Information.

name: Isselhorster Nacht
description: The Isselhorster Nacht is a long-standing running event in Gütersloh-Isselhorst, taking place for the 26th time. It offers races for different age groups and ability levels, including the Bambini Run, Schoolrunning, Fun Run, Corporate Run, Speed Skating and Main Race. The event combines sporting commitment with social engagement by supporting the German Stroke Foundation. A special preparation program, “Fit in 100 Days,” motivates and supports participants on their way to the event. The races take place in the center of Isselhorst and offer a lively atmosphere with many spectators and a varied supporting program.
course_highlights: Various distances from 500 m to 9,200 m for all age groups
Route through the center of Isselhorst, consisting of several laps
Popular Corporate Run with team scoring and inventive costumes
additional: Late entries are possible up to 2 weeks before the event, subject to a late entry fee, except for the Bambini Run and student races. On the day of the event, on-site registration is available from 16:00. The event supports the German Stroke Foundation, with the option to donate money based on kilometers run. There is an extensive preparation program, “Fit in 100 Days,” featuring weekly training sessions and individual support. The races take place in the center of Isselhorst, spectators line the course, and there is a warm-up for children before the first races. A running event with a fundraising campaign against stroke, a varied program, music and a party.

name: XTrail Breitnau
description: The XTrail Breitnau is a diverse running event in the Upper Black Forest, bringing together runners and Nordic walkers of all ages for a day of competition. Four events are offered: the popular XT-Run, with half-marathon and 10 km distances; the XT-Walk, with 12 km and 8 km distances; the XT-Challenge, an obstacle sprint for age groups U8 to U20; and the XT-Kids run for the youngest participants. The routes cross varied terrain, with trails, steep climbs and panoramic views, and participants receive an attractive starter pack and professional timing. The event is organized by Skizunft Breitnau e.V. and takes place.
course_highlights: Half-marathon route with steep climbs and trails through the Ravennaschlucht gorge
Nordic-walking routes on natural paths through Moos, Föhrwald and Hohwartshöhe
Obstacle sprint with a serpentine climb and a varied course through the spa gardens
additional: Race-number pickup on event day from 08:00–11:00 and 12:30–13:45 at the fire station. For XT-Kids and XT-Challenge, race numbers are distributed in sets to each club. Participants must observe the terms and conditions and equipment requirements, such as trail-running shoes with grippy soles for RUN and Nordic-walking poles for WALK. Refreshments are available on the course and at the finish; participants receive a personal digital certificate. XT-Kids finishers receive a medal, and overall and age-group winners receive exclusive trophies and prizes. Late registration is possible for a fee until June 26 at 18:00, and on event day until one hour before the start. Multiple event types, courses and age groups; online registration; race numbers; refreshments; prizes; possible course changes.

name: 18. Osteroder Etappenmarathon - Etappe 1
description: The Osterode Stage Marathon divides the classic marathon distance of 42.195 km into seven enjoyable after-work stages of 5 to 7 kilometers each. The first stage starts in Förste and runs through the beautiful Söse Valley, with views of Lichtenstein and a route past the famous Lichtenstein Cave. The event is open to runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers, and also features a 750-meter kids’ stage in Schützenpark. Stages take place daily and are organized by regional clubs.

name: 6. Hofer Backyard Ultra

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 69 EUR pro Person. (NEU: keine Preisstaffelungen nach Anmeldedatum)

description: The Hofer Backyard Ultra is a unique ultrarunning event taking place on June 26, 2027, in Hof, Bavaria. Participants run a 6.706-kilometer loop with approximately 80 meters of elevation gain, mostly on forest and forestry roads and partly on asphalt. The race is a so-called Backyard Ultra, in which each loop must be completed within one hour, and it ends only when just one runner remains. The event offers a special challenge, focused on recognizing and pushing beyond your own limits.
course_highlights: 6.706-kilometer loop with approximately 80 meters of elevation gain
The course runs on forest and forestry roads and partly on asphalt
Hofer Backyard Ultra arrows mark the route
additional: After 24 hours, approximately 160.8 km will have been covered; after 36 hours, approximately 241.2 km. Sunset on the event day is at 21:27, after which runners need to bring their own headlamp. There are 200 free parking spaces no more than 100 m from the start/finish area at Hof/Plauen Pirk Airport.

name: Fischerhuder Sommerlauf
description: The Fischerhude Summer Run, organised by Sportfreunde Fischerhude e.V., starts at 18:00. Distances include 1 km for children and 5 km and 10 km for young people and adults, run on an officially measured 5 km loop. There is also a 2x5 km relay for friends, families and colleagues. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere, with free hot and cold drinks in the finish area and changing and shower facilities available after the race. A DJ provides entertainment, and an after-run party with a barbecue, cocktails and drinks begins after the races.

name: 100km Staffellauf um den Pokal der Uni Tübingen
description: The University of Tübingen 100 km relay is a long-standing university sports event held annually in Tübingen. Teams of students and other participants run the total distance of 100 kilometers as a relay. The route passes through the scenic surroundings of Tübingen and offers an athletic challenge combined with a sense of community. Refreshments and a program of activities are provided, making the race a special event for runners and spectators.

name: Berglauf 2026
description: The Kyffhäuser Mountain Run is a traditional running event at the Kyffhäuser Monument in Thomm, attracting numerous runners each year. The route climbs uphill and offers a sporting challenge with impressive views. In addition to the main race, there is also a tower stair race, in which participants climb 306 steps inside the monument tower. The event thrives on the commitment of runners, supporters, and volunteer helpers, and promises an unforgettable running experience in a unique landscape.

name: Brauerschwender Basaltlauf
description: The Brauerschwender Basalt Run takes place in Brauerschwend and offers runners of all ages a sporting challenge in beautiful surroundings. The courses have gentle elevation changes, are well marked, and feature kilometer markers. Drinks are available along the course, and the organizer provides refreshments at the finish. The event is aimed both at competitive runners and at anyone who enjoys being active together.

name: Citylauf Leonberg
description: The Leonberg City Run offers a varied running experience for all ages and ability levels. The routes pass through Leonberg’s historic old town, the picturesque center of Eltingen, and the modern city center at Neuköllner Platz, with several fan zones featuring live music and enthusiastic spectators. In addition to the main 10 km race, there is a 5 km race, a 1.4 km schoolchildren’s race, and a 0.4 km children’s race. The event is a lively sporting highlight for the whole city, with a fantastic atmosphere at the start and finish.

name: DJK-Willibaldslauf
description: The DJK-Willibaldslauf is an inclusive running event in Eichstätt, taking place for the second time. All age groups and ability levels are welcome, from the children’s run and inclusive runs to the main race and Nordic walking. The route follows the idyllic Altmühl River and leads to the cathedral. The start and finish are at the DJK Eichstätt car park. The event emphasizes community and fun, with no timekeeping, and all participants receive high-quality running shirts and commemorative medals.

name: Fuchsburg Lauf
description: The Fuchsburg Run is organized by TV Vohburg and takes place as part of the Vohburg Fuchsburg Festival. The event offers runners of different age groups and ability levels the opportunity to run on attractive routes through the region. The races include a 10 km main race, a 2.3 km student race, and a 600 m Bambini race. The event is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere and a shared enjoyment of sport, supported by the dedicated TV Vohburg team.

name: Göllnitz-Schmooksberglauf (LC/NLC)
description: The 2nd Göllnitz-Schmooksberg Run (LC/NLC) takes place in Diekhof (Laage) and is organized by Sportclub Laage. This athletics event is held away from the stadium and invites runners to take part in a sporting competition. The course runs through the scenic surroundings of Diekhof and offers an appealing challenge for all participants. Registration is open.

name: Hohenschönhausener Gartenlauf
description: The Hohenschönhausener Gartenlauf is a running event in northern Berlin, held at the Falkenhöhe-Nord e.V. allotment garden. The event offers running fun for various age groups, including a Bambini race. The course runs through the leafy garden complex and is part of Berlin’s running scene. Official timing and an awards ceremony round off the event.
course_highlights: Run through the Falkenhöhe-Nord allotment garden
Event in northern Berlin with a green setting
Includes a Bambini race and official timing
additional: The event is part of the Berlin Cup and is organized by the Falkenhöhe-Nord e.V. allotment garden association. There is an awards ceremony and official race timing.

name: Klumpenlauf Wessum
description: The Klumpenlauf is a running event that celebrates community, movement, and good vibes. After being cancelled in 2026, the organizers are looking forward to lining up with the runners again in 2027 and sharing special moments. Already booked race entries remain valid, underscoring the event’s sense of connection and continuity.

name: Lubaster Waldlauf
description: The 13th Lubaster Waldlauf takes place in Kemberg and offers runners two distances: 1 km and 6.3 km. The event is ideal for anyone looking to experience a short but varied run through the forest. The race promises pleasant summer weather, with an average temperature of 23 °C and mostly sunny conditions. Participants can look forward to a friendly atmosphere and a well-organized event.

name: Ludwigshafener Stadtlauf
description: The Ludwigshafen City Run offers a varied range of races for all ages and ability levels. From Bambini and schoolchildren’s races to youth and beginner races, as well as a public race for adults, there is something for everyone. The event features a friendly atmosphere, electronic timing, and a functional city-run shirt for all participants. The races take place on varied routes in Ludwigshafen am Rhein and are supported by the City of Ludwigshafen and the Ludwigshafen Sports Association.

name: MÜRITZ-LAUF
description: The MÜRITZ-LAUF is a race around Germany’s largest inland lake, Lake Müritz, and takes place in Waren (Müritz). The route showcases the full diversity of the northern German landscape and, with its easy-to-manage profile, is ideal for runners who want to enjoy nature while also running fast. The event is organized by ESV Waren e.V., a long-established sports club that, with the support of numerous sponsors and volunteers, ensures everything runs smoothly.

name: Schöneicher Eichkaterlauf
description: The 14th Eichkaterlauf in Schöneiche offers a varied selection of races for all ages and ability levels. From short Bambini and children’s races to fun runs and the challenging 12 km signature distance, there is something for everyone. The courses run through the beautiful natural surroundings of Schöneiche and invite participants to enjoy a sporting experience together. The event is family-friendly, and registration is conveniently available online, with late registration also possible on race day.

name: Stadtlauf Abensberg 2026
description: The Abensberg City Run takes place at the new stadium in Abensberg. The event is a special highlight for the athletics department of TSV Abensberg, which is committed to promoting recreational sports. By taking part in the City Run, you support running in the local community and help foster a vibrant sports culture. The run is a great opportunity to come together and cover kilometers in support of a new tartan track and modern training equipment.

name: Volksbank-Bever-Lauf
description: The Volksbank-Bever-Lauf takes place at Beverstadion in Ostbevern. The event offers various running competitions, including a half-marathon relay and individual races for runners born in 2012 or earlier. The course is measured by the DLV and is part of the Volksbank-Cup running series. Drinks and refreshments are available in the finish area, and changing rooms and showers are available right at Beverstadion.

name: Supermaraton Gor Stolowych
description: The Table Mountains Supermarathon is a demanding mountain race held in the picturesque Table Mountains near Karłów. The route follows hiking trails and is technically challenging, with numerous rocks, turns, and significant elevation gain. Participants can expect changing conditions, including possible snow and ice, and are required to carry suitable equipment. The event is part of the Grand Prix DFBG mountain-running series and attracts fans of ultrarunning and mountain half-marathons.

name: Sudecka 100
description: Sudecka 100 is Poland’s oldest night ultramarathon, held amid the picturesque mountain scenery of Boguszów-Gorce. The demanding route runs through the beautiful forest areas of the Kamienna Góra and Wałbrzych Forest Districts, offering unforgettable excitement and a chance to test your limits. The event attracts runners taking part in different distances, including 100 km, 42 km and 21 km. Organizers look after participants’ comfort by providing aid stations along the route and race packs containing technical T-shirts. The atmosphere is enhanced by support from spectators and additional attractions such as concerts and overnight accommodation for runners.
course_highlights: A demanding route in mountain terrain
Runs through the forest areas of the Kamienna Góra and Wałbrzych Forest Districts
A night ultramarathon with a unique atmosphere and support from spectators
additional: Race packs include technical T-shirts for entries paid for by June 12. Aid stations and refreshment points are available along the route. Race packs can be collected at the Decathlon store in Szczawno-Zdrój. The organizer provides free overnight accommodation and a place for runners to rest. Payments at the race office can be made in cash only.

name: XIII Dycha Anny Wazówny
description: The 13th Anna Vasa 10K is a 10 km race held in Brodnica, Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship. The event is an excellent opportunity to test your fitness on a moderately challenging paved course. The organizers offer training plans tailored to different ability levels, supporting participants in their preparations. The event is open and welcoming to runners, encouraging physical activity and competition on the city streets.
course_highlights: A paved course of moderate difficulty
A 10 km road race
Held in the picturesque city of Brodnica
additional: Training plans ranging from 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level and including instructions and expert support.

name: 7 Maraton Pędziwiatra
description: The 7th Pędziwiatr Marathon is organized by the Pędziwiatr Gliwice Amateur Running Club and will take place on June 26, 2027, in Gliwice. Participants will complete 10 laps of a 4.2195 km loop, running mainly along sheltered park paths. The event is both a memorial and a sporting competition, with individual and team classifications and relay races. The start is at 10:00, alongside the start of the Gliwice Park Running Challenge. All runners are welcome to take part in this special event.
course_highlights: 10 laps of a 4.2195 km loop
The route runs mainly along sheltered park paths
Starts alongside the Gliwice Park Running Challenge
additional: Planned classifications: individual overall, women, men, age categories, team, and relays.

name: Gliwicka Prowokacja biegowa
location: Polana za stadionem Piasta, Gliwice, Poland
description: The Gliwice Park Run Provocation is a series of 12 running and Nordic Walking events held in Gliwice, in the municipal forest near Piast Stadium. Each lap is 4,219.5 metres long and runs mainly along forest tracks and gravel paths, with some asphalt. The events aim to promote healthy, active outdoor recreation, with the slogan “Let yourself be provoked into fighting laziness!” Participants can take part in the run or Nordic Walking, as well as the e-Provocation, an online competition.
course_highlights: A lap is 4,219.5 m long
The route follows forest tracks and gravel paths, with some asphalt
Start and finish are in a clearing near Piast Stadium in Gliwice
additional: The events are held once a month on Saturdays. The time limit for the run and Nordic Walking is 3 hours. Participants can complete 1 to 5 laps (about 4.2 km to about 21 km). Race numbers are valid for the entire year and must be returned after each race. After the event, participants receive a drink and a snack (sausage or banana), as well as a bar in the prize draw, if sanitary regulations allow. The e-Provocation has no time limit and participants may choose any activity. In previous editions, the race office opened at 9:00 and the start was at 10:00; advance registration and payment of the entry fee were required to be classified.

name: III Bieg w Sławicach
description: The III Run in Sławice is a 10 km road race held in the picturesque village of Sławice in the Masovian Voivodeship. The event is an excellent opportunity to test your fitness on a moderately challenging asphalt course. The organizers encourage participants to prepare with dedicated training plans tailored to different experience levels. The event is open and welcoming to runners who want to improve their results and enjoy sporting competition.
course_highlights: 10 km asphalt course
Moderate difficulty
Picturesque surroundings of Sławice
additional: Training plans from 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level and including instructions and expert support.

name: X Lubeński Cross
description: Lubeński Cross is a mountain cross-country race held in the scenic area of the Lubenia municipality. The start and finish are at the market square in Lubenia. The main race routes cover varied terrain, including asphalt, paved roads and dirt paths, and participants climb 3 or 5 green hills depending on the distance chosen. The available distances are 13.8 km and 22.3 km. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and is also open to children and young people, who compete on the stadium track over designated loops.
course_highlights: Mountain route with 3 or 5 green hills
Varied terrain: asphalt (21–25%), paved roads (32–38%), dirt roads and paths (41–43%)
Start and finish at the market square in Lubenia
additional: Children’s and youth races take place on the stadium track over designated loops of 200 to 800 m, divided by age and gender categories. Children’s race bibs must be collected by 10:30. On race day, registration for the children’s races is unavailable because of the 200-participant limit. The children’s races start after the shorter main race. On-site registration at the stadium after 10:30 is limited.

name: XIII Bieg Cichociemnych
description: The Cichociemni Run is a demanding cross-country race dedicated to the memory of Poland’s heroes, the Cichociemni soldiers. The course is more challenging than most cross-country races and features natural and man-made obstacles of varying difficulty. Participants must tackle mud and water, jump over obstacles, crawl under them, and squeeze through channels. The race takes place every June in Sochaczew and offers a chance to test your strength and get to know the Bzura River and its surroundings.
course_highlights: A course featuring natural and man-made obstacles of varying difficulty
Sections through mud and water, and through channels
Views and proximity to the banks and riverbed of the Bzura River
additional: Registration is available through the Zmierzymy Czas platform. A dedicated T-shirt can be ordered during selected registration periods. Discounts are available for running groups of at least 6 people upon prior contact by email. Organizer: UKS Dragon Fight Club Sochaczew. The race is held under the honorary patronage of the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of National Defence, and the Mayor of the City of Sochaczew.

name: XXI Dziesiątka Unisławska
description: The 21st Unisław 10K is an annual 10 km race held in Unisław as part of Unisław Days. The course follows paved roads through the scenic Chełmno Landscape Park, passing through Unisław, Stablewice and Gołoty. The race is part of the Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship Grand Prix in Long-Distance Running and is certified by the Polish Athletics Association. The event also includes a Nordic walking event, making it appealing to a wide range of participants.
course_highlights: The course runs through Chełmno Landscape Park
Paved roads through Unisław, Stablewice and Gołoty
The course is certified by the Polish Athletics Association
additional: The race course is certified by the Polish Athletics Association.

name: XXVII Bieg Górski Żar
description: The 27th Żar Mountain Run is a 10 km mountain race held in the picturesque town of Międzybrodzie Żywieckie. The event is a great opportunity to test your fitness on a challenging mountain course and enjoy an active day outdoors. The organizers offer training plans tailored to different experience levels, helping participants prepare optimally for the start. The event is open and welcoming to runners of varying experience.
course_highlights: A 10 km mountain course
Picturesque views around Międzybrodzie Żywieckie
A challenge for runners of varying experience levels
additional: The organizers offer training plans lasting 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level, with instructions and expert support.

name: XXXVII Cross Świętojański
location: Pogórze, Cieszyn County, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 37th Jan Marek Cross-Country Race in Pogórze is a traditional cross-country race organized by LKS Pogórze. The event takes place in the picturesque village of Pogórze, offering participants the chance to compete on a challenging cross-country course. The race is scheduled to start at 18:00, bringing sporting excitement to a summer evening. The organizers provide professional timekeeping using RFID technology to ensure accurate results.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in Pogórze
Evening start at 18:00
Professional RFID timekeeping
additional: The event is organized by LKS Pogórze. Timekeeping is electronic and uses RFID technology.

name: Malofatranská stovka
description: The Malofatranská Stovka is a mountain ultramarathon in the Malá Fatra range, featuring demanding routes with significant climbs and descents. The race is intended for experienced runners in excellent physical condition and crosses the entire range, including Krivánska Fatra and Lúčanská Fatra. The event is a registered ITRA member and serves as a qualifying race for other prestigious ultratrails. It is organized by Slovak Ultra Trail in cooperation with volunteers and partners.

name: Svätojánsky beh na Domaši
location: Domaša, Domaša, Domaša rekreačné stredisko Dobra , parkovisko pri Bogárke
description: The St. John’s Run at Domaša is a traditional running race held at the Domaša Dobrá recreational resort. Runners can choose between two courses—a short 5 km course and a long 13 km course—which run mostly along forest roads and trails with varied elevation. The event is suitable for the general public, with categories by age and gender. The organizers provide refreshment stations, changing rooms, toilets, and medical services. The atmosphere is friendly and competitive, with valuable prizes in kind for the winners.

name: Beh za zdravie – Záhorská Bystrica
location: Záhorská Bystrica, Záhorská Bystrica, pri BYS3T PARK-u, na ulici Ota Holúsku - Krče
description: The Run for Health in Záhorská Bystrica is a charity running event that brings sport together with support for health and the community. It takes place in BYS3T PARK and offers a chance to enjoy a great atmosphere and inspiring stories, while every participant contributes to a good cause. The event is open to all ages and fitness levels, promoting a healthy lifestyle and support for disadvantaged people. Run for Health was established in 2023 and each year supports selected individuals or foundations through movement.

name: Velvet Run Košice
location: Košice, Košice, pri Urbanovej veži na Hlavnej ulici.
organizer: Progres Promotion Košice, s.r.o., Maratónsky klub Košice
description: Velvet Run in Košice is a running event taking place by Urban Tower on Hlavná Street. Participants can choose from the 5 km, 10 km, and 5 km Velvet Nordic Walking events. The event is exclusively for women and offers valuable prizes to winners in various categories. The organizers provide timekeeping using the MyLaps system, and results will be published on the official websites.

name: Čergovský umirak
location: Drienica, okr. Sabinov, Drienica, okr. Sabinov, Chata Ride pub
organizer: Marián Gargalovič, Ondrej Janiga, Slavomír Uličný
description: Čergovský Umirak is a mountain race of approximately 30 km with around 1,000 metres of elevation gain, intended for trained runners. The race takes place at the Drienica recreation centre, where refreshments and additional activities for families are available. The course follows a marked hiking trail, and runners are required to wear their bib visibly attached to their chest. Safety on the course is provided by the Čergov Mountain Rescue Service, and each participant takes part at their own risk. After the last runners finish, there is a ceremony to announce the results and award prizes to the top men and women.

name: Beh cez Hornoorešanské vŕšky – Memoriál Františka Hečka
location: Horné Orešany okr. Trnava, Horné Orešany okr. Trnava, futbalový štadión
organizer: Bežecký klub Viktoria, Obecný úrad Horné Orešany
description: The Run through the Hornoorešanské Hills – František Hečko Memorial is a running race in Horné Orešany, featuring a 10,300-metre course with 100 metres of elevation gain. The course is 50% asphalt and 50% trail, making the race interesting and challenging. The race is open to all age groups, from children aged 1 and up to seniors, with categories for men, women, juniors and local runners. It is organised by Bežecký klub Viktoria together with the Municipal Office in Horné Orešany. The start for schoolchildren is at 15:35, and for everyone else at 17:00.

name: Rajec RunTour Bratislava
description: Rajec RunTour Bratislava is a family-friendly running festival offering courses for all ages and fitness levels. Participants can choose from 3, 5 and 10 km races, as well as children’s races of 500 and 1,000 metres. The event takes place at two locations and offers a race pack with everything runners need. In addition to the races, there is a varied programme of activities, refreshments on the course and at the finish, medical and driving services, and facilities including changing rooms and baggage storage.
