The whole day is designed as an experience for runners and their families, with a raffle and the option to have personal details engraved on medals.

name: Behaj lesmi Bachledová dolina
location: Bachledová dolina, Bachledová dolina, Bachledka Ski & Sun
description: Behaj lesmi Bachledová dolina is a trail run in the stunning natural surroundings of the High Tatras, offering runners a unique experience on soft terrain with fresh mountain air. The route passes through the Treetop Walk, Monkova dolina and the ridge of Spišská Magura, with the start accessed by cable car. The race is part of the Behaj lesmi series, which combines sporting achievement with support for local families and charitable causes. Behaj lesmi Bachledová dolina is a challenge for experienced runners and newcomers alike who want to experience mountain nature and unforgettable views.

name: Skyrun Kubínska
location: Kubínska hoľa, Okres Dolný Kubín, Žilinský kraj
description: Skyrun Kubínska is a mountain run in the beautiful natural surroundings of Orava, offering 24 km and 11 km courses. The race is dedicated to the memory of Barnabáš Üvegeš, and runners can enjoy challenging terrain with views of the surrounding countryside. Participants will experience a combination of mountain trails and natural scenery that makes this event a unique experience.

name: Mistrovství světa veteránů v běhu do vrchu - nahoru
description: Mistrovství světa veteránů v běhu do vrchu 2026 v Janské Lázně je prestižní mezinárodní závod veteránů v běhu do vrchu, který přiláká sportovce z více než 30 zemí. Závody se konají na náročných tratích s výrazným převýšením, které prověří vytrvalost a sílu běžců. Pořadatelem je TJ Maratonstav Úpice pod patronací měst Janské Lázně a Úpice. Registrace je otevřena a závod nabízí několik variant tratí s různou délkou a převýšením.

name: Sloupský lesní běh
description: Sloupský lesní běh je tradiční silniční běh pořádaný v malebném prostředí Sloupu v Moravském krasu. Trať měří 11,5 kilometru a je charakteristická velkým převýšením, což z ní činí náročný a atraktivní závod pro běžce. Akce má dlouholetou historii a přitahuje běžce z širokého okolí, kteří si užívají krásu přírody a sportovní atmosféru.

name: Lochovice - Plešivec
description: Lochovice - Plešivec je běžecký závod v rámci Brdského běžeckého poháru, který se koná v Lochovicích. Trať měří přibližně 5,5 km s převýšením 350 metrů, začíná 2 km asfaltem a pokračuje lesními cestami s prudším stoupáním kolem 3. kilometru. Cíl je na vrcholu Plešivce, odkud je krásný výhled. Součástí akce jsou také dětské závody a rodinný běh na podporu domácího hospice Mezi břehy.

name: Půlmaratón okolo Nového Veselí
description: Půlmaratón okolo Nového Veselí je tradiční běžecký závod pořádaný AO TJ Sokol Nové Veselí, který se koná již 25. rokem. Hlavní závod na 21,1 km vede po třikrát opakovaném obrátkovém okruhu po asfaltových cestách a silnicích třetí třídy s minimálním převýšením. Kromě hlavního závodu jsou připraveny i kratší tratě pro dorost, žáky a předškolní děti, což činí závod atraktivním pro širokou věkovou škálu běžců. Po závodě je zajištěno občerstvení a vítěz hlavního závodu získává finanční prémii. Start je tradičně na náměstí v Novém Veselí.

name: Běžím Krušnohořím Potůčky
organizer: Živé Sokolovsko z.s. a Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s.
description: Běžím Krušnohořím je běžecký a canicrossový seriál, který vás provede krásami Krušných hor. Seriál zahrnuje 6 závodů v různých destinacích, včetně Potůček, kde se koná hlavní závod na 6 až 9 km a zážitková trasa 20 až 30 km. Kromě běhu jsou připraveny i trasy pro chůzi a dětské závody. Akce je vhodná pro běžce všech úrovní, canicrossaře, děti i chodce, a nabízí možnost poznat krásnou přírodu Krušnohoří.

name: Dahlenburger Moorlauf
description: The Dahlenburg Moor Run is a popular community race with manual timekeeping, attracting around 200 participants each year. The event offers races for children, walking, and two main races over 4,600 m and 8,800 m. The course is flat and mostly paved, and the children’s races take place on the tartan track. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and picturesque setting in the Dahlenburg Moor.
course_highlights: Flat, mostly paved course
Children’s races on the tartan track
Run through the picturesque setting of the Dahlenburg Moor
additional: Race number pickup from 08:30 at the DSK sports facility/Dornweg in Dahlenburg. Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start for an additional fee of €3.00. Manual timekeeping. Showers are available at the swimming pool (admission required) or in the clubhouse. Refreshments include drink stations along the course, as well as coffee, cake, and soft drinks at the sports field. Parking is available in front of the swimming pool and the school. Courses, registration, community spirit, various types of running

name: AHRTuS-Lauf mit Ahrtal-TEAM-Cup
description: The AHRTuS Run is a club-organized race day above the Calvary Hill in Ahrweiler, prepared by TuS Ahrweiler volunteers in Quarzkaul. The program starts with races for toddlers, children and teenagers, followed by 5 km and 10 km races and a 6.2 km Nordic walking course. The adult course runs mainly along shaded forest roads and narrow trails, with some elevation gain, including a climb through the Maibach gorge with numerous wooden bridges. The 10 km race is also the final event in the Ahrtal TEAM Cup, where club teams compete for the last points. The event combines a family-friendly atmosphere with sporting competition and offers children medals, a bouncy castle, a play bus and live music at the start and finish.
course_highlights: Shaded forest roads and narrow trails
Climb through the Maibach gorge with numerous wooden bridges
10 km race as the final event in the Ahrtal TEAM Cup
additional: The event features races for toddlers, children and teenagers, a 6.2 km Nordic walking option, finisher medals for children, a bouncy castle, a play bus and live music in the start and finish area. Around 250 runners take part. In addition to the races, the event offers family activities, finisher medals, a bouncy castle, a play bus and live music in the start and finish area.

name: Eschelbronner Schreinerdorflauf
description: The Eschelbronn Carpenter Village Run takes place and offers a course of approximately 10 km on paved paths through Eschelbronn Forest and the surrounding countryside. The course is challenging but suitable for all runners. The start and finish are at the TV clubhouse at Schlossstraße 23 in Eschelbronn. There is also a walking course with timing after 7.5 km, which can also be used for the sports badge assessment.
course_highlights: Approximately 10 km on paved paths
The course runs through Eschelbronn Forest and the surrounding countryside
A challenging course profile, but suitable for everyone
additional: Paved course; start at 9:00 a.m.; registration from 8:00 a.m.; includes a walking category timed after 7.5 km

name: Schwalbacher Volkslauf - Sport gegen Armut
location: Schwalbach am Taunus, Hochtaunuskreis, Hessen, Germany
description: The Schwalbach Volkslauf is an inclusive charity run held annually by Turngemeinde 1887 e.V. Schwalbach. It offers various race distances for all age and ability groups, including 10 km, 6 km, a 3 km fun run, a 1 km handicap run and a children’s run. The event celebrates inclusion, bringing together people of different backgrounds and abilities in a welcoming atmosphere. It supports social projects and raises awareness of poverty.
course_highlights: A range of distances from 370 m to 10 km
Inclusive participation for people with and without disabilities
A welcoming atmosphere, supported by the commitment of helpers and volunteers
additional: The event features several distances, including a handicap run and a children’s run, to promote inclusion. It is supported by Lebenshilfe Main-Taunus e.V., which advocates for people with disabilities in the Main-Taunus district. The event includes multiple race distances, including races for children and people with disabilities, is sponsored by GLOBUS Eschborn, and takes place in June in Schwalbach am Taunus.

name: Tippkötter Sommerlauf in Rheine
location: Bentlager Wald, Rheine, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 11th Tippkötter Summer Run in Rheine takes place in Bentlage Forest and offers scenic, nature-rich routes with views of the salt works and Bentlage Monastery. The spectacular finish is in the FC Eintracht Rheine stadium, where all runners cross the finish line at the penalty spot. Music, professional commentary and surprises make the event a special running experience for participants of all ages. In addition to the main race, there is also a primary school race, making the event a family-friendly sports festival.
course_highlights: Scenic routes through Bentlage Forest
Routes passing the salt works and Bentlage Monastery
Finish in the FC Eintracht Rheine stadium at the penalty spot
additional: Electronic timing with a transponder bib. Race packets can be collected in the VIP room at FC Eintracht Rheine. Headphones are prohibited and may result in disqualification. Bambini race participants receive a participation medal. Trophies for the overall winners of the 2 km, 5 km, 5 km walking and 10 km races. Age-group awards with medals for the 2 km race only. Certificates can be printed via Race Result. Ample changing rooms and showers are available. Food and drinks, including fries, bratwurst, steaks and waffles, are available on site. Parking is available at Rheine Zoo. The 5 km and 10 km courses are officially measured and eligible for rankings.

name: Enorm in Form in Steckenborn
location: Sportplatz Steckenborn, Simmerath, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The ENORM in Form Volkslauf in Steckenborn offers running enthusiasts two distances: 4.7 and 10 kilometers. The race is part of the Regio Aachen Running Cup and the Rur-Eifel Volkslauf Cup. The start and finish are at the sports field in Steckenborn.
course_highlights: Well-marked road course
Courses with challenging climbs
Start and finish at the sports field in Steckenborn

name: 19. Muko-Spendenlauf Hannover
description: The 19th Muko Charity Run Hannover is an inclusive event held at the VfL Eintracht Hannover sports ground. It is open to all ages and fitness levels, whether you run, walk or stroll, with or without a disability. The goal is to raise donations for Haus Schutzengel, a parent and patient hostel for families affected by cystic fibrosis, near Hannover Medical School. Sponsors donate one euro for every lap completed on the 400-meter cinder track. The event promotes community and solidarity in the fight against cystic fibrosis.

name: 32. hella hamburg halbmarathon
description: The hella hamburg half marathon is a major running event in Hamburg, held annually on the last Sunday in June. On an officially measured, flat, paved 21.1 km course, up to 24,000 runners experience a unique running party through the Hanseatic city. The route passes around 50 sights and is accompanied by numerous event zones featuring DJ support and live music. The event is known for its great atmosphere and traffic-free course, secured by police and marshals.

name: 24-Stunden Burginsellauf
description: The 24-hour Burginsel Run in Delmenhorst is a challenging ultramarathon on a flat, approximately 1.3 km loop along Burginsel and the Graftwiesen. The event offers individual and team competitions, as well as a 6-hour run and a 3-hour schoolchildren’s run. The course is closed to traffic, illuminated and mostly shaded, making it ideal for endurance runners who want to test their limits. There is a refreshment station open around the clock during the run, as well as a tent area for rest breaks. The German 24-hour running championships are held as part of this event.

name: BikeNavy Run
description: The BikeNavy! Run is a unique running event held on the grounds of Nordholz Airfield, which is otherwise not open to the public. The course runs within the controlled airspace of the Nordholz Naval Air Base and offers participants a special atmosphere, with views of historic and modern aviation. After the race, participants can visit the AERONAUTICUM Naval Aviation and Airship Museum. The event is ideal for runners looking for an extraordinary and unforgettable running experience.

name: Chamer Stadtlauf mit 22. Halbmarathon
description: The Chamer Stadtlauf is a traditional running event in Cham (Upper Palatinate), organized by ASV Cham e.V. 1863. Alongside the city run, the 22nd half marathon also takes place, attracting runners from the region and beyond. The event places great emphasis on the health and safety of all participants and provides a sporting platform for different age and ability groups. The race runs through the city of Cham and combines sporting ambition with a sense of community.
course_highlights: Route through the city of Cham with an urban atmosphere
Half-marathon distance as a sporting challenge
Event organized by the region’s largest sports club, ASV Cham
additional: Registration for the city run usually closes in mid-September. Late registrations are not possible after the registration deadline. The event is organized by ASV Cham e.V., which, with approximately 3,259 members and 24 departments, is the largest sports club in the region.

name: Halderner Volkslauf
description: The Haldern People’s Run is a long-standing event that brings young and old together and fosters a sense of community among friends and families. The event is taking place again, with the half marathon remaining a permanent part of the program due to the positive response. It offers a welcoming atmosphere for runners of all abilities and invites everyone to take part.

name: Internationaler Trierer Stadtlauf
location: Trier city centre, Trier, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
description: The 40th International Trier City Run takes place in downtown Trier. The new course winds through the historic setting of Germany’s oldest city, past landmarks such as the Porta Nigra and the Imperial Baths. There are suitable distances for all ability levels, from the children’s Bambini Run to the half marathon as the flagship event. The city run combines a sporting challenge with community spirit and a special atmosphere in one of Germany’s most beautiful cities.

name: Kilometer für Kinder
description: Kilometer für Kids is an annual charity event launched in 2014 to support children and young people in need through sporting challenges. Participants rack up kilometers by running, cycling, or swimming, then make a donation for each kilometer completed. The project promotes not only sport, but also social cohesion and the joy of being active. Its aim is to give children renewed courage after difficult experiences and to highlight the importance of physical activity in society.

name: Kreuzwertheimer Landschaftsläufe
description: The Kreuzwertheim scenic runs offer three varied races for different age groups. The 14 km “Run to Himmelreich” takes runners through a nature conservation area and vineyards, with challenging climbs. The new 7 km run around Kaffelstein features gentle climbs and beautiful views of the Main Valley. Children and teenagers can take part in a hilly 2.2 km forest run. The event is family-friendly, with team rankings, prizes and a floral surprise at the finish.

name: Losheimer Trailfest
distance_verbose: 101 km, 75 km, 52 km, 23 km, 13 km, 6 km
description: The Losheim Trailfest offers a diverse trail-running experience in the Saar-Hunsrück-Hochwald premium hiking region. Participants can look forward to spectacular trails featuring bizarre rock formations, winding streams, raised bogs and romantic stream valleys. The ultra-distance routes have been expanded: the T 60 has become the 100-kilometre T 100, and the T 45 the 50-kilometre T 50; both routes lead around the Saarschleife. There is an age-appropriate Youth Trail for young runners, while the T Ch Challenge lets runners experience different routes over two days. The event site at Losheim Seegarten is a great place to relax and celebrate.

name: Ohndorfer Volkslauf
description: The Ohndorf Fun Run is a family-friendly running event held annually in Ohndorf and is part of the Schaumburg Running Series. The event offers a welcoming atmosphere for runners of all ages and ability levels. Online registration is open until race day, with on-site registration available up to 30 minutes before the start. The run is attracting increasing numbers of participants and offers a great opportunity to exercise together and enjoy a sense of community.

name: Rems-Murr 24h Charity-Lauf
description: The 7th Rems-Murr 24h Charity Run takes place at Herbert-Winter-Stadion in Winnenden. The event invites running enthusiasts, families, clubs and teams to complete laps for 24 hours—whether running, walking or strolling. The run supports Clowns mit Herz Rems-Murr e.V. and Zeltlager Salbengehren at Ebnisee, with donations raised going to these organizations. Taking part matters more than performance, and anyone can participate with a sponsor or as part of a team.

name: run + fun in Tuttlingen
description: run&fun Tuttlingen is a versatile running event held in Tuttlingen. It offers a wide range of competitions, including the B. Braun Marathon, half marathon, relay races, Nordic walking, and children’s and youth races. The courses are mostly flat, running along the Danube and through the city, providing a fast and enjoyable running experience. The event is organized by several Tuttlingen clubs and the city, creating a friendly, family-oriented and athletic atmosphere.

name: Seester Sternenlauf
description: The Seester Sternenlauf is being held for the tenth time and is a charity run in support of the Kinder-Hospiz Sternenbrücke in Hamburg. The event offers various distances for runners, walkers, Nordic walkers, and Bambinis, including a special 10 km loop through the historic Lindenallee at Gut Seestermühe. Grilled sausages, coffee, and cake will be available, and the route will be lined with decorated streets and a great atmosphere. The organizing team looks forward to welcoming many participants and spectators to this fun and successful event.

name: Steps for Life
description: Steps for Life is a charity run organized by SV Würtingen for the 20th time to support a relief project. In its anniversary year, 2026, kilometers will be logged to help build a children’s home in the remote mountain region around Musikot, Nepal. The event offers 4, 8 and 15-kilometer routes through the beautiful surroundings of the Swabian Alb. Times are recorded using a professional timing system, and there is also a Kids Race and a Bambini Run on Raceday. Participants can choose between the virtual running period from June 19 to 27 and Raceday on June 28.

name: Trainingslauf Bottwartal-Marathon
location: Steppi-Kreisverkehr, Steinheim an der Murr, Germany
distance_verbose: 51 km, Marathon, 32 km, Halbmarathon, 10 km, 5 km
description: The Bottwartal Marathon is a running event in one of the most beautiful landscapes in southern Germany, taking runners through gentle vineyard slopes, picturesque historic town centres and an exhilarating atmosphere along the course. The route is a loop through the southern and northern Bottwartal, starting and finishing at the Steppi roundabout in Steinheim an der Murr. The marathon is open to adults aged 18 and over and offers a special running experience for beginners and ambitious runners alike. The event also includes other races, such as a half marathon, relay marathon and ultra run, all of which can be entered through the partner Datasport.
course_highlights: Loop through the southern and northern Bottwartal, starting and finishing in Steinheim a.d. Murr
The course passes through historic town centres such as Beilstein, Oberstenfeld and Großbottwar
A flat finish at the Steppi roundabout in Steinheim, ideal for a strong final sprint
additional: Race packs are available at Blankensteinhalle in Steinheim a.d. Murr. Collection is on Saturday from 09:00 to 17:00 and on Sunday from 07:30 until approximately one hour before the race. Parking is available at Wellarium and in nearby areas. Shuttle buses run from Riedstadion to the start at the Steppi roundabout. A bus transfer from Steinheim to Gronau is available for the half marathon. On the event day, a large area of the Bottwartal is closed to traffic.

name: Uni-Lauf Bamberg
description: The Uni-Lauf Bamberg is an open public race and will take place for the 12th time in 2026. It features several race distances, including a 10 km main race, which also serves as the Bavarian University Championships and the Upper Franconian Championships, a 10 km relay, a 2 km girls’ race, and a 500 m children’s race. The flat, officially measured course runs through ERBA Park, along the Main-Danube Canal, through the Hain and Bamberg’s city center, with picturesque views of historic buildings. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and welcomes female runners of all ages and ability levels.

name: Weiner Family Run 2026
description: It is aimed at runners, walkers, children and Bambinis, and offers various distances from approximately 500 metres to 10 kilometres. The focus is on the joy of movement and sharing the experience in a relaxed atmosphere. The start and finish area is in Sparkassenpark Weiner, and the routes lead through the Weiner farming community. Participants can also look forward to a family-friendly programme with commentary and refreshments.

name: Zwiefalter Berglauf
description: The 20th Zwiefalter Berglauf takes place in Zwiefalten and offers runners of all ability levels a varied program. The event includes several races, including the 9.8 km Great Mountain Run, the 6 km Sparkassen Run, a 6 km Fun Run (Nordic Walking), and children’s races. The course passes through idyllic countryside, including some protected areas, and offers a great opportunity to exercise together and have fun. The event is for all ages and encourages people to stay active as a community.

name: Wielka Pętla Izerska w ramach Izerskiego Weekendu Biegowego
location: Szklarska Poręba, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Great Jizera Loop is a scenic half marathon held as part of the Jizera Running Weekend in Szklarska Poręba. The course runs through the town streets and along trails in the Jizera Mountains, offering runners a chance to connect with nature and enjoy mountain scenery. The event combines recreation and sport, promoting physical activity and the popularity of running. Participants use electronic timekeeping, and the time limit for completing the course is 3 hours.

name: XVIII Bieg w pogoni za żubrem
description: The 15th Bieg w Pogoni za Żubrem is an annual running event held in Niepołomice, attracting runners across various distances. The course passes through picturesque surroundings, giving participants the opportunity to compete amid beautiful scenery and a passion for sport. The event is a great way for the whole family to spend time actively, with separate races for children and adults. The organizers ensure professional event management and a welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: An 8-kilometer race route through Niepołomice
A longer 15-kilometer race with a varied course profile
Special races for children tailored to their age and abilities
additional: The event includes 8 km and 15 km races, as well as children’s races. A detailed information guide is available in PDF format at https://biegwpogonizazubrem.pl/Informator2026.pdf. No start times or details about start waves or participant limits are provided.

name: Izery Ultra-Trail
description: Izery Ultra-Trail is a unique mountain race held in the heart of the scenic Jizera Mountains, with the start and finish in Świeradów-Zdrój. Routes of varying lengths and difficulty lead through wild, little-known areas, offering runners unforgettable views and challenges. The event attracts both experienced ultramarathon runners and trail enthusiasts eager to take on demanding terrain and enjoy the beauty of nature. The organizers provide full support at aid stations and specify mandatory equipment to ensure participants’ safety and comfort.
course_highlights: Routes pass through wild, little-known areas of the Jizera Mountains
Start and finish in the heart of Świeradów-Zdrój, in Spa Park
Significant elevation gain: up to +2,650 m on the longest, 100 km route
additional: Start and finish in Spa Park in Świeradów-Zdrój. Routes have aid stations (6 on the 100 km route, 4 on the 50 km route). Mandatory equipment includes a water cup, a cap or buff, a rain jacket, a water container with a capacity of at least 1 liter, an elastic bandage, and a sterile dressing. Runners receive a race bib with a chip, route maps, and a GPS device with the route loaded. A working phone must be available for contact throughout the race.

name: Kresowe Trail #7
description: Kresowe Trail is a series of intimate off-road races organized by the Kresowe Marathons Foundation, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity amid the natural surroundings of eastern Poland. The series consists of several stages held on different courses with varying levels of difficulty, featuring two main distances: Szpurt (6–8 km) and Wertep (17–21 km). The events are characterized by environmental care, a limited number of participants, and an atmosphere of passion, competition, and friendship. Races usually start in the morning, and participants can expect professional organization, timekeeping, and prizes in various categories.
course_highlights: Off-road courses of approximately 6–8 km (Szpurt) and 17–21 km (Wertep)
Carefully marked trails with aid stations along the longer-distance course
Races take place in the scenic regions of Podlasie and surrounding areas, with respect for nature
additional: Starts are organized in corrals based on results from the previous season. The race package includes a race number with a timing chip valid for the entire season, a hot recovery meal with a vegetarian option, medical support, aid stations along the course and at the finish, a commemorative medal (for early registration), photography services, and prizes for the top athletes in the OPEN and age-group categories. Littering on the course is strictly prohibited.

name: Roztoczański Festiwal Biegowy
description: The Roztocze Running Festival 2026 is one of the largest running events in the Roztocze region, organized by the Lubaczów Municipality. The three-day festival takes place in Basznia Dolna, at Kresowa Osada, the start and finish venue for all races and Nordic walking events. Participants can choose from ten different distances, ranging from night races and Nordic walking events to an ultramarathon and half marathon, on routes through the picturesque Lubaczów region. The event combines sporting competition with a festival atmosphere, attracting both experienced runners and amateurs.

name: Łabiszyński Bieg Świętojański
description: The Łabiszyn St. John’s Eve Run is an annual running event held in Łabiszyn, with the start and finish at the Municipal Stadium. The 5 km main race starts at 7:00, followed by children’s and youth races in four age categories. Main-race participants receive a medal and a sweet snack, while younger runners receive a medal and a surprise. The awards ceremony for the top runners takes place after the competitions. The run is part of a running series and offers race packs to the first registrants.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Municipal Stadium in Łabiszyn
5 km main-race route
Children’s and youth races in 4 age categories
additional: After the main race, participants receive a medal and a sweet snack, while children and youth receive a medal and a surprise. The awards ceremony for the top runners takes place after all races have ended. Race packs are available to the first registrants.

name: 3 Otwarty Bieg Sejmowy o Puchar Marszałka
Bieg Powitania Lata
location: Strzelce Wielkie, Pajęczno County, Łódź Voivodeship, Poland

name: Bieg Twierdzy Kraków
description: Bieg Twierdzy Kraków is a cross-country race held in Reduta Park in Kraków, offering 5 km and 10 km courses. The route follows mainly paths and forest tracks, with one significant uphill section, combining sport with history. After the race, participants and their companions can tour historic sites of the former Kraków Fortress with a guide, making the event a unique combination of physical activity and education. The race’s mission is to promote running and raise awareness of local heritage.
course_highlights: Cross-country route along paths and forest tracks
One substantial uphill section on the route
Guided tours of historic Kraków Fortress sites after the race
additional: After the race, participants can take a tour with a professional guide of sites belonging to the former Kraków Fortress, including forts, earthworks, caverns, field batteries, and shelters. The race route is off-road and green, with history in the background. Unique trophies made from 100-year-old bricks are awarded to the top competitors in each category. After the race, participants and their companions can take a guided tour of sites belonging to the former Kraków Fortress, including forts, earthworks, caverns, field batteries, and shelters.

name: V RUNda Żubra Biegi i Nordic Walking
Mistrovství světa veteránů v běhu do vrchu – nahoru
location: Janské Lázně, Janské Lázně, nám. Svobody – kolonáda Janské Lázně
description: The 2026 World Masters Mountain Running Championships is a prestigious international mountain running event for masters athletes, held in the picturesque surroundings of Janské Lázně. The races feature several challenging courses with significant elevation gain, testing the endurance and strength of runners from more than 30 countries. The event is organized by TJ Maratonstav Úpice under the auspices of the towns of Janské Lázně and Úpice. Registration is open, and runners can look forward to professional event organization and sponsor support.

name: Beh údolím Idy
description: The Run through the Ida Valley is a traditional race organized by the Košice-Šaca City District and the municipality of Malá Ida. The race takes place in the pleasant surroundings of the cultural center in Košice-Šaca and offers the opportunity to compete in various age categories. The entry fee is symbolic, while local runners can take part for free. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle in the region.

name: Beh na Poludňový Grúň
location: Terchová okr. Žilina, Terchová okr. Žilina, Vrátna Paseky o 10,00 hod. na údolnej stanici štvorsedačky
organizer: Občianske združenie Grúň, Chata na Grúni
description: The Run to Poludňový Grúň is a mountain running race in the picturesque Vrátna Valley, in the Malá Fatra mountain range. The course crosses challenging mountain terrain, with beautiful views of peaks such as Poludňový Grúň, Stoh, and Veľký Rozsutec. The race is ideal for nature lovers and mountain runners who want to experience a unique atmosphere and challenge in the heart of Malá Fatra. The organizers warmly invite you to enjoy this sporting event in the beautiful surroundings of Terchová.

name: MUM - Moravský Ultramaraton / Boskovická etapa
description: MUM - Moravský Ultramaraton je mezinárodní běžecký etapový závod, který se koná v Boskovicích a je součástí sedmidenního ultramaratonu na sedm maratonů. Tento závod je známý svou náročností a dlouhou tradicí, přitahuje běžce, kteří hledají výzvu v podobě etapového běhu. Boskovická etapa nabízí běžcům možnost zažít krásy moravské přírody a zároveň otestovat svou vytrvalost v náročném terénu. Závod je vhodný pro zkušené ultramaratonce, kteří chtějí poměřit síly s ostatními v prestižním mezinárodním závodě.

name: Montagslauf Rund um Mackenzell
description: The Montagslauf Rund um Mackenzell is a traditional fun run held in the idyllic surroundings of Hünfeld-Mackenzell. The event offers several distances, including a Schülerlauf, 5.3 km, 10 km, and a 14.3 km course with an additional loop. The routes pass through varied landscapes, with refreshment points along the way. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere and medical support from the German Red Cross. Showers are available after the run, and Nordic walking is also offered without timekeeping.

name: Sonnwendlauf Großostheim
description: The Sonnwendlauf Großostheim is a traditional running event that attracts many running enthusiasts from the region each year. It offers various distances for different ability levels, from children's races to classic 10 km races, and is aimed at competitive athletes, recreational runners, and families alike. The course passes through the scenic surroundings of Großostheim, combining a sporting challenge with a nature experience and a family-friendly atmosphere. The race is a regular fixture on the regional sporting calendar and creates a special atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Courses pass through fields and include gentle climbs
Great views around Großostheim
A variety of distances from 750 m to 10 km
additional: Start times vary by distance: the 10 km and 6 km races start at 09:00, the beginner and youth race (1.2 km) at 10:30, and the children's races (750 m) between 10:45 and 12:00. The race is supported by the regional Schlappeseppel brewery, known for quality and conviviality.

name: Tempo Makers Run Plzeň v Pytli - červen
description: Tempo Makers Osmicka je běžecký závod v Plzni, který nabízí trať dlouhou 8 km. Závod je určen pro muže a ženy ve věkových kategoriích od 16 let výše. Start i cíl jsou na stejném místě, s registrací a výdejem čísel od 17:00 do 17:45. Po závodě probíhá vyhlášení nejlepších běžců a losování tomboly. Kapacita závodu je omezena na 75 startujících a každý účastník startuje na vlastní nebezpečí.

name: Lachtan
location: Zoo Praha, U Trojského zámku 3/120, Prague 7, Prague, Česko
description: Lachtan je v Praze 6, Praha, spojován především s chovem a ochranou jihoafrického lachtana v Zoo Praha. Kromě toho se zde koná i divadelní představení s názvem 'Bílý lachtan', které je určeno především pro děti a školní skupiny, a nabízí interaktivní zážitky s ekologickou tématikou. Tento program je vhodný pro rodiny i školy, které chtějí spojit vzdělávání s zábavou a podpořit povědomí o ochraně přírody.

name: Kolem Libotína
description: Běh Kolem Libotína je tradiční závod pořádaný Atletickým klubem Emila Zátopka Kopřivnice, který se koná v okolí Štramberka. Závod nabízí 6,5 km dlouhý okruh s náročným profilem, který byl v posledních letech upraven a přinesl nové traťové rekordy. Akce je součástí Lašské běžecké ligy a přitahuje běžce různých kategorií, kteří si užívají krásné přírodní prostředí a sportovní atmosféru. Po závodě jsou vyhlašováni vítězové v kategoriích a pro všechny účastníky je připravena tombola. Pořadatelem je Atletický klub Emila Zátopka Kopřivnice, který se stará o hladký průběh a podporu běžecké komunity.

name: 36. Göttinger Altstadtlauf
description: The Göttingen Old Town Run is a long-standing running event in downtown Göttingen, taking place for the 36th time in 2026. The event combines running with the special charm of the old town and attracts runners of all ages. In addition to the main race, there are various school races and a popular corporate race with team scoring. The course leads through the historic city center and offers a lively atmosphere full of excitement and activity.

name: AOK Firmenlauf Stuttgart
description: The 19th AOK Stuttgart Company Run takes place at 6:30 p.m. at GAZI Stadium in Stuttgart-Degerloch. This popular corporate event combines team spirit and exercise, with a route through the city. In addition to the run, the event offers a varied program featuring a DJ, a warm-up session and award ceremonies. Rauschenberger provides catering, and all participants receive a complimentary VVS ticket for their journey to the event.

name: MUM - Moravský Ultramaraton / Lomnická etapa
description: MUM - Moravský Ultramaraton je mezinárodní běžecký etapový závod, který se koná na sedm po sobě jdoucích dní, přičemž Lomnická etapa je jednou z jeho částí. Tento závod patří mezi nejnáročnější ultramaratony v České republice a nabízí běžcům výzvu v podobě dlouhých tratí a náročného terénu v oblasti Jihomoravského kraje. Závod je určen pro zkušené ultramaratonské běžce, kteří chtějí otestovat svou vytrvalost a sílu v krásné přírodě. Lomnická etapa probíhá v okolí Olešnice a Lomnice u Tišnova a je součástí celého ultramaratonského seriálu.

name: MUM - Moravský Ultramaraton / Bystřická etapa
description: MUM - Moravský Ultramaraton je mezinárodní běžecký etapový závod, který se koná na sedm maratonů v sedm po sobě jdoucích dnů. Bystřická etapa je jednou z jeho částí, která nabízí náročný a dlouhý běh v malebném prostředí Moravy. Závod je určen pro zkušené ultramaratonce, kteří hledají výzvu v podobě dlouhých etap a krásné přírody. Přijďte si vyzkoušet síly v tomto prestižním ultramaratonu a zažijte jedinečnou atmosféru etapového závodu.

name: Drevenacker Volksbank Abendlauf
description: The Drevenacker Volksbank Evening Run is a traditional running event in Hünxe-Drevenack, organized by the TUS Drevenack TL-Abteilung e.V. Various races take place on the event day, a Friday in July, including an officially measured 10 km road race, a 5 km jogging race with a youth category, a 5 km non-competitive walk, and children’s and toddlers’ races. The course runs through the scenic surrounding area, with the start and finish at the sports field on Buschweg. The event offers suitable competitions for all age groups and professional timing by the TAF Timing Team.
course_highlights: Officially measured 10 km course with age groups in five-year increments
5 km jogging race with a separate youth category and an officially measured course
Children’s and toddlers’ races for children and young people, with age-appropriate distances
additional: The start and finish are at the sports field on Buschweg. Women start at the tennis clubhouse, and men start in the gym on Buschweg. A €2.00 deposit is charged for the timing chip for each race number and refunded when it is returned. Late registrations are possible on the event day from 16:30 until 45 minutes before the respective start, subject to capacity. Every participant receives a certificate; prizes are awarded to the top three finishers in each age group. Online registration is available; the event is part of the Lippe-Issel-Cup; results are available online.

name: Internationaler Stadtlauf Saarburg
description: The International Saarburg City Run takes place for the 11th time and offers runners a fast course through Saarburg’s picturesque town centre. The route passes through the Old Town Tunnel, follows the Saar and climbs up to Kruterberg, with the start and finish at the former bus station near the leisure and indoor swimming pool. The event attracts around 800 participants each year and concludes with an awards ceremony on the Fruchtmarkt stage as part of the Saarburg Market Days. There are several distances for different runners, from the Bambini Run to the 10 km main race.
course_highlights: A fast course through Saarburg’s picturesque town centre
The route passes through the Old Town Tunnel and follows the Saar
The finish straight is on Heckingstraße, with the awards ceremony on the Fruchtmarkt stage
additional: There are several distances: Bambini Run (0.5 km), Youth Run (1.8 km), Company and Fun Run (5.3 km), and Main Run (10 km). The fastest runners are honoured at Saarburg Gymnasium. The event traditionally takes place on Saturday evening alongside the Saarburg Market Days. In addition to the races, the event also offers team competitions for companies and is a social highlight of the Saarburg Market Days.

name: Marburger Nachtmarathon
description: The Marburg Night Marathon is taking place for the 27th time and is the largest running event in the Central Hesse region. The event offers a classic marathon, a half marathon, and a relay marathon with up to four participants. The course runs through Marburg’s picturesque old town and along the Lahn, offering a flat, record-eligible loop with views of Landgrafenschloss and St. Elizabeth’s Church. The race starts at 7 p.m. in a festive atmosphere on the historic market square, with the finish at the university stadium. All participants receive a high-quality medal featuring a distinctive Marburg building each year.
course_highlights: Flat, record-eligible loop
The course runs through the old town and along the Lahn
Views of Landgrafenschloss and St. Elizabeth’s Church
additional: The relay marathon consists of four runners, each covering a leg of about ten kilometers. The first relay runner starts on the market square, and the exchange zone is on Frankfurter Straße. Each relay team receives a race number attached to an elastic race-number belt. Safety pins are provided at registration. The number of participants is limited to ensure safety and an enjoyable running experience. The start and finish are at the university stadium, about 1 km from the starting point.

name: Rotenburger Strandfestlauf - Rotenburg rennt
location: Rotenburg an der Fulda, Hesse, Germany
price_range: 1 Euro Startgeld für Bambini, vergünstigte Preise für Schüler- und Jugendläufe
description: The Rotenburg Strandfest Run takes place every year on the first Friday in July as part of the traditional Heimat- und Strandfest in Rotenburg an der Fulda. The flat, fast course runs through the town centre and offers various events for young runners, main-race participants, elite runners and teams, as well as walking. New features include precisely measured school and elite races, plus the Beer Mile, where having fun is the main focus. The event combines sporting ambition with a friendly, social atmosphere and is a highlight of the regional running calendar.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course through Rotenburg town centre
School race: exactly 1,248 metres—a tribute to the year Rotenburg was founded
Elite race over 1.609 km (land mile), with entry requirements
additional: No on-site registration is possible; advance registration is available only through specialist portals. The 5 km and 10 km courses are no longer offered; instead, the main race covers a 1.5 km course five times. The Beer Mile has no timing and includes four alcohol-free beer breaks at 400 m intervals. Elite race entry requirements: men, 03:10 min/km; women, 03:30 min/km. Events for young runners, main-race participants, elite runners and teams, plus walking. Preparation through a running group; supported by Sparkasse.

name: Brunnenfestlauf
description: The 17th Brunnenfest Run in Reute offers runners a varied program on paved local roads. The main race is an officially measured 10 km course with timing and classification according to DLO categories. There are also children’s and youth races, school relays, a fun run, and Nordic walking. The event is family-friendly, with shower and changing facilities and refreshments at the village square.

name: Traunreuter Stadtlauf
description: The 23rd Stadtlauf Traunreut is a major recreational sports event in Traunreut, Bavaria. The course is a flat, measured, paved 7 km loop starting and finishing at Rathausplatz. The event is open to runners of all ages and includes Bambini and relay races alongside the main race. Drinks and food stalls at Stadtplatz will be available, and an after-race party will provide entertainment.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - červenec
description: Běh na 2 míle v pražské Stromovce je otevřený závod na 3,2 km určený pro všechny věkové kategorie a úrovně běžců, včetně dětí do 12 let, které běží 1,6 km. Závod je ideální pro ty, kdo běhají pro radost, chtějí si zlepšit osobní rekord nebo si jen příjemně zaběhat v krásném prostředí parku. Po doběhu čeká na každého účastníka teplý lívanec se skořicí. Trať vede po asfaltových cestách Stromovky, dospělí běží dvě kola, děti jedno kolo. Čas je měřen každému a výsledky jsou zveřejňovány online.

name: Třtická punčocha
description: Třtická Punčocha je tradiční letní běžecký závod pořádaný od roku 1980 v obci Třtice, vždy první červencovou neděli. Závod má délku 8,8 km a účastní se ho běžci z celých Čech. Původně určený pro děti, dnes nabízí kategorie i pro dospělé podle věku a pohlaví. Kromě letního běhu se v obci koná také Vánoční běh o délce 4,8 km, který se běží 26. prosince. Závody jsou oblíbené a mají dlouholetou tradici s výsledky a fotografiemi archivovanými na webu obce.

name: Náchod - Dobrošov
description: Vojenská tvrz Dobrošov se nachází nedaleko města Náchod v oblasti Kladské pomezí v Orlických horách. Tvrz je významnou součástí československého opevnění severní hranice a nabízí návštěvníkům prohlídky hlavních srubů, muničního skladu, kasáren a ošetřovny. Celou pevností vede naučná stezka, která návštěvníky provede linií opevnění až do lázní Běloves. Okolí pevnosti je bohaté na turistické a cyklistické trasy, které umožňují poznat krásy Orlických hor a okolních historických měst.

name: MUM - Moravský Ultramaraton / Cimrmanova etapa
location: Lomnice, Tišnov District, South Moravian Region, Česko
description: MUM - Moravský Ultramaraton / Cimrmanova etapa je poslední sedmá etapa mezinárodního etapového závodu, který se koná v Lomnici u Tišnova. Závod nabízí náročný a různorodý terén s převýšením 740 metrů, což představuje výzvu pro zkušené ultramaratonce. Start je intervalový podle pořadí z předchozích šesti závodů, což zvyšuje soutěživost a napětí. Tento závod je ideální pro běžce, kteří hledají kombinaci technické náročnosti a etapového závodění v krásné přírodě Jihomoravského kraje.

name: Schwandorfer Charity Stadtlauf
organizer: Alpin Ski · Triathlon · Laufsport · Schwimmen · Nordic Walking · Radsport · Skilanglauf · Snowboarding
description: The Schwandorf Charity City Run is being held for the 20th time and offers runners of all ages a varied selection of events. The event combines sporting ambition with social commitment, as net proceeds go to local non-profit organisations such as Wasserwacht Schwandorf and Bund Naturschutz Schwandorf. Events range from the Bambini run to student and main races, as well as Nordic walking and a Run & Bike team competition. All participants receive a charity medal and an online certificate, and medical support helps ensure safety. The event is family-friendly and also features a Stutz’n relay rally as a fun special.
course_highlights: A variety of distances from 200 m to 10 km, including Bambini, student and main races, and Run & Bike
Routes can be viewed digitally on Google Maps, and the Zwergerllauf takes place at Sepp-Simon-Stadion
Nordic walking with timing and walking without poles are also available
additional: Late registration and race-number collection are possible at the event on the day, during various time slots until 13:30. All participants receive a Charity City Run medal and an online certificate. Medical support is provided by Johanniter Ortsverband Schwandorf. Children and students receive small surprises. Drinks, bratwurst rolls, coffee and cake are sold for charity. Family-friendly; net proceeds go to Wasserwacht Schwandorf, Bund Naturschutz Schwandorf and the self-help group for people affected by post-COVID, post-vaccine conditions and ME/CFS.

name: Oberlichtenauer Sommerlauf
description: The 44th Oberlichtenau Summer Run is taking place, inviting runners of all ages to a sporting event that has brought together the Saxon running community and guests from near and far for more than four decades. The day begins with children’s races over 800 metres and 2.2 kilometres for the U12 and U14 age groups. These are followed by the recreational run of approximately 5 kilometres and the challenging 13-kilometre main race, which tests stamina and agility with steep climbs and fast descents over the Keulenberg. The running group of Sportgemeinschaft Oberlichtenau looks forward to welcoming all participants.
course_highlights: Children’s race: 2 laps around the sports field (800 metres)
U12 and U14 children’s race: 2.2 km along Keulenberstraße
Main race: 13 km with challenging climbs and descents over the Keulenberg
additional: The event day starts with the children’s race at 09:45, followed by a new children’s race for U12 and U14 at 09:55. The awards ceremony takes place immediately after the children’s races. The recreational run starts at 10:25 and the main race at 10:30. The running group is led by Patrick Thomschke (department head) and Jens Schäfer (manager). The event usually takes place in summer temperatures of around 23°C. Registration and further details are available on the official website. The race is a great opportunity for runners to achieve personal bests and experience the beautiful Saxon countryside.

name: 10. Hochkippenlauf
description: The 10th Hochkippenlauf takes place at Stadion Profen and is organized by SV Eintracht Profen. Various races are offered for different age groups, from a Bambini run to distances for young people and 10 km races for adults. The event is part of a sports festival. The race is a great opportunity for sports enthusiasts of all ages to compete in a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 400 m Bambini run (one lap of the stadium)
Distances of 2.1 km, 4.2 km and 5 km for young people
10 km race for U18, U20 and adults
additional: The Bambini runs take place over one lap of the stadium. The race takes place at Stadion Profen, with warm and sunny weather in July. It offers a family-friendly atmosphere and the chance to win prizes in various categories.

name: 46. Küstenkanallauf
description: The event offers 22 km, 11 km and 5.5 km races, as well as walking and hiking routes. The scenic course runs along the Küstenkanal and is suitable for runners of all ability levels. This traditional event is organized by KC Ikenbrügge von 1971 e. V.
course_highlights: Scenic route along the Küstenkanal
A choice of distances: 5.5 km, 11 km and 22 km
Walking and hiking routes available
additional: Start times: Runners in the 5.5 km, 11 km and 22 km races start at 17:00; walking and hiking start at 16:15. Register using the online form on the website or through the contact channel, providing your name, year of birth, club and town. This is a local event with a friendly atmosphere that attracts numerous runners from the region each year. Registration, results and further details are available on the official website and in the event announcement.

name: 9. Bremer Brückenlauf
price_range: ab 8,00 € bis 45,00 € je nach Kategorie und Frühbucherstatus
description: The Bremen Bridges Run invites runners to experience Bremen from a unique perspective. The course crosses bridges spanning the Weser, the Kleine Weser and the Werdersee, offering a maritime atmosphere in the heart of the city. A range of distances is available, including a half marathon, 10 km run, 5 km run, a special 5 km underwear run, and children’s races. The event promises good spirits, a summery atmosphere and breathtaking views of Bremen and the Weser.
course_highlights: Run across several bridges in Bremen
Course crosses the Weser, Kleine Weser and Werdersee
Officially measured courses eligible for record lists
additional: Optional medal engraving (10 € for adults, 7.50 € for children). Start times vary by distance, from 16:30 (underwear run) to 18:15 (5 km and 10 km walking). All main races are measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and eligible for record lists. Children’s races are privately measured. An alphabetical finish list is provided for walkers and Nordic walkers. Conditions of participation and age categories are clearly defined. Circuit course with official measurement, age categories, competition categories, medal engraving available, including Nordic walking.

name: Benkhauser Schlosslauf
location: Schloss Benkhausen, Espelkamp, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
price_range: 600 m Kinderlauf kostenlos, 2 km Schülerlauf 4,00 € (bis 14.06.), 6,5 km 12,00 € (bis 14.06.), 10,8 km 12,00 € (bis 14.06.), 20,8 km 12,00 € (bis 14.06.), Preise steigen nach dem 14.06.
description: The Benkhausen Castle Run is a sporting event taking place for the second time in 2026, set against the unique backdrop of Benkhausen Castle. The event offers varied routes along paved side roads and footpaths in beautiful Benkhausen. The start and finish are at Benkhausen Castle Square, where race bibs are also distributed. The event is open to runners of all ages and includes several distances, including children’s and schoolchildren’s races.
course_highlights: Running routes along paved side roads and footpaths in beautiful Benkhausen
Start and finish at historic Benkhausen Castle Square
Kilometre markers along the route for guidance
additional: Late entries are possible on race day from 12:30 until 60 minutes before the start, provided the participant limit has not been reached, for an additional fee of €2. The number of participants is limited to 200 runners per main race (6.5 km, 10.8 km, 20.8 km), with a maximum of 600 registrations overall. Timing uses disposable chip technology. Shower and changing facilities are available at Benkhausen Primary School. Children’s and schoolchildren’s races award medals to all participants and have no timing or awards ceremony. The well-known announcer Heino Krüger accompanies the races. Late entries are possible on site; the participant limit for the main races is 200 per distance, with a maximum of 600 registrations overall; chip timing; event held as part of a sports festival.

name: Eicherscheider Heckenlauf mit Halbmarathon 2026
description: The 46th Eicherscheid Hedge Run, including a half marathon, takes place in Simmerath-Eicherscheid in the Eifel region. The races pass through the hilly beech-hedge landscape around Eicherscheid, a Federal Gold Village on the edge of Eifel National Park. Events are offered over 5 km, 10 km and the half marathon (21.0975 km), each on a hilly circuit. Children’s and youth races are also part of the event. The start times are staggered through the afternoon and evening, allowing for a relaxed experience.
course_highlights: Hilly circuits through the beech-hedge landscape
Run through the Federal Gold Village of Eicherscheid on the edge of Eifel National Park
Family-friendly event with children’s and youth races
additional: The races have staggered start times: 5 km at 15:45, 10 km at 16:35 and the half marathon at 18:00. All races share the same finish. Exact finish location details require RUNME Premium. Children’s and youth races are also offered; further information is available in the organizer’s official race announcement. The event is family-friendly, with start times varying by distance. Registration is through the official website.

name: Fichtelgebirgsmarathon mit Halbmarathon und 10km-Lauf
description: The Fichtelgebirge Marathon is the largest running event in the Fichtelgebirge, with three different courses for runners of all ages. The races feature challenging elevation gain and beautiful scenery, giving participants a unique experience in nature. For over 20 years, the event has been organized by sports-loving members of the IfL-Fichtelgebirge club, who ensure everything runs smoothly. Online registration is available.
course_highlights: Marathon: 42 km with 800 m of elevation gain
Half marathon: 21 km with 400 m of elevation gain
10 km race with 225 m of elevation gain and a finish in Kurpark Bad Alexandersbad
additional: There are three courses with different elevation profiles and distances. All courses finish in Kurpark Bad Alexandersbad. Detailed course information is available on Komoot. The event is known for its challenging course with elevation gain and the beautiful natural scenery of the Fichtelgebirge.

name: Hochstraßenlauf
description: The Hochstraßenlauf in Weisendorf is a long-standing running event, taking place for the 40th time. The start and finish are at the Museum of the Weisendorf Local History Association. Due to the high temperatures in recent years, the start time has been moved to the morning to provide better conditions for runners. The event is open to runners of all ages and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with scoring for the Weisendorf town championship.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Weisendorf Local History Museum
Run through the area around Weisendorf on scenic routes
Various age groups and scoring for the Weisendorf town championship
additional: Please bring safety pins for your race number. The terms of participation and the data protection form must be brought for children under 16. To be included in the Weisendorf town championship, enter the postcode 91085 and register accordingly. The event takes place in the morning to avoid the heat and offers a wide range of running and walking options.

name: Honiglauf des TuS Horn
description: The traditional TuS Horn Honey Run offers running and walking routes for all age groups around Horn. The event is known for its family atmosphere, with the winners rewarded with a jar of the coveted Horner honey. A range of distances, from the Bambini race to the 10 km run, makes it possible for children, teenagers, and adults to take part. The event takes place at the Horn community center and combines sporting ambition with fun and a sense of community.
course_highlights: Running and walking routes around Horn
Distances from 150 m to 10 km for all age groups
Winners are rewarded with Horner honey
additional: Late entries are possible up to 1 hour before the respective start, with a late-entry fee of €2.00. The start and finish are at the Horn community center, Hauptstr. 18. Showers are available for women at the community center and for men at the clubhouse at the sports ground. The top finishers receive trophies or medals and a jar of honey; all participants receive certificates and prizes. Honey is raffled among the walkers who are present. No specific information is available about course length, registration, or other race details.

name: Stadtlauf - Nördlingen läuft rund
description: The Stadtlauf Nördlingen läuft rund takes place and offers races for children, school students, adults, and walkers. The approximately 6 km main race runs through and around Nördlingen’s historic old town. Team spirit and the enjoyment of exercise are central, and every participant receives a medal at the finish. The event is open to individual and group entries and promotes the shared experience of running.
course_highlights: Approximately 6 km main race through and around Nördlingen’s old town
Children’s and school races with 400 m and 800 m laps
Start and finish area at the market square, with a route via Daniel, Obstmarkt, Hallgasse, and Schäfflesmarkt
additional: Late entries are possible on the day of the event for an additional fee of 2 euros. If participation is high, school races will start separately in girls’ and boys’ groups. There are individual and team classifications, and the three fastest teams in the main race (6 km) will be honored. There is no awards ceremony for walkers; the focus is on health. Tables for socializing after the race can be reserved by email. Distances: 400 m children’s race, 7 km main race; medals for all finishers; prizes for the fastest company teams and the teams with the most participants; the event takes place in all weather.

name: 01. Okertalsperren Ultra-Marathon
description: The course covers 47.4 km and consists of three laps of a 15.8 km, mostly flat loop around the main arm of the Okertalsperre. The route runs along the forebay, over the dam and the main dam wall, offering a scenic course with gentle climbs. The event is suitable for experienced runners; bringing your own refreshments is recommended, and runners are responsible for their own timekeeping. After the race, participants receive certificates by email, and the results are published on the website.

name: 23. Schneekopflauf
description: The Schneekopflauf is one of the most beautiful and challenging mountain races in Germany, held in the Thuringian Forest. The course runs from Schmiedefeld via Großer Finsterberg to Schneekopf and covers distances of 12.7 and 22.2 kilometers, with plenty of climbs and elevation gain. This race is especially suitable for experienced runners who want to test their limits. Since 2025, there has also been a Schneekopf hike for Nordic walkers and hikers, who are also rewarded with a medal at the summit.

name: 40. Schweriner Fünf-Seen-Lauf
description: The Schwerin Five Lakes Run is a traditional race in northern Germany, taking place for the 40th time. The event offers various race distances around Schwerin’s five lakes, including a half marathon, 15 km, 10 km and 5 km runs, as well as a one-mile lake run for children. Runners experience a scenic course with the start and finish at Bertha-Klingberg-Platz. The event is known for its excellent organization, family-friendly atmosphere and various categories, including corporate and school competitions.

name: Auenwaldlauf
description: The Auenwald Run is a long-standing running event in Auenwald-Hohnweiler. The event offers various race distances for children, teenagers, and adults in a friendly, family atmosphere. The start and finish are at the Hohnweiler multipurpose hall, and all finishers receive a medal. The races are divided by age group and awards include trophies, certificates, and non-cash prizes.

name: Degmarner Kocherlauf (Wertungslauf zum Drei Flüsse Cup)
description: The 10 km main race is the fourth scoring race in the renowned 3-Flüsse-Cup, which brings together six regional fun runs. Alongside the main race, there are events for different age groups and ability levels, including walking and children’s races. After the races, the sports festival invites everyone to stay and enjoy music, food, and drinks—a celebration for the whole family.

name: Gocher Steintorlauf
description: The 30th Gocher Steintorlauf takes place as part of the Gocher Fußball Sommer. Organized by SV Viktoria Goch, Athletics/Running Group, the event is expected to welcome more than 800 runners of various age groups in the city center of Goch. Events range from the Bambini Run and the 2,000m hobby group and company run to open races around the Steintor. The event offers suitable distances for both competitive and recreational runners in a welcoming, healthy outdoor atmosphere.

name: KIT-Meisterschaft über 10km
description: The KIT Championship over 10 km takes place in Karlsruhe. The flat, officially measured course starts at the Institute of Sports and Sports Science, passes through the KIT Campus South and the Hardtwald forest, and finishes at the athletics stadium. The event is open to students, staff, and external participants, with age-group and team competitions. The award ceremony takes place at the Institute’s stadium.

name: Kondelwaldlauf, Rund um Bengel und Springiersbach
description: The Kondelwald Run in Bengel is a versatile running event held around Bengel and Springiersbach. The routes pass over grass, asphalt and forest trails, with some climbs, particularly on the fun run and main race. There are rankings and attractive prizes for all age groups, while Nordic walking and the children’s run are untimed. The event is organized by Turn- und Sportverein Bengel 05 e.V. and offers changing rooms and showers right at the sports field.

name: Reutlinger Solcom-Altstadtlauf
description: The Reutlingen Solcom Old Town Run is a popular running event in Reutlingen that appeals to both children and adults. In glorious summer weather, numerous runners take part, setting off in light blue sports shirts. After a two-year break, the participants were especially excited and delighted. The event is organized by the Friends of the Eduard Spranger School, which also sponsors the T-shirts. Race results are available online.

name: St. Georgener Stadtfestlauf
organizer: Förderverein TV St. Georgen e. V. und Stadt St. Georgen
description: The 14th town festival run in St. Georgen im Schwarzwald takes place with races for various age groups and ability levels. The event includes fun runs for young children, children’s races, a 5 km race, a 10.5 km race, and a half marathon. The start and finish are at the Roter Löwe, Hauptstraße 18. The races are part of the Intersport-Denzer Cup and also include team and company cup competitions. There is also a health run without timekeeping, which allows Nordic walking.

name: Wangener Altstadtlauf
description: The Wangener Altstadtlauf has been a fixture in the event calendar in Wangen im Allgäu for over 25 years. The races take place in the historic old town, with its narrow streets, cobblestones and large market square, creating a special atmosphere. In addition to the main race, there are Bambini and schoolchildren’s races, as well as the “Wangener Stolperer,” where participants can run as many laps as possible in 30 minutes. The event is aimed at both experienced competitive runners and recreational athletes, and promotes a shared sporting experience in the town centre.

name: Windener Landschaftslauf
description: The Windener Landschaftslauf is a running and walking event in Winden near Nassau, Germany. The event offers distances of 200 m, 5 km, and 10 km for runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers. The start and finish are at Am Forst. The event began as part of the village’s 775th anniversary, giving it a family-friendly, community-oriented character. The races start one after another in the afternoon, with the 5 km starting before the 10 km.

name: Grill Run=Fun 2026
description: Grill+Run=Fun 2026 is a race held in Palowice that combines sporting competition with a friendly atmosphere and fun. The event starts at 08:00, and participants can expect professional RFID timing and comprehensive technical support. The event is organized by the LUXTORPEDA Association, which ensures high-quality organization and support for runners. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and experience the spirit of sporting community.

name: XXIV Atlantis Bieg Opolski
description: The 24th Atlantis Opole Run is an annual race held since 2003 on the first Saturday of July on Bolko Island in Opole. The route runs through a designated quiet, green area in the city center, offering participants the opportunity to compete over 5 km and 10 km distances. Since 2015, the race has been called the Atlantis Opole Run, thanks to the support of Atlantis-Deweloper. The event is organized by the Opole Run Association, which promotes physical activity and sports-based community integration.

name: Kaliski Półmaraton Nocny
description: The Kalisz Night Amber Hellena Half Marathon is a unique nighttime half marathon held in Kalisz. The event attracts hundreds of runners from different cities, offering a one-of-a-kind atmosphere and a running challenge after dark. The half-marathon course passes through charming parts of the city, giving participants an unforgettable experience. The event has become a tradition and is popular with both amateur and professional runners.

name: Mam Marzenie 12.RAZ 25h RUN
organizer: Fundacja Mam Marzenie oraz Ruchowa Akademia Zdrowia (RAZ Szczecin)
description: 25h RUN is a unique running event organized by the Mam Marzenie Foundation, combining sport with charity. The 10th anniversary edition takes place by Lake Arkonka in Szczecin and aims to make Marlena, one of the foundation’s beneficiaries, dream come true: a trip to the island of Zakynthos. Participants run for 25 hours, and every kilometer brings them closer to achieving this goal. It is not only a sporting challenge, but also an opportunity to work together to support children in need.

name: VI Półmaraton Gęstwinami Murckowskimi
description: The 5th Murckowski Forest Half Marathon is organized by the W Kręgu Natury Association and takes place in the picturesque forests of Murcki in Katowice. The half-marathon course winds through varied woodland terrain, offering participants a chance to connect with nature and enjoy a unique atmosphere. The event is a great opportunity to spend time outdoors, whether you are an experienced runner or a beginner. The organizers provide convenient access by public transport and parking near the start.

name: XI Janikowska ZaDyszka
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Janikowie
description: The 11th Janikowo ZaDyszka is an annual road race held in Janikowo, attracting runners of different ages and ability levels. The race covers 10 km, with professional timekeeping provided using Chronotrack technology. The event is organized by the Janikowo Sports and Recreation Centre, and timing is handled by STS-Timing, ensuring high reliability and organizational support. The race is open and welcoming to everyone who enjoys physical activity.

name: XI Krokowska 10
description: The 11th Krokowska 10 is one of the events in the Kaszuby Biegają 2026 series, taking place on July 4 in Żarnowiec. The race offers a 10 km distance through the scenic landscapes of Kashubia, combining sporting competition with the beauty of the region. Kaszuby Biegają is the largest running event in northern Poland, promoting physical activity and local culture. Participants can expect professional organization and unique medals assembled from pieces awarded at the individual stages.

name: XXVI Bieg o Kryształową Perłę Jeziora Na...
description: The 26th National Run for the Crystal Pearl of Lake Narie is the main race, covering a distance of 31.13 km. It takes place in the scenic surroundings of Lake Narie in Kretowiny. The start and finish are located at the Main Beach in Kretowiny. The event includes age categories for men and women, and participants can look forward to a formal opening and closing ceremony, with awards presented. The event is national in scope and attracts runners from various age groups.

name: Bieg i Nordic Walking O Buławę Sieniawską
Letnia Dwunastka
location: Nowy Targ, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Turbacz Summer Trail
location: Nowy Targ, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Na hoľu
description: Na hoľu is an ITRA-certified vertical kilometer event held on Kráľova hoľa in the Horehronie region. Runners start from the main square in the village of Šumiac, and the route follows the blue hiking trail directly to the summit of Kráľova hoľa. The event is a qualifying race for the 2024 Skyrunning World Championships and offers quality support, including refreshments and medical services. Registration is open, with a participant limit, and the entry fee includes a souvenir and refreshments.

name: Špačinský trojuholník
location: Špačince, okr. Trnava, Špačince, okr. Trnava, Základná škola s materskou školou
organizer: Obec Špačince, Bežecký klub 2001 Špačince, Základná škola s materskou školou v Špačinciach, Dobrovoľný hasičský zbor Špačince
description: The Špačinský Triangle is a running race held in the village of Špačince in the Trnava District. The race starts at 17:00 in the centre of the village, by the Primary School with Kindergarten. Men compete in the overall category regardless of age, and women aged 40 and over compete. The organizers are the Municipality of Špačince, Bežecký klub 2001 Špačince, the Primary School with Kindergarten in Špačince, and JDS Špačince. The entry fee is €10, except for village residents, who can enter for free.

name: Trail Relay Banská Štiavnica – Visegrád – štafety
location: Banská Štiavnica, Banská Štiavnica, Atletická dráha
description: The Banská Štiavnica–Visegrád Trail Relay is a unique 220 km relay race connecting two historic royal towns through the natural beauty of the Štiavnica Mountains and the Danube–Ipoly National Park. The race is open to teams of 3, 4 to 8, and 6 runners, with categories for experienced runners and larger teams. The route runs mainly along hiking trails and through nature reserves, offering a chance to discover the region’s cultural and historical landmarks and natural beauty in Slovakia and Hungary. The organizers emphasize building good neighborly relations and promoting the region.

name: Širokodolská časovka
description: Širokodolská časovka je krátký intervalový běžecký závod konaný v Širokém Dole u Poličky, který je součástí ISCAREX poháru 2026. Závod se běží na asfaltové trati dlouhé 800 metrů s převýšením 80 metrů. Startuje se intervalově po jedné minutě od 10:00 hodin, přičemž registrace probíhá přímo na místě v čase 8:45 až 9:45. Po běhu následuje disciplína kolo, která není součástí běžeckého poháru. Startovné je symbolických 50 Kč, což činí závod dostupným pro širokou veřejnost.

name: Běh pod Slunečnou
description: Běh pod Slunečnou je krosový závod na 8,3 km, který se koná v Moravském Berouně v Olomouckém kraji. Tento závod je součástí Velké ceny vytrvalců Olomouckého kraje a nabízí běžcům možnost změřit síly v přírodním terénu. Trať je vhodná pro milovníky krosového běhu a nabízí zajímavé přírodní scenérie. Závod je otevřený široké veřejnosti a vítá všechny běžce, kteří si chtějí užít sportovní atmosféru a výzvu v krásném prostředí.

name: Dorfener Stadtlauf
organizer: Förderkreis Dorfen e.V. und die Stadt Dorfen
description: The routes lead through the green Isental, a peaceful landscape occasionally accompanied by music. The finish on the town square is cheered on by many spectators and provides a crowning end to the run. Popular children’s races are also offered, making the town race an event for all ages.
course_highlights: Route through the green Isental
Peaceful stretches through nature accompanied by music
Finish on Dorfen’s lively town square
additional: Trial run on June 16 at 7 p.m. at Dorfen Market Church; children’s races are part of the program; finish cheered on by many spectators on the town square; organized by Förderkreis Dorfen e.V. Race distances: 5 km, 10 km, half marathon; start at Unterer Marktplatz; passes through the Isental; children’s races available

name: Sefra rennt gegen Gewalt
organizer: Selbsthilfe- und Beratungszentrum für Frauen in Aschaffenburg e.V. (SEFRA)
description: The Aschaffenburg city race “Sefra rennt – gegen Gewalt” is a long-established race through downtown Aschaffenburg, taking place on July 4, 2027. The event offers 2 km, 4 km, and 6 km routes for children, teenagers, and adults. The start and finish are at the Stadthalle, and the event is organized by the Selbsthilfe- und Beratungszentrum für Frauen in Aschaffenburg e.V. Alongside the sporting competition, the race focuses on standing up against violence.
course_highlights: The route goes through downtown Aschaffenburg, starting and finishing at the Stadthalle
Loop route via Luitpoldstraße, Sandgasse, Roßmarkt, Park Schöntal, and other central streets
Three distances: 2 km (children’s category), 4 km (youth category), and 6 km (youth and adult categories)
additional: Chip timing with a transponder attached to the race bib. Race bibs can be collected on several days before the race at the Sefra counseling center and on race day at vhs Aschaffenburg. Changing rooms, showers, and a clothes drop are available at the State Vocational Secondary School. Refreshments include coffee, cake, sausages, pretzels, and non-alcoholic drinks. Parking is available in the Stadthalle and Stadttheater parking garages (fees apply). The race starts at 10 a.m. Individual and group registration are available.

name: Staffelsee-Panoramalauflauf 2026
description: The Staffelsee Panorama Run is a running and Nordic walking event in Murnau am Staffelsee. The program includes 5 km and 10 km races, as well as 5 km Nordic walking. The event combines sporting activity with the scenery around Lake Staffelsee and the foothills of the Alps.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km runs
5 km Nordic walking route
Routes in the area around Lake Staffelsee

name: VR-Bank-Lauf - Rund um die Veste Coburg
price_range: 10 km – 15,00 Euro; Kinder- und Jugendlauf – 8,00 Euro; Nachmeldungen – 4 Euro
description: The 44th VR-Bank Run “Around the Veste Coburg” is one of the most popular running events in the Coburg region. The 10 km main race runs through the idyllic Hofgarten, past the imposing Veste Coburg, to the airfield, and back to the TV 1848 Coburg sports grounds. In addition to the main race, there is a 1.6 km children’s and youth race and a 400 m Bambini race for the youngest participants. The event offers a lively atmosphere with refreshment stations and a fan zone to give runners extra motivation.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Hofgarten and past the Veste Coburg
Refreshment station at kilometer 3.5 by the airfield
Fan zone at kilometer 8 for extra motivation
additional: Race bibs must be attached with your own safety pins. Race packs can be collected on July 4 from 2 to 5 p.m. and on July 5 from 7:30 to 8:45 a.m. A €4 fee applies to late entries (except for the Bambini race). The first 800 entrants in the main and children’s races receive a finisher T-shirt. Free refreshments, including fruit, mineral water, and non-alcoholic Kapuziner, are available in the finish area. Certificates and results are available online. The Bambini race has no timing or rankings; all participants receive a medal.

name: VW - THIEL Rheda-Wiedenbrücker Staffelmarathon
location: Schloss- und Rosengarten, Rheda-Wiedenbrück, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The VW - THIEL Rheda-Wiedenbrück Relay Marathon is a long-running relay marathon held in the castle and rose gardens in Rheda-Wiedenbrück. The flat, well-maintained course follows a two-kilometre loop through the historic castle park, which runners complete 21 times. The event is organised by LG Burg Wiedenbrück, which has hosted this relay marathon since 2013 and brings together a committed running community. The relay marathon offers runners an attractive and varied route through beautiful parkland, with no disruptive road crossings.
course_highlights: Flat, well-maintained 2 km loop through the castle park
Start and finish in the rose garden, with a view of the historic castle
No disruptive road crossings on the course
additional: The relay marathon consists of 21 laps of 2 km each, run in Rheda Castle Park. The course is flat and has no road crossings. Registration is available online. The event is organised by LG Burg Wiedenbrück, which also holds other running events. Photos and videos from previous relay races are available on the website. Registration is via my.raceresult.com; the race is held as a relay marathon, and results are available on the event day.

name: Wilhelmsfelder Kerwelauf
description: The Wilhelmsfeld Kerwe Run is being held for the 24th time and offers runners and walkers a choice of routes through the beautiful countryside around Wilhelmsfeld. The start is at the Odenwaldhalle, at an elevation of 365 metres. From there, the routes follow varied paths with climbs and refreshment stations. Time is recorded electronically using a chip attached to the race number. This traditional event is for runners of all ages who want to enjoy the fresh air and scenic attractions of this climatic health resort.
course_highlights: Start at the Odenwaldhalle, at an elevation of 365 m, with changing and shower facilities
Routes with challenging climbs, including to the Prinzensitz at 500 m and the highest point, Holzapfelbaum (505 m)
Refreshment stations along the routes, for example at 2 km, Prinzensitz and Sitzbuch-Hütte
additional: Start and finish at the Odenwaldhalle, with changing and shower facilities. Photos and video footage will be taken during the event. There is a 10 km walking route.
