Registration is online with advance payment, saving time on race day. Routes of 6.4 km, 10 km and half marathon; online registration; walking options; weather-dependent conditions in July

name: ZfS-Münster City Run
description: The ZfS Münster-City-Run is organized by Laufsportfreunde Münster e.V., one of Germany’s largest running clubs, with over 800 members. The race takes place in the city of Münster and offers an appealing route through the city center. The event is open to runners of all ability levels and promotes both recreational and competitive running. Laufsportfreunde Münster also offers a variety of training groups and courses to help participants prepare for the race.
course_highlights: Route through Münster city center
Attractive 5 km and 10 km course maps available
Organized by an experienced and large running club
additional: Laufsportfreunde Münster offers training groups with different focuses and levels to help participants prepare for competitions. Course maps for 5 km and 10 km are available as PDFs on the website.

name: Dorflauf TSV Wiera
description: The 6th TSV Wiera Village Run takes place in Schwalmstadt and is officially registered with the German Athletics Association. The event offers races over 600 meters and 10 kilometers. The results are included in the official athletics rankings, making the competition especially attractive to ambitious runners. The race takes place in typical July weather, with pleasant temperatures and mostly sunny conditions.

name: Eselsburger-Tal-Lauf
description: The 28th Eselsburger Tal Run takes place in Herbrechtingen. This long-standing running event warmly welcomes runners of all ages. The varied routes pass through the beautiful Eselsburger Valley landscape and offer ideal conditions for both competitive athletes and recreational runners. The youngest participants can test themselves in the Bambini Run and Schoolchildren’s Run, while the half marathon, the premier event, consists of two laps through the nature reserve. Alongside the sporting competition, the focus is on sharing the experience in a friendly atmosphere with dedicated volunteers.

name: Eßlinger Zeitung Lauf
description: The EZ-Lauf, officially the Eßlinger Zeitung Lauf um den Sport-Flöss-Pokal, is a traditional public race in Esslingen am Neckar, held annually since 1999. Organized by the Eßlinger Zeitung and TSG Esslingen, it is the largest mass-participation sporting event in the district of Esslingen. Since 2003, the main race has covered a 10 km course on a 2.5 km loop through the city center, measured according to DLV guidelines. The event also includes children’s and schoolchildren’s races. Sections of cobblestones make the course challenging.
course_highlights: 10 km main race on a 2.5 km loop through Esslingen city center
Cobblestone sections make the course challenging
Children’s and schoolchildren’s races complement the program
additional: In 2015, the main race was shortened to 7.5 kilometers because of extreme heat. The course was measured with a Jones Counter according to DLV guidelines. The EZ-Lauf is a member of German Road Races.

name: Kraftsolmser Dorflauf
description: The Kraftsolms Village Run is a popular running event in Kraftsolms that attracts runners from the region and beyond. The event offers challenging 5.4 km and 10.4 km routes through the municipality. The run is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and sporting challenges, as demonstrated by the course records being broken several times. The race traditionally starts at Kraftsolms village square, and participation continues to grow.

name: Neuendettelsauer Kirchweihlauf - 10 KM DLV-genehmigt
description: The 27th Neuendettelsau Kirchweihlauf is a DLV-approved 10-kilometer race held in the town center of Neuendettelsau. The event is organized by BLV Kreis Ansbach and hosted by TSC Neuendettelsau, Athletics Department. The race offers an attractive course for runners of all ages and ability levels in the Middle Franconia region. Registration is open.

name: Petersberg Berg-Crosslauf
description: The Petersberg Mountain Cross-Country Run in Marktbergel is a challenging trail run with new courses over 5.2 km and 10.0 km. The event offers races for various age groups, from the Bambini run and student races to the main and recreational races. Timing is electronic, and late entries are possible up to 60 minutes before the start. Alongside the sporting competition, there is an extensive supporting program with refreshments, games and activities for children, and an awards ceremony with prizes for the fastest participants.

name: Stadtlauf Wolfratshausen
description: The Wolfratshausen City Run is a flat, officially measured loop through the historic old town of Wolfratshausen, ideal for personal bests. The event offers a varied program for all ages and ability levels, with a 10 km main race, a 5 km fun run and relay competitions. It is part of the Raiffeisen Oberland Challenge and is known for its friendly atmosphere, with prizes for children and team classifications. The 25th City Run is taking place and warmly invites runners to join in.

name: SVE-Steinwiesenlauf
description: The Steinwiesenlauf organised by SV Eidelstedt Hamburg is a popular running event that attracts numerous participants every year. The event offers various races for all age groups, from a kids’ run and school races to the 5 km and 10 km main races. The course includes a motorway bridge and offers exciting competitions in a family-friendly atmosphere. The race traditionally takes place on a weekend and continues to attract more participants.

name: Bieg Wilka Wilkowo 05.07.2026
description: The 7th Bieg Wilka Wilkowo 2026 is an annual running event held in Wilkowo near Świebodzin. The race attracts runners from various categories and offers the chance to compete on a route combining road and off-road sections. The organizers provide professional timing and technical support, while participants can expect efficient organization and a friendly atmosphere. It’s a great opportunity to get active and bring the local community together.
course_highlights: A route combining road and off-road sections
Scenic surroundings of Wilkowo near Świebodzin
Professional electronic timing
additional: The event is organized by Super Sport, a company from Zielona Góra, which provides timing, race bib printing, and technical support. No details are available about start waves, participant limits, or race packages. Registration will be available at super-sport.com.pl, and the event attracts local runners and sports enthusiasts.

name: Pogoń za Jednorożcem
description: The Unicorn Chase is an annual running event held in Jednorożec, taking place for the eighth time in 2026. The event includes a 5 km race and Nordic walking over the same distance, as well as children’s races over shorter distances. It is organized by the “Jednorożec robi co może” Association in cooperation with local partners and patrons, offering participants sporting competition, numerous attractions, and prizes. The start and awards ceremony take place on the same day, and participants can expect professional organization and chip timing.

name: XV Limanowa Forrest
description: XV Limanowa Forrest is an international mountain race on a route leading to Miejska Góra (716 m above sea level), home to the Millennium Cross—the tallest steel cross in Poland. The Anglo-Saxon-style course covers varied terrain, including hiking trails, forest and field roads, rocky sections, asphalt, and pavement. The start and finish are on Bulwary Street in Limanowa, near the race office. The event is well organized and welcoming to different age groups, including children under 13.
course_highlights: The route leads to Miejska Góra and the Millennium Cross—the tallest steel cross in Poland
Varied terrain: hiking trails, forest and field roads, rocky sections, asphalt, and pavement
Start and finish on Bulwary Street, near the race office
additional: The race office is at 4 M. Konopnickiej Street, Limanowa, and is open from 8:30 to 11:30. Competitor check-in is from 8:30 to 11:30; bag drop is available until 14:30. The Nordic Walking start is at 12:02. The awards ceremony is at 14:45, a prize draw is at 15:30, and the event ends at around 16:30. KS Limanowa Forrest members are exempt from the entry fee.

name: 34 Bieg po Plaży
location: Jarosławiec, Postomino, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 34th Jarosławiec Beach Run is an annual running event organized by the Culture and Sports Centre in Postomino. The race takes place on a scenic route along the beach by the Baltic Sea, offering participants a unique experience surrounded by coastal nature. The event attracts runners from various regions, combining sporting competition with recreation and socializing. The organizers provide professional event support and attractive keepsakes for participants.
course_highlights: The race route runs along a sandy beach by the Baltic Sea
Scenic views of the sea and coastal nature
Flat, fast terrain conducive to good race times
additional: The event is organized by the Culture and Sports Centre in Postomino and takes place in Jarosławiec. The website has no detailed information about start waves, participant limits, or race packages. Reports and photo galleries from previous editions are available.

name: Chwałowicki Maraton Napoleoński
description: The Chwałowice Napoleonic Marathon is a small-scale running event held in the picturesque village of Chwałowice, surrounded by forests and fields. The marathon route passes through woodland and rural areas, offering runners peace and contact with nature, away from crowds and mass events. The race is friendly in spirit, without competitive pressure, creating a welcoming atmosphere and an opportunity to cover the distance together. The organizers, including local runner Arek Tołłoczko, take care of route marking and participants’ comfort.
course_highlights: A 42.195 km route along forest and country roads
Start and finish on Polna Street in Chwałowice
Every kilometre is marked, with convenient parking nearby
additional: The race is small-scale and friendly, without the feel of a mass event or competitive pressure. The varied route is marked every kilometre. Four marathons are held each year: in winter, spring, summer and autumn. There is convenient parking nearby. Sources describe the friendly format and self-timed results.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 6. kolo
description: The Bratislava 2 Miles Run is a regular 2-mile race organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team at the Kuchajda swimming pool complex in Bratislava. The race is open to a wide range of categories, including children, juniors, women, men, and veterans. Registration takes place at the venue from 9:30, and the start is at 10:00. The event also includes a competition for the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team Perpetual Trophy, with runners scored according to their performances and participation in individual rounds.

name: Žaškovský minimaratón
location: Žaškov okr. Dolný Kubín, Žaškov okr. Dolný Kubín, Žaškov na začiatku obce pri rieke Orava
description: The Žaškov Mini Marathon is a traditional running race, now being held for the 55th year in the village of Žaškov in Orava. The course runs mostly along forest roads and village streets, covering approximately 12.4 km with around 600 m of elevation gain. Runners are warmly welcomed by local residents of all ages, creating a pleasant, family-friendly atmosphere. This mini marathon is part of the Šípsko–Fatranské Runs series and is suitable for all running enthusiasts who want to enjoy the beauty of Orava’s nature and the spirit of sport.

name: Domašská desiatka na Eve
location: Vranov nad Topľou, Vranov nad Topľou, rekreačná oblasť Domaša, Eva, pizzeria Palermo
description: Domašská Desiatka na Eve is a traditional running race held in the Domaša recreational area, Eva, near Vranov nad Topľou. The race offers 5 km and 10 km courses, which are part of the Vranov nad Topľou District Road Running Championships. Runners can enjoy a course with refreshment stations, and after finishing they receive a race pack with a medal, food, and a drink. The organizers provide medical services. The race takes place on roads open to traffic, and each participant runs at their own risk.

name: Cyrilometodský beh Kolonickým vrchom – Memoriál Jozefa Chomaniča
location: Kolonica, okr. Snina, Kolonica, okr. Snina, športovo-rekreačný areál Bejvoč
description: The Cyril and Methodius Run over Kolonický vrch – Jozef Chomanič Memorial is a running event held at the Bejvoč sports and recreation complex in Kolonica, Snina District. The race offers categories for children and adults, including several age groups for men and women. The children’s races start at 13:30 and the adults’ race at 15:00. The event is held in memory of Jozef Chomanič and gives runners of all ages the chance to compete in a beautiful natural setting.

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Hlásná Třebaň
description: Běžecká série Berounka v Hlásné Třebani je součástí komunitních trailových závodů konaných v krásném přírodním prostředí Středočeského kraje. Trasa vede přes národní přírodní park Karlštejn s výhledem na hrad Karlštejn a nabízí běžcům pestrý terén s lesními pěšinkami a kopcovitými úseky. Závod je vhodný pro všechny běžce, ať už začátečníky nebo zkušené, a je součástí série 12 závodů, které motivují k pravidelnému pohybu a sportovnímu vyžití. Na místě je zajištěno občerstvení, úschova věcí a diplomy pro nejlepší v kategoriích.

name: Gütersloh Läuft - für den guten Zweck
description: Gütersloh Läuft is a diverse charity running event taking place for the 18th time in Gütersloh City Park. The event offers races for all age groups, from Bambini and school races to Nordic walking, corporate and individual races, as well as a 10 km summer evening run. All participants support the German Stroke Foundation with their entry fee, as €1 is donated for every registration. The routes run through the beautiful city park and offer a sporting, community atmosphere for recreational and ambitious runners.

name: AOK Firmenlauf Göppingen
description: The AOK Göppingen Corporate Run is a popular event for company teams, held annually at the Dr.-Heinrich-Zeller-Stadion. On June 23, 2027, participants set off together at 18:30, accompanied by a motivating atmosphere with DJ music and a group warm-up. After crossing the finish line, there is an awards ceremony and a relaxed get-together with food and drinks. The event promotes team spirit and exercise in a friendly, informal setting.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Dr.-Heinrich-Zeller-Stadion
Group warm-up shortly before the start
Free finish-line refreshments, including non-alcoholic Erdinger, fruit, vegetables, and water
additional: From 17:00, a DJ on stage will create a lively atmosphere. After the run, there will be an awards ceremony and musical entertainment. Participant details can be changed independently up to the registration deadline. A free AOK training plan is available for beginners and advanced runners.

name: City-Sport-Abendlauf
description: The City-Sport Evening Run in Rostock is a popular summer race held annually in Barnstorfer Wald. Hundreds of runners come together for an evening run that combines the joy of running with a good cause. Proceeds from the race are donated to charitable organizations, most recently to the Rostock hospice at Klinikum Südstadt. The race has become a fixture on Rostock’s running calendar and continues to attract growing numbers of participants.

name: Freisinger Sparkassenlauf
description: The Freising Sparkassen Run is a popular summer race held in the Isar floodplains around the SC Freising stadium. It offers distances for all age groups and fitness levels, including children’s and youth races as well as main races over 5.5 km and 10 km. The course is mostly on gravel and forest paths along the Isar, with short stretches of asphalt. In addition to individual results, there is also a team competition that encourages team spirit. Food and showers are available on site, and participants can download their certificates online after the race.
course_highlights: Course through the Isar floodplains around the SC Freising stadium
Main race courses mostly on gravel and forest paths along the Isar
Children’s and youth races on an asphalt loop through the Isar floodplains
additional: Online registration is possible until 20:00 on the event day; on-site registration is no longer available. Payment is exclusively by SEPA mandate during online registration. There is a team competition with teams of 4 runners each. Changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available. The SC Freising clubhouse restaurant is open. Each participant receives a QR code after the race to download their certificate. A tombola with over 100 prizes will be held.

name: VRun Dachau 12. Dachauer VR Firmen- und Schülerlauf
description: VRun Dachau is the popular running event for corporate teams and students in the Dachau region. For the twelfth time, Volksbank Raiffeisenbank Dachau eG is organizing the event together with ASV Dachau, putting team spirit and community center stage. The races include a 2.8 km students’ run and a 5.6 km corporate and public-sector run. In addition to the sporting experience, there are attractive prizes and a raffle for all finishers.

name: Vereinsmeisterschaft im Rheinbacher Wald
description: The club championship in the Rheinbach Forest is a regional cycling competition hosted by RSV Sturmvogel Bad Neuenahr-Ahrweiler. The event takes place in the scenic woodland around Rheinbach and offers participants a challenging course in a natural setting. The club values a family-friendly atmosphere and supports young cyclists. The event is part of the club’s active community life and is open to cycling enthusiasts of all ages.
course_highlights: Course through the Rheinbach Forest with varied terrain
Natural woodland paths and trails
Challenging sections with technical passages
additional: The event is organized by RSV Sturmvogel Bad Neuenahr-Ahrweiler, which also offers other cycling disciplines and training for young athletes. The website has no current information about start times or entry fees. The club asks interested people to get in touch and provides a contact form on its website.

name: Bieg bez Granic
organizer: Słubicki Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji Sp. z o.o. oraz Miejski Związek Sportu we Frankfurcie
description: Bieg bez Granic is an annual race held on the border bridge between Słubice and Frankfurt (Oder). Participants can choose between 5 km (two laps of 2.5 km) and 10 km (four laps of 2.5 km). The start and finish are located at Slubicer Str. 15230 in Frankfurt (Oder), heading towards Poland. The race is international in nature and promotes cross-border cooperation and physical activity in the region.
course_highlights: The course crosses the border bridge between Słubice and Frankfurt (Oder)
The 5 km and 10 km distances consist of laps of 2.5 km
The start and finish are located in Frankfurt (Oder), heading towards Poland
additional: Registration and payment of the entry fee are not available on race day. The start and finish are located at Slubicer Str. 15230 Frankfurt (Oder), heading towards Poland.

name: 5. Běh pro zdraví
description: Běh pro zdraví je charitativní běžecký seriál pořádaný atletickým oddílem TJ Jäkl Karviná, který se koná v krásném prostředí Parku Boženy Němcové v Karviné. Každý běh má délku 3 km a je určen pro všechny, kdo chtějí podpořit své zdraví a zároveň pomoci potřebným, protože výtěžek ze startovného je věnován na charitativní účely. Start je tradičně v 17:45 u Lodiček, přičemž prezence začíná již v 17:00. Všichni jsou srdečně zváni k účasti na tomto přátelském a zdraví prospěšném běhu.

name: Běh okolo Bílé hory
description: Běh okolo Bílé hory je pravidelný běžecký závod v Brně, který nabízí okruh dlouhý 1,7 km. Muži i ženy běží tři okruhy, celkem tedy 5,1 km, zatímco děti mohou závodit na délce okruhu přizpůsobené jejich věku. Závod se koná v příjemném prostředí Bílé hory u hřiště a je vhodný pro všechny věkové kategorie. Start je v podvečer v 18:00 a závodníci si mohou užít atmosféru komunitního běhu s občerstvením a možností úschovy věcí.

name: run4healthineers
description: Run4Healthineers is a community running event that brings together employees on site in Erlangen and virtually across Germany. The event offers various distances, including three main routes, a Bambini run for children, and an inclusive running group for the first time. With more than 2,000 participants and around 17,400 kilometers run, the focus is on the joy of physical activity and supporting a good cause. The event promotes team spirit and health among Siemens Healthineers employees.

name: VUM – Valašské Ultramaraton – DEN1 – Zahřívání 🏃‍♂️

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: DEN1 - Zahřívání / DAY1 - Warm-up 999 Kč do / until 15.12.2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Všechny 3 tratě / All 3 Stages 2 099 Kč do / until 15.12.2026

description: VUM - Valašský Ultra Maraton je náročný třídenní etapový ultramaraton v srdci Valašska a Beskyd. Závod je určen pro běžce, kteří hledají výzvu a nekomfort, s postupně náročnějšími etapami, které prověří fyzickou i psychickou vytrvalost. Každý den je delší a náročnější, s důrazem na soběstačnost a schopnost regenerace. Závod není o rychlosti, ale o bezpečném dokončení a zvládnutí únavy a rozhodnutí během trati. Pořadatelé kladou důraz na respekt k přírodě a zajišťují základní zázemí, ubytování a občerstvení.
course_highlights: Tři dny, tři etapy s postupně rostoucí délkou a převýšením
Trasy vedou krajinou Valašska a Beskyd, včetně turistických tras, cyklostezek a lesních cest
Maximální soběstačnost závodníka, bez klasických občerstvovacích stanic
additional: Součástí startovného je ubytování ve vlastním stanu v areálu závodu, možnost ubytování ve škole (omezená kapacita), občerstvení během závodu zahrnuje kávu, čaj, základní občerstvení před etapou a ovoce, zeleninu, masné a sladké pochutiny po etapě. Na trati je k dispozici 1 litr vody na závodníka přibližně v polovině každé etapy. Elektronická časomíra a online tracking závodníků jsou zajištěny. V případě vyčerpání je možné využít odvoz pořadatele z trati. Finisher medaile obdrží každý, kdo dokončí alespoň jednu etapu, a exkluzivní finisher triko je určeno pouze pro ty, kteří dokončí všechny tři etapy.

name: VUM Valašský ultramaraton
description: Valašský Ultra Maraton (VUM) je náročný třídenní etapový ultramaraton v srdci Valašska a Beskyd. Závod je určen pro běžce, kteří hledají výzvu a nekomfort, s postupně náročnějšími etapami, které prověří fyzickou i psychickou odolnost. Každý den je delší a náročnější než ten předchozí, s důrazem na soběstačnost a schopnost regenerace. VUM není závod na rychlost, ale na vytrvalost a bezpečné dokončení všech etap. Pořadatelé kladou důraz na respekt k přírodě a bezpečnost závodníků.
course_highlights: Tři dny, tři etapy s postupně rostoucí délkou a převýšením
Trasy vedou krajinou Valašska a Beskyd, včetně turistických tras, cyklostezek a lesních cest
Maximální soběstačnost závodníků bez klasických občerstvovacích stanic
additional: Startovné zahrnuje účastnický balíček s bavlněným tričkem, startovní číslo s vlastním jménem nebo přezdívkou, přístup do zázemí s toaletami a sprchami, ubytování ve vlastním stanu nebo ve škole (omezená kapacita), občerstvení před a po etapách, 1 litr vody na trase v polovině každé etapy, elektronickou časomíru a online tracking závodníků. Finisher medaile obdrží každý, kdo dokončí alespoň jednu etapu, a exkluzivní finisher triko získají pouze ti, kteří dokončí všechny tři etapy. V případě vyčerpání je možné využít odvoz pořadatele z trati. Závod není týmový, ale lze běžet ve dvojici jako jednotlivci. Závod je self-supported: běžci si nesou vlastní občerstvení a trasa není standardně značená, povinná je navigace podle GPX. V polovině každé etapy je k dispozici přibližně litr vody na závodníka. Startovní balíček ALL nabízí zázemí a možnost ubytování ve vlastním stanu nebo ve škole.

name: 4. Dorstener 24-Stunden-Lauf
location: Bürgerpark Maria Lindenhof, Dorsten, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Die Startgebühr beträgt pro Person 12,00 Euro

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Läuferinnen und Läufer unter 16 Jahren können für 6,00 Euro starten

description: The Dorsten 24-Hour Run is a charity fundraising event held in Dorsten, near the city center, in Bürgerpark Maria Lindenhof. The course is about 1 km long and runs through a scenic park between the Lippe and the Wesel-Datteln Canal. Participants can run, walk or stroll for any amount of time during the 24 hours and complete as many laps as they choose. 100% of the entry fee goes into the donation fund, which supports various social organizations. The event is open to all ages and fitness levels, from a few short laps to a half marathon or marathon.
course_highlights: Loop course of approximately 1 km in Bürgerpark Maria Lindenhof
Scenic route between the Lippe and the Wesel-Datteln Canal
Central location near Dorsten city center
additional: The event is a charity run, with 100% of all entry fees going into the donation fund. Participants are not required to run for 24 hours straight; everyone can decide for themselves how many laps to run, walk or stroll. The event is organized by interevent GmbH and supported by numerous local sponsors. Functional shirts can be ordered for 27,00 EUR. Start and finish are in the park; registration is available online and on site. Parking is available on Kurt-Schumacher-Straße and in the VHS multi-storey car park. Results for performances of 50 km or more are included in the rankings.

name: Roruper Abendlauf
description: The Rorup Evening Run is a long-standing running event in Rorup, a district of Dülmen in North Rhine-Westphalia, which has attracted runners every summer for more than three decades. The event offers several distances, including a half marathon as its premier event, as well as 10 km, 3 km, a schoolchildren’s race and a Pampers Run for children. The course is flat and paved, with a ten-kilometre loop that is completed once or twice depending on the distance. The finish is in the SV Brukteria Rorup stadium, where runners complete a lap of the stadium before crossing the finish line. In addition to certificates and trophies, cash prizes are awarded to the top runners in the half marathon and 10 km race.
course_highlights: Flat, paved course
Ten-kilometre loop, with a longer first lap for the half marathon
Stadium lap before the finish at the SV Brukteria Rorup stadium
additional: All races start at the Rorup sports ground. Certificates are awarded to all finishers, trophies to the winners, and special prizes to the top three runners in each age group. Cash prizes are awarded to the top three male and female finishers in the half marathon and 10 km race. Courses are officially measured; online registration is available until 30 minutes before the start; parking is available; refreshments are provided on the course; finish in the SV Brukteria Rorup stadium.

name: BarockLauf Ludwigsburg
description: The BarockLauf Ludwigsburg is an enjoyable run through the Blühendes Barock, starting in the Baroque market square in the heart of Ludwigsburg. The event offers various distances for runners of all ages, including 10 km, 5 km, 1.5 km handicap and children’s races, as well as a 500 m children’s race. Registration is online only, and the race is known for its friendly atmosphere and beautiful route through the Baroque parkland.

name: Saarland Mittelpunktlauf
description: The Saarland Mittelpunktlauf in Eppelborn is a long-standing running event. Organized by SV Habach e.V., it offers a sporting challenge in the Saarland region. The event welcomes runners of various ability levels and promotes running in the region. The course passes through the scenic surroundings of Eppelborn and offers a varied running experience.

name: Schwaigfeldlauf
description: The Schwaigfeldlauf is a popular running event in Olching, organized by Bürgervereinigung Schwaigfeld e.V. It offers a sporting challenge in a friendly neighborhood atmosphere and has become a regular event. The course runs through Schwaigfeld and features a new route premiere, suitable for both experienced runners and running enthusiasts. The race brings together sport, fun, and community and is supported by numerous sponsors.

name: Ultramarathon Górski - 3 x Sniezka = 1 x Mont Blanc
description: The 3xŚnieżka Mountain Ultramarathon is a prestigious mountain race held in the Karkonosze Mountains. It covers 62.5 km with approximately 3,300 m of elevation gain and climbs to the summit of Śnieżka three times. It is one of the toughest running events in Poland, an official UTMB qualifier and an ITRA member. The course follows rocky trails in Karkonosze National Park, with the start and finish at the Irena Szewińska Stadium in Karpacz. The race has a 12-year tradition and attracts hundreds of runners from Poland and abroad.
course_highlights: 62.5 km course with +/- 3,300 m of elevation gain
Three climbs to the summit of Śnieżka (1,603 m)
Rocky trails in Karkonosze National Park
additional: Time limits: MINI and MEDIUM 7 hours, ULTRA 11 hours; the event finishes at 20:00 at the latest. A buffet with hot meals is available to runners from 12:00 to 19:30. Mandatory equipment: race bib, charged phone, ID, water container with a minimum capacity of 500 ml, reusable cup, course map, head covering, trail shoes. Aid stations on the course offer water, isotonic drink, Coca-Cola, fruit, vegetables and dried fruit and nuts. The race takes place in Karkonosze National Park; leaving the trail is prohibited.

name: II Policyjny bieg charytatywny Niebieski...
description: The 2nd Police Charity Run, Niebieski Puls Miasta (Blue Pulse of the City), is a sporting event held in Poznań by Lake Malta. The run is charitable and supports retired police animals. The event brings together uniformed services and local residents, promoting physical activity and helping those in need. The atmosphere is friendly and welcoming to all participants.
course_highlights: The route runs by Lake Malta in Poznań
Scenic views of the lake and surrounding area
An event bringing together uniformed services and local residents
additional: Telephone contact for the Municipal Headquarters of the State Fire Service in Poznań: 47 77 16 300 (weekdays, 7:30–15:30). The event is part of the “Niebieski Puls Miasta” (Blue Pulse of the City) picnic, which aims to help retired police animals. Proceeds from the fundraiser support the “Zakątek Weteranów” Association.

name: Běhej lesy Klínovec
description: Běhej lesy Klínovec je trailový závod v Krušných horách. Závod nabízí různé trasy včetně krátké a dlouhé, včetně charitativního závodu. Start je na vrcholu Klínovce s možností vyvezení lanovkou a seběhem do Skiareálu Klínovec. Závod je součástí mezinárodního UTMB Index Races a nabízí speciální rychlostní úseky Conti Speed Section a Generali Investments Finish s atraktivními cenami.

name: Libečovská 14
description: Libečovská 14 je závod na 14,2 km s převýšením přibližně 170 metrů, který vede po asfaltu i terénu. Tento závod je součástí Poháru běžců Kladenska a Rakovnicka a nabízí běžcům zajímavou kombinaci asfaltových a terénních úseků. Trať je vhodná pro běžce, kteří hledají výzvu s mírným stoupáním a různorodým povrchem. Závod se koná v malebné lokalitě Podkozí ve Středočeském kraji a přitahuje běžce z širokého okolí.

name: Králický Sněžník Beze stopy
description: Králický Sněžník BEZE STOPY je náročný horský běh s délkou 14 km a převýšením 1050 m, vedoucí z Heřmanic přes Klepáč a Malý Sněžník na vrchol Králického Sněžníku. Trať nabízí krásné hřebenové běhy s výhledy do polské Kladské kotliny a Dolnomoravského údolí, včetně krátkých a náročných seběhů. Závod je určen pro milovníky horského terénu a je součástí Českého poháru v běhu do vrchu a Iscarex poháru. Pro mladší běžce je připravena kratší trať o délce 5 km s převýšením 440 m. Start hlavního závodu je v 9:30, juniorský závod startuje v 11:00.

name: Hvězdonice - Ondřejov
description: Hvězdonice - Ondřejov je závod do vrchu dlouhý 5,75 km s převýšením 255 metrů, který startuje ve Hvězdonicích. Tento běžecký závod nabízí náročný terén a krásné výhledy v oblasti Středočeského kraje. Je vhodný pro běžce, kteří hledají výzvu v podobě stoupání a chtějí si vyzkoušet své síly v horském běhu. Závod je součástí běžecké terminovky Světa běhu a přitahuje běžce z širokého okolí.

name: Sommerlauf des LSV Porz
location: Gut Leidenhausen, Köln-Porz, Köln, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
price_range: Nachmeldung 2 € am Veranstaltungstag, sonst keine expliziten Angaben
description: The LSV Porz Summer Run is a popular race in the Gut Leidenhausen recreational area in Cologne-Porz. It is held as the Ingeborg Urbach Memorial Run and offers distances from 1 km to 5 km for competitive runners and recreational joggers. The 5 km and 10 km courses are measured by the DLV and eligible for ranking lists, with the 5 km loop regarded as one of the fastest running courses in Cologne. The entry fee also supports Brusthilfe Deutschland e.V. and the Leidenhausen Forest School.
course_highlights: Race in the Gut Leidenhausen recreational area
5 km and 10 km courses measured by the DLV and eligible for ranking lists
The 5 km loop is considered one of the fastest running courses in Cologne
additional: Late registration is available on the event day for a fee of €2; school students are exempt from the late registration fee. Timing is provided by time-and-voice.com. Race numbers must be worn on the front. €1 per participant is donated to Brusthilfe Deutschland e.V. and the Leidenhausen Forest School. Terrain in the Leidenhausen recreational area; registration by SEPA direct debit; race number worn on the front; medals for all pre-registered participants; awards ceremonies for the top runners; certificates available online.

name: Taubertaltrail
description: The Taubertal Trail is a spectacular trail running event through the breathtaking landscapes of the three valleys in the Taubertal. The event welcomes runners of all ability levels to test their limits and experience nature on challenging routes. Organised by SC Adelshofen e. V., the Taubertal Trail offers a unique combination of sporting challenge and scenic beauty.
course_highlights: Run through three picturesque valleys in the Taubertal
Marked trails with varied terrain
Breathtaking views of nature and the landscape
additional: Mandatory equipment for distances of 11 km and above: at least 0.5 litres of fluid, your own cup or flask, a mobile phone with emergency numbers, ID and health insurance card, weather-appropriate clothing and suitable footwear. Wear your race number clearly visible at the front. Weather conditions may make route markings difficult to see; a GPX file is recommended. Litter may only be disposed of in refreshment zones. Medical support is provided by medical services, the fire brigade and course marshals along the route. Distances range from 5 km to 60 km and include trail and hike disciplines, as well as a children’s trail, across varied terrain through fields, meadows, forests and vineyards. Participants receive medals and certificates and have access to showers and on-site refreshments.

name: 6. O-SEE Backyard Ultra
description: The O-SEE Backyard Ultra is a unique elimination race held at Olbersdorfer See near Zittau. Up to 200 runners start together and run a 6.7-kilometer loop every hour until only one runner remains and completes the final loop within the time limit. The race tests endurance, mental strength, and team spirit, and serves as a qualifier for the World Championships in October 2027. The course follows excellent hiking trails, features 70 meters of elevation gain, and is illuminated at night. The event is organized in a friendly, family-oriented way and offers a special atmosphere for runners of all ability levels.
course_highlights: 6.7056-kilometer loop with 70 meters of elevation gain
Excellent hiking trails at Olbersdorfer See, marked and lined with barrier tape
Course lit at night
additional: The race is limited to 200 runners. The start and finish are at Westparkstadion in Zittau/Pethau. The race has a DUV license and counts toward the rankings. The results list includes the distance covered and is published on Facebook and the official website.

name: Aichacher Stadtlauf
description: The Aichach City Run is a long-standing running event organized by LC Aichach for over 40 years. The event offers races for different age groups and ability levels, including races for schoolchildren and teenagers, as well as competitions through Aichach’s historic old town. The races take place in the Wittelsbacher Land region and are known for their family-friendly atmosphere and good organization. Training opportunities to prepare for the event are offered at the Landkreisstadion.

name: Alb-Run Heroldstatt
organizer: SC Heroldstatt e.V. in Kooperation mit SUN Sportmanagement GmbH
description: The Sparkassen Alb-Run in Heroldstatt is a running event for endurance athletes. The varied course passes through the Swabian Alb UNESCO Biosphere Reserve, with beautiful scenery, small trails, and a moderate amount of elevation gain. There are two appealing distances to choose from: 9 km and 16 km. The event offers professional timing, on-course refreshments, finish-line refreshments, baggage storage, showers, and an accompanying program for a well-rounded running experience.

name: Bad Buchauer Stadtlauf mit Federseehalbmarathon
description: The 25th Bad Buchau City Run with Federsee Half Marathon takes place, offering runners a varied experience. The half-marathon course runs through the historic town centre of Bad Buchau, the spa gardens and the largest nature reserve in southwestern Germany, surrounding Lake Federsee. The course is mostly flat, with an elevation difference of approximately 35 metres. It runs partly on asphalt, partly on gravel paths, and includes an approximately 1 km-long wooden boardwalk through a natural woodland reserve. Several aid stations along the course offer water, sports drinks and fruit.

name: Bahnstadtlauf 2026
description: The Bahnstadt Run in Heidelberg is a family-friendly event with various distances for children, teenagers, and adults. It takes place as part of the Bahnstadt Festival and offers live music and refreshments alongside exciting races. The routes run through Bahnstadt, although short-notice changes may be made due to construction work. Events include children’s races, school races, and 5 km and 10 km races, with results in various age categories.

name: Bergheide-Cross 2026
description: SCB Langendamm invites you to the 4th Bergheide Cross 2026. The course starts on the access road to the shooting house of the local small-bore rifle club and runs through the “Osterberg” local recreation and nature conservation area. The event offers three distances for different competition and age categories, as well as walking on the shorter course. There is also a 1,000-meter race for children and young people. The event is approved by the DLV and starts at 16:00.

name: Crosslauf Fichtenau
description: The cross-country run in Fichtenau is a long-standing running event held as part of the Festival by the Lake. The event offers two varied courses through the beautiful municipality of Fichtenau: a 5.2 km fun run for everyone who enjoys being active, and a challenging 10 km cross-country run for those seeking a sporting challenge. The races take place in the so-called “Magic Triangle” of Crailsheim/Dinkelsbühl/Ellwangen and attract runners of all ages. The organizing team looks forward to welcoming many participants and offers convenient registration by SEPA direct debit.

name: Dietfurter 7-Täler-Lauf
description: For the first time, participants can enter the Walking category. Also new is the Team Fun Run, where teams of at least three people compete for prizes for the fastest team, coolest outfit and Lucky Loser. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with bib pickup, changing rooms and showers at the 7-Täler-Halle, as well as medals for Bambini participants and awards for the top finishers in each age group.

name: LAUF10
description: LAUF10! is a training project by the Bavarian Athletics Association that gets people who are not keen on sports fit to run 10 kilometers in ten weeks. The program is aimed at anyone who wants to go from zero to running ten kilometers and has already inspired many thousands of participants. In addition to the run, there is an official fan T-shirt that can be ordered. LAUF10! promotes the joy of running and fitness in a supportive community.

name: Sauerborner Laufabend
description: The Sauerborner Laufabend is an established running event in Bad Soden-Neuenhain. The races start and finish at the Sauerborn sports field and follow a hilly course on paved country roads and firm forest trails. Two distances are offered, 5 km and 10 km, open to different age groups. The event is family-friendly and offers changing rooms and showers in the nearby sports hall.

name: Tanzenhaider Weiherlauf
description: The Tanzenhaider Weiherlauf is a traditional race in Oberreichenbach, held annually in July. The course passes through picturesque landscapes featuring ponds, forests, and historic paths, making it appealing to both runners and walkers. The event offers various competitions for different age groups and ability levels. Franconian grilled specialties and a salad buffet are available at the sports club. Awards ceremonies take place after the respective races, and participants receive certificates that can be created and printed online.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the sports club in Oberreichenbach
The course passes several ponds and runs through wooded areas
The historic Hochstraße is part of the course, which features varied terrain
additional: Participants who register in advance by June 13 receive a free T-shirt. Entry fees are collected by direct debit; late entries must be paid in cash and are subject to a late-entry fee. Medical services are provided by the BRK. Results are published online, and certificates can be created and printed online.

name: X-treme Battle Heroldstatt
description: The X-treme Battle Heroldstatt is a challenging obstacle course and trail run on the Swabian Alb, testing strength, endurance and willpower. Participants can choose between an obstacle course with exciting challenges and an adrenaline rush, or a varied cross-country run without obstacles over a 16 km route with around 350 meters of elevation gain. The course winds through the natural landscape of the Swabian Alb, with beautiful scenery and small trails. A real highlight for endurance athletes and teams ready to take on the challenge together.

name: 1. Stoppelfeld Ultra
description: In this special endurance format, it’s not about speed, but about completing a 6.706-kilometer lap within 60 minutes every hour and starting again promptly on the hour. The course mainly follows field and farm tracks around Blatzheim, starting and finishing at the Blatzheim sports field. The event is limited to 50 participants and promises a family atmosphere as well as a major mental and physical challenge.

name: Bukowiecka Dziesiątka
description: Bukowiecka Dziesiątka is a 10 km race held in Bukowiec, attracting runners eager to take on a moderately challenging course. Every participant who crosses the finish line will receive a commemorative medal. The race office is located in the sports hall in Bukowiec, providing convenient event facilities. We invite all running enthusiasts to take part in this event, which combines sporting competition with a local atmosphere.

name: VI Warmiński Bieg Uliczny
description: The 6th Warmian Street Run in Reszel is an annual sporting event that attracts both amateurs and experienced runners. The race follows the streets of Reszel, giving it a unique atmosphere and allowing participants to experience the city from a different perspective. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively, enjoy sporting competition, and meet fellow running enthusiasts. The organizers welcome everyone, regardless of experience level, emphasizing the importance of exercise and positive energy.

name: X Świerczyniecki Bieg Uliczny
description: The 10th Świerczyniec Street Race for the Mayor of the Gmina Cup is an annual running event held in Świerczyniec. The race takes place on the town’s streets, with the start scheduled for 10:00. It is organized by the Świerczyniec Volunteer Fire Brigade, and timing is professionally provided using RFID technology. The race attracts both local runners and sports enthusiasts from the surrounding area, offering exciting competition and a chance for the community to come together.

name: Bieg na Bucze
location: Górki Wielkie, Brenna, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Ośrodek Promocji Kultury i Sportu Gminy Brenna
description: Bieg na Bucze is a mountain race held in Górki Wielkie, taking runners through scenic Mount Bucze. The event also features a Nordic Walking march and miniBucze for younger participants. The 5.75 km course offers a chance to test yourself on a mountain trail and enjoy an active day in Brenna.
course_highlights: 5.75 km mountain course
The course runs through Mount Bucze
Start and finish in Górki Wielkie
additional: The event programme also includes a Nordic Walking march and races for children as part of miniBucze.

name: III Lubliniecka Piwna Mila
location: Park Smaku, Bulwar Europejski, Lubliniec, Poland
description: The 3rd Lubliniec Beer Mile is a unique sporting event held at Park Smaku in Lubliniec. The race combines competition over a one-mile distance with a relaxed, friendly atmosphere where having fun matters as much as the time. After the race, participants can continue the celebration with music and beer, creating a one-of-a-kind atmosphere. It’s a great opportunity to combine sport with socializing and relaxation in the beautiful surroundings of the European Boulevard.
course_highlights: A one-mile course (approx. 1,609 metres)
The race takes place at Park Smaku by the European Boulevard, behind Lubliniec Castle
A blend of sporting competition and a relaxed, festival-like atmosphere with music
additional: The race office opens at 15:30. After the race, the celebration continues with music and beer. The event takes place on Saturday. The location is Park Smaku by the European Boulevard, behind Lubliniec Castle in Lubliniec.

name: IV Piątka Jagienki
description: The 4th Jagienka Five is a cross-country race of approximately 5.5 km, held in the scenic, gently undulating woodland around Spychowo. The course is a single winding loop, with a longest straight of 600 m and approximately 50 m of total elevation gain. The event is organized by the Przyjazne Spychowo Association and the Spychowo Forest District, with the start and finish by the amphitheatre in Spychowo. Children’s races in various age categories take place after the main race. Timing is manual, using a photo finish and no chips.
course_highlights: Cross-country course through gently undulating woodland
Approximately 5.5 km on a single loop
The course is marked with tape and signs, with a water station at 2 km
additional: Timing is manual, with a photo finish and no chips. The course time limit is 1 hour. Children’s races take place after the main race, in various age categories from age 5 upwards. Entry fees can be paid via Przelewy24 online quick payments. The start, finish, and race office are by the amphitheatre in Spychowo. The main race time limit is 1 hour.

name: Pozytywny Bieg Przełajowy - reaktywacja
location: Kalej, Wręczyca Wielka, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Pozytywny Bieg Przełajowy - REAKTYWACJA is a cross-country race organized by Stowarzyszenie Pozytywnie Aktywni in Kalej. The event takes place on an off-road course that challenges runners who value natural terrain and active recreation. The race marks a revival and offers an opportunity to meet and compete in a friendly atmosphere. Timing is provided by Pomiar Czasu Atelier Sportu, ensuring professional race services.
course_highlights: Cross-country course on natural terrain
Organized by Stowarzyszenie Pozytywnie Aktywni
Professional electronic timing using RFID chips
additional: Timing uses a state-of-the-art electronic system based on RFID chips and start/finish mats. The timing service can be contacted between 8:00 and 16:00 and on race day by phone and email.

name: VIII Przedborska Dycha
description: The 8th Przedbórz 10K is an annual road race held in Przedbórz, attracting runners from various regions. The race takes place over a 10 km course, giving participants the opportunity to compete on the town’s scenic streets. The event is organized by KS Piliczanka Przedbórz and supported by Pomiar Czasu Atelier Sportu, which provides professional timing. The race is scheduled to start at 10:15, and participants can expect smooth organization and a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: A 10 km road course in Przedbórz
Scenic views and a welcoming urban setting
Professional timing using an RFID system
additional: The race is organized by KS Piliczanka Przedbórz. Timing is provided by Pomiar Czasu Atelier Sportu, which uses modern measurement systems based on RFID chips and start/finish mats. Telephone contact is available from 8:00 to 16:00 and on race day via the emergency number.

name: XIII Otwarte Mistrzostwa Zakopanego w Bi...
XIX Bieg Czterech Jezior
description: The Four Lakes Run in Skórcz is an event for those looking for both a sporting challenge and a recreational run. The program includes a 15 km main race and a 5 km recreational run. Join the participants and choose the distance that suits you.

name: Nízkotatranská stíhačka
description: Nízkotatranská stíhačka (NTS) is an individual ultra-trail race with a 98 km main loop from Telgárt to Donovaly, crossing the main ridge of the Low Tatras, and a half-distance route finishing at Čertovica. The race is a qualifying event for the Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc and is ITRA-certified. It is organized by the civic association Time Out - OZ in cooperation with STS HIKING and Slovak Ultratrail. NTS offers a challenging mountain course with beautiful views and challenges for experienced mountain runners.

name: Rozbehni Majerovce
location: Majerovce, okr. Vranov nad Topľou, Majerovce, okr. Vranov nad Topľou, pred Obecným úradom
description: Rozbehni Majerovce is a running event held in the village of Majerovce, in Vranov nad Topľou District, in front of the Municipal Office. The race offers categories for children and adults, with main races of 5 and 10 km. The children’s races start at 09:15 and the main race at 10:15. Organizer Martin Folenta and the Municipality of Majerovce warmly invite runners of all ages to enjoy a pleasant day of sport.

name: Beh Rajeckou dolinou KL Auto
location: Rajecké Teplice, Rajecké Teplice, Námestie SNP Rajecké Teplice
description: The KL Auto Run through the Rajec Valley is a running event set in the scenic Rajec Valley, offering a combination of paved and country roads. The course runs mostly along country roads, with approximately 20% paved surface, creating an enjoyable and varied running experience. The event is known for its excellent organization and friendly atmosphere, attracting runners of all levels. The start is at SNP Square in Rajecké Teplice. The organizer is Ján Valúch Jr., who is available for information and support.

name: Beh malý Caesar
location: Rajecké Teplice, Rajecké Teplice, Námestie SNP
description: The St. Andrew’s Run and the Little Caesar Children’s Run are traditional events in Rajecké Teplice, bringing a sporting and family-friendly atmosphere to SNP Square. The St. Andrew’s Run is a 4.5 km road race with online registration, while the Little Caesar Children’s Run is for children aged 1 to 9 and is free of charge. The event also includes a competition for the best-decorated children’s stroller, adding to the experience for participants and spectators alike. The event takes place in the afternoon, with registration and the start on the square.

name: Beh zvrchovanosti Chrenovec – Brusno
location: Chrenovec-Brusno, Prievidza District, Trenčín Region, Slovakia

name: S-Race
description: S-Race je OCR běh v Mariánských Lázních, který se koná před Kolonádou Ferdinandova pramene. Závod nabízí tratě o délce 6 km, 12 km a 18 km, které vedou převážně po zpevněných lesních cestách s více než 20 překážkami na jednom okruhu. Pro děti jsou připraveny závody přizpůsobené věkovým kategoriím. Start a cíl jsou umístěny přímo u kolonády, kde je zázemí s šatnami, WC, úschovnou a občerstvením. Závod je vhodný pro širokou věkovou škálu a nabízí intervalový start s programem pro děti během hlavního závodu.

name: Koblížkový pasecký běh
description: Koblížkový pasecký běh je tradiční silniční závod v Pasece u Olomouce, který nabízí trať dlouhou 8,2 km. Závod vede po asfaltu, dlažbě a parkových cestách, prochází obcí, cyklostezkou k sanatoriu a parkem Odborného léčebného ústavu, a vrací se zpět na start u obecního úřadu. Start prvních kategorií je v odpoledních hodinách, což vytváří příjemnou atmosféru pro běžce i diváky. Pořadatelem je Ivan Elischer, který zajišťuje hladký průběh akce a podporu běžcům.

name: Halda Trail Run
description: HALDA TRAIL RUN je terénní zážitkový běžecký závod v Kuřimské Nové Vsi, který vede malebnou krajinou údolí potoka Halda a říčky Libochovky. Nejdelší trasa měří přibližně 24 km a obsahuje 23 brodů, které jsou běhatelné a v létě příjemně osvěžující. Závod nabízí tři varianty délky trasy (4, 14 a 24 km), které na sebe navazují a umožňují změnu délky i během závodu. Trasa vede převážně lesem a loukami mimo hlavní turistické cesty, s panoramatickými výhledy, dvěma krátkými prudkými stoupáními a různorodým povrchem, což ocení jak pohodáři, tak ambiciózní trailoví běžci.

name: Běh o Ludgerův meč
description: Běh o Ludgerův meč je třetí ročník běžeckého závodu pořádaného Běžeckým klubem Náchod ve spolupráci s obcí Hořičky. Závod je součástí běžeckého seriálu Primátor CUP a poháru Velká cena východních Čech. Trasy vedou okolím Hořiček s krásnými výhledy na Kladské pomezí, v mírně zvlněném terénu s povrchem šotoliny, lesních cest a minimem asfaltu. K dispozici jsou tratě pro děti, hlavní závod na 8 km a FIT trasu na 4 km. Start i prezentace probíhají v areálu u fotbalového hřiště v Hořičkách.

name: Dodenauer Volkslauf
organizer: Leichtathletik Gemeinschaft Eder (LG Eder) / TSV Dodenau
description: The Dodenau Volkslauf is a recreational running event open to everyone, starting and finishing at the Dodenau multi-purpose hall in Battenberg-Dodenau. The event offers a range of distances from Bambini races to a half marathon, as well as Nordic walking. To be included in the rankings, participants must belong to an athletics club or an LG. Online registration is available until about one week before the race; late registration is possible at the start.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Dodenau multi-purpose hall
Distances for Bambini, short, middle and long races, as well as a half marathon
Nordic walking over 5 km and 10 km
additional: Late registration at the start is possible from 07:45 until 45 minutes before the respective start. To be included in the rankings, participants must provide their club or LG on the registration form. Terrain: Dodenau multi-purpose hall, online registration, various running distances, Nordic walking

name: Monzinger Wingertslauf
description: The Monzinger Wingertslauf offers two attractive running routes of 7.5 km and 15.5 km through the beautiful countryside around Monzingen. The routes are mostly on unpaved farm tracks and are hilly, with the longer route featuring a steep single-track section. Walkers are also welcome on the 7.5 km route; the focus is on enjoying sport. The event is easy to reach by train, and the awards ceremony takes place at the clubhouse by the sports field.
course_highlights: 7.5 km route with 145 m of elevation gain and a refreshment station at km 4
15.5 km route with 330 m of elevation gain, consisting of two laps, each with a steep single-track section of approximately 250 m
Routes are hilly and 80% on unpaved farm tracks
additional: Late registration is possible if all 150 starting places have not sold out, with a €1 late-registration fee. The awards ceremony takes place at the clubhouse by the sports field, approximately a 500 m walk from the start/finish. Parking is available at the sports field. Wine gifts are awarded to the first three men and women in both races, along with vouchers for a pizza evening for new course records. Monzingen has a railway station, making it easy to travel by train. A ride-sharing service is offered. Refreshments are available at specified kilometres. The event is easy to reach by public transport. Sponsored by Lauf-Abenteuer Marathonreisen.

name: Pönitzer Volkslauf

description: The 41st Pönitz Fun Run takes place in Pönitz and invites runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers to a sporting and social event. The course runs through the charming landscape of Holstein Switzerland, with romantic hedgerows, summer fields, and peaceful meadows. At the Pönitz Sports Park, participants can enjoy a friendly atmosphere, refreshments, show performances, and an awards ceremony. All participants receive a commemorative medal, and attractive prizes are awarded to the winners.
course_highlights: Holstein Switzerland scenery with hedgerows, fields, and meadows
Start and finish at Pönitz Sports Park in a summery atmosphere
Refreshments and show performances at the venue
additional: The awards ceremony begins at 11:15, with medals for the overall winners (places 1–3) and trophies and certificates for age-group winners and placers. Members of SVG Pönitz pay half the entry fee. The event offers refreshments, show performances, and a friendly atmosphere for athletes, companions, and spectators. Runners can choose from the half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, and Nordic walking; start times from 8:30; a shared experience of community and nature.

name: 27. Gläserner Mönch Lauf
description: The Gläserner Mönch Run is a traditional trail race in the Harz foothills, returning after a seven-year hiatus. The course is known for its undulating profile, with more than 100 meters of elevation gain per lap, and the legendary climb up 222 steps to the “Gläserner Mönch.” Participants can choose from a range of distances, from the Bambini Run to the 18 km Extreme Run, and enjoy unspoiled nature among rocks and forests. The event combines a sporting challenge with local pride and takes place around the Landhotel Schäferhof in Halberstadt.

name: 8. Barigauer Turmlauf
description: The Barigauer Turmlauf is a traditional running competition in Königsee that welcomes runners of all age groups. The route passes through the scenic countryside around Barigauer Turm and offers a varied challenge on natural trails. The race is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and the excellent organization by Laufverein Königsee.
course_highlights: Run through the scenic surroundings of Barigauer Turm
Natural trails with varied terrain
Family-friendly event with various age groups

name: BTG-Sommerstaffel
description: The BTG Summer Relay is a long-standing relay event organized by Bielefelder Turngemeinde von 1848 e.V. The club is the oldest sports club in Bielefeld and offers a wide range of sports, including athletics. The event takes place in Bielefeld and is aimed at sports enthusiasts who want to compete together in teams. BTG values a family-friendly atmosphere and a sense of sporting community.

name: BÄRENFELS SOMMERTRAIL 63-KM mit MARATHON, HALBMARATHON und 11-KM
description: The BÄRENFELS SUMMER TRAIL offers an unforgettable trail experience amid the unspoiled nature of Saarland-Hunsrück-Hochwald National Park. The event features four distances ranging from 11 km to 63 km, with challenging elevation gains, on a wonderfully scenic circular trail around Bärenfels. Runners and walkers can enjoy the varied landscape of the Nahesteig and look forward to a sporting adventure in a unique natural setting.

name: Dinkelsbühler Staffellauf
description: The Dinkelsbühl relay race takes place in the historic old town of Dinkelsbühl. Each relay team consists of four runners, each completing a lap of approximately 3 kilometres around the old town. The course passes landmarks such as the Alte Promenade, the Wörnitztor, the city park and the music pavilion, accompanied by an inclusive drumming group. Children can take part in the Funtasia Kids-Run, with age-appropriate courses. Alongside the sporting competition, the event offers a varied programme featuring music, a bouncy castle and refreshments.

name: Gibacht Berglauf und Kinderläufe
description: The Gibacht Mountain Run and children's races in Furth im Wald is a traditional mountain race that takes runners of all ages along challenging courses through the scenic landscape around the Gibacht. In addition to the 10 km main race, the event offers a 6 km mountain run and children's races, which are designed to encourage young runners. The race is known for its varied course, including some steep climbs, and is a highlight of the regional running calendar.
course_highlights: Challenging mountain course with steep climbs
Scenic route around the Gibacht
Separate children's races to encourage young runners
additional: The start of the Gibacht Mountain Run has been moved forward to 09:30. Results from previous years are available online. In addition to the main race, the event includes children's races and a 6 km mountain run. The race regulations for the mountain run are available as a PDF in the website's service section.

name: int. Rosskopflauf
description: The Rosskopflauf in Heuweiler is a traditional mountain race featuring various distances, from short Bambini races to the challenging 18.4 km Roßkopflauf with 560 metres of elevation gain. In addition to the main race, there is also the 10 km Wildtalereck Run, walking routes, and races for schoolchildren and young people. The event emphasises a family-friendly atmosphere and supports childcare for children and young people during the summer holidays. Overall winners receive prizes at the awards ceremony, while in the adult age categories, non-cash prizes are forgone in favour of a good cause.
course_highlights: 18.4 km Roßkopflauf with 560 metres of elevation gain
10 km Wildtalereck Run
Routes for Bambini, schoolchildren, and young people
additional: At the awards ceremony, prizes are given to the overall finishers in places 1 to 3. Children and young people also receive prizes for places 1 to 3. In the adult age categories, non-cash prizes are forgone in favour of a good cause. The event supports childcare for children and young people during the summer holidays with a sports programme run by volunteers.

name: Kappelseelauf Rentweinsdorf
description: The Kappelseelauf in Rentweinsdorf is a popular running event held annually since 2008 and has become a fixture for recreational runners. The event offers a varied program for all ages and ability levels, from Bambini and schoolchildren’s races to Nordic walking and a half marathon. The diverse routes pass through idyllic natural surroundings around Kappelsee, along Hutseedamm with views of the castle, and through Rentweinsdorfer Hauptwald and Eichelberg. Refreshments are provided along the route and at the finish, with drinks, fruit, cake, and bratwurst.

name: Nußlocher Wiesenlauf
description: The Nußloch Meadow Run is a long-standing running event in Nußloch, held annually at Max-Berk-Stadion and in the surrounding area. The event offers 5.3 km and 10 km races on loop courses along paved roads and forest trails. The 10 km course has been measured and approved in accordance with DLV regulations, making the race particularly appealing to ambitious runners. The event is well organized and hosted by SG Nußloch Athletics, which also handles online registration and participant support.

name: Ranntallauf
description: The Ranntallauf takes place at the TV Nöttingen club grounds. The race starts at 9:30 a.m. and offers a 5 km course for runners and Nordic walkers. Afterwards, all participants and visitors are invited to enjoy lunch together and a lively family afternoon with grilled food. The event is a great opportunity for sports enthusiasts and families to spend an active and sociable day together.

description: The Stadtlauf Düren on July 11, 2027 offers a varied running experience for all ages and ability levels, with events including the Medici21 Half Marathon, the Parma Immobilien 5 KM Run, the SWD Kids’ Run, and the exciting First or Burst elimination race. The routes pass through the city center, Burgauer Forest, and along the Rur, combining a sporting challenge with a special atmosphere. Participants receive an official MIZUNO event shirt, a high-quality finisher’s medal, goodie bags, electronic timekeeping, and free event photos. The start and finish are centrally located at Düren Market Square, which is also the hub of the event, with a stage and refreshments.
course_highlights: The Medici21 Half Marathon covers 21.1 km through the city center, Burgauer Forest, and along the Rur, with many shaded sections
The Parma Immobilien 5 KM Run follows a flat, varied city-center route with sections along the Rur
The First or Burst elimination race takes place on a compact circuit in the heart of the city center, featuring thrilling head-to-head duels
additional: The SWD Kids’ Run starts in two blocks, one in the morning and one at midday. The First or Burst elimination race starts at 12:00 and is a knockout format with eight scoring rounds of 1 km each. Awards ceremonies take place immediately after the respective events at Market Square. Finish-line refreshments are provided by EDEKA Vogel, Reissdorf, and Nobis. High-quality event photos by JD-PhotoArt are included free of charge for all participants.

description: The Steinenberger Waldlauf is a traditional running event in Rudersberg, offering a range of distances for runners of all ability levels. Held annually in July, the event combines challenging forest trails with a family-friendly sports festival. Races range from the half marathon to short schoolchildren’s races, welcoming competitive athletes, recreational runners, and families alike. The event promotes mass participation in sport and supports local clubs through donations made for each starter.
course_highlights: Forest trails with some challenging sections
New 5 km recreational run with less elevation gain, ideal for beginners and young people aged 16 and over
A varied range of distances, from the 2 km schoolchildren’s race to the half marathon
additional: Online registration is available until 15 minutes before the start. Late registration is available on the event day at the multi-purpose hall from 07:30 until 15 minutes before each start; cash payment is required. Bib collection, a valuables deposit, changing rooms, and showers are available. The event supports local clubs with a donation of €1 per starter. The course and sights can be viewed on the Sportfreunde Steinenberg Komoot profile.

name: Vierländer-Eck Lauf
description: The Vierländerecklauf in Bösingen is a running event featuring a main race, a middle-distance race and a children’s race. The course starts at the VfB Bösingen sports grounds, passes the Vierländereck, runs through the districts of Waldmössingen and Seedorf, and returns to the start. The undulating route alternates between asphalt and gravel paths. Refreshments are available along the course and in the finish area, and participants can shower at the sports clubhouse. The awards ceremony takes place afterward at the sports clubhouse.

name: Bajoro 26
description: Bajoro 26 is a 10 km race taking place in Starogard Gdański. It’s an excellent opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic course and prepare for race day with dedicated training plans tailored to different ability levels. The organizers offer expert support and detailed training instructions, making the event appealing to both beginners and more experienced runners. Bajoro 26 is a moderately challenging event on an asphalt surface, ideal for improving fitness and competing in a friendly atmosphere.

name: II Bieg po Borówkę
location: Centrum Olchowca, Olchowiec, Gmina Obsza, Poland
description: Bieg po Borówkę is a running event held in Olchowiec, in the Obsza municipality, as part of the Berry Relay. The program includes a 10 km run and a Nordic walking event over the same distance. The route takes runners through scenic terrain on the edge of Roztocze and the Solska Forest, combining sporting competition with the promotion of local berries.
course_highlights: Scenic surroundings of Roztocze and the Solska Forest
Route along the Tanew and Wirowa rivers
Section through a blueberry plantation
additional: The run and Nordic walking event are both held over a distance of 10 km. The start and finish are in the center of Olchowiec.

name: II Galicyjska 10
description: The 2nd Galician 10K of the Subcarpathian Regional Chamber of Civil Engineers is a sporting event bringing together Chamber members and their families. It will take place in Urzejowice, in the park by the stadium. The event features 10 km races, a 7 km Nordic walking event, and children’s races in various age categories. It’s a great opportunity to spend active family time outdoors, promote a healthy lifestyle, and bring together the civil engineering community. Participants can look forward to a sporting atmosphere and a fun finish.

name: X Bieg Pamięci Dywizjonu 303
description: The 303 Squadron Remembrance Run is an annual running event organized in the Borki Municipality. It aims to promote running and a healthy lifestyle, and to commemorate the soldiers of 303 Squadron who fought in World War II. The event takes place in Stara Wieś and offers various distances for adults and children. The organizers provide race packs, medals, a post-race meal, and medical care. The event attracts great interest from the local community and runners.
course_highlights: Main race distances of 11.3 km, 5.3 km, and 3.3 km
Children’s races of 100 m, 400 m, and 600 m
Scenic surroundings of Stara Wieś in the Borki Municipality
additional: The organizers provide electronic timekeeping, commemorative medals, cotton bags, T-shirts, water for participants, race packs for children, trophies for the winners, a post-race meal, and medical care.

name: 43 Bieg o Złoty Kłos
location: Kołaczkowo, Września County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 43rd Golden Ear Race is held in Kołaczkowo. It’s an opportunity for those who want to take part in a local running event and tackle the course in a sporting atmosphere.

name: Botaniczna Piątka – edycja letnia
location: Arboretum Leśne Warmii i Mazur, Kudypy 2a, Kudypy, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka is a cross-country running series organized by running enthusiasts since 2014, with an emphasis on scenic routes and the aesthetic qualities of its venues. The summer edition takes place at the Warmia and Mazury Forest Arboretum in Kudypy, offering participants a unique experience surrounded by nature. The event is intimate in scale and promotes physical activity in beautiful natural surroundings. The organizers support the popularization of running and provide a welcoming atmosphere for runners of all levels.
course_highlights: Cross-country route in the Warmia and Mazury Forest Arboretum
Scenic forest trails and natural surroundings
A run in an intimate, welcoming atmosphere
additional: The event is organized by Stowarzyszenie Biegiem w Las, based in Poznań. It places particular emphasis on the aesthetic qualities of its venues and on popularizing cross-country running. The Botaniczna Piątka birthday is celebrated in summer. Location: Kudypy 2a.

name: IX Kraszewski Bieg Po Zdrowie
organizer: Klub Biegacza im. P. Sękowskiego w Płońsku; OSP Kraszewo-Gaczułty
description: The 9th Kraszewski Run for Health is an annual running event held in Kraszewo-Gaczułty near Raciąż. The main 10 km race, with manual timekeeping, attracts runners seeking a sporting challenge. There are also accompanying races over 4.7 km, a Nordic Walking event over the same distance, and a 300 m children’s race without timekeeping. The event takes place at the fire station, followed by a closing ceremony with awards for the winners and a prize draw.
course_highlights: Main 10 km race with gross timekeeping
Accompanying 4.7 km race and Nordic Walking event
300 m children’s race without timekeeping
additional: Registration and race number collection take place from 09:30 to 11:00. The children’s race starts at 11:15, the accompanying race at 11:30, the main race at 12:00, and the Nordic Walking event at 12:05. The closing ceremony and awards are scheduled for 13:30, along with a prize draw for participants. The start and event take place at the fire station. The main race uses manual timekeeping; the other events are untimed.

name: VI Sztafety Grajewskie
description: Grajewo Relays is an annual running event held as part of Grajewo Days. It takes place in the green area by the Grajewo Historical Chamber and around the football pitch. The event is friendly and recreational, with participants competing in relays over 4×330 m, 4×660 m, and 4×990 m. Teams may have 2 to 4 runners, and the relays are mixed-gender, with no division by sex. Every participant receives a commemorative medal, and entry is free, making it a great opportunity to enjoy time together and socialize.
course_highlights: A loop of approximately 330 m laid out on the football pitch
Three distances to choose from: 4×330 m, 4×660 m, and 4×990 m
A skill challenge in the 4×330 m relay: throwing a beanbag at a target, with a possible penalty lap
additional: Teams may have 2 to 4 runners, and each runner must complete at least one lap. Relay changes are permitted only in the designated zone, and the order of changes is up to the team. Runners are verified using an identity document at the race office. The awards ceremony takes place immediately after the events finish.

name: Wałecki Festiwal Biegowy
location: Domki na Promenadzie nad Jeziorem Raduń, Aleja Gwiazd, Wałcz, Poland
organizer: Fundacja Wychowanie przez Sport; Urząd Miasta Wałcz
description: The Wałcz Running Festival is an annual sporting event held in Wałcz, attracting runners of different ages and abilities. The festival promotes running as a simple and accessible form of physical activity and brings together the local community and participants from across Poland. The programme includes children’s races, charity run-walks, and main events, including a half marathon and a 6 km race. The event takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Lake Raduń, offering participants smooth organisation and attractive race packages.
course_highlights: The half-marathon course runs over asphalt, concrete, gravel, and forest trails
There are two refreshment and hydration stations on the half-marathon course
The start and finish are located on the promenade by Lake Raduń
additional: The participant limit for the entire event is 500. The festival includes a best-costume contest and the BiegamBoLubię Pomagać charity initiative benefiting Kazik. The half marathon has a time limit of 2 hours 45 minutes and two refreshment and hydration stations. The race office is located by the Cottages on the Promenade by Lake Raduń, on Aleja Gwiazd.

name: Zdrowy Event
organizer: Fizjoterapia Karolina Kusiak i Szczeciński Bazar Smakoszy
description: Zdrowy Event is the first edition of an event bringing together exercise, health and the local community, held at Wały Chrobrego in Szczecin. Participants meet at 10:00 to set off together on a recreational run, open to everyone regardless of fitness level. After the run, the Health Zone takes place at the Szczeciński Bazar Smakoszy, where from 10:00 to 14:00 visitors can meet inspiring people, take part in meaningful conversations and gain practical knowledge about health. The event is family-friendly and promotes an active, healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: Recreational run at Wały Chrobrego
Health Zone at the Szczeciński Bazar Smakoszy
Open to everyone, regardless of fitness level
additional: The Health Zone is open from 10:00 to 14:00 during the event at the Szczeciński Bazar Smakoszy. The event is recreational and requires no special running preparation. OFF Marina hosts a Health and Wellness Zone with free consultations; the event is also open to people who do not run regularly.

name: Malý Štrbský maratón
location: Štrba okr. Poprad, Štrba okr. Poprad, Nám. pred Kultúrnym domom
organizer: Obec Štrba, Obec Liptovská Teplička, Športový klub Štrba
description: The Malý Štrbský Marathon is a traditional running race held every year on the second Sunday in July in the village of Štrba in the Tatras. Runners can choose between two main distances—31 km and 10 km—which follow an asphalt road between Štrba and Liptovská Teplička. The event is part of the Tatry v pohybe project and attracts runners from several countries. The atmosphere in the square in front of the Cultural Centre is always lively and full of sporting spirit. The organizers are the Municipality of Štrba, the Municipality of Liptovská Teplička, and Športový klub Štrba.

name: COOL-BEACH-TRAIL Sulzkar
description: The COOL-BEACH-TRAIL Sulzkar is a short trail run covering 2.08 kilometers in Bad Wildbad. The course offers runners a varied, nature-filled setting, ideal for beginners and anyone who enjoys short trail adventures. The event takes place annually and attracts running enthusiasts from the region.
course_highlights: Short trail course of 2.08 km
Nature-filled running setting in Bad Wildbad
Suitable for beginners and recreational runners

name: Dvě kola při zdi
description: Dvě kola při zdi je tradiční krosový závod v pražské oboře Hvězda, který nabízí tratě pro muže, ženy i děti. Muži běží hlavní trať dlouhou 7,8 km podél obvodových zdí obory, ženy mají zkrácenou trať 4 km, ale mohou také běžet mužskou trať. Pro děti jsou připraveny dva kratší okruhy. Po závodě je pro účastníky připravena tombola a vydatné občerstvení.

name: Halda
description: HALDA TRAIL RUN je terénní zážitkový běžecký závod vedoucí krásnou krajinou údolí potoka Halda a říčky Libochovky. Nabízí tři trasy o délkách 4, 14 a 24 kilometrů, které na sebe navazují a umožňují změnu délky během závodu. Trasa vede převážně lesem a loukami mimo hlavní turistické cesty, s 23 brody, dvěma krátkými prudkými stoupáními a panoramatickými výhledy. Závod je vhodný jak pro pohodáře, tak pro ambiciózní trailové běžce, a je důkladně značen šipkami a fáborky.

name: REWAG-Firmenlauf
description: The REWAG Company Run is one of the largest running events in the Regensburg region and offers a unique opportunity to run with colleagues in a relaxed atmosphere, connect, and celebrate. The event is limited to 3,000 participants and attracts numerous companies and runners. In addition to the sporting experience, the run supports Jumpakids, the Regensburg Center for Obesity in Children and Adolescents, with a donation. Registration is open from, both individually and in groups.

name: SUNSET Hamburg 2026
description: Altra Sunset Hamburg takes place in Wilhelmsburg Island Park.
