The event offers a scenic approx. 5 km loop course on asphalt and paths, which can be run 1 to 3 times, making distances of approx. 5 km, 10 km or 15 km possible. On the day of the event, participants can choose how many laps to run, with a checkpoint counting the laps. There is also a relay race, in which the course is run four times by teams of 2 to 4 runners. The event is open to anyone who is trained and has no medical concerns; club membership is not required.

name: Lauf um und am Gartower See
description: The run around and along Gartow Lake is a longstanding running event held on the lake’s north shore in Gartow. The course offers a natural setting with views of the lake and the surrounding Gartow pine forest, making it ideal for runners of all ages. The event is organized by the sports club SV Gartow, which has fostered sporting commitment and community in the region since 1946. The start and finish are centrally located in town, creating a welcoming, family-friendly atmosphere.

name: Běh o Neplachovský Hrneček
description: Běh o Neplachovský hrneček je tradiční běžecký závod pořádaný v Neplachově, Jihočeský kraj, který se koná již 14. ročník. Závod je součástí Jihočeského běžeckého poháru a je podporován z rozpočtu Jihočeského kraje. Akce nabízí sportovní zážitek v krásném prostředí regionu a přitahuje běžce z širokého okolí. Pořadatelé srdečně zvou všechny běžce k účasti na této oblíbené akci.

name: Kružberský Tesák
description: Kružberský Tesák je sportovní akce konaná v areálu přehrady Kružberk, která nabízí trasy a kategorie pro zkušené závodníky, mírně pokročilé i úplné začátečníky. Závod je vhodný pro sólo běžce, výletníky i rodiny s dětmi. Součástí akce je také Pejskiáda, zábavná výstava a soutěže pro psy všech velikostí a plemen. Organizátorky Kateřina a Lucie, milovnice přírody a sportu se psy, se snaží vytvořit přátelskou atmosféru a zajistit příjemné zážitky pro všechny účastníky.

name: Kölner Zoolauf
description: The Cologne Zoo Run is a unique running event at Cologne Zoo, taking place for the 13th time. It offers four different races for all age groups, from Bambini and children’s races to ambitious 10 km races. The course runs through the zoo and past numerous animal enclosures, making the run a special experience. Official timing and certificates are included for most races, and the event places great importance on safety and being family-friendly.
course_highlights: A 1.62 km loop through Cologne Zoo, with views of numerous animal enclosures
Option to run between 1 and 6 laps (1.6 km to 10.05 km)
Start and finish in front of the main entrance to Cologne Zoo
additional: Start times: Bambini Run 18:15, Kids Run 18:30, Top Run 19:00, Fun Run 20:15. A requested start number is available for an additional €3. Late entries are possible on site up to the day of the event, with a €5 late-entry fee. Participation with dogs, strollers, walking poles, or music devices is not permitted. Official timing is provided for all races except the Bambini Run. Certificates can be printed online. Safety and supervision of children in the start and finish area are organized. Four race types (Bambini, Kids, Top, Fun); online registration; no refunds for non-participation; participation requires a bib number and chip; participation with dogs or headphones is not permitted.

name: Schwanberglauf Iphofen-Castell
description: The Schwanberg Run is a traditional 10.4-kilometer race from Iphofen to Castell, taking place for the 42nd time. The course combines challenging climbs through vineyards and wooded sections with an idyllic finish in Castell Castle Park, accompanied by a wine festival atmosphere. The event is open to runners and walkers of all ability levels, and proceeds support social institutions. It is organized by volunteers from TG Kitzingen in cooperation with the SBL team.
course_highlights: Start at the Rödelseer Tor in Iphofen, with a steep climb through vineyards
Water stations at kilometers 3 and 6.5, and shortly before kilometer 7
Finish in Castell Castle Park with a wine festival atmosphere
additional: Race bib collection from 15:30 at Karl-Knauf-Halle, Iphofen. Start corrals arranged according to runners’ own 10-kilometer times. Toilets at Karl-Knauf-Halle. Free bus transfer from the finish in Castell back to the start in Iphofen (departures from 16:50 to 17:45, approximately every 10 minutes). Baggage transport by VW van. Medical services provided by the Bavarian Red Cross. Showers available in Castell (men at the Meierei, women at the sports hall). Every finisher receives a bottle of mineral water from Franken Brunnen. Course: 10.4 km; start in Iphofen, finish in Castell; refreshments along the course; showers available in Castell; electronic timing; awards ceremony at the wine festival; online registration; overnight accommodation in Iphofen recommended.

name: Freiberger Bürgerfestlauf
description: The Freiberger Bürgerfestlauf is one of Germany’s largest Bürgerfest running events and takes place in Freiberg. More than 1,600 runners take part across four different distances, ranging from 600 meters to 10 kilometers. The event has a high finisher rate of over 95% and is followed by a Bürgerfest with live music in the market square. The start and finish are in the center of Freiberg, creating a lively, community atmosphere.

name: Leśna Eko Piątka
description: Leśna Eko Piątka is a race held in Piekary Śląskie that promotes the city and supports integration and the prevention of addiction among children and young people. The course follows asphalt and gravel roads through Dioblina Forest, with the start and finish at the MOSiR stadium at 3 Olimpijska Street. The event is held under the honorary patronage of the Mayor of Piekary Śląskie. Participants receive a race package including a bib, timekeeping, a medal and medical support. The time limit is 45 minutes, and the field is limited to 500 participants.

name: Night Run Gdynia
description: Night Run Gdynia is a 5-kilometer night race held on the shores of the Baltic Sea as part of IRONMAN Poland triathlon weekends. After dark, with city lights reflected on the asphalt and water, hundreds of runners set off on a spectacular route through the streets of Gdynia. The event has become an important and eagerly anticipated part of the city’s sporting calendar, combining athletic competition with the unique atmosphere of a night run.

name: eXcytująca Piątka
description: eXcytująca Piątka is a 5-kilometer road race held in the center of Inowrocław. The event attracts fans of physical activity, offering sporting excitement and the unique atmosphere of a nighttime run after dark. This is the event’s second edition, combining sport with the city’s vibrant character.
course_highlights: Race along the streets of central Inowrocław
5-kilometer distance
Nighttime atmosphere after dark

name: XIII Bieg po Chrust
location: Chróścice, Dobrzeń Wielki, Opole County, Poland
description: The 13th Bieg po Chrust is an amateur road race held in Chróścice. The event attracts local runners and fans of physical activity, offering a friendly atmosphere and the chance to compete on the town’s streets. The race is recreational and community-oriented, promoting a healthy lifestyle among residents.
course_highlights: Road course in Chróścice
A distance of 5 km in previous editions
Race associated with Victoria Chróścice’s sports festival

name: Zkus Noční Kuks
description: Zkus Noční Kuks je noční běžecký závod v malebném barokním prostředí Kuksu. Nabízí dvě trasy - 10 km a 5 km - které vedou kolem historických památek jako Braunův betlém a Hospital Kuks. Běh v temnotě osvětlený pouze čelovkami přináší jedinečný zážitek a atmosféru, kterou si závodníci dlouho pamatují. Trasa 10 km zahrnuje poutní linii Křížové cesty 21. století, zatímco kratší 5 km trasa vede podél nočního Labe a hraběcí aleje se 222 stromy.

name: ČEZ RunTour Olomouc
description: ČEZ RunTour Olomouc je rodinný běžecký závod, který nabízí tratě pro hobíky i elitní běžce v délkách 3, 5, 10 a 21,1 km, včetně dětských běhů na 500 a 1000 metrů. Závod se koná v malebném prostředí Smetanových sadů a je součástí celorepublikové série s unikátními tratěmi. Organizátoři kladou důraz na perfektní servis, bezpečnost a zábavu pro celou rodinu, včetně doprovodného programu a charitativního rozměru. Každý účastník obdrží startovní balíček a může se těšit na občerstvení a podporu vodičského týmu. ČEZ RunTour je nejen sportovní událostí, ale i celodenním zážitkem pro všechny věkové kategorie.

name: Noční běh Rusava
description: Noční běh Rusava je nezapomenutelný noční závod v Hostýnských vrších, který nabízí 12hodinový běh na jednom okruhu a také závod na 5 km. Závod je vhodný jak pro jednotlivce, tak pro štafety, a není podmínkou běžet celých 12 hodin. Zázemí závodu zahrnuje tělocvičnu pro odpočinek, celonoční bufet a občerstvovací stanice. Akce se koná v malebném prostředí sjezdovky a lesů okolo Rusavy, což přináší jedinečný sportovní zážitek pod hvězdnou oblohou.

name: 7 pohoří Krušné Hory
description: Závod Krušné hory 2026 je technický trailový běh, který vás provede krásami Krušných hor a bývalou hornickou krajinou zapsanou v UNESCO. Trasa začíná v Abertamech a vede přes bývalý důl Eva, Jelení, Švýcarskou chatu na Plešivci, Merklín, bývalou osadu Kaff, Pstruží a lyžařský areál až do cíle. Nabízí tři tratě různých délek a převýšení, které potěší jak zkušené běžce, tak i začátečníky. Závod se koná za každého počasí a účastníci obdrží pamětní medaili a občerstvení na trase i v cíli.

name: Rokytnice nad Jizerou - Dvoračky
location: Horní náměstí, Rokytnice nad Jizerou, Liberec Region, Česko
description: Trasa z Rokytnice nad Jizerou na Dvoračky je oblíbená turistická cesta v západních Krkonoších, která začíná na Horním náměstí v Rokytnici. Modře značená trasa vede kolem Huťského potoka k malebnému Huťskému vodopádu a dále k horské boudě Dvoračky, která je známá svou historií a výrobou tradičních sýrů. Cesta nabízí krásné přírodní scenérie, zejména v podzimním období, kdy okolní bukové lesy hrají všemi barvami. Trasa je vhodná pro turisty, skialpinisty i běžkaře, kteří si zde mohou užít zasněženou krajinu a příjemné občerstvení v restauraci Štumpovka na Dvoračkách.

name: MORAVSKOSÁZAVSKA 50K

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné ULTRA 50 je stanoveno na 1.000,- Kč

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné DVOJIC je stanoveno na 1.000,- Kč / člen dvojice

description: Moravskosázavská 50K je ultramaraton dlouhý 50 km, který vede údolími Moravské Sázavy ze Zábřehu až k pramenům řeky na Bukové hoře. Trať nabízí pestrou kombinaci lesních cest, přírodních stezek a asfaltových úseků s převýšením 1369 metrů, včetně výběhu na vrchol Bukové hory. Závod je vhodný jak pro zkušené ultramaratonce, tak pro běžce hledající novou výzvu, a končí na vrcholu Bukové hory, odkud se závodníci pohodlně svezou lanovkou. Po závodě je možné kempovat v cílovém areálu s dostupnými sprchami a snídaní v neděli ráno.
course_highlights: Pestrá kombinace lesních cest, přírodních stezek a asfaltových úseků
Celkové převýšení 1369 metrů s výběhem na vrchol Bukové hory
Cílová páska přímo na vrcholu Bukové hory s možností sjezdu lanovkou
additional: Účastníci jsou vybaveni ID náramkem, startovním číslem a GPS lokátorem. Na trase jsou občerstvovací stanice s vodou, iontovým práškem, CocaColou a sezónním ovocem. Po závodě je možné kempovat v cílovém resortu Buková Hora s přístupem ke sprchám. GPS lokátory slouží k monitorování závodníků a výsledky jsou elektronicky měřeny. Lanovka z cíle je krytá a slouží k pohodlnému sjezdu do zázemí. Závod je zařazen do žebříčků UTMB a ITRA. Povinná výbava zahrnuje ID náramek, viditelně upevněné startovní číslo, treker a nabitý funkční telefon.

name: OYLER Berglauf
description: The 27th Oyler Berglauf takes place as part of the sports festival week in Marklohe. Organized by Jugendgemeinschaft Oyle, this race offers a sporting challenge on Oyler Berg. The event is part of a varied sports program and is aimed at runners who want to experience a hilly course in a friendly club atmosphere. The exact course route and further details can be found on the organizer’s website.
course_highlights: Race on Oyler Berg
Venue: Sportplatz Oyle
Part of Sportwerbewoche 2026
additional: The organizer is Jugendgemeinschaft Oyle von 1953 e.V. No pricing or registration details have been published on the website, nor are there any start times or wave details. The event takes place as part of Sportwerbewoche 2026 at Sportplatz Oyle; no specific registration information is available.

name: 22. Wiesenlauf
description: The 22nd Wiesenlauf in Klein Meckelsen gives runners the opportunity to compete on officially measured and DLV-approved 5 km and 10 km courses. The event includes district championships over both distances and a regional championship over 5 km, with results counted from the M/W 14 age group. The start and finish are at the Klein Meckelsen sports field. The event is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational participants.

name: 4. Fachberg 100
description: The Fachberg 100 is a 100 km road race in Northeim, Germany, starting at 6:00 a.m. The course consists of 15 laps and a short out-and-back section, alternating between asphalt and dirt paths. Each lap includes about 75 meters of elevation gain, for a total elevation gain of 1,125 meters. This is a small ultrarunning event with limited entries and no entry fee; runners must bring their own refreshments.

name: HAKRO Stadtlauf
description: The Hakro Stadtlauf in Schrozberg is a charity running event that donates €5 for each participant to Jugendhilfe Creglingen. The race is open to all age groups and promotes running together across generations. Individual competitions are organized by registration category, along with a team competition for companies, clubs, families, and friends. The event prioritizes a smooth schedule and asks participants to register in advance by July 16, 2025.

name: Heizomat Altmühlseelauf
description: The Heizomat Altmühlseelauf is a long-running race event held every July around Lake Altmühlsee in Gunzenhausen. The event features several competitions, including a half marathon, a relay race, a public race, a student race and a Bambini race. The courses are officially measured and pass through the scenic surroundings of Lake Altmühlsee. The event gives both individual and team runners the chance to test their endurance and enjoy a day of sport together.

name: Lautersteiner Panorama-Lauf
description: The Lautersteiner Panorama-Lauf offers runners breathtaking views across the Swabian Alb. The varied course follows forest-edge trails and open stretches around Weißenstein, rewarding the effort with fantastic panoramas. Organized by TV Weißenstein, the event celebrates the joy of sport in nature and a great atmosphere. Runners can choose between a short 4.5 km loop and the challenging 11.5 km main race.

name: Maintal Ultratrail / Bayerische Trail Meisterschaften 30km
description: With its three scenic routes in Franconian wine country, the Maintal Ultratrail offers an enjoyable trail-running experience. The 30 km route with 720 meters of elevation gain leads through picturesque vineyards, nature reserves, and varied forests along the Main. The event is aimed at trail-running enthusiasts of all experience levels who appreciate nature and the shared running experience. The motto for all participants is: fun and experiencing nature come first, not just athletic performance.

name: Sparkasse Kraichgau CityCup Bretten
description: The Sparkasse Kraichgau City Cup Bretten has been a popular race since 2004, attracting runners from the region. The course runs through the beautiful old town and its narrow streets, and across the market square with its half-timbered houses. Events include children’s races, a 5 km race, a 10 km race, and a 4 x 2.5 km relay for companies, clubs, and groups. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and dedicated volunteers.
course_highlights: Course through the historic old town of Bretten
The market square with its half-timbered houses is part of the course
Relay with 4 x 2.5 km laps on the sports field and through the town
additional: Race number pickup, with integrated chip, from 15:15 at TV Platz. Changing rooms and showers are available. Every participant receives a medal at the finish. Certificates and prizes are awarded for the children’s races and age groups. Special prizes for schools with the highest percentage of participants and for the best relay teams.

name: Spendenlauf Recke
description: The Spendenlauf Recke is a charity event in aid of Kinderkrebshilfe Münster. Organized by Andreas Egelkamp Heizung, Lüftung, Sanitär GmbH & Co. KG and Lewe, a company from Recke, the event offers two distances: 5 kilometers for beginners and recreational runners, and 10 kilometers for experienced runners looking for a greater challenge. The focus is on joining forces for a good cause, with the entire entry fee donated. The event combines sporting commitment with social responsibility and invites everyone to take part and show their support.

name: Nocna zaDyszka 2026
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Piekarach Śląskich
description: Nocna zaDyszka is a 10 km race held as part of the 7th PKO Piekary Śląskie Half Marathon, which will take place in Piekary Śląskie. The event attracts many runners, and the participant limit for this distance is 900. The day before, on July 17, the accompanying 5 km Leśna Eko Piątka race will also take place. The organizers invite everyone to take part and expect nearly 3,000 runners across all distances in 2026.

name: 12. Nocny Portowy Maraton Szczeciński oraz 7. Nocny Portowy Półmaraton Szczeciński
description: The 12th Szczecin Night Port Marathon and the 7th Szczecin Night Port Half Marathon are unique night races held in Szczecin, taking runners through the city’s central streets, the port and the shipyard. The marathon course consists of two identical 42,195 m loops, while the half marathon covers 21,097 m; both courses are certified by the PZLA. The race starts at 23:00, creating a unique atmosphere in the city at night and allowing participants to admire Szczecin’s distinctive landmarks. The event promotes physical activity, a healthy lifestyle and the West Pomerania region.
course_highlights: The course passes through the city centre, the port and the Szczecin Wulkan Shipyard grounds
Scenic viewpoints at Wały Chrobrego, with music and spectator support
Two identical marathon loops and distance markers every 1 km
additional: The time limit for both races is 6 hours. The start and finish are at the Florian Krygier Municipal Football Stadium. The marathon course consists of two identical loops, while the half marathon is one loop. There are refreshment stations and distance markers every 1 km along the course. Participants must follow the instructions of the event and safety personnel.

name: 7. PKO Piekarski Półmaraton
description: The 7th PKO Piekary Half Marathon is an annual running celebration held in Piekary Śląskie, attracting both running enthusiasts and people just starting out in the sport. The event takes place and offers an opportunity to spend time actively and bring the local community together. It is a half marathon, and the organizers ensure professional organization and a welcoming atmosphere.

name: Garmin Ultra Race Tolkmicko
description: Garmin Ultra Race Tolkmicko is a unique trail running event held in the picturesque landscapes of the Elbląg Upland overlooking the Vistula Lagoon. The course follows wild trails with varied elevation and peaceful natural scenery, offering runners a chance to connect with the region’s nature and history. The event is part of a nationwide mountain running series that promotes physical activity in harmony with nature, and is aimed at both beginners and experienced ultramarathon runners. Participants can expect professional organization, medical support, and a generous race pack.
course_highlights: The wild natural landscapes of the Elbląg Upland, with picturesque hills
Routes through the Elbląg Upland Landscape Park and four forest nature reserves
Views of the Vistula Lagoon and historic sites, including Old Prussian hillforts and the Imperial Stone
additional: The race pack includes a waterproof race bib with a chip, medical support, course marking, aid stations, drinks and snacks at the finish, a commemorative medal, and a GPS tracker for the 81 km distance. Starts are staggered from 5:00 (81 km) to 10:30 (14 km), with separate Garmin Junior races for children. The system applies discounts when registering for more than one event in the series. The program also includes Garmin Junior races over 200 m, 500 m, and 1,000 m.

name: 2 Chojnicka Piątka
description: 1. Chojnicka Piątka is a road race held in Chojnice, attracting runners looking for sporting excitement and fun. The event takes place on Rybacka Street and offers plenty of attractions for participants. It is a great opportunity to test your fitness over a short distance and experience the atmosphere of a local sports celebration.
course_highlights: A road race in central Chojnice on Rybacka Street
A short 5 km distance, ideal for runners of all levels
The atmosphere of a local sports celebration with numerous attractions
additional: The event is part of the Grand Prix Borów Tucholskich. It offers plenty of attractions for participants and spectators. The start and finish are on Rybacka Street in Chojnice.

name: Biegowe Grand Prix Mazur
location: Kosewo, Mrągowo County, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Silent Hill Resort Sp. z o.o.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Start w biegach głównych: 150,00 zł wpłata jednorazowa za cały cykl biegowy

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Start w biegach dziecięcych i młodzieżowych jest bezpłatny

description: The Biegowe Grand Prix Mazur is a series of races held in the picturesque towns of Masuria, promoting outdoor activity and a connection with nature. The event includes main races of approximately 6.6 km, as well as races for children and young people in different age categories. The main race route runs along asphalt roads, cobblestones, and forest roads, offering participants varied surfaces and beautiful views. Every participant receives a commemorative medal, and the organizers provide water and a hot meal after the race. The event has a family-friendly, inclusive atmosphere, with activities for children and a concert after the winners’ awards ceremony.
course_highlights: The main race route is approximately 6.6 km long and runs along asphalt roads, cobblestones, and forest roads
Children’s and youth races over distances from 100 m to 800 m in different age categories
Picturesque Masurian landscapes around Kosewo
additional: The participant limit across all distances at each race is 400; the Race Office opens 1.5 hours before the start; race packs can be collected and registration is available until 30 minutes before the start; every participant receives a commemorative medal; the organizers provide water and a hot meal prepared by local rural homemakers’ associations; after the awards ceremony, the band Folk Banda will perform.

name: Puchar Polski Nordic Walking - II etap
XIII Półmaraton i Ćwierćmaraton
location: Chrzypsko Wielkie, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Kordícky Extrém
location: Kordíky okr. B. Bystrica, Kordíky okr. B. Bystrica, Obecný úrad
organizer: Marathon Banska Bystrica, s.r.o., ON-POINT o.z.
description: Kordícky Extrém is a challenging mountain run through the picturesque surroundings of Kordíky in the Banská Bystrica District. The course is designed for runners seeking extreme challenges in nature, with significant elevation gain and technical sections. The event is part of the Marathon Tour series and offers a unique running experience in beautiful mountain scenery. The organizers welcome all runners who want to test their endurance and courage on this extreme terrain.

name: Mesciské pancaky
location: Mestisko, okres Svidník, Mestisko, okres Svidník, futbalové ihrisko
description: Mesciské Pancakes is a running event in Mestisko, Svidník District, offering 5 km and 10 km routes for men and women with no age restrictions. The route runs mostly on asphalt, with sections across grass and a dirt road, providing runners with varied terrain. The race starts at the football field in Mestisko. Registration is available online or at the event venue.

name: Behaj lesmi Veľká Fatra
description: Behaj lesmi Veľká Fatra is a trail race in Veľká Fatra National Park, offering runners unforgettable views of the Low Tatras, forest singletracks, and special forest roads. The routes pass through the UNESCO site of Vlkolínec and also include a cable car and Sidorovo. The race is part of the international UTMB Index Races, where runners earn points based on their performance and the length of the course. Three courses of varying distances and elevation gains are available, catering to runners of different levels.

name: Běžím Krušnohořím Fojtovice
organizer: Živé Sokolovsko z.s. a Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s.
description: Běžím Krušnohořím je běžecký a canicrossový seriál, který vás provede krásami Krušných hor. V rámci šesti závodů v různých destinacích si můžete vybrat z hlavních závodů na 6 až 9 km, zážitkových tras 20 až 30 km, chůze s hledáním bodů a dětských závodů. Seriál je vhodný pro běžce, canicrossaře, děti i chodce a nabízí pestrou škálu tras v malebné přírodě Krušnohoří. Závod v Fojtovicích se koná a nabízí hlavní závod, zážitkovou trasu, chůzi a dětské závody.

name: Šachty - Štěpánka
organizer: Český Ski klub Vysoké nad Jizerou
description: Běh Šachty - Štěpánka je tradiční závod pořádaný Českým Ski klubem ve Vysokém nad Jizerou. Závod je součástí Maratonstavu Českého poháru v běhu do vrchu a nabízí běžcům náročnou trať v krásném krkonošském prostředí. Akce přitahuje sportovce i fanoušky běhu do vrchu, kteří si užijí výzvu i atmosféru horského závodu. Pořadatelé vítají všechny běžce, kteří chtějí změřit své síly na této tradiční trati.

name: Aalener Stadtlauf
description: The Aalen City Run takes place at Sparkassenplatz in Aalen and offers a varied running event with different races, including a Bambini Run, a schoolchildren’s race, the AOK Active & Healthy Run, a team run, and the youth and Sparkasse main races. The event is known for its great atmosphere and sporting challenges. New this year is the introduction of the Stadt-Land-Fluss Cup, which combines races in different landscapes and presents a special challenge. Registration is now open, and all running enthusiasts are warmly invited to take part and enjoy an urban and nature-inspired running experience.

name: Barbarossalauf 2026
description: The Barbarossalauf 2026 returns as a city run to Erlenbach am Main on July 19. The new course starts centrally at the old fire station and follows a flat, scenic route along the Main before passing through Erlenbach’s old town to the finish. The event offers races for different age groups and distances, from children’s races to the 10 km main race, which consists of two laps. The course is ideal for beginners and ambitious runners aiming for fast times, and showcases Erlenbach at its best.

name: Flughafenlauf Barth
description: The Barther Airport Run takes place at Stralsund-Barth Baltic Sea Airport and offers a varied program of seven events for runners and walkers of all ages. From short distances for young runners to the half-marathon, there is something for everyone. The event promises a morning full of activity, fun, and exciting races in a unique atmosphere right at the airport. Walkers are also very welcome, and refreshments are available on site.

name: Heumadener Volkslauf 2026
description: The Heumaden Volkslauf has been held annually in Stuttgart-Heumaden since 2009 and offers runners three distances: 5.5 km, 10.3 km and, since 2018, a half marathon of 21 km. The course is a long, mostly flat loop with few climbs, passing through the districts of Heumaden, Riedenberg and Kemnat. The start and finish are at the Untere Hasenwedel sports grounds. The event is part of the family sports festival and includes a water station on the longer course.

name: Internationaler Allgäu Volkslauf
description: The International Allgäu Fun Run in Leutkirch has taken place annually since 1970 on Children’s Festival Sunday and has grown into a major sporting event, attracting hundreds of runners from southern Germany and the twin towns. Organized by the Skiläuferzunft of TSG 1847 Leutkirch e.V., the fun run is supported by numerous volunteers, the Leutkirch DRK, the city administration, and other partners. It is a traditional sporting event in Leutkirch and offers a varied program for runners of all ability levels.

name: Jakob Scheuring Lauf
description: The Jakob Scheuring Run is a traditional memorial race held as part of the Sportvereinigung Ottenau sports festival at Murgstadion. Races are offered over 1.5 km for schoolchildren, as well as 5 km and 10 km courses that pass through the picturesque Salzwiesental. The route runs mostly through forests and meadows, with the start and finish in the stadium. Certificates, prizes, and trophies are awarded to the fastest runners and age-group winners. A special prize is also offered for a new course record.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Murgstadion Ottenau
Route passes through the idyllic Salzwiesental, with forest and meadow terrain
Elevation difference of approx. 140 m for 10 km and approx. 40 m for 5 km
additional: Race-number collection at the festival grounds from 07:30 to 08:50. Late entries are possible until 30 minutes before the start for a fee of €2. Drinks are provided in the start/finish area and at the 10 km turnaround point. Changing and shower facilities are available at Murgstadion. Ample parking is available at Murgstadion. The age-group winners’ awards ceremony takes place at the festival tent from approx. 12:00. Every participant is entered into a raffle for valuable prizes with their race number.

name: neuefinanzkultur Laufevent mit Biosphärenlauf und Auinger Alblauf
description: The Neue Finanzkultur running event in Auingen in the Swabian Jura is an annual major race day featuring various running events, including the Biosphere Run and the Auingen Alblauf. Alongside the sporting competition, there is also a charity walking event in aid of Clowns im Dienst. The event offers timing using a transponder system, awards for the fastest runners in each age group, and special prizes for the largest group. Children can take part in an untimed Bambini Run and receive a medal, certificate, and surprise.

name: run4trees
description: Run4Trees is a running event in Unterhaching. The course leads through the picturesque Perlacher Forst, with the start and finish at the Unterhaching fairground. By taking part, runners show their support for climate protection, as proceeds are donated to Plant for the Planet and the youth program of TSV Unterhaching. The event combines sporting commitment with environmental awareness and community spirit.

name: Sommer Rheinauenlauf
description: The Summer Rheinauen Run in Bad Bellingen is a traditional running event organized by TV Rheinweiler. The races run through the picturesque Rhine meadows and offer a varied course for runners of all ages. The event includes several distances and caters to both recreational runners and ambitious athletes. Alongside the sporting competition, the sense of community is also a key focus.

name: Stundenlauf VfL Dettenhausen
description: The 24-hour run in Dettenhausen is a long-standing running event taking place for the 20th time. The event is held at the VfL Dettenhausen sports grounds and gives both individual and team runners the opportunity to test their endurance. Participation is free, with a strong focus on community and fitness. The course is equipped with a microchip in the race bib for easy timekeeping, and overnight accommodation is available directly at the sports grounds.

name: Vogelsberger Südbahnlauf
distance_verbose: Halbmarathon, 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km, 1.9 km, 0.46 km, 0.45 km, 0.4 km
description: The Vogelsberger Südbahnlauf takes place on 18 July 2027 in Birstein-Unterreichenbach and offers a varied selection of race distances for all age and ability groups. The routes follow the asphalt Vogelsberger Südbahn cycle path as well as surfaced forest and field paths through the hills, fields, forests and villages of the southern Vogelsberg. In addition to the half marathon, there are 10 km and 5 km races, Nordic walking, and races for schoolchildren and toddlers. The event is organized by Lauftreff Unterreichenbach and is family-friendly, with activities for all ages.
course_highlights: Routes on the asphalt Vogelsberger Südbahn cycle path
Through the hills, fields, forests and villages of the southern Vogelsberg
Varied elevation gain depending on the distance (up to +211 m for the half marathon)
additional: Race bib collection begins at 07:30 at the sports clubhouse. Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start and must be paid for in cash on site. The organizer is Lauftreff Unterreichenbach, a division of Dalles Kicker Unterreichenbach 1988 e. V. The organizer’s Crewrun takes place on Tuesdays at 19:00 at the sports field in Birstein-Unterreichenbach.

name: 14. Dolnośląski Festiwal Biegów Górskich
description: The Lower Silesian Mountain Running Festival is a prestigious trail-running event held in picturesque Lądek-Zdrój. As part of the festival, runners can take on a variety of courses with different distances and elevation gains, from short night races to mountain ultramarathons. The event attracts mountain-running enthusiasts, offering unforgettable views and technically challenging courses. In 2026, the festival will take place from 16 to 19 July, and participants can look forward to a varied programme of accompanying events and professional organisation.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Lublin edycja letnia
description: Botaniczna Piątka Lublin – Summer Edition is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts who have been promoting the sport since 2014. The event takes place in the picturesque UMCS Botanical Garden in Lublin, combining sporting competition with the beauty of nature. The race is part of the Botaniczna Piątka series, known for its scenic courses and friendly atmosphere. All running enthusiasts are invited to take part in this special summer edition.

name: Grand Prix Biskupca #3
location: Stadion Miejski, ul. Wiosenna, Biskupiec, Poland

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Udział płatny przelewem - 20,00 zł. Decyduje kolejność zgłoszeń w ramach limitu 200 uczestników na imprezę.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Udział płatny przelewem - 20,00 zł. Decyduje kolejność zgłoszeń w ramach limitu 200 uczestników na imprezę.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Udział płatny przelewem - 20,00 zł. Decyduje kolejność zgłoszeń w ramach limitu 200 uczestników na imprezę.

description: Grand Prix Biskupca is a series of four races held in Biskupiec: the South Run, approximately 5 km long; the Morning Run; the Walrus Run; and the Night Run. The races follow scenic routes around lakes, city parks, and recreational areas, with electronic timing. Gross times count toward the overall standings, and the South Run is an individual 5 km race. The organizers set a participant limit and offer registration both online and on race day. The event is open to amateur and professional runners, with a friendly atmosphere and professional organization.
course_highlights: The South Run course is approximately 5 km long and loops around a retention reservoir and the City Park.
The Morning Run is approximately 5 km long and loops around Lake Kraksy Małe and allotment gardens.
The Night Run is approximately 8 km long and follows paths, cycling routes, and the City Park.
additional: The participant limit for each event is 200. Entry fees can be paid using fast online payment methods after registration. Bib numbers and timing chips are issued at the race office. Chips are reusable and must be returned after the race. Bib numbers must be pinned to the front, at chest or waist height. Race-day registration is available until 30 minutes before the start and must be paid for in cash. The route runs on asphalt, paving stones, sand, and grass; distance markers are placed every 500 m.

name: Piątka Królowej Bony
organizer: Gmina Różan, Lekkoatletyczny Klub Sportowy Maków Mazowiecki
description: Piątka Królowej Bony is a 5 km race held at the Municipal Stadium in Różan. The event is open to people over the age of 15; minors must provide written consent from a guardian. The start and finish are located at Szkolna 3. The event is organized by the Municipality of Różan and the Maków Mazowiecki Athletics Club, and participants can expect professional support and timekeeping.

name: VII Bieg Górski o Złotą Paproć
description: The 7th Golden Fern Mountain Run is a 10 km mountain race taking place in picturesque Tymbark. The event is a great opportunity to test your fitness on a demanding route with varied terrain. The organizers encourage participants to prepare using dedicated training plans tailored to different skill levels. This event attracts runners who value challenges and contact with nature.

name: IX Bieg Uliczny Zarzecze na 5
location: Gminny Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji, Zarzecze, Podkarpackie, Poland
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Zarzeczu
description: The 9th Zarzecze 5 Road Race is an annual 5 km road race organized by the Jarosław Running Group “Sokół” Association. The event takes place at the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Zarzecze, offering participants the chance to compete on a scenic course. The race is part of the local running calendar and promotes physical activity and a sense of community among runners. The start is scheduled for 15:00, and the event is open to runners and Nordic walking enthusiasts.
course_highlights: A 5 km road course
Organized at the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Zarzecze
Scenic surroundings and a local feel
additional: The race is organized as part of the activities of the Jarosław Running Group “Sokół” Association. The organizer has experience running sporting events and works with local institutions. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and physical activity among residents of the region.

name: XV Tatarska Piątka
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Rozwoju Miejscowości Studzianka, Gmina Łomazy, OSP Studzianka
description: Tatarska Piątka is an annual race held in Studzianka that commemorates the region’s Tatar heritage. The event attracts runners looking to take on a 5 km course through scenic areas and places connected with Tatar history. The race is part of a broader programme of sporting and cultural events organised by a local association that works to preserve the area’s traditions and history. Participants can expect a friendly atmosphere and an opportunity to learn about the local culture.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through the scenic areas of Studzianka
Passes places connected with Tatar heritage
Held as part of local cultural and sporting events
additional: Online registration is available through time2go.pl; the race office is located in the former school building.

name: XXII Bieg Szlakiem Partyzantów z Lubatowej
location: Szkoła Podstawowa w Lubatowej, Lubatowa, Poland
description: The 22nd “Along the Partisans’ Trail from Lubatowa” Run is an annual sporting event organized by the Lubatowa Friends Society. It commemorates the partisans murdered in Grabiński Forest and promotes a healthy lifestyle and sport. The event takes place in Lubatowa, starting at the Primary School. The route runs through forest, country roads and paved roads, and finishes at the monument commemorating the fallen. The event brings the local community together and promotes a spirit of competition and fair play among children, young people and adults. After each race, a formal wreath-laying ceremony is held at the monument, and participants receive commemorative medals and prizes.
course_highlights: The main race route is approximately 8 km long and runs through forest, country roads and paved roads
The open-category group starts at the monument in Grabiński Forest
Finish at the monument commemorating the murdered partisans and those who fell in World War II
additional: Competitors start in age groups: children and young people run distances of 800 m and 2,000 m, while the open category runs approximately 8 km. Every participant receives a commemorative medal, and the top finishers in the age-group and overall categories receive prizes and trophies. Registration is online only. Participants receive commemorative medals at the finish; trophies and prizes are also provided.

name: Śremska Dycha
location: Parking przy ul. Roweckiego 22, Śrem, Poland
description: Śremska Dycha is a road race held in Śrem on a scenic route around Lake Grzymisławskie. Runners can choose between two distances: 5 km (one loop) and 10 km (two loops). The course combines asphalt sections, shared pedestrian and cycling paths, and local roads, offering varied but accessible terrain. The event is open to both beginner and more experienced runners, providing an appealing challenge for every running enthusiast.
course_highlights: Route around Lake Grzymisławskie
Two distances: 5 km (one loop) and 10 km (two loops)
Varied course surface: asphalt, shared pedestrian and cycling paths, and local roads
additional: The start and finish are located in the parking lot at 22 Roweckiego Street in Śrem. The race takes place on a Sunday. The course is suitable for runners of varying ability levels. The start and finish are in the parking lot at 22 Roweckiego Street. Participants receive a medal, and there are water stations along the course and professional timing.

name: Bančanská desiatka
description: The Bančanská Ten is a traditional running race in the village of Banské, in Vranov nad Topľou District, held in front of the Cultural Centre in Banské. This popular sporting event has a long history and attracts a record number of participants each year. The race is known for its challenging uphill course and beautiful surroundings, and is organized by Športový klub Banské. In addition to the main race, uphill time trials and other accompanying events are held.
course_highlights: Uphill race in the village of Banské – Mláčky
Traditional start in front of the Cultural Centre in Banské
Challenging course profile, with a new course record of 14:35 min
additional: The event is organized by Športový klub Banské, which has a long tradition dating back to 1985. It is held regularly, and in 2025 the 30th edition of the Bančanská 10/5 will take place. The event also includes the JANTEX Banské–Mláčky uphill time trials, which have their own history and categories. The race includes 10 km and a 5 km relay; registration is available online or on site. There is also a varied accompanying programme, including a bouncy castle and performances.

name: YOUNG RUN Nestlé
location: Prievidza, Prievidza, Námestie J. C. Hronského
description: YOUNG RUN Nestlé is a running event in Prievidza featuring 21 km, 10 km and 5 km races. Competitors are divided into categories by age and gender, and relay events are also available for children. The races start at J. C. Hronský Square, with different start times for each distance. The organizers are YOUNG RUN, Nestlé and the City of Prievidza, providing a quality sporting experience for all age groups.

name: Ipelský Beh
location: Lučenec - Kalonda, Lučenec - Kalonda, hrádza na Ipli
description: Ipelský Beh is a running event held in Lučenec–Kalonda, on the embankment of the Ipeľ River. The course runs mostly over grass and includes a 100-metre section of disused railway track. The race is open to various age categories for men, women and youth, and also includes Nordic walking. The organizers are the town of Lučenec, the municipality of Kalonda and OZ-Novohrad, who warmly invite runners of all levels to take part in this traditional event.

name: Běh za Sliveneckou saní
description: Běh za Sliveneckou saní je závod do kopce v Praze 5-Velká Chuchle, který měří 2,54 km s převýšením 130 metrů. Tento závod je součástí seriálu Běhy do kopců v Praze a okolí a nabízí běžcům výzvu v podobě náročného stoupání. Závod je vhodný pro všechny, kteří chtějí otestovat svou sílu a vytrvalost v kopcovitém terénu.

name: AOK Firmenlauf Schwäbisch Hall
description: The AOK Company Run Schwäbisch Hall is a popular team event held at the Optima Sportpark. The course is approximately 5 kilometers long and is run twice, offering a great opportunity to get active together with colleagues. Alongside the race, participants can enjoy a varied program featuring a DJ, a group warm-up, award ceremonies, and free refreshments at the finish. The company run promotes team spirit and combines exercise with socializing.

name: Wild and Run
description: Wild & Run transforms Oberkollbach into a runner’s paradise and is part of the Sparkassen Volkslaufcup Pforzheim-Calw. The event offers runners a varied route through nature and invites both ambitious runners and running enthusiasts to the starting line. The Wild & Run team looks forward to welcoming many participants and enjoying a sporting atmosphere in the idyllic surroundings.

name: Tobiášův běh Kazín - Cukrák
description: Tobiášův běh Kazín - Cukrák je součástí seriálu KOPEC, který představuje běhy do kopce v Praze a okolí. Tento tradiční závod nabízí běžcům možnost poměřit síly na náročných kopcovitých tratích v malebném prostředí Kazína. Seriál KOPEC je známý svou komunitní atmosférou a podporou běžců všech kategorií, kteří jsou automaticky zařazeni do celkového hodnocení. Závod je vhodný pro všechny, kdo mají rádi běh v přírodě a výzvy spojené s kopcovitým terénem.

name: Trompeterlauf Bad Säckingen
description: The Trompeterlauf Bad Säckingen is a long-standing running event that gets the whole city moving and welcomes runners of all ages. From Bambinis and young people to ambitious athletes, the event offers a variety of courses and categories, putting the joy of running and the shared experience at its heart. It brings generations together and creates a special atmosphere in the Trumpeter City. Alongside individual and team races, there are special races for children, young people and families.
course_highlights: A variety of courses for all ages, from Bambinis to adults
Relay competitions for women’s, men’s and mixed teams
The performance-focused Grieshaber Grand Prix for ambitious runners
additional: Runners with a time over 22 minutes start in the second wave at 18:57. The parent-child race is untimed and has no bib number; participants can also take part on the day without registering. Adult running shirts can be added for €15. The late registration fee on the day of the event is €5 per entry. Certificates and medals are awarded to the three fastest runners in each category.

name: Bokeler Windmühlenlauf
description: The 20th Bokeler Windmühlenlauf takes place in Bokel. This traditional anniversary race is organized by ALG-VfL Bokel. Participation is limited to 300 people, and registration is through the RaceResult platform. The race offers runners a special atmosphere in the region and is a popular event for endurance and athletics enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Various race distances (5 km, 10 km, children's race)
Local club atmosphere
Limited to 300 runners
additional: Places are limited to 300 people. The organizational fee covers provision costs and is non-refundable, including in cases of force majeure.

name: Fun-Lauf "Durch den Wewerschen Wald"
description: The 33rd Fun Run “Through the Wewerschen Forest” in Paderborn is a community run with no timing and no entry fee. The event supports children in need through many thousands of steps and asks participants to make a donation instead. The runs take place on flat circuits with little elevation gain and are suitable for everyone. Competitions for children and teenagers are also offered.
course_highlights: Flat circuit (one lap)
Little elevation gain (30 to 40 metres uphill)
Distance options: 5 km and 7 km
additional: Run with no timing and no entry fee; participants are instead asked to make a donation. Competitions for children and teenagers are available. The finish location is not publicly displayed (RUNME Premium required). Runs on flat circuits, various distances, no timing, no entry fee, donations for charitable causes.

name: Münchnerauer Abendlauf
description: The Münchnerau Evening Run is a long-standing running event organized by SV Landshut-Münchnerau e.V. and held annually as part of the Münchnerau Sports Field Festival. The races offer runners of all ages a great opportunity to compete and then enjoy the festival together. The event thrives on the dedication of many volunteers and its welcoming, family-friendly atmosphere. Registration is easy via QR code or the RaceResult online platform.
course_highlights: Races held as part of the Münchnerau Sports Field Festival
Family-friendly atmosphere followed by the Sports Field Festival
Long-standing event supported by dedicated volunteers
additional: The event is supported by many volunteers. A shared Sports Field Festival takes place after the races. The races include Bambini, school-age, and youth competitions.

name: Sparkassen-Adam-Riese-Nachtlauf
description: The Sparkassen-Adam-Riese-Nachtlauf is an evening running event in Bad Staffelstein, Bavaria, offering races for children, recreational runners and experienced participants. The event takes place in summer and is part of the Bavarian running calendar. Distances range from short races for schoolchildren to main races of about 9 kilometres. Its night-race format gives runners the chance to run under the evening sky, setting it apart from typical daytime races.
course_highlights: Various distances from 780 m to approx. 10 km
Night-race atmosphere under the evening sky
Summer event in Bad Staffelstein, Bavaria
additional: The event offers races for different age groups and ability levels, including races for children and recreational runners. July weather is usually sunny, with an average temperature of 25 °C during the day and 15 °C at night. Night race with multiple distances, part of the Bavarian running calendar, held in summer in Bad Staffelstein.

name: 13. Heilwald Marathon
description: The Heilwald Marathon in Bad Lippspringe is a special race held in the heart of the 200-hectare Heilwald, a unique therapeutic and recreational forest in Europe with a soothing low-mountain climate. The course consists of six large laps of 7.05 km each, for a total of 42.3 km, and has been carefully measured using a measuring wheel and GPS. This is a private, self-supported race. Times are recorded manually, and a photo of the clock must be submitted as proof. Participants take part at their own risk. There is no entry fee; instead, voluntary donations for tree planting are welcome.

name: 38. Heiligenhafen Mitternachtslauf

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgeld: 20,- EURO in der Online-Voranmeldung für alle Teilnehmer.

description: The Heiligenhafen Midnight Run is a traditional race held annually in Heiligenhafen. The main course covers 10 km through the town and around the inland lake, starting and finishing at the Lütjenburger Weg sports field. In addition to the classic 10 km race, there are shorter events for teenagers and children, as well as an inland lake run of approximately 5.5 km. The event offers a special atmosphere, with plenty of support along the course and a late-evening start that makes the race a unique experience.
course_highlights: 10 km loop through Heiligenhafen with views of the inland lake
The course passes the waterfront promenade, holiday park and pier
Gentle climbs and descents; start and finish at the sports field
additional: Several events are offered: the Mini Midnight Run (1 km) for children, the Midnight Run Double Mile (3.2 km) for teenagers, the inland lake run (approx. 5.5 km) and the classic 10 km race. Late registration is available on race day from 6 p.m. at the sports field for an additional fee. Timing is electronic using a transponder, with no rental fee; a fee of 15 euros is charged if it is lost. The field is limited to 1,250 runners.

name: Waldlaufmeisterschaft SV Renquishausen
description: The 37th Forest Running Championships take place in Renquishausen in the Black Forest. The race is part of the Silberdistel Runs and offers various distances for Bambini, students, recreational runners and the main race. The event is open to all age groups and takes place in all weather conditions. Race numbers are issued from 16:00, and the awards ceremony takes place about one hour after the last finisher crosses the finish line at the sports hall.

name: WAREMA Lauf
description: The 19th WAREMA Run in Marktheidenfeld offers a varied running experience for all ages and ability levels. From the short Bambini and schoolchildren’s races to the motivating 5 km company run and the challenging 10 km main race, there is something for everyone. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and lively spirit, which delight both beginners and experienced runners. The start and finish are at the district sports complex, which serves as the event’s central venue.

name: 3Kings3Hills Trailrunning-Festival
distance_verbose: 169 km, 118 km, 85 km, 59 km, 40 km, 26 km, 16 km, 6 km
description: The 3Kings3Hills Trailrunning Festival takes place on 23 and 24 July 2027 in Haidmühle, in the Germany-Austria-Czechia border region. It offers seven distances from 5 to 168 km, with varied trails ranging from flowing sections to technically demanding passages. The route runs through the Bavarian Forest and Bohemian Forest, with impressive views and challenging uphill and downhill sections. The festival is internationally recognised and, in addition to the races, offers all finishers a finisher shirt and a pizza. A tracking app is mandatory for the longer distances, and drop bags are available.
course_highlights: Breathtaking single trails and the famous Grenzsteig along the former Iron Curtain
The region’s highest mountains, including Dreisessel, Haidl and Bayerischer Plöckenstein
Technically demanding trails with flowing sections and a 35 m-high observation tower with an aid station
additional: Bib pickup is on 23 July from 10:00 to 22:00 and on 24 July from 05:30. Drop bags are available at the festival grounds for the 100 Miles ULTRA TRAIL® and ULTRA TRAIL® XL. No drinking cups are provided at the aid stations, so runners must carry a hydration container with a capacity of at least 1 litre. The race is ITRA- and UTMB-registered, and points are awarded. All finishers receive a fresh slice of pizza from Gozney at the finish. Mandatory equipment is subject to random checks.

name: Tatra SkyMarathon 2026
description: Tatra SkyMarathon is a prestigious mountain race held in the heart of the Tatra Mountains, in Zakopane. The original Tatra SkyMarathon course follows the ridge of the Czerwone Wierchy and Starorobociański Peak, with two demanding vertical-style climbs, each with approximately 1,200 metres of elevation gain, interspersed with challenging Tatra descents. The race is part of a running festival that highlights the sporting character of Podhale and Orawa, offering participants and spectators an unforgettable experience. Join us to race or cheer along the course on 23 July 2027.
course_highlights: Course over the ridge of the Czerwone Wierchy and Starorobociański Peak
Two vertical-style climbs, each with approximately 1,200 m of elevation gain
Demanding Tatra descents
additional: The festival village and race office are located in Zakopane. The required mandatory equipment is listed on the regulations page. The course has an interactive map and a downloadable profile. The race is part of a festival featuring many accompanying races.

name: Beskidzkie Gronie
description: Beskidzkie Gronie is a series of mountain races held in the picturesque Beskids, offering courses of varying lengths and difficulty levels. The races take place in several seasonal editions, including an autumn edition featuring distances from 12 km to 50 km. The courses cross varied terrain, including forest and mountain trails, providing participants with exceptional views and challenges. The event welcomes both experienced mountain runners and amateurs looking to test themselves on courses of varying difficulty.
course_highlights: Courses follow picturesque Beskid trails across varied forest and mountain terrain
Distances range from 12 km (recreational course) to 50 km (Twardziel Beskidzki)
Courses are marked and available in GPX format for easier navigation
additional: Courses are available to download in GPX format. The event offers several distances suited to different experience levels, including a recreational course. The races are part of the Beskidzkie Gronie series, which takes place at different times of the year. GPX tracks and the UTRA app are available.

name: Smilovice pomáhají - Běh pro Theu
description: Běh pro Theu je benefiční závod pořádaný Nadačním fondem Smilovice pomáhají, který se koná v areálu Sportcentra Smilovice. Tento závod podporuje léčbu a rehabilitaci malé Thei, která se potýká s vážnými zdravotními komplikacemi. Účastníci si mohou vybrat z několika tras různých délek a věkových kategorií, ať už chtějí závodit nebo se jen projít. Akce je otevřená všem, kteří chtějí podpořit dobrou věc a zažít radost z pohybu v komunitní atmosféře.

name: Běh na Lysou horu
description: Běh na Lysou horu je tradiční závod konaný vždy poslední červencovou sobotu v Krásné - Nižní Mohelnici. Tento 41. ročník přivítá běžce z České republiky i Polska, kteří si kladou za cíl zdolat Lysou horu, královnu Beskyd. Start závodu je nedaleko restaurace Zlatník na rozcestí k Lysé hoře, kde probíhá i prezentace a vyhlášení vítězů. Trať vede po asfaltové silnici po účelové komunikaci Lesů ČR až na vrchol Lysé hory.

name: Běh s létem o závod
description: Běh s létem o závod je smíšený závod na 6,5 km, který se koná u městského koupaliště v Podbořanech. Závod nabízí příjemnou trať vhodnou pro širokou veřejnost a je pořádán Informačním centrem Podbořany. Start první kategorie je tradičně v 9:00. Účast je zdarma, což umožňuje snadný přístup všem běžcům bez ohledu na úroveň výkonnosti.
course_highlights: Trať dlouhá 6,5 km
Smíšený typ závodu
Start a cíl u městského koupaliště v Podbořanech
additional: Závod je zdarma a pořádán Informačním centrem Podbořany. Pořadatel poskytuje kontaktní telefon 775 762 141. Závod je součástí služeb Českého atletického svazu pro běžce a běhání.

name: Borovská desítka
description: Borovská desítka je tradiční běžecký závod konaný v malebné vesničce Havlíčkova Borová na Vysočině. Závod nabízí 10 km trať s mírným převýšením, která vede převážně lesem a asfaltovými cestami, což zajišťuje příjemný běžecký zážitek i za slunečného počasí díky stínu stromů. Start i cíl jsou umístěny v centru obce, s občerstvovací stanicí na trati i v cíli. Po závodě je zajištěno bohaté občerstvení a slavnostní vyhlášení vítězů v různých kategoriích.

name: DJK Jakobuslauf
description: The Augsburg St. James Run, organized by the DJK Diocesan Association, is a special mass-participation event held as part of Augsburg’s oldest folk festival, the Jakober Kirchweih. The run is open to joggers and walkers and deliberately has no official timekeeping, embracing the motto “Experience over Results.” The event includes children’s races and three distances for adults, including a quarter marathon along the Lech. The start and finish are at Jakobsplatz by the famous Fuggerei, giving the run a historic and atmospheric setting.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Jakobsplatz by the historic Fuggerei
Route along the Lech
10.5-kilometer quarter marathon for adults
additional: The run has no official timekeeping, putting enjoyment and the experience first. The ecumenical event is organized by the Catholic DJK Diocesan Association of Augsburg. The Fuggerei opens to visitors free of charge during the Jakober Kirchweih for the run. Distances are available for children, walkers, and adults; there is no official timekeeping, with a focus on community and experience; start and finish at Jakobsplatz in the Fuggerei.

name: Freundschaftslauf Hasborn
description: The Hasborn Friendship Run is a long-standing running event organized annually by DJK Hasborn. It offers a range of distances, from short races for young runners to challenging distances such as 5 km, 11 km and 21 km. The atmosphere is welcoming and motivating, with lively crowds and numerous volunteers helping to make the event a success. The run is a sporting highlight in the region and attracts runners of all ages.
course_highlights: A variety of distances from 100 m to 21 km
Motivating atmosphere with music and refreshment stations
Family-friendly running event with a large number of participants
additional: The run takes place every summer, with a big bridge party featuring music and cheerleaders as a motivational point along the course. Water, sports drinks and snacks are available along the route. The club's running group meets regularly on Wednesdays, providing a good opportunity to prepare for the run. Routes for children and adults; no official times for all distances; an annual event with a special sense of community.

name: 6. GEO-Pfad Ultramarathon
description: The GEO-Pfad Ultramarathon is a 50 km trail run starting in Kaltenweide, Langenhagen, Germany. The route has a modest elevation gain of about 350 meters and must be completed within 8 hours. The course passes through forest and trail sections, by Brelinger Berg with its geological nature trail, and back along Bissendorfer Moor. The event is registered with the German Ultramarathon Association and offers online results, certificates, and finisher medals.

name: Allersberger Kirchweihlauf
description: The Allersberg Kirchweihlauf is a traditional running event held annually in Allersberg. The course follows a very flat loop around Allersberg’s market square, offering ideal conditions for runners of all ability levels. The event is part of the Raiffeisen Läufer-Cup in the BLV Middle Franconia-South district and includes various races, including a schoolchildren’s cup. Several refreshment stations and drinks at the finish are provided.
course_highlights: Very flat loop around Allersberg’s market square
Two water stations per lap
Refreshments at the finish with water, isotonic drinks, apples and bananas
additional: The race office, awards ceremony, late registration and race-pack collection are located at Westhof Gilardihaus, Marktplatz 20. Showers are available at Rothseehalle, Altenfeldener Str. 16. Travel by S-Bahn line 5 or DB to Allersberg-Rothsee station; an on-call bus runs from the station to the market square. Parking is approximately 50 m from the start/finish area.

name: Mulsumer Speckenlauf
location: Mulsum, Wurster Nordseeküste, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Mulsumer Speckenlauf is a traditional running event organized by TSV Mulsum v. 1919 e.V. The event takes place as part of Sports Week and offers races for children over 450 m and 900 m, as well as races for adults over 5.3 km and 10 km. The course runs over gravel, field paths, and asphalt roads and is known as “The Hell of Mulsum.” Food and refreshments are provided, and every participant receives a certificate.
course_highlights: Course over gravel, field paths, and asphalt roads
Children’s races over 450 m and 900 m
Adult races over 5.3 km and 10 km, with a revised 10 km course due to a bridge closure
additional: The start is at the sports field in Mulsum. The children’s races start at 14:00, and the adult races at 15:00. Participation is free for TSV Mulsum members. On-site late registration is available up to 45 minutes before the start. There is an awards ceremony, and all finishers receive certificates. The event is part of the Laufsammler campaign.

name: Rechberghäuser Sommernachtslauf
description: The 14th Rechberghausen Summer Night Run takes place in Rechberghausen. This event, officially registered with the German Athletics Federation, allows participants to run times recognized for athletics rankings. The race supports the solidarity system in sport and offers an athletic challenge in a pleasant summer atmosphere. The event includes two distances suitable for both children and experienced runners.

name: Reichenbacher Citylauf
description: The 31st Reichenbach City Run takes place as part of the Reichenbach Village Festival. This year, only the Bambini Run for children and the school relay races are being offered. The races start and finish at Reichenbach Town Hall and offer primary school classes and the youngest runners a great opportunity to get active and have fun together.

name: Tote Mann Berglauf / 10. Oberrieder Kinderlauf
description: The Tote Mann Mountain Run in Oberried is a challenging 11.1 km mountain race with 750 metres of elevation gain on forest roads and trails. The 10th Oberried Children’s Run also takes place on a flat course at the Goldberghalle, with distances from 0.4 to 1.2 km depending on age group. The race offers a special atmosphere, a varied course and refreshment stations. The start is from 10:00, with different start times for the children’s races.

name: Crazy Runners Frankenwald Trail
organizer: TSV Dürrenwaid und Crazy Runners Team Frankenwald
description: The Crazy Runners Frankenwald Trail is a family-friendly trail running event in Frankenwald Nature Park, held in Geroldsgrün. Organized by TSV Dürrenwaid and the Crazy Runners Team Frankenwald, the race offers nature-rich trails and paths with up to 2,000 meters of elevation gain. There are four race distances and a Kids Race, all of which run predominantly on natural trails. The event is known for its great atmosphere, a starter pack, and ITRA points.

name: 26. Bieg Dookoła Morynia i Jeziora Morzycko
description: Join us for the 26th edition of the Run Around Moryń and Lake Morzycko, a unique event combining sporting competition with the beauty of Western Pomerania. The course follows a scenic route around Lake Morzycko, offering participants unforgettable views and a sense of sporting community. It’s a great opportunity for runners and fans of an active lifestyle to meet in Moryń and enjoy exercising outdoors. Whatever your experience level, there’s something here for everyone.

name: Tatra SkyMarathon
description: Tatra SkyMarathon is a prestigious mountain race held in the heart of the Tatra Mountains, in Witów in the Podhale region. The course runs along the ridge of the Czerwone Wierchy and Starorobociański Wierch, featuring two demanding vertical-style climbs with approximately 1,200 m of elevation gain each, interspersed with challenging Tatra descents. The race is part of a running festival that highlights the sporting character of the Podhale and Orava regions, offering participants and spectators an unforgettable experience. The organizers invite everyone to take part and cheer along the course.

name: Bieg Powstania Warszawskiego
description: The Warsaw Uprising Run is an evening race through the streets of Warsaw, bringing together thousands of participants each year to honour the memory of the Warsaw Uprising insurgents. The event offers two distances, 5 and 10 kilometres, on new routes passing historic sites such as the Warsaw Citadel, the Museum of Polish History and the Polish Army Museum. It is a unique opportunity to combine a sporting challenge with a tribute to Polish history. The race takes place on the last Saturday in July, and participants can also take part in a virtual edition.
course_highlights: The route passes through the Warsaw Citadel, a site of great historical significance.
The race passes by the Museum of Polish History and the Polish Army Museum.
An evening race through the streets of Warsaw, with a unique atmosphere and a tribute to the insurgents.
additional: The 5 km race starts at 20:15; the 10 km race starts at 21:15. Race bibs must be worn on the front of the clothing and must not be covered or altered. Participants line up in start zones according to their predicted finish time. A virtual edition of the race is also available over 5 and 10 km, running from 15 July to 15 August.

name: 24 Bieg Uliczny św. Jakuba
description: The 24th Energa St. James’s Run is an annual running event held in Lębork to celebrate the city’s patron saint. The certified 10 km course runs through the city streets, with appropriate safety measures provided by the services responsible for order. The ceremonial start takes place at Peace Square, and the official start is on Armii Krajowej Street. Participants must obey traffic regulations. The first 600 finishers will receive a commemorative medal.
course_highlights: Certified 10 km course
Runs through the streets of Lębork
Ceremonial start at Peace Square; official start on Armii Krajowej Street
additional: 7:00–9:00 at the Race Office in the gymnasium of the Special Educational Centre in Lębork, at Curie-Skłodowskiej Street. Participants under 18 from Lębork County are exempt from the entry fee upon presenting a valid student ID. The first 600 finishers will receive a commemorative medal. A contest for the best cheering zone will be held, with a prize of PLN 1,000.

name: 9 Bieg Lubliniecki
location: Stadion Miejski w Lublińcu, Lubliniec, Poland
description: The Lubliniec Run is an annual running event organized by Mafia Team Lubliniec, attracting runners of different age groups. The main 10 km race follows a route through the scenic areas of Lubliniec. The event also includes races for children and young people, making it appealing to families and the local community. The race office is located at the Municipal Stadium in Lubliniec, and the organizers ensure participants’ comfort and a great atmosphere.
course_highlights: The main race route is 10 km long
Scenic areas of the city of Lubliniec
Races for children and young people
additional: The race office is located at the Municipal Stadium in Lubliniec at 1 74th Upper Silesian Infantry Regiment Street. Parking is available along 74 GPP Street and by the road next to the fence of the Military Unit.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
description: Botaniczna Piątka Gdynia – summer edition is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts who have been promoting the sport in Wielkopolska and beyond since 2014. The event places particular emphasis on the scenic appeal of its courses, offering picturesque and attractive routes for runners. It’s a great opportunity to combine sport with the beauty of nature and enjoy an active day in Gdynia.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on picturesque routes
Routes with scenic and natural appeal
Organized by experienced running enthusiasts
additional: Botaniczna Piątka has organized races and sporting events since 2014.

name: Gliwicka Prowokacja biegowa
location: Polana za stadionem Piasta, Gliwice, Poland
organizer: Miejski Zarząd Usług Komunalnych w Gliwicach

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: opłata za każdy start: 15 zł - roczniki 2007-2026

description: Gliwicka Parkowa Prowokacja Biegowa is a series of 12 running and Nordic Walking events held in Gliwice, in the municipal forest near the Piast Stadium. One lap is about 4.2 km long and runs mainly along forest trails and gravel paths, with some paved sections. The events are recreational and promote a healthy, active outdoor lifestyle. Participants can choose from 1 to 5 laps, covering distances from about 4.2 km to a half marathon. The event is open to runners and Nordic Walking enthusiasts, and also offers the option to take part in the online e-Prowokacja.
course_highlights: One lap is 4,219.5 m long
The route runs mainly along forest trails and gravel paths, with some paved sections
Start and finish are on a clearing near Piast Stadium in Gliwice
additional: Events take place once a month on Saturdays. The time limit for running and Nordic Walking is 3 hours. Participants can complete 1 to 5 laps (from about 4.2 km to a half marathon). There is a refreshment station with drinks after each lap. Race numbers are valid for the whole year and must be returned after each event. After the event, participants receive a drink and a snack (sausage or banana), as well as a bar in the prize draw, if sanitary regulations allow. The e-Prowokacja can be completed with any activity and has no time limit. In previous editions, the start was on the clearing behind Piast Stadium, with access from Leśna Street.

name: Pogórze Ultra Trail
description: Pogórze Ultra Trail is a mountain race organised by enthusiasts of the Strzyżów Foothills region, combining a love of running with exploring nature. The routes pass through scenic areas with diverse natural features, including old-growth deciduous forests, coniferous forests, loess gorges and unique rock formations. The race offers exceptional experiences, including running through several-hundred-metre-long wartime railway shelters in Strzyżów and Stępina. It is the largest running event in the region and attracts trail running enthusiasts every year.
course_highlights: Routes through the Brzeżanka range, the Kiczora massif, Herby and Chełm Mountain
Passage through the shelter tunnels in Stępina and Strzyżów
Varied terrain: old-growth deciduous forests, coniferous forests, loess gorges and rock formations
additional: The event is organised by the Pogórze Ultra Trail Association, which takes care of logistics and makes the refreshment stations appealing. New features are planned in the finish area. The race offers four distances, with both new and refreshed routes showcasing the region’s best locations.

name: Hel - Rysy
location: Hel, Puck County, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: I Memoriał Pamięci o Funkcjonariuszach i...
Dobra Run a Dobrá dvojka
location: Domaša, okr. Vranov nad Topľou, Domaša, okr. Vranov nad Topľou, RO Domaša - Dobrá
description: Dobra Run and Dobrá dvojka is a running event in Domaša, Vranov nad Topľou District, offering 7 km and 2 km courses. The race is suitable for various age categories of men and women, including children. It is organized by Matore s.r.o. Humenné and BAMM Bratislava. Participants can look forward to a pleasant atmosphere and the chance to compete in different age groups. Registration is available online or on site until the participant limit is reached.

name: Night city run Piešťany
description: Piešťany Night City RUN is a traditional night race held at Námestie Slobody in Piešťany. Runners can take part in the 10 km race, which runs through the city and offers the unique atmosphere of a night run under the auspices of the City of Piešťany. The event is open to various age categories, and all participants receive a commemorative medal. Electronic timing is provided during the race, and the award ceremony takes place in the evening after the run.

name: Extrém maratón Košice – Furča
location: Košice - Furča, Košice - Furča, pred SBD III, Furčianska 60
description: The Košice–Furča Extreme Marathon is a challenging running race organized by the O5 Furča Košice Running Club. The race takes place in the pleasant surroundings of Furča, where runners can enjoy the course challenges and the atmosphere of a traditional marathon. It is intended for endurance runners seeking a more extreme experience over the marathon distance. The organizers provide quality conditions and support for all participants.

name: Beh na Krivošťanku
location: Baffone Family Restaurant, Krivošťany, Strážske, Slovakia
description: The Run to Krivošťanka is a traditional race held in the picturesque surroundings of Strážske and Krivošťany. The race offers a chance to enjoy a sporting experience in nature in a family-friendly atmosphere. The organizers welcome runners of all ages and abilities who want to enjoy a great day of running.

name: Běh na Kozubovou
description: Běh na Kozubovou je tradiční horský běh konaný v Dolní Lomné, který se běží po turistických značkách s náročným převýšením. Závod startuje u pekárny v Dolní Lomné a vede přes Polanu, sedlo Pod Kykulou až k turistické chatě na Kozubové. Trať je dlouhá přibližně 5 km s převýšením kolem 500 metrů, což nabízí běžcům výzvu v podobě strmých stoupání a krásných horských výhledů. Závod je otevřený široké škále kategorií od juniorů po veterány a je známý svou přátelskou atmosférou a bohatou tombolou pro účastníky.

name: Gänslauf Herbolzheim
price_range: 12 € für 5 km und 10 km Lauf, keine Gebühr für Kinder- und Schülerläufe
description: The Gänslauf in Herbolzheim an der Jagst is a traditional fun run taking place for the 18th time. The event offers 10 km and 5 km races, a 1,400 m race for schoolchildren, and 400 m children’s races, and is held as part of the village festival. The course follows scenic, varied loops, starting and finishing at the Herbolzheim sports hall and passing landmarks such as the Herbolzheim castle ruins. Runners enjoy both paved paths and shaded woodland trails along the Jagst.
course_highlights: 10 km and 5 km races starting and finishing at the Herbolzheim sports hall
The course is 60% paved and 40% gravel farm and woodland paths
Shaded woodland sections along the Jagst, with views of the Herbolzheim castle ruins
additional: Late entries are not possible. Advance registration is required. Baby joggers, strollers, and dogs are not allowed in any race. The start and finish are at the Herbolzheim sports hall near the TSV Herbolzheim football field. The course is marked on the ground with green arrows. Medals are awarded to all participants. The event is part of the 2026 Drei-Flüsse-Cup. Events: 10 km, 5 km, 1,400 m schoolchildren’s race, 400 m children’s races; no late entries; baby joggers, strollers, and dogs are not allowed; weather-dependent conditions in July

name: Altmühl-Jura Halbmarathon
description: The Altmühl-Jura Half Marathon is a traditional race in the picturesque region around Greding. The course passes through the varied landscape of the Altmühl-Jura area, offering runners a challenging yet scenic experience. The event is open to runners of all ability levels and is organized by the City of Greding. The Greding Tourist Information Office is available as a contact point.
course_highlights: Altmühl-Jura landscape
Varied and scenic course
Traditional running event in Greding
additional: The contact point is the Greding Tourist Information Office, reachable at 08463 904-20. The event takes place in Greding. Further information and registration are available through the official websites. Terrain: roads and paved cycle paths; online registration; finishers receive a medal, certificates available online

name: Hausener Volks-Waldlauf (TGS-Hausen)
location: Sportplatz TGS Hausen, Obertshausen, Hesse, Germany
price_range: Nachmeldung 5 € für Erwachsene, online Anmeldung bis 25.07.2025, Kinder frei
description: The Hausener Volks-Waldlauf organized by TGS Hausen takes place and offers races over various distances, including a half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, and shorter schoolchildren’s and Bambini races. The start and finish are both at the TGS Hausen sports field in Obertshausen. The courses run mainly along well-marked, flat forest trails, with the half marathon run as two laps of the 10 km course.
