Timing is by transponder with gun-time results, and there is a 100 km team competition. The race is open to all age groups and offers a friendly, family atmosphere with good organization.
course_highlights: Well-marked, flat forest trails
Half marathon run as two laps of the 10 km course
Start and finish at the TGS Hausen sports field
additional: Late registration is possible on race day until 15 minutes before the start. The late-registration fee is 5 euros for adults and no fee for young people and Bambinis. Spikes are prohibited on the sports field. Timing is provided by R.S.T. Volkslauf GmbH. There is a 100 km team competition, with runners from the half marathon, 10 km, and 5 km races eligible to participate (maximum 20 participants per team). Courses on forest trails, gun and net timing, refreshments on the course and at the finish, late registration possible until shortly before the start.

name: Rieslinglauf und 17. Rheingauer Halbmarathon
description: The Riesling Run and the Rheingau Half Marathon are long-established running events that have been held for over 40 years in the picturesque vineyards of Oestrich-Winkel. The races wind through gentle hills and offer idyllic views of the Rhine Valley. The event includes several distances: 10 km, a half marathon, a 5 km fun run, and a 2,000 m student run. It is known for its friendly atmosphere and support from the local community.
course_highlights: Route through the gently rolling vineyard landscape above Mittelheim and Oestrich
Mostly paved route with gentle climbs and approximately 90 metres of elevation gain over 10 km
Idyllic views of the Rhine Valley
additional: The maximum field is limited to 555 starters. On-the-day entries are possible at the venue only until 8:00 a.m. and incur a €5 surcharge, payable in cash. Every participant who registers in time receives a running shirt; for late registrations, shirts are available while supplies last. Timing is recorded using a transponder attached to the race number. The finish closes at 11:30 a.m. on race day. Non-cash prizes are awarded by age group, with special prizes for the largest group/club and for new personal bests. The route passes through vineyards on mostly paved paths with gentle climbs. The start is at the Vollradsser Allee sports field. The field is limited to 555 participants. Children and young people may take part.

name: Wallenstein-Halbmarathon
location: Altdorf bei Nürnberg, Nürnberger Land, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Wallenstein Half Marathon is a long-standing fun run around Altdorf near Nuremberg. The half-marathon course runs through the picturesque Schwarzachtal valley, offering beautiful views, and includes roads, cycle paths, and forest trails. In addition to the half marathon, there is also a 12 km fun run and a family-friendly 5 km course for runners and walkers. The event offers well-organized facilities, including refreshment stations and an attractive start/finish area at the TV 1881 Altdorf sports park. The city championships for the half marathon and 12 km race are also held, with prizes presented by the mayor.
course_highlights: Half-marathon course through the Schwarzachtal valley with scenic viewpoints
Refreshment stations at km 7, 11, 15, 18, and at the finish
Route around Altdorf using roads, cycle paths, and forest trails
additional: Start and finish at the TV 1881 Altdorf sports park (Heumannstr. 5a). Isotonic drinks and water are available at several refreshment stations. Free admission to the outdoor swimming pool for all finishers, sponsored by Stadtwerke Altdorf. City championships and team competitions are held. Scenic route through the Schwarzachtal valley, team competitions, family-friendly 5 km course, and race-day facilities at the Altdorf sports park.

name: 38. Frankenwaldlauf
description: The 38th Frankenwaldlauf in Oßla offers races over 18.5 km and 9 km, as well as Nordic walking. There are also shorter distances for children and young people, including the Oßlaer Gimpel-Lauf. The course runs through the Thuringian Forest and features beautiful natural scenery. The event is part of regional running cups and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with refreshments and an awards ceremony on site.

name: Blutenburglauf
description: The Blutenburglauf takes place in Munich-Untermenzing and offers attractive running routes along the Würm and around the historic Blutenburg. The event includes 5 km and 10 km distances, which take runners through scenic natural surroundings. Timing is electronic, using transponders in the race bibs, and refreshments are available along the course and at the finish. The event is organized by Rotary Club München-Blutenburg Gemeindienste e.V. and, alongside the sporting competition, offers an entertainment program in the start/finish area.

name: Kinderfestlauf Wangen im Allgäu
organizer: Kinderfestkommission Wangen im Allgäu e. V.
description: The Children’s Festival Run in Wangen im Allgäu is part of the long-standing Children’s and Local Heritage Festival, which has been celebrated for over 180 years. The run takes place on the Sunday of the festival weekend and offers children and young people from Wangen and the surrounding area a sporting attraction. Alongside the run, the festival features numerous other events, including a colorful parade, eagle shooting, and a varied program for the whole family. The event combines sporting ambition with a festive sense of community in Wangen’s historic old town.

name: Kusterdinger Hornissenlauf - 4. Lauf des VR-Cups
description: The Kusterdingen Hornet Run is a scenic race with a family-friendly atmosphere and timekeeping, held annually since 1990. The challenging course of around 10 kilometers follows paved forest and cycle paths and finishes on the synthetic track at Kusterdingen Stadium. In addition to the main race, there are races for students, youth and children, a fun run, and Nordic walking. The event is supported by the Municipality of Kusterdingen and Volksbank in der Region. All participants receive medals and certificates, and the top runners are honored.

name: Langauer Inklusionslauf
description: The 3rd Langau Inclusion Run takes place in cooperation with Tri-Team Schongau as part of the 14th Schongau Triathlon. The run is open to everyone who would like to take part individually, in a paired run, or with assistance; participation in a wheelchair is also possible. The course is a flat out-and-back route, starting and finishing on Lechuferstraße by the ice rink. Participation is free of charge, and donations to support Langau are welcome. Every registered participant receives a running shirt and a finisher’s gift, and trophies are awarded to the top finishers in various categories.

name: Mercaden Stadtlauf Böblingen
description: The MERCADEN® Böblingen City Run is a long-standing race held annually in downtown Böblingen. Runners of different age groups compete over various distances, including the 10.2 km Sparkassen Run, the 5.1 km Lotto Run, and children’s and school races. The start and finish are at the Alba Bridge/Wandelhalle, providing an attractive, central route through the city. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere and welcomes runners of all ability levels.

name: Oscheffer TSG-Lauf
description: The 17th Oscheffer TSG Run takes place in Mainaschaff. The event offers various races for different age groups and ability levels, including a schoolchildren’s and youth race, the Sparkassen Run (5 km), the agilimo Run (10 km), a children’s race, and a relay race. The races are part of a long-standing sporting event organized by TSG Mainaschaff 1973 e.V., welcoming both recreational and competitive runners. Online registration is already open, and further information is available in the race information document.

name: Rainer Volkslauf
description: The Rainer Volkslauf takes place in Rain and offers runners of all ages a varied and motivating running experience. The 10 km main race starts at 9:30 a.m., followed by 5 km races and the shorter 1 km and 2 km Spatzenläufe. The focus is on enjoying exercise and promoting health, supported by enthusiastic spectators and a varied program of events as part of the SC Rain 1928 e. V. sports week. Registration includes a popular Volkslauf T-shirt in the race pack. In addition, one euro per participant is donated to the “Freunde durch Helfen” aid initiative.

name: Rückenwindlauf (Garching bei München)
description: The Rückenwindlauf in Garching near Munich is an established running event that has been held for more than 17 years and attracts around 900 participants each year. The course is officially measured and runs mostly along flat, paved paths around Lake Garching. In addition to the main 5 km and 10 km races, there is also a Bambini run for children. The event supports the Initiative krebskranke Kinder München e.V. and combines sporting ambition with social commitment.
course_highlights: Officially measured course with start and finish at the Business Campus Garching
Flat, mostly paved course, with a section on firm gravel paths around Lake Garching
10 km runners complete the 5 km loop twice
additional: Timing is provided by a transponder system. The event is limited to 1,000 participants. There are sufficient refreshment stations along the course and at the finish. Paramedics from Johanniter-Unfall-Hilfe will be on site. A colorful program for the Bambini runners includes face painting. Late registration is possible on race day until 09:00, subject to the availability of places. There is a team competition for clubs, companies, and running groups.

name: Trainingslauf Bottwartal-Marathon
location: Steppi-Kreisverkehr, Steinheim an der Murr, Germany
distance_verbose: 51 km, Marathon, 32 km, Halbmarathon, 10 km, 5 km
description: The Bottwartal Marathon training run leads through the picturesque Bottwartal, with its gentle vineyard slopes and historic town centers. The course starts at the Steppi roundabout in Steinheim an der Murr and passes through several idyllic communities, including Murr, Gronau, Beilstein, Oberstenfeld, and Großbottwar. The flat finish in Steinheim offers a great opportunity for a final sprint. The event welcomes runners of all ability levels and promises a unique atmosphere, with plenty of encouragement along the route.
course_highlights: Loop through the southern and northern Bottwartal, starting at the Steppi roundabout in Steinheim
Pass through historic town centers such as Murr, Beilstein, Oberstenfeld, and Großbottwar
Flat finish with an opportunity for a final sprint at the roundabout in Steinheim
additional: Race-bib pickup and late registration take place at the Blankensteinhalle in Steinheim. Parking is available at the Wellarium and in the surrounding areas. Shuttle buses run from the Riedstadion to the start at the Steppi roundabout. Half-marathon runners can take a bus transfer from Steinheim to Gronau. The Bottwartal is closed to traffic over a wide area on event day. Children’s and youth races take place at the Riedstadion on Saturday.

name: Volkswandertag
description: The Volkswandertag in Bollensen is an annual event held on the last Sunday in July, open to hikers of all ages. A range of family-friendly routes takes participants along forest trails through the beautiful Solling region. The marathon and half-marathon hikes are circular routes starting and finishing at the TSV Bollensen sports hall. All routes are marked and have refreshment stations. The event has a relaxed atmosphere, with food and drinks in the finish area and a strong sense of community.

name: XRUN - Ucieczka Św. Kingi
description: Saint Kinga’s Escape is a mountain trail race held in scenic Krościenko nad Dunajcem. Runners can choose from several distances ranging from 7 km to 40 km, with different elevation gains, taking them through the Pieniny and Little Pieniny Mountains. The course features challenging terrain, beautiful views, and checkpoints and aid stations. The start and finish are at the amphitheatre in Krościenko, and the time limit depends on the chosen distance. The event is organised by the Centre for Culture and Promotion in Krościenko nad Dunajcem.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Pieniny and Little Pieniny Mountains
The longest distance is 40 km with 1,800 m of elevation gain
The start and finish are at the amphitheatre in Krościenko nad Dunajcem
additional: The race office is located at the Centre for Culture and Promotion in Krościenko nad Dunajcem. Time limits depend on the distance: 9 h for 40 km, 7 h for 28 km, and 5 h for 14 km and 7 km. Children’s age categories are available for shorter distances from 150 m to 1,000 m. Starts take place in waves from 7:00 to 10:20.

name: 13 Nadmorski Bieg Uzdrowiskowy
location: Dąbki, Gmina Darłowo, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Seaside Spa Run is an annual running event held in Dąbki, promoting running as a simple form of exercise and a healthy lifestyle. The 10 km race is part of a larger sporting event that also includes races for children and young people and the Spa Nautical Mile. The event is family-friendly and recreational, and also aims to promote the Dąbki Spa and the Darłowo Municipality. It is organized by the Darłowo Municipality Office and the Seaside Spa Run Association, with support from numerous partners and sponsors.
course_highlights: 10 km course
The race takes place in the seaside town of Dąbki
Side events include the Spa Nautical Mile and races for children
additional: The event also includes the Spa Nautical Mile, covering 1,852 m, and races for children and young people over distances from 150 m to 1,100 m. The event is family-friendly and promotes a healthy lifestyle.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
location: Ogród Dendrologiczny w Przelewicach, Przelewice, Poland
organizer: Botaniczna Piątka; współorganizatorem edycji letniej jest Ogrody Przelewice
description: Botaniczna Piątka Przelewice – Summer Edition is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place in the picturesque Dendrological Garden in Przelewice, combining sporting competition with the beauty of nature. The organizers place particular emphasis on the aesthetic appeal of the proposed routes, making the race attractive to nature lovers and those who enjoy active recreation. It’s a great opportunity to combine a passion for running with a unique green setting.
course_highlights: Cross-country route in the Dendrological Garden in Przelewice
Picturesque, aesthetically pleasing natural surroundings
A race amid unique plant life and greenery
additional: The event is organized by a group of running enthusiasts that has been active since 2014, specializing in cross-country races and paying close attention to the aesthetics of the locations. In summer 2026, Botaniczna Piątka celebrated its 10th anniversary. No information is available about start waves, participant limits, entry fees, or additional services. In the previous summer edition, participants received a commemorative medal.

name: Kresowe Trail #8
description: Kresowe Trail #8 is a 10 km race held in Chełm, in the Lublin Voivodeship. The event is a great opportunity to test your fitness on a trail course, and participants can use training plans tailored to different experience levels. The organizers provide expert support and detailed training instructions to help participants prepare optimally for race day. The event is open to all and is aimed at runners looking to improve their 10 km performance.
course_highlights: A 10 km trail course
Scenic areas of Chełm and its surroundings
Challenging terrain requiring good fitness
additional: Training plans of 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level. Organizers can manage the race listing and collaborate on marketing.

name: V Festiwal Biegowy pod Chełmcem Bieg Babinicza
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Szczawnie-Zdroju
description: The 4th Chełmiec Mountain Running Festival – Babinicz Run is a running event held in picturesque Szczawno-Zdrój, at the foot of Chełmiec Mountain. Participants can choose from a range of distances, from 1 km to a full marathon, making the festival appealing to runners of varying abilities. The course runs through charming surroundings, offering both challenges and beautiful views. The event takes place in July, when the weather is typically summery, with temperatures around 25°C and sunny skies.

name: V Bursztynowy Półmaraton Jantar
location: Jantar, Gmina Stegna, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Beh na chatu pod Chlebom, mem. J. Morgoša
location: Turany okr. Martin, Turany okr. Martin, Turany - Šútovo – Zajacová
organizer: BS TATRAN Turany, LK NÁDEJ Turany
description: The Run to the Chata pod Chlebom, J. Morgoš Memorial, is a mountain running race held in the areas of Turany, Šútovo and Zajacová. The course is 3.1 km long, with an elevation gain of 680 metres, and follows mountain roads and trails. The race is part of the 2025 Turiec Running League and is open to various age categories for men and women. It is organised by BS TATRAN Turany, the town of Turany and LK NÁDEJ Turany. The race offers a challenge for runners who enjoy demanding mountain terrain.

name: Zlatý maraton Emila Zátopka
description: Zlatý maraton Emila Zátopka je součástí Zátopkova zlatého týdne, série běžeckých závodů konaných v Plzni na počest olympijských vítězství Emila Zátopka. Hlavní maraton se běží 27. července a nabízí také doprovodné závody jako půlmaraton, maratonské a půlmaratonské štafety a silniční běh na 10,5 km. Start je v odpoledních hodinách v Štruncových sadech a okolí, s bohatým programem a kategoriemi pro muže, ženy i mládež. Závod je známý svou tradicí, kvalitní organizací a příjemnou atmosférou pro všechny běžce.

name: Holger-Nothacker-Gedächtnislauf
description: The Holger Nothacker Memorial Run is a traditional running event in support of the Schömberg Children’s Hospital. The event offers three distances for different groups of runners: a 3-kilometer course for beginners and students, a 5.4-kilometer loop for recreational runners, and a challenging 10-kilometer loop with 148 meters of elevation gain for ambitious endurance athletes. The course runs around Schömberg and offers a sporting challenge in the region. Staff from the children’s hospital support the event and provide refreshments and drinks.

name: Tempo Makers Run Plzeň v Pytli - červenec
description: Tempo Makers Osmička je pravidelný běžecký závod v Plzni, který se koná podél řeky Úslavy. Závod je určen pro muže i ženy ve věkových kategoriích od 16 let a nabízí přátelskou atmosféru pro všechny běžce, kteří sdílejí nadšení pro běh a společně strávený čas. Kapacita je omezena na 75 startujících, což zajišťuje komorní a pohodovou akci. Start i cíl jsou na stejném místě s možností parkování v blízkosti. Po závodě probíhá vyhlášení nejlepších a losování tomboly.

name: Altbulacher Berglauf
description: The 24th Altbulach Mountain Run takes place in Neubulach. It is a short mountain race with two distances: 800 meters and 2.9 kilometers. The race gives runners the opportunity to experience the region’s scenic beauty in typical July weather, with pleasant temperatures and mostly sunny days. Please note that the organizer’s details should be verified before registering.

name: AOK Firmenlauf Sulz am Neckar
description: The AOK Firmenlauf Sulz am Neckar is a team event held at Albeck Stadium. The 5 km course gives companies and teams the opportunity to get active together and strengthen team spirit. In addition to the race, participants can enjoy a varied program featuring a DJ, a warm-up session, and free refreshments at the finish. The event is part of the BW-Running series and is open to runners aged 16 and over.

name: Volkslauf Lauftreff Pfohren
description: The 24th “Rund um Pfohren” fun run takes place. The 10 km course, officially measured by the DLV, runs mainly along paved agricultural paths around Pfohren. In addition to the main race, there are races for schoolchildren and young children, as well as walking and Nordic walking courses. Training runs are offered on Tuesdays at 19:00 at the Pfohren sports and events hall. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere, with awards for the top runners and groups.

name: 4 PolandRockowy Bieg Policz się z cukrzy...
location: Broczyno, Czaplinek, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: 07. Stadtholz Marathon
description: The Stadtholz Marathon in Rheda-Wiedenbrück is a run at Heideteich, with a 6.14 km trail per lap. The event is not competition-focused, but is aimed at runners who enjoy running in nature. The marathon is being held to mark Evi Köppe-Neeb’s linen wedding anniversary and offers a special atmosphere at Heideteich. The course features natural trails and a peaceful setting.

name: 6. Bienwald Backyard Ultra
description: The Bienwald Backyard Ultra is a challenging ultrarunning event in Kandel, Rhineland-Palatinate. As one of the Silver Ticket Races, it gives the winners the opportunity to compete on the German team at the 2023 Big Dog's World Championships. The event takes place at Bienwaldstadion and attracts ambitious ultrarunners looking to test their endurance and mental strength.

name: Nordschwarzwald Trophy
description: The Nordschwarzwald Trophy is a sporting event in Schömberg, offering various competitions and running routes in the picturesque Northern Black Forest. The event features varied courses and a warm atmosphere that appeals to both competitive athletes and recreational runners. Organized by Eventservice Stahl, the Trophy combines a sporting challenge with a sense of community in beautiful natural surroundings.

name: Plattener Straßenlauf auf Elsenborn
description: The Platten Road Race is a long-standing running event organized by TuS 1919 Platten e.V. The event offers races for various age groups, including Bambini, children’s and youth races, as well as main races over 5,000 and 10,000 meters. The course runs through the village of Elsenborn and offers runners a sporting experience in a friendly atmosphere. The race is a regular part of the sports festival and attracts numerous participants every year.
course_highlights: Course through the village of Elsenborn
Races for Bambini, children, youth and adults
10,000-meter main race starting at 19:00
additional: The Bambini and children’s races take place on the sports field. The event is part of the Elsenborn Sports Festival. There is a team shop in partnership with Sport Schmitz in Wittlich.

name: Springe-Deister-Sommerlauf
description: The Springe-Deister Summer Run features a measured 5 km loop at the foot of the Kleiner Deister. The course is approved by the German Athletics Association (DLV), so results can be included in rankings. Kilometer markers are clearly signposted, and the course is gently undulating, with an elevation difference of approximately 20 meters. The race starts at 5:45 p.m. at Schulzentrum Süd (OHG) in Springe and is aimed at runners looking for an attractive, officially sanctioned running event in the region.

name: VI Bieg do Nocy Siedleczek
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Sportu, Turystyki i Rekreacji w Kostrzynie
description: The 6th Siedleczek Night Run is an evening 5 km race held in the picturesque area around the pond in Siedleczek. The course follows forest roads and paved roads, and runners’ times are measured electronically. Participants can expect a race pack with a bib number and chip, water, a post-race meal, and a finisher’s medal. The event is part of the Grand Prix of Running Events in the Kostrzyn Municipality and attracts runners from various categories, with prizes for the top finishers.
course_highlights: 5 km course on forest roads and paved roads
Electronic net timekeeping
Evening start at 21:00
additional: The participant limit is 200. The race office is open on race day from 19:30 to 20:30 near the start/finish line. The race pack can be collected in person or by an authorized person. The maximum time to finish the race is 60 minutes. Trophies and statuettes are awarded in the OPEN category and to residents of the Kostrzyn Municipality. Electronic net timekeeping; the time limit for completing the course is 60 minutes. Participants receive water, a post-race meal, and a medal.

name: Krkonošská 50
location: Areál Svatý Petr, Špindlerův Mlýn, Česko
description: Krkonošská 50 je tradiční trailový běh konaný v malebném prostředí Krkonošského národního parku se startem v Špindlerově Mlýně. Závod nabízí náročnou trasu dlouhou 50 km s převýšením 1784 metrů, která vede po značených cestách a horských stezkách. Běží se v limitovaném počtu 300 startujících a závod je rozdělen do několika věkových kategorií pro muže i ženy. Organizátoři kladou důraz na ekologii a bezpečnost, včetně povinné výbavy mobilním telefonem a zákazem odhazování odpadků mimo občerstvovací stanice.

name: Běhej lesy Bílá
description: Běhej lesy Bílá je trailový horský závod konaný v krásném prostředí CHKO Beskydy. Závod nabízí různé trasy včetně krátké a dlouhé, přičemž dlouhá trasa ČSOB 20 km je zařazena do mezinárodního UTMB Indexu. Běžci mohou využít lanovku na vrchol a těšit se na speciální rychlostní úseky Conti Speed Section a Generali Investments Finish, které přinášejí další soutěžní prvky a odměny. Závod je vhodný pro všechny milovníky horského trailového běhu, kteří chtějí zažít krásy Beskyd a zároveň soutěžit na kvalitně značených trasách.

name: Zlatá stezka
description: Zlatá stezka je historická a mezinárodní turistická trasa spojující Čechy s Podunajím, která vede nádhernou přírodou Šumavy a Bavorského lesa. Trasa o délce 631 km nabízí jedinečný zážitek díky propojení s německou Zlatou stezkou a průchodu několika národními parky a přírodními rezervacemi. Turisté mohou objevovat historická města, hrady, rozhledny a kulturní památky podél stezky, která je vybavena informačními tabulemi a odpočinkovými místy. Zlatá stezka je ideální pro pěší turistiku a poznávání přírodních i historických krás regionu Jihočeský a Plzeňský kraj.

name: Běh na Kamenný stůl
description: Běh na Kamenný stůl je tradiční běžecký závod konaný v Ratajích nad Sázavou, který letos slaví svůj jubilejní 10. ročník. Závod nabízí náročnou a krásnou trasu vedoucí z nádvoří zámku k památce Kamenný stůl, s různorodým povrchem a kopcovitým terénem. Akce je určena jak profesionálním běžcům, tak i amatérům a rodinám s dětmi, pro které jsou připraveny kratší trasy. Závod je součástí seriálu Běhej zámky, který propojuje běžecké závody v atraktivních lokalitách u zámků.

name: Mšecká sedmička
organizer: Městys Mšec a TJ Sokol Mšec
description: Mšecká sedmička je tradiční běžecký závod pořádaný v Mšeci ve Středočeském kraji. Závod má délku 7 km a vede po lesních a polních cestách, což nabízí běžcům příjemný přírodní terén. Startuje se na fotbalovém hřišti TJ Sokol Mšec a závod je vhodný pro širokou veřejnost. Pořadatelem je Městys Mšec a TJ Sokol Mšec, kteří zajišťují přátelskou atmosféru a kvalitní organizaci.

name: Libeř - Radlík
description: Libeř - Radlík je závod do vrchu dlouhý 2,47 km s převýšením 170 m, který je součástí seriálu Běhy do kopců v Praze a okolí. Trasa není čistě do kopce, obsahuje několik rovinek a jeden seběh, což přidává na zajímavosti a dynamice závodu. Atmosféra je příjemná a startovné symbolické, s bohatými cenami pro vítěze od firmy Botanicus. Závod je vhodný pro běžce, kteří hledají výzvu v kopcovitém terénu v blízkosti Prahy.

name: Trail Running Cup - Krkonošská padesátka
description: Krkonošská padesátka je tradiční trailový závod konaný v malebném prostředí Špindlerova Mlýna v Krkonoších. Závod nabízí náročnou trasu dlouhou 50 km s převýšením 1784 metrů, vedoucí po značených cestách a horských stezkách. Startuje se v areálu Svatý Petr a účastníci mohou využít centrální parkoviště ve Špindlerově Mlýně. Závod je omezen na 300 startujících a je vyhlašován absolutní vítěz a vítězka, stejně jako deset věkových kategorií pro muže a ženy.

name: HTV-SPARDA-Rheinuferlauf, 46. Int. Volkslauf mit HM
description: The HTV-SPARDA-Rheinuferlauf in Duisburg is a traditional fun run with a flat course along the Rhine. Events include 5 km, 7.5 km walking, 10 km, and the half marathon (21.1 km). The flat course makes the race appealing to runners of all abilities. All events share the same finish area, and the event offers a pleasant atmosphere for recreational and competitive runners.
course_highlights: Flat course along the Rhine
Events over 5 km, 7.5 km walking, 10 km, and the half marathon
All events finish at the same location
additional: Start times: 7.5 km walking at 15:00, 5 km run at 16:50, 10 km run at 17:40, half marathon at 17:30. All events take place on a flat course. Results will be published on the RUNME results page. Results are available shortly after the race finishes. The event is especially appealing in good weather.

name: Sechs-Std.-Lauf am Förderturm Bönen
location: Ehemaliges Zechengelände, Bönen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Six-Hour Run at the Bönen Headframe is a unique ultrarunning event held on an officially measured loop course at a former colliery site. The course is traffic-free, gently undulating, and consists of asphalt and compact gravel. The event offers comprehensive refreshments, including vegan options, and professional lap counting via race result. With a minimum age of 20, the run is aimed at experienced ultrarunners who want to test their endurance in a friendly, well-organized atmosphere.
course_highlights: Loop course at a former colliery site, traffic-free
Lap length: 1,340 m; surface: asphalt and compact gravel
Officially measured course with gentle undulations
additional: Race bib pickup on event day from 07:00 to 08:30. Showers and changing facilities are available at the nearby Goethe Sports Hall and in the Förderturm Shaft Hall (not supervised; no liability is accepted). A variety of food and drinks, including vegan options, will be provided before and during the run. Laps are counted electronically via race result, with measurement of the remaining distance. First aid is provided by the German Red Cross local branch in Bönen (DRK-Ortsverein Bönen e.V.). Awards ceremony at approximately 16:00. Minimum age: 20. Maximum 200 participants; on-site registration is possible for a €10 fee. Loop course at a former colliery site, vegan refreshments, race bib pickup 07:00–08:30, minimum age 20.

name: Die 10 Kilometer von Dürwiß
price_range: kostenlos, Anmeldung online oder vor Ort gegen Gebühr
description: The 10 km von Dürwiß is a traditional road race held annually on the first Saturday in August by SV Germania Dürwiß e.V. More than 500 runners from Germany and abroad take part, with winning times usually around 30 minutes. The flat, officially measured 2 km asphalt loop runs through the town center of Dürwiß and is completely closed to traffic on race day. What makes this cult race special are the many spectators and lively street parties along the course, with music and decorations creating a unique atmosphere. The event wraps up with an after-run party featuring DJ Steve and a wide selection of refreshments.
course_highlights: Flat, officially measured 2 km asphalt loop through the town center of Dürwiß
Five laps for the 10 km main race, on streets completely closed to traffic
Lively street parties with music and decorations along the course
additional: In addition to the 10 km main race, there is a 4,000 m fun run, children’s and youth races from 200 m to 1,000 m, and a 10 km inline skating race with different lap formats depending on age group. The course is completely closed to road traffic on race day, and parking along the route is strictly prohibited. The event wraps up with an after-run party featuring DJ Steve and extensive refreshments. Course back to 10 km, inline skating and children’s races, street parties, after-run party, music, sponsor prizes

name: 18. Ottonenlauf
description: The Ottonenlauf is a scenic race in the Harz that brings runners from three different villages to a shared finish in Quedlinburg, a UNESCO World Heritage city. The 21.1 km, 42.2 km, and 69 km routes start in Stiege, Alexisbad, and Meisdorf, respectively. The route runs mostly along forest and woodland trails through the Selke Valley, with shaded forests, rural sections, and moderate climbs that call for a good pace. Walking and Nordic walking options are also available, making the event open to a wide range of participants. Electronic timing and finisher medals round out the event.

name: 24. Hella Marathon Nacht
description: The hella marathon night rostock is an atmospheric sunset run set against the picturesque backdrop of the Haedgehalbinsel in Rostock’s city harbor. The event offers races over the marathon, half marathon, Rostocker 7 km, and a children’s race. All start at dusk and finish in a brightly lit finish area. The route passes through the Warnow Tunnel and IGA Park, among other places, and is kept traffic-free. The event combines a sporting challenge with Northern German hospitality and a holiday atmosphere.

name: 5. TCW Backyard Ultra
description: The TCW Backyard Ultra in Wölfersheim is a unique running event focused on camaraderie and endurance. A 6.706 km loop starts at the top of every hour and must be completed within that hour. The race continues until only one runner remains, who is declared the winner. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and motivating community, welcoming runners of all abilities.

name: adidas Runners City Night
description: The adidas Runners City Night in Berlin is a summer sports highlight that combines running and inline skating with a big party. The event offers 5 km and 10 km running routes, as well as a 10 km inline skating route through the lively City West and along Kurfürstendamm. Live bands, cheering zones, and enthusiastic spectators create a unique atmosphere, culminating at a glowing finish arch by the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church. Participants receive a glow-in-the-dark medal as a memento of this special event.
course_highlights: The route runs through the heart of City West and along Kurfürstendamm
Live bands and cheering points along the route, especially at Adenauerplatz
Start and finish at the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church
additional: Timing is recorded using a transponder on the back of the race bib. The 5 km route has just one turnaround point and runs straight along Kurfürstendamm. The 10 km run has a time limit of 1:30 hours. The medal glows in the dark. Personalized medal engraving can be added during registration.

name: hella marathon nacht rostock
description: The hella marathon nacht rostock is an atmospheric sunset run along the Warnow, with a maritime flair and Hanseatic hospitality. The event takes place in August in Rostock and offers races over the marathon, half marathon, Rostocker 7 and a students’ run. The start and finish are at Rostock’s city harbor, where runners set off at dusk and finish beneath bright lights. The course passes through the Warnow Tunnel and IGA Park, among other places, making for a unique running experience.

name: Hemfurth-Edersee-Abendlauf
description: The Hemfurth-Edersee Evening Run is a traditional late-summer race that brings runners of all ages together in the beautiful surroundings of Edertal-Hemfurth. In pleasant temperatures and as the sun sets, the focus is on the joy of movement and a sense of community. At the finish, participants can enjoy refreshments, good music, and a sociable get-together in a relaxed atmosphere. The race is organized by volunteers from TSV 08 Hemfurth-Edersee e.V. and is a popular event for ambitious runners, recreational joggers, and families.

name: Pörndorfer Sommernachtslauf
description: The 15th Pörndorfer Summer Night Run in Aldersbach is a running event with a friendly, family atmosphere and a genuine competitive spirit. It offers suitable challenges for all age groups and ability levels, from the Bambini run through the children’s and youth races to the main race. Nordic walking is also part of the program. The event combines sporting ambition with a communal summer atmosphere and draws runners and spectators from the region.

name: Schwindegger Schlosslauf
description: The Schwindegg Castle Run is an annual sporting event in the idyllic community of Schwindegg. Participants run along picturesque paths and through forests, with views of Schwindegg Castle. There are various categories for all age groups, including children and teenagers. The event is also an opportunity to strengthen the community and support the sports club. Before and after the run, a summer festival with food, a drinks stand and a bar offers a cheerful atmosphere for celebrating and socializing.

name: SWE Halbmarathon Ettlingen
description: The SWE Ettlingen Half Marathon is a challenging and varied 21.1 km trail run linking several Ettlingen districts at different elevations. The route starts in the idyllic Horbachpark and leads through wooded areas with distant views of the foothills of the Black Forest, reaching its highest point at around 400 m. After halfway, the course descends through beautiful natural scenery, with views of the Rhine Plain and the Palatinate Mountains, to the finish at Horbachsee, a scenic former State Garden Show site. Refreshment stations are provided every 3 km, and local residents add refreshments and an encouraging atmosphere. The race is organized by SSV Ettlingen 1847 e. V., Lauftreff Ettlingen division.
course_highlights: Climb through the forest with distant views of the Black Forest foothills
Highest point at approx. 400 m, around 250 m above Ettlingen
Descent with views of the Rhine Plain and the Palatinate Mountains to Horbachsee
additional: The start and finish are in Horbachpark by the pavilion, Middelkerker Straße, 76275 Ettlingen. There are three wave starts at intervals of approx. 3 minutes to ease congestion during the first few kilometers. The maximum number of participants is limited to 800 female starters. Late registration is possible at Albgauhalle on the event weekend. All pre-registered female participants receive a gift with their race number. Timing is recorded by a transponder in the race number, with net-time scoring.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Łódź edycja letnia
location: Ogród Botaniczny w Łodzi, Łódź, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka is a series of cross-country races organized since 2014 by a group of running enthusiasts. The events take place on scenic courses in Wielkopolska and other locations, with an emphasis on their aesthetic and natural qualities. The summer edition in Łódź is a special opportunity to celebrate the event’s 10th birthday, with participants receiving special medals featuring a daylily motif. The race attracts both recreational and more experienced runners, offering a friendly atmosphere and beautiful courses.
course_highlights: Cross-country races on scenic courses
The aesthetic appeal of the locations
Special birthday medals featuring a daylily
additional: The summer edition celebrates Botaniczna Piątka’s 10th birthday with unique medals. The organizers place particular emphasis on cross-country running and the visual appeal of the courses. Events take place at various locations, including Łódź.

name: 32. Bieg św. Dominika
description: The St. Dominic’s International Run is a prestigious running event held annually in Gdańsk since 1994, as an integral part of St. Dominic’s Fair. It is a major sporting event of the summer on the coast, attracting over 1,200 runners and tens of thousands of spectators, and offering a unique atmosphere in the city’s historic center. The course is a 1,412-meter loop along the streets of Gdańsk’s Old Town, with the start and finish by Neptune’s Fountain. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and social integration, and also offers a rich program of accompanying events, including concerts and shows.
course_highlights: A 1,412 m course in central Gdańsk, with the start and finish by Neptune’s Fountain
A loop along Długi Targ, Powroźnicza, Kotwiczników, Podwale Przedmiejskie and other streets
Incredible support from over 25,000 spectators along the course
additional: The event includes four races under the shared slogan “Chase St. Dominic”: the Prologue, open to all St. Dominic’s Fair participants; the 5 km Women’s Run Lotto Cup; the 5 km Men’s Run Energa Cup; and the Men’s Elite Run, the Polish 10 km Championships. The event takes place as part of the Running Festival, with a rich program of accompanying activities, including partner booths, presentations and Fair concerts.

name: Arm Race Kamień
description: Arm Race Kamień is an extreme obstacle race held in the Ceków-Kolonia municipality. The course offers a sporting challenge for participants of varying experience levels, combining competition, technique, and the satisfaction of overcoming obstacles. The event is part of an OCR race series that attracts both competitors focused on results and people new to obstacle-course racing, as well as entire families. It is not just a race, but also an exciting experience and an opportunity to get active outdoors.
course_highlights: A 5 km or 10 km course with around 25 or 40 obstacles
A range of formats: PRO, OPEN, FUN, and family and youth formats
Extreme obstacles requiring endurance, technique, and intensity
additional: Choose a format suited to your experience level, including PRO for those competing for results and OPEN for those looking for a sporting challenge. Family and youth formats are also available. The 2027 season pass includes 3 race entries (5 km or 10 km, including PRO/ELITE) for 699 zł, with an ARM RACE technical cap as a gift.

name: IX Rudzki Półmaraton Industrialny
description: The IX Ruda Industrial Half Marathon is a unique running event held in Ruda Śląska, combining sport with the region’s industrial heritage. The 10.5 km course runs through the city centre, passing post-industrial landmarks such as Chebzie railway station, the Mikołaj Shaft, the Kaufhaus housing estate and the blast furnace at Pokój Steelworks. In addition to the half marathon, an accompanying race of around 10 km is also held, allowing less experienced runners to take part. The start and finish are at the athletics stadium on Czarnoleśna Street, which also houses the race office and event facilities.
course_highlights: A 10.5 km loop through the city centre
Passes post-industrial landmarks: Chebzie railway station, the Mikołaj Shaft and the Kaufhaus housing estate
Runs past the only blast furnace in Silesia, at Pokój Steelworks
additional: The start and finish are at the athletics stadium on Czarnoleśna Street, where the Race Office and event facilities are also located. An accompanying race of around 10 km is available for those not ready for the half marathon. Registration takes place on the DO:ST:AR:TU platform.

name: XI Czastarska Piątka
description: The 11th Czastary Five is an annual road race held in the Czastary municipality, attracting runners from various places. The event combines sport and recreation and takes place on a 5-kilometer course through the municipality’s scenic areas. The race is a great opportunity to spend time actively and bring together the local community and sports enthusiasts.
course_highlights: A 5 km course
A road race through the Czastary municipality
Scenic landscapes and a welcoming atmosphere

name: Bieg z okazji 82. Rocznicy Wybuchu Powstania Warszawskiego
II Wielgomłyński Dycha
location: Wielgomłyny, Radomsko County, Łódź Voivodeship, Poland

name: Półmaraton Cross Laskowa
location: Laskowa, Limanowa County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Bear Foot Poľana
description: BEAR FOOT POĽANA 2026 is a mountain race set in the wild and unique Poľana Mountains, the highest and best-preserved volcano in Central Europe. The race offers two main courses: 24 km with over 1,300 metres of cumulative elevation gain, and 10 km with over 600 metres of elevation gain. The route passes through popular hiking spots such as Bystrô Waterfall, the Kaľamárka Celtic hillfort, and the summit of Predná Poľana. Runners can enjoy the beauty of deep forests, mountain streams, and pastures. The race is part of the Slovak Skyrunning Association league and is limited to 150 runners per course.

name: Porubska 11-ka
location: Porúbka okr. Bardejov, Porúbka okr. Bardejov, Porúbka
description: Porúbska 11-ka is a running race held in the village of Porúbka in Bardejov District. It features gently rolling, hilly to flat terrain at an elevation of 196 m. The course passes through the Carpathian region, which offers a combination of flat stretches and hills, ideal for runners looking for an enjoyable run in nature. The race is organized by the municipality of Porúbka and is part of local sporting activities with a tradition and community spirit. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle in the region.

name: Island Gladiator Slovakia
location: Lednické Rovne, Medné, Lednické Rovne, Medné, Medné
description: Island Gladiator Slovakia is an OCR race that will test your strength, endurance, and determination in Slovakia’s authentic natural surroundings. The course runs through meadows, forests, streams, and hills, with a variety of technical sections and obstacles such as walls, crawling, pulling, balancing, and carrying loads. The race is open to men and women, from beginners to experienced athletes, with a time limit of 3 hours. Every participant receives an official T-shirt, a medal, a race pack, and electronic timing. Island Gladiator is not just a competition, but a challenge to overcome yourself and become a stronger gladiator.

name: Běžím Krušnohořím Moldava
description: Běžím Krušnohořím je běžecký a canicrossový seriál, který vás provede krásami Krušných hor. Série zahrnuje 6 závodů v různých destinacích, včetně Moldavy, s trasami pro běžce, canicrossaře, děti i chodce. Každý závod nabízí hlavní běžecký závod na 6 až 9 km, zážitkovou trasu 20 až 30 km podle mapy, chůzi 5 až 8 km s hledáním bodů a dětské závody od 200 do 1600 metrů. Seriál je vhodný pro širokou veřejnost, která chce poznat krásy Krušnohoří aktivně a sportovně.

name: Hirschbachschleiferl
organizer: Lauftreff Kirchdorf, Abteilung des Sport Club Kirchdorf
description: The Hirschbachschleiferl is a long-standing race in Kirchdorf im Ampertal that welcomes runners of all ability levels. The event takes place at Rathausplatz and combines a sporting challenge with a strong sense of community. In addition to the sporting aspect, the race supports social projects, such as Freising Cancer Support, through donations. Participation is at your own risk, and the organizers emphasize participants’ health and personal responsibility.
course_highlights: Main race over 9.7 km
Course includes sections on asphalt and through the forest
Additional race options over 3.9 km, as well as children’s races
additional: The race supports social organizations through donations from participants and local businesses. There is no information about different start times, tiered pricing, or special running gear. The finish is at Rathausplatz.

name: Nordkirchener Halbmarathon
description: The Nordkirchen Half Marathon takes place on a scenic route through Nordkirchen Castle Park and the Obsen farming community. Runners start in the stadium at Castle Park, complete two laps of the stadium, and then run a loop of just under 10 kilometers through picturesque parkland and villages. Several refreshment points along the route provide runners with supplies. The finish is back in the stadium, where spectators cheer on the runners and help create a wonderful shared experience.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the stadium at Nordkirchen Castle Park
Run through the expansive Castle Park with views of the castle
Loop through the Obsen farming community, with enthusiastic neighbors cheering
additional: Runners may deposit their own refreshments before the start (8:00–8:45). Water is available at refreshment points at km 4.5, 7, 9, 10.5, 14, 16.5, and 18.5. On-site late registration is possible until 8:00 for an additional fee of EUR 3. Bibs with chips for electronic timing will be issued and collected after the race, but may be kept as a souvenir. The route passes through Castle Park and Obsen, with the start and finish in the stadium at Castle Park. Registration is available online and on race day. Results are available live. Parking is available at the stadium, Nordkirchen Comprehensive School, and the Sundern parking lot.

name: 10. Charity-Lauf Koldingen
description: The Koldingen Charity Run is part of the Sparkassen Laufpass of the Hanover Region, one of Germany’s largest running series, with 43 events in 2026. Runners can explore the Hanover Region on foot and collect stamps in their running pass each time they take part. The run offers a varied course in the beautiful surroundings of Pattensen and promotes recreational sport in the region. The event is open to everyone who wants to be active while doing good.

name: 55. Volkslauf Rund um Wellen
description: The 55th Volkslauf Rund um Wellen takes place in Beverstedt-Wellen and is one of Germany’s oldest marathons, with a friendly, family atmosphere. The event offers challenging courses over four distances: marathon, half marathon, 11 km and 5 km. Some courses are certified by the German Athletics Association (DLV). The route passes through varied landscapes, with forest trails and a range of surfaces. The event is organized by TSV Wellen and relies on support from many volunteers from the village.

name: Hilpoltsteiner Burgfestlauf
description: The Hilpoltstein Castle Festival Run is a long-standing running event held as part of the Hilpoltstein Castle Festival. It takes place every year on the first Sunday in August. The event offers races for different age and ability groups, including Bambini, schoolchildren’s, fun and main races. A special highlight is the castle hill sprint in the main race, where the fastest runners can earn the title of Castle Hill King or Queen. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and attractive course, with the start and finish on Marktstraße near the town hall.

name: Kapellenlauf Vorra
description: The Kapellenlauf Vorra is a traditional race held annually by DJK SC Vorra. It offers several distances, including a half marathon, a quarter marathon of 10.55 km, and a fun run and Nordic walking, newly added in 2025. The course passes through the rural surroundings of Abtsdorf and offers both competitive racing and a more leisurely running experience. The race also hosts the Upper Franconian Half Marathon Championships and attracts many participants from the region.

name: Olewiger Charity-Run
description: The Olewig Charity Run in Trier is a diverse running event that combines sporting commitment with social solidarity. The event offers various races for all age groups, including a main race, a youth race, a children’s race, and an inclusive race. 100% of all entry fees are donated to Demenzzentrum e.V. for the Trier region, underscoring the event’s charitable spirit. The races take place in a friendly atmosphere, complemented by sponsors and a costume contest with attractive prizes.
course_highlights: Volksbank Trier Eifel Main Race over 5,000 meters
Youth race and inclusive race, each 1,000 meters
Children’s race over 400 meters
additional: The Olewig Charity Run includes a costume contest with three special prizes awarded by Broadway Filmtheater for the best costumes inspired by current films. The event is supported by regional sponsors who emphasize community spirit and the development of the Trier region.

name: XI Gorce Ultra-Trail
description: Gorce Ultra-Trail is a unique mountain race held in the picturesque surroundings of Ochotnica Dolna. Participants can choose from five varied routes, ranging from 5 to 102 km and suited to different experience levels, from beginners to seasoned ultramarathoners. The routes pass through the beautiful Gorce Mountains, featuring challenging climbs and spectacular views. The time limit for the longest route is 20 hours, underscoring the event’s challenging nature.

name: Kresowe Trail #9
description: Kresowe Trail is a series of small-scale trail races organized by the Kresowe Marathons Foundation, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity amid the natural surroundings of eastern Poland. The series consists of eleven races held over two distances: the shorter Szpurt (6–8 km) and the longer Wertep (17–21 km). The events take place in scenic locations, with respect for the environment and local communities. Participants can expect professional organization, electronic timing, and a generous race package. Kresowe Trail also features Nordic Walking competitions and brings runners together in a spirit of fair play and friendship.
course_highlights: Trail routes of approximately 6–8 km (Szpurt) and 17–21 km (Wertep)
Scenic areas of Podlasie and the Vilnius Region, with marked routes and aid stations
Limited participant numbers to ensure safety and high-quality organization
additional: Starts are divided into waves according to results from the previous season. The race package includes a hot recovery meal, electronic timing, a race bib with a chip valid for the entire season, medical support, aid stations along the route and at the finish, a commemorative medal (for those who register in advance), photography services, and prizes for the top competitors. Littering on the route is strictly prohibited. Online registration is available until 08:40 on race day, and on-site registration is available from 8:00. If you register fewer than 10 days before the race, your race package may be incomplete.

name: XXXIV Bieg Jezior
location: Stary Uścimów, Lubartów County, Lublin Voivodeship, Poland

name: Klokočovská päťka
location: Obecný úrad, Klokočov, Michalovce District, Slovakia
description: Klokočovská päťka is a traditional running race organized by the municipality of Klokočov in the Michalovce District. This sporting event offers runners the chance to enjoy a pleasant day outdoors while supporting the community. The course passes through the municipality’s picturesque surroundings and is suitable for the general public. The organizers welcome all runners interested in being active and enjoying a sporting experience.
course_highlights: The route passes through the picturesque natural surroundings of Klokočov
The race is suitable for the general public and different age groups
The event promotes community spirit and sport in the region

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 8. kolo
description: The Bratislava 2-Mile Run is a regular running race organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team at the Kuchajda swimming pool complex in Bratislava. The race covers 2 miles (3.218 km), with categories for children, juniors, women, men, and veterans. Registration takes place on site from 9:30, and the start is at 10:00. The competition is part of a race series in which runners earn points toward a travelling cup based on their performances and participation in individual rounds.

name: Malý Kavečianský maratón
location: Kavečany - Košice, Kavečany - Košice, Futbalový štadión
organizer: TJ Mladosť Kavečany a MÚ MČ Košice - Kavečany
description: The Malý Kavečianský Marathon is a running event in Kavečany near Košice, offering 21 km and 7 km races as well as children’s runs. The race starts at the football stadium and is open to a wide range of categories, from children to veterans. It is organised by TJ Mladosť Kavečany together with the Košice-Kavečany Municipal District. The event is suitable for runners of various ages and ability levels, with affordable entry fees and online registration available.

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Karlštejn
description: Běžecká série Berounka v Karlštejně je komunitní trailový závod konaný v krásném přírodním prostředí Autokempu Karlštejn. Trasa vede přes pole, louky a lesy až k lomu Malá Amerika, pokračuje po červené svatojakubské cestě k hradu Karlštejn a končí seběhem do cíle. Závod nabízí přátelskou atmosféru, značenou trasu a možnost občerstvení i úschovy věcí. Každý účastník obdrží startovní číslo a nejlepší závodníci v kategoriích získají diplomy a medaile.

name: BWM Sommerlochlauf
location: Steinheim an der Murr, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The BWM Sommerlochlauf takes place in Steinheim an der Murr and is a 10 km race, especially suited to anyone who loves running fast. The flat, fast course through Steinheim offers ideal conditions for achieving personal bests. Its friendly organization and lively atmosphere make the race a popular weekday event where sports enthusiasts can test their fitness together.

name: Rozdělovský čtvrtmaratón
description: Rozdělovský čtvrtmaratón je běžecký závod pořádaný Maratón klubem Kladno, který se koná v Kladně-Rozdělově. Klub se zaměřuje na vytrvalostní běh a pořádání běžeckých závodů v regionu. Závod nabízí příležitost pro běžce všech úrovní, kteří chtějí změřit své síly na čtvrtmaratónské trati v příjemném prostředí Středočeského kraje. Akce je součástí běžeckého kalendáře klubu a podporuje komunitu běžců v okolí Kladna.

name: Berglauf zur Schuhbräualm
description: The 41st Berglauf zur Schuhbräualm is a challenging mountain run held in Raubling. The course covers 7.5 kilometers with an elevation gain of around 678 meters. The run starts at 19:00 and offers runners a challenging mountain route. The event is aimed at mountain-running enthusiasts seeking a sporting challenge in a natural setting.
course_highlights: 7.5 km course
678 meters of elevation gain
Very challenging mountainous profile
additional: Start and finish are provided for all competitions; exact location details require RUNME Premium. Accommodation is available near the start and finish. The run starts in Großholzhausen, with parking, changing facilities, and baggage transport. The event is suitable for all age groups and offers a festive atmosphere with a raffle and commemorative gifts. Early registration is recommended.

name: Krčský lomcovák
description: Krčský lomcovák je tradiční běžecký závod konaný v Krčském lese v Praze 4. Závod nabízí 5 km trasu s startem u Velkého altánu, která je vhodná pro muže i ženy, s odlišnými startovními časy. Akce je součástí sportovně zábavného odpoledne v parku Nové Roztyly, kde si mohou účastníci i rodiny s dětmi vyzkoušet různé aktivity jako slackline, skákání v pytlích nebo discgolf. Závod je organizován magazínem Krčák žije, který se věnuje aktivitám a novinkám v oblasti Krčského lesa a jeho okolí.

name: 6. Bärenkopplauf
description: The Bärenkopplauf is a challenging mountain and trail run in the Rhein-Westerwald Nature Park, following the premium hiking route “WällerTour Bärenkopp” over approximately 11 km, with around 360 metres of elevation gain and 260 metres of descent. The race takes place on the first Friday in August from 18:00, with staggered wave starts. The course is divided into two halves: the first is technically challenging, with trails and steep climbs; the second is predominantly downhill and scenic. A mountain prize is awarded to the fastest man and woman at the Bärenkopp cross. The event is organised by VfL Waldbreitbach and offers a friendly, family atmosphere, refreshments and chip timing.
course_highlights: 11 km course with +360/-260 metres of elevation on the WällerTour Bärenkopp
The first half is a challenging trail and mountain run, with steep climbs and technical sections
The second half is a scenic run on a predominantly downhill course
additional: Starts take place in staggered waves between 18:00 and 18:30, with 20 participants per wave. Race numbers are assigned after registration closes based on the 10 km time provided; the fastest runners start first, while late registrants start in the final wave. There are two water stations at 3.3 km and 7 km. The course is permanently marked and includes steep, sometimes narrow trails with steps and wooden bridges; extra caution is advised when wet. Race number collection and bag drop-off take place in the schoolyard of the Realschule plus. Timing uses disposable chips attached to the race numbers. Finish-line refreshments include water, tea and energy drinks. Parking is available near the start and finish; if you park near the finish, you can jog approximately 1 km to the start.

name: Volksbank Baumberge Abendlauf
description: The Volksbank Baumberge Evening Run is a long-standing running event held at the Dörrhoff sports facility in Laer-Holthausen. The event offers runners an attractive course with a refreshment point and a start and finish area at the sports ground. The run is part of the activities of the Schwarz-Weiss Beerlage-Holthausen sports club and takes place as part of a sports week. The event welcomes running enthusiasts of all ages and offers a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the sports ground in Laer-Holthausen
A refreshment point along the course
Run through the Baumberge region
additional: The ticket entitles you to start at 15:00. Starting in a different group or changing your booked start time is not possible. Race materials will be handed out on site. Venue: Sports facility, Dörrhoff 14, 48366 Laer-Holthausen.

name: Berglauf
description: TuS Ovenhausen 1924 e.V. warmly invites you to the hill run in Höxter, which features a challenging course with varied terrain. The event includes a children’s hill run of approx. 1 km and a main race of approx. 3.2 km, with a steady climb and an elevation gain of about 170 meters. The course starts at the sports field and runs over grassy areas, asphalt paths, meadow trails, and narrow gravel and forest paths, finishing in the woods. This long-standing running event welcomes runners of all ages.

name: Gifhorner Friedhofslauf
description: The Gifhorn Cemetery Run is a special event held at the St. Nicolai Protestant Lutheran Cemetery in Gifhorn. Runners can choose between 4- and 8-kilometer routes. After the run, participants gather for a relaxed barbecue and drinks under the apple trees. Traditionally held in the evening, the event combines sporting activity with a relaxed atmosphere in a historic setting.

name: Sparkassen-Festungslauf
description: The Sparkassen Fortress Run in Königstein is a summer-evening running adventure at one of Europe’s most architecturally and historically valuable hilltop fortresses. The challenging 9.4-kilometre main course climbs 470 metres, with the final kilometres running across the fortress plateau and offering magnificent views of Saxon Switzerland and the Elbe. Alongside the main race, there is a 7.7 km course, as well as a mini run and an inclusive run, each 1.2 km long, on the fortress plateau. The event has been established for over 20 years and offers a special atmosphere, with the awards ceremony held at sunset in the fortress market square.

name: Stauseelauf
description: The Stauseelauf Chemnitz is a running event organized by Leichtathletik-Club Erdgas Chemnitz e.V. The event is open to runners aged 14 and over who are in suitable training condition. The conditions of participation and organizational measures will be announced before the event. The event prioritizes safety and proper conduct, and the organizer reserves the right to disqualify participants for violations.

name: Wendlinger Zeitungslauf
description: The Wendlinger Zeitungslauf is organized by TSV Wendlingen 1920 e.V., a long-established sports club with an active athletics department. The event takes place in Wendlingen and gives runners the opportunity to compete at a modern athletics facility in the “Im Speck” sports park. The athletics department has a long history and strong roots in the region. The race is part of the club’s varied sports program and is open to runners of all ages and ability levels.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the “Im Speck” sports park, with its modern athletics facility
A varied route through the town of Wendlingen
A traditional event with regional significance
additional: The athletics facility was renovated in 2022. The club offers a wide range of sports and regularly organizes sporting events and courses. The Wendlinger Zeitungslauf is part of TSV Wendlingen’s varied club life.

name: X Memoriał Biegowy
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Lidzbarku Warmińskim
description: The jubilee 10th Tadeusz Brzostek Memorial Run is an annual running event organized by the Sports and Recreation Centre in Lidzbark Warmiński. The competition takes place at the Municipal Stadium, offering participants the opportunity to compete and spend time actively in a sporting atmosphere. The event is local in character and promotes sport and recreation among residents and visitors.
course_highlights: The main race is 5 km long.
Children’s and youth races cover distances from 200 m to 1 km.
The Municipal Stadium is the start and finish venue.
additional: Children’s races take place on a tartan running track.

name: Benefičný beh pre Marcelku
description: The Run for Marcelka is a charity running event in Kluknava, offering courses for both children and adults. The main run is 5.5 km long, runs mostly on asphalt, and is suitable for the general public. The event also includes children’s races and Nordic walking, with refreshment stations along the course. The race takes place at the football field in Kluknava, where full facilities are available, including changing rooms, showers, and toilets.
course_highlights: The 5.5 km main run is 95% on asphalt
Refreshments along the course and at the finish (water, fruit, cakes)
Registration and start at the football field in Kluknava
additional: Registration and race-pack collection on race day from 14:30 to 16:30 at the football field. Changing rooms, showers, toilets, and a bag drop are available in the start area. Parking is available by the church, manor house, and kindergarten in Kluknava.

name: Měřínský kros
description: Měřínský kros je tradiční přespolní běh vedený krásnou přírodou Vysočiny, který nabízí hlavní závod na 13 km přes Dědkovskou horu a pohodovou trať na 8 km vhodnou pro rekreační běžce. Pro děti od 5 do 12 let je připraven překážkový běh Junior Kros s obřím skákacím hradem. Závod je měřen čipovou časomírou a po skončení běhu se koná večerní volejbalový turnaj s občerstvením. Start i cíl jsou na hřišti za základní školou v Měříně, kde je k dispozici parkování, úschovna, WC, šatna a sprcha.

name: Mořice Run
location: Mořice, Prostějov District, Olomouc Region, Česko
description: Mořice Run je tradiční běžecký závod pořádaný TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, který se koná v malebné obci Mořice u Olomouce. Závod je součástí série běžeckých akcí zaměřených na kondiční a výkonnostní běh, které klub organizuje na střední Moravě. Liga stovkařů je známá svou podporou pravidelného běhání a vytrvalostních závodů, a Mořice Run nabízí příležitost pro běžce všech úrovní užít si kvalitní závodní atmosféru. Klub také poskytuje podporu a rady běžcům, kteří chtějí začít nebo zlepšit svůj trénink.

name: Slatinická sedmička
description: Slatinická sedmička je charitativní běh dlouhý 7 km, který vede převážně terénem v okolí obce Slatinice u Olomouce. Závod je věnován památce Šárky Krčkové a nabízí běžcům příjemnou trasu s přírodním charakterem. Akce je vhodná pro všechny běžce, kteří chtějí spojit sport s podporou dobré věci.

name: Vnorovská desítka
description: Vnorovská desítka je populární běžecký závod na 10 km, který se koná každoročně v srpnu v obci Vnorovy. Závod je součástí Moravsko-Slovenského běžeckého poháru a přitahuje přes 200 běžců z různých zemí včetně české elity a afrických běžců. Trať vede na uzavřeném asfaltovém okruhu s minimálním převýšením, start i cíl jsou u základní školy. Atmosféra závodu je velmi živá díky početnému publiku a velkému počtu účastníků, celkově se závodu účastní téměř 700 běžců ve všech kategoriích.

name: 16. Piesauer Glasmacherlauf
description: The 16th Piesau Glassmakers’ Run takes place in Piesau, Thuringia. The event offers 2 km races for children and a 10 km race for adults, as well as a 10 km Nordic walking competition on forest trails. It is part of the Sparkassen Cup and the TLV Running and Nordic Walking Cup, and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with changing and shower facilities and refreshments on site. Trophies and awards are presented to the fastest runners and age-group winners.
course_highlights: 2 km children’s race
10 km main race entirely on forest trails
10 km Nordic walking with poles; running is prohibited
additional: Changing, washing and shower facilities are available. Food, drinks and cake are sold on site. Trophies are awarded to the fastest runners in each distance (places 1–3 for each gender), with awards for the top three in each age group. A team classification is held for the 10 km race, based on the two fastest women or three fastest men from a club.

name: Frontrun - Janus Queer Games 2026
organizer: Janus Queer Games / SC Janus e.V.
description: The Frontrun is an inclusive running event held as part of the Janus Queer Games 2026 in Cologne, welcoming runners of all genders. Events include a 5 km run, a 10 km run, and a 5 km partner run. The start and finish are on the Jahnwiesen beneath a large rainbow. The course is clearly marked and supported by encouraging course marshals. The event values community, diversity, and the joy of sport in an open and supportive environment.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the Jahnwiesen beneath a large rainbow
5 km loop for the shorter runs; 2 loops for the 10 km run
Alphabetically marked course with friendly course marshals
additional: Race bibs can be collected until 11:30 a.m.; group warm-up at 11:45 a.m. Manual timekeeping with +/- 3 seconds’ precision. Free water stations during the run; after the run, fruit and a cake buffet are available for donations benefiting Anyway e.V. There are no age-group rankings; rankings are in the female, male, and all-genders categories. The 5 km partner run is ranked in the All Gender category. Race-day registration is possible if places are available. The course is flat and runs on the Jahnwiesen. Registration is available online and on the event day, with refreshments and rankings in several categories.

name: Güttersbacher Volkslauf 2026
description: The Güttersbach Fun Run is taking place for the 29th time and is an established event in the Hesse and Odenwald running calendars. The event is known for its excellent organisation, great atmosphere and smooth running. The routes pass through the beautiful countryside around Mossautal and offer a challenge for runners of all abilities. The start and finish are in the village centre at the community hall, where food and refreshments are also available for participants and spectators.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the village centre at the community hall
Challenging routes through the beautiful Odenwald countryside
Aid stations along the route and free use of the outdoor pool for participants
additional: Late registration is possible on the day of the event, up to 30 minutes before the start. The first 200 pre-registered participants receive a T-shirt, as do the first 80 registered schoolchildren. The first-place finisher in each age group (except walking) receives a trophy, a prize and a certificate. Every finisher receives an exclusive finisher’s medal. Participants can use the Güttersbach outdoor pool free of charge. Food and refreshments will be provided for runners and spectators. Participants receive medals, and T-shirts are available for early registrants. Parking is limited and road closures may be in place. Families receive free admission to the outdoor pool after the race.

name: Monschau-Marathon warm-up
description: The Monschau Marathon is a scenic race through the picturesque Eifel landscape, attracting runners from around the world. The course passes through historic old-town areas, green meadows, forests and challenging climbs that offer a sporting challenge. Its warm, family-friendly atmosphere is shaped by dedicated volunteers and a diverse international field of runners. In addition to the classic marathon, ultra distances and relay races are also offered, making the event a special running experience.
course_highlights: Start in Konzen, with a slight downhill and a perfect warm-up lap
Historic old town of Monschau and nature along the Rur
Legendary Holderbachtal climb with 160 metres of elevation gain
additional: There are 12 aid stations along the course. Medical services, doctors, a massage team and sports physiotherapists are on site. Camping is available on the Am Windrad sports ground (€10 per day/person; children free). Showers and changing rooms are located in the sports hall at Konzen Primary School. Pacemakers for various time goals are available. A finisher’s medal is included; a technical shirt can be booked for an additional charge when registering online by 31 July. Several race distances are offered, including the marathon, ultra, relay and walking; participant services include refreshments, medals, finisher shirts, massage services and an after-run party. Registration deadlines apply, and personalised bib numbers are available.

name: Oettinger Stadtlauf
description: The Oettingen City Run takes place in Oettingen’s town centre as part of the “Summer in the City” festival. The event offers races for children, young people and adults, with timing for the main and youth races as well as the walking event. The routes pass through the historic town centre and offer a sporting challenge for all age groups. The event is organised by TSV Oettingen, Running Group, Triathlon and Athletics departments, and is a popular local race with a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Route through the historic town centre of Oettingen
Children’s race, approx. 0.8 km, untimed
Main race and walking event, approx. 7 km, timed
additional: Children’s race is untimed; registration is available through the Oettingen holiday programme; late registration is possible on the day of the event for an additional fee; medals and drinks for the children’s and youth races; prizes for the first three boys and girls in the youth race; walking event and main race are timed; staggered start times from 16:00. The course is mostly flat, on asphalt and cobblestones. Start and finish at the Market Square. Open to all physically fit participants. Oettingen residents’ city championship.

name: Residenzfestlauf Kirchheimbolanden
location: Innenstadt von Kirchheimbolanden, Kirchheimbolanden, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
description: The Residenzfestlauf Kirchheimbolanden is a traditional race through the town centre of Kirchheimbolanden. The event gives runners the opportunity to take part in a popular local sporting event in a beautiful urban setting. The route runs through the town centre and offers varied urban scenery. The event is organised by LLG Wonnegau, known for its dedicated running community.
course_highlights: Race through the town centre of Kirchheimbolanden
Varied urban running route
Traditional local sporting event
additional: Registration for the LLG Summer Runs 2026 is open. LLG Wonnegau also offers an end-of-year celebration for club members and non-members. The LLG Wonnegau office is located in Monsheim. Routes in the town-centre area; start and finish at the car park; free parking; showers and changing facilities in the school gym.

name: Volkslauf um den Mittelpunkt Deutschlands
description: The Volkslauf around the Center of Germany is a sporting event in Krebeck, suitable for young and old alike, as well as both competitive and recreational runners. The event offers various running and walking routes with varied elevation profiles, some of which are challenging and follow paved or asphalt paths. The races start and finish at the Krebeck sports field, and all participants receive fruit and drinks during and after the competition. Medals and prizes are awarded to the top finishers, and there are age-group rankings and on-site medical support.

name: Volkslauf um den Auesee
description: The course follows paved and partly asphalted paths around Auesee and is almost flat, with no significant elevation changes. The race is part of a popular regional running series with a total of nine events. It is organized by ATSV Espelkamp, which ensures a well-organized event and a pleasant atmosphere.

name: niedamiRUN - Ultramaraton Sudecki
location: Niedamirów, Kamienna Góra County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: NiedamiRUN is a Sudeten ultramarathon held in Niedamirów, a picturesque village at the crossroads of three cultures. The routes run through the Karkonosze Mountains, the Lubawka Gate and the Bóbr Valley, offering participants exceptional views and challenging climbs. The event features four distances: 10 km, 20 km, 50 km and 100 km, across varied terrain including gravel roads, meadows, montane forests and mountain trails. It’s a great opportunity to challenge nature and your own limits alongside fellow running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Routes cross the Karkonosze Mountains, the Lubawka Gate and the Bóbr Valley
They follow the border ridge of the Lasocki Range, the area around Okraj Pass and the shores of Bukówka Reservoir
Varied terrain: gravel roads, meadows, montane forests and challenging mountain climbs
additional: The participant limit is 100 people per distance. VAT invoices are available upon request. The start and finish are in Niedamirów.

name: 10 Śliwicka Dyszka
location: Śliwice, Tuchola County, Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: 12 eXtremalny Bieg Godzinny
description: The 12th eXtremalny Bieg Godzinny is a unique timed race held in Koszalin at Górka Piaskowa. Participants compete on a challenging, approximately 1-kilometre loop through hilly forest terrain with sandy sections. The race lasts exactly 1 hour, during which runners can complete as many laps as they wish; the winner is the runner who completes the most. At the finish, unique, very heavy medals await, along with a barbecue and bonfire, creating a friendly, sociable atmosphere.
course_highlights: An approximately 1 km loop through challenging, hilly forest terrain
Varied surface with sandy sections
Challenging uphill sections and numerous elevation changes
additional: Start and finish at Górka Piaskowa in Koszalin. Electronic chip timing. Participants receive a race bib and safety pins. Drinks and medical support from the Polish Red Cross in Koszalin are available at the finish. After the race, refreshments include grilled sausage, sweet rolls, and a bonfire. Participant limit: 100. Entry is open to participants aged 18 and over with a current medical examination or a declaration.

name: Bieg Zbója
description: Bieg Zbója is a mountain race in Bielsko-Biała inspired by the legend of the bandit Klimczok. The course follows scenic but demanding mountain trails, including the iconic climb beneath the cable car to Szyndzielnia and the summit of Klimczok. The race promises unforgettable thrills and will test every participant’s endurance, combining beautiful views with challenging terrain.
course_highlights: Mountain course with a climb beneath the cable car to Szyndzielnia
Klimczok summit, steeped in the legend of the bandit
A wild, fast descent that demands great endurance
additional: Zimowy Bieg Zbója 2027 offers two courses: Zbójnik, 18 km with 996 m of elevation gain, starting at 09:00, and Piechur, 13 km with 786 m of elevation gain, starting at 09:45. The courses are challenging, with winter conditions and a mountain character. Registration is online, with payments via PayU and PayPal.
