name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
description: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań – Summer Edition is a cross-country race held in the picturesque UAM Botanical Garden in Poznań. The event is part of a series of races that have promoted running and the beauty of natural routes in Greater Poland since 2014. It attracts running enthusiasts who appreciate both sporting competition and the beauty of their surroundings. The alternative location is Lake Rusałka, just 500 metres from the Botanical Garden, offering additional scenic appeal.
course_highlights: Cross-country route in the UAM Botanical Garden
Picturesque green spaces and natural surroundings
Alternative location by Lake Rusałka, 500 m from the start
additional: Race packs can be collected by an authorised representative. The organisers place particular emphasis on the scenic appeal of the proposed race locations. This summer marks the 10th anniversary of Botaniczna Piątka.

name: I Jura Night Dog Run
location: Klucze, Olkusz County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Jura Night Dog Run is a unique canicross race held at night in the picturesque Kraków-Częstochowa Upland. Participants can choose between a 10 km distance and a 21 km half marathon, or take part virtually at any distance. The event is limited to 200 participants, ensuring an intimate atmosphere and safety. The race is scheduled to start at 20:00, adding a distinctive character to the competition with your dog by your side.
course_highlights: A night race in the picturesque scenery of the Kraków-Częstochowa Upland
Available distances: 10 km and a 21 km half marathon
Virtual participation available at any distance
additional: The participant limit is 200. Individual and team categories are available; teams must include at least one woman or one man. A full race package is available for all distances. Standard and virtual race regulations are available.

name: Złota Dycha
description: Złota Dycha is a road race held in Złotoryja, with distances of 5 and 10 kilometres. The course consists of 2.5 km loops, which participants complete twice or four times, respectively. The race is challenging, with a gently undulating course profile, and water stations along the route help participants stay hydrated during the race. After the event, the top runners in various categories are presented with awards. The event attracts runners from across the region and is organised with participants’ comfort and safety in mind.
course_highlights: The course consists of 2.5 km loops
Two distances: 5 km (2 loops) and 10 km (4 loops)
Water stations along the route: 4 on the 5 km course and 8 on the 10 km course
additional: The Race Office is open from 7:00 to 9:30 at the fountain of Delfin on ul. Rynek. Participant limit: 100 places for the 5 km race and 200 for the 10 km race, for a total of 300 participants. Each participant receives a race bib with a chip, a mini race pack, a commemorative medal and a post-race meal. Time limits: 60 minutes for 5 km and 105 minutes for 10 km. The awards ceremony for the top runners will take place after 12:00.

name: Východniarska
location: Kluknava, parkovisko pred Kaštieľom hotela Biela dáma, čierny rytier – 8.8.2026 o 9:00
description: Východniarska is a mountain ultratrail and long-distance hike for individuals, building on the popular Východniarska stovka. The route runs through the eastern part of the Slovak Ore Mountains, mostly through the Volovské vrchy, and offers a challenging 85 km run with +4200 m of elevation gain. The start is in Kluknava and the finish in Kysak, with a time limit of 22 hours. The event is open to the public to participants aged 18 and over and requires proper registration and payment of the entry fee.

name: Hámorská dvadsiatka
location: Obecný úrad Remetské Hámre, Remetské Hámre, Slovakia
description: Hámorská dvadsiatka is a traditional running race organized by the municipality of Remetské Hámre. Despite the cancellation of the last two editions due to the Covid-19 pandemic, the organizers are looking forward to bringing the event back and welcoming a large turnout of runners. The race takes place in the beautiful natural surroundings of the Vihorlat Mountains, which offer attractive routes for sports enthusiasts.
course_highlights: The route passes through the natural surroundings of the Vihorlat Mountains
Beautiful views and tourist attractions in the area
Organized by the municipality of Remetské Hámre, with a long-standing tradition

name: Rajecký maratón
location: Námestie SNP, Rajec, Žilina District, Slovakia
description: The Rajec Marathon is a traditional running race organized by the Rajec Marathon Club, held in the picturesque surroundings of Rajec and the surrounding area. Runners can expect a challenging course with elevation gain and beautiful natural scenery that will test their endurance and fitness. The event has a friendly, family-oriented atmosphere, reflected in its side events and the hospitality at the finish. In addition to the marathon, a half marathon, relay, cross duathlon, and the popular Rajec Borošovec are also held. The Borošovec is a cross-country classic with more than 200 meters of elevation gain.
course_highlights: A course with more than 200 meters of elevation gain
The Rajec Borošovec cross-country classic, 14.1 km long
Natural scenery in Rajec and the surrounding area
additional: The Rajec Borošovec is part of the events that kick off the running season in the Rajec Valley. After the races, participants are served goulash and homemade cakes. The Rajec Borošovec course is dry and fast, with possible obstacles such as fallen trees. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere and also attracts younger runners and juniors.

name: Rajecký In-line polmaratón
location: Námestie SNP, Rajec, Žilina District, Slovakia
description: The Rajecký In-line Half Marathon is a competitive inline skating race held in Rajec at SNP Square. The course runs from Rajec to the village of Čičmany and back, with the finish at the marathon turnaround point in Čičmany. Skaters must wear a helmet throughout the course and use the rented timing chips, which must be returned at the finish. The organizer provides refreshments, changing rooms and showers, as well as free transport back to Rajec for inline skaters. The final finishing straight is reserved for runners, so participants must follow the organizer’s rules.

name: Rajecká štafeta
location: Námestie SNP, Rajec, Žilina District, Slovakia
description: The Rajec Relay is a running event organized by Maratón klub Rajec, held at SNP Square in Rajec. It is a relay race that is part of the Rajec Marathon and gives athletes the opportunity to compete in teams. The organizer provides race bibs, timekeeping, and full support for participants during the race. The event is suitable for runners of various levels and promotes community spirit and enthusiasm for sport in the region.

name: Rajecký detský beh
location: Námestie SNP, Rajec, Žilina District, Slovakia
description: The Rajecký Children’s Run is a running event organized by Maratón klub Rajec, held at SNP Square in Rajec. It is aimed at children and underage runners, with an emphasis on safety and responsibility: a parent or legal guardian must sign for them to participate. The event is part of a wider running program in Rajec and gives young runners the opportunity to experience the atmosphere of a race in a pleasant urban setting.
course_highlights: The race takes place at SNP Square in Rajec
For children and underage runners
Safety is supported by a parent or legal guardian’s signature
additional: Children and underage participants must bring a signed declaration from a parent or legal guardian. Participation will not be permitted without it.

name: Černovírský kros
location: Černovír u Ústí nad Orlicí, Pardubický
description: Černovírský kros je tradiční běžecký závod konaný v Černovíru u Ústí nad Orlicí, který nabízí tratě v kopcovitém terénu s kombinací zpevněných a nezpevněných lesních a polních cest a asfaltu. Závod je součástí ISCAREX poháru a je vhodný pro širokou škálu běžců včetně dětí i dospělých. Start a registrace probíhají u sokolovny v Černovíru, přičemž hlavní závod je na trať do 5 km. Atmosféra závodu je přátelská a závod je oblíbený mezi místními i přespolními běžci.

name: Běh na Krušnou horu
description: Běh na Krušnou horu je tradiční běh do vrchu konaný v obci Hudlice ve Středočeském kraji. Závod startuje na konci ulice Dolejší u lesa a vede po široké lesní šotolinové cestě až k rozhledně Máminka na vrcholu Krušné hory. Trať má délku 2,7 km s převýšením 190 metrů, což nabízí běžcům náročný, ale krásný běžecký zážitek v přírodě. Pořadatelem je TOBI Sport s.r.o. a závod je součástí Českého běžeckého klubu.

name: Brunnenlauf
location: Iburg-Stadion, Bad Driburg, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Bad Driburg Brunnenlauf is an annual running event organized by TV "Jahn" Bad Driburg e.V., welcoming runners of all ages. The challenging course runs along the Sachsenring, through the spa park and the town, and finishes at Iburg Stadium. The event emphasizes fairness and sportsmanship and uses reusable-chip timing. Registration is online only; late entries are not possible.
course_highlights: Challenging out-and-back course with hills
The course runs along the Sachsenring, through the spa park and the town
Finish at Iburg Stadium, Bad Driburg
additional: Timing is exclusively with the reusable chip from race result, worn on the foot with a chip strap. The chip deposit is 10€ and is refunded when the chip is returned. Participants may be disqualified for violations of fairness and good conduct. Online registration only; no late entries. Participation from age 18; children and students are free.

name: Karbener Stadtlauf
price_range: zwischen 2,00€ und 15,00€ je nach Lauf und Jahr
description: The Karben City Run is a traditional running event held every year in Karben at Günter-Reutzel-Weg. The event offers runners of different age groups and ability levels the opportunity to compete on varied courses through the town and surrounding area. An accompanying program provides entertainment and a chance to socialize. The run is a popular event for the whole family and promotes local sporting spirit.
course_highlights: Course through the town of Karben
Finish at Günter-Reutzel-Weg
Varied running courses for different age groups
additional: An accompanying program is part of the event. Registration is via the separate registration page. The event is organized by Karbener Sportverein. Various race disciplines; online registration is open until approximately 60 minutes before the start; late registration is available for a fee.

name: Monschau Marathon
description: The Monschau Marathon takes place in the picturesque Eifel region and offers runners a challenging course with varied terrain. In addition to the classic marathon, the event includes ultra distances (K56 and K70), a recreational marathon, and relay races. The route passes through historic old-town areas, green meadows, and forest landscapes, with impressive views, all in a warm, family-friendly atmosphere. The Monschau Marathon is an international running event with great variety and a strong sense of community among participants, volunteers, and sponsors.
course_highlights: Start in Konzen, with a slight downhill and a fast opening loop
Monschau’s historic old town and nature along the Rur
The legendary Holderbachtal climb, with 160 metres of elevation gain
additional: 12 refreshment points on the marathon course. Relay changeover points in Widdau and Kalterherberg. Medical service, doctors, a massage team, and sports physiotherapists on site. Camping is available on the Am Windrad sports grounds (€10 per day/person; children free). Showers and changing facilities are available in the Konzen primary school sports hall. Pacers for various target times. Finisher’s medal included; technical shirt available for an additional fee when registering online by 31 July. Guided bike tour on Saturday with no entry fee. Multiple race distances, including the marathon, ultras (K56, K70), relay, and walking; an event in the Eifel with refreshment points, start and changeover zones; focused on community and experiencing nature.

name: Rother Kirchweihlauf
description: The Rother Kirchweihlauf is a traditional running event organized by TSG 08 Roth. The race takes place annually in Roth and offers runners a great opportunity to get active and experience a sense of community. Despite occasional weather-related challenges, the event is held with great dedication. It welcomes runners of all ability levels and is a fixture on the regional running calendar.
course_highlights: A traditional race in Roth with regional significance
An outdoor event with a varied course
Part of the Middle Franconian 10 km Championships (when held)
additional: Certificates can be downloaded online after the race. The event is organized by TSG 08 Roth, which also offers other sports activities and classes. The event takes place on a flat, paved course, with various race categories for all ages and ability levels. Results and photos are available.

name: Stefan-Andres-Freundschaftslauf
organizer: Lauftreff Schweich e.V. / LLG Wustweiler e.V.
description: The Stefan-Andres Friendship Run is a challenging trail run through the vineyards of Schweich on the Moselle, held without a competitive element. The joy of running and the shared experience take centre stage. Three distances are offered—12, 18 and 26 kilometres—each with several metres of elevation gain and well-marked trails. After the run, participants can enjoy a social gathering with cold drinks at the Haus des Sports, which also offers changing rooms and showers.
course_highlights: Challenging trail run through the vineyards of Schweich
Three distances: 12 km (approx. 340 m elevation gain), 18 km (approx. 490 m), 26 km (approx. 720 m)
Refreshment stations on all routes, with traditional schnapps at the final station
additional: The event is a friendship run with no entry fees and is held as a charity run for the “Region der Lebensretter” app project. The start and finish are in Schweich: the start is at Niedeprümer Hof, and the finish is at the Haus des Sports, which has changing rooms and showers. At Schweicher Annaberg “Lagenliebe,” each participant is served a glass of wine along the route. The run usually takes place in August, typically in sunny weather at around 25°C. There are refreshment stations offering wine and schnapps tastings, and after the run everyone celebrates together at the Haus des Sports. The event supports the “Region der Lebensretter” app, which alerts nearby first responders.

name: Diekseelauf
description: The Diekseelauf is a popular fun run around Lake Dieksee in Bad Malente-Gremsmühlen. The main course is 11.5 km and runs counterclockwise around the lake, passing through scenic places such as Hafkamp, Timmdorf and Niederkleveez. There is also a 5 km fun run and a 1.5 km children’s run. The event also offers walking and hiking options and is suitable for runners of all ages. Drinks, first aid services and changing facilities are provided for participants’ comfort and safety.
course_highlights: 11.5 km loop running counterclockwise around Lake Dieksee
The course passes through Hafkamp, Timmdorf, Niederkleveez and Holm
Drinks station at 5.5 km in Timmdorf
additional: Race-pack collection from 8:30 a.m. Late entries are possible until 30 minutes before the start for a €4.00 late-entry fee, payable in cash via QR code. Timing is electronic, using a transponder in the race number. Awards ceremonies start at approximately 12:00 p.m. Toilets, a changing tent and shower facilities are available at the Sports and Education Centre. Certificates for all children’s race participants; prizes for the top participants in the various categories.

name: Münzwaldlauf (36. Volkslauf)
description: The Münzwaldlauf is a traditional fun run in Lichtenau, Baden-Württemberg, and will take place for the 36th time in 2026. The event offers various distances, from 0.25 km for Bambini to the 10 km main race. The courses run mostly along forest and meadow trails and are known for their natural surroundings, making the event especially appealing to families and nature lovers. In addition to the short children’s races, there are more challenging sections, such as the 5.2 km trail run. The event is an established local race with a long history.

name: Oberpfalzmeisterschaft Waldlauf 2026
description: The event is hosted by the Upper Palatinate District and organised by TV Burglengenfeld. The cross-country run offers runners an appealing course in a natural setting and is part of the Hammerseelauf. The championship is open to various age groups, from youth to masters, and promises exciting competitions in the Upper Palatinate region.

name: v-office-Europalauf
description: The 39th vOffice Europalauf is an international race connecting the Baltic seaside resorts of Neustadt, Pelzerhaken and Rettin along the half-marathon course. The route offers wonderful views across Neustädter Bucht and follows the beach promenade back to Neustadt, parallel to the beach. In addition to the half marathon, there are races over 10 km, 5 km and 2.5 km, as well as a Bambini race. The event is a popular sporting event in the region and is organized by TSV Neustadt.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
location: Ogród Botaniczny w Kielcach, Kielce, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Kielce – Summer Edition is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place on scenic routes that showcase the beauty of the locations. The organizers aim to promote running and provide participants with a unique sporting and nature experience. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively in the beautiful surroundings of Kielce.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on scenic routes
The beauty of the proposed locations
Organized since 2014, with an emphasis on off-road running
additional: The organizer states that they have been organizing races since 2014.

name: Chudy Wawrzyniec
description: Chudy Wawrzyniec is a mountain ultramarathon held in the Żywiec Beskids, with its base in Rajcza and Ujsoły. The event offers three ultra distances: 50 km, 80 km and 100 km, featuring substantial elevation gain and technically demanding courses. Additional races include Parszywa Bendoszka, Mała Rycerzowa and Muńcuł Vertical, as well as events for children and young people called Chudy Hulajnik. The event promotes physical activity in a natural setting and is scored by ITRA. The organizer provides the Chudy Bus shuttle and parking guidance because parking spaces are limited.
course_highlights: Ultramarathon courses of 52 km, 82 km and 102 km, with elevation gains of 2,500 m, 3,800 m and over 5,100 m, respectively
The course passes through the Żywiec Beskids, including peaks such as Wielka Rycerzowa, Wielka Racza, Pilsko and Romanka
There are three aid stations on the 100 km course, two on the 80 km course and one on the 50 km course; disposable cups are not provided at aid stations
additional: The ultramarathon starts at 4:00 in Rajcza; start times for the accompanying races and children’s events are listed in detail. The time limit for the ultramarathons is 16 hours, for Parszywa Bendoszka 13.5 hours, and for Mała Rycerzowa 5 hours. Courses are marked with tape, and disposable cups are not provided at aid stations. The Chudy Bus shuttle is provided to make transport easier because parking spaces are limited. Children’s and young people’s races cover distances from 200 m to 2.5 km in the area around the amphitheatre in Ujsoły.

name: VII Charytatywny Bieg świętego Dominika
description: The St. Dominic’s International Run is a prestigious running event held annually in Gdańsk since 1994, as an integral part of St. Dominic’s Fair. This exceptional sporting event attracts both amateur and professional runners, offering races over various distances against the picturesque backdrop of Gdańsk’s Old Town. The course runs through the streets of the city’s historic center, while cheers from more than 25,000 spectators create an unforgettable atmosphere. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and social integration and is accompanied by numerous cultural and sporting events.
course_highlights: A 1,412 m course in central Gdańsk, running along Długi Targ, Powroźnicza, Kotwiczników and other streets
Start and finish by the Neptune Fountain in the historic city center
Cheers from more than 25,000 spectators along the course during each race
additional: The event comprises four races under the slogan “Chase St. Dominic,” including a Prologue for all visitors to the Fair, a race for people with disabilities as part of the “Integration Through Sport” program, the 5 km Women’s Race Lotto Cup, and the 5 km Men’s Race Energa Cup. The course is a closed loop, allowing spectators to follow the competition easily. The event is accompanied by numerous attractions, such as partner booths, presentations, shows, and concerts at St. Dominic’s Fair.

name: XI Bieg Lucka
description: The 11th Luck Run is a memorial race honoring Lucjan Chorąży, held in Skawinki near Lanckorona. The event offers several distances: a main race of approximately 14 km, a recreational run and Nordic Walking over approximately 5.2 km, and shorter races for children. The main race route leads to Mount Chełm, and participants can gather for refreshments after the race. The event is family-friendly and welcoming, organized by the Lucjan Chorąży Association.
course_highlights: The approximately 14 km main race route leads to Mount Chełm
Recreational run and Nordic Walking over approximately 5.2 km
Children’s races from 50 m to 1,000 m on the field and meadows near the race office
additional: Entry limit: 270 participants for the Main Race, Recreational Run and Nordic Walking; 80 online places and 30 places on race day for the children’s races. Race bib collection and additional registration on race day from 9:00 to 11:00. Children’s races start at 10:30; the main races and Nordic Walking start at 12:00 in three start groups.

name: Bieg na Wielką Sowę
location: Ludwikowice Kłodzkie, Gmina Nowa Ruda, Poland

name: Beh na Kráľovu studňu
location: Lenartov, okr. Bardejov, Lenartov, okr. Bardejov, Motorest Javorina Lenartov
description: The Run to Kráľova studňa is a traditional uphill race held in the picturesque village of Lenartov, near the historic Kráľova studňa, a meeting place of three kings. The course winds through beautiful countryside and offers a unique mountain-running experience, rich in history and scenic views. The event is part of the local running league and attracts runners from across the region. The organizers create a friendly atmosphere and welcome all participants, regardless of ability.

name: Stezka mužů
description: Stezka mužů je 3 km dlouhý silniční závod, který je součástí série SABZO a uskuteční se v Praze 4. Tento závod je vhodný pro širokou veřejnost a nabízí příležitost k aktivnímu trávení času v přátelské atmosféře. Přestože je hlavní zaměření na běh, akce je součástí většího sportovního a společenského programu v regionu. Přijďte si zazávodit a užít si den plný pohybu a zábavy.

name: Nettetal-Lauf
distance_verbose: 100 km, Marathon, Halbmarathon, 10 km, 5 km, 3000 Meter
description: The Nettetal Run is a traditional road race held annually in mid-August in Ochtendung, Germany. The 2026 event offers a varied selection of distances from 3 km to 10 km, with longer distances also possible in other years. The course is officially measured, allowing results to be recognized in the German rankings. The race is supported by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and is listed in the laufen.de calendar.
course_highlights: Officially measured course
Road race in Ochtendung, Germany
A range of distances: 3 km, 5 km and 10 km
additional: Typical August weather: around 25 °C during the day and 14 °C at night, mostly sunny, with an average of 60 mm of precipitation. The start is in Ochtendung. The race is part of the German athletics calendar, with an official measured course suitable for competitions.

name: 6. Běh pro zdraví
location: Park Boženy Němcové, Karviná, Moravian-Silesian Region, Česko
description: Běh pro zdraví je charitativní seriál sedmi běhů pořádaných v krásném prostředí Parku Boženy Němcové v Karviné. Každý běh nabízí trasu dlouhou 3 km, kterou si může každý uběhnout vlastním tempem. Výtěžek ze startovného je věnován na pomoc potřebným, což dává akci smysl a přidanou hodnotu. Prezence začíná v 17:00 a start je v 17:45 na Lodičkách. Všichni jsou srdečně zváni k účasti a podpoře dobré věci.

name: 15 Diecezjalna Pielgrzymka Biegowa Radom...
description: The Diocesan Running Pilgrimage is a unique pilgrimage run from Radom to Częstochowa, held as a relay over several days. The event combines recreational sport with a spiritual experience, promoting a healthy lifestyle and prayer for world peace. It is organized by the “Biegiem Radom!” Association, which engages the local running community and promotes physical activity in the region.
course_highlights: Pilgrimage route from Radom to Częstochowa
Relay run spread over several days
Spiritual program modeled on traditional walking pilgrimages
additional: The run is held with prayers for peace in Ukraine and around the world. The organizers provide a spiritual program during the run. Participants run in relays. In the past, they held organizational meetings and asked people to express their willingness to lend cars for the duration of the pilgrimage.

name: 8. Wisent-RUN
location: Wisentgehege Springe, Springe, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Wisent-RUN is a popular race at Wisentgehege Springe, taking place for the eighth time. The event offers various race distances, including children’s races and timed competitions, set in a natural environment. With a family-friendly atmosphere and free admission to Wisentgehege from 15:00, the race is a sporting highlight for all ages. The event is organised by VfV Concordia Alvesrode e.V. and is known for its welcoming atmosphere and dedicated volunteers.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Köhlerhütte in Wisentgehege Springe
Race routes through the natural surroundings of Wisentgehege
Timed children’s races and an awards ceremony
additional: Free admission to Wisentgehege from 15:00. The 500 m children’s race, “Frischlingsrennen”, is untimed and for children born in 2021 or later. The 1 km children’s race is timed and includes an awards ceremony, for children born from 2016 to 2021. Ample parking is available. The event is open to everyone, with free admission for visitors. It offers an opportunity to explore the wildlife at Wisentgehege while also being active.

name: 24. Dammer Stadtlauf
description: The 24th Damme City Run is an evening road race through the center of Damme, organized by OSC Damme in cooperation with the City of Damme. The program includes three starts: a schoolchildren’s race, a general race for all participants, and the main evening race. After a two-year pandemic-related break, the race returns with an expected field of over 500 runners. The event is characterized by an open, local atmosphere, with on-site registration available, as runners fill the streets of the town center.
course_highlights: Evening road race through Damme city center
Three starts: schoolchildren’s race, general race, and main race
The course stays in the city center, with a lively atmosphere
additional: On-site registration is available, encouraging open, local participation. August weather is typically sunny, with temperatures between 14 and 25 °C. The event includes several categories, including children’s races and the main race, on a route through the city, with a relaxed, welcoming atmosphere.

name: 24. Knesebecker Einhornlauf
description: The Knesebeck Unicorn Run is a long-standing running event in the Isenhagen region, held annually in August. The event gives runners of various ability levels the opportunity to test themselves on varied courses. Online registration is available through the RaceResult platform, where all results and certificates can also be accessed. The run takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Wittingen and attracts numerous running enthusiasts from the region.
course_highlights: 10 km course
Nordic walking option
Event held on the school grounds in Knesebeck
additional: Registration is online through RaceResult. The run takes place on Friday evening. Participation is limited to 100 people; registration and results are available online; the event takes place on the school grounds in Knesebeck.

name: 17. VSB Dresdner Nachtlauf
description: The VSB Dresden Night Run offers a beautifully illuminated route with views of the Dresden skyline. Torches and glow sticks create a special atmosphere. The 11.5 km route follows the Elbe to the Blue Wonder and returns along the Neustadt side of the river, while the 6.2 km route also runs along the Elbe and crosses the Albert Bridge to the finish. Alongside the sporting experience, there are children’s races and a special team competition for clubs and organizations. The event takes place at Heinz-Steyer-Stadion and is a highlight of the region’s running calendar.

name: 35. Speller Sparkassen-Sommernachtslauf
description: The 35th Speller Sparkassen Summer Night Run is a traditional race in Spelle, organized by SC Spelle-Venhaus. The event offers runners an attractive course in the beautiful surroundings of Wählehof. The race is suitable for all ages and ability levels and takes place in a relaxed atmosphere. Participants can look forward to a well-organized event with a friendly, family atmosphere.

name: Reuter Run Boršov nad Vltavou
description: Reuter Run v Boršově nad Vltavou je běžecký závod na 12,5 km, který se koná od 11:00 v Kemp Poslední štace. Závod je součástí Jihočeského běžeckého poháru a nabízí běžcům možnost poměřit síly na zajímavé trati v jihočeském kraji. Pořadatelem je Zdeněk Richtr a závod je vhodný pro širokou běžeckou veřejnost, včetně registrovaných členů poháru i ostatních běžců. Povrch trati není detailně specifikován, ale závod je součástí seriálu s dlouholetou tradicí a jasnými pravidly.

name: Běžecký mítink Bohuňovice
description: Běžecký mítink v Bohuňovicích u Olomouce je krosový závod, který nabízí mužům trať dlouhou 12,2 km a ženám 6,1 km. Závod je součástí Velké ceny vytrvalců Olomouckého kraje a přitahuje běžce, kteří mají rádi náročnější terén. Mítink je vhodný pro všechny, kdo chtějí změřit své síly v přírodním prostředí s proměnlivým povrchem. Akce je tradičním setkáním běžecké komunity v regionu.

name: 7 pohoří Šumava
description: Trail Run Seriál 7 pohoří je největší akce svého druhu v Česku, která vás provede sedmi nejkrásnějšími a nejtěžšími horskými masivy. Závody nabízejí technické traily, epické výhledy a jedinečnou atmosféru, která prověří sílu, vůli a odhodlání každého běžce. Ať už jste zkušený horský běžec, nebo začátečník, 7 pohoří vás vyzývá pokořit všechny trasy a stát se legendou. Závod Šumava nabízí trasy vedoucí přes vrcholy Špičák a Pacíř, kolem ledovcových jezer a hlubokých lesů s převýšením až 900 m.

name: Jablonská osmička
description: Jablonská osmička je běžecký závod v Jablonném nad Orlicí. Tento pátý ročník nabízí hlavní běh na 8 km, dětské závody a zábavnou pivní štafetu pro čtyřčlenné týmy. Po závodě pokračuje program Food Festivalem a Jabloffestem s hudbou a dětským programem v areálu koupaliště. Závod je vhodný jak pro sportovce, tak pro hobby běžce, a doprovází ho bohatá tombola a dárkové tašky pro registrované účastníky.

name: Křivinský kros
description: Křivinský kros je běžecký závod konaný v Křivicích, který nabízí hlavní trať dlouhou 7,5 km s převýšením 275 metrů a dětskou trať 800 metrů. Závod vede převážně lesními cestami a pěšinami v kopcovitém terénu, což zaručuje náročný a zajímavý běh. Startuje se postupně od 9:30 hodin, nejprve děti, poté junioři a nakonec hlavní kategorie. Závod je součástí Velké ceny východních Čech a je otevřený široké veřejnosti s dobrovolným startovným. Po závodě probíhá vyhlášení výsledků a krátká tombola pro účastníky.

name: Schierker Sommerlauf
description: The Schierker Summer Run is a traditional race in the Harz, taking place for the 24th time. The event offers varied distances from 1 km to 16 km, running through the impressive landscape around Schierke. Runners enjoy breathtaking views, a unique atmosphere, and great support in the finish area at the Schierker Feuersteinarena. The race is part of the new Harzer Laufcup 2026 and is open to runners of all ability levels.
course_highlights: Run on paved forest roads, with two laps for the 8 km main race
Breathtaking views of the Brocken and the Harz landscape
Start and finish at the Schierker Feuersteinarena, with a great atmosphere
additional: The start and finish are at the Schierker Feuersteinarena, which has changing rooms and showers. The course follows paved forest roads. There is a refreshment station at the newly built toboggan run. Registration is online, and early registrants receive personalized race numbers. Use of the showers is included in the entry fee. The event is part of the Harzer Laufcup 2026. Courses on paved forest roads, online registration, personalized race numbers, refreshments included, electronic timing, certificates and trophies for the winners.

name: Brohlbachtal-Lauf mit Halbmarathon und Walking
description: The 15th Brohlbachtal Run in Gamlen offers runners and walkers a varied sporting event on a flat course. The event includes races over 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon (21.0975 km), as well as walking and Nordic walking distances. Children’s and youth races are also offered. The finish is the same for all events; the exact finish address is displayed via RUNME Premium.
course_highlights: Flat course
Events for running, walking and Nordic walking
Distances from 5 km to a half marathon
additional: Children’s and youth races are also part of the event. The exact finish address is only visible with RUNME Premium. The event takes place at the Gamlen community hall and is known for its friendly atmosphere and varied running events for all age groups.

name: Dülmener Wasserlauf mit 5 km Walking
location: Sportzentrum Nord, Dülmen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 11th Dülmen Water Run with 5 km walking takes place in Dülmen. The event offers runners and walkers the opportunity to take part in 5 km and 10 km races. The race takes place at the Sportzentrum Nord and promises pleasant conditions in typical August weather, with temperatures around 25 °C and mostly sunny skies. Please note that the exact event details should be checked with the organizer before registering.
course_highlights: Distances: 5 km and 10 km
Venue: Sportzentrum Nord, Dülmen
Typical August weather, around 25 °C and mostly sunny
additional: The event offers a team classification in which four runners start together, and places special emphasis on water and environmental protection. The event is family-friendly and open to runners of all ability levels.

name: Gederner Stadtlauf
location: Lauterbacher Straße, Gedern, Wetteraukreis, Hesse, Germany
description: The 24th Gedern City Run offers runners of all ages a special running experience through Gedern’s historic old town. With distances of 500 m, 1,500 m, 5 km and 10 km, there is a suitable option for children, teenagers, beginners and ambitious runners. The longer distances follow a varied loop course consisting of four 2.5-kilometre laps, combining a sporting challenge with history. The route follows historic paths such as the Eisenpfad, Basaltweg, Barbarossaweg and Fürstenweg, with a notable climb to Schlossberg and a route through the castle gardens. The start and finish are on Lauterbacher Straße near Kirchplatz. Changing facilities are available at the Gedern gymnasium.
course_highlights: Gedern’s historic old town
Four 2.5 km laps on a varied loop course
Sections along the Eisenpfad, Basaltweg, Barbarossaweg and Fürstenweg, with a climb to Schlossberg
additional: Changing facilities at the Gedern gymnasium (Franseckystraße 32A). The longer distances consist of four 2.5 km laps. The route includes a paved castle courtyard and castle gardens. The event is organised by the Top-Time timing team. Distances for children, teenagers and adults; start/finish on Lauterbacher Straße; changing facilities at the Gedern gymnasium.

name: Hambacher Volkslauf
description: The Hambach Volkslauf takes place in Niederzier-Hambach and offers races over 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon. There are also 10 km walking and Nordic walking routes. The courses are measured by the DLV and are part of the Regio Aachen Running Cup. The event welcomes runners of all ability levels and looks forward to a large turnout.
course_highlights: Measured courses over 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon
10 km walking and Nordic walking routes
Part of the Regio Aachen Running Cup
additional: Registration is now open via the website. Course maps and the event information are available as PDFs. The event is part of the Regio Aachen Running Cup. Courses measured, online registration, part of the Regio Aachen Running Cup

name: 100MeilenBerlin - Der Mauerweglauf
description: The 100MeilenBerlin – The Wall Trail Run is a historically significant ultramarathon that follows the route of the former Berlin Wall around western Berlin. The course of approximately 161 kilometers runs mostly on paved paths, but also includes trail-like and sometimes uneven sections. The start and finish are at Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahn-Sportpark in Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg. The race commemorates the victims of the division of Germany and is held annually, with the running direction alternating.

name: 2. Backyard Ultra-Marathon Tharandter Wald
location: Jugendfreizeithof Grillenburg, Grillenburg, Tharandt, Saxony, Germany
description: The 2nd Backyard Ultra in the Tharandter Wald, organized by SC Freital e.V., offers the popular ultra format in one of Saxony’s most beautiful forest regions. The start and finish area is at Jugendfreizeithof Grillenburg. The 6.7 km loop runs mainly along forest paths through the Tharandter Wald and offers a varied route, with the running direction changing between day and night. A total of 100 places are available, and registration is via RaceResult.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loop, mainly on forest paths
Route through the Tharandter Wald, with the direction changing (counterclockwise during the day, clockwise at night)
Start and finish area at Jugendfreizeithof Grillenburg
additional: The first 8 laps are run counterclockwise, then from 18:00 (night route) clockwise, and from 06:00 (day route) counterclockwise again. There are 100 places in total.

name: Charity Mega Run
description: The Charity Mega Run in Bingen am Rhein is a unique running event with a mission: to get people moving—for themselves, for others, and for a good cause. The event offers four distances, from 5 km to 52 km, along Germany’s most beautiful running route, with stunning views of the Rhine and vineyards. In addition to the run, there is a pasta party on the evening before and a varied program for runners and spectators. The event takes place at the Rhine-Nahe Corner in Bingen and combines sporting ambition with social commitment.

name: Hüttenfelder Volksbankkerwelauf
description: The Hüttenfelder Volksbank Kerwelauf is a traditional running event with more than 30 years of history, offering runners of all ability levels an enjoyable opportunity to test their endurance and have fun together. Three races are offered: a half marathon (21.1 km), a 10 km race, and a 2 km children’s race. The route runs mostly through shady woodland and offers a wonderfully flat, pleasant running environment, with historic ammunition bunkers as special highlights. The start and finish are at the Hüttenfeld allotment gardens, and after the races there is an awards ceremony at the Kerweplatz by the Bürgerhaus.

name: Josef Kaderhandt-Waldlauf Plus
description: The 42nd Josef Kaderhandt Forest Run in Menden is a long-established running event organized by Marathon-Club Menden e.V. The course follows paved forest trails through the scenic Sauerland and offers a sporting challenge with demanding sections. In addition to the classic 20 km forest run, runners can take part in the 20 km Plus Marathon and extend their distance to an ultramarathon of up to 50 km by completing additional laps. The race starts in Waldemei near the Kolping Memorial Stone and finishes at Bürgerbad Leitmecke. There is also a 7.8 km fun run for everyone who enjoys running.

name: Kelheimer Volksfestlauf
description: The Kelheim Volksfest Run is a traditional running event held every August at the Am Pflegerspitz festival grounds in Kelheim. It offers different distances for various age groups, including 2 km for schoolchildren, 5 km for young people, and 10 km for adults. The event is a regular fixture in the city of Kelheim’s calendar and is organized by run & bike Kelheim e.V. Race packets are available from 12:00 on the day of the event in the beer tent, and the award ceremony takes place there after the races.

name: Städtedreieckslauf
description: The Städtedreieckslauf is a traditional race through the three towns of Burglengenfeld, Teublitz, and Maxhütte-Haidhof. The 16th edition of the event brings together numerous runners for a good cause across five competition categories. The course is flat and runs along field paths and public roads, where traffic regulations must be observed. The race offers a great opportunity to experience the region through sport and cross the finish line together.

name: Städtelauf Plauen - Hof
description: The Plauen–Hof City Run is a traditional race in the Saxon-Bavarian border region, celebrating its 35th edition in 2026. The route connects the Vogtland metropolis of Plauen with the Bavarian city of Hof and attracts runners and Nordic walkers from the region and beyond. The race is known for its sporting atmosphere and cross-border city partnership. Every year, numerous participants take part in ideal running weather and enjoy the scenic route.

name: WoKiMen
distance_verbose: Halbmarathon, 10 km, 5 km, 2 km, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: WoKiMen is a family-friendly running day at Parc de Tarbes in Altenkirchen, offering a variety of running and activity options for children, adults, teams, walkers, Nordic walkers, and even dog owners. Children can run 0.5 km or 2 km, while adults can choose between 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km. The TeamChallenge is a relay race with three 1 km legs. In addition to the races, there is a varied program featuring yoga, Zumbathlon, and an adventure course. The day ends with a relaxing Chill & Grill event featuring Nepalese specialties, Italian wood-fired pizza, popcorn, coffee, and cake.

name: 303 Maraton Antoniego Fili
description: The 303 Antoni Fili Marathon is a marathon held in Sztum, Mazowieckie. Runners have access to a training plan tailored to their level, helping them prepare optimally for the race. The organizers offer expert support and detailed training instructions, making the event appealing to runners of various experience levels. The event takes place annually, and in 2026 it will be held on August 15.
additional: Training plans of 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level. The organizer provides expert support and detailed training instructions. The race listing can be managed and marketing partnerships arranged through the TreningBiegacza.pl platform.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
description: Botaniczna Piątka Bydgoszcz - Summer Edition is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place on scenic routes that highlight the beauty of the locations. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and join a close-knit running community in Wielkopolska and beyond.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on scenic routes
The beauty of the proposed locations
Organized by experienced running enthusiasts

name: XII Rozłaziński Bieg po radość z życia
Chminianskonovovesský beh
location: Chminianska Nová Ves, okr. Prešov, Chminianska Nová Ves, okr. Prešov, futbalové ihrisko OŠK Chminianska Nová Ves
organizer: ThLic. Mgr. Pavol Uličný a obec Chminianska Nova Ves
description: The Chminianskonovovesský Run is a traditional running race organized by the municipality of Chminianska Nová Ves and ThLic. Mgr. Pavol Uličný. The race takes place at the OŠK Chminianska Nová Ves football pitch in the Prešov District and offers categories for different age groups of men, women, and youth. It is a community sporting event that promotes an active lifestyle and enthusiasm for sport in the region.

name: Runica Nevoľné
location: Nevoľné, okr. Žiar nad Hronom, Nevoľné, okr. Žiar nad Hronom, futbalové ihrisko
organizer: Marathon Banska Bystrica, s.r.o., ON-POINT o.z.
description: Runica Nevoľné is a running event held at the football field in Nevoľné, Žiar nad Hronom District. The race offers a unique experience in the heart of Slovakia, where runners can enjoy a welcoming atmosphere and well-organized event. The course is suitable for runners of various levels, and the event is part of the Marathon Tour running series. The organizers welcome all runners looking to enjoy a sporting event in a beautiful setting.

name: Štafetový beh 345 km od Tatier k Dunaju Jasná – Bratislava
location: Demänovská dolina, Demänovská dolina, Jasná, Demänovská dolina
description: The Relay Run from the Tatras to the Danube is the largest relay race in Slovakia, covering a distance of 345 km. Teams of 6 or 9 to 12 members start in Jasná in the Low Tatras and run nonstop through day and night, finishing on the Danube embankment in Bratislava. The course is mostly paved, with approximately 3,990 metres of total ascent and 4,870 metres of descent. Runners complete 36 legs of varying length and difficulty; in a 12-member team, each member runs three legs. The race is a test of team spirit and endurance in Slovakia’s beautiful surroundings.

name: Žebrácká pětadvacítka
description: Žebrácká pětadvacítka je tradiční srpnový silniční běh po silnicích a lesních cestách Křivoklátska, který se koná každoročně v Žebráku. Nabízí několik distancí včetně hlavního závodu na 25 km, běhu na 10 km, 10 km chůze a rodinného běhu pro děti. Start hlavního závodu je v 10:00 u Základní školy v Žebráku, přičemž kategorie seniorů startují již v 9:00. Závod je spojen s oslavami Vavřinecké pouti a nabízí krásné sportovní zážitky v malebném prostředí Křivoklátska.

name: MFB MarathOn LABE
description: MarathOn LABE je tradiční mezinárodní běžecký festival konaný v Kolíně a Poděbradech, který nabízí maraton, půlmaraton, 10 km závod a další běžecké disciplíny. Trať maratonu je obrátková a vede po lesních, zpevněných a asfaltových cestách s certifikací ČAS. Akce je vhodná pro běžce všech úrovní a doprovází ji bohatý program včetně závodů dětí a zábavy pro rodiny. Organizátorem je spolek Kolínská 14, který podporuje aktivní a zdravý životní styl v regionu od roku 2011.

name: Tyršův běh na Sokol
description: Tyršův běh na Sokol je tradiční lesní běh v Malé Skále, který nabízí náročnou trať dlouhou 2 km s převýšením 300 metrů. Běh je určen pro milovníky běhání v přírodě, kteří nevadí kopce a technický terén plný kořenů, děr a kamenů. Startuje se v minutových intervalech a závod má dlouholetou tradici, v roce 2021 se konal již 36. ročník. Všichni zájemci o tento typ běhu jsou srdečně vítáni.

name: Volkslauf Rund um den Beerster See
location: Kurpark am Kanal, Bad Bederkesa, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Volkslauf Rund um den Beerster See is a running event for participants of all ages and abilities, held on the third Sunday in August in Bad Bederkesa. The course passes through a natural setting and offers a motivating challenge for both competitive runners and recreational athletes. The event promotes community and the joy of being active, making it a special experience for both race participants and recreational runners. The start and finish are in Kurpark am Kanal, and timing is by transponder.
course_highlights: Scenic course around Beerster See
Start and finish in Kurpark am Kanal
Free drinks on the opposite side of the lake and at the finish
additional: Race packs are distributed in the Amtsscheune opposite the castle. Showers are available at the Moortherme upon presentation of your race number. Timing is by transponder, which must be returned after the race. The cut-off time for the main races is 1 hour 45 minutes. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Course distances: 7.6 km; hiking, walking and Nordic walking: 1.1 km, 0.5 km and 14.6 km. Race packs are distributed in the Amtsscheune. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Timing is by transponder.

name: HuBuT - 8. Hunsbuckel-Trail
description: The HuBuT - Hunsbuckel Trail is a challenging trail-running event in the Hunsrück, with three distances: ShortTrail (12 km), HalfTrail (27 km) and UltraTrail (47 km). The routes pass through varied low-mountain landscapes featuring green meadows, dense forests, singletrack trails, gorges and award-winning hiking paths. A special highlight is crossing the Geierlay suspension bridge, Germany’s most beautiful and highest suspension bridge. The start and finish are in the idyllic village of Laubach, offering participants an unforgettable experience in nature.
course_highlights: Varied low-mountain landscape with elevation profiles between river valleys and ridges
Crossing the 360 m-long and 100 m-high Geierlay suspension bridge
Running over rugged terrain, singletrack trails, award-winning hiking paths and through deep gorges
additional: There are three distances: ShortTrail (12 km), HalfTrail (27 km) and UltraTrail (47 km). The UltraTrail route crosses the Geierlay suspension bridge. The trail features singletrack trails, forest paths, gorges and historic sights such as the ruins of Balduinseck Castle. There is a Winter Edition with a 6-hour race in February. This trail-running event offers several distances, including the UltraTrail, HalfTrail, ShortTrail and a Winter Edition 6-hour race; it takes place in Laubach in the Hunsrück; typical weather in August is warm.

name: Ortskernlauf
description: The Roßdorf Town Center Festival is a long-standing tradition, held annually on the third weekend in August, and celebrates its 42nd anniversary in 2026. It brings together Roßdorf’s diverse community and offers a varied program featuring live acts on three stages, a children’s and family area, and numerous clubs and local organizations. The town center is the social hub where visitors from near and far come together to celebrate. The Town Center Run on Sunday is a sporting highlight, starting and finishing in the town center.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the town center of Roßdorf
Warm-up from 11:00 a.m.; the Town Center Run starts from 12:00 p.m. on Sunday
A diverse community and festive atmosphere in the town center
additional: The Town Center Run takes place on Sunday, with a warm-up from 11:00 a.m. and the start from 12:00 p.m. at the Town Center Run start/finish area. The children’s program and children’s band run from 5:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m. The festival features live acts on three stages, a kids’ and family area, and numerous local clubs. Sporting run; registration opens in summer 2026 on the website of Skifreunde Roßdorf.

name: SV02 Kerwelauf - Der SV02 lässts LAUFen
description: The 8th SV02 Kerwelauf in Schönau is an enjoyable running event. It offers two distances, a 400-meter race and a 10-kilometer race, and is aimed at runners looking for a short but athletic challenge. The race takes place in typical August weather, with pleasant temperatures and mostly sunny conditions. The course runs through the beautiful surroundings of Schönau and promises an enjoyable running experience.
course_highlights: Distances: 400 m and 10 km
Location: Schönau
Typical August weather, around 25 °C and mostly sunny
additional: Please check the event details with the organizer before registering. The event offers a measured course approved by the DLV, live timing, children’s races, and a festive atmosphere with refreshments in the festival tent.

name: Waldlauf / 37. Volkslauf
description: The 47th Waldlauf / 37th Volkslauf is a running event held on Sunday morning in Oberzent-Hetzbach in the Odenwald. The adult program includes hilly courses of 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon. The 5 km course is also open to walkers and Nordic walkers. Start times are staggered, with the 10 km race starting shortly before the 5 km race, giving the event the character of several local races organized together. There is also a 750 m race for children and young people, and all races finish at the same finish line.
course_highlights: Hilly courses of 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon
Shared finish line for all distances
Separate races for children and young people
additional: Typical August weather: approx. 25 °C, mostly sunny, with average precipitation of 60 mm. Hilly terrain, several race distances, including walking and Nordic walking options; weather-dependent conditions in August, with temperatures around 25 °C and about 60 mm of precipitation.

name: Breitunger Pleßlauf
location: Sporthalle am Riegelsweg, Breitungen/Werra, Thuringia, Germany
description: The Breitunger Pleßlauf takes place in Breitungen/Werra and offers running distances from 1 km to 30 km, as well as 10.7 km Nordic walking. The event is organized by SV Lauftreff Breitungen e.V. and starts and finishes at the sports hall on Riegelsweg. The varied courses are suitable for both children and experienced runners. In addition to the sporting challenge, the event offers timing with a disposable chip, trophies and prizes for the fastest participants, and finisher medals for the main distances.
course_highlights: Running distances from 1 km to 30 km
10.7 km Nordic walking
Start and finish at the sports hall on Riegelsweg in Breitungen
additional: Late entries are possible until 45 minutes before each start, with a late-entry fee of €5 for the main distances and Nordic walking. Timing uses a disposable chip provided by GO timing. Changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available at the sports hall. Trophies are awarded to the three fastest finishers in the main-distance races, and the winners receive prizes and cash awards. All finishers of the main-distance races receive a laser-engraved medal. Course profiles, mountain run, online registration, results, photos, videos, dates in 2024–2026

name: Ronneburger Stunden-Paarlauf des Laufprojekt Büdingen
description: The Ronneburg Hourly Pair Relay, organized by Laufprojekt Büdingen e.V., is a unique running competition in which teams of two runners take turns completing laps on the 400 m synthetic track at the stadium at the Ronneburg Youth Center. The event features three competitions lasting 15, 30 and 60 minutes. The laps run are added together and converted into a total distance, with the pair covering the greatest distance winning. The event is open to all gender combinations and promotes team spirit and endurance in a friendly atmosphere.

name: Run´n Roll for Help
description: The Run´n Roll for Help is a long-standing city run in Giessen that has been delighting runners for over 28 years. Every year, the streets of the city center turn into a sporting highlight, where the charitable cause is just as important as the competition. With over 1,200 participants in 2025 and more than €19,000 raised for Lebenshilfe and Aidshilfe, the event is a major charity running festival in the region. The event offers a great atmosphere and warmly welcomes everyone who loves running.

name: Wohldenberger Waldlauf
description: The 21st Wohldenberger Forest Run offers runners of all ability levels varied routes through Wohldenberger Forest. For over two decades, this event has been one of the most popular in the Hildesheim region, attracting 200 to 300 participants each year. The course follows natural forest trails with changing surfaces and hilly sections, making it a true trail-running experience. There are suitable distances for beginners, families, walkers, and ambitious runners, from short children’s races to the challenging half marathon.

name: Wolfsburg Staffellauf powered by VfL Wob e.V.
description: The Wolfsburg Relay Race, organized by VfL Wolfsburg e.V., is a special team experience that brings together runners of all ages and backgrounds. This second edition of the relay marathon gives teams from schools, clubs, and companies the chance to enjoy the spirit of sport and teamwork together. The course runs through the green Stadtforst forest, with the start and finish at VW-Bad, where music will also add to the atmosphere. Children’s relay teams are supported by Förderkreis Leichtathletik VfL Wolfsburg e.V., making participation particularly appealing.

name: Marceliński Bieg Letni 2026
description: Marceliński Summer Run 2026 is a cross-country race organized in Poznań by running enthusiasts from the Biegi.Wlkp. group. The event takes place on scenic routes that highlight the location’s aesthetic appeal. Since 2014, the organizers have focused on promoting cross-country running in Greater Poland, offering participants a unique running experience amid beautiful natural surroundings.

name: XXI Bieg Lesoków
description: The 21st Lesoków Run is an annual race held in Szemud as part of the Kaszuby Biegają series. The event offers two routes, 5 and 10 km long, through the picturesque Kashubian countryside, encouraging participants to enjoy the outdoors. It attracts runners of different ages and experience levels, promoting a healthy lifestyle and local running culture.

name: XXXIII Bieg im. Marszałka Józefa Piłsudskiego
Jazerný maratón
location: Košice - sídlisko Nad Jazerom, Košice - sídlisko Nad Jazerom, splav Jazero 0-tý km /Jenisejská ul./Košice
description: The Jazerný Marathon is a running challenge held in Košice, in the Nad Jazerom neighbourhood, offering distances from 5 to 42 km. The race follows a 2.5 km stretch along the Hornád River embankment, with a high-quality asphalt surface and minimal elevation gain, making it suitable for runners of varying levels. The event has a 15-year tradition and is ideal for those looking for a fast and enjoyable run in nature close to the city. The organisers welcome all runners who want to test themselves over different distances.

name: Žvahov - Ivův běh
description: Žvahov - Ivův běh je terénní závod dlouhý 3,7 km, který se koná v lokalitě Děvín v Praze 5. Závod je součástí seriálu SABZO a nabízí běžcům možnost vychutnat si běh v přírodním prostředí s mírnými kopci a zajímavými výhledy. Tento závod je vhodný pro všechny, kteří mají rádi krátké, ale náročnější tratě v terénu. Přijďte si užít sportovní atmosféru a poměřit své síly s ostatními běžci v krásném prostředí Děvínských kopců.

name: BWM Sommerlochlauf
description: The Bottwartal Marathon is a popular running event in one of the most beautiful landscapes in southern Germany. The course takes you through gentle vineyard slopes and idyllic old towns, with an exciting atmosphere along the route. Whether you’re a beginner or an ambitious runner, everyone can find their own personal highlight here. The dedicated organizing team puts a lot of heart and precision into creating an unforgettable running experience.

name: ČEZ Lipno Sport Festival
description: ČEZ Lipno Sport Festival je tradiční sportovní událost v Lipně nad Vltavou, která nabízí širokou škálu závodů pro všechny věkové kategorie a sportovní nadšence. Festival zahrnuje běžecké závody jako Lipenský půlmaraton, 10 km COOP RUN a rodinný běh, stejně jako cyklistické závody včetně 60 km a 20 km tras pro gravel a MTB. Akce je doplněna o dětské závody a večerní běhy podél malebné cyklostezky Čertovy proudy. Účastníci si mohou užít krásnou přírodu Šumavy a bohatý doprovodný program s kulturními aktivitami.

name: Běh okolo Olympie
description: Běh okolo Olympie je běžecký závod v Brně, který se koná v lokalitě Chrlice. Závod nabízí okruh dlouhý 5,3 km, který absolvují muži i ženy v jedné kategorii, startující společně. Pro děti je připraven samostatný závod s délkou okruhu určenou před startem. Akce je vhodná pro všechny věkové kategorie a nabízí příjemnou atmosféru s občerstvením a možností úschovy věcí přímo na místě závodu.

name: Šárecká 5
description: Šárecká 5 je krosový závod na 5,3 km, který se koná v malebné přírodní oblasti Divoká Šárka v Praze 6. Tento členitý závod nabízí běžcům možnost vychutnat si běh v jedné z nejkrásnějších částí Prahy s náročnějším terénem. Pořádá ho SABZO Praha pod vedením Michala Procházky a je součástí běžeckých aktivit Českého atletického svazu. Závod je vhodný pro všechny, kdo mají rádi trailový běh a přírodní scenérie.

name: The Loop Run
distance_verbose: 225 km, 105 km, 45 km, 30 km, 15 km, 5 km
description: The Loop Run is a mountain race organized by the Rajd Beskidy Association, combining sport, adventure, and the exceptional scenery of the Beskids. The event takes place in the Bielsko-Biała area and offers a range of distances suited to runners of different ability levels. The organizers place a strong emphasis on participant safety and environmental protection. The event is authentic and athletic, driven by a passion for the mountains and endurance running.
course_highlights: The routes pass through the Little Beskids, Żywiec Beskids, and Silesian Beskids
The start, finish, and event village are located at the BBOSiR Sports and Entertainment Hall in Bielsko-Biała
The option to enter two races on the same day (combo packages)
additional: You can enter two races on the same day: Vertical Loop + Klimczok Loop 15 (Combo Package) and Vertical Loop + Loop 30 (Combo Plus Package). The event is scheduled for August 19–22, 2027. Packages combining Vertical Loop with Klimczok Loop 15 or Loop 30 are available.

name: Běh městem Strakonice
organizer: Město Strakonice, Okresní sdružení Česká unie sportu Strakonice
description: XXIII. Strakonický běh městem je tradiční běžecký závod, který se koná 21. srpna v Letním kině ve Strakonicích. Závodníci všech věkových kategorií si mohou změřit síly na tratích dlouhých 3,3 km a 6,6 km, které vedou městem. Start je společný pro obě trasy a probíhá v 18:00 hodin. Všichni účastníci mají možnost vyhrát v bohaté tombole, která se losuje ze startovních čísel. Přihlášky lze zasílat e-mailem nebo odevzdat v den závodu.

name: Abendstraßenlauf
location: Dorfzentrum, Herxheim, Südliche Weinstraße, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
description: The Evening Road Race in Herxheim is a long-running event held annually since 1987. In 2026, it will take place with a new concept and a new course in the village center, starting and finishing at the festival grounds behind the festival hall. Races are offered for the whole family, including Bambini, schoolchildren’s, beginner, and 10 km main races. The main race consists of two laps, and the beginner race has been extended to 5 km. The event combines a sporting challenge with a family-friendly supporting program.
course_highlights: New two-lap 10 km course in the village center
Beginner race extended to 5 km
Start and finish at the festival grounds behind the festival hall
additional: Start times: Bambini races from 18:00, schoolchildren’s races from 18:20, and the beginner and 10 km main races from 19:00. Bambini races are not timed; all finishers receive medals. Age-group rankings include certificates and gifts. The three fastest men and women overall in the 10 km race receive gift vouchers. Organizer: TV Herxheim 1892 e.V., Athletics Department. New course, family and children’s races, online registration, event in the village center

name: Bürener Volkslauf - Hochstift-Cup
description: The Bürener Volkslauf is a traditional running event in Büren. The races cover various distances, including Bambini, children’s, school and company races, on paved courses with little elevation change through the scenic Aftetal. All participants receive certificates, and the top runners are awarded trophies. The event is part of the Hochstift Cup and offers a friendly atmosphere for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: 5 km out-and-back course through the scenic Aftetal
Fully paved course with little elevation change
800 m school and children’s races on the 400 m track
additional: Certificates for all participants. Trophies for places 1–3 (men/women/diverse) in the overall standings. The City of Büren Challenge Cup for first place in the team standings. Special prize for the team with the most participants (company runners only). Certificates can be printed using the “race result” running software after the event. Race numbers and transponders will be issued. Changing and shower facilities are available. Parking options and travel information will be provided. The courses are challenging, with little elevation change. Registration closes on the day of the event; registration is via MY RACERESULT.

name: Jedermanns Lauf und 5. Volkslauf Rund um Zehnhausen
description: The Jedermanns Lauf and Volkslauf Rund um Zehnhausen is a running event in Zehnhausen bei Wallmerod. Distances of 3, 5, and 10 kilometers are offered for different ability levels. The event combines competitive racing with an open offering for recreational runners.

name: 11. Lichterlauf Tangermünde
description: The Tangermünde Lights Run is an atmospheric race right on the Elbe in the historic imperial town of Tangermünde. Runners of all ages and ability levels can take part in a range of distances, including a children’s run, a 5 km fun run, a 10 km main race, and a team relay. The course runs along the picturesque Elbe promenade and offers a special atmosphere, followed by an after-run party in Tangermünde. The race is a community sporting event that puts fun, exercise, and team spirit center stage.

name: 19. Barßeler Hafenfestlauf
description: The 19th Barßeler Hafenfestlauf takes place near Barßel Harbor. The event offers races for various age groups, including Bambini races, schoolchildren’s races, a 5-kilometer race, Nordic walking, and a 10-kilometer main race. The course runs along paved roads and is suitable for all age groups. The event is organized by the Sport- und Turnverein Barßel and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, a supporting program, and refreshments.

name: Buntekuhlauf
description: The Buntekuhlauf, organized by SC Buntekuh e.V. in Lübeck, is a versatile running event for all age groups and ability levels. The courses range from short runs on the sports grounds to longer distances that follow footpaths for multiple laps. The event emphasizes the enjoyment of physical activity and offers various competitions, including relay races and walking. Participation rules are clearly defined, and race materials are distributed on the day of the event and the evening before.
course_highlights: Courses on the sports grounds for the 750 m and 1.5 km races
5 km course on footpaths, with no road or cycle-path closure
10 km and 15 km courses completed by running multiple laps of the 5 km loop
additional: Race materials will be distributed on 20 August 2027 from 18:00 to 20:00 and on the day of the event from 15:00. Late entries are possible until 20:00 on 16 August 2027, and may also be available on the day of the event, but are not guaranteed. There are no personalized race numbers, but certificates will be issued with the usual details. Changes to entries can be made free of charge if requested early; later changes incur a fee.

name: Volkslauf Um die Taakener Ähren
description: The “Um die Taakener Ähren” fun run is a popular, family-friendly running event in Taaken. The event offers various races for all age groups, from a Bambini run and races for schoolchildren and joggers to the competitive 10 km main race and a relay. The course runs through the village of Taaken and its idyllic fields of grain, with fun and community at its heart. All participants receive pastries at the finish, and the winners are awarded traditional winner’s loaves. The village provides refreshments and drink stands, creating a pleasant atmosphere.

name: Mottenburger Meile
description: The Mottenburger Meile is a traditional cult race on the Elbe in Hamburg, held annually on the Friday after the Hamburg school holidays. The precisely measured out-and-back course is 7.5 km, equivalent to a Prussian land mile. The race starts and finishes on the banks of the Elbe below Halbmondweg/Elbchaussee and offers a romantic atmosphere with evening lighting. In addition to the sporting competition, the race supports the Hamburger Spendenparlament and remembers the Jewish victims of the Holocaust with a Stolperstein.

name: Grand Prix Biskupca #4
location: Island on Lake Kraksy, Biskupiec, Poland

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Udział płatny przelewem - 20,00 zł. Decyduje kolejność zgłoszeń w ramach limitu 200 uczestników na imprezę.

description: The Biskupiec Grand Prix is a series of four races held in Biskupiec and the surrounding area, including on an island in Lake Kraksy. The fourth edition is a Night Run of approximately 8 km, following paths and cycling routes and passing through the Municipal Park. The event uses electronic timing and includes an overall classification based on all four races. Participants must wear their race numbers at chest or waist height, and the participant limit is 200. The event has a sporting and recreational character, attracting runners from the region.
course_highlights: Approximately 8 km route on an island in Lake Kraksy
Night run along paths and cycling routes and through the Municipal Park
Electronic chip timing
additional: Registration and payment are available at the race office until 30 minutes before the start; the fee is 30 zł, payable in cash. Race numbers must be pinned to the front at chest or waist height. Timing is electronic, and chips must be returned at the finish. The midday race in the series is held as a four-person relay, but the Night Run is an individual event. The course surface includes asphalt, paving stones, sand, and grass; the route is marked every 500 m. The time limit is 60 minutes, and the participant limit is 200.

name: Cestou Grófa Júliusa Andrássyho
location: Trebišov, Trebišov, priestor pri Mestskom kultúrnom stredisku
description: The Run Along the Route of Count Július Andrássy takes place in Trebišov near the Municipal Cultural Centre and offers various categories, including running, a summer walk, cycling, Nordic walking, and a virtual race. The start is scheduled for 16:15 for children and 16:25 for the main category. The event is suitable for all age groups, including children up to 7 years old and older children up to 13 years old. The organizer, Ing. Michal Majcher, ensures a pleasant atmosphere and well-organized races.

name: Morava Run - proti proudu
description: Morava Run - proti proudu je štafetový běžecký závod vedený napříč Moravou podél toku řeky Moravy, který se koná v týmech o 7 až 12 členech. Trasa dlouhá přibližně 280 km je rozdělena do 30 úseků o délce kolem 9 km, které si týmy rozdělují podle svých sil a strategie. Závod začíná na jihu Moravy v CHKO Soutok a vede proti proudu řeky přes Slovácko, Hanou, CHKO Litovelské Pomoraví až k prameni Moravy na Králickém Sněžníku. Akce je zaměřena na amatérské běžce a klade důraz na týmovou spolupráci a teambuilding, přičemž tempo není limitováno.

name: Brdský půlmaraton
description: Brdský půlmaraton je tradiční trailový běžecký závod konaný v malebném prostředí Kytína ve Středočeském kraji. Závod nabízí dvě trasy - náročnější 21 km s převýšením 430 m a kratší 9 km s převýšením 158 m, obě s občerstvovacími stanicemi. Na delší trati se vyhlašují absolutní vítězové a kategorie podle věku a pohlaví, zatímco kratší trať oceňuje absolutně nejrychlejší muže a ženy. Závod je součástí série Trail Running Cup a je vhodný pro milovníky přírodního běhu s krásnými výhledy a pestrým terénem.

name: Hrabovský 1/2 a 1/4 maraton
description: Hrabovský 1/2 a 1/4 maraton je tradiční běžecký závod konaný v Ostravě-Hrabové, který nabízí půlmaratonskou a čtvrtmaratonskou trať. Závod je součástí Hrabovského poháru a Moravskoslezského běžeckého poháru, přičemž účastníci obdrží medaile a mají k dispozici občerstvení, šatny a doprovodný program. Start i prezentace probíhají na hřišti TJ Sokol Hrabová. Trať vede městským prostředím s příjemnou atmosférou a je vhodná pro široké spektrum běžců.

name: Jesenický maraton
description: Jesenický maraton je legendární a náročný horský maraton v České republice, který se koná v Jeseníkách od roku 2009. Závod nabízí stále stejnou trať pro maraton i půlmaraton, která však díky proměnlivému počasí a horskému terénu působí každý rok jinak. Běžci běží hřebenem lesnatých hor, kolem pramenů, pralesů, kamenných moří a rašelinišť, což vytváří jedinečnou atmosféru a výzvu. Jesenický maraton je určen pro zkušené vytrvalce, kteří chtějí zdolat nejvyšší pohoří Moravy a Slezska.

name: Běh na Svatý Hostýn
location: Bystřice pod Hostýnem, Zlín Region, Česko
description: Běh na Svatý Hostýn je horský běh, který se koná v Bystřici pod Hostýnem v Zlínském kraji. Tato akce je součástí Českého poháru v běhu do vrchu a nabízí náročný závod na 5 km s převýšením 422 metrů, přičemž většina trasy vede po asfaltu. Běh je určen jak pro zkušené běžce, tak i pro širokou veřejnost, a přitahuje běžecké nadšence z celé republiky. Akce je známá svou přátelskou atmosférou a krásným prostředím okolí Svatého Hostýna.

name: Běh k Božímu hrobu
description: Běh k Božímu hrobu je tradiční běžecká akce konající se na Svatém Hostýně v Zlínském kraji, která je součástí širších aktivit poutí a sportovních událostí na místě. Tato událost nabízí běh do vrchu s cílem u Božího hrobu, přičemž se jedná o významnou součást regionálního sportovního kalendáře. Připravte se na atmosféru poutního místa a užijte si sportovní zážitek v krásném prostředí Svatého Hostýna.

name: Běh na Čupek
description: Běh na Čupek je nově zavedený běžecký závod v Metylovicích, který již přilákal dvě stovky běžců. Trať je pěkná a náročná, což zajišťuje zajímavý zážitek pro účastníky. Závod je součástí kalendáře Tělovýchovné jednoty Slezan Frýdek-Místek a jeho budoucnost v termínovce je sledována s očekáváním.

name: Vavřinecký běh Moravským krasem
description: Vavřinecký běh Moravským krasem je sportovní akce konaná v obci Vavřinec v Jihomoravském kraji, která je součástí Okresní běžecké ligy. Akce se koná a nabízí různé běžecké kategorie vhodné pro širokou veřejnost. Tato událost je ideální příležitostí pro milovníky běhu, kteří chtějí poznat krásy Moravského krasu a užít si sportovní zážitek v přírodě.

name: Exter FlexRun! 2026
location: Sparkassen Sportpark Exter, Vlotho, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Exter FlexRun at Sparkassen Sportpark Exter offers a flexible running format for all ability levels. Participants can choose their distance and run up to four laps of 10.5 km each, covering up to the full marathon distance. Relay races, walking and Nordic walking routes, and a children’s race are also available. The event takes place in scenic surroundings and offers a great atmosphere, with refreshments and entertainment on site.
course_highlights: Loop courses along paved paths and mostly asphalt roads in and around Vlotho Exter
Refreshment stations at 4.0 km, 8.5 km, and in Sportpark Exter
Showers, changing rooms, and a wide range of refreshments at Sportpark Exter
additional: The start and finish of all races are at Sportpark Exter. Participants can choose their distance and run up to 4 laps (10.5 km each). The 4 x 10.5 km relay is for teams. Walking/Nordic walking distances are 10.5 km and 21 km. The 1.6 km children’s race is for ages 6 and up. Team and company categories are judged, with awards. Routes are marked and secured by marshals. Registration is via Race Result; the event offers showers, changing rooms, and refreshments and is suitable for families.

name: Heideköniginnenpokal
description: The Heideköniginnenpokal (HeiPo) in Amelinghausen is a traditional fun run, taking place for the 31st time in 2026 as part of the Heideblütenfest week. The challenging routes pass through scenic landscapes, including along Lopausee. The race attracts many participants and is a mainstay of regional running events.
course_highlights: Scenic stretches
Route along Lopausee
Part of the Heideblütenfest week in Amelinghausen
additional: The Amelinghausen running group meets regularly on Mondays and Wednesdays to run together. There is also a beginners’ course that gradually introduces participants to running. The event is part of a lively running-group community that takes part in many fun runs and marathons across Germany. The race takes place in August, with typical summer weather around 25°C and possible rain. There are also children’s races and other fun runs as part of the festival week.

name: Jahn-Gedenklauf
description: The Jahn Memorial Run in Lanz is a traditional running event organized by SV Jahn Lanz e.V. The event takes place at the Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahn Stadium and offers various distances, which also count toward the Prignitz Cup. The start time is 10 a.m., and the run is open to runners of all ages and ability levels. The event is supported by Kreissportbund Prignitz e.V. and is a fixture in the regional sports calendar.
course_highlights: Short course: 6.6 km
Long course: 12.5 km
Outside the Prignitz Cup: 3 km
additional: Courses are not suitable for spikes; on-site registration is possible; start at the stadium

name: Michelsmarktlauf
description: The Michelsmarkt Run is a traditional running event in Reichelsheim, held annually in August. The 30th edition of the Michelsmarkt Run takes place on , featuring a 10 km main race, a 1.4 km schoolchildren’s race and a 400 m Bambini race. The event is organized by the athletics department of KSV Reichelsheim and offers runners of all ages a sporting challenge in a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 10 km main race
1.4 km schoolchildren’s race
400 m Bambini race
additional: The event offers a variety of distances and is very popular with families, school groups and running enthusiasts from the region. Online registration is available.

name: Münsterland-Sternlauf - Benefizlauf
location: Universitätsklinikum Münster, Münster, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Münsterland Star Run is a charity run in aid of Kinderkrebshilfe Münster e.V. at Münster University Hospital. Five routes lead in a star shape from various towns in the Münsterland region to the shared finish at Leonardo Campus in Münster. The run is designed as a stage event, allowing participants to set their own pace and run one or more stages. 100% of the proceeds are donated to Verein zur Förderung krebskranker Kinder Münster e.V. to support the treatment and care of the children affected.
course_highlights: Five routes lead in a star shape from various towns in the Münsterland region to Münster
Mostly farm tracks, footpaths and cycle paths, as well as traffic-calmed streets
Accompanied by stage leaders and a German Red Cross broom wagon; refreshments at stage points
additional: This is not a race, and participants set their own pace. They can run one or more stages, and can start and finish at any stage point. Participants are responsible for their own return transport. For the first time, donations can be made cashlessly. Donation receipts are issued for donations of €200 or more.
