The run is accompanied by stage leaders and a German Red Cross broom wagon. Refreshments are offered at stage points in cooperation with Kolping families. The run takes place in Münster and promotes social cohesion through sporting commitment.

name: 4. Rammelsberger Steigerlauf
description: The Rammelsberger Steigerlauf is a challenging mountain race in the northern Harz, held at the Rammelsberg UNESCO World Heritage Site in Goslar. The event offers a range of courses with gradients of up to 30%, winding through historic mining landscapes and varied forest and mountain sections. Participants can look forward to professional timing and a unique running experience with an alpine character. Courses range from a short race for children to a marathon and trail race with up to 1,110 meters of elevation gain. The event is aimed at runners, walkers, and trail runners looking to challenge their fitness and sure-footedness.

name: Osnabrücker 6-Stunden-Lauf
distance_verbose: 105 km, 82 km, 41 km, 27 km, Halbmarathon, 10 km, 7 km, 5 km
description: The Osnabrück 6-Hour Run takes place at Rubbenbruchsee in Osnabrück and celebrates its 10th edition. The run is a charity event supporting HelpAge’s “Every Grandma Counts” campaign and welcomes all runners who want to cover as many kilometres as possible within six hours. Whether you’re an ambitious runner, preparing for a marathon, or simply looking to run, walk or hike together in the beautiful scenery around the lake, everyone is welcome. The event offers individual and relay entries and places great importance on community and supporting a good cause.

name: Sieber Berg- und Panoramalauf
description: The Sieber Mountain and Panorama Run returns after a 14-year break, offering three challenging routes in the Harz with up to 900 metres of elevation gain. The event is handmade and welcoming, and challenges runners of all ability levels. From the family-friendly 4.5 km Nature Experience Route and the 12.5 km Panorama Loop to the 27.5 km queen distance with 900 metres of elevation gain, there is something for everyone. The runs pass through impressive natural scenery with panoramic views and offer a true Harz experience. Alongside the sporting challenge, there is a pasta buffet and a community village festival to round off the day.

name: THE HUMBLE CLUB Backyard Run IV
description: The Humble Club Backyard Run IV on Oker Island in Braunschweig is a unique running experience that combines an athletic challenge with social commitment. The run supports the “Boxing Against Parkinson’s” project and stands for exercise, community, and social responsibility. The event starts at 10:00, with admission from 8:30, and offers participants basic refreshments including still water and fresh fruit, as well as an exclusive finisher’s medal. Participants are asked to bring their own food and drinks so they can refuel properly.

name: Arnstädter Bach-Ultra
description: The Arnstadt Bach Ultra is a 60-kilometer ultramarathon held in Arnstadt. It was created in response to runners’ wish to complete the 60 km relay course as a standalone ultramarathon. The event is organized by SG Motor Arnstadt in cooperation with the Arnstadt municipal administration and features a challenging course through the region. The race is an interesting initiative that will hopefully attract strong support and become part of Arnstadt’s diverse running tradition.

name: Barumer Stick and Stone Run
description: The Barumer Stick and Stone Run is a challenging obstacle race held at the Barum Forest Stadium and in the surrounding wooded, hilly landscape of the Lüneburg Heath. The course follows sandy, muddy and partly overgrown trails, with water obstacles such as ditches and a village pond. The event offers runners a varied challenge in a natural setting and is suitable for both individual entrants and groups. Participants receive a medal and refreshments in the finish area.

name: Ring of Feier - 2.Hermeskeiler City Lauf
organizer: Kulturbeirat der Stadt Hermeskeil, Hermeskeiler Turnverein
description: The Ring of Feier - 2nd Hermeskeiler City Run takes place in Hermeskeil. It is a short running event with distances of 150 m and 5 km. The race offers a pleasant running atmosphere in typical August weather, with temperatures around 25°C and mostly sunny days. Participants should check the organizer’s details before registering.

name: Staffellauf Rund um Arnstadt
description: The Arnstadt Relay Race is a long-standing running event held in the town of Arnstadt. The race promotes team spirit and sporting community in the region. The course runs through the picturesque surroundings of Arnstadt and offers runners of all ages an appealing challenge. The event is a popular sporting occasion with a friendly atmosphere and enthusiastic participants.
course_highlights: Relay race through the town of Arnstadt
Picturesque course with varied terrain
Promotes team spirit and community
additional: The event is organized by the Arnstadt municipal administration. No publicly available information on start times, pricing tiers, or registration options is available on the website. Contact is via the central email address info@stadtverwaltung.arnstadt.de. The event takes place annually and is part of the town’s sports calendar.

name: Detmolder Residenzlauf
description: The Detmold Residenz Run is a traditional running event held in Detmold. It offers various races for children, young people and adults, including a Bambini run, school races, a 5 km fitness run and the 10 km main race. The start and finish are on the market square in Detmold, providing a central and atmospheric setting. The event is supported by Stadtwerke Detmold and AÜG NETZWERK as title sponsors and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and range of award categories.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the market square in Detmold
Various distances from 1.5 km to 10 km
Timing with the Raceresult timing system
additional: Race number collection on the day of the event from 15:30 at the Rathaus am Markt in Detmold. Timing is provided by the Raceresult timing system; personal chips are not permitted. Free admission to the Aqualip leisure pool upon presentation of the race number. Medals for all participating children and young people. Award ceremonies on the market square: school races from approximately 18:30, 10 km race from 20:00. Friedrich-Brakemeier Wanderpokal for the school with the highest participation rate. Vouchers for schools, teams and groups with the most advance registrations. The race attracts numerous participants from the region and, alongside the main distances, offers children’s races and special competitions. Results and certificates are available online.

name: IV Festiwal Pustelnika
organizer: Stowarzyszenie na rzecz rozwoju Wysowej-Zdroju „Przekrocz Granice”
description: The 4th Pustelnik Festival is an annual sports and recreation event organized in the picturesque town of Wysowa-Zdrój by the Przekrocz Granice Association. The festival brings together sport, culture, and nature, offering participants the chance to take part in runs, marathons, and MTB and E-BIKE races. It’s a unique opportunity to discover the charms of the Low Beskids, spend time actively, and connect with the local community.

name: XI Bieg Obrońców Płocka 1920r
description: The International Run of the Defenders of Płock 1920 is an annual running event organized by the Płock Biega No Age Limit Club. The race commemorates the defenders of the city of Płock in 1920 and traditionally takes place in the second half of August. The event attracts runners from various places, offering sporting competition in an atmosphere of historical remembrance.

name: Night Run Liptovský Mikuláš
description: Night Run Liptovský Mikuláš is an evening running event that invites participants to experience the city on a night run. The event takes place in Liptovský Mikuláš, with the start and event hub located at Námestie osloboditeľov. The 2027 edition is scheduled for August 21.

name: Rusínska 100 a 66
description: Rusínska 100 and 66 is a late-summer ultrarun and long-distance walk starting and finishing in the town of Stropkov. The routes lead through the Ondava Highlands in Zemplín County and continue into Šariš County via the town of Svidník, crossing a region of Rusyn villages and following the border with Poland. The R100 route partly passes through the Eastern Carpathians Protected Landscape Area. The event is part of the Slovak Ultratrail League, is certified by ITRA, and is included in the ITRA National League. It is organized by o.z. Klub bežcov Stropkov, which provides a warm welcome and high-quality organization.

name: Hradný gaštanový beh Modrý Kameň
location: Modrý Kameň, Modrý Kameň, park pred vstupom do Hradu Modrý Kameň
organizer: Mesto Modrý Kameň v spolupráci s občianskym združením Bežci VK
description: The Modrý Kameň Castle Chestnut Run is a running event held in the park in front of the entrance to Modrý Kameň Castle. The race offers various categories, including a 5 km hobby race for children and juniors, a 10 km main race for adults, and 5 km Nordic walking. The course runs along paved roads, meadows, and forest and field paths, offering a varied and enjoyable running experience. The event is organized by the Town of Modrý Kameň in cooperation with the Bežci VK civic association. The children’s race starts at 10:00 and the adults’ race at 11:00.

name: Čachtický polmaratón
location: Čachtice okr. Nové Mesto n. Váhom, Čachtice okr. Nové Mesto n. Váhom, námestie
description: The Čachtice Half Marathon is a traditional half-marathon race held in the village of Čachtice. The course runs mostly on paved roads through the streets of Čachtice and into Višňové and Hrachovište, with a short section on a forest road. The route is gently undulating, with a maximum elevation gain of up to 90 metres. The start is in the square in Čachtice, and the finish is at the grounds of the Čachtice Elementary School. Refreshment stations are provided at several points along the course.

name: Forbaský beh pomoci
location: Forbasy, okres Stará Ľubovňa, Forbasy, okres Stará Ľubovňa, areál Ščava
description: The Forbasy Charity Run is a charity race held at the Ščava grounds in Forbasy, in the Stará Ľubovňa district. The event has a voluntary entry fee and supports aid and solidarity. Runners can enjoy a pleasant atmosphere while contributing to a good cause. The organizer is Valer Kuffa, who is available to provide information and support to participants.

name: Lukačovská 5
location: Lukačovce, okr. Humenné, Lukačovce, okr. Humenné, Futbalové ihrisko
description: Lukačovská 5 is a running race held on the football pitch in Lukačovce, Humenné District. The event offers a 5 km main race and children’s races, with categories for men, women, and a non-competitive Nordic Walking category. The organizer is the Municipality of Lukačovce, which provides a welcoming atmosphere and high-quality race organization. The children’s races start at 10:00 and the main race begins at 11:00.

name: Harhovská desiatka
location: Spišský Hrhov, Spišský Hrhov, pred Obecným úradom
description: Harhovská desiatka is a running event in Spišský Hrhov, offering a 10 km course and a shorter 3.5 km course for recreational and beginner runners. The races are divided into several age categories for men and women, including a special category for residents of Spišský Hrhov. The event is organized by the municipality of Spišský Hrhov, and the start is in front of the Municipal Office. The entry fee is paid at registration and is €10 for the 10 km course and €5 for the 3.5 km course.

name: Brezovský letný beh
location: Rimavské Brezovo, Rimavské Brezovo, Športové ihrisko
description: The Brezov Health Run is a traditional running race in the village of Brezov, Bardejov District. Its route runs along asphalt, field, and forest roads. The race is open to men and women, including participants aged 15 and under and those over 15. The organizers offer two entry categories, with a large or small package, making it possible to take part in this sporting event in pleasant surroundings near the Municipal Office in Brezov. The race is suitable for runners of various ages and ability levels.

name: Behaj lesmi Čičmany
description: Behaj lesmi Čičmany is a running race set in the picturesque Slovak folk village of Čičmany. The course winds through the Strážov Mountains, surrounded by beautiful scenery, unspoiled forests, and expansive meadows. The race is part of the Behaj lesmi series and is included in the UTMB Index Races, giving it international recognition and ranking. Choose from several distances: a long 20 km run with 718 m of elevation gain, the intermediate 11 km Lesnícka course with 380 m of elevation gain, or a short 5 km course. The event also features a special Conti Speed Section, where the top runners can win valuable prizes.

name: Slopenská desítka
description: Slopenská desítka je tradiční krosový běžecký závod konaný v malebné obci Slopné u Luhačovic. Závod nabízí náročnou trať s různorodým profilem, včetně asfaltových cest, prudkých stoupání a seběhů v lesním terénu. Start je situován pod kostelem a cíl na hřišti, kde závodníky čeká bouřlivé povzbuzování diváků. Akce je vhodná pro širokou veřejnost včetně juniorských kategorií a rodinných štafet. Závod je součástí celoročních soutěží Běhy Zlín a Českého poháru v běhu do vrchu KRAKONOŠ.

name: Běžím Krušnohořím Stříbrná
organizer: Živé Sokolovsko z.s. a Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s.
description: Běžím Krušnohořím je běžecký a canicrossový seriál, který vás provede krásami Krušných hor. Seriál zahrnuje 6 závodů v různých destinacích, včetně Stříbrné, kde se koná hlavní závod na 6 až 9 km a zážitková trasa 20 až 30 km. Kromě hlavních závodů jsou připraveny i dětské závody a trasy pro chůzi s hledáním bodů dle mapy. Akce je vhodná pro běžce všech úrovní, canicrossaře, děti i chodce, a nabízí krásné přírodní prostředí Krušných hor.

name: Běh pro Střížák
description: Běh pro Střížák je tradiční závod konaný na Střížovickém vrchu v Ústí nad Labem, letos již v 16. ročníku. Trať je tvořena okruhem, který se běží třikrát, s jedním výrazným stoupáním a klesáním, jinak je mírně zvlněná. Součástí závodu jsou i kratší dětské a žákovské běhy, které umožňují zapojení široké veřejnosti. Závod má zajímavý příběh, protože trať vede územím, které bylo dříve ohroženo plánovanou výstavbou, jež byla díky odporu obyvatel zrušena.

name: Sengbachtalsperrenlauf
location: Sengbachtalsperre, Leichlingen-Witzhelden, Rheinisch-Bergischer Kreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Sengbach Reservoir Run is a traditional scenic race around the Sengbach Reservoir near Leichlingen-Witzhelden. The three main distances follow well-maintained forest trails and a paved section along the dam, on a loop of approximately 9.8 km with around 200 metres of elevation gain per lap. The course is traffic-free and runs through a protected landscape area. Families can take part in a separate race with shorter distances in the area near the event venue. The event provides refreshments along the course and showers in the nearby village of Kuhle.
course_highlights: Loop of approximately 9.8 km with 200 metres of elevation gain per lap
Well-maintained forest trails and a paved section along the dam
Traffic-free course in a protected landscape area
additional: Race numbers and other race materials can be collected in the registration tent on the day of the event from 7:30 a.m. Showers are available at a school in the neighbouring village of Kuhle and are signposted. Refreshments including bananas, water, isotonic drinks and cola are available approximately every 5 km; free tea and bananas are available at the finish. Certificates are available online. The course is traffic-free and has two refreshment stations on the loop. A fundraising campaign is being held for the Leverkusen children's hospice.

name: Gladbecker Sparkassenlauf
description: The Gladbeck Sparkassenlauf is a traditional running event welcoming runners of all ages. It offers various distances, from the Bambini Marathon to the half marathon, as well as a team relay. All courses are DLV-certified and eligible for official rankings. Participants receive finisher medals and personalized race bibs bearing their names, making the running experience special. There is also a district championship classification and extensive award ceremonies.
course_highlights: DLV-certified courses: 1.5 km, 5 km, 10 km and half marathon
Personalized race bibs bearing participants’ first names
Live timing and net times for all races
additional: Finisher medals for all participants; personalized race bibs bearing first names; live timing with net times; changing rooms and showers at the stadium; valuables can be left at storage facilities; trophies and certificates for winners and age-group winners; team and club classifications; district championships with certificates and badges; no classification for the Bambini or walking events. Courses at Gladbeck Stadium; online registration; late registration available until 1 hour before the start; medical assistance provided by the German Red Cross; various course distances and categories.

name: FlorSTADT Halbmarathon 2026
description: The FlorSTADT Half Marathon is a popular race in Florstadt, Hesse, taking place for the 11th time. In addition to the half marathon, the event offers races over 10 km, 5 km, 1.8 km and 300 m, so the whole family can take part. The course runs through beautiful woodland and is secured, with plenty of water stations and medical support. The race is part of the Main-Kinzig Challenge and is ideal preparation for the Frankfurt Marathon. Food and drinks are available, and participants can download a personalized certificate.
course_highlights: Hesse’s most beautiful woodland half marathon
Plenty of water stations along the course
Secured course with medical support
additional: Commentary by Runningvoices, free photo downloads, organic fruit at the finish, warm-up with Smarttraining Ortenberg, playground right at the start/finish area, an event for the whole family, personalized certificate for download, refreshments provided by the Gadde-Crew. The event is part of the Main-Kinzig Challenge and offers electronic timing, medical support and a photo service. August weather is typically warm, around 25°C.

name: ews Volks- und Spendenlauf
description: The 14th ews Volks- und Spendenlauf runs through Bad Segeberg, passing scenic places such as Kalkberg and Lake Großer Segeberger See. Since 2011, the race has been a fixture in the city’s sporting calendar, combining athletic achievement with the joy of exercising together and charitable commitment. The event supports selected projects each year, with donations in 2026 divided among three projects. The race is a community initiative that brings together exercise and social engagement.
course_highlights: Through Bad Segeberg
Past Kalkberg
Along Lake Großer Segeberger See
additional: Team entries are only possible by submitting a paper form, which must be emailed to info@volkslauf-bad-segeberg.de by 02 October 2023. Registration is online and requires consent to the liability waiver and data protection terms. The focus is on enjoying exercise and charitable commitment.

name: TuS Hiltrup Halbmarathon
location: Stadion am Osttor, Münster, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The TuS Hiltrup Half Marathon is an established running event in Münster, starting and finishing at the Osttor Stadium. The course includes a lap of the stadium, runs along the canal promenade and through the Hiltrup residential area, offering a varied and attractive running environment. In addition to the classic half marathon, there is also a relay race, which is especially appealing to teams. The event is open to runners born in 2008 or earlier (individual race) and 2010 or earlier (relay), and offers a family-friendly atmosphere at a large sports club.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Osttor Stadium
Run along the canal promenade with views of the canal
Course through the Hiltrup residential area, with varied terrain
additional: Individual entries for the half marathon are sold out; only relay places are still available. The course closes at 12:00, after 3 hours of racing. The course is accessible, and detailed information is available for local residents about the route and traffic regulations on race day. Measured course, start at Osttor Stadium, individual and relay races, online registration, start times at 9:00 and 9:05, course closes after 3 hours.

name: H Lauf 2026
description: The 10-hour run in Hanau is a charity event held on the grounds of Paul-Gerhardt-Schule. The event starts at 9:00 a.m. and runs until 7:00 p.m., with participants running for a good cause. The run offers a special opportunity to experience endurance and community while supporting social projects.
course_highlights: Run on the grounds of Paul-Gerhardt-Schule Hanau
10-hour run from 9:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m.
Event for a good cause
additional: The run takes place on the grounds of Paul-Gerhardt-Schule Hanau. A program and flyers are available to download as PDFs. The event is a social initiative that raises donations. The run takes place on the school grounds and lasts 10 hours, making it ideal for anyone who wants to challenge their endurance.

name: Rotherbaum 10K Hamburg - K Rotherbaum
description: The 10K Rotherbaum is an officially measured 10-kilometer race in Hamburg, held in accordance with international competition regulations. The course is a loop registered with the German Athletics Association and AIMS, making finish times eligible for rankings. The event is open to runners of all age groups and offers a cup competition across all 10K Hamburg races, with attractive prizes. Registration is online only, and participants are asked to travel by public transport.

name: Der Alstertallauf
description: The Alstertallauf is a family-friendly race along the upper Alster hiking trail, considered Hamburg’s most beautiful running route. It welcomes running enthusiasts of all ages and recreational athletes, and offers several distances. The event takes place near the Albert-Schweitzer-Gymnasium in Hamburg and is known for its friendly atmosphere. In 2022, more than 200 runners took part, with distances ranging from 410 m to 10 km.

name: Eschweiler Citylauf 2026
location: Marienstraße and Grabenstraße, Eschweiler, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Eschweiler City Run is being held for the third time and is organized by Marathon-Club Eschweiler, which is staging a road race in Eschweiler for the 40th time. The start and finish are in Eschweiler city centre, on Marienstraße and Grabenstraße. The event offers races for schoolchildren and two distances for adults: 5 kilometres and 10 kilometres. The 10-kilometre race also counts as the LVN-Nordrhein Championships. The City Run is part of the newly established Regio Aachen Running Cup and offers runners an attractive route through the city centre.

name: Gettorfer Staffelmarathon
description: The Gettorf Relay Marathon is a team marathon held at the Gettorf Sports Park. The course is an approximately 4.2 km loop, run ten times. Teams consist of 5 to 10 people, who pass the chipped relay baton in the exchange zone. Alternatively, two people can compete in the Duo Marathon, freely dividing the ten laps between them. Timing is electronic, using transponders and shoe chips, and split times are recorded for each runner.

name: Bielebohlauf
description: The Bielebohlauf Oppach is a running event in the Lusatian Highlands, offering a range of distances from 400 m to 20 km. The routes follow forest, meadow, and field paths as well as small roads around the Bieleboh. The longer distances are challenging and include steep climbs. Special Bambini and children’s races are available. Refreshments and entertainment are provided at Oppach Stadium, and finishers receive certificates and online clips.

name: 1. Laufchallenge Mellendorfer TV
description: The 2026 Sparkassen Running Pass for the Hanover Region features 43 running events, making it the largest series of its kind in Germany. Participants can collect stamps at various events across the Hanover Region and discover the region as they run. Each successful participation earns a stamp, and frequent runners can qualify for attractive gold, silver or bronze rewards. Participants register directly for the individual runs, which take place at many beautiful locations and offer a variety of activities. There is also a Running Pass app with an event calendar and digital running log.

name: Die Generalprobe
description: Die Generalprobe is an urban road race in Berlin that serves as the ultimate test for marathon training. Four weeks before the BMW BERLIN-MARATHON, runners can assess their fitness on a super-flat loop through the Berlin districts of Steglitz, Wilmersdorf and Zehlendorf. Distances offered are a quarter marathon (10.5 km) and a half marathon (21 km), both taking runners through typical Berlin neighbourhoods and offering a special city-running experience. Children can also take part in Bambini runs of 500 to 1,000 metres. All participants receive a lovely medal at the finish, optionally with a personalised engraving.
course_highlights: Super-flat loop through the Berlin districts of Steglitz, Wilmersdorf and Zehlendorf
The course passes through typical Berlin residential neighbourhoods with an urban feel
Two distances: quarter marathon (10.5 km) and half marathon (2 laps, 21 km)
additional: Timing is provided by a MIKA TAG disposable transponder on the back of the race bib; no return is required. The start and finish are on Schlossstraße in Berlin-Steglitz. Eligible participants must be born in 2011 or earlier (U18).

name: 7. PKO Tarnogórski Półmaraton oraz Tarnogórska Srebrna Dyszka
description: The 7th PKO Tarnogórski Half Marathon and Tarnogórska Srebrna Dyszka are the region’s biggest running celebration, held in Tarnowskie Góry. The 21.0975 km half-marathon course is certified by the Polish Athletics Association and runs entirely on paved streets in Tarnowskie Góry, with traffic partially restricted. The event also offers a race of approximately 10.5 km—the Srebrna Dyszka. Both courses have refreshment and hydration stations, and participants can expect professional organization and a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: A fully paved course through the streets of Tarnowskie Góry
Half-marathon certified by the Polish Athletics Association (21.0975 km)
Refreshment and hydration stations on both courses
additional: The half-marathon and Srebrna Dyszka courses run with traffic closed or partially restricted. Shortening the course results in disqualification. The organizer provides refreshment and hydration stations along the course. The event is part of the PKO Silesian Half Marathon Crown.

name: IV BIEG PEŁNEJ MISKI
description: The Full Bowl Run is an annual running event held in Szubin since 2023. It is a charity run and continues an initiative supporting animal shelters. The event attracts runners who want to combine sport with helping animals in need. It is organized by the "Pod Egidą" Association and the local community.

name: Biegi wokół Bursztynowej Góry
description: The Runs Around Bursztynowa Góra are an annual running event held in picturesque Bąkowo as part of the Kaszuby Biegają series. The races attract runners from various age categories, offering appealing routes and the unique atmosphere of Kashubia. It’s a great opportunity to spend time outdoors amid beautiful nature and local culture. The organizers ensure professional event management and a welcoming atmosphere for participants.

name: XVI Festiwal Biegowy Dziki Weekend
description: The 16th Dziki Weekend Running Festival is an annual running event held in Police that has gained considerable popularity in the West Pomeranian Voivodeship since 2010. The festival offers a range of trail and cross-country races, including races for children and young people, as well as extreme obstacle races. The courses run through the natural landscapes of the Wkrzańska Forest, promoting an active lifestyle and sporting competition in a unique atmosphere. The organizers welcome both recreational and experienced runners to take part in this dynamic and challenging event.
course_highlights: Cross-country routes through the Wkrzańska Forest with natural obstacles
Children’s and youth races with different distances and obstacles
Extreme trail races with military-style obstacles at the training ground
additional: The start and finish of all races are at the sports clearing at ul. Piaskowa 99 in Police. Children’s races start on 22.08 from 10:35, with waves starting every 5–10 minutes. Extreme obstacle races take place on 23.08, with waves starting every 3–5 minutes. The race office is in the sports hall at SP8, ul. Piaskowa 99. The courses feature natural obstacles such as tires, mud, walls, water obstacles, and ropes.

name: Minimaratón
location: Banská Bystrica, Banská Bystrica, Atletický štadión na Štiavničkách
organizer: Marathon Banska Bystrica, s.r.o., ON-POINT OZ, Minimaratón OZ
description: The Mini Marathon is a unique running event exclusively for families with children, held at the Štiavničky athletics stadium in Banská Bystrica. The event offers different age categories, from the youngest runners to older children, including mothers with strollers. The course is adapted to each age group, with 400 m and 200 m circuits. Alongside the sporting experience, there is an accompanying program with activities for children and meetups with athletes. Every participant receives a commemorative race bib, a medal, and refreshments after finishing.

name: Beh na boso Tatry
location: Veľká Lomnica, Veľká Lomnica, Golfový rezort Black Stork
description: Beh na boso Tatry is a running event in the beautiful surroundings of the Black Stork Golf Resort in Veľká Lomnica. Participants can choose between non-competitive runs for children and adults and a competitive 5 km run. The course runs across mown grass, paths and pebbles, giving it a cross-country character. The event is suitable for all age groups and offers a pleasant atmosphere in the nature of the Tatras. The organizer, OZ Beh na boso Tatry, ensures the event runs smoothly.

name: Běh Smetánkou
description: Běh Smetánkou je terénní závod dlouhý 3,5 km, který se koná v Praze 9 a je součástí seriálu SABZO. Tento závod nabízí běžcům možnost vychutnat si běh v přírodním prostředí s různorodým terénem. Je vhodný pro všechny, kteří hledají krátký, ale dynamický závod v příjemné atmosféře. Závod je tradiční součástí běžecké sezóny v Praze a přitahuje běžce z širokého okolí.

name: B2Run Hamburg
description: B2Run Hamburg is a company run of around 5.6 km, ending with a spectacular finish in the Volksparkstadion. The course is varied and largely flat, making it ideal for beginners, walkers and experienced runners. The event promotes team spirit, motivation and a sense of community, and is perfect for companies and individual participants from Hamburg and the surrounding area. In addition to the sporting experience, the run offers a professional supporting programme with commentary and music.

name: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (9) – srpnový
description: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY je pravidelný běžecký seriál v Praze Braníku, který nabízí příjemnou a rychlou trať podél Vltavy. Závody jsou vhodné pro běžce všech úrovní od začátečníků po profíky a často zde padají osobní rekordy. Trať je certifikovaná a na 10 km je možné si zaběhnout limit pro MČR. Po závodě je možnost společného posezení a doplnění energie v místní restauraci. Seriál je součástí 16. ročníku a odměňuje nejen nejlepší běžce, ale i věrné účastníky.

name: Běh Modřanskou roklí - Memoriál Zdeňka Buriana
description: Běh Modřanskou roklí - Memoriál Zdeňka Buriana je závod dlouhý 4 km vedený po mírně zvlněné trati v přírodní rezervaci Modřanská rokle v Praze 4. Závod je součástí seriálu SABZO a nabízí intervalový start, což umožňuje plynulý průběh závodu. Trať je vhodná pro běžce, kteří si chtějí užít běh v přírodě s mírnými převýšeními. Závod je ideální pro všechny, kdo hledají krátký, ale technicky zajímavý běh v krásném prostředí.

name: Bürostadtlauf 2026
organizer: Cargo Human Care und Lufthansa Sportverein ev, Sparte Cargo Bulls
description: The 5 km and 10 km races follow a flat, fast and mostly shaded route along the golf course and Goldstein Cemetery. Alongside the sporting competition, supporting a good cause is at the heart of the event: proceeds go towards expanding the Vocational Training Centre in Nairobi, which offers young people new opportunities. The event combines sport, team spirit and social commitment in a friendly atmosphere.

name: Beskydská sedmička
description: IMOS Beskydská sedmička je extrémní horský maraton přes celé Beskydy, který vede z Třince do Frenštátu pod Radhoštěm. Tento náročný závod dlouhý přibližně 101 km s převýšením 5500 m+ je Mistrovstvím ČR v horském maratonu jednotlivců a je určen pro jednotlivce i dvojice. Startuje se v noci ve 23:00 z atletického stadionu v Třinci a cílová brána se uzavírá po 28 hodinách v neděli ráno. Závod nabízí jedinečný zážitek z horské přírody Beskyd a kvalitní občerstvovací stanice na trase.

name: Alejemi v Kněžicích
description: Alejemi v Kněžicích je běžecký závod pořádaný v okolí kulturního domu v Kněžicích, Vysočina. Nabízí velký okruh dlouhý 9,8 km pro muže a kratší trať 5,5 km pro ženy. Trať vede po asfaltových a nezpevněných lesních i polních cestách, je lehce zvlněná a zhruba 30 % povrchu tvoří asfalt. Závod je vhodný pro běžce, kteří hledají kombinaci asfaltu a přírodních cest v malebném prostředí Vysočiny. Pořadatelem je spolek Běžec Vysočiny z.s.
course_highlights: Velký okruh po asfaltových a nezpevněných lesních i polních cestách
Lehce zvlněná trať s 30 % asfaltového povrchu
Malebné prostředí v okolí Kněžice, Vysočina
additional: Start první kategorie je v 17:30, hlavní kategorie startuje v 18:00. Pořadatelem je Běžec Vysočiny z.s., kontaktní osoba Bohumil Novák. Trať je smíšená s délkou 9,8 km pro muže a 5,5 km pro ženy. Start a zázemí závodu jsou u kulturního domu v Kněžicích. V programu bývají také kratší tratě.

name: 7. Ahnepark-Lauf der Laufgemeinschaft Vellmar
description: The 7th Ahnepark Run, organized by Laufgemeinschaft Vellmar, is a late-summer running event in Vellmar. This club race offers two distances, 200 meters and 17.3 kilometers, and is designed primarily as a community run. Registration and results are managed through my.raceresult.com. The race is listed in the laufen.de running calendar and features officially measured courses that are relevant for rankings.
course_highlights: Two distances: 200 m and 17.3 km
Event in Ahnepark in Vellmar
Officially measured courses for rankings
additional: Registration and results are handled through my.raceresult.com. The race takes place in typical August weather, with temperatures around 25 °C and mostly sunny days. It is a local club race without major branding or destination elements. Distances: 200 m, 17.3 km; registration and results through my.raceresult.com; listed in the laufen.de running calendar

name: Lemgoer Hanselauf
description: The Lemgo Hanselauf is a traditional running event held annually on the last or second-to-last Friday in August in Lemgo. The event offers 3.3 km, 6.6 km and 10 km courses along the city’s ramparts. Children and Bambinis can also take part over shorter distances, making the Hanselauf a family-friendly event. With around 1,000 participants, the Hanselauf is a sporting highlight in the region that brings together fun and community.
course_highlights: Course along Lemgo’s historic ramparts
Distances of 3.3 km, 6.6 km and 10 km
Children’s and Bambini runs over 1.5 km and 400 m
additional: Bib collection and late registration on the event day from 4 p.m. in the right-hand school wing of Engelbert-Kämpfer-Gymnasium. No timing or placings for the children’s and Bambini runs. Assemble at the start from 4:55 p.m. Participation is free. Run along the ramparts, children’s and Bambini runs, registration at Engelbert-Kämpfer-Gymnasium, late registration available on the event day.

name: 26. Verdener Stadt-Lauf
description: The Verden City Run is a road race in Verden, starting and finishing at Lugenstein near the cathedral. The program includes short children’s and youth races, 5- and 10-kilometer races, and a mixed relay. Organized by LAV Verden, the event offers races for various age groups.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Lugenstein near Verden Cathedral
Flat 5 km and 10 km road races
Mixed relay over 3 × 900 meters
additional: The 10 km course also counts as a district championship race for participants in the U16 age group and older.

name: Ibbenbürener Aaseelauf 2026
description: The Ibbenbüren Aasee Run is a long-standing running event taking place for the 41st time in 2026. The event offers races for children of kindergarten and primary-school age, as well as a 5 km fun run, a 5 km team run, and a 10 km main race for competitive and recreational runners. The course runs around Lake Aasee, with the start and finish at Stadion Ost in Ibbenbüren. The event is limited to 1,000 participants and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and good on-course support.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Stadion Ost, Ibbenbüren
Loop course around Lake Aasee, with three laps in the 10 km main race
Drinks stations along the course and in the finish area
additional: Late registration is available on event day from 15:00 until 1 hour before the start of each race for a fee of €2.50. Changes to entries are also possible on event day for a fee. €1 per registration is donated to a charitable organization. Free parking is available at Stadion Ost. Race bibs can be collected on event day from 15:00. Timing is recorded using transponders on the back of the race bib. Registration is online only, with a limited number of places. Late registration costs €2.50; charitable projects can be supported.

name: Sparkassen-Abendlauf
location: Hohenhorster Wald, Recklinghausen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Sparkassen Evening Run in Recklinghausen is a summer running event organized by Recklinghäuser Leichtathletik Club in cooperation with Sparkasse Vest Recklinghausen. Two distances are offered: 5 km (two laps) and 10 km (four laps) through Hohenhorster Forest. Both courses are officially measured and eligible for inclusion in rankings. The evening run also hosts the district championships over 10 km, for which a valid competition licence in the FLVW district of Recklinghausen is required.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km courses in Hohenhorster Forest
Officially measured courses eligible for inclusion in rankings
10 km district championships held as part of the evening run
additional: The 5 km course consists of two laps, and the 10 km course consists of four laps through Hohenhorster Forest. Participants in the 10 km district championships must tick the corresponding box when registering and hold a valid competition licence. Courses in Hohenhorster Forest, district championships held as part of the event

name: Straßenlauf Rund um den Holtenauer Leuchtturm
5. LSG-Waldauer-Wiesen-Lauf
description: The 5th LSG-Waldauer-Wiesen-Lauf is an evening running event held at the Waldauer Wiesen sports ground in Kassel. The event offers various distances for all age groups, from a 500 m Bambini run to an 18 km run. The shorter children’s races start first, followed by the longer races in the early evening. The routes are well marked and include sections around Bugasee and Wahlebach, with refreshment stations and childcare available on site.

name: Domabergsprint
description: The Doma Mountain Sprint in Calw-Stammheim is a challenging mountain run over 2.2 kilometers with an elevation gain of 245 meters. The route climbs from the Nagold Valley to a point below the district’s highest elevation and includes three runnable trails as well as a longer stretch of loose rocks. The run is approved as a charity event and is characterized by steep paths suitable for both younger and older runners. Participants can time themselves and complete the run up to two weeks before the official race day.

name: Sparkassen-Tauchscher-Stadtlauf
description: The Sparkassen Tauchscher City Run is a long-standing running event organized by Leichtathletik Club Taucha e. V. in the town of Taucha on the Parthe. The 21st edition of this city run also incorporates the state championship in the 10 km road race. The event offers runners of all ages an appealing opportunity to compete in a lively atmosphere. Registration opens in February.

name: Letni Ultra Świr
description: Letni Ultra Świr is a unique 24-hour ultramarathon held on a 15 km loop near Grybów. It is a challenge for runners who want to test the limits of their endurance and enjoy an atmosphere full of sweat, dust and fatigue, but also laughter and madness. The event attracts long-distance running enthusiasts, offering a one-of-a-kind experience and intense emotions.

name: Kácovský běh
description: Kácovský běh je tradiční běžecký závod konaný poslední srpnovou sobotu v malebném Posázaví. Nabízí tři hlavní trasy - Devatenáctku, Desítku a Kolečko - s různorodým terénem a převýšením, které prověří jak zkušené běžce, tak i začátečníky. Start i cíl jsou situovány v centru Kácova, s občerstvovacími stanicemi na delších tratích. Závod je měřen čipovou časomírou a doprovázen bohatým programem včetně dětských závodů a tomboly.

name: Cross Parkmaraton
description: Cross Parkmaraton v Krásné Lípě je tradiční běžecký závod v malebném prostředí Národního parku České Švýcarsko. Nabízí různé disciplíny včetně maratonu, půlmaratonu, běhů na 10 km a 5 km, nordic walking, štafet a canicrossu. Trať vede kopcovitým terénem převážně po lesních cestách s krásnými výhledy na Lužické hory. Závod je vhodný pro širokou veřejnost a vítá běžce všech věkových kategorií i rodiny s dětmi.
course_highlights: Kopcovitý terén převážně po lesních cestách
Malebná krajina Národního parku České Švýcarsko
Výhledy na Lužické hory
additional: Start závodu Canicross a Maraton 42 km je v 8:00, ostatní závody (5 km, 10 km Nordic Walking, 10 km, 21 km, štafety) startují v 10:00. Štafety jsou čtyřčlenné týmy, každý běžec běží cca 5 km na trase půlmaratonu. Vyhlašované jsou kategorie podle věku a pohlaví. Závodníci, kteří nestihnou limit maratonu, mohou přejít na půlmaraton. Vyhlášení výsledků probíhá postupně od 10:05 do 14:00. Organizátor zajišťuje šatny a sprchy. Canicross startuje v městském parku C. Dittricha, ostatní závody na Křinickém náměstí. Oficiální web uvádí také nordic walking na 10 km, štafety, canicross a dětské závody.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.parkmaraton.cz/): 2027-08-28 — "Zveme Vás do Krásné Lípy ... na 18. ročník, 28. 8. 2027." (was estimated 2027-08-28)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Zveme Vás do Krásné Lípy ... na 18. ročník, 28. 8. 2027.

name: Chomutovský půlmaraton
description: Chomutovský půlmaraton je tradiční běžecký závod konaný v malebném městě Chomutov v Ústeckém kraji. Závod nabízí rychlou a atraktivní trasu vedoucí historickým centrem města, kolem unikátního Kamencového jezera a krásných přírodních lokalit jako Bezručovo údolí. Součástí závodu jsou také dětské kategorie a štafety, což činí akci vhodnou pro široké spektrum běžců. Účastníci hlavního závodu se mohou těšit na občerstvení na trati i v cíli a účastnickou medaili.

name: Běhej lesy Jizerská
description: Běhej lesy Jizerská je trailový závod konaný v malebném prostředí Jizerských hor v Bedřichově. Nabízí různé trasy včetně krátkých, dlouhých a ultramaratonu, které vedou přes krásné přírodní lokality jako Hřebínek, Smědava, Jizerka a Olivetská hora. Závod je součástí seriálu Běhej lesy a je zařazen do UTMB Index Races, což zaručuje mezinárodní bodové hodnocení. Pro závodníky je připraven také Conti Speed Section a Generali Investments Finish, které přinášejí další soutěžní prvky a odměny.

name: Proběhni si Zoo Ústí nad Labem
description: Proběhni si Zoo Ústí nad Labem je běžecká akce pořádaná v areálu zoologické zahrady v Ústí nad Labem. Běh nabízí jedinečnou příležitost spojit sportovní aktivitu s návštěvou zoo a obdivováním zvířat v přirozeném prostředí. Akce je vhodná pro všechny věkové kategorie a podporuje aktivní trávení volného času v přírodě. Těšíme se na vaši účast a společné zážitky v krásném prostředí zoo.

name: 32. Zeitzer Stadtlauf
description: The Zeitz City Run takes place in Moritzburg Castle Park in Zeitz and is organized by SG Chemie Zeitz. The event begins at 9:15 a.m., with the main races starting at 10:00 a.m. The race office is located in front of the main stage in the city park, and changing and shower facilities are available at the Klinkerhallen on Albrechtstraße. The park entrance is via Stephanstraße. The run offers a great opportunity to be active and enjoy the atmosphere in the castle park.
course_highlights: Run through the historic Moritzburg Castle Park in Zeitz
Main races start at 10:00 a.m.
Changing and shower facilities at the nearby Klinkerhallen
additional: The run begins at 10:00 a.m., with changing and shower facilities at the Klinkerhallen. The park entrance is via Stephanstraße. August weather is usually sunny, ideal for an outdoor run.

name: 37. Heideblütenlauf
description: The 37th Heideblütenlauf takes place in Schneverdingen and is a traditional running event held as part of the Heideblütenfest. The event is organized by TV Jahn Schneverdingen and offers runners of all ages the opportunity to experience the beautiful heathland. The course runs through the picturesque surroundings and is supported by numerous volunteers and supporters who help ensure everything runs smoothly. Participants can look forward to a friendly, well-organized event.
course_highlights: Running routes through the heathland around Schneverdingen
Start in front of the town hall on Schulstraße
Event held as part of the Heideblütenfest
additional: The event is supported by numerous local partners and volunteers, including the City of Schneverdingen, the German Red Cross, Johanniter, the volunteer fire department, and the Heidekönigin. Certificates can be printed for all participants, including Bambini children. Registration is through TV Jahn Schneverdingen; further details are available on the website.

name: 39. Jever-Fun-Lauf
price_range: 4,00 € bis 36,00 € je nach Lauf und Anmeldung
description: The 39th Jever-Fun-Lauf is a long-standing running event in Jever that brings together people of all ages and abilities. The course runs through the town centre, past well-known landmarks, with cheering spectators lining the route. The focus is on the joy of being active and a sense of community, rather than competition. There are various races for children, teenagers and adults, including walking, corporate and team categories, as well as a main race over 10 English miles.
course_highlights: A 2.864 km loop through Jever town centre
The route passes well-known landmarks
Cheering spectators line the course
additional: Merchandise such as sports socks, caps and multifunctional scarves is also available and can be collected in Jever on Wednesdays. Late entries are possible on the event day until one hour before the respective start. The time limit for the main race (10 English miles) is 150 minutes. Several race categories, registration deadlines, start times and further event details are available on the official website.

name: Edersee-Lauf
distance_verbose: 20 km, 10 km, 4.2 km, 2 km, 1.2 km, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: The Edersee Run is part of the Waldeck-Frankenberg Running Cup and takes place in Vöhl-Herzhausen on Lake Edersee. The run is organized by SV 1921 Herzhausen, a club that promotes sport and community for all age groups. The event is very popular and offers runners an appealing opportunity to get active and enjoy the beautiful surroundings of Lake Edersee. Pre-registration opens soon, and the club extends its heartfelt thanks to its supporters and sponsors.
course_highlights: A variety of race distances for all age groups
Flat, fast courses at Lake Edersee
Family and children's runs included
additional: The event is organized by SV 1921 Herzhausen, which also offers other sports activities and training groups. Sponsors support the race bibs. Pre-registration for 2026 opens soon. Various race distances, family-friendly, event held as part of the Waldeck-Frankenberg Running Cup, start and finish at the Herzhausen Grill Hut.

name: Flörsheimer Lebenslauf
location: Flörsheim am Main, Hochtaunuskreis, Hessen, Germany
description: The 15th Flörsheimer Lebenslauf is a traditional race commemorating the town’s deliverance from the plague in 1666. The approximately 10 km course consists of two laps, running from the banks of the Main through Eddersheim, the Stadtgarten and the old town to the historic Gallusplatz, the finish. The motto “Remember – Run – Give Thanks” reflects the event’s religious and community spirit. Proceeds benefit the support associations of Riedschule and Paul-Maar-Schule. In addition to the main race, there are children’s and youth races, which have no entry fee.
course_highlights: Approximately 10 km course over two laps
Route from the banks of the Main towards Eddersheim, through the Stadtgarten and the old town
Finish at historic Gallusplatz, the centre of Flörsheim
additional: Late entries are accepted at the race-number distribution in the Galluszentrum until 30 minutes before the respective race, with no late-entry fee. There is a Bambini race (approximately 800 m) for children born in 2017 or later, with no entry fee, as well as a beginner and youth race of approximately 2.6 km for participants born in 2018 or earlier, with no age-group divisions. Children receive certificates and medals.

name: Maare Mosel Lauf
description: The Maare-Mosel-Lauf is a scenic fun run in the Eifel, held in Gillenfeld. The course passes mysterious maars, rugged cliffs and gently rolling hills, offering runners a unique experience of nature and magnificent views. There are three main distances for beginners and experienced runners, as well as age-appropriate children’s races. Alongside the sporting event, participants can enjoy an attractive program of activities featuring live music and award ceremonies.
course_highlights: Course past the deep-blue Pulvermaar
Loop around the Schalkenmehrener Maar with 240 meters of elevation gain
Scenic nature reserves of Mürmes and Sangweiher
additional: On-site late registration is possible for an additional fee of €5. Race packets will be mailed to participants who register up to 7 days before the event; otherwise, they can be collected on the event day from 15:00 at the school in Gillenfeld. A varied program of activities featuring live music and award ceremonies begins at 19:30. The races take place on the grounds around the Gillenfeld primary and secondary school (plus). There are three distances to choose from, including a 5 km route at the Pulvermaar; a scenic run with elevation gain; online registration available.

name: Mindener Volkslauf
description: The Mindener Volkslauf is the largest running event organized by SV 1860 Minden, attracting more than 1,000 participants each year. Alongside the anniversary, the club is celebrating the 10th anniversary of the merged SV Minden with numerous activities. The event offers a great atmosphere and an after-run party following the company run, inviting everyone to join in the celebrations.
course_highlights: Course with new highlights and varied sections
Start and finish in the stadium with a special atmosphere
After-run party following the company run
additional: The 50th Mindener Volkslauf features an after-run party following the company run. In 2025, 1,467 participants crossed the finish line. The event also celebrates the 10th anniversary of the merged SV Minden, with many individual activities through the end of the year. It is the club’s largest event, with a special focus on community and anniversary celebrations.

name: Monte Sophia XXII und 65. HAG-Lauf
description: The Monte Sophia Mountain Run and the Heinrich-Antons Memorial Run (HAGL) are traditional cross-country races in the Rhenish lignite-mining region near Niederzier. The 25 km Monte Sophia Run, with 380 metres of elevation gain, takes runners across the Sophienhöhe, a former spoil heap with varied trails, distinctive natural and cultural landmarks, and beautiful views. The HAGL offers a shorter 10 km alternative, while the 5.3 km Broisterd Loop is also suitable for beginners. The event also includes children’s races and a 10 km walking route, making it ideal for cross-country runners and marathon trainees.
course_highlights: 25 km route with 380 metres of elevation gain across the Sophienhöhe
Distinctive landmarks including the Stone Compass, Celtic Tree Circle, Golden Meadow and Roman Tower
Varied gradients, from gentle to steep, on firm gravel paths and asphalt
additional: Changing rooms and showers are available in the gymnasium. Aid stations with water, tea, fruit and cola are located along the course and at the finish. Children receive medals and certificates; the top three in each age group receive prizes. Runners entering two races receive a separate bib for each race. Bicycle escorts, jogging strollers, dogs and headphones are prohibited. A challenging cross-country event in the Rhenish lignite-mining region, with a range of race distances, including children’s races and walking.

name: Mußbacher Eselshautlauf
location: Vereinsgelände des TV 1860 Mußbach e.V., Mußbach, Neustadt an der Weinstraße, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
description: The 3rd Mußbacher Eselshautlauf is a community race with four different distances, welcoming participants of all fitness levels. The routes follow farm tracks and pass through the Ordenswald forest, starting and finishing at the TV 1860 Mußbach e.V. club grounds. A special highlight is the after-run party with a DJ, with food provided by a food truck and the club’s catering committee. The event is covered by the German Red Cross and offers restroom facilities as well as a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Routes along farm tracks and through the Ordenswald forest
Start and finish at the TV 1860 Mußbach e.V. club grounds
After-run party with a DJ and food from a food truck
additional: Race bibs can be collected on the day of the event from 15:30 in the TV 1860 Mußbach e.V. gym. Restroom facilities (toilets and showers) are available at the club grounds. Late registration is possible on race day until 16:30. The city champion of Neustadt an der Weinstraße will be determined in the 10-kilometer race. All finishers receive a medal; the top three finishers in each age group also receive a prize and a certificate. Routes along farm tracks and through the forest, online registration, late registration possible on race day, parking available, DLV-approved, participant limit of 300, medals for all finishers, music and refreshments after the race

name: Panoramalauf rund um die Burg Are
distance_verbose: 57 km, 54 km, 52 km, 35 km, 33 km, 19 km, 16 km
price_range: 10,00 bis 24,00 Euro je nach Strecke und Anmeldedatum
description: The Panoramalauf around Are Castle is a scenic popular race in the middle Ahr Valley, organised by Selbstläufer Altenahr e.V. and approved by the German Athletics Association (DLV). With distances of 19 km, 35 km and 57 km, it offers a varied challenge featuring panoramic paths, single-track trails and some demanding climbs. The start and finish are at Martinshütte above Altenahr, where refreshments are also available. The event takes place annually on the last Saturday in August and welcomes runners from near and far to enjoy the nature and scenery of the Ahr Valley.
course_highlights: Panoramic routes with extended uphill and downhill sections
Uses the Red Wine Hiking Trail, the Ahr Hiking Trail and single-track trails
Routes pass over Schwedenkopf, Saffenburg and Steinerberg (the highest point of the Ahr Mountains)
additional: Course refreshments include water, tea, cola, fruit, biscuits, chocolate, energy bars, sandwiches and potatoes (3 stations for K19, 5 for K35, 7 for K57). Drinking cups are provided; bringing your own cup is recommended to reduce waste. There is no official course supervision at road crossings, so please cross carefully. Time limit for K35 and K57: 10.5 hours. A scenic race with uphill and downhill sections, using hiking trails and single-track trails, with refreshments at several stations. The event encourages environmentally conscious use of drinking cups; there is no official course supervision on roads open to traffic.

name: RWW-Ruhrauenlauf
location: Mülheim-Saarn, Mülheim an der Ruhr, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The RWW-Ruhrauenlauf is a traditional race in Mülheim-Saarn, held annually. The event gives runners the opportunity to enjoy the beautiful scenery along the Ruhr floodplains and take part in physical activity. The race is open to all age groups and ability levels and promotes community and health. The course passes through varied landscapes and is suitable for both recreational runners and competitive athletes.
course_highlights: Run along the picturesque Ruhr floodplains
Varied natural course with forest and meadow sections
Family-friendly atmosphere

name: Bottroper Ultralauf Festival (BUF)
description: The Bottrop Ultrarunning Festival 2026 takes place on August 30 and 31 in Batenbrockpark in Bottrop, offering an unforgettable running experience for ultrarunning fans. Alongside the established 6- and 24-hour races, the Halden Backyard is once again a special highlight. The festival stands out for its great community, demanding challenges, and distinctive festival atmosphere, shaped by hourly restarts and parallel events.
course_highlights: 6- and 24-hour races in Batenbrockpark
Halden Backyard as a special highlight
Hourly restarts and parallel events
additional: The festival features hourly restarts, a parallel competition, and a simultaneous walking event, creating a distinctive festival atmosphere. Running event with 6-hour, 24-hour, relay, and Backyard events; in Batenbrockpark; online registration

name: Haineslauf
description: The Haineslauf is the grand finale of the VR Bank HessenLand Cup and offers runners of all ages and ability levels a welcoming atmosphere and excellent organization. A range of distances—including the main race, fun run, Nordic walking, and student and children’s races—makes it a special event for the whole region. The race takes place at the sports field in Ehringshausen and puts a strong emphasis on the joy of exercise and community. Food and refreshments are available in the start and finish area, with aid stations on the longer courses.
course_highlights: Well-marked course with signs at every kilometer
Aid stations at kilometers 4.0 and 9.5 on the longer courses
Start and finish at the SV Ehringshausen clubhouse
additional: Registration is available at the clubhouse until 30 minutes before the start; there is no late-registration fee. Timing is provided using a computer-based results program as well as digital and analog stopwatches. Men and women are scored separately, and student races are classified by age group. The walking/Nordic walking course is not scored, but times are recorded. Certificates are awarded at the awards ceremony on request; mailing them afterward is available only with reimbursement of postage costs. Changing rooms and showers are available. The Haineslauf is part of the VR Bank Hessenland Cup.

name: 8. Stolberger Schloss-Lauf
description: The Stolberg Castle Run 2026 is a charity run in the southern Harz region, starting and finishing right at historic Stolberg Castle. The event offers a range of races for runners of all abilities, including a half marathon, relay, 10 km, 5 km, walking, and fun runs for all ages and children. The varied routes pass through the historic old town, along forest trails and over the heights of the southern Harz, combining a sporting challenge with scenic and cultural highlights. By taking part, every runner supports regional projects in and around Stolberg, giving the event a special charitable purpose.

name: Elstertal-Lauf
description: The 1. SV Gera Elstertal Run is a traditional running event offering a variety of distances for runners of all ages. Individual races are held over 10 km and 15 km, along with relay races for companies and schoolchildren. There are also children’s races and a challenging stair run with around 1,300 steps. The event is part of the Thuringian and Gera running cup series and offers a varied course through the region.

name: Karlis Härtetest
description: Karlis Härtetest is a long-running race organized by Läuferteam Pretzsch. The race takes place every year in autumn near Leipzig and features a challenging cross-country course that tests runners of all ages. The club SG Grün-Weiß 90 Pretzsch e.V. has a long history in running and promotes community and sporting ambition through this event. The race is known for its special atmosphere and the opportunity to prove yourself on a varied course.

name: Lauf rund um Tiefwarensee
description: The 20th Run around Lake Tiefwarensee in Waren (Müritz) is a traditional running event organized by Müritzer LSV. The course leads around the picturesque Lake Tiefwarensee and offers runners an attractive and varied setting. The event welcomes runners of all ability levels and is a regular fixture on the regional running calendar.

name: LimLauf 2026
description: The Limlauf will take place for the 31st time in 2026 in Limbach, Kirkel, and is one of the largest running events in the Saarpfalz district. Events include a traditional half marathon and a 2 km schoolchildren’s race for young runners. The course is officially measured, flat and fast, making fast times possible. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere with award ceremonies, refreshments and a varied supporting programme.

name: Panorama - Run - Bad Laasphe
description: The Panorama Run in Bad Laasphe is a varied race held as part of the SummerCityGames and organized by TV Laasphe. The route leads from Wabachstadion along paved paths and forest trails to the highest point, with a challenging climb and a second half that is mostly downhill and offers beautiful views. There is a 6 km youth/recreational race and a 12 km main race, which covers the route twice and is therefore a real challenge. The event also offers changing rooms and showers right next to the sports field.

name: Salzbergener Raffinerielauf
description: The Salzbergen Refinery Run is a varied road race with events for all age groups, including a children’s race, a students’ mile, and 5 km and 10 km fun runs. The event takes place on 28 August 2027 in Salzbergen and offers an entertaining program for runners and spectators alongside exciting races. The races start at Oberschule Salzbergen and are open to individual runners and teams, with team rankings. The event is part of the EL-CUP and is known for its friendly, family atmosphere.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Oberschule Salzbergen
Distances: 600 m children’s race, 1,700 m students’ mile, 5 km and 10 km fun runs
Team rankings in the main races
additional: Late entries are possible up to 45 minutes before each race for a late-entry fee of €1.00. Race bibs and documents can be collected from approximately 1:15 p.m. at the race office. Walking/Nordic walking is untimed. Trophies are awarded to places 1–3.

name: Umpfertallauf
description: The 13th Umpfertal Run offers a range of race distances, including the 10 km main race, a 10 km relay, a 5 km fun run, and races for schoolchildren and young children. The flat out-and-back course, with around 33 metres of elevation gain, is ideal for less experienced runners. The event starts early on Saturday evening, with the start and finish at the market square, and follows the cycle path to Schweigern. The awards ceremony takes place in the festival tent, rounding off the sporting event.

name: Wixhäuser Kerblauf
description: The Wixhäuser Kerblauf is a traditional fun run held on the last Saturday in August in Wixhausen near Darmstadt. The event offers races for different age groups and ability levels in a family-friendly atmosphere. The course is mostly paved and flat, running through residential areas and open fields. In addition to individual rankings, there is also a team ranking for the 4 km and 6 km races. The event is organized by TSG Wixhausen and is popular with runners of all ages.

name: 4. S-RUN Sparkassenlauf "Rund um das Dünkreuz"
description: The 4th S-RUN Sparkassenlauf “Rund um das Dünkreuz” is a nature-focused community race in Eichsfeld, welcoming runners of all ages and fitness levels. The varied routes wind through breathtaking natural scenery around the Dünkreuz and offer exciting challenges for experienced runners and beginners alike. Alongside the competition, the event puts community spirit at the forefront, supported by an attractive program at the sports field. The race is part of the Eichsfeld Cup and is organized by SG Birkungen 07.

name: Półmaraton Roztoczański im. Czesławy Kwoki , Nielisz - Zamość
description: The Czesława Kwoka Roztocze Half Marathon is a half-marathon-distance race from Nielisz to Zamość. It is the final stage of the Four-Stage Peace Run in Memory of the Children of the Zamość Region. Join us for a race that combines sporting competition with commemorating the children of the Zamość Region.
course_highlights: The half-marathon course runs from Nielisz to Zamość.
The race is the final stage of the Four-Stage Peace Run in Memory of the Children of the Zamość Region.

name: UKIEL Susnet Run Olsztyn
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Olsztynie
description: Participants can choose between the 5 km and 10 km distances, running through the center of Olsztyn with scenic views of the Old Town and CRS Ukiel beach. The course is certified by the PZLA, and the finish line is located on the beach, where a finisher zone awaits with music and lighting. It’s a great opportunity to combine sporting competition with the atmosphere of a city event.

name: 11 Bieg Kurierów Sądeckich
description: The Sądecki Couriers Run is a historic mountain race held in the Sądecki Beskids, on a route from Rytro to the PTTK mountain shelter on Przehyba. The course is marked and features varied surfaces: 15% asphalt, 5% gravel roads, and 80% forest trails, offering participants a chance to connect with nature and tackle challenging terrain. The race commemorates couriers from World War II, and the course record is just under an hour. The organizer provides timekeeping, medical support, a commemorative medal, and a hot meal after the race.

name: 11 Łańcucka Piątka
description: The Łańcucka Piątka is an annual 5 km race held in Łańcut, combining sporting competition with charitable giving. The course passes through the town’s scenic areas, offering participants attractive views and a friendly atmosphere. The event draws runners of different ages and abilities, promoting physical activity and community spirit.
course_highlights: A 5 km course in central Łańcut
Scenic views and a welcoming urban setting
Held as part of the Łańcucki Bieg Dobroci
additional: The event also includes the Mini Łańcucka Piątka for children. Organizers provide race packs and prizes, and the event supports local charitable initiatives.

name: Gliwicka Prowokacja biegowa
organizer: Miejski Zarząd Usług Komunalnych w Gliwicach
description: Gliwice Park Running Provocation is a series of 12 running and Nordic Walking events held in Gliwice in 2026. They take place once a month on Saturdays in the park behind Piast Stadium. The 4,219.5-metre route runs mainly along forest trails and gravel paths, with some sections on asphalt. A refreshment point is located at the start/finish line. The event aims to promote healthy, active outdoor recreation under the slogan “Let yourself be provoked into fighting laziness!”

name: Kunicki Bieg Reggae
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Kultury i Sportu w Kunicach
description: Kunicki Reggae Run is a nationwide sporting event held on the picturesque Lake Kunickie in Kunice. Participants can choose from three certified running routes: 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon. The start and finish are in front of the GOKiS in Kunice at 11 Słoneczna Street. The event combines sporting competition with a friendly atmosphere and reggae music, attracting a growing number of participants from across Poland.

name: Mały Wielki Bieg
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji Gminy Pruszcz Gdański
description: Mały Wielki Bieg is the largest race in the Pruszcz Gdański municipality and returns to Straszyn after a one-year break. It is organized by the Sports and Recreation Centre of the Pruszcz Gdański Municipality, which promotes sport and recreation among local residents. The event is an important sporting occasion in the region.

name: NorDan RUN
description: NorDan RUN is a race held in the picturesque town of Wolsztyn, with routes following paths through the municipal park along Lake Wolsztyńskie. Participants can choose from several distances, from shorter races for children to challenging 48 km routes with checkpoint and refreshment stations. The start and finish are located at the “Fala Park” venue, offering convenient race arrangements and beautiful views. The race is a great opportunity to spend time outdoors and enjoy the surrounding nature.

name: Tatraman
description: Tatraman is a challenging half-Ironman-distance triathlon held in the scenic areas of Polish and Slovak Spiš and the Tatra Mountains. The course starts in Niedzica on Lake Czorsztyn, crosses mountainous terrain, and finishes at the summit of Kasprowy Wierch. The event is aimed mainly at experienced athletes, but amateurs can also test their skills on this extreme course. Tatraman combines sporting competition with beautiful views and highland hospitality.

name: VIII Dycha nad Wisłą
description: The 8th Dycha nad Wisłą is an annual road race held in Tczew and forms part of the 9th Kociewie Running Grand Prix. The race attracts runners from various regions and offers a scenic route along the Vistula. The event combines sport and recreation, promoting physical activity and bringing the local community together.

name: X Jubileuszowy Charytatywny Cross
description: The 10th Anniversary Charity Cross-Country Run and Nordic Walking event in Iwonicz-Zdrój is an annual sporting event held at Dietl Square in Iwonicz-Zdrój. The event combines a cross-country run and a Nordic walking march, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle in this beautiful spa town. This anniversary edition attracts participants of different age groups and ability levels. The organizers invite everyone to take part and emphasize the event’s charitable nature.

name: XVI Bałtycki Maraton Brzegiem Morza
description: The 16th Baltic Seaside Marathon is an annual running event held in the picturesque towns of Jastarnia and Władysławowo. Participants can choose between the marathon and half-marathon distances, both of which follow the coast, offering exceptional views and atmosphere. The event attracts runners from various age groups, including the K60+ and M65+ categories. The participant limit is 250, ensuring an intimate and friendly atmosphere.

name: XXIX Bieg Miodobrania Kurpiowskiego
location: Kurpiowska Kraina nad Zalewem Wykrot, Wykrot, Poland
description: The 29th Kurpie Honey Harvest Run is an annual 10 km race on a certified course, running from Myszyniec to Kurpiowska Kraina by the Wykrot Reservoir. The event is held and organized by the Myszyniec Municipal Athletics Club. The program also includes shorter accompanying races for children and young people. The start and finish are located at Kurpiowska Kraina, and participants can expect professional timekeeping and an awards ceremony for the winners. The race has a family-friendly, regional character, promoting physical activity and local Kurpie culture.
course_highlights: Certified 10 km course
Starts in Myszyniec and finishes at Kurpiowska Kraina by the Wykrot Reservoir
Accompanying races for children and young people over distances from 200 to 1,200 m
additional: The race office and finish are at Kurpiowska Kraina, 1 Miodobrania Street, Wydmusy. The race starts in Myszyniec, and participants are transported by coach from the car park next to Karczma Kurpiowska. The timing chip is issued at the race office and must be returned after the race. The children’s accompanying races take place in the car park next to Karczma Kurpiowska. Competitors from the Myszyniec municipality and those in the 65–69, 70–74, and 75+ age categories receive a 50% discount on the entry fee when paying by traditional bank transfer. The children’s races cover distances of 200, 400, 800, and 1,200 m.

name: Piąteczka dla każdego
location: Nowy Dwór Mazowiecki, Masovian Voivodeship, Poland

name: XI Bieg Dożynkowy
location: Kobylarnia, Gmina Nowa Wieś Wielka, Poland

name: XVII Maraton Pieszo i Rowerem Dookoła Lubina
Prešov Half Marathon
description: The Prešov Half Marathon is a road running event in the centre of Prešov, with the start and event facilities on Hlavná Street. The half-marathon course runs through the city, and its certified loop gives runners the chance to discover the city in a sporting atmosphere. The event also typically includes shorter races and a children’s run.
course_highlights: Urban course in the historic centre of Prešov
Half-marathon distance of 21.1 km on a certified loop
Start and finish in the Hlavná Street area
additional: In previous editions, the programme also included a 10 km race, a shorter race and a children’s mini-marathon.

name: Beh vďaky Senica – Prietrž – pamätník SNP u Rehušov
location: Pamätník SNP u Rehušov, Prietrž, Senica District, Trnava Region, Slovakia

name: Běh teplickými skalami
description: Běh Teplickými skalami je veřejný terénní běh, který se koná každoročně poslední srpnovou neděli v Teplicích nad Metují. Závod má tradici od roku 1994 a je součástí sportovního programu Mezinárodního horolezeckého filmového festivalu. Trať dlouhá 9 km vede podél řeky Metuje ke skalnímu městu, zahrnuje písčité úseky a schody a vrací se stejnou cestou zpět. Od roku 2011 je součástí závodu také dětský běh podle věkových kategorií. Start i cíl jsou na fotbalovém hřišti TJ Slavoj.

name: Běh zámeckou zahradou
organizer: Tělocvičná jednota Sokol Lysá nad Labem
description: Běh zámeckou zahradou je tradiční běžecký závod pořádaný v zámeckém parku v Lysé nad Labem. Tento 62. ročník se koná a je určen pro široké spektrum účastníků od předškoláků až po seniory. Závod nabízí příjemné prostředí historického parku a podporuje sportovní aktivitu všech věkových kategorií. Pořadatelem je T. J. Sokol Lysá nad Labem, který dlouhodobě podporuje sport pro všechny.

name: Běh Bezděkovem
description: Běh Bezděkovem je tradiční krosový závod s délkou trati přibližně 9 km, který se koná v malebném prostředí Bezděkova pod Třemšínem. Trať vede převážně po lesních cestách v členitém terénu s mírným převýšením a nabízí kombinaci asfaltových a kamenitých úseků. Závod startuje u myslivecké chaty a zahrnuje náročný výběh s až 7% stoupáním, který prověří výkonnost běžců. Po náročném úseku následuje závěrečný sjezd a rovný finiš, což dává možnost běžcům ukázat své tempo. Součástí akce jsou i dětské závody, což činí závod atraktivním pro širokou veřejnost.

name: Kolínská desítka
description: Kolínská desítka je obrátkový závod na 10 km, který vede po asfaltu a upravené lesní cestě v okolí sportovního stadionu Mirka Tučka v Kolíně. Závod je součástí Grand Prix Kolína a nabízí běžcům příjemnou kombinaci asfaltového povrchu a přírodního prostředí. Tento závod je vhodný pro všechny běžce, kteří hledají rychlý a zároveň malebný běh v přírodě. Přijďte si užít atmosféru závodu a poměřit své síly s ostatními běžci v krásném prostředí Kolína.

name: Rakovnická 15
description: Rakovnická Patnáctka je silniční závod na 15 km, který se každoročně střídá ve startu mezi městy Rakovník a Křivoklát. Závod je součástí Poháru běžců Kladenska a Rakovnicka a nabízí běžcům příležitost poměřit síly na atraktivní trati v krásném prostředí Středočeského kraje. Tento závod je vhodný pro všechny běžce, kteří hledají kvalitní silniční běh s tradicí a atmosférou regionálního běžeckého poháru.

name: Sázava - Lázek
description: Sázava-Lázek je závod v běhu do vrchu s délkou 7,9 km a převýšením 375 metrů. Trať začíná na asfaltu a pokračuje po polních a lesních cestách, přičemž největší stoupání je v závěru. Tento závod nabízí náročný a pestrý terén pro běžce, kteří hledají výzvu v přírodním prostředí Pardubického kraje.

name: Běh okolo Hříšné Milady
description: Běh okolo Hříšné Milady je krosový závod v okolí České Lípy v Libereckém kraji, který nabízí dvě tratě o délce 12 km a 6 km. Trasa vede převážně po lesních cestách a stezkách pro pěší, které jsou za běžného provozu. Závod je součástí Okresní běžecké ligy a je vhodný pro milovníky trailového běhu, kteří hledají přírodní a technicky zajímavý terén. Start hlavní kategorie je tradičně v 11:45, což umožňuje pohodlnou účast širokému spektru běžců.

name: Všenory - Jíloviště
description: Všenory - Jíloviště je silniční závod s hromadným startem, který nabízí běžcům výzvu v podobě tratě s celkem velkým převýšením. Závod se koná v malebném prostředí v okolí COOP obchodu ve Všenorech a je součástí oficiálního kalendáře Českého běhu. Pořadatelem je Český atletický svaz, který zajišťuje certifikaci tratí a profesionální časomíru. Závod je vhodný pro širokou veřejnost a nabízí možnost zapojení do běžecké komunity.
course_highlights: Silniční trať s hromadným startem
Celkem velké převýšení na trati
Malebné okolí Všenor a Jíloviště
additional: Start je před prodejnou Coop ve Všenorech, přibližně 200 metrů od železniční zastávky Všenory.

name: Burgwald Märchen Marathon
description: The Burgwald Märchen Marathon in Rauschenberg is a varied running event with distances for an ultramarathon, marathon, half marathon, 3/4 marathon, fun runs and a costume run. The event offers a well-organized course with refreshments, timing and medals for all finishers. Race bibs can be collected the day before, and the races start from 8:00 a.m. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to enjoy the race in a fairytale setting.
course_highlights: A variety of distances from 5 km to ultramarathon (52 km)
Start and finish close to the sports hall and outdoor swimming pool in Rauschenberg
Cutoff time for all races is 16:00
additional: A maximum of 1111 entries are available across all races. Late entries are possible on 29.08. from 17:00 to 19:00 and on 30.08. until one hour before the respective start, subject to late-entry fees (€3 for the ultra, marathon and half marathon; €2 for other races). All finishers who reach the finish by 16:00 receive a medal. Certificates can be printed online or collected in the finish area. The start and finish are close to the sports hall and outdoor swimming pool in Rauschenberg. The course runs mostly through the forest, partly on paved paths; refreshments are available every 5±2 km; dogs are allowed.

name: DO IT FAST
description: DO IT FAST in Dortmund offers runners the opportunity to run their personal best on a fully measured 2.5 km loop course.
