Depending on the distance, the course is completed 2 or 4 times and is eligible for official rankings. Alongside the sporting competition, participants can look forward to a finisher’s medal, refreshments, and an awards ceremony for the top runners. A photo banner near the finish area invites participants to take commemorative photos, and results are available digitally via QR code.
course_highlights: DLV-measured 2.5 km loop course
10 km race: 4 laps; 5 km race: 2 laps
Photo banner in front of the blast furnace as a spot for commemorative photos
additional: The race office opens at 07:30. Awards ceremony for men and women, places 1–3, after they finish, at the event area. Finishers receive a medal and refreshments. Results and certificates are available via the QR code on the race number. A €5 late entry fee applies for registrations after the entry deadline.

name: Kölner Halbmarathon- Die Generalprobe
location: Sportpark Müngersdorf, Köln, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 27th Cologne Half Marathon offers runners a choice of four distances: 7 km, 14 km, 21 km and 28 km. All participants start together at 10 a.m. at the NetCologne Stadium in Sportpark Müngersdorf. The route leads through Cologne and is designed as a dress rehearsal for other races. Water, bananas, muesli bars and non-alcoholic drinks are provided along the course and at the finish. The event is organised by Leichtathletik-Team Deutsche Sporthochschule Köln e.V. and is known for its friendly atmosphere and professional organisation.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the NetCologne Stadium in Sportpark Müngersdorf
Four distance options: 7 km, 14 km, 21 km and 28 km
Refreshments along the course and at the finish, including water, bananas and Maxi Nutrition bars
additional: For safety reasons, baby joggers, dogs, walkers and music devices are not permitted. Custom race numbers can be selected for a fee of €3. Changes to registrations are only possible at race-pack collection and cost €15. Course, start/finish in Cologne, on-site late registration available, refreshments, race-pack collection, parking, showers, changing rooms

name: Lahnparklauf
price_range: 14,00 € für 21,1 km und 30 km, 9,00 € für 5 km und 10 km
description: The Lahnparklauf takes place in the heart of Hesse and is an established running event for runners of all ability levels. The proven course concept, known as the LOOP, will be retained this year. The organizing team at team-naunheim SPORT e.V. looks forward to welcoming many participants and also offers training in a variety of sports.
course_highlights: Proven LOOP course route
Running event in the heart of Hesse
Suitable for runners of all ability levels
additional: In addition to running, training is also offered in running, trail running, triathlon, fitness, dance, Zumba and yoga. Course map and elevation profile available online; online registration; parking at the REWE car park; no bag storage provided by the organizer; medical services provided by Malteser Hilfsdienst e.V.

name: Panoramalauf
description: The Münstertal Panoramic Run is a varied 10 km cross-country run with a trail section and 229 metres of elevation gain. There are also school races over 1.0 km and 2.0 km. The event takes place in the picturesque Münstertal Staufen region and offers runners an appealing route through nature. Advance registration is via RaceResult.
course_highlights: 10 km cross-country run with a trail section
229 metres of elevation gain
School races over 1.0 km and 2.0 km
additional: The event is organised by Zweckverband Schwarzwaldsüden. Advance registration is via RaceResult; the event includes a 10 km run with trail sections, as well as other distances, including fun runs and trail runs.

name: Rund um Ennepetal
description: Rund um Ennepetal is an annual mass-participation sporting event held on the last Sunday in August. It combines running, hiking and walking along the 60 km Ennepetal Circular Hiking Trail, divided into five stages. The route passes through varied countryside, with magnificent views of the Bergisches Land, reservoirs and historic places. The event is suitable for all ability levels and offers guided groups for runners and walkers, as well as independent hiking. The stages are scenic and feature cultural highlights and challenging sections. After the event, participants can access their results and certificates online.
course_highlights: 60 km over 5 stages, with varied ascents and descents through forests, floodplains and horse pastures
Magnificent views of the Bergisches Land, reservoirs and historic half-timbered villages such as Beyenburg
Guided groups for runners and walkers; independent hikers receive GPX data; refreshment points at the end of each stage
additional: Late registration is available on the event day for a fee, up to 30 minutes before the start. The start and finish are at the sports grounds of Rot-Weiß Rüggeberg e.V. Bus transfers to the start points of stages 2 to 5 and back are arranged. The course closes at 20:30. Runners and walkers are accompanied in groups by guides familiar with the area; hikers receive GPX data for independent tours. Results and certificates are available online. The event comprises several stages on a challenging route, including bus transfers between start points and refreshments at the changeover points. Participation is open to everyone, with various disciplines and a friendly, family atmosphere.

name: Mühlhäuser Altstadtlauf
organizer: Stadtverwaltung Mühlhausen, Kreissportbund Mühlhausen, SV 1899 Mühlhausen e. V.
description: The Mühlhausen Old Town Run is a traditional race through the historic old town of Mühlhausen, held annually since 1997. With three distances of 1.7 km, 5 km and 10 km, it offers a sporting alternative to the Mühlhausen Kirmes and brings runners from the region together. The traditional start and finish are at Untermarkt in Mühlhausen. The event is organized in cooperation with the athletics club SV 1899 Mühlhausen e.V. and attracts around 800 to 1,100 participants each year.

name: 22. Eilenriederennen Hannover
description: The Eilenriederennen Hannover is an established summer running event through the green heart of Lower Saxony’s state capital. The public race offers three different distances: 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon. The course is officially measured, mostly paved and almost completely flat, making fast times possible. The event has a pleasant atmosphere, with a musical programme in the beer garden, and is part of the Sparkassen-Laufpass-Serie der Region Hannover.

name: 23. Windmühlenberglauf
description: The 23rd Windmühlenberglauf takes place in Fallersleben (Wolfsburg) at the district sports facility on Windmühlenberg. The event is hosted by VfB Fallersleben and gives runners of various age groups and ability levels the opportunity to take part in a traditional race. The course runs through the scenic surroundings of Windmühlenberg and promises a varied running experience. Registration is open.

name: 30. Lauf um den Arendsee
description: The 30th Run around Lake Arendsee (LUDA) takes place at the Arendsee beach resort. This anniversary edition offers runners from the region and beyond a scenic natural setting for sport. There will also be a small party on the eve of the event to celebrate sport and community together. Organized by Kersten Friedrich Events, the event promises professional delivery with strong regional ties.

name: 45. Königseer Stadtwaldlauf
description: The Königsee City Forest Run is a traditional running event in Oberhain near Königsee, held annually. The event offers runners of various ability levels an attractive course through the city forest, with varied terrain. Its friendly atmosphere and scenic surroundings make the run a special experience for participants and spectators.

name: 6-Stunden-Sparkassenlauf
description: The 6-hour Sparkasse Run in Fleestedt takes place on a 1,200-meter loop at the Seevetal Sports Center. The course runs mainly on paved surfaces, with some sections on grass, and is easy to view from the start/finish area, keeping spectators on the edge of their seats. In addition to the individual race, there are team and relay competitions, with the marathon (42.2 km) receiving its own classification. The race is open to runners born in 2008 or earlier, and for the first time the relay is also open to young people born in 2014 or earlier. Younger participants can take part in a 5,000-meter run and have the opportunity to earn the DLV running badge.

name: Blankeneser Heldenlauf
location: Strandweg Ecke Mühlenberg, Blankenese, Hamburg, Germany
description: The Blankeneser Heldenlauf on August 29, 2027, offers five varied courses with different distances and profiles, taking runners through some of the most beautiful parts of Blankenese. The races start at Strandweg/corner of Mühlenberg and run along the Elbe, through the stair district and various parks. Whether you’re a beginner, a recreational runner or an experienced half-marathon runner, there’s a format for everyone. The event is known for its unique combination of maritime stretches and challenging climbs.
course_highlights: Courses run along the picturesque banks of the Elbe and through the famous Blankenese stair district
Half-marathon options with different levels of difficulty: moderate (“Sutsche”) and challenging (“Derbe”), with ramps and climbs
Finish at Blankenese weekly market square, with a finisher’s medal included
additional: The start is at Strandweg/corner of Mühlenberg, about a 15-minute walk from the event grounds. Award ceremonies will be held in stages from 10:00 a.m. on the stage at Blankenese weekly market. Bag drop-off is available at the event grounds from 8 a.m. Late registration is available online from August 19 to 25, 2027, at an increased entry fee. Finishers receive a medal included in the entry fee. Travel by public transport is recommended, as parking is limited.

name: Grafschaftslauf
description: The Grafschaft Run connects the historic towns of Rietberg, Verl and Schloß Holte-Stukenbrock, offering runners a varied route rich in history and atmosphere. The race starts at Gut Rietberg, passes historic buildings and runs through the town centre, then follows the Ems to the garden show grounds. The route continues through atmospheric locations, with several relay handover points, and finishes in the Holter Wald at Jagdschloss zur Holte, which provides an impressive backdrop for the finish. The race features varied rural paths, enthusiastic spectators and a special connection between sport and regional history.

name: Altra Sunset Wattenmeer
description: The Altra Sunset Wattenmeer is a unique team relay race. The route covers around 250 kilometres through the stunning natural landscape along the Elbe and the UNESCO World Heritage Site Wadden Sea National Park. The race starts on St. Pauli Hafenstraße in Hamburg and finishes in the Bad district of St. Peter-Ording. Teams consist of 5 or 10 runners, each taking on several sections of the route, making the race a special shared experience.

name: CrossFunRun
description: The CrossFunRun in Ahrensburg offers a variety of distances from 500 meters to 5 kilometers, suitable for all ages, from the youngest participants to adults. The races take place on varied terrain, with laps across meadows, through woods, and on trails, making the event especially exciting. The event is family-friendly and organized by the WEcycle e.V. club, which also provides good facilities, including changing rooms and toilets. Late registrations are possible on site, and all participants receive medals, certificates, and prizes.
course_highlights: Course surfaces: 10% asphalt, 80% meadow/woodland, and 10% trail
Start and finish at Heidkoppelhof in Ahrensburg
Loop courses of various distances from 500 m to 5 km
additional: Late registration is available on site from 10:00 a.m. for a fee of 5 euros. Relay options are available for teams of 3 or 4. Changing facilities and toilets are available at the start/finish. The course is well marked with arrows and flags.

name: Koberstädter Waldmarathon
description: The Koberstädter Forest Marathon has been held annually since 1979 on the last Sunday in August in Egelsbach and is organized by the athletics department of SG Egelsbach. The event offers races over 5 km, 10 km and the half-marathon distance (21.1 km) through a picturesque, gently undulating forest landscape. In addition to races for competitive runners, there is also a Bambini run for children in the stadium. The family-friendly atmosphere and professional organization make it a popular event in the region.

name: Straßenlauf TV Rheinau 1893
location: Clubhaus des TV Rheinau, Rheinau, Mannheim, Germany
description: The TV Rheinau 1893 road race is a traditional 10 km road race held in accordance with the regulations of the German Athletics Association (DLV) under the supervision of the Baden Athletics Association (BLV). The race takes place in front of the TV Rheinau clubhouse in Mannheim and is part of the engelhorn sports Brooks Laufcup. The course is measured according to DLV guidelines, and official timekeeping and certificate printing are provided. Changing rooms and showers are available to participants at the clubhouse.
course_highlights: 10 km road course measured according to DLV guidelines
Start and finish in front of the TV Rheinau clubhouse
Part of the engelhorn sports Brooks Laufcup
additional: Late registration is possible until 30 minutes before the start. Payment is collected by SEPA direct debit during the week after the race. Prizes (vouchers) are awarded to the top three finishers in each category. Course record bonuses are offered for men and women. The awards ceremony takes place at approximately 11:00 at the TV sports field/hall. The venue can be reached by tram line 1, getting off at Waldseestraße.

name: Stundenlauf des TuS Fleestedt
description: The TuS Fleestedt 6h SPARKASSE Run is a traditional running event in Seevetal that welcomes runners of all ages. In addition to the 6-hour run, the event offers several other races for children and young people. The course circles the Seevetal Sports Centre and provides an attractive running environment with good accessibility. The event is open to everyone who wants to test their endurance and running performance.
course_highlights: Loop course around the Seevetal Sports Centre
Attractive running course with good public transport connections
Family-friendly events, including races for children and young people
additional: Late entries are possible at the venue on race day between 8:00 and 9:00. Race packs can be collected from 8:00 at the race office on the first floor of the sports hall. Participants who arrive by bicycle receive a voucher for cake. Medals can be ordered online until August 9.

name: Trainingslauf Bottwartal-Marathon
location: Steppi/Kreisverkehr, Steinheim an der Murr, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Bottwartal Marathon is a running event in one of the most beautiful landscapes in southern Germany, taking runners through gentle vineyard slopes, picturesque historic town centers, and an exhilarating atmosphere along the course. The marathon route is a varied loop through the southern and northern Bottwartal, passing historic town centers and finishing on a flat stretch at the Steppi roundabout in Steinheim. In addition to the marathon, other distances include a half marathon and a 5 km run, suitable for different age groups and ability levels. The event is organized by a dedicated team of volunteers and partners and offers a family-friendly atmosphere for runners of all experience levels.
course_highlights: Loop through the southern and northern Bottwartal, passing historic town centers
Flat finish at the Steppi roundabout in Steinheim for a strong final push
The route follows the Bottwar River and passes through picturesque vineyards and charming half-timbered towns
additional: The marathon starts at 9:30 a.m., with runners assembling from 9:00 a.m. at the Steppi roundabout in Steinheim. The half marathon starts at 11:00 a.m. in Gronau, with several start waves spaced about 5 minutes apart. The 5 km run starts at 12:00 p.m. in Großbottwar, with the course closing at 2:00 p.m. in Steinheim. A free bus shuttle from Steinheim to Gronau is available for the half marathon. Late entries and changes to registrations are possible until a date to be announced. Registration is handled through the partner Datasport. Age restrictions: marathon from age 18, half marathon from age 16, 5 km run from age 14 (with a transitional provision for ages 12–13). Previous training runs started at the Steppi/roundabout meeting point in Steinheim.

name: Volkswandertag
description: The 40th Volkswandertag of TSV "DE" Immingerode e.V. is a traditional hiking event held in Tiftlingerode. It is aimed at hiking enthusiasts and offers a lovely opportunity to enjoy nature and the surrounding area. This sociable sporting activity is suitable for all age groups. The event is organized by TSV "DE" Immingerode e.V. and is part of the German Athletics Association’s competition calendar.

name: Öko-Run
description: The Öko-Run in Wächtersbach is part of the Main-Kinzig-Challenge and takes place here. The route is fully paved and traffic-free, running alongside meadows and fields along the Kinzig. Races are offered over 5 km and 10 km, as well as a 1,000 m student race in various age groups. Every finisher receives a running shirt, and the event is part of a race series featuring scoring races and attractive non-cash prizes.

name: RAG Hartfüssler Trail
description: The Hartfüssler Trail is a challenging ultratrail in Saarbrücken that brings the 250-year history of Saar mining to life. The 58 km route takes runners through varied terrain featuring historic mining facilities, reclaimed water areas and distinctive spoil heaps. Along the way, runners enjoy impressive views, challenging climbs and a unique blend of nature and industrial heritage. The event offers a welcoming atmosphere, with comprehensive refreshments and medical support along the route.
course_highlights: The wild and romantic Netzbach Valley, with its enchanting trails
A steep climb up the Halde Grühlingstraße, with a literary ascent and panoramic views
Historic mining facilities and reclaimed subsidence ponds along the route
additional: The start and finish are in the schoolyard of the Förderschule soziale Entwicklung Saarbrücken in the Von der Heydt mining settlement. The course has cutoff times (e.g. VP3 Göttelborn, km 30.8, at 12:30; VP5 Halde Grühlingstraße, km 53.1, at 17:00). Aid stations offer drinks, solid food and regional specialties. There are no disposable cups, so runners must bring their own drinking vessels. Medical support and course marshals are provided. An event shirt can optionally be ordered during registration.

name: 11 Bieg po Oddech

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Dla dzieci i młodzieży do lat 17 włącznie. Pakiet z koszulką

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: Dla dzieci i młodzieży do lat 17 włącznie. Pakiet bez koszulki

tiers.label: tier_4
tiers.description: Pakiet dla chorych na mukowiscydozę. Pakiet z koszulką

description: The 11th Bieg po Oddech is a charity 5 km run through the streets of Zakopane, organised to support people with cystic fibrosis. Participants start and finish in the Municipal Park, and the event is accompanied by a family picnic with games and competitions. Every participant receives a special T-shirt and medal, and all proceeds support rehabilitation and treatment for people with the condition. The run promotes physical activity as an important part of everyday therapy, as well as social inclusion.
course_highlights: The 5 km route passes through the scenic streets of Zakopane
Start and finish in the Municipal Park
Family picnic with games and competitions after the run
additional: Electronic timing is provided by S-Time. Refreshments are served to participants after the run. A charity family picnic with games and competitions takes place in the event village. Race packs include T-shirts and medals. Virtual participation is available.

name: Jurajskie Mistrzostwa NA SKRAJU PRZEŁAJU
description: The Jurassic Championships ON THE EDGE OF CROSS-COUNTRY is an extreme winter half marathon and quarter marathon held in the picturesque terrain of the Kraków-Częstochowa Upland. The Cold Half is a challenging half marathon with Jurassic climbs and forest trails, a true test of character for runners. The Chilly Quarter is a shorter distance for runners and Nordic walking enthusiasts, offering a technical course and a unique winter-adventure atmosphere. The event takes place in December weather, further highlighting its distinctive character.
course_highlights: Jurassic climbs and forest trails
A technical course with picturesque scenery
Winter weather and challenging terrain
additional: Starts: Cold Half (21 km) at 10:30, Chilly Quarter (11 km) at 10:40, and the 11 km Nordic Walking event at 10:45. The finish closes at 13:05; results are announced and awards presented at 13:10. Partners and sponsors include Gmina Łazy, the Sports and Recreation Centre in Łazy, Under Armour, and Decathlon. GPX course files are available. Race office and phone contact: +48 664 715 931.

name: 47. Półmaraton Szczecin Bieg na 10 km
location: Jasne Błonia im. Jana Pawła II, Szczecin, Poland
description: The 47th PKO Szczecin Half Marathon and 10 km race is an annual sporting event held in Szczecin, combining competition with the chance to discover the city’s most beautiful sights. The course runs through central Szczecin, including Wały Chrobrego and Wojska Polskiego Avenue, offering participants exceptional views and comfortable running conditions. The start and finish are located at John Paul II Jasne Błonia Square. Runners can choose their distance during the race: 10 km or a half marathon on a single PZLA-certified loop.
course_highlights: The course runs through central Szczecin and Wały Chrobrego
The route includes Wojska Polskiego Avenue, Szczecin’s longest street
Start and finish at John Paul II Jasne Błonia Square
additional: Runners can choose their distance (10 km or half marathon) during the race at the distance selection point, approximately 9.6 km into the course. The course is marked every 1 km. Time is recorded electronically using chips in the race bibs. Two race pack options are available: basic and extended, the latter including a Ventus technical shirt.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Poznan
description: IRONMAN 70.3 Poznań is a prestigious triathlon held on the shores of historic Lake Kierskie, the site of Poland’s first triathlon in 1984. Athletes can expect calm, warm waters for the swim and a fast, flat bike course through picturesque villages and the western part of Poznań. The run finishes at Enea Stadium, where a special sporting atmosphere awaits, with the finish line on the pitch at Lech Poznań Stadium. This exceptional event combines sporting competition with local culture and modern infrastructure.
course_highlights: Swim in the calm, warm waters of Lake Kierskie, the site of Poland’s first triathlon
A flat, fast bike course through villages and the western part of Poznań
A run finishing at Enea Stadium, with the finish line on the pitch at Lech Poznań Stadium
additional: The race starts in a rolling-start format. The finish line and race village are located at Enea Stadium and the Poznań International Fair. The race offers qualification slots for the IRONMAN 70.3 World Championship. Participants must be at least 18 years old on race day.

name: Kresowe Trail #10
description: Kresowe Trail is an intimate series of trail races organized by the Kresowe Marathons Foundation, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in natural surroundings. The races take place on scenic routes in eastern Poland, with respect for nature and local communities. The event is open to runners of all ages, offering a variety of distances and formats, and bringing the running community together through a spirit of passion, competition, and friendship. The organizers prioritize safety, high-quality event organization, and an environmentally friendly approach.
course_highlights: Trail routes in the scenic regions of Podlasie and the Lublin area
Carefully marked trails with refreshment stations on longer distances
A time limit of around 2 hours for the main distances, with electronic timing
additional: The race package includes a hot recovery meal with a vegetarian option, electronic timing, a free race bib with a chip valid for the entire season, medical support, refreshment stations along the course and at the finish, a commemorative medal (for early registration), photography, and awards in age-group and open categories. Registration is also available on race day until 08:40. Littering on the course is strictly prohibited.

name: Półmaraton Buski
description: The half-marathon course passes prominent hotels and sanatoriums, the scenic Spa Park, and charming promenades, giving the race a unique atmosphere. The time limit for completing the 21.0975 km distance is 3 hours and 30 minutes, allowing both experienced runners and amateurs to finish at a comfortable pace. It’s a great opportunity to test your abilities and join the sporting celebration in Busko-Zdrój.
course_highlights: The course passes prominent hotels and sanatoriums in Busko-Zdrój
Run through the scenic Spa Park and charming promenades
Time limit of 3 hours and 30 minutes for the 21.0975 km distance
additional: Mass start from the Municipal Stadium. The course is available to download in GPX format for Suunto and Garmin devices. The 3-hour-and-30-minute time limit runs from the start to the finish.

name: VII Maraton od Zmierzchu do Świtu
Draždiak Run
location: Bratislava - Petržalka, Bratislava - Petržalka, Veľký Draždiak (Pláž pri bufete Barracuda).
description: Draždiak Run is a running event held in Bratislava, in the Veľký Draždiak area of Petržalka. Runners can expect courses along gravel and hiking trails, suitable for different age groups and ability levels. The event includes children’s races, 5 km races for adults, Nordic walking, and a family run with a dog. It is organized by Športová Nadácia Kotrmelec, which provides a welcoming atmosphere and high-quality organization.

name: Beh pod Sninským kameňom
location: Snina, Snina, Rekreačná oblasť Sninske rybníky - OMW Snina
description: The Run beneath Sninský kameň is a running event in the Sninské rybníky recreational area in Snina, offering races for children and adults. The courses are on asphalt and dirt roads, while the children’s categories cover distances from 50 to 600 metres depending on age. The main category starts at 16:30 and is divided into men’s and women’s age groups. The event is organised by BehajmeSpolu o.z. in cooperation with the city of Snina. The entry fee is €15 for online registration and €20 on the day.

name: Běh Anny-Marie
description: Běh Anny-Marie je závod konající se v Praze 4, který nabízí 6,6 km trať vedenou smíšeným terénem přes Milíčovský les a přes umělou kopci. Akce je organizována sdružením SABZO Praha a je součástí jejich seriálu běhů, přitahující běžce všech úrovní. Trať zahrnuje jak lesní cesty, tak asfaltové úseky, což činí závod atraktivní pro různé typy běžců. Závod se koná a nabízí jedinečnou příležitost užít si přírodu a sportovní atmosféru v Praze.

name: After Work Run Bad Homburg
location: 61352 Bad Homburg vor der Höhe, Germany
description: The After Work Run Bad Homburg is an annual running event where running enthusiasts from companies and institutions in Bad Homburg meet to race against the clock together after work. The event regularly attracts around 2,950 participants and offers a sporting opportunity to end the workday actively. The event takes place on September 1, 2027, and is open to everyone who enjoys running in a community atmosphere.
course_highlights: Running route through Bad Homburg
Running together after work
Around 2,950 running enthusiasts from companies and institutions take part
additional: Personal advice about the event is available by appointment only. Registration and further information about the After Work Run 2027 will be published on the official website in due course.

name: Fohlenhoflauf
description: The Fohlenhof Run in Schwarzenbach near Homburg is more than just a sporting event—it is a celebration of connection that brings people together. The event is organized by CJD Homburg and combines sporting commitment with a sense of community. The run takes place in a natural setting and encourages interaction and togetherness among all participants.
course_highlights: Run through the natural surroundings of Schwarzenbach
Event as a celebration of connection and community
Organized by CJD Homburg with a social focus

name: Leśna Piątka Odwrotnie
description: Leśna Piątka Odwrotnie is a cross-country race held in Koszalin and the final event of the Leśne Piątki season. The course runs in the opposite direction to usual, allowing participants to experience it anew. The event is open to runners, Nordic Walking enthusiasts, and mixed pairs. All participants receive medals at the finish, with trophies for the top finishers in various age groups and disciplines. The race takes place on the Karnieszewice Forest District’s educational forest trail, amid scenic natural surroundings.
course_highlights: Course on the Karnieszewice Forest District’s educational forest trail
Start and finish at the car park on Słupska Street in Koszalin
The course runs in the opposite direction to usual, offering a fresh experience
additional: Race numbers with timing chips can be collected from the race office on the day of the event. Participants can compete in the running race, Nordic Walking, and mixed-pair categories. The race is part of the Tour Biegów po Okolicy - TurBO, where participants can accumulate kilometres throughout the year. All participants receive medals at the finish, with trophies for the top finishers in the main classifications, Nordic Walking, and mixed-pair categories.

name: 24. Duderstädter Sparkassenlauf
description: The 24th Duderstadt Sparkassenlauf takes place in Duderstadt’s historic pedestrian zone. The event starts at 16:00 with the opening ceremony in front of the town hall, which is also the finish point for all races. Distances range from a 600 m Bambini run and 1.25 km school races to 5 km and 10 km races. Children and young people receive finisher medals, participants in the 5 km and 10 km races receive neckerchiefs, and winners are rewarded with cake. The event is supported by the City of Duderstadt, Sparkasse Duderstadt and other sponsors.
course_highlights: Races through Duderstadt’s historic old town and pedestrian zone
Finish in front of the beautiful town hall
A range of distances from 600 m to 10 km, including races for children and young people
additional: The event opens at 16:00 with a ceremony led by patron and Mayor Thorsten Feike and the board of Sparkasse Duderstadt. The Bambini runs have participant limits of 250, while the school races have limits of 300 to 400 participants. Neckerchiefs are given as finisher gifts for the 5 km and 10 km races. No on-site late registration is available. The awards ceremony begins at 18:00. Multiple race distances, registration via the website, medals for children, neckerchiefs for longer races, event in the historic city centre

name: Höinger Heidelauf
location: Ense-Höingen, Kreis Soest, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Höinger Heidelauf is a traditional running event held annually on the first Friday in September in Ense-Höingen. Known as the toughest 10 km race in the Soest district, the event offers distances for different types of runners, including 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon. The course runs along mostly paved paths and gravel trails through the Sauerland hills and features challenging terrain. Alongside the sporting challenge, the event puts community and atmosphere at the forefront, making it a special experience for all participants.
course_highlights: Toughest 10 km race in the Soest district
Course along paved paths and gravel trails
Run through the hilly Sauerland landscape
additional: Children’s races start at 16:45, the 5 km and half marathon at 17:30, and the 10 km race at 18:30. The start and finish are at Karl-Kleine-Stadion. The event offers great refreshments and a strong sense of community. Temporary road closures and safety measures should be taken into account. In the past, the event has set participation records despite adverse weather conditions. Running event with children’s races and main races, a challenging course with elevation gain, and online registration available.

name: IHK-Ausbildungslauf move-on
location: Rostrup bei Oldenburg, Ammerland, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The training run “Move On!” is organized by the Oldenburg Chamber of Industry and Commerce (IHK) and takes place around the Zwischenahner Meer. The course is approximately 12 km long and runs from BBS Ammerland in Rostrup via Eyhausen, Zwischenahn, Aschhausen and Dreibergen, returning to Rostrup. It is aimed at trainers, apprentices, examiners, teachers and other people involved in vocational education and training in the Oldenburg region. In addition to the run, the event includes a program with race-number collection, team photos, a barbecue evening with music and an awards ceremony. The event takes place in all weather. Parking is available at BBS and at Bau-ABC Rostrup.
course_highlights: Approximately 12 km circular route around the Zwischenahner Meer
Start and finish at BBS Ammerland in Rostrup
Route via Eyhausen, Zwischenahn, Aschhausen and Dreibergen
additional: Race numbers and T-shirts can be collected at BBS Rostrup on the day of the event from 14:00 to 15:30. There is a walking group starting at 15:00. The run starts in four groups from 16:00, at 4-minute intervals. After the run, a barbecue with a music act will take place from 18:00 at Bau-ABC near the finish. The awards ceremony is scheduled for 18:30. The IHK accepts no liability for accidents or theft. Valuables cannot be stored.

name: Sparkassen Pütt-Tage-Lauf 2026
organizer: Sparkasse Münsterland Ost, SG Rote Erde Beckum, Ski-Club Beckum, TV Beckum, Lions Club Beckum-Ahlen
price_range: online registration, exact fee not specified
description: The Sparkassen Pütt-Tage Run is a road-running event held on Fridays in downtown Beckum as part of the city’s Pütt-Tage festivities. The program includes short children’s races, a youth race, a charity run, and the 10 km main race, which also serves as the FLVW 10 km Road Running Championships. The course covers several laps through the streets around Hühlstraße, where the start and finish are also located. The event is organized by several local clubs and the Lions Club Beckum-Ahlen. Timing uses a RaceResult transponder in the race bib.
course_highlights: City streets around Hühlstraße in Beckum
10 km main race over several laps
Charity run of approximately 4.2 km over about five laps
additional: The program begins with a 400 m Bambini Run, followed by 1 km children’s races (ages 6–9), a 2 km youth race (ages 10–15), and the 10 km main race (ages 16 and up). Timing uses a RaceResult transponder in the race bib, and results are published online. Multiple race types, including children’s, youth, charity, and main races; held as part of the Pütt-Tage festivities; city-street race; timing with a RaceResult transponder.

name: Straberger 1/3 Marathon
description: The Straberger 1/3 Marathon takes place in Dormagen and offers races over 5 kilometers and 14.065 kilometers. The scenic route passes Kloster Knechtsteden and runs through the forest, making it ideal for beginners, experienced runners, and ambitious athletes. The event is filled with samba and a festive atmosphere in the town center, and is also suitable as a training run for the Cologne Marathon. Children can take part in junior races and receive free running shirts and medals at the finish.
course_highlights: Scenic route passing Kloster Knechtsteden
Run through the forest
Festive atmosphere and samba in the center of Straberg
additional: Children up to U8 receive a free running shirt and a medal at the finish. Adults can order a breathable running shirt for 18 euros when registering and collect it with their race number on event day. The junior races take place at Linden-Kirch-Platz in the town center, with different lap lengths for each age group. Parking is available nearby at Hubertus-Schützensaal and the sports ground. Scenic route, junior races, festive atmosphere, start and finish at Linden-Kirch-Platz, online registration, free for children up to U8, running shirt included

name: 23. Lehrter CityLauf
description: The Lehrter City Run is a long-standing running event held annually in downtown Lehrte. The course includes 2 km, 4 km and 10 km races, as well as children’s and school races. A special highlight is the inclusion run, held as part of the 2 km race. Alongside the sporting challenge, the event offers a varied program of activities with musical accompaniment and team competitions for companies.
course_highlights: The course runs through downtown Lehrte
Races over 2 km, 4 km and 10 km
Inclusion run as part of the 2 km race
additional: There is a team competition for companies over 4 km and 10 km, with prizes awarded by KURTULUS GRUPPE. Walter Nebel provides musical accompaniment. Participants can take part in the supporting program with a stage performance. Volunteers are needed for organization and course support. Booth spaces are available for companies.

name: 6. Fränkischer Backyard Ultra
description: The Fränkische Backyard Ultra is a unique ultra-running event in the “Backyard Ultra” format, with a 6.7 km loop and approximately 90 metres of elevation gain. A new loop starts every hour, and the last runner to complete a loop within the 60-minute time limit wins. The race takes place in Heuchling and has no fixed end time, continuing until only one runner remains. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere with extensive refreshments and a special focus on endurance and community.

name: FLVW 10 km-Straßenlaufmeisterschaften
description: The FLVW 10 km Road Running Championships are a long-standing running event in Beckum that brings together runners from the region and beyond. The course follows a well-measured 10-kilometer road route that appeals to both competitive athletes and recreational runners. The event offers professional organization and a welcoming atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Well-measured 10 km road course
Scenic route through Beckum
Long-standing FLVW championship

name: Nocny Jelczański Bieg Towarzyski 3
description: Nocny Jelczański Bieg Towarzyski 3 is a night race covering 10 km, held in Jelcz-Laskowice. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic course and prepare for autumn races. The organizers offer training plans tailored to different ability levels so everyone can prepare for the race optimally. The event is aimed at runners who enjoy the atmosphere of night running and sporting competition.

name: Z Ľubotína na hrad Plaveč
location: Ľubotín, Ľubotín, Polyfunkčný dom Ľubotín (budova za obecným úradom)
description: The Run from Ľubotín to Plaveč Castle is a traditional race that starts in the village of Ľubotín, by the Multifunctional Building. The race offers categories for men, women, juniors, Nordic walking, and a 4 km hobby run. The main race starts at 17:30, and the children’s categories begin at 16:30. The organizers are the municipalities of Ľubotín and Plaveč, which welcome runners of all ages and abilities. The race is ideal for anyone looking to run in beautiful surroundings, with the finish at Plaveč Castle.

name: SOKOLOVSKÁ 12/24 RUN
description: Sokolovská 12/24 RUN je vytrvalostní běžecký závod trvající 6, 12 nebo 24 hodin, určený pro jednotlivce, dvojice a čtveřice. Závod se koná na nenáročném zvlněném okruhu okolo Přírodního koupaliště Michal v Sokolově. Start je v 11:15 hodin a závod nabízí možnost ubytování v kempu s kompletním zázemím. Závod je vhodný pro širokou sportovní veřejnost a nabízí různé věkové a týmové kategorie s možností střídání na předávacím území u bufetu.

name: Běh kolem Světa
description: Běh kolem Světa je tradiční běžecká akce konající se v Třeboni, která vede kolem rybníka Svět. Od svého vzniku v roce 2012 si závod získal věrné příznivce a nabízí atraktivní trasu dlouhou 11,7 km, jež kopíruje Naučnou stezku kolem Světa. Akce se pravidelně koná v září a je oblíbená pro svou přírodní scenérii a pestrý povrch, který zahrnuje hlínu, bláto, písek, trávu, dřevěné lávky a části asfaltu. Závod je vhodný pro širokou běžeckou veřejnost a nabízí možnost zakoupit startovné ve formě vánočního voucheru.

name: Mirovice - Běh do háje
description: Mirovice - Běh do háje je běžecký závod konaný v malebném prostředí Hřiště v Mirovicích. Závod nabízí náročnou trasu s převýšením, která prověří kondici i vytrvalost běžců. Pořadatelem je Český atletický svaz prostřednictvím služby Český běh, která podporuje běžecké akce po celé České republice. Závod je vhodný pro všechny běžce, kteří hledají výzvu v přírodním terénu a chtějí si užít atmosféru komunitního sportovního setkání.
course_highlights: Hromadný start na hřišti v Mirovicích
Náročný terén s výrazným převýšením
Přírodní lesní a polní cesty v okolí Mirovic

name: Podhostýnská 10
location: Zámecký park, Bystřice pod Hostýnem, Česko
description: Podhostýnská 10ka je běžecký závod pořádaný v Bystřici pod Hostýnem, který nabízí tratě na 10 a 5 kilometrů, včetně dětských závodů. Akce se koná v zámeckém parku a je součástí běžeckého seriálu Běhy Zlín. Závod je vhodný pro širokou veřejnost a běžce všech věkových kategorií, kteří si chtějí užít sportovní atmosféru v krásném prostředí. Pořadatelé kladou důraz na tradici a kvalitní organizaci závodu.

name: Běh Plzeňské teplárenské kolem Boleveckých rybníků
description: Běh Plzeňské teplárenské kolem Boleveckých rybníků je tradiční běžecká akce pořádaná agenturou Pro Sport Activities, která nabízí tratě pro děti i dospělé v malebném prostředí Boleveckých rybníků v Plzni. Závod je součástí Běžeckého poháru mládeže Plzeňského kraje a je vhodný pro širokou veřejnost, včetně nejmladších běžců. Startovné je zdarma a pro prvních 300 přihlášených je připravena poukázka na občerstvení. Kromě závodů je připraven i doprovodný program pro děti a autogramiáda sportovců.

name: Birell Večerní Běh na 10 km Praha
description: Birell Večerní běh na 10 km Praha je tradiční noční běh, který nabízí jedinečnou atmosféru osvětlených pražských ulic. Závod startuje za soumraku a umožňuje běžcům zažít krásy města v netradičním světle. Můžete se zúčastnit jako jednotlivec nebo v týmu a užít si magickou noční atmosféru pod hvězdnou oblohou. Tento závod je součástí běžecké série RunCzech a přitahuje tisíce běžců každoročně.

name: adidas Běh pro ženy 5 km Praha
description: Přijďte si zaběhat na adidas Běh pro ženy 5 km v Praze, největší závod vytvořený speciálně pro ženy. Trasa dlouhá 5 km je vhodná i pro běžkyně bez předchozího tréninku, s limitem 50 minut. Užijte si neopakovatelnou atmosféru a podporu tisíců žen na exkluzivním závodě bez mužů na trati. Přihlaste se s kamarádkami a zažijte společně radost z běhu a solidarity.

name: Barokomaraton
description: Barokomaraton je 19. ročník cross country běhu, který se koná v malebném prostředí městečka Plasy a údolí řeky Střely. Závod je určen jak pro zkušené běžce, tak pro ty, kteří běhají pro radost a chtějí si užít krásnou podzimní přírodu. Na závodníky čekají tratě vedoucí lesními a polními cestami s pravidelnými občerstvovacími stanicemi. Pořadatelé připravují také kulturní program, zábavu pro děti a občerstvení, což dělá z Barokomaratonu příjemný den plný sportu a pohody pro celou rodinu.

name: Strážný nahoru a dolů
description: Strážný nahoru a dolů je součástí ISCAREX poháru, tradičního seriálu běžeckých závodů v Pardubickém kraji. Závod nabízí náročný běh do vrchu a z kopce v malebném prostředí Dolní Dobrouče. Pořadatelé zajišťují kvalitní sportovní atmosféru a zázemí pro všechny účastníky. Akce je vhodná pro zkušené běžce i hobby sportovce, kteří si chtějí vyzkoušet běh v kopcovitém terénu.

name: Lupenická dvanáctka
description: Lupenická dvanáctka je tradiční běžecký závod v Lupenici, který se koná již 33. rokem. Závod nabízí 12 km trať s převýšením 98 metrů, která vede zcela po asfaltu a je dobře značená. Start je v sportovním areálu Lupenice a závod je součástí Velké ceny Východních Čech. Každý účastník běží na vlastní nebezpečí a mladší 18 let musí doložit souhlas rodičů.

name: Jenštejnská pětka
description: Jenštejnská pětka je každoroční běžecký závod na 5 km, který se koná v obci Jenštejn od roku 2014. Kromě hlavního závodu jsou pořádány i další běžecké kategorie, což umožňuje účast širokému spektru běžců. Akce je tradičním sportovním setkáním v regionu Středočeského kraje a nabízí příležitost pro sportovní vyžití v malebném prostředí obce Jenštejn.

name: Zbraslavská Závist
description: Zbraslavská Závist je terénní běh do vrchu, který startuje v Praze-Zbraslavi u bývalé minizoo a vede na bývalé keltské hradiště na vrcholku Závisti. Trať má délku 3,5 km s převýšením 190 metrů, což nabízí náročný a zajímavý běžecký zážitek. Závod je vhodný pro sportovce, kteří jsou připraveni na svižný start a náročné stoupání. Pořádá ho spolek KOPEC, z.s., pod záštitou Českého atletického svazu a je součástí tradičního běžeckého kalendáře v Praze.

name: Felsburglauf
description: The Felsburglauf is a traditional running event held annually since 2013 on the last Sunday in August at the stadium below Felsburg in Felsberg. The event offers races over 400 m, 1,000 m, 5,000 m and 10,000 m and attracts runners of all ages from the region. Its family-friendly atmosphere and beautiful setting make it a popular event in the Schwalm-Eder district. As a licensed race in the KSK-Schwalm-Eder-Cup, participants can also earn points toward the overall standings.
course_highlights: Races over 400 m, 1,000 m, 5,000 m and 10,000 m
Start and finish at the stadium below historic Felsburg
Family-friendly atmosphere in beautiful surroundings
additional: The race is part of the KSK-Schwalm-Eder-Cup. The youngest participants are often born in 2020 or later, and the oldest runner was born in 1937. The event is organized by TSV Eintracht 1863 Felsberg and partner TSV Jahn Gensungen. Distances: 400 m, 1 km, 5 km, 10 km; terrain: stadium and the area around Felsburg; registration not explicitly mentioned

name: Herbstwaldlauf (Volksbank Sauerland Lauf Cup) inkl. Hobby-Mountainbike-Rennen
location: Finnentrop-Fretter, Finnentrop, Märkischer Kreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 62nd Herbstwaldlauf (Volksbank Sauerland Lauf Cup) in Finnentrop-Fretter is a short running event. There is also a hobby mountain bike race. The event offers runners and mountain bikers an appealing opportunity to experience the Sauerland’s autumn scenery and enjoy some active sport.
course_highlights: Short 0.4 km running course
Includes a hobby mountain bike race
Autumn forest scenery in the Sauerland
additional: The event offers a varied course layout, including a trail run, hill run and mountain biking, with mostly changeable weather in the Sauerland.

name: Sparkassen-City-Lauf Meppen
organizer: TV Meppen 1912 e.V. und SV Union Meppen 1947 e.V.
description: The Sparkassen-City-Lauf Meppen is a long-established race jointly organized by the clubs TV Meppen 1912 e.V. and SV Union Meppen 1947 e.V. The event takes place in downtown Meppen and offers races for all age groups and distances. Runners can look forward to a varied course through the city, an enthusiastic atmosphere, and plenty of spectators. Race packets can be collected a few days before the race, and late registrations are still possible in person.
course_highlights: The course runs through downtown Meppen
A range of races for all age groups and distances
Jointly organized by TV Meppen and SV Union Meppen
additional: Late registration is possible in person at the club office or on-site on the day of the event. Race packets can be collected from September 1 during opening hours. On the day of the event, packets can be collected until approximately 45 minutes before the start. The 5 km and 10 km races are part of the Emsland running series (EL-Cup).

name: Volkslauf in St.Vit Laufen und Gutes tun
location: St. Vit, Rheda-Wiedenbrück, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The charity run "Run and Do Good" takes place in St. Vit, Rheda-Wiedenbrück. The races follow flat circuits through the village of St. Vit, starting and finishing at the Küsterhaus. The event supports various social projects, including outpatient palliative care for children, the Malteser Herzenswunsch Krankenwagen, DKMS and families in need. In addition to the races, there will be an inline skating race for the first time, as well as a charity tattoo event that encourages participants’ social engagement.
course_highlights: Flat circuits through the village of St. Vit
Start and finish at the Küsterhaus
9.1 km inline skating race (5 laps), helmets required
additional: Timing is recorded using a disposable chip attached to the running shoe. Race bibs are available on the day of the event from 13:30 in the registration tent next to the Küsterhaus. Water is provided along the course, with tea and fruit in the finish area. Changing facilities are available at the local youth center. Helmets are required for the inline skating race. Charity tattoo event and DKMS registration on site. Participation is possible through membership; donations support children's hospices, DKMS and families in need. Races are offered over various distances, including a kids’ run and inline skating.

name: Warendorfer Emssee-Lauf
location: Warendorfer Freibad, Warendorf, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Warendorf Emssee Run is a long-established fun run with a special atmosphere in the Münsterland, welcoming runners of all abilities. The varied routes circle the Emssee and pass through the Münsterland parkland, with the start and finish at Warendorf outdoor swimming pool, creating a friendly, lively atmosphere. The event combines sporting ambition with community spirit and the joy of running, and is supported by numerous volunteers. Many health insurance providers subsidize participation through their bonus programs, supporting an active lifestyle.
course_highlights: Varied route around the Emssee and through the Münsterland parkland
Start and finish at Warendorf outdoor swimming pool, with a friendly atmosphere
Routes include gravel paths, woodland trails, asphalt roads, and grassy areas
additional: Race packs can be collected at the outdoor swimming pool from 9:00 a.m. on event day. Race bibs with an integrated disposable chip are issued upon presentation of an identity card. Due to construction work, the courses are not officially measured and are therefore not eligible for best-list rankings. Parking is within walking distance at the “Zwischen den Emsbrücken,” “Lohwall,” and “Bootshaus” car parks.

name: Werler Kurpark Crosslauf - Hindernislauf für Groß und Klein
location: Werl Kurpark, Werl, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Werler Kurpark Crosslauf is an obstacle race for all ages, held in Werl’s picturesque Kurpark. The event offers races for different age groups and ability levels, from short courses for children to challenging 6.4 km races for endurance runners. New in 2026 is the relay cross-country race, which promotes team spirit and fun. The varied course includes numerous exciting obstacles, making the race a special experience.
course_highlights: A variety of obstacles, including Climb the Wall, Waterlagoon and Mountainclimber
Distances from 480 metres to 6.4 kilometres
New for 2026: Project S as an additional obstacle
additional: On-site late registration is possible until 60 minutes before the respective start (except for the relay). Race bibs with electronic timing via Racersult. Spikes, running barefoot and costumes are not permitted for safety reasons. Accompanying runners on the course are allowed only in the U6 Bambini race. Obstacles, courses for children and adults, family-friendly, team spirit, fun

name: Wiehler AggerEnergie- und Sparkasse Gummersbach Sommerlauf
location: Wiehltalstadion, Wiehl, Oberbergischer Kreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Wiehler AggerEnergie and Sparkasse Gummersbach Summer Run is a varied running event for all age groups and performance levels. Starting from Wiehltal Stadium, the courses pass through the newly redesigned parks in the center of Wiehl and offer a scenic setting. Whether running individually or as part of a team, the Summer Run invites participants to get active, enjoy a sense of community, and have fun. The motto “We are sporty!” highlights Wiehl’s vibrant sporting culture.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Wiehltal Stadium
Run through newly redesigned parks in the city center
Scenic and varied course
additional: The event is open to individual runners and teams. Contact: Nicole Woberschal (Tel. 02262 99-206). Courses start at Wiehltal Stadium and offer a scenic setting. Registration available.

name: Wildman Harz
description: WILDMAN Harz is a challenging trail-running event around the mountain town of Wildemann in the Harz Mountains. The course features tough climbs, technical downhills, spruce forests and alpine meadows, offering an authentic trail-running experience in the Upper Harz. With distances from 1.5 km to 55 km, there is a suitable challenge for every trail runner. The event also features a varied program, including a pasta party and a barbecue party, making the weekend a special experience.
course_highlights: Tough climbs and technical downhills
Spruce forests and alpine meadows
Singletrack trails over rugged terrain around Wildemann
additional: Late registration is possible online up to 30 minutes before the respective start, with a late-registration fee of EUR 10. Age limits are defined for each course. The program includes a pasta party on Friday and a barbecue party on Saturday. There are race categories, mandatory equipment and aid stations. Registration is through the partner myRacePartner.com. Courses have up to 2,100 metres of elevation gain. Aid stations, timing, environmental and fair-play rules, a program including pasta and barbecue parties, and registration are required.

name: Ederauenlauf
distance_verbose: Halbmarathon, 10 km, 4.7 km, 2 km, 1 km, 0.4 km
description: The Ederauenlauf in Bergheim is a popular running event offering a variety of distances suitable for runners of all ages and ability levels. The course runs through the scenic Ederauen and offers ideal conditions on a measured course eligible for record lists. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, numerous volunteers, and great spirit. Alongside the competition, the focus is also on sharing the experience and supporting social projects.
course_highlights: Measured course through the Ederauen, eligible for record lists
Distances from the 400 m Bambini race to the half marathon (21.1 km)
Start and finish at the central sports grounds of TV08 Bergheim
additional: The event offers various distances, from the 400 m Bambini race to the half marathon (21.1 km). The course is dry and sheltered from the wind, with ideal running weather. There is a family-friendly atmosphere, with many volunteers and spectators. The event supports social projects such as the Marburg Children's Cancer Aid. The central sports grounds of TV08 Bergheim serve as the start and finish venue. Courses are measured and well marked, including the Nordic walking route; donations for Children's Cancer Aid.

name: Fehmarn Marathon
description: The Fehmarn Marathon takes place annually on the island of Fehmarn and offers runners a varied route through the eastern part of the island. The main races follow roads, dike paths, and uneven country paths, providing a diverse running experience. The event starts at 9:30 a.m. at the sports ground at the Inselschule in Fehmarn. In addition to the marathon, there are other races with award ceremonies, and all participants receive an official marathon shirt. Timing is done using a foot chip attached to the running shoe, and the event takes place in all weather conditions.
course_highlights: Loops along roads, dike paths, and uneven country paths
Route through the eastern part of Fehmarn
Start and finish at the sports ground at the Inselschule
additional: Race number pickup is available the day before from 4:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m. and on the event day from 8:00 a.m. Award ceremonies take place after the races, staggered by race. Timing is done using a foot chip, which must be returned after the race; a fee of €15 is charged if it is lost. The event ends at approximately 3:15 p.m. with the arrival of the cyclist accompanying the final course sweep. Parking is recommended within walking distance of the start area. Late entries are possible until 30 minutes before the respective race. Shirts tend to run small, so larger sizes are recommended. The event takes place in all weather conditions; online registration is available, including running shirts and various categories.

name: 4. Backyard Ultra Munich
description: The Munich Backyard Ultra is a unique running event in Munich where all participants repeatedly run the same 6.7-kilometer loop. A new lap starts on the hour, and the race ends only when one person remains. The event is built around community, mutual support and a special atmosphere in which everyone starts, takes breaks and celebrates together. The course passes through green areas and is fully marked, with a well-equipped base camp at the Oberschleißheim Olympic Regatta Course.
course_highlights: A 6.7-kilometer loop that is run repeatedly
The course passes through green areas and is fully marked
The event takes place at the Oberschleißheim Olympic Regatta Course, with a base camp and cheering zone
additional: The start is on the hour, signaled by a bell; late starts are not possible. Each lap must be completed within 60 minutes. Personal support is allowed only in the start and finish area. Slower runners must let faster runners pass. A base camp offers refreshments, lighting, medical staff and volunteers. Photographers cover the event. Mandatory equipment includes running shoes, weatherproof clothing, a headlamp and personal refreshments.

name: Palatina Backyard Ultra
description: The Palatina Backyard Ultra is a unique running event in Erfweiler, where a 6.7 km lap starts every full hour. The winner is the last person to successfully complete a lap within one hour. The route runs along picturesque forest paths through the Glastal and Langenbachtal valleys, including a trail around Langenbach Weiher. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, well-equipped base camp and dedicated volunteer team.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Belmontplatz in Erfweiler
Lap along wide forest roads, paths and trails around Langenbach Weiher
Scenic route with a gentle climb and varied terrain
additional: Tent and campervan pitches, as well as equipment drop-off areas, are available at the start/finish at Belmontplatz, but spaces are limited and allocated on a “first come, first served” basis. A communal tent serves as the race-number pick-up and refreshment station, but is not accommodation. Toilets and showers are available on site. Participants are responsible for their own insurance; medical services will be on site during the event.

name: Intern. Steinhuder-Meer-Lauf
location: Neustadt am Rübenberge, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The 46th International Steinhuder Meer Run, organized by TSV Poggenhagen von 1946 e.V., is taking place. This traditional public race is scored in accordance with the German Athletics Regulations (DLO) and is recognized for all DLV public-race badges. Certificates are available for all placements for download online, and an awards ceremony will be held for the top three finishers in each category. A special prize will also be awarded to the largest registered group. Acceptance of the terms of participation and liability limitations is a prerequisite for taking part.

name: Volkslauf Eisbergen 2026
organizer: TuS Eisbergen TURN- UND SPIELVEREIN 1919 EISBERGEN e. V.
description: The Volkslauf Eisbergen is a long-standing running event in Porta Westfalica, offering various distances for children and adults. The course runs around the Eisbergen sports field and offers varied running options, with a 5.7 km Volkslauf and a 17.7 km long-distance race. Refreshments are also provided for participants, and the event is part of the Mühlenkreisserie. The course can also be viewed on Komoot, making it easy to prepare.

name: Spargellauf - "Run den Damm"
description: The asparagus run “Run den Damm” in Lampertheim is a popular community race with a 35-year tradition, welcoming runners of all ages and ability levels. The event offers 5 km, 10 km and half-marathon distances on a flat, well-marked loop course along the Altrheindamm, finishing at Adam-Günderoth-Stadion. Spectators, music and an after-race party with a live DJ create a lively atmosphere and an unforgettable experience. The 10 km race is also the Bergstraße district championship. The event is family-friendly and warmly welcomes competitive runners, beginners and walkers alike.

name: Strassenlauf
description: The Sandhofen Road Race is an attractive 10 km loop through the Sandhofen fields in Mannheim. The course is officially measured by the DLV, flat, paved and mostly asphalt, making it ideal for competitive and recreational runners. In addition to the main race, there is also a 1,200-meter school race, giving young people a taste of competition. The event is part of the engelhorn sports Brooks Running Cup 2026 and offers a welcoming atmosphere with refreshments, changing rooms and showers, as well as medical services.

name: Volksbank Mitte Kurstadtlauf
description: The VR-Bank Mitte Kurstadtlauf in Heilbad Heiligenstadt is a longstanding race, taking place for the 27th time. The 19-kilometer route crosses the Dün and starts and finishes in the Vitalpark. A tree is planted for every participant to help reforest local woodlands, making the race particularly eco-friendly. The event offers a warm atmosphere and welcomes runners of all abilities.

name: 55. Brockenlauf
description: The Brockenlauf is Germany’s oldest mountain race and has been held annually in Ilsenburg in the Harz Mountains since 1927. The main 26.2 km course climbs 890 meters to the Brocken, the highest mountain in northern Germany, and offers a challenging experience with changeable high-mountain weather at the summit. The route passes through picturesque natural scenery and historic places, with impressive views. In addition to the main race, there are other shorter courses that also offer an experience in nature. The event is open to all runners, regardless of club membership.

name: Brokser Volkslauf
description: The Brokser Volkslauf takes place in Bruchhausen-Vilsen and offers running and walking events for all age groups. The event includes distances from 400 m to 20 km, as well as walking and Nordic walking routes. Held in all weather, it offers participants a varied supporting program with a bouncy castle, drinks, cake, and bratwurst. The races start at the school and sports center, and children’s and youth races are rewarded with medals.

name: Gremsdorfer Kerwalauf 2026
description: The Gremsdorf Kerwalauf is a traditional running event in Gremsdorf, offering various distances for all age groups. The event includes races for toddlers, children, youth, recreational runners and the main race, as well as walking competitions. The routes pass through the scenic surroundings of Gremsdorf and offer a varied experience for both recreational runners and ambitious athletes. The race takes place annually as part of the Kerwa festival and is a popular event for the whole family.

name: 46. Internationaler Steinhuder-Meer-Lauf
description: The 46th International Steinhuder Meer Run invites all running enthusiasts to Poggenhagen. The event offers 5 km, 10 km, and half-marathon races, all starting together. The scenic course runs around Poggenhagen, past the air base and as far as the bathing island in Steinhude. There are also 450 m and 850 m races for children. All races finish at the TSV Poggenhagen sports park.

name: X Srebrna Dziesiątka
description: Srebrna Dziesiątka is an annual road race in Olkusz, organized since 2016 in memory of the distinguished coach Kazimierz Chechelski. The event combines sporting competition with bringing the local community together and promoting an active lifestyle. Participants can choose from several distances suited to different ability levels, and the course runs through the city streets, starting and finishing at the stadium. The race is also an opportunity to have fun together and motivate people of all ages and abilities to stay active.
course_highlights: The course runs through the streets of Olkusz, starting and finishing at the stadium
Distances: 10 km main race, 5 km accompanying race, 5 km Nordic Walking
The course passes along, among others, Parkowa, Żuradzka, Mazaniec, and Starowiejska streets
additional: The Kazimierz Chechelski Memorial for the youngest participants is held as part of the event. The event offers commemorative medals and prizes for the top finishers. The course is marked, and the race office runs efficiently. The race promotes a healthy lifestyle and brings together runners from Olkusz and the surrounding area. Information about the previous edition lists the start and finish at the stadium at 12c 29 Listopada Street in Olkusz, and a 90-minute time limit for the main race. These details may change for the 2027 edition.

name: RAWki na Surowo
description: RAWki na Surowo is a mountain trail race held in the magical Bieszczady Mountains, taking runners across the scenic alpine meadows of Mała and Wielka Rawka. The 29 km course with 1,550 m of elevation gain passes through Bieszczady National Park, requiring the race to be held without aid stations or course markings. The event is certified by ITRA and UTMB and is part of the MTrail Running Series. The start and finish are in Wetlina, and the race follows a self-supported format, emphasizing its rugged character.

name: 60. Festiwal Chodu
description: The International Race Walking Festival in Gdańsk is a prestigious sporting event that brings together competitors of different ages and skill levels. The festival features race walking events over 3 km, 5 km and 10 km, including the Polish Masters Championships and the Polish U23 Championships. The event also promotes physical activity among people with disabilities, offering wheelchair races and FrameRunning events. The festival also includes the open “Walk with the Postman” and the Defenders of the Polish Post Office Run, creating a sporting atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Race walking events over 3 km, 5 km and 10 km for different age categories
Polish Masters and U23 Race Walking Championships
Competition and activities for people with disabilities: wheelchair races and FrameRunning events
additional: Defenders of the Polish Post Office Energa Cup. The event promotes physical activity among people with disabilities by organizing parallel events adapted to their needs.

name: Chojnik Karkonoski Festiwal Biegowy
description: The Chojnik Karkonoski Running Festival is a mountain running event held in the scenic Karkonosze Mountains, in Sobieszów. The festival offers a variety of distances, from an educational family run to a challenging 102 km ultramarathon with over 5,000 metres of elevation gain. The routes feature rocky descents, forest trails and mountain peaks, offering unforgettable views and challenges for runners of varying abilities. The event brings people together and promotes running as a team sport, as well as nature education in Karkonosze National Park.
course_highlights: 102 km ultramarathon with over 5,100 m of elevation gain
Scenic routes through Karkonosze National Park, with rocky descents and forest trails
A range of distances, from an 8 km family run to 71 km and 42 km races
additional: The start and finish of all races are located near Chojnik Castle in Sobieszów. The ultramarathon has a 20-hour time limit, and the half-marathon a 7-hour limit. A wide range of food options and an expo area are available during the festival. The educational family run features learning stops and questions to test participants’ knowledge. Mandatory equipment for the ultra and half-marathon includes, among other items, a phone with roaming, a headlamp, an NRC emergency blanket and a course map. Participant limits are set for each distance (e.g. 100 for the ultra and 375 for the half-marathon).

name: Olkuski Bieg Uliczny
description: The Olkusz Street Run VII Silver Ten is an annual running event organized by the Olkuszbiega Association, the Olkusz City and Municipality Office, and the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Olkusz. The races take place over 10 km (main race), 5 km (companion race), and a 5 km Nordic walking route, with the start and finish at the Market Square in Olkusz. The route follows streets with asphalt and some cobblestone surfaces, is marked every 1 km, and has an intermediate time check at 5 km. Runners use a chip timing system, and the time limit for completing the race is 90 minutes. The event promotes an active lifestyle and running as a form of recreation for all age groups.
course_highlights: The 10 km route consists of two 5 km loops, with asphalt and cobblestone surfaces
The route is marked every 1 km, with an intermediate time check at 5 km
Refreshment point at around 6 km of the main race
additional: The participant limit is 300. Verification and race-pack collection take place on 6 and 7 September 2024. Chip timing device is attached to the shoe. The route is partially closed to vehicular traffic until 16:30. Underage participants must have written consent from a parent or guardian. A bag drop is available at the Race Office.

name: Półmaraton Praski
description: The Praski Half Marathon is an annual night half marathon held in Warsaw, attracting runners from across Poland and abroad. The route passes through the picturesque districts of Praga, offering a unique night-running atmosphere in the heart of the city. The event is well organized, with timing and extensive facilities for participants. The event also includes the Praska 5K Run, welcoming runners of varying experience levels.
course_highlights: A night run through the streets of Warsaw’s Praga district
Picturesque views of historic neighborhoods
Professional timing and start zones
additional: The event also includes a 5 km race, the Praska 5K Run. Customer service is available Monday to Friday, 9:00–18:00. The route and event program for 2027 will be announced closer to the event.

name: XLVI Usedom Marathon
description: The XLVI Usedom Marathon is a unique race connecting two countries and offering unforgettable moments surrounded by nature. The route leads from Świnoujście along Europe’s longest seaside promenade, through the historic Kaiserbäder, coastal forests, and on to Wolgast. Runners will experience a variety of surfaces and landscapes, from asphalt and cobblestones to forest paths, with views of the Baltic Sea and a fresh sea breeze. The race starts at 9:00 in Świnoujście and finishes at Peene-Stadion in Wolgast, offering a unique sporting and maritime experience on the island of Usedom.
course_highlights: The route follows Europe’s longest seaside promenade
Varied surfaces: asphalt, cobblestones, and forest paths
Crossing the German-Polish border and views of the Baltic Sea
additional: Baggage transport to the finish stadium is provided. Time limits: runners must pass the Kölpinsee checkpoint (km 21.8) within 2:30 h and Zinnowitz (km 30) within 3:30 h. Runners who exceed the limits are withdrawn from the course and transported to the finish. After the time limits, there is no course support or refreshment stations.

name: I Mistrzostwa Śląska Osób z Niepełnosprawnościami
V Bieg Pamięci Ofiar Bombardowania Węzła Kolejowego
XIV Grand Prix Nordic Walking Nowa Wieś Lęborska
Beh Novoveskou Hutou
location: Novoveská Huta, Spišská Nová Ves, Slovakia
organizer: Športový Klub ROHALS a Mesto Spišská Nová Ves

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: muži nad 60 a ženy nad 50 rokov - 3 €

price_tiers.distance: Dorast a beh pre zdravie 5 km

description: Sports Club Rohals warmly invites you to the 16th edition of the Run Through Novoveská Huta, taking place in Novoveská Huta. Adults can take on a new 12.2 km course to Vojtechova samota and back, the same for women and men. A 5 km course is also available for those who prefer a shorter distance. Children and young runners will compete on shorter courses through the streets of Huta, grouped by age category. After the race, participants can refuel with goulash; children can enjoy a small theatre performance, and adults will be entertained by the band 3násť ciest.
course_highlights: The new adult course goes to Vojtechova samota (Šadroň) and back
The adult course is 12.2 km and is the same for women and men
Short courses for children through the streets of Novoveská Huta, grouped by age category
additional: Registration for school-age participants is from 11:30 to 12:45, and for juniors and adults until 14:45. Participants may start in only one category. Goulash will be provided after the race; children can enjoy a small theatre performance, and adults will be entertained by the band 3násť ciest. Adult categories compete for points in the Spišská Nová Ves District Running League. 12.2 km and 5 km courses, categories for different age groups, registration on the day of the event, activities for children and adults.

name: Marathon Chopok
description: Marathon Chopok is a challenging mountain run in the beautiful surroundings of the Low Tatras, testing your abilities on a variety of surfaces and terrain. There are two main courses: the 43 km SkyMarathon Chopok, with 2,600 m of elevation gain, and the shorter 21 km Sky Race Jasná Trail, with 1,400 m of elevation gain. Relay entries are also available for the long course. The route runs along both the southern and northern sides of Chopok, including the main ridge, and offers beautiful views and varied terrain.

name: Kokava Trail
description: Kokava Trail is a certified trail race starting and finishing in Kokava nad Rimavicou, with routes through the Veporské vrchy and Stolické vrchy mountain ranges. There are two distances: the main course is 78 km with +3330 m of elevation gain and an 18-hour time limit; the shorter Pasiečky Trail is 23 km with +1200 m of elevation gain and a 7-hour time limit. The varied route consists of 45% meadow sections, 45% forest trails and 10% asphalt. It has no difficult technical sections, but includes several steeper descents and climbs. Runners can make use of six aid stations. Mandatory equipment includes a thermal blanket, headlamp, mobile phone with an active SIM card, GPS device, reflective vest and sufficient fluids. Winners in the Men, Women, Men 50+ and Women 50+ categories will receive medals and prizes during the awards ceremony at the cultural centre.

name: Prešov Running Series 3. kolo
description: Prešov Running Series Round 3 is part of a series of running events held in Prešov throughout 2026. The event is open to all ages and fitness levels, from beginners to professionals. The courses are designed to bring the community together, promote a healthy lifestyle, and make exercise enjoyable. The entry fee includes timing, a medal, refreshments, and an accompanying program. Children who are members of Prešov Running Team can run for free.

name: 6 hodinovka pod Šarišským hradom
location: Veľký Šariš okr. Prešov, Veľký Šariš okr. Prešov, Ul. Doliny
description: The 6-Hour Run Under Šariš Castle is an endurance running event held in Veľký Šariš, Prešov District. The race is open to individuals and relay teams, with categories divided by age and gender. The entry fee is the same for all runners, and the event offers the chance to test your endurance in a six-hour run in the beautiful surroundings below the castle. The organizers, Gejza Sabanoš and Ondrej Fedor, ensure the event runs smoothly.

name: Ozorovská dvanastka
location: Malé Ozorovce, Malé Ozorovce, Parkovisko pred KD
description: Ozorovská Twelve is a running race held in Malé Ozorovce, offering courses for both children and adults. The race is organized by OZ Zorovčan in cooperation with the municipality of Veľké Ozorovce. Participants can compete in the 6 km and 12 km races, with categories by age and gender. The children’s race starts at 9:00, and the adults’ race at 10:00. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant atmosphere near the cultural center.

name: Horský kros Gerlach
location: Gerlachov okr. Poprad, Gerlachov okr. Poprad, Gerlachov od pomníka ( Prezentácia: Obecný úrad Gerlachov )
description: Horský kros Gerlach is a traditional mountain uphill race that starts in the village of Gerlachov and runs through the Velická Valley to the Sliezsky dom mountain hotel. The course is 8,400 metres long with an elevation gain of 879 metres, and runners tackle a rocky trail and sections of asphalt road. The event is suited to runners who enjoy challenging mountain terrain and beautiful views of the High Tatras. The programme also includes children’s races, and runners can purchase an entry with original Horský kros Gerlach socks.

name: Beh za Tatry
location: Štrbské Pleso, Vysoké Tatry, Štrbské Pleso, Vysoké Tatry, pod vyhliadkovou vežou Tatras Tower
organizer: Barbora a Slavomír Ogurčákovci v spolupráci s občianskym združením Žiť Tatry
description: Beh za Tatry is a running event held in the picturesque setting of Štrbské Pleso in the High Tatras, below the Tatras Tower observation tower. The races offer a start for children at 14:00 and for adults at 16:00, with the course running on natural surfaces along the lakeshore and cross-country ski trails. Categories are divided by age and gender, allowing runners of various age groups to take part. The organizers are Barbora and Slavomír Ogurčák, in cooperation with the Žiť Tatry civic association, who ensure a welcoming atmosphere and high-quality organization.

name: Veľatský lesný beh
description: The Veľaty Forest Run is a traditional running event organized by the civic association OZ Stopa in the village of Veľaty. The race takes place at the FK Veľaty sports field and offers courses of various lengths for men and women aged 15 and over, while children’s races are held directly on the football pitch. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, voluntary donations in place of an entry fee, and refreshments. Volunteers support runners throughout the day, and times are recorded by timekeepers, followed by the announcement of the winners and the presentation of prizes.

name: Telekom Night run
distance_verbose: 50 km, Maratón, 16 km, 11.6 km, 10 km, 5 km, 3.2 km

name: Vorkloster run (1. etapa)
description: Vorkloster Run je etapový závod konaný v malebném prostředí podhůří Českomoravské vrchoviny a v atmosféře středověkého kláštera Porta Coeli. Závod nabízí tři etapy s různou délkou a profilem, od rychlé rovinaté etapy po náročnější kopcovité úseky.
