Pořádá ho zkušený tým DálRunDál ve spolupráci s Klášterním pivovarem Porta Coeli, který přispívá k autentickému zážitku. Trasy jsou pečlivě značené a vedou převážně mimo dopravní provoz, s krásnými výhledy na okolní krajinu a historické památky.

name: Ostrava City Marathon
location: Masarykovo náměstí, Moravská Ostrava, Ostrava, Česko

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Ceny absolutního pořadí (ženy i muži) 1. 5.000,- Kč 2. 3.000,- Kč 3. 2.000,- Kč 4. 1.000,- Kč

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Ceny absolutního pořadí (ženy i muži) 1. 4.000,- Kč 2. 3.000,- Kč 3. 2.000,- Kč 4. 1.000,- Kč

description: Ostrava City Marathon je nejstarším maratonem v České republice, který každoročně oživuje centrum Ostravy sportovní atmosférou a propojuje běžecký svět s industriální duší města. Nabízí širokou škálu závodních kategorií od dětských běhů přes štafety až po klasický maraton, vhodný jak pro výkonnostní běžce, tak pro hobby sportovce. Běžecký festival je otevřený všem, kteří chtějí zažít jedinečnou atmosféru a podpořit charitativní běh MiniMarathon. Start i cíl jsou na Masarykově náměstí, což umožňuje běžcům i divákům užít si centrum Ostravy v pohybu.
course_highlights: Maratonská trasa vede historickým centrem Ostravy
Občerstvení na trati přibližně každých 5 km a v cíli
Doprovodný program a pohybový program s INDIVIDUAL FITNESS
additional: Startovní čísla jsou personalizovaná podle přihlášené trati, elektronické měření času je zajištěno nevratnými čipy součástí startovního čísla. Pro závodníky je zajištěno občerstvení, toalety, sprchy, šatny a úschovna zavazadel. Startovní časy: maraton a půlmaraton v 09:00, štafeta v 09:20, dětské závody od 09:45. Doprovodný program zahrnuje pohybový program s INDIVIDUAL FITNESS a vystoupení Judo Club Baník Ostrava. Minimaratonský běh má charitativní zaměření. Akce se podle pořadatele koná za každého počasí a je bezbariérově přístupná.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://ostravacitymarathon.cz/): 2027-09-05 — "Ročník 68 Datum 05. 09. 2027" (was estimated 2027-09-05)

name: Podčerchovský kros
description: Podčerchovský kros je náročný krosový běh konaný na Babí hoře u Chodova, který vede po lesních cestách s několika obtížnými stoupáními. Nejdelší okruh měří 2,5 km a je vhodný i pro běžce používající tretry. Závod je otevřen všem věkovým kategoriím a nabízí různé délky tratí od dětských kategorií až po hlavní závod mužů. Vyhlášení výsledků probíhá krátce po závodě a vítězové získávají medaile, věcné ceny a v hlavní kategorii i finanční odměny.

name: Běh na Lahti
description: Zveme vás na 47. ročník tradičního běžeckého závodu Běh na Lahti, který se koná v Děčíně. Závod nabízí dvě tratě - hlavní trať dlouhou téměř 10 km s převýšením 230 metrů, vedoucí přes vyhlídku Kvádrberk až nad obec Ludvíkovice, a zkrácenou trať o délce necelých 5 km s převýšením 130 metrů. Trasa vede terénem v děčínských lesích nad pískovcovým kaňonem řeky Labe, což zaručuje krásné výhledy a náročný běh. Prezentace a registrace probíhají na místě startu od 8:00 do 9:45 hodin, start závodu je v 9:00.

name: Rychnov pomáhá během
description: Rychnov pomáhá během je charitativní běžecký závod pořádaný v Rychnově nad Kněžnou, který nabízí trasy pro děti i dospělé v různých věkových kategoriích. Závod se koná na začátku září a je známý svou přátelskou atmosférou, doprovodným programem a podporou potřebných. Každý účastník obdrží startovací balíček a medaili, nejlepší běžci v kategoriích získají hodnotné ceny. Součástí akce je také autogramiáda a zábavný kvíz o ceny, což přispívá k rodinné pohodě a komunitnímu duchu.

name: Běh mezi mosty
description: Běh mezi mosty je charitativní sportovní akce pořádaná Domácím hospicem Athelas a Spolkem Přátelé Kamenného mostu Písek. Tento běh, který obnovuje tradici původního závodu, je určen pro všechny, kteří chtějí podpořit vážně nemocné pacienty a jejich rodiny. Účastníci mohou běžet, projít se nebo symbolicky přispět, přičemž startovné je dar, který pomáhá zajistit péči doma pro ty, kteří už běhat nemohou. Akce se koná v Písku a nabízí různé trasy včetně dětských běhů a rodinných procházek.

name: Jihlavský půlmaraton
location: Sportovně relaxační centrum Český mlýn, Jihlava, Česko
description: Jihlavský půlmaraton je tradiční běžecký závod na 21,0975 km, který se běží na dvou okruzích v areálu Sportovně relaxačního centra Český mlýn v Jihlavě. Závod je určen jednotlivcům, dvojicím i čtveřicím a trať je oficiálně změřená a značená každý kilometr. Kromě hlavního závodu nabízí program i dětské závody, rodinný běh a běh na 10 km. Akce je doprovázena bohatým doprovodným programem pro celou rodinu a charitativní podporou pro Nikču, která čelí vážným zdravotním problémům.
course_highlights: Oficiálně změřená trať 21,0975 km na dvou okruzích (10,54 km každý)
Občerstvovací stanice přibližně každé 3 km s vodou a iontovými nápoji
Start a cíl v areálu Sportovně relaxačního centra Český mlýn v Jihlavě
additional: Startovní číslo obsahuje čip pro měření času, který se nevrací. Štafety obdrží čip při prezentaci a vrací ho po závodě. Registrace a vyzvednutí startovních čísel probíhá v pátek před závodem v Decathlonu Jihlava a v den závodu na místě startu. Na trati je občerstvení, v cíli další občerstvení a doprovodný program včetně sportovních aktivit a zábavy pro děti. Parkování je doporučeno na bezplatných parkovištích Kaufland, OBI, Albert Hypermarket a Vodní ráj. Šatna a WC jsou k dispozici v areálu. Ročník 2027 se koná 5. září, start je plánován na 11:00. Program zahrnuje také závod Decathlon 10 km a rodinný běh. Zázemí je v areálu Český mlýn.

name: Horský čtvrtmaraton Jablonné nad Orlicí - Suchý vrch
description: Horský čtvrtmaraton Jablonné nad Orlicí - Suchý vrch je horský závod, který se uskuteční v Jablonném nad Orlicí. Trať vede po horském terénu na Suchý vrch a je součástí Českého poháru v běhu do vrchu a Krkonošského poháru v běhu do vrchu. Závod nabízí přibližně 10 km s převýšením kolem 580 metrů, přičemž trať je náročná na výdrž i techniku běhu v horském terénu. Přihlášky jsou možné na místě a závod je určen pro běžce hledající výzvu v přírodě.

name: Binger Stadtlauf
organizer: Stadt Bingen am Rhein, Leichtathletik-Club Bingen
price_range: Schüler 5,00 Euro, Erwachsene 13,00 Euro, Staffeln 22,00 Euro, Binger Starter kostenfrei

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Meldegebühr Staffeln nicht aus der Stadt Bingen

description: The Bingen City Run is a long-standing running event in Bingen am Rhein, welcoming runners of all ages. It offers 10 km and 5 km races on courses measured by the DLV. The event takes place during the Bingen Winzerfest and attracts many spectators who enthusiastically follow the races and relays. Alongside the main races, there are also school and relay races, making for a diverse field of participants.
course_highlights: DLV-measured courses of 10,000 m and 5,000 m
Start and finish on Gerbhausstraße
Relay races with 5 × approx. 700 m laps
additional: Relay races are open to clubs, schools, and groups, with teams of 3 men / 2 women or 3 women / 2 men. All finishers receive medals, and the overall winners receive the City of Bingen coin. The fastest relay team receives a challenge trophy. Changing facilities are available at the Kulturzentrum am Freidhof. The time limit for the main races is 75 minutes. Online registration is open until 27.08.2025; late registration is possible on the day for a fee. Start and finish on Gerbhausstraße; start time is 11:00. Courses vary in length and difficulty.

name: Ehriker Stadtmauerlauf mit 2. Ehriker Burg Ramstein Lauf
description: The 6th Ehriker City Wall Run takes place in Ehrang and offers runners a varied program with several distances. New to the program is the 10 km Burg Ramstein Run, a shaded scenic run that is part of the 4REGIO-CUP. The 5 km course passes through the old village, with a lively city-run atmosphere over four laps. Children can take part in exciting youth races and Bambini races in the running tunnel between the fairground stalls. The event is officially measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and promises a sporting experience for all age groups.
course_highlights: 10 km shaded scenic run, officially measured by the DLV
5 km city run over 4 laps through the old village, officially measured by the DLV
Youth races and Bambini races in the running tunnel between the fairground stalls
additional: All races start in front of the stage at Kyllkreisel. All races except the 10 km race finish at Peter-Roth-Platz; the 10 km race finishes shortly before the end of Ramsteiner Weg in Ehrik (Ehrang). Children’s races feature thunderous applause, with Bambinis racing in the running tunnel between the fairground stalls. The event also includes family and youth races, and the courses are officially measured by the DLV. Registration is via laufen.de, and the event is part of the 4REGIO-CUP, a regional running series.

name: 16. Wardenburger Sommerlauf
description: The Wardenburg Summer Run is a long-standing race in Wardenburg that welcomes runners of all ages. Various distances are offered, from 5 km to the 10-mile race; some start together and split at the Tillysee. The event focuses on fair, well-organized race management with chip timing and offers runners a varied route through the region. Children can take part in special untimed races, and Nordic walking is also on the program. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and the support of a dedicated organizing team.
course_highlights: The 10 km and 10-mile races start together and split at the Tillysee
Varied routes from 5 kilometers through the Wardenburg region
Timing with a chip integrated into the race bib
additional: No on-the-day entries are possible. Race bibs have an integrated chip; race bibs must be returned in the finish area. Running with dogs is not permitted. Baby joggers are allowed; participants with baby joggers should line up at the back. The Bambini run is without a race bib or timing. Toilets and changing rooms are available. Runners who exceed the 16:00 time limit will not be timed. Several distances; some races are not timed; participation is only permitted with a race bib; no on-the-day entries; organized via Laufmanager.

name: 31. Fulda-Marathon
description: The Fulda Marathon is a special running experience in the heart of Fulda, Hesse. The course passes the cathedral, winds through the Baroque Old Town and the Fulda meadows, and finishes in the stadium. The race is organised on a voluntary basis by Leichtathletik-Gemeinschaft Fulda e. V. and offers a well-designed course and professional organisation. In addition to the half marathon, there are other races, including 5 km and 11 km runs and a mini-marathon for different age groups.
course_highlights: The course passes the cathedral and runs through the Baroque Old Town
Run through the natural landscapes of the Fulda meadows
Finish in the stadium in the city of Fulda
additional: Start times for the other races: 10 km at approximately 09:40, 5 km at approximately 10:00, mini-marathon at 14:00 (primary school) and 15:00 (secondary level 1). Course maps for all races are clearly laid out and can be downloaded. The event is organised on a voluntary basis, with extensive support along the course, medical care and refreshments. Fulda Marathon T-shirts and a health check are available. Various races include the half marathon, 11 km, 5 km, team race and mini-marathon; please note the participation terms and cancellation fees. Numerous refreshment and support points, an accompanying programme and medical care.

name: DresdenHALF
location: Dresden city center, Dresden, Saxony, Germany
description: The DresdenHALF is an exciting half marathon that, for the first time, runs through the heart of Dresden. The 21.1-kilometer course follows the Elbe and passes some of the city’s most beautiful sights, with each mile symbolically dedicated to one of Dresden’s partner cities. The event offers runners a unique experience amid a historic setting and international atmosphere. In addition to the half marathon, there are other races for children and recreational runners, making the weekend a special running experience.
course_highlights: 21.1 km through the heart of Dresden along the Elbe
Each mile symbolically dedicated to one of Dresden’s 13 partner cities
Start at the World Trade Center Dresden, finish at the Saxon State Parliament
additional: The DresdenHALF starts at the World Trade Center Dresden and finishes at the Saxon State Parliament. The course is officially measured and eligible for rankings. Participants must be at least 16 years old, and the time limit is 3 hours. Every participant receives exclusive arm warmers and a finisher’s medal. The EWG Dresden5K includes an exclusive pom-pom beanie. Bib transfers are possible for a fee. All KidsRUN participants receive a finisher’s medal and certificate. Officially measured course, minimum age 16, 3-hour time limit, merchandise and bib transfers available, including children’s races and pre-race events on September 5.

name: Canyon Run Mühlheim
description: The Canyon Run in Mühlheim am Main is Hesse’s most beautiful forest run through the Mühlheim quarries. The event features flat, officially measured courses, attractive cash and non-cash prizes, and a unique atmosphere with live music in the finish area. Runners of all ages can choose from a range of distances, from the 400 m mini run to the half marathon, with excellent refreshments along the course. The run also supports social projects in the region, making the Canyon Run a special community experience.
course_highlights: Flat, officially measured courses through the Mühlheim quarries and Mühlheim Forest
Half marathon with 80 metres of elevation gain, 10 km with 50 metres, 5 km with 20 metres
Start and finish at the Dietesheim sports grounds, with live music and excellent refreshments
additional: Net timing by transponder, provided by RST Volkslauf GmbH. Cash and non-cash prizes for the fastest runners. Team classifications for companies, clubs and schools. Professional photos in the finish area. Charity run with donations to local social organisations. Runs for families, kids and teams; includes refreshments, prizes, photos and community activities.

name: Kasseler Frauenlauf 2026
description: The Kassel Women’s Run is a charity event for women in Kassel-Wehlheiden, traditionally held on the first weekend of September at Buchenau-Kampfbahn. The event emphasizes exercise without performance pressure: there is no timing, no rankings, and no pressure to achieve personal bests. Participants can run, jog, walk or stroll, with short children’s races as well as 5 km and 10 km run-and-walk routes on flat courses. The day supports women in need and promotes a relaxed community atmosphere with a warm-up, music, food, a tombola, childcare, applause and participation certificates.
course_highlights: Flat 5 km and 10 km routes
Children’s races of 400 m and 800 m
Finish at Hessenkampfbahn on Auedamm
additional: There is no timing or ranking, and participants can run, jog, walk or stroll. The event takes place at Buchenau-Kampfbahn in Kassel-Wehlheiden and emphasizes relaxed, inclusive participation for women and children of all ages.

name: Lauf mal wieder mit in Schmidt
description: TuS Schmidt warmly invites you to the 13th Lauf mal wieder mit in Schmidt. Featuring a new half marathon, the event offers a challenging 22 km course with 480 meters of elevation gain through the beautiful Eifel countryside. The event is open to runners of all ages and is part of the Eifel-Cup and Regio-Aachen-Cup 2025. In addition to the half marathon, there are 4 km and 10.8 km races, with the fastest female and male TuS Schmidt runners recognized in each distance.
course_highlights: Half marathon covering 22 km
480 meters of elevation gain in the Eifel
Races over 4 km, 10.8 km, and the half marathon
additional: The half marathon has a 2 p.m. cutoff (3 hours after the start). The races count toward the 2025 Eifel-Cup and 2025 Regio-Aachen-Cup standings. The event recognizes the fastest female and male TuS Schmidt runners in each distance: 4 km, 10.8 km, and the half marathon. The race takes place annually in September, starting at 11 a.m. with a 2 p.m. cutoff. The event is also suitable for families and children, with special children's races and medals for all children.

name: Lembecker Galgenberglauf
description: The Lembecker Galgenberglauf is a traditional race with a history spanning more than 40 years, held in Hohe Mark Nature Park. The routes pass through gently hilly woodland and offer runners a special experience in nature. Various distances are offered, from a 400 m Bambini run to the 10 km main race, as well as walking and Nordic walking routes. The event is family-friendly and offers suitable races for all age groups.
course_highlights: Routes pass through gently hilly woodland in Hohe Mark Nature Park
Running routes are entirely on forest paths, some of which are gravel
Gentle climbs along the route
additional: Start times are staggered by distance and age group from 09:30 to 10:40. Tea and water are available in the start and finish area, and breakfast is offered. No showers or changing rooms are available. The late entry fee for in-person registration on the day of the event is €3.00. Race on forest paths with gentle climbs; registration online or on the day of the event; no showers or changing rooms; tea, water and breakfast available.

name: New Balance KÖ MEILE 2026
price_range: kostenlos bis 28 Euro, je nach Kategorie und Meldedatum
description: The New Balance Kö Meile is a unique running event on Düsseldorf’s Königsallee. It offers runners of all ability levels a running party filled with great atmosphere, music, confetti and a special city-centre setting. The event includes various races over 5 km, the mile (1,609 m), and children’s and youth races. The course is officially measured, asphalted and certified by World Athletics, making it eligible for record lists. Whether you’re aiming for a personal best or running for the first time, the shared running experience takes centre stage.
course_highlights: Officially measured, asphalted circuit on Königsallee
Official World Ranking Competition certified by World Athletics
Atmosphere with a DJ truck, cheering zone, medal and doughnuts
additional: The 5 km races are divided by target finish times to avoid lapping. A limited-edition event technical shirt is available to order only when registering. The women’s and men’s Elite Mile, as well as the REHACARE Inclusion ½ Mile, are invitation-only races. Late registration is possible until the day of the event for an additional fee, but only until the participant limit is reached.

name: Schapener Volkslauf
description: The Schapen Volkslauf offers runners and walkers a choice of distances in a natural setting around the village of Schapen and the Riddagshausen ponds. The routes pass through idyllic woodland and pond landscapes, as well as historic places such as Schapen station. The 1.2 km route is especially family-friendly and is intended primarily for children and young people, accompanied by an adult. The event features a group warm-up, childcare and massages in exchange for a donation, and warmly welcomes everyone who enjoys running.
course_highlights: The 10.5 km route goes around the Riddagshausen ponds and through Buchhorst
The 6.1 km route passes Schäfer’s Ruh and the historic Schapen station
The 1.2 km route is for children and young people and can be completed once or twice
additional: Start times vary by route, from 9:15 a.m. to 10:20 a.m. The event is organized by Turn- und Sportverein 1921 Schapen e.V.

name: Sparkassen-Stadtlauf
description: The 20th Sparkassen City Run in Wachtendonk is taking place, transforming the municipality into a lively running arena. The event is open to all age and ability groups, from ambitious runners and recreational joggers to families. The races start at 2:00 p.m. at Friedensplatz, with an exhilarating atmosphere, a varied supporting program, and dedicated volunteers. The run offers outstanding athletic performances and personal achievements in a community-minded atmosphere.
course_highlights: A variety of races for all age and ability groups
Start and finish at Friedensplatz in Wachtendonk
An exhilarating atmosphere along the course and a varied supporting program
additional: Registration is easy via the registration button on the website. For the first time, the event is being run and organized by the Municipality of Wachtendonk. A varied supporting program and dedicated volunteers help create a special atmosphere. Races for all age and ability groups, online registration, supporting program, at Friedensplatz

name: Stadtwerkelauf Pinneberg
description: The Stadtwerkelauf Pinneberg is a long-established running event held in Pinneberg. The event offers various distances for children, teenagers and adults, including a 1 km fun run for kindergarten children, a 2.5 km beginners’ and team run, and 5 km and 10 km courses for older participants. The races follow green loops through Pinneberger Fahlt and around Drosteipark, with the start and finish centrally located on Am Drosteipark. The event is family-friendly, and spectators can watch and cheer on the children throughout the fun run.
course_highlights: Green loop through Pinneberger Fahlt and around Drosteipark
Children’s fun run with 2 laps around Drosteipark
Start and finish centrally located on Am Drosteipark
additional: Late registration is available online until one hour before the start for a surcharge of €5.00. The team competition consists of 3 runners, whose individual times are added together; mixed teams are allowed. Online registration is available. Race bibs can be collected on September 4 and 5 at the VfL sports centre. Late registration is subject to a fee. The start and finish area is at Drosteiwiese.

name: Wallmeroder Bahnhofslauf/ 34. Nat. Straßenlauf
description: The Wallmerod Bahnhof Run is a traditional road race in Wallmerod, Germany, and will be held for the 34th time in 2026. Organized by the local sports club TuS Wallmerod, the event features two distances: a short 400-meter run and a half marathon of 21.1 kilometers. The race starts early in the morning and is firmly established in the German road-racing calendar. The course is themed around the town’s railway station and is aimed primarily at local runners and club athletes.
course_highlights: Road race with a railway-station theme
Distances: 400 m and 21.1 km (half marathon)
Traditional event with more than 30 years of history
additional: Results from previous years are available online, with an archive dating back to the early 2000s. Participants receive certificates and can access individual result searches. September weather is typically mild, with daytime temperatures of around 19 °C and nighttime temperatures of 10 °C. It is usually cloudy, with an average of 45 mm of precipitation. The race takes place in typical September weather in Wallmerod. Participants receive certificates and can access their results, with a focus on local runners.

name: Geithainer Herbstlauf
description: The Geithain Autumn Run is a family-friendly autumn race held at the Geithain Stadium in Geithain, Germany. The event offers various distances for all age groups, including a 300 m Bambini Run, a 2.5 km Chestnut Run for children, a 7 km Fun Run, a 7 km walking route, and a 17 km scenic run for older participants and walkers. The start and finish are at the stadium, and the courses are GPS-measured and approved by the German Athletics Association. In addition to the races, there is a children’s programme, a bouncy castle, certificates, medals and small prizes. Every fifth finisher in races of 7 km or longer is rewarded with a bottle of sparkling wine.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Geithain Stadium
GPS-measured courses ranging from 0.3 km to 17 km
Family-friendly programme with children’s races and walking routes
additional: Every fifth finisher in the 7 km races or longer receives a bottle of sparkling wine. The event is organised by Impact Geithain e. V., with support from FSV Alemannia Geithain e. V. The children’s programme and bouncy castle are part of the event. The event includes children’s races, childcare, certificates, finisher medals, small prizes for children and a special bonus: every fifth finisher in the longer races receives a bottle of sparkling wine.

name: 10. Parchener Fiener-Cross
description: The Parchen Fiener Cross is a long-standing cross-country race in the Jerichower Land district, held in northern Saxony-Anhalt as part of the ELBE-OHRE-CUP running series. The event attracts numerous runners of all ages each year and offers additional competitions, including the Heidel Team Cup and a family classification. The race takes place at the Klapperhalle on Parkstraße in Parchen and is known for its varied cross-country course. The event promotes running in the region and brings together sporting competition and a sense of community.

name: 15. Brunsberglauf
location: Holm-Seppensen, Buchholz in der Nordheide, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Brunsberglauf is a longstanding running event in Holm-Seppensen near Buchholz, held annually on the first Sunday in September. A range of distances is offered, from children’s races to a half marathon, on routes through the varied landscapes around the Brunsberg. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, professional organization by runners for runners, and attractive supporting program. Water stations are provided on the longer routes, with tea and sports drinks available at the finish.
course_highlights: Routes pass through the varied landscapes around the Brunsberg
Children’s races take place on the sports field
Water stations on the longer routes and refreshments at the finish
additional: The timing transponder is loaned free of charge and must be worn around the ankle. A fee of 40 EUR is charged if it is lost. There is a team competition on the 5 km and 11.7 km routes, with at least four runners per team. Late registration is only possible on the day of the event and costs an additional 3 EUR. Changing rooms, showers, and sports bag storage are available in the sports hall.

name: 23. Schoninger Volkslauf
location: SC Schoningen Turnhalle, Schoningen, Uslar, Lower Saxony, Germany
distance_verbose: 24.3 km, 17 km, 11 km, 10 km, 9 km, 6 km, 5 km, 2.3 km
description: The Schoninger Volkslauf is a long-running race event held annually in Schoningen. It invites running enthusiasts, hikers, families, and newcomers to sport to experience the beautiful countryside around Schoningen. The event is centered at the SC Schoningen gymnasium and starts in the morning. There are various courses for all age groups and ability levels, so everyone can take part.
course_highlights: Run through the beautiful countryside around Schoningen
Routes for running, hiking, and walking
Family-friendly running event in the Solling
additional: There are options for running, hiking, and walking. The event is aimed at families, newcomers to sport, and experienced runners.

name: 37. CURREX Alsterlauf
description: The CURREX Alsterlauf is a traditional road race in Hamburg, held on a flat, traffic-free loop around the Inner and Outer Alster lakes. The event offers a unique start and finish atmosphere in Hamburg city center and is one of Europe’s largest 10-kilometer road races. In addition to the main 10 km race, there are also 5 km events, a schoolchildren’s race, and the R5K Tour for young runners. The courses are officially measured and ideal for fast times.

name: 38. Volkslauf des TSV Breuna
description: The 38th Breuna Malsburg Run is taking place. This traditional running event is held in the Breuna running and hiking park. The run offers an attractive route through the beautiful natural surroundings of Breuna and is open to runners of all ages. The event is organized by TSV Breuna e.V. and is part of the Nordhessencup. Registration is through the RaceResult platform.

name: 6. Tuchmacher Stadtlauf
description: The Tuchmacher City Run in Bramsche is a popular event with several race distances that attracts numerous participants each year. The event is known for its welcoming atmosphere and varied route through the city center. The 10 km main race is particularly popular with competitive athletes, while the schoolchildren’s race draws a large field and creates a lively atmosphere. The Bramscher Rumläufer organize the event with great dedication, supported by local schools and sponsors.

name: Bahndammlauf
description: The Buchholz Bahndamm Run is a varied running event that combines a nature experience with good food. The route leads from the stadium along the railway embankment through several districts, with a notable uphill section to Mückensee, followed by a return route that is mostly downhill. The event is organized by SV Buchholz 05 e.V. and offers both a sporting challenge and an extensive cake buffet and hearty food. Runners are provided with drinks and snacks at three aid stations, and award ceremonies with trophies and certificates take place after the races.
course_highlights: Gently uphill railway embankment through the districts of Wahl and Wallau
800 m uphill section to the highest point at Mückensee
Three aid stations along the route with drinks and snacks
additional: Registration is via RaceResult until 04.09.2027; late registration is possible on the event day for a fee of €5. Race packets can be collected from 07:30 at the start and finish area. The event takes place at the SV Buchholz 05 sports ground, with free parking available at the nearby REWE car park. The half-marathon is limited to a maximum time of 3 hours. The entry fee is non-refundable if you do not participate; the amount will be donated to Förderkreis Bonn e.V. An awards ceremony for the top three finishers takes place after each race.

name: Breunaer Volkslauf mit 21,1km Malsburglauf
description: The 38th Breuna Malsburg Run is an established running event in Breuna. The route passes through Breuna’s running and hiking park and offers an attractive course for runners. The event is organized by TSV Breuna e.V. and welcomes runners of various ages and ability levels. Registration is via the RaceResult platform.

name: Gölitztallauf
description: The Gölitztallauf is an annual race in Marktgölitz, celebrating its 44th edition. The event offers four different distances, including a 1 km children’s race. It is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and awards in various age categories. Award ceremonies take place shortly after the races to keep participants’ wait times to a minimum.

name: Hochgratlauf
description: The Hochgratlauf is a traditional mountain race to the highest peak in the Allgäu Nagelfluhkette. The course covers 12.8 kilometres, with 714 metres of elevation gain and a summit elevation of 1,834 metres. Alongside the main race, there is a junior mountain race for runners born between 2010 and 2015 on a shortened course. Held annually, the race attracts runners and spectators from near and far, who enjoy the challenge and the scenic beauty of the Allgäu Alps.

name: Lautrer Lebenslauf
description: The Lautrer Lebenslauf is an annual charity run in Kaiserslautern that shows solidarity with people with cancer and their families. The event is organized by the “Mama/Papa hat Krebs” support association and supports the work of Krebsgesellschaft Rheinland-Pfalz e.V. The run brings together runners of all ages, who join in sending a message of hope and courage. Alongside the sporting activity, the social purpose is at the forefront: supporting affected families.
course_highlights: Charity run in Kaiserslautern with a spirit of solidarity
Running together for and with people with cancer
Supporting Krebsgesellschaft Rheinland-Pfalz e.V.
additional: The event is supported by the FCK-Running-Team. Certificates and results are available online. Photos are provided by Michael Schmitt (MS Sportfoto); copyright must be observed. An aftermovie is available on the Instagram page.

name: Nerother Charity Run
description: The Nerother CharityRun is a running event in Neroth that combines physical activity with social commitment. On September 5, 2027, children, young people, adults, recreational runners and leisurely runners are invited to run, walk or hike together for charitable causes in the region. 100% of the proceeds will be donated to local organizations such as the Neroth Primary School Support Association, the Neroth Kindergarten Support Association, the youth department of SV Neroth and the Vulkaneifel Dementia Network. The event promotes community, exercise and local support in the Vulkaneifel.
course_highlights: A variety of routes for running, walking and hiking
Event in the natural surroundings of Neroth in the Vulkaneifel
Community event with a charitable purpose
additional: The Nerother CharityRun supports four charitable institutions in the region with 100% of the proceeds. There are opportunities to take part as a runner, volunteer or supporter. The event is open to all age groups and ability levels, from children to adults.

name: R5K - 5K Alsterlauf Hamburg 2026
description: The CURREX Alsterlauf Hamburg is a traditional running event featuring officially measured, flat, paved courses along the Outer Alster and on Ballindamm. The event offers various distances, including 10 km, 5 km and children’s races, and is open to runners of different age groups. The races are traffic-free and safely supervised by police and race marshals. The Hamburg 10 km Road Championships are also held as part of the Alsterlauf.

name: SaarschleifenLand-Lauf
description: The SaarschleifenLand-Lauf in Merzig offers a varied running program for all age groups, with distances ranging from 250 m to the half marathon. The main race is especially exciting: participants can decide during the race whether to run 15 km or the half marathon (21.1 km). The course follows the scenic Saarleinpfad, offering beautiful panoramic views, and includes the city half marathon championships. The event is family-friendly, with Bambini and schoolchildren’s races, and offers showers and a bag drop at the Stadthalle Merzig.

name: Stadtallendorfer Stadtlauf
description: The Stadtallendorf City Run takes place as part of the Heimat- und Soldatenfest in Stadtallendorf and is organized by TSV Stadtallendorf in cooperation with the German Armed Forces. The course is a loop through Heinz-Lang-Park and the adjacent stadium. Races are offered for various ability levels, including a 5-kilometer fun run and a 10-kilometer main race. These are followed by races for young people and children. The event attracts numerous athletes and offers a sporting challenge in a friendly, festive atmosphere.

name: Stadtwerke Halbmarathon Bochum
description: The Stadtwerke Bochum Half Marathon takes place on September 5, 2027, in downtown Bochum and offers runners a range of distances from 250 meters to the classic 21.1 km half marathon. The flat, fast loop course runs through the heart of the city, passing Bermuda3Eck, the Musikforum, and Bochum’s Old Town, and is officially measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV). In addition to the individual half marathon, there are relay races, school races, and Bambini runs, all accompanied by lively crowds. In addition, €1 is donated to AIDS orphans in sub-Saharan Africa for every finisher.
course_highlights: Flat, fast loop course through downtown Bochum with approximately 150 meters of elevation gain
Start and finish at Bermuda3Eck with strong spectator support
Route passes through Bochum’s Old Town and by the Musikforum, with its impressive architecture
additional: Race day begins with a stage program at 08:30. The half marathon and relay start at 09:00, followed by the 5 km and 10 km races, as well as school and Bambini runs in the afternoon. The half marathon relay consists of four legs, with three changeover zones at notable points around the city. The races are free for schoolchildren and children. Since 2003, the event has supported AIDS orphans in sub-Saharan Africa with a donation of €1 per finisher.

name: Staffellauf der MBB-SG Augsburg
description: The 41st Augsburger Relay Race, organized by MBB SG Augsburg, takes place in the Siebentischwald forest in Augsburg. The event offers a relay marathon with three runners, each running a lap of 7,032.5 meters, as well as an individual half-marathon over 21.1 kilometers. The route is paved, flat, and fast, and runs mostly through the forest, creating ideal conditions for runners of all ability levels. There is also a recreational run of about 7 kilometers, particularly suitable for beginners. The course is well marked and designed as an out-and-back route.

name: Dörverden läuft 2026
description: The run in Dörverden is a versatile running event suitable for all ages and ability levels. The measured courses range from 1.8 km for walking and running to the 10 km main race, which consists of two 5 km laps. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and promotes community sport in the Lower Saxony region. Races start in staggered intervals from 10:00 a.m., so every participant can find a suitable event.

name: Fränkische Schweiz-Marathon
description: The Fränkische Schweiz Marathon takes place in the picturesque landscape of Franconian Switzerland. The course runs from Neideck to Walberla, passing idyllic villages, castles, and rock formations. The car-free federal highway provides ideal running conditions. Tens of thousands of spectators and a varied supporting program give the event a festival atmosphere. The anniversary edition warmly invites runners of all ability levels to take part.

name: Glomb City Marathon Bremerhaven
description: The GLOMB City Marathon Bremerhaven is an annual marathon in Bremerhaven, held since 2005. In addition to the marathon, the event includes a half marathon and a 10 km race. The course is a flat loop starting and finishing in front of the Bürgermeister-Smidt-Gedächtniskirche, and runs through the city center and Havenwelten. Runners enjoy an attractive route with many sights and a unique setting along the water and harbor facilities. The event is organized by the event agency Execute Sports Events, which ensures professional organization.

name: 14 Tyski Półmaraton
description: The 14th Tychy Half Marathon is a 21.0975 km race certified by the PZLA. It runs through the streets of Tychy and around Lake Paprocany. The start, finish, and race village are located at the Tychy Athletics Stadium. The event promotes an active lifestyle and the city’s sporting spirit, and offers numerous activities, including children’s races, massages, and sports demonstrations. The course was modified in 2022 to reduce the number of uphill sections, making it more participant-friendly. The race is held under the honorary patronage of the Mayor of Tychy and has been growing in popularity since 2012.

name: Festiwal Sportowy im. Kazimierza Bubuli 2026
organizer: LKS Markam Wiśniowa – Osieczany, LKS Lubomir Wiśniowa oraz Gminny Ośrodek Kultury i Sportu w Wiśniowej
description: The Kazimierz Bubula Sports Festival in Wiśniowa is a special sporting and community event taking place on September 5, 2027. The program includes races at two distances: Wiśniowa Run (5 km) and the mountain Bieg Trzech Wysp (15 km), along municipal roads and hiking trails. In addition to the races, the festival features sports tournaments, roller-skiing competitions, and activities for children, making it a family-friendly event full of sporting excitement. Participants can look forward to attractive cash prizes and commemorative medals.
course_highlights: Wiśniowa Run — a fast, challenging 5 km course along municipal roads, partly closed to motor traffic
Bieg Trzech Wysp — a 15 km mountain race along municipal roads and hiking trails in the Grodzisko/Księża Góra/Ciecień massif
The courses are properly marked and secured
additional: The awards ceremony will take place at 3:00 p.m., followed by cross-country races for children. Cash prizes in the OPEN categories for women and men: 1st place — 700 zł, 2nd place — 400 zł, 3rd place — 300 zł. Additional prizes of 200 zł will go to the top residents of Wiśniowa Municipality in both races. Everyone who finishes within the time limit will receive a commemorative medal. A prize draw for goods will be held after the races. The race office is located in the gymnasium of the Primary School in Wiśniowa. The race pack includes a race bib, medal, meal voucher, and bag for depositing belongings.

name: Perly Malopolski Szczawnica Pieniny
description: Perły Małopolski Szczawnica is a mountain running event held in the picturesque Pieniny Mountains. The course runs through varied terrain, offering participants exceptional views and challenging climbs. The event is part of the Perły Małopolski series, attracting runners who value being close to nature and sporting competition. Szczawnica is an excellent start and finish location, providing good organization and a welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: Mountain course in the Pieniny Mountains with views of picturesque landscapes
Varied climbs and descents on natural trails
Start and finish in Szczawnica, a popular spa town

name: 26 Eco Półmaraton Wałbrzych
description: The 26th edition of the Toyota Eko Half Marathon Wałbrzych is one of the most important running events in the region and the country, attracting runners from all over Poland. Following last year’s organizational success and record attendance, the event once again confirms its strong position on Poland’s sporting map. Participants gave the half-marathon course very high ratings, and the unique atmosphere created by Wałbrzych’s supporters gives the event its unmistakable character. We warmly invite you to take part or cheer on the runners.

name: 44 Międzynarodowy Otwarty Bieg Przełajowy o Puchar Leśny pamięci Tomasza Hopfera
location: Obliwice, Nowa Wieś Lęborska, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: We invite you to the 44th International Open Cross-Country Race for the Forest Cup in memory of Tomasz Hopfer, which will take place in Obliwice. The main race course is 6.4 km long and consists of two 3.2 km loops, with the start and finish in the same place. The event has a unique sporting atmosphere, combining competition with recreation for the whole family amid nature. The race commemorates Tomasz Hopfer, a legend of Polish sports journalism and a track and field athlete, and also promotes a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in the local community.

name: 64 Bieg Westerplatte
description: The 64th Westerplatte Run is Poland’s oldest continuously held 10-kilometre road race, taking place in Gdańsk. The race starts at the historic site where World War II began, giving the event a unique character and an atmosphere of reflection on sacrifice and peace. The course is certified and marked every kilometre, and the finish is at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, providing an extra attraction for participants. The event attracts up to 5,000 runners and is both a sporting challenge and a tribute to the Defenders of the Coast in 1939.

name: Bieg KoBBiet
description: Bieg KoBBiet is an annual race held in Bielsko-Biała. In 2026, it will take place on September 6 at the Municipal Stadium. The event is dedicated to the memory of Ewa Szymanek-Płaska, Head of the Education and Sports Department at the Bielsko-Biała City Hall. This year’s race supports children on the autism spectrum, and registration will open at 10:00. The race is held under the honorary patronage of Jarosław Klimaszewski, Mayor of Bielsko-Biała.

name: Szybka Piątka Sokoła
description: Szybka Piątka Sokoła is a 5 km race held in Bukownica, Mazowieckie. It’s a great opportunity for runners of all levels to test their fitness on an easy asphalt course. The organizers encourage participants to prepare using training plans tailored to their individual levels and offer support from experts. The event has a friendly, motivating atmosphere and is ideal for those who want to improve their fitness and enjoy running.

name: Wiśniowa Run
organizer: LKS Markam Wiśniowa – Osieczany, LKS Lubomir Wiśniowa oraz Gminny Ośrodek Kultury i Sportu w Wiśniowej
description: Wiśniowa Run is a 5 km race held as part of the Kazimierz Bubula Sports Festival in Wiśniowa. The course is fast but challenging, and runs along municipal roads that are partially closed to car traffic. The event combines sporting competition with community spirit and a family-friendly atmosphere. In addition to Wiśniowa Run, the 15 km mountain Bieg Trzech Wysp is also held, followed by cross-country races for children after the main races. Participants can look forward to attractive prizes, commemorative medals, and a draw for prizes.
course_highlights: 5 km course along municipal roads that are partially closed to car traffic
15 km mountain race along municipal roads and hiking trails in the Grodzisko/Księża Góra/Ciecień massif
Courses are clearly marked and secured
additional: Cash prizes in the OPEN classification: 1st place: PLN 700, 2nd place: PLN 400, 3rd place: PLN 300. Commemorative statuettes are also awarded for 1st–3rd place in age categories. An additional classification is available to residents of Wiśniowa Municipality, with a PLN 200 prize for the fastest woman and man across both distances. A draw for prizes takes place after the competition. Everyone who finishes within the time limit receives a commemorative medal.

name: XVIII Bieg Koguta
description: The 18th Rooster Run is a 10 km race held in Oława. The event is organized by the Oława Running Group in cooperation with local institutions, and participants can expect professional timekeeping. The race office will be open both the day before the race and on race day, making it easier to collect race packets. The race is open and welcoming to runners of varying experience levels.

name: Bieg na Rowerze - Rower na Biegu
VII Bieg o Puchar Wójta Gminy Zblewo
location: Twardy Dół, Zblewo, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: X Bieg Neptuna
location: Trzebież, Police County, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 9. kolo
description: The Beh 2 míle Bratislava is a regular 2-mile running race organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team at the Kuchajda swimming complex in Bratislava. The race is open to the general public, including children, juniors, women, men, and veterans, who are divided into categories. Registration takes place on-site by the volleyball court from 9:30, with the start at 10:00. The race is part of a series in which runners earn points toward the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team Traveling Cup based on their performance and age.

name: Dukelský beh mieru
location: Svidník, Svidník, Štart: Dukliansky priesmyk, Cieľ: pešia zóna Svidník
description: The Dukla Run for Peace is one of the oldest and most significant running events in Slovakia, held every year on the first Sunday in September. The route runs from Dukla to the centre of Svidník and is 19 kilometres long, descending from 479 m above sea level at the start to 244 m above sea level at the finish. Runners follow a historic route associated with the Carpathian-Dukla Operation, commemorating the victims and the struggle for peace in 1944–1945. The event has a rich history and strong emotional significance, bringing together competitive runners and amateurs.

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Srbsko
description: Běžecká série Berounka v Srbsku je komunitní trailový závod vedený převážně po Naučné stezce Srdcem Českého krasu. Trasa začíná u nádraží a vede přes Srbeckou lávku, Bubovické vodopády a údolím Kačáku podél řeky Berounky až do cíle. Závod nabízí krásné přírodní scenérie, přátelskou atmosféru a možnost občerstvení i úschovy věcí na místě. Každý účastník obdrží startovní číslo a první tři v kategoriích získají diplomy.

name: S kopečka do kopečka
description: Běh S kopečka do kopečka je tradiční vytrvalostní závod pořádaný TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, který nabízí běžcům možnost změřit síly na náročné trati v Olomouci. Závod je součástí seriálu Velké ceny vytrvalců Olomouckého kraje a je určen jak pro kondiční běžce, tak pro závodníky s ambicemi. Liga stovkařů je známá svou dlouholetou tradicí a podporou běžecké komunity na střední Moravě. Závod je vhodný pro všechny, kteří chtějí zažít běh v krásném prostředí s výzvou kopcovitého terénu.

name: Novostrašecký běh - Memoriál Vildy Šubrta
description: Novostrašecký běh - Memoriál Vildy Šubrta je tradiční běžecký závod konaný v Novém Strašecí, který nabízí trať dlouhou 6 km. Závod se odehrává na fotbalovém stadionu SK Nové Strašecí a v jeho okolí, s povrchem kombinujícím asfalt, polní a lesní cesty. Start hlavní kategorie je plánován na 18:00 a závod je vhodný pro širokou veřejnost, přičemž dospělí platí startovné 100 Kč, děti mají účast zdarma. Online přihlášky jsou možné i v den závodu, což zajišťuje pohodlný přístup k účasti.

name: Geofyzikální běh
description: Geofyzikální běh je tradiční běžecká akce pořádaná Geofyzikálním ústavem Akademie věd ČR, která se koná v malebném prostředí Krčského lesa v Praze 4. Tento běh má dlouholetou historii sahající až do roku 1985 a nabízí sportovní zážitek v přírodě s vědeckým zázemím. Akce je vhodná pro širokou veřejnost a spojuje sportovní aktivitu s popularizací geofyziky a přírodních věd.

name: 7. Běh pro zdraví
location: Park Boženy Němcové, Karviná, Moravian-Silesian Region, Česko
description: Běh pro zdraví je charitativní seriál sedmi běhů pořádaných v krásném prostředí Parku Boženy Němcové v Karviné. Každý běh nabízí trasu dlouhou 3 km, kterou si může každý uběhnout vlastním tempem. Výnos ze startovného je věnován na pomoc potřebným, což dává závodu smysl a přidanou hodnotu. Start je tradičně v 17:45 na Lodičkách, přičemž prezence začíná již v 17:00. Všichni jsou srdečně zváni k účasti a podpoře dobré věci.

name: Witzenmann Opavská míle
description: Witzenmann Opavská míle je prestižní běžecký závod na jednu míli (1609 m), který navazuje na tradici memoriálu Stanislava Mikesky. Závod je určen pro širokou škálu účastníků včetně profesionálů, amatérů, dětí, rodin, firemních a školních týmů, hendikepovaných i vozíčkářů. Koná se v Opavě a je podporován generálním partnerem Witzenmann Opava. Traťový rekord drží Filip Sasínek s časem 3:55 minut z roku 2023. Závod se koná pravidelně a je jedním z nejvýznamnějších běžeckých závodů v České republice.

name: Noční běh pro světlušku Liberec
description: Noční běh pro Světlušku v Liberci je charitativní běžecká akce konaná ve sportovním areálu Vesec. Účastníci si mohou vybrat mezi tratí 3 km (1 okruh) a 6 km (2 okruhy), přičemž běh startuje v 20:00. Startovné je 500 Kč, z čehož polovina jde na podporu projektu Světluška a polovina na přímou pomoc těžce zrakově postiženým. Akce nabízí doprovodný program včetně koncertu a startovní balíčky s čelovkou nebo sportovní čelenkou pro registrované včas.

name: Běh Akátkami
description: Běh Akátkami je pravidelný běžecký závod v Brně-Židenicích, který nabízí tratě pro muže, ženy i děti. Muži běží 5,2 km (3 okruhy), ženy 3,6 km (2 okruhy) a děti jakéhokoliv věku mají svůj vlastní okruh 1,6 km. Závod se koná večer s registrací od 17:15 a startem hlavního závodu v 18:00. Po doběhu je zajištěno občerstvení a možnost úschovy věcí. Závodníci startují na vlastní zodpovědnost a mohou využít dostupnou městskou dopravu i parkování v okolí.

name: Prajzské kilo
description: Prajzské kilo je ultratrailový běh v krajině Hlučínska, který připomíná historické hranice a příběhy regionu rozděleného v roce 1742. Závod nabízí tři trasy o délce 30, 50 a 100 km s různými časovými limity a převýšením. Běžíte krajinou plnou starých cest, kapliček a polních tratí, která nese stopy historie a identity místních obyvatel. Závod je bodovaný v rámci Česko-Slovenského poháru v ultratrailu a nabízí i body do UTMB indexu a ITRA. Součástí je unikátní medaile, triko, občerstvení na trase i v cíli a hlídání dětí pro kratší tratě.

name: Bergisch Gladbacher Stadtlauf
organizer: SV Blau-Weiß Hand e.V., Stadt Bergisch Gladbach
price_range: Hauptlauf: 11-23 Euro, Erlebnislauf: 9-13 Euro, Gruppenrabatte verfügbar
description: The Bergisch Gladbach City Run is a long-standing running event held annually since 1996. Around 1,000 running enthusiasts set off from Konrad-Adenauer-Platz at 6:30 p.m. in the car-free city center. The event includes a fun run without timing and a main race with age-group rankings. A colorful supporting program featuring music, food, and drinks adds to the atmosphere of the city and cultural festival.
course_highlights: Run through the car-free city center of Bergisch Gladbach
Start and finish at Konrad-Adenauer-Platz in the city center
Traditional opening event of the city and cultural festival
additional: Fun run without timing or age-group rankings. Main race with rankings for all age groups, starting with the 2014 age group, in accordance with the 2025 German Athletics Rules. Certificates for all participants are available online. Awards ceremony at around 9 p.m. Special awards go to the largest registered group and the youngest and oldest participants. Distances: 3 km and 9 km. Online registration. Timing with a MikaTag transponder. Supporting program with music and food.

name: Bergneustädter AggerEnergie- und Sparkassen Nachtlauf
location: Bergneustadt, Oberbergischer Kreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Bergneustädter AggerEnergie- und Sparkassen Nachtlauf is an evening running event in Bergneustadt, Germany, held on a Friday after nightfall. The program offers several running and walking options, including a flat 3.7 km course, a 5.4 km relay, a 5.4 km run, and a 10 km run. All races start and finish at the same locations, making the event family-friendly and easy to follow. Children’s and youth competitions round out the program, making the evening appealing to local clubs, young runners, walkers, relay teams, and adults looking for a short but intensive evening run.
course_highlights: Flat 3.7 km course as a gentler option
Hilly 5.4 km and 10 km courses
Shared start and finish area for all races
additional: The event takes place on Friday evening after nightfall. It is designed to be compact, making it easy for families and supporters to follow. Typical September weather is around 19 °C during the day and 10 °C at night, usually cloudy, with an average of 45 mm of precipitation. Family-friendly; children’s and youth competitions; September event with typical weather of around 19 °C high, 10 °C low, and 45 mm of precipitation.

name: Int. ENNI Citylauf Xanten
price_range: 40 Euro (5 km und 10 km), 25 Euro (Jahrgang 2010-2013 5 km), plus Pfand
description: The 31st Int. ENNI Citylauf Xanten takes place in Xanten and offers races over 1.5 km, 5 km and 10 km. The event is an established running event in the city of Xanten and is open to runners of all ability levels. The race takes place in typical September weather, with mild temperatures and mostly cloudy skies. The route runs through the city and offers varied scenery.
course_highlights: Distances: 1.5 km, 5 km and 10 km
Route through the city of Xanten
Typical September weather, with mild temperatures and cloudy skies
additional: Please check the event details with the organizer before registering. Races in Moers, Sonsbeck, Neukirchen-Vluyn and Xanten; T-shirt included; rankings based on gun times

name: Ipsheimer Weinberglauf
location: Ipsheim, Neustadt an der Aisch-Bad Windsheim, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Ipsheim Vineyard Run is a traditional race held on the second Friday in September in the picturesque Ipsheim vineyards. It offers various events for schoolchildren and recreational runners, as well as the main race over a distance of approx. 5,800 m. The course is well marked and runs through the vineyards, offering a wonderful view of the Aisch Valley. After the race, participants can relax with refreshments and wine at the awards ceremony at the Weinberghaus. The race has become a sporting highlight, with almost 400 participants.
course_highlights: Race routes through the Ipsheim vineyards
Excellent views over the Aisch Valley in the finish area
Routes marked with colored arrows and distance markers
additional: Race number collection from 16:00 on race day in the start area below the Ipsheim vineyards. Race numbers must be worn on the front of the chest. All participants receive a high-quality technical T-shirt as a gift. Showers are available at the Ipsheim festival hall. Toilets are located in the start area and at the Weinberghaus. Free refreshments in the start area, during the main race, and at the finish. Clothing transport from the start to the finish for all races. Shuttle bus from the finish to the showers and the Weinberghaus, with shuttle service to the parking lot every half hour from 20:00. Parking at the start is available in a lit parking lot; parking in the vineyards is prohibited. Awards ceremony after the main race at the Weinberghaus, with wine and refreshments. Terrain in the vineyards, online registration, medals, T-shirts, refreshments, shuttle service, parking in Ipsheim

name: monte mare-Firmenlauf
description: The monte mare Corporate Run in Andernach is an attractive corporate running event. The course is a circuit through the picturesque Rhine gardens of Andernach and gives runners and walkers born in 2010 or earlier the opportunity to compete. In addition to the main race, there is a youth race for the U14 and U16 age groups. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and professional timekeeping using single-use transponders.
course_highlights: Circuit through Andernach’s Rhine gardens
Corporate Run distance: approx. 5.6 km (three laps plus the finishing straight)
Youth race: approx. 2.0 km, finishing at the Rheintor
additional: Start times: 16:30 Rasselstein Youth Run, 17:00 Raser Run, 17:40 Hobby Run, 18:30 Leisure Run. Timekeeping uses single-use transponders attached to the race bib (gun time). Tents and catering can be booked, with equipment available including beer-garden benches, tables, a power connection and a refrigerator. The run is a charity event, with part of the entry fees donated to good causes, and online registration is available. Tent and catering options and training information are also available.

name: SportScheck RUN Köln
organizer: Motor Presse Hamburg GmbH & Co. KG Verlagsgesellschaft
description: The SportScheck Run Cologne is an atmospheric night run that gives runners the chance to experience Cologne after dark. Participants traditionally start on the Rheinboulevard and run either 5 km or 10 km through the city center, passing historic landmarks such as the Town Hall and enjoying an impressive view of Cologne Cathedral illuminated at night. The event is part of Germany’s largest and longest-running city race series and offers an unforgettable atmosphere, with refreshments at the finish and a finisher’s medal.

name: Lauf der Bildung Aschersleben
description: The Lauf der Bildung in Aschersleben is a family-friendly city race on Friday evening, starting and finishing at Augustapromenade. The course passes through the historic city wall area and offers distances of 2.3 km, 4.6 km and 9.2 km for children, recreational runners and ambitious runners completing multiple laps. The event is part of the Solvay Cup and attracts both club runners and local families. The atmosphere is small and welcoming, and the event is well organised by the Kreisvolkshochschule Aschersleben.

name: Garmin Ultra Race Radków 2026
distance_verbose: 159 km, 79 km, 56 km, Maraton, 24 km, Półmaraton, 10 km
description: Garmin Ultra Race Radków 2026 is a mountain trail race held in the picturesque surroundings of the Table Mountains, near Radków Reservoir. The courses pass through rocky mazes, technical trails, and beautiful rock formations such as Szczeliniec Wielki and Błędne Skały. The event attracts both beginners and experienced ultramarathon runners, offering a range of distances and a unique atmosphere close to nature. Radków is an ideal place for a sporting adventure and a chance to recharge amid nature.

name: Okolo Kolovrat
description: Běh Okolo Kolovrat je tradiční závod, který vás provede krásným okolím Kolovrat, včetně sousedních obcí Uhříněvsi, Lipan a části Říčan. Nabízí trasy 11 km a 21 km, přičemž kratší trať lze absolvovat i ve dvoučlenné štafetě. Tratě vedou převážně po polních, lučních a lesních cestách lemovaných stromy, což zaručuje nádherné běžecké zážitky v přírodě. Závod je vhodný pro všechny běžce, kteří chtějí zlepšit svůj čas nebo si zaběhnout osobní traťový rekord.

name: ČEZ RunTour Brno
description: ČEZ RunTour Brno je rodinný běžecký závod konaný u Brněnské přehrady, který nabízí tratě pro všechny věkové kategorie od dětí až po zkušené běžce. Na výběr jsou tratě o délkách 500 m, 1 km, 3 km, 5 km, 10 km a půlmaraton (21,1 km). Závod je známý svou přátelskou atmosférou, kvalitním zázemím a doprovodným programem pro celou rodinu. Každý účastník obdrží startovní balíček a přispívá charitě. ČEZ RunTour je ideální příležitostí pro hobíky i elitní běžce, kteří chtějí zažít radost z běhu v krásném prostředí Brněnské přehrady.

name: Běh na Boží horu
description: Běh na Boží horu je tradiční závod v Ivančicích, který představuje výzvu v podobě běhu do 109 schodů na Boží horu. Účastníci startují jednotlivě v časovém intervalu jedné minuty, což zajišťuje plynulý průběh závodu. Akce je součástí bohaté nabídky aktivit pořádaných Střediskem volného času Ivančice, které má dlouholetou tradici a podporu města. Závod je vhodný pro širokou veřejnost a nabízí jedinečný sportovní zážitek v atraktivním prostředí.

name: Běh Kovohutěmi
description: Běh Kovohutěmi je tradiční běžecký závod pořádaný v Lhotě u Příbramě, který se koná již od roku 1967. Tento závod nabízí hlavní trať dlouhou 12 km a také závody pro děti a mládež. Akce se koná na stadionu TJ Kovohutě a je oblíbená mezi běžci všech věkových kategorií. Každoročně přitahuje mnoho účastníků a je součástí Brdského běžeckého poháru.

name: Strojařská desítka
location: Správa údržby silnic Zlínského kraje, Zlín, Česko
description: Strojařská desítka je tradiční silniční běžecký závod ve Zlíně, který se koná již 42. rokem. Závod nabízí 10 a 5 kilometrů dlouhé tratě s převýšením 153 metrů na certifikované obrátkové trase vedoucí mezi zlínským Majákem, rozcestím U Boudy, Salaší a zpět. Start je vždy v 10 hodin u sídla Správy údržby silnic na ulici K Majáku. Závod je vhodný pro širokou veřejnost a běžce všech kategorií, kteří si chtějí zazávodit v krásném prostředí Zlína.

name: Běh přátelství Klenčí pod Čerchovem - Waldmünchen
location: Klenčí pod Čerchovem, Plzeňský kraj, Česko
description: Běh přátelství Klenčí pod Čerchovem - Waldmünchen je součástí běžeckého seriálu Běžec Chodska, který nabízí pestrou škálu závodů v okolí Chodska. Tento závod se koná v malebném prostředí Klenčí pod Čerchovem a přitahuje běžce všech věkových kategorií. Trasa je vhodná pro milovníky přírody a běhu v terénu, přičemž atmosféra závodu podporuje přátelské setkání běžecké komunity. Seriál Běžec Chodska je známý svou tradicí a kvalitní organizací, která zajišťuje příjemný zážitek pro všechny účastníky.

name: Bezdězský půlmaraton
description: Bezdězský půlmaraton je běžecký závod konaný v malebném prostředí Máchova kraje v okolí hradu Bezděz. Nabízí dvě trasy s délkou přibližně 13,6 km a 21,2 km s převýšením 200 až 300 metrů, vedoucí lesními cestami, pěšinami a krátkými úseky po asfaltu. Závod je vhodný pro širokou veřejnost a je doplněn dětskými závody. V areálu je zajištěno občerstvení, úschovna zavazadel, WC a vyhlášení výsledků s tombolou. Kapacita je omezena na 500 startujících, což zaručuje příjemnou atmosféru a kvalitní zázemí.

name: 7 pohoří Krkonoše
description: Trail Run Seriál 7 pohoří je největší akcí svého druhu v Česku, která vás provede sedmi nejkrásnějšími a nejtěžšími horskými masivy. Závody nabízejí technické traily s epickými výhledy a atmosférou, kterou jinde nezažijete. Ať už jste zkušený horský běžec, nebo začátečník, 7 pohoří prověří vaši sílu, vůli a odhodlání. Pokořte všechny pohoří a staňte se legendou trailového běhu.

name: Běh k Mohyle Hanče a Vrbaty
description: Běh k Mohyle Hanče a Vrbaty je tradiční horský běh konaný v Krkonoších, který startuje na Bílém mostě přes Labe ve Špindlerově Mlýně a končí u Mohyly Hanče a Vrbaty. Trasa dlouhá 9 km s převýšením 696 metrů vede převážně po asfaltu a terénu, nabízí krásné výhledy a nezapomenutelné zážitky. Závod je zařazen do Českého poháru v běhu do vrchu a je vhodný pro širokou škálu běžců v různých věkových kategoriích. Po závodě je možnost občerstvení a tomboly, a také využití veřejné dopravy zpět ze závěru trasy.

name: ČEZ RunTour Ostrava

price_tiers.distance: Dětské závody Lupilu 500 m a 1000 m

description: ČEZ RunTour Ostrava je součástí populární běžecké série, která nabízí závody pro všechny věkové kategorie a výkonnostní úrovně. Na závodníky čekají tratě od dětských běhů přes 3, 5, 10 km až po půlmaraton. Akce se koná v unikátním prostředí Dolní oblasti Vítkovice a nabízí rodinnou atmosféru s bohatým doprovodným programem. Každý účastník obdrží startovní balíček a přispívá charitě. ČEZ RunTour je ideální pro hobíky i elitní běžce, kteří si chtějí užít radost z běhu a kvalitní servis.
course_highlights: Tratě 3, 5, 10 a 21,1 km v unikátním industriálním prostředí Dolní oblasti Vítkovice
Dětské běhy na 500 a 1000 metrů s doprovodným hlídáním v dětském koutku
Občerstvovací stanice na trasách 5 km, 10 km a půlmaratonu, oficiální gymsack s dárky
additional: Na závodě je k dispozici zdravotnický tým a vodiči, kteří pomáhají běžcům dosáhnout cílového času. V cíli je občerstvení pro všechny běhy, včetně dětských. Pro děti je připraven dětský koutek s hlídáním a rozcvičky. Na závodech lze zapůjčit běžecké boty od partnera. Startovní balíček obsahuje dárky od partnerů, děti dostávají speciální balíček od společnosti Lidl. Program zahrnuje také dětské běhy na 500 a 1 000 m.

name: Volvo Tierparklauf
description: The Volvo Tierparklauf takes place at Berlin Zoo and is especially family-friendly and suitable for beginner runners. The course runs through the zoo, past various animals such as monkeys and flamingos, and offers a unique atmosphere with free admission for participants and their companions. The event is part of the popular Berlin läuft! series and is known for its animal-themed atmosphere and comprehensive race pack.
course_highlights: Course through Berlin Zoo with views of monkeys, flamingos and other animals
Free admission to the zoo for participants and their companions
Running festival for the whole family on the event grounds
additional: Timing is recorded using a transponder attached to the shoe. Participants receive a comprehensive race pack, with refreshment points, toilets, an online certificate and free admission to the zoo. Groups of 15 or more receive a 10% discount and can collect their race packs together. Late entries are possible up to one hour before the start. Additional services such as event shirts, medal engraving and HD finish-line videos can be booked. Free admission, run through Berlin Zoo, family-friendly, course passes animals

name: Freiberger Herbstlauf
location: Platz der Einheit, Freiberg, Saxony, Germany
description: The Freiberger Autumn Run is a traditional race through Freiberg’s municipal forest, starting at 10:00 a.m. at Platz der Einheit. The varied program offers races for the whole family, including Bambini and children’s races, Nordic walking, distances from 2 km to the half marathon, a company relay, and the Einfach?Mensch!Lauf. The varied routes lead through the surrounding forests and include some climbs, making the race particularly appealing.
course_highlights: Route through Freiberg’s municipal forest
Start and finish at the Platz der Einheit sports venue
Varied routes with some climbs
additional: Activities for the whole family include Bambini and children’s races, Nordic walking, a company relay, and a one-wheel race. Distances range from 400 m to the half marathon. Start and finish at the Platz der Einheit sports venue. Multiple events include the half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, children’s races, Nordic walking, a one-wheel race, and team competitions; the event takes place in the municipal forest and at Platz der Einheit.

name: Lauf in den Herbst
description: The Putzbrunn Autumn Run is a DLV-approved public race organized by the sports club’s gymnastics department. It offers running opportunities for all age groups and ability levels, with distances from 1.5 km to 10.7 km. A special feature is the inclusive nature of the race, which welcomes people with different abilities. Alongside sporting competition, the event emphasizes community and the fun of running.
course_highlights: Distances: 1.5 km, 5.3 km, and 10.7 km
Inclusive race with participants from Lebenshilfe and Frame Runner
Age-group rankings and team rankings
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 12:00 at the Putzbrunn triple gymnasium. Late entries are possible on the day of the event until 30 minutes before the respective race. Certificates will be handed out on site and made available as PDFs the following day. Special prizes are awarded to the fastest runners and the oldest participants. Refreshments and changing facilities are available on site. Courses are available for different age groups; registration by email; no advance registration required.

name: Nordhorner Meile
location: Nordhorn, Grafschaft Bentheim, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Nordhorner Meile is the largest running event in the Grafschaft Bentheim, with more than 2,000 participants. The varied 5 km and 10 km courses run along the Verbindungskanal and through Nordhorn city centre, finishing at the Alte Kirche am Markt. In addition to elite runners and recreational athletes, more than 1,500 students from the region take part. The event is known for its lively atmosphere, with more than 3,000 spectators cheering runners along the course.
course_highlights: Varied 5 km and 10 km courses
Route along the Verbindungskanal and through Nordhorn city centre
Finish at the Alte Kirche am Markt
additional: Online registration is available exclusively via the website. The event also includes student races and is part of the new Grafschafter running series. More than 3,000 spectators create a special atmosphere along the course. The event is open to runners of all abilities, from recreational runners to competitive athletes.

name: Schwarzenbacher Ausdauertag 2026
location: Sportzentrum Turnerheim, Schwarzenbach an der Saale, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Schwarzenbach Endurance Day offers a varied program of running and walking events for all age groups. From the Bambini Run and schoolchildren’s run to the Fun Run, 10 km run and half marathon, there is something for every ability level. The start and finish are at the Turnerheim Sports Center in Schwarzenbach an der Saale. Refreshment stations with water and bananas are available along the course and in the finish area. At the finish, participants can enjoy a buffet with fruit, water and cake. Timing is provided by a disposable chip in the race bib, except for the Fun Run and Bambini Run.
course_highlights: A variety of running and walking events for all age groups
Start and finish at the Turnerheim Sports Center
Refreshment stations with water and bananas along the course and at the finish
additional: The event takes place in the Upper Franconia region and offers a mix of running and walking courses as well as a family-friendly supporting program.

name: VL Rund um Weitersburg und 19. Weitersburg Halbmarathon
description: The VL Rund um Weitersburg and the 19th Weitersburg Half Marathon are local running events in Weitersburg, organized by the running team of SV Weitersburg. The event offers both a traditional fun run and the full half-marathon distance of 21.1 kilometers. The club fosters a friendly village-club atmosphere with regular training, summer barbecues, and other running events throughout the year. Beginners and those returning to running are very welcome. The motto is “Just keep running!”
course_highlights: Fun run and half marathon over a distance of 21.1 km
Event in the municipality of Weitersburg with a friendly village-club atmosphere
Regular training at the Weitersburg sports field
additional: The SV Weitersburg running team offers training twice a week at the sports field. The event takes place in typical September weather, around 19 °C with mostly cloudy skies. There is a village-club atmosphere, with a summer barbecue, a Fun Run in September, and a season finale in November. Running event with distances from 200 m to 21 km, including a half marathon; organized by a local club, with regular training and a village-club atmosphere.

name: 10-Teiche-Marathon
description: The 10 Ponds Marathon in Hahnenklee is a scenic marathon held in September as part of the HarzerWanderWochen. The course takes runners through the Upper Harz, offering the chance to experience the region’s natural beauty and numerous ponds. The event is part of a ten-day hiking program featuring a variety of activities and live music. The marathon is a special challenge for runners who appreciate combining athletic achievement with enjoying nature.

name: 3. Wunstorfer Citylauf
description: The Wunstorf City Run is a running event in the city center of Wunstorf, organized by TuS Wunstorf. The race starts and finishes in front of the town church, which serves as the event hub. There are various distances, from a 400-meter Bambini run and several children’s and youth races to the 10-kilometer main race. The course is a 1,400-meter loop through the city center, run a different number of times or in a modified format depending on age group and distance. The City Run thus offers suitable races for runners of all ages and ability levels.

name: Fichtl-Fun-Run
description: The Fichtl-Fun-Run is an annual running event in Fichtenberg that is aimed particularly at children aged 6 to 11. Training for the run includes playful activities, running games, obstacle courses, and athletic exercises, held both outdoors and in the community hall. The event promotes community and enjoyment of sport in a family-friendly atmosphere. The run is organized by Sportkameradschaft Fichtenberg e.V., a long-established club with a wide range of sports.

name: Freisinger Volksfestlauf 2026
description: The Freising Volksfest Run takes place at the Volksfest grounds and in the adjacent Isar meadows, offering a varied course with a festival atmosphere. There are different distances for children and young people, as well as 5 km and 10 km main races. The races run mostly on gravel paths, with short sections of asphalt, and offer a special atmosphere as they pass right through the Volksfest. New glass trophies are awarded to every first-place finisher as a lovely tradition, and all participants receive attractive prizes and certificates.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Volksfest and the Isar meadows
Mostly gravel paths with short sections of asphalt
Loop course: 2 laps for 5 km and 4 laps for 10 km
additional: Payment is accepted exclusively by SEPA direct debit for online registration. There is a team competition, with 4 runners per team. Every adult receives a high-quality running cap; children receive a gingerbread-heart medal and a free water bottle. Every participant receives a voucher from sports freising for a water bottle, a towel or socks. The award ceremony takes place at around 17:00 in the beer tent, with awards presented by the mayor.

name: Gassenlauf 2026
description: The Gassenlauf in Großrückerswalde is a sporting highlight in the Ore Mountains and will take place for the 17th time in 2026. The event offers several race distances, including the 10.4 km main race and the 6 km Gassenlauf light, as well as Nordic walking and walking. The course leads from the Großrückerswalde sports grounds to the wind turbines above the Alter Gericht and offers a festive atmosphere with refreshments, a finish-line video, and an outdoor awards ceremony. The Gassenlauf is part of the Westsachsen Laufcup and a meeting place for sport, community, and joie de vivre.

name: Gaisenheimer Rhein-Wein-Lauf
description: The Rhein-Wein-Lauf in Geisenheim is a traditional running event that welcomes runners of all ages. It offers various distances, from children’s races to the 10.38 km main race, which takes runners through the picturesque Rheingau region. The races feature varied routes with short and long loops, appealing to both recreational and competitive runners. The event emphasizes a family-friendly atmosphere, with separate age-group rankings and prizes such as medals for children and bottles of wine for age-group winners.

name: KlosterLauf Wiedenbrück
description: The KlosterLauf in Rheda-Wiedenbrück is a special running event being held for the fourth time. The start and finish are at Wiedenbrück Monastery, and the races follow two scenic circular routes through the town. The event is for both ambitious runners and anyone who enjoys the camaraderie and fun of running. Community and the joy of running are at the heart of this sporting highlight.

name: Lauf mit - Isingen 2026
description: Lauf mit! Isingen 2026 is a cross-country running event in the beautiful countryside around Isingen in the Swabian Alb. The event offers various disciplines, including the Crosslauf-Strong, covering 8.1 km with 200 metres of elevation gain; the Crosslauf-Light, covering 4.8 km with 100 metres of elevation gain; and the Molkekär-Kälble Kidsrun for children. The courses are well marked and take runners through scenic natural surroundings. All participants receive chip timing with an integrated transponder, access to refreshment stations and a certificate. All Kidsrun participants also receive a medal. The event also promotes team spirit with a group competition called the “euroTECH Team Battle”.

name: Neubrandenburger Staffelmarathon (LC/NLC)
description: The Neubrandenburg Relay Marathon is a long-standing relay competition held in Neubrandenburg. The event is organized by SV Turbine Neubrandenburg e.V. and gives runners the opportunity to tackle the marathon distance together as teams. The start is at 9:30 a.m., and the event runs until around 2:30 p.m. The club’s running group organizes the event and looks forward to welcoming many participants.

name: Rudelsburglauf
description: The Rudelsburglauf is a long-standing running event along the Rudelsburg near Bad Kösen, organized by LG Rudelsburg 1995 Bad Kösen e.V. The race takes place annually and gives runners of all ability levels the opportunity to experience the beautiful local region together. The event is a highlight in the club’s calendar and combines a sporting challenge with an experience of nature. Information about the race details and registration is published in good time before the event.

name: Run of Hope
description: The Run of Hope is an annual charity event in Kronach that brings together runners of all ages to fight cancer together. The event offers various distances, including Nordic walking and a fun run, and takes place on the LGS grounds in Kronach. Starting at 12:00, participants can enjoy a sporting yet supportive atmosphere made possible by generous sponsors and dedicated volunteers. The race combines athletic effort with social commitment and invites everyone to make a difference with every step.

name: Schledehausener Berglauf
