description: The Schledehausener Berglauf is a 10-hour hill-running event in Schledehausen, part of Bissendorf, Germany. The race starts and finishes at the Schledehausen sports hall. The goal is to climb and descend a short hill as many times as possible, accumulating the most elevation gain within the time limit. The course is 700 metres long and has an elevation gain of 32 metres, with an average gradient of 10%. There are individual, relay and team categories. Omas on Tour organises the race as a charity event in support of HelpAge Deutschland e. V.

name: Spiegelsbergelauf
description: The Spiegelsbergelauf in Halberstadt offers varied running routes for all ability levels. The 14 km route passes over the Gläserner Mönch and, with its elevation gain and terrain, is a real challenge. The 8 km loop around the Jagdschlösschen combines speed and nature, while the 4 km route through the Spiegelsberge offers a relaxed introduction to racing. The youngest runners can take part in a 400 m fun run. The event is organized by SwimBikeRun Halberstadt e.V. and takes place at the Sportanlage Friedensstadion.

name: SÜDTHÜRINGENTRAIL
description: The SÜDTHÜRINGENTRAIL is a welcoming trail race in the beautiful surroundings of Suhl, celebrating its anniversary edition. The route follows some winding paths away from the main artery of the Thuringian Forest, past clear streams, dark valleys, and glistening ridgelines. The event offers an unforgettable experience in nature with spectacular views and is part of the SüHLER BÜCHSEN CUP. All finishers on the longer distances earn ITRA/UTMB® qualifying points.

name: ULTRAMARATHON DM im 100km-Straßenlauf
description: The 38th German 100 km Ultramarathon Championships will take place at Wartenberg Stadium in Berlin-Wartenberg. This road race is a demanding long-distance event that requires endurance and mental strength. The event is aimed at experienced ultrarunners and offers an official championship atmosphere under the auspices of the German Athletics Association. Participants can look forward to professional organization and an athletic challenge.

name: Unstrutlauf
description: The Unstrut Run is a versatile running event in Dingelstädt, offering suitable distances for all ability levels, from 2 km to the half marathon (21.1 km). The varied routes follow the Unstrut and feature scenic highlights, paved cycle paths and short climbs. Drinks, fruit and bratwurst are provided. All proceeds are donated to charitable projects in the region, giving the event a special social character.

name: Niedermeiserer Dorflauf
description: The Niedermeiser Village Run is a running event organized by TSV 1864 Niedermeiser e.V. and held in Liebenau/Niedermeiser. The races take place around Bodenberg, with distances ranging from 400 meters to 18.5 kilometers. Walking and Nordic walking events over various distances are also offered. The start and finish are at the sports ground in Niedermeiser, where race packets are also distributed. The event is approved by the Hessian Athletics Association and is conducted in accordance with the applicable regulations.

name: 10. PKO Bieg Charytatywny
description: The 10th PKO Charity Run is a nationwide initiative that combines sporting excitement with tangible support for an important social cause: the mental health of children and young people. The event will take place throughout Poland, encouraging participants to run together and take action for their communities. Every lap, kilometre and minute on the course matters, highlighting the spirit of community and support. This anniversary edition invites runners to take part and show their support.

name: Bieg 7 Dolin
description: Bieg 7 Dolin is a 100 km mountain ultramarathon held in the scenic Sądecki Beskids, starting and finishing in Piwniczna-Zdrój. The course follows challenging mountain trails with significant elevation gain, offering participants exceptional views and a chance to connect with nature. The race is part of the Running Festival, which combines sporting competition with promoting the region and an active lifestyle. The time limit for completing the course is 19 hours, and aid stations and drop bags are available along the route. It is a challenge for experienced mountain runners looking to take on demanding but beautiful terrain.

name: IX Bieg o Puchar Miasteczka Siewierz Jeziorna
description: The 9th Race for the Siewierz Jeziorna Town Cup is an annual running event held in the picturesque town of Siewierz. The race attracts runners from various categories, offering the chance to compete on courses suited to different levels of experience. It is a great opportunity to spend time actively outdoors and connect with the local community.

name: 5 Aktywna Piątka
location: Frydek, Gmina Miedźna, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Aktywna Piątka Run is an annual running event held in Frydek, in the Miedźna Municipality. The 5 km course is certified by the Polish Athletics Association, ensuring its accuracy and fast nature. The event also hosts the Silesian Voivodeship 5 km Road Running Championships. A Family Run for children and young people up to 15 years old is also part of the event, making it appealing to whole families.
course_highlights: Exactly 5 km of asphalt course, certified by the Polish Athletics Association
Course marked every 1 km, with a hydration point and water-spray arches
Fast, flat road course; start at 189C Modowa Street
additional: The main race is limited to 600 participants. The top five women and men in the OPEN classification receive awards. The Family Run has three distances for children and young people up to 15 years old. The course is marked every kilometre and has hydration points and water-spray arches.

name: Bieg przez Most – Białołęcka Triada Biegowa
II Ćwiartka Drzymały
location: Miasteczko Krajeńskie, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Leszczyński Festiwal Sportu – Półmaraton Leszczyński C&C Partners
Orawski Półmaraton Rysim Tropem
location: Lipnica Wielka, Nowy Targ County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: XIII Razem do Celu
location: Oleszka, Zdzieszowice Municipality, Opole Voivodeship, Poland

name: XVII Bieg o Puchar Wójta Gminy Sieroszewice
location: Sieroszewice, Sieroszewice Municipality, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: XVIII Bieg Papieski
location: Służewo, Aleksandrów Kujawski County, Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Nočný beh mestom Lučenec
description: The Night Run Through Lučenec is a night race along the illuminated streets of Lučenec, covering a distance of 4.5 km. The event is open to the general public, including juniors and adults, with categories by age and gender. It is organized by the City of Lučenec and OZ Novohrad and takes place near the Synagogue, with electronic timing and chip technology. The start is scheduled for 19:30. Participants can expect a commemorative medal, a race number, refreshments, and an accompanying program.

name: Školáčik detský beh
description: Školáčik Children’s Run is a running event for children of various age groups, held in Lučenec near the synagogue. It is organized by the City of Lučenec and OZ Novohrad. The race is open to boys and girls aged 3 to 15 inclusive, including children with disabilities. The entry fee is symbolic and encourages children to take part in sports activities in the pleasant surroundings of the city.

name: Beh okolo Lysej
location: Lysá pod Makytou okr. Púchov, Lysá pod Makytou okr. Púchov, pri kultúrnom dome
description: Beh okolo Lysej is a traditional running race in the village of Lysá pod Makytou, offering various categories for children, juniors, women, and men by age. The race takes place by the cultural centre and is organised by Bežecký klub Lysá pod Makytou. The children’s start is at 11:00, categories E, women, and juniors start at 12:30, and men start at 13:00. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle in the region.

name: Behaj lesmi Topoľčianky
description: Behaj lesmi Topoľčianky is a night trail race in the beautiful wine-growing region of Topoľčianky. Runners will enjoy routes passing the Château Topoľčianky and Hrušov Castle, with forest paths and an atmosphere beneath the stars. The race is part of the Behaj lesmi series and is included in the international UTMB Index, adding to its prestige. There are two main distances: 11 km and 22 km. The course also features the Conti Speed Section, a timed segment with a valuable prize.

name: Marina Liptov RUN
location: Bobrovník, okres Liptovský Mikuláš, Bobrovník, okres Liptovský Mikuláš, Marina Liptov
organizer: Olympijský klub Liptova a rezort Marina Liptov
description: Marina Liptov RUN is a sports and leisure event set in the beautiful surroundings of the Marina Liptov resort near Liptovská Mara. This unique run combines nature with quality services in harmony with the four elements—fire, water, earth, and air. Runners can enjoy a peaceful and inspiring setting with views of the surrounding countryside and the chance to relax at the resort after the race. Marina Liptov is an ideal destination for athletes and families looking for an outdoor experience.

name: Lemešanská bežecká liga 3. Jesenné kolo
organizer: Obec Lemešany, Športová komisia obce Lemešany
description: The Lemešany Running League – 3rd Autumn Round is a running competition held in the village of Lemešany, in the beautiful surroundings of the Garden of Movement. The race is open to all age groups and ability levels, offering a pleasant atmosphere and the chance to enjoy sports outdoors. It is organised by the Garden of Movement, which provides quality facilities for sport and recreation.

name: Beh pre Labky jesenný špeciál
location: Košice, Košice, Košice - časť Kavečany, chata Hrešná
organizer: Únia vzájomnej pomoci ľudí a psov
description: The Run for Paws Autumn Special is a running event in Kavečany, Košice, near Hrešná Cottage, organised by the Union for Mutual Assistance of People and Dogs (UVP). The race is open to various categories, including women, men, children, and runners with dogs, including shelter dogs. The 5 km course offers a pleasant autumn atmosphere surrounded by nature. Registration is available online at a discounted price and on site for a higher fee. The event supports dog adoption and brings runners and animals together in a friendly setting.

name: Night run Michalovce
organizer: Mesto Michalovce, TAZS Michalovce, MSKS Michalovce, Fitko Michalovce, R M s.r.o.
description: Night Run Michalovce is a night running race held at Námestie osloboditeľov in Michalovce. The race offers three distances: 10 km, 5 km, and 3 km, suitable for different age groups and performance levels. The adult race starts at 19:00, and the children’s races begin at 17:00. The organizers are Mesto Michalovce, TAZS Michalovce, MSKS Michalovce, Fitko Michalovce, and R M s.r.o. The race is suitable for the general public looking to enjoy a sporting atmosphere in the city at night.

name: Okolo Muňáku
location: Munice u Hluboké nad Vltavou, Jihočeský
description: Okolo Muňáku je rodinný běžecký závod v Municích u Hluboké nad Vltavou, který nabízí pohodovou atmosféru a rychlou trať kolem Munického rybníka. Závod je součástí Jihočeského běžeckého poháru a je určený pro všechny věkové kategorie, včetně dětských běhů. Každý ročník podporuje charitativní organizaci Centrum Bazalka, kam putuje část startovného. Po závodě je připraven bohatý doprovodný program včetně tomboly a odměn pro nejrychlejší běžce.

name: Vrchlabský 1/2 Maraton
description: Vrchlabský městský 1/2 Maraton je první ročník půlmaratonu, který se koná v srdci Krkonoš na náměstí T. G. Masaryka ve Vrchlabí. Během závodu si účastníci užijí sportovní výzvu na asfaltové silnici, polních a lesních cestách, a zároveň kulturní program a přátelskou atmosféru. Kromě hlavního půlmaratonu jsou připraveny i kratší trasy 2 km a 9 km vhodné pro děti, juniory a rodiny s dětmi, které vedou městem a jeho vedlejšími uličkami. Akce spojuje běh, zážitky a komunitu a je spolufinancována Státním fondem životního prostředí ČR.

name: Forestova čtrnáctka
description: Forestova čtrnáctka je běžecký závod na 14 km trati v okolí Záluží u Plzně, který nabízí kombinaci polních, lesních a štěrkových cest s lehkým trailovým terénem. Závod je vhodný pro širokou veřejnost včetně dětí a mládeže, kteří mají start zdarma. Na závodníky čeká bohaté občerstvení, účastnická medaile a fotky ze závodu. Prezentace začíná v 9:00 a start je plánován do 9:45, přičemž závod se koná za každého počasí. Organizátor klade důraz na bezpečnost a zdravotní způsobilost účastníků, kteří startují na vlastní nebezpečí.

name: Králický Lískovec
description: Králický Lískovec je tradiční běžecký závod konaný v krásném prostředí vrchu Lískovec a jeho okolí v Králíkách, Pardubickém kraji. Závod nabízí různé tratě od krátkých dětských kategorií až po hlavní závod dlouhý 8 km, který je součástí ISCAREX poháru. Start hlavního závodu je v 11:30, přičemž dětské kategorie startují již od 10:30. Závod je vhodný pro širokou veřejnost a nabízí ceny pro vítěze v jednotlivých kategoriích. Přihlášky je možné podat na místě v den závodu od 8:00 do 9:45 hodin.

name: Kokořínský kros
description: Kokořínský kros je trailový běh konaný v malebné přírodě CHKO Kokořínsko, nedaleko Prahy. Závod nabízí tři hlavní trasy s délkami 15 km, 10 km a 5 km, které vedou romantickými roklemi a kolem unikátních pískovcových věží. Start i cíl jsou umístěny v areálu městských lázní ve Mšeně, kde je zajištěno zázemí včetně občerstvení a dětského koutku. Závod je vhodný pro všechny běžce, od začátečníků po zkušené, a nabízí bohaté kategorie s možností změny délky trasy i v den závodu.

name: Hostivařská 15°
description: Hostivařská 15 je rodinný trailový závod v přírodním prostředí Prahy Hostivaře, který nabízí zážitek více než jen výkon. Závod se koná v okolí přehrady, golfu a meandrů Botiče s převahou lesních cest a minimem asfaltu. Startuje se bez měřící techniky, vítězem se stává ten, kdo nejpřesněji odhadne svůj čas. Atmosféra je přírodní, pivovarská a vhodná pro všechny věkové kategorie včetně dětí.

name: 4Drun
description: 4Drun je tradiční běžecký závod pořádaný Sportovním klubem DDsport, z.s., který se koná v malebném prostředí Duban u Prostějova. Závod nabízí trať dlouhou 10,2 km vedoucí po okolí Duban, sousedních vesnicích a přilehlých cyklostezkách, kombinující asfaltové a krosové úseky. Součástí programu jsou také štafetový závod 2x5 km, rodinný běh na 4 km a dětské závody, což činí akci vhodnou pro všechny věkové kategorie. Během závodního dne je připraven bohatý doprovodný program a každý účastník obdrží pamětní medaili.

name: Internationaler Altenaulauf
description: The International Altenaulauf in Borchen is a long-standing race organized by SC Borchen 1926/32, Athletics Department. Held annually, the race is part of the Hochstift-Cup. Alongside the sporting competition, the event also supports a social cause: coffee and cake are offered free of charge, and donations are collected for Aktion Lichtblicke e.V. The event offers runners of different age groups and ability levels an appealing opportunity to take part.
course_highlights: Part of the Hochstift-Cup
A variety of distances for different age groups
A traditional race with a social commitment
additional: Coffee and cake are offered free of charge at the cake counter. Runners can register for distances online; the event also includes social activities such as coffee and cake, as well as donations for “Aktion Lichtblicke e.V.”

name: 6. DeisterCrossing Springe
description: DeisterCrossing is a nature-focused extreme experience in the wooded Deister hills near Springe. The event offers running and walking routes of 10 km, 21.1 km (half marathon) and 42.2 km (marathon), with challenging climbs, including the Deisterhölle, with 200 metres of elevation gain in one stretch. Participants enjoy a well-marked course with aid stations, places to sit and filled rolls for walkers. The event is all about consideration for others and enjoying nature, with awards for the fastest runners and a finisher’s gift as a souvenir.
course_highlights: Deisterhölle with 200 metres of elevation gain in one stretch
Marathon walk with an additional climb to Bielstein and the Deister ridge
Aid stations with places to sit and filled rolls
additional: Race bib collection from 7:15 a.m. at IGS Springe. Chip timing with a rental chip; return the chip to receive a wheat beer glass as a finisher’s gift. Showers and changing rooms in the IGS Springe sports hall. Parking at IGS, netto and BZE. Travel by S5 to Springe station, then a 10-minute walk to the Nord school centre. Awards ceremonies: 10 km and half marathon at 12:00, marathon at 14:30. Sew-on patches for walkers. Trail event with challenging terrain, refreshments at aid stations, and options for runners and walkers.

name: Braker hkk Lauf
description: The 19th Braker hkk Run takes place in Brake (Unterweser). It is a short running event with distances of 850 meters and 10 kilometers. The race offers an enjoyable running opportunity in typical September weather, with mild temperatures and mostly cloudy skies. Please check the exact event details directly with the organizer.
course_highlights: Distances: 850 m and 10 km
Typical September weather with approximately 19°C and 45 mm of precipitation
Start location in Brake (Unterweser)
additional: The race includes two distances: 850 meters and 10 kilometers. September weather is typically mild and cloudy, with an average of 45 mm of precipitation. The event usually takes place in comfortable temperatures of around 19°C. Participants should check the latest details with the organizer before registering.

name: Brückenlauf Halbmarathon Köln des ASV Köln
description: The ASV Köln Bridge Run Half Marathon is a long-standing 21.1-kilometre race that takes runners through the heart of Cologne, along the Rhine and across six of the city’s most beautiful bridges. The course offers spectacular views of the cathedral and the city, with an uplifting atmosphere and music along the route. Alongside the half marathon, shorter distances are available: the Kölsche Runde (11.11 km) and the Bambini Run (500 m), for beginners and children. The race combines a sporting challenge with Rhineland joie de vivre and is ideal for both ambitious and recreational runners.
course_highlights: 21.1 km along the Rhine with views of Cologne Cathedral
Cross six Cologne bridges, including the Hohenzollern Bridge and Rodenkirchen Bridge
Start and finish at the Chocolate Museum forecourt, with a lively atmosphere
additional: The Bridge Run is measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and is eligible for record lists. The LVN South-East regional championships take place as part of the half marathon. Registration is online, with on-site late registration available on the day of the event. The Kölsche Runde is ideal for beginners and recreational runners; the Bambini Run is for children aged 3–6. The start and finish are both at the Chocolate Museum forecourt. The event features music, commentary and a lively atmosphere along the route. The race starts in the Rheinauhafen and is part of the LVN South-East regional championships. Online registration is available, including a T-shirt for members. Entry fees vary by category.

name: Erzhäuser Heegbachlauf
description: The Erzhäuser Heegbachlauf is a long-standing running event that has been organised by the Kaltduscher in Erzhausen for almost 30 years. Its aim is to offer an affordable yet high-quality running experience for all ages and ability levels. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, careful organisation and iconic item of clothing as a souvenir. Despite modern timing and logistics, it retains its original spirit and strong sense of community.
course_highlights: Distances from 0.5 km to 6.4 km
Family-friendly atmosphere and iconic item of clothing
Charity run and community activities
additional: The event offers an iconic item of clothing (KKK) as a finisher’s souvenir, redesigned each year. The organisers take inspiration from major city marathons while keeping entry fees low. Long-standing sponsors support the event and help ensure it is delivered to a high standard. Iconic item of clothing, medals, modern logistics, online registration

name: Hattinger Hüttenlauf
description: The Hattinger Hüttenlauf is a traditional race in HenrichsPark in Hattingen, offering a range of running and walking distances for all age groups. The course follows paths surfaced with paving stones, water-bound gravel and asphalt, passing the park’s ponds. The start and finish are beneath Blast Furnace 3 at the LWL Industrial Museum Henrichshütte. Alongside the sporting competition, there are categories for Bambini, youth, the fun run and the 10 km Sparkasse Run, as well as awards for the largest groups and the fastest Hattingen runners. The event is family-friendly, and all participants can print their certificates online.
course_highlights: Course in HenrichsPark on paths surfaced with paving stones, water-bound gravel and asphalt
Start and finish beneath Blast Furnace 3 at the LWL Industrial Museum Henrichshütte
Course runs alongside the park’s ponds
additional: Late entries are possible up to one hour before the respective start. All Bambini race participants receive a medal. All participants can print their certificates online. Age-group categories are offered, with awards for the largest groups (schools and clubs) and the fastest Hattingen runners. Various running distances, online registration, supporters from the sports and business sectors.

name: Kiel Lauf
description: The Kiel.Lauf is a long-established running event in Kiel, with various competitions for all age groups. The main event is the half marathon, covering 21.1 kilometers through western Kiel and attracting both recreational runners and elite athletes. The 10.2-kilometer fun run is the event’s largest race by participation and offers a lap through Kiel city center with a great atmosphere. There are also shorter races for schoolchildren and Bambinis, making the event family-friendly.
course_highlights: The half marathon runs across western Kiel
The fun run goes through Kiel city center
A range of distances from approx. 0.7 km to 21.1 km
additional: The half marathon starts at 10:50 a.m. and the fun run at 09:45 a.m. Due to construction work, short-notice course changes may occur and will be announced in good time. The event is very popular, with more than 10,000 runners. There are various races for schoolchildren and Bambinis, making the event family-friendly. The event includes street closures and participant information, and offers technical running shirts for most categories.

name: LAUF FÜR MEHR ZEIT
location: Opernplatz, Frankfurt am Main, Hesse, Germany
description: The charity run LAUF FÜR MEHR ZEIT is a well-established sporting and social event in Frankfurt am Main. Recreational runners, elite athletes and celebrities compete together on a circuit through downtown Frankfurt. Alongside the sporting competition, fundraising and the joy of working together are at the heart of the event. The run offers five different distances for all age groups, from the Bambini run to the 10-kilometer run, with the start and finish at Opernplatz.
course_highlights: Circuit through downtown Frankfurt
5-kilometer course is one lap; 10-kilometer run is two laps
Water stations along the course provided by Frankfurter Laufshop
additional: Race bibs with electronic timing. The races take place one after another, each with its own timing, starting signal and finish.

name: Maiwaldlauf
description: The Maiwaldlauf in Rheinau-Freistett is a traditional community race organized by SV Freistett. The event offers runners and walkers an attractive route through nature around the Friedrich-Stephan-Stadion. The race is part of the Ortenauer Volkslaufserie and is open to recreational athletes of all ages. Its friendly atmosphere and well-organized proceedings make the Maiwaldlauf a popular event in the region.
course_highlights: Routes through the Maiwald forest and surrounding countryside
Start and finish at the Friedrich-Stephan-Stadion
Part of the Ortenauer Volkslaufserie
additional: The Maiwaldlauf includes various distances, including a 10 km run, a 5 km run, and walking. Detailed course maps and information about each route are available on the website. The event is part of the Ortenauer Volkslaufserie. It is organized by the Breitensport department of SV Freistett, with contacts including Alexander Dahlke and Regina Huber. The event takes place in September, when average temperatures are around 19°C, and offers Nordic walking and hiking as well as running events.

name: Meißner Berglauf mit Hess. Meisterschaft
description: The Meißner Mountain Run with the Hessian Championships is a traditional mountain race in the Werra-Meißner district, organized by Ski-Club Meißner. The course runs through the scenic countryside around Meißner-Abterode and offers runners a challenging route with varied terrain. The event attracts both competitive athletes and running enthusiasts from the region and is part of the North Hesse Running Cup standings.
course_highlights: A challenging mountain-running course in the Werra-Meißner district
Varied terrain with scenic sections
Part of the North Hesse Running Cup standings
additional: The Meißner Mountain Run is part of the Nordhessencup, a series of races held in North Hesse. The event is organized by Ski-Club Meißner, which also offers other sports activities, including athletics, a running group, and skiing.

name: Nibelungenlauf
description: The Nibelungenlauf in Worms is a long-standing running event held annually on the second Sunday in September. The event offers a varied program of races over different distances, alongside a cultural program on the banks of the Rhine near the Hagen Monument and Kriemhild’s Rose Garden. Since 2004, more than 44,000 participants from many nations have taken part, highlighting the event’s popularity and international character. The race welcomes beginners and professionals alike, creating a special running experience in the Nibelungen city.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the newly developed Rhine promenade, close to the Hagen Monument and Kriemhild’s Rose Garden
Three out-and-back courses with clearly marked routes: half marathon (blue), 10 km (red) and 5 km (green)
Run through the historic Nibelungen city of Worms, with enthusiastic spectators and a cultural program
additional: The event begins on Saturday with various activities and concludes on Sunday with the races and awards ceremony at the Hagen Monument. There is a team classification, and participants under 18 must provide consent from a parent or guardian. Event T-shirts and hoodies can be ordered during registration. The event often sells out before the registration deadline. The start and finish are at the Nibelungenlauf Arena on the Rhine.

name: Othaler Gutshof Lauf
distance_verbose: Halbmarathon, 10 km, 5 km, 2 km, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: The Othaler Gutshoflauf is a young but popular running event starting and finishing at the Youth and School Farm at Gutshof Othal. The event offers distances ranging from 0.5 km to the 21.1 km half marathon, which is known as the Intersport Liebig Half Marathon and passes through several villages. The race gives participants the chance to explore the eastern foothills of the Harz on varied routes. Around 350 runners take part each year, highlighting the event’s growing popularity.
course_highlights: Half marathon route through Sotterhausen, Holdenstedt, Klosterrode and Beyernaumburg
Start and finish area at the Youth and School Farm at Gutshof Othal
Distances ranging from 0.5 km to 21.1 km
additional: Start times: 09:00 half marathon, 09:45 10 km run/walk, 10:00 5 km run/walk, 10:05 0.5 km run, 10:15 1 km run, 10:30 2 km children’s race. Routes for children, recreational runners and competitive runners; start and finish area at the Youth and School Farm in Othal; supported by sponsors such as Intersport Liebig and Autohaus Liebe.

name: Rathaus Center Dessauer CityRUN
description: The 26th Dessauer Rathaus-Center CityRUN is a long-standing race in downtown Dessau that has attracted runners from the region and beyond for many years. The route follows a circuit through the city’s central streets, with the start and finish on Zerbster Straße near the Rathaus-Center. The race offers a sporting challenge in an urban setting and is part of a varied sports programme organised by Anhalt Sport e.V., which has been organising major sporting events in the region for decades.
course_highlights: Circuit through downtown Dessau
Start and finish on Zerbster Straße at the Rathaus-Center
Route along Steinstraße, Askanische Straße and Kavalierstraße
additional: Volksbank children’s race for children up to 9 years old over 1,000 metres, free for all children and schoolchildren from Dessau. The organiser is Anhalt Sport e.V., which has been organising numerous major sporting events in the region for over 20 years. Various distances, including children’s races; company race; on-site registration available; finisher medals

name: Seewooglauf
description: The Seewoog Run in Ramstein-Miesenbach is organized by FV Olympia Ramstein and offers 10 km and 5 km races as well as a 5 km walking event. The event is open to runners and walkers of all ability levels. The course runs through the scenic surroundings of Ramstein and offers a sporting challenge in a pleasant atmosphere.
course_highlights: 10 km and 5 km race courses
5 km walking course
Venue: Reichswaldsporthalle in Ramstein-Miesenbach
additional: Entry fees from €7, late registration available up to 30 minutes before the start, results online, small surprises for children’s races

name: Sindiso-Spendenlauf
location: Hof von Walter Jahn, Zeitlarn, Bavaria, Germany
price_range: 20 Euro für Laufshirt, Spenden ab 20 Euro für Teilnahme
description: The Sindiso Charity Run in Zeitlarn is a community event that brings together running, celebration, and fundraising. The event takes place at Walter Jahn’s farm and offers races for all ages, as well as a colorful festival with lots of attractions for children. Alongside the sporting experience, supporting the education project in Rabuor, Kenya, is a key focus. Food and drinks are available, and there is a variety of entertainment, including a children’s train, face painting, and vehicle displays.
course_highlights: 10 km run consisting of 2 laps of 5 km each
Attractions for children, including a children’s train and face painting
Vehicle display by Wasserwacht Neutraubling, Freiwillige Feuerwehr Laub, and BRK Barbing/Neutraubling
additional: The Sindiso running shirt can be purchased for €20 on race day after ordering through the online registration. There are races for different age groups and disciplines, including a 400 m farm run for toddlers, a 1.5 km children’s race, a 5 km run, a 10 km run, and 5 km Nordic walking. The event kicks off with a big party from 11:00 and offers a variety of food and refreshments, as well as a colorful program of activities. 10 km run (2 x 5 km), family activities, children’s program, vehicle display, donations for an education project in Kenya

name: TSG Altenhain 1900 e.V. - Wuzzelauf Altenhain
description: The Wuzzelauf Altenhain is an annual charity run held since 2008 and organized by TSG Altenhain 1900 e.V. It continues a local tradition in which residents of the Main-Taunus district referred to one another by nicknames, including “Wuzze” for people from Altenhain. The run combines sporting commitment with regional history and a sense of community. The event takes place and welcomes runners of all ages to participate in this special event.
course_highlights: Traditional connection to the region’s nickname culture
Run through the community of Altenhain in the Main-Taunus district
Charity event with local ties
additional: The event takes place annually on the second Sunday in September. Proceeds benefit various charitable causes, including support for people with disabilities in the Rhine-Main region. Registration and further details are available on the official website.

name: Volksbank-Münster-Marathon
description: The Volksbank-Münster-Marathon is a major running event organized by runners for runners, largely by volunteers and with great dedication. With around 12,000 participants, more than 300 artists and bands, and over 100,000 spectators along the course, this autumn marathon offers a unique atmosphere. The course is almost entirely flat and runs through the running- and cycling-friendly city of Münster. A red carpet is rolled out in the finish area on Prinzipalmarkt, making the finish a special experience.
course_highlights: Almost entirely flat course
More than 300 artists and bands along the course
Finish on a red carpet at Prinzipalmarkt
additional: The marathon is part of a major event featuring several races, including the Atruvia Staffelmarathon, Wecker-28 (28 km), Stadtwerke-Kids Marathon, Westfalen AG Charity-Lauf (10 km), and H+B technics-Gesundheitslauf (6 km). There is a combined ranking with the Enschede Marathon. The marathon office is open on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays from 9:00 to 15:00. A marathon guide with general information and FAQs is available. The marathon attracts around 12,000 runners, offers qualification opportunities for other races, and is supported by numerous sponsors. There are also accompanying events such as talks and health seminars.

name: Waldlauf des TuS Calle-Wallen - Volksbank Sauerland Laufcup
description: The 46th TuS Calle-Wallen Forest Run is part of the Volksbank Sauerland Running Cup and takes place in Meschede. The event offers 1 km and 10 km races and is open to runners of all ages. The race route passes through the wooded areas around Meschede and promises a varied course in a natural setting. Typical September weather is mild and mostly cloudy, ideal for running events.
course_highlights: Run through the wooded areas around Meschede
Distances of 1 km and 10 km
Natural and varied running course
additional: Typical September weather is around 19 °C, with lows of about 10 °C and an average of 45 mm of precipitation; skies are mostly cloudy. The event takes place in Meschede, with typical temperatures around 19 °C and cloudy skies. It is a great opportunity for the whole family to take part in a traditional race.

name: Wehratallauf
price_range: Hauptlauf 15 €, Nordic Walking 10 €, Schülerlauf kostenlos, Kindertallauf kostenlos
description: The Wehratallauf is a traditional running event held annually in September in Wehr since 1990. The event offers various races for all age groups, including a 10.2 km main race, 8.6 km Nordic walking, a 2.87 km student race and a 750 m children’s valley race. The courses run directly past the Frankenmatt Stadium and through the surrounding area. The event has a particular charitable focus, with part of the entry fees donated to the Förderverein für krebskranke Kinder Freiburg e.V.
course_highlights: 10.2 km main race through the area around Frankenmatt Stadium
8.6 km Nordic walking course
2.87 km student race and 750 m children’s valley race
additional: Late registration is possible up to 1 hour before the respective start (except for the children’s valley race) for an additional fee of €5. Electronic timing is provided by transponders integrated into the race bibs. Changing and shower facilities are available. There is a team competition and special prizes for clubs with the most participants. Parking is limited, especially on Industriestraße. Donations are also collected for children with cancer.

name: Wemdinger Stadtlauf
description: The Wemding City Run invites runners of all ages to explore Wemding’s historic old town and the scenic countryside on the edge of the Ries. A special highlight is the panoramic run to the Maria Brünnlein pilgrimage church, combining sporting challenges with impressive views. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and welcomes both experienced runners and beginners. Timing is handled electronically using transponders in the race bibs, and an awards ceremony takes place on the stage at the market square.
course_highlights: Run through Wemding’s historic old town
Panoramic run to the Maria Brünnlein pilgrimage church, with views across the Ries
Start and finish at the market square in the town centre
additional: Race-pack collection and late entries are available on the event day until 30 minutes before each start at the race office in the Geopark Information Centre at the market square. The children’s run has no timing or results list; all children’s and school races receive medals. Timing for the other races is handled using transponders in the race bibs. Parking is available at Johannisweiher, with access via Wolferstädter Straße. Various race distances, medals, non-cash prizes, group prizes, children’s and school races, group training before the event.

name: wep-Lauf
organizer: WEP Intersport Engels / Ralf Sester / TuS Jahn Hilfarth
description: The wepLAUF in Hückelhoven is a versatile sporting event with the feel of a family festival. Distances range from the marathon to short children’s races, including a Flexi-Marathon where participants can decide after each lap whether to continue. The start and finish area is on Breteuilplatz. Alongside the races, the event features a varied program with a bouncy castle, stage entertainment and stalls. The event especially encourages children and young people to take part through a school competition. Nearby streets are closed during the races, and free parking is available at Hückelhoven Center.
course_highlights: The marathon course is completed four times and the half-marathon course twice
Flexi-Marathon with a choice of distance and a certificate for the distance completed
Start and finish area on Breteuilplatz; streets are closed during the races
additional: The marathon traditionally starts as the first event of the day. The varied program includes a bouncy castle, stage entertainment and sponsors’ stalls. The schools with the most participants receive awards. Registration is open until September 10. The start and finish area is on Breteuilplatz. Free parking, changing rooms and showers are available, along with support for young runners and corporate relay teams.

name: 17. Parklauf Tangerhütte
description: The 17th Park Run Tangerhütte takes place in the idyllic Tangerhütte City Park and is part of the ELBE-OHRE-CUP race series in the north of Saxony-Anhalt. The event offers various distances for all age groups, including 1.1 km for young runners, 2.9 km for youth, and 5.4 km and 10.3 km for adults. The routes pass around Spiegelsee and by sights such as the New Palace and the Mausoleum. In the finish area, SV Germania Tangerhütte provides refreshments for participants, including grilled food, drinks, fruit, coffee, and cake.

name: 21. swb-Marathon Bremen
description: The 21st swb-Marathon Bremen is taking place, offering runners a varied running experience through Bremen. The start and finish are at Bremen’s Market Square. The course passes well-known sights including Werdersee, Weserwehr, Rhododendron-Park, the University, Bürgerpark, Überseestadt and Schlachte, and ends with a run through the Weserstadion. In addition to the marathon, there is also an AOK half marathon, a HIRSCH 10K race and an AOK children’s race. The event is aimed at both beginners and experienced runners and promises an unforgettable day of sport, with a great atmosphere and support from spectators.

name: 43. Internationalen Airport Race
description: The 43rd International Airport Race in Hamburg is taking place, offering a varied running experience around Hamburg Airport. The 10-mile race traditionally starts at 11:00 a.m. at the LSV sports grounds on Borsteler Chaussee. In addition to the main 10-mile race, there are also 5 km events and the Mini Airport Race. The unique airport setting offers ever-changing views and a special atmosphere.

name: Bitburger Stadtlauf
description: The Bitburger City Run takes place in Bitburg and offers an inclusive running event where recreational runners, people with disabilities, and competitive athletes can take part together. The event grew out of a desire for a great running event in Bitburg and promotes sporting competition in a friendly atmosphere. The start and finish are at St. Martin School, Kölner Straße 14. The event is part of the CITY SPORT Trier event calendar and warmly welcomes all running enthusiasts.

name: Brachter Depotlauf
description: The Brachter Depot Run is a guided cross-country run through the beautiful Brachter Depot, with different pace groups from 5:00 to 7:00 min/km. Various distances are offered, including a half marathon, 14 km, a 5 km beginner run, a children’s run (max. 2 km), and walking. The event emphasizes experiencing nature and social commitment: participation in the children’s run is free, and a starting donation will be collected on the day of the event. The runs are organized by TSF Bracht and Depotrunners Bracht and offer a varied route in a natural setting.

name: DeisterCrossing Springe
description: DeisterCrossing is a nature-focused endurance event that combines running and walking in the outstanding natural surroundings of the forested Deister mountain range. The event offers 10 km, 21.1 km, and 42.2 km courses for runners and walkers. The challenging routes pass through the Deisterhölle, including a continuous 200-meter elevation gain, and offer a unique nature and mountain experience near Hanover. The event has a relaxed atmosphere, with participants looking out for one another, and offers aid stations, finisher gifts, and an awards ceremony in addition to the sporting challenge.

name: Dübener Heidelauf
description: The Dübener Heide Run is a traditional forest race held at the scenic Obermühle in Bad Düben, a spa town in northern Saxony. The event is organized by SV Bad Düben and offers courses for children, teenagers, and adults. With distances ranging from 500 m to the half marathon (21.1 km), the race appeals to both young runners and experienced long-distance athletes. It is part of the regional athletics structure for northern Saxony and Leipzig and is known for its family-friendly, club-oriented character.

name: ebm-papst Marathon
description: The ebm-papst Marathon in Niedernhall is a long-standing running event taking place for the 29th time. The event offers various disciplines, including the marathon, half marathon, duo marathon, relay marathon, 10 km run, handbike and inline skating races, as well as children’s races and Nordic walking. The course runs through the region’s scenic countryside and offers a varied experience for runners of all abilities. In addition to the sporting competition, participants can enjoy a varied program of events featuring a show, childcare and a pasta party. Every finisher receives a medal and can download a free finish-line photo.

name: Eicklinger Volks- und Familielauf
description: The 1st Eicklingen Community and Family Run is aimed at active families who want to spend an enjoyable day running together. The focus is on fun and the joy of running, without the pressure of competition. The event offers a welcoming atmosphere for all age groups and encourages people to get active together.

name: Garbenteicher Volkslauf
description: The Garbenteich Volkslauf, organized by Sportverein 1928 Garbenteich e.V., is a traditional race in Pohlheim, known as a good training run for the Frankfurt Marathon. The course has been optimized for safety, so it no longer crosses any federal highways or railway lines. There are seven refreshment stations offering water, cola and tea, and excellent refreshments await participants after the race. Race bibs can be collected on the day of the event from 08:00 or the day before at the Sport- und Kulturhalle Garbenteich.

name: Hahnenfalzhüttenberglauf
description: The Hahnenfalzhüttenberglauf is a challenging mountain race that runs from Sägwasenplatz in Bad Herrenalb to the Hahnenfalzhütte. The course covers 6 kilometers with an elevation gain of 519 meters and includes steep ramps and gravel paths. The race is a traditional event organized by Skizunft Bad Herrenalb and offers runners a challenging and scenic route in the heights above the source of the Alb. The event combines a sporting challenge with a sociable hut festival at the Hahnenfalzhütte.

name: Holzlandlauf
description: The Holzlandlauf is a traditional race in the Holzland region near Hermsdorf, held every year on the second Saturday in September. Starting in 2026, the race will be part of the International Trail Running Association (ITRA), giving the courses international recognition and making runners’ performances visible worldwide. The event offers several distances, including 5 km, 11 km and a half marathon, through the beautiful natural landscape of the Holzland. The race welcomes both ambitious trail runners and recreational runners and offers a special atmosphere in the region.

name: Kristall Lauf Weißwasser
description: The Kristall-Lauf Weißwasser is a versatile popular race that welcomes runners and walkers of all ages. The course crosses mixed terrain, including asphalt, concrete, sand paths and forest trails with roots. The race is part of several regional competitions, including the Bezirksrangliste Dresden, the Sachsenenergie Läufer-Cup and the Niederlausitz-Cup. It also offers an official walking competition recognized by the German Athletics Association. A special feature is the traditional team race, which encourages community and team spirit.

name: Miltenberger Landkreis Lauftag
description: The Miltenberg District Running Day offers a variety of races for different age and ability groups. The routes pass through the Elsenfeld State Forest and along the former Spessart steam railway line, with scenic, mostly flat sections. All participants receive T-shirts, and the top runners are awarded prizes in kind. The event is ideal for runners looking for a well-organized race in a natural setting.

name: Run for life
description: The race starts at 2:00 p.m. in the forecourt of the Bavarian National Museum in Munich and follows a well-known route through the English Garden. The event is under the patronage of Munich’s Lord Mayor, Dominik Krause, and combines sporting commitment with social engagement.

name: runroll City
description: The runroll City event takes place in Bielefeld and offers a fast-paced sporting experience on a flat, 7.2-kilometer course through the heart of the city. The course is ideal for fast times and is suited to both intensive running training and a quick race. Participants can enjoy being active in an urban setting and become part of a dynamic event.

name: Zeuthener Jedermannslauf
description: The Zeuthen Jedermannslauf is a popular community run held every September in Zeuthen. It offers various races for all age groups, from Bambini to adults, with distances ranging from 400 m to 10 km. The event is family-friendly and promotes recreational sport in the region. The races start at Zeuthen S-Bahn station and follow a varied route along the forest promenade.

name: HochRhön-BergTrail
description: The HochRhön Mountain Trail is a challenging trail-running event in the picturesque uplands of the Hochrhön around Hilders. The event offers four trail distances from 7 km to 42 km, with varied routes through forests, along singletrack trails and forest roads, and across meadows. The races feature some steep climbs and wonderful views, particularly from Auerbergsee and Buchschirm. The event also supports a good cause, with part of the entry fees donated to the Malteser Children’s Hospice and Family Support Service in Fulda. The event is part of the regional Trailrunning Cup Rhön and also offers children’s races.

name: II Złotowska Dziesiątka
description: The II Złotowska Dziesiątka is a 10 km road race held in Złotów. The course consists of two 5 km loops and runs along the city’s picturesque streets. The event is a great opportunity for running enthusiasts to enjoy an active day and compete in a friendly atmosphere. The organizers ensure participants’ safety and the smooth running of the event.
course_highlights: The course consists of two 5 km loops
A road race in the center of Złotów
Scenic views and safe conditions on the course
additional: The race takes place over two 5 km loops. The organizer works with the relevant services to ensure the safety of runners, pedestrians, and drivers. The ZCAS office is located at al. Mickiewicza 18 in Złotów.

name: Poznań Track Day 2026
description: Tor Poznań Track Day is a series of exciting automotive events held at the Poznań race track. Participants can compete, train, and take part in qualifying rounds held throughout the 2026 season. The event is aimed at motoring enthusiasts and also offers the option to rent cars and take one-to-one lessons with instructors. It’s a great opportunity to experience the excitement of motorsport and hone your skills on a professional track.
course_highlights: Poznań race track with professional facilities
Opportunity to take part in various rounds and qualifying events during the 2026 season
Training options and one-to-one lessons with instructors
additional: You can rent a car for yourself to drive on the track or as a gift. The entry package includes participation by one team member, the option to take part in a co-drive (age >17), full catering, individual timing, and instructor-led training options. To confirm participation, payments must include the required wording in the payment reference.

name: XI Bieg Nadziei oraz VII Mistrzostwa Wielkopolski Prawników
description: The 11th Run of Hope and the 7th Greater Poland Lawyers’ Championships are annual running events held in Środa Wielkopolska. The event combines sporting competition with bringing together the region’s legal community. It attracts both professionals and amateurs, offering a unique atmosphere and an opportunity to spend time actively outdoors. Registration for the run is now open, and participants can expect a well-organized event with a long-standing tradition.
course_highlights: The course runs through the scenic areas of Środa Wielkopolska
The run combines competition with bringing together the legal community
Held annually and backed by a long-standing tradition

name: XRUN - Vistula Trail
description: Vistula Trail is a mountain trail race held in Wisła, offering a variety of distances, from short routes for beginners to demanding long-distance races. The routes follow scenic Beskid trails, with significant elevation gain and beautiful views. The event has a friendly atmosphere and welcomes both experienced runners and amateurs looking to spend time outdoors. The start and finish are located in the center of Wisła or in Ustroń, and the time limits allow for a comfortable race.
course_highlights: 40 km distance with 1,800 m of elevation gain, starting at 07:00 in Wisła
16 km route with 1,000 m of elevation gain, starting at the lower station of the Czantoria Rope Ski Resort
Shorter distances of 6 km and 4 km, with demanding climbs and fast descents
additional: The time limit is 9 hours for the 40 km route, 7 hours for 26 km, and 4 hours for 16 km. The races start on Sunday, 12.09.2027, except for the 4 km distance, which starts on Saturday at 13:00. The routes pass through the Czantoria Nature Reserve and the area around Bukowa Mountain. Children’s age categories include distances from 150 to 1,000 m. The race office is located in Wisła.

name: 16 Bieg Częstochowski
description: The 16th Częstochowa Run is a road race taking place in the center of Częstochowa. The 10 km course runs along the city’s main avenues, including the area around Jasna Góra, giving the race a special prestige. The race has an official course certification, attracting runners focused on a fast pace and setting personal bests. It’s an excellent opportunity for sporting competition in scenic urban surroundings.
course_highlights: 10 km course through the center of Częstochowa
Route passes near Jasna Góra
Officially certified course
additional: A structured training plan tailored to the 10 km distance is available.

name: Bieg na Skałę
description: Bieg na Skałę is a unique sporting event that combines physical activity with the natural beauty of this picturesque region. The race route follows charming paths and hills through Ojców National Park, offering participants stunning views and varied terrain, including forest trails, rocky sections, and steep climbs. The race is a challenge for experienced runners and an opportunity for beginners to embrace the spirit of adventure and enjoy the fresh air. After the race, participants can look forward to commemorative medals, prizes, and numerous activities, including games and contests for children.
course_highlights: Route through Ojców National Park with beautiful views
Varied terrain: forest trails, rocky sections, steep climbs
Activities for children: bouncy castles, entertainers, contests with prizes
additional: Three race distances are available: the Bieg po Pstrąga Ojcowskiego (8 km), with team rankings and a prize for the top resident of Skała Municipality; the Bieg Szlakiem Skał i Dolin (15 km), also with team rankings and a prize for the top municipal resident; and children’s races over 100 m (ages 2–5, unranked), 800 m (ages 10–11), and 1,300 m (ages 12–15). The entire event takes place in a friendly, sporting atmosphere.

name: Chyża 10
description: The 12th Chyża Ten is a popular 10 km race organized by the Chyży Nowotomyski Running Club in Nowy Tomyśl. The course is fast and popular with participants, and the race takes place in a friendly atmosphere. It also counts toward the Nowotomyski County Grand Prix. The race is scheduled to start at 9:00, making for comfortable racing conditions. The organizers warmly invite runners to this event, which brings together a passion for sport and the local community.
course_highlights: A fast course popular with runners
A 10 km race in Nowy Tomyśl
Counts toward the Nowotomyski County Grand Prix
additional: The race office is open from 07:00 to 08:30 on race day. Winners’ awards ceremony at 10:45. The race is co-funded by the Municipality of Nowy Tomyśl and Nowotomyski County.

name: XV Półmaraton Damak
description: The 15th DAMAK Tarczyn Half Marathon is a family celebration of running held in Tarczyn. Participants can look forward to a certified half-marathon course, a wonderful atmosphere, and sporting excitement in a welcoming, family-friendly setting. The event attracts runners from a range of backgrounds, offering memorable experiences and a community of running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Certified half-marathon course measuring 21.097 km
Family-friendly atmosphere and a wonderful race-day experience
Sporting excitement and a chance for runners to connect
additional: The race office is located at 8 Szarych Szeregów Street in Tarczyn. The event takes place annually in September, with the start at 10:00. The program also includes the 5 km Tarczyn Run and races for children and young people.

name: XXI Radomski Maraton Trzeźwości
description: The Radom Sobriety Marathon is an annual running event organized by the “Biegiem Radom!” Association. The race takes place on scenic routes in the Kozienice Forest near Jedlnia-Letnisko, offering participants a unique experience surrounded by nature. The event brings people together and promotes a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in the spirit of sobriety. The marathon has a long-standing tradition, and the organizers ensure a welcoming atmosphere and professional organization.
course_highlights: The route passes through the Kozienice Forest
Scenic forest trails and natural surroundings
The race takes place near Jedlnia-Letnisko
additional: Medals can be personalized during the event for a nominal fee of 10 PLN. The organizer is the “Biegiem Radom!” Association, which promotes running and physical activity in the region. The event is a forest cross-country race and traditionally takes place in September.

name: Żyrardów w Biegu
description: Żyrardów in Running is an annual running event organized by the Żyrardów Cyclists’ Association, taking place on September 12, 2027. The event features two distances: a 10 km main race and a 5 km accompanying race, both run around the Żyrardów Reservoir. The course is flat and consists of laps around the reservoir, offering scenic views and favorable conditions for fast times. Participants receive race numbers with chips, and athletes using active wheelchairs may also take part in the 10 km race. The event promotes physical activity and a welcoming sporting atmosphere in the city of Żyrardów.
course_highlights: Course around the Żyrardów Reservoir
4 laps for the 10 km distance and 2 laps for the 5 km distance
A flat, scenic course that favors fast times
additional: Race numbers with chips can be collected at the race office on race day. The event base (start, finish, and parking) is located by the Żyrardów Reservoir, 17 Ziołowa Street.

name: 32. Międzynarodowy Bieg Uliczny o Puchar Przewodniczącego Rady Miejskiej
Biegaj razem z nami
location: Zebrzydowice, Cieszyn County, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: II Bieg Tropem Wilka
location: Korpele, Szczytno County, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland

name: III Palmirski Bieg Pamięci Janusza Kusocińskiego
XII Bieg Marchewkowy
location: Zielonki, Kraków County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: XVIII Bieg o Puchar Burmistrza Miasta i Gminy Kąty Wrocławskie
location: Kąty Wrocławskie, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: XX EKO Bieg po Dolinie Będkowskiej
Beh Ždaňou
location: Ždaňa, okr. Košice okolie, Ždaňa, okr. Košice okolie, Obecný úrad
description: Beh Ždaňou is a running event in the village of Ždaňa in the Košice-okolie District, offering courses for various age groups and ability levels. The races cover 2.5 km and 5 km, with categories divided by age and gender. The event is suitable for the general public, including children, adults, and seniors. The organizers welcome all runners who want to enjoy a sporting day in the pleasant surroundings of the village.

name: Beh okolo Spišského hradu
location: Spišské Podhradie, Spišské Podhradie, Pred MsÚ
description: The Run Around Spiš Castle is a traditional running race in Spišské Podhradie, featuring a mix of asphalt and compacted dirt roads with grassy sections. The course passes around the historic Spiš Castle and is suitable for various age groups, including children and adults. The event is organized by the Town of Spišské Podhradie, which ensures a welcoming atmosphere and high-quality race organization. Registration is available online or on site, and residents of Spišské Podhradie can enter for free.

name: Crow Mountain Survival
description: The Crow Mountain Survival obstacle race in Bremen is an exciting adventure entering its ninth edition. Distances range from 1.2 km for children to 15 km for experienced runners, with challenging obstacles and spectacular water sections, including a swim across Lake Werdersee. The event offers challenges for beginners and experienced OCR veterans, as well as inclusive races for people with disabilities. The varied course runs through forests, meadows and different types of terrain, testing endurance, strength and agility. Children and newcomers can take part in special untimed races that make it easier to get started.
course_highlights: Spectacular swim across Lake Werdersee
Varied course through forests, meadows and different types of terrain
Challenging obstacles involving climbing, balancing, crawling and traversing
additional: Wave starts of 10 participants every 60 seconds for the 5 km, 10 km and 15 km races; participants are grouped by pace at registration; untimed junior and inclusive races; medals and certificates for all participants; start times vary by distance, e.g. junior race at 09:30 and taster race at 12:00; children under 12 require prior approval to participate on certain courses. Distances from 5 km to 15 km, including water sections, natural trails through forests and meadows, challenging obstacles, and junior, taster and inclusive races.

name: Tempo Makers Run Plzeň v Pytli - září
description: Tempo Makers Run Plzeň v Pytli je pravidelný běžecký závod na 8 km, který se koná v příjemném prostředí Plzně. Závod je určen všem běžcům, kteří sdílejí nadšení pro běh a společně strávený čas. Start i cíl jsou na stejném místě s možností parkování pro závodníky. Akce nabízí přátelskou atmosféru a je vhodná pro různé věkové kategorie.

name: AOK Firmenlauf Mosbach
description: The 5th AOK Mosbach Company Run takes place at Messplatz Mosbach-Neckarelz. The event is part of the BW-Running Company Run Series and gives teams from companies the opportunity to get active together and experience team spirit. The main race course is approximately 5 km long; there is also a shorter “Run for Everyone” of approximately 2 km. After the run, participants can enjoy complimentary refreshments at the finish, and a range of activities are available to help them prepare for and enjoy the event together.

name: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (10) – zářijový
description: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY je pravidelný běžecký seriál v Praze Braníku, který nabízí příjemnou a rychlou trať podél Vltavy, kde často padají osobní rekordy. Závody jsou součástí 16. ročníku a jsou vhodné pro běžce všech úrovní od začátečníků po profíky. Trať je certifikovaná a na 10 km lze zaběhnout limit pro MČR. Po závodě je možnost společného posezení a doplnění energie v místní restauraci, což přispívá k pohodové běžecké atmosféře.

name: Podzimní běh okolo Europlantu
description: Podzimní běh okolo Europlantu je tradiční běžecký závod pořádaný v Praze Horních Počernicích. Závod má délku 7,5 km a vede kombinací asfaltových a terénních úseků. Startuje se v podvečerních hodinách, přičemž pomalejší běžci startují dříve. Akce je otevřená všem běžcům a je podporována městskou částí Praha 20. Po závodě jsou pro účastníky připraveny brambory jako odměna od sponzora Europlant.

name: B2Run Berlin
description: B2Run Berlin is a corporate run with a route of around 5.7 km around Berlin’s Olympic Stadium. The run ends with an emotional finish in the historic Olympic Stadium and offers a unique team event for companies and individual entrants from Berlin and the surrounding area. The focus is on team spirit, motivation and fun rather than personal bests, making it ideal for beginners, walkers and experienced runners. The event combines physical activity with workplace health promotion and a professional supporting program featuring an emcee and music.

name: AOK Firmenlauf Waiblingen
description: The AOK Waiblingen Corporate Run is a popular team event held in Waiblingen. The approximately 5.5 km course goes around the Rundsporthalle and offers a great opportunity to get active with colleagues and strengthen team spirit. The event begins at 18:00 with a DJ program and a group warm-up, followed by the run and an awards ceremony with musical accompaniment. Free refreshments are available at the finish, so you can round off the evening in a relaxed atmosphere.

name: Malý Pieninský maratón – mem. Bohuša Ježíka
location: Červený Kláštor okr. Kežmarok, Červený Kláštor okr. Kežmarok, Kúpele Smerdžonka
organizer: Malý pieninský maratón – memoriál Bohuša Ježíka
description: The Malý Pieninský Marathon – Bohuš Ježík Memorial is a running event in Červený Kláštor, offering an 18 km course with 163 metres of elevation gain. The route runs through the Dunajec River Gorge, with half the surface paved and half forest trail. The start is scheduled for 10:00. The entry fee includes a medal, a gift, a race number, refreshments along the course and at the finish, lunch, and a raffle. In addition to the main race, a non-competitive 9+9 km relay is also available.

name: Běh proti násilí
organizer: Asociace pro práci s lidmi, kteří se dopouštějí násilí z.s.
description: Běh proti násilí je tradiční charitativní běh pořádaný v Oborě Hvězda v Praze 6, který podporuje program Stop násilí a klienty dlouhodobých terapií zaměřených na zvládání vzteku a agresivity. Tento běh spojuje běžce všech věkových kategorií, kteří chtějí svým během vyjádřit podporu a naději pro ty, kteří se snaží změnit své chování. Trasa má délku 5 km a je vhodná pro všechny, kdo chtějí podpořit dobrou věc a zároveň si užít pohyb v přírodě. Pořadatelem je Diakonie ČCE, významný poskytovatel sociálních služeb v ČR.

name: AOK Firmenlauf Feuerbach
description: The AOK Feuerbach Company Run is a popular team event held at the Feuerbach Sports Park in Stuttgart. The run promotes exercise, team spirit and shared experiences, and is part of the BW-Running company run series. In addition to the run, the event offers a varied supporting program with music, warm-up exercises and complimentary refreshments at the finish. Participants must be at least 16 years old, and travel by public transport is recommended.

name: Stadtfestlauf Lüdinghausen
description: The Stadtfestlauf Lüdinghausen is a long-standing running event organized by SC Union 08 Lüdinghausen e.V. It gives runners of different ages and ability levels the opportunity to compete on varied routes through the town and surrounding area. The race is part of the Westmünsterlandlaufserie and attracts numerous participants each year, who value both the sporting competition and the sense of community. The event is open to everyone who enjoys running and is organized by a dedicated club with many years of experience.
course_highlights: Varied routes through Lüdinghausen and the surrounding area
Part of the Westmünsterlandlaufserie
A range of running routes for different ages and ability levels
additional: Runners can register online; the event also includes a market, music, and family activities.

name: Stadtlauf Hanau - Stärke zeigen - gemeinsam gegen Gewalt an Frauen
description: The Hanau City Run takes place under the motto “Show Strength – Together Against Violence Against Women.” Around 3,500 people take part each year to take a stand against violence against women. The run combines sporting commitment with an important social cause and provides a platform for solidarity and awareness. The event is well organized, with race bib collection and the race office at Hanau City Hall.
course_highlights: Route through Hanau city center
Start and finish at Hanau Market Square
An urban city run with good infrastructure
additional: The race office opens at 14:00 on race day at City Hall. Race bib collection begins at 14:00. Baggage storage is available at City Hall from 15:30. Changing facilities are limited. There are no showers. Paid parking is available in nearby parking garages. Mobile structures on Market Square are permitted only for the organizers. The run is an annual event that collects donations for women’s shelters. More than 3,500 participants are expected.

name: Wipperfürther Stadtlauf
location: Wipperfürth, Oberbergischer Kreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
price_range: ab 4 EUR (Bambini- und Schülerläufe), 9 EUR (4,4 km Lauf), 14 EUR (Hauptlauf)
description: The 20th Wipperfürth City Run takes place through the historic center of Wipperfürth. The event offers races for all age groups, from the kindergarten run to the 10 km main race, which is officially measured by the DLV. Times are recorded electronically, and all participants receive commemorative medals. The event is open to everyone; club membership is not required. Attractive awards are presented to the fastest runners and age-group winners.
course_highlights: Historic center of Wipperfürth
10 km main race with 7 large laps, measured by the DLV
Various distances from 0.5 km to 10 km
additional: Race packs can be collected from 16:00 at the market square. Changing rooms and showers are available at the fire station at Lüdenscheider Straße 14. Relay exchanges take place in the start area on Lüdenscheider Straße, with the sash or baton passed to the next runner. All participants receive commemorative medals; the top finishers in the Bambini and schoolchildren’s races receive trophies, and the 4.4 km and main races award non-cash prizes. The city champions are determined from among the fastest participants from Wipperfürth.

name: SportScheck RUN Hannover
organizer: Motor Presse Hamburg GmbH & Co. KG Verlagsgesellschaft
description: The SportScheck Run Hannover is an evening night run that transforms Hanover’s city centre into a spectacular display of lights. Runners can choose between a 1 km children’s race and 5 km and 10 km courses, which pass through the illuminated city centre and landmarks such as Opernplatz, the Lower Saxony State Parliament, Kröpcke and the New Town Hall. The nighttime atmosphere makes the run a particularly memorable experience. The fastest runners can take part in a 10 km SpeedRUN, with a target time of under 50 minutes. The event welcomes runners of all ability levels and also offers training plans to help them prepare.

name: ONW-Lauf Dannenberg 2025
description: There are three race distances of 2.1 km, 4.2 km and 10.5 km, starting at the Market Square. The event welcomes participants of all ages and supports a good cause while fostering a strong sense of community. The entry fee for female students is covered; adults pay 6 euros. Groups of four or more can enter the team competition and win trophies.

name: Maraton 3 Jezior / Three Lakes Marathon
description: The 3 Lakes Marathon is a mountain running festival held in the scenic Beskid Mały region, in the Soła River valley. The main distance is an ultramarathon of approximately 43 km with around 2,485 m of elevation gain, taking runners through the highest parts of the Beskid Mały Mountains, with beautiful views of three lakes and the surrounding mountains. The course combines challenging climbs and technical descents, giving participants the chance to discover both the region’s wild nature and its historic sites. The event takes place during the beautiful transition from summer to autumn, adding to the charm of the route and its surroundings.

name: 23 Przejście Dookoła Kotliny Jeleniogórs...
description: The Hike Around the Jelenia Góra Valley is one of Poland’s best-known long-distance hiking events, held since 2004. Participants cover a route of approximately 140 km around the Jelenia Góra Valley, crossing the Karkonosze, Rudawy Janowickie, Kaczawskie Mountains and Izera Mountains. The event commemorates GOPR rescuers. The entry fee includes race materials, a souvenir, a hot meal and a certificate. The challenging route has approximately 5,500 m of elevation gain, and participants have a 48-hour time limit to complete it.

name: 3 Backyard Ultra Zagłębie
description: Backyard Ultra Zagłębie is a unique ultramarathon run on a 6.706 km loop around Pogoria 3 Lake in Dąbrowa Górnicza. Runners start every hour, and the last person to finish each lap continues running until only one winner remains. The course combines varied surfaces—asphalt, dirt and forest paths, and a beach section—requiring both endurance and technical precision. The event is the final of the Polish Backyard Ultra League and attracts fans of extreme challenges from across Poland.

name: Ogólnopolskie Mistrzostwa Policji
location: Łazy, Zawiercie County, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Běh pro hospic Červený Kostelec
description: Běh pro hospic je otevřený benefiční závod pořádaný v Červeném Kostelci, který nabízí tratě pro všechny věkové kategorie. Závod zahrnuje dětské tratě vedoucí lesní cestou a tratě na 2, 5 a 10 km vlnitým kombinovaným terénem s převahou asfaltu a částečně lesních a polních cest. Akce je součástí běžeckého seriálu Primátor CUP a podporuje hospicové služby Oblastní charity Červený Kostelec. Pro účastníky je připravena příjemná krajina kolem kosteleckých rybníků s výhledy do okolních hor.

name: Zátopkova 10
description: Zátopkova 10 je tradiční běžecký závod konaný v Lomené aleji ve Staré Boleslavi, který se běží po dvou pětikilometrových okruzích lesními cestami. Závod je součástí seriálu Trail Running Cup 2026 a nabízí hlavní závod na 10 km, štafetu dvou běžců a dětské závody na 500 a 1000 metrů. Trať je převážně rovinatá a start je intervalový, s průběžnou občerstvovací stanicí. Závodníci obdrží startovní číslo s měřícím čipem, pamětní medaili a další služby včetně občerstvení a fotografií z trati.

name: Li.T.R. – Lipno.trail.run.
description: Li.t.r. je víkendový trailový festival s hlavním závodem na 108 km a převýšením přes 2000 metrů okolo Lipna. Běh nabízí jedinečnou příležitost poznat neznámou krajinu Lipenska, její historii a příběhy během náročného ultratrailu. Závod je určen jak pro sólové běžce, tak pro týmy, a je doplněn doprovodným programem od pátku do neděle. Atmosféra je komunitní a přátelská, akce je organizována běžci pro běžce s respektem k přírodě a místní kultuře.

name: Mattoni Running Festival Ústí nad Labem
location: Ústí nad Labem, Mírové náměstí, Ústecký
description: Mattoni Running Festival Ústí nad Labem 2026 je tradiční běžecký závod s rychlou a rovinatou tratí, která vede podél řeky Labe a místní chemičkou. Tento půlmaraton je známý jako „Ferrari mezi závody“ díky své rychlosti a často padajícím rekordům. Během závodu si běžci užijí krásné výhledy na České středohoří a hrad Střekov. Festival nabízí různé běžecké disciplíny včetně půlmaratonu, štafetového půlmaratonu, běhu na 10 km a rodinných běhů.

name: Mladé Běchovice
description: Mladé Běchovice je tradiční běžecký závod určený dětem od 1 do 18 let, který se koná na travnatém hřišti v Praze-Běchovicích. Závod nabízí tratě různých délek od 50 do 1300 metrů, aby vyhověl širokému věkovému spektru účastníků. Každoročně se ho účastní přibližně 800 dětí, což z něj činí významnou sportovní událost pro mladé běžce. V roce 2026 se uskuteční již 61. ročník tohoto oblíbeného závodu.

name: Běh Moravským krasem
description: Běh Moravským krasem je součástí Okresní běžecké ligy Blansko, která má tradici od roku 1976. Tento závod nabízí běžcům z Blanenska i okolí možnost poměřit své síly v krásném přírodním prostředí Moravského krasu. Závod je vhodný pro širokou veřejnost a je součástí celoroční soutěže, která podporuje běžecký sport v regionu. Pořadatelé se snaží zajistit kvalitní servis a příjemnou atmosféru pro všechny účastníky.

name: Litovelská nealkoholická čtrnáctka
description: Litovelská nealkoholická čtrnáctka je tradiční běžecký závod pořádaný TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, který se koná v malebném městě Litovel v Olomouckém kraji. Závod je součástí běžeckého seriálu a nabízí příležitost pro kondiční i výkonnostní běžce. Liga stovkařů je známá svou dlouholetou tradicí a podporou běžecké komunity na střední Moravě. Závod je vhodný pro širokou veřejnost a přátelskou atmosféru podtrhuje i jeho název, který odkazuje na nealkoholický charakter akce.

name: Podzimní běh Heřmanův Městec
description: Podzimní běh v Heřmanově Městci je tradiční běžecký závod konaný v krásném zámeckém parku. Nabízí dvě hlavní trasy na 5 km a 10 km (dva okruhy) a také dětské závody v prostoru startu a cíle. Závod je součástí sportovní ligy Vládce Mrdic a přitahuje běžce všech věkových kategorií, kteří si užívají příjemné podzimní atmosféry a kvalitní zázemí.

name: Hořovický cvoček
description: Hořovický cvoček je tradiční běžecký závod pořádaný v Hořovicích, který nabízí trať dlouhou přibližně 12 km. Závod vede po lesních cestách i asfaltu a startuje se z ulice Valdecká u vodojemu směrem na Hvozdec. Hlavní závod začíná v 10:00 a je určen pro dospělé běžce bez dětských kategorií. Startovné je 150 Kč při předregistraci a 200 Kč na místě. Závod je součástí Brdského běžeckého poháru a má dlouhou historii s dostupnými výsledky a statistikami.

name: Kačina Run
description: Kačina Run je běžecký závod konaný v krásném prostředí zámku Kačina a rozlehlého zámeckého parku, který je součástí seriálu BĚHEJ ZÁMKY STŘEDNÍ ČECHY. Závod nabízí tratě pro děti do 800 metrů a pro dospělé tratě 5 a 10 km, které vedou převážně po mlatových a lesních cestách. Akce je vhodná pro všechny milovníky pohybu a přírody a nabízí příjemnou atmosféru s občerstvením na trati i v cíli. Start a zázemí jsou situovány v zadní části zámku Kačina, kde probíhá i prezentace a vyhlášení výsledků.

name: Leskros Mácháč
description: Leskros Mácháč je novinkou sezóny s krásnými trasami ideálními pro běh i canicross v CHKO Kokořínsko, nedaleko Máchova jezera. Trasy vedou měkkým písčitým podložím posypaným jehličím, což zajišťuje příjemný běžecký zážitek v přírodním prostředí. Závod nabízí různé délky tratí od dětských závodů po 21 km, včetně kategorií běh, canicross, chůze/běh a dogtrek. Zázemí závodu zahrnuje občerstvovací stanice pro lidi i psy, masáže, tejpování a psí fyzioporadenství, což přispívá k pohodě všech účastníků.

name: Štramberský Jasoň
organizer: Spolek Bezva běh pro bezva lidi z. s.
description: Štramberský Jasoň je tradiční turistický pochod a běžecká akce konaná ve Frýdlantu nad Ostravicí a okolí. Nabízí 22 tras různých délek od 6 km až po 67 km, včetně závodních i turistických variant. Účastníci si mohou vybrat z tras přes Lysou horu, Palkovické hůrky, Velký Javorník a další malebné lokality Moravskoslezského kraje. V cíli na Štramberku obdrží všichni registrovaní originální medaili a mohou si objednat tričko s potiskem. Akce je vhodná pro širokou veřejnost včetně rodin s dětmi a nabízí i trasy přizpůsobené kočárkům a seniorům.

name: Havlíčkova pětka
location: Havlíčkovo náměstí, Havlíčkův Brod, Vysočina, Česko
description: Havlíčkova pětka je běžecký závod na přibližně 5,2 km, který vede převážně po cyklostezkách a chodnících podél břehu řeky Sázavy v Havlíčkově Brodě. Tento závod je vhodný pro ty, kteří nemají tým na štafetu nebo považují půlmaraton za příliš náročný. Startuje se z Havlíčkova náměstí a část startovného je věnována na podporu sportovního vybavení pro mládež. Závod je součástí běžeckého poháru Běžec Vysočiny a nabízí občerstvení na startu i v cíli.

name: Běh rodným krajem Emila Zátopka
description: Běh rodným krajem Emila Zátopka je tradiční závod věnovaný odkazu slavného olympionika Emila Zátopka, který se koná pravidelně nejbližší sobotu k jeho narození 19. září. Startuje se v rodném městě Kopřivnice u sochy Emila Zátopka a cíl je ve Valašském muzeu v přírodě v Rožnově pod Radhoštěm po náročné 22,3 km trati s kopcovitým profilem. Závod je otevřený od 15 let a nabízí i doprovodné běhy pro děti a veřejnost. Po závodě probíhá slavnostní vyhlášení vítězů za účasti významných hostů.

name: Kocelovice-Hornosín-Kocelovice
description: Přespolní běh Kocelovice - Hornosín - Kocelovice je tradiční sportovní akce pořádaná obcí Kocelovice v Jihočeském kraji. Běh se koná a účastníci mohou očekávat trasu vedoucí z Kocelovic do Hornosína a zpět. Akce je vhodná pro milovníky běhu a aktivního vyžití v malebném turistickém a cykloturistickém terénu. Start i cíl jsou u budovy bývalé školy v Kocelovicích, kde také probíhá organizace závodu. Doba trvání akce je přibližně 4 hodiny.

name: Havlíčkobrodský půlmaraton
description: Havlíčkobrodský půlmaraton je tradiční běžecký závod konaný v Havlíčkově Brodě, který v roce 2026 oslaví svůj 14. ročník. Hlavní půlmaraton vede po veřejných cyklostezkách a chodnících, převážně podél řeky Sázavy, s průběhem přes Havlíčkobrodské náměstí. Kromě hlavního závodu jsou součástí akce i dětské závody, štafety a kratší běh Havlíčkova pětka, což umožňuje účast široké veřejnosti v různých věkových kategoriích a výkonnostních úrovních.
