Závod nabízí kvalitní zázemí, občerstvení na trati i po závodě, profesionální časomíru a bohatý doprovodný program.

name: Běh pro Hospic Anežky České
description: Běh pro Hospic Anežky České je otevřený benefiční závod pořádaný v Červeném Kostelci, který nabízí tratě pro všechny věkové kategorie. Závod zahrnuje dětské tratě vedoucí lesní cestou a tratě na 2, 5 a 10 km vlnitým kombinovaným terénem s převahou asfaltu a částečně lesních a polních cest. Akce je součástí běžeckého seriálu Primátor CUP a podporuje hospicové služby. Startovní čísla se vydávají od 8:15 a vyhlášení vítězů hlavního závodu proběhne ve 12:00.

name: Jilemnice - Žalý
description: Jilemnice - Žalý je závod v běhu do vrchu s celkovým převýšením 569 metrů, který se koná v malebném prostředí Jilemnice v Libereckém kraji. Tento závod je součástí Českého poháru v běhu do vrchu a nabízí náročnou trať dlouhou 9,5 km. Startuje se na náměstí v Jilemnici a závod je vhodný pro běžce, kteří hledají výzvu v kopcovitém terénu. Pořadatelem je ČKS SKI Jilemnice, z.s., který zajišťuje profesionální organizaci a podporu závodníků.

name: Soběchlebský Š-krpál
organizer: místní běžečtí nadšenci ve spolupráci s obcí Soběchleby a SDH Soběchleby
description: Soběchlebský Š-krpál je tradiční běžecký závod pořádaný od roku 2017 v okolí obce Soběchleby. Hlavní trať měří přibližně 11,7 km s převýšením 268 m a vede z 90 % po polních a lesních zpevněných cestách. Od roku 2024 je součástí závodu také kondiční běh na 6 km, vhodný pro začínající běžce a chodce. Start i cíl jsou na fotbalovém hřišti v Soběchlebech, kde je k dispozici zázemí včetně šaten, sprch a občerstvení. Doprovodný program zahrnuje dětské závody pro různé věkové kategorie.

name: Černošický běh
description: Černošický běh je tradiční běžecký závod konaný v Černošicích, který nabízí tratě pro různé věkové kategorie od nejmenších dětí až po dospělé. Závod se koná na hřišti na konci Husovy ulice a zahrnuje krátké tratě pro děti, rodinnou štafetu i delší tratě pro dospělé běžce. Starty probíhají postupně od 14:00 do 15:40, což umožňuje účastníkům různých věkových skupin pohodlně se zapojit. Akce je vhodná pro rodiny i závodníky hledající sportovní výzvu v příjemném prostředí města.

name: Dagersheimer Waldlauf
description: The Dagersheim Forest Run is a long-standing event held in the afternoon at the Dagersheim Forest Stadium. It offers races for various age groups, including a Bambini Run, children's races, a fun run, and a 10 km race that covers two laps through the Dagersheim Forest. Bib number pickup begins at 13:00, and late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective race for an additional fee. The event features a scenic forest course and offers runners of all ages an attractive opportunity to run in September.

name: 9. Bernburger Halbmarathon
description: The Bernburg Half Marathon takes place on September 18, 2027, at Rosenhag in Bernburg. The main course follows the Saale through Bernburg’s lower town, crosses the Marktbrücke, and continues to a point below the castle in Plötzkau before returning to the finish on the banks of the Saale. In addition to the half marathon, 5 km and 12 km races are also offered, both featuring scenic routes along the Saale. The event offers electronic net timekeeping, finisher medals, and an awards ceremony for the top runners.
course_highlights: Course along the Saale with two river crossings
Turning point below the castle in Plötzkau
Start and finish at Rosenhag by the Tiergartenschänke/Saalefee landing stage
additional: Race bib pickup on September 17, 2027, from 18:00 to 20:00 and on race day from 08:30. Electronic net timekeeping via race bib. Late registration is available until 30 minutes before the respective start for a fee of €2. Time limits: 3 hours for the half marathon and 2 hours each for the 5 km and 12 km races. Finisher medal and certificates (also available online) included.

name: Bessunger Merck-Lauf
description: The Bessunger Merck Run is a traditional neighborhood race in Darmstadt, welcoming runners of all ages. The event offers various distances and features a varied route through the Bessungen district. Registration is now open, with the early registration deadline on September 13 for organizational reasons. The race promotes community spirit and the joy of running in the region.
course_highlights: Distances of 1.1 km and 10 km
Event in Darmstadt
Organized by TGB 1865 Darmstadt e.V.
additional: The event is organized by TGB 1865 Darmstadt e.V. September weather is typically mild.

name: Mühlenlauf in Laar
location: Laar, Grafschaft Bentheim, Lower Saxony, Germany
organizer: Verein zur Erhaltung der Windmühle Laar/Vechte e.V.
description: The Mühlenlauf in Laar has been organized by SV Grenzland Laarwald since 1986 and takes place annually on the third weekend in September. Runners of all ages can choose between 2 km, 5 km and 10 km courses. The start and finish are both by the historic windmill, which, together with the windmill association, creates a welcoming atmosphere. Drinks and refreshments are provided for participants and spectators.
course_highlights: Start and finish by the historic windmill in Laar
Course distances: 2 km, 5 km and 10 km
Run through the scenic surroundings of Laar
additional: The Mühlenlauf is organized in cooperation with the sports club. The windmill and the local heritage house can be rented for celebrations. Drinks and refreshments are available on site for runners and spectators. The Mühlenlauf takes place in September, with drinks and refreshments provided. Advance registration is possible; late registration is available on site. The event takes place in all weather conditions.

name: Nassauer Hospiz-Charity-Run 2026
description: The event combines an athletic challenge with social commitment by supporting the important work of the hospice in Nassau. Participants enjoy the beautiful Taunus countryside and experience a family-friendly event centered on helping others together.
course_highlights: Distances ranging from 250 m to 10 km
Run through the beautiful Taunus countryside
Family-friendly event focused on solidarity and support
additional: The run is a charity event supporting the Rhein-Lahn inpatient hospice. Great emphasis is placed on community involvement and donations for the hospice.

name: Röderhof-Benefiz-Lauf
description: The Röderhof Charity Run takes place in Diekholzen and offers various running and walking distances for all age groups and ability levels. This traditional charity event focuses on the enjoyment of running and working together for a good cause. Distances range from 500 metres to 10 kilometres, including special wheelchair races. Start times are staggered to ensure the event runs smoothly.
course_highlights: A range of distances from 500 m to 10 km
Inclusive wheelchair races and walking routes
Run through the scenic surroundings of Diekholzen
additional: Online registration closes on 15.09 at 21:00. Late registration is possible on the event day up to 1 hour before the start, with an additional late-registration fee of 2 euros. Payment by direct debit is possible. The event has multiple start times for different distances and categories, including special wheelchair races and walking routes. Various running events, wheelchair races, walking, and the option to donate via PayPal

name: Welterbelauf Zollverein 2026
location: Zollverein, Essen-Stoppenberg, Essen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Welterbelauf Zollverein takes place on the grounds of the Zollverein Coking Plant in Essen-Stoppenberg. The race routes follow the Ring Promenade and pass prominent industrial landmarks such as the Double-Headed Winding Tower, the SANAA Building and Zollverein Spoil Tip. A range of events is available for all ages and ability levels, including a 10 km run, relays, walking and Special Olympics categories. The 10 km course is officially measured by the DLV and eligible for ranking lists. The race combines a sporting challenge with the unique atmosphere of a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
course_highlights: Route along the Ring Promenade and past the Double-Headed Winding Tower
Passes the SANAA Building and Zollverein Spoil Tip
10 km course officially measured by the DLV and eligible for ranking lists
additional: The event offers eight different competitions, including the 10 km Zollverein Run, 3 x 3.3 km Pütt Relay, 5.4 km Kumpel Run and Steiger Walk, 2.7 km Coking Plant Run, 1.2 km student race, 600 m Helen Keller Run and 300 m Bambini Run. Parking on the grounds is free for participants and visitors. The venue is easily accessible by public transport and car. The DLV and IAAF International Competition Rules apply. The event includes team relays (Pütt Run) and offers certificates and online results.

name: Tübinger Erbe-Lauf
description: The Tübinger Erbe-Lauf is a varied running event in Tübingen’s historic old town. The main course covers 10 kilometers, divided into four laps through the old town and the Umbrian-Provençal Market. In addition to the main race, there are other events, including the 5K, the Team Challenge, the Junior Run, and the BG Handbike Challenge. The event offers personal timing, an exclusive finisher’s medal, and a unique atmosphere in this picturesque city. All participants receive breathable running socks made from organic cotton as part of their entry fee.

name: BraunenBerg-Trail
description: The BraunenBerg Run in Aalen offers varied mountain-running courses for different age and ability groups. A particular highlight is the Rolladen Kaiser-BraunenBerg Trail, which starts underground at the Tiefer Stollen Visitor Mine and covers 32 km of trail running with 1,100 metres of elevation gain. Beginners and runners can take on the technically easy VR Bank-BraunenBerg Run, covering 14.6 km with 446 metres of elevation gain. Children’s and youth races round out the programme. The event also offers personalised race numbers, chip timing, refreshments and a bag drop in the finish area.
course_highlights: Rolladen Kaiser-BraunenBerg Trail: 32 km of trail running with 1,100 metres of elevation gain; starts at the Tiefer Stollen Visitor Mine
VR Bank-BraunenBerg Run: technically easy 14.6 km mountain run with 446 metres of elevation gain
Children’s and youth races with personalised race numbers, timing and refreshments at the finish
additional: A special bus transports runners from Oberalfingen to the start at the Tiefer Stollen Visitor Mine, departing at 9:45 a.m. A bag drop is available in the Oberalfingen finish area. Personalised race numbers and chip timing are provided for all races. Medals for all finishers. Disqualification for exceeding the time limit (32 km by 3:30 p.m.; the 14.6 km race also has a time limit). Awards ceremony at 3:30 p.m. in Oberalfingen. Multiple races, including the trail, children’s and youth races; registration includes starter packs with timing chips and medals.

name: 32. Stadtparklauf
description: The Stadtparklauf Sondershausen is a traditional running event held annually in Sondershausen City Park. It offers various distances from 500 m to 10,000 m and is open to runners of all ages and ability levels. The route winds through the picturesque city park, offering a pleasant running atmosphere in a green setting. The event is organized by SV Glückauf Sondershausen e.V. and is very popular in the region.

name: Altstadt-Run 2026
description: The Altstadt-Run Treysa is a running event in the Schwalm-Eder-Laufcup, held in the historic old town of Schwalmstadt. The event offers runners an attractive route through the picturesque town center and is a popular competition for runners of all abilities. The race takes place annually and attracts numerous participants from the region. It is organized by ESV Jahn Treysa, which ensures the event runs smoothly.
course_highlights: Route through the historic old town of Schwalmstadt
Attractive course with an urban feel
Part of the Schwalm-Eder-Laufcup

name: Aspacher Volkslauf
description: The Aspach Volkslauf is a long-established running event around the Feuersee in Kleinaspach, organized by the Murrtal-Runners. Held annually, it offers races for various age groups, including a 10-kilometer main race and shorter distances. The start and finish are at the Mühlfeldhalle Großaspach, where refreshments are available before, during, and after the race. The event is open to runners of all abilities and is known for its friendly atmosphere and scenic course.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Mühlfeldhalle Großaspach
Course runs through the Fautenhau, including scenic sections
Single-use transponder in the race bib for timing
additional: On-site registration is available from 15:30 until 30 minutes before each race start, for an additional fee of €3.00. Ample parking is available at the Mühlfeldhalle, Rathaus Großaspach, and Gemeindehalle. Coffee, cake, and light hot meals are available at the Mühlfeldhalle. Prizes are awarded to the top three overall finishers (men/women) in each race, along with certificates and gifts for the age groups in the main race. Results and certificates are available online.

name: Baedleslauf
description: The 22nd Baedleslauf takes place on Saturday afternoon in Stuttgart-Zuffenhausen and offers adult races over 5.3 km and 10 km. There is also a shorter 1.5 km distance, available as both a run and Nordic walking, ideal for runners and walkers. The flat course allows for a steady pace without significant climbs. All races finish at the SSV Zuffenhausen outdoor swimming pool grounds in the 70435 district. The program also includes children’s and youth races, making the Baedleslauf a family-friendly running event.

name: Belchenberglauf
description: The Belchen Mountain Run is a challenging 11.4 km mountain race with 824 m of elevation gain, running from Schönau in the Black Forest to Hotel Belchen. The course is about 37% forest roads and 63% paved roads, and is marked with white arrows and red signs, making it suitable for training year-round. About 80% of the race passes through open terrain with pastures, offering impressive views of Feldberg, the Little and Great Wiesental valleys, and the Swiss Alps. The event is held and is part of the Black Forest Mountain Running Cup. Participants receive free return transport by cable car and bus, as well as luggage transport to Belchen.

name: Black Forest ULTRA Trail Run
description: The Black Forest ULTRA Trail Run offers five challenging routes in the heart of the Black Forest, taking runners along narrow trails, steep climbs and technically demanding sections through impressive scenery. The routes feature varied sections with stunning views, challenging elevation gains and unmistakable Black Forest character. Whether it’s the 76 km ultra trail with seven aid stations and drop bag service or the 55 km route through rugged, varied terrain, trail runners will experience an uncompromising adventure. The event is approved by the DLV and promises an unforgettable experience for everyone who wants to discover the Black Forest in all its diversity.

name: BraunenBerg-Lauf
location: Besucherbergwerk Tiefer Stollen, Aalen, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The BraunenBerg Run offers varied mountain-running courses on the Ostalb, with different distances for a range of runners. The highlight is the 32 km Rolladen Kaiser BraunenBerg Trail, with 1,100 metres of elevation gain, which starts underground in the Tiefer Stollen Visitor Mine and passes through distinctive landscapes and landmarks. Other courses include the 14.6 km VR Bank BraunenBerg Run and the 8.2 km Getränke Keller BergBau Run, both offering scenic routes with elevation gain. Special races for children and young people take place in Oberalfingen, introducing the next generation to running. All races include personalised bibs, chip timing, refreshments at the finish, and certificates and medals for finishers.
course_highlights: 32 km trail run with 1,100 metres of elevation gain and 75% trail terrain
Underground start in the Tiefer Stollen Visitor Mine
Courses pass landmarks including the Mining Trail, Naturfreundehaus, television tower and Agnesburg
additional: Special buses transport runners to the start in the Tiefer Stollen Visitor Mine. All finishers receive a certificate and medal. Bibs and chip timing are personalised. Refreshments at the finish are included.

name: Duinger Berglauf
description: The Duinger Berglauf takes place in Duingen, Lower Saxony, and offers races for children and adults. The event starts and finishes at the OBS sports hall and includes short children’s races as well as more challenging 5 km and 10 km hill runs with around 110 metres of elevation gain. Organized by Duinger Sport-Club e.V., the race has been an accessible local hill-running event for 19 years. After the race, all participants receive free access to the indoor swimming pool and sauna, with changing rooms, showers, and refreshments available on site.

name: Edeka Ladage-Lauf Wennigsen
description: The EDEKA Ladage Run in Wennigsen offers a varied programme for all age groups, with distances ranging from about 600 m for kindergarten children to 10 km for adults. The races take place on a varied loop course on the grounds of Sophie Scholl Comprehensive School, running through residential areas and along field paths, with a special atmosphere at the start and finish. Alongside the sporting competition, the event also has a social focus, as proceeds from the main race are donated to the Bastlergemeinschaft der Wennigser Wasserräder e.V. The event is a popular community run with a family-friendly atmosphere and a long tradition in the region.

name: Fichtelgebirgstrailrun
description: The Fichtelgebirgstrailrun is a challenging trail-running competition held on partially unpaved roads and trails in the natural surroundings of the Fichtelgebirge. It requires participants to have good fitness and coordination, as well as respect and a sense of personal responsibility toward themselves, fellow runners, and the environment. The course passes through the unique and sensitive natural landscape of the Fichtelgebirge, offering runners an immersive experience in nature. The event places great importance on safety, fairness, and environmental protection.

name: Fit in Lautern Lauf 1. Lauf zu Gunsten des Fördervereins Waschmühle e.V.
description: The Fit in Lautern Run is a charity run in support of the Förderverein Waschmühle e.V. in Kaiserslautern. The event offers a sporting opportunity to strengthen the community while supporting a good cause. The run takes place in the vicinity of the Waschmühle outdoor swimming pool, a well-known location in Kaiserslautern. The event is open to all running enthusiasts and promotes health and social engagement.

name: Freimarktslauf
description: The Freimarktslauf in Garrel is the region’s largest community race, offering a varied running experience for young and old, beginners and professionals on its flat loop courses. The event features distances ranging from a 400 m children’s race to the 10 km main races, which take place on a flat 2.5 km loop through Garrel. Alongside the sporting competition, community and fun take center stage, supported by RunClub Garrel, which specifically encourages beginners. More than 1,300 participants make the race a popular event filled with unforgettable moments.

name: Int. Bodensee-Marathon
description: The International Lake Constance Marathon in Kressbronn am Bodensee is a long-standing running event with a history spanning more than 50 years. The course follows a loop through the town center, along the Argen and the Lake Constance shore, with marathon runners completing two half-marathon loops. The event offers an appealing combination of sporting challenge and scenic beauty in a natural setting. Finishers receive wooden medals, and a high-quality finisher shirt can be ordered optionally. A popular street festival with music, food and drink, and a flea market takes place alongside the race.

name: Kapuziner-Kessellauf
description: The Kapuziner Kessellauf is a traditional race through the Kessel and the Kulmbach Forest, starting at the Weiher Sports Center. Since its revival in 2002, it has been a fixture on the Upper Franconian running calendar. Alongside the sporting competition, participants can enjoy a varied supporting program featuring music, coffee and cake, a finish-line buffet, and a large raffle. The Bambini and schoolchildren’s races are especially family-friendly, with medals for all participants. The event also promotes community spirit through team rankings and awards for the teams with the most participants.

name: Klausdorfer Kranichlauf
description: The Klausdorf Crane Run invites runners of all ages to take part in various races through the beautiful surroundings of Klausdorf. Times are recorded using a chip issued with the race number. Every participant receives a certificate and a medal, and the top three finishers in each race are honored separately. Refreshments are provided along the course and at the finish, and changing rooms and restrooms are available at Vorpommernhus. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational athletes.

name: Schurwaldlauf Rommelshausen
location: Rommelshausen, Kernen im Remstal, Baden-Württemberg, Germany

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 10km 12,00€ + 5,00€ Pfand für den Laufchip, m/w 2012 + älter

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 5km 12,00€ + 5,00€ Pfand für den Laufchip, m/w 2017 + älter

description: The Schurwaldlauf Rommelshausen is a running event in Kernen, organized by the athletics department of Spvgg Rommelshausen. The event promotes team spirit, community, and the joy of sporting challenges for all age groups and ability levels. In addition to the main race, there is also a popular night run with various distances. Runners can look forward to a well-organized event with refreshments, changing facilities, and professional timekeeping.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the stadium in Kernen
Refreshment station with drinks during the 10 km race
Night run with results based on net time and transponder-chip timing
additional: Late registrations are possible on the event day from 16:30 until shortly before the start, subject to a late registration fee of €2.00. Race packs will be available at the stadium from 16:30 on race day. Parking is available around the stadium; public parking spaces at Sportpunkt are within walking distance. Changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available at the stadium. Valuables can be left in the tent near the finish. Timing is done using a transponder chip attached to the running shoe. The race number must be worn clearly visible at the front, as the finish is also recorded by camera.

name: Seelauf TSV-Obernzenn
description: The TSV Obernzenn Lake Run is a long-standing running event featuring various distances for children, young people, and adults. The course includes a Bambini run, children’s races, a middle distance, and a long-distance race of approx. 10.7 km. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with gifts for participants and attractive prizes for the top runners. Registration is online only via my.raceresult.com. Start times are staggered to ensure the event runs smoothly.

name: Sparkassen-Altstadtlauf
description: The Sparkassen Old Town Run in Ottweiler is a traditional race that brings together inclusion, emotion and outstanding athletic performance. The event takes place annually and gives runners of all ages and ability levels the opportunity to run through the historic old town of Ottweiler. It fosters community and sporting ambition in a lively atmosphere.

name: Volkslauf Rund um den Disibodenberg
description: The Disibodenberglauf is a traditional community race around Disibodenberg in Odernheim, taking place for the 38th time in 2026. The scenic route combines flat sections along the Glan with a challenging climb on the Eselspfad, which shapes the character of the race. Events include 5 km and 10 km races, walking on the 5 km course, and children’s and youth races from 200 m. The event has a sporty, family-friendly focus, with special prizes for records, families, teams, and Walk & Talk groups. The awards ceremony and social gathering take place in the gymnasium, with coffee, cake, and grilled food.

name: Wehringer Wertachlauf mit schwäbischen Meisterschaften
description: The Wehringen Wertach Run is a local running event in Wehringen, Germany, organized by Laufgemeinschaft Wehringen. The program includes a short 350-meter run and a 10 km run, classified as a short run. The course goes around the village of Wehringen and offers a family-friendly atmosphere. This edition also includes the Swabian Championships.

name: Wilstermarsch Lauf
description: The Wilstermarschlauf is a long-standing running event in Wilster, taking place for the 35th time on September 18, 2027. The event offers various distances for children and adults, including 400 m, 2 km, 5 km, and 10 km runs, as well as walking routes. The start and finish are at the Wilstermarsch Stadium, and the course runs through the scenic Wilstermarsch on flat terrain. Alongside the sporting competition, a varied program featuring games, a DJ, inflatable cushions, and prize draws provides entertainment and a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Flat course through the Wilstermarsch
Start and finish at the Wilstermarsch Stadium
Children’s races featuring a lap of the stadium and routes through Wilster and the surrounding area
additional: The Wilstermarschlauf is part of the Steinburg Cup. The accompanying program includes games, inflatable cushions, a DJ, a barbecue stand, refreshments, and a photo wall. Around 40 volunteers support the event, and prizes and vouchers are drawn for participants. The event is organized by MTV Wilster e.V.

name: Wutzseelauf
description: The Wutzseelauf in Lindow (Mark) is a family-friendly fun run taking place for the 21st time. The varied courses loop around Lake Wutzsee through the Stechlin-Ruppiner Land Nature Park and offer running opportunities for all ages, from Bambinis to experienced runners. The event is known for its welcoming atmosphere, professional chip timing and varied supporting programme. Participants can choose distances from 600 metres to 22 kilometres, including Nordic walking. Award ceremonies take place after the races, and every finisher receives a certificate to download or print on site.

name: Insellauf mit HM, 10km, 3x7km Staffel und Kinderläufen
description: The Reichenau Island Run is a traditional running event held annually in September on Reichenau Island. Various distances are offered, including a half marathon, a 10 km run, a 3 × 7 km relay, and children’s and youth races. The routes follow varied and scenic paths around the island. The Island Run attracts numerous runners of all ages and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with a range of running options.

name: Arberland Ultratrail
description: The ARBERLAND Ultra Trail is an autumn trail-running event in the Bavarian Forest, taking runners along challenging routes through one of Germany’s most beautiful natural landscapes. The event offers several distances from 20 km to 100 km, starting at the foot of the Großer Arber and crossing varied forest and mountain terrain. The routes stand out for their impressive views, technically demanding sections, and relaxed, welcoming atmosphere, created by the dedicated organizers from Woidläufer e. V. The race has become a popular end-of-season event for the trail-running community, combining a sporting challenge with enjoyment of nature.
course_highlights: Challenging climbs to 18 peaks over 1,000 metres
Breathtaking high-altitude trails with spectacular views
Technically demanding downhill sections
additional: The race starts at the Hohenzollern Ski Stadium by the Großer Arbersee. The event is organized by Woidläufer e. V., which can also provide information about the best trails in ARBERLAND. It takes place in autumn and is a popular end-of-season event for trail runners.

name: REHAmed Herkules-Berglauf
location: Wilhelmshöher Allee near Mulangstraße, Kassel, Germany
description: The REHAmed Herkules Mountain Run is a traditional mountain race in Kassel, following paved natural-surface paths through Bergpark Wilhelmshöhe. The course includes varied sections, some with wet and slippery surfaces, and finishes at the Hercules Monument. In addition to the individual race, there is a relay for families, clubs and companies. The event is open to runners and walkers aged U16 and above and includes a team classification.
course_highlights: Course almost entirely on paved natural-surface paths in Bergpark Wilhelmshöhe
Passes well-known sights including Apolloberg, Teufelsbrücke, Löwenburg and Steinhöfer Waterfall
Finish at the Hercules Monument, with a varied course
additional: The start and finish are on Wilhelmshöher Allee near Mulangstraße. Bib pickup and the race office are at the Reformschule gym, Schulstraße 2, Kassel. Transport of clothing to the finish is arranged; bags can be dropped off in the start area from 10 a.m. The return to the start is on foot or by bus route 22; a return trip can be arranged if needed. The relay consists of three legs, with the individual times added together. The start area is on Wilhelmshöher Allee near the junction with Mulangstraße. Bags containing dry clothes can be handed in before the start; the route back from the finish is on foot through the park. The paths may be slippery in wet weather.

name: XI Bieg po Gminie Zduńska Wola
location: Ochotnicza Straż Pożarna w Janiszewicach, Janiszewice, gmina Zduńska Wola, Poland
description: The 11th Run Around Zduńska Wola Municipality is an annual running event organized by the Volunteer Fire Brigade in Janiszewice. The race is aimed at fans of fast, flat asphalt courses, which have been officially certified at 10 km since 2021. The event is both sporting and community-focused, and also includes children’s races that promote physical activity among the youngest participants. The website features reports, photos, and results from previous editions, highlighting the event’s growing popularity and record attendance.
course_highlights: Flat, fast asphalt course
Officially certified 10 km course since 2021
Children’s races over shorter distances
additional: Children aged 4–15 can take part in races of approximately 300 metres, held without pressure or competition and aimed at fostering a love of movement. The children’s races are for participants aged 4–15.

name: 17. PKO Bytomski Półmaraton
description: The 17th PKO Bytom Half Marathon is a prestigious half-marathon held in Bytom, which in 2026 was awarded the status of the Open Silesian Half Marathon Championships. The course is a single 21.097 km loop, entirely on asphalt and certified by the PZLA, with markers every kilometre and refreshment and checkpoint stations. Runners have a time limit of 3 hours, and after the race they can personalise their medals with engraving. The event is an excellent opportunity to promote a healthy lifestyle and bring the local community together.
course_highlights: 21.097 km course — one asphalt loop, certified by the PZLA
Course markers every 1 km, plus refreshment and water stations
3-hour time limit, with checkpoints and transport for runners finishing after the cutoff
additional: A group warm-up is scheduled for 9:45. After the race, runners can have their results engraved on their medals, courtesy of partner Wikoss Sport (two stations). Pacemakers for 1:45, 2:00 and 2:15 will be at the start. Participants must be 18 or older. The start and finish are in the car park of G City Plejada Shopping Centre, Bytom, al. Jana Nowaka Jeziorańskiego 25.

name: 30 Międzynarodowy Bieg Uliczny Bieg Rekreacyjny 10 km
description: The 30th International Street Race in Jaworzno is an annual running event that attracts both professionals and amateurs. The event includes a recreational 10 km run held on the city’s streets. The course is appealing to runners who enjoy urban races with good organization and atmosphere. It is an excellent opportunity for sporting competition and spending time actively with the running community.
course_highlights: 10 km road race
The course runs through the streets of Jaworzno
An event with an international character

name: Gontyniec Celtic Trail
description: Gontyniec Celtic Trail is a unique reverse-format race, lasting 6 or 12 hours on loops of approximately 10 km through the scenic Gontyniec massif. Runners cover as much distance as possible, with fully equipped aid stations after each loop. The course offers changing scenery at different times of day, beautiful views of the Noteć Valley, and unique natural and cultural attractions, such as beehives shaped like ancient gods. It’s a special experience for runners seeking a challenge and unforgettable memories.

name: Run in Sopot IV - Opera Leśna
location: Parking przy Operze Leśnej, Sopot, Poland
description: Run in Sopot Opera Leśna is a 5 km race held in the scenic surroundings of the Forest Opera in Sopot. The route runs through the forest, with numerous climbs and descents, including a steep climb up Łysa Góra, and passes former ski jumps and residential areas. The start and finish are in the parking lot by the Forest Opera, and the participant limit is 250. The race is part of the Run in Sopot series, which also includes beach races.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the parking lot by the Forest Opera in Sopot
The route runs through the forest and past former ski jumps on Łysa Góra
A steep climb up Łysa Góra and varied terrain with switchbacks
additional: The finish is at the starting point. Only people wearing a race bib may be on the course. Competitors line up in the designated start area.

name: XIV Jastrzębska Dziesiątka
location: Hala Widowiskowo-Sportowa, Aleja Jana Pawła II 6, Jastrzębie-Zdrój, Poland
description: The 14th Jana Tyniec Memorial “Jastrzębska Dziesiątka” Street Run is an annual road race held in Jastrzębie-Zdrój. The 10 km race follows the city’s central streets, with the start and finish located at the Sports and Entertainment Hall. The event takes place, and the race office is open from 14:00 on race day. The sporting event attracts runners of different ages and experience levels.
course_highlights: 10 km route through the city’s central streets
Start and finish at the Sports and Entertainment Hall, Aleja Jana Pawła II 6
Urban course, flat and fast
additional: The start and finish are located at the Sports and Entertainment Hall, Aleja Jana Pawła II 6. The 11th Mały Jastrząbek Runs are also held on race day before the main race, from 15:00 to 15:50.

name: Rollercoaster 21 WMRA Mountain Running World Cup

location: Złoty Stok, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: 44 Strzeliński Rogaining
location: Łagiewniki, Strzelin County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Big Bear's Ultra
description: Big Bear's Ultra is a challenging ultra-trail race around the city of Žilina, offering a unique running experience in nature with beautiful views of the surrounding landscape. The race takes place near the Považské Museum and Budatín Castle and features various distances that test runners’ endurance and determination. The course runs through hills and mountain areas with significant elevation gain, making the event a challenge for experienced runners. The organizers emphasize an eco-friendly approach and participant safety.

name: Oktoberfest Run Nitra 2026: Half Marathon
description: Oktoberfest Run Nitra 2026: The Half Marathon is a certified half marathon with World Athletics international status, held in Nitra’s historic centre at Svätopluk Square. The event brings together sport, community and charity, offering runners a unique experience in an Oktoberfest atmosphere. Alongside the half marathon, the festival also features relays, family and senior runs, charity runs and children’s races. The organisers emphasise a healthy lifestyle, inclusion and community cooperation in the region.

name: Kopaničiarska 10-tka
location: Myjava, Myjava, pred MsÚ v Myjave
organizer: TJ Spartak Myjava Atletický oddiel a mesto Myjava
description: Kopaničiarska 10-tka is a running race in Myjava offering a 10 km course for men and women, with shorter options for women and the Buď - fit category. The race takes place in front of the Municipal Office in Myjava and is organized by TJ Spartak Myjava Athletics Club and the town of Myjava. The main race starts at 13:00, while primary school boys and girls start at 10:00. The race is suitable for a wide range of ages, including age-based categories and special categories for Buď fit and children.

name: Dobšinská desiatka
location: Dobšiná okr.Rožňava, Dobšiná okr.Rožňava, Dobšiná, Lanyiho Huta
description: Dobšinská desiatka is a traditional running race organized by the ŠK Dobšiná civic association. It takes place in the picturesque setting of Lányiho Huta in Dobšiná. The race features a varied course combining forest roads and asphalt, suitable for runners in different categories, including Nordic walking. The event also includes activities such as an autograph session with Slovak Olympians and family activities, creating a pleasant atmosphere for all participants.

name: Kapušianska 5-ka
description: Kapušianska 5-ka is a running race held in Kapušany Park in the village of Kapušany. The race is open to various age groups, including juniors, adults, and veterans. It is an enjoyable sporting event that promotes an active lifestyle and community sports. The event is organized by the municipality of Kapušany, which also provides support and contact information for participants.

name: Letné športové hry pracovníkov U.S.STEEL
location: Košice, Košice, vstupný areál USS Košice Šaca
description: The U. S. Steel Košice Summer Sports Games are a traditional event that has been held for 34 years, giving employees the opportunity to compete in a variety of sports. The games include athletics, badminton, bowling, tennis, football, table tennis, beach volleyball, cycling, chess and darts. The event is for U. S. Steel Košice employees and promotes sportsmanship and team spirit in the pleasant surroundings of the USS Košice Šaca complex. Golf tournaments and other sporting activities are also organized alongside the competitions.

name: Generali Trail Hubkovou
description: Generali Trail Hubkovou is a running race in Humenné organized by Bežecký klub Humenné with support from the city and local sponsors. The race takes place in the square by the Municipal Cultural Centre and offers categories for men, women, juniors, and children. The main race starts at 13:00, and the children’s categories begin at 11:00. Participants can choose from several entry packages, which include a medal, a promotional pack, a raffle, refreshments, and a technical T-shirt. The race is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant atmosphere, with refreshments along the course.

name: Trail Český ráj
description: Trail Český ráj je oblíbený terénní půlmaraton, který vás provede srdcem Českého ráje, včetně nádvoří hradu Kost, borovicových hájů a pískovcových skal. Tento závod je pokračováním již jedenáctého ročníku populárního závodu ELEVEN PŮLMARATON ČESKÝ RÁJ a nabízí pravděpodobně nejhezčí trasu terénního půlmaratonu v České republice. Start je u Komárovského rybníka a cíl je za odměnu pro každého běžce. Závod je doplněn o bohatý servis pro závodníky včetně občerstvení, šaten a zdravotnické služby.

name: PoHodová devítka
description: PoHodová Devítka je tradiční běžecký závod ve Velké Bíteši, který se koná v září vždy po místních hodech. Hlavní trať měří 9 km a je vhodná pro všechny běžce, děti mají možnost závodit na kratších tratích. Závod nabízí přátelskou atmosféru a je otevřený široké veřejnosti, včetně kategorií pro děti a dorost. Trasa vede zhruba z jedné třetiny po asfaltu a ze dvou třetin po nezpevněných cestách, běží se za plného silničního provozu a každý závodník běží na vlastní nebezpečí.

name: Memoriál Matěje Mauera
description: Memoriál Matěje Mauera je běžecký závod dlouhý 9 km, který vede převážně po lesních cestách s jedním delším stoupáním. Závod se koná v malebné lokalitě Capartice u Plzně a je součástí seriálu Běžec Chodska. Tento závod nabízí běžcům příležitost změřit síly v přírodním prostředí s náročnějším profilem trati. Je vhodný pro běžce, kteří hledají výzvu v terénu a chtějí si užít atmosféru tradičního závodu.

name: Bedburger Citylauf 2026
description: The GVG Citylauf Bedburg takes place in Bedburg city center. The races run through the traffic-free city center, starting and finishing at the Market Square in front of the town hall. Various distances are offered, from the 300-meter Bambini run to the 10 km main race, as well as relay events. The race is suitable for all age groups and offers a great opportunity to experience Bedburg on the move.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Market Square in front of the town hall
Routes run through Bedburg’s traffic-free city center
The 10 km main race consists of five laps through the city center
additional: Late registration is possible on race day until one hour before the respective start, with a late registration fee of €3.00 (except for the Bambini run, which is free to enter). Headphones, MP3 players, jogging strollers, and dogs are not permitted for safety reasons. Multiple race distances; registration online and in person until one hour before the start; no dogs or headphones on the course.

name: Internationaler Hugenottenlauf
description: The 49th Hugenottenlauf in Neu-Isenburg is taking place and invites runners of all ages to enjoy a sporting and community-focused event. The event offers various race distances through the city, suitable for different ability levels. Music, refreshments, and professional timekeeping help create a pleasant atmosphere. The event is part of the Main-Lauf-Cup and offers age-group categories in accordance with DLO regulations.
course_highlights: Various race distances: 21.1 km, 10 km, 5 km, and a 2.95 km school race
Start and finish in Neu-Isenburg; course maps are available
Music along the course adds to the atmosphere
additional: Age-group categories in accordance with DLO regulations, timekeeping, race bib collection, changing rooms and showers, valuables storage, awards ceremony, certificates and results lists, raffle, refreshments, medical services, photos, Main-Lauf-Cup, parking and public transport are organized. Various race distances, registration by direct debit authorization, supporting program for families, courses are well marked

name: Stadtlauf Erding 2026
description: The Erding City Run is a long-standing running event for runners of all ages. A range of distances is offered, including children’s races, a 5 km run and a 10 km run through the beautiful town of Erding. The event embraces inclusion and features special classifications, for example for children from St. Nikolaus School. It is organised by the Trisport Erding club and is a popular sporting event in the region.
course_highlights: Children’s races with age-appropriate distances of approximately 0.8 km to 2.5 km
Stadtwerke Run over 5 km and 10 km through Erding city centre
Inclusive classification for children from St. Nikolaus School
additional: The Erding City Run offers special children’s races with different distances for each age group. There is a separate 0.8 km classification for children from St. Nikolaus School. The event emphasises inclusion and is open to runners of all ages. Running routes, registration, results, photos, road closures

name: Aerzener twinfit-Volkslauf
price_range: € 5,– bis € 9,– je nach Lauf und Anmeldung
description: The Aerzener twinfit Volkslauf is a family-friendly running event with various distances, starting and finishing in Aerzen. It offers 5 km and 10 km Volkslauf races, a 5 km company and team race, a 1.8 km school race, and a free children’s race. The event offers a pleasant atmosphere, refreshments, and an awards ceremony. The races are DLV-rated, and prizes and a participant raffle are available.
course_highlights: Start and finish at twinfit, Königsförder Straße 19, 31855 Aerzen
5 km and 10 km Volkslauf races, plus a 5 km company and team race
1.8 km school race and free children’s race
additional: Changing facilities with showers are available at twinfit. The awards ceremony is scheduled for around 13:30, with certificates for places 1–3 and a raffle. Drinks are available along the course and snacks in the finish area. Parking is available at twinfit.

name: Druffeler Volkslauf
description: The Druffeler Volkslauf takes place in Rietberg-Druffel and offers timed races over 1 km and 10 km. The event supports a solidarity initiative in sport that promotes running and maintains a relief fund for the families of injured runners. Members of laufen.de can benefit from the “Book smart, pay less!” formula. The course is officially measured and eligible for rankings.
course_highlights: Timed races over 1 km and 10 km
Start in Rietberg-Druffel
Typical September weather: around 19 °C and mostly cloudy skies
additional: Registration supports a solidarity sports initiative and a relief fund for injured runners. Typical September weather is around 19 °C, with a minimum of 10 °C and average precipitation of 45 mm; skies are mostly cloudy. Registration via laufen.de may offer a discount; supports charitable causes; ask the organizer for details before registering.

name: Engenhahner Gickel-Waldlauf
description: The Engenhahn Gickel Forest Run takes runners along varied circuits through the Taunus forest. Races ranging from a children’s run to a half marathon start at the Engenhahn sports field. The program also includes 10 km, 6.5 km and 3 km races.
course_highlights: Forest routes in the Taunus with hilly terrain
Circuit courses of 6.5 km, 10 km and 21.1 km
The routes feature around 160 metres of elevation gain over 6.5 km, 220 metres over 10 km and 480 metres over the half marathon
additional: Children’s races over 1.2 km and 375 m round out the race program. The event is part of the Taunus Running Challenge.

name: Herbstlauf und 29. Wandertag Fleckenberg
location: Sportplatz auf der Latroper Straße, Fleckenberg, Hochsauerlandkreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 39th Autumn Run and Hiking Day in Fleckenberg takes place at the sports field on Latroper Straße. The event is a scoring race in the Volksbank Sauerland Lauf Cup and features a scenic 15 km loop with varied terrain. The course runs along forest paths, an asphalt climb, and some stony sections, making well-cushioned running shoes ideal. Changing rooms and showers are available, along with food and drink for sale. After the race, there is an awards ceremony with certificates and trophies.
course_highlights: 15 km loop starting at the sports field, at an elevation of 360 m
Varied course with an asphalt climb, firm forest paths, and some stony terrain
The return route follows the final kilometres of the Rothaarsteig Marathon
additional: Indoor changing rooms and showers are available. A wide selection of food and drinks is on sale. The awards ceremony begins at around 12:00, with awards for the children’s and youth races. Every participant receives a certificate, and the fastest runner receives a trophy. Scoring race in the Volksbank Sauerland Lauf Cup; start and finish at the sports field on Latroper Straße; indoor changing rooms, showers, refreshments, and certificates for all finishers.

name: Jesteburger Volkslauf
description: The Jesteburg Volkslauf is organized by VfL Jesteburg and offers a wide range of race distances from 2.3 km to 10.5 km, with something for runners of all ability levels. The event takes place in Jesteburg and is a popular opportunity for sports enthusiasts to compete in a friendly, family-like atmosphere. The routes pass through varied landscapes and offer a great running experience for both recreational runners and ambitious athletes.
course_highlights: A variety of distances from 2.3 km to 10.5 km
Routes through varied landscapes in Jesteburg
Suitable for runners of all ages and ability levels
additional: Registration is online until 17.09.2027 (24:00) via www.stgk.de. No specific information is provided about start times or waves. VfL Jesteburg offers a family-like club atmosphere with a wide range of sports. The club office is open Wednesdays and Thursdays from 17:00 to 19:00. Youth races over 400 m and 800 m, as well as 10 km walking.

name: Laacher See Naturlauf mit 21. VR Bank Cup
location: Maria Laach, Verbandsgemeinde Mendig, Rheinland-Pfalz, Germany
description: The Laacher See Nature Run with the 21st VR Bank Cup is a traditional popular race held annually by Laufgemeinschaft Laacher See e.V. in Maria Laach. The race takes place and offers runners of all ability levels the opportunity to experience the scenic route around Lake Laach. The event is part of an active club community that also offers running courses and training groups for beginners and those returning to running. LG Laacher See looks forward to welcoming runners to a sporting and community-minded experience.
course_highlights: Scenic route around Lake Laach
Nature-rich running route with volcanic views
Suitable for beginners and experienced runners
additional: The club offers a running course, “From 0 to Around Lake Laach,” for beginners and those returning to running. It starts in spring and ends with participation in the Laacher See Nature Run in September. Regular group runs take place on various weekdays, divided into ability groups. Club membership is not required to participate in the running course. Distances: 200 m, 8.5 km; no refreshment station on the course; mindfulness exercises before the start; environmentally friendly event with strict environmental requirements.

name: Lauf durch das Thüringer Schiefergebirge
organizer: LAV Saale-Rennsteig, SV 90 Stahl Schmiedefeld, Feuerwehrverein Schmiedefeld und SV Germania Gebersdorf
description: The run through the Thuringian Slate Mountains takes running enthusiasts through the forested, hilly landscape around Schmiedefeld near Saalfeld. Various distances are offered for adults, as well as races for children and young people. Beginners and experienced runners alike can discover the Slate Mountains on varied routes.
course_highlights: Forest roads, narrow trails and varied terrain
Half marathon with around 550 metres of elevation gain
Distances ranging from short children’s races to the half-marathon distance
additional: The event is part of the Sparkassen-Cup and the TLV Running and Walking Cup. There are five aid stations for the half marathon.

name: Lauf Rund um den Fühlinger See
location: Fühlinger See, Köln, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
price_range: 15€ für 10 km und 5 km, 10€ für Jugend, Kinder kostenfrei, Nachmeldung 5€
description: The Rund um den Fühlinger See race is a traditional road race in Cologne. The event offers a wide range of distances for runners of all ages: a half marathon, 10 km, 5 km and a 1 km children’s race. The courses run around the regatta course used for the 1998 World Rowing Championships and are measured by the DLV, allowing performances to qualify for ranking lists. The race is an ideal test ahead of the Generali Cologne Marathon and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, attractive medals and prizes for the age groups.
course_highlights: Course runs around the regatta course used for the 1998 World Rowing Championships
Courses measured by the DLV and certified
Low-traffic road-race courses in Cologne-Fühlingen
additional: Timing uses a disposable transponder attached to the race number, included in the entry fee. Late entries are possible online until 30 minutes before the start (adults €5, children/youth free). Race packs are available on race day from 08:45 at the boathouse at Fühlinger See. Changing rooms and showers are available at the boathouse. Prizes are awarded to the first three finishers in each age group, and attractive medals to the first three finishers in each race. Measured courses, DLV-measured, start times from 09:30, free parking, changing rooms and showers at the Fühlinger See boathouse, music and refreshments on site

name: Möhnesee-Pokal-Lauf = Mehr als eine Herausforderung
description: The 38th Möhnesee-Pokal-Lauf, under the motto “More than a challenge,” takes place in Möhnesee-Günne. The event offers two distances, 5 km and 30 km, and challenges participants with a demanding course. The race is known for its varied scenery and the special atmosphere at Möhnesee. Runners can look forward to a sporting challenge in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: 5 km and 30 km race distances
Venue in Möhnesee-Günne, surrounded by scenic countryside
Typical September weather with mild temperatures and mostly cloudy skies
additional: Average temperatures are around 19 °C during the day and 10 °C at night. Around 45 mm of precipitation is expected, with mostly cloudy skies. The race takes place in September, with typical temperatures around 19 °C; participants are advised to check further details with the organizer before registering.

name: Panoramalauf Kriegsheim
description: The Panoramalauf Kriegsheim is a running event in Kriegsheim organized by LLG Wonnegau. It is part of the club’s summer running calendar and offers runners an attractive route through the scenic surrounding area. LLG Wonnegau is an active club that organizes other running and sporting events in the region in addition to the Panoramalauf. The event is open to runners of all ability levels and promotes a sense of community in the sport.
course_highlights: Run through the picturesque countryside around Kriegsheim
Part of LLG Wonnegau’s summer running calendar
Attractive route suitable for different ability levels
additional: LLG Wonnegau offers other running events and training sessions. The club office is at Silvanerstr. 4, Monsheim. The pages reviewed provide no explicit information about start times, pricing tiers, or registration for the Panoramalauf Kriegsheim. Start times: 9:45 a.m. for Bambini; 10:00 a.m. for the main race, 5 km, and walking. Late registration is possible on the event day until one hour before the start. The event is scheduled to take place in all weather; it may be canceled in the event of severe weather.

name: Preungesheimer Dorflauf
location: Sportpark Preungesheim, Goldpeppingstraße, Frankfurt am Main, Germany
description: The Preungesheim Village Run is an annual running event in northern Frankfurt that attracts many running enthusiasts. It is organised by Turnverein Preungesheim von 1880 e.V. and offers a friendly, sporting atmosphere. The run takes place in Sportpark Preungesheim and is a popular opportunity for the local community to get active and enjoy sport together.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km races for adults
Children’s and youth races, including short Bambini and youth race distances
Finish in Sportpark Preungesheim on Goldpeppingstraße
additional: Refreshments are provided; small snacks await participants at the finish.

name: Seidenraupen Cross
location: Hülser Bruch, Krefeld, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Seidenraupen Cross in Krefeld is one of the most interesting cross-country races in North Rhine-Westphalia, organised in a friendly, family atmosphere. Runners can look forward to challenging 6.5 km and 16 km courses through Krefeld’s largest nature reserve, the Hülser Bruch, with tough climbs, fast descents and beautiful natural scenery. Alongside the main races, there are also children’s races at the Hülser district sports complex. The event offers a varied, nature-filled running experience for beginners and experienced runners alike.
course_highlights: Run through the Hülser Bruch nature reserve, with three hills
Tough climbs and fast descents
Children’s races on a variety of surfaces (grass, sand pits and cinder track)
additional: The start for hikers, walkers and Nordic walkers is at 10 a.m. Registration is open until one hour before the race. The course distances are approximately 6.5 km and 16 km, and can also be covered on foot. The children’s races take place at the sports complex on Hölschen Dyk. The event supports social projects every year. Trail and cross-country sections; routes on forest and hiking trails; start and finish at the Hölschen Dyk sports ground; registration until one hour before the race.

name: Kassel Marathon
description: The Kassel Marathon is the largest sporting event in North Hesse and offers a varied program for runners of all ability levels. On September 26, 2027, participants can take on the marathon course with 200 meters of elevation gain and look forward to a well-organized event with comprehensive medical support. In addition to the marathon, there are also a half marathon, power walking, relay and corporate races, as well as a mini marathon and a Bambini run. The event is distinguished by a strong sense of community, attractive goodies such as finisher shirts and medals, and a varied supporting program.
course_highlights: Marathon course with 200 meters of elevation gain
Start and finish at Auestadion in Kassel
A variety of running events, from the Bambini run to the marathon relay
additional: Finishers receive a medal at the finish and can download their certificate online. After the race, a free massage is available at Auestadion. Medical support is provided by the German Red Cross and a medical team. The start and finish are at Auestadion/Balance Fitness Center. There is an extensive supporting program with a test run, a marathon service, a party, and a Social Night.

name: 12. PSD Bank Halbmarathon
description: The PSD Bank Half Marathon in Hamburg is a fast, flat running event that takes runners through the Wandsbek district and as far north as Berne subway station. The course then heads back via Rahlstedt and Tonndorf to the start and finish area on Wandsbeker Marktstraße. The race is known for its unique atmosphere, with support from spectators and live bands along the course, and takes place in late summer at dusk.

name: 14. Northeimer Tageslicht Ultra
description: The Northeimer Tageslicht Ultra is a challenging ultramarathon held in Northeim. The course passes through varied terrain and offers a special challenge for experienced ultrarunners. The event has a long tradition, with numerous finishers and records that underscore the race’s high quality and athletic demands. Participants can download the course GPX track to prepare optimally.

name: 21. Fun-Run
description: The 21st Maisel’s FunRun takes place in Bayreuth and is a fixture on the regional running calendar. The event attracts over 4,000 running enthusiasts every year, from beginners to ambitious athletes. Various distances are offered for adults, including a half marathon, quarter marathon and 5 km run, as well as several children’s races with no entry fee. The finish line leads directly onto the Maisel’s Weissbierfest grounds, where runners can celebrate with live music and freshly tapped Maisel’s Weisse. The varied course is mostly flat, passes some of Bayreuth’s most beautiful spots and creates a great running atmosphere.

name: 28. Hiddestorfer Rübenlauf

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Das Startgeld beträgt 10,00 €, für Jugendliche bis einschließlich 16 Jahre (Jg. 2010) 6,00 €.

description: The Hiddestorfer Rübenlauf is a family-friendly running event with distances of 1.4 km, 5.2 km, 10.1 km and 21.3 km. Alongside the sporting competition, the event offers a varied program featuring a legendary runners’ breakfast, cake, waffles, grilled food and drinks. Children can also enjoy face painting and other activities. The run is organized by the running group of Sportverein Eintracht Hiddestorf and welcomes runners of all ages and ability levels.
course_highlights: Distances of 1.4 km, 5.2 km, 10.1 km and 21.3 km
Start on Ihmer Straße, with different start times for each distance
Chip timing; the chip is issued with the race number
additional: Race packets (race number and chip) can be collected on the event day from 7:00 a.m. Timing is provided by a chip, which must be returned after the run. Changing rooms and showers are available at the sports club/tennis club, close to the start and finish. Parking is limited, with the nearest spaces no more than a 500 m walk away. Children can take part in a free 500 m Möhrchenlauf without registering, and in a 1.4 km children’s race, which is free for children aged 7 to 12.

name: 8. Altstadtlauf Salzwedel
description: The Altstadtlauf Salzwedel is part of the Elbe-Ohre-Cup and will take place for the eighth time in 2026. The course runs through the historic old town of Salzwedel on a 5 km loop. The longer distances, 10 km and half marathon, are run over multiple loops accordingly. The event is organized by Sportclub Demker ’95 e.V. and offers runners in northern Saxony-Anhalt an attractive racing opportunity.

name: Gau-Algesheimer Alagastaluf
description: The Gau-Algesheim Alagastaluf is a traditional fun run that has been held in Gau-Algesheim since the 1980s. The event follows country paths and roads around Binger Straße and through the old town of Gau-Algesheim. It offers a sporting challenge in beautiful autumn surroundings and is suitable for runners of all ages. The event is organized by SV 1910 Gau-Algesheim e.V. - Athletics Department and takes place every year in autumn.

name: Karlsfelder Seelauf
description: The Karlsfeld Lake Run is a long-standing running event held at Lake Karlsfeld. The race offers an attractive route in a natural setting and is open to runners of all ages and ability levels. The event is organized by TSV Eintracht Karlsfeld and will take place for the 47th time in 2026. Participants can look forward to a well-organized event with a friendly, family atmosphere.

name: Uentroper Geithelauf
description: The event is organized by Turn- und Sportverein 46/68 Uentrop e.V. and offers a sporting community in a natural setting. The routes run through fields and forest paths in the surrounding area and are suitable for various fitness levels. The event emphasizes fun, community, and a pleasant atmosphere for all participants.

name: Baden-Marathon Karlsruhe
description: The Baden-Marathon Karlsruhe offers a varied running experience, with a marathon, half marathon, team marathon, health run, inclusion run and mini-marathon for children. The flat, fast course runs through the city center, past Karlsruhe Palace and through Citypark Ost, finishing in a lively atmosphere at the Carl Kaufmann Stadium. A special feature is the option to be accompanied by Marathon Angels for the final 4 kilometers, making the race a shared experience. Attractive shorter distances for beginners and families put the fun of running first.

name: Bordesholmer Seelauf SEE +RUN
description: SEE & RUN is a running event organized by TSV Bordesholm and held annually at Lake Bordesholm. After being canceled in 2026, the focus is now on its return on September 19, 2027. The event offers a safe, high-quality running experience in a beautiful natural setting and welcomes running enthusiasts of all ages.
course_highlights: Run around Lake Bordesholm
Nature-rich course with varied terrain
Event in a friendly, sporty atmosphere
additional: Registration for 2026 is closed. Refunds of entry fees will be processed by email. The 2026 event was canceled due to organizational and staffing constraints. The organizer is Turn- und Sportverein Bordesholm von 1906 e.V.

name: CANOSSA Benefiz Berglauf
description: The CANOSSA Charity Mountain Run® in Bad Harzburg is a challenging fundraising run through Harz National Park. Participants can complete the course by running, Nordic walking or hiking. It finishes at the CANOSSA Column on Burgberg. The run supports inclusive work with children and young people in the Goslar district, combining a sporting challenge with social commitment. After the run, participants can enjoy a festive after-race event with music, refreshments and an awards ceremony.

name: CEB-Saarwiesenlauf
description: The CEB Saarwiesenlauf is a running event in Hilbringen near Merzig, organised by Christian Adult Education in Hilbringen together with Sparkasse Merzig-Wadern and Merzig Athletics Club. Despite difficult weather conditions, almost 500 runners and 16 relay teams took part in an earlier edition, reflecting strong community involvement. The race offers various distances and allows both individual and relay entries, making it appealing to runners of all abilities.

name: Citylauf Leer
description: The Citylauf Leer is a traditional running event held in Leer city center at Denkmalsplatz. The event offers races for various age groups and distances, including Bambino, Teeny, 5 km, and 10 km races. The route follows closed circuits through the town center, with refreshment stations along the course and in the finish area. All participants receive a T-shirt (while supplies last), and attractive non-cash prizes and certificates are awarded to the top runners. The event is open to individual and team rankings and takes place in all weather conditions.

name: EDITH LÜCKE-Frauenlauf TRIER
description: The EDITH LÜCKE Women’s Run in Trier is a special event celebrating its sixth edition. The 5-kilometer course takes runners on a sightseeing tour through Trier’s Roman history, starting in front of the Imperial Baths and finishing in spectacular fashion in the Amphitheatre. The run is open to women and girls aged twelve and over, with a focus on the joy of exercising together, regardless of fitness level. After the run, all participants can enjoy a glass of sparkling wine from a local winery to celebrate the day.

name: Eltviller Familienlauf 2026
description: The Eltville Family Run offers various distances for all age groups, from the Bambini race to the 10 km run. The course runs mostly along paved roads with flat cobblestones and includes a short, gently uphill section. The event is family-friendly and allows both individual and team entries. Race packets can be collected the day before or on race day. Bag storage and toilets are available at the start and finish areas. Young people up to age 16 can take part in the paid races free of charge, but registration is required.

name: Fürst Carl Seenlandmarathon
description: The Fürst Carl Seenland Marathon takes place in Pleinfeld on Lake Brombach. The event offers various distances, including a marathon, half marathon, relay, fun run, schoolchildren’s run, and Bambini run, on paved and partly asphalted paths. The marathon and half-marathon distances are officially certified by the DLV. The event is open to runners of all ages and offers a varied program with accompanying activities and refreshments.

name: Grebinlauf
description: The Grebinlauf takes place in Grebin and offers varied routes for runners, walkers, children, and relay teams. The event is known for its great atmosphere and a special finish on the Grebin sports field. One highlight is the turning point at the Grebin Mill, which makes the course special. Registration is through the Davengo platform.

name: Halbmarathon Altötting
description: The Altötting Half Marathon is one of the fastest nature runs in the world and has been awarded 5 stars by the European Athletics Association. The course runs 80% on well-maintained forest trails through the Altötting Forest. It is flat, sheltered from the wind, and has little asphalt. In addition to the half marathon, the event offers a 6 km run and a fun run. Free childcare is available for children aged 5 and over, and numerous bands and music along the course create a lively atmosphere.

name: Heidelauf Halle am 20.09.2026
description: The 278th Heidelauf Halle takes place in Halle (Saale) and is organized by SV Halle Triathlon. The event gives runners of different age groups and ability levels the opportunity to take part in a long-standing race. The course runs around the Heidebad and offers varied running terrain. Registration is open until race day.

name: Horster Löwenlauf
description: The 2nd Horster Löwenlauf takes place around Horst Castle in Gelsenkirchen. This sporting event offers a lively, inclusive atmosphere for all age groups, with refreshments and entertainment in the castle park. Following the great success of the inaugural event, the race is once again being organised as a sporting highlight for the Horst district. The event takes place on World Children’s Day, which is considered especially fitting.

name: Hörnle Berglauf Bad Kohlgrub
description: The Hörnle Berglauf in Bad Kohlgrub is a traditional mountain race held annually, taking runners up the local Hörnle mountain. The event features a challenging course with impressive views and a sporting test for mountain-running enthusiasts. The race takes place in September and attracts participants from both the region and beyond. The Bad Kohlgrub Ski Club organizes the event with great dedication and provides a family-friendly atmosphere.

name: IWB Laurentiuslauf x Landkreislauf
description: The IWB Laurentiuslauf x Landkreislauf takes place annually in Bobingen and is a traditional running event along unique trails and enchanting paths in the forests west of Augsburg. Alongside the sporting competition, the event focuses on supporting a vocational training project at Bobingen Middle School, giving participation a social purpose as well. The event also features a career-orientation rally that offers young people exciting insights into regional vocational training opportunities. The race is part of a vibrant community of dedicated sponsors and volunteers and is always held on the third Sunday in September.

name: Kemmerner Kuckuckslauf
description: The Kemmern Cuckoo Run is a traditional running event in the center of Kemmern, taking place for the 16th time. A range of events is offered for all age groups, including Bambini, schoolchildren’s and youth races, as well as a 4 km fun and company run and a 10 km main race. The event is known for fair, sporting competition and a friendly atmosphere with many spectators. Food and refreshments for runners are available at the SC Kemmern sports clubhouse.

name: km von Röthenbach
description: The 10 km of Röthenbach is a race sanctioned by the German Athletics Association and held in Röthenbach a.d.Pegnitz. The event offers various distances for all age groups, including a fast, flat loop course measured by the German Athletics Association. Timing is provided by a chip integrated into the race bib, and the event is family-friendly, with races for children and teenagers. Changing rooms, showers, and medical services are available on site, and the venue is easily accessible by public transport.

name: Lohelauf
description: The Lohelauf in Wentorf bei Hamburg is a long-standing running event that welcomes runners of all ages and ability levels. The event offers various race distances and places particular emphasis on community and inclusion, as demonstrated by the 200-meter run for people with disabilities, offered for the first time. Alongside the sporting competition, there is a varied program with refreshments and entertainment for participants and spectators. Professional timing and support from numerous volunteers help ensure the event runs smoothly.
course_highlights: Running routes through the Wentorfer Lohe
Inclusive 200-meter run for people with disabilities
Refreshments of fresh fruit and water provided by REWE
additional: The event is attended by Mayor Kathrin Schöning, who also presents the awards. The German Red Cross (DRK) provides medical cover and helps with the power supply. Timing and results are handled professionally by the RaceResult team. The program includes a Haspa soccer darts board for entertainment.

name: Memminger Altstadtlauf
description: The Memmingen Old Town Run is a traditional race through Memmingen’s historic old town. The course is a flat, paved circuit approximately 1 km long that winds through the picturesque old town. The event is open to club runners, professionals, and recreational runners, and features professional transponder timing. The start and finish are on the market square, where the awards ceremony also takes place. All participants receive a high-quality towel as a keepsake.

name: Mommelsteinlauf
description: The Mommelsteinlauf in Floh-Seligenthal, OT Hohleborn, is a family-friendly running event organised by SV 1962 Hohleborn. From the Bambini run and youth and beginner courses to the challenging 32 km trail, every runner and Nordic walker can find a suitable route. The routes are marked, with refreshment stations on routes of 8 km and longer. The event offers timing using a bib-chip transponder and medical support. At the finish, participants can enjoy refreshments and a coffee-and-cake buffet.

name: Sonneberger Spielzeuglauf
description: The 6th Sonneberg Toy Run and 2nd Company Run takes place in Sonneberg. The event offers several race distances, including the main race, beginners’ race, Nordic walking, schoolchildren’s race and children’s race. They all start at the same time and finish together. In addition to the individual rankings, there is a special company ranking for the company with the most participants and the most creative company, as well as an award for the club with the most participants. The Nordic walking event is timed, but there is no awards ceremony. The event is family-friendly and organised by Leichtathletik Sonneberg e. V.

name: Sparkassen-Küstenmarathon 26
description: The Sparkassen Coastal Marathon in Otterndorf is a long-standing race on the North Sea coast. The event offers various distances, from a Bambini run for kindergarten children to the classic marathon of 42.195 km. The courses pass through the historic old town, along the Elbe dike and by the water, guaranteeing a varied and scenic running experience. In addition to the marathon, there are also half-marathon, 10 km and 5 km races, as well as relay and walking events. The event places emphasis on community, endurance and a family-friendly atmosphere.

name: Weddelbrooker Dorflauf
description: The Weddelbrook Village Run is a popular running event in Weddelbrook that welcomes runners of all ages. It offers a range of distances, from 900 m for Bambinis to 10 km for experienced runners. The races follow varied routes through the community and create a family-friendly atmosphere. The Village Run is known for its excellent organisation and the warm support of its many volunteers.
course_highlights: 10 km, 5 km, 3.2 km and 900 m Bambini distances
Start at the sports field, with a 900 m loop for Bambinis
Family-friendly atmosphere with many participants and volunteers
additional: The races start one after another: first the 10 km, then the 5 km, followed by the 3.2 km junior race, and finally the Bambinis on the 900 m loop. The event attracts many participants and is supported by numerous volunteers.

name: Wilscher FUN-RUN
description: The Wilsche FunRun is a longstanding race that has been held annually at the Wilsche sports field in Gifhorn since 2005. It is part of the Gifhorn-Wolfsburg Running Cup and offers an appealing race over a 10 km distance. The race is known for its friendly atmosphere and strong participation, and is an established part of the regional running scene. The race starts promptly at 10 a.m., and the event is supported by local organizations such as the fire brigades and the German Red Cross.

name: Hiddestorfer Rübenlauf
description: The Hiddestorfer Rübenlauf is a family-friendly running event organized by the running group of Sportverein Eintracht Hiddestorf. It offers routes of 1.4 km, 5.2 km, 10.1 km and the Hemmingen Half Marathon (21.3 km). Alongside the sporting competition, participants can enjoy a legendary runners’ breakfast, cake, waffles, grilled food and drinks, as well as a varied supporting program that includes face painting for children. The event is particularly suitable for runners of all ages and places great emphasis on a friendly, welcoming atmosphere.

name: Trail Marathon Heidelberg
organizer: Motor Presse Hamburg GmbH & Co. KG Verlagsgesellschaft
description: The Heidelberg Trail Marathon is one of Germany’s most extraordinary trail-running events. Under the motto “HERRLICH.HÄHER.HÄRTER,” it offers challenging and varied courses with plenty of trails, steep climbs, and impressive views. The event features three distances: the Base Trail (20 km), the Half Trail (30 km), and the Heart Core Trail (45 km) with more than 2,000 meters of elevation gain. The course passes, among other places, the Thingstätte, the Philosophenweg, the Heiligenberg, and the Königstuhl, offering a unique atmosphere for trail runners of all levels.

name: 12 Bieg "Król Parku"
location: Park Miejski w Mosinie, Mosina, Poland
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Mosinie
description: The 12th “King of the Park” Run is an annual running event organized by the Mosina Sports and Recreation Centre. The race takes place in the scenic surroundings of the town park, offering participants an attractive course and sporting competition. It attracts both amateur and more experienced runners, promoting an active lifestyle and bringing the local community together. The organizers provide professional support and a generous race pack.

name: 49 Półmaraton Lechitów
description: The 49th Lechit Half Marathon is Poland’s oldest half marathon, held continuously since 1978. The 21.0975 km race route runs from the Small Open-Air Museum in Ostrów Lednicki to the finish at St. Adalbert’s Square in Gniezno, following the route of Otto III’s historic journey. The race attracts thousands of runners every year and is part of the Polish Half Marathon Crown and the Greater Poland Half Marathon Grand Prix. The organizers provide professional race services, timekeeping, and course safety. Participants receive a race package with a medal and a recovery meal.

name: 6 Półmaraton Aleją Dębów Czerwonych
organizer: Gmina Łęka Opatowska, Gmina Wieruszów, Gminny Ośrodek Sportu i Turystyki w Wieruszowie, Spółdzielnia Socjalna Green Service
description: The 6th Half Marathon along the Red Oak Avenue is a half-marathon race (21.097 km) taking place in Wieruszów. The event is organized by the Łęka Opatowska Municipality, the Wieruszów Municipality, and the Municipal Sports and Tourism Centre in Wieruszów. The race is open and runner-friendly, with a scenic route along the Red Oak Avenue. The race office will be open on event day from 08:00 to 11:30, and timing will be electronic. The event is supported by local partners and sponsors, and participants can expect professional organization and attractive race-day conditions.

name: 7 H2O Półmaraton
description: The 7 H2O Half Marathon is a 21.097 km race in Wrocław. The course is flat and paved, with sections of compacted gravel surface. It follows a single loop, starting and finishing at 3 Międzyrzecka Street. The event promotes running and physical activity among Wrocław residents, offering participants professional organization and a friendly atmosphere. The race has a time limit of 3 hours and provides hydration points and a recovery meal at the finish.

name: Bieg Charytatywny
organizer: Urząd Miejski w Oławie, Stowarzyszenie Ludzi Aktywnych „Biegnij Oławo”
description: The CZTERY PORY ROKU Charity Run – Stage IV is a sporting event held in Oława, in the park by the railway station. Participants can take part in a run of approximately 5 km or a Nordic Walking event on the same route.
