The event is charitable in nature and is coordinated by the Active People Association “Biegnij Oławo” and the Oława Municipal Office. The race office is open on race day from 09:30 to 10:30, and the event is scheduled to start on December 20, 2026. The event is supported by local partners, and timing is provided by ZmierzymyCzas.pl.

name: Festiwal Górski Maraton Trzech Jezior
description: The Three Lakes Mountain Marathon Festival is a unique running event in the picturesque region of the Beskid lakes, featuring four distances: the 3.5 km Czupel Vertical with 600 m of elevation gain, a 43 km marathon, 21 km, and 17 km. The routes pass through the wild mountain terrain of the Little Beskids, offering participants beautiful views, varied terrain, and a chance to connect with nature and the region’s history. The event brings the running community together and promotes an active lifestyle as well as the area’s tourist and cultural attractions. The races take place, and the main marathon is an ultramarathon with challenging climbs and technical descents.

name: II Bieg Farmera
description: The 2nd Farmer’s Run is a 10 km road race taking place in Police. The event is a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic course, and participants can use training plans tailored to different ability levels. The organizers provide expert support and detailed training instructions to help participants prepare optimally for the race. This sporting event is aimed at runners who value good organization and opportunities for development.

name: Prószkowski Bieg Uliczny
organizer: Ośrodek Kultury i Sportu w Prószkowie
description: The Piotr Blachucik Prószków Street Run is one of the region’s most atmospheric running events, held in Prószków. The race offers a dynamic course and sporting excitement, and children’s races are also held before the main event, encouraging an active lifestyle from an early age. It’s a day full of energy, smiles, and friendly competition, ideal both for runners chasing a result and for those looking to spend their time actively.

name: VII Bieg Pocztyliona
description: The 7th Pocztylion Run is a 10 km race taking place in Cewice, Pomeranian Voivodeship. Participants can prepare for the race using dedicated training plans tailored to different experience levels. The event is a great opportunity for runners to test their fitness on a scenic course and enjoy friendly competition in a welcoming atmosphere.

name: 12 Bieg Ziemi Puckiej
location: Połczyno, Puck County, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: 4 Wilczy Pęd na Trójmorski Wierch
location: Jodłów, Międzylesie, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Bieg na Zamek po miecz Spycimira
XI Gminna Zadyszka
location: Kurnos Drugi, Bełchatów County, Łódź Voivodeship, Poland

name: XIX Mazowiecki Bieg Norwidowski
location: Dębinki, Gmina Zabrodzie, Masovian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Olsztyn Półmaraton
description: The Olsztyn Half Marathon is an annual 21.1 km race held around the picturesque Lake Ukiel in Olsztyn. The course has a mix of surfaces, including compacted gravel, forest trails, asphalt, and paving blocks. The route is marked every kilometer, and runners have access to at least two refreshment stations. The event also features a 5 km race and races for children, creating a sporting atmosphere for the whole family. The organizers provide professional support and an appealing schedule, welcoming both recreational and experienced runners.
course_highlights: 21.1 km course around Lake Ukiel
Mixed surfaces: gravel, forest trails, asphalt, and paving blocks
At least two refreshment stations on the course
additional: The time limit is 3 hours for the half marathon and 45 minutes for the 5 km race. The race office is open on the day before and on race day. Registration is not available on race day. The course is not certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA).

name: Bešeňovský charitatívny beh pre MAPENZI
organizer: Občianske združenie MAPENZI by Generation of love, Obec Bešeňov
description: The Bešeňov Charity Run for MAPENZI is a running event organized by the MAPENZI by Generation of Love civic association and the municipality of Bešeňov. The races take place at the football field in Bešeňov and include 10 km and 5 km categories, children’s races, and a recreational 2 km run. The children’s races start at 15:00 and the main race at 16:00. The event is charitable in nature and suitable for the general public, including people of various age groups.

name: Olšavský pohár – Memoriál Júliusa Kažimíra
location: Ruskov okr. Košice okolie, Ruskov okr. Košice okolie, pred Obecným úradom
organizer: Obec Ruskov and Dobrovoľný hasičský zbor Ruskov
description: The Olšavský Cup – Július Kažimír Memorial is a running race held in the village of Ruskov in the Košice-okolie District. The race offers two main courses of 16.8 km and 9.7 km, with the start in front of the Municipal Office. Men, women, and children can compete in various age categories. The event is organized by the municipality of Ruskov and the Ruskov Volunteer Fire Brigade in cooperation with neighboring municipalities. The race is suitable for the general public, including seniors and children, who can enter for free.

name: AOK Firmenlauf in Haslach im Kinzigtal
description: The AOK Haslach im Kinzigtal Company Run is a team event that is part of the BW Running Series. The event promotes physical activity, team spirit, and shared experiences in the workplace. The main race course is approximately 5 km long, and there is also a 2 km “Run for Everyone.” After the race, participants can enjoy complimentary refreshments at the finish, and special meeting points are available for teams to experience race day together.

name: Flugfeld Firmenlauf Tage
description: The Flugfeld Company Run Days are a sporting event in Böblingen that brings companies and teams together to get active. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and varied competitions, which promote team spirit and fitness. Organized by an experienced family business, the Run Days offer an appealing platform for sporting challenges and socializing.
course_highlights: A variety of competitions for companies and teams
Event venue in Böblingen with an appealing running course
Team area and refreshments on site
additional: There is a Team Captain registration, team areas, and refreshments on site. The event is organized by a family business with many years of experience.

name: Noční běh pro světlušku Zlín
description: Noční běh pro Světlušku ve Zlíně je charitativní běžecká akce konaná na náměstí Míru. Startuje se v 20:00 a účastníci si mohou vybrat trať podle svého uvážení, případně ji i projít. Startovní balíčky jsou k dispozici ve dvou variantách - s čelovkou nebo se sportovní čelenkou. Část startovného je věnována na pomoc těžce zrakově postiženým, což podtrhuje charitativní charakter akce. Kromě běhu je připraven i doprovodný program pro všechny účastníky.

name: Běh okolo Campusu
organizer: Běžecký spolek z.s. a Sportuj s námi, z.s.
description: Běh okolo Campusu je běžecký závod v Brně, který se koná v lokalitě Bohunice. Závod nabízí okruh dlouhý 5,6 km, který absolvují muži i ženy v jedné kategorii. Součástí programu je také dětský závod pro děti jakéhokoliv věku s délkou okruhu určenou před startem. Akce je přátelská a otevřená všem běžcům, s možností poznat zajímavá místa v Brně.

name: AOK Firmenlauf Balingen
description: The AOK Firmenlauf Balingen is a popular team event held at the marketplace in Balingen. The course is approximately 5.9 kilometres long and consists of two laps of about 2.9 km each. The race promotes movement for everyone and inclusion, enabling people with and without disabilities to take part together. After the race, participants can enjoy free refreshments at the finish and a lively awards ceremony with music. The event is a great opportunity to experience team spirit and add sporting activity to the working day.

name: Eleven Večerní běh
description: ELEVEN Večerní běh je noční závod na 5 km, který se koná v podvečerním rytmu v areálu pivovaru VOLT v Jablonci nad Nisou. Trasa vede v okolí tří přehrad a je vhodná pro muže, ženy i mládež od 16 let a starší, stejně jako pro děti do 15 let. Závod nabízí sportovní atmosféru s čipovou časomírou a hodnotnými dárky pro první registrované účastníky. Start a cíl jsou umístěny v areálu pivovaru, kde je také možné vyzvednout startovní čísla.

name: Běh Březinou v Polné
description: Běh Březinou v Polné je tradiční běžecký závod pořádaný Běžeckým týmem Polná a Běžec Vysočiny z.s., který se koná na fotbalovém stadionu v Polné. Závod nabízí tratě pro různé věkové kategorie, od nejmenších dětí po veterány, s hlavním závodem na 9,5 km vedoucím polními a lesními cestami údolím řeky Šlapanky. Startuje se v 17:00 a účastníci mohou očekávat příjemnou atmosféru a upomínkové ceny pro nejlepší v kategoriích. Závod má dlouholetou tradici s více než 39 ročníky od roku 1992.

name: ENTEGA Nightrun
location: Radgelände des Darmstädter Velodroms, Darmstadt, Hesse, Germany
description: The ENTEGA Nightrun is a unique running event on the cycling grounds of the Velodrome in Darmstadt. The course is fully illuminated and offers a varied mix of grass, asphalt, gravel and hard-packed surfaces. With distances of 1.6 km (children’s race), 2.5 km, 5 km and 7.5 km, there is something for runners of all ages and abilities. The special atmosphere at dusk and the pulsating energy of fellow runners make this an unforgettable experience for all participants.
course_highlights: Illuminated circuit around the cycling track grounds
Varied surfaces: grass, asphalt, gravel and hard-packed surfaces
Atmospheric run at dusk with dazzling lights
additional: Race bibs can be collected on the event day from 17:30 in the hall. Every participant receives a finisher’s medal. Shoes with spikes are not allowed. Water and regional products from Alnatura will be provided. Medical services are available on the course and at the finish. Parking is available on the tennis grounds next to the event venue. Valuables can be handed in at the hall for a fee of €1. No showers are provided. Course on grass, asphalt and gravel; shoes with spikes are not allowed; parking at the TGB tennis grounds; no showers; medical services available.

name: Nachtlauf über 7 Meilen und 30. Jedermannlauf über 3,1 Meilen (5 km)
description: The Zonser Night Run offers two exciting races: the 7-mile race and the 5 km fun run. The event takes place in Dormagen-Zons and is known for its unique nighttime atmosphere. The course runs through the historic old town, giving runners a special experience. The race is open to all ages and ability levels and is a popular event in the region.
course_highlights: 7 miles (approx. 11.3 km) through the historic old town of Zons
5 km fun run as a shorter option
Night run with a special atmosphere and lighting
additional: No late registration is possible. The event takes place in the historic old town of Zons. There is an accompanying program and an awards ceremony. Parking and travel information are available on the website. The race takes place at night and offers a special atmosphere. Late registration is not possible. The event is suitable for runners of all levels and offers a great opportunity to experience the historic surroundings.

name: Schülerlauf
description: The Rüppurr Schools’ Students’ Run is a long-standing annual running competition that brings together students from various schools in Karlsruhe. The event has separate categories for girls and boys, and all participants receive certificates and medals. Prizes are awarded for first, second and third place. Registration is through the schools, and late entries are possible on the day of the event. The run takes place around the TUS Rüppurr club grounds and encourages young athletes in the region.

name: Beh Tokajskými vinicami
location: Oddychové centrum, Čerhov, Trebišov District, Slovakia
description: The Run Through the Tokaj Vineyards is a traditional running race held in the village of Čerhov in the Trebišov District. The course winds through the picturesque Tokaj vineyards, offering beautiful natural scenery and a pleasant setting for runners of all ages. The event is suitable for both amateur and experienced runners who want to enjoy a day of sport outdoors and discover the unique Tokaj region. It is organized by the municipality of Čerhov, which ensures a welcoming atmosphere and high-quality organization.
course_highlights: The course passes through the Tokaj vineyards, with beautiful views
Natural surroundings with moderate elevation gain
A combination of paved and forest roads
additional: The event takes place at the Recreation Centre in Čerhov. A course map is available on the municipality’s website. No specific start times or wave assignments are provided. Registration information is available on a separate page. No entry fees or race categories are listed.

name: Mělnický vinařský běh
description: Mělnický vinařský běh je tradiční běžecký závod v Mělníku, který nabízí trať s délkou 10 km a 21 km. Běží se v jednom okruhu s krásnými výhledy na zámek a vinice, přičemž trasa vede přes historické a přírodní zajímavosti v okolí města. Po doběhu čeká na účastníky ochutnávka místních vín, pamětní sklenička, oběd zdarma a bohatá tombola. Závod je vhodný pro širokou veřejnost včetně dětí, které mají vlastní závody zdarma. Organizátorem je spolek Run the World, který podporuje běhání jako komunitní a přátelskou aktivitu.

name: Grymovská pětka
description: Grymovská pětka je tradiční běžecký závod pořádaný TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, který nabízí sportovcům příležitost poměřit své síly v příjemném prostředí města Grymov. Liga stovkařů Olomouc je specializovaným klubem na kondiční a výkonnostní běh, který organizuje řadu vytrvalostních závodů v Olomouckém kraji. Závod je součástí jejich běžeckého kalendáře a přitahuje běžce různých věkových kategorií a výkonnostních úrovní. Klub také podporuje běžce v tréninku a závodní přípravě, což zajišťuje kvalitní sportovní zážitek.

name: Běh Bohutínem
description: Běh Bohutínem je tradiční běžecký závod pořádaný SK Sporting Bohutín, který se koná na fotbalovém hřišti Litavan. Závod nabízí tratě pro muže o délce 8 km a pro ženy 4 km, s povrchem kombinujícím asfalt a lesní cesty. Součástí akce jsou také dětské závody, což činí událost vhodnou pro široké spektrum běžců. Start hlavního závodu je v 13:00 a atmosféra je přátelská a sportovně laděná.

name: Běh Zlínského kraje
description: Běh Zlínského kraje je součástí oslav Dne Zlínského kraje, který se koná v Zlíně. Akce nabízí nejen sportovní zážitek v podobě běhu na 6 km, ale také kulturní program, regionální gastronomii a rodinné aktivity. Běh je otevřený široké veřejnosti a je součástí bohatého dne plného zábavy, řemesel a regionálních produktů. Organizátorem je Zlínský kraj, který tímto podporuje sport a místní tradice.

name: Běh Velké skály
description: Běh Velké skály je tradiční běžecký závod pořádaný v Děčíně, který nabízí tratě o délce 11 km a 6,5 km v lesním a městském terénu. Závod je součástí Děčínského běžeckého poháru a je vhodný pro širokou veřejnost včetně dětí, pro které jsou připraveny speciální závody. Startuje se na atletickém stadionu ASK Děčín a atmosféra závodu je podpořena krásnou přírodou a skalními útvary v okolí. Závod se koná již 56. ročník a je známý svou výjimečnou atmosférou a kvalitní organizací.

name: Plzeňský kardioběh
description: Plzeňský kardioběh je největší plzeňský krosový běh s tratěmi 5,8 km a 10 km. Závod je součástí Běžeckého poháru mládeže Plzeňského kraje a zároveň mistrovstvím České republiky zdravotnického personálu v přespolním běhu. Pořádá ho agentura Pro Sport Activities, která má dlouholetou tradici v organizaci sportovních akcí v Plzni a okolí. Akce je vhodná pro širokou veřejnost a nabízí kvalitní sportovní zážitek v přírodním prostředí Plzně-Roudné.

name: 7 pohoří Beskydy
description: Trail Run Seriál 7 pohoří je největší akce svého druhu v Česku, která vás provede sedmi nejkrásnějšími a nejtěžšími horskými masivy. Závod Beskydy se koná v amfiteátru na Horečkách v Trojanovicích a nabízí technické traily, epické výhledy a atmosféru, kterou jinde nezažijete. Trasy vedou po lesních cestách a pěšinách s výběhy na zajímavé kopce a dlouhými seběhy. Každý účastník obdrží pamětní medaili a může se těšit na občerstvení i profesionální zázemí.

name: ŠumpeRUN
location: Historical Centre of Šumperk, Šumperk, Česko
description: ŠumpeRUN je oblíbený městský běžecký závod, který se koná historickým centrem Šumperka. Osmý ročník závodu nabídne tratě pro širokou veřejnost včetně hlavního závodu na 10 km, závodu na 3,33 km, štafet tříčlenných týmů a dětských závodů s různými délkami. Závod podporuje zdravý životní styl, komunitní soudržnost a připomíná kulturní dědictví města. Pro rok 2026 je připraven bohatý doprovodný program včetně společných rozcviček a hudebního doprovodu na trati.

name: K3-run
description: K3- krčmaňský běh přes tři vrcholy je závod dlouhý 11,3 km s převýšením přibližně 350 metrů. Trasa vede krásnou krajinou přes tři vrcholy, převážně po zpevněných cestách a částečně po trávě s převážně tvrdým povrchem. Tento běh nabízí sportovcům příjemný zážitek v přírodě a výzvu v podobě stoupání a běhu v terénu.

name: Neusser Integrationslauf
description: The Neuss Integration Run, organized by DJK RHEINKRAFT Neuss 1914 e.V., takes place at the Ludwig-Wolker sports facility in Neuss. The event celebrates integration in practice, bringing together people of all backgrounds, skin colors and religions, including people with disabilities, to run or walk together. The focus is on community and promoting integration, not competition. A colorful program featuring music, activities for children and food makes the day a celebration for participants and visitors.
course_highlights: An open course for running and walking, with no time pressure
Participants of all ages and backgrounds
A colorful program featuring a bouncy castle, bull riding and music
additional: The run is open to people of all ages, backgrounds, skin colors and religions, including people with disabilities. There are no rankings; the focus is on having fun and coming together. The program offers a range of activities for participants and visitors, including a bouncy castle, bull riding, activities for children, music and culinary specialties. The event takes place at the Ludwig-Wolker sports facility and is part of SportWoche für Alle 2026, which features inclusive sports activities and taster sessions.

name: Kreuzhorst Ultra
description: The Kreuzhorst Ultra (KRHU) is a friendly backyard ultra in Magdeburg-Kreuzhorst, taking place for the third time. The 6.7 km course starts again at the top of every hour, and participants run as many laps as they can or wish to. The race is a private invitation-only event focused on community, passion, and the joy of running. The course runs mainly along forest and farm tracks with no significant climbs, and there are classifications for distances of 53 km, 100 km, and 160 km.

name: Schottener Stauseelauf
description: The Schotten Reservoir Run is organized by TGV Schotten, the largest sports club in the Vogelsberg region. The event gives runners the opportunity to compete on varied courses around the reservoir. The run is part of the club’s extensive sports program, which also includes numerous major running events. Participants and visitors are warmly welcome to enjoy the sporting atmosphere and beautiful scenery.
course_highlights: Running routes around the Schotten Reservoir
Varied terrain in the Vogelsberg region
Organized by an experienced sports club with professional timing
additional: Registration, results and certificates are provided through the club’s own timing service, "TGV SportStar". TGV Schotten is a large sports club with more than 1,300 members and organizes other major events in running and other disciplines in addition to the Reservoir Run. The race is known for its fast, flat course and attracts runners from across the region. Registration is available on the official website, and the event is a popular opportunity for recreational and competitive runners to improve their personal bests.

name: Appelhülsener Landlauf
location: Appelhülsener Landlauf, Nottuln-Appelhülsen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Appelhülsener Landlauf is a family-friendly running event in the beautiful Münsterland, offering routes for all age groups. The officially measured 5 km and 10 km races are eligible for inclusion in rankings and combine Westphalian charm with rural idyll. Refreshment stations and a varied selection in the finish area ensure participants are well catered for. The event is part of the Westmünsterland Running Series and offers a friendly atmosphere for runners and walkers.
course_highlights: Officially measured 5 km and 10 km routes, eligible for inclusion in rankings
Water refreshment stations every 2.5 km
Changing and shower facilities at the sports centre in the start and finish area
additional: Race packs can be collected at the sports centre on race day from 13:00. Timing is provided by Race-Result using a reusable chip attached to the bib, which is collected at the finish. Changing and shower facilities are located directly in the start/finish area. The first three male and female runners in the 5 km and 10 km races receive awards. All participants in the Bambini and student races receive a medal. Nordic walking is not timed competitively and has no awards ceremony. Certificates and results are available online; certificate printing is offered at race-pack collection. Parking is available at Marienplatz 15, 48301 Nottuln.

name: Bahnstreckenlauf
location: Zinhaine, Bad Marienberg, Westerwaldkreis, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
description: The Wäller Bahnstreckenlauf in Bad Marienberg is a new running event starting in 2025. From 2026, it will also count as a scoring race for the Wäller-Lauf-Cup. The course is an out-and-back route along the cycle path between Langenbach bei Bad-Marienberg and Nistertal. The start and finish are on Zinhainer Weg, above the Rübsamen company, with a nearby parking lot for participants. The event is organized by TuS Bad-Marienberg Leichtathletik and offers runners an attractive course in the region.
course_highlights: Out-and-back route along the cycle path between Langenbach and Nistertal
Start and finish on Zinhainer Weg, above the Rübsamen company
Parking available right by the start and finish
additional: The event is part of the Wäller-Lauf-Cup from 2026. Certificates and individual results are available online. The course is an out-and-back route on a cycle path, suggesting a flat, fast course. The event offers various age categories and distances.

name: Brückenlauf Wetter
description: The Brückenlauf Wetter is an inclusive running event in Wetter (Ruhr), where people with and without disabilities can take part together. The event offers various distances, from the Bambini/FUN relay to 5.6 km and 11 km, for both running and walking. It places great importance on team spirit, community, the enjoyment of exercise, and accessibility. It is a special opportunity to be active together and share the joy of sport.
course_highlights: Distances of 4×400 m relay, 5.6 km, and 11 km
Inclusive participation for people with and without disabilities
Accessible courses for all ability levels
additional: Certificates can be printed online. The event is organized by Volmarsteiner Inklusionssportverein e. V. There is a 4×400 m FUN relay for all age groups. The FUN and Bambini relays are open to all age groups.

name: Halveraner Herbstlauf
location: Innenstadt von Halver, Märkischer Kreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Halver Autumn Run takes place annually on the last weekend in September in Halver town centre. Organised by SSV Halver together with LGHS, the event offers races for toddlers and schoolchildren, as well as a relay for recreational runners. The main event is a 4 x 900-metre relay with two categories (U100 and Ü100). The event has been a fixture on the local running calendar for over 20 years and takes runners right through Halver city centre.
course_highlights: Relay race with 4 x 900-metre laps
The course runs through Halver town centre
Separate races for toddlers, schoolchildren and youth
additional: Late entries are possible online or at the race office up to 45 minutes before the respective race start. A fee of €1.50 (online) or €2 (race office) applies to entries on the day of the event. Toilets, showers and changing facilities are available at Lindenhof School. The roads will be closed for the race from 12:00. All participants receive a medal; the top three in each age group also receive medals and certificates. Relay race, 4 x 900 m, in Halver town centre, age categories U100 / Ü100

name: Hofheimer Volkslauf
description: The Hofheim Volkslauf is a long-standing running event held at Sportpark Hofheim in Lampertheim-Hofheim. It is organized by Turnverein 1896 Hofheim im Ried e.V. and offers runners of all ages a friendly, welcoming atmosphere. The event is known for its good organization and the opportunity to get active and enjoy a sense of community.
course_highlights: Various distances (1 km, 5 km, 10 km)
Running, walking, and Nordic walking events
Venue at Sportpark Hofheim, with a flat course
additional: Registration is by submitting a form downloaded as a Word document. Esther Heilmann and Verena Salomon are the contacts for questions; their telephone numbers and email addresses are provided. The website also has a contact form for further inquiries. The event is open to runners of all ages, including children’s and youth competitions. Start times are 15:15 and 15:30. Further details, registration, and the race information are available on the website.

name: Rodheimer Volkslauf
description: The Rodheim Fun Run is a family-friendly running event and part of the popular Main-Lauf-Cup series. The start and finish are centrally located at the sports center on the main playing field, creating an appealing stadium atmosphere for sports enthusiasts. The event offers a range of competitions, from a children’s race to a half marathon and 10 km race, suitable for children, fitness enthusiasts, and ambitious runners alike. The awards ceremony is lively, and the event attracts a good turnout.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the sports center on the main playing field, with a stadium atmosphere
A variety of distances, from the 0.15 km children’s race to the half marathon and 10 km race
Part of the Main-Lauf-Cup, with scoring races for various age groups
additional: Late entries are possible on the event day until approximately 30 minutes before the respective start. The event includes scoring races in the Main-Lauf-Cup and BBF-Junior Main-Lauf-Cup. The office is open at specific times on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays. Scenic run, family event, inclusive options, various race distances, on-site registration

name: Volksbank-Citylauf Telgte
description: The 19th Volksbank City Run Telgte is taking place and offers runners of all ages a varied programme. The routes pass through the historic old town, along the Ems and through the surrounding countryside, vividly reflecting the motto “Town, Country and River.” In addition to the main 10,000-metre race, other events include a 5,000-metre race, walking, student and Bambini races, and an untimed Fun Run. The event is suitable for competitive runners, recreational runners and families, and is organised by TV Friesen Telgte e.V.
course_highlights: 10,000-metre main race through the old town, the Ems floodplains and the countryside
5,000-metre race with a drink station halfway along the route
Varied surfaces, including asphalt, a tartan track, paved paths and natural trails
additional: Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start, with a €2 late-entry fee (for the Bambini race, this fee is charged once per family or group). Changing facilities are available in the old double gym at the school centre, close to the start and finish. Medals, trophies and certificates are awarded in various events and age groups. The varied route includes asphalt, a tartan track, paved paths and natural trails. Photos and video footage will be taken and published. The start and finish are at the school centre sports field. Registration is online. Changing facilities are in the Old Double Gym. Children’s races are not timed.

name: Weezer Staffellauf
description: The Weeze Relay Race has been held in Weeze every year in mid-September since 1985 and has become a popular relay event with up to 250 participating teams. The course follows a scenic 5 km loop along the Niers walking trail. The event offers various relay categories, including Bambini, schoolchildren’s and regular teams, and attracts runners of all ages. The athletics department of TSV Weeze organizes the event with great dedication and looks forward to welcoming many participants in 2026.
course_highlights: 5 km loop along the Niers walking trail
Relay event with Bambini, schoolchildren’s and regular teams
Held annually in mid-September since 1985
additional: Event information and registration will follow at the end of July. Up to 250 relay teams have participated. The 38th Weeze Relay Race in 2024 saw 32 Bambini, 36 schoolchildren’s teams and 55 regular teams finish. The event also includes school and community competitions, as well as on-site refreshments.

name: Herbstcross des SSV-MG-Ahlsdorf / 2. Peter Zinke Gedenklauf
MOUNTAINMAN Reit im Winkl
organizer: Motor Presse Hamburg GmbH & Co. KG Verlagsgesellschaft
description: MOUNTAINMAN Reit im Winkl is a challenging trail-running event in the Chiemgau Alps, with five different distances ranging from 11 to 73 kilometers. The routes pass through impressive mountain scenery, with highlights including ski jumps, the idyllic Klausenbach Gorge, alpine pastures, and Dürrnbachhorn, with breathtaking views all the way to the Wilder Kaiser. The event welcomes trail runners from beginners to professionals, although the longer distances are suitable only for experienced runners. Special routes are available for hikers, and dogs are also welcome on the shorter routes. The event offers a friendly, family atmosphere, with an expo, Kids’ Trail, Community Trail, and a pasta party on the evening before the race.

name: Bausch+Ströbel Stadtlauf Ilshofen
description: The Bausch+Ströbel Ilshofen City Run is a long-standing running event held annually in Ilshofen. It offers runners of various ages and ability levels the opportunity to compete on a varied route through the city. The course is well marked and passes through attractive parts of the city, making the race appealing to both participants and spectators. The city run is a popular event on the regional running calendar and is organized by TSV Ilshofen.

name: Herbstlauf
description: The Ötigheim Autumn Run is a traditional running event held annually by Turngemeinde Germania Ötigheim 1907 e.V. The race offers a friendly atmosphere for running enthusiasts of all ages and ability levels. The event is known for its relaxed atmosphere and the opportunity to experience the club community. Numerous photos and reports from previous races are available on the website to give an impression of the event.

name: 1. Basche-Cross
description: The Basche-Cross is a traditional cross-country race in Barsinghausen, welcoming runners of all ability levels. The course passes through varied terrain and offers a demanding challenge away from paved paths. The event is known for its natural atmosphere and the chance to experience cross-country running in a scenic setting. Participants can look forward to a well-organized event with a friendly, family atmosphere.
course_highlights: Natural cross-country course through varied terrain
Demanding sections away from paved paths
Scenic surroundings in Barsinghausen

name: 10. Göttinger Lichterlauf
description: The Göttingen Charity Lights Run is an atmospheric running event around Kiessee lake in Göttingen, bringing people together to do good. The event features special lighting, a varied music program, and the strong commitment of participants and volunteers. The run supports Elternhaus Göttingen, which provides families with seriously ill children a home away from home during a difficult time. The Charity Lights Run is an evening of community, music, and lights that delights many people every year.
course_highlights: Atmospheric lighting around Kiessee lake
Varied music program during the event
A community running and walking evening in support of Elternhaus Göttingen
additional: The event is a charity run in support of Elternhaus Göttingen, which helps families with seriously ill children. It is an evening run featuring music and lights, and walkers are welcome too. The event is supported by many volunteers, musicians, and supporters.

name: Benin Benefiz-Lauf
description: The Benin Charity Run is a scenic running event in Hirzweiler, taking place for the 19th time. The route offers panoramic views across the Ill Valley and runs mostly along paved country lanes. The event supports aid projects in Benin, with proceeds and entry fees going to AG Benin. In addition to the run, participants can enjoy a generous cake buffet, grilled sausages and drinks at the Dorfwaldhalle in Hirzweiler, followed by the awards ceremony.

name: Bergzeitlauf Brockenheroes 2026
description: The BROCKENHEROES mountain time trial and uphill race is a challenging individual time trial in the Harz, held in Schierke. Participants compete on various routes of up to 24 km and with up to 900 metres of elevation gain, including road cycling, mountain biking, unicycling, running, roller skiing and Nordic walking. The event offers a unique challenge against the clock, the mountain and oneself, starting on Brockenstraße and finishing on the Brocken plateau. The atmosphere combines sporting ambition with the impressive natural scenery of the Harz.

name: Böckstiegellauf
description: The Böckstiegellauf is a scenic race through the Teutoburg Forest and the Ravensberg Hills, running from Peter auf’m Berge in Bielefeld to the center of Werther. Distances include 18 km and 10 km, as well as a 2.5 km schoolchildren’s race. The course partly follows the Hermannslauf and passes the Böckstiegelhaus and the Böckstiegel Museum. The event is very well organized, with a shuttle bus from the finish to the start and an awards ceremony in the center of Werther.

name: Cloppenburger Citylauf
organizer: Stadt Cloppenburg, Lauftreff des SV Bethen
description: The Cloppenburg City Run is a popular running event held as part of the Cloppenburg City Festival, which takes place annually on the last weekend in September. The main race starts at the Red School on the market square and runs along Eschstraße to Rathausplatz. In addition to the main race, there is a relay competition in which teams of four each complete a course of approximately 1,000 metres four times. The event is organised by the running group of SV Bethen e. V. and overseen by the NLV district of Cloppenburg.

name: Crosslauf Winhöring
description: The cross-country race in Winhöring offers a varied event for different age groups and ability levels. It includes a 7.5 km main race and a 700 m children’s race. The course passes through the scenic surroundings of Winhöring and offers runners of all ages an athletic challenge.

name: Drei-Täler-Lauf
description: The 3-Täler-Lauf, organised by TV Mettingen 1930 e.V., takes participants along varied routes through the three valleys of Fahlbachtal, Ölmühlental and Köllbachtal in the Tecklenburger Land. The 14.1 km main race features challenging, hilly terrain and impressive views of Querenberg, Schafberg and Schniederberg. There is also an 8.3 km 2-Täler-Lauf and a Nordic walking option for beginners and experienced athletes alike. Children are welcome to take part in an 800 m schoolchildren’s race and a 400 m Bambini race, where fun is the main focus. The family-friendly event offers timing with a disposable chip, as well as showers and changing rooms at Ludgeri School.

name: Durlacher Turmberglauf
description: The Durlach Turmberg Run is a flat, fast 10-kilometer race through the historic old town of Durlach, along the Pfinz to just before Grötzingen and back. There is also a children’s race in Durlach Palace Gardens. The race attracts many runners and offers an appealing course for fast times.
course_highlights: Flat, fast 10 km course
Route through Durlach’s old town
Along the Pfinz to just before Grötzingen
additional: The Africa Runners running team supports the Turmberg Run and raises donations to build a school in Africa. Interested runners can join the team and run for a good cause wearing an Africa Runners shirt.

name: Emmertinger Herbstfestlauf
description: The Emmerting Herbstfest Run takes place at the sports field in Emmerting and is part of the local autumn festival. The event is aimed at children, adults, club runners, recreational runners, and walkers. There are various distances, including Bambini runs, children’s races, 5- and 10-kilometer runs, and Nordic walking routes. Its family-friendly, festive atmosphere makes the run a popular meeting place for the local running community.

name: Friedrichshaller Runde
description: The Friedrichshaller Runde is a running event in Bad Friedrichshall, taking place on September 25, 2027. It is part of the 3-Flüsse-Cup and offers runners an attractive route through the scenic surroundings of the city. The event is aimed at running enthusiasts of all ages and offers not only a sporting experience but also the opportunity to actively explore the region. It is organized by Stadtmarketing Bad Friedrichshall, which is also responsible for other tourism services in the region.
course_highlights: Run through the scenic surroundings of Bad Friedrichshall
Part of the 3-Flüsse-Cup, with a varied course
The route follows well-known cycling and hiking trails, such as the Kocher-Jagst Cycle Route
additional: The event is organized by Stadtmarketing Bad Friedrichshall. You can get in touch by phone at 07136/832-106 or by email at tourist@friedrichshall.de. The Friedrichshaller Runde is part of a wide range of leisure activities in the region, including cycling, hiking, and cultural tours.

name: Herbstfestlauf
description: The 30th Niederstetten Autumn Festival Run takes place around the town hall in Niederstetten and offers varied routes for all age groups. The shorter races run through the town center, while the main race follows the scenic Vorbach Valley. Participants can look forward to beautiful views of the vineyards and Weikersheim Castle. A range of race categories, from the mini run to the relay, means there is something for everyone.

name: Hohenlockstedter Pellkartoffellauf
description: The Hohenlockstedter Pellkartoffellauf is a long-standing running event that has been held annually on the Pohl-Boskamp grounds since 2002. With distances of 2.8 km, 5 km and 10 km, the race offers a suitable challenge for both beginners and experienced runners. The event is especially family-friendly, with special Bambini runs for children and a varied program featuring games, a food mile and entertainment. It promotes a sense of community and the joy of being active, and welcomes individuals, school classes, teams and companies.

name: Hotfoot Run Warstein
description: The Hotfoot Run Warstein is a spectacular obstacle race, with distances ranging from 5 km (Family Edition) to 20 km, making it suitable for all fitness levels and age groups. The course crosses the Montgolfiadengelände, the ski slope and the quarry, with plenty of muddy obstacles, water slides and foam. Since 2007, the event has offered an electrifying start show, a unique atmosphere, and a focus on team spirit and fun. Whether you’re a fitness fanatic, a fun-loving group or a family, everyone can enjoy an unforgettable adventure here in NRW.

name: Höhlerfestlauf
description: The 11th Höhlerfest Run in Gera offers a varied running event with courses for all ages and ability levels. New this year is the 22 km cross-country run with obstacles and 420 m of elevation gain, which leads through the city forest and Hofwiesenpark. In addition to classic distances from 0.8 km to 12 km, there are walking and handicap courses, as well as the popular parent-child run for preschoolers. The event stands out for its special atmosphere, with live music and a family-friendly feel, and is supported by the City of Gera.

name: Kreismeisterschaften Waldlauf (Kreis Ludwigsburg)
location: Remseck am Neckar, Ludwigsburg, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Remsecker Forest Run is a family-friendly race held annually in September in Remseck. The event offers challenging routes through the Remsecker Forest and is open to runners of all ages and ability levels. The RunningCrew Remseck community meets regularly for group training and promotes the enjoyment of running and a sense of community. The race is known for its friendly atmosphere and varied routes.
course_highlights: Challenging routes around the Remsecker Forest
Trail section up to 9 km long through the Hochdorfer Forest
Routes for different ability levels, from 3 km to 9 km
additional: Regular group training on Fridays at 18:30 in front of the entrance to the Hochdorfer Forest (Schlossstraße 36). Running drills and a warm-up before training. Running shirts are available, with replacements provided if lost. Club membership is not required to take part in the group training.

name: König Ludwig Lauf - Sommeredition
description: The König Ludwig Lauf - Summer Edition is Bavaria’s most scenic panoramic run in the Ammergau Alps. The event offers varied courses from 6 km to 21 km through the picturesque landscape of the Ammergau Alps Nature Park. A free shuttle bus takes participants to the start in Ettal, and the event is ideal for trail and landscape running enthusiasts. Its family-friendly atmosphere and well-organized arrangements make the run a special experience.

name: Lauf Rund um den Grengel
description: The Rund um den Grengel Run is a traditional fun run in Engelskirchen, held annually by VfL Engelskirchen e.V., Athletics & Triathlon Department. The event offers various distances, including a Bambini run, schoolchildren’s races, a 5 km fun run and a 10 km main race, some of which are held as municipal championships. The course is flat and runs over a sports field, roads and forest paths; it has been measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV). Its family-friendly atmosphere and inclusion of children and young people make the run a special event for all age groups.

name: R5K Berlin
description: The R5K Tour Finale is an exciting 5-kilometer run for children and young people as part of the GENERALI BERLIN-MARATHON. The race takes place on September 25, 2027, between Potsdamer Platz and the finish line at the Brandenburg Gate. It gives young runners the opportunity to take part on an attractive course in central Berlin and be part of a major running event. The event promotes exercise and community under the motto of getting the next generation moving.
course_highlights: Course between Potsdamer Platz and the Brandenburg Gate
Attractive location in central Berlin
Part of the major GENERALI BERLIN-MARATHON event
additional: The R5K Tour Finale takes place on Saturday, September 25, 2027. The exact start time is not specified. The event is part of the GENERALI BERLIN-MARATHON Kids & Youth offerings and is supported by sponsors such as Generali and adidas.

name: Remsecker Waldlauf
description: The Remseck Forest Run is a family-friendly race through the picturesque Hochdorf Forest in Remseck. The event offers various distances for children, teenagers, and adults, taking runners through varied woodland terrain with muddy, uneven ground and narrow paths. The race combines sporting ambition with a nature experience and a sense of community, and is open to runners of all ages and ability levels. The event is organized by Sport- und Gesangverein Hochdorf e.V. and will be held for the sixth time in 2026.

name: Schelder Berglauf
description: The Schelder Berglauf is a challenging mountain run in Dillenburg, held annually by ASC Dillenburg. The course passes through varied terrain with steep climbs, offering runners an athletic challenge in a natural setting. The event attracts both competitive and recreational runners and is a regular fixture on the regional running calendar.

name: Wald-und Hügellauf
description: The forest and hill run in Groß-Umstadt is a long-standing event that starts and finishes at Ludwig-Wedel-Stadium. Participants can choose between two distances: the classic 13.2 km course and the half-marathon distance of 21.1 km. The run is part of the Langlauf Cup Jugenheim and is sanctioned by the DLV. The course winds through forests and hills, where runners can expect witches in the woods and the “Mountain of Truth.” Refreshments are provided along the way, and after the run there is an awards ceremony, with showers and changing rooms available on site.

name: Int. Pronsfelder Volks- und Straßenlauf
description: The 38th International Pronsfeld Fun Run and Road Race offers a varied running experience in the heart of the Eifel for all ages and ability levels. From Bambini and children’s races to the fun run and half marathon, there’s something for everyone. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, attractive prizes, and excellent refreshments in the finish area. The start and finish are at Autohaus Mais-Glandien in Pronsfeld, and the race is a sporting highlight with a strong tradition and community spirit.

name: Nocna Piątka 2026
location: Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, Gdańsk, Poland
description: Nocna Piątka is a unique 5-kilometer race taking place in Gdańsk, the day before the Garmin Gdańsk Half Marathon. The start and finish are on the illuminated pitch at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, where participants can enjoy a spectacular show featuring lasers, music, and light effects. The course runs through the city and features cheering points with music and fire shows, creating a one-of-a-kind nighttime atmosphere. This new version of the well-known race held alongside the half marathon has moved to Saturday evening to give runners and spectators a special experience.

name: Gliwicka Prowokacja biegowa
organizer: Miejski Zarząd Usług Komunalnych w Gliwicach
description: The 146th Gliwice Park Run Challenge is an annual running event held in Gliwice, combining sport, a friendly atmosphere and time in the city’s green spaces. The run is open to experienced runners and anyone looking to spend time actively without the pressure of competition. The start traditionally takes place in the clearing behind the Piast Stadium, and the race office opens at 9:00, with the run starting at 10:00. Advance registration and an entry fee are required. It’s a great opportunity to end February actively and head into the upcoming spring season with renewed energy.

name: Kołobrzeska Odyseja
description: Kołobrzeska Odyseja ’26 is a series of three exceptional races held in Kołobrzeg, combining passion, strength, and a seaside atmosphere. The event offers races over 5 km, half-marathon, marathon, and 10 km distances. The courses are certified by the PZLA, and participants can look forward to generous race packs, a finisher zone with a hot meal and drinks, and valuable prizes. It’s a great opportunity to feel the energy of the seaside and become part of a new running tradition in Kołobrzeg.

name: X Cross Doliny Małej Panwi
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Mała Panew Team Zawadzkie Koło Towarzystwa Przyjaciół Lasu "Dolina Małej Panwi"
description: X Cross Doliny Małej Panwi – In Pursuit of the Beaver is a running and Nordic walking event held in the picturesque surroundings of Zawadzkie. The event offers 5.3 km and 10.3 km routes through the Mała Panew Valley, giving participants the chance to connect with nature and enjoy an active break. It is organised by the Mała Panew Team Zawadzkie Association and the “Dolina Małej Panwi” Circle of the Society of Friends of the Forest.

name: XI Bieg po Gminie Zduńska Wola
description: The 11th Run Around Zduńska Wola Municipality is an annual running event organized by the Janiszewice Volunteer Fire Department. The race is aimed at fans of fast, 10 km asphalt courses, which have been certified since 2021. The event is open and welcoming to runners of different experience levels, and also includes children’s races that promote physical activity among young participants. The website features reports, photos, and results from previous editions, highlighting the event’s tradition and growing popularity.
course_highlights: Certified 10 km asphalt course
Flat, fast course conducive to good results
Children’s races over distances of approximately 300 m for ages 4–15
additional: Children’s races take place during the event, offering distances of approximately 300 meters for children aged 4–15, without the pressure of competition. The organizers provide reports, photos, and results from previous editions of the race.

name: XIII Bieg Branicki
description: The 13th Branice Run is a 10 km road race taking place in Branice, Opole Voivodeship. Runners can prepare for the event using dedicated training plans tailored to different experience levels. The event is a great opportunity for runners to test their fitness on a scenic course and enjoy the sporting atmosphere. The organizers provide expert support and the option to manage race information through the TreningBiegacza.pl platform.

name: XXI Mikołowski Bieg Uliczny
description: The 21st Henryk Biskupiak Mikołów Street Race is the biggest sporting celebration in Mikołów and takes place annually. The street race attracts runners of different age groups and ability levels, promoting physical activity and the spirit of sporting competition. Participants can take on a route through the city streets, while the organizers provide professional support and an atmosphere full of sporting excitement. The event is an excellent opportunity to bring the local community together and promote a healthy lifestyle.

name: Bieg Twierdzy Kraków
description: Bieg Twierdzy Kraków is a cross-country race held in Reduta Park in Kraków, with 5 km and 10 km routes. The course runs mainly along paths and forest tracks, with one significant uphill section, combining sport with the chance to discover the history of the Kraków Fortress. After the race, participants can explore historic fortifications and sites of the former Kraków Fortress with a guide, making this event a unique combination of physical activity and history education. The organizers are members of the Adventure Association, who have been involved in organizing sporting and adventure events for years.
course_highlights: Cross-country route along paths and forest tracks
One substantial uphill section
Guided tour of historic Kraków Fortress sites after the race
additional: After the race, participants and their companions can take a guided tour of historic sites of the former Kraków Fortress with a professional guide. The top finishers receive unique trophies made from 100-year-old bricks. The running routes are off-road and green, with history in the background. Guided tours of sites of the former Kraków Fortress are available after the race. Information about the distances, route and location comes from previous editions.

name: VIII Bieg Szlakiem Kolejowym
location: Czerwona Woda, Gmina Węgliniec, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Horský beh Pačanským chotárom
location: Pača, okr. Rožňava, Pača, okr. Rožňava, pred Kultúrnym domom
description: Pačanský Chotár Mountain Run is a running event in the village of Pača, offering two main courses: a more challenging 13.5 km main race with 492 m of elevation gain and a shorter 6.3 km hobby run with 203 m of elevation gain. The routes combine paved and forest roads, with beautiful views and refreshment stations along the way. Runners start and finish in front of the cultural centre in Pača, and the organizers provide route navigation and marking. The event is suitable for both experienced and recreational runners and offers a sporting atmosphere with refreshments and a raffle.

name: Rybnícka 10-ka a 5-ka
location: Rybník, okr. Levice, Rybník, okr. Levice, futbalový štadión
organizer: Obec Rybník, ZŠ s MŠ Rybník
description: Rybník 10K and 5K is a running event held at the football stadium in the village of Rybník, Levice District. Races are held over two distances—5 km and 10 km—with various age categories for men and women. The children’s race starts at 9:00, and the adults’ race at 11:00. The event is suitable for the general public, including secondary school students and seniors, who receive discounted entry fees. The organizers provide a welcoming atmosphere and quality facilities for runners.

name: Behaj lesmi Devín
description: Behaj lesmi Devín is a unique trail race near Bratislava, offering a route with views of the confluence of the Danube and Morava rivers and Devínska Kobyla. The trails follow the historic Amber Road and pass through blooming wild garlic avenues, making the run an unforgettable experience. The race is part of the Behaj lesmi series and is listed as a UTMB Index Race, providing an international points ranking. You can compete on the short 12 km route or the 22 km half marathon. Both routes feature a marked Conti Speed Section, with a valuable prize up for grabs.

name: S Ankou za život
description: The Run with Anka for Life is a charity event held in Košice near St. Elisabeth Cathedral. The entry fee is a voluntary contribution, and all proceeds from entry fees go to the Oáza - Hope for a New Life facility. The event is organized by the Anka Kolesárová Pastoral Centre in Vysoká nad Uhom. Runners can combine a sporting challenge with supporting a good cause.

name: Hutčanská 5 s vierou – beh srdcom i telom
description: The Run with Heart and Soul in Nižná Hutka is an annual running event offering a 5 km course for experienced runners and a fun 500 m route for the youngest participants. Alongside the sporting experience, the program includes a spiritual reflection, refreshments, a panel discussion, and music. The event creates a welcoming community atmosphere and encourages both competition and the joy of running.

name: Běchovice - Praha, MČR v silničním běhu mužů, žen, juniorů a juniorek
description: Běchovice - Praha je legendární silniční běh na 10 km s nejdelší nepřerušenou tradicí v Evropě, který se koná již po 130. ročník. Závod je oficiálním mistrovstvím České republiky v silničním běhu a nabízí náročnou trať o délce 10 031 metrů, která prověří každého běžce. Atmosféra závodu je výjimečná a doplněná moderním zázemím, včetně doprovodného programu a pamětních medailí. Závod je otevřený široké škále kategorií od juniorských po veteránské a také nabízí štafetový běh.

name: Běh metropole Praha 1
description: Běh Metropole je seriál veřejných běžeckých závodů konaných v různých městských částech Prahy, jehož cílem je podpořit zdravý životní styl a sounáležitost obyvatel k jejich městské části. Závod je otevřený všem věkovým kategoriím, od dětí po seniory i handicapované, kteří reprezentují svou městskou část. Každý start přináší body do soutěže o nejsportovnější městskou část Prahy. Atmosféra je přátelská a motivující, s originálními medailemi a dárky pro účastníky.

name: AggerEnergie- und Sparkassenlauf Gummersbach
description: The AggerEnergie and Sparkassen Run in Gummersbach is a long-established running event organized by LG Gummersbach. The route runs through the city and offers a varied course that also passes through the pedestrian zone and several neighborhoods. The event attracts numerous runners and spectators and is known for its good organization and friendly atmosphere. In addition to the sporting competition, there is also an attractive program of activities for the whole family.
course_highlights: The course runs through the pedestrian zone and the access road
At the Alte Vogtei / Zur Vogtei junction, the route splits into two loops of different lengths
Start and finish at Lindenplatz, with a spectator area and refreshments
additional: The event is supported by around 60 volunteers. There is a bouncy castle for children and mobile refreshments at Lindenplatz. The course is separated from the spectator area by crowd-control barriers. The volunteer team provides refreshments and a cake buffet. Races of 450 meters, 2 kilometers, 4 kilometers, and 10 kilometers are offered. The 10-kilometer race has a time limit of 75 minutes.

name: 14. Bahrs-Kartoffellauf
description: The 14th Bahrs-Kartoffel-Lauf 2026 in Jembke offers runners a varied program with three distances: the 10 km Bahrs-Lauf, the 5 km Kartoffellauf, and an 800 m children’s run. The event takes place in a family-friendly atmosphere, with culinary delights and a varied program featuring performances by the Jembke cheerleaders. Race bibs must be returned after the run, and late registration is not available. The event is part of the running cup and offers not only sporting competition but also a chance to socialize over a generous cake buffet and hearty food.
course_highlights: 10 km course on Komoot
5 km course on Komoot
800 m children’s run
additional: Start times: 10 km Bahrs-Lauf at 10:30, 5 km Kartoffellauf at 12:00, and 800 m children’s run at 13:15. Late registration is not available; registration is in advance only. Race bibs must be returned after the run. Food options include potato soup, veggie bowls, potato pancakes with apple sauce, burgers, bratwurst, shashlik, and rosemary potatoes. The Jembke cheerleaders perform at approximately 11:45 and 13:00. Award ceremonies take place after each race. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, a variety of running options for all age groups, and the opportunity to combine the run with socializing.

name: 7-MEILEN-TRAIL
description: The 7-Mile Trail in Kaiserslautern offers two challenging routes: a short 4-mile route for running and Nordic walking, and a long 7-mile route exclusively for runners. The routes pass through varied terrain with a high proportion of singletrack trails and are completely unpaved. The start and finish are opposite the Sommerhaus restaurant on Pfaffenbergstraße. The event is ideal for trail-running enthusiasts looking for a scenic, challenging course.
course_highlights: 4-mile route: approx. 6.4 km with 130 m of elevation gain
7-mile route: approx. 11.3 km with 340 m of elevation gain
Routes consist of 40–60% singletrack trails and are completely unpaved
additional: Aid stations: 4-mile route, once in the finish area; 7-mile route, twice (after 6 km at the TSG fountain and in the finish area). The long route is for runners only; the short route is also open to Nordic walkers.

name: Altkönig-Lauf
price_range: 10 km 16,00 Euro, Halbmarathon 18,00 Euro, Schülerläufe 5,00 Euro, Walking 14,00 Euro
description: The Altkönig Run, organized by MTV Kronberg, is a traditional community race with DLV approval. Events include a half marathon (21.1 km), 10 km races, children’s races, a Bambini run, and walking/Nordic walking. The course winds through the scenic Taunus landscape, with around 350 meters of elevation gain in the half marathon. The race is part of the Taunus-Lauf Challenge and offers every finisher a medal, as well as trophies and cash prizes for the top runners. Start and finish are at the MTV sports facility in Kronberg.
course_highlights: Half marathon with approximately 350 meters of elevation gain
Start and finish at the MTV sports facility in Kronberg
Part of the Taunus-Lauf Challenge, which has three scoring races
additional: Every finisher receives a medal. The 10 km walking and Nordic walking events start at 9:40 a.m. and are untimed. Children’s races start from 12:00 p.m., over distances of 350 m and 1,000 m. There is a drinks station on the course. Participants are asked to bring reusable cups or their own mugs to help protect the environment. The awards ceremony is planned for around 1:00 p.m., with finisher trophies for all participants in attendance and cash prizes for the top runners. Courses pass through the Taunus on forest trails. Elevation gain: 150 m for 10 km and 350 m for the half marathon. Start and finish at the MTV sports facility in Kronberg. Registration is available online and on race day. Environmentally conscious behavior is encouraged at the refreshment station.

name: Asse-Volkslauf und Nordic Walking
description: The Asse Fun Run and Nordic Walking event organized by TSV "Vater Jahn" Wittmar is held annually and will take place for the 34th time. The event is very popular, with record participation last year. It offers a range of running and walking routes in the beautiful surroundings of Wittmar and welcomes athletes of all ages. Registration is available from the end of June. Late registration is possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start, except for the kindergarten run.
course_highlights: Distances of 0.3 km and 10.6 km
Nordic Walking included
Location: Wittmar, Germany
additional: Registration opens at the end of June; detailed information is available in the official announcement; the event includes running and Nordic Walking disciplines

name: Kraichgaulauf
description: The Kraichgaulauf in Sinsheim-Rohrbach is a long-established race offering runners of all abilities varied routes through the scenic Kraichgau countryside. From the short 5 km course and popular 10 km race to the challenging half marathon and demanding 42.2 km hill marathon, there is something for everyone. The routes pass through nature and offer stunning views, including of the landmark Steinsberg Castle. The event is ideal for anyone looking to combine endurance, enjoying nature, and sporting ambition.
course_highlights: Hill marathon with varied elevation profiles and stunning views
10 km course featuring asphalt, paved farm roads, and picturesque woodland
5 km course with panoramic views of Kraichgaublick and Steinsberg Castle
additional: Bib pickup until 30 minutes before the start at Kreuzgrundhalle. Changing rooms and showers at Kreuzgrundhalle and the sports grounds. Parking available around the hall and in the sports field area. Bag storage in the start/finish area (Rohrbach Primary School). Refreshments including drinks, fruit, and snacks at several stations, depending on the course. Medal for all finishers. Timing uses a disposable chip integrated into the race bib. Late registration is possible until 30 minutes before the start, subject to availability.

name: Neandertallauf
organizer: TSV Hochdahl 64 e.V., Lauftreff Alt-Erkrath e.V. und TuS Erkrath 1930 e.V.
description: The Neandertal Run on September 26, 2027, in Erkrath-Hochdahl offers runners of all ages a varied program. The main event is a one-third marathon of 14,065 meters, taking a scenic route through the Neandertal, including a visit to the site where the Neanderthal was discovered and the Höhlenblick Adventure Tower. There is also a 5-km fun run, as well as walking and Nordic walking routes. Children can take part in age-appropriate races on a 900-meter circuit, making the event family-friendly.
course_highlights: One-third marathon route featuring paved and unpaved forest and field paths, with some sections suitable for cross-country running
Passage by the site where the Neanderthal was discovered and the Höhlenblick Adventure Tower
5-km route with flat and gently uphill sections through fields and a nature reserve
additional: The start and finish are at Bessemer Straße 10, at TIMOCOM. Race packets will be available from 8:30 a.m. on the day of the event. All timed races (except Bambini and U8) use bibs with a timing chip on the back. Free showers are available for 45 minutes at the nearby Neanderbad upon presentation of the race bib. Award ceremonies include certificates and prizes for various age groups. Children's races are not timed, but honorary prizes and certificates are awarded to the top runners. The start and finish are on Bessemer Straße in Erkrath-Hochdahl. Timing is provided for all races except Bambini U6 and children’s U8.

name: Schusterlauf
description: The Schusterlauf Preetz is a traditional running event with various distances, held in Preetz. The challenging 16 km course runs through forests and meadows and along Lake Lanker, and requires good to very good fitness. In addition to the main race, there are shorter distances, including the Bambini Run for children and the Kirchsee and Wehrberg runs. The event is part of the ZIPPEL’S Kiel.Cup, where participants can earn points toward the overall standings.
course_highlights: 16 km course through forests, meadows and along Lake Lanker
Good, firm-footed trails in the Wehrberg and along the shore of Kirchsee
Challenging course with a checkpoint at Gut Wahlstorf
additional: Bib pickup is available the day before the event (19:00–20:00) and on event day from 08:00 at the Alte Wilhelminenhalle, Schulstraße 2, 24211 Preetz. Automatic participation in the ZIPPEL’S Kiel.Cup with points scoring. Bib transfers are not possible. New service: Bags can be dropped off in a truck at the Market Square, near the finish. GPX files for the 5 km and 16 km courses are available to download. Courses are available as GPX files; online registration; start and finish in Preetz; includes a bag-drop service and results downloads.

name: Trainingslauf Bottwartal-Marathon
location: Riedstadion, Steinheim an der Murr, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Bottwartal Marathon is a running event in one of southern Germany’s most beautiful landscapes, taking runners past gentle vineyard slopes, idyllic old towns and lively crowds along the course. The route is a loop through the southern and northern Bottwartal, with varied sections on paved country roads and through historic town centers. The flat finish at the Steppi roundabout in Steinheim invites runners to make a strong final push. Whether you’re a beginner or an ambitious runner, you’ll find your own running experience here.
course_highlights: Loop through the southern and northern Bottwartal
Passage through historic old towns such as Steinheim, Murr, Gronau, Beilstein, Oberstenfeld and Großbottwar
Flat finish at the Steppi roundabout in Steinheim, perfect for an exciting final push
additional: Free monthly training runs in different pace groups on the last Sunday of the month in Steinheim. Summer holiday runs every Tuesday evening during the summer holidays, including a 10 km long run. Year-End Run: a 10 km run with punch and mulled wine at the end of the year. Registration is via Datasport. Late entries and transfers are possible until shortly before the run. In addition to the marathon, the event includes a half marathon, 10 km, 5 km and running events for all age groups.

name: Bergkloster-Lauf
description: The Bergklosterlauf, organized by TuS Velmede-Bestwig in cooperation with Bergkloster Bestwig, takes place in the Sauerland. The 6, 10 and 21 km races follow idyllic streams, cross ridges with magnificent viewpoints and pass through small settlements before finishing at Bergkloster Bestwig. Alongside the races, there are children’s and youth races and a supporting program featuring live music, childcare, free massages and extensive catering. The event is also part of the Volksbank Sauerland Laufcup organized by LAC Veltins Hochsauerland. The start and finish are easy to reach and offer ample parking as well as affordable overnight accommodation at the monastery.
course_highlights: Routes pass idyllic streams
Ridges with magnificent viewpoints
Finish at Bergkloster Bestwig
additional: Free massages are available after the finish. Childcare is provided for “running parents.” The start and finish are only 600 meters apart and are easy to reach by bus, train or car. There are 500 parking spaces nearby, including spaces for motorhomes. Affordable overnight accommodation is available at Bergkloster. The 10 km race is also open to walkers. The children’s and youth races start at 12 noon. The 10 km race and the children’s and youth races count toward the Volksbank Sauerland Laufcup. Routes of 6, 10 and 21 km; children’s and youth races; registration via Race Result; parking and accommodation at Bergkloster; route maps on Outdooractive

name: Bertlicher Straßenläufe
location: Sportplatz an der Heinrich-Obenhaus-Straße, Herten-Bertlich, Herten, Germany
description: The Bertlich Road Races are a long-standing road-running event in Herten-Bertlich, with competitions for different age and ability levels. A wide range of distances is offered on flat, paved farm roads around Bertlich. The start and finish are at the sports field on Heinrich-Obenhaus-Straße.
course_highlights: Flat, paved farm roads around Herten-Bertlich
Routes pass through the recreational area between Herten and Marl
A wide choice of distances, from short children's races to long-distance events
additional: The courses are measured by the DLV; refreshment stations are provided along the longer distances.

name: Bickendorfer Büdchenlauf
description: The Bickendorfer Büdchenlauf is an atmospheric race through the Cologne neighborhood of Bickendorf, offering an extensive selection of different running events so there is a suitable distance for everyone. The event delights competitive runners as well as children and recreational runners. The start and finish are on Venloer Straße in Cologne-Bickendorf. In addition to the sporting event, participants and visitors can enjoy a varied program featuring food and drink stalls, exhibitors, and music.
course_highlights: Race through the Cologne neighborhood of Bickendorf
Start and finish on Venloer Straße in Cologne-Bickendorf
Varied program featuring food and drink and music
additional: The event grounds offer a varied program featuring food and drink stalls, exhibitors, and music. The race offers different events for all ages and ability levels. Various distances, including children’s and dog races; registration opens on February 14; a traditional neighborhood race in Cologne-Bickendorf

name: Cochem Zeller Crosslauf Serie
description: The 39th edition of the Cochem Zeller Cross-Country Series takes place in Ulmen, Germany. The event offers two distances, 400 meters and 8 kilometers, on courses that are often suitable for record-setting performances. As part of the solidarity system in sport and running culture, Laufen.de members benefit from reduced entry fees. The race is known for its varied cross-country courses in the Eifel region.
course_highlights: Cross-country courses suitable for record-setting performances
Distances: 400 m and 8 km
Scenic surroundings in Ulmen, Eifel
additional: Typical September weather: around 19°C, low of 10°C, 45 mm average precipitation, mostly cloudy. September weather around 19°C, cloudy; several venues in the region; certificates and trophies for winners

name: GVG Citylauf Erftstadt
description: The GVG Citylauf Erftstadt is the region’s largest running event and takes place every September. It offers a special atmosphere for everyone who loves running, from children and recreational runners to elite athletes. The 10 km main race takes runners four times through the medieval old town and Lechenich Castle Park, with numerous spectators lining the route. Shorter races for schoolchildren, families, and companies are also available; they start and finish at the market square in Erftstadt-Lechenich.
course_highlights: 10 km main race with four laps through the medieval old town and the castle park
Loop course starting and finishing at the market square in Erftstadt-Lechenich
Officially measured, fast course with few turns
additional: The 10 km main race is also available as a relay. All finishers in the 5 km, 10 km, or relay races are entered into a draw to win a hot-air balloon ride for two. The course is designed so that runners pass the market square several times and can be cheered on by spectators. The youngest runners have a 750 m loop; schoolchildren run 2.5 km, and the family and company race is 5 km (2 laps). The event is approved by the German Athletics Association and follows its guidelines. Running event in the medieval old town and castle park, open to all ages and ability levels, including Laufcup 2026

name: Internationaler Hochfelln-Berglauf

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Nenngeld 40.- € inklusive Nudelparty, Talfahrt mit der Hochfellnseilbahn, Parkplatz, Verpflegungsbuffet, Duschen, Gepäcktransport

description: The International Hochfelln Mountain Run is a traditional mountain race in Bergen, Germany, held annually. The course starts in the valley at the Hochfelln cable car station at an altitude of 600 metres and finishes at the summit of the Hochfelln at 1,671 metres. It is 7.8 km long, with 1,071 metres of elevation gain. The race is part of the Mountain Running Grand Prix and offers runners a challenging, scenic mountain-running experience. In addition to the race, the event includes a pasta party and a wide range of refreshments for participants.
course_highlights: 7.8 km course with 1,071 m of elevation gain
Start at the valley station of the Hochfelln cable car (600 m), finish at the Hochfelln summit (1,671 m)
Part of the Mountain Running Grand Prix, with challenging mountain terrain
additional: The €40 entry fee includes Saturday's pasta party, the downhill ride on the Hochfelln cable car, parking, a generous refreshment buffet, showers and luggage transport. Race bibs can be collected on the evening before the race and on race day. Welcome party with pasta dinner on Saturday evening. Mountain trail terrain, registration required, historic race with multiple editions.

name: Volkslauf durch das schöne Alstertal
description: The Volkslauf through the beautiful Alstertal takes place in Hamburg and offers runners an attractive natural course along the walking trails in the upper reaches of the Alster. The event includes various distances, from a half marathon to 10 km and 4 km, as well as introductory runs for children. The course stands out for its natural setting in the heart of Hamburg, with a few small climbs and stairs. The event is part of the 27th Hamburger Laufcup and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with refreshments and medical support.

name: 52. BMW Berlin-Marathon
description: The GENERALI BERLIN-MARATHON is one of the world’s most renowned marathon events and part of the Abbott World Marathon Majors. On September 26, 2027, runners from around the world will gather to run through the streets of Berlin, cheered on by millions of enthusiastic spectators. The race is known for its unique energy, diversity, and the opportunity to achieve personal bests on a fast, flat course. In addition to the marathon, there are also exciting events for children and young people that promote running.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course through central Berlin
Support from millions of spectators along the route
Part of the Abbott World Marathon Majors, with international prestige
additional: Children and young people can take part in special races such as the mini-MARATHON, Bambini-Lauf, and R5K Tour Finale, which take place on September 25, 2027. The event is supported by strong partners such as Generali and adidas.

name: Northeimer Stadtlauf
description: The Northeim City Run is a long-standing running event held in the city of Northeim. The races start and finish at Münsterplatz, a central location in the city. The run is organized by Kreis Sportbund Northeim-Einbeck e.V. and offers a sporting event for runners of all ages. The event takes place and includes various running routes through the city.

name: Aindlinger Kleeblattmarsch
description: The Aindling Cloverleaf March is a unique 24-hour march in which participants can cover up to 100 kilometers over four 25-kilometer loops. The route is not marked and there are no road closures, requiring considerable determination and a good sense of direction. The route passes through varied, hilly landscapes around Aindling, including woodland and open countryside as well as picturesque villages. The march supports social projects, combining athletic effort with a good cause.

name: Kienberglauf
description: The Kienberglauf is a traditional running event organized by SV 08 Oehrenstock e.V. and held annually on the last Sunday in September. The event offers various competitions for different age groups and ability levels, including Nordic walking, children’s races, and distances from 2 to 16 kilometers. The course runs through the scenic surroundings of Oehrenstock near Ilmenau and is a highlight of club life. The fastest runners receive trophies, and all participants receive a certificate.

name: Kleeblattultra (100-Meilen-Lauf)
description: The Kleeblattultra is a challenging 100-mile ultramarathon in Schwarme, Lower Saxony, passing through three districts. The event was conceived with the idea of establishing the first 100-mile race in northern Germany. Organized by TSV Schwarme and a dedicated planning team, the race offers experienced ultrarunners a unique opportunity to complete the full distance. The event prioritizes comprehensive support, including timing, live tracking, and course refreshments.
course_highlights: 100 miles through three districts
Four individual course sections of 25 miles each
Start and finish area in Schwarme, with the sports hall serving as the event center
additional: Check-in on 24.09.2027 from 17:00 to 19:00 and on 25.09.2027 from 07:00 to 08:30; briefing on 25.09.2027 at 08:30; finish cutoff on 26.09.2027 at 12:00; the race cutoff time is 27 hours; participant limit of 50 individual starters; open to participants aged 18 and over; free showers are available in the start and finish area; the entry fee includes timing, live tracking, a pasta party, a substantial breakfast, extensive race refreshments, certificate printing, and a high-quality finisher shirt.

name: Kurparklauf 2026
description: The Kurparklauf in Bad Homburg v. d. Höhe takes place annually, turning the Kurpark into an attractive running course. The event offers two distances: a 10 km fun run for experienced runners and a 5 km run open to everyone who prefers a shorter, more accessible course. Both races start and finish on Brunnenallee and follow a 2.5 km loop through the green Kurpark, passing meadows, trees and garden paths without crossing heavily trafficked roads. The race is an established event and celebrates its 30th edition in 2026.

name: Lions - Dietzenbacher Stadtlauf 2026
description: The Lions - Dietzenbach City Run is an established running event in Hessentagspark Dietzenbach that combines sporting activity with social commitment. Every year, numerous runners of all ages take part, accompanied by families and spectators. The event offers a 4 km fun run, a competition for businesses and clubs, and a 10 km main race. The city run stands for community, exercise, and responsibility for the city of Dietzenbach.

name: Marner Kohltagelauf
description: The Marner Kohltagelauf is a traditional race in Marne and an official part of the Dithmarschen Cup and the Dithmarscher Firmencup. The event offers various distances, from 400 meters for children to 10 kilometers for adults. The courses are closed to traffic, clearly marked, and every kilometer is marked. Timing is handled professionally using a chip attached to the race bib, and the event takes place in almost any weather.
course_highlights: Courses are closed to traffic and clearly marked
Every kilometer is marked
