Water stations every 5 km and refreshments at the finish (mineral water, isotonic drinks, fruit)
additional: Late registration is possible online until 30 minutes before the start, with a €5 late registration fee. Timing uses a chip attached to the race bib, with no rental fee. Changing rooms are available, and showers can be used after the event at the Marne swimming pool.

name: Möhrendorfer Karpfenweiherlauf
description: The 10th Möhrendorfer Karpfenweiherlauf is a traditional scenic race for running and Nordic walking enthusiasts, held in the picturesque surroundings of Möhrendorf. The course follows forest, meadow, and field paths, passing numerous carp ponds, and includes around 150 metres of elevation gain over 21.1 km. In addition to the half marathon, there are Nordic walking events and various youth and children’s races. The event offers a varied, nature-rich setting for runners of all ages.

name: Nordahl Grieg Gedenklauf
organizer: Förderverein der Maxim-Gorki-Gesamtschule mit gymnasialer Oberstufe Kleinmachnow
description: The Nordahl Grieg Memorial Run is a traditional running event in Kleinmachnow, held at Maxim-Gorki-Gesamtschule. The event offers various races for Bambini, schoolchildren, young people, and adults on circuits around the school and Lake Kleinmachnow. All participants receive drinks and refreshments in the finish area, as well as medals after crossing the finish line. The event is organized by the Friends Association of Maxim-Gorki-Gesamtschule and is held under the patronage of the Norwegian Ambassador and the Mayor of Kleinmachnow.

name: Rheinhöhenlauf - RUN50
description: The Rheinhöhenlauf RUN50 is a three-day running event featuring three varied stages covering a total of 50 kilometers and around 1,000 meters of elevation gain. The event combines a sporting challenge with a friendly, personal atmosphere, making it ideal for running enthusiasts who want to combine their sport with a short break. It is organized by a dedicated team from TV Linz, BBC Linz and VfB Linz, and offers an attractive program alongside the race, including refreshments, luggage transport, a finisher’s medal, a technical shirt, a finger-food buffet and a ride on a historic railbus. Proceeds benefit the organizing clubs and the support association of Franziskus Hospital Linz.

name: Ruhstorfer Geländelauf
location: Ruhstorf an der Rott, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Ruhstorf cross-country race is a long-standing event in Lower Bavaria, inviting runners of all ages to enjoy a day of sport amid the beautiful countryside around Ruhstorf an der Rott. The varied program includes races for toddlers and schoolchildren, a fun run, and the main race over 7.5 kilometers. The varied course combines paved sections with field and meadow paths and features several climbs, offering a balanced mix of pace, nature, and sporting challenge. The race is part of the Grenzland-Laufcup and the Landkreis and Sparkassen Laufcups for schoolchildren and youth. The start and finish are at the parking lot of the Niederbayernhalle.
course_highlights: Loop course through the countryside around Ruhstorf
Combination of paved sections, field paths, and meadow paths
Several climbs provide a sporting challenge
additional: There are races for toddlers, schoolchildren, a fun run, and a main race. The organizer is SVG Ruhstorf e.V. 1923 - Leichtathletik und Laufen.

name: Rund um den Kellerskopf
description: Rund um den Kellerskopf is a road race event in Wiesbaden-Rambach, Hesse, where TuS Rambach has organized running events since 1960. The event offers various distances, including 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon of 21.1 km, as well as children’s and youth races on the same morning. The course is hilly rather than a flat city route, making it an appealing challenge for both serious runners and families. The start and finish are at the sports field on Trompeterstraße. The event combines the charm of a local club race with a range of participation options.

name: Saaraltarmlauf
description: The Saaraltarm Run is a long-standing running event in Saarlouis that attracts runners from the region and beyond every year. The event offers a well-organized race atmosphere, with the start and finish in Saarlouis. The course runs through the scenic surroundings of the Saaraltarm and offers an appealing challenge for both competitive and recreational runners. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and professional organization by LSG Saarlouis.

name: Sechs Stunden Urwaldlauf
location: Urwald vor den Toren der Stadt, Saarbrücken, Germany
description: The Six-Hour Urwald Run in Saarbrücken is a unique running event where participants can run as many laps as possible within six hours on a 1.85 km loop through the forest on the outskirts of the city. The course combines wide forest paths with idyllic single-track trails and offers a challenging 46 metres of elevation gain per lap. The event places great importance on mutual respect among runners and environmental protection, supported by a sustainable refreshment concept and the offsetting of CO2 emissions. The start is flexible from 10:00, and the finish is at 16:00, allowing everyone to set their own pace and breaks.

name: SPORT IN Reisberglauf
description: The 29th SPORT IN Reisberglauf takes place in Lippertshofen. The race is recognized by the German Athletics Association (DLV), which means performances can be officially included in athletics rankings. Two distances are offered: a short 400-meter race and a longer 13.8-kilometer race. The event gives runners the opportunity to compete in an official, recognized event.

name: Theodor-Heuss-Lauf
description: The Theodor Heuss Run is a traditional city race in Brackenheim, held annually at Wiesental Stadium and in the surrounding picturesque countryside. It offers a range of distances for all age groups, from Bambini and kindergarten runs to school races and the main 5 km and 10 km races. The course follows the cycle path along Austraße, passes through the “am Blasenberg” development and the villages of Meimsheim and Dürrenzimmern, then returns to the stadium. Alongside sporting ambition, fun and community are also at the heart of the event, with local partners providing attractive prizes and gifts for all participants.

name: Topiblütenlauf Staffort
description: The Topiblütenlauf Staffort is a running event held as part of the Stutensee CUP in the beautiful surroundings of Staffort. The event offers 5 km and 10 km races, with the 10 km race counting as the third race in the Stutensee CUP. The races start at the SV Staffort sports facility, and the event welcomes runners of various age groups. Bib pickup begins at 8:30 a.m. The 10 km race starts at 10:00 a.m. and the 5 km race at 10:15 a.m.

name: Bleckeder Storchenlauf
description: The 1st Bleckede Stork Run is taking place, offering runners and walkers a choice of distances in the natural surroundings of the sports field in Bleckede. The routes pass through wooded areas and open spaces with small to moderate hills, providing varied running conditions. Bib numbers and chips must be collected 30 minutes before the respective start. The event is organized by VfL Bleckede von 1862 e. V. and is open to participants of all ages, including a Bambini run for the youngest children.

name: Bondorflauf
description: The Bondorf Run is a traditional running competition held annually in Bondorf. It gives runners the opportunity to test their endurance and fitness in a friendly, sporting atmosphere. The event is part of SV Bondorf’s diverse range of sports and is open to runners of all ability levels. The race takes place regularly and is a fixture on the regional running calendar.

name: City-Lauf Lübeck
description: The City Run Lübeck is a long-established running event offering different distances for various age groups and interests. The event includes a Bambini run, a students’ run, unicycling, a 5 km run and walking, as well as a 10 km main race. The routes lead through Lübeck city centre and feature varied courses that are adapted each year to current conditions. The event is open to all runners, including those who are not members of a club, and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with team competitions and a supporting programme.
course_highlights: Route through Lübeck’s historic city centre
Circuit for unicyclists, who are required to wear protective gear
Varied routes for Bambinis, students, and the 5 km and 10 km races
additional: Late registrations are possible up to the day of the event; on the day itself, late registration is available only for the 10 km race. T-shirts for late registrants are available only while stocks last. Unicyclists must wear protective gear, and team competitions are held for students and the 5 km race. The race bibs must not be altered in shape or size.

name: Crosslauf Friedrichsruh mit Kreismeisterschaft
description: The Friedrichsruh Cross-Country Run with District Championships is a cross-country event in Geestland, Germany, held at the Sportzentrum Nordeschweg. The event is organized by TV Langen von 1908 e.V. and offers various distances, from 0.5 km for the youngest participants up to 25 km. In addition to the district championship races for children, young people, and adults, there are also open supporting races over distances from 2.5 km to 10 km. The event is characterized by a friendly club atmosphere and a focused local running event.

name: Crosslauf und Nordic Walking in Birkenwerder
description: The Cross-Country Run & Nordic Walking in Birkenwerder takes place and is organized by SV Grün-Weiß Birkenwerder e.V. Several race distances from 400 m to 8.6 km are offered, as well as a Nordic walking event in which proper pole technique is mandatory. The event is open to various age groups, from Bambini to seniors, and all participants receive a printable certificate, with medals awarded to places 1 to 3. Registration is online and limited to 500 starting places; late registration is possible up to the day of the event.

name: Diezer Stadtlauf mit 10 km (Regionsmeisterschaft)
description: The Diez City Run is a 10 km road race starting at the market square in Diez, Germany, and taking place in late September. This edition also serves as the regional championships, adding extra competitive significance to the race. In addition to the 10 km race, shorter distances are available, including a 400 m race for children and 5 km races for various age groups. The event is organised by SV Diez-Freiendiez and offers competitions for children, young people, open runners and masters, with separate classifications for men and women up to the older age groups.

name: Einstein-Marathon
description: The Ulm Einstein Marathon is one of the largest running events in southern Germany and attracts over 15,000 runners each year. The event offers various disciplines, including the marathon, half marathon, relays and Nordic walking. The course runs through the city of Ulm and offers a varied running experience with an urban atmosphere. The event is known for its professional organisation and the option to transfer or change entries flexibly.
course_highlights: Course through the historic city of Ulm, with views of Ulm Minster
A range of disciplines: marathon, half marathon, relay, Nordic walking
Professional organisation, with race bib collection available on several days
additional: A late registration fee of €5 applies. Entries can be transferred digitally until the registration deadline, and only in person after that. Changes to another discipline can be made online until the registration deadline, and only in person after that, for a fee of €5. Race packs can be collected over two days at different locations. Running with strollers, bicycles or dogs is not permitted.

name: Elmshorner Stadtlauf
description: The Elmshorn City Run is a traditional running event for the whole family, appealing to young and old alike. The main course follows an officially measured 5-kilometre loop through Elmshorn’s largely paved city centre. Shorter distances of 600 metres and 1.5 kilometres are offered for children, making the city run a varied sporting event for all age groups. The event is known for its great atmosphere and for incorporating state championships over 5 and 10 kilometres.
course_highlights: Officially measured 5 km loop through Elmshorn city centre
Largely paved course
Children’s distances of 600 m and 1.5 km
additional: In addition to the main races, the city run includes SHLV state championships over 5 and 10 km. Children receive medals. The event offers entertainment for the little ones and a lively atmosphere with musical accompaniment. The course is inspected annually to ensure safety.

name: Eper Michaelislauf
description: The Eper Michaelislauf is a long-standing, family-friendly race held around the town festival in Gronau-Epe. It is recognised as a DLV race and offers low entry fees and affordable refreshments. The event is known for its pleasant atmosphere, appealing to both competitive and recreational runners. Due to possible runoff elections, the race is held on Saturday in some years.

name: Esslinger Schurwaldlauf
description: The Esslingen Schurwald Run is a traditional running event held in Esslingen on the Schurwald heights. The start and finish are at Georgii Forest Stadium, set in a scenic location between the Neckar and Rems valleys. The event gives runners of all ages the opportunity to compete in various races, including the Esslingen City Championships over 10 km. The course runs through the beautiful natural landscape of the Schurwald and is suitable for both competitive and recreational runners.

name: Herdorfer Götzelauf
description: The Herdorf Götzelauf is a local race in Herdorf, organized by DJK Herdorf and listed in the official German running calendar (laufen.de). The event offers two distances, 500 meters and 10 kilometers, and is aimed primarily at the local community and regional runners. DJK Herdorf is an active sports club with regional partnerships, making the race a down-to-earth, community-focused event. Official DLV rankings may be maintained for some races.

name: Herner St. Martini City-Lauf
description: The Herne St. Martini City Run takes place on Boulevard Bahnhofstraße in Herne. The event offers various races for all age groups, from Bambini to adults, with distances ranging from approximately 400 m to 5 km. The courses are officially measured and the races are held under official supervision. Timing is electronic via easychip, and all participants receive a certificate. The event is organized by IG Herne City e.V. and TV Wanne 1885 e.V.

name: Garmin Półmaraton Gdańsk
location: Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, Gdańsk, Pomorskie, Poland
organizer: Arena Gdańsk Operator Sp. z o.o.
description: Garmin Gdańsk Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Gdańsk, featuring a 21.0975 km course. The start and finish are located at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk. The race is open to a large field, with start corrals based on declared finish times, and also offers the option of taking part in four-person relay teams. The organizers provide professional timing, medical support, refreshments and water along the course. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, as well as raising the profile of Gdańsk in Poland and abroad.
course_highlights: A 21.0975 km half-marathon course in Gdańsk
Start and finish at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk
Start corrals based on declared finish times
additional: The start is divided into time-based corrals according to declared finish times (red, blue, green and yellow). Relay teams start from the blue corral. The race pack includes a waterproof bib with a chip, timing, medical support, water at refreshment points, refreshments after the finish and a medal. The bib must be attached horizontally to the front of the shirt. Passing the bib to another person without the organizer’s consent is prohibited. The event includes various distances, including a half marathon and 5 km, with a participant limit of up to 10,000. Registration is online, and fees can be paid via Przelewy24 or by traditional bank transfer. Races for children and young people are also available.

name: 48. Maraton Warszawski
description: The 48th Warsaw Marathon is a special running event held in the heart of Warsaw, attracting thousands of runners. The course passes through the capital’s most beautiful and historic locations, offering unique views and an unforgettable atmosphere. Every participant receives a commemorative medal and T-shirt, while spectators can enjoy numerous attractions and cheering zones. It is a celebration of running that brings together sport, culture, and community.
course_highlights: Start beneath the Palace of Culture and Science in the centre of Warsaw
The course passes along Krakowskie Przedmieście and Nowy Świat, over Poniatowski Bridge with views of the Vistula, and by PGE Narodowy
Road closures ensure safe and comfortable running conditions
additional: The race number must be worn on the front of the clothing and must not be covered or altered. The start and finish are in the city centre, near metro stations. On race day, baggage storage, changing rooms, and toilets are available. The event features numerous attractions and cheering zones, as well as a programme at the Marathon Fan Zone and EXPO Sport&Fitness. Participants can join the #BiegamDobrze charity programme with a free race number. Races include a 10 km event (Warszawska Dycha) and the Mini Marathon for children and young people, held during the same weekend. Registration is available through the official website, and the event also includes a half marathon and a 5 km race. The organisers provide attractions and support for participants.

name: 21. Kamień Extreme - Rybnik
description: The 21st Kamień Extreme is a challenging mountain race held in Rybnik, attracting fans of extreme running challenges. The event offers professional timing using RFID technology. It is organized by MOSiR Rybnik, ensuring smooth organization and a sporting atmosphere for participants. The race starts at 12:00, and registration closes at 23:59.

name: 1 Półmaraton Ostrzeszowski
description: The Half Marathon on the Crown of the Wielkopolska Hills is a unique race held in picturesque Ostrzeszów. The half-marathon course takes runners over two hills and past two springs, offering participants distinctive views and off-road challenges. It’s a great opportunity to tackle a demanding course and enjoy a sporting adventure in the heart of Wielkopolska. Runners are invited to take part and celebrate sport and nature together.
course_highlights: The course takes runners over two hills
It passes by two springs
Picturesque landscapes of Wielkopolska

name: 16 Bieg im. Pawła Lorensa
description: The 16th Paweł Lorens Memorial Run is an annual 10 km race held in Tychy, commemorating the outstanding runner Paweł Lorens and his contributions to the development of athletics in the region. The course follows scenic paths around Paprocany Lake. It is flat and fast, making it favorable for good results. Free children’s races are also held on race day, with registration available that day. The event is organized by the Przyjaciele Tyskiego Sportu group in cooperation with MOSiR Tychy and other local partners.
course_highlights: 10 km course around Paprocany Lake
Flat, fast course on packed paths and a paved sidewalk
Scenic views of the lake and Paprocany recreational areas
additional: Free children’s races are held on race day, with registration available that day.

name: Kresowe Trail #11
description: Kresowe Trail is a series of small-scale trail races organized by the Kresowe Marathons Foundation, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity amid the natural surroundings of eastern Poland. The series consists of eleven stages, held mainly in Podlasie, with routes of varying difficulty suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. The races are non-commercial and have a limited number of participants, helping ensure safety and respect for local communities and the environment. The series offers two distances: the shorter Szpurt (approx. 6–8 km) and the longer Wertep (approx. 17–21 km), as well as a Nordic Walking competition. The 2027 season finale will take place on September 26 in Michałowo.
course_highlights: Trail routes of approximately 6–8 km (Szpurt) and 17–21 km (Wertep)
Routes marked with colored arrows (green on a yellow background for Szpurt, red for Wertep)
Races take place in the scenic regions of Podlasie and the Vilnius Region, with respect for nature and local communities
additional: Runners start in waves based on results from the previous season. Time limits are approximately 2 hours for the shorter distance and 2 hours 15 minutes for the longer one. The race package includes a race bib with a chip, a hot recovery meal (including a vegetarian option), refreshment stations along the route and at the finish, medical support, a commemorative medal (for those who register in advance), and race photography. Registration is available on race day until 08:40, though the race package may be incomplete. The organizer allows the entry fee to be transferred to another date at no additional cost before online registration closes.

name: X Półmaraton Crossowy
description: The 10th Cross Half Marathon is a trail race held in the scenic surroundings of Jelcz-Laskowice. The half-marathon course crosses varied terrain, offering participants a challenge and the satisfaction of overcoming natural obstacles. The event attracts runners who value being close to nature and competing in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: The half-marathon course crosses rugged terrain with natural obstacles
Scenic landscapes around Jelcz-Laskowice
Varied woodland and field terrain

name: XXVIII Jesienne Biegi Małkińskie
description: The 28th Małkinia Autumn Runs is an annual running event held in Małkinia Górna, attracting running and Nordic walking enthusiasts from across the region. The route follows scenic forest paths near the Municipal Culture and Sports Centre, offering participants a unique sporting experience and a chance to connect with nature. The event brings people together and promotes an active lifestyle among different age groups. The organizers ensure a friendly atmosphere and professional organization.
course_highlights: Scenic forest paths around the Municipal Culture and Sports Centre
Route suited to runners and Nordic walking participants
A regional event with a long-standing tradition
additional: The event takes place near the Municipal Culture and Sports Centre in Małkinia Górna. It brings together runners and Nordic walking participants. The organizer is the Municipal Culture and Sports Centre in Małkinia Górna.

name: Festiwal Biegowy i Nordic Walking
location: Olszewo-Borki, Ostrołęka County, Masovian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Nice To Fit You Warszawska Dycha
Nowotarski Półmaraton
location: Nowy Targ, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: XII Zielona Wierzchosławicka Dycha
location: Wierzchosławice, Tarnów County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Mariatálsky štvanec
description: Mariatálsky štvanec is a traditional running race set in the beautiful surroundings of the Little Carpathians, offering a range of events for recreational and competitive runners. The event takes place in the village of Marianka, with a family-friendly atmosphere, and culminates in a beautiful sunset. You can compete in the 6 km, 10 km, and 15 km categories, in three-person teams over 3×6 km, or in the children’s Beh Záhoráčik races. The start and finish are at the football pitch, and the race is governed by the rules of the Slovak Athletic Federation.

name: MTBIKER Kylof Ľubietová
location: Ľubietová, okr. Banská Bystrica, Ľubietová, okr. Banská Bystrica, OÚ Ľubietová
description: MTHIKER Kylof Ľubietová is a running race that combines history, nature and a great atmosphere in the picturesque heart of Slovakia. There are three race distances: a 4.3 km hobby run for beginners and young runners aged 13 and over, a 10 km main race for competitive and recreational runners, and an 850 m children’s race for children aged 6 to 12. The course features climbs and beautiful views of the Low Tatras. Runners can compete for cash prizes and valuable awards. After the finish, participants can enjoy traditional granadír and an original medal that is part of the Marathon Tour.

name: Gréta Run
location: Liptovská .Sielnica okres L. Mikuláš, Liptovská .Sielnica okres L. Mikuláš, 8,7 km štart z Kvačianskej doliny (ústie) , 15 km štart z Koliby Gréta
description: Gréta Run is a traditional running race set in the scenic surroundings of Kvačianska Valley and Liptovská Sielnica, offering routes of various lengths for children and adults. The race follows the yellow hiking trail and the embankment, finishing at Koliba Gréta, where refreshments and a cultural programme await participants. The event also includes a rich programme of activities for families and children. The organizer, the Liptov Olympic Club, provides high-quality technical and medical services.

name: Svatováclavský běh Blažovicemi
organizer: Spolek přátel Svatováclavského běhu - sdružení Vévoda
description: Svatováclavský běh Blažovicemi je tradiční krosový a trailový závod konaný v malebném prostředí Blažovic v Jihomoravském kraji. Nabízí dvě hlavní trasy o délce 10 km a 5 km, které vedou převážně přírodními cestami a lesními úseky. Součástí akce jsou také lidové běhy a dětské závody s délkami od 50 do 1100 metrů, což činí závod atraktivním pro širokou veřejnost a rodiny s dětmi. Pořadatelem je Spolek přátel Svatováclavského běhu, který zajišťuje přátelskou atmosféru a kvalitní organizaci.

name: Běh Neumannovou stezkou
description: Běh Neumannovou stezkou je tradiční běžecký závod pořádaný běžeckým oddílem T. J. Sokol Unhošť v malebném lesnatém okolí Unhoště. Závod nabízí možnost sportovního vyžití v přírodě a je doplněn dětskými běhy. Předem přihlášení závodníci mají výhodnější startovné. Akce má dlouholetou tradici a pravidelně se koná na podzim.

name: MilešovKa(p)
description: MilešovKa(p) je tradiční běžecký závod z Teplic na Milešovku s délkou 17,5 km a převýšením 846 m. Trať vede po asfaltu, turistických pěšinách, polních a lesních cestách a je značená červenou a modrou značkou Klubu českých turistů. Závod je určen široké veřejnosti a nabízí ocenění pro nejlepší v kategoriích, vrchaře i věkové rekordmany. Pořádá ho spolek SPONA Teplice, který se věnuje podpoře amatérského sportu v regionu. Vyhlašování výsledků probíhá společně s dalšími běžeckými akcemi v listopadu.

name: Běh kolem Panské skály
description: Běh kolem Panské skály je oblíbený trailový závod, který se koná v Kamenickém Šenově-Práchně v Libereckém kraji. Závod nabízí trasy dlouhé 3 km a 6 km, které vedou kopcovitým terénem v okolí Panské skály, a je součástí Okresní běžecké ligy Českolipsko. Akce je určena jak pro rekreační běžce, tak i pro zkušené závodníky, a nabízí jedinečný zážitek z běhu v přírodě s krásnými výhledy.

name: AOK Firmenlauf Ludwigsburg
description: The AOK Ludwigsburg Corporate Run is a popular team event held in front of Ludwigsburg Residential Palace. The approximately 5.7 km course offers a great opportunity to get active together with colleagues and add exercise and team spirit to the workday. In addition to the run, participants can enjoy a varied supporting program featuring a DJ, a group warm-up, award ceremonies, and complimentary refreshments at the finish. The event also places importance on inclusion and a shared running experience for everyone.

name: Podzimní běh projektantů "Od hospody k hospodě"
description: Podzimní běh projektantů "Od hospody k hospodě" je tradiční běžecká akce konaná v malebném prostředí Krčského lesa v Praze 4-Krč. Tento závod je oblíbený mezi běžci a pořádá se již mnoho let, přičemž vítá všechny příznivce běhu a milovníky přírody. Pořadatelé Pepa Krejčí a Honza Vočko srdečně zvou k účasti na této oblíbené trati, která nabízí příjemný zážitek v přírodě. Přihlášky jsou přijímány v den závodu přibližně hodinu před startem.

name: OTF presented by DYNAFIT
description: The OTF presented by DYNAFIT is a trail running festival in Oberaudorf, Bavaria. It offers five distances from 12 km to 100 km, including the new OTF 100 XXL Ultra, with 104 km and 5,900 meters of elevation gain. The event is part of the ITRA National League and offers ITRA points for the various distances. The afterparty adds to the lively atmosphere, bringing runners and spectators together to celebrate.

name: ACE BATTLE RUN:  ACE BATTLE Mile indywidualni zawody rankingowe na dystan...
description: ACE BATTLE RUN is an innovative tactical team running format held over one mile (1609 m) at Podskarbińska Stadium in Warsaw. The competition combines individual qualifying with team competition, where individual and team results contribute to the official runners’ ranking. The 2027 season features exciting head-to-head matchups and competition for a place in the ACE BATTLE Mile City League Warsaw. Runners can compete solo or in teams, earning levels and ratings in the ACE BATTLE RUN system.
course_highlights: One-mile distance (1609 m) on a stadium track
Individual and team competition with an official ranking
Exciting team matches in a tactical format
additional: The competition consists of three stages: individual qualifying, a team race for an ABR level, and an ACE BATTLE Mile team rating. Teams earn an official rating, and each participant becomes an ABM athlete. After the season, teams with a rating compete in head-to-head matches in the ACE BATTLE Mile City League Warsaw. Results and photo galleries from past events are available online. The official website lists Podskarbińska Stadium as the venue for the ACE BATTLE RUN format. The program also includes a briefing, team roles, and prizes.

name: Běh Karla Havlíčka Borovského
description: Běh Karla Havlíčka Borovského je tradiční okruhový běh v Havlíčkově Brodě, který nabízí tratě pro různé věkové kategorie od nejmenších dětí až po dospělé. Trasa vede parkem Budoucnost a kolem významných míst jako je památník obětem světových válek a socha Karla Havlíčka Borovského. Běh je vhodný pro všechny věkové skupiny a nabízí kombinaci asfaltových a nezpevněných cest s mírným převýšením. Start i cíl jsou u základní školy V Sadech 560, kde jsou k dispozici i sprchy a WC.

name: Baran Trail Race
description: Baran Trail Race is a recurring running event held in scenic Węgierska Górka. The event offers a range of distances from 10 km to 100 km, along challenging mountain routes with beautiful views and natural terrain. It attracts both amateurs and experienced runners, offering unique challenges and an exciting atmosphere. The organizers ensure the event runs professionally and participants stay safe.

name: PUMA Třeboňský půl/maraton 10 a 5 km
description: Puma Třeboňský maraton, půlmaraton, 10 km a 5 km jsou závody vedené unikátní přírodou Chráněné krajinné oblasti Třeboňsko. Trasy jsou rovinaté s minimálním převýšením, většinou po asfaltových cyklostezkách a lesních cestách, což umožňuje běžcům dosáhnout osobních rekordů v krásném a klidném prostředí. Závod začíná na renesančním náměstí v Třeboni a vede přes historickou bránu do přírodní rezervace, která je kandidátem na zápis do UNESCO. Ideální termín v říjnu nabízí příjemné běžecké počasí a motivující atmosféru s profesionálními vodiči na trati.

name: Run Berounka Run
description: Run Berounka Run je štafetový závod pro týmy i jednotlivce, který vede podél řeky Berounky z Újezdu u Svatého Kříže do Prahy Radotína. Trasa o délce 130 km je rozdělena do 6 úseků s převýšením přes 3100 metrů, převážně po lesních a polních cestách. Závod startuje od 5:00 hodin v několika vlnách, kategorie Ultra startuje již večer. Závod je určen pro týmy od 2 do 6 běžců a jednotlivce v kategorii Ultra, s vyhlášením vítězů v několika kategoriích a zajištěným občerstvením v cíli.

name: 24DS (24 Dlouhé Stráně)
location: Kouty nad Desnou, Olomouc Region, Česko
description: 24DS je 24hodinová vytrvalostní výzva v unikátním prostředí Hrubého Jeseníku, která vede z Koutů nad Desnou na horní nádrž vodní přečerpávací elektrárny Dlouhé Stráně. Závod nabízí nádherné výhledy na Jeseníky a kombinuje denní i noční běh s východem a západem slunce. Trasa je náročná, s převýšením 820 metrů a 90 % trailovým povrchem, vhodná pro jednotlivce i dvojice. Areál Kouty nad Desnou poskytuje komfortní zázemí včetně restaurací, ubytování a parkování.

name: Běh kolem Hejtmanu
description: Běh kolem Hejtmanu je tradiční sportovní akce konaná v Chlumu u Třeboně na Třeboňsku, vždy druhou sobotu v říjnu. Hlavní závod je běh na 10 km s časovým limitem 1 hodina 20 minut, vedoucí přes místní komunikace a hráze rybníků v malebném prostředí. Závod je veřejně přístupný a probíhá za běžného silničního provozu s důrazem na bezpečnost a dodržování pravidel. Pro děti a mládež do 15 let jsou připraveny kratší závody s prezentací přímo na místě v den závodu. Pořadatelem je TJ Jiskra Chlum u Třeboně, z.s.

name: ČEZ RunTour Praha
location: Praha, Park Ladronka (u televizní věže), Praha
description: ČEZ RunTour Praha je rodinný běžecký závod, který nabízí tratě pro hobby běžce i elitu v délkách 3, 5, 10 a 21,1 km, včetně dětských běhů na 500 a 1000 metrů. Závod se koná v krásném prostředí parku Ladronka a je součástí celorepublikové série osmi unikátních lokalit. Organizátoři kladou důraz na perfektní servis, bezpečnost a zábavu pro celou rodinu, včetně doprovodného programu a charitativního rozměru. Každý účastník obdrží startovní balíček a má možnost přispět na charitu svou účastí.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - říjen
description: Běh na 2 míle ve Zlíně - Přílukách je otevřený závod na 3,2 km určený pro všechny věkové kategorie a úrovně běžců, od začátečníků po zkušené. Trať vede převážně mezi zahradami v průmyslové zóně Příluky a je tvořena méně než dvěma koly na přesně změřeném asfaltovém okruhu. Závod se koná každou první sobotu v měsíci s registrací před budovou firmy Madal Bal a startem v 9:00. Na každého účastníka čeká v cíli teplý lívanec se skořicí jako odměna za snahu.

name: Běh na Čerťák
description: Běh na Čerťák je tradiční závod pořádaný AK Běžci z Rýmařova, který se koná v areálu Flemmichovi zahrady ve Rýmařově. Závod nabízí tratě pro různé věkové kategorie od předškoláků až po seniory, s hlavní trasou vedoucí přes lesní cesty a vrchol Kamenné hory. Startuje se v areálu SKI Flemmichova zahrada a trať zahrnuje běh po polních cestách, loukách a lesních stezkách s krásnými výhledy. Po závodě je zajištěno občerstvení a vyhlášení výsledků v areálu SKI. Závod je součástí Velké ceny vytrvalců Olomouckého kraje a vítězové v kategoriích získávají věcné ceny.

name: Benešovská osmička
description: Benešovská osmička je tradiční přespolní běh v Benešově u Semil, který se koná již více než půl století. Závod nabízí tratě pro celou rodinu, od předškolních dětí až po veterány, s hlavním závodem na 8 000 metrů vedoucím malebnou krajinou kolem obce a na svazích vrchu Benešov. Start i zázemí jsou ve sportovním areálu v Horním Benešově. Pro závodníky jsou připraveny věcné ceny a drobné občerstvení pro všechny účastníky i diváky.

name: Běh města Příbrami
description: Běh města Příbrami je tradiční běžecký závod pořádaný již 32. rokem v malebném prostředí Nového rybníka v Příbrami. Závod nabízí různé kategorie včetně hlavního závodu na 10 km, štafet a dětských běhů, což umožňuje účast širokému spektru běžců. Akce je vhodná pro rodiny, studenty i jednotlivce, kteří si chtějí užít sportovní den s přátelskou atmosférou. Startovní časy a prezence jsou přizpůsobeny jednotlivým kategoriím, aby vše proběhlo hladce a organizovaně.

name: Mattoni Liberec Trail Run
location: Liberec, Náměstí Dr. E. Beneše před libereckou radnicí, Liberecký
description: Mattoni Liberec Trail Run je závod v přírodě, který nabízí běžcům možnost uniknout z městského ruchu a užít si běh lesními stezkami Jizerských hor. Závod je posledním v sezóně a vede lesem, kolem přehrady, přes žulový lom a zpět. Běžci si mohou vybrat mezi kratší trasou 12 km a delší 22 km, což umožňuje otestovat své síly v krásné přírodní scenérii.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - říjen
description: Běh na 2 míle v pražské Stromovce je otevřený závod pro všechny věkové kategorie a úrovně běžců, kteří běhají pro radost a chtějí si zlepšit osobní rekord nebo si jen příjemně zaběhat v krásném parku. Trať vede po asfaltových cestách Stromovky, dospělí běží dvě kola (3,2 km), děti do 12 let jedno kolo (1,6 km). Po závodě čeká na každého teplý lívanec se skořicí jako odměna. Závod je součástí celoročního Lívancového poháru, který motivuje k pravidelné účasti a sebereflexi výkonů.

name: SILESIA kros 1/2marathon ZRUŠENO
description: SILESIA kros 1/2marathon je tradiční běžecký krosový závod konaný v Opavě-Kylešovicích s centrem v areálu U Chovatelů. Závod nabízí tratě 21 km a 13 km, které vedou přes malebné lokality jako Raduň, Vršovice, Chvalíkovice, Hradec nad Moravicí, Branka a Opava. Trať je náročná a vede částečně po silnicích s plným provozem, přičemž je nutné dodržovat pravidla fair-play a respektovat přírodu. Měření časů probíhá elektronicky bez čipů a vyhlášení výsledků se koná v cílovém areálu. Pro rok 2026 je závod zrušen, ale informace o předchozích ročnících a tratích jsou k dispozici.

name: Běh zámeckým parkem
description: Běh zámeckým parkem je běžecký závod vedený v malebném prostředí vlašimského zámeckého parku. Trať o délce 8,4 km kombinuje terénní a asfaltové úseky, což nabízí běžcům různorodý zážitek. Závod pořádá Atletika Vlašim, z.s., a je součástí oficiální termínovky Českého běhu. Akce je vhodná pro běžce, kteří chtějí zažít běh v krásném parku s historickou atmosférou.

name: Z(a)tracené vrchy
description: Z(a)tracené vrchy je adrenalinový orientačně-pivní běžecko-chodecko-plazecký závod v týmech, který se koná v malebném terénu Bordovic v Moravskoslezském kraji. Soutěžící musí projít trasu s 10litrovým sudem piva na zádech, plnit minihry na stanovištích a pivo na stanovištích vypít. Závod kombinuje fyzickou výzvu s týmovou spoluprací a zábavou, přičemž trasa vede členitým terénem s výstupy a sestupy. Vítězný tým získá putovní pohár a dárkové balíčky. Akce je určena pro dospělé nad 18 let a klade důraz na bezpečnost a zodpovědnost účastníků.

name: Běh Pístovickou riviérou
description: Běh Pístovickou riviérou je tradiční krosový běžecký závod vedený po lesních cestách nad rekreačním areálem Pístovická riviéra v Pístovicích u Vyškova. Závod je určen všem nadšencům zdravého pohybu, od dětí po dospělé, a koná se za každého počasí. Trať je nerovná, s možnými kalužemi a blátem, a zahrnuje běh i chůzi do kopce i z kopce. Pořadatelé z Lyžařského klubu Vyškov srdečně zvou závodníky i diváky k účasti a podpoře sportu v regionu.

name: Cibulka - Košířský okruh
description: Cibulka - Košířský okruh je oblíbený běžecký závod konající se v pražské čtvrti Košíře, který nabízí trať dlouhou přibližně 4,5 km. Tento závod je součástí série místních běžeckých akcí a je určen jak pro rekreační běžce, tak pro ty, kteří chtějí zlepšit své výkony v přírodním prostředí. Trať vede lesními cestami a pěšinami v okolí rozhledny Cibulka, což poskytuje příjemné a členité prostředí pro běh. Akce je vhodná pro všechny věkové skupiny a úrovně běžců, s důrazem na radost z pohybu v přírodě.

name: Běh za bořetickým burčákem
description: Běh za bořetickým burčákem je tradiční sportovní akce pořádaná v malebné vinařské obci Bořetice v srdci Modrých Hor. Běh nabízí účastníkům možnost zažít krásnou krajinu s vinohrady a vinnými sklepy, které jsou charakteristické pro tuto oblast jižní Moravy. Akce je organizována Kulturní komisí obce Bořetice, SDH Bořetice a Republikou Kraví hora a je součástí bohatého kulturního kalendáře obce. Start běhu je plánován na odpoledne u Sóla u kulturního domu.

name: Korschenbroicher Waldlauf
location: Waldstadion Korschenbroich, Korschenbroich, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 21st Korschenbroich Forest Run takes place at Waldstadion Korschenbroich. The event offers races over distances from 400 to 10,000 metres, as well as walking, and is open to all age groups. It includes a new 2,300-metre race for young people from U14 to U18. Alongside the sporting competition, there will be a cafeteria and a raffle in support of the youth department. Held on German Unity Day, the event combines sporting commitment with a good cause.
course_highlights: Distances from 400 to 10,000 metres, plus walking
New 2,300-metre race for U14 to U18
Event at Waldstadion Korschenbroich on German Unity Day
additional: There will be a cafeteria and a raffle in support of the youth department. The NEW Group is the new main sponsor. Registration opens in early 2026. The courses run over the sports field and forest trails; spikes are not permitted.

name: RheinEnergie Kinderlauf Köln
description: The RheinEnergie Children’s Run Cologne takes place at Roncalliplatz by Cologne Cathedral. The event offers several child-friendly races over distances from 500 m to 2,000 m, most of which are closed to traffic and secured by course marshals. Before the run, there is a children’s service at Cologne Cathedral, after which the children set off together in their races. Children born between 2015 and 2021 are eligible to participate. There is no timing—the focus is on having fun and taking part.
course_highlights: The course passes Cologne Cathedral
Start and finish at Roncalliplatz
Closed course with course marshals
additional: On-site registration is also available on the event day from 9:00 to 12:15. Depending on the number of participants, the children start in several waves, divided by year of birth and/or gender. There is no timing, and children should be able to complete the course without parental accompaniment. Several races with different distances; no timing; open to children born in 2015 or later; limit of 1,000 children; online registration available; race number collection on the event day.

name: Rothaarwaldlauf
location: Rothaargebirge, Bad Berleburg-Aue, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Rothaar Forest Run, organized by TSV Aue-Wingeshausen, is a popular and scenic forest race in the Rothaar Mountains. The event offers various distances, including loop courses and point-to-point races, appealing to both competitive athletes and recreational runners. The races are part of the Rothaar-Laufserie AOK-Cup, which celebrates its 25th anniversary this year. The course passes through beautiful woodland with moderate climbs, and the event offers excellent refreshments as well as bus transfers to the starting points of the longer races.
course_highlights: Various distances from 400 m to 28 km, including loop courses and point-to-point races
Start and finish at the Aue-Wingeshausen sports ground, with bus transfers to the starting points of the longer races
Scenic forest routes with moderate climbs and good refreshments
additional: Start times vary by distance; for example, the main race starts at 13:30. A bus transfer runs from the Aue-Wingeshausen gymnasium to the starting points of the longer races (15 km and 28 km). Race bibs can be collected at various locations until shortly before the start. Showers and changing facilities are available at the gymnasium. Late entries are accepted at the starting points until 30 minutes before the start. The event is part of the Rothaar-Laufserie AOK-Cup, which is celebrating its 25th anniversary. Participants benefit from a bus shuttle, refreshments including cake, waffles, and fries, and a long-established tradition on the running calendar. The event is part of the Rothaar-Laufserie AOK-Cup.

name: Saerbecker Kirmeslauf
price_range: Bambinilauf € 1,00; Schülerläufe 1,2 km und 2 km € 3,00; 5 km Jedermannlauf € 8,00; 10 km Hauptlauf € 10,00
description: The Saerbecker Kirmeslauf takes place at the Sparkassen-Stadion Saerbeck. The course is entirely paved and flat, and runs along well-maintained side roads, making fast times possible. The event offers races for different age groups, with chip timing and results determined by finish order. Children receive medals, and awards are presented for the overall and age-group rankings. Participants can print their certificates online.
course_highlights: Well-maintained, entirely paved course
Flat side roads for fast times
Start and finish at the Sparkassen-Stadion Saerbeck
additional: Timing is provided by a chip attached to the back of the race bib. Finish order determines the results. Certificates are available online for all participants. The course is monitored by volunteers, but traffic rules must still be followed. Every child receives a medal in the children's races. Liability for theft is excluded. Participants must confirm that they are in a healthy state of training. Online registration is available; late entries are accepted on the event day for a fee; the event is held under official supervision in accordance with DLV/IWR rules.

name: 16. Köhlbrandbrückenlauf
description: The Köhlbrandbrückenlauf is Germany’s largest bridge run and crosses the landmark in the Port of Hamburg. The course offers runners a unique experience with impressive views of the port and the Köhlbrand Bridge. The event attracts numerous participants every year and is known for its special atmosphere and sporting challenge.
course_highlights: Run across the famous Köhlbrand Bridge in the Port of Hamburg
Impressive panoramic views of the port during the run
Course through the South/West Terminal grounds with an urban port atmosphere
additional: Registration opens on December 3, 2026, and experience suggests it fills up quickly. Bag storage is available on event day, and every finisher receives a medal. Travel by public transport or bicycle is recommended, as parking is very limited.

name: 26. Bismarck-Gedenklauf
description: The Bismarck Memorial Run is an annual road and forest race in Schönhausen (Elbe), Saxony-Anhalt, held on German Unity Day. Organized by SV Preussen 27 Schönhausen, it is part of the ELBE-OHRE-CUP and offers 6.5 km and 13 km distances, as well as shorter races for children and young people. The course starts at the club’s sports center and follows paved roads into the forest, past Kollerberg. The longer distance is run twice. The event honors Otto von Bismarck, Schönhausen’s most famous son, and concludes with an awards ceremony and refreshments at the sports center.

name: 28. Alfelder Leinetal-Lauf
description: The 28th Alfelder Leinetal-Lauf takes place in Alfeld, Lower Saxony. Various distances are offered for adults, including 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon, all finishing in Hindenburg Stadium, which serves as the shared finish area throughout the day. The flat, signposted courses are ideal for running at a steady pace. There are also races for children and teenagers, making for a varied program.

name: 49. Warburger Oktoberwochen Volkslauf
description: The Warburg Oktoberwochen Run is a long-standing running event in Warburg, held annually in October. The event offers various distances, including a 5 km company competition, and is open to young people, school students, and adult runners. It takes place at the Diemelaue Sports Center and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and involvement of the local sporting community. Warburger SV organizes the run and promotes grassroots sport in the region.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Diemelaue Sports Center
5 km course with a company competition
Family-friendly running event with youth and school student categories
additional: The entry fee is collected by SEPA direct debit via RaceResult.

name: 10km Lauf Neuhütten
description: The Neuhütten 10 km run is a popular race starting and finishing at Burgfriedenhalle in Wüstenrot-Neuhütten. The course is a gently rolling but fast loop, suitable for both competitive and recreational runners. The event offers age-group rankings up to M/W 80 and a finisher’s medal for young participants. After the race, there is an awards ceremony with prizes and certificates. The race is also part of the Laufcup Schwäbisch Fränkischer Wald.

name: Alfelder Leinetal-Lauf
description: The Alfelder Leinetal Run takes place in Alfeld, Germany. Races are offered over 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon, all finishing at Hindenburg Stadium, which serves as the shared finish area throughout the day. The flat, marked courses are ideal for maintaining a steady pace. There are also races for children and young people, making for a varied program.

name: Burgentrail Unterfränkische Traillaufmeisterschaften
description: The Burgentrail in Ostheim is a challenging trail-running event that hosts the Lower Franconian Trail Running Championships. The course follows varied forest and meadow paths, passing historic castle ruins such as Lichtenburg and Königsburg, and features technically demanding trails with roots and steep descents. The scenic backdrop, with views across the Grabfeld, makes the race a special experience for trail-running enthusiasts of all ability levels. SC Ostheim/Rhön warmly invites all running enthusiasts to take part in this sporting highlight.

name: BÄRENFELS SECHS-STUNDEN TRAIL
distance_verbose: 100 km, 63 km, 60 km, 53 km, Marathon, 32.4 km, 32 km, Halbmarathon
description: The BÄRENFELS SIX-HOUR TRAIL offers runners a challenging trail experience amid the ruggedly romantic natural surroundings of Bärenfels in Saarland/Pfalz National Park. The event is part of the diverse trail and sports events organized by BÄRENFELS TEAM, which has been creating unforgettable running adventures since 2002. The route follows the Nahesteig and promises an experience of nature and a sporting challenge in a unique landscape.

name: Crailsheimer Sparkassenlauf (4. Lauf des 4-Jahreszeiten Laufcup 2026)
description: The Crailsheim Sparkassenlauf is a family-friendly sporting event held in the city center of Crailsheim. The event offers a variety of race distances for all ages and fitness levels, including Bambini, student and main races, as well as walking and relay races. The races follow varied circuits through the heart of the city, with enthusiastic spectators and a lively atmosphere. Sustainability and community are a focus, so participants can take part in a sporting event that is also environmentally conscious with a clear conscience.

name: Gemüselauf
description: The Maxdorf Vegetable Run is a long-standing running event in Maxdorf that appeals to runners of all ages. The event includes several races, including the main race, the Fun Run, and the junior race “Young Vegetables.” The course has been modernized in recent years and offers attractive running conditions and the opportunity to achieve great times. The race is part of the Engelhorn Sports Trail Cup and Brooks Running Cup and is very popular in the region.

name: Heckengäu-Volkslauf 2026
description: The Heckengäu Volkslauf is an annual running event in Wiernsheim, starting and finishing at the Lindenhalle Wiernsheim. It is firmly established in the local club SFG-Serres’s events calendar; the club also organizes other village festivals and club events. The event is part of Germany’s club-based road-racing system, supported by volunteers, regional sports associations, and official timekeeping. It offers various distances for runners of all ages and ability levels.

name: Herbstlauf TuS Ofen
location: Ofen, Bad Zwischenahn, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The TuS Ofen Autumn Run is a family-friendly event taking place for the 35th time. It offers distances for all age and ability groups, from 800 m for the youngest participants and a 3 km schoolchildren’s run to a 5 km walking event and fun run, and the 10 km EDEKA-Böse Run for ambitious runners. The start and finish are at the TuS Ofen sports field. A large cake buffet in the sports hall will provide refreshments, and all participants will receive a gingerbread heart at the finish as a special treat.

name: Kirchertlauf
description: The Kirchertlauf in Nürtingen-Rossdorf is a traditional running event through the Kirchert recreational area. Three races are offered for different ability levels: a 10 km main race, a 5 km Nordic walking/everyone’s race, and a 3 km schoolchildren’s race. The routes follow firm, partly paved forest paths with gentle, rolling terrain and are well marked. The event offers refreshments at the start/finish, changing and shower facilities, and on-site medical support.

name: Krautsander Insellauf
description: The Krautsand Island Run is a long-standing running event on the Elbe island of Krautsand near Drochtersen. Organized by SV Dornbusch and TV Wischhafen, the race offers an attractive route in a natural setting. The event is open to runners of all ability levels and takes place annually on October 3. It is organized by the Kehdingen Athletics Association, which ensures everything runs smoothly.

name: Neudorfer Fichtelberglauf mit LM Berglauf
description: The Neudorf Fichtelberg Run is a challenging mountain race covering 9.4 kilometers with 550 meters of elevation gain. It has been held annually in Sehmatal in the Ore Mountains since 1987. Considered the toughest mountain race in Saxony, it attracts both professional and amateur runners. The race starts at the Neudorf Spinning Mill and finishes on the Fichtelberg summit plateau. The event includes an open state mountain running championship and offers a free shuttle service for the return journey.

name: Oberbayerische Straßenlaufmeisterschaften 10 km
description: The Schweiger Forest Run is a long-standing running event organized by LG Sempt in Anzing, held annually on October 3 since 1983. The 44th edition in 2026 offers fast courses and a family-friendly atmosphere in the heart of the Anzing Forest. The Upper Bavarian 10 km Road Running Championships are held as part of the Forest Run. The event is open to runners of all age groups and is known for its excellent organization and large running community.

name: Ochsenweiherlauf Emskirchen
description: The Ochsenweiherlauf in Emskirchen is a long-standing running event organized by TSV Emskirchen and held annually on October 3. The event offers various distances for all age groups, including a Bambini run, a youth/schoolchildren’s run, a fun run, walking, and the 10 km main race. The course follows paved forest paths around the Ochsenweiher and is suitable for both recreational runners and competitive athletes. Refreshments are provided, and times can be used for the German Sports Badge.

name: Rodenbacher Lauftag
description: The Rodenbacher Lauftag is a long-standing race for peace and democracy in Europe, taking place for the seventh time. The event offers four competitions for the whole family on a flat, paved, IAAF-measured high-speed course through the oxygen-rich Rodenbach Forest. A special highlight is the stadium finish at the end of the 5 km circuit, offering exciting views for spectators and runners. The youngest participants can enjoy an entertaining stadium cross-country race with obstacles, commentated by an experienced team of announcers. The race is ideal preparation for an autumn marathon and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and professional organization.

name: Stauch Cup
description: The Stauch Cup, also known as the Kupferzeller Kärwelauf, is a long-standing running event in Kupferzell. It offers a variety of distances for all age groups, including a toddlers’ race, children’s and youth races, a health run, Nordic walking, and a main race. The event takes place around the Carl-Julius-Weber-Halle, which also serves as the start and finish area and provides changing rooms and showers. The award ceremonies are held in the hall, where refreshments are available, creating a pleasant atmosphere.

name: Staufener Altstadtlauf
description: The Altstadtlauf Staufen is a traditional running event held annually on October 3 in the historic old town of Staufen. The race is part of the Markgräfler Cup and offers runners an appealing route through the picturesque old town. The event attracts both recreational runners and ambitious athletes and is a popular event in the region.

name: Stimberg-Haardlauf
description: The Stimberg-Haardlauf is a long-standing race in Oer-Erkenschwick, starting and finishing at Stimbergpark. Various distances are offered for children, young people and adults, including 500 m, 4.9 km and 9.4 km. The adult courses feature elevation changes, offering a varied alternative to flat road races. The event includes individual and team competitions and is open to club runners, local teams, and young and adult athletes.

name: Strausseelauf
description: The Straussee Run in Strausberg is a traditional annual running event. It gives runners of different ability levels the opportunity to compete and enjoy the beautiful surroundings of Lake Straussee. The event is organized by Kultur- und Sportclub Strausberg e.V. and takes place at Theodor Fontane Gymnasium in Strausberg. It is known for its friendly atmosphere and good organization.

name: Taubertal 100
location: Rothenburg ob der Tauber, Bavaria, Germany
description: Taubertal 100 is a scenic ultramarathon offering distances of 50 km, 70 km, 100 km, and 100 miles. The point-to-point course runs from Rothenburg ob der Tauber through the Tauber Valley to Bad Mergentheim, Tauberbischofsheim, Wertheim, or Gemünden. The race is IAU Bronze certified and offers a measured course eligible for official rankings, particularly the 100-mile distance. The event takes place annually on the first Saturday in October, combining an athletic challenge with an attractive holiday region. Mandatory equipment is required for the 100-mile distance, and extensive refreshment and return-transport options are provided.
course_highlights: Point-to-point course on a paved cycle path through the Tauber Valley
Elevation profiles with moderate climbs and varied sections, for example between km 85 and 95
Officially measured course and IAU Bronze certification for all distances; the 100-mile distance is eligible for rankings
additional: Mandatory equipment applies only to 100-mile runners from km 100, with a drop bag. Bus transport is available from various finish locations back to Rothenburg. Shower facilities are available at all finish locations. Runner dinner with a talk on Friday evening at Hotel Rappen. Online race briefing via Teams on the Monday before the race, in German and English. Every kilometer is marked; turns are marked three times, with reflective bands at night.

name: 4 Moore Ultratrail-Marathon
description: The 4 Moore Ultratrail Marathon is a non-commercial 53-kilometer ultratrail run through the countryside around Langenhagen. The route passes through a variety of moorland and heathland areas, including Kananoher Forst, Schwarzes Moor, Otternhagener Moor, Helstorfer Moor, Große Heide and Bissendorfer Moor. The course is unmarked and navigated by GPS; the final GPS track and a briefing are sent by email in advance. Three aid stations provide drinks and snacks. Participants must bring their own hydration containers and cups. Entry is limited to 50 runners, and the time limit is 9 hours.

name: Black Forest Trailrun Masters
description: The Black Forest Trailrun Masters offer a challenging trail-running experience in the Black Forest, with four varied courses and a two-day stage race. The premier event is the stage ultramarathon, covering 55 km and 37 km over two days; it can also be entered as a single race. The courses pass through picturesque valleys and along challenging forest paths and singletrack trails with impressive views, making them ideal for experienced trail runners and beginners. There are also shorter trails and children’s races, making the event appealing to all age groups.

name: ING Biegnij Warszawo
description: ING Biegnij Warszawo is one of Poland’s most recognisable running events, bringing together thousands of participants every year in the heart of the capital. The race takes place on the first Saturday in October and features a 10 km route through Warsaw’s most iconic locations. The FUNRUN format welcomes everyone, regardless of age or experience, focusing on the joy of movement and having fun without the pressure of competition. Participants can look forward to music zones, crowd support and comprehensive medical cover along the route.
course_highlights: A 10 km route through Warsaw’s most atmospheric and iconic locations
Music zones and crowd support along the entire route
The route is certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA) and is beginner-friendly
additional: The race pack includes a Nike Dri-FIT T-shirt with a commemorative print, a race bib with a timing chip, gifts from partners and a commemorative medal. There is a hydration station halfway along the route, and the organiser provides comprehensive medical cover. The participant limit is 10,000.

name: VIII Bieg Zielonym Szlakiem Niziny Mazow...
location: Szkoła Podstawowa w Czerwonce Włościańskiej, Czerwonka Włościańska, Poland
description: The Bieg Zielonym Szlakiem Niziny Mazowieckiej is a 5 km race held in the picturesque village of Czerwonka Włościańska. The start and finish are at the Primary School in Czerwonka, and the route follows National Road No. 60 between Maków Mazowiecki and Różan. The event is organized by local sports clubs and institutions, and participants can expect professional organization and an awards ceremony for the winners. The race is open to people over 18 and to younger participants with the consent of a legal guardian.
course_highlights: A 5 km route along National Road No. 60
Start and finish at the Primary School in Czerwonka Włościańska
Picturesque surroundings of the Masovian Lowland
additional: The participant limit is 200 race packs. Registration and race-pack pickup take place at the race office on the school sports field in Czerwonka from 08:30 to 10:00. An awards ceremony for the winners and an event wrap-up are scheduled after the race.

name: XIII Podbieg na Makowicę
description: The 13th Run up Makowica is a 10 km mountain race held in the picturesque town of Rytro in the Lesser Poland Voivodeship. The event is a great opportunity to test your fitness on a challenging course with uphill sections. The organizers offer training plans tailored to different experience levels to help participants prepare optimally for race day. The event is small and welcoming, appealing to runners who value being close to nature and sporting competition.
course_highlights: A 10 km mountain course
Picturesque views around Rytro
The challenge of the climbs up Makowica
additional: The organizers offer training plans lasting 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level, with instructions and expert support. There is also an opportunity to manage the race listing and collaborate on marketing through the TreningBiegacza.pl platform.

name: XXXVII Oskie Biegi im. Krzysztofa Malinowskiego
Jarabský polmaratón
location: Jarabá, Brezno District, Banská Bystrica Region, Slovakia
description: The Jarabá Half Marathon is a unique mountain trail race in the Low Tatras, covering 22.1 km. It features a demanding course with climbs, descents, and technical terrain. The race is designed for trail-running and active-outdoor enthusiasts, who can enjoy beautiful views and the atmosphere of a running community ranging from professionals to recreational athletes. The event has been held since 2015 and embodies the spirit of a friendly running get-together: “Go as you can around Jarabá.” In 2025, it is part of the Slovak Skyrunning League, underscoring its quality and challenge.

name: U.S.Steel Family Run – Minimaratón
description: The U. S. Steel Family Run - Mini-Marathon is a running event in Košice and part of the traditional International Peace Marathon. Runners of all ages are welcome, with no age restrictions. The event follows the rules of World Athletics and the Slovak Athletic Federation, and the organizers ensure thorough preparation and organization. The start and finish are on Hlavná Street in Košice, making for an appealing city run.

name: Matúškovský beh
organizer: Občianske združenie DAM Šport Matúškovo a obec Matúškovo

price_tiers.distance: Hlavný beh, Hobby beh, Nordic walking

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: obyvateľ Matúškova, žiak MŠ Matúškovo zadarmo

description: The Matúškovo Run is a running event in the village of Matúškovo, featuring a 12 km main race, a 4 km hobby run and 4 km Nordic walking. The course runs on paved and asphalt roads through the village, consists of 4 km loops and is marked with traffic signs. The event also includes children’s categories with distances varying by age. Participants receive finisher medals, while winners receive cups and certificates. The event takes place in all weather and is limited to 300 runners, excluding children.
course_highlights: The course runs on paved and asphalt roads through the village and is marked with traffic signs
The main race consists of three 4 km loops
Children’s categories offer distances that vary by age
additional: Race-day registration is from 8:00 at the Cultural Centre in Matúškovo. Parking is available around the Cultural Centre. The maximum number of starters is 300 runners, excluding children. All runners who finish receive participant medals. The race takes place in all weather. The route runs on paved and asphalt roads through the village, alongside traffic in one lane separated by traffic signs; it is not certified. Registration and parking are at the Cultural Centre in Matúškovo. The capacity is 300 starters, excluding children.

name: Karpaty Run – Bratislava Trail Run
location: Malokarpatské Námestie 1, Bratislava - Lamač, Bratislava, Slovakia
description: Karpaty Run - Bratislava Trail Run is the largest trail running festival in the Little Carpathians, offering routes of varying lengths and difficulty for runners and hikers. The race takes place in a pleasant natural setting, with an emphasis on protecting nature and promoting a healthy lifestyle. The routes run mainly along forest roads and trails, with minimal asphalt, and are suitable for intermediate to advanced runners. The organizer is the Hojta civic association, which supports sports and ecological values.
course_highlights: Routes are 65% forest road and 33–35% forest trail
Elevation gain ranges from 80 m to 876 m, depending on the route length
Refreshments are available at several points along the route, depending on its length
additional: The start is 700 m from Malokarptské Square in Lamač, with a transfer 20 minutes before the start. There is no time limit for most routes, except for the longest ones, which have a limit of 5 or 7 hours. Refreshment stations are available along the route depending on its length. Refreshments can be purchased at Biely Kríž.

name: OLFINCAR HRADECKÝ PŮL/MARATON
description: OLFINCAR Hradecký půlmaraton je největší sportovní událostí ve východních Čechách, která se koná od roku 2013. Závod nabízí certifikované trasy včetně maratonu, půlmaratonu, štafety, běhu na 10 km a dětských závodů. Trasa patří mezi nejrychlejší v České republice a je považována za jednu z nejhezčích městských tras. V roce 2026 bude závod hostit také Mistrovství ČR veteránů v půlmaratonu a Přebor ČR záchranných a bezpečnostních složek v půlmaratonu. Zázemí nové fotbalové arény v centru města poskytuje komfortní servis pro závodníky.

name: Horský běh Alfrédka - Memoriál Miroslava Čermáka
description: Horský běh Alfrédka - Memoriál Miroslava Čermáka je závod vedený převážně po lesní cestě o délce 13,6 km s převýšením 430 m. Závod je součástí Velké ceny vytrvalců Olomouckého kraje a Českého poháru v běhu do vrchu. Nabízí náročnou trasu v krásné přírodě Moravskoslezského kraje, která potěší milovníky horského běhu a vytrvalostních disciplín. Závod se koná ve Stará Vsi u Rýmařova a je vhodný pro zkušené běžce hledající výzvu v terénu.

name: Běh okolo Panoramy
description: Běh okolo Panoramy je tradiční přespolní běh v náročném horském terénu v okolí jáchymovského fotbalového stadionu. Tento závod je určen pro všechny věkové kategorie a koná se již 33. rokem. Akce je organizována Tělovýchovnou jednotou Jáchymov a nabízí sportovní vyžití v krásném prostředí Krušných hor.

name: Běh údolím Orlice
organizer: Tělovýchovná jednota Sokol Klášterec nad Orlicí
description: Běh údolím Orlice je tradiční krosový běh konaný v Klášterci nad Orlicí, který nabízí tratě vedoucí po loukách a místních cestách s kopcovitým terénem. Závod je součástí ISCAREX poháru a je vhodný pro širokou škálu běžců včetně dětí a dospělých. Na vítěze čekají medaile, věcné ceny i finanční prémie. Start a cíl jsou umístěny na fotbalovém hřišti u školy, přičemž hlavní závod začíná dopoledne.

name: Slatinský kros
description: Slatinský kros je tradiční přespolní běžecký závod pořádaný v Brně-Slatině, letos již 19. ročník. Závod se koná v parku Terénky na ulici Dědická a nabízí travnatou trať se zvlněným profilem, která prověří běžce v příjemném přírodním prostředí. Závod je pod záštitou Městské části Brno-Slatina a je vhodný pro širokou veřejnost. Účastníci mohou očekávat poháry, medaile a hodnotné věcné ceny.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Olomouc - říjen
description: Běh 2 míle Olomouc je otevřený závod na 2 míle (3,2 km) určený pro všechny věkové kategorie a úrovně běžců, od začátečníků po zkušené. Závod je zaměřen na radost z běhu a soutěžení především se sebou samým. Místo konání je v Smetanových sadech v Olomouci u fontány, s výjimkou některých červnových a srpnových závodů, které se konají u řeky. Běh je součástí soutěže o pohár, kde se výsledky přepočítávají podle věkového koeficientu a body se sčítají během roku.

name: Roštejnské stráně
description: Roštejnské stráně je tradiční krosový běh pořádaný Orlem Telč, který je součástí Orelské běžecké ligy. Tento 14. ročník se koná v krásném prostředí u Ranče u Lipek v Telči a nabízí běžcům různé kategorie včetně rodinných štafet a lidového běhu pro začátečníky. Závod je otevřen všem věkovým kategoriím a klade důraz na fair play a sportovní hodnoty. Pro vítěze jsou připraveny medaile, diplomy a věcné ceny, a to i speciální ocenění pro nejmladšího a nejstaršího běžce.

name: Běh kolem Lužnice
description: Běh kolem Lužnice je tradiční běžecký závod pořádaný atletickým klubem Atletika Veselí ve Veselí nad Lužnicí. Závod nabízí jedinečnou příležitost pro běžce všech věkových kategorií vychutnat si krásnou přírodu a sportovní atmosféru na stadionu TJ Lokomotiva. Klub se dlouhodobě věnuje atletice a běžeckým závodům, přičemž klade důraz na kvalitní organizaci a přátelskou atmosféru. Závod je vhodný jak pro zkušené běžce, tak i pro začátečníky a děti.

name: Huť - Bratříkov - Huť
location: Huť u Jablonce nad Nisou, Liberecký
description: Huť-Bratříkov-Huť je tradiční přespolní běh konaný každoročně první říjnovou neděli v Huti u Jablonce nad Nisou. Tento závod s historií od roku 1972 nabízí hlavní závod na 10 km a kratší varianty pro různé věkové kategorie. Trať vede přes malebnou krajinu s travnatým hřištěm jako startovním a cílovým místem. Závod je vhodný pro všechny milovníky běhu, od dětí po dospělé, a je známý svou přátelskou atmosférou a kvalitní organizací.

name: 25. Benther-Berg-Lauf
location: VSV Benthe Sportplatz, Am Hammfeld, Ronnenberg-Benthe, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Benther-Berg-Lauf takes place in Ronnenberg-Benthe and is part of the Sparkassen-Laufpass der Region Hannover. The event offers a variety of race distances for all age groups, from Bambini and children’s races to a half marathon covering 21.8 km. The course runs through the scenic surroundings of the Benther Berg and offers a varied running experience for both competitive runners and recreational athletes. Race number and transponder pickup starts at 8:30 a.m. in the gymnasium of VSV Benthe. Late entries are possible up to 45 minutes before each start.
course_highlights: 21.8 km long-distance race (half marathon) through the Benther Berg
A range of distances from the 550 m Bambini race to the 21.8 km long-distance race
Part of the Sparkassen-Laufpass der Region Hannover
additional: Late entries are possible on the day of the event up to 45 minutes before each start, with an additional late-entry fee of €5 (€2 for the Bambini and children’s races). Parking is available in a designated lot behind the sports facility; on the day of the event, access is only possible as far as the dead end. Groups of 5 or more can request a discount by email.

name: 31. Geiseltalseelauf
description: The Geiseltalsee Run is a long-standing running event in Braunsbedra that welcomes runners of all ability levels. The route passes through the scenic surroundings of Lake Geiseltal and offers a sporting challenge across varied terrain. The event is very popular and attracts numerous participants every year. Alongside the competition, the sense of community is also a central part of the event.
course_highlights: Route around Lake Geiseltal
Varied terrain with scenic views
Half marathon with a course record set the previous year
additional: Late entries are possible on race day up to 1 hour before the start. The event also includes children’s and youth races as well as walking events. It takes place in Braunsbedra at Lake Geiseltal and is part of the Landescup. The exact start and finish locations can be found on the official website.

name: Buchdorfer Jedermannslauf
price_range: 8 Euro für Erwachsene, 4 Euro für Schüler/Jugendliche
description: The 33rd Buchdorf Fun Run takes place and offers runners a challenging course through a romantic woodland. There are two distances: 10 km for adults and 3.3 km for young runners. The event is ideal as a personal fitness test and is open to everyone, regardless of club membership. The entry fee is moderate, and the winners receive nutritious prizes, with a special prize for the team with the most participants.
course_highlights: 10 km and 3.3 km courses on well-maintained forest roads
A challenging woodland section with a romantic atmosphere
Start area in the nearby woodland, next to the football pitch in the direction of Daiting
additional: Registration is possible until approximately 25 minutes before the start at the Eisstockschützenheim next to the football pitch. Nordic walkers may use the course without registering, but will not be timed or ranked. Participation is at your own responsibility and risk. Distances: 10 km and 3.3 km; registration until approximately 25 minutes before the start; no club membership required; participation at your own responsibility.

name: Essener Seelauf 2026
description: The Essen Seelauf is a traditional running event at Lake Baldeney in Essen. The 14.2 km course follows well-marked cycle paths and passes through the bird sanctuary. There are two refreshment stations, and the race starts at 10:00 a.m. The event is held in accordance with the guidelines of the German Athletics Association (DLV) and is open to runners with or without a DLV competition licence. Late registrations are possible up to one hour before the start, subject to availability.
course_highlights: 14.2 km course at Lake Baldeney
The course passes through a bird sanctuary and over Lantermannsfähre
Two refreshment stations at km 5 and km 9.5
additional: Late registration is possible up to one hour before the start, with a late-entry fee of €3, payable in cash. Changes of registration are possible only until 30.09. by email to teamessen@gmx.de. Race numbers must be worn visibly on the chest. The use of technical devices such as smartphones with headphones is prohibited. The course is not measured by the DLV, but every kilometre is marked. The 14.2 km race is not measured by the DLV. There are two refreshment stations at km 5 and km 9.5, manual timekeeping, race numbers worn on the chest, parking at the Regattaturm, and changing rooms and showers in the Regattahaus.

name: Kranlauf
description: The Kranlauf Offenbach takes place every year on German Unity Day at the blue harbor crane, and all proceeds support Aidshilfe Offenbach. The event offers three timed race options suitable for both individual participants and groups. The route goes around the harbor and offers a unique atmosphere in Offenbach. Race bibs are equipped with a timing chip, and a €5 deposit is charged, which can be refunded or donated.
course_highlights: Run by the blue harbor crane in Offenbach
Distances: approx. 1.3 km, 2.6 km, and 5 miles
Timing chip in the race bib
additional: Race bibs with an integrated timing chip for the 5-mile race. A €5 deposit is charged for the bib; it can be returned or donated. Online registration is open until 30 minutes before each race start; on-site registration is also possible until 30 minutes before the start. Event runs from 10 a.m. to 3 p.m. at Offenbach Harbor. Parking is available in the Hafenzentrum underground garage and near the Mainparkplatz. Travel by bicycle, on foot, or by public transport is recommended. Races over 1.3 km, 2.6 km, and approx. 8 km; online registration until 30 min. before the start; harbor festival with music and food and drink.

name: Labertal-Lauf
description: The Labertal Run is a traditional running event in Geiselhöring, taking place for the 16th time. The route is considered one of the most scenic in the region, away from town centers and busy roads, and partly alongside the Kleine Laber. The Lower Bavarian 10 km Road Running Championships are also held as part of the Labertal Run. The event attracts runners from the region and beyond, and offers ideal conditions for fast times in autumn running weather.
course_highlights: Scenic route away from town centers
Partly right alongside the Kleine Laber
The Lower Bavarian 10 km Road Running Championships are held as part of the event
additional: The race traditionally starts in the morning, most recently at 09:40. The route is well established and offers ideal running conditions. The event is part of the Lower Bavarian Championships and attracts the region’s top runners. Registration is possible until race day; club membership is not required. Flat courses for all ability levels.

name: NRZ Klosterlauf
location: Kloster Kamp, Kamp-Lintfort, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The NRZ Kloster Run takes place on German Unity Day around Kamp Abbey in Kamp-Lintfort. The event offers races over 5,000 meters and a half marathon, with suitable options for runners of all levels. The detailed race information and schedule will be published once planning is complete. An established event organized by SV Alemannia Kamp-Leichtathletik, the run warmly invites runners to take part on this special day.
course_highlights: Run around historic Kamp Abbey
Races over 5,000 meters and a half marathon
Event held on German Unity Day
additional: The race information and schedule will be published online once final planning is complete. The event is part of SV Alemannia Kamp-Leichtathletik and takes place annually on October 3. Distances include 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon; on-site registration is available; part of the regional running events on the Lower Rhine.

name: Odenwälder Herbstlauf
description: The Odenwälder Herbstlauf is a traditional running event held in Mudau. The event offers five different routes through the beautiful Mudauer Odenwald, including a half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, Nordic walking and a Bambini run. The routes run mostly on paved, flat forest paths and asphalt, with no significant climbs, making them challenging yet scenic. Prizes are awarded for course records on the half-marathon and 10 km routes, and each registration supports a charitable cause.
