The start and finish areas are at the Odenwaldstadion in Mudau, where race bibs are also distributed and awards ceremonies take place.
course_highlights: Routes through the Mudauer Odenwald on asphalt and paved forest paths
Flat terrain with no significant climbs
Officially measured routes: half marathon (21.1 km), 10 km, 5 km, Nordic walking (10 km) and Bambini run (600 m)
additional: Race bibs can be collected on race day from 7:30 a.m. at the Odenwaldstadion. Timing is recorded using gun time, with a disposable transponder integrated into the race bib. There are up to 5 aid stations along the route, offering bananas, sports drinks and water. Changing rooms, showers and toilets are available at the TSV clubhouse. Valuables can be stored there securely. Awards ceremonies take place at the stadium as soon as possible after the races. Age-group rankings and team competitions are available for the 5 km and 10 km races. Late registration is possible on race day until 8:45 a.m., by email or in person, for an additional fee of 4 EUR. The race is known for its rolling courses and friendly, family atmosphere. There are also special competitions for children and young people.

name: Ortsstraßenlauf
description: The TV Marienhagen village road race has been held annually on German Unity Day since 1990 and is the club’s largest sporting event. The courses run along roads within and outside the village, as well as paved forest and field paths. The event is part of the Waldeck-Frankenberger Running Cup and offers categories for Bambini, students, youths, and seniors. Everyone is welcome to participate; club membership is not required. Advance registration is no longer available—registration is exclusively on site. Refreshments are provided during and after the event, and every participant receives a certificate.
course_highlights: Courses along roads and paved forest and field paths
10 km run and 7.5 km Nordic walking on out-and-back courses
Part of the Waldeck-Frankenberger Running Cup
additional: Registration is available only on site, no later than 45 minutes before the start. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Children and youths may not enter more than one race. Refreshments are provided during and after the race at the village community centre by the sports ground. The course runs through the village. No advance registration is available. Refreshments are available on site, and all participants receive certificates.

name: Sparkassen-Phoenix-Halbmarathon
description: The Sparkassen-Phoenix Half Marathon in Dortmund is a popular half marathon held annually on October 3. The 21.1 km course runs through southern Dortmund, past Phoenix Lake, Phoenix-West, Westfalenpark and Rombergpark. It is officially measured, making it suitable for personal bests. In addition to the individual half marathon, there are relay races and a KNAX Fun Run for children. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with refreshments, cheer zones and a rendezvous point for relay runners shortly before the finish.
course_highlights: The course passes Phoenix Lake, Phoenix-West, Westfalenpark and Rombergpark
Officially measured 21.1 km course, eligible for rankings
Relay exchange zones at kilometers 7 and 14, with shuttle bus connections
additional: Bib pickup on October 2 from 14:00 to 17:00 and on race day from 8:30. Bibs are printed with participants’ names and sent by post. Online late registration is available until October 3 at 10:00; after that, registration is possible on site for a fee. Relay teams receive a timing baton, which can be collected on race day upon presentation of ID. Refreshments are available at kilometers 4, 11 and 17, as well as in the finish area. Changing rooms, toilets and bag drop are at the Sparkassen Academy by Phoenix Lake. Shuttle buses take relay runners to the exchange zones. A rendezvous point for relay runners is located approximately 150 m before the finish. Course through parks and industrial areas, registration, advertising opportunities, race on October 3

name: Treiser Volkslauf
description: The Treis Volkslauf is being held for the 34th time in Staufenberg-Treis. The event is for runners, walkers, and hikers of all ability levels and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with a large cake buffet and delicious pea soup. The race is part of the Mittelhessen-Cup, a popular running series in Hesse and the surrounding area. Registration is available via Race Result from [date not specified].
course_highlights: Part of the Mittelhessen-Cup, a regional running series
A variety of routes for running, walking, and hiking
Large cake buffet and pea soup
additional: A large cake buffet and pea soup are available for participants. The race is part of the Mittelhessen-Cup running series, which includes several events in the region. The club also offers regular running and walking groups, as well as beginner courses. Running, walking, and hiking event; community activities; refreshments including a cake buffet and pea soup.

name: Volks - und Feuerwehrlauf Rhede
price_range: 2,00 EUR (zusätzliche Gebühr bei Voranmeldung bis Limit)
description: The Volks- und Feuerwehrlauf Rhede is a traditional running event organized by the Rhede Fire Department. Held annually, it gives runners the opportunity to take part in a friendly and safe atmosphere. The races start at the Rhede School Center and follow a varied route through the town. Prizes are awarded to the top four finishers in each category, and certificates and live results are available on-site and online.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Rhede School Center, Büssingstraße 14
Varied route through Rhede
Live results on monitors in the finish area and online
additional: Late registration is possible for a fee of 2.00 EUR until 30 minutes before the respective start. Registration is available on October 2 from 18:00 to 19:00 and on October 3 from 09:00 at the race office. For safety reasons, MP3 players are prohibited. Baby joggers and dogs are not allowed. The event takes place at the Rhede School Center. Registration is on October 2 and 3. Participation rules include safety requirements such as not using MP3 players and not bringing strollers or dogs. Results are available live and online.

name: Volkslauf SV Traisa
description: The SV 1911 Traisa fun run takes place annually on October 3 at the Traisa sports ground in Mühltal. Participants can choose between a challenging half marathon and a classic 11 km run. The course winds through scenic surroundings and traditionally finishes at a generously stocked cake table welcoming all participants. The event is a popular opportunity for sports enthusiasts of all ages to compete and enjoy the public holiday together.
course_highlights: Half-marathon and 11 km race options
Start and finish at the Traisa sports ground
Scenic running course with elevation profile
additional: The run takes place annually on October 3. The event ends with a large cake table for all participants. The Traisa sports ground is easy to reach by car, bus, and regional train. The website contains no explicit information about start waves or late-registration fees. The main race starts at 9:00 a.m. and the youth race at 11:30 a.m. The event takes place at the Traisa sports ground in Mühltal and is a sociable club race with a strong community spirit.

name: Bismarckturmlauf
location: Neustadt an der Orla, Thuringia, Germany
description: The Bismarck Tower Run in Neustadt an der Orla is a long-established running event, taking place for the 33rd time on October 3, 2027. The run is open to recreational athletes of all ages and offers a range of distances through varied landscapes. Organized by Freizeitsportverein 1978 e.V. Neustadt an der Orla, the event celebrates exercise, fitness, and community. It is supported by numerous sponsors, club members, and volunteers, and offers a sporting challenge in a convivial atmosphere.
course_highlights: A variety of distances from 0.7 km to 21.1 km
Run through the scenic surroundings of Neustadt an der Orla
A traditional event with a family-friendly atmosphere and a broad participant base
additional: Registration for the Bismarck Tower Run opens in April 2027 through the registration portal on the website. There is a 0.7 km children's loop as well as other distances, with GPX files available to download. The event is organized by Freizeitsportverein 1978 e.V. Neustadt an der Orla and supported by local sponsors. Results and photos from previous years are available on the website.

name: 26. Generali Köln Marathon
organizer: Kölner Marathon Veranstaltungs- und Werbe GmbH
description: The Generali Cologne Marathon is a unique running experience that combines elite and recreational sport with carnival, a street festival and a running festival. The course passes through lively Cologne neighbourhoods such as Rodenkirchen, Lindenthal, Ehrenfeld and Nippes, and finishes spectacularly at Cologne Cathedral. With up to 15,000 participants, the marathon offers an exhilarating atmosphere, supported by thousands of spectators along the course. The event also places great importance on sustainability and offers a varied programme of activities.
course_highlights: Start in Deutz at Ottoplatz, with panoramic views of Cologne Cathedral and the Old Town
Pass Rudolfplatz three times, with strong spectator support
Course through diverse neighbourhoods such as Südstadt, Ehrenfeld and Nippes
additional: The marathon starts in Deutz at Ottoplatz and passes several relay and school-marathon changeover zones. There are 11 refreshment stations for the marathon and 6 for the half marathon. The marathon is limited to 15,000 participants. The course passes well-known Cologne landmarks and neighbourhoods, and the finish is at Cologne Cathedral. The event values sustainability and offers a varied programme of activities featuring carnival and a running festival. Registration is open; various race disciplines, limited entries, special competitions for students, sustainable event

name: Soester Stadtlauf
price_range: abhängig von der Distanz (Infos im Anmeldeportal)
description: Experience the traditional Soest City Run, a sporting highlight for young and old in the historic city centre of Soest. Whether you’re a recreational runner, a competitive athlete or running with your family, together you’ll make the day an unforgettable experience, with a unique atmosphere along the course. The event offers various race distances, an appealing supporting programme, and refreshments for all participants and guests.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the heart of the historic old town
Atmospheric run through Soest city centre
Commentary, music and refreshments along the course
additional: Race distances: children’s races 475m (start 12:00), school races 950m (born 2016–2018, start 12:45) and 1450m (born 2006–2015, start 14:15), main races 4km (start 15:00) and 10km (start 15:45). Parking available on the outskirts of town, with a shuttle service. Drinks and snack stands for participants and guests. An appealing family programme and on-site commentary. Various race distances, start and finish in the heart of the old town, refreshments, shuttle service, awards ceremony immediately after the races.

name: Cross der deutschen Einheit
description: The Cross der Deutschen Einheit in Weißensee is a traditional cross-country race organized by the sports club Blau-Weiß 1921 Weißensee e.V. This race is being held for the 35th time and offers various competitions for all age groups, including Bambini races, youth races, a 3.5 km race, a 10.5 km race, a half marathon, and walking/Nordic walking. The course runs around the Gondelteich, with varied sections including climbs and stairs, and offers a sporting challenge for runners of all ability levels. A jubilee relay race rounds off the program and requires no registration or entry fee.

name: 14. Burgdorfer Spargel-Lauf
description: The Burgdorf Asparagus Run is an annual running event held as part of the Oktobermarkt town festival in Burgdorf. The routes run along the Aue and through the city center, with the start and finish at the Auebrücke Poststraße / Braunschweiger Straße. The event offers 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km races, as well as Nordic walking and a children’s race.

name: 23. Mitteldeutscher Marathon
description: The Central German Marathon connects the Central German metropolitan region with a unique route from Leipzig to Halle (Saale). The marathon starts at the Sportforum in Leipzig and passes through two federal states and two cities before finishing in the historic center of Halle. Other events include the Händel Run Half Marathon, half-marathon relay, 10 km run, 10 km walking, Salzwirker Run and AOK Tryout Run. The event offers runners of all abilities a varied and culturally interesting running experience.
course_highlights: Marathon start at the Sportforum in Leipzig
Finish in Halle (Saale), which is over 1,200 years old
Run through one of Germany’s greenest cities in the Händel Run Half Marathon
additional: The marathon, half-marathon, 10 km, Salzwirker Run and Tryout Run routes are loops starting and finishing at the Marktplatz in Halle (Saale), except for the marathon, which runs from Leipzig to Halle. All routes are subject to official approval. Various events and relays are offered, including the Central German University Championships. Race packets can be collected, and late registrations and transfers are possible.

name: Apfellauf 2026
description: Apfellauf 2026 takes place on October 4 in Mössingen-Laubuseschbach and offers runners a scenic route through orchards, along forest and field paths, and on a closed state road. The start and finish are on the grounds of Kelterei Heil. Two distances are offered: 5 kilometers (one lap) and 10 kilometers (two laps). The race is open to competitive and recreational runners, as well as teams who can take part together. Children up to age 9 can enter the children’s race for free.

name: Bayerische Halbmarathon-Meisterschaften
description: The Bavarian Half Marathon Championships take place in Aschaffenburg on Westring, near the Linde MH Arena. The event is hosted by TV Haibach and is open to active athletes and masters from Lower Franconia, Bavarian Lower Main, Northern Bavaria and across Bavaria. The championships give runners the opportunity to compete on an official half-marathon course and vie for Bavarian championship titles. Online registration is available.

name: Boitzer Herbstlauf
description: The Boitzer Autumn Run is a local autumn race with walking in Walsrode, Lower Saxony, organized by the SV Kirchboitzen sports club. In 2026, the event will be held in person for the 19th time and is open to runners and walkers of all ages. Participants can get the key information directly from the organizing team on site. Further practical details are provided by SV Kirchboitzen.

name: Cottbuser Oktoberlauf
description: The Cottbus October Run is a traditional running event held at the Cottbus Sports Center, in the athletics stadium and mainly in the adjacent woodland, on paved paths and cycle paths. The event offers various distances from 400 meters to the half marathon (21.1 km), as well as walking and cross-country runs for different age groups. The races are part of the Sparkasse Running and Walking Cup and feature varied courses with both paved and unpaved paths. All participants receive a commemorative medal and can print a certificate online; trophies and prizes are also awarded to the top runners.
course_highlights: Routes pass through woodland on paved paths and cycle paths
Refreshment points at the Spree Bridge
Varied routes with both paved and unpaved paths, including obstacles in the Kids Run
additional: Timing is recorded using an ankle transponder, which must be returned after finishing. A fee of 20 EUR applies if it is lost or damaged. The race number must be worn visibly on the chest. Late registration is available online from 29.09. to 02.10.2027 and on the event day until one hour before the start. Age-group award ceremonies are held, with certificates and trophies. The event is part of the Sparkasse Running and Walking Cup.

name: Gaudilauf 14
organizer: Lauf- und Walkingverein 05 Bad Liebenwerda e.V.
description: The Gaudilauf is a traditional race held in Bad Liebenwerda. The route runs from Munich via Bad Liebenwerda back to Munich and offers a scenic course along the Elster. The event is characterized by a friendly atmosphere, with the competitive aspect taking a back seat. Refreshments are provided every 5 kilometers, and participants can look forward to a relaxed celebration at the finish with drinks and grilled food. A bus transfer from the finish back to the start is available on request.

name: Herbstlauf
description: The Ovenhausen Autumn Run is a traditional race held annually on the first Sunday in October and organized by TuS Ovenhausen. The event offers various distances for different age and performance groups, including a challenging 20.8 km tour through forests and hills, as well as shorter races for young athletes. The course is varied, with sections on cycle paths, in the Grubestadion, and through the forest. The race is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational athletes, and usually takes place in pleasant autumn weather.

name: Herbstlauf Ready4Run Niederwangen
description: The Niederwangen Autumn Run takes place annually and is part of the Voralpen VBAO Cup. The event offers a quarter-marathon distance and is known for its attractive cup standings, with the overall awards ceremony held at the Autumn Run. It welcomes runners of all ability levels and is a fixture on the regional running calendar.

name: IRT - Läufermeeting
description: The IRT Running Meeting takes place every year in early October on the grounds of the Industriepark Region Trier (IRT) in Föhren. The event offers super-flat, super-fast courses officially measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV), making them ideal for personal bests. Events are held over 10 km, 5 km and 1 km for children and young people. Net timing is used in all races except the Bambini Run, with a single-use bib featuring an integrated transponder. Changing rooms and showers are available at the nearby Föhren Primary School.

name: Kalbsvilla Run
organizer: Motor Presse Hamburg GmbH & Co. KG Verlagsgesellschaft
description: The Kalbsvilla Run takes place in Ortenberg, Hesse, with the historic Kalbsvilla on Am Mühltor serving as the start and finish area. Various distances are offered, including a 5 km run, a 10 km run, a half marathon, and 5 km Nordic walking. There are also races for toddlers, children, and teenagers, making the event family-friendly. Timing is electronic via a Race Result transponder, and the event supports a good cause as a charity run.

name: Luftschifflauf
description: The TURCK Airship Run at Essen/Mülheim Airport offers a unique running experience on the airport runway. The flat, fast course, with no tight turns or elevation gain, is ideal for setting personal bests. The highlight is the spectacular finish inside the impressive WDL airship hangar, making the race an unforgettable event. This family-friendly event offers various distances for children, teenagers, and adults and takes place in all weather conditions.

name: Mitteldeutscher Marathon
description: The Central German Marathon is a unique running experience in the heart of Germany, connecting the Central German metropolitan region on a fast course between Leipzig and Halle (Saale). The classic marathon course, which hosted the first German marathon in 1925, runs from the city of Bach, Leipzig, to Halle, the cultural capital. In addition to the marathon, other events include the Händel Run Half Marathon, the half-marathon relay, the 10K run, 10K walking, and the Salzwirker Run. The event offers a varied program and is suitable for runners of all ability levels.

name: Oktoberlauf Embsen
description: The Oktoberlauf Embsen is expected to take place on Sunday, October 3, 2027, in 21409 Embsen. Running events over 5 km and 11 km are offered, as well as events for children and young people. All events share the same finish location. The event is open to runners of all ages and offers a sporting challenge amid Embsen’s autumn scenery.
course_highlights: 5 km and 11 km running courses
A shared finish location for all events
Events for children and young people
additional: The exact finish locations are shown only with RUNME Premium. The website does not provide detailed information about start waves, participant limits, or late entries.

name: TrailRUN21
description: The TrailRUN21 in Zell am Harmersbach is a challenging trail-running race in the Black Forest. There are two main distances: the TrailRUN21, at 20.3 km with 710 metres of elevation gain, and the TrailRUN Light, at 10.3 km with 390 metres of elevation gain, ideal for beginners. The course is well marked and passes through varied terrain that appeals to both experienced trail runners and newcomers. The race is organised by TV 1898 Unterharmersbach e.V. and places great importance on environmental protection, for example by not using disposable cups at the refreshment stations.

name: UNO URBAN CROSS LAUF
description: The UNO Urban Cross is an urban obstacle race through the heart of Saarbrücken city centre. The course ranges from 2.5 km to 10 km and features numerous creative obstacles, such as scaffolding, stacks of tires, cable reels and hay bales. The race offers a true city adventure for individual and team runners and is supported by Mayor Uwe Conradt. The event promises fun, challenge and thrills in a unique urban setting.

name: Festiwal Biegowy JuraRun 2026
distance_verbose: 104 km, 81 km, Maraton, 23 km, Półmaraton, 12 km, 10 km, 9 km, 5 km
description: JuraRun 2026 Running Festival is a unique trail-running event held in the heart of the Kraków-Częstochowa Upland, in Podlesice. Participants can choose from a range of distances, from short children’s races to demanding ultramarathons that follow scenic forest trails, limestone rock formations, and the upland’s hills. This event is for lovers of sport and nature, combining a passion for running with the chance to discover the beauty of the region. JuraRun is also an opportunity to meet people with similar interests and enjoy an unforgettable running adventure.
course_highlights: Routes pass through the scenic landscapes of the Kraków-Częstochowa Upland
Limestone rock formations and forest trails of varying difficulty
Distances range from 100 metres for children to an ultramarathon of over 100 km
additional: Starts take place in waves, including the JuraRun Night 10+ night race at 21:00 and the JuraRun ULTRA 100+ and ULTRA 80+ ultramarathons at 23:00. The race office is open from Friday at 17:00 until Saturday at 13:30, with registration closing at different times for each distance. The event also includes a 12 km Nordic walking event and children’s races starting at 100 metres. Places for each distance are limited, and race packages are available at different times.

name: Festiwal Biegowy Silesia Marathon 2026
description: Silesia Marathon is the largest running event in Silesia, and in 2026 it will take place as a three-day running festival. Participants can choose from a range of distances, including the marathon, half marathon, ultramarathon, and 10 km and 5 km races. The finish line is at the iconic Silesian Stadium, adding a unique touch to the event. It’s not just a competition, but also an unforgettable experience and a celebration of the running community.

name: 25 Poznań Maraton
description: The Poznań Marathon is the 25th-anniversary edition of the city’s premier 42.195 km marathon, held in the heart of Poznań. The route runs along the city’s most important streets, including a return to the Old Market Square after 18 years, as well as scenic locations such as Sołacki Park, Malta and Enea Stadium. The event attracts both experienced runners and amateurs, offering a unique atmosphere and enthusiastic spectator support. Organizers have prepared a new, attractive course and a rich accompanying program, including children’s races and shorter distances.
course_highlights: The route passes through the Old Market Square, Ratajskiego Square and Wolności Square
Runs through the scenic areas around Malta and Sołacki Park
Finish at Plac Marka, at the Poznań International Fair
additional: The start for wheelchair athletes is at 8:55, and for runners at 9:00. Start corrals are assigned according to the declared marathon finish time and marked with colored stripes on race bibs. The participant limit is 8,000. The race office is open October 2–3 at the Poznań International Fair.

name: II Radomski Bieg Onkologiczny
description: The 2nd Radom Oncology Run is a sporting event organized by the “Biegiem Radom!” Association in Radom, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The run is charitable and inclusive, welcoming people of different ages and running abilities. The organizers emphasize community and support for people affected by cancer, combining sport with an important social mission. The event takes place in the scenic surroundings of Radom and welcomes both runners and fans of physical activity.

name: Wild Run
description: Wild Run is a charity race held in Wrocław at the Wrocław Zoo. Participants can run the 10 km distance or take part in a virtual race on a route of their choice. The event supports the protection of endangered animal species and promotes physical activity and a family-oriented lifestyle. It is organized for nature lovers and runners of all ages, and also features races for children and teenagers.
course_highlights: The main course is a loop of approximately 5 km inside the Wrocław Zoo, completed twice
The option to take part in a virtual race on a route of your choice
Accompanying races for children and teenagers over approximately 1 km and 100 m
additional: Race packs can be collected on race day from 12:00 to 15:00 at the zoo ticket offices, and on Saturday at Decathlon Magnolia from 15:00 to 20:00. Entry to the zoo is with a single-entry ticket, which participants receive when collecting their race pack. The first 1,000 participants in the in-person race will receive a special canvas bag. The extended pack offers the option to purchase technical T-shirts and a quick-dry towel, and to support the Zoo Wrocław - DODO Foundation.

name: Botaniczna Piątka - edycja jesienna
location: Botaniczna Piątka, Ogród Botaniczny w Kielcach, Kielce, Poland

name: Bieg o Puchar Wójta Mikołajki Pomorskie
Medzinárodný maratón mieru
description: The International Peace Marathon in Košice is a traditional running festival held on Hlavná Street. Organized by the Košice Marathon Club, it offers a marathon, half marathon, and other disciplines, with the start and finish located in the city center. The event is known for its long history and high-quality organization, including the Slovak Half Marathon Championships. Runners can expect professional timing and a rich program of accompanying events.

name: Majstrovstvá SR v polmaratóne mužov a žien - MMM 2026
description: The Slovak Republic Championships in the Men’s and Women’s Half Marathon are part of the Košice Peace Marathon, held in Košice. The half-marathon course is fast, with few sharp turns and a favourable elevation profile, allowing runners to achieve excellent times. The start and finish are on Hlavná Street in the city centre, creating a pleasant atmosphere for runners and spectators alike. The event is organised with an emphasis on professional preparation and support for the running community.
course_highlights: A fast course with few sharp turns
A favourable elevation profile suited to fast times
Start and finish on Hlavná Street in Košice
additional: The start of all events is on Hlavná Street, between the DoubleTree by Hilton hotel and the Dargov department store. The MMM relays consist of four runners, with legs of 12 km, 9 km and 12 km. The organiser awards age categories for the marathon and half marathon. Registration is available online only through the official website.

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Tetín
description: Běžecká série Berounka - Tetín je komunitní trailový závod konaný v malebném prostředí Tetína. Trasa vede přes kopce a nabízí nádherné vyhlídky na Český kras a okolní krajinu, včetně stoupání k vyhlídce na Beroun. Závod je součástí série 12 běhů, které motivují běžce všech úrovní k aktivnímu pohybu v přírodě s přátelskou atmosférou a zázemím místních hospůdek. Na místě je zajištěno občerstvení, úschova věcí a odměny pro nejlepší v kategoriích.

name: Mrdická mašina
description: Mrdická mašina je rychlý běh na 2,0 km přes mrdické louky v Heřmanově Městci. Tento závod je součástí Heřmanoměstecké ligy sportu, která zahrnuje deset atletických a cyklistických závodů v okolí tvrziště Mrdice. Závod je otevřen široké veřejnosti a nabízí zábavnou a sportovní výzvu pro všechny běžce. Pořádá ho Běžecký klub Heřmanův Městec, který podporuje běh a sportovní aktivity v regionu.

name: Warburger Stundenlauf 2026
description: The 34th Warburg Hour Run takes place in Warburg. The competition is aimed at adults and offers both individual and team categories. The course is flat and the event lasts one hour. There are also competitions for children and young people; details can be found in the organizer’s official announcement.
course_highlights: Flat course
Duration: 1 hour
Individual and team categories available
additional: A competition for children and young people is offered. The start and finish are at Hüffertsportplatz; precise location details require RUNME Premium. The event is part of the RUNME race calendar. Participants receive certificates and trophies; registration is online; the event takes place in October in good weather.

name: Biberacher Herbstwaldlauf 2026
description: The Biberach Autumn Forest Run is a small autumn race in Biberach an der Riß that starts at the Burrenwald parking lot. The event is organized by TG Biberach 1847 e.V. and offers runners a choice of 5 km or 10 km. It is a relaxed running event with no advance registration; participants can register on-site on race day. The route passes through the autumnal Burrenwald area and offers a nature-rich running experience. The entry fee is just 4 euros and includes refreshments at the finish and a certificate, which can be collected later or sent by email.

name: Herbstcross auf dem Bergfried
description: The Herbstcross auf dem Bergfried is a short autumn cross-country race held on the grounds of the Bergfried in Saalfeld, Germany. Distances range from 800 m to 4.8 km and are designed for fast off-road running rather than long road races. The race takes place outside the stadium and is classified as both a hill race and a cross-country race. The Saalfelder Leichtathletikverein has organized the event for many years, with separate races for children and adults and various age groups.

name: Herbstcross des Saalfelder LV
distance_verbose: 13.5 km, 10 km, 9.9 km, 5 km, 3000 Meter, 2 km, 0.8 km, 0.4 km

name: Běh pro Světlušku s knihovnou
location: Masaryk Public Library, Dolní náměstí, Vsetín, Česko
description: Běh pro Světlušku s knihovnou je tradiční sportovní akce pořádaná Masarykovou veřejnou knihovnou ve Vsetíně. Tento běh spojuje sportovní aktivitu s podporou dobré věci a přitahuje širokou veřejnost včetně rodin a nadšenců běhu. Akce se koná v příjemném prostředí Dolního náměstí a nabízí příležitost pro aktivní odpočinek i společenské setkání.
course_highlights: Start a cíl na Dolním náměstí ve Vsetíně
Příjemné městské prostředí s možností zapojení celé rodiny
Akce propojená s knihovnou a kulturním děním
additional: Výtěžek putuje Světlušce, projektu Nadačního fondu Českého rozhlasu. Účast je bez registrace; běží se nebo jde na vlastní zodpovědnost.

name: Roštejnskou oborou
description: Běh Roštejnskou oborou je přátelský závod pro širokou veřejnost, který se koná v malebném prostředí lesů u Růžené na Vysočině. Trať vede lesními cestami a je vhodná pro všechny věkové kategorie od 4 let výše, s délkami od 300 metrů do 8 900 metrů. Akce je součástí poháru Běžec Vysočiny a nabízí jedinečný zážitek z běhu v přírodě s možností pozorování místní fauny. Organizátorem je TJ Růžená, z.s., a závod je ideální pro rodiny i sportovní nadšence, kteří chtějí spojit sport s přírodou.

name: Pražský Kelt
description: Pražský Kelt je unikátní 100km ultra trail v srdci Prahy, který nabízí běžcům možnost poznat krásnou přírodu a keltská hradiště s celkovým převýšením 2500 metrů. Trasa vede zalesněnou kopcovitou krajinou Prahy, zahrnuje historická místa jako hradiště Šance, Butovice, Závist, Vyšehrad a další, a nabízí nádherné výhledy na město i okolní přírodu. Závod startuje a končí v areálu Základní školy Kunratice a je určen pro běžce, kteří chtějí zažít atmosféru ultramaratonu v netradičním městském prostředí. Kapacita závodu je omezena na 120 osob, což zajišťuje komorní a přátelskou atmosféru.

name: Cena Metuje
organizer: Sportovní klub Nové Město nad Metují z.s.
description: Cena Metuje je tradiční silniční běh na 10 km, který se koná v Novém Městě nad Metují jako součást běžeckého seriálu PRIMÁTOR CUP. Tento 65. ročník nabízí také závody pro žactvo v různých věkových kategoriích. Trať vede po asfaltové silnici údolím řeky Metuje do Pekla a zpět, což zajišťuje příjemný a zároveň náročný běžecký zážitek. Závod je vhodný pro širokou veřejnost včetně dětí, rodičů a prarodičů, kteří mohou sbírat body v rámci seriálu. Vyhlášení vítězů probíhá jak v dětských kategoriích, tak v hlavním závodě s finančními a věcnými cenami.

name: VOKOLO priglu
location: Brněnská přehrada, Brno, South Moravian Region, Česko
organizer: Brněnský klub běžeckých a sportovních aktivit z.s.
description: Vokolo priglu je tradiční běžecký závod okolo Brněnské přehrady. Závod nabízí jedinečný sportovní zážitek na trati dlouhé 14,1 km, což je přibližně jedna třetina maratonu. Trať je mírně zvlněná, převážně po asfaltu s částí kamenitého povrchu, a nabízí krásné výhledy na Brněnské moře, Hrad Veveří a podzimní lesy. Závod je určen pro jednotlivce, dvojice v parníkové štafetě, čtyřčlenné týmy, firmy i univerzity a je známý svou přátelskou atmosférou a kvalitní organizací.

name: Běh Borským parkem
description: Běh Borským parkem je tradiční podzimní sportovní akce v Plzni s historií od roku 1970. Závod je určen jak začínajícím hobby běžcům, tak zkušeným sportovcům všech věkových kategorií. Nabízí vzrušení na startovní čáře, napětí závodní atmosféry a radost v cíli. Pořadatelé zajišťují přívětivé závodnické prostředí a domácí občerstvení pro všechny účastníky.

name: Běhej lesy Lednice
description: Běhej lesy Lednice je součástí populárního běžeckého seriálu, který nabízí závody v nejkrásnějších přírodních lokalitách České republiky. Závod v Lednici se koná v malebném Lednicko-valtickém areálu, kde běžci procházejí zámeckým parkem, kolem rybníků a ikonických památek jako chrám Tří Grácií či Apollonův chrám. Trasy jsou vhodné pro různé úrovně běžců a zahrnují krátkou trasu Nova 14 km a delší ČSOB 21 km, obě s mezinárodním UTMB Indexem. Závod je doplněn o soutěže na rychlostních úsecích a atraktivní cílovou rovinku, která přináší další motivaci pro účastníky.

name: Hradčanské vlnky
description: Hradčanské vlnky je tradiční krosový trailový závod v Hradčanech u Olomouce, který nabízí tři hlavní tratě: 5,6 km, 10,4 km a půlmaraton 21,1 km. Závod klade důraz na pohyb v terénu s převahou lesních a polních cest, což zajišťuje atraktivní a náročný běh. Součástí závodu jsou také dětské kategorie s různými délkami tratí. Pro závodníky je zajištěno občerstvení, čipové měření a bohaté zázemí včetně sprch. Atmosféra je přátelská a závod je vhodný pro široké spektrum běžců od dětí po zkušené trailové běžce.

name: Podzimní běh Olympu
description: Podzimní běh Olympu je tradiční běžecký závod pořádaný Policejním sportovním klubem Olymp Praha, který se koná v malebném prostředí parku Stromovka v Praze 7. Závod nabízí příležitost pro běžce všech úrovní, aby si užili podzimní atmosféru a sportovní výzvu v příjemném městském parku. Akce je vhodná pro širokou veřejnost a podporuje týmového ducha a aktivní životní styl. Organizátoři vítají všechny zájemce a poskytují podporu při registraci i během závodu.

name: Benešovský půlmaratón a desítka Pojizeřím
description: Benešovský půlmaratón a desítka Pojizeřím je tradiční běžecký závod v malebném prostředí obce Benešov u Semil v Libereckém kraji. Závod nabízí půlmaratónskou a desetikilometrovou trasu vedoucí krásnou přírodou Pojizeří s různorodým terénem. Pořadatelem je TJ Benešov u Semil, který zajišťuje přátelskou atmosféru a drobné občerstvení pro závodníky i doprovod. Závod je vhodný pro širokou běžeckou veřejnost a je součástí sportovních aktivit obce.

name: Běh Bukovem
description: Běh Bukovem je pravidelný roční sportovní festival běhu, který se koná v krásném přírodním prostředí Bukova a Plískova v rámci Brdského běžeckého poháru. Závod probíhá výhradně na loukách, lesních cestách a pěšinách, což nabízí běžcům příjemný zážitek v přírodě. Akce je vhodná pro širokou škálu věkových kategorií, od nejmenších dětí až po veterány. Pořádá ji obec Plískov ve spolupráci s Farmou Ekl a je známá svou přátelskou atmosférou a tradicí.

name: Kašavský kros
description: Kašavský kros je tradiční terénní běžecký závod v okolí Kašavy, který nabízí dvě hlavní trasy pro závodníky od 16 let a také dětské závody. Závod se koná a je známý svou ověřenou trasou s kopci a příjemnou atmosférou. Pořadatelem je spolek VALACHBAJK TEAM KAŠAVA, který spolupracuje s místní obcí a školou. Dětské závody probíhají po doběhu hlavních závodů a jsou rozděleny do několika věkových kategorií s různými délkami tratí.

name: MUTRAverz - Mikulovský Ultra Trail Run (2)
organizer: Mikulovský Ultra Trail Run, z. s.
description: MUTRAverz je extrémní ultra trailový běh pořádaný v Krušných horách, konkrétně v Mikulově a jeho okolí. Tento závod je určen pro zkušené běžce, kteří hledají náročnou trať v krásné přírodě s turisticky značenými trasami. Pořadatelé kladou důraz na bezpečnost, fair-play a kvalitní organizační zázemí. Závod je vhodný pro běžce starší 18 let, kteří jsou fyzicky i psychicky připraveni na extrémní podmínky. Těšíme se na vaši účast na dalším ročníku.

name: Rybský trhák
description: Rybský trhák je silniční běh pořádaný Atletickým klubem Emila Zátopka Kopřivnice ve spolupráci s obcí Rybí a TJ Sokol Rybí. Závod má délku 7 km s převýšením 135 metrů a je určen pro různé věkové kategorie mužů i žen. Startuje se na fotbalovém hřišti TJ Sokol Rybí a závodníci mohou využít zajištěné šatny a sprchy. V cíli je připraveno občerstvení a věcné ceny pro nejlepší běžce v kategoriích, včetně ceny pro nejstaršího účastníka a nejlepšího běžce z obce Rybí.

name: Běh pro Kleofáše
description: Běh pro Kleofáše je tradiční benefiční běh konaný v lázeňském parku v Třeboni, který podporuje místní hospic. Soutěžící si mohou vybrat z několika kategorií, od dětských krátkých běhů až po 12kilometrový běh kolem rybníka Svět. Pro méně zdatné běžce je připravena příjemná čtyřkilometrová trasa a také štafeta pro dva nebo čtyři běžce. Akce nabízí bohatý doprovodný program pro děti a je součástí Týdne pro hospic.

name: Malá cena Špindlerova Mlýna
location: Městský úřad Špindlerův Mlýn, Špindlerův Mlýn, Česko
description: Malá cena Špindlerova Mlýna je tradiční 34. ročník běhu do vrchu, který se koná v rámci českého poháru. Závod startuje u Městského úřadu ve Špindlerově Mlýně a nabízí náročnou trasu dlouhou 14 km s převýšením 901 metrů. Tento závod je ideální pro nadšence běhů do vrchu, kteří chtějí změřit síly v krásném horském prostředí Krkonoš.

name: Červený okruh
description: Červený okruh v Doksech je tradiční závod v rámci Okresní běžecké ligy Českolipsko. Závod nabízí běžcům možnost poměřit síly na zajímavé trati v přírodním prostředí Termitu v Doksech. Akce je součástí série regionálních běžeckých závodů a přitahuje širokou veřejnost i zkušené sportovce. Organizátoři zajišťují příjemnou atmosféru a kvalitní zázemí pro všechny účastníky.

name: Bašťanská šestka
description: Bašťanská šestka je tradiční běžecký závod konaný v malebném prostředí přehrady v Bašce, Moravskoslezském kraji. Závod pořádá Tělovýchovná jednota Slezan Frýdek-Místek, z.s., která se dlouhodobě věnuje atletice a podpoře sportovních aktivit v regionu. Akce je vhodná pro širokou veřejnost a nabízí příležitost pro sportovní vyžití v krásné přírodě. Přihlášení a účast jsou vítány jak od zkušených běžců, tak od rekreačních sportovců.

name: Svatováclavský běh - Tyreto RUN
description: Svatováclavský běh Tyreto RUN 2026 je charitativní běžecký závod, který se koná 10. října v Děčíně. Závod nabízí tratě pro muže, ženy i děti, včetně rodinného běhu, a podporuje pacienty s roztroušenou sklerózou prostřednictvím výtěžku ze startovného. Účastníci si mohou užít sportovní zážitek a zároveň pomoci dobré věci. Pro prvních deset registrovaných je připravena odměna ve formě slevy na nákup pneumatik u Tyreto.

name: BKK Walking am Baldeneysee mit Mini-Marathon
description: BKK Walking at Baldeneysee is part of the Westenergie Marathon weekend in Essen and offers a varied programme for walkers, Nordic walkers and runners. The main marathon takes runners twice around Baldeneysee, with an additional turnaround loop, and features a flat course and fast cycle paths. The marathon has been held annually since 1963, making it Germany’s oldest event of its kind. The event is organised by TUSEM Essen’s athletics department with the support of numerous volunteers. The number of participants is capped at 3,000 to avoid bottlenecks on the course.
course_highlights: Flat course around Baldeneysee
Two laps, with an additional turnaround loop on the first lap
Fast cycle paths and early autumn weather
additional: The walking programme offers distances of up to 14 km. The event takes place annually on the second Sunday in October. Distances: 1.1 km, 7 km, 42.2 km; participant numbers are capped at 3,000; October weather is around 14°C and cloudy; registering with the organiser is recommended.

name: Coesfelder DJK - Citylauf
description: The 32nd Coesfeld City Run takes place in Coesfeld. The event is organized by DJK Eintracht Coesfeld e.V. and gives runners of all age groups the opportunity to take part in sport. The City Run combines recreational, competitive, health and rehabilitation sports and is an established event in the region. Online registration is available via the official website.
course_highlights: Measured, flat city courses through the historic town center
A variety of running distances for all age and performance groups
Attractive prizes, certificates and trophies for top runners and groups
additional: The organizer’s office is open Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 12:00 and 14:30 to 18:00. The office is closed on December 24 and 31 and on public holidays. The website refers to photos by photobello and provides entry lists for the individual races. Road/cross-country run, registration open, various running distances, start and finish in Coesfeld city center, age groups for children, recreational runners, club members and older participants

name: Damscheider Kuckucks-Trail
price_range: Early-Kuckuck 14,00 Euro, Kuckuckspreis 18,00 Euro (9,5 km); Early-Kuckuck 21,00 Euro, Kuckuckspreis 25,00 Euro (21 km)
description: The Damscheider Kuckucks-Trail offers a varied trail-running experience across three distances in the picturesque landscape of the Rhine Heights near Damscheid. The 21 km Extended course runs through Damscheid Forest, across natural meadows and vineyards, and along the Schwede-Bure-Weg down to the valley at Oberwesel and back, with around 700 metres of elevation gain. The 9.5 km Best of Trails course offers a classic trail feel with changing terrain and 240 metres of elevation gain. Children can take part in an approximately 1 km Kidsrun around the sports ground. The event combines a sporting challenge with enjoyment of nature and a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 21 km Extended with around 700 metres of elevation gain through forest, meadows, vineyards and the valley
9.5 km Best of Trails with changing terrain and 240 metres of elevation gain
Kidsrun of approximately 1 km at the edge of the forest and around the sports ground, designed for children and focused on fun
additional: Race number collection from 11:00 at Damscheid sports ground. Personalised race numbers with transponders for timing in the main races. Aid stations on the courses, drinks at the start and finish, and a grill stand and cakes at the sports ground. Showers and changing rooms available on site. Dogs are not permitted during the competition.

name: Lindenseelaufserie
description: The Lindenseelaufserie is a long-standing running event in Rüsselsheim at the Lindensee, held annually. It gives runners of different ages and ability levels the opportunity to run on varied routes around the lake. The series is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and well-organized event. Participants can look forward to a scenic course and a friendly running community.
course_highlights: Running routes around the Lindensee in Rüsselsheim
Varied routes for different age and ability levels
Scenic and well-marked running paths
additional: Races in November and January; no series ranking for the 5 km race; start and finish area moved to a field path; moderate entry fees; awards for top finishers and age groups

name: Loßburger Waldlauf
description: The Loßburg Forest Run is a traditional autumn forest race in Loßburg, Germany, organized by the Loßburg Ski Club. The event is being held for the 30th time and offers runners a varied course on roads and forest trails, with no laps on a track. There are several distances, including a 400 m race for children and teenagers and a challenging 10 km race for adults with a hilly profile. The races start in the evening, with the 10 km race beginning at 19:00.
course_highlights: Forest and road race in October
Hilly profile on the 10 km course
Children’s and teenagers’ races over 400 m
additional: The 10 km race starts at 19:00, while the shorter 6.7 km race begins earlier in the evening. The event takes place at the school center in Loßburg. Typical October weather is around 14 °C, with mostly cloudy skies and an average of 40 mm of precipitation. The event also includes races for children and teenagers over various distances, including a 400 m race for the youngest participants.

name: Muswiesenlauf
description: The Muswiesenlauf is a traditional fun run in Hohenlohe, celebrating its 41st edition. It is the oldest fun run in the region and offers various distances for children, young people and adults. The courses are officially measured and follow varied routes along paved agricultural roads and gravel forest paths. Every participant receives a certificate, and children also receive bumper-car tokens. The event is part of the historic Muswiese festival, which has been held annually since 1434.
course_highlights: Officially measured courses of 500 m, 1 km, 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km
Varied routes on paved roads and gravel forest paths
The race is part of the traditional Muswiesenfest in Hohenlohe
additional: Late entries are possible on race day up to 45 minutes before the respective start. Changing rooms and showers are available at the multi-purpose hall "Forum", 2 km away; basic changing facilities without showers are available in the start area. The awards ceremony takes place in the Muswiesenhalle on the festival grounds. Parking is available around the festival grounds and the start/finish area; heavy traffic may cause congestion. Races over 500 m, 1,000 m, 2,500 m, 5,000 m and 10,000 m; online registration until one day before the race; late entries possible on race day; race-number distribution at Stadel Hofburk.

name: Wadersloher Volkslauf
description: The Wadersloh Volkslauf is a long-standing running event in Wadersloh, welcoming runners of all ages and ability levels. Officially measured 5 km and 10 km courses are available and are eligible for rankings until 2029. There are also shorter races for children and walking routes. The event takes place at the Sportpark on Winkelstraße and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with a start-number deposit and timekeeping.
course_highlights: The 5 km and 10 km courses are officially measured and eligible for rankings until 31.12.2029
600 m Bambini run and 1000 m schoolchildren’s race on the synthetic track at the Sportpark
7.5 km walking and Nordic walking route available
additional: A start-number deposit of 2.00 EUR is collected by SEPA direct debit when registering online and refunded in cash on the event day when the start number with chip is returned. The 5 km and 10 km races are officially measured and have DLV approval until 2029. Photos and videos are taken and published as part of the event. Measured courses, online registration, start numbers with chips, sponsors

name: Lichterlauf in Steckenborn
description: The Steckenborn Lichterlauf is an atmospheric night race in Simmerath-Steckenborn. The 10 km course follows a 2 km loop, run five times, illuminated after dark with floodlights, lanterns, candles, and torches. Spectators and festively decorated sections of the course create a special atmosphere. In addition to the individual race, there are youth relays for teams of two.
course_highlights: Illuminated course with floodlights, lanterns, candles, and torches
Two-kilometer loop, run five times for the 10 km race
Spectators and decorated sections of the course provide spirited support
additional: The race takes place at the sports field in Steckenborn.

name: Vorlauf zum Harz-Gebirgslauf
description: The Harz Mountain Run warm-up is a free test run held one week before the main race. It gives runners the opportunity to check their fitness and get to know the Harz Mountain Run courses. The event starts together at 9:30 a.m. in Himmelpforte, Wernigerode, and offers distances of 2 km, 5 km, 11 km, and 22 km. At the finish, participants are welcomed with tea and bread with lard. No registration is required, but the courses are not yet marked.

name: 25. Volkslauf um den Altwarmbüchener See
description: The Volkslauf around Lake Altwarmbüchen is a popular running event in the Hanover region and is part of the Sparkassen-Laufpass. Participants can enjoy the beautiful natural surroundings of Lake Altwarmbüchen while collecting stamps for their running pass. The event is aimed at recreational runners and offers a great opportunity to explore the region on foot and stay active.
course_highlights: Run around Lake Altwarmbüchen
Nature-rich route in the Hanover region
Part of Germany’s largest running series, with a wide range of running events
additional: Participation is part of the Sparkassen-Laufpass of the Hanover region, with both digital and traditional running passes. An app includes an event calendar and a digital running diary. Successful participation is rewarded with a stamp, with Gold, Silver or Bronze rewards for frequent runners.

name: Abt-Degen-Lauf
description: The Abt-Degen Run organized by TV 1884 Zeil is a long-standing running event being held for the 30th time. Various distances are offered, including an 11 km main race, student races over 1600 m and 800 m, and a Bambini race. The event offers a well-organized course with timing, race bib collection, showers and changing rooms, as well as refreshments and an awards ceremony. The race welcomes runners of all ages and promotes a sense of sporting community in Zeil am Main.

name: Brakelsieker Volkslauf "Am Fuße des Mörths"
description: The Brakelsiek fun run “At the Foot of the Mörth” is a classic local running, walking, and Nordic walking event in Schieder-Schwalenberg, held on a Saturday afternoon in October. Various distances are offered for adults and young people, including 5 km, 9 km, and 15 km runs, as well as 5 km and 9 km walking and Nordic walking. The start and finish are at the Brakelsiek sports field, and the route runs around the village sports field, with a gently rolling rural profile at the foot of the Mörth. The event offers a lovely opportunity to enjoy the autumn landscape in a relaxed atmosphere.

name: Herbstlauf
description: The 2026 Autumn Run takes place on October 10 at the Waldstadion Schutterwald. The course covers 10 kilometers of flat forest and field paths, measured and marked in accordance with DLV specifications. The event is open to runners of all age groups and offers an appealing running opportunity in a natural setting. Registration is online via my.raceresult.com, and the organizer is happy to answer questions by email.

name: IKK Südwest Freundschaftslauf
description: The IKK Südwest Friendship Run is a traditional one-hour run in Marpingen, offering various running distances as well as walking and Nordic walking routes. The event is not a competition; it focuses on community and the joy of running. Routes range from 5.5 km to 11 km, as well as hiking routes with no timekeeping. The run is organized by the Saarland Athletics Association and takes place.

name: Kuppinger Mondfängerlauf
description: The Kuppingen Mooncatcher Run is a special run into the night that has replaced the well-known Zigeunerberglauf since 2009. It features illuminated sections of the course that create a unique running atmosphere. As the sixth and final race in the Schönbuch Cup series, it traditionally takes place on the second Saturday in October. The event is firmly rooted in the region and appeals to runners who appreciate a special atmosphere while running.

name: Parforceheide Crosslauf
description: The Parforceheide Cross-Country Run has been organized by RSV Eintracht 1949 in Stahnsdorf since 2008, giving recreational runners in the region the opportunity to discover the varied landscape of the Parforceheide. The course starts at the sports ground on Heinrich-Zille-Straße and passes the Südwestfriedhof cemetery, continuing through woods and natural surroundings with small climbs, sandy sections, and stretches of asphalt and cobblestones. Races are offered over 1 km (Bambini), 3 km (schoolchildren), 5 km, and 10 km for young people and adults. After the run, the organizer provides food and refreshments, and football matches are often held at the sports ground, making for a lovely day of sport for participants and their companions.

name: Pegnitztallauf 2026
description: The Pegnitztallauf is an afternoon event in Vorra, Germany, featuring a flat, single-lap course with no repeated laps. Events include 5 km races for adults and youth, a 10 km race for adults, and 5 km Nordic walking for adults. Children’s and youth races round out the program, making this a local, club-oriented running event. The finish is at the tennis facility in 91247 Vorra, and the start is at 3:00 p.m.

name: Ramsthaler Wein-Berg-Lauf
description: The Ramsthal Wine Mountain Run is a traditional running event held annually in Ramsthal. It offers various races for all age groups, from Bambini to schoolchildren, teenagers, and adults. The routes pass through Ramsthal’s picturesque vineyards and offer varied scenery. In addition to the running events, there is also a walking route that lets participants enjoy the beautiful surroundings.

name: Solvay Lauf
description: The Solvay Run Bernburg is a 5 km race in Bernburg, Saxony-Anhalt. The race starts at Krumbholzallee 8 at 10:00 a.m. Part of the Solvay Cup, it combines cross-country and road running, so it is not an easy, flat city course. It is aimed primarily at local clubs and usually attracts 100 to 300 runners. The event offers professional timing, online results, certificates, showers, changing rooms, parking, free bag drop and refreshments at the finish.

name: Volkslauf mit Walking um den AWB See
description: The 25th Volkslauf with Walking around AWB Lake is a local running and walking event in Altwarmbüchen, a district of Isernhagen. The event offers short, flat distances around Altwarmbüchener See, with one lap measuring approximately 3.66 km. There are various running and walking routes for adults, as well as races for children and young people, making it a community running experience for the whole region. The start and finish are at Seestraße 23, and the races take place in the afternoon.

name: II Korczyński Półmaraton Górski XI Korczyński Bieg i Nordic Walking "Do Prządek"
description: The 2nd Korczyna Mountain Half Marathon and the 11th Korczyna “Do Prządek” Run and Nordic Walking event take place in the scenic surroundings of the Czarnorzecko-Strzyżowski Landscape Park. Participants can choose between running distances of 21 km and 6 km, or a Nordic Walking route, putting their fitness and endurance to the test amid beautiful scenery. The event promotes an active lifestyle and the region’s natural attractions, bringing together the local community and sports enthusiasts. It is organized by the Municipal Cultural Centre in Korczyna, with the involvement of numerous partners and sponsors.
course_highlights: Routes pass through the Czarnorzecko-Strzyżowski Landscape Park
Available distances: mountain half marathon (21 km) and 6 km run
Scenic landscapes and the region’s natural attractions
additional: The event is organized by the Municipal Cultural Centre in Korczyna. Around 120 people take part. Medals and prizes are presented by representatives of local government and partner organizations. Cooperation with volunteer fire brigades and volunteers supports the event. Partners include the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Krosno, Kołaczyce Forest District and local schools.

name: 30 Bieg Przełajowy o Nóż Komandosa
location: Stadion Miejski w Lublińcu, Lubliniec, Poland
description: The “O Nóż Komandosa” Cross-Country Race is an annual running event held in Lubliniec, attracting numerous military, police, and sports teams. The race is a cross-country event on a challenging course. Its tradition spans many years, as reflected in the high turnout and participants’ commitment. The race is held under the honorary patronage of Bishop Wiesław Lechowicz, the Military Ordinary of Poland, underscoring its standing and significance. The event also has a charitable and community-building dimension, and reports and photos from previous editions are available online.
course_highlights: Cross-country course with varied terrain
High turnout and participation by military and police teams
Honorary patronage of Bishop Wiesław Lechowicz, the Military Ordinary of Poland
additional: Results and reports from previous editions are available online. Numerous military and police teams take part in the race. The event has a charitable and community-building character.

name: 2 Maraton od Źródeł do Ujścia Grabiszynki
Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz

tiers.description: Opłata za pojedynczy bieg uiszczona najpóźniej do środy poprzedzającej start

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Karnet na cały cykl w jednym mieście (4 imprezy) można wykupić najpóźniej do środy przed drugim biegiem

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in seven locations, including Warsaw’s Młociński Park. The races are recreational and sporting events that promote physical activity outdoors and a healthy lifestyle. The series includes four races in each location, and participants can compete in local and overall standings. Races take place during the season from October to April, with the main race starting at 11:00.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through forests or urban parks
A race in the natural surroundings of Młociński Park in Warsaw
A series of four races per season in each location
additional: The race office opens at 8:30, and race bibs and chips are collected on race day. The entry fee on race day is PLN 60. A season pass also allows one free start in a city other than the main location, provided the participant applies by email in advance. Participants must be at least 16 years old; younger participants (born 2008–2010) may take part with parental consent. The race schedule is fixed and also includes CITY TRAIL Junior races for children. The Warsaw races for the 2026/2027 season are scheduled for October 10, November 21, January 16, and March 20; the start is at 11:00.

LIII Maraton Pieszy w Puszczy Kampinoskiej
VIII Półmaraton Lasy nad Utratą

location: Zębowice, Opole County, Opole Voivodeship, Poland

XIV ultraMaraton Bieszczadzki

name: Javornícka stovka
description: The Javornícka Stovka is a mountain ultramarathon and long-distance hike held in the Javorníky Mountains. Runners cross challenging mountain terrain with several checkpoints and time limits. The event is intended for experienced runners seeking a challenge in beautiful natural surroundings. The start and registration are in Čadca, and the finish is in Lysá pod Makytou. The organizers emphasize safety, mandatory equipment, and medical assistance along the entire route.

name: GARMIN Beh Súľovskými skalami
organizer: SCK CYKLO TOUR Súľov - Hradná a MTBIKER community
description: The GARMIN Run Through the Súľov Rocks is a traditional running race set in the beautiful surroundings of the Súľov Rocks, offering three courses of varying lengths and difficulty. Runners pass through picturesque countryside with views of rock formations and ridge trails, and the courses include refreshment stations. The event is suitable for the general public, including children, who have their own categories and starts. It is organized by the Slovak Cycling Club CYKLO TOUR Súľov - Hradná, which provides thorough preparation and services for participants.

name: Spoznaj Trebišov behom – Night RUN
location: Námestie pod OD Billa, Trebišov, Slovakia
description: Discover Trebišov by Running – Night RUN is a night race in the centre of Trebišov, offering a unique experience of running under the stars. The event is part of the Discover Trebišov by Running series and is organised by Majcher-Production s.r.o. Runners can look forward to a pleasant atmosphere, an urban course and the chance to discover the beauty of Trebišov in a different way than during the day. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle.
course_highlights: Night race in the centre of Trebišov
Urban course with an atmosphere under the stars
A chance to discover Trebišov from a different perspective

name: Grand Prix – Cabaj-Čápor
location: Cabaj-Čápor, Cabaj-Čápor, neďaleko penziónu Salaš Cabaj, Čáporský les
description: Grand Prix Cabaj-Čápor is a traditional cross-country race in beautiful natural surroundings, held in the village of Cabaj-Čápor, starting near Salaš Cabaj. Runners can choose from several distances, including 10 km, 3 km, and children’s races over 600 m and 1,000 m. The event is ideal for anyone who wants to enjoy the atmosphere of sport outdoors, whether for competition or simply for the joy of movement. Registration is open and participant numbers are limited, so it is best to sign up early.

name: Jesenný beh Michalovčanov
organizer: Mesto Michalovce a Atletický klub Michalovce
description: The Autumn Run of Michalovce Residents is a traditional running race in Michalovce, offering an opportunity for competitors of different age categories. The race takes place at the grounds of 2nd Primary School at J. Švermu 6 and consists of a 400-metre children’s run and a 3-kilometre main race. The event is suitable for families and runners who want to enjoy the autumn atmosphere and take part in sporting activities in pleasant surroundings. The organizers provide refreshments and commemorative items for participants.

name: Beh Myšľou
location: Nižná Myšľa, Nižná Myšľa, Archeoskanzen Nižná Myšľa
description: The Beh Vyšnou Myšľou is a running event organized by the Running Club of the Municipality of Vyšná Myšľa and the Municipality of Vyšná Myšľa. The races take place at the football pitch in the municipality of Vyšná Myšľa, in the Košice-okolie District. The children’s categories start at 14:00 and the adult categories at 16:00. Men and women can compete in various age categories, including a two-person relay over 2 × 3 km. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant atmosphere for running in the municipality.

name: Beh Neporazených
description: Beh neporazených is a charitable running event in Bratislava that supports prevention and assistance for people who have had a stroke. The race takes place at Dvořákovo námestie by River Park and offers courses for various age groups, including children’s races and a special run for stroke patients. Participants can run the 5 km or 10 km course, and the event emphasizes its community and awareness-raising purpose. Proceeds from entry fees go to the Porážka.sk civic association to support patients and their rehabilitation.
course_highlights: Courses run along the Danube embankment in central Bratislava
Children’s races of 100 m, 300 m and 600 m, depending on age
Start and finish at Dvořákovo námestie by River Park
additional: The event has a capacity of 600 participants. Check-in and race number collection for children’s races and stroke patients is from 07:30 to 08:45; for the 5 km and 10 km races, it is from 07:30 to 09:30. Race numbers are non-transferable, and entry fees are non-refundable. Participants can order the official event T-shirt at a discounted price during registration. Proceeds from entry fees, after bank and service fees are deducted, are allocated to the operation of the Porážka.sk civic association.

name: Rozhanovská dvanástka
location: Rozhanovce, Košice-okolie District, Košice Region, Slovakia

name: Borský kros
description: Borský kros je tradiční běžecký závod pořádaný Borským klubem lyžařů Machov v malebném běžeckém areálu Doleček v Královéhradeckém kraji. Trať nabízí různé obtížnosti, od mírných táhlých stoupání vhodných pro rodiny s dětmi až po náročné členité a strmé profily pro zkušené běžce. Závod je součástí pestré sportovní činnosti klubu a koná se v krásném přírodním prostředí s kvalitním zázemím. Pořadatelé se starají o příjemnou atmosféru a kvalitní sportovní zážitek pro všechny účastníky.

name: Podzimní přespolní běh - Memoriál Jiřího Bláhy
description: Podzimní přespolní běh - Memoriál Jiřího Bláhy je tradiční závod pořádaný od roku 1986, letos se koná již 39. ročník. Závod se běží v areálu koupaliště v Novém Městě na Moravě, kde se prezentace začíná od 8:30. Nejdelší trať měří přibližně 6 km pro muže, ženy běží 2 km, a tratě pro mládež jsou od 300 m do 1500 m. Běží se na travnatém povrchu, vhodné jsou tretry. Starty kategorií jsou postupné, aby všichni stihli nedělní oběd, a vyhlašování výsledků probíhá krátce po doběhu poslední mužské kategorie.

name: Lesní běh Říčany XCR
description: Lesní běh Říčany XCR je oblíbený lesní závod konající se v Říčanech, který nabízí tratě vhodné pro všechny věkové kategorie od dětí po veterány. Závod se koná v krásném přírodním prostředí Středočeského kraje a zahrnuje různé délky tratí, včetně 11 km a 5,7 km pro dospělé, s náročnými lesními cestami a prudkými stoupáními. Akce je určena nejen pro sportovní nadšence, ale i pro rodiny s dětmi, které si mohou užít běh na kratších trasách přizpůsobených věku závodníků. Organizátor Bežecký klub Říčany zve všechny k aktivnímu pobytu v přírodě a k účasti na této tradiční akci.

name: Běh na Strandu
description: Běh na Strandu je specifický běžecký závod do vrchu konaný na Stránské skále v Brně-Slatině. Závodníci startují jednotlivě s minutovým intervalem, což umožňuje soustředěný výkon na trati dlouhé 450 metrů s převýšením 47 metrů. Trať vede po kamenité a travnaté cestě a závod je rozdělen do několika věkových kategorií od mladších žáků až po veterány. Po doběhu je nutné vrátit startovní číslo a vyhlášení výsledků probíhá po doběhu posledního závodníka. Registrace probíhá v den závodu od 9:00 do 10:00, start je v 10:01.

name: Hrabenovský kros
description: Hrabenovský kros je lesní krosový závod na 7,47 km s převýšením 200 metrů, který se koná v malebném prostředí Hrabenova u Šumperka. Závod je součástí seriálu Chlapácký běh, který nabízí náročné krosové tratě v okolí Šumperka. Tento závod je vhodný pro běžce, kteří hledají výzvu v přírodním terénu s výrazným převýšením. Trasa vede lesem a nabízí krásné přírodní scenérie a technicky zajímavý terén.

name: Slavkovský lesík
description: Přespolní běh Slavkovský lesík je tradiční závod pořádaný TJ Opava, který se koná v malebném lesním prostředí u Slavkova u Opavy. Závod nabízí běžcům možnost užít si běh v přírodě s různorodým terénem a atmosférou sportovní pohody. Start i prezentace probíhají u fotbalového hřiště TJ Sokol Slavkov, přičemž start je tradičně v 10 hodin. Pořadatelé zvou všechny běžce k účasti a slibují příjemný sportovní zážitek.

name: Rozběháme (i) Klenčí
location: Klenčí pod Čerchovem, Plzeňský kraj, Česko
description: Rozběháme Klenčí je tradiční běžecký závod v malebném prostředí Klenčí pod Čerchovem v Plzeňském kraji. Závod nabízí příležitost pro běžce všech věkových kategorií a úrovní, kteří si mohou užít sportovní atmosféru a krásnou přírodu regionu. Výsledky a pořadí jsou pečlivě sledovány a závod je součástí širšího seriálu Běžec Chodska. Pořadatelé vítají všechny běžce k účasti a zajišťují kvalitní organizační zázemí.

name: Z Dobřichovic na Šraňk
description: Z Dobřichovic na Šraňk je závod do vrchu dlouhý 3,7 km s převýšením 280 metrů, který je součástí seriálu Běhy do kopců v Praze a okolí. Tento běh nabízí náročnou trať s výrazným stoupáním, ideální pro milovníky horského běhu a výzev v přírodě. Závod se koná v malebném prostředí Dobřichovic a je vhodný pro běžce, kteří chtějí otestovat svou vytrvalost a sílu v kopcovitém terénu. Přijďte si užít atmosféru závodu a překonat sami sebe na této tradiční akci.

name: Büdelsdorfer Eiderlauf
description: The Büdelsdorf Eiderlauf is a traditional autumn race in Büdelsdorf, Schleswig-Holstein, organized by SG Athletico Büdelsdorf. It offers classic local road-race distances, including 5 km and 10 km, on flat, manageable courses that are ideal for recreational runners and beginners. The start and finish are often at Eiderstadion, giving the event a friendly, informal atmosphere. The race attracts children, young people, and local club runners, and is a fixture on the regional autumn running calendar.
course_highlights: Flat road-race distances
Start and finish at Eiderstadion
Family-friendly local club race
additional: The race takes place in typical October weather, with daytime temperatures around 14 °C and mostly cloudy skies. Distances range from 1.5 km to 11.1 km, including children's races. After a break during the COVID-19 pandemic, the format was adjusted to incorporate the start and finish in the stadium. Distances: 1.5 km, 5.3 km, 5.8 km, 10.9 km, 11.1 km; flat courses; autumn event; start and finish in the stadium; open to all age groups

name: Berglauf
location: Geislingen an der Steige, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The mountain race organized by Schneelaufverein Geislingen is a long-standing event held annually in Geislingen an der Steige. The course climbs uphill and offers runners a challenging test in a scenic setting. The event attracts both competitive and recreational runners and is known for its friendly atmosphere. Registration is through MY RACE RESULT, with the registration deadline falling shortly before the race.
course_highlights: Uphill course with a challenging elevation profile
Scenic setting in Geislingen an der Steige
Start and finish at the Skihütte SVG, Dorfstr. 70
additional: Registration and results are handled through MY RACE RESULT. The registration deadline is 12:00 noon on the Saturday before the race. The start and finish are at the Skihütte SVG in Geislingen an der Steige (Weiler o. H. district). Course and elevation profiles are available; registration is through Race Result; the venue is SVG, Dorfstr. 70, Geislingen an der Steige.

name: Citylauf Schwabach 2026
description: The RIBE Citylauf Schwabach offers a varied race program for all age groups and ability levels. Events include a half marathon, relay, main race, fun run, walking and children’s races. The races start and finish at Königsplatz in Schwabach, and participants can expect a well-organized event with a family-friendly atmosphere. The course runs through the city, offering a special running experience in Schwabach, the City of Gold Beaters.
course_highlights: Half-marathon course of approximately 21.1 km
Start and finish at Königsplatz, next to the town hall
A variety of race distances for children, young people and adults
additional: Late registrations are possible only on race weekend, subject to availability. Places are limited, and on-site registration is not possible for sold-out races. Participants in the main races must be at least 16 years old; the maximum time is 3 hours. Relay legs are approximately 7 km each. The start and finish are at Königsplatz, next to the town hall, and at Fürstenherberge, respectively. A variety of categories are available for different age groups and ability levels; refreshments are provided at several points along the course.

name: Geilenkirchener Volkslauf und 34. Halbmarathon
description: The Geilenkirchen Volkslauf and Half Marathon is a long-standing running event in Geilenkirchen-Gillrath, organized by DJK-Gillrath e. V. The event offers a flat 21.1 km half-marathon course as well as several other distances, including a 10 km run, 10 km walking and Nordic walking, a 4 km run, youth races and a Bambini run. All races finish at the Gillrath sports ground, where race materials are also distributed. The event caters to both recreational and competitive runners and is part of a five-year series ranking as well as the RAC ranking.
course_highlights: Flat, technically straightforward half-marathon course
4 km course is wheelchair-accessible
Events for people with disabilities in the 2.5 km and 4 km races
additional: Start and finish at the Gillrath sports ground; race-number pickup on site at the race office; the half marathon and 10 km run count toward the five-year series ranking and the RAC ranking; October weather is typically around 14 °C (daily high), with a low of 6 °C and mostly cloudy skies. Several events for adults and children/young people; accessible course sections; participation in series and RAC rankings; on-site registration at the Gillrath sports ground.

name: Salzachbrückenlauf
description: The Salzach Bridge Run starts and finishes at Burghausen town square, below Burghausen Castle, the longest castle complex in the world. The route follows the Salzach, which forms the border between Germany and Austria, and includes several border crossings. Various distances are offered, including a 505-metre parent-child run, a 3.2 km fun run, a 5.5 km walk and the 8.8 km main race. More than 1,000 participants take part each year, from children and recreational runners to club runners and fast athletes. The run is a charity event organised by nine volunteers, with proceeds supporting local people in need.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Burghausen town square below the castle
The route crosses the Salzach and the German-Austrian border
The 8.8 km route includes four border crossings and sections on gravel paths by the bathing lake
additional: The run takes place annually under the patronage of Bürgerinsel Burghausen. The 8.8 km route includes a second lap and passes a bathing lake and a rowing lake. Typical October weather is around 14 °C, with mostly cloudy skies and an average of 40 mm of precipitation. Multiple distances, including a 505 m route; charity event; scenic surroundings around Burghausen; open to children, recreational runners and competitive runners.

name: Thänhuser Schloss Erbhof-Lauf 2026
location: Schloss Erbhof, Kirchwiehe, Thedinghausen, Niedersachsen, Germany
description: The Thänhuser Schloss Erbhof-Lauf takes place in Kirchwiehe, directly opposite Schloss Erbhof in Thedinghausen, Lower Saxony. Organized by TSV Thedinghausen, this road race has welcomed children, teenagers, active adults and Masters since 2016. Distances on offer are 10 km, 5 km and an 800 m children’s race, which takes place in the Baumpark near the start and finish. The course is a measured, flat 5 km loop that is also suitable for Nordic walking.
course_highlights: Measured, flat 5 km loop
The 10 km course covers the loop twice
800 m children’s race in the Baumpark, right by Schloss Erbhof
additional: October weather is typically 14 °C, with lows around 6 °C and mostly cloudy skies. The children’s race, “Löwenlauf,” is designed especially for the youngest participants and takes place near the start and finish area. Start and finish in Kirchwiehe opposite Schloss Erbhof; children’s race in the Baumpark; October weather with temperatures around 14°C, lows of 6°C, 40 mm of precipitation and mostly cloudy skies.

name: Westenergie Marathon
description: The Westenergie Marathon in Essen is a traditional race around the picturesque Baldeneysee. In addition to the classic marathon, the event offers the Westenergie Seerunde, the AllbauTeamStaffel, a mini-marathon for children, and a Walking Day. The course is known for its scenic beauty and proximity to the lakeshore, making the race a special experience for runners of all ages. The event is very well organized and attracts numerous participants every year.
course_highlights: A run around the Baldeneysee with picturesque lakeside scenery
Start and finish at Seaside Beach in Essen
Sections with lake views and through the Heisinger Aue nature conservation area
additional: The start and finish are at Seaside Beach on the Baldeneysee. Late registration on the event day is paperless and uses a QR code. Children can take part in a 1.1 km mini-marathon, with a prize and medals for all participants. Photobello offers race photos. The Walking Day routes include various distances with beautiful lake views and also pass through the Heisinger Aue nature conservation area. The marathon is Germany’s oldest continuously held marathon, with a flat, fast course, several race disciplines, and support for the region. Results and certificates are available online.

name: Stadtwerke Lübeck Marathon
price_range: 45 € bis 85 € je nach Disziplin und Anmeldezeitraum
description: The Stadtwerke Lübeck Marathon offers runners a diverse range of distances in the historic Hanseatic city of Lübeck. In addition to the classic marathon, the event includes a duo marathon, half marathon, relay race and other shorter races suitable for all ages and ability levels. The course winds through the picturesque city and offers a sporting challenge with regional championship scoring. The event is approved by the German Athletics Association and emphasizes community and a passion for sport.
course_highlights: Marathon with Schleswig-Holstein state championship scoring
Duo marathon relay point in Travemünde on the Baltic Sea
Course through the historic Hanseatic city of Lübeck
additional: A preferred bib number can be selected free of charge during the early registration phases, subject to availability. Relay race with 10 x 4.2 km. Handbike half marathon on the same course as the runners’ half marathon. Duo marathon relay point in Travemünde on the Baltic Sea.

name: Filderstadt-Halbmarathon
