description: The Filderstadt Half Marathon takes place annually in Filderstadt-Bernhausen and offers an officially measured half-marathon course, a 10 km race, a students’ and toddlers’ race, and a team relay. The event attracts many runners and is known for its friendly atmosphere and well-organized facilities, including refreshment stations and medical support. The course is eligible for rankings and is supported by experienced pacers. Race-pack collection takes place on event day at the Bürgerzentrum Bernhausen.
course_highlights: Officially measured half-marathon and 10 km courses
Refreshment stations approximately every 4 km with drinks and bananas
Team relay with five runners; exchange zone in the start/finish area
additional: Late entries are possible at the Bürgerzentrum Bernhausen up to 30 minutes before the start. The late-entry fee is €5 for individual entries and teams. Timing uses chips integrated into the bib numbers (RaceResult passive system). Award ceremonies take place at the Bürgerzentrum (10 km at 11:20 a.m., half marathon at 12:30 p.m.). Medical care is provided by the DRK Filderstadt, with emergency physicians. Event held in September, with several race distances; ideal for recreational runners and families, close to Stuttgart Airport.

name: Berliner Morgenpost Great 10K
description: The Berliner Morgenpost Great 10K is Berlin’s fastest 10-km race, starting in front of Charlottenburg Palace. The course runs through Berlin Zoo and offers a unique running experience in the capital. In addition to the classic 10-kilometer course, there is also a 2 x 5 km relay and a 4.2 km short course from the zoo to Charlottenburg Palace. The event is suitable for all abilities and age groups and offers a large running festival for the whole family.

name: 19. Burger-Rolandlauf
description: The Burger Rolandlauf is a traditional race that normally takes place in Burg and is jointly organized by Rolandgymnasium Burg and LG Ihleläufer Burg. The course runs through the town along the Ihle, through the forest and past the Bismarckturm, finishing in the school courtyard. Alongside the sporting competition, participants can enjoy a varied supporting program with music, activities for children and refreshments. The 2026 event in Burg was cancelled due to a lack of permits; instead, a replacement event will take place in Tangerhütte City Park.

name: Frühstückslauf
description: The breakfast run in Wernigerode is a group run without timekeeping, leading from the market square up to Wernigerode Castle. The route is about 3 kilometers long, with an elevation gain of 100 meters. The run takes place as a group and is free of charge. A light snack is served afterward, making it a sociable event.

name: H/21 Halbmarathon
description: The H/21 Hannover Half Marathon is a new running event on the national events calendar, combining urban flair, modern beats and green sections of the course. The start and finish are in the heart of Hannover, and the route passes notable hotspots throughout the state capital. The event takes place in autumn and offers a special running experience in a vibrant urban setting. Join the prologue as Hannover begins a new chapter in running history.

name: München Marathon
description: The Munich Marathon offers a varied running experience in the Bavarian capital, with the marathon, half marathon, 10 km run, and marathon relay. The marathon course passes through Olympiapark, Leopoldstraße, the English Garden, and Munich city center, and finishes in Olympiapark. The half-marathon course starts in the English Garden and also finishes in Olympiapark. The marathon relay lets teams cover the 42.195 km together, with handovers at designated kilometer markers. Due to renovation work, the finish is at Hans-Jochen-Vogel-Platz next to the Olympiahalle.

name: Bad Hersfelder Lollslauf
description: The Bad Hersfeld Lollslauf is a traditional running event held annually in Bad Hersfeld, attracting runners of all ages and ability levels. With distances ranging from the Bambini Run to the 10 km individual race, the Lollslauf offers a sporting challenge in beautiful surroundings. Alongside competition, the event also emphasizes community and the joy of running. It is a regular fixture on the running calendar and draws participants from across Germany.

name: Hotfoot Run Bad Hönningen
description: The Hotfoot Run Bad Hönningen is an exciting obstacle race with distances from 7 to 26 kilometers, suitable for all fitness levels. The route passes through the picturesque spa town of Bad Hönningen on the Rhine, by vineyards and historic buildings, and features varied terrain with plenty of elevation gain. In addition to a sporting challenge, participants can expect spectacular obstacles, mud, water slides, and a unique atmosphere with a spectacular opening show. The race is ideal for solo runners, teams, and families looking to enjoy fun and adventure together.

name: Int. Schwarzwald-Marathon
description: The Black Forest Marathon in Bräunlingen is a traditional race held annually since 1968 and known as the world’s oldest nature and women’s marathon. The course runs mainly along well-maintained forest paths, offering a varied natural experience with a gentle climb through kilometer 21 followed by a slight descent. In addition to the classic marathon, events include a marathon relay, half marathon, 10 km races, Nordic walking, and other races for different age groups. The event is ideal for runners looking to combine nature with an athletic challenge.

name: Klosterlauf Aurachtal
description: The Klosterlauf Aurachtal is a running event starting and finishing near Münchaurach Abbey Church. All routes are marked with kilometer signs and run mainly on paved and gravel paths. Various events are offered, including a 10 km main race, a fun run, youth races, Nordic walking, and children’s and Bambini races. The event is open to all healthy people who are sufficiently trained; club membership is not required.

name: Porta Volkslauf
description: The Porta Volkslauf is a long-standing running event in Porta Westfalica and has been part of the regional Mühlenkreisserie for more than three decades. The event attracts runners of all ages, from competitive athletes to recreational runners. The route runs around the Nammer sports ground and through the Nammer Unterholz nature reserve, offering varied, flat sections and a magnificent panorama of the Porta. The friendly atmosphere along the route makes the race a special community experience.
course_highlights: Route along roads and farm tracks around the Nammer sports ground
Paved paths in the Nammer Unterholz nature reserve
Magnificent panorama of the Porta, with flat and varied sections
additional: The race is part of the Mühlenkreisserie and takes place at the local sports facility in Nammen (Poggenbeeke). Course maps for the short distance (5,500 m), medium distance (8,800 m) and long distance (17,000 m) are available as PDFs. Parking is designated around the sports facility; parking in driveways or along farm tracks is not recommended.

name: Sebastian Fredrich Gedenklauf (LM/LC/NLC)
description: The Sebastian Fredrich Memorial Run is a long-standing running event in Lubmin, organized by the triathlon and running group of HSG Uni Greifswald. The event offers a sporting challenge in a friendly, well-organized atmosphere, supported by many volunteers. The route passes through scenic sections and is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational athletes. The event is part of an active running and triathlon community in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania.

name: Storkower See Lauf
description: The Storkower See Run is a traditional running event organized by Triathlonverein Fürstenwalde 1990 e.V. and approved by the Brandenburg Athletics Association. Runners of different age groups and ability levels can take part on various distances around Lake Storkow. The event offers a fair competitive atmosphere and is open to running enthusiasts of all ages. Online registration opens in January, and participants are included in an official participant list.

name: Trochtelfinger Nordic Walking Stöckles-Cup

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Für Gruppenanmeldungen von 10 Personen (zahlend, 13 Jahre und älter) und mehr gilt der ermäßigte Tarif von 11,- €

description: The Trochtelfingen Nordic Walking Stöckles-Cup is a popular nature run on the Swabian Alb, held annually in Trochtelfingen on the second weekend in October. The event offers two marked routes of approximately 9 km and 13.5 km through the gentle hills of the Sonnenalb. Participants enjoy a friendly atmosphere with no age or category rankings, where everyone is celebrated as a winner. A raffle with high-quality prizes provides additional entertainment alongside the sporting challenge.
course_highlights: Two routes: an approximately 9 km short route and an approximately 13.5 km long route
Gentle hills of the Sonnenalb with an extensive network of trails
Water station along the route and marked trails
additional: Race number distribution from 08:30 at Tommis Sportshop. Start window for the 13 km loop until 10:30. Finish closes at 13:00; no timing after that. Participants receive chip timing and an online certificate. Raffle with valuable prizes from 13:15. Refreshments including a standing snack bar, coffee, and cake from 10:00, provided by TSV Trochtelfingen.

name: Wendlandmarathon
description: The Wendlandmarathon Kolborn is a traditional road race in Lüchow, Lower Saxony, held since 1993. The event offers a wide range of distances, from the marathon and half marathon to short children’s races, appealing to both long-distance runners and families. The course is measured to AIMS/IAAF standards and has kilometre markers and aid stations. Practical facilities for participants include parking, showers, changing rooms and certificates, as well as finisher medals for children.

name: Wzgórzowa Trzynastka
description: Wzgórzowa Trzynastka is a 13 km trail race held in the scenic area around Chrząszczyce. The course follows local roads and crosses a military training area between Chrząszczyce, Domecko, Opole-Winów and Górki. The event promotes a healthy, active lifestyle and running as a form of recreation. Alongside the individual race, it also features relay races, a uniformed services category and a family team orienteering challenge. The start and race office are in Chrząszczyce, and the participant limit is 300.

name: 12. PKO Cracovia Półmaraton Królewski
description: The 12th PKO Cracovia Royal Half Marathon is a prestigious half marathon held in historic Kraków, combining sporting competition with the unique atmosphere of a city with a thousand-year tradition. The certified 21.0975 km course runs through Kraków’s picturesque streets, with the finish line inside the impressive TAURON Arena Kraków, making for an unforgettable finish. The race is part of the Royal Running Triad and the Polish Half Marathon Crown, attracting thousands of participants from around the world. The event is known for its high participation and international character, as well as record-breaking performances by runners from Africa and Poland.
course_highlights: Certified 21.0975 km course
Finish line in Poland’s largest indoor sports and entertainment arena, TAURON Arena Kraków
Kilometre markers and water stations along the course (around the 4th and 13th km)
additional: The Race Office and Expo will be open on 9–10 October and on race day, 11 October, until 9:00. Starts are assigned by declared finish time. The time limit for completing the course is 3 hours. It will not be possible to join the race after the start gate has closed.

name: Dobromiejski Festiwal Biegów i Nordic Wa...
location: Swobodna, Gmina Dobre Miasto, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Piwna Mila
location: Wąsowo, Kuślin, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Beer Mile is a unique race over a flexible distance of 1,700 to 2,000 metres and the main event on the third day of the Sun Festival in Wąsowo. Participants start immediately after drinking a beer, and beer stations are placed along the course approximately every 500 metres. Runners must drink the beer at each station. This sporting celebration brings together runners, spectators and families, offering a one-of-a-kind atmosphere and a special finisher’s medal.
course_highlights: Flexible distance of 1,700 to 2,000 metres
Beer stations approximately every 500 metres
The race starts after runners drink their first beer
additional: 9:30–10:30. The race bib must be pinned to the front of your clothing and must not be altered. You can order a T-shirt when paying for your race bib in the Runner’s Panel. Photos from the event will be available after the race.

name: UltraKotlina
description: UltraKotlina is a series of mountain ultramarathons held in the Jelenia Góra Valley and surrounding areas. The races offer a variety of distances from 15 km to 144 km, along scenic trails and through the wilderness of the Western Sudetes. The courses feature significant elevation gain and challenging terrain, with the finish in Szklarska Poręba. Organizers provide bus transport to the start lines and a rich programme of accompanying events, including talks and workshops. UltraKotlina is an excellent opportunity to combine extreme running with mountain tourism and to bring the running community together.
course_highlights: Courses pass through the main mountain ranges of the Jelenia Góra Valley
Significant elevation gain, e.g. 5,541 m over the 144 km distance
Scenic views and course marking with reflective white tape and directional signs
additional: Race packets can be collected at race headquarters or just before the start. The organizer provides buses from the finish to the start. The race office operates at different locations and times depending on the distance. The course is marked with special tape bearing the UltraKotlina logo and directional signs. A GPX track will be available to download from the website about 2 weeks before the race. As part of UltraKotlina Week, talks and workshops are held, including sessions on supplementation and mountain safety.

name: XIV Biegi Przyjaźni
location: Skrzeszewo, Gmina Żukowo, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Friendship Run is one of the events in the Kaszuby Biegają series, the largest running event in northern Poland. The race takes place in the picturesque area around Skrzeszewo, giving participants the chance to spend time actively and discover the charms of Kashubia. The series attracts runners of different ages and abilities, promoting a healthy lifestyle and bringing the local community together.
course_highlights: The course runs through the picturesque landscapes of Kashubia
The race takes place in a natural, welcoming environment
The event is part of the Kaszuby Biegają series, the largest running event in northern Poland

name: Dwumaraton Olęderski
location: Wąsowo, Kuślin, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Bieg Październikowy
location: Łubianka, Toruń County, Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in the beautiful wooded settings of city parks and forests. In Poznań, the course loops around Lake Rusałka, starting near Św. Wawrzyńca Street, with the finish by the municipal beach on the lake. The races are open to runners of all abilities, from beginners to more experienced runners, who can compare their results on the same course over the years. The event promotes outdoor physical activity and a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through woodland around Lake Rusałka
Start near Św. Wawrzyńca Street; finish by the municipal beach on Lake Rusałka
Suitable for both beginner and advanced runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. A group warm-up with the CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place before the 10:45 start. The event follows a consistent schedule, and the race office remains in the same location throughout the season. Participants under 16 may take part with the consent of a parent or guardian. The series also includes races for children and young people.

name: Pielgrzymi Półmaraton o Memoriał Jana Pawła II
X Festiwal Biegów Rodzinnych Cała Oleśnica Biega
Beh za zdravie – Kuchajda
description: Run for Health - Kuchajda is a charity running event held at Kuchajda in Bratislava. It combines sport with support for health and the community, aiming to help disadvantaged people and organizations through physical activity. Participants can run, jog at an easy pace, or walk, creating a wonderful atmosphere filled with inspiring stories and solidarity. Run for Health is open to all ages and fitness levels and supports charitable projects with a real impact.

name: Beh ulicami Krompách
location: Krompachy okr. Spišská Nová Ves, Krompachy okr. Spišská Nová Ves, pred budovou mestského úradu
organizer: Mesto Krompachy, Komisia kultúry a športu pri MsZ v Krompachoch
description: The Run Through the Streets of Krompachy is a traditional race in the town of Krompachy, offering categories for children, adolescents, juniors, men and women in various age groups. The race takes place in front of the town hall and is organized by the City of Krompachy and the Culture and Sports Commission of the Krompachy Municipal Council. The start is split, with children’s categories and adolescents starting at 9:30 and adults at 11:00. The entry fee is a symbolic €5, except for schoolchildren, adolescents and runners over 60. The race is suitable for the general public and supports sporting life in the region.

name: Beh do vrchu Banské – Mlačky
organizer: Športový klub Banské a Obecný úrad Banské
description: The Banské–Mláčky uphill run is a traditional mountain race on a 6.4 km course with 326 metres of elevation gain, running from the Cultural Centre in Banské to the summit of Mláčky. The race is part of the Bančanský Cup and the Eastern Slovak Uphill Running League, with categories for men, women, juniors and children. The race starts directly in front of the Cultural Centre and the course runs mainly on asphalt through the village of Banské towards Košice. The organisers are Športový klub Banské and the Banské Municipal Office, which also provide facilities at the Cultural Centre.
course_highlights: 6.4 km asphalt course with 326 m of elevation gain
Climb from the Cultural Centre in Banské to the summit of Mláčky
Part of the Eastern Slovak Uphill Running League and the Bančanský Cup
additional: Race registration opens at 7:30 at the Cultural Centre. Children’s races start at 9:00 and the main race at 11:00. The awards ceremony takes place at 15:45 at the Cultural Centre. Competitors must register at least 30 minutes before the start of their category. Changing rooms and race packs are available for those registered online. Children’s courses are 50, 100, 200, 300, 500 and 800 m long.

name: Beh prvého nádychu
description: The First Breath Run is a charity run in Trnava supporting the Neonatal Department of the University Hospital Trnava. Runners can choose between a 3.9 km or 7.8 km route, with the shorter loop available to complete twice. The event offers a medal, refreshments at the finish, and an accompanying programme including music and dance performances. Its goal is to improve conditions for new mothers and their babies while creating a welcoming community atmosphere.
course_highlights: A 3.9 km loop in Bela IV Park, which can be completed twice
Refreshments and support from the Trnava Slávia basketball players along the route
An accompanying programme with music, a warm-up and a dance performance
additional: Race bib collection from 8:30. The first three men and women in the categories will receive small prizes from partners. An accompanying programme and refreshments are planned after the run. Volunteers over 18 are needed at the start and along the route. Refreshments will be available at the finish.

name: Beh okolo Sidorova
location: Hotel Áčko, Hrabovská cesta 34, Ružomberok, Slovakia
organizer: Bežecký spolok Ruža Ružomberok a Centrum voľného času Elán Ružomberok

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Dorastenecké a juniorské kategórie a muži a ženy nad 70 rokov 0 €

description: Beh okolo Sidorova is a running event in Ružomberok, offering 4.8 km and 13 km routes that follow forest trails and partly run along roads. The event also includes free children’s and school-age races for various age groups. Competitors take part at their own risk, and the organizer does not provide insurance. The event is part of the Liptov Running League and takes place in pleasant surroundings. Race materials can be collected at Hotel Áčko on race day.
course_highlights: The routes follow forest trails and partly run along roads
Children’s and school-age races from 50 m to 1.5 km, with medals for all participants
Cash prizes and prizes in kind for winners in various age groups
additional: Registration and collection of race materials take place at Hotel Áčko on race day from 08:00. Registration closes 15 minutes before the start of the relevant category. On-site registration is available on race day from 08:00 to 09:00 in some categories. The top three in children’s categories 3 and 4, and in the younger and older school-age categories, receive diplomas and medals. Cash prizes are awarded in the overall standings and in the masters categories, provided there are enough competitors. A prize of 30 € is offered for breaking the course record.

name: Běh na Kraví horu
description: Běh na Kraví horu je veřejný závod v běhu do vrchu s hromadným startem, který se koná v malebném prostředí Kraví hory v Teplicích nad Metují. Tento závod je součástí běžeckých vršků a nabízí sportovcům výzvu v podobě náročného stoupání a krásných výhledů. Závod má dlouholetou tradici a je oblíbený mezi běžci, kteří si chtějí vyzkoušet své síly v horském terénu. Pořadatelem je Redpoint Teplice nad Metují, který zajišťuje kvalitní organizaci a příjemnou atmosféru závodu.

name: Zátopkova pětka
description: Zátopkova pětka je tradiční běžecký závod pořádaný Atletickým klubem Emila Zátopka v Kopřivnici. Závod se koná na škvárové dráze stadionu Emila Zátopka a je součástí Lašské běžecké ligy. Je určen pro širokou veřejnost a nabízí příležitost zaběhnout si na kvalitním atletickém oválu v příjemné sportovní atmosféře. Závod má dlouholetou tradici a je oblíbený mezi běžci všech věkových kategorií.

name: Prešovská hodinovka na tartane
location: Prešov, Prešov, atletický štadión Prešovskej univerzity
organizer: BK ZasRun, Olympijský klub Prešov, AK TJ Slávia Prešovská univerzita
description: The Prešov Tartan Hour is a running race held at the Prešov University athletics stadium in Prešov. The competition is open to various age categories of men and women and offers a unique opportunity to test your endurance and speed on a tartan track. It is organized by BK ZasRun Šarišské Bohdanovce, Olympijský klub Prešov, and AK TJ Slávia Prešovská univerzita. The race is ideal for runners who want to experience a high-quality athletics atmosphere and compete in the pleasant surroundings of a university stadium.

name: Běh Heulosem - memoriál Jiřího Šmrhy
description: Běh Heulosem - memoriál Jiřího Šmrhy je tradiční běžecký závod pořádaný v lesoparku Heulos v Jihlavě. Závod nabízí různé kategorie a délky tratí pro muže, ženy, veterány, juniory, dorostence i děti, s barevně odlišenými okruhy po cestách a pěšinách lesoparku. Akce má dlouholetou tradici od roku 1977 a je součástí seriálu Běžci Vysočiny. Startuje se v odpoledních hodinách na atletickém stadionu Na Stoupách, přičemž trasy jsou vhodné pro širokou škálu běžců od nejmladších po veterány.

name: Gladiator Race Praha
description: Gladiator Race Praha je náročný překážkový běh zasazený do přírodního parku Čihadla v příměstské části Prahy. Závod nabízí kombinaci rovnějších běžeckých úseků, vody, bahna a náročných překážek včetně sítě nad vodním stavidlem. Tento devátý ročník přináší jedinečnou atmosféru, nové výzvy a přátelství, které si závodníci velmi oblíbili. K dispozici jsou různé kategorie závodů pro dospělé, děti i psy, což dělá závod atraktivní pro široké spektrum účastníků.

name: Stovka Považím - Považie ultra trail
description: Stovka Považím is a challenging long-distance hike and ultra trail in the beautiful Považie region, intended for experienced ultrarunners and hikers. Each year, it offers an original and extremely demanding course, with Route A forming part of the Czech-Slovak Ultra Trail Cup and the first stage of the Extreme Ultra Trail Combination. The event takes place in Trenčín and the surrounding area, with several routes and luggage transport provided between the start and finish. Participants can sleep in the gym at Predmier Elementary School, adding to the comfort of the competitors.

name: ČEZ RunTour Pardubice
description: ČEZ RunTour Pardubice je rodinný běžecký závod, který nabízí sedm různých běhů pro všechny věkové kategorie a výkonnostní úrovně. Na tratích od 500 metrů pro nejmenší až po půlmaraton si každý najde svou výzvu. Závod se koná na Velkém pardubickém závodišti a kromě sportovního zážitku nabízí i bohatý doprovodný program pro celou rodinu. Účastníci obdrží startovní balíček a přispívají charitě. Atmosféra je přátelská a podporuje jak hobíky, tak elitní běžce.
course_highlights: Trať zahrnuje délky 3, 5, 10 a 21,1 km, dětské běhy 500 a 1000 m
Start a cíl na Velkém pardubickém závodišti s unikátní atmosférou
Občerstvovací stanice na trati, v půlmaratonu minimálně 2x
additional: Závod nabízí speciální telefonní linku záchranné služby během závodu. Každý závodník obdrží gymsack s dárky od partnerů. Pro děti je připraven startovní balíček od společnosti Lidl a dětský koutek s hlídáním. Na trati jsou vodiči, kteří pomáhají běžcům dosáhnout cílového času. V cíli je občerstvení pro dětské běhy a na delších tratích občerstvovací stanice. Akce zahrnuje více tratí, medaile pro účastníky, občerstvovací stanice, šatny, sprchy, lékařskou podporu a fotografování po závodě.

name: Půlmaraton Český les
description: Půlmaraton Český les je tradiční trailový běh konaný v malebné přírodě Českého lesa v obci Nemanice. Závod nabízí dvě trasy, 21 km s převýšením 520 m a 7 km s převýšením 80 m, které vedou krásnou krajinou s možností stáhnout si GPX trasu. Na delší trati se vyhlašují absolutní vítězové a kategorie podle věku, zatímco kratší trať oceňuje tři nejrychlejší muže a ženy. Start i cíl jsou umístěny přímo v Nemanicích s možností parkování u místa startu.

name: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (11) – říjnový
description: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY je pravidelný běžecký závod v Praze Braníku, který nabízí příjemnou a rychlou trať podél Vltavy. Závod je součástí 16. ročníku běžecké ligy, kde se mohou běžci porovnávat s ostatními i se svými předchozími výkony. Trať je certifikovaná a na 10 km je možné si zaběhnout limit pro MČR. Po závodě je zajištěna pohodová atmosféra s možností občerstvení a vyhlášení nejlepších běžců.

name: NN NIGHT RUN České Budějovice
location: Náměstí Přemysla Otakara II., České Budějovice, Česko
description: NN NIGHT RUN České Budějovice je jedna z největších běžeckých událostí v Českých Budějovicích, která se koná na Náměstí Přemysla Otakara II. Tento noční běh nabízí atmosféru města za svitu čelovek a je určen pro běžce všech věkových kategorií a výkonnostních úrovní. Každoročně se akce účastní více než 2000 běžců, od začátečníků po zkušené závodníky. Součástí programu jsou také dětské závody a charitativní běhy, které doplňují hlavní závod na 10 km.

name: Ultramaraton Zapomenuté hory
location: Tábor v Račím údolí - Uhelná 126 - býv. okres Jeseník, Olomoucký
description: Ultramaraton Zapomenuté hory je podzimní trailový závod, který vás zavede po dokonalých horských stezkách do nejodlehlejších míst Rychlebských hor. Trasy vedou přes hluboká údolí, odlehlé hřebeny a krásné výhledy, včetně nejvyššího vrcholu přilehlých Gór Bialskych v Polsku. Závod nabízí tři varianty tras s různou délkou a náročností, které jsou vhodné pro zkušené běžce hledající divokou přírodu a nezapomenutelné zážitky. Součástí akce je i večerní program přednášek a zábavy. Těšíme se na všechny, kteří chtějí poznat tyto zapomenuté hory jako málokdo před nimi.

name: Běh kolem Ameriky
description: Běh kolem Ameriky je třetím nejstarším běžeckým závodem v České republice a nejstarším terénním během v zemi, který se koná od roku 1925 v lesoparku Amerika v Písku. Tento tradiční lesní běh nabízí závodníkům možnost změřit síly na různých tratích, přičemž hlavní závod má délku 10 400 metrů. Závod má bohatou historii a je známý svou atmosférou a spoluprací s partnerskými městy v zahraničí. Každoročně přitahuje širokou škálu běžců od sprinterů po vytrvalce a je významnou sportovní událostí v regionu.
course_highlights: Lesní terén v lesoparku Amerika
Hlavní trať dlouhá 10 400 metrů
Historický závod s tradicí od roku 1925
additional: Závod má 25 soutěžních kategorií a je mezinárodně uznávaný díky spolupráci s partnerskými městy v Anglii a Německu. Start se nachází u Interhotelu Amerika. V historii se nekonaly pouze dva ročníky - v roce 1942 a 2020. V roce 2027 se má konat 101. ročník závodu a 2. ročník Memoriálu Jaroslava Putschögla.

name: Běh podél Halštrova
description: Běh podél Halštrova je tradiční podzimní běžecký závod, který vede krásnou krajinou přírodního parku Halštrov z vrchu Háj až k minerálním pramenům v Doubravě. Závod je určen jak pro dospělé, tak pro děti, kteří absolvují kratší trasu. Účastníci si mohou užít kombinaci asfaltových a lesních cest s cílem u minerálky, kde je zajištěna doprava zpět do Aše a občerstvení. Počet startujících je omezen na 200, proto je doporučena včasná registrace. Akci pořádá Lyžařský klub Jasan Aš za podpory města Aš a místních lesů.
course_highlights: Trasa vede přírodním parkem Halštrov z vrchu Háj k minerálním pramenům v Doubravě
Délka dospělých cca 9,7 km, dětí 4 km
Závod vede po asfaltu i lesních cestách
additional: Start dospělých je přibližně v 11:00 od pramene Halštrova, start dětí v 10:45 v Dolních Pasekách. Cílem je minerálka v Doubravě, odkud je zajištěna doprava zpět do Aše. V cíli je občerstvení. Registrace je možná e-mailem do 15. října do 20:00 nebo osobně na místě do 9:30. U ročníku 2026 byla kapacita omezena na 200 závodníků; z místa prezentace byla zajištěna doprava na start a z cíle zpět do Aše.

name: Od radnice k radnici
organizer: Okresní sdružení České unie sportu Náchod
description: Běh Od radnice k radnici je součástí běžeckého seriálu PRIMÁTOR CUP v regionu Náchodsko. Tento závod je otevřený pro všechny věkové kategorie včetně dětí a nabízí rodinnou atmosféru. Trasa vede z náměstí v Hronově přes hlavní silnici a městské ulice až k radnici v Náchodě, což zajišťuje zajímavý městský běh s výhledem na okolní krajinu. Závod je vhodný pro běžce všech úrovní a podporuje aktivní životní styl v regionu.
course_highlights: Start na náměstí v Hronově a cíl na náměstí v Náchodě
Trasa vede po hlavní silnici, přes železniční most a městské ulice
Městský běh s kombinací asfaltových a místních komunikací
additional: Registrace probíhá online na sportchallenge.cz od 1. 9. 2026 do 17. 10. 2026 do 8 hod. Možnost přihlášení i na místě v den závodu za zvýšené startovné. Výdej startovních čísel probíhá v hale SK Náchod (Rubena) v pátek 16.10. od 13 do 18 hod. a v sobotu 17.10. od 7:45 do 9:45 hod. Děti mohou sbírat body za účast na všech závodech seriálu a získat odměnu. Závodníci startují na vlastní náklady nebo náklady vysílající organizace. Informace o tratích a cenách jsou dostupné pro ročník 2026; podrobnosti k ročníku 2027 zatím nejsou v podkladech uvedeny. Nejmenší děti mohou běžet s doprovodem.

name: Silniční běh Hronov-Náchod
organizer: Okresní sdružení České unie sportu v Náchodě
description: Silniční běh Hronov - Náchod je tradiční závod, který vede mezi dvěma městy na Náchodsku. Běžci startují na náměstí v Hronově a po silniční trati dlouhé 8 850 metrů doběhnou na náměstí T. G. Masaryka v Náchodě. Závod je také přeborem okresu Náchod v silničním běhu a bývá součástí seriálu Primátor CUP. Součástí programu jsou také dětské běhy v Náchodě.
course_highlights: Silniční trať dlouhá 8 850 metrů z Hronova do Náchoda.
Start na hronovském náměstí a cíl před radnicí na náměstí T. G. Masaryka v Náchodě.
Závod se běží za plného silničního provozu.
additional: V Náchodě se pořádají také dětské závody „Od radnice k radnici“, s tratěmi dlouhými 150 až 1 200 metrů. V předchozích ročnících byli účastníci hlavního běhu z Náchoda dopraveni autobusy na start v Hronově.

name: Malá křivoklátská
description: Malá křivoklátská je tradiční lesní běh s dlouholetou historií od roku 1973, který se koná v malebném údolí Rakovnického potoka pod hradem Křivoklát. Hlavní závod měří 6000 metrů a běží se na dvou okruzích po lesních a asfaltových cestách s mírným převýšením a krásnými výhledy na hrad. Zázemí závodu a žákovská trať jsou umístěny na sportovišti Kolečko, které poskytuje ideální podmínky pro závodníky všech věkových kategorií. Žákovská trať je rovinatá a měří 600 metrů, přičemž délka závodu se přizpůsobuje věku běžců. Závod je pořádán jednotou Sokol Křivoklát, která má bohatou sportovní tradici a zázemí v obci Křivoklát.
course_highlights: Lesní trať s převýšením k hradbám hradu Křivoklát
Dvě okruhy hlavního závodu o délce 3000 metrů každý
Rovinatá žákovská trať 600 metrů na sportovišti Kolečko
additional: Zázemí závodu a start/cíl jsou na sportovišti Kolečko. Hlavní závod startuje hromadně a trať vede přes lávky a brod přes Rakovnický potok. Žákovská trať je okruh s délkou 600 m, běží se 1-3 okruhy podle věku. Trať je kombinací lesních pěšin, asfaltu a cyklistické stezky s drobným štěrkem. Závod má dlouhou tradici a stabilní trať od roku 1975. V roce 2026 se koná 54. ročník.

name: Běh okolo Lemberka
location: Kaplička u Markvartického rybníka, Jablonné v Podještědí, Česko
organizer: Sportovní klub ZŠ Jablonné v Podještědí
description: Běh okolo Lemberka je tradiční podzimní běžecký závod konaný u kapličky u Markvartického rybníka na zelené turistické značce mezi Jablonným v Podještědí a Lvovou. Závod nabízí různé délky tratí od dětských kategorií až po dospělé běhy včetně štafet. Start je v sobotu ráno a závod je součástí Českolipské okresní běžecké ligy. Účastníci mají k dispozici omezené šatny a první tři v každé kategorii obdrží diplom a věcnou cenu.
course_highlights: Trasy vedou po zelené turistické značce mezi Jablonným v Podještědí a Lvovou
Různé délky tratí od 50 m pro nejmenší až po 10 000 m pro dospělé a veterány
Závod je součástí Českolipské okresní běžecké ligy - O pohár Českolipského deníku
additional: Prezentace od 8:30 hod. v prostoru startu a cíle. Pánské a dámské šatny v omezené míře ve stanu poblíž startu. Veteránské kategorie jsou vypsány pouze na 10 000 m. Závod je zařazen do Českolipské okresní běžecké ligy - O pohár Českolipského deníku. Vypsány jsou také dětské a mládežnické běhy. Podle dostupných informací se ročník 2026 koná 17. října; termín ročníku 2027 není potvrzen.

name: Malá Kunratická
description: Malá Kunratická je tradiční krosový závod pořádaný Atletickým veteránským klubem ČR 1982 za podpory Městské části Praha 11. Závod se koná v Kunraticích u Kunratického mlýna a nabízí středně těžký kros dlouhý 3 250 metrů. Startuje se ze stejného místa jako Velká Kunratická, ale trať je zcela odlišná. Akce je vhodná pro běžce, kteří hledají zajímavý terénní závod v příjemném prostředí Prahy 11. Prezentace probíhá u altánku v blízkosti startu od 9:30 hodin.
course_highlights: Středně těžký krosový terén
Délka tratě 3 250 metrů
Start na stejném místě jako Velká Kunratická, ale s odlišnou tratí
additional: Závod je podporován Městskou částí Praha 11 a pořádá jej Atletický veteránský klub ČR 1982. Start i cíl jsou v lokalitě Kunratický mlýn, Praha 4, Kunratice. V dříve zveřejněném rozpisu začínala prezentace v 9:30, veteráni nad 40 let startovali v 10:30 a muži do 39 let spolu se ženami v 11:00. Časy i další podrobnosti pro ročník 2027 nebyly potvrzeny.

name: Heimstaden Havířovská desítka
description: Heimstaden Havířovská desítka je tradiční běžecký závod v centru Havířova, který spojuje sportovní výkon s podporou sportovců s hendikepem. Závod nabízí různé tratě pro jednotlivce, rodiny i firemní týmy, včetně hlavního závodu na 10 km, běhu na 5 km, štafety 4×2,5 km a rodinného běhu na 500 metrů pro děti. Každý rok se zde setkávají běžci všech úrovní, aby společně sdíleli radost z pohybu a pomáhali dobré věci. Startovní balíčky obsahují čipové měření času, občerstvení a medaile pro účastníky.
course_highlights: Hlavní závod 10 km po dvou okruzích centrem Havířova
Štafetový závod 4×2,5 km s možností firemních týmů
Rodinný běh na 500 m pro děti mladší 15 let
additional: Registrace je možná do 11:00 v den závodu pro hlavní závod a štafetu, do 10:00 pro 5 km běh. Čipové měření času, občerstvení na trati i po závodě, možnost objednat běžecké tričko za 350 Kč. Benefiční rozměr závodu - 100 Kč ze startovného jde na podporu Handicap Sport Clubu Moravia. Štafetový závod je určen pro všechny starší 18 let nebo mladší s písemným souhlasem zákonného zástupce, týmy mohou být smíšené bez rozdílu pohlaví. Startovní balíček podle informací k ročníku 2026 zahrnoval čipové měření času, občerstvení a účastnickou medaili. Část startovného běžců s trvalým bydlištěm v Havířově podporuje boccisty HSC Moravia. Informace o cenách se vztahují k ročníku 2026, nikoli k závodu v roce 2027.

name: Krumlovský běh
organizer: AC Moravský Krumlov a Orel Jednota Rakšice
description: Krumlovský běh je silniční závod pořádaný v Moravském Krumlově, Rakšicích v areálu Orlovny. Nabízí tratě o délce 10,9 km pro muže a 4,5 km pro ženy, vedené po asfaltovém povrchu a okolních cestách. Závod je zařazen mezi běhy pro zdraví, hobby běhy a dětské závody, což jej činí vhodným pro širokou veřejnost a běžecké nadšence všech věkových kategorií. Pořadatelem je AC Moravský Krumlov pod vedením Mgr. Zuzany Markové. Registrace probíhá na samostatné stránce a závod je součástí služeb Českého atletického svazu pro běžce.
course_highlights: Tratě vedeny po asfaltovém povrchu a okolních cestách
Délka tratí 10,9 km (muži) a 4,5 km (ženy)
Závod zahrnuje hobby běh a dětské závody
additional: Závod je součástí Českého běžeckého klubu a Českého atletického svazu. Pořadatelem je AC Moravský Krumlov, kontaktní osoba Mgr. Zuzana Marková. Závod je určen pro širokou veřejnost včetně hobby běžců a dětí. Program zahrnuje také dětské závody, hobby běh a běh pro zdraví. Uvedené informace se týkají ročníku 2026; podrobnosti pro rok 2027 nejsou potvrzené.

name: Viersener Herbstwaldlauf Rund um den Bismarckturm
description: The 79th Viersen Autumn Forest Run Around the Bismarck Tower takes place in Viersen. The event offers a 5 km run for adults on a hilly course, with a time limit of one hour. There is also a 7.25 km walking and Nordic walking event. The age limits are 14 to 99 for the run and 10 to 99 for walking. This traditional event is aimed at runners and walkers looking for a challenging course through autumnal woodland.
course_highlights: Hilly course
Around the Bismarck Tower
One-hour time limit for the 5 km run
additional: There are events for children and teenagers; further information is available in the organizer’s official announcement. The start and finish are the same for all events; exact locations are shown only with RUNME Premium. Results are listed by age group, with age-group placement determined by year of birth. Multiple events with different distances, age groups, and start times; participation for teenagers aged 14 and over; results will be published on the website.

name: Bad Dürkheimer Berglauf mit RLP-Meisterschaft
location: Sporthalle der Berufsbildenden Schulen, Bad Dürkheim, Bad Dürkheim, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
description: The 29th Bad Dürkheim Mountain Run, featuring the Rhineland-Palatinate Championships, takes place. The course runs from the sports hall of the vocational schools in Bad Dürkheim up to the Bismarck Tower on the Peterskopf. Over a distance of 8.7 km, runners climb 510 metres, mostly on varied forest paths and trails with stones, roots and steps. The race is a DLV-approved competition with various age groups and a team classification. In addition to the sporting competition, the event offers a friendly atmosphere, refreshments and return transport for participants.
course_highlights: 8.7 km course with 510 metres of elevation gain
Start at 123 m above sea level, finish at the Bismarck Tower at 493 m above sea level
Varied natural course with forest paths, narrow trails, stones, roots and steps
additional: The entry fee includes contributions to the federation and mountain-running cup, timing, a rental chip (to be returned at the finish), a clothing bag and clothing transport, a sports drink, bananas, a rental cup (to be returned at the finish), a photo frame, bus return, a sparkling-wine stand along the return route, and free certificate printing via my.raceresult.com. On-site late registration is possible, but not for the Rhineland-Palatinate Championships. Non-cash prizes and special prizes are awarded at the awards ceremony; prizes are given only to participants who are present. Hilly natural course; trails with stones, roots and steps; online registration; parking fees nearby; bus transfer included.

name: Bottwartal-Marathon Run und Fun Day
location: Steinheim an der Murr, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Bottwartal Marathon is a unique running event set amid the picturesque landscapes of southern Germany. The course takes you through gentle vineyard slopes and idyllic historic town centers, with an exciting atmosphere along the route. Whether you are a beginner or an ambitious runner, there is a highlight for everyone. In addition to the marathon, a range of races from 5 km to an ultra is available for all age groups and fitness levels.
course_highlights: Run through historic town centers such as Großbottwar and Steinheim
The course follows the Bottwar River and passes through vineyards
Flat finish at the Steppi roundabout in Steinheim
additional: Free monthly training runs with pace groups and guides to help you prepare. Summer holiday runs every Tuesday evening during the summer holidays. Year-End Run with 10 km, followed by punch and mulled wine. The OPR30 Run is limited to 150 participants. All races have refreshment stations approximately every 5 km. Late entries are possible until shortly before the event; registration via Datasport. Various distances, including children’s and inclusive races; registration via Datasport; GPS-supported course measurement; medals at the finish.

name: Falke-Rothaarsteigmarathon
location: Schmallenberger Sauerland, Hochsauerlandkreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 23rd FALKE Rothaarsteig Marathon takes place in the Schmallenberger Sauerland. The event offers marathon, half-marathon, walking, Nordic walking, and a 12.5 km AOK run. The course passes through the scenic Rothaargebirge region and is recognized by the DLV as an officially sanctioned public race. More than 1,000 active runners take part each year and enjoy the varied trail and woodland scenery.
course_highlights: Scenic course in the Rothaargebirge
Officially sanctioned public race recognized by the DLV
A range of events: marathon, half-marathon, walking, Nordic walking, and a 12.5 km AOK run
additional: Late entries are possible up to half an hour before the respective start. Start times are staggered: marathon at 11:00, half-marathon at 12:00, walking and Nordic walking at 12:15, and AOK run at 11:45. The event takes place at Latroper-Str. 57392 Fleckenberg in the Schmallenberger Sauerland.

name: Hachenburger Löwenlauf
description: The Hachenburger Löwenlauf is a traditional running event with a family-friendly atmosphere, held in Hachenburg. The event offers various distances, including a half marathon, a 10.5 km race, a 6.3 km fun run/team race, and children’s races. The routes pass through the varied landscapes of the Westerwald, with scenic elevation changes and wonderful views. Since 1989, proceeds from the race have been donated to social projects, giving the event special social significance.
course_highlights: The half-marathon route reaches its highest point at Gräbersberg (513 m) and features varied climbs and descents.
The 10.5 km race runs mostly on forest trails, reaching its highest point at 439 m above sea level.
Start and finish area at the Rundsporthalle in Hachenburg, with changing rooms and showers available.
additional: Electronic timing without a chip, certificates for all finishers, prizes for age-group winners, and a special prize for the largest team-race group. Late entries are possible on 16 October from 17:00 and on race day from 09:00. Refreshments along the course and at the finish include electrolyte drinks, water, tea, cola, and fruit. Changing rooms and showers are available at the Rundsporthalle. Various race distances (half marathon, 10.5 km, 6.3 km team and fun run, children’s races); start and finish area at Lohmühle, Hachenburg; electronic timing (without a chip); certificates for all finishers; prizes for age-group winners; refreshments along the course and at the finish; online registration only.

name: Herbstlauf des LSV Porz
organizer: LSV Porz / Kölner Lauf- und Nordic-Walkingteam
description: The LSV Porz Autumn Run is Cologne’s oldest road race and takes place in the picturesque Leidenhausen recreation area. The event offers distances from 1 km to 10 km, measured in accordance with the German Athletics Association (DLV) regulations and eligible for rankings. Both competitive runners and recreational joggers can enjoy the autumn scenery as they run. The 5 km loop is considered one of the fastest running routes in Cologne and the surrounding area, and is often used by top runners to assess their form.
course_highlights: Running routes through the Leidenhausen recreation area amid autumn scenery
The 5 km loop is one of the fastest running routes in Cologne
Routes measured in accordance with DLV regulations and eligible for rankings
additional: Race numbers must be worn on the chest. Timing is provided by time-and-voice.com. Late registration is possible on the day of the event for a fee of €2; school students are exempt from the fee. No liability is accepted for theft, accidents or other damage. Payment is by SEPA direct debit a few days before the event. No entry fee will be debited if the event is cancelled. Courses measured, registration until 14.10.2025, start times from 11:00, parking nearby, participation in running and Nordic walking events

name: TeutoMarsch
location: Grundschule Hohne, Lengerich-Hohne, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Teutomarsch is a unique hiking and running experience through the Teutoburg Forest and its surroundings. Organized by Turnverein Hohne von 1911 e.V. in Lengerich, the Teutomarsch offers two routes designed to delight participants. The event is very popular, and places fill up quickly. The exact route is still being finalized, but promises to be a wonderful and unique course. Participants must be at least 16 years old, and dogs are allowed on a leash.
course_highlights: A unique route through the Teutoburg Forest and surrounding area
Two different routes for a special experience
A nature experience in the Lengerich-Hohne region
additional: Registration for the Teutomarsch 2026 sold out within 30 minutes, with 500 places available. There is a waiting list. Participants consent to being photographed and filmed and to the publication of the images and footage. Entry fees are non-refundable. Minimum age: 16. The organizer accepts no liability for personal injury or property damage, or for loss or theft. Trail running, no timing, aid stations along the route, start and finish at Grundschule Hohne, participant limit: 500

name: Altmühltrail
description: The Altmühltrail 2026 takes place on October 17 in Dollnstein in the Altmühltal Nature Park, offering a unique trail-running experience that combines sport, nature, and culinary delights. The route leads over challenging trails, past impressive rock formations, through dense forests, and along scenic ridges. In addition to the sporting challenge, tasting stations featuring regional specialties make for a special experience. The children’s race, with its trail obstacle course, also gives young runners the chance to gain their first experience.

name: Herbstlauf der DJK Feudenheim
description: The DJK Feudenheim Autumn Run is a traditional running event in Mannheim-Feudenheim, held every year in October. With different distances for the main race, the recreational run, schoolchildren and Bambini, the event offers a wide range of options for runners of all ages and ability levels. The course runs through the autumn scenery and is organised by a dedicated team of volunteers. Alongside the sporting competition, the event also focuses on community and the joy of running.
course_highlights: 10 km main race with a time limit and official results
3.5 km recreational run
Schoolchildren’s race and Bambini run over shorter distances
additional: Race number collection is available on Friday from 13:00 to 17:30 and on the event day from 10:00 until shortly before the start. The event takes place in all weather conditions. No drinks are provided on the course, so participants must bring their own. Timing is recorded using a transponder on the back of the race number. Warm tea is available in the finish area, along with changing rooms, showers and medical services. Wearing headphones is prohibited for safety reasons.

name: Oberwaldlauf
description: The Oberwaldlauf is an annual race held on the third Saturday in October, with 5 km and 10 km routes through Karlsruhe’s Oberwald. The routes are officially measured and approved by the German Athletics Association, making results eligible for rankings. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere, refreshments, changing rooms and showers, as well as a varied supporting program for all participants. The start and finish are near the TUS Rüppurr clubhouse, which is also used for race-number collection and late registration.

name: Panoramalauf Niedenstein
description: The 24th Niedenstein Panoramic Run takes place in Niedenstein. The event is organized by SG 1898 Chattengau e.V. and Lauftreff Niedenstein. The race offers an attractive course around the Hessenturm Stadium and the clubhouse, set amid the beautiful landscape of the region. Participants can look forward to a well-organized running event as part of the Schwalm-Eder Running Cup.

name: Prignitzer Moormeile
description: The Prignitz Moor Mile in Bad Wilsnack is a traditional race taking place for the 26th time. The event offers a range of distances from 1 km to 12.4 km, running through the Wilsnack forests and the Kurpark, and around the Karthanehalle. The races are suitable for children, teenagers, and adults, and are part of the Prignitz Cup and the Brandenburg Cup. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, good on-course refreshments, and professional timing.

name: Rottachseelauf 2026
description: The Rottachseelauf is a long-standing running event in Oy-Mittelberg, taking place for the 35th time. Various distances are offered for different age groups, including a 15-kilometer main race for participants aged 16 and over, as well as children’s races over 2.4 km and 1.2 km. The event is aimed at runners of all ages and offers a sporting challenge in beautiful surroundings. Registration opens in mid-August.

name: Schloss Cross Laupheim
description: The Schloss-Cross Laupheim is a varied cross-country race on a 1,550-meter loop through the picturesque Schlosspark in Laupheim. Several events are offered, including a 9.3-kilometer main race, a 4.65-kilometer fun run, a 6.3-kilometer Nordic walking event, and children’s races over 1.55 kilometers. The course starts at the archway on Klaus-Graf-Stauffenberg-Straße by the Kulturhaus and follows gravel and crushed-stone paths as well as paved sections, with an elevation difference of 19 meters. The event offers an appealing program for competitive runners, recreational runners, and children alike.

name: Steigerwald - Fackellauf 2026
description: The Steigerwald Torchlight Run is being organized for the 39th time by the athletics department of TSV Burghaslach and traditionally takes place on the third Saturday in October. The event gives runners of all ability levels the opportunity to run together through the beautiful Steigerwald countryside. It is a fixture in the regional sporting calendar and promotes community and enjoyment of running.

name: Vellberger Volkslauf
description: The Vellberg Volkslauf is a local running event in Vellberg, Baden-Württemberg, organized by TSV Vellberg e.V. It is part of the Stadtwerke Läuft bei dir series, which also includes races in Michelfeld, Gaildorf and Bibersfeld. The event offers a classic 10 km race and a 400 m race for different age groups. Registration is online only; late registration is available up to 45 minutes before the respective start. Timing is provided by Speed Timing, and certificates can be printed on site.

name: Berchtesgaden
description: Berchtesgaden lies in southern Bavaria and offers an impressive alpine landscape of high peaks, romantic lakes, and Germany’s only Alpine National Park. The region is ideal for hikers and mountaineers, who can experience nature up close on a variety of circular trails and tours. The historic center of Berchtesgaden combines culture and history with a modern shopping experience in an Alpine setting. A special destination is the Kehlsteinhaus, with its breathtaking panorama at an altitude of 1,834 meters.

name: XTERRA O-SEE Ultra Trail
description: The XTERRA O-SEE Ultra Trail in Kurort Oybin, Germany, is part of the XTERRA Trail Run World Series and serves as the European Championship. The event offers a range of distances from 0.5 km to 100 km, taking runners through the varied and challenging landscape around Oybin. Runners experience a combination of nature, trail running and sporting challenge in a picturesque setting. Alongside the races, there is an extensive programme of activities, including a pasta party, awards ceremony and Canicross the following day.

name: Ndb. und KR Passau Cross-Laufmeisterschaft im Rahmen des 5. intern. DJK Crosslauf in Passau
Coconaut Pomerania ULTRA Trail
location: Luzino, Wejherowo County, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Dębowiec Nocna Pętla
description: Dębowiec Night Loop is a mountain run on the slopes of Dębowiec in Bielsko-Biała. The route follows forest trails from Dębowiec to the Wapienica Valley and back. The approximately 8 km course includes a steep climb beneath the Dębowiec chairlift. After the run, participants can enjoy a bonfire and a meal at the Dębowiec 520 mountain shelter. The event also includes an approximately 4 km Nordic Walking march starting at the lower station of the Dębowiec chairlift. It’s a great way to spend an active October evening in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: An 8 km route along forest trails from Dębowiec to the Wapienica Valley and back
A steep climb beneath the Dębowiec chairlift
Finish at the Dębowiec 520 mountain shelter, with a bonfire and a meal
additional: Runners must bring a headlamp. The first three finishers in the Open categories and the first three women will receive vouchers for sports equipment. Special prizes are planned for the oldest male and female participants. All participants will receive a race pack, a medal and a meal at the finish. A bonfire will be held after the run at the Dębowiec 520 mountain shelter. A free Nordic Walking march of approximately 4 km will take place at the same time; advance registration is required via the Decathlon GO website.

name: IV Wilczy Półmaraton
location: Uroczysko Głębokie Doły, Nadleśnictwo Rybnik, Poland
description: The IV Wilczy Half Marathon is a race organized by the ZATYRANI Association, taking participants through the scenic Wilcza nature reserve. Runners can expect professional organization, including timing provided by LESZY.RUN and race-pack collection upon presentation of a QR code. The half-marathon course has water stations and a special WK DZIK Sprint Bonus at the 14th kilometer. The race also promotes the #17milionów social campaign, supporting children with cerebral palsy.
course_highlights: The course runs through a nature reserve
WK DZIK Sprint Bonus at the 14th kilometer
Water stations at kilometers 6 and 19; no disposable cups are provided, so bring your own
additional: Race packs are issued only upon presentation of a QR code. Bib numbers are reusable and must be returned after the race. No disposable cups will be available on the course or at the finish; participants should bring their own cup or soft flask. Three official parking areas are available to participants. Timing and race communications are handled through the LESZY.RUN system.

name: Rajd Waligóry
description: Rajd Waligóry is an orienteering cycling rally that combines adventure, physical activity, and great fun outdoors. Participants receive a map with checkpoints to find in any order, using their ingenuity and navigation skills without GPS. The rally takes place in the scenic area around Bochnia, offering challenges for cycling and navigation enthusiasts. It’s a great opportunity to test your skills and have fun in the fresh air.
course_highlights: A cycling route with checkpoints to find
Scenic areas around Bochnia
Navigation without GPS, using only a map and compass
additional: Participants receive a map marked with checkpoints and must confirm they have reached them using a control punch. GPS navigation is prohibited, ensuring a true adventure and requiring a good strategy. The winner is the person who finds the most checkpoints within the allotted time and does so the fastest.

name: Grand Prix Dziewiczej Góry w Biegach Górskich
description: The Dziewicza Góra Grand Prix Mountain Running Series is a series of races held in the Zielonka Forest Landscape Park, promoting physical activity and environmental protection. The races take place on forest trails around the park’s highest elevation, Dziewicza Góra. Participants can choose from 5 km and 10 km races, a Nordic Walking event, and shorter races for children and young people. The event brings together runners of different ages and ability levels, creating a welcoming atmosphere of sporting competition and recreation.
course_highlights: The course follows a 5.15 km loop entirely on forest trails
The route climbs twice to the summit of Dziewicza Góra, the highest point in the Zielonka Forest Landscape Park
The route passes through the event center after approximately 3.7 km, where spectators can cheer on the runners
additional: The race office is open from 8:15 to 10:30 in the building of the Łopuchówko Forest District Education Center. Children’s races start between 9:00 and 9:45, over distances of 200m, 500m, 1000m, and 1500m. The 5 km race starts at 10:50, the 10 km race at 11:00, and Nordic Walking at 11:02. The participant limit is 500. After leaving the forest, runners finishing the race should head to the left side of the balloon marked Finish; 10 km runners pass under the Finish balloon and continue for a second loop.

name: X Bieg o Puchar Rektora ANS w Nowym Targu
XI Półmaraton Piastowski
location: Wilkszyn, Miękinia, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: 35 Orla Pięść
location: Świeszyno, Koszalin County, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: III Festiwal Biegowy w Nadleśnictwie Kli...
location: Sowno, Goleniów County, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Podvihorlatský kros
location: Poruba pod Vihorlatom, Poruba pod Vihorlatom, futbalové ihrisko (amfiteáter)
description: The Podvihorlatský Cross is a running event held at the football field (amphitheatre) in Poruba pod Vihorlatom. The races include starts for children’s categories and the main category. The course runs mainly along field and forest roads, with 30% asphalt surface. The event is organised by Mgr. Ján Podstavský with the support of the Municipality of Poruba pod Vihorlatom. It is part of the Michalovce–Sobrance Running League 2025 and offers categories for various age groups and Nordic walking.

name: Extrém Maratón Oščadnica
location: Oščadnica, Oščadnica, Račatak na Námestí M. Bernáta pri fontáne
organizer: Obec Oščadnica, Klub turistov Oščadnica, extremmaraton.sk
description: Extrém Maratón Oščadnica is a mountain marathon through the picturesque Kysuce countryside, mainly along mountain ridges with beautiful views of Veľká Rača. The 42-kilometre course, with nearly 1,700 metres of elevation gain, will test your endurance, strength and love of the mountains. This is not a race but a recreational running experience that celebrates the joy of movement, friendship and determination. The organisers provide full services, including refreshments, a T-shirt and a post-run get-together.

name: Rozhanovská dvanástka
organizer: Obec Rozhanovce, Občianske združenie KŠK Rozhanovce
description: Rozhanovce Twelve is a running race held at the amphitheatre grounds in Rozhanovce. It offers two main categories—a short 6 km course and a long 12 km course—for both men and women. The race is organised by the Municipality of Rozhanovce and the KŠK Rozhanovce civic association, and is suitable for runners of varying abilities. The children’s races are scheduled to start at 10:45 and the main courses at 11:00.

name: Šurianska desiatka
description: Šurianska desiatka is a running event held in the town of Šurany, with the start and finish in front of the Municipal Office. The course runs along the town’s streets and through part of Nitriansky Hrádok on asphalt roads. The event is open to the general public, including pupils, juniors, recreational runners, and Nordic Walking participants. It is organized by Gymnázium Bernolákova 37, Šurany, and the number of participants is limited in categories A to J. Refreshments and drinks are provided for competitors. Winners receive diplomas, prizes, and cash rewards.

name: Memoriál Ondreja Holca v cezpoľnom behu Poniky
location: Futbalové ihrisko ŠK OPL Poniky, Poniky, Slovakia
description: The Ondrej Holec Memorial in Poniky is a cross-country race starting and based at the ŠK OPL Poniky football field. The event includes a 10-kilometre main race, a shorter hobby race and children’s races. The courses run through the surrounding area and offer runners of different age categories a chance to take part.
course_highlights: The main course is 10 km long with approximately 290 m of elevation gain.
The main course follows village roads, forest and field paths, and logging roads.
The hobby course is 3.7 km long with approximately 60 m of elevation gain.
additional: The programme also typically includes children’s races, with courses for schoolchildren, preschoolers and the youngest children.

name: STOP.SHOP. Liptovský Mikuláš polmaratón
location: STOP.SHOP Liptovský Mikuláš, Liptovský Mikuláš, Slovakia
organizer: STOP.SHOP. Slovakia s.r.o.; Olympijský klub Liptova
description: The STOP SHOP Liptovský Mikuláš Half Marathon is a 21.1 km road race on an asphalt loop with 114 metres of elevation gain. The course is certified by a commissioner of the Slovak Athletics Association, and after the turnaround runners return along the same route. Refreshment stations are available at 5, 10 and 15.5 km, with water at the 5 km station. The event is part of the Liptov Running League and is organised by STOP.SHOP Slovakia s.r.o. together with the Liptov Olympic Club.
course_highlights: Asphalt road loop with 114 m of elevation gain
Refreshment stations at 5, 10 and 15.5 km; water at 5 km
Course certified by a Slovak Athletics Association commissioner
additional: Race-day registration and bib collection take place from 8:00 to 9:30 on the first floor of the STOP SHOP shopping centre. The first 200 registered participants receive a race pack including a goulash voucher and other gifts. Participants receive a finisher’s medal at the finish. Changing rooms and toilets are available in the shopping centre. More than 380 outdoor and underground parking spaces are available at the shopping centre. The start and finish are beside the STOP SHOP shopping centre.

name: Večerný beh Moldavou
location: Športový areál Pod Kopcom, Moldava nad Bodvou, Slovakia
organizer: Athletic Legion Club – Moldava nad Bodvou
description: The Moldava Evening Run is a traditional running race in Moldava nad Bodvou, offering 5 km and 10 km routes on asphalt and forest terrain. The event is open to a broad age range, from 13 years old, and runners can compete in various men’s and women’s age categories. Running headlamps and reflective elements are mandatory, emphasizing the event’s evening character. Category winners receive cash prizes, and all participants receive a finisher’s medal.
course_highlights: 10 km route (2 laps) and 5 km route (1 lap)
Surface: 80% asphalt, 20% forest
Start and finish at the Športový Areál Pod Kopcom
additional: The time limit is 2 hours (18:00–20:00). Winners in the M17 and Ž17 categories receive non-cash prizes; other category winners receive cash prizes. Every participant who finishes receives a participation medal. A running headlamp and reflective elements are mandatory on the course.

name: onsemi Jesenný beh okolo Sĺňavy
location: Bufet Dino, Sĺňava Reservoir dam embankment, Piešťany, Slovakia
organizer: OZ Sĺňava Piešťany a Atletický oddiel TJ Družba Piešťany
description: The onsemi Autumn Run Around Sĺňava is a running event in Piešťany offering a 12 km asphalt loop around the Sĺňava Reservoir. The event also includes two-person relay races on the same course and free children’s races for various age groups. Runner registration takes place on race day at the start line. The event is organised by OZ Sĺňava Piešťany and the TJ Družba Piešťany Athletics Club, and is suitable for the general public across a range of ability levels.
course_highlights: 12 km asphalt loop around the Sĺňava Reservoir
Two-person relay on the same course
Children’s races for various age groups
additional: Registration and race-number pickup take place on race day from 9:30 to 10:45 at the start venue; relay registration closes at 10:30. Men’s age categories are divided by age, while women compete without age divisions. The children’s races start after the main category has set off. Free children’s races are also on the programme.

name: Trnava Run
location: Atletický areál Slávia Trnava, Trnava, Slovakia

name: Vajnorský minimaratón
description: The Vajnory Mini-Marathon is a traditional autumn road race in Bratislava-Vajnory, which includes the Slovak Championships in the 5 km road race for men and women. Runners can choose between the 5 km and 10 km races or children’s races for the youngest participants. The event takes place in the pleasant surroundings of Park pod lipami, where a lively sporting atmosphere filled with music and excitement awaits. Every participant receives an original medal and has a chance to win prizes in a raffle.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km on paved roads in Park pod lipami
Course certified by the Slovak Athletics Federation
Slovak 5 km Road Championships
additional: Race bibs are distributed on race day from 10:30 to 13:45, and for the 10 km race until 14:45. Changing rooms, a bag storage area, toilets and refreshments are available on site. Wearing headphones during the race is prohibited for safety reasons. Children can register online or on site until 12:00; participation in the children’s races is free. The course has a time limit of 2 hours and is certified. The children’s races are free. Park pod lipami is accessible on foot, by public transport and by car; parking is available in the surrounding area.

name: Psotkov memorial
description: The Psotkov Memorial is a traditional mountain running race in the heart of the High Tatras, held near Štrbské Pleso. Runners can choose between two challenging courses: BASIC, 25.3 km long with 1,540 m of elevation gain, and EXTREME, 37.9 km long with 2,490 m of elevation gain. The route passes through picturesque mountain scenery, including a climb below the summit of Kriváň, a descent to Tri studničky, a stretch past Jamské pleso and through the Furkotská Valley, and a finish at Chata pod Soliskom. The race is part of the Skyrunner® National Series Slovakia and offers a unique experience of running in challenging mountain terrain.

name: Tajovský beh
description: Tajov Run is a running event featuring 6 km and 9 km trail courses, held in the village of Tajov near the Municipal Office. The races offer challenging terrain suited to trail-running enthusiasts. The start is scheduled for Saturday, 9 October 2027, at 10:10. The event is organized by the Tajov Run civic association (Tajovský beh, o.z.) and is suitable for recreational runners and endurance athletes.
course_highlights: 6 km and 9 km trail courses
Mostly field tracks, surfaced hiking trails, and forest roads
Refreshments along the course
additional: The participant limit for the courses is 550. The minimum age for the recreational course (6 km) is 13; for the endurance course (9 km), it is 16. Poles and running with a dog are prohibited on the course. The results announcement and award ceremony take place at 12:00. Changing facilities and bag storage are available at the Tajov Fire Station. The changing room is supervised. The event capacity is 550 participants. Running with poles or with a dog is not permitted on the courses.

name: BIOBEH Vinohradmi Veľký Krtíš
location: Veľký Krtíš, Okres Veľký Krtíš, Banskobystrický kraj, Slovakia
organizer: Grand centrum o.z. Veľký Krtíš, VÍNO NATURAL Domin & Kušický
description: BIOBEH Vinohradmi Veľký Krtíš is a running event held among the beautiful vineyards of Veľký Krtíš. The event offers a range of disciplines, including children’s races, 4 km and 7 km trail runs, Nordic walking, MTB cycling and a duathlon. The course runs over grass, meadows, and field and forest roads, with refreshment stations at the start and finish. The event is part of the Krtíš Running League and is organized by Grand centrum o.z. Veľký Krtíš together with the Domin & Kušický winery.
course_highlights: The course runs over grass, meadows, and field and forest roads
Refreshment stations at the start and at the entrance to the second vineyard
A range of disciplines, including trail running, Nordic walking, MTB cycling and a duathlon
additional: Check-in and race-number collection take place at Poľná 5 in Veľký Krtíš, in front of the entrance to the Domin & Kušický winery grounds, no later than 30 minutes before the start of the participant’s category. Children receive a finisher’s medal and a pack with a sweet treat, a drink and an apple. On-site registration is available for the main race, Nordic walking, the duathlon and MTB cycling. In addition to the runs, the event includes 7 km Nordic walking, 15 km MTB cycling, a 22 km duathlon and children’s races.

name: Beh na Muránsky hrad
location: Main entrance gate of Muránsky hrad, Muráň, Slovakia
organizer: Obec Muráň, Občianske združenie Vyšší level a Správa Národného parku Muránska planina
description: The Run to Muráň Castle is a 4 km mountain cross-country race with 550 metres of elevation gain. The route runs mostly along forest trails, with a small section on an asphalt road. The race takes place by the main entrance gate of Muráň Castle in Muráň and is open to various age categories for men and women. It is organised by the Municipality of Muráň, the Vyšší level civic association and the Muránska planina National Park Administration. Refreshments are provided along the course and at the finish. After the race, participants receive a medal, lunch and a race pack. The first three finishers in each category receive a trophy, a diploma and prizes.
course_highlights: 4 km cross-country race with 550 m of elevation gain
90% forest trails, 10% asphalt road
Start and finish by the main entrance gate of Muráň Castle
additional: Registration and collection of race numbers and chips take place at the Muráň Primary and Nursery School grounds from 8:30 to 9:30. Changing rooms and showers are available at the school. Parking is available around the school, approximately 100 m from the grounds. The entry fee includes a participant medal, lunch and refreshments.

name: Štefánik urban trail
description: Štefánik Urban Trail is an ultramarathon running race in Bratislava, covering 51 km with 1,574 metres of elevation gain. The course runs mainly on trails (65%) and asphalt roads (35%), with three aid stations at key points. The race has a time limit of 10 hours and 30 minutes and requires mandatory gear, including a headlamp, which is checked after dark. Runners can also compete in relay teams of 2 or 4, with categories divided by gender and mixed teams. The event is organised by URBAN SERVICES, s.r.o. and O.Z. VESTIGIUM, and starts at OC Eurovea in Bratislava.
course_highlights: A 51 km course with 1,574 m of elevation gain
65% trail and 35% asphalt surface
Three aid stations at kilometres 12, 23 and 37
additional: Mandatory gear includes a race bib worn visibly, a fully charged mobile phone, an emergency thermal blanket, a personal cup and a headlamp, which is checked on the course from 17:30. Relay teams may have 2 or 4 members; a 3-member team may also enter the 4-person relay. The time limit is 10 hours and 30 minutes, with intermediate times at three checkpoints. The finish and event facilities are located by OC Eurovea, beneath the statue of M. R. Štefánik. Relay teams can choose between formats with two or four runners.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Gajary
location: Gajary, Malacky District, Bratislava Region, Slovakia

name: Beh od hradu k hradu
location: Lesopark Brezina near Hotel Veverica, Trenčín, Slovakia
description: The Run from Castle to Castle is a running event connecting the historic castles of Beckov and Trenčín. The course passes through picturesque countryside and offers a challenge for runners of various levels. The event is organized by the civic association Sportkemp o.z., which provides quality organization and refreshments at several checkpoints. The race is suitable for anyone who wants to push their limits and experience the unique atmosphere of a running event in the Trenčín Region.
course_highlights: The course runs between Beckov and Trenčín castles
Refreshment stations at 9 km, 14 km, 21 km, 26 km and 30 km, offering fruit, isotonic drinks, water and non-alcoholic beer
Results are timed using an app, with two intermediate timing points in Selce and Soblahov
additional: Registration opens 1 hour before the start and closes 15 minutes before the race begins. Participants must carry their health insurance card. Runners’ belongings are transported to the finish. The finish time limit is 3:30 hours; the limit at the first timing point in Soblahov is 2:30 hours, and in Selce it is 1:25 hours. Results are published live on vysledkovyservis.sk via a QR code on the race bib. The entry fee includes transport to the start and transport of belongings to the finish. Individual course sections are also available.

name: Kros Českým rájem
description: Kros Českým rájem je trailový běh v malebném a málo známém koutě Českého ráje, který nabízí pestrou a členitou trasu vedoucí mezi pískovcovými skalami, lesními pěšinkami a cestami s bílým pískem. Závod je 100% trail a je vhodný pro milovníky přírody a technických běhů. Start a cíl jsou v obci Skokovy, která je dostupná z Prahy za necelou hodinu. Součástí závodního dne jsou také dětské závody a doprovodný program včetně dětského koutku.

name: Podzimní Kiosk
description: Podzimní Kiosk je krosový závod konaný v Tyršových sadech v Šternberku, který nabízí mužům trať dlouhou 7 km a ženám 3,5 km. Závod je součástí Velké ceny vytrvalců Olomouckého kraje a přináší běžcům možnost poměřit síly v příjemném podzimním prostředí. Trať je vedena smíšeným terénem, což zaručuje zajímavý a dynamický běh pro všechny účastníky.

name: Běh Zlínem "Přes valašské kotáry"
description: Běh Zlínem "Přes valašské kotáry" je tradiční běžecký závod konaný ve Zlíně, který nabízí běžcům možnost prožít krásy valašské krajiny a zároveň si užít sportovní atmosféru. Závod startuje na stadionu Mládeže a trasa vede malebnými kopci a přírodními scenériemi. Pořadatelé kladou důraz na kvalitní organizaci a přátelskou atmosféru pro všechny účastníky. Závod je součástí celoročního seriálu Běhy Zlín, který zahrnuje různé běžecké akce v regionu.

name: PREFA Brněnská 25
organizer: BehejBrno.com, MARATON BRNO z.s., Aleš Čtvrtníček
description: PREFA Brněnská 25 je tradiční silniční závod konaný v Brně a okolí, který se běží nepřetržitě od roku 1967. Nabízí různé délky tratí - 25 km, 16 km, 8 km a štafety - a je určen široké veřejnosti od výkonnostních běžců po začátečníky. Závod se koná v areálu Olympia park u lanového centra v Modřicích a je součástí Českého běžeckého klubu. Start první kategorie je v 11:00, což umožňuje pohodlnou účast i rodinám a rekreačním běžcům.

name: Horokros
description: Horokros je součástí seriálu Chlapácký běh, který nabízí náročný krosový závod v malebném prostředí Jeseníků u Šumperka. Závod je určen pro běžce, kteří hledají výzvu v terénu s různorodým povrchem a přírodními překážkami. Trasa je známá svou obtížností a krásnými výhledy, což přitahuje jak zkušené závodníky, tak i nadšence do horského běhu. Seriál Chlapácký běh oceňuje pravidelné účastníky, kteří absolvují minimálně šest závodů v ročníku. Přijďte si užít sportovní atmosféru a překonat své limity v jedinečném prostředí Jeseníků.

name: Běh na Žaltman
description: Běh na Žaltman je veřejný závod v běhu do vrchu s hromadným startem, který je součástí seriálu Krakonoš Český pohár v bězích do vrchu a Velké ceny Východních Čech. Závod se koná v Malých Svatoňovicích v Královéhradeckém kraji a nabízí sportovní výzvu v krásné přírodě. Trasa závodu vede náročným terénem s převýšením, což přitahuje běžce všech úrovní. Akce je tradiční součástí běžecké sezóny a vítá všechny sportovce i fanoušky běhu do vrchu.

name: Běh okolo Rané
description: Běh okolo Rané je závod vedený okolím Rané u Loun v Ústeckém kraji, který nabízí mužům trať dlouhou 8,5 km a ženám 4,25 km. Závod je součástí Lounského běžeckého poháru a přináší běžcům příležitost užít si běh v přírodním prostředí s malebnými výhledy. Akce je vhodná pro širokou běžeckou veřejnost, která hledá kvalitní závod s tradicí v regionu.

name: Běh pro republiku
description: Běh pro republiku je každoroční běžecká akce konaná v okolí Památníku Vojna u Příbrami, která připomíná vznik Československé republiky a osudy politických vězňů. Trasa vede po lesních a polních cestách s asfaltovým a kamenitým povrchem, a účastníci si připomínají významné osobnosti boje za svobodu a demokracii. Akce je pořádána pod záštitou prezidenta republiky Petra Pavla a nabízí závody pro dospělé i děti, stejně jako procházky a nordic walking. Součástí programu jsou také prohlídky Památníku Vojna a další doprovodné aktivity.
course_highlights: Trasa dlouhá 5 km vede od Památníku Vojna přes Žežice a Lešetice zpět k Památníku Vojna
Povrch trasy zahrnuje asfalt, zem s kameny, lesní a polní cesty
Běh probíhá za běžného automobilového provozu, trasa je vyznačena fáborky a sprejem
additional: Registrace probíhá online pro 5 km, dětský běh 200 m, procházku nordic walking a procházku se psy na 5 km.
