Parkování je možné před Památníkem Vojna nebo podél cest, doporučuje se příjezd na kole. Občerstvení a voda jsou k dispozici v cíli závodu. V prostoru startu a cíle je přítomen dobrovolník s lékárničkou. Prohlídky Památníku Vojna a doprovodný program probíhají každou celou hodinu do 16:00. Památník Vojna se nachází v Lešeticích u Milína.

name: Herberts Bremserlauf mit dem TSV Zornheim
description: The Herberts Bremserlauf with TSV Zornheim is a local road race in Zornheim. With 2 km and 10 km distances, it offers a club and community race format that differs from stadium events. It is part of the Wingertscup series in the Mainz region and is open to children, school-age runners, youth, adults, masters, and recreational runners. Changing facilities and showers are available at the nearby Hans-Steib-Halle. On-site registration is possible, but costs a small additional fee.
course_highlights: Road race in a club and community race format
Part of the Wingertscup series in the Mainz region
Start and meeting point at Herberts Kulturscheune
additional: On-site registration is possible for a small additional fee. Changing rooms and showers are located at the Hans-Steib-Halle at Zum Neuen Sportplatz. Typical October weather is around 14 °C, with a low of 6 °C; it is mostly cloudy, with an average of 40 mm of precipitation. On-site registration is available, and facilities such as changing rooms and showers are at the Hans-Steib-Halle.

name: Burscheider Stadtlauf
location: Burscheid, Rheinisch-Bergischer Kreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Burscheid City Run takes place in the center of Burscheid and offers runners of all ability levels an ideal setting. There are several distances: the 10-kilometer main race, a 3-kilometer race, and an 800-meter race that serves as a qualification for the Sports Badge. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere and is aimed at both competitive runners and recreational athletes. All finishers receive the traditional Kretzer City Run bread, and the top finishers are awarded special trophies.
course_highlights: 10-kilometer main race through the city center
3-kilometer race for recreational athletes
800-meter youth race as a Sports Badge qualification
additional: Late entries are possible at the registration office on race day for an additional fee of €5.00, but late entrants will not receive Kretzer City Run bread. Race packets will be available from 10:30 a.m. at the Protestant church. Changing rooms and showers are available at the “Auf dem Schulberg” sports hall. Free drinks are available along the course and at the finish. Age-group rankings follow DLO regulations. First aid is provided by the German Red Cross, Burscheid branch. Race numbers must be worn on the chest. The event also includes children’s races, race packets available from 10:30 a.m., online results, age-group rankings, medals, and trophies. October weather is usually mild, making participation pleasant.

name: Laubacher Ramsberglauf
price_range: bis 20. September vergünstigtes Startgeld, danach zzgl. Nachmeldegebühr
description: The Laubach Ramsberg Run is a traditional running event that starts and finishes in the picturesque castle park in Laubach. The event offers various distances for different age and ability groups, including a 10 km main race, a 5 km fun run, and races for schoolchildren and Bambini. The races feature a varied course through the beautiful countryside around Laubach. The organizers provide a welcoming atmosphere, with refreshments, changing facilities, and an awards ceremony right in the castle park.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Laubach Castle Park
A varied course through the countryside around Laubach
Refreshments and changing facilities at the Sports and Cultural Hall
additional: Registration is via RACERESULT, with a reduced entry fee available until 20 September; a late registration fee applies thereafter. Changing and shower facilities are available at the Sports and Cultural Hall. The awards ceremony takes place right in the castle park. Distances: 10 km main race, 5 km fun run, children’s races over 1500 m and 300 m; registration via Raceresult; start and finish in the castle park; refreshments, changing and shower facilities on site; October weather: approx. 14°C, cloudy

name: Offenbacher Mainuferlauf
description: The Offenbach Main Riverside Run is an open running event held annually along the Main River in Offenbach. Races are offered over 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon, as well as a 2 km schoolchildren’s run. The course follows the Main and offers an attractive riverside setting. In 2025, short-notice course changes were made due to construction work. The event is open to all runners; club membership is not required. It has a family-friendly atmosphere and a dedicated organizing team.
course_highlights: Run along the Main with attractive riverside scenery
Distances of 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon
Separate 2 km schoolchildren’s run
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Mathildenschule Offenbach, Arthur-Zitscher-Str. Parking is recommended at the Innenstadt car park on Berliner Straße (about 750 m away; fee of approximately €1 per hour). Due to construction work, Mainstraße is closed, resulting in short-notice course changes. This year’s course is not eligible for record purposes because official measurement was not possible. The half-marathon starts about 350 m from the previous start location. The 5 km and 10 km races start by the Main at the finish arch. The 2 km schoolchildren’s run starts by the Main as usual. Event photos are provided by Team Ingo Kutsche. Course changes due to construction work; course not eligible for record purposes; registration opens on 1.8.2025; weather-dependent conditions; various race distances

name: Styrumer Straßenlauf "Rund um die Neustadtstraße"
location: Neustadtstraße, Mülheim an der Ruhr, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
distance_verbose: 25 km, Halbmarathon, 20 km, 15 km, 10 km, 7.5 km, 5 km, 1 km
description: The Styrum Road Race “Around Neustadtstraße” is a traditional road race in Mülheim an der Ruhr, centered on Neustadtstraße in Styrum. The event offers various distances from 1 km to 100 km, including 5 km, 7.5 km, 10 km, 15 km, 20 km, 25 km, a half marathon and 50 km. The courses are officially measured and listed in the laufen.de race calendar, making participation in the German rankings possible. The race is held in accordance with the rules and safety standards of the German Athletics Association (DLV).
course_highlights: Officially measured road race courses
A range of distances from 1 km to 100 km
Event on Neustadtstraße in Styrum
additional: Typical October weather: approx. 14 °C, low of 6 °C, average precipitation of 40 mm, mostly cloudy. The event also includes shorter distances such as 5 km, 7.5 km, 10 km, 15 km, 20 km and 25 km, as well as special races for children and young people. The course runs along Neustadtstraße and through Sportpark Styrum, in cool October weather averaging 14°C. The event is listed in the official race calendar and meets the standards of the German Athletics Association.

name: Biberacher Genießerlauf
location: Biberach an der Riß, Baden-Württemberg, Germany

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Teilnahmegebühr 28 EUR. Incl. der Option, eines der Funktionsshirts für nur 3 EUR zu erwerben – gültig für die ersten 150 Anmeldungen.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Kreissparkasse Biberach Staffellauf 36 EUR BKK VerbundPlus Halbmarathon: Teilnahmegebühr 28 EUR. Incl. der Option, eines der Funktionsshirts für nur 3 EUR zu erwerben – gültig für die ersten 75 Anmeldungen.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: REWE Engel Genuss Walk: 15 EUR BKK VerbundPlus Halbmarathon: Teilnahmegebühr 28 EUR. Incl. der Option, eines der Funktionsshirts für nur 3 EUR zu erwerben – gültig für die ersten 40 Anmeldungen.

description: The Biberach Genießerlauf offers a scenic running event in the heart of Upper Swabia, with the start and finish on the historic Biberach Market Square. Participants can choose between the BKK VerbundPlus Half Marathon, the 2 x 8 km Kreissparkasse Biberach Relay, and the 6 km REWE Engel Genuss Walk. The route follows paved paths as well as firm forest and field paths, with wonderful views, including the Bussen, Upper Swabia’s holy mountain, and, in good weather, even the Alps. Excellent refreshments are provided along the route and at the finish, where finishers can also look forward to a glass of Prosecco.
course_highlights: Half marathon with a flat start, a climb from km 5, and wonderful views of the Allgäu
2 x 8 km relay with the baton handover in Biberach city centre
6 km Genuss Walk along beautiful paths in the Wolfental, with or without poles
additional: Race bibs can be collected on Saturday, 17 October, from 17:00 to 19:00 at the Stadthalle Biberach. Generous refreshments are provided along the route and at the finish, including a glass of Prosecco for finishers. Technical shirts can be purchased online or when collecting race bibs (while stocks last). On-site late registration is possible if places are available. Race entries can be transferred to another person free of charge. Age categories follow DLV guidelines. Certificates and prizes are awarded for age-group winners and the fastest participants/teams. Course on asphalt and forest paths; refreshments along the route and at the finish; registration online and on site; no shirts for corporate registrations; race bib collection at the Stadthalle.

name: Hambacher Herbstwaldlauf
description: The Hambach Autumn Forest Run is a long-standing race in Niederzier-Hambach, held annually in autumn. In autumn weather, runners enjoy the beautiful atmosphere and the forest’s vivid colors. Around 200 participants compete in various age groups and distances. The event is organized by DJK "Löwe" Hambach e.V. and offers a friendly, sporty atmosphere for recreational runners and competitive athletes.
course_highlights: Run through the autumn forest, surrounded by colorful foliage
A variety of distances for children, teenagers, and adults
A traditional event with a friendly club atmosphere
additional: The event attracts around 200 runners. Results from the previous year are available online, along with certificate printing. The website provides no explicit information about start times, pricing tiers, or registration options.

name: Lauf der 39. Crosslauf-Serie Cochem-Zell 2026 in Bremm
description: The 39th Cochem-Zell Cross-Country Series race in Bremm is an exciting running event in the picturesque Moselle wine region. The cross-country routes, ranging from 1 km to 8 km, follow uneven, natural trails through mud, meadows, and woodland. These challenging routes require sure footing, strength, and coordination, offering runners an authentic cross-country experience away from paved roads. The event is ideal for anyone looking to test their winter fitness and enjoy nature.
course_highlights: Run through the Moselle wine region
Rugged, uneven trails through mud, meadows, and woodland
Distances from 1 km to 8 km, with challenging sections
additional: The cross-country series is part of the popular running events in the Cochem-Zell district. The course is a test of winter fitness and offers a genuine cross-country feel on natural trails. Cross-country running, 1 km to 8 km, uneven trails, trail running in a wine region, registration presumably required

name: Naturpark Schönbuchlauf Hildrizhausen
description: The Naturpark Schönbuchlauf in Hildrizhausen is a traditional autumn race with a long history, taking place for the 51st time. The event offers distances from 5 km to 50 km, including the popular 25 km Naturpark Schönbuchlauf and the challenging 50 km Schönbuch-Ultra. The races pass through the scenic Schönbuch region, an ideal area for running with well-marked courses. The event welcomes runners of all abilities, from beginners to experienced ultrarunners, and also offers children’s races. The running group of TSV Hildrizhausen organizes the race with great dedication and looks forward to welcoming many participants.
course_highlights: Scenic routes through Schönbuch Nature Park
Well-marked routes with spray-painted arrows and direction signs at critical points
A variety of distances from 5 km to 50 km, including an ultramarathon
additional: The event center is at Schönbuchhalle, which opens at 08:00 on race day. The awards ceremonies are also held there. The courses are marked throughout with spray-painted arrows, with direction signs at critical points. Children’s races (approx. 1,000 m and 2.5 km) and a 5 km junior race are available. The event is part of the Schönbuch-Cup, with standings for various races. Distances: 5 km, 10 km, 25 km, 50 km; online registration available; parking and public transport available; changing rooms, showers, and refreshments at Schönbuchhalle.

name: Rottweiler Volksbanklauf 2026
description: The 13th Rottweil Volksbank Run is a varied running event in Rottweil, offering both children’s and youth races and a challenging main race over 10.12 km on a rolling circuit. The course consists of 1.3 km laps with 108 m of elevation gain, featuring repeated hills that challenge runners. There are also relay races over 10.1 km for teams of 3 to 8 participants. The event is more of a local running day, with a varied program for all age groups.
course_highlights: Main race over 10.12 km on a rolling circuit
1.3 km lap with 108 m of elevation gain
Relay races for teams of 3 to 8 runners
additional: Children’s and youth races over 300 m, 600 m and 1.3 km are part of the program. Typical October weather: approx. 14 °C high, 6 °C low, mostly cloudy, with an average of 40 mm of precipitation. Races for children and young people; local event; varied course with 108 m of elevation gain per lap.

name: Salacher Löwenlauf
description: The Salacher Löwenlauf is a running and Nordic walking event in Salach, Germany. The courses cover 500 meters for children, 2 kilometers for teenagers, 6 kilometers for fitness runners and Nordic walkers, and 10 kilometers for experienced runners. The course is hilly but well suited to beginners, and all races finish on Baumgartenstraße near the Stauferlandhalle. The event is organized by TSG Salach, which also highlights the connection to the Stauferland region in the Nordic walking race.
course_highlights: Hilly course profile, not a flat sprint
Finish on Baumgartenstraße near the Stauferlandhalle
A range of distances for children, teenagers, and adults
additional: Start times are planned around midday. There are special races for children (500 m Bambini Löwenlauf) and teenagers (2 km Jugend-Löwenlauf). The event also includes a 6 km Nordic walking race. October weather is typically around 14 °C, with occasional rain and mostly cloudy skies. The event also includes Nordic walking and is aimed at all age groups. It is recommended that participants check the details with the organizer before registering.

name: Traditioneller Sparkassen-Herbstwaldlauf
location: Sportzentrum Harberstadion Neubeckum, Beckum, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Traditional Sparkasse Autumn Forest Run in Beckum is a popular running event held at the Harberstadion sports center in Neubeckum. The event offers various races for all age groups, including a Bambini run, a student race, a 5 km fun run, 5 km walking, and the 10 km main race. Participants receive medals, certificates, and trophies, making the event a motivating experience for recreational and competitive runners. Late entries are possible until about 30 minutes before the start, offering flexibility for last-minute entrants.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Harberstadion sports center in Neubeckum
Races for all age groups, from Bambini to the main race
Trophies for the fastest runners and certificates for all participants
additional: Late entries are possible on the event day until approximately 30 minutes before the start, for a late-entry fee of €2. All participants in the Bambini and student races receive medals; participants in the 5 km fun run and 5 km walking receive certificates; and the top three runners in the 10 km main race receive trophies, while all participants receive certificates. Forest running event; registration and results on the website.

name: Weißenhorner Altstadtlauf
description: The Weißenhorn Old Town Run is a traditional race held every year in October in the historic old town of Weißenhorn. The event is organized by TSV Weißenhorn and gives runners of all ages the opportunity to take part in a friendly, sporting atmosphere. The race is known for its varied course through the picturesque old town and is suitable for both competitive and recreational runners. Enjoyment of running and community are at the heart of the event.
course_highlights: Course through the historic old town of Weißenhorn
Varied terrain with views of the town
Traditional event in October
additional: The race is organized by TSV Weißenhorn, which also offers other athletics training groups and events. The athletics department meets regularly for training, and the Old Town Run is an annual highlight in October. The event takes place at the TSV hall and in the old town. It is held every year, with various races for all age groups. Registration is usually through Race Result, and the results are publicly available. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and support from the local community.

name: Oldenburg Marathon
price_range: 35 Euro für Sportshirt (genaue Startgebühr nicht spezifiziert)
description: The Oldenburg Marathon offers runners a varied programme featuring a marathon, half marathon, half-marathon relay, 10 km city run, 5 km run and children’s mile run. The course passes through Oldenburg and Wardenburg and is known for its excellent refreshments and friendly atmosphere. The event welcomes runners of all ability levels and also offers a public race series with additional events throughout the year. Participants receive high-quality long-sleeved shirts, and extensive services are available on site.
course_highlights: Refreshment stations every 5 km on courses of 10 km or longer, offering water, sports drinks and fruit
Showers at the sports hall of Graf Anton Günther School, approximately 300 m from the start/finish area
Changing facilities and baggage drop-off on Parking Deck 1 at Schlosshöfe
additional: Race packs will be available at Schlosshöfe from 11 a.m. on 11 October. On race day, collection opens at 7 a.m. for marathon runners and at 8 a.m. for everyone else. Group registration is available. After the race, extensive refreshments will be provided, including drinks, fruit, coffee, tea, pastries and non-alcoholic wheat beer. Physiotherapy students will offer free massages. Portable toilets and changing facilities are available. Several race distances; start in Wardenburg; road closures in the city centre; medals for finishers; online registration available.

name: 20. Müggelsee-Halbmarathon
description: The Müggelsee Half Marathon is a scenic race in southeast Berlin that runs entirely around the Großer Müggelsee. The event offers three distances: a half marathon, 10 kilometers, and 5 kilometers, each set up as either an out-and-back course or a loop. The route passes through the historic Spree Tunnel and offers idyllic views of Berlin’s largest lake and the surrounding Müggelberge. The race is suitable for all runners, whether they are aiming for personal bests or simply want to enjoy the community and nature. The start and finish are at Müggelseeperle, and the race takes place.

name: Almetal-Marathon
description: The Almetal Marathon 2026 takes place on October 18 and offers runners a scenic route from Büren-Ringelstein to Ahorn-Sportpark in Paderborn. Alongside the classic marathon distance, there are two half-marathon options and a relay race covering four stages. The event is shaped by the volunteer commitment of numerous sports clubs and offers a family-friendly atmosphere and an impressive experience of nature in the Alme Valley.

name: Ditzinger Keltenlauf
description: The Celtic Run in Ditzingen-Hirschlanden is a versatile race for all ages, with distances of 12 km, 6 km, 1.5 km, and 800 m. The course passes through the scenic Strohgäu region and by significant archaeological monuments such as the Celtic Warrior and the Celtic woman’s grave. The races take place at the Seehansen Sports and Leisure Center and offer suitable events for adults, schoolchildren, and Bambinis. The event takes place in all weather and uses modern RFID timing.

name: Döbraberg Dr. Heinz Laubmann Gedächtnis Lauf
description: The Döbraberg Dr. Heinz Laubmann Memorial Run is a traditional group run that starts in Hof and takes participants along the Webersteig to the Döbraberg, the highest point in the Frankenwald. The event takes place in October and offers distances of 8.5 km, 14.5 km and 23 km, as well as 8.5 km walking and Nordic walking routes. The shorter adult runs are untimed, with the focus on reaching the summit together. The route is hilly and challenging, with a structured format in which pacemakers set the pace and overtaking is not permitted. The run was established in 1968 in honour of Dr. Heinz Laubmann, founder of the IfL clubs.

name: Gosheimer Lemberglauf
description: The Gosheim Lemberg Run is a traditional race starting in the town center by the Kreissparkasse, with the finish on the Lemberg or at the Jura School. The event is part of the Silberdistel Alb Cup and offers individual and club rankings, as well as a ranking for participation in all races. There are various race distances, including children’s and Bambini races, which start at 12:00, while the other races begin at 12:45. Participants receive prizes for places 1 to 3 and certificates for all runners.
course_highlights: Start by the Kreissparkasse in the town center
Finish on the Lemberg; clothing transport is available
Part of the Silberdistel Alb Cup, with overall and club rankings
additional: Late registration is possible at the Jura Hall in Gosheim until 30 minutes before the respective start, subject to a late-registration fee. There are children’s and Bambini races, as well as other races with different start times. Prizes are awarded for places 1 to 3, and all participants receive a certificate.

name: Hubertuslauf
description: The Hubertuslauf in Neuruppin is a traditional running event organized by the Ostprignitz-Ruppin District Sports Association. It offers 8 km and 15 km races, a 3 km company run, and an 8 km walking event. The event is open to athletes of all ability levels and takes place annually. The course runs through the scenic surroundings of Neuruppin, offering runners and walkers an enjoyable and varied experience.
course_highlights: 8 km and 15 km races
3 km company run
8 km walking event

name: Kauferinger Stauseelauf
description: The Kaufering Reservoir Run is a running event in Kaufering offering several distances, including a half marathon and shorter routes of 0.4 km, 0.8 km and 8.2 km. The event attracts runners from the region and features a varied course around the reservoir. The atmosphere is family-friendly, making it suitable for runners of all ages and ability levels. Results and photos from previous years are available on the website, highlighting the race’s tradition and popularity.

name: Müngstener Brückenlauf
description: The Müngstener Brückenlauf is a traditional race in Solingen that passes through scenic landscapes. The course starts on the narrow Schäfchenweg and features one final climb before the finish, passing meadows and fields. The race is organized by Solinger Leichtathletik-Club 1951 e.V. and attracts runners from the region.

name: Spannrit Volks- und Straßenlauf TSG Kleinostheim
description: The Spannrit Volks- und Straßenlauf TSG Kleinostheim is a local road-running event in Kleinostheim, Germany, held at the Maingauhalle on Ludwigstraße. The event is organized by TSG Kleinostheim and offers children’s and youth races as well as 5 km and 10 km races for adults. The adult course is flat and follows an out-and-back route, with all races finishing at the Maingauhalle. The event is being held for the 15th time and is listed in the German athletics calendar, underscoring its significance in organized club running.

name: 52.Maraton Dębno 2026
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Dębnie
description: The 52nd Dębno Marathon is the oldest and one of the fastest marathons in Poland. The 42.195 km course, certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA), runs through the streets of Dębno and the surrounding area, offering ideal conditions for personal bests. The event has a rich tradition dating back to 1966 and attracts both amateur and professional runners from Poland and abroad. Participants can expect professional organization, numerous refreshment stations, and enthusiastic support from spectators. The marathon is also an opportunity for the running community to come together and a celebration of sport for the whole family.

name: 12. PKO Półmaraton Gliwicki
description: The PKO Gliwice Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Gliwice since 2014. It has grown in popularity as a local initiative promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The half-marathon route runs through the city’s scenic streets, with the start and finish at PreZero Arena Gliwice. Participants have 3 hours to complete the distance and can expect professional event management and support along the route. The event is part of a larger health and sports festival that attracts runners of different ages and abilities.
course_highlights: Start and finish at PreZero Arena Gliwice
The route runs through the streets of Gliwice
The time limit for completing the half marathon is 3 hours
additional: The race office is located at PreZero Arena Gliwice. Race packs can be collected on the Saturday and Sunday before the race. Water and music points are available along the route. The event also includes the Health Festival and the Poho50 running races for different age groups. The time limit for completing the half-marathon distance is 3 hours from the start.

name: 10 Półmaraton Lubelski
description: The 10th Lubelski Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Lublin, attracting runners from across the region. The half-marathon course runs through the city streets, offering participants dynamic and fast sections. The event is part of Lublin’s running calendar for the 2026 season and is an excellent opportunity for sporting competition and bringing the running community together.
course_highlights: The course runs through the streets of Lublin
Dynamic and fast sections
Picturesque urban scenery
additional: The event is part of the 2026 Grand Prix of Lublin. Lublin’s running calendar features many events, and the half marathon is one of the season’s major races.

name: Wartko!... bez Gaszowice
description: WARTKO!... bez Gaszowice is an annual 10 km race organized by the Culture and Sports Centre in Gaszowice. The event attracts people who enjoy an active lifestyle and promotes sporting competition in scenic surroundings. The race takes place in October and is growing in popularity, offering participants professional organization and a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 10 km course
Scenic areas of Gaszowice
Professional timing
additional: Race packs can be collected at the race office in the Culture and Sports Centre. Open running and Nordic walking training sessions are also held on the WARTKO! course. Traffic disruptions may occur on race day.

name: XVII Półmaraton Ziemi Puckiej
description: The XVII Puck Region Half Marathon is a well-known running event in Pomerania, returning in a new format under the STONE TRI & RUN banner. Held in autumn, it offers a refreshed course and a unique atmosphere, serving as the final event in the Puck Running Triad. It’s an ideal opportunity to end the running season on a high note, competing in the half marathon or shorter races and Nordic walking events. The organizers provide participants with comprehensive information and support, including the event schedule, course maps, and baggage-drop areas.
course_highlights: Refreshed half-marathon course measuring 21.097 km
Autumn atmosphere and the final event in the Puck Running Triad
Additional 5 km race and 5 km Nordic walking event
additional: Race office open 15:00–20:00 and 7:00–9:00 on race day at MOKSiR Puck. Baggage drop available 8:00–13:00. Start times: half marathon 10:00, 5 km race 10:05, 5 km Nordic walking 10:07. For children: Mini Kids Run (approx. 400 m) and Mega Kids Run (approx. 800 m) after the half marathon. Winners’ awards ceremony at 13:00.

name: 40. Bieg Barbórkowy o Lampkę Górniczą – Sztafeta Międzyzakładowa
XII Otwarty Bieg Uliczny i Marsz Nordic Walking
Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 10. kolo
description: The Bratislava 2-Mile Run is a regular running competition over a distance of 2 miles (3.218 km), with categories for children, juniors, women, men, and veterans. The race takes place at Kuchajda in Bratislava and is organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team. The start is traditionally at 10:00, and the event also includes children’s races of approximately 200 meters. The Bratislava 2-Mile Run is part of a series of races held throughout the year, offering runners of various age groups and ability levels an opportunity to compete.

name: Challenge Airport Run
location: Prešov, Prešov, vojenská letecká základna v Prešove
organizer: Prešov Running, v spolupráci s Vojenskou leteckou základňou v Prešove
description: Challenge Airport Run is a unique running experience at the Military Air Base in Prešov, combining sport with the atmosphere of military training. Runners can choose between a 5 km and a 10 km course, with each participant carrying a symbolic weighted backpack, highlighting courage and endurance. The event offers an unforgettable atmosphere among helicopters and military equipment, which is rarely accessible to the public. In addition to the athletic challenge, it is also a tribute to discipline and strength, with a rich accompanying programme and original race packs.

name: Slaňaki CUP – Beh do vrchu Dubník
location: Zámutov okr. Vranov nad Topľou, Zámutov okr. Vranov nad Topľou, pred Obecným úradom
organizer: Klub otužilcov Vranovské Vydry, Obecný úrad Zámutov, Penzión Kondor Zámutov
description: Slaňaki CUP - Dubník Uphill Race is a traditional uphill race held in Zámutov, Vranov nad Topľou District. The course is 11.2 km long with 600 metres of elevation gain, and the finish is at Slovakia’s highest structure, the Dubník transmitter, at an altitude of 318 metres. The race is part of the Slovak Uphill Running Cup and is open to a broad range of male and female runners of various ages. It is organized by the Vranovské Vydry Winter Swimming Club, Zámutov Municipal Office, and Penzión Kondor Zámutov. The race challenges runners to test their endurance and strength on demanding mountain terrain.

name: Žipovská desiatka
description: The Žipovská desiatka is a traditional running race held in the village of Nižný Žipov, offering runners the chance to test themselves on a 10-kilometre course. The race is organised by the Municipality of Nižný Žipov and is part of the village’s sporting life. The course runs along local roads and streets, allowing runners to experience the atmosphere of the village and its surroundings. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle.
course_highlights: The route runs along Hlavná Street in Nižný Žipov
A 10 km race with an inline option
The atmosphere of a traditional village sporting event
additional: The event also includes an inline race on the same course. Race results are published on the municipality’s official website. The organiser is the Municipality of Nižný Žipov, which also provides other services and information for participants. In the previous edition, changing rooms were available in the cultural centre.

name: Beh okolo Dulova 2026
description: The Run Around Dulov is a traditional running race taking place for the 56th time in 2026. Runners can compete in various categories, including children’s, junior, women’s, and men’s. The course runs around the village of Dulov and offers athletes of all ages the chance to compete in a pleasant setting. The organizers provide convenient registration online and in person, and welcome all runners who want to experience the atmosphere of this event.
course_highlights: The main course is 5 km.
Runners can also choose the 2.5 km course.
Children’s categories have courses ranging from 75 m to 850 m.
additional: Registration on race day is available only in 2026; from 2027, it will no longer be available for any category. Children’s categories start from 10:00 to 11:20, and juniors, women, and men from 11:00 to 13:00. Runners over 70 do not pay an entry fee.

name: Trenčianská bežecká liga – 8. kolo
location: Námestie T. G. Masaryka, Trenčianske Teplice, Slovakia

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: klasické štartovné + Spojená škola internátna, Trenčín – dobrovoľný príspevok (štartovné sa platí priamo na mieste)

description: Trenčianska Running League – Round 8 is a running event in Trenčianske Teplice, offering a 9.72 km course combining paved and off-road sections. The start is at T. G. Masaryk Square, and the route passes the spa hall, pond, allotment garden colony and Baračka dam wall, then follows a forest road with a long climb to the blue educational trail. Runners can enjoy beautiful natural scenery and varied terrain. The race starts at 10:00, and registration opens at 9:00. The entry fee is paid on site.
course_highlights: A 9.72 km course with 30% paved and 70% off-road terrain
A climb along a forest road to the blue educational trail
Crossing the Baračka dam wall and passing the pond
additional: Registration takes place at the start venue from 9:00. Parking is available in the central car park for a fee of EUR 1.5 per hour. In previous editions, the race started at 10:00 and registration opened at 9:00; the entry fee was paid on site.

name: Bež, kto môžeš
description: Bež, kto môžeš is a charity run organized by Oáza Bernátovce, supporting people in extreme hardship and those experiencing homelessness. This running event has attracted many kind-hearted people and has a strong social focus, bringing sport together with support for disadvantaged groups. The run takes place in Košice - Barca and is part of a long-term project supporting socially excluded people. The organizers give the community an opportunity to get involved in helping others through sport and solidarity.
additional: The run is part of the DOMA SI ?! II. project, running from 08/2024 to 06/2027, which helps people facing long-term disadvantage and at risk of poverty and social exclusion.

name: Klánovický 1/2maraton
description: Klánovický 1/2maraton je terénní půlmaraton vedený krásným prostředím Klánovického lesa v Praze. Závod nabízí certifikovanou trať dlouhou 21,0975 km, která vede po lesních cestách, naučné stezce a stezkách s minimem asfaltu, bez výrazných stoupání. Součástí akce jsou také závody na 10 km, štafeta a dětské závody, vše s pohodlným zázemím a občerstvením na trati. Závod je vhodný pro milovníky přírody a terénního běhu, kteří chtějí poznat krásná zákoutí lesa a užít si přátelskou atmosféru s doprovodným programem.

name: Dvojmíľový beh 30. ročník, Memoriál Gabriela Zelenaya 5. ročník - preteky mládeže
organizer: ŠŠK Junior Prešov, Atletický klub TJ Slávia Prešovská univerzita a Olympijský klub Prešov
description: The Two-Mile Run – Gabriel Zelenay Memorial is a traditional youth event held in Prešov at the ZŠ Šmeralova 25 stadium. The races include children’s runs over distances from 300 to 1,000 metres, divided by age category. Athlete check-in begins at 15:00, and the races start at 15:45. The event is organised by ŠŠK Junior Prešov, Atletický klub TJ Slávia Prešovská univerzita, and Olympijský klub Prešov. Facilities are available in the school building, including changing rooms and restrooms.
course_highlights: Children’s runs over distances from 300 to 1,000 metres
Races divided by age categories, from birth years 2019 to 2011
Start and finish at the ZŠ Šmeralova 25 stadium in Prešov
additional: On-site registration is available. Entries had to be submitted by 16:00 on the preceding day; entries can no longer be changed or added on race day. Results are announced on an ongoing basis at 16:10 and 17:00. Athlete check-in takes place in the primary school building, where changing rooms and restrooms are available.

name: Loučení s oválem
description: Loučení s oválem je tradiční závod pořádaný Tělovýchovnou jednotou Slezan Frýdek-Místek, který se koná každoročně od roku 2000 jako poslední dráhový závod sezóny. Původně byl určen pouze mládeži, ale od roku 2014 se přidaly i dospělé kategorie s délkami 1500 m pro muže a 800 m pro ženy. Po přestávce v letech 2017 až 2019 byl závod obnoven v roce 2020 s tratěmi 800 m pro mládež a 3000 m pro dospělé. Závod se koná na adrese Na Příkopě 1159 ve Frýdku-Místku a je oblíbenou akcí atletické komunity v regionu.

name: COOL-BEACH-TRAIL Skihütte Bad Wildbad
location: Skihütte Bad Wildbad, 75323 Bad Wildbad, Germany

name: Beh k srdcu SNP
location: Atletický štadión pri Strednej odbornej škole polytechnickej, Ul. Čs. armády 24, Martin, Slovakia
organizer: Atletický klub Martin a Martinská tréningová akadémia

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 10 eur pri prihláške cez internet s kompletnými údajmi

description: The Beh k srdcu SNP is a traditional athletics race organized by Atletický klub Martin in cooperation with local partners. The race takes place on the 400-meter tartan track at the athletics stadium by the Secondary Vocational School of Polytechnics in Martin. Competitors are divided into several age categories with different race distances, including a one-hour run for adults and several shorter races for children and young people. The event is known for its long tradition and high-quality organization, and winners receive prizes in kind.
course_highlights: The course is on a 400-meter tartan athletics track
The one-hour run takes place under artificial lighting
Several age categories, from preschoolers to veterans
additional: Check-in for runners who registered in advance closes 30 minutes before the start. The race office opens at 14:45 in the stadium grounds. Registered members of Atletický klub Martin and young people born in 2007 or later are exempt from the entry fee. Winners in each category and the overall winners receive prizes in kind. In the one-hour run, the fastest man and woman from the Turiec region, based on permanent residence, are also awarded. The one-hour run takes place under artificial lighting.

name: Medziklubové preteky Jesenný kros ŠK Juventa Žilina
Mizuno Neon Run Olomouc
description: Mizuno Neon Run v Olomouci je noční běžecká akce plná barev, světel a zábavy, která není závodem, ale zážitkem pro všechny účastníky. Tento neonový běh nabízí divoký a šílený zářící zážitek, který oslavuje radost z pohybu a společné zábavy. Připravte se zazářit a užít si nezapomenutelnou atmosféru v areálu Výstaviště Flora v Olomouci.

name: Tálínská desítka
location: Náves před obecním úřadem, Tálín, Česko
organizer: Obec Tálín a Progres TT Tálín
description: Tálínská desítka je tradiční běžecký závod pořádaný v obci Tálín, který spojuje sportovce všech věkových kategorií v malebném prostředí obce. Závod je součástí sportovního kalendáře obce a podporuje komunitní život a sportovní vyžití místních obyvatel i návštěvníků. Akce je organizována ve spolupráci s místními sportovními oddíly, včetně Triatlon Team Tálín, a nabízí příležitost pro rekreační i závodní běžce. Start i cíl závodu jsou umístěny na návsi před obecním úřadem, což vytváří přátelskou atmosféru a snadnou dostupnost pro účastníky i diváky.
course_highlights: Start a cíl na návsi před obecním úřadem v Tálíně
Malebné prostředí obce Tálín vhodné pro běh
Akce vhodná pro všechny věkové kategorie včetně tělesně handicapovaných
additional: Závod je součástí sportovních akcí obce Tálín, které podporují komunitní život a jsou určeny pro širokou veřejnost včetně dětí, seniorů a tělesně handicapovaných. Pořádají jej místní sportovní oddíly Triatlon Team Tálín a Galaxy Cyklošvec Písek. V obci je také mobilní aplikace V OBRAZE pro sledování aktuálních informací.

name: Třebíčský maraton
description: Třebíčský maraton vás zve k běhu malebnými uličkami historického centra Třebíče, kde můžete obdivovat atmosféru UNESCO památek včetně ikonické Baziliky sv. Prokopa. Kromě maratonu si můžete vybrat i poloviční trasu půlmaratonu nebo kratší desítku, které také vedou přes historické a přírodní krásy města. Na trati i v cíli vás čekají občerstvovací stanice a po závodě příjemný relax s AfterRun party, která je ideálním zakončením sportovního dne. Pro rodiny jsou připraveny i dětské závody přímo v centru města s nezapomenutelnou atmosférou.
course_highlights: Malebné uličky historického centra Třebíče
Atmosféra UNESCO památek včetně Baziliky sv. Prokopa
Občerstvovací stanice na trati s příjemnou atmosférou
additional: Registrace a platba startovného musí být uhrazeny do 14 dnů od registrace, jinak je registrace zrušena. Po řádné online registraci je možné se registrovat i na místě, ale startovní balíčky jsou omezené. Po doběhu je připravena AfterRun party jako zakončení dne. Dětské závody probíhají přímo v centru města s živou atmosférou. Vypsané jsou maraton, půlmaraton, závod na 10 km a dětské závody. Ceny zveřejněné pro ročník 2026 nemusí platit pro rok 2027.

name: Slapy Trail Maniacs
description: Slapy Trail Maniacs je značený trailový závod v okolí Slapské přehrady, který nabízí tři náročné trasy o délce 61 km, 47 km a 33 km. Hlavní trať s převýšením 2300 metrů vede po cestách, pěšinkách, brodech, skalkách a srázcích, což zaručuje pestrý a technicky zajímavý běh. Na trati jsou dvě prémie - vrchařská a rychlostní, a závod je vhodný i pro získání ITRA bodů. Pro nejlepší běžce jsou připraveny medaile, diplomy, věcné ceny a prize money. Pořadatelem je Š&P Outdoor z.s., který zajišťuje kvalitní organizaci a podporu závodníků.
course_highlights: 61 km hlavní trať s převýšením 2300 m
trasy vedou po cestách, pěšinkách, brodech, skalkách a srázcích
na trati jsou vrchařská a rychlostní prémie
additional: Po absolvování tratí 61 km nebo 47 km lze získat ITRA body. Na nejrychlejší čekají medaile, diplomy, věcné ceny a prize money. Pořadatelem je Š&P Outdoor z.s., kontaktní osoba Ondřej Kutiš. Závod je značený a nabízí technicky náročný terén v okolí Slapské přehrady. Zázemí závodu je uváděno v Hořovické chatě v Boroticích.

name: Olomoucký kros
description: Olomoucký kros je tradiční běžecký závod pořádaný TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, který se koná v přírodním prostředí koupaliště Poděbrady v Olomouci. Tento závod je součástí Velké ceny vytrvalců Olomouckého kraje a nabízí sportovcům možnost vyzkoušet si kondiční a výkonnostní běh v krásné přírodní lokalitě. Liga stovkařů je známá svou dlouholetou tradicí a podporou běžecké komunity na střední Moravě. Závod je vhodný pro širokou veřejnost i závodníky s ambicemi, kteří chtějí poměřit své síly v terénním běhu.
course_highlights: Běh v přírodním prostředí koupaliště Poděbrady
Součást Velké ceny vytrvalců Olomouckého kraje
Terénní krosový závod s přírodními překážkami
additional: Dostupné informace o předchozích ročnících se týkají závodů dětí a mládeže; program ročníku 2027 není potvrzen.

name: Skalička run
location: Obecní hřiště, Skalička, Jihomoravský kraj, Česko
description: Skalička run je pětý ročník úspěšného terénního zážitkového běžeckého závodu, který vede převážně údolím potoka Lubě v Jihomoravském kraji. Závod nabízí tři tratě o délkách 22 km, 13 km a 7 km, které jsou charakteristické krosovým a trailovým terénem. Startuje se na obecním hřišti ve Skaličce a závod je vhodný pro milovníky přírodních běhů s různou náročností. Pořadatelem je spolek DálRunDál z.s. pod vedením Pavla Matouška.
course_highlights: Trať vede převážně údolím potoka Lubě
Krosový a trailový terén
Délky tratí 22 km, 13 km a 7 km
additional: Závod je pořádán spolkem DálRunDál z.s., kontaktní osoba Pavel Matoušek. Typ závodu je kros/trail. Start první kategorie je v 11:15. Start první kategorie je uveden v 11:15; místo startu je obecní hřiště.

name: Leskros Hradečák
location: Kemp Stříbrný rybník, Malšova Lhota, Hradec Králové, Česko
description: Leskros Hradečák je součástí největšího českého běžecko-canicrossového seriálu Leskros, který nabízí pravý trailový zážitek. Závod se koná v krásném prostředí kempu Stříbrný rybník v Malšově Lhotě u Hradce Králové a zahrnuje různé kategorie v běhu, canicrossu i unikátní závod Leskrosí jednadváca. Na své si přijdou jak jednotlivci, tak celé rodiny, včetně dětských běhů a charitativního pochodu. Seriál klade důraz na férovost, transparentnost a podporu neziskových organizací prostřednictvím startovného a darů.
course_highlights: Pravý trailový běh v zajímavých lokalitách po Česku
Canicross na hlavní trase cca 4 km s kategoriemi OPEN a ELITE
Unikátní Leskrosí jednadváca - 19 - 22 km po neznačené trase vedoucí krásnými místy okolí
additional: Závod nabízí kategorie běh, canicross i Leskrosí jednadváca. Dětský běžecký program Rozběháček je zdarma. Součástí je i charitativní pochod na 4 km. Výsledky jednotlivých závodů i celého seriálu jsou vyhlašovány. Registrace a přihlášky jsou spravovány přes aplikaci Rozběháme Česko. Pořadatelem je nezisková organizace Rozběháme Česko z.ú., která podporuje charitativní projekty. Pro ročník 2026 byl uveden start první kategorie v 8:00; tento čas nemusí platit pro ročník 2027.

name: KEEN Prague Park Race – Prokopské údolí
description: KEEN Prague Park Race - Prokopské údolí je tradiční podzimní běžecký závod v krásné přírodě Prokopského a Dalejského údolí v Praze. Nabízí dvě hlavní trasy o délce přibližně 8,7 a 14,3 km, které vedou po zpevněných i nezpevněných cestách, loukách a pěšinách s omezeným provozem na asfaltových silničkách. Závod je vhodný pro širokou veřejnost a doprovázen je pohodovou atmosférou s občerstvením a doprovodnými dětskými závody. Kapacita je omezena na 500 startujících, což zajišťuje komfortní průběh akce. Pořadatelé kladou důraz na kvalitní značení trasy a bezpečnost závodníků.
course_highlights: Trasy vedou krásnou a divokou přírodou Prokopského a Dalejského údolí
Dvě trasy o délce cca 8,7 km a 14,3 km s označením každého kilometru
Trasy kombinují zpevněné i nezpevněné cesty, louky, pěšiny a asfaltové silničky s omezeným provozem
additional: Prezentace a registrace probíhá v den závodu od 9:00 do 10:45. Start dětských závodů je od 10:00, hlavní závody startují v 10:45 (8 km) a 11:00 (14 km). Kapacita závodu je omezena na 500 startujících, registrace na místě možná za příplatek 600 Kč, pokud nebude kapacita naplněna. Na trase je jedna občerstvovací stanice. Čip pro měření času je připevněn na startovním čísle a po doběhu se nevrací. Doporučená obuv je trailová s hrubší podrážkou. V areálu je zajištěno WC, úschovna zavazadel, stany pro převlékání, vyhlášení výsledků a tombola. Údaje o tratích, ceně a času startu pocházejí z ročníku 2026.

name: Běhej Valachy
description: Běhej Valachy je závod v trail runningu po ostrých valašských kotárech v malebném údolí Velkých Karlovic. Trať vede údolím Hanzlůvky a kolem zvoničky Za Miloňovou na hřeben Vsetínských Beskyd, pod Vysokou a na Člověčí, odkud klesá po ostrém hřbítku s nádhernými výhledy na Beskydy i Javorníky. Závod nabízí jedinečné výhledy, náročné kopce a obrovský zážitek z pohybu a přírody. Součástí jsou také dětské závody různých věkových kategorií a rodinný závod.
course_highlights: Trať vede údolím Hanzlůvky a kolem zvoničky Za Miloňovou na hřeben Vsetínských Beskyd
Nádherné výhledy na Beskydy i Javorníky z ostrého hřbítku
Náročné stoupání kolem chalupy U Křenků a horská prémie na kótě 938 m.n.m.
additional: Závod má hromadné starty pro dospělé na 12,5 km, 6,5 km a rodinný závod 3,2 km. Dětské závody jsou rozděleny do kategorií podle věku od 4 do 15 let. Startovní prostor se otevírá v 11:45, prezence a registrace dětí probíhá od 8:00 do 9:15, prezence dospělých od 9:30 do 11:30. Cílová rovinka je atraktivní s dostatečným prostorem pro závěrečný sprint. Pořadatel si vyhrazuje právo na změnu časů v den závodu. Podle dostupných informací k ročníku 2026 jsou v nabídce tratě 12,5 km, 6,5 km a rodinný běh 3,2 km, vedle dětských závodů. Zázemí zahrnuje registraci, šatnu, sprchy a občerstvení; informace o cenách pro rok 2027 nejsou potvrzené.

name: Zlatý maraton Emila Zátopka Ostrava
description: Zlatý maraton Emila Zátopka Ostrava je prestižní běžecký závod, který nabízí maraton, půlmaraton, 10 km a týmový smíšený závod na rychlé, certifikované trati v Ostravě-Vítkovicích. Závod se koná na Městském stadionu Ostrava-Vítkovice, kde start i cíl jsou umístěny na oválu stadionu. Běžci mají možnost běžet ve stopách legendárního Emila Zátopka a zažít atmosféru profesionálního závodu s doprovodným programem a kvalitní organizací. Součástí startovního balíčku je originální funkční triko, medaile a občerstvení během i po závodě. Závod je vhodný pro všechny běžce, od začátečníků po zkušené sportovce.
course_highlights: Rychlá, certifikovaná trať v Ostravě-Vítkovicích
Start a cíl na oválu Městského stadionu
8 občerstvovacích stanic na maratonské trati s vodou, ovocem a energetickými doplňky
additional: Startovní číslo s čipem se umisťuje na prsa pro správné měření času. Maratonci absolvují po startu jedno kolo na oválu stadionu před výběhem na trať. Na trati jsou vodící vozidla a cyklisté pro první i poslední běžce. K dispozici jsou šatny, toalety a úschovna zavazadel v areálu stadionu. Parkování je možné u Ostravar Arény za poplatek nebo zdarma v omezeném rozsahu v okolních ulicích. Po závodě je k dispozici bohaté občerstvení, expo a fyzioterapeutická péče zdarma. Datum 23. října 2027 nebylo na oficiálním webu potvrzeno.

name: Moravská Sázava
location: Horský Resort Buková Hora, Červená Voda, Česko

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné ULTRA 50 je stanoveno na 1.000,- Kč

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné DVOJIC je stanoveno na 1.000,- Kč / člen dvojice

description: Moravská Sázava Ultra 50 je běžecký ultra závod na 50 km vedoucí údolími řeky Moravské Sázavy ze Zábřehu až na vrchol Bukové hory. Trať nabízí pestrou kombinaci lesních cest, přírodních stezek a asfaltových úseků s celkovým převýšením 1369 metrů. Závod je vhodný jak pro zkušené ultramaratonce, tak pro běžce hledající novou výzvu, a končí na vrcholu Bukové hory, odkud se závodníci pohodlně svezou lanovkou dolů. Po závodě je možné kempovat v cílovém areálu s možností sprch a snídaně v neděli ráno.
course_highlights: 50 km trať s převýšením 1369 m
Kombinace lesních cest, přírodních stezek a asfaltu
Cíl na vrcholu Bukové hory s možností sjezdu lanovkou
additional: Účastníci jsou vybaveni ID náramkem, startovním číslem a GPS lokátorem. Na trase jsou občerstvovací stanice s vodou, iontovými nápoji, CocaColou a ovocem. Po závodě je možné kempovat v cíli s přístupem ke sprchám. Cílový areál je na horní stanici lanové dráhy, kterou se závodníci mohou pohodlně sjet dolů. Výsledky se měří elektronicky i ručně, GPS lokátory jsou povinné a slouží ke sledování závodníků online. Závod je zařazen do UTMB Index 50K a ITRA 50K - 2. Zázemí závodu je v Horském Resortu Buková Hora.

name: NN Night Run Olomouc
description: NN Night Run Olomouc je největší běžeckou událostí v Olomouci, která se koná na Výstavišti Flora. Závod nabízí noční běh na 10 km, štafetu 2x5 km, charitativní běh na 5 km a rodinný běh na 3 km, včetně dětských závodů. Akce přináší nezapomenutelnou atmosféru, bohatý doprovodný program a podporu charitativních projektů. Každý účastník obdrží pamětní medaili a může si užít běh za svitu čelovek v nočním městě.
course_highlights: Noční běh městem Olomouc s atmosférou za svitu čelovek
Různé tratě od 300 m pro děti až po 10 km noční běh
Charitativní běh Bellis Run proti rakovině prsu
additional: Registrace a výdej startovních balíčků probíhá od 13:00 do 17:30 dle závodu. K dispozici je úschovna a šatny. Po závodě je možné využít doprovodný program včetně fotokoutku, malování na obličej, skákacího hradu, testování a prodeje běžeckého vybavení a doplňků výživy. Startovné je možné převést na jiného účastníka online nebo na místě za poplatek. V cíli obdrží všichni účastníci pamětní medaili. Zázemí závodu je na Výstavišti Flora. Online registrace končí 19. 10. 2026 v 18:00; registrace na místě závisí na volné kapacitě. Časový limit hlavního závodu je 90 minut.

name: Běh kolem Asuánu
location: Jižní konec retenční nádrže Asuán, Jinonice, Prague, Česko
description: Běh kolem Asuánu je tradiční krosový závod konaný na hrázi retenční nádrže Asuán v pražských Jinonicích. Nabízí tratě různých délek pro všechny věkové kategorie od nejmenších dětí až po dospělé, s mírně zvlněným terénem a přírodním povrchem, zakončeným asfaltovou cílovou rovinkou. Závod je přístupný pouze pěšky od několika blízkých autobusových zastávek a pořádá jej Atletika Stodůlky z.s. Startovní poplatek je dobrovolný, což umožňuje širokou účast běžců všech úrovní.
course_highlights: Mírně zvlněná trať s přírodním povrchem
Cílová rovinka na asfaltu
Start a závodní kancelář na hrázi retenční nádrže Asuán s přístupem pěšky
additional: Kategorie závodu jsou rozděleny podle věku s různými délkami tratí od 250 m pro nejmenší až po 3600 m pro muže. Start a závodní kancelář jsou umístěny na jižním konci retenční nádrže Asuán. Přístup je možný pouze pěšky od autobusových zastávek Ovčí hájek, Galerie Butovice a komplexu Volcano. Start a závodní kancelář jsou na jižním konci nádrže; přístup je pouze pěšky.

name: Běh do vrchu na Pastýřskou stěnu
location: Pastýřská stěna, Děčín, Ústecký kraj, Česko
description: Běh do vrchu na Pastýřskou stěnu je nejstarší běh do vrchu v České republice s převýšením 110 metrů. Závod nabízí extrémní stoupání ve druhé části trati, která vede po schodech, dlažbě a lesních cestách. Koná se v Děčíně a je vhodný pro běžce, kteří hledají náročný a technický běh do vrchu. Pořádá ho AK Loko Děčín pod vedením Zdeňka Hrnčíře.
course_highlights: Nejstarší běh do vrchu v ČR s převýšením 110 m
Extrémní stoupání ve druhé části trati
Povrch tvoří schody, dlažba a lesní cesty
additional: Start první kategorie je v 10:30, hlavní kategorie startuje v 11:00. Pořadatelem je AK Loko Děčín, kontaktní osoba Zdeněk Hrnčíř. Trať je krátká, 0,83 km dlouhá, s výrazným převýšením a technickým povrchem.

name: ENSINGER Laufcup
location: Vaihingen an der Enz, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Ensinger Laufcup offers runners of all ages and ability levels suitable distances in the beautiful Vaihingen an der Enz region. The event features a variety of races, from Bambini events to challenging trail courses of up to 24 kilometers and up to 700 meters of elevation gain. Runners can enjoy the diverse landscape of asphalt, gravel paths, and trails. The Laufcup is also part of a regional support program that helps schools and fosters community spirit.
course_highlights: A variety of courses from 550 m to 24 km, with up to 700 meters of elevation gain
A mix of asphalt, gravel forest paths, and trails
Start and finish area in front of the Ensinger Kelter, with good public transport connections
additional: All participants receive a medal at the finish. The event is part of the school support project of the Alison and Peter Klein Foundation, which covers entry fees and donates €5 to each finisher’s school. The start and finish area is at the square in front of the Ensinger Kelter on St. Veith-Straße. Parking is permitted only in designated areas; travel by public transport is recommended. Multiple race distances, trail and asphalt courses, and detailed course information are available.

name: Altendorf-Ersdorfer Obstmeilenlauf
description: The Altendorf-Ersdorf Orchard Mile Run is a traditional fun run that has taken place every year since 1995 on the last Saturday in October. The event offers races for all ages and ability levels, including the Little Orchard Mile (5.3 km), the Big Orchard Mile (9.6 km) and the Mega Mile (16 km). The course runs through the picturesque orchards of Altendorf-Ersdorf and is especially popular for the fresh apples at the finish and the fruit baskets awarded to the winners. There are also special children’s races over 400 m and 1,000 m. The run is a sociable event that combines running with nature and a sense of community.
course_highlights: Course through the orchards of Altendorf-Ersdorf
Three main distances: 5.3 km, 9.6 km and 16 km
Children’s races over 400 m and 1,000 m
additional: The event is always held on the last Saturday in October. The runners meet regularly for training in the Altendorf-Ersdorf Forest. The winners receive generously filled fruit baskets, and fresh apples are handed out at the finish. The event includes distances of 400 m, 1 km, 3.3 miles, 6 miles and 10 miles. It is a family-friendly event with children’s and toddler races, held annually in October in Meckenheim.

name: Helberhäuser HauBerg-Lauf
description: The Helberhäuser HauBerg-Lauf is a traditional race taking place for the 29th time. The event is organized by TSG Helberhausen and features an adjusted course that runs over two laps of the well-known route. The race is part of the Rothaar Laufserie and offers runners of all ages a sporting challenge in the Hilchenbach region. TSG Helberhausen is a versatile sports club with a wide range of activities, and organizes the race as one of its many popular events.
course_highlights: Two laps of the well-known HauBerg-Lauf course
Part of the Rothaar Laufserie
A traditional race in the Hilchenbach region
additional: The course was adjusted for 2025. The event is part of the diverse sports program offered by TSG Helberhausen, which has more than 20 departments and offers a wide range of sports. The 2026 anniversary features a special course layout, with all runners running the courses in reverse. The event offers a variety of competitions, including children's races and Nordic walking, and takes place on a challenging, hilly course.

name: Internationaler Halbmarathon, 56. Internationaler Volkslauf
description: The International Half Marathon and International Volkslauf in Herzogenrath are established road races organized by DJK Jung Siegfried Herzogenrath. The event includes a 21.1 km half marathon and a 5 km Volkslauf, designed as a community race for all age groups. With the 46th edition of the half marathon and the 56th edition of the Volkslauf, the event has a long tradition and is listed in the laufen.de race calendar. The organizer is a multi-sport club that offers the community other sports and fitness activities in addition to running.
course_highlights: Road race in Herzogenrath
Officially measured half-marathon course (21.1 km)
5 km Volkslauf as a community race
additional: Typical October weather: approx. 14 °C, mostly cloudy, average precipitation 40 mm. The event is integrated into local club activities and, alongside the race distances, offers a community atmosphere that encourages both sporting challenges and socializing.

name: NELLINGER Kirbe-Lauf
description: The Nellingen Kirbe Run is a long-standing popular sporting event in Ostfildern-Nellingen, held every year in October. The main race is approximately 7.3 km, and there are also student and Bambini races for younger participants. The event is organized by Turnverein Nellingen 1893 e.V. and offers a family-friendly atmosphere alongside a sporting challenge. The course runs through the town and is closed to vehicle traffic from 1 p.m. to ensure a safe race.
course_highlights: Main race: approx. 7.3 km (5 laps)
Student race: approx. 1.45 km (1 lap)
Bambini race: approx. 400 m for children under 8
additional: The course is closed to vehicle traffic from 1:00 p.m. Parking is limited, so the use of public transport is recommended. Trophies are awarded to the overall winners, prizes to the top three finishers in each class, and team trophies for the student race, main race, and corporate category. Award ceremonies take place at 15:10, 16:20, and 16:40. The event also includes local awards, medical support from DRK Ostfildern, and nearby parking.

name: Nordwalder Laufspektakel
description: The Nordwalde Running Spectacle is a popular running event with various distances, including 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon, as well as children’s races. It takes place annually in Nordwalde and attracts numerous runners looking forward to a sporting challenge. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and good organisation. It offers suitable running options for competitive runners, families and children alike.
course_highlights: Distances: 5 km, 10 km, half marathon
Children’s races over 1 km and 2 km
Participant and course records for the 5 km and half marathon
additional: The event takes place annually and offers children’s races alongside the main distances. It combines a sporting challenge with a family-friendly atmosphere. Results and photos from previous years are available on the website. The event takes place in Nordwalde, with more than 800 participants at the last edition, including record-breaking times and food and drink.

name: Sparkassen Alb Marathon Schwäbisch Gmünd
location: Großsporthalle Schwäbisch Gmünd, Schwäbisch Gmünd, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Sparkassen Alb Marathon Schwäbisch Gmünd is a traditional ultramarathon that has been held annually since 1991 during golden October. The 50-kilometer course with 1,100 meters of elevation gain crosses the Three Imperial Mountains—Hohenstaufen, Rechberg and Stuifen—through breathtaking scenery. In addition to the main race, other events include the Alb Ultra at approx. 60 km, the 37 km Alb-Trail, a 25 km race, a 10 km run and walk, and a children’s race. The event offers a sporting spectacle for the whole family and a varied program including a talk, briefing and pasta party.
course_highlights: 50 km course with 1,100 meters of elevation gain across the Three Imperial Mountains: Hohenstaufen, Rechberg and Stuifen
Breathtaking natural scenery and landscapes
A range of distances, from the children’s race to the 60 km Alb Ultra
additional: Start for all races (except the Alb-Trail) is on Schwerzerallee, level with the Großsporthalle. Event center at the Großsporthalle Schwäbisch Gmünd. Electronic timing using a transponder in the race number (no ChampionChip). A medal is included for races over 25 km; medals for other races can be ordered online for €5. Return transport by local and special buses is available to participants with a race number. Friday evening program includes a talk, briefing and pasta party (€7 contribution toward the meal). Loop course across the Imperial Mountains, aid stations, relay and team competitions, award ceremonies, race number with RFID transponder

name: Burgkirchner Raiffeisen-Crosslauf
location: Freizeitzentrum Halsbachgraben, Burgkirchen an der Alz, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Burgkirchner Raiffeisen Cross-Country Run is a hilly cross-country race in Burgkirchen an der Alz, Bavaria. The start and finish are at the Halsbachgraben Leisure Centre. The event is part of the Raiffeisen Cross-Country Series and offers various distances for children, teenagers and adults, including short courses from 0.65 km to 1.3 km and longer races of 4.5 km and 6.6 km. The course is challenging and hilly rather than flat, making even the short distances strenuous. Separate races for children and teenagers, as well as a special 6.6 km race for men, round out the programme.
course_highlights: Hilly cross-country course, not a flat road
Start and finish at the Halsbachgraben Leisure Centre
Various distances for children, teenagers and adults
additional: Results, photos and further details are available at laufpix.de. Official information is also linked via crosslauf-is.de. Typical October weather: around 14 °C during the day and 6 °C at night, mostly cloudy with an average of 40 mm of precipitation. Multiple course distances, separate categories for children and teenagers, not a flat road race, and a sporting challenge due to the hilly terrain

name: Gelenauer Erzgebirgscross
description: The Gelenau Erzgebirge Cross is a long-standing running event in the Ore Mountains, organized by LV 90 Erzgebirge. The competition takes place in Gelenau and gives runners of various age groups and ability levels the opportunity to test themselves on a challenging course. The event is known for its scenic and varied cross-country course through the Ore Mountains. It is open to children, youth, active runners, and masters, and is a fixture on the regional athletics calendar.
course_highlights: Scenic cross-country course in the Ore Mountains
A variety of courses for children, youth, active runners, and masters
Organized by the experienced LV 90 Erzgebirge
additional: Entries should be sent to Sophia Teicher, Kemtauer Straße 27, 09423 Gelenau/Erzgebirge. The contact email is given as meldung "ät" lv90.de. The event includes various categories and age groups, with possible official results for rankings. October weather is typically cool, with temperatures around 14°C; rain is possible.

name: Lauf zur Crosslauf Serie im Kreis Bernkastel-Wittlich
description: The cross-country running series in the Bernkastel-Wittlich district offers runners of all ages varied competitions over different distances. The races take place on flat vineyard slopes around the sports ground in Breit and are known for their friendly, family atmosphere. Children and young people are ranked by year of birth and receive certificates, while prize money is also awarded from the U14 age group. The series comprises several events, and participants who take part in three races are rewarded with a gift.
course_highlights: Start on Schulstraße, below house no. 11
Run through flat vineyard slopes
Event at the sports ground, with showers and changing rooms in the clubhouse
additional: Late entries are possible on site until 1 hour before the start (except in Bengel) for a late-entry fee of 2.00 euros. The event includes several age groups, with different course distances from 200 to 7700 metres. Certificates for children and young people are printed on site; certificates for everyone else are provided online. At the final event, series winners receive certificates and prize money. There is also a raffle featuring signed T-shirts.

name: Lusatian Race Walking
description: The Lusatian Race Walking is an international race walking meeting held annually in Zittau. The event offers half-marathon and marathon races on a 1-kilometer circuit. It attracts top athletes from various countries and is part of the World Race Walking Tour at Silver level. The course is flat and offers good visibility, ensuring exciting races for spectators.
course_highlights: 1-kilometer circuit
Flat course, ideal for fast times
International top athletes and meeting records
additional: The race is part of the World Race Walking Tour at Silver level. The venue is Zittau, Germany. The organizers are AC Rumburk, z.s. and O-SEE Sports e.V.

name: Alb Marathon
description: The Alb Marathon Schwäbisch Gmünd is a traditional ultramarathon that has been held every year since 1991 during golden October. The main course covers 50 kilometers with 1,100 meters of elevation gain, crossing the three Imperial Mountains—Hohenstaufen, Rechberg and Stuifen—through impressive scenery and unique natural surroundings. In addition to the 50 km race, other events include a 25 km race, the 37 km Alb Trail, the 60 km Alb Ultra and relay races. The event offers a sporting spectacle for the whole family and welcomes both competitive runners and those who run for enjoyment.
course_highlights: 50 km course with 1,100 meters of elevation gain over the Imperial Mountains of Hohenstaufen, Rechberg and Stuifen
Breathtaking scenery and unique natural surroundings in the Swabian Alb
Various distances and relay races for different ability levels
additional: The start and finish area is at the Großsporthalle, Katharinenstraße 33 in Schwäbisch Gmünd. The 50 km race uses electronic timing via a transponder attached to the race number. There are five aid stations along the course, offering water, tea, soft drinks, salted pretzels and bananas. Special buses run from the event center to the starts in Essingen and Lautern for the Alb Ultra and Alb Trail. A medal is included for individual entrants in the 60 km, 50 km, 37 km and 25 km races, and can also be ordered online for €6.

name: 100km Staffellauf um den Pokal der Uni Tübingen
B.U.T.XxX - BURGBERNHEIM ULTRA TRAIL
description: The B.U.T.XxX - Burgbernheim Ultra Trail is a challenging ultratrail run held in the picturesque surroundings of Burgbernheim. The event gives runners the opportunity to experience nature and varied landscapes on demanding courses. The run is part of TSV Burgbernheim’s activities and combines sporting ambition with community and tradition.
course_highlights: Challenging ultratrail course in the surroundings of Burgbernheim
Varied terrain with natural landscapes
Part of TSV Burgbernheim’s club activities

name: Lauf der Crossserie des BLV-Kreises Ansbach
Łemkowyna Trail
location: Krynica-Zdrój, Powiat nowotarski, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
distance_verbose: 149 km, 102 km, 69 km, 46 km, Maraton, 28 km, 10 km
description: Łemkowyna Trail is a mountain race along a route marked by the Main Beskid Trail in the Low Beskids. The event takes place around Krynica-Zdrój and Komańcza, offering a range of distances from 10 km to a 150 km ultramarathon. The course features substantial elevation gain and challenging natural terrain, making it a test for trail running and mountain adventure enthusiasts. The event has a strong tradition and attracts runners from across Poland and abroad.
course_highlights: Route marked by the Main Beskid Trail
Significant elevation changes of up to +5860 m and -5970 m on the longest distance
A range of distances from 10 km to 150 km, with time limits
additional: Participant limits for individual distances range from 300 to 550. Each distance has a time limit. The event takes place on natural mountain trails with substantial elevation gain. Courses include elevation gain of up to 740 m for the 30 km race and the 150 km ultramarathon, with time limits of up to 35 hours. Online registration is available, with options to receive a refund of the entry fee and transfer race packages.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata za pojedynczy bieg uiszczona najpóźniej do środy poprzedzającej start

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Karnet na cały cykl w jednym mieście (4 imprezy)

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in seven locations, including Wrocław’s Osobowicki Forest. The event is recreational and competitive, promoting physical activity in nature and a healthy lifestyle. The series includes four races in each location, and participants can compete in local and overall rankings. The main race starts at 11:00. The event is open to people aged 16 and over; younger participants may take part under parental supervision.
course_highlights: The 5 km route runs through the urban forest of Osobowicki Forest in Wrocław
A cross-country race in a natural setting, through forest and parkland
A series of four races per season in each location
additional: The race office opens at 8:30. Race bibs and chips can be collected on race day. A charity package supporting the Siepomaga Foundation is available for purchase. A season pass allows participants to enter all four races in a given city. Season-pass holders may also take part in one race in another city free of charge, after notifying the organizers by email in advance. There is no participant limit. The main race starts at 11:00, and the event ends at around 12:15. Cars cannot access the start area or race office; parking is available along Osobowicka Street.

name: XXIII Bieg śladami ks. Józefa Londzina
Beh hrebeňom Čergova
location: Kamenica, Sabinov District, Prešov Region, Slovakia
description: The Run Along the Čergov Ridge is the longest mountain race in the Čergov Mountains, intended for nature-running enthusiasts and trained runners. The route starts in the village of Kamenica and passes over the range’s highest peaks, including Minčol, Dvoriská, Solisko, Veľká Javorina, Čergov, Lysá and Sedlo Besná, offering magnificent panoramic views. The course is 32 km long with 1,413 metres of elevation gain, making it a challenging and appealing race for mountain runners. The race starts at Farma Kamenica and finishes at Sedlo Besná, by Hotel Šport Lysá. The organizer provides transport for runners from Drienica to the start and takes their personal belongings to the finish.
course_highlights: The route passes over the highest peaks of the Čergov Mountains, all above 1,000 m
Magnificent panoramic views throughout the race
Forest hiking trails marked in blue and green
additional: A large bus will take runners from the village of Drienica to the village of Kamenica at 7:15 a.m. on race morning. Race-day registration is from 7:00 to 8:30 a.m. at Farma Kamenica. The results ceremony and lunch will be held at Hotel Šport Lysá.

name: Rajecká 12-minútovka
location: School sports field on Lipová Street, Rajec, Žilina District, Slovakia
description: The Rajecká 12-Minute Run is a running competition organized by the Rajec Marathon Club. It takes place on the sports field beside the elementary school on Lipová Street in Rajec. This dynamic timed run challenges participants to cover the greatest possible distance in 12 minutes. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle in the pleasant surroundings of Rajec.
course_highlights: A 12-minute timed run
Start and finish on the sports field beside the elementary school on Lipová Street
Pleasant urban surroundings in Rajec

name: Beh vinicami Bojničiek a Hlohovca
location: Kultúrny dom, Bojničky, Hlohovec District, Trnava Region, Slovakia
description: The Run through the Vineyards of Bojničky and Hlohovec is a running race organized by Atletický klub Bojničky and the Municipality of Bojničky. The race takes place amid the scenic vineyards around Bojničky and Hlohovec, with categories for men, women, and Nordic walking. The start and finish are by the cultural center in Bojničky, creating a welcoming community atmosphere. The race is suitable for the general public, including students and running enthusiasts of various ages.
course_highlights: The route runs through the vineyards around Bojničky and Hlohovec
Start and finish by the cultural center in Bojničky, near the church
Categories for men, women, and Nordic walking over 6 km
additional: The entry fee can be paid online or on site on race day. The organizers are Atletický klub Bojničky, the Municipality of Bojničky, Ing. Ivan Pavelka, and Ján Šiška. The organizer can also be contacted by phone at 0905 236 204.

name: Ružínska desiatka
location: Jaklovce, Gelnica District, Košice Region, Slovakia
description: Ružínska desiatka is a running race in the village of Jaklovce, offering 10 km and 5 km courses, as well as children’s races. The course is mostly asphalt with a small gravel section, making for a fast and enjoyable run. The race is organized by Športový klub Jaklovce in cooperation with the municipality of Jaklovce and is suitable for the general public, including various age groups. The main race starts at 11:00, and the children’s races start at 10:00.
course_highlights: The course is 90% asphalt and 10% gravel (macadam)
The race takes place in the village of Jaklovce, Gelnica District
Categories include 10 km, 5 km, and children’s races
additional: The children’s races start at 10:00. The organizers are Športový klub Jaklovce o.z. and the municipality of Jaklovce. Contacts: Peter Budinský (0905 527 234), Peter Mitrík (0905 377 836).

name: Beh Rematskou dolinou
description: The Remata Valley Run is an event in the Dynasport Running League 2026, held in Handlová. Runners can choose between a short 5 km course with 135 m of elevation gain and a longer 9 km course with 280 m of elevation gain. The courses follow asphalt and forest roads, offering a mix of natural surroundings and firm surfaces. Runner check-in begins at 9:00, and the start is scheduled for 11:00. The top three finishers in each age category will be awarded.
course_highlights: Short course: 5 km with 135 m of elevation gain
Long course: 9 km with 280 m of elevation gain
Courses run on asphalt and through the forest
additional: Runner check-in begins at 09:00 on race day. On-site registration is also available for €20, provided the participant limit has not been reached. Age categories are based on age attained in 2026, with different categories for the short and long courses.

name: Jesenný Cani-Cross Fatranský Vĺčko
location: Lezecká stena Ovčín, Turčianske Jaseno, Slovakia
description: The Autumn Cani-Cross Fatranský Vĺčko is a dog-running race set in the beautiful surroundings of the Veľká Fatra, near Turčianske Jaseno. The 7.7 km course, with 250 m of elevation gain, follows marked trails offering views of the Turiec Garden. The start and finish are by the Ovčín climbing wall. Competitors running with dogs start individually at timed intervals, while runners without dogs start together. The event offers chip timing, refreshments, and the option to shower after the race. Categories are divided into women, men, juniors, and children. Children under 12 may start only when accompanied by a parent.
course_highlights: The route follows scenic trails in the Veľká Fatra, with views of the Turiec Garden
Course distance: 7.7 km, with 250 m of elevation gain
Start and finish by the Ovčín climbing wall in Turčianske Jaseno
additional: Participants with dogs must bring the dog’s vaccination record showing valid vaccinations. Dogs must be at least 12 months old. The dog’s microchip will be checked during on-site registration. Runners with dogs start individually at timed intervals; runners without dogs start together. The entry fee includes a race number, chip timing, a drink, and the option to shower after the race. A meat or vegetarian meal can be ordered at the finish for an additional €5. A valid vaccination record is required to start with a dog, and the dog must be at least 12 months old.

name: Night run Šaštínskými bormi
description: The Run Through the Šaštín Pines is a night race organized by Běžecký klub Hodonín, held in the picturesque surroundings of Šaštín-Stráže. The race offers runners a chance to experience the unique atmosphere of the forest and nature in the evening. It is part of a long-standing tradition and supports the community of endurance runners in the region.
course_highlights: A night run in the natural surroundings of the Šaštín pines
The route follows forest roads and trails
An atmosphere of quiet and nature in the evening
additional: The organizer is Běžecký klub Hodonín, which has a long tradition of organizing running events in the region. The club chairman is Pavel Bíla, tel.: 606 156 937. The race is part of the club’s broader calendar of running events.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Brezová pod Bradlom
location: Brezová pod Bradlom, Myjava District, Trenčín Region, Slovakia

name: Sparťanský Areál Challenge 3
