name: Chlumecká pětka - Svatomartinský běh
location: Chlumec nad Cidlinou, Hradec Králové District, Česko

name: Lauf Winterlaufserie 2026/2027
description: The 1st Winter Running Series 2026/2027 in Beverstedt-Wellen is a winter running series connected with the traditional Rund um Wellen event. It is organized by the local running club, which also runs the historic Wellen Marathon, one of the oldest marathons in Germany. The event offers a welcoming, family atmosphere, various distance options, and strong local support from volunteers, sponsors, and the local fire brigade. The organizers aim to preserve the event’s well-established challenge and familiar character.
course_highlights: Part of the long-standing Rund um Wellen event, with four distances
Rural, family-friendly atmosphere, organized by a local club
Strong local support from volunteers and the fire brigade
additional: Typical November weather: average 7 °C (minimum 2 °C) with frequent rain (45 mm of precipitation). Start location: Beverstedt-Wellen. Terrain: mixed. Registration: not specified. Further notes: Part of the Rund um Wellen event, with local support and volunteers involved.

name: Bibersfelder Herbstlauf
description: The Bibersfeld Autumn Run is part of the “Stadtwerke - Läuft bei dir” race series and offers suitable courses for runners of all ages. The event features varied routes, with the classic 10-kilometer race at its heart. Participants can look forward to a friendly, family atmosphere, and both individual runners and teams are welcome. All finishers receive certificates and gifts, while younger runners also receive medals. Registration is online only, and late entries are possible up to 45 minutes before the start.
course_highlights: Classic 10-kilometer race
Family-friendly event with courses for all ages
Part of the regional “Stadtwerke - Läuft bei dir” race series
additional: Certificates are provided digitally and can be printed at the venue or conveniently at home. The Cup Quartet awards ceremony takes place after the fourth race in Bibersfeld, from approximately 14:00. Various running and walking distances, online-only registration, certificates can be printed at the venue or at home, including a 10-kilometer race and a half marathon.

name: Hohen Neuendorfer Herbstlauf
description: The Hohen Neuendorf Autumn Run is a traditional running event that has been held in Hohen Neuendorf since 1900 and is considered the birthplace of cross-country running in Germany. The run attracts numerous participants from the region and beyond each year and offers distances for all age groups, from a children’s run to longer distances. The event brings generations together and is supported by many volunteers and local partners. It traditionally takes place in November and is a fixture on the regional sporting calendar.
course_highlights: Traditional cross-country run with a history dating back to 1900
Participants spanning generations, from age 3 to over 90
Support from local clubs and reservists along the course
additional: The run includes various distances, including a 400-metre children’s run and a 5.5 km course. The event is supported by many volunteers, including the Roter Adler Reservists from Lehnitz. The Autumn Run is one of the largest running events in the Oberhavel district and attracts participants from various regions. It takes place at the Rudolf Harbig sports ground and is weather-dependent. Registration is via MyRacepartner. The event is known for its historical significance in cross-country running in Germany and promotes a sense of community through sport.

name: int. Hohenzollern Berglauf
description: The International Hohenzollern Hill Run is a long-established hill race organised by Ski-Club Hechingen e.V. The challenging course leads from Hechingen’s Weiherstadion up to Hohenzollern Castle and puts runners to the test. The race attracts both beginners and experienced hill-running specialists, and delights participants with a special atmosphere featuring music and cheering along the course. With more than 70 volunteers and a large field of participants, the race is a highlight of the regional running calendar.
course_highlights: Start at Hechingen’s Weiherstadion
Challenging climb from kilometre 4 to the finish in the courtyard of Hohenzollern Castle
Music and atmosphere along the course (Runner’s Dixxies at km 3, Schnorchelhuaschter at km 5.5)
additional: The race is organised by Ski-Club Hechingen with more than 70 volunteers. The course starts out flatter and becomes increasingly steep from kilometre 4 to the finish in the courtyard of Hohenzollern Castle. The event offers a special atmosphere, with live rock music at the start and music and cheering along the course. Participants range from beginners to experienced hill runners; some have been taking part for more than 30 years. Registration until 5 November 2025, shuttle service to the castle, and a supporting programme with an awards ceremony.

name: Lauf der 39. Crosslauf-Serie 2026 Cochem-Zell in Kaisersesch
description: The 3rd race of the 39th 2026 Cross-Country Series in Kaisersesch takes place at the Waldsportplatz in the Eifel and offers distances for Bambini, schoolchildren, recreational runners and adults. Distances range from 300 m for the youngest participants to 8.2 km in the main race for U20 and older participants. The course runs around Kaisersesch, with children and young people running a slightly modified loop. The race is part of the Cochem-Zell Crosslauf Series, where participants earn points toward the overall standings and can compete for the district championship title. The event is organised by the local athletics club, with volunteers helping with refreshments and event organisation.
course_highlights: Course runs around Kaisersesch
Modified loops for children and young people
Part of the Cochem-Zell Crosslauf Series, with overall standings
additional: The race is organised by the local athletics club, with volunteers helping with cake donations, sales and the start-finish area. At one of the most recent editions, 145 participants took part across all distances. Typical November weather, with temperatures of around 7 °C and rainy days, is to be expected. Distances range from 300 m for the youngest participants to 8.2 km for the main race; the event is rooted in the Cochem-Zell region and takes place in typical November weather.

name: Lop dwasch dörn Wildenloh
location: Wildenloh bei Oldenburg, Landkreis Oldenburg, Niedersachsen, Germany
description: Lop dwasch dörn Wildenloh is a traditional cross-country run held in early November on the beautiful fitness trail in Wildenloh, west of Oldenburg. The name means “Run across Wildenloh” and reflects the event’s rustic character: it takes place in the forest, without showers. The event is organised by the sports club Team Laufrausch e.V., which creates a friendly, nature-oriented running atmosphere.
course_highlights: Cross-country run on the local fitness trail in Wildenloh
Rustic forest course without showers
Traditional event with regional character
additional: The run takes place on a rustic forest course without showers. Several distances are offered (short course: 1600m, middle course: 3200m), and results from previous years are available. The event is organised by the sports club Team Laufrausch e.V. The run is held annually in November. There are no showers on site, results are published, and categories include children and adults.

name: Martins-Crosslauf
description: The Martins Cross-Country Run in Krefeld is a traditional cross-country event held annually in November. The course runs through the scenic Hubert Houben Anlage and offers runners of all ages a sporting challenge in a natural setting. Organized by Preussen Krefeld Leichtathletik e.V., the event is open to children, young people and adults and promotes athletics in the region.
course_highlights: Run through the Hubert Houben Anlage on varied terrain
A natural course with woodland and meadow sections
Suitable for all age groups, from Bambini to adults

name: Obersulmer Volkslauf
description: The Obersulm Fun Run takes place around Lake Breitenau and offers runners of all ages an enjoyable running experience. The event includes various distances, such as the 10 km main race, the 5 km fun run, and walking and Nordic walking routes. The scenic course has moderate elevation changes and is cheered on by enthusiastic spectators. Its friendly atmosphere and professional organization make the fun run a popular event in the region.
course_highlights: Loop course around Lake Breitenau
5 km course with a starting elevation of 227 m and an elevation of 233 m
Attractive course with gravel and crushed-stone surfaces
additional: Professional timing with a transponder in the race bib. Wear the race bib on the front. Medals for Bambinis and schoolchildren at the finish. Award ceremonies take place directly after the races on the Bauhof grounds. The top three finishers in the fun run, main race, and walking/Nordic walking events receive a wine gift. Free parking directly at Lake Breitenau. The course follows an attractive loop over gravel and crushed-stone surfaces. Course profile: 5 km and 10 km laps; refreshments on the course; food and drinks provided by the lakeside kiosk; medical services provided by the German Red Cross; free parking at the lake; event takes place in all weather; personal data is used in accordance with data protection regulations.

name: Refrather Herbstlauf
location: Königsforst, Bergisch Gladbach-Refrath, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Refrath Autumn Run is a traditional running classic in the Königsforst near Bergisch Gladbach-Refrath, held annually since 1986. The event offers 5 km, 10 km and half-marathon races, all measured by the DLV and eligible for ranking lists. The routes pass through the autumn forest and feature out-and-back courses with challenging yet scenic sections. The race attracts both competitive runners and recreational participants, and awards ceremonies for all age groups follow shortly after the finish.
course_highlights: Out-and-back courses through the autumnal Königsforst
DLV-measured routes over 5 km, 10 km and the half marathon
Scenic forest paths with challenging sections
additional: Start times: 5 km at 10:00, 10 km at 11:00, half marathon at 12:30. Awards ceremonies take place shortly after runners finish. Parking is available on Rather Weg, about 1.2 km from the Bensberg exit of the A4. Public transport: take KVB line 1 to “Refrath”. Participants can register online. The routes are gently rolling, with an elevation difference of about 6 m for the 5 km race and 20 m for the 10 km race. The event has been a fixture on the region’s running calendar for many years.

name: Rursee-Marathon
description: The Rursee Marathon takes place in Simmerath-Einruhr and offers runners a unique natural experience in Eifel National Park. The marathon route follows a hilly circular course along the Obersee, Urftsee and Rursee lakes, with stunning autumn scenery and varied landscapes. In addition to the marathon, other events include a 52 km ultramarathon, a 16.5 km run, a 5 km run and children’s races. The event is known for its challenging course and picturesque surroundings, making every run a special experience.
course_highlights: Hilly circular course along the Obersee, Urftsee and Rursee lakes
Route through wooded areas with stunning autumn scenery
Loop around the entire Rursee with challenging sections and 370 metres of elevation gain
additional: The course is 70% unpaved field and forest paths and 30% asphalt. There are 7 aid stations plus refreshments at the finish. The event offers clear course marking on race day and is part of the Eifel Cup. Multiple race options, online registration, event photography, early-bird discounts until the end of August, and late-entry fees of up to €5.

name: RWW-Herbstwaldlauf
description: The RWW Herbstwaldlauf in Bottrop is a long-standing race. It is part of the International Marathon and Ultra Cup and offers various distances for beginners and experienced runners. The event takes place at Jahnstadion, where the Herbstwaldlauf tradition has been rooted since 1973. Participants can look forward to a sporting challenge amid picturesque woodland scenery, bringing together community and a passion for running.
course_highlights: Run through the picturesque woodland landscape of Bottrop
Start and finish at the historic Jahnstadion
Part of the International Marathon and Ultra Cup
additional: The cutoff time for all races is 15:30. A human sweeper is on hand to provide support. T-shirts can be ordered in advance. The event takes place at Jahnstadion, where the training groups of Adler-Langlauf Bottrop are also active. The race takes place in November, with routes through woodland and nature, and offers a friendly club atmosphere for runners of all levels.

name: Steinheimer Geologenlauf
description: The Steinheim Geologenlauf is a long-standing running event that has been held in the beautiful Steinheim Basin for over 35 years. The main course is 10 km long, mostly paved, with two small climbs, and offers an appealing challenge for both competitive runners and beginners. The program also includes a 5 km fitness run, a team run, walking, and children’s races, suitable for all age and ability groups. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, dedicated team of volunteers, and good refreshments at the club center.
course_highlights: 10 km course, mostly paved, with two small climbs at 3.2 km and 6.4 km
5 km fitness run, extremely flat and well suited to beginner runners
Start and finish at the club center in Steinheim am Albuch
additional: Late registration is available online after advance registration closes and in person on the event day until 60 minutes before the respective start, but without a personalized race bib. Changing facilities and showers are available at the club center. Refreshments include cake and grilled sausages in the outdoor area. The three fastest women and men in each age group will be honored. Various running disciplines, online registration, results, and photo galleries available; event held in November.

name: Süderelbe Halbmarathon durch das Alte Land
price_range: 20 Euro Halbmarathon, 18 Euro 10 km, 5 Euro Kinderlauf
description: The 50th Süderelbe Half Marathon through the Altes Land takes place. The route starts at the CU Arena by Neugraben S-Bahn station, runs through the Altes Land to Neuenfelde, and then returns. Alongside the half marathon, there are also 10 km and 5 km races, a 5 km walking event, and a 1.2 km children’s race. The event is organized by Hausbruch-Neugrabener Turnerschaft von 1911 e.V. and offers a varied program for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the CU Arena, Neugraben S-Bahn station
Route through the scenic Altes Land to Neuenfelde
Return to the starting point along the same route
additional: The program includes 10 km and 5 km races, a 5 km walking event, and a 1.2 km children’s race. The organizer is Hausbruch-Neugrabener Turnerschaft von 1911 e.V., with office hours Mon–Fri 09:00–11:00 and Mon–Thu 16:00–18:00. Route through the Altes Land, various race distances, children’s race, walking event, course closes at 12:30, parking at the P+R facility at Neugraben S-Bahn station, race numbers available on event day, refreshments along the route, medals and certificates for participants.

name: Teufelsberglauf 2026
description: The race offers 5 km and 10 km courses and is organized by ESV Sportfreunde München-Neuaubing e.V. The course likely runs through the grounds around Teufelsberg and is very popular with runners of all ages. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and long history in Munich’s running scene.
course_highlights: Run on cross-country terrain around Teufelsberg
Course distances of 5 km and 10 km
Traditional club race with a long history
additional: Several categories, including children’s and youth races; the event is celebrating its 50th edition; in the event of bad weather in Munich in November

name: Waldkater Cross
description: The Waldkater Cross is a small but challenging cross-country race in Weyhe, Lower Saxony, held on forest trails. The event offers various distances for children, teenagers and adults, including 1.2 km, 2.4 km, 4 km and 8.4 km. The routes pass through natural terrain, making the race a special challenge. The race is organised by SV Weyhe, with support from the 2026 Cross-Country Series, and is a popular opportunity for runners of all ages to combine nature and competition.
course_highlights: Race on forest trails in natural surroundings
Various distances for all age groups
Part of the 2026 Cross-Country Series in Weyhe

name: Westfalenparklauf
location: Westfalenpark Dortmund, Dortmund, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
organizer: Lauftreff Bittermark Dortmund, LT Bittermark Dortmund, Dortmunder Volksbank
description: The Dortmunder Volksbank Westfalenparklauf is a sporting event in Westfalenpark Dortmund that welcomes runners of all ages. The event offers various distances, including Bambini, children’s and main races over 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km, with electronic timing. The course is measured by the DLV and runs through the beautiful Westfalenpark. All finishers receive medals, and the fastest runners are honored. The event prioritizes safe and fair race operations, with medical support and refreshments in the finish area.
course_highlights: Course through Westfalenpark Dortmund, with the start and finish at the Ruhrallee entrance
DLV-measured courses of 2.5 km (1 lap), 5 km (2 laps) and 10 km (4 laps)
Electronic timing and a lead bicycle in the main races
additional: Race-number collection is available on race day until 45 minutes before each start. There are no changing facilities, but bags can be stored at the owner’s risk. Headphones, dogs and strollers are not allowed. The Bambini race is untimed; participants receive a certificate only. Awards go to the top three men and women in the 5 km and 10 km races, as well as age-group winners. Medical support is available on the course and in the start/finish area. A lead bicycle accompanies the 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km races. This is a local event with a traditional character, including finisher medals, online registration and medical support on the course. Certain participation rules apply, including no dogs or umbrellas.

name: 3TuermeWEG TRAILRUN
location: Hagen Stadtwald, Hagen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 3TürmeWEG Trailrun is a timed trail race organized by TV Hasperbach 1898 e.V. in cooperation with Hagen.Wirtschaftsentwicklung. The course runs through Hagen City Forest and follows the well-known 3TürmeWEG Premium Hiking Trail. Along the way, runners pass three historic towers and a fallow deer enclosure and enjoy numerous scenic views. The course has been evaluated by the International Trail Running Association (ITRA) and is part of the National League 2026. A guided course preview run with historical commentary takes place every August.
course_highlights: The course runs counterclockwise past three historic towers: Kaiser-Friedrich-Turm, Bismarckturm, and Eugen-Richter-Turm
Runs through Hagen City Forest, with a fallow deer enclosure and numerous viewpoints
Evaluated by ITRA and part of the National League 2026
additional: A guided course preview run with historical commentary takes place on the third Thursday of August each year. The course is available as a GPX file for runners to follow on their own.

name: Robert-Hannemann-Volkslauf 2026
description: The Robert Hannemann Fun Run is a traditional cross-country race held annually in the autumnal Glacis of Minden. The course winds through a scenic area near the Weser promenade and offers a family-friendly atmosphere at the Weser Stadium. The race is known for its pleasant atmosphere and attracts runners of all ages. The event is organized by SV 1860 Minden e.V., which runs a large athletics department with a wide range of training programs.
course_highlights: Cross-country race through the autumnal Glacis of Minden
Start and finish at the clubhouse on the Weser promenade
Family-friendly atmosphere at the Weser Stadium
additional: The race traditionally takes place in November and is known for good weather and a pleasant atmosphere. The course was recently adjusted to pass through shaded areas of the Glacis. The event is part of SV 1860 Minden’s diverse athletics program.

name: Steinhart500 – KLIMANEUTRAL
description: The Steinhart500 is a challenging marathon in Steinfurt, taking place on November 7, 2027. The event is climate-neutral and places great importance on environmental protection, including planting trees along the course to offset CO2 emissions. In addition to the classic marathon, shorter distances of 28 km, 14 km, and 7 km are also available. The 7 km loop, with 50 meters of elevation gain, is particularly suitable for beginners. Flex tickets for distances of 28 km and above let participants decide during the race whether they want to finish earlier and still be included in the results. The course crosses varied terrain and features a notable hill leading to the Finnish track.
course_highlights: Climate-neutral event with CO2 offset through tree planting along the course
Flex tickets for distances of 28 km and above allow participants to finish early and still be included in the results
7 km loop with 50 meters of elevation gain, ideal for beginners
additional: All tickets for distances of 28 km and above are Flex tickets, allowing participants to decide during the race when to finish. The 7 km course goes over a hill to the Finnish track and is somewhat challenging, with 50 meters of elevation gain. The event takes place as part of Turnerbund Burgsteinfurt e.V., which offers a wide range of sports activities.

name: 50. Hermann-Löns-Park-Lauf
description: The Hermann-Löns-Park Run in Hannover-Wülferode is a traditional road and fun run held annually in early November. The event offers various distances from 400 m to 10 km, officially measured by the German Athletics Association. The races run through Hermann-Löns-Park and offer an attractive course, starting and finishing at the Annabad grounds. The event is organized by the TKH running group and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and professional timing.
course_highlights: Officially measured 5 km and 10 km courses in accordance with German Athletics Association standards
Start and finish at the Annabad grounds in Hannover-Kirchrode
A range of distances from 400 m to 10 km for all age groups
additional: Race bibs require a €2 deposit, which is refunded only if the bibs are undamaged. Spikes are not allowed and may result in disqualification. The event takes place in all weather conditions.

name: Braunschweiger Speed5
description: The Braunschweiger Speed5 is a fast road race in Braunschweig, organized by the Polizeisportverein Braunschweig and the Braunschweiger Laufclub. The event is distinguished by its high number of participants and numerous records, including state and German bests. The race takes place on a fast course and attracts both competitive runners and running enthusiasts from the region. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere, excellent organization, and plenty of support from volunteers and spectators.
course_highlights: Fast 5 km course in Braunschweig
Record-breaking performances, including state and German bests
Event held on the grounds of the Polizeisportverein Braunschweig
additional: Late entries are possible up to 1 hour before the start of the respective race, with a late-entry fee of €3 per athlete. The stadium has a synthetic track surface and may only be entered with spikes up to 6 mm long. There are individual and relay classifications, as well as various age groups.

name: Friesenheimer Eulenlauf
description: The Friesenheim Owl Run is a long-standing running event in Ludwigshafen, returning after a six-year break. The event offers several distances, including a classic 10 km main race, a 3 km race for students and beginners, and a 400-meter race for young children. It is known for its friendly atmosphere and good organization, supported by many volunteers and sponsors. The course gives runners of all ages the opportunity to test their running performance and gain their first running experience.
course_highlights: Classic 10 km course for experienced runners
New 3 km course for beginners and students
400-meter race for the youngest runners
additional: The race traditionally takes place in pleasant weather in November. Alongside the races, the event receives extensive support from volunteers and sponsors. Results and certificates are provided via the br-timing website.

name: Karlsbader Volkslauf
description: The Karlsbad Volkslauf in Langensteinbach offers runners an attractive choice of distances: 2 km, 5 km and 10 km. The 5 km and 10 km courses run partly on paved paths and partly on surfaced forest trails, while the 2 km course is mostly on paved paths. The start and finish are in the stadium at SONOTRONIC Sportpark, creating a pleasant atmosphere for participants and spectators. The event is an established race in the Karlsbad area and welcomes runners of all ages and ability levels.
course_highlights: The 5 km and 10 km courses run partly on paved paths and partly on surfaced forest trails
The 2 km course is 95% paved
Start and finish in the stadium at SONOTRONIC Sportpark
additional: GPS data for the courses (2 km, 5 km, 10 km) are available to download from alltrails.com and Komoot for common GPS devices.

name: Lauf am Lech - 2. Lauf der Jedermannserie
description: The Lauf am Lech is the second race in the Jedermann series by LG Donau-Ries, an autumn running series in the Donau-Ries region of Bavaria. The race takes place at Georg-Weber-Stadion in Rain and offers 3 km and 10 km courses. The series caters to both recreational and experienced runners and moves from town to town, with each race held at a different venue. Race numbers are equipped with transponders and must be collected at least 20 minutes before the start. Online pre-registration is recommended to avoid waiting on race day.
course_highlights: Start at Georg-Weber-Stadion in Rain
3 km and 10 km course distances
Part of a multi-race series through different towns in Donau-Ries
additional: Race numbers with transponders; collection at least 20 minutes before the start; online pre-registration recommended to avoid queues on race day. Participants can pre-register online; the series visits several towns in the region; November weather is usually rainy.

name: Lauf Rund um den Höglwörther See
description: The Run Around Höglwörther See in Teisendorf is a popular running event with distances for all age groups, including a 13 km main race, a 4.2 km charity run, and Bambini and Kids Runs for the youngest participants. The scenic route circles Höglwörther See and offers a great atmosphere, with music points along the course and a grandstand in the finish area. The event combines competitive sport with social commitment, as part of the proceeds are donated. All participants receive high-quality race gifts, and there is a festive awards ceremony with special prizes and medals.
course_highlights: Scenic running route around Höglwörther See
Atmosphere along the course with music points and a grandstand at the finish
Digital course views to preview the 4.2 km and 13 km races
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 08:30 at the Teisendorf sports hall near the start/finish. The Bambini and Kids Runs have special start times between 10:00 and 10:50, with color-coded race bibs. All starters receive a high-quality hat worth €30. There is a team competition with attractive prizes. Refreshments, including a cake buffet, fruit, and drinks, are available in the athletes' area, with on-course refreshments for the 13 km race. Registration is exclusively online through partner Zeitgemaess GmbH. No on-site registration is available for Bambini and U10; on-site registration for U12 and U14 is possible on event day.

name: Quickborn Run über 5 km und 10 km
description: The Quickborn Run is a long-standing running event, taking place for the 48th time in 2027. There are 5 km and 10 km races, starting at the Dietrich-Bonhoeffer-Gymnasium in Quickborn. Childcare is available for families with young children, so parents can take part with peace of mind. The event is open to runners aged 12 and 14 or older, respectively, and offers a friendly atmosphere, changing facilities, and free parking.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Dietrich-Bonhoeffer-Gymnasium in Quickborn
5 km and 10 km races
Childcare during the event
additional: Race packets are distributed from 8:00 to 10:30. Timing is provided using a free loan chip. Changing facilities are available in the sports hall. Free parking is available at the sports hall and in the parking garage at the AKN railway station. The rules of the German Athletics Regulations apply.

name: Wernigeröder Armeleuteberglauf
description: The Wernigeröder Armeleuteberglauf is a challenging trail run in November, starting and finishing at Haus Blume in Wernigerode. The course takes runners to the Kaiserturm and offers a varied challenge with narrow forest trails, muddy sections, and steep climbs. Alongside the main races of 5.4 km and 10 km, there are also children’s races of 1 km and 2.1 km. The event is organized by Harz-Gebirgslauf 1978 e.V. Wernigerode and, with around 160 participants, is a popular local tradition that also includes a pasta party on the eve of the race.
course_highlights: Trail run on narrow forest trails
Steep climbs to the Kaiserturm
Muddy and fast downhill sections
additional: The event includes four distances: 1 km and 2.1 km for children, and 5.4 km and 10 km for the main races, which start together later in the morning. Trail character with challenging climbs; registration by email; pasta party on Saturday evening at the Waldgasthaus Armeleuteberg.

name: Riedlinger Misse-Lauf
distance_verbose: 10 km, 8.2 km, 4.5 km, 2 km, 1500 Meter, 1 km, 0.8 km

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Academy of Physical Education and Sport (AWFiS), Gdańsk, Poland
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata za pojedynczy bieg uiszczona najpóźniej do środy poprzedzającej start

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Karnet można wykupić najpóźniej do środy przed drugim biegiem

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide cross-country running series covering 5 km and held in seven locations, including the Tricity (Gdańsk and Gdynia). The races take place in forests and urban parks, giving participants the chance to compete outdoors in a natural setting. The series consists of four races at each location, with results combined for the overall standings. The races are open to participants aged 16 and over, as well as younger participants with the appropriate permission. The main race starts at 11:00.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through forests and urban parks
Tricity location: Gdańsk Forest District, Tricity Landscape Park near the Gdańsk University of Physical Education and Sport
Regular schedule and consistent race-office locations
additional: A charity package supporting the Siepomaga Foundation is available for purchase. The race office opens at 8:30; race numbers and timing chips can be collected on race day. Participants with a season pass can take one free start in another city after notifying the organizers by email in advance. There is no participant limit. A group warm-up with the CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place before the start. In the 2026/2027 season, CITY TRAIL races in the Tricity are held in Gdańsk and Gdynia.

name: Międzyzdrojska Liga Biegowa
description: The Międzyzdroje Running League is an annual, free running and Nordic walking league held on the scenic routes of the Międzyzdroje Municipality. In the 2026/2027 season, participants compete over distances of approximately 5 and 10 km in the running events, and 5 and 7 km in Nordic walking. The league is known for its friendly, family atmosphere and healthy competition, welcoming both returning participants and newcomers who enjoy active recreation. To qualify for the overall standings, participants must complete at least four events at the required distances. The events are open to people over 14, and participation is free.
course_highlights: Routes of approximately 5 and 10 km for runners
Routes of approximately 5 and 7 km for Nordic walkers
Scenic routes in the Międzyzdroje Municipality
additional: Participation is free. Participants must be at least 14 years old; minors may take part with written permission from a parent or guardian and under their supervision. To be included in the league standings, participants must enter and complete at least four events at the required distances (two 5 km and two 10 km running events, or two 5 km and two 7 km Nordic walking events). The series includes several events during the season; participation in at least four is required for the overall standings. Registration is handled through ProTiming24. Participant age: 14 and over; minors need written permission from a parent or guardian.

name: VII Bieg Chrystowskich dla Niepodległości
location: Tłokinia Kościelna, Gmina Opatówek, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Beh oslobodenia mesta Strážske
location: Strážske, Michalovce District, Košice Region, Slovakia
description: The Strážske Liberation Run is a traditional running race organized by the town of Strážske in cooperation with the MBO Strážske running club. The event commemorates the liberation of the town each year and attracts runners of various age groups, including youth and adults. The course passes through the town, and competitors are divided into several age and performance categories. The atmosphere is sporting and community-oriented, with prizes for the best runners and a rich tradition approaching its 50th anniversary edition.
course_highlights: Multiple age categories, from preschoolers to adults
Race organized in cooperation with the local MBO Strážske running club
Traditional run commemorating the liberation of the town of Strážske
additional: The run has a long tradition, and its 50th anniversary edition will take place in 2027. After the race, the fastest runners in each category receive awards, and a raffle with valuable prizes is held. More than 300 runners have taken part in the past, including local and international competitors.

name: Trenčianská bežecká liga – 9. kolo

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 6 EUR – klasické štartovné + Spojená škola internátna, Trenčín – dobrovoľný príspevok (štartovné sa platí priamo na mieste)

description: The Trenčín Running League is a regular running competition in Trenčín and the surrounding area, encouraging runners of all ages to stay active and lead a healthy lifestyle. The 9th round takes place at the football pitch in Trenčianska Turná and features a 7.8 km course with 123 metres of elevation gain. The route runs mainly along paved roads, with some off-road sections, through the village and past natural and cultural landmarks, making it an enjoyable and interesting run. The start is scheduled for 10:00, and participants can make a voluntary donation to support the Special Boarding School in Trenčín.
course_highlights: 7.8 km course with 123 m of elevation gain
80% paved surface, 20% off-road
The route passes through Trenčianska Turná and by the Slovak Double Cross
additional: Registration takes place at the venue from 9:00. The entry fee is paid on site. Runners can make a voluntary donation to the Special Boarding School in Trenčín. Results are announced after the run, followed by a social event. The elevation gain for this course was listed as 123 m in the previous edition.

name: Běh na Dobrošov
description: Běh na Dobrošov je veřejný závod v běhu do vrchu s hromadným startem, který se koná v malebném prostředí Náchoda - Běloves. Závod je součástí série Běžecké vršky a nabízí sportovní výzvu na tratích dlouhých 3,8 km a 1,5 km. Akce je vhodná pro širokou veřejnost a běžce všech úrovní, kteří chtějí zažít atmosféru běžeckého závodu v krásné přírodě Královéhradeckého kraje. Pořadatelem je sportovní klub Redpoint Teplice nad Metují, který zajišťuje kvalitní organizaci a podporu závodníků.
course_highlights: Běh do vrchu s hromadným startem
Trasy o délce 3,8 km a 1,5 km v přírodním prostředí
Malebné okolí Náchoda - Běloves v Královéhradeckém kraji

name: 10 Bieg Niepodległości z wąsem
description: The Wrocław Independence Day Run with a Mustache is an annual running event held on November 11 to commemorate Poland regaining its independence. Participants can choose the PZLA-certified 10 km distance or the accompanying 5 km run. The start and finish are at the Olympic Stadium in Wrocław, and the course passes through scenic areas along the Oder Canal and the Chrobry Bridges. The event is open to all and promotes physical activity and patriotism among city residents.
course_highlights: The PZLA-certified 10 km course is one loop around the Olympic Stadium.
The 5 km course runs along the Oder Canal embankments and the Chrobry Bridges.
The start and finish are at the Pergola at the Olympic Stadium.
additional: Race packs are distributed at the Olympic Stadium in the days leading up to the race and on race day. The pack includes a race bib, a race wristband, a stick-on mustache, a Nose Up strip, kabanos sausages, a calendar, and a medal. A technical T-shirt and a race bib belt are available for purchase. The race takes place on closed roads; traveling by tram is recommended. Time limits: 90 minutes for 10 km and 45 minutes for 5 km. There is a hydration and refreshment station on the course.

name: Karneval-Marathon
description: The Carnival Marathon in Cologne-Pesch combines a passion for marathon running with the enthusiasm of Cologne Carnival. The course is measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and follows a flat, paved loop around Pescher See, which participants run several times. The field is limited to 50, and costumes are expressly encouraged to add to the fun.
course_highlights: 15 laps of 2.732 km each, plus a 1.215 km out-and-back section at the start for the marathon distance
Flat loop around Pescher See in a protected landscape area
Refreshment station in the start/finish area, passed every 2.7 km
additional: Race numbers are distributed from 9:30 to 10:30 at the playground by Pescher See. Changing facilities, showers, and toilets are available at the nearby clubhouse of FC Pesch 1956 e.V. Timing is manual, by punching the lap numbers on each race number. After the race, there is Kölsch beer and a unique Carnival finisher's medal. The event is non-commercial, and proceeds are donated to Cologne Carnival associations. Course on a paved 2.7 km loop; no lighting or medical station; race numbers are limited (50); no refunds for non-participation or force majeure; participation from U20.

name: 14. PKO Bieg Niepodległości w Rzeszowie
description: The 14th PKO Independence Run in Rzeszów is an annual running event organized by the Rzeszów Biega Running Club. The 10 km main race takes place on November 11 and promotes an active lifestyle and running in Rzeszów and the Podkarpackie region. Participants compete in various age categories, and everyone receives a commemorative medal at the finish. The organizer provides a race pack, including a T-shirt, bib number, and chip, as well as the option to have the medal engraved.
course_highlights: 10 km main race
Classifications by age and special categories (e.g. doctors, top Rzeszów residents)
Participants must wear the organizer’s T-shirt (white or red)
additional: The participant limit is 3,500. On race day, race packs are available only at the race office; payment is by cash. Medal engraving is available for an additional fee of PLN 30. Participants compete at their own risk and must have a valid medical certificate or submit a declaration of fitness to participate.

name: 36. Bieg Niepodległości w Warszawie
location: al. Jana Pawła II, Warsaw, Poland
description: The 36th Independence Run in Warsaw is a classic 10-kilometer road race that brings together thousands of participants each year to actively celebrate Independence Day. The course is fast and ideal for setting personal bests, with the start and finish at Jana Pawła II Avenue. Alongside the main race, there are also events for children and young people over the symbolic distance of 1,918 meters, and a Nordic Walking march of approximately 6 kilometers. The event combines sporting competition with a patriotic atmosphere and a shared celebration.
course_highlights: A 10 km course through the streets of Warsaw, starting and finishing at Jana Pawła II Avenue
A fast course conducive to personal bests, almost unchanged for years
The symbolic 1,918 m Independence Mile for children and young people
additional: On race day, the race bib must be worn on the front of the outfit, and participants must line up in the appropriate start zone based on their predicted finish time. The organizers provide spectator zones and activities for participants and their loved ones near the start and finish. Press accreditation is also available, with limited access to the start and finish zones. A Virtual Independence Run over 10 km is available for those who cannot be in Warsaw.

name: Poznański Bieg Niepodległości – Kocham Polskę!
description: The Poznań Independence Run – I Love Poland! is a cross-country race held in picturesque locations in Poznań, particularly in Strzeszyn near Malibu Beach. The event is part of the activities of a group of running enthusiasts who have been promoting cross-country running in Greater Poland since 2014, with an emphasis on attractive courses and the sporting character of the event. The race has a patriotic dimension and takes place on 11 November, combining sport with a celebration of Poland’s independence. Runners are invited to take part in a range of distances amid beautiful natural surroundings.
course_highlights: Cross-country course around Strzeszyn and Malibu Beach
Picturesque green areas of Poznań
A patriotic race held on 11 November
additional: The organiser is a group of running enthusiasts from Greater Poland, active since 2014 and specialising in cross-country races. The race takes place in the green areas of Strzeszyn, near Malibu Beach. The event has a patriotic character and is part of the Poznań Running Triad. Participant limit: 750; picturesque courses; cross-country races.

name: 9 Olsztyński Bieg Niepodległości
description: The Olsztyn Independence Run is an annual patriotic sporting event held in Olsztyn, combining the joy of running with the celebration of Poland’s Independence Day. The event takes place at the Ukiel Recreation and Sports Centre and includes 5 km and 10 km races, Nordic walking, and children’s races of up to 400 metres. The event is open to everyone, from experienced runners to whole families with children, creating an atmosphere of community and patriotism. The main race is scheduled to start at 9:00, and places are limited, so registration is online.
course_highlights: The race routes run through the Ukiel Recreation and Sports Centre and along nearby streets: Sielska, Schumana, and Kapitańska
Available distances are 5 km and 10 km, as well as Nordic walking
Children’s races on short routes of up to 400 metres
additional: The start and finish are located at the Ukiel Recreation and Sports Centre. The event also includes Nordic walking and children’s races. Traffic disruptions are expected along the race route.

name: Gdyński Bieg Niepodległości
description: The Gdynia Independence Run with PGZ Naval Shipyard is an annual running event held in Gdynia to commemorate Poland regaining its independence. The event attracts thousands of participants who come together to celebrate the run’s patriotic spirit. The route passes through charming parts of the city, and participants can expect professional organization and a festive sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: The route passes through central Gdynia
The event takes place in November to commemorate National Independence Day
A patriotic atmosphere and sporting camaraderie among residents
additional: Photos and video footage are taken during the event to promote events organized by GCS and the Municipality of Gdynia.

name: XXXVIII Goleniowska Mila Niepodległości o Puchar Burmistrza Gminy Goleniów
description: The Goleniów Independence Mile is an annual road race held in the Gmina of Goleniów to commemorate Poland regaining its independence. The event attracts strong interest from the local community and runners from the region. The race course is one mile long, making it appealing to both recreational and more experienced runners. The organizers ensure professional event management and a welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: A one-mile course (approx. 1,609 meters)
A road race in central Goleniów
An event commemorating Poland regaining its independence

location: Veľké Uherce, Partizánske District, Trenčín Region, Slovakia

name: Hannah Pilsen Trail Krkavec
organizer: Pilsen Trail pořadatelský team, Jiří Mlátil Bouchal
description: Hannah Pilsen Trail Krkavec je tradiční podzimní běh v lesích okolo Plzně, který nabízí tratě pro všechny věkové kategorie od nejmenších dětí až po zkušené vytrvalce. Závod se koná v krásném přírodním prostředí s výběhem na Chlum, trailovými úseky a parádními vyhlídkami podél Berounky a stoupáním na Krkavec. Na startu je vždy početná účast a v cíli čeká na všechny dřevěná finisher medaile. Součástí závodu je také občerstvení na trati i v cíli a elektronická časomíra s čipem.
course_highlights: Výběh na Chlum
Trailové úseky s vyhlídkami podél Berounky
Stoupání na Krkavec
additional: Prezentace závodníků probíhá od 8:30 do 10:50 v centru závodu. Každý závodník obdrží startovní číslo a čip pro elektronickou časomíru, který je nutné vrátit po doběhu. Parkování je omezené, doporučuje se využít parkoviště kolem Boleveckého rybníka a dojít pěšky. Vyhlašování výsledků probíhá postupně podle kategorií, dětské tratě mají vyhlášení kolem 11:30, hlavní tratě kolem 14:20. K dispozici jsou také dětské tratě.

name: BoBoBěh
location: Bedřichov, Liberec District, Liberec Region, Česko
description: BoBoBěh je závěrečný horský běh trilogie BoBoloppet, který vede krásami Jizerských hor. Závod nabízí trasu dlouhou 30 km přes Vysoký hřeben, Kanál, hráz Černé Nisy, Olivetskou horu, Ferdinandov a náročné stoupání Bílým Štolpichem. Pro méně zkušené běžce je k dispozici kratší trasa Buď Fit na 10 km a dětský MINI běh na 1 km. Závod je otevřen všem milovníkům běhu a přírody a nabízí jedinečný zážitek z horského terénu s krásnými výhledy.
course_highlights: Trasa vede přes Vysoký hřeben a oblíbený Kanál
Překonání hráze Černé Nisy a dvakrát výběh na Olivetskou horu
Nejtěžší stoupání Bílým Štolpichem v Jizerských horách
additional: Start není hromadný, závodníci mají dvouhodinový limit pro opuštění startovního koridoru, což umožňuje taktiku startu. Trasa není značená, závod je částečně orientačním během. Možnost volby běžeckého stylu během závodu.

name: Běh přes Černovírský les
location: Hlušovice, Olomouc District, Olomouc Region, Česko
description: Běh přes Černovírský les je tradiční rovinatý závod dlouhý 10 km, který vede po cyklostezce z Hlušovic do Olomouce a zpět. Závod je součástí Velké ceny vytrvalců Olomouckého kraje a přitahuje běžce různých věkových kategorií. Trasa je vhodná pro běžce, kteří preferují rychlý a nenáročný profil s příjemným podzimním prostředím. Závod je oblíbený mezi místními i vytrvalci z okolí a nabízí příležitost poměřit síly v přátelské atmosféře.
course_highlights: Rovinatý profil trasy po cyklostezce
Trasa vede z Hlušovic do Olomouce a zpět
Délka závodu 10 km
additional: V minulosti se závod konal v listopadu a účastní se ho běžci z různých věkových kategorií. Trasa je vhodná i pro veterány a nabízí příjemné podzimní běžecké prostředí.

name: Běh Dlouhými záhony
location: ZŠ Lány, Úpice, Královéhradecký kraj, Česko
description: Běh Dlouhými záhony je náročný krosový závod dlouhý 6,8 km s výraznými výškovými rozdíly. Závod je součástí Českého poháru v běhu do vrchu a Zimní běžecké ligy O krále Jestřebích hor, což podtrhuje jeho prestiž a náročnost. Trať vede v okolí Úpice - ZŠ Lány v Královéhradeckém kraji a nabízí běžcům výzvu v podobě členitého terénu. Závod je vhodný pro zkušené běžce, kteří hledají kvalitní horský běh s technickými pasážemi.
course_highlights: Náročný kros dlouhý 6,8 km
Velké výškové rozdíly na trati
Součást Českého poháru v běhu do vrchu a Zimní běžecké ligy

name: Svatomartinský běh
location: Petřkovice u Starého Jičína, Moravian-Silesian Region, Česko
description: Svatomartinský běh je tradiční běžecký závod konaný v malebném prostředí Petřkovic u Starého Jičína v Moravskoslezském kraji. Závod nabízí tratě pro muže i ženy na vzdálenosti 5,5 km a 11 km, které vedou krásnou přírodou a jsou vhodné pro různé úrovně běžců. Akce je součástí sportovního programu Zámku Berchtold a přitahuje běžce z širokého okolí. Po závodě je možné využít zázemí hotelu a restaurace v areálu zámku.
course_highlights: Trasy vedou malebnou přírodou v okolí Petřkovic u Starého Jičína
Dvě hlavní vzdálenosti: 5,5 km a 11 km pro muže i ženy
Přátelská atmosféra a možnost využití zázemí Zámku Berchtold
additional: Výsledky z předchozích ročníků jsou dostupné online. Areál nabízí parkování pro cca 150 aut na třech parkovištích. Po závodě je možné využít hotelové a restaurační služby v areálu zámku Berchtold.

name: Ludgeřovický kros
location: Hřiště TJ Ludgeřovice, Ludgeřovice, Moravian-Silesian Region, Česko
description: Ludgeřovický kros je tradiční běžecký závod v přírodním prostředí obce Ludgeřovice, který každoročně přitahuje malé i velké běžce. Hlavní trať měří 10 km a vede členitým terénem - lesními cestami, polními pěšinami i kolem místních památek. Kromě hlavního závodu jsou k dispozici i kratší běhy na 4 km, Nordic walking na 9 km a dětské tratě podle věkových kategorií. Závod je součástí Prajzsko-opavské běžecké ligy a nese podtitul Běh válečných veteránů, kterým vzdává úctu hrdinům nejen z minulosti.
course_highlights: Hlavní trať 10 km s 140 m převýšením
Terén zahrnuje lesní cesty, polní pěšiny a okolí místních památek
Doplňkové závody: běh 4 km, Nordic walking 9 km, dětské tratě 100 a 500 m
additional: Kovová finišerská medaile vlastního designu, pamětní magnetka pro prvních 200 na prezentaci, kniha Ještě jeden maraton pro prvních 300 přihlášených, finanční odměny pro vítěze hlavního závodu, čipová časomíra i pro dětské běžce, vyhlašování i 4. místa ve všech závodech, doprovodný program Den válečných veteránů Ludgeřovice, osobní video a fotografie ze závodu, šatny, sprchy a pohodlné parkování, dětské běhy s vyhlášením a tombola. Trať na 10 km, 9 km, 4 km, dětské běhy, počasí nejisté, propojení s Dnem válečných veteránů

name: Půlmaraton pátera Václava Kosmáka
description: Půlmaraton pátera Václava Kosmáka je silniční obrátkový závod, který vede z Moravských Budějovic do Lukova a zpět. Závod nabízí běžcům možnost poměřit síly na půlmaratonské trati v malebném prostředí Vysočiny. Akce je vhodná pro všechny běžce, kteří hledají kvalitní závod s tradiční atmosférou a dobře značenou trasou.
course_highlights: Silniční obrátkový závod
Trasa vede z Moravských Budějovic do Lukova a zpět
Malebné prostředí Vysočiny

name: Hubertův lesní trail
description: Hubertův lesní trail je běžecký závod pro děti i dospělé, který se koná v krásném prostředí hradeckých lesů na Lesní "Finské" běžecké stezce v Malšovicích. Start i cíl jsou situovány nedaleko Lesního hřbitova. Závod nabízí dětské kategorie s kratšími tratěmi bez měření času a hlavní závod pro dospělé. Pro první tři závodníky v každé kategorii jsou připraveny medaile a drobné dárky. Výsledky jsou zveřejněny do 24 hodin po závodě na webu pořadatele.
course_highlights: Lesní "Finská" běžecká stezka v Malšovicích
Start a cíl 200 m od Lesního hřbitova
Krásné lesní prostředí hradeckých lesů
additional: Dětské kategorie startují od 10:20, prezence dětí je od 09:30 do 10:15. Hlavní závod dospělých startuje mezi 11:00-11:45. Dětské závody startují v 10:20 a hlavní závod ve 12:00. Startovné zahrnuje měření času, občerstvení a medaili; první tři v každé kategorii získají také drobný dárek. MHD: linka 9, zastávka Lesní hřbitov; parkování je u Lesního hřbitova.

name: Dvouetapový kros Zaječov
location: Malá Víska, Zaječov, Central Bohemian Region, Česko
description: Dvouetapový kros Zaječov je běžecký závod rozdělený do dvou etap konaných během dvou dnů na tratích připravených pro závody psích spřežení v Malé Vísce u Zaječova. První den se běží dlouhá etapa o délce 13 km, druhý den krátká etapa 5,7 km. Hlavní výzvou je soutěž v kombinaci obou etap s celkovou délkou 18,7 km, kde se časy závodníků přepočítávají koeficientem podle pohlaví a věku. Závod je otevřený všem bez rozdílu pohlaví a věku a nabízí krásné přírodní prostředí louk a lesních cest v Brdech.
course_highlights: Dvě etapy na tratích pro závody psích spřežení
Povrch tratí tvoří louky a lesní cesty
Kombinovaná soutěž o celkové délce 18,7 km
additional: Po každé etapě se vyhlašuje prvních 5 závodníků podle přepočtených časů. Muži ve věku 25-30 let mají koeficient 1,0, ostatní kategorie mají koeficient nižší. Dlouhá etapa startuje v sobotu 14. 11. ve 12:00, krátká etapa v neděli 15. 11. v 11:00. Místo konání je louka Malá Víska u Zaječova.

name: Kuchařovická výzva
description: Kuchařovická výzva je běžecký závod pořádaný v Kuchařovicích, který nabízí tratě pro muže, ženy i děti. Mužská trať měří 8,4 km s převýšením 114 metrů, ženská trať 5,9 km s převýšením 71 metrů a dětská trať je dlouhá 150 metrů. Závod vede převážně po lesních cestách a asfaltu s mírně zvlněným profilem. Start i prezence probíhají před víceúčelovým zařízením v Kuchařovicích. Parkování je zajištěno u restaurace Emrammus, mateřské školy a na ulici Větrná.
course_highlights: Trať pro muže 8,4 km s převýšením 114 m
Trať pro ženy 5,9 km s převýšením 71 m
70 % lesní cesty, 30 % asfalt, zvlněný profil
additional: Prezence a registrace probíhá od 8:30 do 9:30 před víceúčelovým zařízením v Kuchařovicích.

name: Hrouzovka 2026
description: Tento závod nabízí trať dlouhou přibližně 15 km, vedoucí přes kopcovitý terén s různorodým povrchem, včetně asfaltu, trávy a kamenitých cest. Akce je určena pro běžce, kteří hledají výzvu v přírodním prostředí a chtějí si užít sportovní atmosféru v krásném okolí. Podrobnosti o organizátorovi a registraci zatím nejsou zveřejněny, ale závod je součástí místního běžeckého kalendáře.

name: Podzimní Řakom
location: Dolany village square, inn hall, Dolany, Plzeň Region, Česko

name: Alten-Busecker Winterlaufserie - 1. Event
description: The Alten-Buseck Winter Running Series is a long-standing running event held in the Buseck/Alten-Buseck region. It comprises several races over different distances, including 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, 15 km and a half marathon (21.1 km). The races each start at 2:00 p.m. at the Harbig Hall in Alten-Buseck and offer a friendly atmosphere for runners of all ages and ability levels. The series promotes a sense of community with a series classification for participants who take part in all three races. Refreshments and an awards ceremony for the fastest runners follow the finish.
course_highlights: Course profiles for 5 km, 10 km, 15 km and 21.1 km are available on Komoot
Start and finish at the Harbig Hall in Alten-Buseck
Timing with a passive transponder from Raceresult
additional: Timing is provided using passive transponders from Raceresult. There is a series classification for participants who take part in all three races in the series. After finishing, runners receive a complimentary soft drink. Coffee and cake are available for purchase. Toilets, showers and changing facilities are available at the Harbig Hall. The awards ceremony takes place after the races, recognising the three fastest participants (men/women) in each race on the day, as well as the age-group winners at the end of the series. Winter running series, cross-country character, several race distances, community event in November 2026

name: Alzauenlauf TSV Trostberg
description: The Alzauenlauf in Trostberg is a traditional race. The 10 km main course runs through the picturesque Trostberg Alzauen, an idyllic woodland area along the Alz, the outflow of Lake Chiemsee. The course combines pleasant natural forest paths with a lap in the stadium, offering a varied running experience. Shorter distances are also available for children and young people. All participants can enjoy refreshments in the finish area, and changing rooms and showers are available at the nearby Alois-Böck sports hall.
course_highlights: 10 km course through the picturesque Trostberg Alzauen on natural surfaces
Start and finish in the stadium, with one and a half laps before the forest section
The course runs along the Alz, the outflow of Lake Chiemsee
additional: Race-number collection from 10:30 to 13:00 at the Alois-Böck sports hall. Electronic chip timing, with the chip integrated into the race number. Changing rooms and showers are available at the Alois-Böck sports hall. Anyone who registers for the 10 km course at least 14 days before the race will receive a technical T-shirt; after that, shirts are available only while supplies last. Late entries are possible for an additional fee of €5. The race takes place in all weather conditions. Refreshments are available for all participants at the finish. Participants must accept the DLV terms and conditions. The event includes refreshments, changing rooms, showers and chip timing; online registration is available; family-friendly and suitable for all age groups.

name: Bokeler 6 Stundenlauf
description: The Bokeler 6-Hour Run is an established ultramarathon challenge in northern Germany, held in Bokel, Schleswig-Holstein. Participants run a loop course approximately 3.67 kilometres long, completing as many laps as possible in six hours. The event attracts endurance athletes looking to test their limits and offers a family-friendly atmosphere in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: 3.67 km loop course
Flat terrain in Schleswig-Holstein
Six-hour run with individually determined distance
additional: The course is a loop that runners complete multiple times. The event is a longstanding tradition and takes place annually. Results from previous years are available on the website. The race is held on a 2,040 m loop course, with a growing number of participants and a legendary refreshment buffet. A participant record was set in 2023, and the event was already fully booked well in advance for 2024. November weather is usually cool and rainy, adding to the challenge.

name: Gudensberger Crosslauf 2026 Hermann Kilian Gedächtnislauf
description: The Gudensberg Crosslauf Hermann Kilian Memorial Run is a long-standing cross-country race in Gudensberg, offering short off-road distances. The start and finish are on a dirt track and meadow below the Terrano swimming pool on Schwimmbadweg. The course runs mostly on unpaved paths, and spikes are allowed, emphasizing its classic cross-country character. The event commemorates Hermann Kilian, a dedicated runner and coach with TSV Obervorschütz.
course_highlights: Start and finish on a dirt track and meadow below the Terrano swimming pool
Course mostly on unpaved paths; spikes allowed
Three distances: 1000m (two small laps), 2000m (two large laps), 4000m (one longer lap)
additional: Depending on the event announcement, district championships may be included. Typical November weather is expected, with temperatures around 7 °C and rainy days. November is usually rainy; the terrain has a cross-country style. The event honors Hermann Kilian for his dedication to running.

name: Int. DEULUX-Lauf
description: The International DEULUX Run takes place annually on the second Saturday in November in Langsur and offers four different races for all age groups. From a 360-meter run for the youngest participants to the 10-kilometer road race—the largest 10-kilometer road race by number of participants in Rhineland-Palatinate—there is something for everyone. The event is part of the 4-Regio Cup and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and professional organization. Runners can look forward to varied courses and special awards.
course_highlights: Four different races, from 360 m to 10 km
The largest 10-kilometer road race by number of participants in Rhineland-Palatinate
Family-friendly event with a special award for every participant
additional: Start times: youngest participants’ race 13:30, children’s race 14:00, youth race 14:30, main race 15:00. All children’s races are free to enter. RFID chip timing for the children’s and youth races. Late entries are not possible, including on the day of the event. Several race distances, including children’s and youth races; registration will open in a few weeks. The event takes place in Langsur.

name: Kerner Nachtlauf
description: The Kerner Night Run is an atmospheric autumn race held on Saturday evening in Kernen. Runners set off at dusk on a loop of about 4.5 km, following illuminated paths through gardens, vineyards, and residential streets around Kernen. A 10 km distance is also offered. The event celebrates a passion for running and the shared joy of sport in a special atmosphere.
course_highlights: Loop of about 4.5 km along illuminated paths
Route passes through gardens, vineyards, and residential streets
Starts at dusk on Saturday evening
additional: Run along illuminated paths, with 4.5 km and 10 km options; an atmosphere lit by lights and torches; finish at the stadium with snacks and drinks

name: Neusser Erftlauf
description: The Neuss Erftlauf is a traditional running event organized annually by DJK Novesia 1919 Neuss e.V. The 53rd edition is taking place and offers runners of various ability levels an attractive course along the Erft. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, good organization, and the support of numerous sponsors. The 15 km main race is especially popular and has seen a strong increase in participants in recent years.
course_highlights: 15 km main race with a construction detour; the 5 km loop is eligible for record lists
Course along the Erft with varied terrain
Refreshment stations and refreshing drinking water at Durstlöscher
additional: The Erftlauf is supported by numerous volunteers, who help ensure smooth operations along the course, in the start and finish areas, and at refreshment stations. The event is supported by sponsors including the RheinLand Versicherungsgruppe, Stadtwerke Neuss, and other partners. There is a construction detour on the 15 km course, but the 5 km loop remains eligible for record lists. An extensive photo album is available online. Courses on paved paths and roads; spikes are not allowed. Online registration opens on 01.09.2025. Start times from 11:30 a.m. Medals for children; prizes in kind for winners. Limited parking; showers available.

name: Potzberg-Berglauf
description: The Potzberg Mountain Run is a traditional hill race organised by TuS Glan-Münchweiler. The course covers 8.2 kilometres with 350 metres of elevation gain and offers runners a challenging experience in the beautiful landscape around Potzberg. The race takes place annually and attracts both ambitious runners and hill-running enthusiasts. The organisers thank their sponsors and are happy to answer any further questions.
course_highlights: Course distance: 8.2 kilometres
Elevation gain: 350 metres
Landscape around Potzberg
additional: The Potzberg Mountain Run is the 4th race in 2026. Results from previous races are available on the website. No events or registration dates are listed on the website. TuS Glan-Münchweiler can be contacted by telephone for further information. The race is part of the Pfälzer Berglauf-Pokal-Cup and has categories for adults and young people, as well as a convenient baggage and clothing transport service to the finish. The event takes place in November.

name: Sparkassen Cross Pforzheim
description: The Sparkassen Cross Pforzheim is a traditional cross-country race held in the picturesque surroundings of Lohwiesenhof in Pforzheim-Huchenfeld. The event offers runners of all ages and ability levels challenging terrain and varied courses. Alongside the sporting competition, children’s training and inclusive races are also a focus, making it a family-friendly and inclusive running experience. The event is supported by the City of Pforzheim and is known for its professional organization and varied supporting program.
course_highlights: Varied cross-country courses on the grounds of Lohwiesenhof
Children’s training with Kira Weis
Inclusive races such as the Special Olympics Cross and the Integration Run
additional: Cashless payment is available on site; extensive refreshments; parking available; event held under the patronage of the mayor and the local district mayor; various additional competitions, including school championships, Baden-Württemberg Cross Championships, and university championships; live videos and photos from previous years available online. Competition venue: Würmstraße 68, 75181 Pforzheim-Huchenfeld.

name: Steverlauf
location: Sportpark Senden, Senden, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Steverlauf is an established running event held annually at Sportpark Senden, welcoming runners of all ages. The courses over 5 km and 10 km, officially measured by the DLV, run along park paths and paths beside the canal, offering an attractive running setting. Children and young people have a separate entry option at a reduced entry fee. The event takes place in all weather conditions and offers changing and shower facilities, as well as refreshments including coffee, cake, soup and bratwurst. The organizing team looks forward to welcoming many participants and to a successful event.
course_highlights: Courses over 5 km and 10 km, officially measured by the DLV
Routes run along park paths and paths beside the canal
Changing and shower facilities at Sportpark Senden
additional: Refreshments including coffee, tea, cake, biscuits, soup and bratwurst provided by roterkeil Senden e.V. The event takes place in all weather conditions. No liability for damages. Changing and shower facilities are available. Routes pass through Schloss Senden, along the canal and through Königspark; there is a good supply of cake, drinks and hot food; the event can take place in any weather.

name: Wuppertaler Löwenlauf
description: The Wuppertal Löwenlauf is an exciting running event held in Wuppertal. Organized by Leichtathletik-Verband Nordrhein e.V., the race offers a challenging cross-country or forest course in a natural setting. The event welcomes runners of all ability levels and promises a sporting experience in a motivating atmosphere. It is a great opportunity to experience Wuppertal’s running community and enjoy nature.
course_highlights: Cross-country/forest run in a natural setting
Challenging terrain for runners of different ability levels
Outdoor event in Wuppertal in November
additional: The race is a forest and cross-country event; details about course distance and registration are not specified.

name: Kunstweglauf Rednitzhembach
description: The Kunstweglauf in Rednitzhembach is organised by the endurance sports club PowerBärs Rednitzhembach e.V. and will take place for the 18th time in 2026. The event brings art and sport together in a unique symbiosis and is centred around the school building in Rednitzhembach, which offers excellent facilities including changing rooms, showers and refreshments. The start and finish are right in front of the school, creating a pleasant atmosphere for participants and spectators. The race is an established event in the region south of Nuremberg and offers a friendly, sporty experience in November.
course_highlights: Start and finish directly in front of the school building in Rednitzhembach
Excellent facilities including changing rooms, showers and the school café
A running event that brings art and sport together
additional: Late entries are possible on the event day up to 60 minutes before the respective start. The event takes place in and around the school building, which serves as its hub, with an assembly hall for the awards ceremony and refreshments. The event also includes results, race information and photos, and is a creative blend of art and running fun in Rednitzhembach.

name: Nussdorflauf
description: The Nussdorflauf is a long-standing running event in Nussdorf bei Eberdingen, held annually in November. The event offers various competitions for all age groups, from Bambini and schoolchildren’s races to beginner and panoramic runs, as well as Nordic walking. All participants receive a medal and certificate after crossing the finish line, and some receive trophies or cash prizes. The race is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and broad support from sponsors and volunteers.
course_highlights: Various distances from 400 m to 10 km
10 km panoramic run with age-group categories for all ages
Courses for Bambini, schoolchildren, young people, and adults
additional: Late registration is possible on race day from 10:30 at the Nussdorf community hall, up to 30 minutes before the respective start. Trophies and cash prizes are awarded to places 1–3 in various categories. Registration for the Bambini and schoolchildren’s races is handled through schools. Various race distances; registration opens on 01.09.2025; participation conditions, results, and photos available online.

name: Bezirksmeisterschaften Crosslauf
description: The District Cross-Country Championships in Velpke are a long-standing cross-country competition organized by the NLV Braunschweig District. The race is open to various age groups, from children and young people to senior and masters athletes. The event offers a challenging cross-country course on varied terrain in the Braunschweig region. Online registration is available until shortly before race day, allowing for flexible participation.
course_highlights: Cross-country course on varied terrain
Competition for children, youth, senior and masters athletes
Event in the Braunschweig District with regional significance
additional: Online entries are possible until the entry deadline at 23:59 on the evening before the race.

name: Biegerparklauf
description: The Biegerparklauf in Duisburg-Huckingen is a traditional running event held on a partly paved circuit through Biegerpark. The 10 km runners complete three laps, the 5 km runners two laps, while schoolgirls run a shortened lap. The final 300 metres are on the stadium’s cinder track. The event offers various distances for bambinis, schoolchildren and adults, and is known for good organisation, with transponder timing and medals for all children.
course_highlights: Circuit through Biegerpark, partly paved
10 km runners complete 3 laps; 5 km runners complete 2 laps
Final 300 metres on the stadium’s cinder track
additional: Late entries are possible online until the event date and in person up to 30 minutes before the respective start, with a late-entry fee of €2.00 from 12.11.2027. Bib number distribution begins at 11 a.m. on the event day. Timing is by transponder in the bib number. Showers, changing rooms and toilets are available at the sports facility. All bambinis and schoolchildren receive medals; trophies go to the top three in each school class and to the overall winners of the 5 km and 10 km races. Certificates can be printed online or collected in person, with a wait. Medical services are available on site.

name: Deutsche Polizeimeisterschaften Crosslauf
description: The German Police Cross-Country Championships are the police’s official cross-country running championship, focused on competition within the police force. The event takes place in the Ravensbergerwald in Potsdam and features distances of 3.6 km and 9 km. The races are part of a larger German running series regulated by the German Athletics Association (DLV), with officially measured courses and professional timing. Registration is generally handled through the state athletics associations. The race offers a challenging cross-country experience in typical November weather, with cool temperatures and frequent rain.
course_highlights: Cross-country running in the Ravensbergerwald
Officially measured courses of 3.6 km and 9 km
Part of the DLV-regulated Police Championships
additional: Typical November weather: approx. 7 °C, a low of 2 °C, an average of 45 mm of precipitation, and rainy days. The event is not an open road race but is exclusively for police runners. It is not open to the general public and is organized within the police force. The challenging course includes uphill and downhill sections and sandy terrain.

name: Graal-Müritzer Schneckenlauf
description: The Graal-Müritz Schneckenlauf is a long-standing running event held annually at the Graal-Müritz Forest Stadium. Runners and walkers of all ages can choose from several distances, including a Bambini race, 2 km, 5 km and 10 km. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, good organization, and awards for the strongest classes and best teams. The Streuselschnecken pastries served after the finish are especially popular.
course_highlights: Red course: 2 km run
Blue course: 5 km and 10 km (2 x 5 km laps)
Start and finish at the Graal-Müritz Forest Stadium
additional: Start times: 10:00 a.m. Bambini race, 10:30 a.m. 2 km run, 11:00 a.m. 5 km and 10 km runs. Walkers start 5 minutes after the runners. Training for children takes place on Wednesdays from 4:30–6:00 p.m. in the sports hall at Ostseegrundschule. Traditional awards are given to the strongest class and best team. Streuselschnecken pastries are a popular post-race treat. The race takes place at the Forest Stadium. Advance registration is available, with categories for children and adults as well as team and class competitions.

name: Herzowerke-Trail 2026
location: TSH sports grounds, Herzogenaurach, Bavaria, Germany
description: The 3rd Herzowerke Trail takes place in Herzogenaurach. The trail starts and finishes at the TSH sports grounds and runs through the Dohnwald around the town. Several distances are available, from 0.5 km to 16 km; the longest distance can be run as one or two laps. It is a true forest trail, and the use of poles is permitted. There are no refreshment stations along the route; refreshments are available only in the start and finish area. The event is organized by the running division of Turnerschaft Herzogenaurach.
course_highlights: Trail through the Dohnwald around Herzogenaurach
A true trail where the use of poles is permitted
Refreshments only in the start and finish area; no provisions along the route
additional: Several distances are available: 0.5 km Bambini Trail, 2 km Kids Trail, 4 km Youth Trail, 8 km Speed Trail, and 16 km (one or two laps). The course is self-supported, with no water or refreshment stations in the forest. Times, result lists, and placings will be published online. The top three will be honored. Trail with various distances; self-supported in the forest sections; start and finish at the TSH sports grounds; results and placings online; cool and wet November weather is possible.

name: Potsdamer Cross im Rahmen der 22. DPM
description: The 2nd Potsdam Cross, held as part of the 22nd DPM, is an athletics competition organized by OSC Potsdam Luftschiffhafen e.V. The event takes place in Potsdam and gives runners the opportunity to compete in cross-country running. It is part of the regional athletics scene and is open to athletes of various age groups. Participants must register by the entry deadline.

name: Zeiler Waldmarathon
description: The Zeil Forest Marathon is a challenging race through the Haßberge Nature Park in the Zeil am Main running park. The course follows almost entirely paved forest paths, including Schlossberg and Bischofsheimer Höhe, with wonderful views of the Sieben Seen and Bischofsheimer See. The marathon consists of two laps of the half-marathon course, which has 420 metres of elevation gain. Refreshments are available every 5 km, and timing is recorded using a chip integrated into the race bib.
course_highlights: Challenging course through the Haßberge Nature Park on paved forest paths
Route over Schlossberg and Bischofsheimer Höhe, passing the Sieben Seen
Half-marathon course with 420 metres of elevation gain; the marathon consists of two laps
additional: Race-bib pickup at the school (Schulring 3, 97475 Zeil am Main) on Friday from 19:30 to 21:00 and Saturday from 8:00. Showers and changing facilities are available in the school gym. Toilets are available in the start/finish area and in the school gym. No baggage-storage service. Free bus transfer from the school building to the start every 5 minutes.

name: ILM – Ich lauf mit gegen Gewalt
W rytmie biegu, w rytmie jeziora
Zemplínsky extrém – Beh v múzeu
description: Zemplín Extreme is a running league in eastern Slovakia that offers challenging courses, clear rules, and fast results. Run in the Museum is one of the league’s events and takes place on the grounds of the Zemplín Museum in Michalovce. Runners can enjoy quality courses that count towards the league standings and compete in various categories. The league is suitable for runners looking for serious races with professional organization.
course_highlights: Running courses on the grounds of the Zemplín Museum in Michalovce
Courses that count towards the standings, with clear rules and fast results
Part of a running league in eastern Slovakia
additional: The race is part of a league where points are awarded based on finishing position on the scored course. The schedule, registration, and results load directly from the Racetime platform.

name: Zelenyáková trinástka
location: Cultural House, Hronovce, Levice District, Slovakia

name: Šutrovský bežecký maratón
location: Ivanka pri Dunaji, Senec District, Slovakia

name: Beh na Minčol
location: Višňové, Žilina District, Žilina Region, Slovakia
distance_verbose: 118 km, Maratón, 13.7 km, 11 km, 10 km, 8.3 km, 6 km, 5 km, 4.5 km
description: The Minčol Run is the toughest uphill race in the vicinity of the Višňovská Valley. It follows a marked hiking trail to the summit of Minčol, with beautiful views of the Krivánska and Lúčanská sections of the Malá Fatra. The course is characterized by steep climbs from start to finish, with little chance to rest; the final section often requires a fast walk. The race is organized with an emphasis on thorough preparation and the experience of running in nature. Refreshments and lunch are provided after the finish at the Holý Diel ski resort.
course_highlights: A marked hiking trail with blue waymarks
Steep climbs from the start to the finish
Views of the Krivánska and Lúčanská sections of the Malá Fatra from the summit of Minčol
additional: Race check-in is from 8:30 to 9:30. Results are announced shortly after the last runner finishes, at approximately 12:30. Transport for each runner’s belongings to the results-announcement venue is provided. Refreshments are available on the course at approximately 2 km and at the finish. After the race, lunch (homemade cabbage soup and a drink) is served at the Holý Diel ski resort.

name: Ferčekovská desiatka
location: Malé pole, Ferčekovce, Spišská Nová Ves, Slovakia

tiers.label: tier_2
