name: Lysacup – Visalaje, parkoviště
location: Parkoviště ve Visalajích, Visalaje, Staré Hamry, Česko
description: Lysacup je zimní etapový běžecký pohár v Beskydech, který se koná většinou na Lysé hoře. Každý víkend se běží etapa z jiného místa a soutěží se jak jednotlivci, tak týmy. Start je obvykle v 10:00 a účastníci používají čipy, které se aktivují na celý ročník dobrovolným příspěvkem. Závod nabízí atmosféru tradičního horského běhu s možností zapojení i jako chodec. Celkový vítěz získává putovní pohár a závod je podporován řadou partnerů a sponzorů.
course_highlights: Zimní etapový běh v horském terénu Beskyd
Každá etapa startuje z jiného místa, většinou na Lysé hoře (1323 m n.m.)
Atmosféra horského běhu s bodováním jednotlivců i týmů
additional: Start je obvykle v 10:00, účastníci musí mít čip aktivovaný na celý ročník, který se získává zasláním dobrovolného příspěvku. Čipy lze odkoupit od jiných závodníků nebo pořadatelů. V případě velkého počtu závodníků si pořadatel vyhrazuje právo upravit bodování. Do celkového hodnocení se škrtají dvě nejhorší etapy z první a druhé poloviny poháru. Možnost účasti i jako chodec s přiděleným počtem bodů. Celkový vítěz i nejlepší týmy získávají putovní poháry. Pořadatelé zajišťují pitný režim a ceny od sponzorů.

name: 13. Schloss Marienburg Marathon
description: The 13th Schloss Marienburg Marathon takes place on November 21, 2026, in Nordstemmen-Adensen. This varied scenic marathon is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners. The course follows village streets, paved and unpaved country lanes, woodland paths, and trails, with about 560 metres of elevation gain. A special highlight is the refreshment station in the courtyard of Schloss Marienburg, where runners can take a break. The 21.1 km course is shaped like a figure eight, with three refreshment stations in Adensen, and offers beautiful views of the Calenberger Land and the Leinebergland in good weather.
course_highlights: Varied course featuring village streets, country lanes, woodland paths, and trails
Refreshment station in the courtyard of Schloss Marienburg
Figure-eight course with about 560 metres of elevation gain and views of the Calenberger Land and Leinebergland
additional: Early marathon start at 9:00 a.m. for runners who need more than 6 hours. Official electronic timekeeping. Refreshments approximately every 5 km, including water, tea, isotonic drinks, cola, fruit, and gingerbread. Changing rooms, showers, toilets, and baggage storage in the start/finish area. German Red Cross medical service in the start/finish area and along the course. Participant limit: 550 runners, including a maximum of 300 half-marathon runners. Hilly course with trails, 560 metres of elevation gain, scenic views, aid stations every 5 km.

name: 4. Heartbeat Ultra
description: Heartbeat Ultra is a participatory charity ultrarun in Fulda, taking place on November 21, 2026. Participants run laps of approximately 6 km, covering up to 112 km, and decide for themselves when to start, take breaks and finish their run. Each lap raises donations for children with half a heart, supporting research and quality of life. The event is open to everyone, from beginners to ultrarunners, and wheelchair users are warmly welcome.
course_highlights: A loop of approximately 6 km in Sportpark Johannisau, Fulda
Charity laps covering up to 112 km
Flexible start and running time between 06:00 and 21:00
additional: This is a charity run where every lap counts and the entry fee is donated in full. Participants receive a personal fundraising page where supporters can donate for each lap completed. There is a 400-metre children's run in the stadium, with each lap counted. The event is also available virtually, so people can take part from anywhere in the world. Flexible running time, virtual participation, donations for children with heart defects, registration with a personal fundraising page, medal for the first 1,500 participants.

name: 50. See-Park-Lauf
description: The 50th Bad Gandersheim See-Park Run is a traditional road race held in late November in Bad Gandersheim’s Seepark. Organized by SVG GW Bad Gandersheim, it offers categories for various age and performance groups, including boys, girls, men, women, juniors, open runners, and masters up to 95+. The event is closely connected with Bad Gandersheim Oberschule, whose students and teachers take part and support the organizing team. After the race, results, personalized certificates, and a photo gallery are published online.
course_highlights: Road race around the grounds of Bad Gandersheim’s Seepark
Separate categories for a range of age and performance groups
Strong connection with Bad Gandersheim Oberschule, with active participation
additional: There are two distances: 400 m and 10 km. Typical November weather is expected, with daytime highs of about 7 °C and rainy days. The organizing team comprises about 50 people, supported by around 80 students and teachers. Results, certificates, and a photo gallery are published online after the race. Road race in the Seepark, distances of 400 m and 10 km, organized by the school, with rainy November weather expected.

name: Ainringer Crosslauf
description: The Ainring Cross-Country Run is a long-standing event organized by Ski-Club Ainring e.V. in the municipality of Ainring. The start and finish are on Schwimmbadstraße. The event gives runners the opportunity to test their endurance and running technique on varied cross-country courses. It is part of the club’s diverse sports program and welcomes runners of all ages and ability levels.
course_highlights: Start and finish on Schwimmbadstraße in Ainring
Varied cross-country courses in the municipality
Long-standing running event organized by Ski-Club Ainring
additional: The race takes place in the Ainringer Moos and around the Eschlberg area; the start and finish are on Schwimmbadstraße; children’s and school races are included.

name: Braunsteichlauf Weißwasser
description: The Braunsteichlauf Weißwasser is a traditional race held at the end of the running season, taking participants through the Braunsteich nature reserve. A particular highlight is crossing the Braunsteich on the wooden Braunsteich Bridge, which offers a picturesque view across the water. The event is for all ages, from children to seniors, who enjoy running and walking. The race is part of the Dresden District Rankings and the Niederlausitz Cup, and is officially recognized by the German Athletics Association in the walking category.
course_highlights: Crossing the Braunsteich on the wooden Braunsteich Bridge, with views across the water
The route mainly follows public forest paths, with three short sections on quiet residential cul-de-sacs
Autumnal November atmosphere in the Braunsteich nature reserve
additional: The 5 km and 10 km routes have three short sections on public roads, which have little traffic as they are residential cul-de-sacs. The rest of the route follows moderate forest paths, some of which are cross-country style. The race is open to all age groups, and walking is also officially recognized. Participant limit of 300–500; medals for finishers; registration on site or online; free showers and changing rooms available; integrated into regional athletics.

name: Crossmeisterschaft SC Magdeburg
description: The SC Magdeburg Cross Country Championships is a traditional cross-country running competition organized by SC Magdeburg and the City of Magdeburg in Saxony-Anhalt. As a championship cross-country race in the German athletics calendar, it offers a challenging off-road course that differs from classic track races. The event is part of the DLV system, with official entries, rules, and timing, and is supported by the volunteer club and federation culture. The races take place in November, typically in cool and rainy weather, offering an authentic cross-country experience for club and federation runners.
course_highlights: Cross-country course, not on a track
Distances: 700 m and 1.4 km
Event held as part of the German athletics calendar
additional: The event is officially listed in the DLV system, with entries, rules, and timing. Typical November weather is cool (7 °C, low of 2 °C) and rainy, with an average of 45 mm of precipitation. The start location is in Magdeburg; detailed directions are available. Cross-country course, distances of 700 m and 1.4 km, held in November in rainy weather

name: Rhädenlauf
description: The Rhädenlauf takes place on November 21, 2026, in the Rhäden Nature Reserve in Wildeck-Obersuhl. The race is organized by TV 1888 Obersuhl and is part of the 2026 competition year. The event is for runners who want to experience a nature-rich route through a protected landscape. Timing has been provided by a modern ALGE system since 2022, ensuring precise results.
course_highlights: Run through the Rhäden Nature Reserve
Nature-rich and scenic route
Modern ALGE timing system in use since 2022
additional: Timing is provided by an ALGE system, including a start trigger with an integrated flash (E-Start). The department head is Luisa Wunn, who can be reached at 0177 4691132. Club training takes place on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays from 17:30 to 19:00 at the stadium or the Obersuhl indoor sports hall. Route through the nature reserve, training plans for participants

name: Artenschutzlauf
description: The Species Conservation Run in Karlsruhe covers a 7.6-kilometer route through the heart of the Zoological City Garden. The event combines sporting commitment with the important goal of supporting the fight against species extinction. Now in its third year, the run offers a special opportunity to take part in a sporting challenge at one of the city's most beautiful locations while also contributing to species conservation. Anyone who wants to combine nature and exercise is welcome to participate.
course_highlights: The route runs through the heart of Karlsruhe's Zoological City Garden
Course length: 7.6 kilometers
Combines sporting activity with species conservation
additional: The run takes place on November 22, 2026, at 12:00. Proceeds will go to the Zoo Karlsruhe Species Conservation Foundation. The run is fully booked, and late entries are not possible.

name: Memmelsdorfer Schlosslauf
description: The Memmelsdorf Castle Run is a longstanding running event held annually in Memmelsdorf since 1985. The event offers various race distances around Seehof Palace, with community and the beautiful setting at its heart. Participants of all ages are warmly invited to explore the varied routes in and around the palace and enjoy sport together.
course_highlights: Runs around Seehof Palace
Various distances for all age groups
Scenic routes through the palace park and surrounding forests
additional: Multiple race distances, including Bambini, junior races and a fun run; registration and detailed information on the website; the event takes place in late November.

name: Berliner Mannschaftslauf - einzeln oder als Team
location: Stadion An der Windmühle, Buckower Damm 150, 12349 Berlin, Germany
description: The Berlin Team Run on November 21, 2026, is a traditional race around Britzer Garten, with distances of half marathon, quarter marathon, and 3.7 km. Its special format, with teams starting at 20-second intervals, adds excitement and team spirit. The event is open to teenagers and adults, with various categories, including the Youth Cup and Runners’ Cup. The varied route passes through green spaces and offers a nature experience in the middle of the city. Photos of runners are provided free of charge.
course_highlights: A varied route through green spaces and past Britzer Garten
Team starts at 20-second intervals for extra excitement
Categories for teenagers and adults, including the Youth Cup and Runners’ Cup
additional: The start and finish are at Stadion „An der Windmühle“, Buckower Damm 150, 12349 Berlin. Team names can be added on the day of the event. Participants can enter individually or as part of a team. Photos of runners are provided free of charge if they are captured on camera. Start and finish: Stadion „An der Windmühle“, Buckower Damm 150, 12349 Berlin. Categories are planned for youth, open, masters, and the public race.

name: Crosslauf Denzlingen
description: The Denzlingen Cross-Country Run takes place on November 21, 2026, at Mauracher Hof in Denzlingen. The event is organized by the athletics department of TV Denzlingen and offers runners of all age groups an appealing opportunity to compete. The course has been slightly adjusted due to course conditions; current course maps are available in the race information. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and the beautiful surroundings of Denzlingen School Center.
course_highlights: Slightly adjusted course due to course conditions
Start and finish at the athletics stadium of Denzlingen School Center
Run through the natural surroundings around Mauracher Hof
additional: Registration is through RaceResult. The event is supervised by experienced coaches. Training opportunities are available at the athletics stadium and, in suitable weather, in the school sports hall. Spikes with long pins are recommended on wet ground. Register at https://my.raceresult.com/424510/info.

name: FLVW Crossmeisterschaften
location: Stadion am Merschweg, Schloß Neuhaus, Paderborn, Germany
description: The FLVW Cross Championships are a long-standing cross-country running competition held at Stadion am Merschweg in Paderborn-Schloß Neuhaus. The event offers various distances from 1.0 km to 10.0 km and is open to runners of different ability levels. The varied course runs through woodland and cross-country terrain, promising exciting races in a natural setting. The event is open to everyone and promotes running in Westphalia.
course_highlights: A range of distances from 1.0 km to 10.0 km
Woodland and cross-country terrain
Venue: Stadion am Merschweg in Paderborn-Schloß Neuhaus
additional: The event includes several races over different distances, including short, middle and long distances. Registration is open until 11.11.2026. The start and finish are at Stadion am Merschweg.

name: Harsefelder Klosterparklauf
location: Parkplatz hinter dem Rathaus, Harsefeld, Germany
description: The 9th 6-Hour Run in Klosterpark Harsefeld takes place on November 21, 2026, and gives runners the opportunity to complete as many laps as possible within six hours on an officially measured 1,461.4-meter course. The course runs mainly along paved sand paths through the idyllic Klosterpark. The event is open to everyone aged 18 and over and is organized by Lauftreff Harsefeld 05. Refreshments are available at a well-stocked station on every lap, and timing is recorded using a rental chip from RaceResult.
course_highlights: Officially measured 1,461.4-meter lap
Mainly paved sand paths through Klosterpark
Lap counting with a rental chip and a refreshment station in the start area
additional: Race packets can be collected on event day from 8:30 to 9:30 a.m. directly at the start/finish. Toilets and changing facilities are available; there are no showers. The event takes place in all weather and is sanctioned by the German Athletics Association. Participation is open to those aged 18 and over; limited to 150 participants. The start and finish are in the parking lot behind the town hall. Refreshments are provided during the run; toilets and changing facilities are available, but there are no showers.

name: Nordrhein Meisterschaften 2026 10km Straße
description: The 2026 Nordrhein Championships in the 10 km road race will take place on November 21, 2026, at Lake Baldeney in Essen. This championship is a major event in the Nordrhein Athletics Association and gives athletes the opportunity to compete on a scenic course. The race features an attractive route along Lake Baldeney that is both athletically challenging and beautiful. The event is aimed at competitive runners and promotes regional sporting spirit.
course_highlights: Scenic route along Lake Baldeney
Paved roads with a flat to gently rolling profile
Start and finish on Freiherr-von-Stein-Straße in Essen
additional: The event is organized by Leichtathletik-Verband Nordrhein e.V. No start times or pricing tiers for the 10 km road race championship are explicitly listed on the website. Registration is online through the LV Nordrhein portal. Further information about accompanying events or special participant requirements is available on the association’s linked pages. The competition venue is at Lake Baldeney.

name: Offene LM Crosslauf
location: Leichtathletikstadion an der Friedrich-Ebert-Straße, Magdeburg, Germany
description: The Open State Cross-Country Championships will take place on November 21, 2026, at the athletics stadium on Friedrich-Ebert-Straße in Magdeburg. The event is for runners of various age groups and ability levels and features a challenging cross-country course. The championships are an established event on the Athletics Association of Saxony-Anhalt calendar and promote regional running.
course_highlights: Cross-country course at the Magdeburg athletics stadium
A range of age groups and distances
Traditional state championships with regional significance
additional: Online registration is available.

name: Waldsträßer Crosslauf
description: The 34th Waldsträßer Crosslauf takes place on November 21, 2026, in Schlosspark Wiesbaden-Biebrich. The event starts at 11:30 a.m. and gives runners of different age groups and ability levels the opportunity to compete on varied cross-country terrain. Registration is preferably via the LA.Net3 registration portal; clubs and schools without access can register by email. The event is an established cross-country tradition in the region and is organized by TV Waldstraße Wiesbaden.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in Schlosspark Wiesbaden-Biebrich
Varied terrain with natural obstacles
Traditional event with regional significance
additional: Entries should preferably be submitted via the LA.Net3 registration portal. Clubs and schools without access should register by email, preferably in spreadsheet form, with surname, first name, gender, year of birth, club and race number. The event provides a participant list, schedule and results in the LA portal. Entries should preferably be submitted via LA.Net3. Clubs and schools without access can email la-meldungen@tv-waldstrasse.de.

name: Eifellauf Wolsfeld
description: The Eifellauf Wolsfeld is a relaxed run in the Eifel, aimed above all at discovering beautiful running routes and bringing runners from different clubs together. The runs usually take place on Saturdays, at an easy pace of between 5:30 and 7:30 minutes per kilometer. Different groups are formed according to ability, with the shared running experience taking priority over competition. After the run, there is often an opportunity to shower and socialize over coffee, cake, or a beer.
course_highlights: Running routes in the Eifel, 15–22 km long
Easy pace of between 5:30 and 7:30 min/km
Three running groups based on ability; no race pace
additional: Runners meet on Saturdays at 14:30 at meeting points, usually for a welcome and route briefing. There are also so-called taster runs for beginners over a shorter distance (up to about 11–12 km). After the run, people often shower together and relax over a chat. The competitions are scheduled for 10:30.

name: 41. Lippesee Marathon
location: Parkplatz beim Gut Lippesee, Paderborn-Sande, Germany
description: The 41st Lippesee Marathon takes place in Paderborn-Sande and is held in accordance with the rules of the 100 Marathon Club Germany. The course consists of seven large laps of 6.1 km each, for a total of 42.7 km, and is very busy in good weather. Timing is done with a manual stopwatch; a photo of the watch must be submitted by email on race day as proof. There is no entry fee, but a €5 donation to environmental or social projects is requested. The event is limited to 15 participants, and the minimum age is 18.
course_highlights: Seven laps of 6.1 km each, for a total of 42.7 km
Course measured with a measuring wheel and GPS watch
Self-service is possible, with supplies available at your car after each lap
additional: Timing is done with a manual stopwatch, which is started at the start and stopped only at the finish. Participants who stop the watch during breaks will be disqualified. Showers and changing rooms are not available on site. The course will be provided 2–3 days before the race with a GPX track, map, and Komoot access. The event will take place only if there are at least five participants. Participant limit: 15; minimum age: 18. Register by email by 6 p.m. on the day before the race. Self-service, hand-timed results, and a certificate by email.

name: Kreismeisterschaften Crosslauf
location: Ofen, Bad Zwischenahn, Lower Saxony, Germany

name: 2. Paradieslauf Weimar West
description:
We invite you to the west of Weimar!

A fast, scenic course and a wonderful sense of community await you!

All proceeds go to a good cause!

Bambini races
Children’s races
Beginner’s race (3.5 km)
Relay race (3 x 3.5 km)
Main race (10 km)

images.alt_text: Illustration mit Läufern und Infos zum 2. Paradieslauf Weimar West am 29.08.26

name: Stadtparkstaffelmarathon
description:
All information about the 2024 Stadtpark Relay Marathon organized by the marathon department of FC St. Pauli von 1910 e.V.

Date: Sunday, 04 October 2026, 10:00 a.m. (finish cutoff: 3:00 p.m.)

Start / finish: “Jahnkampfbahn” (stadium), Stadtpark, Linnering 3, 22299 Hamburg

Course and format: Relay race, 5 participants per team—women’s, men’s, mixed (at least 2 women). Each team member runs two laps of 4.2 km each on paths in the western part of Stadtpark (around the planetarium). Course marshals will be present. A detailed course map can be viewed at the end of the page.

Registration: by email to staffelmarathon@marathon.fcstpauli.com

Registration deadline: 20.09.2026

Required information: First and last names of all relay team members, the relay team’s name, and whether the team is a women’s, men’s, or mixed team.

name: II Mazowiecki Bieg Jesieni
description: The 2nd Mazovian Autumn Run is an annual race held in Staroźreby, taking place on November 21, 2026. Participants can compete in the 10 km race, and a 400-meter race is prepared for the youngest runners. The event is open to everyone, offering attractive prizes, medals, and the opportunity to take part in both the main race and children’s races. The race takes place in urban and park areas, providing a welcoming atmosphere for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: 10 km route on asphalt and through park areas
400-meter race for children
Medals and prizes for participants
additional: Online and on-site registration; the event also includes a program for children and adults, with the schedule and details available on the organizer’s website.

name: X Koszęcińska Dycha
description: The anniversary 10th Koszęcińska Dycha is a special race held in Koszęcin that attracts runners from various places. Its anniversary edition highlights the event’s special significance and atmosphere. The race follows a 10 km course, giving participants the chance to test their fitness in scenic surroundings. description: What sets the Nieuchwytni Run apart from other events is its regionally unique “moving finish line” format. Participants do not run toward a designated point; instead, they try to stay ahead of the pursuit team for as long as possible. The runners will start at 10:00, and exactly 15 minutes later the “finish line” will set off along the course—a cyclist and a car equipped with professional timing equipment. The moment these vehicles overtake a runner marks the end of their race, and their result is recorded. The pursuit team will gradually increase its speed, from an initial 15 km/h to 35 km/h in the final stage of the race.

name: I BIEG JABŁONI
description:
1st Apple Blossom Run - Jabłonna Lacka | 5 km

We invite you to the 1st Apple Blossom Run, taking place on October 10, 2026, in Jabłonna Lacka. This is the first edition of an event that aims to bring together sporting competition, activities for the whole family, and local culture and tradition.

The main event will be a 5 km run, starting at 12:45. The course runs through the streets of Jabłonna Lacka and features varied surfaces, consisting mainly of paved roads and a section of unpaved road. The time limit is 45 minutes.

The Main Run is open to anyone who will be at least 16 years old on race day. The entry fee is PLN 40. The participant package includes a race bib with a chip for electronic timekeeping, a commemorative finisher’s medal, water, and a hot recovery meal.

The 5 km race will feature overall classifications for women and men, as well as age-group categories. There will also be a special classification for the fastest female and male residents of the Municipality of Jabłonna Lacka.

But the 1st Apple Blossom Run is about more than just 5 km. Free races for children and young people aged 4–15 will also take place from 10:15, over distances of approximately 150 m, 400 m, 600 m, and 1,100 m. Every child who completes their race will receive a finisher’s medal, and categories D2–D4 will feature electronic timekeeping and separate girls’ and boys’ classifications.

At the Race Village, sport will meet culture, with a Literary and Educational Zone accompanying the event.

name: II Bieg Transgranicznej Przyjaźni
description:
A 5-kilometre main race, a Nordic walking event over the same distance, and shorter races for children in the Young Athlete Zone. The event opens the Polish-Czech Grand Prix series, which concludes a month later in Ludgeřovice.

Course: moderately easy, with a new route this year

We have changed the route compared with the first edition. Four kilometres now run along Teligi and Czarnieckiego streets—on asphalt, with plenty of space and no tight turns. It’s a stretch where you can keep a steady pace from start to finish.

Only the final kilometre goes through post-mining areas. The surface gets uneven, but it’s just five minutes of running—and also the most interesting part of the course. You run through a part of Silesia that is coming back to life.

The total elevation gain is 18 metres, spread across the whole distance. There are no climbs that disrupt your rhythm. It’s a good course for your first-ever five kilometres, and a fair one for anyone looking to test their time—as long as you save some strength for the finish.
additional:
The event is part of the “Pink October” campaign and promotes breast cancer prevention. It is organised by the “Srebrne Nici” Association, with the Czech club BK Ludgeřovice as its partner.

name: XXV Bieg Sobiborski "Ocalić od zapomnienia - uczyć dla przyszłości"
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji we Włodawie
description: The start is at 12:00 by the Sobibór Museum and Memorial to the Victims, on county road No. 1727L along the Żłobek–Sobibór–Wołczyny section. After approximately 300 m, runners cross the tracks of railway line No. 81 Chełm–Włodawa and run to provincial road 816. They then follow provincial road 816 towards Włodawa. After approximately 8.5 km, runners cross the tracks of railway line No. 81 Chełm–Włodawa again and run through the village of Orchówek to Włodawa, continuing along Okunińska Street, Rynek Street and J. Piłsudski Avenue, with the finish at 4 Szkolna Street.
additional:
“There are places in our country marked especially by the blood of thousands of victims murdered in the cruellest way and in the name of the most despicable of ideologies—the ideology of hatred. One such place is Sobibór, where, in just over a dozen months (1942–1943), the Nazis managed to murder approximately a quarter of a million people, especially people of Jewish nationality.”

The race is an unusual history lesson for society. It contributes to achieving sporting goals and also helps instil in the younger generation a remembrance of the tragic history of the extermination camp in Sobibór.

name: Bieg Wolności Podatkowej
description:
When the tax authorities let up, the race begins! IFIRMA invites you to a special event celebrating Tax Freedom Day and the company’s 25th anniversary. It’s a race for entrepreneurs, IFIRMA customers, and everyone who values being active, independence, and good energy.

On June 13, participants can take on the 5 km or 10 km distance, either in person in Wrocław or virtually from anywhere in Poland. The main event will take place at the Olympic Stadium, and the route follows a scenic loop along the Oder. Flat and scenic—ideal running conditions in the City of a Hundred Bridges.

Every step has extra meaning here. Race participants support the “Na Ratunek Dzieciom z Chorobą Nowotworową” Foundation, showing that the energy of sport can make a real difference to others. It’s a great opportunity to combine physical activity with supporting an important cause.

Participants will also receive a generous race pack prepared by IFIRMA: the official race T-shirt, a finisher’s medal, a race bib, a reusable cup, a sports bag, and a certificate for a tree of their own in the IFIRMA forest in Oleśnica.

Join the 2026 Tax Freedom Run and celebrate freedom actively!
additional: The start and finish will be located by the Pergola at the Olympic Stadium, al. Jana Ignacego Paderewskiego 35, Wrocław.

name: XI ZaDyszka Gminy Bełchhatów
organizer: Centrum Sportu i Promocji Gminy Bełchatów
description:
We encourage all running enthusiasts to mark September 20 in their calendars. The eleventh edition of ZaDyszka Gminy Bełchatów will take place then. After a one-year break, the street charity race returns to Kurnos (last year, ZaDyszka was held in Postękalice). The race will follow the familiar loop through Kurnos Drugi and Kurnos Pierwszy, starting and finishing at the Alfons Brandt Primary School.

As usual, runners can choose between two distances: 10 km in the main race and 3.4 km, one lap of the course, in the recreational race. The youngest participants can take part in the Krasnal Race, while primary school pupils can run distances from 400 to 1,000 m.

As always, a race village will be set up on the school grounds, with a children’s play area and a place to enjoy a restorative meal.
additional:

Main race – 10 km (3 × 3.4 km = 10.2 km)
Recreational race – 3.4 km (one lap)
Krasnal Race for the youngest preschoolers
Children’s and youth races (grades I–VIII) over 400 m, 800 m and 1,000 m
